It may not be fair to compare it against what used to be served in the same location, but honestly, the food's just not on par with that provided by the previous tenants.  Perhaps they'll get better as they find their stride.  Or perhaps it's a regional thing (Punjabi vs. Kashmiri, etc.).  I'll have to try it again in a month or two and see if things have kicked into a higher gear.

The best thing I can say about the new owners is they've (wisely) expanded their lunch buffet to run every day, instead of just weekdays.  They've also expanded the number of dishes available, compared to our old friends, which if for nothing else makes this a pretty good value for the money.  There is, however, one change that has GOT to go: the obnoxious TV in the front corner of the restaurant.  

At least one other Yelper mentioned the TV playing Indian music videos during their visit, which I suppose could be a fun addition to the experience.  During our visit, though, the TV was blaring a Spanish-language confrontational talk show (of the Jerry Springer variety), so we got to listen to people shouting at each other in a language that does not originate on the subcontinent.  Half-way through our meal the viewing content changed to a "telenovela" ... not much of an improvement.  I'm guessing the television fare was likely the selection of the staff (gone are the Hindu and Sikh cooks and servers, replaced by folks who speak Spanish and whom one might presume did not learn to make curries and tandoori in their grandmother's kitchen).  

Perhaps other folks like to have a blaring TV playing while they eat.  I DO NOT.  In fact, I often avoid restaurants that feature this distraction, thus, I found this to be a HUGE strike against whether we'll be back for another try.  That, and the very casual "service" (water refill, anyone?) dropped a couple stars off this review.

I guess it's time for us to make the rounds and try some other options for Indian food in Reno.

I love love love cupcakes! I'm super pumped that they brought Sprinkles to Nashville finally. 

Overall the space is very cute, but the service is surprisingly slow for just cupcakes/cookies/sweets and they had like 5 workers out, it was weird.

The cupcakes are super rich, and just the right amount of icing without making you feel sick! I love it! They are kinda pricey, I think I paid roughly like $3.75

*****WARNING**** if you get their cupcakes from the 24 vending machine it is $4.75 because it comes in a cardboard box.

Overall it was great and I'll probably be back, I just wish the service was better.

Best collection of cowboy boots in NYC and beyond. Everything here is well curated = impeccable design and quality. Such a gorgeous collection.  I'd like one pair of each for myself and my cowboy pretty please. Great people too! Paul and Jaylin are super cool, happy to create the boot of your dreams

Everything I've ordered here is amazing. Beets are well represented, which I appreciate. Music is WAY to loud, but the music choices are FANTASTIC so I'm not mad about it. Cocktails are subtle, not too sugary and complement the alcohol rather than hide it.

This was another find due to LivingSocial. I'm positive that I would not have known about this place otherwise. "Local" and "friendly" were two words that immediately came to mind when I walked in. I ordered a two sandwiches and a side of red potato salad... and no I didn't eat all of it one sitting.

The Hot Chicken and Cheese sandwich was loaded with chicken strips, mushrooms, onions, melted provolone cheese. In my opinion, the bread is what elevates the sandwich from good to great. The bread was wonderfully soft, lightly toasted and held everything perfectly. Nothing particularly unique about this sandwich, but there's nothing wrong with simple in this case.

"Ronnie's Pastrami Special" was definitely special. It was unlike any pastrami sandwich I've ever had. This triple decker sandwich was layered  with thinly sliced hot pastrami, hot corned beef, Swiss cheese, lettuce and tomato on rye. It was awesome. Everything worked together harmoniously.

Overall, the sandwiches are great and the service was really friendly. I would definitely return for the pastrami sandwich, but the red potato salad didn't really strike a chord with me and could have done without it.
This place has bad customer service. The front desk check in staff is very rude. All they want is your money, they could careless about your child's teeth.

Poor service, overpriced,  uncomfortable waiting area. Cart of dirty dishes and wasted food passed by our table multiple times from the bussing service. Food was overly greasy and did not look appetizing but tasted good.  Server asked for order and then started talking to other staff instead of listening to response.
Love this little gem. When visiting Tennessee came to eat here breakfast twice. Awesome waitress and delicious breakfast

Amidst the chaos and closures inside of  Circus Circus, Silver Legacy and El Dorado properties we found this gem.  There is a fifty million dollar renovation going on at these properties so lots of venues have been closed.

Fortunately we found The Buffet open and for a measly $12.99 we enjoyed a very tasty buffet.  Now there was nothing special as far as buffets go but the food was well prepared and had good flavor which is more than can be said of most buffets.

Our favorite was the brisket which we found smokey, tender and juicy.  If you are looking for someplace to eat at these properties and don't want to spend a fortune The Buffet is a good option.

I have been here now several times and can't believe I haven't reviewed this place so far. It is hard to say for sure if my review is influenced by the fact that there are very few quality restaurants in Chestnut Hill, but Stella Sera ranks in the top two. I can say that I have truly enjoyed every single course I have ever been served here.

 The service is always courteous, friendly and efficient. Recently we ate there on a Saturday night and, sure, service was a bit slower than on a weeknight. It was still as accommodating as one could expect given the crowd. 

 The food is truly delicious and this is coming from an Italian-American woman who has worked in the business and her 84-year-old Italian dad who has no time for poor food. Their portions are more than adequate, the bread is good, the seasonings are just right. I don't know what more I could ask for.

Shout out to this hidden gem in Tampa. They have an interesting take on Taiwanese cuisine here. 

I came here with some local Tampa peeps and also brought a friend who has a family that owns a Taiwanese restaurant and grew up working in it as well. We were big fans of the General Tso's Chicken Pizza as well as all the other dishes we ordered. We tried the Braised Pork rice and Pepper-Seasoned fried chicken. Everything was so yummy!! I haven't eaten that much pizza in a long time. I also recommend the braised pork rice, it was delicious and is a perfect meal for one person or to share. 

The restaurant looks like a traditional pizza joint and isn't full of decorations but it doesn't matter because the food makes up for it. All in all, I recommend trying out this place with your friends and supporting this locally owned business. The food, aside from their experimental dishes, are authentic, and the service is good.

The worst thing about this strip mall restaurant is its name. Seriously, Kung Fu makes it sound like the menu is designed to please the lowest common denominator palate and Noodle implies that the menu is devoted to, well just that, noodles. Both are untrue. The menu is extensive and the food is anything but commonplace. We had a variety of dishes and they were all quite good. During these COVID times, this small restaurant is busy with takeout orders. The Grub-Hub order device was dinging away. And, the staff was working to keep up. One thing I liked was they were really good on their timing. They told me my food would be ready at a given time and it was being put up in the restaurant at just that time. Moreover, it was packaged well. Often restaurants have failed to improve their takeout service and packaging, but KFN does a great job. One strange thing for me was the absence of condiments; I'm a mustard freak. Their answer, "We have good spice and sauce on everything." Having tried the food, I would agree, but I still would have liked some nice mustard.

Had a table of 8 last night.  Took 35 minutes to get the first round of drinks.  Pretty sure the waiter forgot to put them in.  He brought out our water and left them on a cart next to the table and we had to get them ourselves.  The second round of drinks only took 20 minutes.  The appetizers came out with the meal not before.  The food in general: long John silvers has better food than this place.  Very disappointed and will not go back ever.  In the end it took 2 hours and 15 minutes to have dinner.

My third visit here and my last. 

I called and made an appointment. When I arrived on time, was told to wait a moment while they serviced walk-ins. I ignored my gut instinct to leave and continued with the tech who was rude even though I made numerous attempts to counter her rudeness with kindness. I ended up having to move chairs twice (with my shoes and bag) nearly messing up my newly painted pedi. 

My tech didn't speak to me except to acknowledge the tip that I left (because of my bad habit of tipping bad service to keep from being perceived as someone who doesn't tip). My tech mainly communicate by tapping my hands or feet when she wanted me to move. I left with a uneven, too short gel manicure that is already chipping (a day later). I haven't had a good experience with this place yet. Never again.

Wow I thought this only happened to me. The food is mediocre. But I too waited a long wait maybe 8-10 min for my food which I didn't mind, it was a lot and I just wanted them to get it right honestly after the girl couldn't confirm my order correctly on the mic a ton of times. So she said everything correctly finally. Went to the window waited ... she gave me my food  said it correctly. Opened the bag and everything was wrong and a burger was missing My husband loves this place but for me it's torture. 3stars for at least keeping my husband happy.

The bad first. 
Rock hard beds. 
Sparse towels in a double occupancy room. We had to conserve the toilet paper.
We stayed on 4-20-19 so the people next to us totally got high on weed the entire weekend we were there.
No free breakfast except free coffee. 
The price was a lil high considering the whole row of hotels were not that crowded. 

The good is that it was a VERY CLEAN hotel. 
Lots of parking in the back. 

I gave it three stars for the cleanliness. 
However I wouldn't stay here again.

My brother and I spent a weekend in Philly right before Christmas and stayed here.  I have to say, it was the perfect hotel experience.

1. Excellent location
2. Incredibly friendly and helpful staff
3. Huge rooms with full kitchen, dishwasher, full-size fridge, cooking surface, a cute little breakfast nook and a balcony with great views
4. Free Wi-fi
5. Decent fitness center
6. Good restaurant on site
7. Walking distance to many attractions

Sure, it's not the fanciest hotel in the world, but I've found that with fancier hotels, they nickel and dime you on everything ($20/day wi-fi, etc.) .  This place is an excellent price, has more than we needed, and I would stay there again and recommend it to anyone.

We had a really nice and comfortable stay here. The hotel is located only two blocks from Bourbon St. so it's easily walkable to all the attractions.  The staff were all friendly and very helpful with recommendations. The room was clean and spacious, also the toiletries were high quality and smelled amazing. There is plenty of parking near the hotel. We parked in a covered garage just across the street. It was $30 per 24 hrs but it was safe and convenient.  Would definitely stay here again!
Wonderful manager doing everything in her power to correct a situation only to be screwed by the kitchen AGAIN.  Please get your kitchen staff some hair nets.

I have tried to give Caviar and Bananas the benefit of the doubt because it's so convenient and the inside is really cute. But the food is so subpar and highly overpriced for what you get. The service really isn't bad in terms of the employees they are usually friendly but god is the food terrible. Picture of my "sweet potato and kale hash".
Amazing food! We have been 3 times and live in Sylvan Park. We have been needing a healthy, yet filling spot like this for quite some time!

Yes! Yes! Yes!   This is THE place for ice cream while on the beach side in Florida.  The two people working tonight are Fantastic and Fabulous.  Try their rotator flavors.  You can always come back for the others at anytime. Me, overall I prefer the kiddie cup yet today was determined to order the Killer Sunday.   A piece of fudge topped by enormous scoops of ice cream and unlimited toppings.  I was unable to finish it and it was so very yummy.  Perfect for someone with a really big appetite or to share.  Awesome place!  Awesome people work here!

Completely rude and unprofessional. Also, she seriously told me to return my Groupon because she won't know if she can help me until after the consultation. Yes, really. Avoid like the plague. Seriously.

I went from scanning for something different to finding a spot that I could frequent weekly!!! The ambiance is so laid back, the staff is super friendly, and they probably have the best wings in Nashville!!!

I was referred by Home Depot employee Tony. I called John and made schedule to  come to  my house he was 15 min earlier than my schedule time.
He is very honest and he did excellent job. I'm very satisfied with his work. I'm very happy that I found him.
The wait in line is worth it for this place.  The food was good and the pancakes that are listed on the menu were unique and all sounded good to eat.

My bf and I stayed here for one night for our friends wedding. I ordered shuttle bus tickets from the airport to the hotel over the phone. They were 40 bucks round trip each. Dear, lord we should have just got a cab. Our shuttle bus driver was this woman who actually told us her story about living in a trailor park. She was entertaining but her recommendations for food were not so good.  

We arrived at the hotel. My bf was wearing his suit because he didnt want to pack it away and get it wrinkley. His button fell off so I asked when we checked in for a sewing kit. They had one thankfully! Check in was quite easy, there is a mandatory 15 buck charge though for internet and bottle water.... Oh well, it was a splurge trip. 

Our room was in the Magnolia wing, we got a nice view of one of the huge Christmas trees, the wedding was on December 22. The room was very luxourious.

We walked around with our friends who had been there before and they gave us the story of the whole place. It was quite lovely. The gardens were breathe taking!

The wedding was held in the Delta gardens and it was gorgoeus. I didnt like the fact that people could just walk by and watch but I dont think the couple cared much. They had their hearts set on this venue! We had the reception in the Magnlia ballroom and it was perfect. Cake and food was great! Overall, it was just fantastic. If we were to go back we would stay there for sure!

First I used Fixit, then my husband, then my daughter, primarily for IPhone issues and repairs. The staff is friendly, honest, gives quality workmanship with great customer service, and are so patient with the technologically challenged.

Three of us had lunch here today and it was very good. We had pita & tsatseki, Greek salad, grouper sandwich, smelts, & coffee. All very good, except the tsatseki was short on garlic, onion & cucumber flavors. Great service and desserts in the bakery next door to make you cry!

We've been eating at Pappas for at least the last 6 years. Lately I feel the restaurant is going down hill: not as clean & not managed as well. Today several of the "clean" tables were very sticky. They've made some changes to the menu, one of which will cause us not to return. Our favorite thing on the menu is the Tuscan Chicken Sandwich, the ciabatta bread really makes this sandwich delicious. Well they no longer have ciabatta bread, they are only using plain white bread. It may seem silly but the ciabatta bread was the main reason we'd come here.

My brother has been raving about this place to me for a couple weeks and we finally both able to go today! As an appetizer my brother ordered the pretzels with beer cheese sauce. Soooo good. I got the Bourbon Street sandwich with no caramelized green peppers. It was SO good. A little messy but how could I really be mad about that. My baby complaint was that the sides were either potato salad or potato chips, I'd have to REALLY check if those were it, that's just all they said when I ordered. But overall such a good experience. They actually have parking in the back so I love that you don't have to hassle around for a street spot. 5/5.

Got into town late with a few hungry kids. Stopped in to grab some pizza. Even though it was almost closing time, Becky happily took our order, got the food out quickly, and didn't rush us to get out. Great pizza and wings but even better customer service! One of our favorite spots in Carp.

This hotel is the worst hotel that I've ever stayed at.  The beds were terrible, they were supposed to be sleep numbers but no one could control them.  It was old and dirty and there were bed bugs in the room.  To add insult to injury the room cost $140.00 because of indy 500 weekend.  Even though I was refunded from the booking company Istill feel as though i lost.

Waited over two hours to get an oil change and we were not even in a bay. We asked how long it was going to be to get it done and were told with complete apathy that it was because we made our appointment online and that she couldn't give us an estimate. Basically, don't make an appointment online and don't be surprised if they move slowly and don't give a shit about your business.

Great sandwich spot!! I've been coming here since I was a kid in the 90's. And they still got the same Ms. Pacman game I used to play and be a record holder on( which has since then been beat). This is definitely a staple spot for sparks/Reno area.

I'm a fan of checkers when done correctly, the problem is most checkers locations are staffed poorly, and the consistency of food varies wildly depending on who's currently staffed, I've been to the Roosevelt checkers 3 times during the last month, and all of the experiences have been as night and day to one another.

Pro-tip, avoid late-nights here at all costs, things turn out pretty terrible, half the time stocks run out, and buns are half stale. Another issue with this branch is just how slow everything is, even during the good times to visit, don't expect your food quickly.

Best time to visit this checkers is around rush hour 4-5PM, the sooner the better- that late night shift swap is what kills it. Visit before last, couple weeks back me and a bud showed up late night, fries were over done, and less cold than you'd expect, the buns felt like someone left the packaging open and they'd been in the air for too long.

Fast forward to yesterday, immediately after work, food came out okay, buns weren't stale, fries were actually hot and not overcooked, order took forever as per usual, but it wasn't bad.  I cant really reccomend it, but i keep coming back hoping things will improve- when its good its pretty good, but too often it isn't.

Flavor & Presentation 2.5/5   |   Service & Speed 1/5   |   Price & Proportion  3/5

Overall 2/5

If I could give this place less than one star, I would.  Not only was I having problems, but a gentleman was also having problems.  The lady was totally rude and unhelpful Josette is her name.  I loved the location, but that is all.

Terrible food. Ice tea tasted like warm water. My grilled cheese was boring so added a slice of avocado and tomato. This threw the price into the category of a steak. My boyfriend had the Thanksgiving dinner. Worst he ever had. My daughter thought her salad was ok. Altogether we had one drink, one soup and sandwich, one large salad and one dinner.  Bill over 60 dollars. Not worth it!! Waitress was very unfriendly and unconcerned with serving a good meal. It was pretty much take it or leave it. So what?
Quick, fresh, delicious, healthy sushi bowls and burritos. My new favorite lunch spot. They have beer too!

So I tried this pizza establishment on a whim the first try and loved the atmosphere but quickly noticed it wasn't as clean as it should be.  If utensil and napkins(cloth) aren't clean it makes me question food prepping etiquette.  My Coworker states it was end of the night and it may have been an unintentional mishap.   So we ordered a pizza to share, burchetta, and the pair salad that was Soooooo Delicious!!!!  Food was great so I decided to give it a second try this time. 

I brought my family out as I knew my boys would love it!  We sat at the round booth by the door so we could all cozy in and talk to each other! I quickly noticed how filthy the booth was as well as the salt and pepper shakers.  We were also given a dirty cup that contained water. This bothered me since my previous experience I had dirty utensils and cloth napkin.   

While the food was once again fantastic, mentally it bothered me that the area where food was prepared may have the same issue.    It will be awhile before I go again but that's why I gave it 3 stars instead of 5.
I don't think I've liked a brunch more than here at tavern. The food was amaaaaazing. The 2 for 1 drink specials made it even better. Will be here weekly ;)
So I seen the building was so cute on the outside had to come back. Clean, friendly n fast during our visit. Sold t shirts too. I tired the alligator po boy, gumbo, and 5 pc wings. Delicious food.

I started taking my daughter to Korey just before she turned two. In addition to being a great instructor, he is also very kind, and was able to elicit smiles from my daughter, which is no easy feat! But most importantly, he taught her to swim in just 6 short weeks! The peace of mind that he gave me and my husband is immeasurable. I will forever be grateful to Korey for giving my daughter this life-saving skill. I recommend him to all of my friends!

Grooming is a fun and gentle experience for dogs here. They get to play with others when they're waiting for a groom or for owners to pick them up (if they're dog-friendly), instead of being stuck in a cage and treated like an assembly line object.  They get treats (they ask if you allow it first). The groomers talk to the dogs and encourage them. They are time-attentive--you don't have to wait half the day to get a call. Thank goodness for the amazing caring people here. One of my dogs had previously been traumatized by groomers (and was terrified to go), and the others I've had never liked to go. Now my dog loves it. I'm so glad someone referred us here. It costs more but is sooooooo worth it. My dog is One Lucky Dog for sure.

I get it, New orleans is a little slower and these women were really sweet- but they are so understaffed- we were there as a group and we all had to order at separate times, we didn't even get to eat together cuase we got our food separately.....my roast beef po boy was insanely good though- i am still thinking about that DELICIOUS gravy, yum yum yum!!  the women were super sweet, but they are understaffed and need more help up front.  We literally saw about 3 people storm out frustrated, but after the awful experience at River's Edge we had to eat- we were STARVING.....i would go back for sure- hoping and wishing they had more support staff.
Blues city diner makes an amazing sandwich. It is on my top 3 everyone in in Saint Louis

Staying in this hotel was like  being a guest in your best friends home. It is cozy, and warm, and absolutely lovely. It is a privately owned hotel and the owners Greg and Jennifer are wonderful. They take great care to ensure the experience of their guests is top notch. Their "continental breakfast" is actually homemade baked goods that are out of this world and there was also a warm and delicious egg and spinach dish that was fantastic!  The room felt like a little guest cottage and I can not wait to visit again!
Great place to stay in Tuscon! It is definitely one of the nicest KOA. The fruit trees are a plus!

The women's suiting area was well organized, staff people were very helpful and when the pants size for the suit I wanted were not available, they shipped my size right to my home for free. The store is peaceful and calming to shop, versus the disorganization and chaos of the Macy's in the Citrus Park mall.
Katie did an awesome job on my mini schnauzer! The salon is very cute, clean, and smelled really nice. Maxson is already scheduled for his next appointment! Thank you Katie !!
Really good food, negra modelo on draft. Came in for an early lunch. Cashier was friendly and helpful. Restaurant was clean. We've been looking for a new taco shop- this is probably our new spot!

I've popped in an out of this place for years!  It's a hit or miss kind of thing. One day you may be in bargain nirvana with all the things you may find - next you may go "where the hell did this crap come from?"

I love it when I find name brand things in good shape or even better when it still has original tags on and was never worn! WOOT!  I've purchased several dresses there that have gotten me tons of compliments and where did I get that from questions.  Their jaws dropped when I told them how much I spent for the things.  Parking can be dicey and even more so when they are running one of their big sales like the all you can shove in a brown grocery bag for one price sale.

They have it all: dresses, skirts, tops, designer,  jeans, purses, jewelry, menswear , plus size, formal, and shoes.  Go explore!

I used to get take-out from here once a week before I moved a few years ago! Now my husband and I are back in Drexel Hill and we frequent this restaurant quite a bit and I'm not complaining about that. Their buffet is always fresh and never disappoints! Friendly staff and I have to say again that their food is amazing. 

Side note: Great gluten free options and vegan options too! Also, they use cloth napkins which is great for cutting down waste (which I really appreciated)

You would think that Penllyn Pizza would HAVE to make a good cheesesteak sandwich seeing as Conshohocken, PA is so close to Philly. But you'd be wrong. Their cheesesteak sandwich is a great pick if dry and bland is your thing. The cheesecake I ordered needed thawing in order to consume. I can't say that I was a big fan of the 40 minute delivery eta given over the phone either. Overall: 1 star-- and that's being generous, sadly.

Great local business that always produces high quality meals using the freshest ingredients. My favorite is the ahi tuna bowl and gold digger wellness shots. Having dealt with GI issues for years, these shots really help to alleviate my stomach pain. Highly recommend!

Dr. Thompson is the best!! He is super friendly and compassionate. My crown fell off and I couldn't get into any other office at the time and Dr. Thompson got me in and fixed me up quickly. You could tell that he really cares about his patients! I would highly recommend his office! Thank you Dr. Thompson!
Great food. Very nice service. Amazing flavorful and generous portions.  A MUST try!!! Very authentic and delicious

I understand the service department is the leading profit source for dealerships, but this dealer shoots itself in the foot by forcing customers to waste time when their cars need work. If you come for a checkup and anything actually needs done, they won't do the work then- you have to make another appointment and come back another day- this has happened to me twice there. Also grossly overpriced. I had a dash light go out and they wanted $200- to change a light bulb! Looked on YouTube and did it myself in 20 minutes- bulb was $5. On the plus side, at least this last time I wasn't forced to endure Fox "News" in the waiting room.

This is the worst store I have ever been to or have dealt with. If I could give 0 stars I would. In June I moved from Saint Louis to California and instead of using a moving company I decided to ship 6-7 boxes to myself through this store. Upon arriving, I received no help with the boxes from my car and was clearly struggling as a female in a store with 3-4 male employees. Little did I know this would be the least of my worries. Once I started the process, I realized the owner was the one helping me. He rang up each box individually and it ended up taking 1.5-2 hours. While he did tell me I could pay more for more insurance coverage he did not alert me to the fact that he could re-package some fragile items or that the process of me receiving money for damaged goods would be this horrific. Fast forward to June 13 and I receive all of my packages. All of the boxes I received were packaged HORRIBLY. There were holes and no fragile writing on the ones that needed care. I noticed so many damaged items but decided they were not worth reporting except for the one box I received with my 14 mugs. All of which were COMPLETELY broken. I called to report a claim and it has been 2 months of me playing telephone and being shoved off. I have called almost every week to try to get insurance on my mugs and have been told to "call back" or that "it would be handled". I even overheard the owner tell his employee that I was lying and he was annoyed by me while he thought I was on hold. I am so infuriated with this process and have called corporate to report this store who has then called the store and STILL it has been over 2 months with no progress. I do not have time to spend 4-5 hours a week calling UPS for a simple solution. I am at the end of my rope and will NEVER use UPS to ship again, nor will I recommend it to any of my friends.
I wanted to like this place but the claypot pork gave my friend and me serious stomach issues. The dish was really tasty so was disappointed later when we got sick. Won't be back

Such a prime location! Right in Elliston Place. Man, EVERYTIME I drove down 21st, it just so happened that I would be in the vicinity of Krispy Kreme when the HOT sign was on. Sooo good and soooo worth every calorie! These literally melt in your mouth. I also liked their Very Berry Chiller.

My family and I were in the store shopping on Labor Day mid morning. A drawer had slid open causing an injury to my lower leg. The wood drawer had a metal face that was lifted off the upper left corner. As a result, my leg was immediately bruised and punctured from the metal face. This drawer was held together by duct tape indicating this was an existing issue that was poorly resolved. Upon notifying your employee, no action was taken. As my leg continued to bleed, we asked for a first aid kit and were informed there was no first aid kit. Despite this, we alerted your staff to prevent other customers from sustaining injuries while at check out. At this point, the manager was called. What was extremely disappointing was that we were not acknowledged or spoken to (i.e., didn't ask if I was OK or offered to help). The first aid kit brought to us by the employee was understocked (i.e., no band-aids, no antibacterial ointment, no gauze). At this point, we left without further assistance proceeding to a CVS to attend to my wound. I would like express my disappointment and frustration in the handling of this matter - with the staff but most especially with the floor manager. We have frequented this shop but this treatment reroutes our support. I would hope this information is met with action to correct and acknowledge the many errors present that day - chief among them the unsafe furniture displaying your clothing and poor customer service following an injury.

Since we eat here at least once a week, I figured I should probably write a review. I love Mexican food but usually don't eat it too often because it's typically saturated. The food here is lighter and always fresh.
The queso is so good! I can't get enough of it. The tortilla chips are perfect to go with it. Light and crispy. Not too salty. I've tried all different things on their menu and they were all delicious. I've tried the quesadillas, burritos, enchiladas, and tacos. They were all delicious and made with fresh, unique ingredients.
I've only ordered delivery so I can't speak to the atmosphere or drinks, but I'm sure they are amazing too!

Impressive place! Service is great, food is wonderful.
Great experience on our last trip to Reno. We are definitely coming back for more.
We went for Dinner and then for Breakfast. 
Stylish restaurant, compliments to cooks. Even kid's hamburger was delicious. Tried local brewery beer.
Recommend to everyone.

Fulton Alley was great for our company event! We wanted to do something different for our company cocktail party and this place could not have been more perfect. The staff was more than accommodating and promptly helped me with any of my questions/requests. The atmosphere was awesome, the food was delicious and the games were entertaining. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking to host an event.

Loved the place! We are in town from San Diego and my husband has bought their beer before . We had to visit. It's right next the the green belt, dog friendly, spacious, they took COVID measures to where we felt relaxed. Wear a mask to your table then chill. The weather was perfect, all the dogs enjoyed the nice cool floors. Bryan had the Sofa King Sunny- loved it! I sampled a few, Iam a cider girl and loved the Strong Arm SemiSweet Cider. But if you are here Friday?! Please go try the Tent Foxy Franks outside! Their pulled pork Quesadilla and Pulled Pork Nachos were so filling and good! Thank you Libby for recommending and being such a wonderful server- so sweet! We are going to try and come back tomorrow after  our Boise float. It's around 6:45pk on an August summer Covid day, more people are arriving and chilling . Great atmosphere outside . We will be

Stay away from this company! They are at best incompetent and negligent, at worst fraudsters.
 Our house was in escrow (October/November 2017) and the buyer called Jhonny's to inspect for termites. Their inspector came up with $3,500 + in work to be done! They made the report (Oct. 31/17) sound so bad that one might think the house would fall down. This in spite of Jhonnys having performed an inspection and a complete tenting of the house barely six months earlier (March 25, 2017). The October report also did not mention that they had tented the home in March!  Our buyer backed out of the escrow, and the deal fell through.  We had another local company (Escalera) come a few days later to do an inspection and full report, and their report completely refuted everything Jhonny's had found. Where Jhonny's said there was currently active infestations - Escalera said there were signs of old infestations ...  and there was no work needed. In addition, Jhonnys'  "inspector" went to our neighbors  (good friends of ours) and told them our house was so badly infested they had better tent their house immediately! We contacted Jhonny's twice and were stonewalled - all they said was they had not done anything wrong. We have filed a complaint with the California Pest Control Board, and the local Better Business Bureau.
 Be warned! Stay away from Jhonny's Pest Control!

PS: the owner has now posted a "response" still claiming there were ground-based termites, even though Escalera's inspection showed there were NONE.  He still refuses to accept any responsibility for his company's actions and the fact their report cost us the sale of our house!
Good food, large portions, and friendly staff. Due to the large rooms voices carry and it can be noisy. Wait staff is friendly

I scheduled an appointment to meet Greg at my property for a quote on electrical work. I met him, and we did a thorough review of the work to be done. He said he'd have the quote ready within a week.

The deadline passed. I called him, and he said he was "just working on the quote," which would be ready in a few days.

The quote never came. He stopped answering my calls and texts. His inbox was always full, so I couldn't leave a voicemail. In the end, I had to start over with another electrician.

Greg, I feel disrespected and disappointed. I took the time to meet with you, and I was ready to hire you. If you didn't want the job, or didn't want to finish the quote, you could have said so. You wasted my time and held up my project with no explanation. This was not a good experience.

After hearing good things from my coworkers and reading some recent Yelp reviews about how pleased the Yelpers were coming to Bareburger, I decided to come here for lunch today with my coworker. We were mostly pleased.

The first thought upon entry was the bright colors and spaciousness of the place with the booths on one side and tables on the other. The sign directed people to sit where they wanted. After a walk down the movie theatre somewhat sticky floor, we sat near the front of the restaurant. A short wait for our friendly waitress and we got our paper menus. I was very happy to see that a lot of the foods here are organic.  

The appetizer of the crispy Brussels sprouts was excellent. Perfectly fried with no grease and the Asiago cheese with scallions and lemon wedges really upped the anti. I had to save room so I took half home with me as my coworker is not a foodie like me and also not adventurous to even try except for the piece of cheese that was calling her name. She liked it!

For my burger, I chose to go the "build your own" route but they do have plenty of other options. Bison burger on lettuce with crisped onions, sweet pickles, tomato, spinach, pepper jack cheese, and sriracha sauce. Medium rare. My coworker went with the beef on Brioche and organic cheddar, with a spicy chipotle Mayo  sauce. Well done but not burnt.

My burger was perfectly made and very flavorful. My coworker knew there would be a problem with hers once she saw a bit of blood on the plate. She did try it, but it was not to her liking and had to send it back. The Manager eventually came back with the burger after it was refired and it was better, but not great. We did get an apology and he said he'd speak with the grill chef. We also got and shared some excellent crispy fries and the organic ketchup was better than most other ketchups you'll find. Definitely better than the popular brands. For drinks, I had a strawberry hibiscus tea, and my coworker had the cucumber blueberry lemonade. Both were good, but the lemonade was that perfect Country Time saying Not Too Tart, Not Too Sweet, and especially the cucumber taste pulled through. It was so good, I got myself one. 

The restaurant was advertising they needed staff and this unfortunately was quite apparent. In a relatively crowded restaurant that more were showing up and others coming for takeout, the staff at the time we were there on a Friday just after opening (12pm) was only a waitress, Manager, and I think a single chef. They certainly did their best to get orders out, but people who came after us were served their food before ours. I can imagine how there could be severe issues during rush times. 

Overall, a very pleasant experience in a new lunch place. Friendly staff, and I'd come back.

I should mention that the back of the menu has a bucketload of beer, cider, and mixed drinks available. When I ordered one, I was told something about the liquor license, so no alcohol was available. Turned out ok because of that awesome lemonade and maybe in the future we could get some of that mixed with some vodka or something!

$65 including tax and tip for two build your own burgers, two drinks, appetizer Brussels sprouts, and side of fries.

Almost everything is fresh and homemade. Foods are good especially the Italian hoagies and cheese steak. Soups are also hot and tasty. Clean environment and prices are affordable. I would recommend everyone who wants good quality food and quick for a short break. Please go to bevan's. If you don't want to wait, you can just call ahead and pick it up later especially for hot food because they have to take time to cook.

Great food! The best Thai restaurant in Nashville! The customer service is superb! The ambiance is beautiful and out of the Thai locations I've visited in Nashville, it reminds me of little spot in 5 points Atlanta or the Lazy Leopard in New London. Exquisite!!!

Used to be one of my favorite places to eat. Just went there and the waitress forgot to put my boudin order in. When I got it I didn't like it and wanted to order something else. I was told the kitchen was closed. I was seated at 10:15. Restaurant closes at 11. Got the Boudin at 11:10. I ate crackers and butter because I was hungry.

I'm back yelp friends! Short story: I've moved to Florida. Sunny, gorgeous Florida. With alligators and Zika. Not stopping me from reaching my fitness goals. You know what is stopping me?!?! Steak N' Shake, but that's for another review. Anyways, I was content at working out in the tiny apartment gym. It has some basic equipment. I gave myself DOM's (no, 50 shades fans, not that DOM. Delayed onset muscle soreness. Like when you squat so much you can't walk, those are DOMS.) I digress. I needed a squat rack. This gym wasn't cutting it. 

It was my intention to check out ALL of the gyms in the area. This was first on my list. Abe is a good sales person. I have somewhat of a loyalty to ATF. It's where I began, as a mega obese girl in Oregon three years ago. Now I'm a fittish chubby girl who is like hey y'all! Coming to work out! Watch out! Anyways. I never made it to the other gyms. My nostalgia mixed with Abe's excellent salesmanship won me over, and I did what I promised I wouldn't do on the same day and signed up. 

I've been four times. Boot Camp on Saturday. Don't ever ever ever do Boot Camp after Friday leg day. I'm moving leg day to Thursday. I did Body Blast today and I was going to do Yoga Flow, but I changed my mind at the last minute because I was starving. :D anyways. These are the first classes I've ever done. I would like to do more. Maybe someday. Also I need more reasons to get more workout clothes. Because workout clothes are the only reasons I go to the gym 5-6 times a week. 

Tech specs:
Squat racks- yes
Plenty of benches- yes
Olympic bars-yes
Cardio stuff-I hate cardio, but yes. (Also take note that lack of cardio is why I'm still chubby. Cardio-ing it up, and no more steak N' shake. If anyone local knows of any place with healthy choices, hit me up!)
Lots of dumbells-yes
Clean-yep
Free classes-yesssss

I'll revisit this with progress when I make some.

**edit: one month later,  down 13lbs and seeing some massive progress. Everyone is still amazing. I was in a vehicle accident and Abe even gave me bath salts and recruited me to come to yoga in the middle of leg day. Usually I would carry on, but I was sore. Abe, Mary, Karen, you are the best! None of the other trainers have taken time to visit with me. Kind of wonder if it's because I have RBF. Maybe, maybe not. :)

**edit: 10 months later: still rocking it out and looking and feeling fantastic. Might hire a coach soon for these aesthetics. ;)

***Edit: 13 months later. How come you can't out train a bad diet? I really think you should be able to. I mean? Come on! Still love the gym.

The best spice shop anywhere. Enormous selection, excellent quality, great prices, and none of the pretentiousness found at other "gourmet" spice shops. They closed for a few months in 2010 thanks to a catch-22 battle with the city's Licenses & Inspections department, but thankfully they are now back. Whew! If you live in the area and have ever spent $5 on a crappy little bottle of supermarket rosemary, go here once and you will wonder how you could have ever been so duped.

Awesome time at this slightly more upscale divey Old City mainstay. Was awaiting the arrival of a friend from out of town so popped in for a beer. The selection was solid without being intimidating, and the service couldnt have been better. Despite it being my first time, it felt like I had been going there daily for years. The bartenders were super friendly and any of the menu items that went by looked good. I had a Lancaster Brewing Company Baked Pumpkin Ale with the glass lined with cinnamon and brown sugar (nice touch!) and then another, and then my friends arrived. The staff urged me to return later, so after hitting a few other Old City faves - Khyber Pass, Sassafras, 2nd Story - we all did head back to RR's for a last few. Again, was greeted like family and everyone had a good time. Will be back for sure. Price was right, staff was great. Thanks for a good time!

We ordered three appetizers from Postmates to be delivered. The crabcakes, the fritters, and the calamari. The fritters would've been good if they weren't mostly charred, and overcooked. The dipping sauce was good. The crabcakes were also charred/overcooked and came with some strange yellow dipping sauce and they were actually better with the dipping sauce that came with the fritters -overall they were still the worst crabcakes I've ever had. The calamari was the worst appetizer by far. It was 90% onion straws 10% calamari. I have never had calamari served mixed in with onion straws. I actually thought they may have made a mistake until I saw a few calamari throw in. Overall- just not good. We won't be back.

First to review?! Hard to believe when this place is synonymous with great customer service. They know all their customers on a first name basis and always goes above and beyond every time you go in there. 

This place is hardcore about their wine. They have weekly wine tastings and the largest indoor wine storage facility in Louisiana. And they have a sommelier on site! Last time I was there, I got a chance to sample some hundred dollar wine. Yep, they just cracked that puppy open and split it with everyone in there. How awesome is that?

Plus they're very community-oriented. They have a featured business and an interesting events every month. They just recently advertised for an indoor garage sale where they had over 50 sellers and door prizes! Don't know of any other garage sales where they give out door prizes- and ask for donations for a local blood bank and school. 

And they're doing stuff like this all the time. Every time I go to a fundraiser in Jefferson Parish, Elmwood Self Storage is involved in some shape or fashion. I've even used their board room for a meeting I conducted. They let me use that space- free of charge- and even helped me advertised for it. These people seriously get around!

So check out their facilities and you won't be disappointed. I haven't been!

Amazing service and great, simple food. Loved the breakfast potatoes and all their oniony goodness. I stayed in New Orleans for five days. We went to two "fancy places" and then opted to go to Mena's for the next three days because of how delicious it was

Dr. Stephen Cwikla is AMAZING!

Dr. Stephen Cwikla and Diamond were amazing. I am so thankful I was sent there. The office is very clean and welcoming. They were able to get me in when the referring doctor wanted me to be seen. The situation was rough for several reasons but they were so caring, kind and gentle. I have had several root canals in the past. This root canal was the easiest. Thank you for caring. The office person was very helpful setting up this appointment that had some issues to work through. Thank you everyone.
So glad to see that Reginelli's came out with a new menu that includes several new items! I'll definitely eat here more now and pass the word around!

I will definitely be coming back. 
I have been doing an IVF cycle, and the embryo transfer is in one day from the time of those review. Not only am I nervous and stressed, I am being told not to be nervous and stressed. Easier said than done, I say. 
Now, with ivf nowadays, there are shots involved. In the stomach and in the butt. So both of those areas are particularly tender for me since I am still in the midst of said shots.
I looked for a massage everywhere, and couldn't decide if I wanted to stay safe and not get a massage at all and not release muscle chemicals, or if I wanted to risk it and help myself relax. I stumbled on Indy Massage Co, and decided, meh, I'll just call and ask. The receptionist couldn't answer my question, but she did say she would give me to a massuer that would know the answers to my questions. 
Fast forward to the appointment, and I explained the situation to Anna. She recommended a normal massage since the main difference in a prenatal massage and a swedish is positioning, and avoiding certain points for risk of hurting a baby. Since I don't have a baby atm, it seemed logical. She also mentioned that she had dealt with ivf clients before and that if I wanted to come back she would be happy to help me out with the tender areas after the shots were done. 
Not going to like, I almost cried when she mentioned that she knew the ivf process a little. It was extremely reassuring, and I felt very safe. 
Then the actual massage. I've never had a swedish massage before, but oh goodness I'm a convert. I had mentioned I carried stress around my shoulder blades and my upper back, and she spent a good amount of time focusing those muscles and helping them to relax. She didn't forget the rest of theassage at all, it was timed very well, she took the full hour on the massage itself, and the one time I made a noise of pain, she moved away and avoided that area for the rest of the session. 
I will definitely be going back to see Anna again, hopefully for a prenatal massage next time!

Absolutely the best shipping business I have ever went to! The customer service is OUTSTANDING! They work with UPS and FedEx so getting packages out is with the most affordable option. They have boxes and they will even help you pack your items. I'm with the military and was happy to see that the owner was retired Air Force. Absolutely will spread the word about this place and will return when I go back into town to ship things home. Two thumbs up!

I want to love this place, but we were placed right next to the server's station, and all the servers kept bumping into my husband's chair because there was barely enough room to walk between tables. Our food was pretty good, but these couple things kind of soured our experience.

Pretty good. I had the power bowl. It was sweet and savory. It was also very filling. It comes highly recommended. Also, the pesto wrap is good. We also had the bbq bowl. It was just fair. Not recommend is the Greek bowl. It has more rice than anything else. If you want healthy this is not her dish to order. I also found it weird that the Greek bowl had a seafood taste to it. Gross. On the plus side the tzekei was great!!

This is a quality bakery. I got a cake that was really chocolatey but I wasn't much of a fan. It wasn't that cakey because it was really hollow and cream filled and wasn't anything like what I expected. But I also got an iced latte which was good. Other cakes were good, too and the prices were really reasonable. The staff seemed pretty friendly. I got ice cream here once and it was delicious. (the picture of the ice cream isn't very recent, fyi.)

My house trained dog started peeing in the house so we needed to find a vet to check for infection. I called for an appointment and though pretty booked, they were able to get me in same day, which I really appreciated. My husband took out r dog in and said everyone was just as nice and accommodating as the woman I booked the appointment with. They recommended some behavioral changes, tested my dog's urine, and when it was determined she did indeed have a UTI, prescribed antibiotics. Best of all, they offer a 10% military discount, which definitely helps with the cost of unexpected pet illnesses. Will definitely return if we have to have our pets seen by again.

I've been to Fleming's twice.  Once for my mom's birthday, and once for New Year's Eve.    I'm not usually a huge fan of chains, but this one is really well run.  The service really is exemplary, and they gave my mom a $25 gift certificate and a box of truffles for her birthday.

The food really is pretty good.  The steaks are high quality and the sites are done well.  The brussels sprouts are well cooked (crispy and not sulfurous).   The desserts are pretty good as well, esp if you like carrot cake or walnut pie.     

On Sundays they have prime rib, a side, a salad, and a dessert for $40.  A great deal.   I'll be back.

I stayed at Loews on the weekend of Presidents Day. The hotel is located right in the middle of town. Walking distance to everything. There is a subway stop 1 block up. Reading Market is a block away. Walking distance to Liberty Bell. The service at the hotel was top. From the valet parking, bellhops, front desk to room service. Everyone was polite and friendly. The valet parking was very handy. The view from the hotel was great. The hotel was clean and the room was on par with what is to be expected. Room service was timely. The one drawback was the restaurant only has a buffet on the weekend. We had to order room service instead. But the food was good. I would highly recommend this hotel in the future.

We hired Angel to paint the interior of our home, and are so pleased with the results. From beginning to end, Angel was incredibly helpful and professional. He was very kind and answered all of our questions promptly. On top of that, Angel and his crew did a fantastic job with painting and were very quick with getting the job done. His prices were also very fair considering the high level of customer service and work we received. I very highly recommend Angel for any painting work!

Great food, wonderful service, amazing atmosphere. 

Being a vegan, I was pleasantly surprised by how many options we had to choose from and how accommodating the staff was to our dietary restriction. 

The owner, Priya, was very attentive and made sure we had a memorable experience by going above and beyond expectation. 

I highly recommend Guru's and will definitely be back!

I love this place. They have a restaurant I haven't made it to yet but I will! This is an excellent place to pick up Cedars, fruit trees, shrubs as well as an arrangement of perennial and annual flowers. There's also a good selection of merchandise for the garden that includes kelp based fertilizers. The staff were very knowledgeable. There is also a beautiful botanical garden that you can walk around in for inspiration and relaxation. All of the plants that I have purchased there so far have been healthy and the selection is the best around.

Just enjoyed a wonderful Easter brunch at Chill. The food was delicious, the ambience was great, and the service was spectacular!
Our server, Cadea, was attentive, efficient, and even loving! She made me feel like a guest in her own home!

I ended up here on Mother's Day for dinner with friends. There was a Blues Game on at the bar and I was initially worried about volume as everywhere seemed to be seated next to a speaker, but I was delighted to be proved wrong! The bar is designed in such a way that all the noise stays over there. For Sunday dinner, we got in, seated, and eating pretty quickly. The space is truly unique but the food is what really shines through. 

I got the fried chicken with the Mac n cheese and mashed potato sides. My friend is Gluten Free but had no problem ordering and had a wide selection. She'd been craving bread and was delighted to find their cornbread was GF. I also love anywhere that has Excel sodas, and they had a great selection! Everything was delicious and filling and totally worth the price. I will gladly be back soon.

Service was very poor today.  They are supposed to open at 11am and were 15 minutes late opening.  I called in my order and it took almost 30 minutes for them to give it to me.  Someone ordered the exact same thing as me after me and got there order before me (except I ordered a shake).  I asked about my order and the lady said she just had to bag it.  She kept taking more orders instead of giving me my order.  Finally, bagged and she never made my shake so as my food got cold I had to wait more for the shake.  VERY DISAPPOINTED HIP CITY

This place is shady, they try to take a trade at wholesale price and low ball you even though your car has higher value. Carmax was even higher at a cash price vs this place. There is a reason why they have low  star ratings, please avoid this place as if it was the source of covid and buy somewhere else.

Usually love Bella Pizzeria and would love to give them five stars but unfortunately it didn't live up to their standards this evening. Went in simply to get some garlic knots and cheese to go, and discovered they had a check in offer, sweet! 

I ordered the ten garlic knots and wanted the three additional as well, since I was splitting them with my sister and figured 13 would be enough between us. Upon leaving I had a feeling they didn't give me the right amount and good thing I did, because they shorted me my three free garlic knots! I nicely asked the cashier for my extra garlic knots and she simply yelled out to the cook for three more, received them, bagged them, and handed them over without an apology. 

Even upon arriving home, which isn't far from Bella's at all, me and my sister discovered they were cold!! We ended up having to reheat them and the cheese which just didn't have the same taste as you would eat them if they were fresh. 

Based on my experience from this Bella's tonight, I see myself going to the Clay Terrace location instead, since the food and service is more accommodating.

Amazing food and amazing atmosphere!!! The chicken and waffles, burritos and guac were SO GOOD. And the vibe and and theme is so cute and fun to look at all the decorations. Our waitress was so good and sweet. 10/10 experience.

This store has one of the best selections of electronics and pretty good prices depending on the sales.  Some of the sales people are knowledgeable and others are not.  Be persistent if you have seen a lower price elsewhere.  They will look up the comparison prices for you if you ask.  The computer help desk is usually backed up so if you have computer problems prepare to stay awhile.  The only computers I'll go with now is apple because I have had so many problems with all the other brands but that's my preference.  Not all of the best buy stores has all the apple products so you have to call around to make sure.  I go to the Langhorne  store because they carry them all when they have them in stock.  It's a good store all around for electronics.  If your looking for electronic accessories I would shop at walmart/sam's club/bjs for them.   for them, depending on what your looking for.

This was my 4th time there and they didn't disappoint. Went there with my wife and four friends . The waiter was very good as he explained the daily specials. One person ordered the Chipinio---seafood stew- it was big enough to share. I had the daily special of blackened pasta with crab and shrimp in a blush sauce: This is a BYOB restaurant so you can save some that way. Can't wait to go back for my 5th time

Weird. Went once. Thought it was BBQ, buy the waitress was tarted up like a ho. Did I go to Hooters by mistake?  She was not friendly, but instead, sort of cursory to the point of being off-putting. Why?

Food was okay, but pricey.

What is this place, and what does it want?

I'm Jamaican so I can't eat anybody food. The service wasn't bad or anything but I ordered the stew chicken and it wasn't it. I couldn't finish it. And me is a person weh love nyam! Can't say I'll be back.

This is my favorite hike in Tucson. I think it's the perfect hike for out of towners who want to see the city from above and are in decent shape. It's relatively short (a little over 6 miles total) and has the most amazing views of Tucson and Mount Lemmon. It is pretty steep for a lot of it so it is a great workout.  I also love the satisfaction of getting to the end and literally running into a sign and a dead end unlike most trails at Sabino that interconnect and go on and on. You also don't have to be on the road for much of the hike like you do for seven falls. There are a coupe crossings that can get washed out during heavy rains but otherwise isn't too affected by the weather. There aren't any restrooms or water fountains once you get on the trail so bring your own water and make sure you look for the signs in the beginning so you don't miss a turn on to phone line or the off phone line on to Blackett's.

We paid extra to add brown rice in the bibimbap bowl but the brown rice was not fully cooked. Since we went there with out little ones and he might not even be able to tell the difference and just swallow whatever it was. Won't come back again.

My children and I came here for brunch.  I really wanted to give them two stars, but it didn't feel right for their bartenders who did the best they could because of the major backup at the kitchen.

Service:
We got seated as soon as we walked in.  Since we didn't have a reservation for the outdoor dining, we opted for some seats at the bar.  Their bartenders were friendly and attentive, and frequently came to check on us despite the long time we had to wait for our food.  I thought it was odd that I only saw one or two tables get their food for about 40 minutes until the bartenders apologized to us for the major backup in their kitchen.


Food:
I must say their bartender was excellent at making a cocktail.  My daughter, who is picky with alcohol, really enjoyed their Red Zone Mimosa.  Usually, she'd pass over her cocktails to me to finish them but not today!

For the food, they made one of the best home fries we've ever had, but everything else was overcooked much to our disappointment.  My daughter had rubbery scrambled eggs and pancakes.  That was bad, but their Eggs Benny was wrong on so many levels: overcooked poached eggs with English muffins that were soggy from sautéed spinach placed directly on top of untoasted English muffins.  It was an epic failure.

Buyer beware! The hotel appeared to suffer structural damage to the flooring due to flooding. My wife substained mutiple injuries due to taking a fall from the extremely warped flooring, the end result was our trip being cut short due to injuries my wife substained at the hotel. We notified the hotel of the issue & nothing was done.
We spoke with the hotel representative named Kathleen Langle, who first responded back but after an email or 2 she's transformed to extremely unprofessional & has since ignored all means of contact. She has ignored all calls & emails.

It pains me to give this 2 star review but this place has gone downhill since I moved here in 2016.  I've given it lots of tries and each time it gets a little bit less great.  Went about a month ago, outdoor dining.  Sticky tables, the papers taped under the tables are covered in soy sauce and old stains and need to be removed.  The soy sauce dishes have a permanent brown ring around the edge and the glasses were completely filthy!  The bathroom was absolutely foul as well.  The entire restaurant just had a funky smell and I was nauseous after going to the bathroom for the rest of the night.  Didn't want to touch anything in there.  Some of the fish did also not taste fresh and came out straight up warm.  Alas, after being my favorite place I no longer will be visiting.  It really needs a complete decor overhaul, all new serveware, a dishwasher upgrade and a complete bathroom remodel.  Need to check the fridges and ventilation.  Super bummed.  Not sure what happened here.

Good food for the area. We had the crawfish etouffee, gumbo, and red beans and rice. Food was not warm but had a great flavor. I recommend the crawfish dish! Great service but kind of expensive for what you get! I recommend trying it out if you don't mind spending about $20/person.
The food here never disappoints! Our favorite is the lobster ravioli and the lamb chops. They are the best in the city!

I am a new customer, got my first lawn service. Everything went well, my lawn was taken care of perfectly, including edging. Cleaned up the area after work was done. Even helped me take down a dead palm leaf. Would recommend my agent, Ronnie, to anyone. Very professional and courteous.

Amazing seafood and drinks! The staff is warm and friendly. Got to meet Chef Chris. Their food is fresh and a wait that is worth the fresh tastes. How every restaurant should be, quality you can taste. 
When you walk in the door, you're presented with a beautiful oyster bar. Really wish this place was back home. On vacation and this is our second night in a row. Can't wait to come back.

I love this place and would eat here a lot more, but hubby is not a fan.  He says he always leaves hungry.  I always leave with half of mine!  lol
Anyway, we went at an odd time and were the only diners in the place, so we had great service!  Hubby got the beef lo mein and loved it.  I had the fried rice with chicken and it was delicious!  We had the ginger ribs for our appetizer.  I'm a happy girl when I get to eat here.  Oh and I love the tunes being played

You HAVE to come here! The atmosphere is wonderful whether you sit inside or outside. Inside you have a beautiful fish tank and outside you have amazing views of the water and downtown! 
Ordering the Yucatán shrimp is a no brainer. Make sure to dip your bread into the sauce too!

I had possibly the worst burger of my life off of the value menu.  Talk about "Where's the beef", Dave Thomas would be spinning in his grave.  The burger was so small and room temperature, the bun was too big and the cheese was not even a little bit melted.  

Also, the cashier (and I believe the manager) Mercedes couldn't have looked any less happy to be there.  Greeting: Me "Hello", Mercedes, "Will this be for here or to go?"

Nice...

I'm not afraid to admit we come here almost every week. Both of our favorites are the smash burger, make sure to ask for a side of the sauce as well! My husband loves the turkey legs! It's such a great establishment, the owners are so nice and we are looking forward to their brunch menu.

* I like the beef "Del Taco". Really really. Hard to beat. Yet I think I prefer the tater tots at Taco Johns as opposed to the fries here.
* Today I drank some Cherry Coke before eating the tacos, and then the meat didn't taste all that flavorful. Was it a change in recipe, or was it the phosphoric acid messing with my taste buds? Somebody help me out here. 
* Last week I had a strawberry lemonade, which seemed like a great deal, at only 1 dollar. In their haste, the server didn't mix up the muck of strawberry preserves at the bottom of the cup with the weak (not fresh squeezed) lemonade on top.
* My server offered a free replacement lemonade today, and it was an improvement. Yet I would not want to spend another dollar for it.

Growing up in Louisiana I've very particular about my snowballs. Usually based on the consistency of ice and now unique flavors. Sno-La lived up to the hype! I wasn't sure what to expect when they said cheesecake stuffed snowballs. Honestly I was just picturing chunks of cheesecake throughout. It was more like a whipped cheesecake. Just go and you'll thank me later! It's my favorite summer time treat in nola.
Stopped in to try a nice healthy salad for lunch. Ordered the baked falafel fattoush bowl. Best falafel ever!!  Can't wait to return!  Sylvan Park is definitely up and coming.

Great Chicago style pizza! We had the sampler appetizer plate - which was huge - and split two pizzas between four (hungry) adults and went home with 6 slices leftover! We will definitely be returning!
Yum! I crave this place now all the time, it's crazy the flavor of the ramen here. Food is delicious my drink was even better and the atmosphere is beautiful!

I was blown away at this spot I googled.  I have never had such an amazing everything bagel with smoked salmon.  The pickled onions were nothing short of amazing.  The whole thing melts in your mouth. My companion had the avocado toast which was delicious as well. So rich and creamy. The addition of feta cheese made it super decadent. It was enough for two. The bread was amazing. A bit hard to cut with a regular knife but nice and crusty

The pork belly tacos  the chicken & green waffle  Kim Chi burger & sweet potato fries  fresh avocado smoothie  delish! 

Nice location, nice modern decor. Great prices. Must try for modernized Vietnamese food!

Food is usually pretty good, but it's so cold in the restaurant (this is May) that my wife and I couldn't wait to get out.  Another customer was complaining about the cold also, but nothing was done.  In fact, when we asked a server why they keep it so cold her only answer was that she was freezing too, but couldn't do anything about it because of the manager.  He was sitting back in a office near the restrooms where I noticed it was notably warmer than the eating area of the restaurant.  We will go back but have already decided that we will leave if it's as cold inside. There are more comfortable alternatives.

Went to the Marana 4th of July celebration yesterday and ordered a meatball sub from these guys after waiting almost an hour in line. When we got the food they got our order wrong and instead of making it right he said he had to get to other customers first. I asked for Alfredo sauce on the sub per the menu and he gave me a regular sub which was no big deal but the owner I presume then made an annoyed face when I asked for just a side of sauce and then gave the sauce to me cold!!! Worst thing about it is that the sandwich sucked! Subway makes a better meatball sub for almost half the price!

I always come here for their marked down books, and sometimes I surprise myself with the good finds. They serve Starbucks coffee and Cheesecake Factory pastries and cakes. Oh and love the free wi-fi :)

Philadelphia's Fairmount residents are lucky to have such a great, independent pet shop. They have a top-notch selection of of all-natural foods and treats, toys, and other pet items. The staff and owner are knowledgeable, patient, and helpful. On our last visit, the owner took the extra time to help us properly fit our westie puppy with an easy-walk harness even though it was closing time. So next time you need pet supplies, skip the big-box store and visit the Fairmount Pet Shoppe.

I came here on a Thursday night with my girlfriends and we had reservations. It was pretty busy in there so I would recommend making reservations. The seating area inside is smaller in the back and they have outdoor seating. 

I started off with the red wine flight and it was on the sweeter side. I loved all of them and I was surprised because I like drier reds. Then I opted for their house red which was great as well. For food, I got their wild mushroom flatbread and it was delicious. I loved how it is light crisp crust and backed with toppings. It's bursting with flavor. 

They also have a wine store in the middle and a bar in the back where the tables are. I had a great experience here and the service was great despite the busyness.
Awesome Cafe and Restaurant environment!   :D

Unfortunately I have had the opportunity to see Drs Wickman, Proctor, and A Kupperman all for exercise-related injuries. So far I have not been kept waiting in the lobby or in the exam room and the docs each took time to carefully explain what was going on, what could/should help, and what sort of follow-up I needed, including sonogram, MRI, and PT. Plus I was referred to one of their associates for a steroid injection in my neck which completely resolved 10 years of pain (over a year now) from a herniated cervical disc. The PAs and other staff are also very professional. I have not had billing problems. The front desk staff could be more cheerful but are they over-worked/stressed? Also the parking is bad but I try to get there early.

This is hands down some of the best food I have ever eaten in all of my travels! The empanadas, the Yucca fries, all the sauces they come with. Staff is soo friendly, drinks were bomb! I saw people on dates and meetings and I was solo solo and felt so good and comfortable. Waits are long. Make reservations.

My wife and I had a great time! The tour hosts were very entertaining and were very knowledgeable with what they presented. The free beer at the end of the tour brought it all together. Go check this out!

This is by far the best Indian restaurant I have ever eaten at. The naan was so good that we devoured it and ordered another one! The chicken tikka masala was perfectly flavored and very saucy! The wait staff were very helpful. The atmosphere is a little weird because we were the only ones in there and from the outside it looks kind of creepy but it is totally worth it!

Masks?!?!? There is a mask posting in place , and employees consistently wore their mask, but there were many mask-less patrons allowed with no comments made to them. I understand the challenge this poses for a restaurant but the posting is misleading. If not for the protection of your employees, masks should be required to protect your patrons!

As usual excellent food! But can't go back with mask optional approach.

I am in town visiting my baby brother & I wanted to take him to get his first tattoo! We went to Electric Mayhem because of a waiters recommendation! Luke did an amazing job making my brother feel comfortable and giving him what he wanted, he ended up getting three tattoos!!

Let's talk about my tattoo! I decided to get a slot machine tattoo,m. That's where you get 3 elements (yes by playing a slot machine) and the artist designs something unique for you. Patrick Day was my artist and he did such an incredible job. The whole experience was so fun! My tattoo is amazing, one of my favorites I've ever gotten and it was such a good deal, I am going back today to get a second one!! 

The shop is stylish and very clean, prices are extremely good and the staff are wonderful! I wish I lived closer, I'd be back all the time!

I had the absolute best shopping experience with Niya at Luxe Bridal Studio! It was my first time shopping for wedding dresses, and Niya was so supportive and easygoing which made a stressful experience feel like a dream. She really paid attention to everything I wrote in my questionnaire as far as what to pull for me before my appointment, and even added a dress she posted on Instagram that I loved. The appointment reservation fee was $10, but honestly to have a completely private appointment was worth wayyyyyy more than that.

The studio itself is intimate and cozy. There's a convenient parking lot right outside, and the studio is very private, which I loved, especially for my first time trying on dresses. Niya already had some things pulled for me to try on, and then let my guests and me pick out a few others to try as well.  Niya was super adaptable, and listened to my feelings on each of the dresses and was able to eliminate styles/swap out samples for me to try on based on my feedback. I also loved how she would pair the dresses with different veils, so I could get a sense of what a completed look might be. It was truly the best experience. 

The range of dresses that Luxe carries is so impressive. There was something to fit every bridal style- From boho to ballgown, understated to glitzy AF, but every one of them was absolutely gorgeous. 

At the end of my appointment, Niya took my measurements and ran the numbers on my dress to give me to keep and think on it. She was never pushy or aggressive for a sale, and instead felt more like your cool aunt guiding you through your journey of finding a gown. I loved every moment of my experience at Luxe, and if I could give Niya and her team 10 stars I would!! And don't forget to follow them on Instagram because you never know what you'll see pop up there!

What a bunch off ripoff artists.  Everything they sell from pack and ship to shipping services is priced about 4 times what is fair and appropriate. They looked me in the eye and said that a 2 day letter would cost over $50 to deliver. Then they expected 9 for a small box and some packing peanuts. When I balked at those prices they offered the USPS service that costs about $8... For $19. 

I'm not opposed to a business making a profit but that is excessive. Considering how much they must be making off of Amazon returns I'm astounded that they mark up at all. 

I took everything to the USPS and paid $12 for the same results.

Great beer selection, I had the pickpocket, a Belgian style IPA, if your a fan of the style this one is fantastic. I had a bite of my girlfriends kielbasa sandwich and it was delicious, I also noticed the dumplings/pirogies the table next to us was ordered and they looked delicious. 

First time here, would definitely come again if I wasn't moving out of town :(

5/5 great atmosphere, great staff, great beer, all that matters haha

sausage lemonade!!!!!!
Love my service and my dogs likes the staff!!

Visiting nola 2 days
I bought ticket for this tour
A nice guy pick up and  drop-off afther tour
I see alligators, racons, and a pig
Aso grab some souvenirs at they store

I wanted to post an update, this place is one of the most interesting gourmet ramen places in the city. The combinations of flavors and foods are amazing! The menu is small but excellent I have tried everything on it and with out fail enjoyed everything. The Rangoon is a must, the fat noodle dish is new. It has a flavor that is spicy and pops with each bite. Lastly the drink menu is fun and interesting as well I really enjoyed the "tie one on" drink.

Anthony was the best server I've ever had! 
Anytime u come ask for him

Visited New Orleans and thanks to Yelp we chose this restaurant. The customer service was great.  The food was delicious and the DRINKS       were bomb. I had to order a second one. I don't know what's in New Orleans water but even the restaurant water they give you was good.
Went for lunch and sat upstairs on the balcony. The food was AMAZING, the drinks inventive and delicious, and the service was 20 out of 10.

I really enjoyed my visit with Dr. Nicole and the staff at Great Expressions. As a new patient, I was prepared for a long wait time. To my surprise I wasn't waiting longer than 10 - 20 minutes. The hygenist Victoria took her time in explaining what my treatment plan may be. 

Dr. Nicole was very informative and made the information palatable. When setting my follow up appointment I was given a print out of the treatment plan with the cost of each service. 

Definitely looking forward to seeing the staff at my next appointment.

I absolutely love this store! I went  in here three times on my recent trip to New Orleans. The selection is great for punk, steampunk and goth.  And it is all very reasonable compared to other stores I have been in looking for the same products they carry. The owner and employees are extremely helpful, complimentary, and patient.
