They let my sister rest while I tried on clothes. Rochelle, Becca and Stephanie are the greatest. They helped me pick out several items for different outfits and events.   And all their suggestions looked great. What they didn't have in my size they were able to order and ship back home for me. I will definintely be coming back in when I get back that way and i will be ordering more from them in the future  ;) Will  Post more pics when i recieve what i ordered

Excellent, will definitely go back!
First time we have been here, we were looking for a new place to try that looked interesting as we are food lovers but now dine with a tiny one along when we get the chance to get out. So glad we stumbled on this place we drive by all the time... we have been missing out!

Trendy, upbeat atmosphere but not too pretentious. The staff is super friendly and accommodating from beginning to end. Even kid/ baby friendly.
The menu is full of vibrant delicious versions of Latin and Caribbean dishes that leave you inspired and wanting more.
We started with the tres salsas, the chips were definitely warm and freshly made... excellent! The three Salsas each had good flavor but weren't over powering, nice starter to share. Mango salsa was very good.
We also shared the golden beet salad with whipped herb goat cheese and toasted nuts... can you say yum! Goat cheese really is what brought each of the elements together on this dish, light, beautiful and refreshing.
There were 3 of us and we had the : moqueca which I had never heard of before but was between a Latin stew / curry (style ie not curry spice). Comfort food at its best, the shrimp on top were big and delicious, cooked perfectly and so much to share. Barbacoa empanadas... not like the little fried (or baked) empanadas you are used to. $24 seems like a lot for empanadas until you see this large plate with two beautifully large empanadas thin crispy outside packed with meat and flavor, sauce drizzled on top with green rice on the side. Tamal corn cakes just delicious!!! Never had anything like it. Sweet tamale on the bottom which was almost like corn bread but less dry, piled high with barbacoa covered in salsa Fresca and crema, bursting with flavor and too much too eat. Sides of yucca mash very good, roasted veggies cooked perfect with good flavor. Esquites was very good, not amazing but good flavor. Would have loved to try the churros for dessert but we were way to full and brought home left overs so next time. The drinks were ok, not outstanding ... spicy margarita beautifully done but was very spicy so a difficult pairing with spicy food, I would do it differently next time. Mojito was good a little sweet and less carbonated mint flavor. 
The one negative would be the regular water. Not sure about everyone else but I always try to drink plenty of water when I am out to dinner. Great time to hydrate and also keeps me from way over eating .... not that I don't often over indulge...anyways the table/tap water tastes absolutely awful... like a warm salt water pool. I immediate ate one of my daughters puffs to clear the taste ( desperate !) soooooo next time byob of water ... I will bring my own water bottle:) other than this: service and staff was outstanding. We will be for sure going back to try more unique foods. Hats off to the chef for making creative flavorful combinations. Keep it up

Best in the neighborhood. It's nice to see a small business show patriotism in there name! Johnny puts pride in his business & it taste great. He gave my lil girl a Johnny B t-shirt! It's great to be appreciated as a customer! 
10

First visit to this location. Visited on a Sunday at 11:30 AM.

CONs:
- prices are a little high for the local market. (Personal Bias)
- No complimentary rice options with entrees. This should be a standard within Latin dining. Instead you must order from side menu items at additional cost. Not cool.
- No complimentary bread. This should be a standard within Latin dining. Instead you must order from side menu items at additional cost. Not cool.

PROs: (Because you should always end on a positive note)
- Facility is clean and not clutter like the Orlando/Kissimmee location.Very Cool.
- Venue is not loud like the Orlando/Kissimmee location. You can hear what the people across from you are saying.Very Cool.
- Staff kind and friendly. Solid menus knowledge. 
- Atmosphere music is only Carribean Latin music (Salsa, merengue, etc.) Very Cool.
- Food, great taste and fresh. Taste authentic. They are light on the salt.
- Serving time is not customary of most Latin places with authentic taste, meaning they serve as fast as most loved restaurants. Very Cool.
- Serving size, great portions. Those with small stomachs may want to share one order.

I would come back.

Well where to begin....the food tasted below average. They were out of dark meat chicken and spicy chicken but if you wanted to wait 20 minutes you could get the white meat which costs more. The dining room was filthy as was behind the counter. The workers were rude and spoke Ebonics. The Overall experience was terrible.
Southern Style Farm To Table Food! My all time favorites are the skillet massive garlic knots and the avocado toast with eggs! Always a perfect brunch spot! Some weekends they have live music
One word. Nasty.  Just caught one of the employees having used the bathroom and left without washing his hands.  And no, he didn't just use the urinal, if that tells you anything.

I have been here before and it was good. Great experience.


Last night my family & I went out to eat, 
First we got served bread that tasted/ felt like it had been sitting out for 3 days.. next we ordered the spinach artichoke dip that was served cold..
We had the mushroom arancini crispy on the outside frozen in the middle...
I had ordered for my main meal mashed potatoes asparagus and broccolini, the only thing not cold was the asparagus... I'm extremely disappointed with this experience.  
The cheesecake even had a weird taste to it, somewhat of a  metal flavor... 
never going to this place again...

The Brewery Lights Holiday Festival around Christmas is a must attend STL to-do. The closer to Christmas the more hectic it gets. Parking can be a challenge and is $10. However as you get there, you get a free beer at the entrance. 
The place outside and indoor attractions are intense. You'll get a nice walking exercise as you view all the lights, beergarten, Clydesdale horses, trains, etc. 
You can purchase beer, various snacks and meals as you view all the Christmas lights scenes. 
Stop by their gift shop for any last minute Budweiser merch gifts.

DL created MAGIC on my face. I have always had very fine, white eyebrows. From afar they look so transparent that it didn't even look like I had eyebrows a lot of the time. DL created a beautiful shape, matched my hair color, and created such a natural looking brow for me. I can't thank him enough!
The owner does amazing acrylic nails and designs. Great service and willing to fit you in if you are last minute. Thank you!

Whoa!!! Did someone say Prosecco was part of this experience? Making a chocolate bar or several was crazy... I got the the dessert experience that you would not beliveve. 

From the moment you enter the doors to this hidden gem, you are immediately engulfed with the experience as your sense of smell is heightened with rich aromas of chocolate... the decor is that of no other... with florals and neon signage creating an environment sure to take you to wonderland where you will enjoy the full experience of boutique dessert making, served with the friendly smiles that are sure to make your visit one to remember.

The environment is so lively, upbeat, fun and a great place for the next date night or group night of fun. Either way you need a reservation so make one and definitely check out this gem of Tampa. Cheers

Best food and service ever!! 

Read the reviews and was questioning about coming here. So glad I did! Because I had the best experience and sea food! Don't believe everything you read on here! Everything was nice and clean. Cooks are very nice, servers were great! Prices are reasonable. Will be returning :)!

I don't usually like breakfast sandwiches but I'm a big fan of the Pro-Love sandwich! The bread is crunchy yet has enough give and the wrapping holds it all together. The grilled onions and spinach go perfectly with the cheese and sausage and helps to balance out the flavor. If you're looking for something sweet, check out their blueberry muffins! Haven't tried their drinks yet as I've been making coffee at home but I've heard great things.

If you're in the area, definitely try them out. Not only are you getting great food but you're also supporting a local business with a mission and intent as shown by their menu. 

*Order ahead online to avoid the wait time.

Came here for brunch on a girls trip to NOLA. They sat us outside within 15 minutes even though we didn't have a reservation which we really appreciated. Bottomless brunch was a great deal - the waiter made good conversation and kept topping our drinks off with champagne! Everyone enjoyed the food and atmosphere. Would recommend to people visiting.

They never check our termite pods even though we pay 1000 a year for termite services, also they only show up to spray for mosquitoes when its raining so its no good , they spray the inside of the home and we still have bugs in our house they are ripping people off by charging you a month ahead of your service to where there competitors make you pay after completing the job . Customer service is non existent they put you on hold for hours to hang up on you .

This place is amazing. Living in Louisiana, I've tried a lot of really great seafood restaurants, and this place takes the cake. This is not just a typical po-boy restaurant with a few fried platters. The menu options are unique and delicious! The stuffed artichoke is wonderful for a starter! Ask for a side of butter and you'll be in for a treat! Shout out to our waitress Kristine, who was very attentive, fun, and engaging!

This is my favorite PI in St. Louis. Why, you ask? That's because of the Delmar pizza. The homemade bbq sauce is AMAZING! It didn't sound great when a friend suggested it but OMG is it delicious! TRY IT!

Really friendly staff and affordable prices. 
As a female auto shops always want to try to screw me over by telling me all these things I don't really need at the moment, but they were really honest about what needs done right away and what can Wait for a later time. 
It's nice to have a auto shop I can rely on.

I am in  Town on business and ended up working a little bit late and was tired so I thought I would try a place that was convenient. I am staying at the Embassy suites downtown and this place is attached to that hotel so you can just walk through the lobby and into this establishment.  before I made my decision I looked at their menu online and didn't really see anything that I wanted to try, and there are other restaurants in the area that I really wanted to try but  again, I wanted the convenience and I didn't want to go very far. I tried the Carnitas taco, the Borracho beans, and the mexican rice.  in hindsight I should have went with my gut feeling and tried another place like a barbecue  restaurant or an Italian restaurant perhaps. I sat at the bar even though the restaurant was not busy, and this was on a Tuesday night around 5:30 PM .  I tried the taco meat first as I just didn't want to bite into it, I wanted to taste how good the Carnitas meat was, and believe me it wasn't good. I don't know how they can even call this meat Carnitas, it taste nothing like the real thing. Real Carnitas take a long time to cook and build a deep, rich flavor which was not the case here  I then tasted the beans, they had so much salt in them I thought I was going to have a stroke . Next up I tasted the rice which was basically white rice that had an orange color and zero flavor. Mexican rice should at least have onions and a cumin flavor, at the very least and this rice has zero flavor. Now, I know what some of you are saying,  why would somebody from San Diego eat Mexican food in Missouri. it wasn't because I was trying to recapture the taste of home or that I was really starving for Mexican food,again, it was just because of convenience and now I am paying the price and I'm sorry. The taco was over three dollars and super tiny and the side orders were also very small as well so this place is pretty overpriced for Mexican food. I can get a much better and larger Mexican meal in Southern California for far less money.  at least they got the name of this restaurant correct, Gringo because it tastes like a bunch of gringos are in the kitchen trying to cook Mexican food.  Believe me, I know plenty of gringos that can make much better Mexican food than this.  Anyway, if you're in the area stick to what they do well here, barbecue and avoid the Mexican food at all costs, or at least the Mexican food at this place as this is the only Mexican food restaurant in St. Louis that I will be trying due to the poor experience I had here.

Bing's is my go to boba place! The boba is plain and not sweet, but it's still good. The other toppings are also decent, I like getting half egg pudding. There's many games so you don't get bored with your friends and couches where you can relax. I love the KPop that they play.

Worth the wait! We waited about 15-20 min just to add our name to the wait list...although their system is awesome because it sends you a link that you can check where you are in line and see how many people are in front of you and how long they've waited so you can have a good idea on how much longer you will be waiting...that way you can go for a walk or check your emails without wondering how much longer:)...lavender honey latte was amazing and even though I don't usually eat carbs I had to have the biscuit and it was worth it!

Went with someone for lunch and had little items and 2 main course items (1 kabob & 1 slice of pork - no sides included). They had no prices included so we thought "might be more then we'd spend normally but it looks good." The bill came out to an unreasonable $83. Why unreasonable?
1: The amount/quality of the food is not quantified. 
2: why am I paying restaurant prices at a place where I can't sit & has no waiters
3: since you can't eat there, you need to reheat your $83 meal at home, which comes with no utensils, napkins, OR HEATING INSTRUCTIONS.

There's absolutely better ways to spend that kind of money at much better places.
Good Brunch, limited choices  but the choices are good. The atmosphere is upbeat and fun.

Went for brunch. Very affordable & well made sushi. Bottomless mimosa for $20 is a good deal. Large fresh juice selection. Sake selection is very nice as well! Will definitely go back & recommend you everyone for well made fresh sushi at a great price!

Checked in for 11 year anniversary. Supposed to be special. Turned out to be a nightmare. I should have know when someone called and confirmed the reservation and they were so rude.

First thing, we got a suite nonsmoking, showed up the room was definitely smoking, it was disgusting. And I mean disgusting. Dirty toilet, tons of hair and grime in the spa tub, sticky stuff on floor, horrible view of a roof, and stained sheets and bedding. Remind u this is supposed to be a suite.

I ordered champagne and strawberries upon arrival. The champagne and 6 berries was $65. Berries were disgusting and old champagne was hot. 

I am not a complainer and would have sucked it out and moved on but my husband was pissed. I called front desk and the moved us rooms. It was a down grade to a regular room, not a suite, but it was clean and nonsmoking. They didn't offer to reimburse the difference.  When asked why the front desk attendant was extremely rude and disrespectful.  The walls were paper thin and I could basically hear everything my neighbor was doing. The shower was nice! The pool was fun and clean for the most part. They were on u heavy about masks which is understandable. 

We ordered room services and it was horrific. Ordered drinks by the pool, they were also disgusting. Thankfully we had dinner reservations at Atlantis which saved our date night. 

Gambling wise we didn't win or see anyone winning at Peppermill but definitely did at Atlantis. We spent a lot and didn't get a single free drink which was weird. I will be going back to Reno but obviously giving a different hotel my money!

Went to this bar because my boyfriend used to go during his college days. Did not expect the food to be so amazing! Or the kitchen to be open so late (I think we got there around 11 or later). It has New Orleans style food on the menu. We had gumbo, fried chicken po boy with mac and cheese and our friend had a mushroom etouffee. My boyfriend despises mac and cheese, but he actually enjoyed the one here. Everything exceeded our expectations.
Also, being from the DC area, I thought the craft beer prices were very cheap. Like 3 or 4 bucks a pint..... pretty sweet. Definitely going back to this bar whenever I'm in Philly.
Clean , great prices ! Friendly staff. Food is amazing. Must try if you have not already

Food is eclectic but delicious. Great place to branch out and try something new. We've beenn several times and the service is always good. Good options for vegetarians, however younger kids may have a harder time finding a "traditional" pizza, but it's a good opportunity for them to try something different! Also love how they handled their business during the COVID-19 shutdown. Highly recommend!

Sabroso, delicioso YUMMMMMM! Whenever traveling we try and find foodie gems and we scored tonight. The pictures show half eaten food, because we dug in before even thinking about taking pics. Lobster empanada was fried perfectly and filling was creamy and satisfying. The stars were the Cubano and the Cuban Fried Rice (who even knew that was a thing! I would come back to St Pete Beach for this meal!!!!

My boyfriend and I eat here a lot. When we have a Sunday together we try to eat at Bradley's. Today however, was disheartening. My scrambled eggs came out runny. I lost my appetite. It is what it is. I just push my plate to the side. The server asked if she could replace my eggs and I politely said no, I'd lost my appetite. When she brought us our check she had informed me that she couldn't take the breakfast i did not eat off the bill but the manager had been informed and, she would probably take it off at check out. I thought that was so awesome, i left her a fat tip for her "taking care of me" well........ We were charged the full amount for the meal. So....... bad bad bad management. Oh and by the way it was in NO WAY busy for them on a Sunday. They should have been able to pay attention to the quality of food sent to the tables and they should have remembered who's check needed to be discounted. We are very disappointed and will not be back.
The most unfriendly staff!!! Not welcoming and very rude! Sad, was excited to experience it as I've heard great things!

I ate here once got take away food was JUST OKAY! Nothing to brag about, cou ppl le guys from work wanted to go to a buffet I called and their price is $14pp which is a little high compared to other indian buffets in the area. I mean the food isnt that great, adjust the price and quality.

Beautiful office. Wonderful staff!!!

Will always go here. Dr. Hiple is incredibly nice and the assistants plus hygienists are very comforting to their patients. Always leave with a better looking smile. I have recommended this dentist and will keep recommending, Dr. Hiple is great for the whole family.

I'm local to Nashville and live in the downtown area. Last Saturday I was at Jason Aldean's and was shocked to find out today that my credit card was over changed multiple times. Unfortunately, this seems to be a common theme at the broadway bars. 

The phone number on google is disconnected and there is no contact us section on the website. 

STAY AWAY!!!!!!!

I genuinely enjoyed this place. They have a good brunch menu and such fair prices for drinks. I had the potato hash. It's a sweet potato hash but I got regular potatoes instead. I loved that they were able to adjust the entree to my liking. My boyfriend got the All Hail The Omelet. He said he liked it a lot. He cleaned his plate so it's safe to say it was delicious. I'd definitely recommend this place. The vibe is comfy and modern which is nice!

Nothing beats this place for Sunday breakfast. They don't overcook their eggs, the potatoes are just right, and their coffee is out of this world. As a hypoglycemic, you can tell I take breakfast seriously.

Food was incredible, & a plate was great to share with 2 people. Nice selection of local beer on draft. Brisket & French fries were amazing. 

10/10 would recommend.

Driest burger I have ever had! The worst part is that the burger is supposed to be one of the best in Philly. I get that restaurants sometimes have a bad day but a place owned by a celebrity chef and that is on all kinds of lists for its burger should not serve a cardboard tasting one.
They have good food. Loved the catfish. My husband liked several of their special dishes. I don't recommend their hush puppies or the beignets.

Cutest place in the world. Everything is dainty and pink. The salt is pink. The idea for a restaurant/ bakery is fairly unique and very enjoyable. They go all out decorating for holidays so be sure to stop by during your favorite holiday to check out the decor.

Tea time is a big thing here. They expect that you've made a reservation for lunch, which doesn't seem very typical but it makes sense after your lunch lasts 3 hours (I might be exaggerating a little but not much). Painfully slow service but I believe that is part of their aesthetic. I would highly recommend taking someone you'd love to talk to for hours; mom, best friend, grandma, or long lost friend you need to do some catching up with. I personally love talking so no problem. I enjoyed spending part of my afternoon on their patio, with the company of good friends. But I would by no means take one of my impatient male friends or family (no offense guys but you like things prompt and don't cherish gossip the way we women do).

But oh the prices. The menu is short and sweet but everything seems very steep. I had the mushroom soup and liked it but expected something amazing. The cake was pretty incredible though. I would go back solely for that carrot cake. I don't even care how much it costs.

All of that being said, I will totally return and hopefully soon to see their Christmas decorations!

Holy hell this place is delicious.  A friend recommended this place for lunch the last time I was in town.  I'm not normally huge on Cajun/Creole food.  I like it, but its one of those types of food I have to be in the mood for.  However the food here is incredible.  We walked in and I told the person at the register that I like spicy and I'm not big on seafood.  He suggested the jambalya.  They will even offer you a sample.  And it was without a doubt the best jambalya I've ever tasted.  I'm actually pondering a trip back to Indy just so I can taste it again.  The bread they serve it with is good too but I didn't eat much of it because I was so focused on my entree.  The place is very reasonable and the portions are huge!  I had enough leftover for another meal.  I highly recommend this place and can't wait to go back and eat there again.
The triathlon burger was awesome.  I loved that there was more than just one vegetarian option on the menu.  And the truffle fries?  HELL YES.  This is a must-eat for burgers in Nashville!

Do not leave out-going packages with the front desk! I left two of my packages for shipment and now they're missing. These items were for return, so now I'm out the return money and the items.
The front desk said they accept all outgoing packages, when I specifically asked UPS, USPS, and Fed-Ex. I contacted management with this issue, to which they replied that they're investigating it.
After another attempt to get information, management referred to the lease on how they're not liable for any items left with the landlord, yet their front desk staff accepted the packages? Additionally, management said "Tower Place will accept returns, we are not a UPS/FEX-EX/Amazon etc drop off". However, there is no information in the lease regarding this. They said they'd reach out to me the next day... it's been three weeks and I haven't heard anything along with no updates on the UPS tracking or return site. 
Please be cautious of the disconnect between what the staff tells you, what procedures are actually conducted, and the lease because you won't get answers or be compensated.
I'm a new tenant and so far enjoyed the apartment however I'm extremely frustrated by the way this was handled. I will not be utilizing this "service" in the future.

People who leave reviews tend to be negative, right? Whoever noticed that is on to something because a terrible experience gave me the energy to want to write one. 

Grain exchange has had food issues in the past and was closed for a while due to health inspection failures. While we didn't have any health issues (yet), I will say I can't see myself going back.

This was my third time at grain exchange. My appetizer of fried Gouda and my hot hot hot burger, which I asked to be cooked medium, were both charred to a blackened crisp, and essentially tasted identical. My wife got chicken on her sandwich instead of a burger (you have to option on the burger menu) and had no major complaints other than the Gouda appetizer and slow service (see below). I got a side salad and my wife got sweet potato fries as sides to our main dishes. Both were solid. 

Beers were cold when they finally got to us but it seemed the bar tender and waitress were the only two employees in the place on an i assume, uncommonly busy Monday night. There was a delay between first and second drinks and ultimately between our drinks and order and order and final check. If I'm in mt airy, I'm going to earth bread or going further into chestnut hill until this place either fixes itself (doubtful based on the deli they lost up the street) or becomes something else.

We just sat in the this place for 20 minutes! Not one person came to our table to offer service! No one! It's not even busy right now. We're leaving and will never be back! Service is everything and this was awful!
This place is a new favorite after only one visit! I had the beef bulgogi and it was perfect! The Thai tea was just right and the service was A1. I will definitely go back soon.

Amazing pizza and salads! Super fresh and I couldn't believe how tasty the food was.  At most places a beet salad has a few small pieces. At Lulus my salad was loaded with beets which made my day! Also super friendly staff!!

What a historical landmark. I had the cinnamon pancakes, real apple smoked bacon, and oh damn those awesome hashbrowns. Expect a wait come hungry and enjoy the GREAT FOOD, atmosphere, service, and the cleanliness. 
After you eat it's time for a knap. Stop by enjoy the best breakfast Nashville has to offer.
What a great place to have a baby! We had a wonderful birth experience here, and loved the prenatal care we received. The staff is very caring and understanding.

Booked the Spa Suite ($220 normal, $160 if you book in advance)
3pm check in, 11am check out 

Pro:
1. A private hot tub in your room 
2. Nice detail art and trims in the room
3. Fancy sony tv, no cheap brand tv
4. Friendly staff during check in. My room wasn't ready but they send me text message when it's ready
5. Nice temperature control, isn't loud when I had the AC on

Con:
1. No vent in the bathroom 
2. Pillows, there were only 2 size, flat or fluffy pillows you get from a sofa. My neck was killing me. For a king size bed, I would think you get more pillows. 
3. Shower floor and hot tub is surrounded by  marble. I almost slipped a few times. Nice but dangerous
4. Shower head, either get heavy pressure of water that hurts or water spraying everywhere. 
5. Fridge, I couldn't put anything in there. Hotel loading it up with drinks. They have a scale where if you pick something up, BANG! You get charged. I had to cool my personal drink with their small ice bucket
6. They also have a scale full of snacks. Right in front of the tv where if you touch it, BANG! You get charged. 
7. For a spa suite, there were NO robes. Kind of disappointing. 

Overall, I enjoyed the hot tub the most. There were a lot people at the pool and spa at the hotel can add up. No hotel is perfect but I did enjoy my night.
The webpage doesn't give much about the servives offered, I would suggest to try their free week and decide for yourself.

Excellent food options, good BBQ but the service could use some adjusting. I noticed a few of the sub-par reviews indicated some issues with service overall. Slow to seat, issues with getting correct orders, etc. The food ratings, on the other hand, seemed to be much better. So I gave it a try.

Walked in and was seated right away. Nice. Seated in the center of the restaurant and learned it was part of the bar area, so our server was the bartender. It did take some time for introductions and drink orders. To be fair, he was a very nice guy and was helpful through the rest of the meal. I used my Yelp app to order a free appetizer- went with the nachos and they were delicious. Big fan, would order again. When our sweet teas arrived, they were actually unsweetened- and it took some time to get that right.

There are daily dinner specials- our visit was meatloaf. I ordered the brisket sandwich with baked beans and mac n cheese. Someone else at the table ordered the meatloaf special, while another went with the smoked turkey sandwich. Our meals arrived timely. The meatloaf was barely room temperature, bummer (but tasted good). My brisket was excellent and there was a lot of it. The sides were excellent- those beans. Damn. Extra sweet so if that's your thing then don't skip them when ordering your sides. Mac n cheese was run of the mill, nothing special. 

There are about 4 house BBQ sauces to try: Sweet, Hot, Tangy, and one other (the label was unreadable but it was another sweeter glaze). All of the sauces were very good and tasty. I was squirting each bite with a different sauce or a mix of several sauces. I was told that the turkey was flavorful and moist. Looked pretty good to me.

There's a full bar to enjoy, along with a happy hour. The place inside was pretty cool- looked like an old service building converted into a restaurant- love that kinda stuff. There's a really good sized patio our front with great lighting- a perfect place to enjoy some 'que on a nice weather day/evening. The place sits off an old train track and seems to be surrounded by peaceful non-commercial area, a nice touch when seated outside. 

Overall Hendricks is great. Aside from a few mishaps that weren't really a big deal in the grand scheme of things- the food was tasty, the atmosphere was fun, and there are many choices for hungry diners. We didn't explore the desert menu but it looked pretty impressive as well. 

I'll be back!

Food=ok, debately below par for the price. Service=don't bring a date or anyone important. This place just opened. I'd wait to try this place in late summer 2017. 

First, the guacamole was ok, but the avocados were not ripe yet; hence the guac was a bright neon green. Lol. Second, the service... it's as if they WANTED a bad review.

We ordered two entrees (two people), but when the server brought us the food, she said they "ran out" of the other entree. (How?! They just opened 3 hours earlier and were not that busy. Lol). Instead of apologizing and bring the menu over, she said non-chalently "If you want more food, I can bring the menu over."  Again, lol. It was comically bad form. There were a host of other service issues not worth mentioning.

To top it off, perhaps the first time ever, I asked to speak with a manager (young guy) before leaving. After recounting the above events, he said, also non-chalently, that they just opened and that no amount of preparation is enough. Fair point, but why not also simply apologize or pretend to sound apologetic? Strange. 

This place will hopefully be solid by late summer, 2017. Until then, manage your expectations. As their young manager emphasized, they just opened and are not fully prepared.

Used Priority Pass here for a drink last year, service was fine. But it seems like starting October 1, 2019, they stopped accepting priority passes (also confirmed on the priority pass website). There's really no reason to come here now. The food is meh.

The Aussie coffee scene has made its way to suburban Philly (via NYC)! There aren't too many coffee shop options out here besides Starbucks and Saxbys, so I was eager to try out this recent Bluestone outpost despite it being card only (is that legal in PA?).

It's a smallish, sleek-looking counter in the Savor food court (aka the fancy food spot in the fancy new part of KOP). The guy at the register was super patient while I asked him many questions about the different drinks. I was tempted by the golden latte (turmeric, ginger, and cayenne), beet latte (dehydrated beets with cocoa), or chai (made w/ a boxed concentrate) -- but opted for the matcha latte with almond milk. It was pricey even for matcha ($5 for 8 oz), but very creamy and full of matcha flavor without too much bitterness (relatively unsweetened too, which is my cup of tea but may not be yours).

I also got a small gluten free zucchini loaf ($4), which was full of shredded veggies and walnuts, but really wet and didn't have much flavor. Still, they had a few GF bakery options, which I could appreciate.

Next time, a flat white!

I have ordered from here a few times. I'll admit initially it was mostly out of convenience as there is nothing else near by, but I actually really like their food. Everything I have ordered has been enjoyable. The prices are very reasonable and the service is very quick (less than 15 minutes usually). Definitely a great place to check out if you live in the area.

I went from damaged bleached and kitty crushed hair to Rockin Blondie! I know it was a challenge but I thank you from the bottom of my heart
Makai
Ps thank you for knowing the color levels in bleaching and yellow is not white! Great job!

Ricky at Carpinteria Lock and Key is a gem.  He made a key for my 2015 Toyota for almost half what the dealership would have charged me for the same key.  He was friendly, fast and really knows his stuff.  He also made another key for the car at no charge that will unlock just the door just in case.  Bypass the dealership and head to Carpinteria Lock and Key.
The customer service was amazing. Very friendly and helpful workers!! The food was delicious!!! We will be back SOON!!!

We were a party if 7 and JF no problem being seated right away. We had just about everything! Sushi - apps - saki - noodles etc...and each thing was better than the next. Service was prompt and good. Food was fresh and delicious. We will definitely be going back & would highly recommend Umi to everyone.

My family and I had a really lovely experience today.   We were a larger party with boisterous kids and we were treated like dignitaries.   When I made my reservation I did warn the person I spoke to about that, so they seated us downstairs, which was a good call.  All of the food was fantastic, loved the deviled eggs, and the hot chips.  My heath conscious mother that will usually pass up every cheesey/fried food devoured those chips.  I have never seen her eat so many chips in my life.  The kids loved the kids menu and ice cream.  My Dad might have had the burger, but he ate it so fast I didn't even see it on his plate.  It's always challenging to go out to eat with an extended family like this, and The Hattery made it such a great experience. 

I can't wait to go back for some grown-ups only cocktail time.

This place is AMAZING! Tucson needed a cool brunch spot and this is it. We went for carry out this morning and the pastries were phenomenal! The menu looked amazing as well. Can't wait to go back next weekend and try the duck confit hash. This morning we got "doughsants" (a rendition of the popular "cronut" - half donut half croissant) - they definitely gave that NYC pastry chef a run for his money.

While on travel, my coworkers and I decided to stop by for some teppanyaki and had a blast! The food was delicious and you get a ton of food for the price! Their steak was tender and super juicy and the rice was soooo delicious!! We had the pineapple sake which was also really good and smooth, not super strong! 

We will definitely go back when in Nashville!

Harrison is an incredible artist! I have three pieces of his work on me and have plans for more. He also did my first tattoo and has made each session enjoyable. He's a nice guy and super easy to talk to which makes the whole process less stressful. He's the only artist that has offered to buy me coffee and even bought me a burrito when the nice burrito lady came by! (5 stars for her food as well)

The shop is clean and everyone is very welcoming and has no issue answering questions. I highly recommend Black Rose on 4th to everyone!

I first heard about this pace from a gentleman I met on a airplane ride into St. Louis. Well, I finally tried it today and was not disappointed. I got the famous concrete block strawberry flavor. Best ice cream I've had in a while. Please try this place out if you're ever in St. Louis.

Our wedding was about 120 people and the University Club was the perfect size for our wedding reception.  We held the ceremony at a beautiful park just 2 blocks away, which made the reception site easy walking distance.  We loved the classic charm of the University Club and also liked that there was an outdoor area for cocktails, before the dinner and dancing inside.  Another bonus was having the tables, chairs, food and drink, all set up and taken care of by the venue.  Chrissy was easy to work with and organized during our preparation leading up to the event.  It gave us confidence that everything would work out well, and it did.  It's a great venue if you want your reception in a downtown SB location!
Fantastic coffee every time I've gone, the staff is always super friendly and seem very down to earth  love this place!
Brought some out of town friends there and everyone loved it. Had the BBQ shrimp! Wonderful stuff! Couldn't get enough of the sauce!! Little pricey, but that was expected. Will definately be back!
What a gem. I was able to come here to listen to some live jazz and will gladly go again.
Discovered this place via tiktok and it did not disappoint! Very upscale furniture store with absolutely gorgeous designs. So inspired by all the layouts and different styles across all 4 floors!

In Nashville for the weekend and went to almost every bar to find the best Lemon drop. Hands down the best one here at Casa Rosa in the upstairs bar made by Chris!!! Absolutely the best one in the trip!!

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed living in our apartment at Landmark! The grounds were always well manicured, maintenance was fast and efficient, snow removal and salting of the sidewalks was always done early in the mornings during the winter, and it was very quiet and enjoyable! Our utilities were reasonable for our apartment space and Stephanie and the other girls in the office were great to work with! We lived there for two years and were sad to leave! We would definitely recommend living here!

The Narrative Loft, besides the fact that it is an amazing venue, have really great people taking care of it. Michelle worked with my team and was very understandable with everything. I say understandable because we are all international students who were, for the first time, planning an event. She was patient and always replied to our email as soon as she could and always made time to meet with us. People at the event loved the place and we were just so glad to have had the amazing opportunity of working with The Narrative Loft team.

always messy. mostly rude staff. today i came in just looking and the woman helping was very sweet. i got a dog toy that had the wrong label, so the toy was $8 more than it was marked. the woman helping me seemed newer and she asked another lady who seemed like the manager and she was SO rude to her. like the original lady was asking how to check the price and the manager lady was like "this. that's the only way." in a rude "how didn't u know this you're inconveniencing me" tone. then i asked if they take a military discount after the manager ladt walked away, and she shouted across the registers "NOPE." like onfg u don't have to be rude i was asking. way to ruin a good mood.
Rude. Just absolutely rude.  It's sad to see hospitality take a back seat. Walked out without even ordering.

I like this location lots!! I have great time here and always get food I likes. The worker so happy and have a beauty look on their faces every time and it's so sweet and makes me pleased. I love to talk with them because I live by self and see them and gives me good conversation? Usually I am alone so it is nice to see them happy for me!! I put a photo of my favorite dish I get. It's yummy in my tummy and I like it so much delicious!! Love Goleta here and love panda so!!!

My experience is very unique and probably more on it being my first time at this restaurant looking for a after work snack.  I order the Tzatziki /Pita appetizer, and Shrimped skewer which I learned at its presentation included more tzatziki and pita lol .  After receiving the dishes I asked my waitress if that was the normal presentation for the shrimp skewer and I was informed it was.  I made a comment that it would've been nice when I ordered both dishes; if she might have mentioned it would result in double tzatziki/pita.  

I would have been able to change my order to incorporate a different dish and not have duplicated.  She was quite receptive and notify the manager immediately which case he came to the table and offered an apology with a credit to my check adjusting the duplicate.  We then discussed dessert and I asked what was homemade and he mentioned that a local bakery makes the baklava cheesecake w walnuts for them and it was his favorite.  I decided to take his advice and I was not disappointed presentation was beautiful!!  Definitely turned my evening around !  Wow Thank you Dio for coming through with top notch service.

One of the worst meals I've ever had anywhere! Mediocre service, at best. Brisket was fatty. Pork steak was excessively fatty. Food was tepid. Served a grand total of 3 onion rings for $6. Not a bad deal for the restaurant. Save your $$. Salt and smoke is just down street. They will  treat you right. Forget Hendricks nightmare!!

We visited Convivio for a date dinner, sans kids. It was the perfect place to enjoy a glass of wine and eat good Italian food. 

I know the specialty at Convivio is fresh, house-made pasta, but I couldn't stop myself from ordering a calzone instead, and I'm glad I did because it was delicious. It was also huge. Between it, a Caesar salad, the complimentary bread and the generous glass of wine, I could only eat half of the calzone and I took the rest home. Speaking of wine, they have a nice Barbera d'Asti here, so I recommend you get a glass.

We visited around 4 on a weekend, and there were only a couple other people in the restaurant besides us, so it was quiet and nice.

10am appointment, to come to a closed shop at 10:03, waited till 10:20 still a no show. I think the reviews are "plushed" by family and friends. Very unprofessional business. Booking the appointment was super sketchy, and disorganized.

All starts with the front desk. When I called she was very nice and worked with me. Scheduling wasn't an issue and got in within a week. On my arrival, I we greeted by a nice staff. Moved right in, had my X-rays, then had teeth cleaned and spoke with dentist. Super fast. Super helpful. Sweet and caring staff. I really highly recommend!
Place has very tasty lunch specials the yellow chicken curry is amazing. They have spring rolls but you do only get too. The martini was okay not sweet enough for me though

This is the place to go! Only good vibes here, with lots of classes, warm-hearted students, and awesome teachers!! You can also schedule a massage, and be on the lookout for cool workshops! Yes!! It's an all-around good gig! :)

I researched on line and local printers and found that Fast Color Printer could make rack cards for our non-profit club for about 1/3 of the lowest price I found.  Initially their representative, Haily, was very aggressive with emails and calling me to place an order even though I explained I needed to get committee approval, which might take a while.  (Having my own small business I realize the necessity to follow through immediately with a potential buyer.)  At this point she backed off and only sent me occasional e-mail reminders.

Once I received committee approval and started the design process, Haily, was always available to answer my design and uploading questions via email or over the phone.  She made some excellent suggestions and took me through the process of submitting my design (I can be a bit cranklie-danklie when I don't understand the computer lingo).  Then....just before I submitted my payment .....I checked the internet reviews for Fast Color Printer and got afraid...I got VERY, VERY afraid!  However, as I said, I too own a small business and while I verbally receive hundreds of positive comments; I do on occasion receive a negative internet review.  I feel that people are 10 times more likely to write a review if they have had a negative experience and will often not bother to write a review if their experience was as expected or even above expectations.  It's those internet reviews that can break your business and make potential future customers take flight.  So having come this far, I rechecked my proof and made a copy of it for my records.  I then held my breath and ordered 5000 rack cards. 

I received the boxes of rack cards in less than a week and immediately opened them......they were......FANTASTIC!  They had beautiful two sided color printing, excellent boarder spacing, a glossy professional finish and a sturdy card rack paper weight.  I will definitely reorder from this company again and will also use them in the future for my small business printing needs.

This Country Inn & Suites can be found right in front of a parking lot designated for airport parking. Being that the Tucson airport is located very, very close, you may hear a few planes overhead (I was woken up by one a few times around 7 am).

This hotel is pet friendly, which allows 2 pets up to 25 lbs for $25 per pet, per night. Complimentary breakfast is available Monday- Friday 6- 9:30 am and weekends/ holidays 7- 10:30 am. Breakfast includes hot food, pastries, waffles, various juices, coffee/ tea, cold cereal, milk, instant oatmeal packets and (cold) hard boiled eggs. Oranges and apples area available in the lobby for all guests.

My husband, our little girl dog and I stayed here for 3 nights. We checked in this past Saturday evening around 11:30 pm. We were initially not planning on checking in until Sunday but unfortunately our AirBnB in Phoenix had cancelled on us and so we decided to just keep on driving to Tucson after briefly visiting my sister in law in Phoenix.

When we arrived, we were greeted and assisted by a friendly employee at the front desk. I made my reservation through hotels.com and I happen to be a VIP gold member and so I was greeted with 2 bags of snacks and a bottle of wine (which had mentioned this when I had made the reservation. And because I had 2 separate reservations for this stay, I got 2 bottles of wine). After that, we headed to our room, unpacked and went to sleep.

During our stay, my husband, our little girl and I enjoyed the breakfast with various hot food items (different food items on different days) which included a breakfast sandwich that had egg, sausage and cheese on a croissant, tater tots (yep as potato for breakfast), French toast, cheese omelet, potato with onions and bell peppers. Hot food items are already made and wrapped in tin foil when you go to the kitchen/ breakfast area on the first floor. You are welcomed to get other food items as well and then head up to your room to eat your breakfast since there are no tables and chairs placed out for you to consume your breakfast here.

There were a few things that were a miss during our stay. In the bathroom, for some reason, the outlets did not work so I plugged the hair dryer into one of the outlets by the bed. One of the lights in the bathroom flickered and eventually stopped working, but it was still bright enough in the bathroom. There was another outlet that did not work in the main room. Also the outlets on either side of the bed was blocked by the dresser. I had to move the dress to the side so that I could use it for the hair dryer. And lastly, the WiFi was rather slow at times. I had to do a few zoom meetings (I know it sucks to work on vacation but I can make it work) but ended up using my data from my cell phone as a hot spot so that I would not have spotty connection during those zoom meetings. Oh and of course there is the airplanes that fly by the hotel but I did not find that to be too bad since I had to wake up early anyway but this may be a problem for others. I believe there is a quiet hour that planes aren't supposed to be flying from 11 pm- 7 am or so.

Overall, I had a great stay with this hotel and would stay here again. All the employees that I had interacted with were very nice and friendly.

If you like flea markets and you haven't been to Gilley's out on West Highway 40, past Plainfield, then you really haven't been to a flea market! It looks daily big on the outside, but when you get inside you will find out that it's enormous. You walk and walk and twist and turn. When you think you're done you find another room with more and more aisles with booths and lots of glass cases. I am certain that no matter how much time you spend at Gilley's, there is no way to see everything that's for sale there. I saw beautiful jewelry, a lot of old vintage furniture, all types of jewelry. Some jewelry was valuable, some was just fun. There was old guns, plenty of knives for fishing, hunting, and collecting. Musical instruments? Yes! Those too. Just walk and look. You just might find something special. Come check out Gilley's!! I highly recommend it.

I totally thought this place was going to be a bunch or burgers but I was so wrong! Awesome menu. Very unique. The food was so so good and the customer service was on point. We had the whipped feta, the beets, the kale salad and the gnocchi. All of it was awesome ESPECIALLY the whipped feta! Can't wait to go back. Glad it's so close to my house!

This is a bar but the chef has been here at least 8yrs and knows his stuff. The food is simply well prepared and good product.  Since it advertises bourbon tasting I used to walk but, till the charming hostess Coleen, wanted to make reservations for me I looked at the menu and in no time this place was filled. The greatest surprise was that they offered decent wines by the glass. Shiraz, Zin and Rose sparkling are my favorites.  
One Negative: The live blues is simply too loud, but they do try to accommodate and have them tone down.  My wife and I go out to discuss the day or week and it is very difficult to have a conversation.  They should start these guys after 9pm.

I've been to this restaurant several times and every single time it has been a very positive experience. Heather was our waitperson at least twice and she is attentive, professional, and was quick to ask if we needed anything and fill drinks. I am a firm believer that a meal should be a pleasant experience - every time we have been to this outback it has been :)

I contracted with callahan pool Plastering to replaster my pool, George the salesman sold me on a colored plaster to make the pool look a dark deep blue. I asked him about all the pros and cons and he stated the only con is the pool might fade alittle over time.May be 10 to 15 years


One thing I noticed is that the minute the pool was done being plastered they acid washed it...

After I hired a consultant I come to learn that was a huge mistake

After three months The entire pool has faded, pitted, marbled and over all looks terrible,

George came out twice with some BS story and blamed it on the sun...An act of God and it  was not covered under their warranty, They stopped answering my calls and became hostile and will not help rememidy the situation

STAY clear from this  the company...The original owner has retired and moved to florida..George has no idea how to plaster a pool...He married the owners daughter and has no idea what he is doing...He stole my eleven thousand dollars
Food gave us both diahrea 15 minutes after eating. Yellow curry tofu and spicy noodles tofu. We shared and something was bad in the food. This was our first and last time dining there

Heard a lot about Mac Mart over the past few years, so a friend and I stopped in for lunch today; and it was A-OK.

You can see that this is a small place, so seating is very limited to about 6 people inside and 6 people outside (when the weather is nice). 

Everything on the menu is built around a sandwich-sized plastic container of mac & cheese. How others write that they get 2 meals out of this, is beyond me; but my tummy was nearly satisfied by the sized dish that it is.

You have a number of interesting entree choices, based upon the combination of meats, veggies, dressings and other assorted toppings.

I went with one of the more meaty options - the Wit Mac: mac & cheese with shredded steak, caramelized onions, potato chip pano crunch, and a ketchup drizzle.

The meat and toppings were delicious, as was the mac & cheese base, but a little too sparse of the meat for my preference. One could also add meats to their dish for additional price, or create a bowl by choosing their own toppings.

Like others have said, the macaroni was served al dente - with a nice firm texture, rather than overcooked and falling apart into mush. So the macaroni is perfect. And the seven-cheese sauce was great also.

The fountain drink choices were quite limited - pepsi, ginger ale, root beer, some super-sweet cherry drink, and something else I forget. But you could also get a bottled water or other container drink.

The Wit Mac plus fountain drink was a pricey $13.50.

Mac Mart is great for what it is, and for those who love to get their mac & cheese fix in a quick way.
Terrible customer service. Only wanted to give excuses not fix the problem.

Fantastic breakfast !! Great service and they even had flavored creamers for the coffee (shouldn't everyplace by now) i couldn't decide so I ordered blueberry pancakes and the Heuvos Rancheros.  

Pancakes were light fluffy and filled with blueberries. Great texture and flavor 

The rancheros were a 9 out of 10.  The view here across the bay adds to the experience.  A must try when in Sand Key.

My spouse and I came here on a weekend night to have a few drinks. We wanted to go to the rooftop to enjoy the view , it was a great view from up there. We stayed for a while and danced a bit too. Not too crowded like I thought it would be, maybe we got lucky that night :D
Had some problems upfront with hostess, but she did her best to resolve the issue and everything was worked out. Food was just average. Not bad at all- just nothing particularly special.

5 stars for food! 5 stars for ambience! 5 stars for my waiter Billy! It was my first time coming to First Watch and I had the avocado toast. It was the best I've had + the perfect portion. Our waiter Billy was friendly, outgoing and kind! So I recommend coming here and visiting my friend Billy!
Owner gave me a great deal. Would recommend this place to anyone who is looking for high quality suits.

Philadelphia Marriott old city is a beautiful hotel. I wish I would've taken pictures of the lobby. I see there are plenty in other yelp reviews though. The hotel is conveniently located right near 2nd Street in Old City. There are plenty of bars and restaurants within walking distance. Many of the historical attractions are also within a few blocks. 

The rooms are very nice bright and comfortable. It seems as if the hotel was renovated recently. The showers are quite large and have double shower heads.  We had a king bed which was very comfortable. 

I think the hours of the bar and coffee shop are limited due to covid, but that's understandable.

Caution to those with allergies... The pillows are down feather. I had a bad experience once in another hotel so I proactively check before I go to sleep. I called down to the front desk and asked for different pillows. Housekeeping was not available but the security on staff quickly delivered new pillows to me. All of the staff were very friendly and accommodating.

The only downside to this hotel is the price of parking. It cost us $50 to park our car overnight.  This is a bit steep in my opinion. There are a few parking garages nearby that you could probably grab for about $25.

It is a Marriott hotel so it is not one of the least expensive you can get, but it is definitely worth it for the convenient location and nice rooms.

I was in the area with my sister, my bro-in-law and the bf to look at marble for a kitchen island.  Unfortunately, everything was closed on Sundays.  So when I saw Kermit's, we decided to check it out so our trip wasn't completely wasted.   

I got an everything bagel with plain cream cheese and my sister got the plain bagel with scallion cream cheese.  The bf got some coffee and a slice of cheese pizza.   While the bagels were just okay (NY bagels are incomparable!), the scallion cream cheese was very flavorful.  The pizza was delicious!  I can see why people are raving about Kermit's pizza.  That's the only reason to come here.

We also got the yo shorty cake, which was some almond cake with a weirddddddd raspberry cream in the middle and mousse and a strawberry glaze.  It was beyond gross!  No one could eat it at my house.  The raspberry in the inside of the cake was rotten or something.  We also got a vanilla cream puff for my mother.  She hated it.  The texture of the cream was super thick and sticky.

Pizza, yes!
Desserts, no..

Two stars for the gross aftertaste that cake left in my mouth

I am a local business manager in Manayunk, just outside of Germantown. 

I attempted to call a cab for a customer at 1am. By this time, buses had stopped running and they were short on options. 

When I told the Germantown cab operator where my business was and the destination the customer was going to, she replied "We don't do that". Keep in mind, that my business and the destination are both within 10 minutes of Germantown. 

The business card for Germantown Cab clearly states "local and long distance". I really don't understand what the problem was. 

She knew that I represented a local business, which I thought would demand a bit of professional courtesy. That wasn't the case so I'll be looking for a new cab company to direct all my customers to.

I finally made it! That didn't dissuade me from ordering it; glad I did because they were very tasty.  The spice was significant but I could've handled a 7 or possibly even an 8.  

Of course, I had the dan dan noodles as well.  There's nothing I can add to what other Yelpers have said other than it's a definite "must get".  This comes with a default spice level of 7 but, just as with the cucumbers, I could've stood even more.

Silly me, dining solo I was unaware of the portion size so my initial thought to follow those orders with an entree went straight out the window.  But there's always next time.

If the female who takes your order over the phone learned to say thank you, that would be nice. She seems to actually WAIT for me to say thank you which I usually do. This time I didn't and she just hung up without saying anything......nice!! We are longterm customers but will find another pizza shop.
Went today and I'm so happy with my nails!! Amy did amazing  and I will definitely be coming back here :)

Very tasty food from a very unexpected good place! The owners are very friendly and helpful. I got the catfish sandwich and it was first class all the way..lettuce, tomato and home made fries. My wife had shrimp casadilla (sp?) and it was very good as well. We got a dozen steamed crabs and they were slightly undercooked and too soft and mushy inside. The seasonings are put on the crabs as they steam but it did not get enough inside and the meat was kinda bland and not as tasty to us. We regularly order steamed crabs from Maryland and they are much better than these were. We will go back and try again...it was that close. The owner lady gave us some homemade peach cobbler and it was excellent. Overall a 9 out of 10 and the friendliness of the owners will bring us back in.
Great spot in the midst of downtown. Service was fast and food was amazing. We would come back just for the Burrata & Fig alone. Highly Recommend!

If you have every been to one of those old juke joints from "back in the day" then you would feel right at home at Barber's. If you ever want to KNOW what those places were like then you have found your place!

If you are looking for oohhhh so cheap liquor. Head on down
If you are looking for great customer service. Get the hell outta here
If you are looking for down home good greasy cooking. Head on down
If you are looking for room to move. Get the hell outta here
If you...Forget all that, All i have to say is $1 shots on Wednesday


and I'm out
Cute little shop in old town Zionsville with the absolute best pies in Central Indiana.  Sugar Cream pie is heavenly!  Pricey, but oh so worth it!

Having backed into our garage door we needed to replace the damaged one. I called Banko and they were out in a few days. The new door is awesome and so were the techs who took the old one down and put the new one up. I couldn't be happier, well if I didn't wreck my old one I'd be happier.
Very happy, thanks.

Epic Mother's Day fail!
If I could give a negative 5 star review I would!  Placed an order on Wednesday for a very pricey edible arrangement.  Wanted it for Sunday (Mother's Day) but no...had to accept Saturday or nothing.  They took the money immediately.  No delivery arrived on Saturday.  No explanation, no email, no call, NOTHING!  Sunday, I call my 88 year old mother and learn she received NOTHING but my card that I sent via USPS.   Immediately called the number they provide but got an answering machine instead of a person. Just for the Fingalickingood garlic sauce...we'll return! It's amazing. Ordered the fries w/shrimp, crab and this delicious sauce. Yum! Used it with the wings, too. Double yum! Looking forward to trying more off the menu. Great service, too.

We come to Edwardsville yearly and always stay at Holiday Inn Express. We noticed a new Barbecue restaurant which we tried for dinner bc we love barbecued ribs. What a disappointment. The ribs were so tough that it was impossible to cut them apart with the plastic utensils we were given. When an employee came by we asked if these were the Baby back ribs and after carefully looking at my plate he said yes. I wish I had read some of the reviews before we went.

Soooo our pharmacist told us the line would go fast. It did not. We ordered a concrete and it was all runny. No one handed it to us upside down because of they did it would have all fallen out. Now the taste was good, I'll give it that but man, it's called a concrete...why couldn't our ice cream have been harder. My husband described it as a Wendy's frosty.

This is our go to place. They have remodeled the place, is clean and we enjoy the sushi. We have never had an issue quality of fish. We like the appetizers they are good. Service is usually fairly quick. Friendly servers.

Of course no place is entirely perfect, but Pima Canyon has been a great place to live and I've had no real complaints. I lived there from Sep 2018 - June 2020.

Pros - It's a quiet complex and generally people keep to themselves but are friendly. It's still very new (the oldest apartment quadrant first built wasn't more than 3 years ago, and the SW quadrant is only a year old) and I was the first person to live in my unit. Originally it was owned/managed by MEB, but it was sold to Northland in 2019. Naturally rents were going to be raised from the initial move-in promo offers, but the increases are reasonable considering the area and what older complexes nearby are charging. The office and maintenance staff members have been great and helpful. I think in my entire time there, I only submitted 1 ticket for a bent/broken oven door hinge that was replaced. The water billing charge was a low, flat rate. Electricity charges are also very reasonable even when running AC 24/7 in the summer - I don't think I ever had to pay more than $80-85 in a month to TEP. I also appreciated how minimal the move-out cleaning charge was, because corporate apartments generally love to price gouge and nitpick to keep your deposit. BTW, the deposit required to move in was very low too. There are a good number of dog owners but generally they are all responsible and pick up after their pets with the exception of just a slight few. The office monitors that and does their best to enforce people following the rules too. There are multiple dog waste/bag stations and dumpsters on the property, so there is really no excuse to be a lazy dog owner, but in a big complex, you'll always have a few. Parking is easy (plenty for visitors too), plus it's covered which is nice. One underrated aspect of the apts is the huge amount of closet space!  Even in the single bedroom 684 sq foot apts, there's a walk-in closet for the bedroom with shelves, plenty of shelving above the W+D in their closet, lots of shelving in the living room closet, and a large shelved pantry closet in the kitchen and also an outdoor patio closet. You can store a lot of stuff - I forgot just how much I had until I moved out! I also really liked the countertop space - it goes well with a barstool chair. The walls/insulation are thick enough that you won't hear your neighbors' every action or words.

Cons - very few. If you're out of town or staying elsewhere overnight, be careful about having packages delivered directly to your door. I had an $8 package stolen once and my neighbor had a large $300 package stolen (they were gone for a week and it was a surprise gift sent by a friend) from the doorstep. I don't consider this to be the fault of the apt complex at all; it's Tucson and property theft is high almost anywhere. There's nothing they can do to stop people from off the street from getting into the complex (hopping the fence or piggybacking through the car gate ) and it's not realistic to expect a security patrol all night. I believe this was more of an isolated thing done by shady characters in the middle of the night while people are asleep. But don't think that happens habitually - I've taken my dog out plenty of nights at 2 am and there's nobody walking around. It's a pretty safe and quiet complex. It's just big, but I have never personally witnessed anyone casing the joint who seemed out of place. The area has very few pedestrians and hardly any sidewalk so there are not people habitually walking around or coming in. It's quite close to a lot of shopping and restaurants in Oro Valley just up Oracle.  

Also, originally MEB only communicated things via paper notices on doors. However, Northland since taking over has done a good job of communicating now via emails and texts and they do more little things to show residents appreciation, such as a COVID-19 home quarantine gift/care package with popcorn and soda when this all started back in March. Their online portal works well and online payments are a breeze.

I definitely recommend Pima Canyon as a great place to live in Tucson!

I believe that many women, like myself, want a natural birth in a comfortable setting with midwives to help their baby into the world. A water birth sounds so magical! And if you are lucky enough to have this experience, I'm sure the Birth Center is a great option. The women at the front desk are incredibly kind. Most of the midwives are wonderful and will make you feel like everything is going great. But sometimes it doesn't go that way. Sometimes, perhaps even most of the time, issues come up in pregnancy and delivery that require the medical expertise of a doctor or even a maternal fetal medicine specialist. If this is the case for you, please transfer your care immediately to a medical doctor. Midwives are wonderful and can be the perfect choice for a low risk birth, but even if you are perfectly healthy, pregnancy can go from low risk to high risk in an instant, and high risk is not what midwives are trained to do. In my experience, I wish I would have transferred care sooner to a medical doctor. I fully believe that my labor would have gone more smoothly, my baby would not have been subjected to as much trauma during delivery, and I would have been treated sooner for high blood pressure issues that a doctor would have noticed several months earlier, which resulted in an extended hospital stay after delivery. Please, if you choose to go to the birth center, watch your blood pressure, look out for issues that the midwives may tell you are not a big deal, but may actually be a sign of something serious. Everyone, including the midwives, wants you to have a beautiful uncomplicated birth, but don't let their kind words fool you into thinking that's where your headed if your symptoms say otherwise. And please, even if you are in labor, pushing, and something doesn't seem right, ask for a doctor to be brought in. Do not let things go south just because you want to trust your midwife. If something seems wrong, trust your instincts. I am thankful that everything with my birth experience turned out fine in the end, but I will not be returning to El Rio. I fully believe that things would have gone much smoother if I had asked for my care to be transferred to a medical doctor  sooner.

I've been here a lot. I bring my family here. I bring my friends here. Being Taiwanese, I feel that real Taiwanese offerings are pretty scarce in Philadelphia (hint hint, someone open up a new Taiwanese joint already sheesh!). Sometimes I crave the food that you can just pick up from some random street cart in Taipei. Anyway, so I scoured the internet for Taiwanese places in Philadelphia, and if anyone has another suggestion for one, please let me know. That's how I stumbled across Empress Garden a couple years ago. I've been going fairly regularly since.

They've recently remodeled, and the restaurant actually looks much nicer (although I was sad when they were closed for remodeling). There are a few staples I always get:

- Scallion pancakes - Even though the ones here aren't really super authentic, they're just really good! They're deep fried, and that fish and vinegar sauce it comes with is really good. I usually get two orders, and if I'm sharing with friends I secretly hog it. 

- 3 Cups Chicken - This dish should have the bone in (for flavor), basil, ginger, and that sweet sticky soy sauce. This is really quite addicting. The flavors are perfect in combination.

- Fried pork chop - The ones here are very juicy and have a crispy outside. 

- Jah Jang Mein - It's Taiwanese style, so for the Koreans out there, don't expect zucchini and black tarry sauce. It's savory, meaty, flavorful, and really hits the spot. I'm not sure if the noodles are house made, but they definitely have that chewy spring to them (for those who know what I'm talking about, very "Q").

- Beef noodle soup - This also has that authentic Taiwanese developed flavor. Again, the noodles are so good here.

They also do offer a lot of Taiwanese street foods including oyster pancake, Taiwanese meatball with glutinous rice wrap ("bah wan"), and other tasty offerings.

Finally, if you don't speak Chinese, can't read it, or don't have a Chinese friend to bring with you to the restaurant, choose something off the above list. There are 2 menus here, the English menu and the Chinese menu (which has more of the authentic tasty food). I would hate for you to come here and end up with General Tso's chicken.

My search for the best Korean pork stir fry ends here! This place is amazing. I only ordered my food items to go (twice in one week!) and I thought it was absolutely great. I can't wait to actually sit down and enjoy a meal there.

The first time coming here, I was greeted right away with smiles. It was half hour before closing and they were still all smiles! Normally, when I do go to places that are about to close, I get these nasty stares and eyes rolling. It was a nice surprise to get genuine kindness. Wife and I ordered a few dishes:

Pork stir fry: Absolutely amazing. The pork was not fatty at all and had the perfect amount of heat. They put the right amount of veggies in it which didn't overpower the pork itself. Normally, at other places, I get tons of veggies and a few measy pieces of pork that is all fat. Barf! And, another plus is that they give you a good portion too. I was able to have two meals out of the pork. The rice it comes with is awesome! It had beans in it which gave it a nice flavor.

Spicy rice cakes: Mmmm. The rice cakes were cooked to the perfect consistency. And the fish cakes that came with it so delicious

Fish cake soup: This was for my son, but they put tons of fish cakes in it and the broth was very flavorful.

Kimchee chigae: broth was very flavorful, spice level was perfect, kimchee tasted fresh, and loaded with lots of pork as well. :-)

Overall: This is my newest korean spot to go to. It's that good!

From out of town, thought I would try something local and it was listed as "recommended restaurant guru". Ordered food to go and was told it would be 15/20 minutes. 35 minutes later my food was ready. Ordered it medium and it was burnt, overcooked and flavorless. Tennessee fries probably would've been better had I eaten them there but they were super soggy. Asked for a side of ranch, thankfully I noticed it wasn't in the bad before I left. Wouldn't recommend.

If I could leave a 0 I would. They are a scam and rip you off like no other. Cost about $900 to move 9 pieces of furniture 5 miles down the road. They charge you an hour rate to just drive 5 miles. I'll be reporting them to the BBB. They need to be shut down

Very good selection and helpful staff as well. Found what I was looking for and also for some guidance on purchase. Was getting first fish purchase and got a elephant ear female. Staff helped me with collecting all needed items and information of how to take care of fish.

My brother and I visited on sunny weekday morning. We sat outside and enjoyed the spacious set up.  Our server  Emma was very pleasant,  she checked on us and brought  what we needed.  We both enjoyed  Wilbur Skillets and definitely recommend.

I tried out this location a couple of times during my recent visit. It did not disappoint. The beignets were perfectly fluffy and the coffee as tasty as ever! The park setting is nice especially if you have kids. It is also not as crowded as the French Quarter location and parking is more readily available. Recently I had adopted a puppy through matchdog.com who with the adoption of the pet will pay for the spray/neuter of your dog as well as microchip.  This is the hospital they deal with.  

Since my new puppy was seen here before and this is where she needed to go for the spay/neuter and microchip this was my first visit here. 

I will say this. The staff was very accommodating and kind and understanding of my concerns and making sure to make me feel like my fur baby was going to be take. Full care of and be okay.  They contacted me as soon as her survey was complete and gave me the time to come get her and all I needed to know to take care of her.  

I felt very comfortable with the staff and the way they treated her.  I will now make this be her full time vet and will be returning back here.  Even though it's thirty minutes away from my home, I like how they made me feel secure and the kindness that they showed.

I guess it depends when you go and who's working judging by some of the previous reviews. But my experience was great! Haven't been out bowling since pre-pandemic, so I was excited to finally attempt to go out to bowl. There were two workers at the register. Both were friendly and cracked jokes with us! Off to a great start. My friends and I had our own lane socially distanced from other people. Bowling balls of all weights were already conveniently placed at our lane. Overall I would recommend this place!

This weekend is the soft opening of a wonderful new brewery in Lansdale! Well Crafter offers plenty of tables, some bar seats, side bar seating, and even a couple couches.

Flights are 4 beers per flight, and currently they offer a really great selection of saisons, a pale ale, porters, and a Hefeweizen. The beers are all very flavorful, and the staff appears very attentive, friendly, and helpful. At this time, they also offer a few guest beers including two ciders.

The live music brings the place to life, the crowd is lively, and the games give people something to do while hanging out.  I am looking forward to seeing how Well Crafted grows as they have more time to brew here in Lansdale. I really appreciate that they have the space for plenty of people! I'm sure we'll be back sometime in the future to see how they grow.

I would probably give this place 3.5 stars if I could. The only reason I'm not crazy about it was I think that I had high expectations for it from friends and reviews- it was good, but not spectacular. I'm glad I tried it. It is very small and sometimes cramped, the picture on the website makes it seem bigger then it really is.

We started off with Mediterranean Sampler, which was my favorite part. I don't think it's hummus, but whatever the green dipping sauce, it was amazing. It was my favorite part of the whole meal. I would order that and just eat that all night if I could. I got the Pad Thai (which isn't called that on the real menu) and it's good that they changed the name because it's really nothing like Pad Thai, in my opinion. I enjoyed it though. Different flavors and a small spice to it. I don't like my food drenched in a lot of sauces so I think that's what turned me off a bit. 

My boyfriend got the Green Curry Shepherds Pie and we thought it would be more of a solid dish, but it was more of a soup then a pie. He thought it tasted really good and I thought the same. 

Prices are more then I expected, but the portions are really big, a person could probably share a meal and be content with it. I think that since the portions are so big that it's okay to be that price, but it's not worth a second trip back for me. I would def recommend trying it at least once though.

As I drove down Washington avenue, I saw Blondie's currently located in STL to my left and of course I parked and went inside and it was the perfect way to start my day.
