I love the inside It was so cozy. I had been twice so I have sat at the front windows before with the street view which is really cool. It gives you that downtown in the city diner vibes sitting there and the second time I sat in a booth further into the restaurant. There are so many cool sitting spots in the restaurant you'll def have endless options and the staff are so down to earth and super helpful. They made sure my entire order was correct and well cooked and was providing great service it was a really good experience both times. The first photo is pictured directly left as I parked and walked inside as the beginning of the blog begins... & the second photo featured is my lovely meal I had the pleasure of indulging in! I will say this has to be the best banana French toast I ever had it was so good and didn't even need any syrup that's how delish it was and the eggs with cheese oh my gawd lol talk about and to top it off turkey sausage and guys when I say you try syrup on that it will completely change your tastebuds and your life lol. Enjoy comment and share if you're on Wash Ave!

Since we live on the Northside, El Charro North has been our go-to since it opened until it took a nosedive in every area: service, food prep and taste, appearance of restaurant, etc. We visited a new Mexican restaurant close-by which was very disappointing.  We began traveling to the Sunrise El Charro location even though it was a long trip for us.  About four months ago we decided to try "our" El Charro again.  WHAT AN AMAZING TURN AROUND!  The entire atmosphere is inviting.  The wait staff is courteous, very knowledgeable, helpful, and professional.   Servings are generous and food tastes delicious.  In checking, we learned there is a new manager.  Great place to proudly take visitors and enjoy the savory flavors.  They have recently added vegan choices!
Love this cute little blow bar. Everyone was so nice from my initial phone call, to my bottle service, to my blow out. Thank you for awesome blow out.
Pricey for small portions and no bread or salad with dinner.  Have to order separately.  It's Italian, you alway should get bread with dinner!!

There's a reason this place is getting so much recognition. Breakfast, brunch and coffee is like no other. The pastries alone make you wanna smack yo momma. I'm also a fan of latte art and making food not only tasty but pretty, like a work of art. 

This place is mad busy during the weekend so go off hours during the week. 

It's also a great place to people watch. I bring my camera and snap away.

Breathtaking is the word that comes to mind!
Luxury in the French Quarter.  The carousel bar is a must stop.  The experience is just as the name implies the bar actually rotates!
People waa tching at its best!!! Try the signature drink Sazerac small but potent.

My boyfriend and I celebrated our anniversary in Santa Barbara this past weekend. At first, with so many options for wine tours, we were overwhelmed with which tour we wanted to do. We emailed Wine Edventures with our questions and they got back to us so quickly! We ended up doing their "Grapes and Hops" tour and Shawn did not disappoint! We visited three wineries and one brewery. Along with your tour fee, you get a boxed lunch from a local deli, a souvenir wine glass, a winery tour (process from grape to bottle), and fun facts about the area! Shawn was very knowledgable whenever we had questions and was such a great tour guide! He even gave us restaurant suggestions for the rest of our weekend!

The times I've gone here some of the employees have an attitude and talk  about you in Spanish . Which I understand and can speak . Also they always fill my fries half way . If I wanted a smaller size I would have ordered a smaller size . ... So make sure if you go here check your food before you leave

my wife stopped in on Saturday and it was nice due to the corona virus situation they had blue tape outside and in 6ft apart as we got in it was a fast enjoyable shopping employees were nice as usual and the atmosphere was cheerful even though they were out of kombutca it was still nice

I've been here on more than one occasion and I can definitely say that this is my choice of coffee shop in the area! I've had a different drink each time and they've all been spectacular. My favorite recently being the limited La vie en Rose,  which was as beautiful as it was tasty. They also have wonderful and convenient outdoor seating.
Amazing pho in Trenton. A few good veggie choices. Amazing portions. Don't expect a decor or fast service. This is family run operation ... one of the best pho in NJ for me.

I was super impressed by the service here! I just went in to have some house keys I bought online matched and they did an awesome job and were wayyy nicer then the people at Home Depot. I definitely recommend coming here and I'll be back next time I need keys or locks!

Good thing I didn't swallow this piece of metal staple in my tom yam soup. I actually thought I bit into a fish bone! This really makes me wary about ordering from them again since my kids are eating too. 

We got a bit of everything to see if we could add this to our list of takeout places. Hailing from SE asia, our taste buds are a little less americanized. I understand there are only less than a handful of truly good and authentic asian restaurants within an hour's drive, so I'm way more lenient than usual. Even so, for the price, this place and Mama Thai's will likely not come to mind again should I have a Thai food craving.

The leather surgeons restored my 2 vintage Chanel 255 bags with their spa treatment. These bags are so old and one had blue denim stain all over it. They did an AMAZING job. The bags were a camel color and a white.  They look like new. And they restored the chain and hardware. They were an absolute pleasure to deal with and they made the process incredibly easy. I100% recommend them to restore or repair any of your leather goods.

OLDEST ITALIAN RESTAURANT IN THE.....U.S.!!! STEVIE spits facts ONLY  - you doubt me???? VERIFY it yourself, I dare you! Every dish = fantastic. Decent service, as expected.  Felt like I was in Grandma Stevie's living room in the downstairs section! Ah, to be young and Italian!! 

Yous know it's all about the vibes!! A++!! Upstairs, downstairs, bathroom, outside, the walls - you name it! STRONG STEVIE SELL RATING!

Kind of shocked by all the bad reviews. My hubby and I came here tonight for the first time. We're always eager to try new restaurants and Apollo Burger just opened for business a few days ago.

The restaurant looks nice and the decor is clean and modern. I ordered a bacon cheeseburger and my hubby got the YBW burger. We each made ours a combo with a side and a drink. I paid $1.50 extra for a "premium side" (fried zucchini) and the total was $22. A little steep for a "fast food" type experience, but the food was really good. Both of our burgers were flavorful. The fried zucchini was really awesome! No issues with cold food like others have indicated. Everything we were served was hot.

Appreciated that someone came by to check on us, ask if we needed any sauces or refills, and explained that we leave the trays on the table when we're done.

We'll be back. Welcome to the neighborhood!

Stopped in for a quick lunch. Not bad, but just slightly above Taco Bell. The chips were a bit stale and the guacamole had a strange metallic taste. I had the steak street tacos and P had a chicken quesadilla. Not the worst we've ever had, but I also won't rush back.

I don't like this place.
Employees are not so nice. 
Mac can do better.

This place is very good.
Interior: it's a small restaurant with maybe 15 seats.

Service: always very respectful and timely. 

Food: i usually order 2 summer rolls, 1 grilled pork Bahn mi and 1 grilled beef Bahn mi, and 2 jasmine milk teas with bubble. Definitely some of the freshest, tastiest Vietnamese foods in Delaware.

Price: not the cheapest, the summer rolls are $4 for 2, which is a bit high. Overall worth it.

Overall score: 4.6/5

A total treasure of a store in the heart of the funk zone!

This building is very nondescript from the front and if the "blue door" wasn't open, it'd be another place you'd just walk by. Totally feels like a speakeasy sort of spot. 

The Blue Door is so very carefully curated and feels more like a beautiful time capsule of a museum than a consignment shop. The merchandise appears to be hand-picked and is all of utmost quality. The building has three floors (the second floor has a low ceiling and wonderfully creaky wood flooring) with each displaying their own collection of treasures. The merchandise is largely mid century and offers something for even the most discerning of tastes. 

I came here the other day to redeem a gift card for my birthday and ended up purchasing a beautiful crystal decanter for my home bar. It's almost too nice to fill up with my whiskey, but still functional enough to serve its purpose. I picked up the gift card from the front cash register and found the ladies behind the counter to be friendly and polite. 

Very cool place to explore. I will most definitely be back.

Delicious! We got the eggplant parmesan sandwich and a gyro. Everything in here looked amazing. Fresh pasta and amazing bakery! I wish we had something like this is Seattle. It's crowded inside but worth the wait.

Part of what I love about New Orleans is a lot of restaurants have happy hour everyday! This place is no exception. After another grueling 8 hour conference day, I still made it to the happy hour 4-7pm. Decent priced happy hour menu $5 - under $10. I'm hard pressed to find a $5 glass of wine for HH back home in SF. 

I wanted to try some of the other HH drinks but conference sessions start at 7am the next morning so no can do. I'm getting my money's worth of CLE hours!

I wanted to partake in the $9/dozen oysters but I had my eye on the fried chicken entree and side of mac and cheese. Great choice.

Fried chicken was moist even under the layers of breading. 3 pieces: leg, thigh, and breast. Something for every preference. Came with mashed potatoes with debris gravy and buttered cabbage. The debris gravy was not my thing; probably not used to the flavor. I just ate around the gravy. Cabbage was delicious.

Mac and cheese was my fave. Ate it all. Cheese was light but still very flavorful. Great choice of cheeses.

Bartender was lovely with southern hospitality. Wished I didn't book my flight back so early so I could come again the next night to try some other dishes and drinks.

Place was not busy but could have been the tornado warning kept the tourists away for the weekend since its on the edge of French Quarter.

I needed the 30 minute walk back to the hotel. I was stuffed to the gills.

21st is one of my favorite bars in New Orleans for hand crafted cocktails. This is a real cocktail bar with live jazz, intimate setting with a VIP room for lounging (first come first serve), and excellent service.

Eddie is my favorite bartender of Nawlins'. He takes his time but still can carry a conversation at the same time. He made me a killer old fashioned with enough bitter and alcohol to keep me pumped. He's professional and knowledgable. He definitely made a great impression; I have to take friends here next time! 

Thanks Eddie!!

I was a Founding member at OTF for 11 months. I liked the workouts and the members very much. I had a few favorite trainers. About 10 months into my membership a cell phone was stolen by a stranger from off the street.I wasn't even in the studio when the theft occurred. I was told  that the thief said he was in the studio waiting on me. The Studio manager told me the guy said he was waiting on someone named Johnson. My last name is Johnson. The Studio Manager said the owner wanted me to look at the surveillance tape to identify the thief.   
I wondered why was I being asked to look at a videotape when a person said they were waiting on a member named Johnson. I was more than sure I wasn't the only member with the last name Johnson. The owner contacted me and told me she only asked I view the tape because the thief mentioned me by first name. I found that even more disrespectful because I have a very uncommon first name. I found it hard to believe a stranger would walk off the street and say that that they were waiting on someone named Titus. Especially someone I definitely don't know . Also why would someone mention a name if they had the intention of stealing when they entered the studio. It was very clear to me that the owner was lying to me.
I requested a meeting with everyone that was involved to try to get to the bottom of this ordeal. When I got into the meeting the owner had a very nasty arrogant attitude. Her tone was disrespectful and condescending. She gave me a fake apology and insulted my intelligence and told me the front desk attendant gave 2 different stories to the studio manger and general manager. I thought why would he do that knowing they work together everyday. Why would this person lie? She basically tried to blame the whole thing on the front desk employee. She told me she fired the guy the day before. I just couldn't believe she found this out right before our meeting. The bottom line is I was treated very poorly as customer. The owner of this business did not try to get to the bottom of this incident. A  paying customers cell phone was stolen and my name was improperly implicated. I enjoyed the gym strictly from the perspective of working out but customer service deserves a rating less than zero. 

After my meeting was over I posted a YELP review because trainers always ask customers to go online and give a YELP or GOOGLE review. They ask us to do that when we are stretching  after class. After posting about my experience with this studio I was kicked out via email after the owner of the gym saw me after my Saturday morning workout. She didn't even have the guts to tell me to my face . She canceled my membership without  me knowing days before . When my membership was canceled I was in Fort Lauderdale for a work conference. I attempted to work out a a local OTF in the area. When I called to book my class I was told my membership was canceled. I told them it must be some type of mistake. They looked into it an told me that it must coming up as frozen because I was a guest from out of town. They let me work out. It wasn't until I got home that I found out she canceled my account  after I worked out that Saturday morning. She sent me an email saying my membership was being canceled because of my YELP review. I recommend you to join this gym to work out only if you never have to deal with a situation that requires customer service from the owner or certain members of management. The workouts are good but customer service to me was super poor.


I am speaking about this place simply based upon my experience. I can't speak for anyone else. I'm sure some people may love OTF'S level of customer service. I DON'T!
This is all first hand information. No second hand information .Everything is true .I welcome anybody to challenge my facts. Especially if the owners's brother tries to get this review taken down like my last one. I have read the YELP guidelines and I have stuck to them. I am happy YELP gives us the platform to rate and post our experiences with businesses. Consumer feedback is very important.!

I love me a good sports bar especially one where the Engerlish and the Oirish hang out, and this place fits.  So I went to this place on a blind date on a Sunday Morning to watch Man U v Chelsea.  Man U won which pissed me off.   Despite this (and because the Eagles beat the Giants that day) I had a good time.  Eamon the owner / barman was attentive and nice.  He made me delish Bloody Marys and the food I got was really tasty.

This was the most epic dinner we had till now in New Orleans!! I had the bacon garlic oysters and my husband got himself crab cake shrimp pasta. Both were just fabulous. Perfect till the end. Would probably come here again.

I can easily give this place a 5 star review.

My wife surprised me by bringing me here this morning.  (August 3, 2018)  We went for breakfast.  I got their signature dish with the yucca fries and pork belly.  It was AMAZING.  I loved the whole dish.  My wife got the French Toast and that was incredible as well.

The staff was so friendly and genuinely cared about our time there.  I really look forward to going back.

By the way, I changed my mind.  The 'Beermosa' should be served with frozen strawberries as a garnish.

We sat in a booth for twenty minutes and even asked the host to get a server for us. We walked out and nobody even acknowledged us. 
We won't be back.

I am torn as would like to give Honeygrow four stars but I just can quite do it. 3.5 maybe? Honeygrow has many fine attributes: clean, well appointed fast casual dining. The food is healthy as long as you don't overdo it with the side sauces, which are salty. The ease of ordering on their slick computerized menu is impressive, and their staff is working hard. The problem lies with the fact that they never seem to get the order right. If you order to dine in, they pack it to-go. If you order beef, you get chicken. If you order pineapples there's not enough. Another annoyance is the deafening music at their University City and Center City locations. Besides those frustrations it is a great place for a pretty healthy din-din. 3.5 stars great.

There's no denying that this place is fun if you're in the mood for rowdy drunk college kids. As a graduate student new to the area, I felt a little overwhelmed walking into an undergraduate past-time, especially when my friend came back from the bar with drinks served in plastic buckets, the kind that kids build sandcastles with. 

This is in no way shape or form a classy establishment, it's just where people get hammered, dance, sing, and have a good time.

I have had so much trouble getting a good company to service my pool and then I found these guys.

It's going to take a heck of a lot to have me call anyone else after 3 service calls and 3 absolutely excellent responses.

Yes, they fixed the problem, yes, 6 months later I'm still happy, and yes they found me someone I like to handled normal pool maintenance.

These guys are great, I had a broken leg and while I was out I don't know what the heck happened but while I was in a hospice the pool started leaking, the pump died, and the pool went green.  I went through 3 other people, nada. Called these guys and in 2 weeks it was swim time.  Very professional. compared to other quotes a no-brainer, just really appreciate companies like this.  They did a great job all around.

I don't think you can go wrong with these guys.

Tucked away behind Three Wise Men, you'll find this hidden Mexican Restaurant and breakfast! Came here on a Sunday and this place was busy! Luckily we were seated right away but I think I only saw two empty tables in the whole place. I ordered the sausage scramble, and it was just alright and made me wish I would've ordered the Mexican food that they offered. My guest ordered French toast with blueberries and it was incredible! I definitely enjoyed that much more than my meal. The service was quick and accommodating, it seems that you don't have just one server here, but rather all the employees help to fill drinks and serve food. 

Based on reviews, it appears you get salsa and chips for free but i believe that if you order breakfast that is not included! I wasn't aware of this until after but I definitely see myself coming back to try their Mexican food instead.

All the staff is super friendly and attentive. The oysters were good and the happy hour is a great deal. I was also surprised with birthday bread pudding on the house. Everything was great, but I docked off one star because the plates and glasses were stained from probably just being put in a dishwasher and not being properly washed.

Stopped in for a quick breakfast. It was moderately crowded but the line moved fast. I ordered an egg sandwich. This was a mistake. It wasn't horrible, just not great. They had a huge display of wonderful looking pastries, donuts and a lot more. THAT is what I should have ordered. I would give another try. Service was great, very clean and social distancing was taking place.

It has taken us a while to finally getting around to North 53, and in the words of GOB Bluth, I've made a huge mistake (by waiting this long) - because North 53 is fantastic 
It's a smaller, place but they've packed quite a few seats in there - so intimate is not the word I would use to describe it. The unfinished wood, the black leather and steel details give the place a Canadianness combined with the soundtrack of early 90's hip hop give the place gives it a really cool, very Edmonton vibe.
For the cocktails, we spun the flavour wheel. I elected for: whiskey, smoky and my date; whiskey, savoury. I asked what was in mine, but it was ingredients I didn't recognize and can't recall now but I can tell you it was something special, as was my dates. She later had rum, tart that was quite delicious.
We ordered 2 small plates, the griddled mushrooms and the popcorn chicken. The mushrooms may have been the best I've ever had with an egg yolk to dip in and the popcorn chicken was worthy of its reputation (though I personally might have offered a dipping sauce).
We had the lamb with farro and the steak and eggs to finish. The lamb portion was a bit small imo, but the taste and texture were fantastic. Next was the steak with a perfectly basted egg, chimichurri sauce, potatoes and greens. To combine them all in one bite was sheer decadence and that fine taste lingered on the palette for the rest of the night.
I can't fault North 53 for anything, the service, vibe, food and drink were all exceptional and the bill was surprisingly reasonable.
I can't wait to go back (and try dessert).

came here for a date night, had reservationsat 6:45. We walked in right at 6:40, but 3 other groups walked in behind us. None had reservations. They were all seated before us and we weren't even acknowledged until after all the other groups were seated. We were looked over because we are young 20 year olds. Not to mention almost none of the customers walking in had masks on, and nobody asked them to put masks on. Once we were sat, service was amazing and attentive. Food was fantastic but the hostesses left a bad taste in my mouth for the rest of the night. Hope it was just a bad night, and that this isn't normal for katie's.
Stopped Manger started this place every one going out every where is trash not good team workers don't go this place

When I tell you my mango daiquiri was all that! A bit pricey but it was delicious. It had the right amount of alcohol in it!! They had various flavors to choose from. I think I will try watermelon next....can't wait!!!
Worst McDonald's I've ever been to In My Life. The service is horrid. The orders are always messed up. After several similar experiences here I will never return.

WE WAITED AN HOUR AND A HALF! Now don't get me wrong it was amazing but I feel like you should be warned about the wait over the weekend. I got Crispy Treats (Fruity Pebbles & honey) and it was great! It's definitely a cool experience but I don't think I'd wait that long next time. Homemade ice cream with unlimited toppings, can't go wrong...except for the wait.

The wait staff were nice, but our server did not know the menu...at all. But then, apparently neither did the chef! We ordered Mapo Tofu Rice which was missing the bok choy that was supposed to come with it, so we had to ask for it. The Mapo sauce was bland albeit very spicy; if you left out the red pepper it'd have no taste. The scallion pancakes were super greasy. The fried chicken dumplings were OK. Hard to mess up a plate of steamed vegetables, so they were OK. We had to request the condiments that usually appear on the table (soy, chilli oil, black vinegar, et.al.), as our server didn't seem to know what they had. We had to request chop sticks, as they were not offered. We had to walk up to the register and request our check as our server totally disappeared; we were as nice as possible, but every time we had to ask for something she got confused and then apparently got SO upset she simply stopped waiting on us and had the other server deal with us instead; we felt bad for her but it was odd. We realise new employees sometimes get flustered, and there may be other good things on the menu but based on what we ordered the food just wasn't good enough to warrant a return trip. Meh.

Located between 96th and 106th street off of Hague Road, this park is the perfect place to wonder around and forget for a moment that you are still within the city limits. This park as several trails that lead you through a meadow, a swamp area, and into the woods. It is the perfect place to enjoy a nice day and take in all that nature has to offer. The trails are also nice for dog walking, but keep in mind that these are natural trails and they can get quite muddy after a rainy day. Bikes are not allowed on the trails, so keep this in mind. Parking is a large gravel lot and Fishers's Parks Dept hosts several different nature events at the park throughout the year. They also have some nice picnic spots and public restrooms. If you are in the Fisher's area this is definitely one of the places to check out to enjoy some peaceful nature views.

Awesome awesome awesome. Those are the three best words I could think of to describe the sand which I am eating right. He. I ordered the Mississippi Nights and it is truely a transcendent experience. Or maybe that is the icy cold 4 Hands Beer coursing through my veins.

Edit: I went back for more. I couldn't stay away. Here is a photo of another sandwich I tried.

Don't know what all the bad reviews are about but the cappuccino was very good.  Definitely a step above Starbucks.  Staff was pleasant and the place has a homey feel.  I can't comment on any snacks or food but if espresso based drinks are what you're after this place is a good spot.
Fabulous tapas- a pleasant surprise! Great service, unique, fresh, aromatic and delicious in a fun casual atmosphere.

If tots were considered a real meal, I'd eat a Greg's every day. Greg's is the perfect spot for a no fuss, good old delicious breakfast that you could probably make at home, but tastes so much better because you didn't have to. The waitstaff is nice, there's a good amount of seating, and the food is sure to fill you up!

Don't go there.  Accused us of trying to take a bottle of pop we had purchased at another store.  Said the had video which must have been a lie 
Had a guy who flash a badge like a cop but I suspect he was not nopd    Avoid this store.
Had a bridal shower here and it turned out great. The pricing was very reasonable and the service was great. Everyone really enjoyed the food. They made sure every went smoothly. Highly recommend it

My daughter absolutely LOVES this place. There are many fun and educational exhibits and activities she can play with. It is always so packed with kids. I've never been here when there wasn't at least 50 kids or more. It's a little bit of a hike for me but worth it if I'm looking for something different to do with my daughter.
The staff is mostly friendly and helpful if you have questions. They even do birthday parties at a reasonable price if you are looking for somewhere to have one. I've never had a party here so I can't really review that aspect. Overall a fun place for kids to unwind.

Worst service ever from waitress and manager the waitress started ok then after she took our order we didn't see her for 30 min no refills then when he would stop couldn't get a word in while she ran by. Watch one of out beers sit on the bar for 20 min getting warm before it was brought to our table. Had to wait another 20 min for ranch for my wings before just asking another waiter. Went to talk to manger he was just rude and didn't even stop to hear what we had to say before saying I hear ya and walking off. bww is my favorite restaurant but I will drive the extra distance to get to any other one but this one. Worst experience I've ever had at a restaurant.
They have been working on my lashes for 3 yrs and they still look amazing and healthy .. Cierra is a Master of her Craft.. best of the best.. thank you

Basics: tofu salad a bit watery. Crispy tempura Roll was lean,  very very very stingy w/ the wasaby & Ginger. The nigiri was good. The $ 34.00 price tag was out of control. Trying to order more food @ 1 minute to 9 ended in them telling me they had already closed. Next time I'll drive the 11 miles to bonjung and not have regrets.

Cheesy, overly nice, plastic wait staff training wannabe wait staff.  Service sucked.  Food was tasteless.  How can you screw up a sirloin steak....  Couldn't get a drink refill here even if you were on fire.  

Go to Steak and Shake or hell even Boston Market instead.
Wonderful breakfast ,bring an appetite we ran out of time I would have loved to go back for dinner

We have a new puppy and we're looking for a lunch spot that would allow our Morty. This also was our 1st dinning experience with him so we were a little nervous.We weren't sure how it was going to go, saw the reviews and checked it out. 

Staff was very friendly service was great! They offered out pup water right away. What I liked about the seating was the restaurant is an open concept and the patio is an extension of the inside. So you don't feel like you have to be banished to the patio just bc you brought your pup. To be honest the patio felt like the place to be! 

The ability to bring our pup is what brought us but the food and the service is what will keep us coming back! Our waitress and hostess were amazing. The Napa burger was delihcious, highly recommend. They also have a huge assortment of cocktails, wines and beer. If you like light beers Momma's Yella Little Pils was awesome. Check it out for yourself!

Absolutely love this little hidden gem in U-City!  I had the jerk chicken meal and it was soooo delicious.  Service was great and friendly!  People keep telling me to try the jerk chicken salad and the red snapper. So I will check that out next and report back!

I was in Tampa on business and found this spot on Chowhound.  This sushi spot is very good!  Its not fancy, but the sushi is fresh, tasty, and affordable.  It looks like a husband and wife team owns the business.  He cuts the sushi and she is the wait staff.  I was in town for 7 nights and I ate at this spot three of those nights.  The service is friendly and food is delivered to you in a timely fashion.  The Japanese food is also good as one night I had the udon noodle soup and found it to be very good.  I AI Sushi serves escolar... I love when a sushi bar carries this fish... yum!  I loved this spot and I hope you will too.  Enjoy!

I went here for restaurant week with my friends and I had a great time . The service was outstanding,  we never felt rushed or annoyed. Our waiter was knowledgeable and very nice. The food was amazing . I got the salmon Flatbread appetizer and it was out of this world. Then I ordered the lobster bisque and lobster entrée.  They were amazing and cooked to perfection . I expected very small portions since it was restaurant week but nope ! I was so full I didn't have any space for deserts.  I got one either way. It was their mixed berries one (I dont remember the name ) soooooooo good . I'd go again it for a nice dinner (tho everyone was dressed very casual ).

Not the biggest mall out there but it has it's charm.  This mall has started to become more and more modern in recent years adding stores like West 49, Below the Belt, Le Chateau, etc...I used to attend high school just across the street so I spent a few hours here as a teen to say the least.  I can usually find what I am looking for here and it's not typically crazy busy.  It's central to Sherwood Park as well so it is easy to get to and parking is not usually an issue.  You will find a good number of teens loitering in the food court at times though - as I did back in the day!

Will not disappoint. I have been ordering from these guys for the past 8 months now, and have been amazed every time. Their homemade rolls are amazing! Cheesesteaks and hoagies. They also have really good pasta dinners.

Saw the big red sign while cruising down state st. Came in with a family of 5 who was hungry. Wife and grabbed a slice with a salad and the kids had a medium pizza. Added a pitcher of soda. Staff was super friendly. Pizza came out hot. Salad was a good size. Kids liked the pizza. Quick, easy and good. Just the way I like it! And the price was reasonable.

I just think there needs to b a whole lot more training for servers. TO IN SURE PROMPT SERVICE (TIPS)  it's not prompt service if I have to wait for refills on water more napkins e c t.... but the food here is so good u kina have to overlook it...

Wow were we impressed. Went on only their second night and expected some hiccups. The place was packed for dinner and their were minor hiccups like being seated at the wrong table and having some items being out of or near being out of. However, the service was excellent. The bar manager stopped by, the manager, and the wait staff were excellent. We had the Stove Fries which is their take on Poutine, in a word awesome! Our table had the mussels, ribs, and burger. Everyone raved about the food and value. Certainly will be back.
The hot chicken mac and cheese is to die for. Fast pace, great atmosphere, great cocktails!

I love this place! I live a couple blocks from here, so I've been more than a couple times. The guy who is always there is so nice! The one thing I really like about this place is they cook over a grill, not a flat top griddle. Also, they really put love into their food... roasted peppers are roasted in house, not from a jar, burgers are hand made.... They have pizza as well, which is reallyyy good,  the crust is crisp and not soggy and over loaded  like a lot of other places on Fairmount and always different varieties available. I wouldn't  put this under the pizza place category,  they are doing so much more! Hummus and pita great! Grilled chicken with home made pesto over roasted peppers and fresh mozzarella- sooo good! Chicken cheesesteak  french fries  burger. And the place is simple and cute inside !  Thanks Zuzu's!!!!

I am a spa snob. Unabashed. Spa. Snob. Terme di Aroma met almost of all of my expectations and exceeded them when it came to the actual service I received. I had an amazing Swedish aromatherapy massage. The therapist also (without my mentioning it or asking) identified some particularly stressful areas and used some deep tissue techniques as well. She was thorough, efficient, friendly, and generally ah-mazing. 

So why didn't I give the spa 5 stars? The relaxation room was relaxing, but there was no changing into a luxurious spa robe, there was no warm foot bath before or after my treatment. I have always taken the relaxation room for granted. I didn't know how much I valued it until the experience was different. I yearned for that warm plush robe. I wanted to have more soothing music being pumped in along with the great scents and amazing apple cider. 

Other than the lack of relaxation in the relaxation room, I would return again and again. In fact, next time I am in Philadelphia, I plan on it! And that's coming from a spa snob!

Good sandwiches. Kind of pricy but good. .75 charge for cash or charge, but they will take off if you not ok with it? Who would be ok with it? Overall clean, friend service, and quick. Probably back sometime or another.

I'm very conflicted as I write this review.  If you're looking for AMAZING fresh made food then this is the place for you.  Their salads are creative and tasty and their homemade bread is divine.  I love their chips (homemade and delicious)!

The problem I have is their delivery and lack of time management.  People at my office order from them several times a week.  We always feel like we're taking a risk ordering from them because our lunch hour has been over before the food gets to us.  Just this week I ordered two salads and a sandwich.  It took them over an HOUR to deliver the food--and they are located less than 4 miles away from my business!  I would understand if this happened once, or even twice, but regularly is a problem.  

One other suggestion:  UPDATE your website.  Your prices online do not match your new menu!!!

If Linda Jeans' owner/manager reevaluated their food turnout and reliability they would have a GREAT business!  I wish them well but doubt we will be ordering from them again.

Pros: Good location, relatively safe even late at night, accepts coupons, cheap food.
Con: 9 out of 10 times you go there you'll see some little kid being smacked upside the head by an easily frustrated "parent". It's almost as bad as SEPTA!

Hated this place because of the lack of customer service I experienced. Six months later needed a suit on the spot I usually go to Enzo Custom Clothiers Who takes about 3 to 6 weeks for a custom suit. I did not have the time to wait met with Connor Who was hands-down amazing. I think the store manager might be new there because he was also very polite and very nice. Not the usual suit supply that I've experienced in the past which was mean and uptight. Go see Connor.

The tailor was a grumpy old man...

My boyfriend and I were craving breakfast late one night, and decided to give Merritt's a shot (I had never been) rather than Denny's or IHOP. 

I was a little surprised to see just how run-down this place is. I knew it was a dive, but I'm confused how they even pass the health code.

Since it was late, I was not surprised to find a large group of high-school or college-aged kids sitting at the large center table. We opted for a booth in the corner, hoping to find some quiet. (We had no luck.)

I ordered the biscuits and gravy, and was extremely disappointed. The food was... gross. The gravy was so bland and tasted as if it consisted of only flour and milk. If that wasn't bad enough, my boyfriend's finger steaks were RAW. In fact, I was kind of upset he didn't send them back. 

We got a "scone," as they are Merritt's claim to fame, and was not any more impressed. It's nothing that a scone should be, essentially just a funnel cake you'd get at the fair. 

To make it worse, the service was terrible.

How does this place have 4 stars?! YUCK! I'd rather have gone to Denny's...

We went here looking to try something different and that certainly happened. While the frog legs and burger were tasty, everything else we ate was just too salty. Four of us shared what we got and we all agreed on the salt content, so it wasn't just a one off situation. I would maybe try it once more if I'm in town again, but it won't be my first suggestion.

My boyfriend took me here for my birthday dinner because I love an excellent steak.  I wasn't disappointed.  It was well worth every penny he spent.  Awesome... awesome!!!  The decor is beautiful.  I felt like I was in a Hollywood film.  The service was great - our waitress even engaged us in a brief conversation filled with laughs.  The food was some of the best I've ever had! I could have made a meal of the wedge salad and stuffed hash browns, alone!

The first time I ever went to eSalon was at the start of summer to get some balayage done by Megan. I was nervous to have blonde in my hair after being a brunette for so long but she did an amazing job. I was so happy with the color, which wasn't brassy at all, and my hair looked gorgeous. Megan has a very artistic style and I felt like my hair was definitely a work of art after. Megan was very friendly and great at her job.
Towards the end of the summer, I decided to return to a rich chocolatey brown. I made my appointment with Caitlin and she listened intently as I explained the shade of brown I wanted my hair. In the end, I came out with luxurious deep brown hair with warm undertones that makes my blue eyes and skin tone really stand out. I couldn't be more happier with the final result! Caitlin is so nice and is extremely talented. 
I plan to return here in the future!
Huge and delicious po-boys--we tried the shrimp and 1/2 shrimp/1/2 oyster, both were amazing!

Best Halal cart in the city! Since the offer is available, whenever I get lamb, chicken, or combo over rice I allow them to add fried pepper and onion. ALWAYS worth it! Great prices for great meals, not to mention a very friendly fella serving 'em up!

I randomly stumbled in here before an event at Saint Louis university, and am so happy that I did. The staff was incredibly friendly, from the moment I stepped in. The ambiance is light. the bartender/ server was just awesome. 

I ordered the chicken and apple skillet, and trust me, you will not be disappointed. the cheese worked so well with the kale and the egg, it was amazing. 

I hardly write yelp reviews but this visit warranted a write up, because it was just awesome. great new space, and great for slu students, theater goers, or Chicagoans like me.
Great coffee and biscuits with specialty items as fillings. You won't want to miss it.

I happened to be in Ruskin on business and was looking for a breakfast joint . I see this run down looking restaurant with a parking lot loaded with cars so I decided to check it out . I got the last open table and was quickly greeted by a server. This place was packed and everybody looked happy....a good sign . I ordered my breakfast and it was served quickly and was delicious . Really good breakfast at an amazingly low price and great service. I wish I lived closer because It would be my local hangout.
The flavors in these popsicles are amazing! Their gelato is creamy and delicious. The staff is friendly, variety is insane, and everything is fresh!

I enjoy stopping here when I'm in town and have a little time to kill.  I love browsing their fresh baked pastries, cookies and cakes, as well as their fresh produce and meats.  They have a nice selection of beauty and skin care products as well; I was really in a bind last winter with dry, cracked lips and Gelson's had the most amazing balm that I still carry with me and save for when I really need extra special care of my lips.  Their fresh flowers are fantastic and I'd recommend them for any time you need something extra special for a meal or a gift for that special someone.

We loved this place! Stopped in early afternoon on a Tuesday, so we weren't experiencing the crowds that other reviewers talk about. The atmosphere was pretty laid back- seat yourself, high top tables and a bar, no silverware (prepare to wash your hands after). We absolutely enjoyed our food! All three of us got tacos; overall we tried the traditional beef taco, adobo chicken taco, catfish taco, and hot chicken taco. We all agreed these were some of the best tacos we've ever had! The flavor profiles were wonderful, and they were full of meat. Plus, each order came with a small side of chips, and some awesome salsa. (My personal fav was the hot chicken taco, with a kick of spice but not so hot that you want to spit it out) This is definitely somewhere we would like to return to.

Edit: we also ate here at about 7:15 on a Friday night, smack in the middle of fall break, with a concert going on at the area (right next door), and still did not experience the poor service that others have shared. While we did have to put our name in and wait for a table, we had wonderful service on the rooftop, and enjoyed the live music!
I had the pho. Quite good and tasty although I would have like a little more on the portion. Nice quiet place. Very good for lunch. I will return to try other dishes.
Workouts are always changing and they play great music!

I contacted Check Maid based on the other reviews I read on yelp, and they did not disappoint!!  

My family and I were moving out of our old, dusty Victorian in West Philly and I knew that I wouldn't have time (nor the effort) to clean it myself.  I requested an appointment online, which was super easy.  June wrote me back within 24 hours to confirm my appointment.

Liz and her partner (sorry, i can't remember his name) cleaned the house from top to bottom and were able to work around our movers - we had to move the same day as the cleaning!  They exceeded our expectations by far.  I've never seen the house this clean in all the time we lived there.  Plus they were super friendly and professional!  

My experience with Check Maid was the best that I've had with a cleaning service.  I will definitely hire them again.

This is my 5th New Years Eve dinner at Carlucci's and it still amazes me that we keep having great meals and fantastic service. The only bad part was I couldn't use one of their coupons because they consider New Years Eve to be a holiday. The Shrimp & Salmon Amalfi was great. My wife had the pasta privamera. Started off with mozzarella sticks. The clam chowder was a nice light cream soup with large chunks of clam. Blue cheese stuffed olives for my martini. My wife had her bay breeze and said they were pretty strong. I wish I could have tried the bacon wrapped scallops stuffed with crabmeat which was also one of the appetizers. The place was very crowded, but everyone seemed to be having a good time. It attracts a middle aged to senior type crowd.

Played Lulu recently in the GAP matches and enjoyed the layout and the facility. There's some encroachment of trees preventing some tee shots on a preferred line but the condition of the course was otherwise reasonable. I don't know how much they charge for a round but if it's the $80 or so that other reviewers mention I would say it is well worth it.

Very good flavor to the rotisserie chicken, service was friendly and fast - the only thing that was preventing the 5th star was the sauces.  I was hoping for a traditional jalapeño cilantro green sauce.  I personally didn't care for any of the 3 sauces.

I never leave reviews but I just had one of the best dinner experiences at Bistro Romano! Our waiter was awesome! We ordered the table side caesar salad which was the best I've ever had. My husband even loved his and he's not even a fan of Caesar dressing. 
Dinner was great as well. Our waiter felt that dinner had taken longer than necessary to be made so he offered us complimentary after dinner drinks with our desert. 
We got our check by realized we hadn't been charged for a bottle of wine we ordered. After bringing it to our waiters attention he offered to give it to us for free but we refused. He gave us a new check along with a $20 gift card to use at our next visit for our honesty. 
Great food, atmosphere and customer service! I would have given them 10 stars if I could! I highly recommend enjoying a meal at Bistro Romano!
Didn't eat here so I cant speak to that...but it has one of the best beer selections I've seen anywhere. It's incredibly relaxed and a great place to try some new and perhaps some rare beers.

This place is a little bit of St. Louis awesome. The bar is up front, but if you go further inside you'll find two dining areas that feel like you just got invited into an exclusive club - photos of Cardinals baseball and other St. Louis stuff lines the wall. The service is great - exactly what you would expect - hospitable but they're not going to take any guff from you either. I had the steak sandwhich and the waffle fries because everyone here says to get them. My partner had the special of the day which was fried chicken and looked amazing. Both were probably more food that what we *really* needed, but, hey, who's counting calories here? My dad tells me that the name of the place used to be Stan & Biggies - as in Stan Musial, the Cardinals legend. I can't exactly confirm that, but I can see Stan the Man hanging out in this place. You should see yourself hanging out here too.
Great place to visit! Beautiful gardens and a relaxing way to spend the morning. Lunch at the cafe is worth it. Expensive but delicious fresh menu. They use as many local ingredients as possible.
Great find in Reno! Great food and fantastic service with smiling faces. The burger with bacon and bbq sauce was a hit with my husband.
Best place to start a night, get a wine tasting and then head out. Knowledgable staff and great prices.

We have tried Zen Bistro 4 times since it opened (2 take-out, 2 eat-in).  The food was inconsistent.  We had some things we liked and others that were frankly awful.   The service is excellent and the restaurant is clean and comfortable, however.
This is the best hibachi restaurant I have ever been to. Amazing food and great service

By far the highlight of my trip. After spending a week eating amazing food, I needed to learn to make it. Not only was the food some of the best of the trip, but the hints and suggestions the chef provided on ways to make the food at home were great. There are certain foods harder to get in different areas of the country and his substitutionshopefully will give me some authentic flavors. I can't wait to get home and try the recipes.

First time there and the experience was awful! 
It took our waiter 30 minutes or so to bring us our drinks and it wasn't busy. The food was flavorless and our waiter wasn't very professional.

If I could give this bar negative stars I would. We drove around for 20 minutes looking for parking because we heard that this place has really good burgers. We found parking...10 blocks away...and walked. We got there around 9pm (it was a quiet Monday night). There's a little area towards the back where there are tables, and we sat down. We didn't necessarily go there to drink, though I intended to get a beer if they had anything good on tap. They didn't. It seemed like the tables in the back were taken up by couples and families there to eat. It certainly wasn't crowded or rowdy at all, which is what we were looking for. After sitting there for 15 minutes without any attention, the bartender told us to get up and sit in the bar instead (not very politely, mind you). So we moved to the cramped and uncomfortable table at the bar. The bartender came back 5 minutes later and asked for IDs. Fine. My friend (who is almost 40, and looks over 30) forgot his ID at home. He asked if he could just order food and not a drink. The bartender (with a mohawk) swore at us and told us to get out. "It's the f---- law." He didn't even want to order a drink. just a burger. Apparently you can't eat a burger at a restaurant if you're 36. You can vote without an ID, but not eat a burger. 

Awful excuse for any establishment that actually has to deal with customers. If you're going to require everyone in the place to show ID (except the teenager eating there with his family at one of the back tables, and everyone else that walked in around the same time as us), you should do it at the door, not make people sit there for 20 minutes, treat them rudely, and then swear at them. They could even put it on their web site, so I don't have to walk pretty far just to be insulted by their ridiculous excuse for a bartender.

Needless to say, I will never even venture near this place again, and I will make sure all of my friends know not to either. We ended up at another bar/restaurant, where we were treated nicely and were able to eat without being sworn at.
I waited about 20 mins before the lady started my hair. The women was nice and quick. I will be returning.

Simon's signs seems to be  knock-offs of New Orleans' icon, Dr Bob. It is Dr Bob's "Be Nice or Leave" signs that have adorned so many of the city's restaurants and bars over the last 20 years. Dr Bob's works can be viewed at his massive Chartres Street studio/compound in the Bywater neighborhood.

Overpriced drinks which is typical for Philadelphia but usually in that case it is offset by good service. Nope not here. Came here on a Saturday night with a bunch of friends and the bouncer made it a point to come over to us while we were finishing our drink to let us know the place was closed. Meanwhile at least 20 other people to the left and right of us finishing up their drinks he decides to grab our drinks and throw us out and then wait outside instead of getting everyone else out of the bar. All in all just rude people. It's one thing to kick the whole bar out but don't single out 2 people.
Friendly, reliable, thorough and effective.  Very satisfied and highly recommend.  Ask for Kelly!

My husband and I checked out Kingmakers one evening, and were so impressed that we vowed to return with a group. Games are always more fun in groups, after all. It's $5 a person for an unlimited day of gaming, and there are so many games from which to choose. I was most impressed with the staff here. I mean, how on earth do can they learn the rules and nuances of these games well enough to teach and guide people? They were so good and answered all of my questions, which were plenty.

Awesome food at a decent price!. Yes it is rundown so be prepared for that but the breakfast I had was delicious. Merritt's is famous for their "scones" but everything they serve is good old fashion Dive food. Try it!

So I never knew it could be so hard to find a good poboy in NOLA. Who would have known? 
So, on my quest to find a GOOD poboy I stumbled on this funky hidden spot. 
We initially walked right past it because of course I am looking for a big ass Killer Poboy sign. But of course it's actually inside Erin Rose all the way in the back of the bar. 
I will say, do NOT expect fancy dining. If that's what you are here for, don't bother or write bad reviews about it! However, if you are someone who appreciates good food from the "hole in the walls" this is for you. 
They offer fish, shrimp & pork belly poboys. We got the grilled shrimp poboys & added home made hot sauce made from scratch. The chef makes the sauce daily from her fresh picked peppers from her garden at home. How cool! 

I definitely reccomend this place for a quick and very tasty poboy. I will definitely come here again when I visit!

Finally tried this place out after driving by for 2 years.  So glad we did, though wish we had done so sooner.  The wife and I did take out, sharing chicken wings and catfish with a range of sides--collards, Mac and cheese, herbed rice and broccoli.  Everything was very tasty.  The wings were big and juicy and the portion of catfish was huge.
The owner was super friendly and we had a nice conversation while we waited.
It will not be another 2 years before we return.
This place is phenomenal!! Found it by accident and was pleasantly surprised. Cheap bottles of wine, great Thai beer. The menu is somewhat extensive but you'll enjoy the freshness of the dishes.

Solid.  The line at lunch speaks for itself.  

I can't remember what their seating situation looks like.

SO GOOD! got there around 11:30 on a Thursday, only a couple people in line - yay! I had the bean gordita ... didn't really like it, it was very bland. I also had the pasilla pepper and cheese between 2 corn tortillas .... YUM!!! The guacamole is also very tasty, and its not often that you find a place that makes HOMEMADE corn tortillas to order! Score! Oh, and their horchata and aqua frescas are FANTASTIC, not to be missed. We will definitely be back again to try more :)

I have been to this place about a year ago and they were good, but since the new owners took over, it seems like the quality of food has gone down. The vegetables weren't fresh. I had to pick out the brown old pieces. I had maybe only 3 pieces of sliced meat in my pho soup. The taste wasn't as good as it used to be. I liked eating here because the location was convenient and the food was good, but now I'll have to drive a few more miles into town to get some decent pho. 

I've been there a couple times just to see if it was just a one time occurrence of bad food but that wasn't the case. Too bad. The service was good though. Just wish they used fresher vegetables.
This is always a great place to stop. Begals are always fresh and the smoothies are great also. And if you dare the calories try their muffins. You will not be let down.
always treated very well.  the prices are very fair.  I've taken my car here 4-5 times and couldn't be happier
Not a place to eat in at, but Take Away and Delivery FTW!  Chinese or Thai *AND* they deliver?  How can you beat that?

We walked in on a saturday night without a reservation and enjoyed a delicious meal. We were seated immediately. I explained to our server that I have multiple food allergies (gluten, soy, dairy) and he was very accommodating and answered all my questions. We had the three course "value menu" where you have app, entree, and dessert for fixed price. The food was fantastic, with good portions, and service was top notch. I was afraid I would not be able to enjoy any of the dessert options due to my allergies, but luckily they had a sorbet trio on the menu--I enjoyed my blackberry, banana, and melon sorbet while my husband enjoyed the creme brulee.  I also really like to support local farms/foods and appreciated that they try to use local food. There is even a sign when you walk in listing all the farms the food that night is from.

The La Creperia Cafe is best avoided. The prices are expensive, the crepes are tough like an over-cooked tortilla but the coffee con leche was flavorful.  We went on a Saturday evening and the place was not too busy. Our waiter was prompt and to the point. But the time for our crepes to arrive from the point of ordering was excessive. The crepes were a disappointment because of the need to cut them forcefully with a knife to make bite size portions. The coffee was tasty but it ought to be for $5.25 a cup.   My recommendation is to save yourself some frustration and go to Wawa. Have a coffee and donut there. The prices are and atmosphere are better.

Not. Good. I wanted to like this place. The space is amazing even though you are practically sitting on top of the people next to you. The wine was tasty and our server was really nice even though she seemed to forget a lot of details during the meal. So for those reasons alone I give it two stars.

Overall the food was bland and under seasoned. The menu jokingly describes the macaroni gratin 'too fancy' to call mac and cheese but it was devoid of taste and the gratin tasted like Progresso bread crumbs or as my dining companion pointed out, like shake & bake was poured on top. Neither of us ate the macaroni past the tasting bite. The cheeses we ordered were awkwardly thrown on a large plate along with the accompaniments. The cheese bits themselves were literally very small portions and they were accompanied by bread which could break a tooth. The potato rösti which should be bursting with flavor had none as it sat atop a boring tomato sauce. The lobster salad sounded tasty but again pretty lifeless. The scallops themselves where well cooked and well seasoned but the accompaniments got lost. The beet salad was boring and we left most of it untouched. We skipped dessert. 


The most redeeming part of this meal out was the company and conversation. There are just too many great restaurants in our city to waste time and money coming back to this place.

I needed a cool place to study with free wifi, just the right amount of ambient noise, reasonable prices, a plug, and friendly people. I found it. 

This is my first time here, I'm sitting in the place, and it had me at hello. It has super chill loungey study music. It's a little bit away from my school, but with free street parking on Sunday (tho a little hard to come by) I hope to be a somewhat regular.

The best Honey Roasted Pork around! Talk about authentic Chinese food -- "fresh, quality ingredients", China Yuan is it! Atmosphere is family oriented and decoration is like many of the Chinese restaurants around but they do offer a lot of room for big parties. Service is alright, cleanliness-check. Pricing is reasonable.

Started off with Seafood and Fish Maw Soup. Soup served very hot and taste is just right! I had the wonderful Triple BBQ on Rice. Although it was "Triple" BBQ, I did not realized how much meat was given in one serving! Flavoring was rich; the caramelized meat was placed over steamed white rice along with bokchoy and oyster sauce was served on the side. 
They also offer Dim Sum in the AM to early Noon, but it was alright.
Wonderful staff.. Quality food.. Comfortable environment.. Chai latte was perfect.. The lady who ran the place is super sweet and in tune to customer needs.

Great family owned bounce house shop in the Lutz area. If you live around here and need a bounce house rental I highly recommend them. There's no drama and they deliver then remove on time. For all the parents out there managing a kids party these guys make your life easy!

I am very disappointed in this company. I had a deal that seemed convincing but regretfully found out the hard way that this company doesn't go by their word. About a year ago, I got a deal with Comcast for Xfinity triple play for 97.99/mo with no hassle for two years. I'm nearly half way done with my plan and I recently just moved. I called in for a professional to set up the cable and internet and, honest mistake, I missed my first appointment. I called in again to reschedule and a technician came and assisted me. He went through everything and did a great job setting everything up and everything seemed to be working until he claimed that on his end there was some errors going on and would have to come back another day. I called in to reschedule and the conversation went from just trying to get a technician to fix it to having my plan increase by 40 dollars because the promotion is no longer offered. Even if the plan isn't offered I signed a contract/agreement that would guarantee a fixed rate (only increase I noticed, which was minor, was the broadcasting fees) and would of never thought simply moving and trying to get my package back would lead to disappointment and writing a bad review. I only moved a couple of streets within the city and would never expect this to happen. Word of advice, beware of what they offer because they will try to play you in the long run.

The people at Pack Rat are very nice and very helpful.  Things can be a bit disorganized at times, but their willingness to help makes up for it.  I would definitely recommend using Pack Rat for any shipping, whether USPS or overnight.

On vacation and looking for pizza. Yelp showed me the bomb in Wild Garlic. Stealthily went into restaurant located in a quaint Reno neighborhood and found a seat taking in the decor, bar area and watching The Empire Strikes Back on one of the many tvs. Decided to get my order to go.. 16" Angry Pig and some Garlic knobs. After about 20 minutes here comes my order. The smell was outrageously good!! Once back at my inn the pizza did not disappoint. DELICIOUS!! Thank you, Wild Garlic, for a great dinner many leftovers for the trip back to San Diego tomorrow.

I love the endless flavors of reasonably priced frozen drinks at Wet Willie's! Service here is the only reason I'm not awarding 5 stars, but please note I did not try their food. Our server offered us samples, and was very helpful. When I arrived a few minutes after my friends had ordered, our server came by to acknowledge me & was quick to return to take my order. Unfortunately, after all three of us had our drinks, we never saw her again. Two of us had started with small sized drinks, thinking we could try a second flavor, but since our server never returned, and our 3rd friend had finished her large drink, we decided to just head to dinner. Even then, we had to flag down another server to get our bills. This Wet Willie's was kinda busy while we were there, but later we saw how busy they are around 11pm, which confirmed that the 7pm crowd was minimal, and our service could have been better.

I hosted my 30th birthday party here in the upstairs room.  It was incredible.  They only have a bar minimum, which we easily surpassed with close to 60 guests. There's a private bathroom up with that room as well.  They even made me a customized cocktail list.  HIGHLY recommend if you're booking something for a birthday, engagement, or so forth.

The martinis are great.  The food...meh.  The entree I got was pretty much entirely fried and a bit soggy.  Service was definitely lacking and it took us a full 15 minutes to get one of the waiters to flag down our waiter to get us the check.  It took him another 20 minutes to get it to us and take the credit card slip.
This is the worst Dunkin' I have ever been to. Terrible customer service. Extremely angry with this Dunkin' Donuts especially since it's so close.

Don't bother. What a shame to waste such a great location and structure.  Somebody is trying too hard to save a buck. My wife and I just left.  I am not one to leave many reviews, especially a negative one.  Very disappointing.

Crab cakes, ok. Off to a good start.
Stuffed flounder, was recommended. No scallops in heavy bread mix. Blah.
Seafood pot?, NOT!  See one first.
  Better crab on a Chinese buffet. 2 broken up clusters and only 4 legs?
  6 shrimp size 35, and over cooked.
  Mussels were ok. Not day fresh, but not overdone.
  Clams, way overdone and gritty.
  Carrot nubs poured out of a bag, old, stained. Really? From the cheap bag
  Potatoes, over cooked and mushy.
Key lime pie.  Box made but finally some closure. 

Such a great opportunity.  Change management and get some good food on the plates.  Make the servers proud again.  Ours tried her best, so she earned a great tip.  Without her, I give it a single star for the ambience.
This place is amazing! Came here on a Saturday expecting a rush. But they were fast, efficient, and very professional! Very easy process and answered all the questions I had.
The food was very disapointing. The building is interesting, waiter friendly. Tons of better places close by.

Had dinner here with a group so I tried several things. The crab cakes were pretty good. The lobster bisque was also good. For dinner I had the swordfish, which I really enjoyed. I "upgraded" to lobster mac and cheese, but that was disappointing: not cheesy like you'd expect. Just like buttered noodles with some chunks of lobster. 

I was pretty stuffed after all that and had a hard time finishing my carrot cake desert, but it was delicious. Overall, nice location by Rittenhouse Square, good service, nice place. Not cheap.

I had a pretty pleasant experience with Liberto's.

The location is decently convenient, and the staff were polite and professional.

I had no issues picking up and paying for the service, and they have done a great job cleaning my clothes.

Can't go wrong with Target! This one is a convenient location on the NW side of town. It's not as large as it's Oracle Rd counterpart, but it has all your basics and it will get the job done! Tip, if you're going for something specific (I recently went for a specific comforter set), you can call ahead of time and they'll grab it off the shelf and hold it at the front Customer Service. That way no one snags it while you're on your way there, and it's super quick and easy to pay and leave since it's already been pulled for you (no searching around trying to find it or asking employees to check in the back, etc.)

well almost 2 years later and we're still going to Reale's on Wednesdays. The wing special is back to the original which was all day long with no cut off.  The staff knows me and my friends and are always friendly and accomodating.  First order of business is ALWAYS the long island iced tea slushy...absolutely refreshing all year long.  I typically eat a plant based diet but make an exception on Wednesdays to satisfy my craving of lemon, garlic butter wings and sometimes garlic parm.  Occasionally I will order mussels in white sauce but I haven't gained enouch discipline to tell them to hold the bread!! This place is a hit with the food and drink prices if you're looking for something local.  After 6 pm metered parking is free.

Lee House has went through a couple of changes in the two years they have been open. They first took over a buffet restuarant off of Bloomingdale that had been there for years.  The previous buffet was pretty good and had a local following.  Lee House went through a transition where they switched to being non-buffet and offering a traditional Chinese and Dim Sum menu, not just the American Chinese most of us are familiar with.  That's when my wife and I fell in love with the place.  Shortly after that, they closed down.

A few months later, they bought another buffet place on 60.  That buffet place had only been there a couple of years.  It started out really good and went down hill really fast.  I had stopped going there all together.  When Lee House took over, the first thing to go was the buffet.  It took them a couple of months to make the change over and they have worked hard to make the interior of the restaurant nicer......

That's not the reason to go though... The reason to go is the food.  It's amazing.  Everything is very fresh and very well traditional.  Their menu will seem huge, because the front half is traditional Chinese and the back half is American Chinese.  So if you want General Tso Chicken, you will be happy, but if you want to be a little more adventurous, try the front half of the menu and make sure you add in a few of the items from the Dim Sum Menu.

I will admit, they have had some staffing issues as they have gotten going, but most of the time, the service is good too.

In my quest to visit all of the NFL stadiums. My next stop was Raymond James Stadium. Home of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. I must say this place is impressive. The fans where true sports fans so the conversations where awesome. The parking wasn't bad & it was cheap ($15) I was upset cause I ordered mines from Stubhub for $35 ‍ One thing I'll admit the pirate ship & the cannons puts Tampa's stadium over the top. Every time dey score the cannons & crowd exploded. Ion know if it's always a packed house or if it was just cause it was a Thursday night & my Patriots were in town. The energy & crowd was electric. I think I got to sit down like 10 minutes the rest of the game was standing up interacting. If you're a fan of football I highly recommend Raymond James Stadium be on your list!!!! 5 stars in my book

This is the best NYC-style pizza delivery I've found so far in New Orleans. (by which I mean I am a strong believer in hole-in-the-wall, non-gourmet, appropriately greasy pizza). The sauce, cheese, crust ratio is in correct proportion. Plus, they don't skimp on the pepperoni (that's the only thing I ever order, so all I can speak for...) 

30-40 minute delivery times so the pizza is still hot - with the added bonus that you're not dying of hunger when it arrives. Only thing that takes a star off is I agree with previous review the crust could be crisper. 

Also, $9.99 16" Large pizza special on game days are great when you're kickin it at home with a hangover and football.

One of my least favorite things to do in general is looking for new doctors. I was way due for my woman exam and my new primary care physician had highly recommended SLUCare for all my gynecological needs. He even mentioned that they are in no way affiliated but since I already had to deal with the new environment change of  finding a new primary care that I might as well just go up one more floor to do the other business. Sure, why not? I called them the very moment I got home and the lady on the phone was very pleasant and informative. She had told me that I might have to wait for 4-6 weeks but since I told her that I didn't care whether my doctor is male or female, I ended up with an appointment in 3 weeks. Great! So they send me all the paperwork I needed in the mail a few days before my actual appointment with clear instructions on how to get to the place, general information about the practice, the actual gynecologist I will be seeing, and of course the preliminary forms you had to fill out before coming in. A couple of days before my appointments I had calls to confirm it which was a nice reminder especially during my busy work weekend.

The day of my appointment, I came up and they gave me a couple short questionnaire (Ebola screening and well woman paperwork). I had merely sat down when my name was called and comes Dr Ward's nurse, Erika. She was very jolly and made me feel at ease. When I met Dr Ward, he was also very soothing and nice. I had some issues which I won't mention here but he made me feel like it wasn't my first visit at his office right away! I am glad I went with my PCP's suggestion and made an appointment here. I feel like the people really care about your well-being, the wait was next to nothing, and my doctor actually took his time to listen to some things I wanted to discuss.

Having lived in Japan for 4 years, this place brings me back. The food is delicious and the staff are quick. The miso ramen is so authentic, can't get any closer than if you were in Japan yourself. Definitely coming back here.

Wow! So good! Stephen hosted us at The  Magic Castle earlier this week. Our group was just so amazed at the tricks he did.  We continuously asked ourselves "how is this possible?" Maybe he really does have magical powers ? :) He was very personable and interesting with so much knowledge about magic and the history of magic. I would not hesitate for a second to hire him for a show. You will not be disappointed. He was so entertaining. We had a great time! Thank you Stephen!

I lived in Boston for a long time, and I always liked Legals. So I was excited when my mom suggested we head there for dinner on Sunday night. It's located in the Court, on the 2nd floor. They're on OpenTable, so we made reservations beforehand, and were seated right away. We had a great booth right near the raw bar, and the seats were really comfortable. The inside decor is definitely nicer than the multiple Legals I've been to in Boston.

The waiter came over to take our drink order. Throughout the night, he was nice enough, but a bit pushy/aggressive. I think he was told to up-sell or recommend different things, and it really didn't come across well. I ordered an iced tea and a glass of Chenin Blanc. A few minutes later, he came back to inform me that the Chenin Blanc was out and that they had a Sauvignon Blanc that he suggested instead. When I said I wasn't really a fan of Sauvignon Blanc, he said it tasted almost the same as the Chenin Blanc, and that these two wines were grown right next door to each other with very similar grapes. I didn't have time to re-look over the menu and felt kinda pressured, so I just said I'd have a glass of that (when the bill came, it was $2 more per glass, which he didn't mention). When it came, the glass definitely didn't taste anything like a Chenin Blanc. But it did go well with my food, so it was fine. My second glass, I ordered an Alberino, and I liked it a lot better. 

I ordered an appetizer of regular calamari ($12) and a crabcake appetizer for my entree ($15). My mom ordered a cup of clam chowder ($4.50) and the crabcake dinner with a side of scallops and shrimp ($29). The calamari and soup took forever to come. Like, forever. We were kinda looking around to see if they had forgotten us. Two pieces of delicious, hot bread came at some point and we gobbled it down and then just kept sitting and waiting for our apps. When they finally came, they were pretty decent. The clam chowder is amazing, hands down. The calamari was well-cooked, but just didn't have tons of flavor. I also really didn't like the dipping sauce (some sort of red marinara sauce). About 3-4 minutes into eating our apps, our dinner arrived. The waitress just stared at us, as we were eating our other food, and said "here are your dishes". She then just placed them at the side of the table and walked away. We were just kinda like ummmmm.... what? So we tried to finish our apps fast so our dinner wouldn't get cold. 

Moving onto our entrees. My mom and I got the exact same crabcake, with a side salad. The only difference between the two dishes was that mine only had a crabcake ($15) and hers had the crabcake along with 3 medium-sized scallops and 3 shrimps on it ($29). Definitely not worth $29... total rip-off. The menu said it was served with a side salad, and the waiter told us all this stuff that was in it (like nuts, cranberries, arugula, etc.). When it came, it was just a small pile of frisee salad with some cranberries on it. Weird. Maybe they ran out of the other ingredients? The crabcake also came with a sauce, and my mom had some on her plate, but I couldn't find any on my plate. But I must say... the crabcake was delicious. It had large lump crab in it and almost no filler. Two thumbs up. 

Throughout dinner, we went through 2 glasses of wine each, and I had about 3-4 glasses of iced tea, plus apps/entrees. Our waiter wouldn't totally clear our table when he would stop by, so we just had plates and glasses piling up at the side of our table. He would stop by, grab a wine glass, and leave the rest of the stuff there. It was really weird and my mom was getting super annoyed by all the clutter on our table. He also never asked us how our dinner was. 

For dessert, we decided to share a hot toddy. LOTS of bourbon in it, which I liked. So two thumbs up for that. Then we sat and waited for our bill for about 15 minutes. We were looking around the restaurant and didn't see our waiter anywhere. When it finally came, it was about $120. With tip, we spent almost $150 on dinner. Was it worth it? No. Was it worth maybe 2/3 that? Yes. When we left, the girl at the hostess stand was having a fight with somebody, and instead of saying goodbye as I smiled at her, she just ignored us and glared down at her stand. 
 
Overall, our dinner was "meh, okay". Most of the food was good (hot bread, crabcakes, clam chowder), but some was not so good (the calamari). The service was somewhere between neutral and horrible. And certain things on the menu were incredibly overpriced. I'd go back for dinner if I was at the mall and craving seafood, but I wouldn't make a special trip out of my way to come back here.

Update: my mom received an email from OpenTable today saying she didn't show up for her reservation. Sigh.

This hotel was fantastic. Stayed for only one night and for the price of the room I wasn't expecting much, however I was pleasantly surprised. Big spacious rooms with everything you can ask for, neat little shop downstairs for food and drinks, grills outside under a pavilion. Candlewood is the bomb and when I make my way back to Indy I will most certainly be staying here for it.

Friday evening, place was full.  Liked the atmosphere with the wine and oil/balsamic store sharing the space.  Had the crabcake dinner, she had the scallops.   Apps (soup/mussels) came out quick, then a big lag to our meals, which were warm and not hot..... like they sat at the window for a while before getting run out.  

Thats the gripe that knocks the rating down as the food was very good.  Will eat there again.

Meh.

Goi cuon was mostly vermicelli. No herbs, no pork, a shrimp and just a tiny bit of iceberg. Skip this

Pho is ok. The broth isn't especially rich, but it's not bad. The vermicelli in the Pho is mediocre. I didn't finish them. There are a zillion brands and I think they should consider a better brand
