We placed our orders, and I had the burger, which is listed on the menu as coming with bleu cheese, tomato, bacon relish.  What I got was a grilled meat patty and a bun on a plate. That's it. When I asked "wasn't this supposed to come with bleu cheese-something-or-other?" The waitress looked at me like I was a boil that needed lancing and grated "I guess they forgot to put it on there."  When I had the audacity to add "Could I get some lettuce and tomato too?" She looked at me like I'd just run over her dog, and said "I'll request that for you, sure." Wow. Like she was going to go to the Overlord and submit my LT2101 form, but it might not come back approved. 

The burger was decent, and the bleu-tomato-bacon relish was great.  The beer offerings are widely varied, and plenty of local selections, including Yuengling, are available.  Their wine list is great, and the prices are very, very reasonable for the quality of food you get. 

In the end, I wanted to like Harry's a lot more, but our server really went out of her way to make us feel bad about being there, so three stars is the best I can do.

This place is too good to be true!   Josh helped me out this time as 8 people rushed in at 4:45 on a Saturday.  Did we all have flat tires?   Staff is always friendly, professional and knowledgeable.  Why can't I get this level of customer service at the bank!?

I go to this QT ALL THE TIME. Everyone is super nice and the service is fast. Never have I ever watched someone work in there quik kitchen without gloves or a hairnet on, luckily a coworker pointed out the hairnet for me, good job putting it on when your halfway done with my food! & He still had his sweaty palms all over the rim of the cup to my smoothie. Gross. Never again.

I give it 5 stars because everything one could ask for is provided.  Authentic Mexican dishes? check. Even ones not on the menu? check. Dos XX? You know it.  Glasses you could fall in?  Believe it!  I have not been to another Mexican Restaurant in Tampa because I just cannot find a reason to leave this one.  I believe the happy hour is til 8:00 p.m. and you get 2 for 1 margaritas, however, they are not the top shelf ones which I definitely prefer.  Enjoy my friends

I live sandwiched between two children consignment stores and since finding Kids Sweet Repeats  I don't bother with the other one at all.  The owner's are extremely personable and helpful -- Bo learned my name after I had been there just once.  

My favorite part about shopping here is the online shop.  I'm able to reserve a good number of things online and pick them up whenever which takes the pressure off when you're looking for something particular.  

I definitely feel better buying the brands I love second hand since I know my kids are going to destroy them and Kids Sweet Repeats makes it easy.

I've eaten here several times.  i'm one of the people that enjoy sitting outside even when it's a little hot and muggy.  

They have a nice out door seating so I stop here  from time to time.  i had several things on the menu, but the last time i got the blackened grouper sandwich.  AND, they serve ice cold tap beer.  ice cold!!

The good :
The food is not bad!

The bad :
Here goes the story - I ordered 2 large pizzas for my friends and I on a weekday at 9:05 pm. I was told the pizza would be delivered in 45 mins. Well, 45 mins later I call them only to be told that the pizza delivery boy was out with the delivery and should be reaching us soon.(My place is 3.8 miles from the restaurant). 

20 mins later I still had hungry folks asking me where's the pizza. I give them a call and they say he should be really close and would be delivering the pizza soon. 

Another 15 mins later, I still had no pizza! I call them and the lady on the phone responds saying the pizza delivery guy left long back and the first delivery he had to make took him longer than expected and he should be in our place in under 5 mins. 

25 mins later, the pizza guy finally makes it, I was extremely hungry and angry that couple of pizzas took 2 hours to be delivered to a location which is 5 mins away! I ask him why he was late and his reply - "Well I was given the pizza 20 mins ago and I was lost". Either he was lying or the lady on the phone. 

I then paid him and upon opening the box realized that the pizzas were cold that I had to place it in an oven to make them edible ! Absolutely pathetic !! 

Will never be ordering from these guys again.

DON'T GO! I went in with a toddler (bi-racial) and asked for a high chair. I was told by the waitress give her one second while she takes food to another table. I waited and waited...again she said just hold on. Then I was given a look by another employee of disguist as she shakes her head at me. Kept standing there another couple of minut

If you want the best and award winning crepes, then you must try Planet of the Crepes Food Truck Crepes! Each order is freshly made by enthusiastic staff and perfectly prepared and presented! So delicious! I can't believe I ate the whole thing! I loved it so much that I make a point to go to the wonderful St. Philip's Plaza Farmer's Market every weekend to enjoy their crepes and of course check out the market. Just recommend you come hungry! These crepes are aaaaaaamazing!
Not a decent breakfast burrito. Sad. The sausage on the burrito tape I get there for days left overs cut in half. Half an egg, half a cheese slice. Not impressed.

Ellendale's is a great dining establishment tucked away behind the busier streets by the airport. The location lends to its charming character and exquisite selections. I just had drinks and appetizers, but I feel confident based on the service that we would enjoy the full dinner service. Reservations are recommended, especially on holidays, so take heed. They offer about a dozen specialty drinks and I chose the Milwaukee Style Bloody Mary. It was beautifully garnished with peppers & olives. It was very spicy and you could smell the horseradish before taking a sip. The appetizer, the James Bond, was a great combination of steak, mushrooms, & green olives in a rue. Jordan is a great and attentive bartender. So, go out and see him and the rest of the crew!
Great food! I had vegetable rice noodle soup and fresh spring rolls. Service was good and loved the Thai iced tea. The food came quick and the prices were reasonable.

Considering the dinery nature of Ellsworth, it really impresses. The food tastes homemade, like it's made by a mom--which it is. And then you're served by a son, who is attentive and friendly. You can buy cigarettes here, or napkins for 5 cents each, to give you a feel for how they operate. 

I got the St. Paul's sandwich because it's a St. Louis food. Mine was a fried mass of shrimp in between two soft pieces of wonderbread, with some lettuce, mayo, and pickles. When I dipped it in ketchup I was reminded of McDonalds in a positive, nostalgic way. 

The thing to get here is the General Jors chicken, which is like pieces of fried chicken with sauce on top, so it's not soggy or drowning in goop like other Chinese dishes. It's hot and fresh, so it's worth the small wait.

Wow, outstanding food at lunch and friendly service. Pita's were homemade and very fresh and delicious. Gyro was outstanding, lamb and beef so well prepared. Veggie balls and babaginoushe were both outstanding.
Staci A is the best! She has been doing my hair for years. Her coloring is always spot on, as are her cuts. Plus, she's fun to chat with. I always refer Staci to anyone who asks about my hair.

This place like many of their competitors, is a very slimy business. It was $19.99 over the phone, then i get here and its $30 cause my car uses 5w20 instead of 5w30, ok, when i asked how much?  it was $42.50 with the "shop fees" and all kinds of hidden costs.  Needless to say i walked, if they hadnt lied to me over the phone i wouldnt have wasted my Saturday coming here.

I'm a pretty big fan of Buffalo Wild Wings, but the Asian wings here were 10x better than the Asian zing wings at BWW. I typically come here to play golf and eat tater tots but I decided to enjoy some basketball and some drinks at the bar. The food definitely impressed me today. They only have two bartenders for the entire eating area which means they're under staffed but completely capable of the work load. I'm very satisfied!

Holy schnikes! What a fun place!  Pignic has great beer (ever changing), BBQ's for personal use (they only ask you buy a drink or two), plenty of outdoor space with a patio, and is great for events or parties.  

 The grill guys are great, they set everything up for you then bring you a box of grilling and eating utensils.  They have some meat & other grill items you can purchase, but it's cheaper to bring you own.  The paper towels, spices, etc. are by the fridge at the end of the bar btw, enjoy!

I heard about this place from several sources, all saying that this is the place to go! They were right; the food was excellent, service was incredible, margaritas were great. Very diligent staff and very friendly. The atmosphere felt so light and comfortable. This was a very great restaurant to visit and enjoy a meal. I think whoever enjoys Mexican cuisine should visit this place. I totally recommend it!

This place was right by my hotel and within easy walking distance of the convention center where I spent most of my days on a week long business trip.  And I ended up eating here almost every single day.  But it was more than just convenience.  The food here was exceptional.  The collard greens were some of the best I've had in years, bursting with flavor and filled with bacon.  And the fried chicken was amazing!  I know that other places have more name recognition for their fried chicken, but this place beats them all.  Perfectly crispy, perfectly spiced, and incredibly juicy.

The red beans and rice were also good, creamy and generously portioned.  Only thing that was a little less impressive was the alfredo pasta, which was good but not spectacular like their other offerings.

The service was great.   And the place was never very crowded at lunch time, so it was easy to get food within a short window of time (important when you've got limited time!)  Glad I discovered this place.  Will definitely recommend to any friends visiting New Orleans.

Wonderful meal tonight! Hubby and I ventured to Da Soli for a pre-Valentine's dinner & enjoyed every course. Noise level was appropriate and reasonable, timing of course was perfect, wait staff was appropriately attentive.

It's quite possible that my experience would have been slightly better if I hadn't ordered online, but it would really only be slightly.

Last year when I knew I would be in Philadelphia for a concert around August, I researched where the best place to get a Philly cheese steak would be.  After narrowing it down to three, i ultimately decided on Johns based on the incredible reviews.  

Since I was getting a hotel room and I knew what my timing would be like, I ordered online and set my order up to be picked up when I got there.  I ordered two philly cheese steaks with a side of cooked onions to add to my sandwich.  I found the orders slightly pricey, but since the trip into Philly only happens once in a while, I ordered them anyway.  

When we got to the area, parking was incredibly difficult to find so I sent my boyfriend in to pick up the sandwiches.  We then drove the twenty-five minutes back to our hotel in Camden, NJ and began to unwind from the seven-hour car ride that we had just taken.  

When we finally unpacked and settled down to eat, I can not tell you how disappointed I was, when I found that my philly CHEESEsteak didn't have any cheese.  Neither sandwich did, actually.  

When I was placing the order, the only option pertaining to cheese was whether or not you wanted EXTRA cheese.  Since it was a Philly CHEESEsteak that I ordered, I was under the impression that cheese was a given, otherwise it's a steak sandwich, right?  At this point, I had not only driven a half hour out of my way to go get this thing and even paid five dollars to cross a bridge, so going back was out of the question.  I had just spent like close to forty dollars to go out of my way and get a cheesesteak sandwich that required me walking across the street to the Wawa to buy a $5. package of cheese to melt on this thing.  

It is quite possible that this could have been avoided had the person who set up their online ordering been paying better attention... but to be quite honest, even if this thing had cheese, the bread was stale, the meat was hard and the onions weren't cooked enough.   

This thing was not only disgusting, but it was a big disappointment given all of the stellar reviews.

Portions are small and the prices are way overpriced for the amount of food you get. Granted seafood is expensive but this was literally not enough food for a 3 year old. Wouldn't return. There's many other places that you will get the same exact thing for less.

What a gem of a restaurant.  A friend and I shared the Polish sampler platter for 2 and as mentioned in previous reviews it was divine.  The service was excellent and the cafe is very well appointed with tasteful yet simple but also fun decor.  It has an upscale feel for a neighborhood cafe.  Even the background music was perfect (Edith Piaf on Pandora).  Met the owners who were lovely and made us feel most welcome.  Can't wait to return and try more of the menu selections.

Subs, like coffee and tax returns derive most of their quality from who prepares them.  That's why even sub chains like Penn Station can have the quality vary greatly from location to location.  Except Penn Station might be one chain exempt from that rule because every location I've ever been to has been delicious.

They all aren't amazing, but I think this location on Hampton is pretty close.  The real bonus is that the staff here are super friendly and fast.   Despite being so tasty, I do think they are a tad bid overpriced.  And I am not a fan of the lemonade-is-now-behind-the-counter-so-you-can't-order-a-regular-drink-and-get-it-without-paying-20-cents-extra trick.  But these are minor bumps in the road to sub sandwich heaven.

Pleasantly intrigued by the combination of breakfast and Thai/Chinese, so my sister and I had to swing through during our road trip from California to Georgia.

Hillbilly fried rice -- Two over-easy eggs over fried rice chopped ham, bacon, and sauasage made into fried rice... an incredible meal at 9:30am.

Gra pow -- Sister enjoyed this beef and rice entree. Commented that it was sweet and yummy with added flakey red peppers.

Tom yum soup -- Mintly fragant (shoutouts to lemongrass) and delicious. Wished I had ordered a larger size.

Shoutouts to the waiter bro for the friendly service. I would return during future road adventures.
What a hidden gem. Some of the best middle eastern food I've eaten in a long time. Amazed to find this is West County. This is now a staple of my diet since discovering it.

My buddy calls this place "Los Microwaves". It's not that bad actually, but to me, its just way overpriced. I much prefer Los Arroyos if you are looking for a similar Mexican dining experience, or if I'm just getting tacos I would go to Lily's.

I was driving the family on 86th street tonight, when they decided to have a pizza. We stopped at Puccini's, and what a mistake it was.
Let me start with the good - the kids who were running the place were all very nice. But that is about all that one can say positively about this place.
Now to the bad - the food.
The worst were the pizza and calzone, which were both not fully baked. No wonder we were scraping the toppings and refused to eat the actual slices. The calzone was chopped to bits, looking for a piece that could be eaten, then abandoned.
The salad and bread sticks tasted, well, "cheap". This would explain why the prices here are relatively inexpensive. Not because this place is a great bargain, but because one gets one's money worth.
As we left, I took a closer look at the kitchen. It says it all. The place looked like an assembly line, like an airport food outlet. Do they even cook anything there, or just grill/heat and pull together items that come from a central kitchen? A pile of bread slices, all wrapped in plastic, was just opened to prepare "fresh" garlic bread. 
Bottom line: I'll refuse to go to Puccini's in the future.

Last thought. I actually spent the time to read previous reviews, to understand how a place like this can actually be in business. Some of the reviews were shockingly supportive. Perhaps the lesson here is to ignore Yelp ratings of less than 300 reviews, at least. Or just admit that  Yelp may be entertaining, but a bad resource to pick your next restaurant reservation.
The best! We had a great meal, the hostess was very nice, and I love the renovations that happened over the winter.

Hello, 

My name is Jonathan Fayard and I work for Aptora. Me and Bill Dawson do business together. Bill has always been a pleasure to work with. I deal with allot of companies on a daily basis and Best Services Inc stands out due to high integrity and a highly trained professional work force.

Sincerely,
Jonathan Fayard

jaimie b I disagree. Although I have not had my hair done at Ulta.
Enter the store to the right is High end to the left...Lower. I feel like its a Macymart with an eerie feeling of jail cell as I pass through the two towers of snatch detection. The sales people
are either disinterested or clueless or maybe both. Their stock
is good for some products,poor for others and I "get" that its geared for younger women but I ask myself on my way out past
the twin towers..."Whos YOUR Daddy?"

It's become unfortunate that I love Buffalo Wild Wings, except I have continuously received poor service and poor quality food. I never recommend sitting in the bar area because it will take forever to get service to begin with and anything you might need after that, like water.. well forget it. What topped it off for me tonight was my food. I placed a to go order and once I received it the wrap I got had no meat at all. I doubt there was even 2oz of meat in the wrap. It was all tortilla.. extremely disappointing. I hope they step up their service and food quality because I do love the food, but I won't be going back for awhile.

i HATE the seats in this theatre, they almost cripple me after a few hours, a plus is you can purchase food in the mall to go & depending on which person (if any) is taking tickets, you can take it in
i'm glad they have ONE theatre Downtown, but where's the stadium seats?

My sister came into town and wanted chargrilled oysters. We weren't really hungry so we just ate a bunch of oysters and appetizers. The crabmeat au gratin was awesome. My sister wanted to try the shrimp and grits with tasso. It was like eating a spoon of salt! Yuck.

Wow, this was outstanding in every aspect with the only exception of two tables near us were so loud I think they were competing to see who could be the loudest. Back to the food, they have a weekly fixed menu that offers incredible choices all of which are prepared to perfection, deserts were to die for, byob or wine no corkage fee here. Our server made you feel like you were royalty and extremely knowledgeable on the menu items. Place is very small and RESERVATIONS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

Yo, this TAIWANESE restaurant is the FUCKING BEST. The owners are super cool and nice and the food is awesome. I have been to this place over 10 times already. If you like Asian food then I highly recommend you to come here. NICEEEEE. They also have a little buffet too, so if you are lazy then you could also try to buffet.

I had a horrifying experience at this place.  I wouldn't even go back if it was free.  The entire time I was there was a sales pitch to buy packages and their products.  The technician didn't leave the room to let me undress and get settled.  I got a bikini wax and she went over the same places with the wax "three to four times" which she said is normal, and I know that's not.  I know waxing is uncomfortable and at points can hurt, the pain that she inflicted on me was beyond anything I've experienced.  I almost told her to just stop because she was so bad at what she does.  THEN, when I got home, there were still areas of hair left.  She didn't even do her job!

We headed to Bazbeaux on Saturday night after attending Comedy Sportz.  We had a group of 8 and arrived about 9:45.  We were seated quickly and our waitress came by to take our order.

I didn't like the attitude of our server, but maybe she was just having a bad day.

The food was pretty decent - although I was a little disappointed with the Garden pizza.  The deluxe veggie at Papa Murphy's is significantly better.

It was more expensive than I feel it was worth.  I probably won't be back, but it was ok.

Stopped by on the way home. Very friendly staff whipped up a delicious cheesesteak with hot peppers in less than 5 minutes. Excellent sandwich. Menu had a ton of choices and had a south Philly  style flair to the selections. Clean location with a TV to watch the football game while dining in if you choose. I would come again.

This place has really gone downhill in the last 6 months. The yogurt use to be yummy and creamy and not its a completely different consistency. Seems they are cutting it with milk which is an interesting move since they also raised the prices. Sadly, it's the only fro-yo place in the area so if you are having a craving they are your only option.
Bring back the old stuff. It was sooooo good

Took our two yr old lab here this afternoon, since he goes to camp 3 or 4 times a month he is very well socialized, loves people and all other dogs, even cats, Once you get through the gate, it;s like walking in a mine field of dog poop, literally you cannot look 20 ft in any direction without seeing a pile left behind by lazy owners, actually witnessed 3 dogs doing their business while were there ( only stayed 15 minutes) and watched the dog owners just walk away like it was something they were accustomed to doing everywhere,  for the following, I do not believe there is anything such as a bad dog, just bad owners, There were two guys there who each had a pit bull, obviously one male and one female, they were trying to breed them, My problem is this, my lab was smelling everywhere, like labs do, being friendly with everyone and every dog in the place, when he approached the pits, immediately they both became very aggressive towards him, the owners had to quickly grab them by the collars to get them of of him, luckily they had not bit him, My wife and I immediately decided to leave this horrendous place before we either were witness to a dog fight or would have had to confront these idiots who think it perfectly ok to take your dog to a dog park  to breed them, I will NEVER take my or any other dog to this park, it is unkempt, smelly from dog feces and obviously some people there who have no business at such a place.  I personally think it needs to be a manned by a county employee to stay on top of people since some dog owners do not know what responsibility is. Even while leaving, there was a woman taking her boxer in the gate as we exited, I told her, watch out for those two pits, the guys are trying to breed them and they are a bit aggressive, her response, Oh, he will tell them ( her dog). I suppose he is superdog and can single handily take on two pit bulls , again, another fine example of people who do not need to own a dog. In the end, had my dog been hurt, I would not have hesitated to protect him by whatever means necessary, from man or beast..

Going to see Cameo was the best thing I did for myself during pregnancy and even after pregnancy! I would highly recommend Cameo for prenatal massage and continuing on after pregnancy. 
I started going to Cameo when I was about 14 weeks pregnant and feeling the effects of pregnancy. I felt amazing after my first session!!! I continued to go to Cameo through out my entire pregnancy. My child is 6 months old and I continue to see Cameo and continue to feel relaxed and rejuvenated after each session.  
Cameo really listens to how you are feelings and makes great efforts to work on troubled areas. Cameo is professional, knowledgeable, and excellent at what she does. Her work space is relaxing, comfortable, and tranquil. If you are looking for a massage therapist who is simply the best at what they do, call Cameo!!

Are you interested in being overwhelmed with choices?! THIS IS YOUR PLACE. They have everything you could ever need and then 5-8 other options that are just as good. I love the market and I recommend everyone check it out. Cheap produce and solid selection.

As we were walking around in Santa Barbara we came across this location.  We were seated fairly quickly. Our server gave us prompt attention and delivered our drinks quickly.   The food came out and was very well prepared.  The only thing I can complain about is the soup could've been a little warmer. The fish was excellent.  The restaurant is a clean well run restaurant. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone in the area that would like to get a good dinner and be well served.


I visit Santa Barbara at lest 5 or 6 times a year. The town seemed like it changed so much I was glad to see how nice you keep your building.  It was a pleasure eating there.

Food is always very tasty and at a very reasonable price. The service on the other hand has something to be desired.  I have been there many times and the first two were my absolute best with both the food and the service. Since this time my service experiences have been less than stellar, but the food has remained good.

This place is great, if you can find a seat.  The bartenders may seem like they're giving you a hard time; but they always give a good pour and warm up by the time you leave.  A lot of bars that specialize in beer will screw you on drink size, pour, and attitude if you order a cocktail in this town...not here.  This place operates more like a neighborhood joint, and they have great beer.

They recently updated they menu, and the new items are fantastic.  The new burgers are even better than the old greats, and the veggie burger may be the best I've had.

This is a good place to duck out of work early, before it gets crowded; but you end up staying way too late.  This aspect makes this place kind of dangerous.
cozy place, not too busy and loud (came after work on a week day though). The environment is just right for chats over drinks and food. Would love to come back on a weekend night.
Horrible service!  It's like a bunch of high school kids who don't give sh*t, slow and they disappear.  Could care less, all great qualities when in the service industry.  Have fun, I won't anymore.

We have been customers of SPS for the past four years. Their work is always top notch and the service they provide is outstanding.  Most recently, we converted from propane to natural gas. Their expertise was exactly what we needed. They actually advised us of some financing programs the gas company was offering and wound up converting our entire house including changing to new heating and air-conditioning- all high-efficiency units

You cannot go wrong with using SPS for all your mechanical needs
This popular place is one of my favorite "go to " restaurants. Great for celebrations, casual dining & even carryout & happy hour.The staff is fun & knowledgeable & the food is YUM! Recommended.

I have consigned here and had an overall good experience. The only snag occurred when my some of my items dropped off for consignment were processed during a different time frame than initially expressed to me during my consultation. Fortunately, I followed up earlier than my paperwork indicated, and I was able to retrieve my "rejected" items. No such snag happened during the claim period after my consignment ended. My advice to consignors: Be proactive in the process and be vigilant about following up for items you want to retrieve at the beginning and close of the consignment period in order to avoid a sour experience.

The staff is friendly. I went in periodically to check on my consignment and was always treated considerately. I was a little bummed at some of the pricing of my items (pricing is left to the sole discretion of the shop), but I made more than selling at B/E. I sold almost all my items,  and my check arrived promptly in the time frame they told me.

I've browsed as a consumer, and the clothes are cute and in great condition. So, from both perspectives--as consignor and consumer--I can recommend Green Street and will return.

The Next Act is legitimately my favourite place to eat on the Whyte Avenue! They're food is delicious, they're beer list is awesome and the staff is super fantastic! 

If you go you should check out the Cameo which is a sandwich offering that changes every week and is always awesome! 

I appreciate the staff a lot because sometimes it is mad busy in there and they're always funny and gracious!

Ordered for take out and went to pick it up. When I walked in, the most obvious thing was that the portions are way bigger if you eat in. The food on the menu is from multiple areas in Asia, and I loved being able to dip my banh mi into a thai curry with so many veggies and pieces of beef. It was surprisingly spicy which was exactly what I asked for. The banh mi was better than I've had in a while, with the fresh vegetables and the jalapenos making it crisp, and the pork flavors and bread made me crave another. Not too expensive of an option compared to other Thai places.

Came again and ate in-- the portions were bigger and the pad thai was on point! Will be my go to place for refreshing sandwiches this summer.

All the reviews were right! We loved the food- vegetarian, lechon, Cuban, fritta- all bursting with flavor, great texture, so fresh and delicious. Portion was generous. We enjoyed fresca from here, as well as juices from next door. Staffs at bodega were kind and cheerful. We enjoyed eating outside with salsa music playing. We'll be back.

Upon writing this review I seen they already have a 2.5 star rating. They aren't that good. Let's start with appearances, they have a buffet setup that didn't have any food in the trays but school supplies and coloring books. Is this a daycare? No. I come to the register and a 12 yo boy takes my order. Asks me twice if I want anything else. I'm like no. Im polite and so is he. I order bbq spare rib tips with sfr. The ribs were full of bones and over cooked. I will not be back.

What an awesome restaurant! It's on top of a hill in this old looking house. I loved the atmosphere. This place is enormous...

I tried the chicken pasta for lunch. Delicious!! It's gotta be one of the best pasta's I've ever had. 

I also had the soup of the day (chick pea?). Just wonderful!

Food was amazing ! Chow mien is so flavorful and the noodles are perfection. 10/10 would recommend! So tasty and didn't leave me feeling super sleepy after and that's after eating way more than I should've.
Wonderful service!  The mechanic, Juan, was prompt, polite and very informative. He went out of his way to instruct me on prevention and troubleshooting future problems!  Thank you!!!
If you're looking for a good crabcake with actual crab in it, this is your place. Everything we got was tasty. First time trying fried soft shell crab and I'll def come back for more.

Centrally located so it's easy to find, Sonora Quest Lab seems to handle anything I need for bloodwork. The staff is sometimes friendly-ish but mostly just all business. 

You sign in on the pedestal in front of the counter and then take a seat in their huge waiting room. Without an appointment you may wait an hour in the early afternoon. Those with an appointment seemed to wait as well. It would have been over a week to schedule an appointment so I opted to do a walk-in.

I called ahead to make sure they would be able to do all my labs. They said yes. I took my order in and waited for 75 minutes while they inputted everything in the system. It would have been much better if they had written things down over the phone so it was ready when I came in. As it was, I had to come back the following day to get the actual blood drawn. Another hour wait. I'm disabled and live with chronic pain and fatigue so this was a major problem for me.

My doctor got my lab results quickly. They only odd thing was that one of them had my birthdate wrong. This was really weird because the labs were all drawn at the same time. I personally looked at the labels on all 22 vials after the tech completed the draw. So something got mixed up somewhere. 

Also, my doctor and I thought we ordered a specific lab that did not show up. Since I handed over the only copy of my lab order, we can't be sure. But now I have to go back in for another draw.

Had an excellent dinner at this fun, kitschy, casual Cajun joint.  Fried green tomato and calamari and special spicy brussel sprouts appetizers were amazing.  Complimentary cornbread muffins and a fried oyster salad were outstanding too.  For dinner, we enjoyed the fries chicken, crawfish etoufee and a soft shell crab special entrees.  A lively place with a good bar and friendly service.  Will definitely go back.

Food was so bad that we walked out! Cheese dip cold, chips cold, greasy,shrimp fajitas had 3 small pieces of cold plastic like shrimp. The sour cream smelled rotten. My refried beans were in a bowl that looked like soup and smelled foul. Waitress didn't care. So we left.

It's about time I give some credit where it's due. I had been getting Banh Mi sandwiches at a place by my house when they suddenly stopped making them. 

Eventually my craving for a Banh Mi brought me to Yelp to find a new place to get them. That's when I found the reviews for Tan Phat. 

First of all, when you walk into this place, you'd have no idea they were slinging magic sandwiches out of the back. It's a small Asian market with few signs of food preparation actually happening there. Don't worry, you're in the right place! 

When I got there I thought, this little place can't be selling delicious sandwiches, can it? Then the pleasant gentleman behind the counter rang me up.......3.50. 

I was horrified. Just how good could a three dollar and fifty cent sandwich be? 

How bout the best freaking Banh Mi sandwich I've ever had in my life good! For three dollars and fifty cents. 

I had to give this place 5 stars because it's such a hidden gem, and such a great value. I mean, you can't get a crap sandwich at a gas station for 3.50.

My family has been coming to Palms for many, many years. It's in a really old building that you can tell was a house once in the olden days (especially near the restrooms). The trick is to get here right before they start serving dinner at 5:30, otherwise there is a wait, especially on the weekends. The bar is nice too. I usually order the salmon if I am really hungry because it only takes a few minutes to cook. Otherwise, I get the filet mignon which I cook for 6 minutes on the first side, then 4 minutes on the other, and let rest for about 5 minutes. Whatever you choose, be sure to season it very well. If that is too much to remember, you can also order food cooked by them. They have really improved on the side dishes. The beans are better. The croutons are better now too, before they were fried and the grease used to congeal on the roof of my mouth. Overall, the Palms is something different and good value.

I'd been dying to try this place since driving by the brand new sign a few weeks ago, even more so after viewing their menu online.  Safe to say, my expectations were high.  Just imagine my excitement when they were exceeded 10 fold.  Two of us decided to pay them a visit on a recent Saturday evening soon after the grand opening.

We couldn't make up our minds and had both the Sopressata Piccante and Filetti di Pomodori - all pizzas are 14 inches and in the $13-18 range, and all looked delicious.  Both were excellent.  The Sopressata Piccante was topped with their tomato sauce, spicy sopressata, and homemade mozzarella.  It had  a little bit of a kick but wasn't too spicy to be enjoyable.  The Filetti di Pomodori was great as well, a simple oil and garlic sauce with fresh basil and tomatoes in addition to their phenomenal homemade mozzarella.  The crust on both was perfect - chewy and soft, just crisp enough to maintain the structure without the slice flopping all over the place.

We ordered 2 pizzas with the intention of taking leftovers home, but they didn't stand a chance.  We couldn't stop until we finished every last crumb, and I practically had to be rolled out of the place.  So worth it.  

It's a casual place, brightly lit with a handful of clean tables.  Having both grown up in old-school Italian families we felt right at home between the wonderful food, friendly owners, and Ellis Island photos adorning the walls.

This isn't a fancy, 5-star Italian restaurant downtown.  They make pizza, and they do it well, clearly not wasting any space or talent on salads, hoagies, or other accompaniments.  The only thing I might add would be a simple mushroom pizza, given the proximity to Kennett Square and wide availability of fresh, delicious funghi.  It's a BYOB so we took a six pack with us, a few others had brought wine in on this particular evening.

Would highly recommend to anyone looking for an authentic Italian pie, especially given the paucity of good pizzerias in the area.  We'll definitely be back.

Yum yum yum!! The everything avocado toast is delicious!! I was visiting for a few days and saw this on yelp! I was not disappointed at all! I also ordered the Healthy Elvis, which was also delicious. The service was quick and the staff was very friendly!

Wow, so good. I was in town to drop my son off at a lacrosse camp and found this listed on yelp. When you pull up it looks like a deli shop (I wasn't even sure they were open). I had the rigatoni and meatballs and it was both inexpensive and fantastic. Very simple decore so no romance but the meal was great.

Omg the food was amazingly phenomenal, i will be transparent at first i was a bit skeptical because out the establishment appearance but "don't judge a book by its cover" matches this place perfect. Trust me when i say you will not be displeased. Friendly staff, amazing food, a bit crowded but definitely worth the wait.  three thumbs up!!!!

This was my go to spot for the morning after (afternoon after seems more appropriate) when I lived in the area. They have the most amazing wings. They are fairly small, but very crispy and loaded with sauce. Their philosophy on this is that "smaller sized wing makes a tastier wing because the meat is cooked perfectly through" and I could not agree more. I personally suggest having them mix the hot sauce and bbq sauce together- you will not be disappointed. Their pizza is so-so.. Seems lacking in sauce and overcooked. This I have only noticed when ordering slices, not whole pies. They renovated at some point within the last few years and added the counter. The atmosphere seems able to accommodate just about anyone. Their beer selection is pretty good. You are able to have a beer or two with your meal if you eat in. Worth a try.

Good barber and gave me exactly what I wanted. After going here I haven't been able to make time to get back in, but will try harder now. The other shops just don't compare and I walk away thinking i've been ripped off. I also made the mistake of not having cash, he does have a sign though, and I simply went to the atm at the Tattoo shop next store. If you have to wait, then wait, it's worth it.
Excellent food, great price.  Ordered the meatball pizza +chicken, sweet potato fries, and girlfriend had balsamic cranberry chicken.  Would eat at again.

Lemme start by saying this ain't the Metairie store. This one is packed with poor service. The waiter forgot not one but 2 people's orders. Even after being reminded of it. We waited close to an hour for our food. 

Food was decent as food in Louisiana always is but the price is on the expensive side so not for a casual meal definitely a date kind of place. 

Would not recommend this restaurant.

Kids had a great time however all of the adults felt like the host was not friendly and pretty rude to the kids actually. My husband and I agreed that he didn't seem interested, kept telling the kids to sit down and raise their hand. My son who was the birthday boy wanted to play a game and he went around and kept asking if anyone else wanted to play before he let them- said it has to be a democracy. Just didn't like his vibe at all. For the amount of money this cost would have liked a host that was more kid friendly, engaged and pleasant.

The Edge is everything all in one. An amazing view, great staff, clean rooms, very comfortable all around. I was very pleased with the dining experience and options. We had a formal dinner at what they call the 505 and then went to the 10th floor with a view that is simply breathtaking for the sunset. I took a picture of the fire bar up there. They even have option for transportation/limo service and fun rentals to get around on Clearwater Beach. Our friends are thinking about using them for their upcoming wedding.They have a big square deck out on the water across from the jetty. Very, cool. I highly recommended this hotel/experience. Larry Bell

I recently picked up a cannoli cake and it legit was the best cake EVER!!! SO MUCH better then actual cannolis. I was so so happy with it!!! They also now have little cup desserts, I got the peanut butter silk one for my boyfriend and he loved it. I also picked up a small blueberry cheesecake for myself, DELISH.

Still my absolute favorite bakery in South Jersey! I just wish they had gluten free/vegan options for when I feel guilty about eating desserts. But I don't think they specialize in that and I'm sure NOT having those items is a reason why everyone still loves this bakery so it's okay I guess LOL

I really love this place. I've been ordering delivery once or twice a week over the last few months, which is terrible for my wallet but so extremely rewarding for my taste buds. Soondubu and Jajangmyun are my favorites. I used to live in NYC and went to Ktown often, but when I moved here I realized Philly doesn't have as many options for Korean food, so it's a blessing that this place exists. It's consistently good and satisfying food that's reasonably priced, what's not to love?
Amazing food. A must visit. The bartender Crystal gave excellent service and makes even better drinks. Had the fried chicken and would definitely recommend you try it!

This was a really great place for a casual night out. The menu features all of the usual cravings plus some creative spins on popular classics. The food was pretty average but nonetheless very delicious. Only complaint was that lettuce was forgotten on one of the burgers, but other than that it was great! The atmosphere was also nice because it was very Philly sports themed so customers would feel at home in the restaurant.

Writing an update specifically to say the owner replied back to this update when I originally posted this providing an explanation for the service and offering to provide me with a wax for free done by her, when I replied and declined the offer, looks like she removed her response. LOL.

Hidden gem. Lived here my whole life and never knew about it! Atmosphere is eh and the place is cramped, but the food totally made up for it. We both got the crab stuffed raviolli. Amazing! We practically licked the plates clean. Free taste of bruscetta when we sat down- nice and yummy touch, but skip dessert. It seemed like it was out of a box- nothing special for the price tag. Can't wait to go back, but I'm sure we'll need a reservation if we try to go on a weekend.
This place is absolutely great definitely a jem on central. Friend plantains are addictive and third pork is yummy.

This place has an amazing vegan option. I had the vegan bowl and it was aaamazingggg. I will definitely come back but this time I'll make sure that I take it to go, which is why....I'm giving this place a 3 star for the following reason:

Lack of staff professionalism! I was there last night and it got very awkward for a moment there, not because of the customers but because of an employee. He (taller dude) went off on the cooks and was cursing to the point where everyone was just awkwardly quiet and I kid you not... the place was empty within 10 min. Yelling at them to not "f#%king talk to him unless it's work related" etc. He went as far as telling his next customer that his co workers annoyed him. Dude you're at work and should remain professional, no need for all that. Anyway it was laughable but awkward lol.

Like a lot of Santa Barbara fish places, this place is okay.  Nothing spectacular, but they have decent food.  If you go for happy hour be warned that you will be crammed in next to strangers and the stools you are forced to sit on are very uncomfortable.

The guy working there was uncomfortably awkward. He was very knowledgable of the garments, but seemed offended when I wanted to know what attire a pink g-string would go with. I was really just curious. Great selection. So awkward.
I love the romantic atmosphere, great place to take a date that your trying to wooo. I've been here 3 times and enjoyed it every time . The staff is amazing and friendly.

This is very classy for a chillis!, I have had great experiences here with friendly staff, and prompt service and good food.

I did have one negative experience but they handled it professional and excelled in customer service as my dish was not at all up to par, the waitress offered me something else off the menu but I was pressed for time, so she took it off my bill and apologized. I will definitely go back!

The staff was fantastic - very helpful and accommodating. Inside restaurant staff and outdoors' ride staff! Unfortunately, their gaming set up is so confusing - you pay for tokens, yet they give the kids credit cards and the games cost strange amounts like 3.1  ???!!!  My husband and I mentor children, all of the kids, six (6), ages (6 - 9) had a blast outdoors. We dropped $250+ for the afternoon. When we moved indoors to eat and game, we expected that the games would yield a few tickets per game... In any event, the few tickets that were accumulated garnished only enough for cheap rings that didn't fit little fingers. On the way out the door 4 rings fell off those tiny fingers and there were tears galore! My husband, tried to remedy the situation by going back to the "prize" counter to buy 4 little cheap rings and was turned down. He was told he couldn't buy them. I'm sorry but Chuck E Cheese would have given him free replacements. AND, a token is a token, and they give players a prize no matter how many coupons a child might have. 

I am not promoting CCC, because I also could have bought one seasonal pass to Disney for the year.... No Disney promotion. Kudos to the staff. Again, kudos to the staff, consisting of mostly enthusiastic young men and women.

We stayed here for a night before our cruise in the Quarter tower, 14th floor. We had a great room that faced the French Quarter. This tower has been recently renovated. I can tell because I've stayed at plenty of Marriott hotels for work. This tower has elevators where you simply key-in the floor you want to go to and it will tell you which elevator will take you there. The key cards are so new they don't even say Marriott on them yet. When you look over from the Quarter tower to the River tower, you can see that rooms in the River tower have not yet been renovated. 

I liked this hotel. It was in a great location, right next to the French Quarter and across the street from the Central Business District. We were able to walk 10 mins to the cruise port rather than spend $7 on a taxi. 

I would stay here again.

WiFi is free for Elite members.

This year the festival was at Penn's Landing. It was difficult to find what to do and where to go. I've been to the past festivals on the Parkway which logistically was a better set up. My kids 13 and 10 still enjoyed themselves. Lots of free items to take and not so long lines to participate in the different hands on activities. I recommend getting there early to get first access to the free stuff and activities.

Another great meal at Bonefish!
Octavia, our waitress was fantastic.
Informative and super sweet. 
Started off with the calamari and it was delish. Then I had the spicy tuna bowl and was it great! Such a super presentation I had to take a picture. We were seated in the booths by the bar and I asked the bartender if she would put the Phillis on and she was happy to oblige:) I was feeling down after a bad day before dinner but after leaving was dancing out to the car. Thanks for another great meal and I look forward to going back soon!

This place is great. Apparently it's been here a while, but there just isn't that much review information on this spot (on yelp anyway). I didn't record much data on my last trip, so I'll be sure to leave an update at some point when I got back.

Let's see... what do I remember? Well, I can't remember the name of my dish, but it was basically a make your own taco kind of deal, with rice and beans on the side. It was extremely good, but I'm confident that pretty much whatever you wind up getting here will be quite good. They also serve avocado with most of their dishes, so that's kind of cool as well?

I'm not sure if water is free here. Because I didn't ask, I wound up buying a jarritos. I would encourage you to actually bring some water when you come here just because I'm not clear on the protocol, since their green sauce or whatever it is... is actually pretty hot. They also serve some interesting looking breads here, but I didn't get the chance to try. I promise to write an update soon!

This is pretty much where to go when you want some Chinese baked goods. Even Asian stores that carry Chinese baked goods probably got them form Fortune Star Bakery. Just take a peep at the label and you may even see the name Fortune Star Bakery on it.

I wouldn't say this place sells the best baked goods but it's pretty good in the area. There's not many Chinese bakery that I know in the area compared to where I'm from so I don't have much of a choice. My favorite baked good from when I was young would have to be the Egg Custard Tarts.

They also bake some good Asian cakes. The fruit filled ones. Compared to the American cakes you would buy at a grocery store these cakes are super soft and not as sweet. The frosting is whipped and loaded with fruits!

Seriously amazing food and coffee. I was a little bummed when I moved because I hadn't found a favorite coffee spot - the search is over! The horchata espresso is fantastic. Each burrito order is actually 2! The chorizo is the best I've had. Oh and the tamales? YUM. Vegetarian and vegan options too! This place is a must try. I also love the patio seating.

The only reason this place getting a star, is because I have too. I had the worst experience in my life at CITY DINER. The manager Danny was my server: he was very rude he let me know that my color skin was not welcome there. He was sharp tongue  with my 13th year old daughter When she was placing her order. We had a mother/daugther day @ the Fox.. HE RUIN IT... with his racist. ... The meatloaf  dinner was garage! It was cold it tasted like grease in my mouth. It was burnt on the bottom, they put alot on gravy on it to cover up I couldn't see wat I was eating. I moved the gravy over it wasn't appealing. I ask for hotter food. He told me it was hot & he seen it prepared.  He then took  the plate away ,over to the shake station & put it in the microwave, then start making shakes! I got a box for daughter food n ask for bill. I had to wait for Danny to close ticket. The other worker couldn't help.. He continues to ignore us walking around. I waiting 10 minutes before took my money n walk away & and said. These peoples never want to pay. REALLY. Then he came back with my changes 5 minutes later. Im looking at him the whole time.. He  just put my changes   on the counter n didn't even acknowledge me n my child as a person. I just walk off out holding my child hand. I explained to her im only accountable for my actions, not Danny. I never dine there again.

I have been going to Dunedin brewery for 3 years now and I will keep going as long as I live in Florida. Wednesday night jams and weekend music is always on point. I love everyone there and always have a great time.
 The selection of beer has always been good but I'd like to see more.. the cranberry wheat, american classic ipa, fruits of liesure, and the moon reflects on hibiscus should all be on the list! 
The food is delicious poutine with jalapeño curds has to be my favorite!
Service is good most of the time but could be a little better I always suggest the brewery to my friends and they always come back to me saying they loved it but that the service was poor and they weren't treated nicely.

Very disappointed.  Hardly anyone was here. Server didn't know what she was doing. My drink took 15 mins. to get from the bar. 
Order a half salad with chicken....came with no chicken, romaine was old. 
Manager was hanging out at the door leaning on wall. 
Just a typical Antioch experience.

We haven't been to this Pizza Hut in over a year.  Not crowded for a Saturday night. We were seated right away to a table that had straw wrappings and a piece of crust near the paper towel holder.  The menu is the same as a takeout menu. So, they no longer have some of the items we previously enjoyed at Pizza Hut dine in locations such as garlic bread and salad.

We ordered a pizza without sauce, just cheese for the kids. It was overcooked and didn't have the usual amount of cheese.  They didn't want to take the leftovers (first time not taking pizza leftovers). We also ordered a vegetable pizza that was fine.

I don't know where to begin with this.  We got to the restaurant and it was mostly empty.  The time was about 6:15.  Our table was dirty and we had someone come over and clean it for us.  It should have been an omen of things to come.  We ordered our beverages and they arrived shortly thereafter but then the service deteriorated.  We ordered appetizers which took about 30 minutes to come out.  The appetizers were good but super delayed.  When we finished the appetizers, we were anticipating our main course to be done shortly as the restaurant was pretty empty.  We waited, waited, waited some more and then a bit more.  After half an hour was up (after finishing our appetizer), the time now being 7:40 pm, we asked for a manager.  That took about five minutes.  My wife asked the manager how long was an appropriate wait for a meal after finishing our appetizer to which he responded a few minutes.  I guess 30 minutes was a bit excessive.  Suffice it to say, we were out of there.  This excursion ruined our evening as we wanted to see a movie at the local theater but by the time we got there, everything had started.  We did wonder around 9pm if our food was done yet.

Updated to add- still amazing. Best priced blow out in the city. Rochelle rocks!!!

Amazing service, great vibe, and most importantly amazing stylists!! Rochelle rescued 10months of unkempt hair, she is AMAZING!!!! Prices are very reasonable, I would pay more for the quality I received. If you know exactly what you want or if you have no idea it's the place to go. Highly recommended.

Went here the other night for a big group event.  They were very accommodating, gave us some big tables, and prepared our wings in advance so we didn't have to wait too long.  

All we had were the wings, but they were great.  I have had the other things on the menu before (burgers, ribs ect.) and not been that impressed, but that doesn't really bother me as they are all about wings and they do them well.  They have a great variety of sauces to choose from ranging from totally mild to unbelievably spicy.  All were worth trying. My personal favorites were Garlic Parmesan and Asian Zing.   Wings were well cooked, not overdone or too greasy.  They were well sauced, not too much, not too little.  Decent beer selection too with a number of specials. 

The atmosphere is a little noisy. There is a bar area and a seating area, and both have huge numbers of TV screens showing any and all sports games that are on.  I am sure this place fills up for big games.  

Bottom Line:  If you want to eat a whole meal of wings in a very sports focused environment, BWW is a good bet.

My sister and I popped in for drinks and appetizers after a day of Christmas shopping in December. A lively and fun place the food was delicious and though they were very busy, it came out in no time at all. Order the queso app!

Skip the drinks--they were good margaritas but very small. That's the only reason I didn't rate them 5 stars.

What a great find! I had strolled past this spot because it was near my hotel and decided to stop in and grab a sandwich.

I stopped in after the lunch hour figuring it would be less crowded. It was still a bit crowded. There are tables and chairs to the left and to the right is a counter to place to go orders. 

I had to wait my turn, but that gave me the time to peruse the menu of hot & cold sandwiches. They have salads too, but I ignored. I had narrowed it down to either the Muffaletta or Smokey Blue. So I asked the counter clerk her opinion and she confidently answered the Smokey Blue. Sandwiches come with chips or a salad (mixed greens, parmesan & a creamy garlic dressing). I had to wait about 10-15 minutes. As I waited I noticed they have a happy hour and events with wine & cheese pairings. They have a great selection of items to take home for your own party.

The Smokey Blue? Excellent. House smoked blue cheese, sliced roast beef, worcester mayo, tomatoes, lettuce on toasted Wild Flour multigrain bread. The simple greens were perfect too. All the ingredients were fresh.

This was the best sandwich I have had in ages!

Not sure what the issues the previous reviews are about.  I had a very good experience with DC painting.  The cost of the job was competitive but fair in comparison with the other estimates I got.   His team was competent, and professional.  The office team was also great to work with even when I made an error they had no problem helping get it resolved.  I would hire them again.

Called AATS after the last big storm.  I had lost several branches on multiple trees and was concerned about one falling over.  Josh scheduled me for the following week and came by when scheduled.  We discussed my issues and he made some suggestions.  He was very knowledgeable and didn't try to upsell me on anything.  He was up front about the work that would be done and said he would e-mail me an estimate after he got back to the office.  I received the estimate later that day and it was lower than I had expected.  He let me know that due to the volume of calls it would be about 4 weeks before he could get to me.  I had no problem with that and scheduled the work.  
  The work was done exactly as promised and in the time-frame estimated.  These guys do a great job and I will use them again in the future.
Bolton's is one of my favorite hot chicken joints. I love the location, the environment, and the heat. It feels so real when you order and eat. I like being able to bring my own drink as well.

I ve been going there for almost 4 years. I usually get my haircut by the younger lady. Last 3 times, I got my haircut by the owner who is in her 60's, she didn't do it as I asked her to do. She asked me "how do you want me to cut your hair?" I gave her the instructions.... it seems that she can't follow the directions. Later I saw other people showing her pictures of models or celebrity, cuz she can only carry conversational talk. The owner (older looking woman) was so rude saying that I came without making appointments and talking behind back of me. She thought I can't hear or do not understand Korean. I asked her how much is the haircut as I was handing her $20, she is like "it's $20' then I gave the "huh?" look. Other places charges me $15 with better service. Then she awkwardly she replies, "you gave me $20 including tips right?" I have never seen any hair stylist as rude as her. I go there because of convenience but now I am graduating and going back home. I am glad I don't have to deal with that type of profesionalism. 

Watch out folks. If you don't understand English, she has a tongue of Devil.

I give 2/5 rating because I had good experience with the younger woman.
Love this place! Luck of the Irish & really good rum raisin in a waffle cone was fantastic! So good!

If I want just a drink I'll come back and only sit at the bar. If I want food with a drink will not be back. Service was horrible waited very long for everything then had to ask for anything we need ex. Napkin, silver ware, water just the normal. Cool idea of a place but not super impressed.

There isn't really anything wrong with this P.J. Whelihan's and I do prefer this location to some of the others in the area. However, there isn't anything special about it either. It is basically a chain restaurant, similar to Applebees or Fridays although slightly less family oriented. You have your normal chain/bar menu where food and drinks are concerned. The service is normally friendly, the food is decent but I don't enjoy the atmosphere. It's just not my scene. It is, however, a good location to watch sporting events as they have a lot of tvs and tend to draw the sport crowd.

This is the most authentic poke I've ever found on the mainland! I'm all about that Aloha vibe, we love going to Kaua'i, I even SUP because it makes me feel like I'm on my favorite island. This place takes me back to Hawai'i in the middle of Indiana. Everyone is so nice and they help you build a great bowl. Also, this is a super great gluten free option.
I had the Shrimp Creole. Lots of shrimp and I love shrimp, but not enough sauce leaving the dish almost dry. The red beans were very nice. Next time I'll try the gumbo.

I had for the first time a pizza with the cauliflower crust and it is now my favorite pizza. It was recommended by our waitress which was fantastic throughout the experience. we have very good service you have very good food but why am I giving it only three stars?. Here is why. The manager was telling our server and another of all the cleaning they have to do which included pulling out the equipment and clean behind it and the floor which was directly in front of us at the bar where we were sitting.You don't really want to see everything that falld  inside of the condenser and behind the equipment while you're still eating. I don't blame the server as she was being told to do this. Having managed restaurants in the past... You do not have workers cleaning while patrons are still eating... No exceptions, especially in a higher end place... 
JRB

Post script. Our waitress has her own recipe for cauliflower pizza that she makes it home and I think it should be on the California Pizza Kitchen menu.
We will eat here again and I will update my review at that time.

After many years while living in Florissant and 2 years of driving 30 miles to his office, I have decided to change dentists. Dr. Herrin and his team have all been so great, always super nice and want to get to know you! I will be missing all of his girls very much. The only reason I am giving him 4 stars is because of the absolute turn off I get coming to his office because of Connie, who runs the front desk. She was always rude and does not fit the atmosphere at all. I hope his practice continues to do well and Connie doesn't make him lose anymore clients. Best of luck to you all!

Don't waste your money or time. The burger was over cooked. The chicken wings looked like they were pigeon.tbe blue cheese dressing and the manager Dave was so rude to us because there was a problem with my wife card and instead of him trying to help us beat the heat he just gave us attitude I don't really give this place any good stars or any type of good anything because the food was s*** the games is lousy and I could have went to Dave and Busters and had a better time was ranch. Bowling was 106 for a family of four for one hour. I give this place no stars. You have too ask for utensils. They don't give you bread of fries went you when you first come in graduate for your mail it's just too chaotic they have no organizational skills the owner of this place needs to recheck the way he do things in order to make this place a better place not charge $36 for bowling per person I was saddened by the lack of coordination and skills that these people displayed I really give this place no stars but they make you give them a star

This is hands down the best cheesesteak I've ever experienced. The steak has a fantastic flavor. The cheese is acts as bonding agent unlocking the flavors of the steak, and the fresh bun just enhances the experience.

You know John's is good when your consider the amount of business they get in an awful location with extremely limited hours. Not only is this the best Philly cheesesteak experience I've had, its probably the only positive experience. 

Pats, Geno's, and Jim's have all been huge disappointments. Mediocre quality, hastily put together, and craptastic buns. If you want a good cheesesteak in Philly go to John's, or expect to be disappointed.

I had a fabulous Christmas eve here. Although I did not get to try the  bacon happy hour (which is the best idea ever) everything else was great. I ordered the BBQ shrimp for an appetizer and then the filet for my main course. They serve a fabulous bread with garlic butter, which I couldn't get enough of. 

It was really crowded with no availability for tables, but we were actually able to get a seat at the bar pretty quickly. The service was not bad for how busy it was. The bartender told me she could charge my cellphone, but never plugged it up! She did take it from me, so I thought she did, but must have forgotten. LOL. The food made up for that. 

I would like to try this place again for happy hour.

Food was ok. Ordered a steak Terriyaki bento box and a shrimp bento box.  There was barely any steak or shrimps,  a lot of white rice and when the food was delivered the plastic foam boxes were squash.  So it was really messy.  Soy sauce was all over the bag and dripping all the food.  Don't think I'll be ordering food from here again.

I'll start with the only reason that this is not a five star rating and the reason my fiance and I will NOT be back to this location. The service.

Yesterday was my birthday and we wanted to try something new (one of my fav things to do!) I had been wanting to try Salt + Smoke for a while. We arrived and there was no wait- about 15 min prior to 9 pm. GREAT- we got our seats and our waiter came over. We ordered water to start so we could peruse the menu. 

Decided to start with some drinks and an appetizer- I got a whiskey- Caribou Crossing while Jason got a whiskey drink- Tennessee Rose. We decided on Trashed Ribs (fried.) The drinks were stong (obvs.) and the ribs were excellent! 

While looking through the menu: my fiance asked one of the men working there some questions about the use of onions in the food- because I don't like them at all. The guy who answered our questions was SO HELPFUL AND NICE!!  (Turns out like everything but the brisket, deserts, and Mac has some form of onion! Ha!)

When the drinks were delivered, we had ordered our meal- both of us got the two meat plate. (With two sides and a popover!) I got brisket and wings while Jason got pulled pork and MORE RIBS.  Our food arrived when we were finishing up our appetizer. 

NEEDLESS TO SAY, ALL OF THE FOOD WAS GREAT. EVERY BIT. (I TOOK HALF HOME AND JUST FINISHED IT FOR MY LUNCH - STILL DELICIOUS.) 

Our waiter was also the bar tender, when interacting with others in the restaurant, he seemed fine, happy, and willing to engage; however, for us- it seemed as though he could not care less that we were there. I think he checked in once, we were never offered another drink (while we heard others..), we did not have our waters refilled until near the end, when I said thank you (multiple times)- he mumbled or did not respond and walked off, lastly no desert was offered. (Seriously, do you not like money!??)

I'm not sure what happened or why the bar tender/waiter decided WE deserved sub-par service but I don't care. It was unacceptable. 

SO MAYBE GET YOUR FOOD TO GO!?

If your pulled pork is tasty, you'll get 5 stars from me. 

I know a lot of people make comparisons to Pappy's, and rightfully so. A local BBQ joint serving smoked and dry rubbed meats to accompany your own ratio of sauce is pretty similar to the other local BBQ joint serving smoked and dry rubbed meats to accompany your own ratio of sauce. 

I did like the fact that it was less crowded than Pappy's, but for me, they're on equal footing. The pulled pork sandwiches are fantastic.

My phone stopped functioning properly so I went to Sprint today to see what they could do to help me get a new phone for the lowest price possible. 

I expected to be waiting in line, to be annoyed, having to pay a huge fee, or having to wait several days to receive a new phone. 

But my initial expectations were very wrong!

Tony, Anthony, and Alex provided me with best customer service experience. They thoroughly explained all of my options and gave me advice of which option was the ideal for saving money and that will keep the amount I usually pay each month for my bill around the same. I asked a lot of questions, and they were patient with me by happily guiding me through my options and setting up my new phone. They even gave me a free battery pack (worth about $70), which is a device that can charge your phone on-the-go! It seemed as if Tony, Anthony, and Alex were just as excited as I was about my new iPhone! 

I've never encountered Sprint associates that gave as honest of advice, and that were as knowledgable about the products as Tony, Anthony, and Alex are. 

I left the store in a great mood with my fully backed-up phone. I am very happy with the customer service I received. I am definitely looking forward to coming back in the store to buy more phone accessories and get a new phone upgrade. Ask for them!

This place freaking rocks. My husband, "Screw it, I'm not buying a smoker, I'll just come here instead. It's easier." We had the pulled pork and a brisket sandwich. Absolutely love it. We drove by, kind of saw it, but smelled deliciousness and made a U turn the next block to come back. We're super glad we did  Can't wait to come back.

The best pizza I've been able to find in Tucson. It's fantastic. It's unique. It's delicious. The owners clearly care about the food they put, they use quality ingredients and everything tastes fresh. They have some great variations in toppings you can pre-order. The sauce is top-notch, the crust is thick, but light, and the prices are not high at all.

I spent a whole year searching for a good pizza in the Dirty-T. I have finally found it. Bless you Los Olivos.

Unbelievable. This was by far the best restaurant I  have been to in Nashville.  I hate to say it, but, as a Chicagoian, I've been spoiled by good food.  I love to try new things,  interesting dishes and spice. To put it plainly,  I love food. In Nashville,  the times I've been here, the food I've had would fall under good.  Nothing has blown my socks off...until I ate at Skull's. I ordered the lamb burger, after a recommendation from our incredible bartender,  and it was delicious.  However,  my friend ordered the chicken fried steak; it was so tender and came with this heavenly side of creamy spinach. It was exactly what I had been searching for,  but hadn't yet found. Go!

Great show!  I have been wanting to go for a few months but the tickets were sold out or it was not open due to a private event being scheduled. We finally went this weekend, and it was great! We took our 13- and 14-year-old sons, and they really had fun!  It's a small group, so every member of the audience gets to participate in some fashion. It's not just the people who sit in the front row like many shows like this. Great job!
This is not real Italian pizza. I will never go back. Service was slow and nothing on the pizza. Over priced frozen pizza.

This is my first review so my experience was positive enough to get me to sign up for yelp. My food was awesome. The salad was super fresh. The atmosphere is nice and the place is clean. Definitely a hidden gem in hermitage. I'm already wanting to visit again.
Update - Food & service was so good that we were in Louisville & hit up the Louisville location.   Both spots have great staff!  Great food & drinks.

I appreciate Tiny's for still doing take out orders durning this corona virus pandemic. Tiny's food was extremely good and even though it was a burger it felt like it was cooked at home! The portions are hefty and worth every penny. Only concern was the lady who was taking payments for the orders seemed like she needed customer interaction classes but 5 stars on the food! Thank you Tiny's!
We had our first visit to China Wok tonight. Customer service was great, food was ready when we got there and we were offered a free drink. Food was very good. Great experience all around.

I just don't get it. When we moved here everyone recommended this place. We must have different tastes. Prefer a crisper crust than theirs, also too much cheese for our tastes. Sorry folks, just not for us.

This place won my heart immediately.  "Choose your milk" feature that's added to your basic espresso shots.  Simple and clean, much like the decor, but here's where I bought in completely - cosy throws hanging over the chair.  Warm inside and out.  And the coffee is delicious.

Easy scheduling and ample parking. My posture has been shit and I went to Dr Klein to see if he could assess and advise me in what I need to do to correct my posture. 

He assessed me in less than 5 minutes and recommended some exercises to do to fix my posture. Awesome!

Let me tell you about The Game. The game is to get a plate of black bean rice nachos and manage to eat them completely without using a fork or utensil and not look like you escaped from a mental institution.

This is a more difficult endeavor than you might image as the plate is literally filled to the edges with nachos, beans, sour cream, rice, jalapenos, tomatoes, spanning a 10-12 inch wide plate and stacked like a pyramid rising 3-4 inches. It's then "cemented" together with what looks like volcanic eruption of cheesy goodness and served at a temperature that's somewhere between nuclear and burn ward.

It's a whole lot of food when they make it like they usually do, and it comes to you hot and fresh and extremely fast.

There's no middle ground with the black bean nachos. You either take them down or you go down fighting, leaving miserable and way way too full. You might even leave that way if you win the game.

Additional challenges present themselves in the form of their fruit tea. Sometimes the greatest drink on the planet, the fruit tea is an inconsistent part of the Calypso Cafe experiment. When it's good, it's great, when it's bad, it's still good but is disappointing.

People you bring with you can also be considered your enemies as they will attempt to push large, freshly-baked Boija muffins on you as they come two to an order and few can eat more than one.

I should mention, silverware is provided. There's no reason you have to attempt to locate the optimum nacho to continue along your eating path. There's also no reason you shouldn't attempt to exercise and improve your cognitive nacho-pulling spacial skills in an attempt to leave no nacho behind while keeping your fingers clean.

Should you think you beat the game, well, just remember that you lost the game. And if you don't know what that means a quick google search for The Game, or a look at your waistline after eating the nachos should be enough to cement that.

Unfortunately the variety of this place, at least for vegetarians, does not change ever. It may be considered vegetarian friendly, but it's that because you can get a lot of food for little price, not because there's a vast array of choices (there are two that I will eat there.) 

The beans, they are beans, there's nothing done to them, and the rice, it's not special. The chips come from a bag and the tomatoes, sour cream, cheese, etc are all probably restaurant supply. Vegans are going to have a couple of options here, and I think I may be overselling it by saying a couple.

The jerk chicken, I think, is the only thing they seriously work on. Everything else can be considered a plate full of fixin's.

But the food is good, the service similarly so, the price reasonable, and as long as you're not attempting to go there when 400 other people are there (lunch) you'll probably have a good all-around time. If you're a vegetarian, go for the black bean rice nachos or black bean salad, I'd avoid the pita / veggie burger options as, well, I hate them and think they are stupid.

But that's my opinion, and I just lost the game

I loved going to All Happy. My favourite place to go after a night out on the town. Always had the best food. That was until we had the misfortune of choosing to go for dinner. I always order the same thing, so I know what to order and what the item is supposed to look and taste like. One of our items was the deep fried curry squid. It is amazing, when it is the right order. The waitress brought to our table a version of hot pot. Maybe it was squid but definitely not what we had ordered. I mentioned this to our waitress. She was very blunt. "Its what you ordered!" I did try to explain that was not what we ordered and I order the same thing all the time. 
She took it back, and when payinf the bill we noticed it was not taken off the bill. We were told because it was made we had to pay a restocking charge. A what? Yes, a restocking charge. Just because we didnt eat it we still needed to pay for it as they made it. 
I have never returned since. When does a restaurant charge a restocking fee?

Went in for a simple tire rotation. 
We have used Big O for many many years and it has always been great!!!
DO NOT USE THIS BRANCH. 
OK. the technician didn't know how to put the center hub caps back on properly. The first one fell off in the parking lot as we were leaving big o. He also stripped and ruined 2 more. 

I understand that things happen and people make mistakes. What is not acceptable is how the owner / manager treated the error. 

First..... we have a large Lexus sedan that we keep in pristine condition. We take care of our car, keep it clean and maintained. The wheels were purchased with the car at the Lexus dealership. 

After the damage was recognized we talked to the manager and he just wanted to get rid of us.  He had an employee make calls to find center caps but was unwilling to pay what they are worth to replace.   
He takes no accountability and responsibility for his shops actions. 
IF THEY BREAK IT ....SHOULD THEY NOT FIX IT???

We ended up fixing it ourselves with no help from this branch. 
It is sad that branch ruined our impression of a company we have happily used for 19 years.
