Large sized orchard just west of Indianapolis! Plenty of free parking and you can actually drive out to pick apples as well. The parking lot is right by the children's area with playground and haystack. There are some pre picked pumpkins near here as well. The barn has cafe and food options that are cheaper than other orchards. The hayride was $3 per person and free for kids under 3 and runs every 12 minutes. This place is dog friendly! Only downside was that there were not that many staff around to ask questions. Great spot for families and friends to gather!
Thank god for Toups and their bourbon selection to keep me warm on this cold, cold night!

I am so glad that they bough out the original dentist here name "downtown dentist". They are totally opposite of the other place. Excellent staffs and dentist here! I had a filling redone by this Dentist and she fixed it with care and i had no sensitivity the next day! It was awesome. I am sticking to this dentist!

I'd like to start by saying I did not want to go to this establishment. Nevertheless, I was dragged in and tried to make the best out of the situation. It was very challenging considering the table for four outside could barely fit 2 people. I couldn't breathe because my chair was so close to the people next to me. I then thought it was a minor inconvenience, then I ordered my meal. Boy was I wrong. My table ordered Fish n chips, grilled cheese caprese pesto, and a chicken Cesar salad. Disappointing. I couldn't event eat the oiled up sandwich. The fish n chips were .... questionable. Chicken looked a little rubbery and the cesar dressing was drenched in mayo. 

I don't think this restaurant holds up to Philadelphia's standards, but overall my diet coke was good, hard to mess that one up.

If it were not for Jen I would not go to Rainbow nail salon.  Owner and her husband can be rude especially the husband.  Not sure what he is even doing there.  The place needs to be updated and is quite shabby.  The prices are decent but the waxing room is pathetic and they try and squeeze 2 people in this room which is so tiny and does not allow for any privacy.  I will take my business elsewhere.

Absolutely not the first time I've been here and it won't be the last either.  One of my first visits was for new tires for my Jeep.  I shopped around EVERY tire shop in town for a better price and couldn't find one.  This place is serious when they say they have the best prices in town AND they have price match guarantees to boot and had exactly what I was looking for in stock and ready to install.  

Customer service was fantastic.  I had the opportunity to observe phone calls and in person customer interactions while I was sitting in the waiting room.  I repeatedly saw an honest, straight forward approach.  The staff had confidence in their product and had the tools to appropriately put their product knowledge to good use when necessary in order to meet the client with the products and services they needed.  No overselling, no bait and switch.  

This is my favorite tire shop to reccomend to friends.

I realize that most movie theaters try to squeeze every penny they can out of you with concessions. However This theater takes it to any entirely new level. I buy my ticket and go to get refreshments and buy a large popcorn and candies and then I go to get a water and they won't even give me an average sized cup. They only give "courtesy cups"  the size of the wax cups that you are given at doctors offices because it would be too much for them to give me a slightly larger cup even after buying the ticket an $8 popcorn and a $4 candy that I could get at the dollar store. Then when the movie got out I check to see if there were any fine print terms for the advertised free refill on the large popcorn and not to much surprise there was. I was told that not only would I need the the receipt and the popcorn bucket (when usually the buckets are the only thing needed) but the refill is only good same day. The refill was the last straw for me. I can absolutely say that I will never return to this theater. Maybe I can at least get a average sized water cup by going to another.

I had purchased a Groupon for this business.  I left a message on the website and called and left messages.  No one returned the call.  This is not the first time I had a problem with Groupon and a business.  It is a shame because I was looking for a place to get my massage's.  I ended up coming on  YELP and making a selection from the reviews left.  I have contacted Groupon for a refund--we will see because they like other companies have moved certain parts of their company overseas.

I'm kind of disappointed at the BBQ here. I ordered a BBQ bowl and I got a cold bowl full of sides with a tiny pile of meat on top. I could tell it came out of the refrigerator. The meat was chilled and was served with a little side cup of BBQ sauce. It was peppery and bland. The bottom was swimming in vinegar. I'm sorry what did I pay over $11 for? It didn't come with fries. It wasn't worth the money I paid. I'm still hungry. 

The brisket meal was okay. Lots of fat and the meat was dry. The burnt ends fries were actually pretty good. Accept the burnt ends were half fat.  The flavors didn't mesh well and all around it wasn't worth the $50 I dropped on two 'meals' and a side of fries. 

It was delivery so maybe it's better when you go there? I could have gotten 3X the food at a better quality at Famous Dave's. Sad I didn't have much better to report. 

Probably won't order again. Almost wanted my money back.

Great food for cheap, cold beer but music I so loud. You can tell it's a regulars dive bar so they don't seem to mind. Would recommend to eat here before a flight or if hungry friends arrive in Tucson as it's really close to airport. Good find.
If you have a chance, it's worth a visit to get this delicious homemade ice cream. The owners are lovely too. The flavors are unique and the texture is very creamy. Don't miss out on a sweet treat.

Sarah S knocked it out of the park again this month with the ISC!  Met a group of 12 Yelpers here for dinner.  When we arrived it was clear that they were not prepared for us, but they set us up with a table lickety-split.  

I started off with the beet salad.  I like a beet salad and it was the best I've had so far.  Three different kinds of beets with a frisee and...a battered fried round of goat cheese!  The creaminess of the goat cheese went so well with the different beets and the frisee; this really was a great salad and I highly recommend it.

For dinner I had the margherita pizza - I usually try the margherita pizza if a place has one because there was a restaurant in my last city that made a great one and I'm trying to find a replacement here.  It might have been the closest I have come so far in STL - could have used a touch more basil but otherwise it was just how I like it.  Crispy, salty crust, plentiful tomatoes, just enough cheese.  And very reasonably priced at $12.

 We've all been places where the presence of a large group killed the experience of the other diners; well not at Tavolo V!  There was a much larger group seated already when we arrived - in fact, thanks to Aaron B for snagging me before I went over and sat down with them thinking they were our group.  The restaurant handled the situation like a champ!  The pace of our dinner and the quality of service made us feel like we were the only ones there and I had the feeling that the other group felt the same way.  That says a lot about the quality of the management.

Overall, it was a really enjoyable experience and I would definitely return to try more of their offerings.

We went to Your Pie for the second time the other night and brought my sister in law from NYC with us. She has a serious gluten allergy and they are so accommodating. Not only do they use a gluten free crust but they also cook the pizza in a separate oven to make sure there is no cross contamination. We all created our own pies which is so much fun, especially because I am a picky eater sometimes. Also, I know a few people mentioned there were a lot of noisy children, but both times it has been fairly empty. Maybe it was the time or day we went. PLus they have one of those great soda machines with the hundred options. I'd prefer going to Your Pie any day over ordering in!
Pros: good drink menu, sangria is good and crowd is fun. Cons: spotty service, food is so so and some of the tables are in really poor locations. Tourist trap.

Pricey. Definitely for sea food lovers only. I'm not a huge fan of sea food and struggled to find something on the menu I would actually want - but I'm bias against sea food so I'll give it an even 3 stars. Chicken Sautéed was good but Not a lot of options outside of fish, oysters, and other sea food options. I doubt I'll go back. Select

What a TREASURE. It's been pretty chilly in NOLA during Mardi Gras this year. And since the bars were all shut city-wide during the final Mardi Gras weekend, we took our buddy around to get a taste of the Quarter before it became a lil' too dead (while bars were still open last week). She requested an afternoon coffee, and Yelp brought us here. But we stayed for several amazingly tasty cocktails, great conversation with the owner Matt, and a bit of fetch with his rad doggie. Can't overstate how cool the space is and how good the drinks / company was. Thanks again for an incredible experience Matt! We'll be back.

We came looking for a good dinner and were disappointed. We took advantage of a table in the bar.  Jonathan our waiter said he had to take care of his regulars. We had to ask for everything from chips, menus to the to go boxes & our check. There was no service at all the bartender even apologized. Thought we were going to have a nice evening with friends but we were out the door within an hour with cold food & to go boxes. Too many good Mexican Restaurants is St. Louis it's sad we won't be back. Thx Jonathan

The previous review was not written by me personally, it was written by someone who encountered the service of this company secondhand. That being said, I apologize for the inconsistency of reviews coming from this account, as the first one was a very inaccurate statement. 
Overall, the Trinity store has wonderful guest service. The girl Kelly that seems to be there every time I go in, is very honest and has taken the time to get to know me on a first name basis. I can't say I'm happy with the length of time it has taken to get my alterations back, but it is through no fault of theirs. They've been very helpful and have been upfront about the status of my dress, which has been great. I have no doubts that my dress was put in careful hands and will return to me with the proper alterations done. I really appreciate all that the people at Quality Plus have done, and recommend them to anyone looking for great sincere service.

This was my first visit to a Taziki's -- I had heard great things from friends who have been to other locations, so I was excited to see if it lived up to the hype. Although it was a Sunday night on a holiday weekend, I was surprised that the restaurant was empty sans an employee eating at a booth. We placed our order and saw that it was cooked to order, which is always a good thing. The service however left much to be desired -- no one working seemed to care that we were there. I'm sure they were bored by the lack of customers, but come on! At least pretend to be somewhat happy to take a customer's order. Thankfully, the "grilled chicken feast" I ordered was really, really good. I got the rice as my side but also tried the potatoes and would recommend those over the rice. The signature taziki sauce was alright but I loved the Greek salad dressing much more. Despite the tepid service, I was very impressed by my first Taziki's visit. It seems like a nice addition to the Gulch, one that I'm sure is packed during the weekday lunch hour.

Their food is absolutely amazing, but the prices are very high. I paid around $6 for my specialtyt bagel with turkey and some vegetables on it, but it was the best bagel sandwich I've ever had! So you decide whether you want to pay the premium... I certainly might ;)

My daughter of 17 loves this place!  I never know what to order and when I do, I always see something better on another table.  Food is good but I swam to always get the bad server.  Most people seam very happy in there and it always looks packed.

Good for the area! Food is typical Mexican. I had the house marg (2 for 1 on a Saturday!) But it wasn't good enough to have 2. Our waiter, Daniel, was excellent and he brought me a Don Pablo marg that was much better and no charge. I had the Wet Burrito, which had cheese dip on it, and the hubs had chicken fajita quesadilla which was huge! Great service, great food.

This is a great Mexican restaurant It has been about a week since I have been there and I still think about my time! "The best server or little Venezuelan boy" was a particularly great server definitely recommend this restaurant!

This is our weekly visit the pizza, pasta, meatballs, etc are terrific...but it is not the only thing that keeps us coming to Pizzeria Stella's the staff has become like family....Treacy, Jared, Nate, Conner, Kira, Patrick, Alex, Isaac, Allison etc. and of course Che
f Shane....they make each visit feel like we are home!  This week my husband and family held a surprise 60th birthday celebration for me at Pizzeria Stella's and I would not have wanted to celebrate in any other venue with anyone other than my Stella family!  Thank you all for being so wonderful!!!

Great experience! It's been years since I've been here, but my wife and I went out on a date, and sat in the lounge and got appetizers and a flight of wine each. The server was incredibly knowledgeable and attentive even though they were very busy. Honestly, every appetizer we had was stellar. The pickle flight, the cheese flight, the spaghetti and the salad were all memorable. We'll be back!

I love the feel of this store...it feels like shelves and shelves of treasures waiting to be found.  The new high street location is so beautiful!  I always great product suggestions and have become an addict of a few products I've been turned on to.

Being from out of town, we found this joint on yelp, and decided to try it out.  Heather was amazing from the moment we came into the restaurant. She gave great recommendations for the two of us to share, and continued to provide great service our entire visit. We ordered each got a side, and the recommended candied bacon, burnt ends, and pork steak. Everything was so great. We bought some of the house made BBQ sauce to take back home as well. Wish we could take this joint home with us.  Highly recommended.
Just walk out and don't bother. The staff was rude and literally told us "read the sign". We dont know what the food tastes like because the Jerky staff literally left a bad taste in our mouths.

Only had the chance to come here two times so far, but I will make it my mission when I come into town.  Their iced coffee is really good, not as bitter and bold as the typical chains such as Starbucks and coffee bean.  

Their cold brews is comparable to portola coffee in irvine.  Not as great since they don't do a straight Kyoto, but comparable.  Definitely one of the best places in Santa Barbara to stop by.  Affagotto is a must as well if you haven't tried it before. 


The vibe is also really good, bright and funny.

Went for breakfast this morning and was genuinely impressed! There was a bit of a wait but it was a busy Sunday morning and we didn't have to wait as long as expected. We ordered pancakes, country fried steak, eggs, hash browns and all were delicious! The kids size "mini pancakes" were huge! My son loved them! All of the food was hot and fresh, made to order. It might be a little more on the pricey side compared to other restaurants but overall it was delicious and service was great so we will be back!
We were seated at a table outside, and received ZERO service. Went inside to ask for our waitress three times, and nobody ever came...so that sucked

My family has been here several times. This place is great. Food is Awesome. They also have a few American dishes. Service is great too, the staff always keeps our glasses full and come around to check on us several times during the meal.

Very good donuts sold by a fellow Pennsylvanian!

Seriously, donuts were solid. Plain glazed was really good, but the cronut was delicious. Will stop by next time I'm in town.

After being stranded on an airplane in Philadelphia by American Airlines for 6 hours we were promised a flight back on Tuesday 07/08/19.  Here we were with no luggage having to take a Lyft to a Hotel and then buy a whole new wardrobe.  We rented a car, spent money on 3 Nights in a Hotel.  I missed 3 days of work and did not believe that they would get us back to Las Vegas.  That flight was cancelled at 2100 hours on Monday.  I booked a Spirit Flight and was amazed!  The plane for the Cross Country trip was comfortable and clean!  The staff was very friendly and we left on time.  If it wasn't for Spirit I would have rented a car and drove 2500 miles to get home!

I hereby dub Sands Buffet "The Biggest Little Buffet in Reno."  It's that good, and it's that small.

It all revolves around the prime rib:  the best-quality roast I've tasted in any Reno restaurant, buffet or no, served at the far-right corner of a floor measuring about 400 square feet, if that.

The chefs manage to sneak in Italian, Asian, or some other exotic entrees here and there through the week, but the staples are satisfactorily heated beef, chicken, steamed vegetables, and fresh mashed potatoes and brown gravy.  Sands Regency at the end of August scuttled Friday and Saturday Steak Nights, thus prime rib and shrimp (scampi skewers, butterflied/fried, and chilled peel-and-eat) carry on as weekend house specialties.

The salad bar comprises popular ingredients fastidiously presented, and soups are excellent, especially clam chowder and tomato-basil served on Fridays.  Don't hesitate to add some of the latter into a partially filled cup of the former--soup heaven.  Desserts are a cut above cookie-cutter buffet quality, and complemented by soft-serv ice cream.

So you're not likely to run into an Engelbert Humperdinck or Dionne Warwick moving down the Sands Buffet line, but hotel guests and a host of Reno locals cotton to this eatery just fine, and with the various discounts offered by the hotel, paying full price is uncommon.

Recently acquired by Jacobs Entertainment Inc., word has it that Sands Regency plans to renovate and enlarge the buffet.  In its current configuration, it's a long way from Atlantis' Toucan Charlie's on South Virginia Street, in more ways than one, but it fills a niche for diners with hearty appetites who know what they want and know where to get it.

Excellent customer service + experience. We made an appointment to come in for a site tour and fell in love with the space instantly. Trinidy was incredibly knowledgable and kindly helped us secure our new place. The facilities are new and modern with a pool, hot tub, dog washing room and roof top deck. There is enclosed/covered parking and its actually located on the water, not near the water. There are shops next door that are being remodeled and should be quite lovely when its complete. I highly recommend this location if you're looking for a new apartment.
Excellent selection of shoes, even in wide.  But the biggest plus is Missy who really knows her stuff about feet and shoes and the needs of different activities.    She is fabulous.

Great pizza and good value.  Don't come here expecting cheap fast pizza just not their style!  I don't go to mcdonalds expecting a steakhouse style burger, if you know what I mean.  Nice place to finish or start the night if your going out or wrapping up.  

Service is average but not enough to knock down my rating.  Employees just seem like they could care less about their job.

Food was pretty good. This is not a friendly place and I'm not sure if it's because of the location or not. The food was seasoned ok. It seemed like a "gas station" type of seafood spot. 

I won't visit this place again. I need more culture from my seafood places especially when visiting NOLA.

The day after New Year's, our sprinkler pipes burst, flooding the yard with massive quantities of icy water for hours.  We called and called plumbers.  Only Dave Thiel was working.

He rushed out at warp speed, handled the issue, and charged us only $10 for gas, because no repairs or replacements were needed.

We will be giving him a call this spring to get our sprinklers up and running like they should be.  He's honest, reliable, and won't beat you up with bells & whistles on the price tag.

I'd recommend Dave Thiel's plumbing service to anyone.

Wish I could give 0 Stars. I switched to 1800PackRat, and I suggest you do the same! We had an 8:45-11:45am delivery window. At 1:15pm I called customer service. They said my Pod was on the truck on the way. At 4:24pm I received a notification my order was cancelled. No call, no show. Pod's customer service claims the driver tried to call several times, and claims power lines were in the way. There aren't even power lines on this side of the street! No calls on my phone or the secondary number I provided. Very poor customer service, and very low level of accountability of behalf of Pod's.

Only have been open for a month!  It's a small little shop right now but with a lot of personality and a lot of different flavors! 
DeAndre(the founder) was sweet and informed me they will be moving to two more locations. 
Don't delay, go in, sample, and support our locals
Queen's is a great friendly place with outstanding pizza, we have been coming back for over 5 years it is worth the drive from our home and enjoy the polite caring servers!
Love this place. When I return to the N O I will come back here. I had the crawfish and shrimp. You have to buy the flavoring on the side, butter Cajun spice ect.

From the get go very good service and communication And overall the front door we ordered is as designed and a very nice product. The installation was nothing less than perfect. They put the new door within the current casing which I thought might be an issue. My concern is that at time of ordering I was told 6- 8 weeks for delivery. Not even close. It was 13 weeks and multiple emails and phone calls to get a real answer. Multiple promises of "in a couple days" we were told and no follow up. The compensation for such poor delivery ? $100. off a very high priced door. Well that response has cost them 3 garage door sales which were due next. I was really hoping they were interested in making up for their own delays, As I was prepared to order new matching garage doors. Good product but be prepared to wait longer than they say.
Good service. Clothes are always ready when promised. Very easy to deal with and always friendly

Italian food for the masses. The food is very decent. The prices and value are reasonable for Italian food. The consistency across the chain is the charm of the dining experience here. 

This location used to be the Victorian Station and is different from the standard format of a typical Olive Garden. The impressive thing about this location is hat it sits in the middle of tons of restaurants. It has not only outlasted several but remains super busy all of the time.

I absolutely love this place. I try to make it there almost every time I'm on the southshore. My favorite is the shrimp with fried green tomatoes. My family get the more traditional poboys and they are always a a hit.

It's fine for what it is. The prices aren't great but the selection is large and the staff is friendly. Wish there was more seating around the store- it can be at a premium because of the free wifi. Bathrooms are generally cleaner than at the one in Princeton.
I won't elaborate why I give them three stars. My food was mediocre but the beer was good.

I found this gem through Yelp and wanted to try it out. The pictures made my mouth water. I had no issue looking for the location and there are available parking spots. During COVID, they provide hand sanitizer up front and check your temperature before being seated. I was a walk-in so the wait time is around 10 minutes or so. I ordered a house salad, Upside Down Roll, and Salmon Lemon Zest. They were all good, not the best. I also ordered one of their drinks (forgot the name) and it was good too! I ended my night with their Tempura Ice Cream with a friend of mine. We enjoyed our dinner, and our server was very sweet and accommodating. 

What threw me off was the bartender that night was drinking on the job/shift, but that didn't really bother me much. I guess it a way of interacting with customers and enjoying each other's company. Also, some of the servers aren't wearing their mask properly and I get it, it gets hot under the mask when you running around the restaurant.

Really bad managed complex with plummer flooding, no heat, no communication, bad quality on refurbishment, and "concierge" focusing on coffee making! Don't even consider coming here!!!
Also total lack of introducing to facilities, which should be standard if you settle down in this kind of "luxury" place. You have to find the gym, mailbox, pool etc by yourself. How difficult can it be to teach the coffee guys to introduce new tenants in basic facilities/amenities???

This was our second visit, and we were happy to say we still feel El Paso is the best Mexican restaurant in the Oldsmar/Westchase/Citris Park area!  Drinks and food are fresh, delicious, and very generous portions.  They are attentive without being intrusive.  I held back one star for ambiance, it would be fun to see a little more Mexican decorations inside, but it is adequate.  Again the service, food and drink will bring us back for many return trips.

I moved here from South Florida a couple years ago and was looking for a car wash. I somehow stumbled on Camel Car Wash and wow I am impressed. One of the best drive thru car washes I've been to all around the US and am an avid road tripper. Thank you Camel and looking forward to referring many clients.
This is one of my favorite Mediterranean spots. The food is delicious and the service is exceptional. Definitely a must try if you haven't already!
Everytime we come here to eat, there's no place to sit, the back area is reserved. When we do find a place to sit, the service is horrendous. Not coming to this place anymore.
Sooo yummy, highly recommend. Huge portion sizes. The coconut curry was really delicious. Some elements have a nice spicy kick

Cosmopolitan feeling grows huge in this grocery store, it is a unique place that l was surprised to run into! If you'd like some rattle snake, python, camel or ostrich meat for dinner, you'll find it there!  I loved the aisles and abundant choices of everything.  Prices are reasonable except for coffee!

As someone else said I really want to like this place. It could have a lot of potential. I came in for a gel full set mani and I got a lady who seemed a bit in a rush. She was basically doing 3 girls nails at one time. She was EXTREMELY rough with my nails with not only the drill but the filler as well. It felt like she was going to take my nail off. Or cut my skin with the nail clipper. All the other technicians seemed relaxed and were taking their time but not her. She seemed really irritated with me the whole time. Once the nails were done they looked fine but I was just ready to leave. When I left and took a closer look I noticed in the light there were a lot of air bubbles in between the coats. She was so in a rush she even asked me if she had done a second coat because she couldn't remember. Looking at my nails now I see some that are crooked, the shapes aren't the same on both hands, there's a lot of rough edges from where she filled AFTER she painted them so there's som naked spots. I'm just really unhappy with the service. She even mentioned that she's been a technician for 21 years, but it really didn't show. I hope they can get their act together bc they could be a thriving business.

Friend & I went for a piercing & Lisa didn't seem very interested in doing our piercings. We were asking a lot of questions (rightfully so) & she seemed bothered & didn't really have answers to all of our questions.  She even stated we should go back another day to see a more experienced piercer that could answer our questions. She didn't seem very confident in doing it herself. We obviously decided to leave & go elsewhere.
The queso fundido was incredible!  A must try is the tequila infused jalapeño! Just about anything on the menu is phenomenal!

Glad this place reopened, but it's not quite as good as it was a couple months ago. Price went up a tiny bit for the breakfast combo, which is fine, but I ended up with about 1/3-1/2 of the hash browns I got pre-closure. The french toast also wasn't quite as good as it used to be, and it was a bit undercooked. It used to be like a cinnamon roll, now it's closer to generic french toast.

This is absolutely fabulous place for breakfast and coffee! It's rich and flavorful at the same time! 

I have never tried crepes with spinach and cheese and a sunny egg on it, it's just delicious!

They serve the coffee in nice cups which reminds me a lot about Europe, Italy and France in particular !

The whole atmosphere is fantastic! If we ever come to New Orleans once again we will definitely come back here for another good fulfilling food served with taste and care!

This place is wonderful. The ceviche was delicious. The plantain chips, a nice surprise. We even got delicious margaritas that I would absolutely recommend. The service was wonderful and the size of the restaurant is small enough to feel intimate which works for couples or friends. I can't wait to go back.

This is by far the closest you will get to eating a pizza from Italy.  Homemade dough and mozzarella make it light and easy to eat more than 1 pie. Recommend coming early and reserving your dough. It helps that the owner Dave is right there and nice as well!

I had a Groupon which prompted me to visit Peace Water - two tastings and a discount on bottles purchased. Sadly, as a sweet wine drinker I did not find a wine I felt passionate about purchasing. However, I want to note that the interior decor is #goals. I also love their initiate to support local charities instead of accepting tips. Definitely encourage those who enjoy dry wines to visit but I do not see myself returning.
BEST CUPCAKES IN TAMPA!!! The cupcakes are amazing and the people who work there are so helpful and really brighten your day!

LITERALLY one of the best bars I have ever frequented!! They have great drink specials and the food is some of the BEST I've ever had!! The vibe is very welcoming and warming! There's everything from corn-hole to life size Jenga, to darts and golf! They have either live music or a DJ every single night! It's just a fun place to go that isn't inside the deep depths of Soho. It's a very good mixed crowd! I'm 33 years old and brought my parents in who absolutely loved it!!! Not to mention that there's 25 TVs in any which direction you can look so that all of your sports needs are taken care of!! If you want a good local neighborhood bar... this is the one for you!!!!

So my very Dominican boyfriend and I were looking for a great Valentine's Day and we found it here. If you are looking for an authentic Latin experience you will find it here with music, food, and hookah!
We spent over 3hrs here with my 8 and 6 year old.  There is so much to see and do and its all fun and educational at the same time.  I would recommend this for you next visit.

The food here is great and the bar service is wonderful, but the restaurant service is so poor it ruins the entire experience of dining here and makes you never wanna come back.  If you're done in the restaurant, be prepared to have to get up from your table and go find your server to collect a glass of water. Yes, it's that bad.

I have been to Sopapilla's many times but no visit has ever been as amazing as ours on Saturday night! We lucked out when we got the best server, Eryn! She was super knowledgeable about the drinks and the food but even better was her fun and spunky personality. Having a great server can seal the deal with a dinner out and Eryn nailed it! Food was delish! Drinks were awesome! The sopapilla's for dessert were the best we've had yet!!!! Thank you so much!!!!
We had a great experience with Oliver.  He explained what had to be done and completed it quickly and on budget.

Santa Barbara Taco Tuesday tour stop #2 finds us at Super Cuca's Taqueria. Lots of authentic food items on the menu. I got the Carnitas taco combo. This taco was like no other I've had as the flour tortilla was folded and buried under all the yummy goodness. A bit messy to eat, the taco filling included not only carnitas but grilled onion, zucchini, mushrooms and whole pintos. Three salsas to choose from and all were delicious. I give this place  Also, I heard the $10 burritos here are huge so I'll get one of those next time.

Looks like they managed to delete my last review. My car was towed a few months ago around 11pm, and I showed up at opening time to pick it up the next day. Nelda or whatever her name is told me she would only accept cash??? Probably so she could pocket money. So I show up with a huge wad of cash (over $400) and when she opens the door she tells me I can't come inside (small little run down place) and she WONT show me a receipt before I hand her all of this cash. I'm a young girl, so foolishly I gave it to her. She ran inside with it, and came back with a receipt and pulled out my car left the keys in admission and ran inside. Not a word to me. Then, I finally look at my receipt and see she charged me for 3 days in their lot. 3 days. My car was there for less than 12 hours. They then did not answer the locked door. I had my lawyer call them, and I had to drive back about an hour later to pick up $200 she owed me. Absolutely ridiculous. Any good reviews here are not real- PLEASE avoid this place at all costs.
I had the arrroz con mariscos paired with the Zinfandel- so delicious. A big plate too! Good value - I ate half and took the rest home. It was even better the next day. Highly recommend.

The overall experience was confusing! If you are not a fan of community seating, do not eat here! And yet, the food was outstanding and the service was great! Would we go back?! Hmm...I don't know.  We sat in the very front. It was very cold and worse, the employees--later learned to be mostly the valets, but also managers, left multiple times through main doors! Not okay if I'm paying $16 for a glass of Chardonnay--times three!! Michael, our server, was the best and understanding!! We didn't want any comps--although he took care of dessert! Very appreciative! Would we go back? First, I'd ask about our seating!! But if Michael was our server...I'd have to rethink even more--he's top class!! Great food! Awesome server! Mediocre environment--so much room to improve!!

I'm old, and I've had to buy and sell many times in my life.  I've never had a real estate agent to compare with Seth Neal's patience, expertise, understated knowledge of the real estate market, kindness, and instinct.  Did I mention unparalleled honesty?  It took me quite awhile to even decide what I wanted, what I needed, in this later phase in life.  Seth was patient all the way through the process, which went on quite awhile as I sifted through houses and finally came to what seemed best.  Seth showed me many homes over time, and with each one he'd point out valid good points and negative points.  

I was in contract with one, and he astutely managed the situation that became difficult with seller and seller's agent.  As it turned out, it was best that it fell through.  Seth continued to encourage me, and he never rushed nor tried to influence.  He simply remained honest, wise, prudent, savvy, and adept at finding homes that we'd check out, and also wise in seeing what was good and what would put the house off the "buy" list.  

Then came the house that was IT.  I happened to not be in the area at the time, but Seth made haste to video tape the interior and exterior surroundings, sent me the video, gave his expert advice, his "take" on the house.  We made an offer immediately, responded to a counter the next morning, and the deal was sealed and closed 20 days later.  When I had to fly in for a doctor appointment that dove-tailed with the inspection, Seth even picked me up at the doctor's to take me to the property, then back to the Airbnb where I stayed before flying out the next morning.  

I can tell you in the very long time it took ME to figure out what I really wanted, Seth was patient and positive, upbeat and encouraging, all the while showing me properties.  I was also going through some family strife, as well; he was compassionate yet always focused to help me find my next and perhaps final "place".  Ever the professional, he even came to closing to give moral support.  Then, a week later, he had readied to send me a reminder to file the home owner's exemption!  So Seth even keeps up with his outstanding, helpful service AFTER you have your home!  

We had some laughs, too; Seth has a great sense of humor which helps a lot in real estate, as many of us realize!  He earned every bit of his commission with me, the hard way, and I owe Seth a tremendous debt of GRATITUDE.  My lender was not familiar with Seth prior, but part way through the home-hunting process and a couple other offers on houses, the lender said he was extremely impressed with Seth as an excellent agent and that I could totally trust Seth's advice.  Yes, Seth knew how to negotiate and never pushed for me to offer more or pressure to accept less than what I wanted.  

What a guy! Yes--Seth IS the Boise Real Estate Guy!  When I started out in the house-hunting venture, I researched online to find the best buyer's agent--Seth!  But I tell you that when it comes time for me to sell, I'll want Seth as a seller's agent--if he can put up with me again!  THANK YOU ETERNALLY, SETH!!!

The closest you're gonna get to a nyc slice out here.  Full disclosure though, this place gets an additional star is for all the Mets paraphernalia.  The only Yankees penant you'll see is at the entrance to the hall leading to the bathroom.  The Yankees make me want to move my bowels too.  Thumbs up.

Terrific hotel pretty much down the street from the Hard Rock Casino about a mile away. Full review later when I am sober.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

OK - now that I am mentally able to review this hotel I have to say it's a pretty damn good place to crash for the night in case the rooms at the Hard Rock Casino are outrageously overpriced. All we needed was one night but the casino could not comp us a room so we came here for $89 and it was well worth it. Literally the hotel is a five minute drive to the casino, and they also offer a shuttle service to and from the casino. Really close so it's a great location.

My experience at The Comfort Inn which is across the street from the Florida Fairgrounds - 

Super clean and modern decor hotel
Free wifi throughout and in all rooms
Free shuttle service
Well kept pool and patio area
Clean guest laundry
Small but nice workout room with LifeFitness equipment
Friendly and helpful front desk staff
Great room - spacious with separate area featuring a couch and pullout work desk 
Comfy beds with comfortable sheets and pillows
Good bathroom amenities (which I swiped!) 
Large flat screen in the room
Microwave, fridge, and coffee maker in room
Cold air conditioning
Full breakfast in the morning including bacon, scrambled & hard boiled eggs, make your own waffles, yogurt, cereal, fruit, etc
Small convenience store on site
Free parking
Free coffee available in the lobby 24 hours a day

We would definitely stay here again for our next visit if we can't get cheap/comped rooms at the Hard Rock. I'd rather use that extra cash for booze, food, and gambling!
I bought a latte they gave me coffee, she tried to trick me ahaha? Plus they don't know how to smile and say hi

This place will not disappoint!  The house salad was yummy and satisfying in its simplicity. Light and not overdressed. The pizza is amazing!  Just look at it!  Nothing skimpy here!  All the staff was was very observant, helpful, and efficient.
Excellent dentists, facility and staff. Courteous and professional. Modern practices, have never felt pain and scheduling is easy. Find reminder visit texts & emails helpful with a busy schedule.

So, I get the wrong pizza, call the store, they say they'll remake it and send it out. Over an hour later, I call the store back to ask where my pizza is. "Oh the driver forgot it so it's probably cold by now. Do you want us to remake it?" No. No, I don't. "Ok we'll refund you for the pizza." Waiting, waiting... "Ok there's a $20 coupon on your account." No thanks, I want my money back. Guy proceeded to tell me he didn't think they could do that, manager clearly had no desire to speak with me, eventually caved and just gave me my money back. My advice? Spend your Saturday night watching paint dry, it will be more enjoyable than dealing with these nimrods.

Food was mediocre at best. Prices did not match to the quality of food. Soda was ice cold and the staff was very friendly. The floats were pretty but, not a place I would go back to eat. $11 for frozen chicken strips and $8 for a kids meal is absurd.

Location is great and you can tell it's new! They did a great job with COVID safety measures. I normally would rate this five stars but the employees aren't always the friendliest.  It's nice they offer the self checkout and scanning option so I do that more frequently especially considering the current situation. It's also nice this one has a beer/wine section!

Authentic Mexican food in a hard to find location!  The sign on the building says it's a grocery store and the building next door is undergoing renovations.  Don't let that deter you and you will be well rewarded!  The menu is extensive.  My husband had the tacos dorados and loved them.  They were more like giant flautas rather than those I've had in Mexico.  I had the baleadas which I have never eaten before.  They were tortillas with frijoles, cheese and egg folded over and fried.  It was the Central American equivalent of comfort food like a grilled cheese sandwich your Mom makes you when you come home for a visit!  When the last bite is as tasty as the first you know you had something good!  The salsa was sweet with a little kick.  Warning: they will also bring you a salsa made with avocado that looks like runny guacamole.  It is really spicy so beware!!!  All of this for less than $20 including tip for the two of us!  You have to check this place out!

It feels like everyone is having a great time at Parc. Tables of family, friends, married couples, couples on first dates, solo travelers at tables or the bar... One thing is for sure. They're all having a great meal. The food and the atmosphere are authentically French, with more than a soupçon of Philly. The veal scallop in a cream mushroom sauce was out of this world, as was the bread with which to mop it up. My son declared the warm shrimp salad to be the best shrimp he ever had (and he knows fresh shrimp). The service was solicitous without being overbearing. I only wish I had saved more room for dessert. And oh yes, overlooking Rittenhouse Square affords excellent people-watching!

Went with a group -- we were seated quickly and attended to even faster. 

Ordered the house salad and duck confit with their take on an old fashioned and glass of cab with dinner. 

My wife ordered the cheese board and onion soup and loved it, but the best thing on the menu are the steak sliders. 

Love that you can go in and sit at the bar directly. 

Just like the restorative, parts of Paris, and the little lamb, the ambiance was romantic and casual with the feeling that you're stepping away from the hum-drum of seafood-catering tourist stops. 

Can't wait to go back and hope to be there often!

A friend  knocked me over with a feather when she told me to try MJ's BBQ, I asked where it was located and she said, practically outside your back door which was true! Place has been there a year + and I had no idea!
Wanted to try the ribs, but were on a tight budget so we opted for sandwiches. I had the pulled pork which was the absolute BEST pulled pork I've ever tasted! Hubby had the tenderloin which he was super pleased with. Onion ring order was HUGE and even the 2 of us couldn't finish them.
Diners, drive In's & Dives would have a Hey day here!

I'd been here several times before with no difficulties whatsoever. I have celiac disease and gluten will make me REALLY sick. Mexican restaurants are usually pretty gluten-free friendly but ANY restaurant requires a serious conversation with the server or the manager. GF is not hard, but very specific. I always have to ask if the corn tortillas served with salsa when you arrive are ONLY corn (some places serve corn chips that have been dusted in wheat flour ... why? Who knows.). I ordered shrimp tacos and reiterated like 3 times that I could ONLY have them on corn tortillas. It was rather early and the place wasn't super busy. We were served by a runner rather than our server and I asked if he was sure my tacos were on corn tortillas. He swore they were corn tortillas and even compared them to another dish at our table on flour tortillas. I believed him and enjoyed the tacos ... only to go home and be sick as a dog for hours. Needless to say, I won't be back. There are many restaurants in the area that are very gluten aware, but this ain't one. Beware!
I went Mimi's cafe ordered the desert Ridge that was good. We tried three different dishes along with Desert Ridge and shared with the table but service was slow.
They don't have carry out, at least not yet. That's weak. I had to buy lesser wings from another place.

This clinic KILLED my dog HARLEY yesterday!! I took him in for a dental cleaning, when I picked him up at 2:30 PM he could not even walk I had to carry him to the car! After being home for a couple of hours I called ABC back and told them that HARLEY wasn't doing good, his tounge was still sticking out and he still wasn't getting up, they told me he would be GROGGY for a while and he would be OK. An hour later I called their emergency clinc which is PIMA PET CARE, they told me that they did not know what ABC clinic had done to HARLEY and that they could not help us! 
We ended up having to take HARLEY to VSCT animal hospital. those people did everything they could do to SAVE HARLEY but it was to late HARLEY had DIED!!! 
DO NOT take your pet to ABC LOW COST PET CARE clinic if you want your pet to live afterwards!!!  Thanks ABC for KILLING my dog HARLEY!!!!!

Rooms were nice. Front desk staff were friendly. Decent breakfast. The free shuttle service is terrible, don't waste your time trying to use it, just take an uber or lyft as they will hold you hostage and drive you around for 20 to 30 minutes while they pick up other people trying to earn tips rather than dropping you off at your destination. The shuttle service was an incredible disappointment and waste of our time.

Came here for the first time to celebrate my birthday (surprise pick from my fiancée). It was during restaurant week so we ordered off the restaurant week menu. You're able to order 2 options from the first course, 2 options from the second course and one option from dessert. The food we ordered was good (minus the lamb meatballs we just didnt enjoy the sauce it was in). However we never received 2 options from our first course. They completely forgot about it. Additionally we had the worse service ever. We couldn't even tell her until she asked us about dessert because she never came to the table to check on us. In about the 2 hours we spent there we saw her maybe 3 or 4 times. Thankfully the manager comped our one meal because we were def not paying full price when we were missing 2 of our dishes. Overall an okay experience I just wish we had a different waiter as I could see that other waiters were very attentive.

This place is definitely authentic.  I like trying out new spots and this place had a different feel.  The service was very good and the tacos came out quickly.  The tortillas were not homemade, but overall it was a good experience.

Took my mother-in-law out to her favorite Italian restaurant. She would eat there everyday if we let her. I was pleasantly surprised with the amount of food I received. I honestly thought someone made a mistake when my plate arrived. Service was awesome and my whole family (even my picky eater son) enjoyed their food.

I have been coming here for sometime now. Watch battery changes, new watch bands, adding or replacing links in watch bands. Miscellaneous jewelry repairs. Caesars jewelers does it all. And most of the time minor repairs and change out of batteries are done while you wait.

I have the upmost faith in Caesars  Jewelers, and will continue to use them in the future.

Tacconelli's is hands down the best pizza I've ever had. It beats out all other pizza joints I've eaten at, including but not limited to those in Italy, New York and Philly (even Pizzeria Beddia). Love Tacconelli's no-frills classic pizzeria vibe and it's a BYOB. Service is also fantastic. Sauce, cheese and crust are perfect every time I'm there. Highly recommend ordering a Red pie (plain pie) and a Signature pie (white pie topped with cheese, spinach and chopped tomatoes). A side of their house made long hots is a must as well.

Was going to the Thai restaurant next-door before I show at the pageant. But Tavolo had no wait. Unfortunately they were out of the IPA on tap and toasted ravioli. The Pomodoro pasta was good and the calamari. However the cauliflower was burned so bad it was inedible. And spinach cakes were just tolerable. Short staff made for a hectic. I did notice and appreciate the cleanliness (sweet liquors protected with plastic wrap) and ambience.

The Lure is a gem of a restaurant in downtown St. Petersburg.  I love the atmosphere, day or night.  Today I stopped in for lunch and tried Rob's Cobb.  The blue cheese crumbles were pure awesomeness, and let's face, that's the whole reason to order a Cobb salad.  Then, it got even better!  The chicken was deliciously seasoned instead of pasty white.  Loved it, though gotta admit, the tuna (sushi) avocado salad is still my favorite menu item so far.

I won't be eating at Village Inn Brandon no time soon. They brought out coffee cups for 4 people THREE times in a row that were dirty, (kept showing them the dirt and lipstick and asked for CLEAN), lipstick on them, took an hour to bring out cold breakfast, didn't get half our orders right, (got sarcastic about bringing the CORRECT order), bacon wasn't hardly cooked at all even though asked for crispy, and then got nasty with us when we complained. Cher, the waitress who took over for the new girl and obviously should know better being more experienced kept reaching over my plate to hand food to another person at our table THREE TIMES, right in front of my face - said something to her about it for her to get sarcastic about that, like that shouldn't be a bother to me. "Nobody has ever complained about that before..." go back to school for waitress mannerisms! Manager said they'd bring our food right out (at 50 minutes wait) and we still sat for another five minutes and got up to complain again. Others who had come in behind us but not a mixed group was getting their food before us, within a few minutes of ordering...literally!

I won't even eat there, as a veteran, for free. Had to ask for styrofoam cups to drink out of because none of their coffee cups were clean. Water glasses weren't clean. Silverware had to be soaked in steaming hot water at the table to clean off particles of food. Never again!

Terrible service. Ordered food. Waited thirty minutes for sister to order. She got a number. We had to enquirer about our food multiple times until they told us it was never put in. Waited 45 mins for no food.

Absolutely fantastic service. They told me an hour and it was closer to 30 mins. I had a slow leak in my tire and they fixed the valve and sent me on my way no charge. I would highly recommend to anyone with tire issues!  Thank you to Delip and the rest of the Big Brand Tire staff.

Came here for restaurant week with 3 other friends and man were we excited! The restaurant week selections are slightly different than the regular menu, with 3-4 of the more expensive cuts not being available, but with 9 skewers of different meats still accessible, it was more than enough for us. 

We were first introduced to the friendly servers who pointed us to the market table full of charcuterie, cheeses, veggies, fruits, salads, and soups. You can honestly get full from just this table, but of course, that was just the beginning. They then brought cheesy bread, fried bananas, polenta cakes, and mashed potatoes over to the table, which were all delicious. After that, we flipped over our cards from the red side to green to signal that we were ready for the meat.

Once I flipped my card over, skewers of meat swarmed to the table and I had to flip my card quickly back over to red since the service was so fast. Honestly, I ate so much meat that I couldn't recall which was which, though the one that stuck out most in my mind was the Parmesan pork chop. It was tender, moist, and flavorful. 

We ate until we were full, and then we ate some more. The only thing I would criticize is that when they ask you for a temperature for your meat (at least with my med rare preference), I typically got a more medium-mid well cut. 

Overall, I would definitely recommend it to meat lovers, protein loaders, and people who want a fun experience with some good food.

Recently made a major purchase at the Indianapolis store and the sales associate was excellent but the follow-up and customer service after left a lot to be desired.  The purchase was an upgrade to my wives main wedding ring so during the purchase my wife mentioned the surrounding ring had lost a small stone over the years.  The associate told us they could sent it to their corporate office and would look for a replacement.  She estimated that it would be $300-350 and they would call to confirm an estimate once they found one.  She also said it might end up being gratis based on the amount we spend on the main stone upgrade.  The other benefit was they would warranty that ring too.  

Well, after no news for about 4 weeks my wife started calling and around 6 weeks finally got someone that said, your ring is back and repaired.  No call for estimate, just it is fixed and back.  When we went to pick it up it was just under $1000 with tax and they said no warranty as they didn't sell the rest of the ring.  It was a tiny stone and the price seemed really excessive.  I mentioned they were supposed to call us with an estimate first and the lady told me they could take the stone out.  After being without it for six weeks, I couldn't do that to my wife so I just took it but won't be doing any more major purchases with them in the future.   I was astounded at the lack of customer service there.

This Asian market moved to its new location by the Crossfit gym a few months ago. I live in east Nashville and it is very convenient to have this little gem so close to my house. 

The man who runs the store is friendly enough. I usually tell him what I need then he guides me around the store while I make my selections. They have a variety of produce that I cannot find at any other grocery store in the area, and everything is cheaply priced. I will say that when I am making a recipe, like green curry, I have to go to two grocery stores to find everything I need (i.e. chicken, smaller bags of rice, some vegetables).

A few of things that I have purchased are: lemongrass, limes, curry paste, noodles, chiles, sprouts, thai basil, and Japanese eggplant

Bring cash if you can! Credit card machine fees are expensive for small businesses like this.
Nice park for nature but my kids didn't care for it because there was only one playground that we saw and nobody else was there

You don't really feel safe here.  This is another La Quinta that needs a remodel. It is an old building with water pipes that make noise. The bathroom is tiny. The room is one of those rooms where it just " feels" dirty. The carpet is old.
Another biggie  for me was I was put on the second floor with pet carriers and ALOT of luggage and NO ELEVATOR. ( what century are we in?)

However I do have to say in all fairness, the staff was nice and the pet area was the nicest I have seen at any La Quinta so far. But i would not stay here again.

As a former Chicagoland resident, I was thrilled to see Portillos moving into the Tampa Bay area, especially with the Fowler location being just a few blocks from my Fire Station. They've done a good job of maintaining the same atmosphere as Portillos back in the homeland and the food quality hasn't suffered the geographical shift. Kudos to the management staff for keeping it authentic and up to the standards of Portillos fans from up north.

bullshit.
because i went with a group of girls doesnt mean that i dont want to be served like any other person in this place.
the bartenders really need to change their attitude.
the girls arent really that great either.
i would say only one stripper went to us and talked to us..
BUT... she said she loves asian people cause we look like hello kitty...?
should i take that offensively?
Excellent service, great food and $2.00 mimosas! Great place to eat outside on a rooftop deck. Highly recommend the brunch!

Super disappointed. I've seen such hype about this place so i was excited to be able to try it tonight . 
The crispy beef was really good. 
The fried rice was super bland.
The Dan dan noodles were too spicy and oily
Our drinks were flat
Service was super slow
I also felt like i was at Waffle House the way they bring one item out at a time.. (we had my husbands entree 30 min before the fried rice. )
Nice place, ambience is cool. But highly over rated.

Four of us got on the carriage expecting a relaxing and enjoyable ride and before  15 minutes had passed we were back at our starting point and told that the tour was over.  "That's it" was my only question and I got the excuse that the riverside was closed due to an event and normally it's better.I can't recommend this company.

Okay I'll try it out and I walked in and ordered I seated myself.  We ordered 2 sandwiches and a order of onion rings and we may have got 8 onion rings for $2.99.
I couldn't help but to notice that the same lady that took my order was in the kitchen cooking.  ( just hoping she washed her hands). The corn beef was all chopped up and I couldn't tell if it was the meat or the salad dressing that tasted sour.   No pickles or frills just a sandwich.  I gave 1 star for store cleanliness, 1 star for the music and 1 star for location.  
Staff in kitchen that I am looking at do not have on any masks and it is 3 employees. How sad!

Bespoke is a great place to get house plants in Collingswood. I got a zz plant and a small string of hearts plant there. Both were well taken care of and well labelled at the store, which is great for newcomers. At the time I shopped there, they had fruiting lemon and pineapple plants which I often don't see in other nurseries in the philly/NJ area! There was also an awesome collection of different types of snake plants.

There is a great selection of pots, through they are on the pricer side compared to big box stores like home depot. However, I think given the looks and quality, they are worth the price. Also, they have a dog!

I'll definitely be back when I want to add to my plant family.

I come to New Orleans monthly and always bring guests. I've always made B.B. King's part of our weekend for the music not the food. They seem to make you a second class customer if you want to come drink and listen to the music and not eat there. Despite this, we have always come to hear their All Star Band that came down Wednesday through Sunday from Memphis to anchor this great music venue. OMG, how disappointed I was this weekend to learn that my favorite band was booted (likely because the owner wanted to Save money on a cheaper band). Well, they got what they paid for. The band was good but not nearly as engaging as the All Stars from Memphis. Hardly any audience participation and no one was dancing. The All Stars always got the crowd going and dancing. I've brought dozens of guests here. It's now off my list until they bring back the All Stars. Another example of penny wise and pound foolish. The owner needs to go there and observe the difference. Shame on them!

After my review from one year ago and others, the owners brought back much of the original All Star band, added the great local talented female vocalist Geena Brown and this became part of my weekend routine again during my monthly visits. All for the music, not the food. Well, the owner has done it again and booted the great engaging band that got everyone dancing and singing and replaced them with an undoubtedly cheaper band. Shameful and ignorant ownership move which makes loyal repeat customers like myself an ex customer now. Penny wise and pound foolish. So disappointed.

I've only had Jamaican food twice. My first experience was here. I had curry goat and fried plantains. I enjoyed my meal. While service was very slow, I didn't mind it as the restaurant was small but busy. Unfortunately, my second Jamaican food experience (in the middle of no where in Massachusetts) showed me how flavorful Jamaican food can be. In comparison, the curry goat here does not have enough spice....it was pretty....bland. 

If you don't like too much spice (and I'm not referring to just hot spiciness but the combinations of spices/herbs) in your food, you may not mind it as much. The restaurant is small but carefully decorated. I liked the atmosphere.

This place has never let me down with the gumbo until my last 3 times going hoping they would get it right. The gumbo is good don't get me wrong but for some reason they fill your cup with juice and sausage. Can I please get more than 3 shrimp and a lil piece of chicken in my cup! PLEASE!!! Stop trying to stretch it out. Starting to think this is typical when selling to a different community.

Ordered Dozen oysters and Chicken romano. The chicken Romano was really good and the quantity would fill two people. The oysters were fantastic and made my visit to New Orleans even better. The oysters are a must try when in New Orleans.

The food and the service are unmatched. Great food great service and great atmosphere. Super kid friendly... the burger might be is a total sleeper. Could be the best in the city but the seafood is unbelievable.

I ordered the vegan burger to-go and had to immediately brush my teeth after taking a bite. The texture was mealy and it tasted like taking a bite of fresh earth outside. Their website says they have the Impossible burger but this is not that. 

I know these are hard times but we need better options than this. Highly disappointed in the vegan offerings. I can't stomach to try to eat here again. Maybe their other burgers are worth getting but vegans should pass on this less than stellar option.
This place will always be my first love! The prices fluctuate due to it being seafood but it's sooooo as addictive and worth every penny!

My son Steven first took me here and said his friend was the owner. I came in skeptical thinking that he's going to say it's good regardless of how it tasted. I was pleasantly surprised! While we got there too late for the lunch special, they had everything and anything you need to make your own lunch. We got some pastries that were delicious. 
 My other son Johnny is a huge fan of sausages. We went in last week and he loved it! The portions are huge which is always a plus. I had the split pea with ham and I have to say, it was the best split pea soup I have ever had in my life! I have been enjoying that soup for 50 years and I have never had it as delicious as this. 
The people there are kind and remembered me when I returned on my own to see if today's soup was split pea. Sadly it wasn't but ham & beans was, and it was also delicious. Do yourself a favor and try this place out. It will quickly become your favorite! Thanks for consistently being a great place for lunch.

I was in the area, pretty good distance from my house, but decided to call in a to-go lunch order of my tried and true favorites that I usually get at another location. Easy peasy order over the phone, except I didn't catch my total. I was on my handsfree in the car so it was a bit muffled. 

The parking lot was a bit confusing and I ended up walking around the entire building for the front door, just to end up five feet from where I parked! Glad no one saw me do that, or at least I hope they didn't! Once inside,I headed over to the bar at the other end of the restaurant to pay and grab my order. It was a bit pricey, a little more $$$ than the Hillsborough location.

That half hour drive home felt like forever, smelling my Yummy House as I was cruising down I-4 to my exit! Once home, hubby and I devoured our (2) BBQ pork fried rice, Mongolian beef and honey chicken! It was as good as our regular location. And we had plenty of left overs, namely the next round two hours later!

I have had a wonderful experience everytime I go to this location but on Saturday June 1st, 2019 I was truly impressed with the service. The young man working was short staffed but was still upbeat, friendly and displayed excellent customer service skills!!! I had to leave this review because he needed to be recognized. I ran into a old friend and we talked forever in line but this young man  asked if we were okay and never got frustrated that we were technically holding up the line because he was multi tasking well and us procrastinating definitely stopped his flow but he still maintained a positive accommodating attitude. He was AWESOME!!! I told the store manager as we were leaving and she was equally pleasant as well  i will definitely go back!!!
I loved everything ! I had the shrimp and the shrimp Po boy. I ate here 5 times while visiting over the weekend

Awesome, quiet, romantic and dim lighting to create the ambiance. Ill definitely be visiting again soon. The staff was amazing and very attentive to anyone's table. 

They worked as team to make sure you were well cared for. I probably saw 6 or 7 people stop by and make sure I had everything I needed.

We ordered carry out last week. Hot, packaged well, and just as good as if we were dining in. Great flavor. No, they don't put on a show, but the outcome is still great food at reasonable prices. We've dined in before and it was great, too!!

Tucked in the little strip on 21st before Hillsboro Village proper, right next to Taco Mama, step into a cool little spot that makes you feel like you are in another city.

***** Five stars for decor and atmosphere: black, red and white sleek clean interior, menus that look like laminated album covers, and music videos playing on 5 or 6 screens placed around the space (but not so loudly you can't hear your neighbor).

***** Five stars for service: Whitney and the whole staff were really sweet and eager to share about the concept and menu specialties.

**** Four stars for the food:  I had sushi (tuna and albacore nigiri), hibachi and miso soup.  The miso soup was really miso-y and flavorful; it was my favorite.  (The main specialty here on the menu is lots of maki rolls named after rock bands with lots of ingredients which I did not order as that style of sushi is not my preference.)

The name serves its purpose because they have delicious gumbo! I am very particular about my gumbo and I tend to only stick to what I am familiar with but i went out on a limb and got the gumbo with the fried shrimp and OMG it was amazing! It will definitely leave you craving for more even after you've gotten full! Definitely a great place to stop by and try. Not much seating but the atmosphere is sooo homey it doesn't even matter! Really enjoyed it!

Just moved to Boise yesterday, came across this restaurant by chance and HOLY SH!T soooo good!! Wings dank as ever, drinks will get you lit, solid AF service, pretty much the illest spot in Idaho. Don't miss out on this place. 10 stars

Ive been waiting for them to re open for dinning (still have takeout of course).. The experience was un matched for my date night... Service was great outgoing friendly the quorky fun train that delivers your food and ohh the food yes. What a wonderful experience.. Oh forgot to say loved watching the chef hand pull my noodles to order.. We left so happy, food,ambiance and service .. Perfect package thank you for a fun delicious meal.

The location on 4th street could use more cleaning & upkeep.    

What I would love to see are more zumba classes that include some R&B and soul music.
Although the instructors are very good, the focus seems to be more on lots of "twerking"

TODAY is Friday the 17th of September, 2021. 
this place sucks. i've given it way too many chances, every time i go i wait way too long for a sloppy messy bagel that was obviously not made with care. They always seem to mess up an aspect of my order too. I will never be returning and i hope none of you decide to eat here. the cherry on top is how overpriced everything is. they need to fire everyone and get a whole new staff.

We were looking for some mid-century furnishing ideas and decided to stop by and look around.  This store is located in Hyde Park, Tampa.  Parking can be tricky but we got lucky and found a 'one hour' space right in front of the store. We were greeted as we entered.  The sales staff seemed friendly.

They did a have a great variety of household goods as well as furniture.  When we were there, a lot of folks were buying their bedding and linen.  The prices are on the higher side but the quality seems to be there, too.

I'm glad that we stopped by to give us a chance to see some of the chairs, desks, credenzas and sofas that we've seen online.  Sometimes it's difficult to make a big dollar decision with just on-line pictures and descriptions.

I can definitely recommend stopping by if you're interested in mid-century furnishings and household accessories.

So I'm not a regular customer at this nail salon, but i went there today because the normal one i go to was busy and i really needed my nails done. I had got a refill and had one missing nail, the lady rung me up and said $20 for a refill, i went to grab a $20 out my wallet and 2 $20s came out by accident, she seen the money and went up to $35, i asked her what she rung me up for, how the hell did the price jump? she went to calculating the refill and the broken nail and the design i had and it came up to $28, SO BE CAREFUL GOING HERE!!! THEY WILL RIP YOU OFF! ask them how much everything is before you even get serviced because they will make their own prices up!
THEIR COCONUT ICE CREAM WAS TOO GOOD! You could tell that the ice cream was homemade! They had a ton of flavors to choose from as well!

I ordered 10 banded kuhli loaches as they had in the picture and they send me 10 dojo brown loaches......... I ordered 10 frogs and they sent me 7 - 1 was DOA. I bought s. repens and both were completely wadded up and DOA. They advertised their pennywort as dwarf  "japan" when it was actually huge Brazil clearly out of a large pond- will not work in any of my tanks due to its gigantisism . Have to take trimmings of new growth to make it work. The Wisteria I ordered was above ground and its going to to take a month for it to acclimate and change its leaves to underwater. I send them an email- a week later I have no response. I honestly just wish I would had looked up reviews before I spent 180$. I hate giving a place like this a bad review but its the false advertising that really pisses me off- I was basically punked by these people and it really bummed me out for about 2 days. The fish i received from them act like they were being attacked by a cat or something so the only thing I feel good about is that I got those loaches and frogs out of there.

The girl that helped us was nice but the supervisor who's name is Diana or manager, whatever she was, was a complete .. jerk. She walked back and forth correcting  the rest of the employees which rubs everyone else the wrong way including the employees and makes it awkward for everybody and it's just plain rude. The little time we sat there people would call and as soon and they would hang up she'd make unprofessional comments to herself regarding whoever called. Avoid the plumb location if you want to avoid a headache. The rest of the employees were nice so that sucks.

It is the changing of the seasons and time to decorate once more.  Ok, so I used that as an excuse to go looking at furniture.  This place has only recently opened so it is still all nice and shiny and full of all sorts of goodies.  It's also nice for getting some decorating ideas...but I digress.

Nice store, nice things, decent enough pricing, two floors full of items for dining rooms, living rooms, kiddie rooms, etc.  Some of the items were "who the hell is going to put THAT in their house?" while others had me wanting to just gut our place and start anew. We had a very nice young sales girl - Preslie - walk with us through both levels of the store holding a lamp I was trying to match up with a table.

Go, look, and you might even buy!

Went here the day before Valentine's day and expected it to be busy and it wasn't at all! The place is really big and looks nice enough on the inside. The waiting area/front entrance is so tiny--like only one family can fit. The food is delicious. Love the bread with the oil. I got the spicy chicken romano pasta and it was very good, even had leftovers. I would definitely recommend this place for some good italian! Just don't expect to be in and out, the service is a little slow.

Terrific barbecue at a terrific price. We took a detour to check this place out due to the great reviews, and were more than happy that we did. I got the 8 ounce brisket sandwich, and could only eat half of it! The barbecue sauces are all served on the side, and I recommend mixing the coffee barbecue sauce with the hot barbecue sauce, for a perfect blend of smokiness and hotness. If I were ever in this town again I would definitely stop by.

If you go when Tommy is bar tending it's a great experience.  Good bartender!  The other gentleman is a must avoid.  I won't go into detail but I assure you, with many other choices in the area...you'd be better off going elsewhere.  The food is very bland and boring but I don't expect much from a dive bar so I can't complain about that.  But, you do expect good service and you won't get even common decency from the bartender at this place.  Take your $$ to PJs or Miller's.

What a cute place! Located in downtown Tucson, this place offers unique shopping all held within a lovely atmosphere. 

We absolutely adored the flower shop. Very friendly customer service, and the quality of each flower product was fantastic. I didn't notice anything wilted, and the employees answered all of my questions about this one type of succulent (super exciting stuff). 

The desserts were interesting. Mexican styled desserts that are unique and not too sweet.

The food was good, the service was not great and we were the only two other people in the place.  Coffee mugs sticky.  Literally had to get up to ask for water and coffee.  Servers seem to hate their job, quite mouthy.  It has potential but needs to up the bar on service for sure.

The sandwiches I got were great. They have a lot of meat on them and are a nice size. The biggest down side is the wait! It took over an hour to get my two sandwiches. Luckily I had been warned about this Liz

LOVE this place! Stopped here on a whim while in St. Pete Beach and was very impressed! Great service and great food, plus all day happy hour. Visited in december and they have outdoor heaters which was nice for at night. Jill and Red both rook care of us and were very friendly and good about checking in on us to see if we needed anything. Will definitely come back if we are in the area again!

Wonderful consignment store. The staff are very friendly and helpful. I've purchased several items from here in the last 2 months. They even offer a contracted delivery service for larger items. I used this service to have a large dresser with mirror delivered. It went smoothly. They get a lot of fine furniture from estates and nice homes. Something else that is really cool is that some items like my dresser are brand new items from builder trade shows/displays. I do agree with another reviewer that the prices can be surprising at times but relative to the original retail price of item/quality of item you would be hard pressed to beat them. You will find great deals here. I'm phobic of bed bugs/germs so some secondhand things gross me out but I would buy any upholstered furniture here without hesitation. They have high standards and I've never seen anything on the floor that was not in good to excellent condition. You won't find $50-100 couches here(like gross ones at goodwill) but you will find $600-$700 couches that retailed for at least twice that amount new. In many cases items are 75% or more off the original price. This is the best place I've found in Indy to get quality pieces at affordable prices. You can get solid wood pieces & genuine leather items without paying through the nose for it.

This place was great! We were having a really shitty day and camme back to the hotel fed up with everything. I ordered fish tacos and we had some shots. The service was fast and friendly, and the food was terrific, probably eating here tomorrow
I haven't been yet, hut I was there when the first New World Brewery was started. It was a surprise that NWB followed me to Sulphur Springs. I will be sure to come in soon!

Low price! Great new management, they really try to help! I have lived here for 2+ years and I love it here. The apartment itself is spacious and different then any other place in town. Love the lodge, wilderness feel.

HORRIBLE EVERY TIME! I get it's fast food but holy hell, how hard can it be? They never get the orders right and then give you attitude when you ask for them to correct it. They always forget the sauces, napkins and straws. They are constantly rude! Fries are ALWAYS burnt and old. Save yourself and go to the one off stead Blvd (literally 5 minutes away) and thank me later.

I always go to manju she is simply the best !
I've been a regular customer and she takes her time to listen and shape my eyebrows as I like  , the whole team is accommodating but manju is my favorite there :)
Beautiful pool love going life guards can be alil rude at times especially to the younger kids which I don't care for. But if your with your child at all times it's a great pool clean we love it.

Went to this place on 6/10/18 at 5:02pm
