Spent $44.91. Everything was horrable for starters they didn't have any soda that day because they said there CO2 was messed up are server name was jodi she was so rude and nasty we watched her make many trips and got many plates of food for herself and we watch her do nothing but eat plate after plate after plate the whole time we was there. They couldn't keep any food up of you wanted a steak it took 45 min to get a steak along with other food if something ran out it took 30to45 min for them to put something else back out we spook to the manager working that night and she said she was sorry she said just bring in are receipt and they would buy us dinner next rime .
So today we go back 6/14/18 at about 5:10pm and as soon as we walk in the door the server from last time jodi the one that did nothing but eat and talk crap about everyone ran right to this black manager talking crap about us then this black manager comes to us she had no name tag on and wouldn't even give us her name got in are face a screaming and yelling at us saying that she wouldnt give us the free meals that we was told would be replaced and that she was not there that night and that it wasn't her problem so we ask for corporate phone number and her bosses name she flips us off and says no then runs and hide in the office so as we are leaving the server jodi had one of the cooks run out and take photos of are truck and license plates threating to call the cops on us because we wanted the black managers name and corporate phone number then jodi the server that does nothing but eat and talk crap about other people runs out and flips us off amd told us to go fuck are self.

Mike at Wayne's Garage helped me out when I had to get the cooling system replaced and was willing to work with me every step of the way. He took me step-by-step through the problem, explained why each part needed to be replaced (and their function in the system, to boot), and was patient and understanding when it took me time to decide whether to get my car fixed on my recent-grad budget. While their labor cost is on the higher end of the spectrum, as other reviewers have pointed out, their quality work is worth it, and they have an 18 month/18k mile warranty on all parts and labor.

Nobody tried to upsell anything, and they were able to salvage and repair one of the more expensive parts, saving me $100. They definitely have a returning customer.

My Nada experience was a good one! Was greeted right away and didn't have to wait too long for reservation that was already made. The atmosphere was great, seemed like a more upscale lounge. There were tv's to see sports with was a big plus on my behave. Food was delicious! Got the pork tacos with pineapple in them which tasted great! It was a good mixture of spice and sweet at the same time loVed them! And the  dessert was amazing!

Went with my daughter for lunch. She ordered the California wrap and I had the buffalo chicken wrap. Let's start with the bad, the food wasn't awesome. My daughters didn't have the black beans it was supposed to come with, so it was basically a white rice burrito. My wrap didn't have a hint of buffalo, but was heavy with ranch...which it was supposed to come with. Mine was good, but my kid wasn't overly excited.

The good: The fries are awesome! My daughter cared less about her flop of a wrap because she had a huge portion of great fries. We also asked for a dipping sauce for her wrap to give it some flavor. They brought out an incredibly mild one, but it had good flavor. I asked our server if they sold sauces by the bottle; she wasn't sure and later brought over her supervisor. She said they didn't, but offered to bring us out samples. After we told her to bring us the hottest, she brought us out the three hottest sauces they have. All were incredible! 

The service was fantastic; I wish I remembered our servers name because she was great. Both she and the supervisor were incredibly friendly and attentive seeing as my daughter needed several drink refills. 

So yes, the food had some mistakes, but that is not reflective of the ladies out front and they totally made up for it. I'd rather have decent food with great service than amazing food with bad service. I know we'll be back.

I consider myself a bit of a grocery store enthusiast. In a perfect world I would shop at whole foods. But my bank account doesn't like the idea quite as much. I was so excited to see they were opening a neighborhood market so close to my house, and they didn't disappoint. The first thing I noticed was the organized layout of this location, which made me super happy. Pretty nice produce section with all fresh things. (They should be as it had only been open about 3 days during our visit). I didn't find it to be to crowded even though we went in the middle of a Saturday. Well def be back!

Super Average.  Its is a chain and as such it lacks any local personality.  I like Rick Reef better.  It feels like a big touristy type place, but in a bad way.  At Crabby Bills you know what you are in for and the food is good.  Here, you think it is a local place, only to find out it is run like a red lobster...

review of dozens of visits and take outs.

when you want awesome smoked meats and do not want to travel far
Dalie's is there

when you have a impromptu group of people show up at your house and they are hungry 
Dalie's take out is there

when you have planned a smoked meat dinner for 15 coworkers
Dalie's catering is there

when you are driving home and just need dinner for four
Dalie's take out is there

when you need a quick but great lunch
Dalie's is there

Bowled here several times with friends - even without bumpers!

Easy parking. Roomy. Affordable rates - credit cards accepted. Food's available, and there are a few arcade machines too, I think? (Never played them.)

Conveniently close to Springfield Mall.
Quick and easy. Laptop was repaired in just a day. Service was helpful and friendly. Very straightforward service and fair price.

So impressed with their service! Friendly, fast and efficient. I even came in a few minutes late from my scheduled smog appointment. Fernando was so understanding and we probably got in and out of their under 30min. Definitely recommend. Also the receptionist was very friendly as well.

My fiance I had so much fun being on tour with Mike! I could have been on tour with him all day. Very friendly, knowledgeable, and funny. This isn't just a tour for beer people, it's built for everyone. We also stayed after to grab some food and brews. Even bought a case to take home with us. Highly, highly, recommend this spot in Philly.

Seriously bad attitude from the drive-thru window worker who was working at 11:30 a.m. on 12/11/20. This lady was handling people's food and interacting without her mask pulled up over her face. When I questioned why she complained it was uncomfortable and she couldn't breathe. Apparently, her spreading of a potentially fatal disease doesn't matter to her or her manager. The health department should really have a talk with the staff of this place. I have sympathy for the discomfort. But, this is flat out irresponsible.

These wings are some of the bestastound. There is a great atmosphere with TVs all over the  place and a lot of energy. The only downside is the long wait as they currently do not do call ahead seating, however, it is worth the wait. Going at lunch time  is a lot easier to get in.

I live their pizza, and Italian dishes! They give you plenty of toppings on pizzas, and generous amount of pasta with garlic bread. Love their Italian house salad with lots of toppings, and great house Italian dressing. Very family friendly. Serves is fast, and friendly. It's a Great neighborhood restaurant .
Dr. Pizzo went above and beyond to find me the best Halloween contacts! He was so friendly as well as all of the rest of the staff!!!
Hmm...Well...it is what it is.  Seems a little dirty and all. I go for the selection of Asian beer mostly. What is it about that smell?

called to book a spot when we arrived the lady told us 5 teenagers had also booked the spot and to come back later. (dont know why we couldnt go along with them) wasted time until it was our time to go back. when we showed up for the second time in the same night she told us thats someone else had booked on line (even though we already booked the spot with her) and that we couldnt go. as she could tell i was upset and she said "haha look at her face" as if the situation and us being upset was funny. i will NEVER return.

I was in town for a convention and arrived on Sunday and left on Thursday... I came here three times. I love beer and I love artisan pizza. Their beer wall is impressive, though I found one I liked and drink the same thing each time. Their pizza is the best I have ever had!  They have a beautiful patio to eat outside... In the summer it's a bit hot but nighttime is beautiful! Arcel was  an amazing waiter - it was only his third day but you think you've been here for years!

Absolutely favorite sandwich shop. The fries are heavenly, the bread selection is sublime, and the staff is absolutely incredible. They are always so friendly and willing to help, even through all the stress of the pandemic. I wish I could be as friendly and optimistic as them.
Support local, support small businesses, especially this one!!

Thank You Very Much Earl Welsh (Cherryhill Triplex Jeep, Dodge,  Chrysler) for Being Such A Wonderful God Sent Blessing To Me & My Family. You went above and beyond to make sure that We had the right car at the right price to meet our families finances and budget. You Gave us your Beautiful Spirit of Excellence . You are very knowledgeable & helpful. You worked very hard to make everything  work in our favor which made it a very pleasant & nonpressured experience. 
Thank You Marla, Russell & Dorothy.

I have been here twice and both times I come in feeling like, "oh this place is so cute!" and leave feeling like, "oh, that was cute...."  I like the location, on a nice day it gives you a chance to walk around as you wait for your table and it is also located around the block from a parking lot which is always awesome in this area. 

The first time I came, I went all out and got a fancy crab, avocado omlette that was just ok. It sounded absolutely wonderful, but it came out and it was just bland, no salt or pepper and not umpf. It needed maybe a sauce to really make it all come together. The coffee was nice and strong which was great. 

The second time I ordered a specialty burger with fried egg, ham and the works on it. After taking the first bite, again I felt the same way, there needed a sauce to bring the tastes together. The meat was well seasoned but the ham was too much, and overall I was just not that in love with it. I did however love the fresh chips. 

I really want to give this place a 3  but I haven't enjoyed the food when I'm here. My service hasn't been excellent either, it seems like they never have enough waitstaff and it takes a while to get your food. Generally I would say come here if your first option doesn't work out.

My wife and I eat here on a weekly basis, personally our favorite tacos in town. I see that yelp only gives it a 3.5 star rating and I think it's absurd. We love this place. The burger is also one of the best in town. Get the pork belly taco, the piggy, or the Bang bang shrimp. Well worth it!

We didn't spend much time here as we mainly slept and got ready but the staff was friendly and the rooms were decent. It was nice that they had a small kitchenette so we didn't feel like we had to eat out every day. Everything was clean and the price was good for being right on the beach.

We only waited 15 minutes for one of the small round tables up front. Great view of the band - traditional jazz with a lead clarinet. Talented young guys, but they made some off color jokes. We ordered poor boys, and after waiting 30 minutes for our food, were told that they didn't have any bread. Finished our drinks and went elsewhere.

This was the very first place I eat when I came to Reno. It's a small very diner like feel and it has a classic comfort when you walk inside. I was alone so I sat at the bar in the waitress and other patrons were very friendly. This was of course before Covid!

Now if you want to feel nostalgic this is definitely the police to grab breakfast brunch or lunch. They have pancakes that I absolutely adored and reminded me of all the times I would go to Gunther Tooties back in Colorado. The service staff was very kind easy to work with and they seated me rather quickly even though it seems so busy.

Now I have to warn you the food might be a win but the parking lot is the size of the head of a pin so if you're going to come here you might as well park in the parking lot behind the restaurant so you save yourself the headache and get in a few extra steps. That was the only complaint I had to be honest so really I can't wait to go back because it brings back so many great memories in the food although it isn't five star quality I would say it's five star for my expectations. 

10/10 would recommend!

Excellent tacos and homemade horchata! This small sit down restaurant is tucked away in a grocery store with a handful of tables and chairs. Staff is friendly and everything is homemade, even the tortillas.

This business is selling dogs with PARVO! Not only that but they can't provide ANY information from the previous shelter that's apparently located in Puerto Rico...seems extremely shady and they should be shut down immediately! Money hungry scumbags who obviously don't care about the well being of these pets

What an amazing store!  I am LOVING my new evil eye ring from Porter Lyons.  I live in Scottsdale, AZ.  I was first introduced to this place while working from home when their facebook advertisement came up in my feed.  I ended up buying an adorable little gold and diamond hoop earring at that time.  The salesperson I spoke to on the phone helped me get the best price and free shipping.  Since then, I've been enjoying browsing their pieces online regularly.  We were in New Orleans this past weekend and I was so excited to visit the store in person to pick up my gold and diamond snake hoop earring with emerald eyes.  I don't have a picture, but it is lovely.  All the jewelry here is designed by the owner, and there is such variety.  They have something for everyone.  You are buying and wearing art when you shop here.  These are pieces you won't find at "Jared" or other big box jewelry stores.  I got this beautiful ring with the help of Aria and Sarah, who were so welcoming and made it a really fun experience.  I got 20% off for my birthday!  I'll definitely be recommending this store to my friends in AZ.  It's important to me to support small businesses, especially in this very difficult time.

I had the pleasure of touring the Garden District with Randy!!!!! Not only was he hilarious, he seems to know absolutely everything that has ever happened to any person, place, and thing in the history of New Orleans. I went on several tours and his was the most informative by far. I can't wait to come back and take another tour with him. Book him now and tip him extra because he's a bad-Ass!
The best nail salon in the area! I love viví she is the best and they are so nice! Also they take pride in their work and I always love how my nails come out!

Delicious Shawarma! Very similar to the chicken shawarma I've eaten overseas. It's a good truck but they do an amazing job! You should definitely try it! I recommend the chicken more than the beef, but both still delish!! Seating area but I recommend you just grab and go! Very flavorful and homey!

Great place with awesome chicken. You can choose how Spicy you want it and it's hot!  but so tasty at the same time. 
Best part for me was the great staff.
Oh and I checked in and they gave me a free giant chicken wing!

TD bank is probably the worst bank around. Their fees alone are enough make me cringe whenever I check my account. I finally switched when mint.com told me I paid over$200 last year in fees. The hours are convenient but not the cost. Please look into every bank in your area before giving then your business.

Sal's seafood was fresh and good,  and it arrived at our table hot and quick.  We had never had a whole crab prior to tonight so we did not know how to crack it open.  No worries though - the waitress and one of the locals showed us how to do it.  What great hospitality!! If ever back in this area again, I'll eat at Sal's again.
The staff was engaging and fun. The food was perfect. We had a blast and will most definitely be returning.

I like Savers.... they have good quality used clothing. They have special deals like members get 50% off days and other fun stuff. If you donate you get a coupon for a percentage off. I am a yo-yo dieter so when I need big clothes savers it is!

Just had a great meal at the Stillery's sister location 2 doors down called The Republic. Food was great. Service was wonderful. Hostess had a glass slip off of a table (as will happen from time to time) and addressed it immediately. Cleaned it up and apologized to nearby customers. 2 of those customers laughed and made fun of her for several minutes. One kept it going on for the remainder of her meal. Believe she also spoke with waitstaff about it to continue the harassment and belittlement of the hostess. This was nothing more than a couple of elitist patrons giving a hard working hostess a hard time. Hostess was a true professional with her apology and positive attitude. These entitled patrons were nothing more than petty bullies who spent the evening mocking an employee with the only purpose being to humiliate her. They were disgusting and should be ashamed of themselves.

We stopped in Nashville as a stopping point on our way from Georgia to Colorado. And we stopped by The Stillery based on the reviews. 

It did not disappoint! We were here on a Thursday night around 7:30pm. There was about a 30 minute wait so we put our name on the list to get a text when our table was ready. Time went fast as we just walked down the street exploring the area for a few minutes. 

I ordered the brussel sprouts pizza. Anyone that commits to making a Brussel Sprouts pizza must know what their doing because that's just crazy! It was ahhhhmazing! 

My family ordered the Mac and cheese topped with hot chicken, firehouse pie (no sausage, pepperoni instead) and The steak sandwich. All were superb! 

Service was quick and friendly and the food was great! We'll definitely return when in the Nashville area again.

If you like Pizza Hut but want to spend twice as much for half the amount of food, you'll LOVE this place.

The salad was nice though.
Good food. Nice atmosphere. The dipping sauce for the pot stickers and spring rolls was a little spicy as was the fry seasoning but it was still good. I wish they had more sauce to their bao.

If I could rate it zero stars, I would. The Santa Barbara office is full of incompetent and rude staff with the exception of two (new) receptionists. Every time I have had to deal with them directly it has been a disaster. 

The day I moved in I was given the wrong set of keys TWICE. Instead of making a third trip back to their office the super made me a copy of his key to my apartment. When i went back to get the correct mail key a few days later I was told, "Don't lose it because it's our only copy". 

There was also a huge debacle, all of which was their fault, none of which they took responsibility for, when trying to add my fiance to the lease. Based on the other reviews here, I am dreading the moving out process. 

I can't remember a company I've dealt with that had worse customer service. Unfortunately, they don't seem to care or want to improve, and probably don't have to since housing options aren't exactly plentiful here. 

If you can avoid renting from them, I absolutely would.

If you aren't looking for ZEN Thai, you wont see it from the road.  Located off Watson in a quiet shopping plaza (across from the closed Crestwood Plaza, next door to Aldi's and American Red Cross).  Fantastic option for Thai when you cant make it to the Tower Grove area.

I've had several "to-go" orders placed over the phone ready at the exact time they promised, with all the promised items, too.  Very friendly and easy to understand over the phone.  The dining room recently expanded into the space next door giving the restaurant a slightly disconnected feeling.  But the extra space was needed since this place seems to get pretty packed for weekend dinners.

My favorite dish to order is the Tom Kha soup (comes in 2 different sizes).  You can also order most dishes to your specified spice level- go for medium, you can handle it.  I also enjoy their Pad Thai.  Always has enough sauce and enough peanuts.  Served with a lime for an extra punch of freshness.

Don't forget to order the pot stickers- they come sitting in a wonderful Panang curry sauce that will make you want to lick the plate clean.  Completely acceptable, by the way.

I'm basing this review off one single drink and one single experience but what I love is the adorable atmosphere, the unique drink options, and super nice server. This gin drink wasn't my favorite ever but the presentation was gorgeous with the freshest, healthiest mint - none of that sad, browning wilted stuff. 

The hidden door to the bathrooms disguised as a bookshelf set off the vibe too.

My Vietnamese friend brought me to the original one in Kensington and I've been too scared to go back myself since she ordered for me and I didn't even know the name / address. So glad I found this place again! Very authentic, they don't even give you the menu because it's either chicken pho or beef pho, it's a good price so it's just whether you want meat added in already or on the side. Personally, the meat on the side is better because it's more tender and sweeter and also they give a lot more meat than you would have if you order pho ga instead of half chicken + plain noodle soup. Best pho in Philly, even though it's in the same plaza as 3-4 other pho places. Went at 5:30-6 on a Friday night and it was decently busy before the dinner rush. After we ordered, food came out in less than 5 mins - piping hot, very fresh. Amazing service, iced tea was great, and there's a Mr Wish next door for dessert

First time I went to this Brazilian Steakhouse. I compared it to Fogo de Chao as to me that is a 5 star. The ambiance is not that great. The service was ok. The waiter was also one of the meat slicers. They seem to be understaffed. This place was a buffet style restaurant with only the meat slicers at the table. Of you want a plate you have to go to the buffet table to get it, if you want bread, if you want mashed potatoes, if you want plantains you have to go to the buffet table. All theses things Fogo would bring you to your table. I got up so many times that I was tired. We ran out of water and no one came to the table to ask us if we needed more. I was also upset because they apparently had many variety of meats, however, the meat slicer came to our table 4 times with sausages! I got very upset because they didn't come to the table with the meats. I had to complain about it then they would come periodically and bring meats. It's not like Fogo where one after another they would bring you all the variety of meats to try. This place needs some work. Their prices were reasonable around $50 pp.  it it was not for me. I would not go back. There are other places that have their act together like Chima and Fogo that I would go to instead. My time and money is valuable and I would think twice where to spend it. You want to have a good experience and I did not. With that said we tried the Tres Leche dessert and that was tasty as well as the fresh pineapple juice. One thing I liked but I had to ask for it was their bbq pineapple that was spiced with cinnamon and sugar. Very good.

Honestly I give them 3 stars only because I was starving but honestly the food was not good. If you want 5 pieces of fish then go ahead. It was WAY over priced and they filled the whole bowl with ginger and edamame versus tuna. It was sad. Save your money and go somewhere else. I hate leaving these kinds of reviews but it just wasn't good

Just purely awesome service.  Had a pair of sunglasses with horribly scratched lenses.  I purchased a new set went in and Larry Shaw set them free of charge.  I will be needing eyeglasses very soon.  Larry will be my first visit.  Thank you!
Cindy is a great waitress!!!! I will be back because of her:) Food was good but lobster dip was cold. I didn't say anything because I didn't want to send my food back.
Excellent food. Great atmosphere. Good value. Enjoy. Off the beaten path. Best food we had in Clearwater.

Excellent place! The food is very good: I had the Chicken Cheesesteak and loved the peppers on the sandwich along with the whole presentation. They serve a salad, which I appreciate, and it is a good salad.

Regarding their beers: love them. I tried their sampler and found their Philadelphia Pale Ale to be my favorite: enough hops to be like a Midwest IPA but not a bitter-bomb. I have had their beers several times while on business trips and they are among my favorites.

My Fiancé and I were celebrating our two year anniversary and we decided to make a little road trip to Oasis Diner since we saw it came very recommended. After a three hour drive we get there very hungry, and I go inside to pick up our food. I wait for 30 mins just to get my food. And while eating my pork tenderloin it tastes like nothing but grease and my fiancé's food was so bland she couldn't finish it. Vey much not worth the money. Very disappointing and will most likely never visit again

Best ramen in Wesley Chapel so far. We had the spicy stamina and curry seafood ramen - both were delicious. Noodles were nice and chewy (tasted fresh). Passion fruit tea was really fragrant and delicious as well. Bonsai cocktail was okay, could use some acidity in my opinion.  Service was great as well.

We got the breakfast sandwiches and potato side on our first trip. Best breakfast sandwiches I've ever had. The bread, the egg, the toppings..... all in perfect unison. In follow up trips we've tried some pastries, which have all been killer. 
 
10/10 recommend this spot

I needed to find a car wash/vacuum/full service for my 2022 Mitsubishi Outlander around the Langhorne, PA area and I came across JR Express Car Wash on Google and checked out their website. I was getting off from my job in Philly this morning and I wanted to stop by to get my car washed before my oil change appointment at noon.
I called the number and spoke to JR, I asked if I needed an appointment for a full service. He said yes and gave me all the information included in the Full Service Package. He was very helpful, friendly and great phone customer service. He was able to squeeze my car in this morning and I am very grateful. 
When I showed up, I met JR. He helped me at the kiosk, I paid for the package, went through the all the works (wash, dry, Shine, vacuum, etc). I also met George and Anthony. Very kind, great customer service and professional. George worked on my Outlander. He did an amazing job, interior and exterior. Phenomenal work!! He made sure he took his time and was attentive to every detail. 
I am mother of a 1 year old, also traveling for work couple times of month so I can never find the time to get my car washed/vacuumed and I'm very happy that I found JR Express Car Wash.  I will definitely be coming back again!!! THANK YOU!

This place used to be one of our GO TO pizza shops.  But news owners recently and both the food quality and the service has deteriorated.  Pizzas are underdone or overdone, and recently we waited (no joke) 1.5 hours for delivery of a simple cheese and pepperoni pie.  Did they apologize or offer money off for the inconvenience? NOPE.  They are off our short list.  Back to Vic & Deans we go.

Can't say I'd recommend this place. The family was fighting during my appointment which was super awkward, and they use actual push pins, not clamps, to hold the dresses up. Not effective or safe. I actually stepped on a rouge pin on the floor on my way out in a dress and my mom had to pull it out of my foot. Not quite the dream experience. I hear they do amazing alteration work, though!

This gelato was absolutely delicious. They have great flavors as well. I had the cookie butter which was heaven and my son who can't have dairy had their coconut and sweet potato flavor which tasted like a coconut pumpkin pie. Fabulous.

I was in the mood for a Banh Mi and since this was closer to where I was than QT's, I decided to give this place a try. I am glad I did because they make a GOOD banh mi!! It is cheaper than QT's and easier to find parking in this area. Unfortunately it isn't centrally located in Chinatown, but it was well worth the trip! It also tasted great even later for leftovers! The man who helped me was also super nice! They have a few tables to sit and eat, and it's not fancy, but you can sit there and enjoy your sandwich if you like.

I am originally from Alabama and I worked for a BBQ place for a few years when I was younger. I know good good BBQ.

The beast BBQ looks like nothing when you pull up to the restaurant. I was extremely skeptical at first. I ordered a duroc pork steak with beans and slaw. The baked beans were the BEST beans I have ever put into my mouth. The pork steak was so tender they didn't even give me a knife. Best pork I have ever had.

Terrible service and a quick reminder why I use amazon.   I came into this location expecting to spend at least $2000 on drones and gimbal equipment, instead I stood around waiting to be helped.  When a guy from geek squad came around, i asked him to please get help for me. He called for help using his earpiece; but because two clusters of employees were entertaining one another, nobody came.    So much for trying to deal with actual people and  give business and helping their jobs remain relevant in the process.  I guess I'll be making yet another amazon order.

Son una porkeria y mas el encargado de la cocina k cuida como perro fiel  como si fuera el dueño o peor aun. Se ekivocaron en mi orden y me la hicieron la orden otra vez y todavia se enoja el desdichado como si pagara de su bolsa pobre infeliz

I had to try this place after seeing the delicious plates being served outside. I took a first available seating and ended up inside for brunch.  Entering the restaurant the overwhelming smell of burnt toast filled the room. It was hard to not notice and periodically the toasting machines would emit another strong waft of burnt bread. 
So. Eat outside so you can enjoy the flavor of your food. I had prompt and efficient service. The food was good. I had the gyro omelet. I would have enjoyed it more minus the burnt smell in the room.  My companions had the eggs Benedict which were cooked to perfection. 
If I head back I'll wait to get seated outside !

I was obsessed with this restaurant the food was so so so good the server was great very personable the scenery of the restaurant was very cute ancient rustic barnyard type of thing I loved it there! Honestly one of the best places I've been for brunch

Wow ! Emmy pizza is a huge hit. We just got back from eating some of the best pizza I have ever had. 
Parking was very easy with a lot about 100 yards from the restaurant. The seating was immediate and the waitress was at our table before we were even settled in. The dining room is brand new with a modern flair. The staff was unbelievably professional and very friendly. 
We ordered two pies, the Vodka and the Colony. 
Both pies were unbelievably tasty. We also ordered a burger, Le Big Matt. It was perfectly executed and I could not put it down. I ate the whole thing and it was very large. My Wife ordered two drinks, the Nephew Will and the With Love from Emily. She enjoyed both of them very much. The prices are very reasonable for the quality and quantity of food you receive. 
I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone of my friends or family. I will definitely be back to try all of the pies that they offer. My Wife is very excited about this place, as am I.

They are SO SLOW!!! Who manages this place?? I've been stuck in their drive thru for almost 20 minutes just waiting on a frozen coffee. There's a six car pile up behind me, and the chick at the window looks like she's been smoking meth all day.

This is the perfect little brunch cafe! The food is...OH MY GOD ! I am as full as a tick! The portion sizes are ...let's just say I could've gotten full off of a side of loaded grits alone ! Soooooo yummy! Great service. Fast service. Our drinks never went unattended. We'll be back !

I have gone to the Flower Show every year for close to thirty years. Some years were better than others but in general the show has become on major disappointment. When I went to the Acme to purchase tickets my reaction when I heard the price was, " Are you kidding? " 
I understand that prices rise but even with a senior discount $43 is way out of line.
The displays were mediocre at best and many flowers needed to be replaced. We went on a Wednesday morning and I warned my friend about the crowds. Not this year. Apparently the price and the virus scare have taken their toll.
There are more vendors than displays. I payed $5 for a pretzel and $4 for a bottle of water. Given the quality and the cost I doubt I will be attending this event in the future.

Came here with high hopes and hoping to really enjoy this place on a Wednesday night. Sadly we were very underwhelmed by the food. We got: tempura, spicy Dragon, tiger, and spider rolls. They were just very mediocre.
The service was great - quick seating and attentive service from our waiter. 
No bonus points for vibes or views, either.

I've never spoken to you about my complaint . It was all via email. I'm not reading your anti science propaganda again that people have told you . I have confronted anti-maskers before in my recent life and it has not gone well.  I was not going to cheat them of their tip, because I hold
their company responsible , including to protect their health as essential workers . Also if I don't care about life and death every day, you should still follow the mandates and not risk people's lives .

The meads were delicious and I hope I can return after covid because the inside looks very Instagram worthy and trendy. We ordered by the door via the staff waiting with iPad and sat outside on the patio. I love that they were dog friendly!! They had an art installation going on when we visited yesterday (Thursday) and we were able to create some art and enjoy our mead. My favorite was the 35-1 but we tried almost all of them and none disappointed! Highly recommend trying this spot. There is also some other spots to get a drink nearby so it's a great launch point. Definitely will be returning!

So I went here with an old family friend. The special is good. Honor it with an Olympic attempt.  My friend only eats fish once every 6 weeks and he did 8 rolls. 

I am a normal I only had 4 and hated myself for 2 hours. Here are the veteran/varsity moves. Go for lunch. It saves 8$ off. Then get only salmon and tuna everything else is off brand. 

I don't say that with knowledge I say that with statistics. Almost everything outside of those two will be scrofula or other weird diarrhea fish. 

I cannot say that about this place as I have not tested it, but I can say that it is easy to recognize tuna and salmon so stay with that. Also. 

After you are full of sushi get the other stuff not the other way around. Like I said I had 4 he had 8. So portion control. Honestly one of the few places I got for Midwest sushi

Disgusting old buildings with tons of problems that they will only take care of (very slowly) if you hound them over and over again.  Very unhelpful employees.  They work with contractors who are told to tell you "noooo there's no mold in here" when your entire ceiling is filled with black mold.  Looking to move out of my meridian group apartment as soon as possible.
The food here is unbelievable. Great staff &, seriously, excellent food. Outside dining is really good.

Why 4 stars? Because this is another solid eatery in the area.

   ---   ---   ---

I'd driven by El Jefe's a few times but just never had the timing line up for me to stop in. Recently, I knew I needed to find a spot for lunch, so I specifically planned to finally check El Jefe's out. 

My wife and I ordered Cuban sandwiches, yucca fries, regular fries, cafe con leche's and we also tried out the torrejas. I'd never even heard of torrejas before, but it's Cuban bread, strawberries, cream cheese, powered sugar and syrup - all things that are great individually and possibly even better when combined. I will definitely order this if I ever see it on a menu again.

In addition to the food itself, the menu is huge, the people are friendly and they even have a drive-thru window, which I took advantage of. My only regret about this experience is that it took me so long to stop in when it's so close to my house!

Floors smell like your walking through a bottle of cleaning liquid. Room cards didn't work.  Wifi didn't work.  TV didn't work.  Eventually, room cards and wifi fixed.  Still waiting on TV.  

UPDATE: TV now works. Yippee.

Plugs are on the base of their lamps, with the two prongs at the bottom.  What's that mean?  Good luck plugging in your iPhone or iPad charger, because it won't fit!

No USB ports in the room.

Attracts customers that you can just tell are going to keep you up all night yelling and screaming because they're drunk and//or stoned.  I'll bet anything there's been Elvis sightings at this place!

On the plus side the pulled pork sandwich at Ben's BBQ, as well as the sides were excellent. So was the beer on tap selection.

This is NOT a business hotel.  Even with the Hotels.com discount, stay somewhere else.

I was searching for a place to have french toast for my birthday. I saw that Half and Half was recommend by Yelp and close to where I was. The inside was super cute and I'm glad I made the decision to go. The French toast was so yummy and the blackberry compote was excellent and fresh. The latte was cinnamon dense, just like I love it, and the potatoes were crispy on the outside and soft in the inside. Overall very enjoyable breakfast and would go back to try the other French toast options. They do have other foods I'm just a French toast fanatic haha
Stopped in this week and We got the best service ever.  Our server was a Trainee and when we return we will specifically ask for Nina.  Food was amazing and it was a great atmosphere overall!
Very friendly and fun place to eat. We enjoyed trying different items on the daily menu. We are planning on going back soon.

I went to the Manchester location on Saturday February 21 2021. A guy was jammed and couldn't get out of the was , the car wash had control of my car because it was in neutral so I had no control. My car slid slowly into his vehicle,  the attendant admitted that he didn't do the shut off in time,  my car was severely damaged.  This guy Jason has not called me yet. Dave the manager agreed with me that they should pay for my damages.  They refused to give me the name of their insurance company.  I am taking them to small claims court for damages and negligence. It was a horrible experience and on the same day I had gotten a membership with them. I canceled my membership,  I will never wash there again. I was very fair about trying to get justice.  Very upset.

Blackened Salmon, Seafood Mashed Potatoes, Crawfish Hushpuppies and Green Beans 

Chicken's Kitchen

Rating 

#nola #neworleans #lunch

An inviting and warm atmosphere from the moment you pop in the door off of St. Charles. From the incredible fresh pastries to aromatic coffee in the air, you can't go wrong! The perfect spot to stop on a dog walk and sit outside sipping a brew or jumping in before work. Local, loving and quality.

I can't remember the last time we went to Squealers but it was so good to be able to go in, sit down and enjoy good service and a good meal. They still have social distancing in place with only every other table being available.

I ordered the "Award Winning" Pulled Pork Pit Sandwich with one side.  I picked the potato salad even though my sandwich came with steak fries.  I just love Midwest potato salad.  You can't get it fixed this way out west where they offer three different kinds in most Delis but none come close to our "Mom's" style.  And I was able to get my favorite soft drink, root beer.

My wife ordered the Sweet Tea and the Pulled Chicken Dinner with two sides. She really enjoyed the potato salad, which reminded her of the potato salad her mom made with a little bit of a sweet pickle taste versus dill. And she had the baked beans which went great with her chicken and potato salad. She also said she liked getting a little treat with her meal, a fried biscuit with apple butter. A perfect way to end a good meal according to her.

When you get BBQ at Squealers you can actually get a sweet sauce without any spiciness to it. So many places have like a million sauces but they all seem to have some level of spicy which doesn't work for me. Their sauce is sweet and perfect for chicken, pork, ribs etc. 

The server was friendly and attentive. They had a good crowd which is so good to see after such a tough year. Plenty of free parking.  The prices are reasonable, the food is really good and we've always had great service. Looking forward to making this a regular dinner spot again.
GO!!! So much fun. Drinks and ambiance are amazing. Such a fun concept. It's spendy-so know it and don't complain. Read the confessions on the back wall. Some of you are a mess!

The place is very nice. It is a whole
Experience, not just a service. The amenities such as the relaxation room and fountain room are spectacular. It would have been 5 stars from me
Except for two things. 1) I felt very rushed by the staff upon arrival. I would have liked more time to relax and enjoy the amenities before my service. No big deal though, I will just arrive earlier next time. 2). What I really didn't like was that during my massage, the RMT had her phone on her. It kept vibrating throughout the massage, and at one point went off ringing at full volume while I was laying face up with her massaging my shoulders. It was very loud and alarming, and difficult to relax again after such an abrupt awakening. Other than that I would still go again, just maybe with a different therapist.

Delicious food, very friendly staff. AMAZING VEGGIES!!! Night time we had live music. We looked lost as we walked in and the owner was super friendly and showed us how this "line" works to get food. He was super friendly and did I say the food was AMAZING!!!
Very solid. Not the best I've ever had but not the worst. They had my order ready fast, the food was hot and fresh. I will come here again.

We went here for dinner on Saturday night since were in the area. They were doing an amazing job with social distancing and cleaning the tables/chairs. We ordered a couple of appetizers! Chicken sliders, nachos and a pizza. The sliders were amazing!! Especially the pretzel buns! The nachos were also very good they added quinoa to them and the pizza was a little too oily and I'm a firm believer that pizza shouldn't have Parmesan cheese on them. Overall a pretty decent restaurant !
I waited to be served ad I was asked What did I want?! Pass this truck stop up and go across the street. Unless they have something there that no other place has DO NOT STOP HERE!...The End

Kim is the beat. Food Delicious. 
My granddaughter loved her dinner as I did too. 
I had a great Eggplant Parm Sandwich.

I use the Gandy Bridge on a daily basis, mainly because of its location which is closer to my house the Howard Franklin Bridge. Also, I hate that bridge. It's always backed up and you've got slow drivers in the "fast lane". I also feel like I'm on an old roller coaster with the unevenness of the road. It's in need of some resurfacing. Anywayss, the Gandy  Bridge has a beautiful view desire what direction you're traveling in, so don't get too distracted. There's hardly any accidents or delays/traffic jams, so you should make it to wherever you're trying to go on time. Just know that the healthy people living in the area like to walk, run, and ride their bicycles over the bridge, so please be careful. After you've enjoyed your drive over the bridge onto the St. Pete side, you can pull off the road to enjoy the sun going down or walk beside the water. I have when is people dragracing here at night so also be careful of that too. Enjoy xo
Food is really good come out hot and fresh, nice location friendly staff. The French toast is very good

Very Very, Very bad experience. They never return phone calls, never submitted the diagnosis to 2-10 in a timely manner or complete the work. Said the A/C needed a compressor.  Said they put in a new one only to find out they didn't after having another company come out to fix it. Dealing with them we were without air for over  30+days. Our home Warranty  2-10 sent them out. WARRING!!
STAY AWAY FROM THIS COMPANY!

I was very happy by the end of my experience at ModerNash. There were some hiccups with my order (none of which were their fault) and I received great customer service by Nick and Ryan. I will definitely be purchasing from them again in the future and I love my IKEA table. Thank you!

I had experience with Ferrandino and Son last year as a contractor. Their communication and organization is the worst I have seen in the industry. They also find different excuses on why the invoices you submitted are not acceptable and will not pay. I have spent countless hours talking to countless people and cannot get a straight answer. You immediately get directed to another department. If you are a contractor, RUN AWAY! The job is not worth your time and headache.

Just as I remembered in Tallahassee... same juicy tenders with that legendary sauce! This was my usual 'go to' after a night out in college food, but I enjoy it just as much in the daylight! The chicken tenders aren't overly breaded and have some juice in side them still... can you really ask for much else in a chicken tender?? Also, the sauce backs up its hype and its worth to get an extra one if you're a saucy kind of person, like myself!

I wish it wasn't so far in South Tampa, but if you're in the area & feening for some fried chicken tenders, this won't disappoint.

Worst place to order unless you have over an hour to kill! I get we're in a Pandemic but damn this is Insane!! I run a pizza shop that literally is busier then most chain restaurants! Abd our orders are ready in 20-30min max! And our food is top notch!  What a joke! Never again sorry TB! Oh also they want people to wear masks picking up their food yet they're not!

Uh what to say...so the best thing I had was my drink which was the only thing I took a picture of. I order risotto, it was supposed to be a seafood risotto but I was not that hungry so I just for plan risotto. I also ordered the calamari appetizer. The app I had to send back because it was over cooked dry and chewy. They made me a fresh order which was better but no flavor. The risotto was not creamy and heavy on the salt. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The place was well lit clean and organized. I would go back definitely for the drink and I'll try other items.

Yum, girlfriend got this for dinner, I had a bite and it was amazing. 

Quick service, friendly people, what more can you ask for?

This place has got to be some kind of retard joke!! I've been here more than I want with several family members over the last 2 months and each time, they are stupid as hell!! You have to prompt them and give them ideas on what might be wrong because they can't figure it out themselves. My mom has a fever throughout the night and they didn't figure that out until the morning. Don't get me started on my grandma who had a stroke. It took days for them to get the scan done to see if that's what she truly had. Her blood pressure was beyond low and yet they continue to give her blood pressure medication. I would seriously try anywhere else your insurance takes and if it was something real damn serious, I'd go to any other hospital and file medical bankruptcy before I ever let Renown touch me. You'll be lucky if you leave this hospital alive or don't die later due to their inadequate, cognitive, handicapped dysfunction. Med school must have gotten to be special education courses because that's about all these people are worth. They say IEP kids should be treated the same....lucky for them, Renown is an equal opportunists, they'll hire the worst of the worst SPED nurses and doctors!! You use to die at Saint Mary's but now ah damn, you're definitely gonna die at Renown.
Subpar donut. Ambience isn't cute. They need to add like greenery, art or better furniture. Feels like a warehouse in there. Staff was kinda rude too.

Went on a Saturday night. I was seated outside on the side patio. I highly recommend sitting outside; inside was very noisy. 

Service was great. Our waiter was attentive and knowledgeable. Even though the restaurant was packed, we did not have a very long wait for our food. Everything was delicious, and we're planning a return trip!

We've had take out twice from Green Chili since they've opened. What I like about it is the location and the friendliness of the staff. Quakertown is a tough spot for non-garden variety American fare. While this isn't the best of the Punjabi restaurants in Southeastern Pennsylvania, it's great for the area. The tandoori mixed grill was good, but missing lamb. The flavor of the keema naan was good. The green chili naan much better. Thus far, all of the breads that we've eaten here were drier than we like. However, we can see them making it fresh for each order. It usually takes a little time for a new restaurant to hit its stride. We'll keep coming back. Otherwise, my wife will send me 30-40 minutes away to get her favorites. I really do hope this restaurant is here to stay.

As I belly up to the bar, my favorite bartender asks me " the usual."?  enough said .. This is my FAVORITE sushi spot! In the numerous times I have had dinner , lunch and countless HH's here .. I have not been disappointed. Always fresh, fast & it has a cool ambiance . Dragon roll is a favorite ! Tuna tataki is a south beach friendly choice & a skinny bitch ( vodka & water ) also stays within the SB restrictions!  Check this spot out!  Loving it!!!!!!

im not sure if ive just been there at the right times. im reading some of the reviews and ive never had horrible experience. Everytime i have been there the dog owners have been responsible. My dog loves to run and its perfect for her she loves it.

This place is right down the street from us. Today me and my girlfriend Keria decided to splurge and get two starters in addition to our typical order of two ramen bowls. First was the takoyaki! These were made beautifully and were visually appealing. Of course they were delicious as well. We also got fried shumai, which I HIGHLY recommend. Finally for the main course, we each got Miso Ramen with Black Garlic broth. It's too delicious, so much so that I haven't even ventured to try the other appetizing ramen choices on the menu. $13.95 for each ramen bowl, $4.50 for the shumai, and $4.95 for the takoyaki. Very much worth it in my opinion. I will always recommend this place to anyone looking for a good ramen joint. Also - the inside of the restaurant looks AWESOME. We haven't dined in yet but it is on our list!

Nice hiking trail within the city. Easy to access on the south side of town, with a smallish parking lot and a couple trails to pick from.
Zero shade so this is hike is better done during the cooler or spring/fall months. Once away from the trail head we didn't see to much signage but it's not a big deal because every thing is so open, you can easily gauge what direction to go. 
Fun to watch the airplanes head toward the airport and would be a nice spot to catch the sunset.

I moved into ElevenNorth a little over 3 years ago while I familiarized myself with Nashville and decided where I wanted to buy a house. Well, I loved it so much that I am still here. The location is perfect. I walk to work downtown and all of the great M street restaurants in the gulch. The amenities are great (especially the great pool, hot tub, and grilling area) and the free parking on the street - as well as in a gated parking lot for residents - is convenient for guests. The apartments are also more spacious than others in the gulch, the staff is always super friendly, and maintenance has always responded to issues the very next day. Residents are also really nice and good neighbors. It's super safe and secure.

Very disappointed in our visit this evening. We arrived around 7 and didn't get our food until almost 8:30. We waited almost 25 minutes to get any water and our waitress messed up our order and had not written anything down. When I went to the restroom I could see the wait staff hanging out in a side room instead of tending to customers. My food was lukewarm and it was obvious that it had been sitting out while someone I was with couldn't eat because his was so hot. We saw multiple tables come in after and leave before us. We had a great experience in the past but will not be returning.

As a recent transplant to Nashville, I love Hattie B's! Such amazing hot chicken and sides. I always bring out of town guests so that they can enjoy amazing Southern cuisine. I recommend medium spice for the hot chicken sandwich if you like some spice and kick but don't want your mouth to be on fire! All of the sides are delicious as well.

We came here for drinks during dinner. Most restaurants require that you order food with drinks and so we ordered two small dishes. This Raw Tuna and the sweet potato. 

Raw Tuna: it's a new menu item and it's actually quite good. It's a bit tart and has drops of wasabi and picked red onion. I thought it was quite interesting that they served it was a side of crispy rice? Idk how to describe it other than the rice waaaaay at the bottom of the pot that was left out and became very crunchy. Lol lol I liked it. It's different lol.

Sweet Potato: I didn't actually try it myself but I'm sure it was very good. Hand Model- "They were hearty. There was some sort of cream at the bottom that once I found it, really added to the dish. I would eat again."

The service was great as usual. They did a great job of following guidelines and kept tables separated by distance of shields. It's very difficult to get a table inside so I strongly recommend booking in advance.

I have taken my car to this shop several times to get my oil changed as well as general maintenance. The staff is always so positive and professional. It can be difficult and scary to take your car to the shop as a young woman. This is a place you can trust to give you great service and take care of your car!

For as long as I could remember my 1st experience with Chinese food was Lemay Garden.... How could I have gone so many years living in the area and never tried such incredibly tasty Chinese entrees... I used to work in Dierberg's Plaza Where Lemay Garden has been for over 23 years.  That has got to scream excellent Chinese food... It doesn't matter what you order it comes out fresh and Allen is always ready to say hello how are you doing... They don't make managers like Alan anymore.. But take my advice, view their menu and then call in your order and take a quick ride to pick it up... It is so worth it..........

First time coming to this particular Panera. Had a solid experience. Placed a take out order and they had everything ready right on time and correctly. The store manager was super friendly and helpful in finding my order when I didn't see it on the shelf right away. The food itself is your decent Panera food. The baked potato soup was nice a creamy with nice chunks of potato and bacon bits. Perfect soup for dipping a nice crusty bread into to soak up the flavors. The Steak and Cheese sandwich was delicious as well. The pieces of steak were nice and tender, and I love the use of cheese and mustard. It gives the sandwich a nice tangy contrast. Overall, good location that is convenient and makes your food orders correctly :)

Ive changed my route to work to intentionally pass this place. The location is clean and the service is fast.

Cold Pressed Juice: the Pineapple Charcoal Lemon-aid is currently in my fridge but I can't expound at the moment as I haven't tasted it.

Made to Order Smoothies: I've tried a few. I enjoy Blue Sky most, Better Together second, Honey Love third, Goji Glow fourth, Buzzed fifth, and Green Balance last. I will not re-order Green Balance - it had a strange after taste and I wasn't eager to finish it.

Shots: I had the wheatgrass shot accompanied with the coconut water chaser. I honestly recommend it just for the fun of it. I had a persistent headache following it which seemed unusual  after taking a nonalcoholic shot however I read online that this is a side effect of rapid detoxification. At least that means it may actually work!
Cute little dive bar. Blonde girl serving was very friendly and quick to help each person. Nice patio to feel like you're outside but not directly in the sun.

I started going to Bisou when my regular nail salon got too crowded for my comfort during COVID. It's been a great experience every time. I have used most of the nail techs and they have all been good. Place is lovely and relaxing. The family that owns it are so nice. They always remember me when I come in and even gave personalize drink bottles at Christmas to their regulars. I always get the sangria and find great colors to choose from. I had my eyebrows waxed and they did a great job. I am so tempted by the other services they offer especially the lashes and lip tinting as the pictures look beautiful. I really don't want you to check it out because I don't want it to be crowded, but definitely need to give them a good review. They have been great!

I visited this place with some friends because we like to try new sushi restaurants and I will not return there. The Miso Soup was room temperature and lacking something. The sushi rolls were okay, but nothing spectacular. The worst part of the night was the waitress who told us what we should tip her. If the service is not up to par why do you feel you deserve a bigger tip?! It was very unprofessional and trust me she did not deserve a large tip.

Philippa Main is the consummate professional realtor and was fantastic to work with selling our condo.  I live in WA state, so she was my boots on the ground managing the whole process from 3k miles away!  She is very thorough and understands the mechanics of the sale process very well.  Our sale was an estate sale, so there were some potential complications with the appropriate paperwork, signatories, etc.  Philippa got in touch directly with our probate attorney and ensured that everything was in place in order to sell the property.  She kept us informed completely throughout the process and handled everything expeditiously.  

On top of that, she got us a great price!  I felt very at-ease during the sale.

Philippa is a real go-getter and a great realtor.  I recommend her without reservation.

DO NOT BUY FROM THIS COMPANY.  This is a long story, but will show you why you should never purchase from ABC.  

At the end of October I bought a high end Miele range and dishwasher from ABC.  This ran over $7000 without including installation - which they subcontracted I spite of stating that they install and service all the brands that they sell.

The delivery and installation went fine, but on our first attempt to use the oven we noticed that the cookies my wife was making were not cooking properly.  They were very underdone.  Using a oven thermometer we discovered that the temperature in the over was 100 degrees lower than it was set to.  This started a almost 2 1/2 month process of trying to get a working oven.

Upon discovering the problem we called ABC.  We were to,d that since the oven was new and under warranty that we had to call Miele for service, not ABC and that Miele would authorize them to come out.

While strange, we did this.  According to Miele, ABC was an authorized reseller, but not service of their products.  They then sent out a factory rep.  Turns out ABC had not updated their registration with Miele.  This repair visit was the first of 5 to try to correct the problem.  While I have a separate beef with Miele about their product, the issue here is ABC and how they handled the situation.

Through the entire process they took the position that they were not responsible and could only do what Miele told them to do.  When we pointed out that we bought the products from ABC, not Miele directly they responded that this was just the way it is.  Multiple times through the process we asked to speak to the owner/manager.  While we were assured that he had received our messages we were told he "does not talk" to customers.

After the 5th unsuccessful repair attempt we requested a refund/replacement of 5e defective range.  While ABC acknowledged that the unit did not work, their position was that only Miele could do authorize a return/credit.  I had to call Miele numerous times to get the return authorization, but was able to finally do so.  Even then, ABC would not issue a credit until they had picked up the unit.  So to get the replacement I had to shell out another large sum of money to make hat happen.

Needless to say, I did not purchase it from them.  

So the caution here is that you might as well by an appliance over the web directly from the manufacturer rather than deal with ABC - as they offer zero customer service and in spite of all the assurances the sale people give you - they have no sense of customer service.

BTW - still have not heard from the owner manager  - he obviously just does not care.

Where do I begin?! This is my favorite spot in Reno hands down! Great food, great drinks and the people who work there are so sweet. I love that they change the menu occasionally so you can always try something new. But-- the black spaghetti is always a favorite! This is place is great for a little date night or just to grab food with friends. This place always makes me want to come back! The prices are great too. You really get what you pay for. Highly recommend! Already planning my next dinner there

I have purchased numerous appliances from Christie's in the last 15 years. I have always been satisfied with the product and price. Sales customer service not so much. However, my last purchase was a microwave for my 'downsized' move to a TH. The installer did not get the microwave 'straight' and was sent back twice. Each time he gave me a plethora of excuses why my old cabinets were to blame and how he could not tighten or loosen the microwave to make it even.  In a small kitchen the cockeyed look is very observable and I am disappointed Christie's did not think it important enough to find a way to level it to the eye. Christie's will not be my first choice in the future. Kudos to the last salesman Chris (no relation) who was informative.

Food great
Service Bad 
It's that simple. I think it originates from the "Hurry up and order" culture but it also takes them a long time to get your stuff, meanwhile employees are standing around. 
Good meat though but service is what is most important and it's lacking.
Excellent food and service!!  This is one of the best Mexican restaurants in Nashville!!

5 star food
4 star service

Came to Savannah for husband's 50th. When I read this is on Yelp's top 100 of places to eat in the USA, we had to come here. You can only make reservations up to 10 days ahead.

Disappointed we never saw anyone play piano or band. It's why we came. Apparently that happens later. Only time we could get for dinner was when they opened at 5pm. So I was bit upset when we entered a completely empty restaurant and they seated us at a booth all the way in back right in front of the kitchen.  I understand there were other people coming in who made reservations sooner than I, but in an empty restaurant surely you could do better with seating. I politely asked, and we were only moved to beginning of booth section, but at least the kitchen wasn't right next to us.

The food and the service were both excellent. 
I am glad we came. But next time we come back, we won't dine here unless we get a later reservation when there is live music.

The food is mediocre at best. The portions are small and overpriced. 
The owner is verbally abusive to his hard working staff that goes above and beyond. 
I originally was routing for this new establishment,  overlooking not so great food and prices. However,  after seeing first hand the way the owner treats his employees via messages etc I decided I would no longer support them. Some things can be overlooked. Lack of morals and integrity can not. 
The owner directly behaves in unsafe behavior that could affect his customers and the community. When confronted he becomes confrontational. 
Save your money and support someone else.

This place is amazing and a must go. Sunday morning outdoor markets are filled with a variety of foods and drinks. Everything is cash only so make sure you bring enough. The pho is absolutely delicious and usually has a 20 to 30 minute line depending on how early you get there. Would highly recommend getting there around 9 o'clock because it starts to get more and more busy. I have only gone once so I haven't tried everything but the Thai coffee and donuts were a great post meal treat. decently priced and you can take anything to go as well.

I've had the worst experience with Progressive. I paid for a full 6 months of coverage and now that I moved to another Auto Insurance carrier. They are charging me for a $40 Installment Fee and $50 cancellation Fee. Talk about a racket and taking advantage of people. I am putting this on here so that people can be aware that when you sign up with them, you cannot ever cancel. They punish you for leaving. They will charge fees that are unreasonable. My other policy began days before the one with Progressive expired and I paid for the full last month with Progressive and still getting charged fees. If anything, they owe me money. I'd hate to find out how they would handle claims if I ever was in an accident. Big disappointment !!! DO NOT SIGN UP WITH THEM.

I have wanted to try Grimaldi's pizza since I read a blog about it years ago, and this was my first opportunity.

A group of us went for dinner and were seated immediately.  The service was prompt, the order accurate and the waitress friendly.

I ordered a pizza with a bunch of toppings, extra cheese and extra sauce.  The crust was thin and crispy, just like it's supposed to be.  The toppings, IMHO, were sparse and the extra cheese and extra sauce were minimal at best.

No idea of the cost, as someone else picked up the tab, but honestly, I was so underwhelmed at the overall pizza yumminess that I doubt I'd go back.

I should have read the reviews first! I went spent over 1,300 dollars on February 25th and still waiting on delivery that "I  would receive a call in regards of setting up delivery within 5-7 business days." They wait until after you pay them to let you know there is no refund. I still haven't received a call I end up calling the store for them to say I had to wait 2 weeks! I waited 3 weeks just to still get the runaround. There is no upper management to talk to but a bunch of salespeople who get's there commission and can care less. Needless to say never!!!

My wife and I went for brunch and, after putting on the required masks (because the restaurant apparently believes the County Exec can impose it..which he can't) stepped in to a very nice place.  It was confusing for though, with a drink bar on the left and the food counter on the right.  There was a lady helping to navigate but still confusing.  We ordered our food then ordered our drinks (process still confusing).  I ordered the bacon, egg, and cheese burrito and whitefish toast, my wife ordered a quiche and toast with jam.  We also ordered $10 martinis.  The food was outstanding and we would order it again.  My whitefish spread was the best I have had.  The martinis were a huge disappointment, very small and so-so (we ordered two "The Annex).  Don't waste your money.    The cooler had a wide variety of meats, specialty spices, and prepared food..so a good go-to if you're in a pinch.  I gave it a 3 star because of the drinks and confusing set-up..but recommend it for food on the go.  Wear your mask, though...my guess is that it's a year 'round requirement from now on.

Best breakfast and Lunch in town!! Great cup of coffee also! Can't beat the great prices, food quality and portion sizes! Cozy atmosphere and all around good stuff. Try the Mexican Skillet or the Patty Melt!

Usually, I've had good experiences with Preflight since I've used them about 4 times but this last time I was over by 10 minutes and my total came out to be the same as it would be for 3 days! For 2 days and 10 minutes I was charged $34 (even after presenting the coupon)! 

Honestly, thats WAY too much in my opinion for parking! I will be trying other lots in the future.

Good Latin food is not as ubiquitous in Florida's West coast as it is in South Florida and Miami. That being said, Bodega is on par with any spot I've been to Miami. This is hands down the best Cuban sandwich I have found in the region since Jose's Real Cuban Food shut down in Bradenton. I've been a few times annually and it's stayed consistently good. Staff are super friendly and quick. The food is excellent, and the Cuban style coffee is superb. 

I recommend calling in your order ahead of time, as the wait was about 20 minutes at lunchtime.

Order: Brisket Chipotle Cheddar Mac n Cheese w/ Green Onions | Apple Pie

Omgomgomg I saw the Brisket Mac n Cheese on the menu, I saw the crazy long line & decided to brave it at the Fall Harvest Festival in Tower Grove Park and I am soooo glad I did!!! It was a revelation!!! Highly recommend if you stumble across this food truck to treat ya'self & probably toss in some Apple Pie too, cuz you're worth it!

The gal who was taking orders was so sweet & on top of things! They're running a really wonderful business & I hope St. Louis gets to keep enjoying their gorgeous food forever & ever!!!

Little walk-up eatery located inside the Urban Eats establishment. Serving crepes, both sweet & savory options as well as homemade cakes, coffee and bottled soft drinks.

I went in to grab a coffee from what I remembered to be the original UE and was pleasantly surprised by the new & improved setup. The staff at Crepes and Treats were extremely welcoming & informative. So although I didn't have food on my agenda, I throughly enjoyed a caprese crepe with egg whites along with a delicious hot coffee.  My meal was served to perfection.

Highly recommend! 

~Christy

Last year I had their pumpkin latte, and it was delicious... so delicious. They didn't have the option on their menu last week, but I heard this week it should be back. I got the Tumeric latte and it satisfied my fall cravings. My boyfriend got a standard latte and he enjoyed.

I will definitely be back to try some more coffee options. I love the addition of Big Mouth Biscuits that you can order through the QR code on the counter. 

The inside is nice, bright, and clean. There are a few outdoor tables.

Barkefeller is where I always took my Siberian husky before he passed in 2017. They always to good care of him with the exception of the one time I requested the premium package on his grooming and they only bathed him but charged me the premium price. They also trimmed his whiskers really low which was something I did not ask them to do and I'd never heard of that so I was extremely shocked. But they re-washed him and did an excellent job the second time around. The facility is very clean and I live the idea of each animal having their own suite. Nothings perfect but I highly recommend giving them a try. I think you'll be glad you did.

Food and Drink Ordered:
* worth trying

- [Creme Brulee*]: Tastes like your standard creme brulee. The ratio of caramelized sugar to custard is good. I don't like when there's barely any caramelized sugar. 

- [Charcoal Cake Roll]: On paper it seemed really interesting to try but it tastes like a drier version of a vanilla/original cake roll. I'm not sure if they have this dessert anymore. 

- [Tofu Cheesecake]: This isn't like your typical cheesecake; it's very bouncy and jiggly. Unfortunately, the cheesecake wasn't to my taste. I can't quite pinpoint why. Perhaps it was the distinct yogurt-y flavor. But my friend, who I gave the rest to, liked the taste of it. 
 
Would I go back? : I'd be interested in going back. I've already been to More Sugar twice and both times I've tried to order their sesame creme brulee. However, both times it was sold out. D: So if they still have the dessert, I'm hoping third time's the charm. Also, I'm interested in trying the brunch because other reviewers speak very highly of it.

Kitschy little place right on the corner. Street parking out front. Fresh herbs growing out front. Service was efficient and food was wonderful. I had the hot pot beef. The crispy rice at the bottom was delightful. My husband ordered beef noodle soup. We saw an employee walking out front to clip some fresh herbs. Those were the same herbs that came to the table with his soup. Wonderfully fresh! This is not the place to go if you're looking for friendly service but the lack of personable interaction did not affect the overall efficiency.

I really looked forward to trying out the new location. I hoped the move away from the convention/tourist crowd would allow the restaurant to go back to its excellent roots.  I longed for the amazing table side service and excellent prepared dishes.  Unfortunately, I left disappointed and questioning how could they get this wrong. The new split dining areas are modern and sleek although  on two levels.  It took some time for out waiter to take our drink orders and quite a delay to get our drinks.  I understand staffing issues etc but you are paying dearly for it.  If you expect over the top service that you were used to, you will leave disappointed.  Salad and apps were fine.  I ordered the Lobster Albonella.  It was not prepared table side and my friend ordered the same. Our dishes came out different with the pasta mixed on the plate with one and not the other.  The lobster was quite overcooked and rubbery as it was heated in kitchen and not table side.  Every ones else said meal was ok but nothing special.  
Here is what makes me not to ever go back.  I ordered a regular stoli martini, they up charged me a dollar for the stoli.  I have never seen that. Its $17 a bottle and the drink was $14.50 without the up charge and they charged two dollars extra for blue cheese olives.  .  An extra dollar was added to a whiskey order for a big ice cube.  Again never seen that.  Grey goose, 3 dollar up charge for a drink.  Grey Goose!  Supposed fine dining restaurants don't up charge for bs like this.  I have lived in St. Louis for years and have been to all three locations.  This place is living on its old name and there is much finer dining and food in St. Louis then this has been.  You can't rely on name alone.  Save your money and go elsewhere.
We love the Strawberry Festival for the strawberry shortcake and the many activities.  Our favorite music was Stephanie Ann who plays the violin in a variety of ways from classical to fiddling.
Lunch was ok, but service not great and they are very inflexible.   Also charge 18% gratuity for any party size. I will not be going back.

Such rude people who work here. I called because I purchased ten phlox violet pinwheels. All ten are dead. Only the plants I purchased from this nursery died. My Moana plants and High Country Gardens plants are all alive and thriving.  Those nurseries / businesses guarantee their plants.  Lady on phone at Rail City who was rude and condescending said if we didn't plant them then we don't guarantee them.  A few hundred dollars wasted but at least I know where NOT to go buy plants now.  Followed the planting guide to a T as well - I can understand one dying but all ten - definitely not my fault. I've attached a few pics that show beginning and now. Also a few from Moana and High Country Gardens - all doing amazing.  Makes you wonder why Rail City doesn't guarantee plants.
This is my favorite Vietnamese restaurant in Reno. They have great customer service and the food is really good. The tofu spring rolls are a must-have and I always order the chicken pho.

I went into this hoping I would absolutely love this place because we really need more restaurants with outdoor seating.  I came away with mixed feelings.  I'm not trying to hurt this business.  Rather, I hope they consider my honest feedback and make some changes.  

The positives:  Burger tasted great and outdoor seating was nice.  It looked like there was even an outdoor TV (which wasn't on).  The ambiance was good.

What didn't I like?  Burger was very small for the price.  A fountain drink cost a ridiculous $3 plus tax and tip.  Drink was served in a small glass which empties too fast, and glass melts ice fast when it is outdoors in warm air.  LARGER plastic or foam cups would be much better.  In any event, I refuse to order a soft drink in a casual restaurant for $3 plus tax and tip, so next time I will drink water.  If they were content to make a reasonable profit on a soft drink I would order it.  They make no profit from water, so it's their loss.  Instead of serving soft drinks to almost everyone at a reasonable price, they will charge an outrageous price and sell fewer.  That's a lose - lose for everyone because I enjoy a soft drink with my meal.  I am more likely to eat somewhere if I can order a drink. 
And by the way, they conveniently elect not to list soft drinks on the menu, so you don't know the price of nearly $4 until you get the bill -- a sneaky thing to do.  

There was an understandable upcharge for sweet potato fries, but they were not very good.  I get these at a lot of restaurants, and I'd rank these near the bottom for taste and quality.  Waffle fries are a novelty, but I prioritize taste over novelty.  Just give me a good quality, tasty regular cut fry and I'll be happy.

Now for the part that really irritated me.  If I don't go back it will be for this reason:  I ordered a $15 hamburger that was supposed to have BBQ sauce on it.  It didn't have much sauce at all, so I asked for a little more.  The waiter brought out a tiny plastic cup with about a tablespoon of BBQ sauce in it and CHARGED ME AN EXTRA $.50 for a "side" of sauce.  Okay, sorry -- THIS IS A DEAL-BREAKER FOR ME.  If a $15 hamburger doesn't have enough BBQ sauce on it I don't expect to be charged extra to make it right.  Plus, it was a SMALL hamburger.
