The more I think about it, the more irritated I get about the sauce.  So now that I've reminded myself of this, I probably won't go back.  It's not only the cost.  It's the principle.  And if management thinks people are too stupid to notice things like this on a bill, they are mistaken.  It's an outrageous policy, considering their already high prices.  Two small hamburgers, fries, and one soft drink was more than $35.  I don't think so... Sadly disappointed in all of that.  In addition, they don't offer a burger under $9, and every burger on the menu has cheese on it.  Newsflash: Not everyone wants cheese on their burger, and almost no one wants to pay for cheese they're not going to eat.  Again -- just a little sneaky.

I do have to say though... burger tasted good.  But there are good burgers in other more reasonably priced restaurants who don't price gouge and nickel and dime customers to death.  I'm afraid if they keep these policies up, they will be closed reasonably soon.

I have been with meenan for years because I felt stuck not being able to research other companies raising my kids with my husband traveling often. This company makes so many promises they never keep. They kept my children and I without heat and hot water multiple times. They have sent multiple service representatives out to fix my issues only to make things worse (or at least that is what the next service representative said) or not fix things at all. I was given specific representatives to be available to me because my services had been so bad and they wanted to keep me as a customer but when I called for their services I found out "they are no longer with the company"?  They say the call systems are being updated so I ask "so there is no communication happening for 15 days" It's all a farce. Meenan has done so much damage to me as far as time, promises not kept and just taking as much money as they can with no remorse of their treatment to me as a customer. It's just not worth calling them. I JUST NEED SERVICE!!!

This can be a five star place if they can keep the tables wiped off and trash off the floor.  This is my third time coming during lunch and there are dirty tables and trash on the floor.  I hope the kitchen isn't a reflection of the front end.  I'm not for sure how many people work at this location, but cleanliness is important.  Each time I've gone the service and food was great.  My daughter is in love with the chicken tenders.  She compares the tenders from each restaurant m.  She says they're the best, hands down! 

I always get the three wings.
Macaroni and pepper the green beans need salt.  The coleslaw and fries are the best sides.  The greens are good, but not a good choice if you don't eat pork.  The chicken and the spiked honey sauce is the best things!

The servers are always friendly. 

If you love chicken I would stop here for lunch, but don't have four and five star expectations.

I have been here twice in one week. The 1st time was for an u/s of my leg to r/o clot. The girl who called me up to the window was condescending and not helpful at all. She informed me my appt was made for the next day when my Dr had just called to work me in and my paperwork stated same day.
The next week I went in for a ankle /foot x ray. The tech was extremely short and rude. I told her I could not bend my leg or foot the distance she wanted... Well she made sure it got bent
 After the test she excused me with a flick of her hand. It was more important to get back to gossiping with the young man that was hanging around.
Unbelievable.... Back to radiology Ltd  for this lady.

Dr. Baldo completely disregarded my concern for my dad's hard of breathing. She wasn't on top of his medications that he needed to take even if it was over the counter. I waited over an hour with my dad to see the doctor and she told me that there was a little bit of scarring in his lungs but nothing of great concern. I had to take him to the EMERGENCY ROOM yesterday because there was too much fluid in his lungs that needed to be flushed. Also found out that his heart was working at only 25% even though she knew he had an enlarged heart. She hasn't referred him to the cardiologist since 2016 when it was working at 40%. They sent me back-and-forth to LabCorp and Saint Mary's downtown for his bloodwork and EKG but nothing came back. I asked her for the information for the cardiologist so she only gave me a trunk line for the St. Mary's cardiology department. She had no idea which specialist he had to go to. When I addressed the hard of breathing at the appointment last week, she said " well he's not breathing hard now." So she completely dismissed it. She made me feel crazy for a showing concern of his breathing, and it turns out he was practically drowning in his own fluids. All of this could've been prevented had she showed any sort of concern. I will take my incident to a medical board for her negligence.

I loved this park for my dog. He is high energy and friendly and was able to run, swim and play with other dogs. 

A few notes, the park is not fenced in therefore, don't take your dog if a runner.

Most people were nice but there is always one in the bunch. Unfortunately, that is life.

This place never misses. Favorite sushi in Tampa, hands down. 
Food is always great. Menu has some unique options compared to your classic sushi restaurant. I usually sit at the sushi bar at lunch (dinner can be busy, as expected). But regardless of time of day, service is always absolutely stellar. Attentive and kind staff. Great vibes inside. Just always a pleasure to visit!

Burger was cooked to perfection, Jerk grilled chicken sandwich was delicious seasoned just right very authentic tasting variety of seasoned fries which were very good. Fast friendly service and very reasonably priced. Casual atmosphere Trivia on Thursday evenings I would highly recommend I'm a fan and will be back !

Came here to watch Rebirth perform.  Tickets were $27.  

Bartenders were quick and friendly enough.  You can hang out both downstairs and upstairs but there is no seating in either.  Super mixed crowd and it was a very fun vibe the whole time we were there.  It's a little far from the more touristy spots but worth a visit, especially if a band you like is performing.

Definitely one of the better dentists I've been to. The place is upscale, and like others have mentioned, they offer a lot of spa like services, but none of these are a big plus for me.  In fact, as a guy, some of the stuff just makes me feel awkward.

The real plus for me was Dr. Choi and an efficient staff.  I was in and out quickly on my first visit, and he was good about answering any questions I had.

I called Blush Nail Salon about 45 minutes before I wanted to come in and made an appointment for a gel manicure and pedicure. When I arrived they seated me immediately. The same girl who did my pedicure also did my manicure. I appreciate it when they try and speed up the process by having one person start your manicure as the other person is doing the pedicure, but they didn't have enough people on staff to do this. 

The woman who did my nails was efficient and friendly. However, her efficiency at doing my nails didn't match my perfectionist standards. As she was trimming my cuticles she nicked my pinky finger along the nail line. It drew a tiny bit of blood, which I'm sure she noticed yet didn't acknowledge. After she was done with my nails I examined them noticing that the lines were messy and uneven around each nail. It wasn't bad enough to make her re-do it, but when you look up close it is definitely noticeable. My pedicure was good and I enjoyed it, so no complaints there.

My experience here was okay but not good enough to make me want to return. I didn't get the impression that the lady who did my nails was actually concerned about how they looked. She was more concerned about just getting the job done but not doing it well.

Not a terrible breakfast place. But not a show stopper either. The wait for our table wasn't long but the food took almost 40 minutes. The pancakes were more chewy then expected. And the biscuit was very small for the price. 
Service wasn't terrible but you could also tell we weren't a priority.

Guys were professional and efficient while maintaining safe distancing and wearing their masks. Job was completed as stated with suggestions for a better finish which turned out beautifully.

This pic doesn't due the job justice but I wanted to share.

I honestly have never dealt with a company that treated potential clients the way Union Roofing has. I don't usually take the time to write extensive reviews, but Im still shocked by how unprofessional whoever I dealt with at Union Roofing was. Here is my experience: 
1. Called Union Roofing to explain situation and left a message (leaking ceiling inside home thought to be due to roofing issue). 
2. Got a return call at 5:30am the following day by a loud individual speaking way too fast and did not listen to the answers to my questions. I didn t think much of this and laughed it off because I was happy that someone called back promptly to address the issue. I was able to arrange a time schedule with the he gentleman of around 9-11am arrival to look at roof. I then verified this time with my tenant. 
3. Got a call from Union roofing office staff responding to my message and saying they could be there from 12-3pm. I told them someone had called me already in the AM indicating 9-11am and that I verified this time with my tenant already but can change If needed. The girl told me to hold, and then the man from the AM call came onto the line screaming "WHATS THE PROBLEM I ALREADY SPOKE TO YOU THIS AM ILL BE TBERE BETWEEN 9-11" and hung up... ??? As if I was the one who called?? I was annoyed, but thought I'd let that be and move about my day. 
4. I didn't get a quote until 2 weeks later...waited patiently. The quote included pictures and listed needs of the exterior stucco and roofing. cost was $3,000+. I'm not a roof expert so I called the office as requested to review the quote. I was put in touch with the same man and when I started to ask questions he said "do me a favor and look at the pics, its self explanatory, then you can call me back" and hung up the phone before I could speak. I called him again indicating that I did review the quote and I had questions about the need for the stucco work since Im not familiar with these procedures - was this something that was needed or was it affecting the leaking as well? **I'm in the medical field so stucco specifics aren't my strong point...** Before I could finish even that question, the man interrupted me saying "listen, if you're going to be asking questions and you don't want the whole thing done then you can just take your business elsewhere! (***which, I never said I didn't want the work done, I wanted all of it done because I understand there's many factors that influence leaking...I just wanted more of an explanation to make sure my 3k+ was going to necessary work and that I wasn't being ripped off***) And he hung up again. I have never been so disgusted with how someone spoke to me and was never disrespected like that in my life. 
5. I called the office to see if someone else could review the quote with me, and the girls said they would have to put me back in touch with the same man because he did the assessment. I asked to speak to the manager and she said he wasn't available and would call me back. Called again a day later and got the same story. 
6. Never got a call back and had 2-3 weeks of time lost and leak persisting 
7. Hired someone else, had the problem resolved within 2 days at a FRACTION of the cost. 

You guys should really consider who you hire...Don't waste your time with rude people trying to rip you off.
Our second lunch visit was every bit as surprising and satisfying as our first. The owners have done a great job with the decor, the extensive menu, the food preparation, and the service. Bravo!
The doctor and his whole staff are sensitive people. Don't go in there with a joking attitude or you will get turned away.

I love CMA Festival. I flew in from CA for the event, as I am a ginormous fan of Country, and I was surprised how big the event was. It was like a city-wide party. There were performances at the riverwalk, at the LP field, all kinds of bars/clubs jam packed with people from all over the place. Nashville is such a great, energy filled city with awesome people who know how to party. I would come back every year if I could. It's also SO COOL how many artists hang out around town, and make appearances at local spots. If you are even a slight Country fan who likes to travel- check this place out, you'll have a blast! 
My tip- I would suggest staying in the downtown Nashville area, even if it is a little more expensive. Also, if you really want to enjoy the music, get tickets closer to the stage- LP field is HUGE and the higher cheap seats are no bueno. :)
Love the Spanish style food and atmosphere! This is the go to date night spot for my husband and I. Especially love the patatas bravas!

I got some glasses here a couple of years back and not only was I sold some glasses that did not fit my face but I was treated as if it was my own fault. I have such poor vision that I can't see anything without my glasses on so trying on frames I had to trust the staff. When I came in for multiple attempts to get them to fit me correctly the staff became very rude. I will not go back and I do not recommend business.

I will say I was surprised.  Walking in was not what I was expecting and the prices were a bit more then I was prepared.  Needless to say, this quant spot hit the spot!  Breakfast was great, food diversity of items with good portions.  Wait staff is attentive.  Even though the food was excellent and well seasoned, all of the items we had were roughly $6 overpriced.  If you do nothing else, get a meatball!!  Well worth it.

What in the absolute hell. It's January 6th and I've been going back and forth with them since before thanksgiving to try to transfer from another college and register for classes. The downtown campus isn't allowing advisors on-site...so the only way to speak with them is via email. The advisor I spoke to takes days to respond and here I am again waiting on hold to speak with someone because she hasn't gotten back to me again. Anytime I've called I've gotten a different answer or someone who can't answer a simple question. I've never had the runaround like I have received at pima. Staying one semester and going back to my old school. I understand Covid has made things difficult but pima is going out of their way to make things challenging. If students and others are allowed on campus why aren't advisors when it's the main time of year they are needed?

DO NOT send your children to the childcare in this gym! My daughter has gotten lice 3 times from there!!!! I thought it may have been her little cousins giving it to her but NO everytime I sent her in the childcare she came home with it. Also the girls watching the children can give two shits about the kids. They are too busy talking and texting on their phone and don't keep a good eye on the kids

As I write this, Pastaria is the highest rated place in Clayton....so I decided to check it out. I knew before coming in there that it would be kind of hipster, or more like the so-called "new restaurant scene". But either way, I really enjoyed it here. 

The name is misleading, because it sounds like they only serve pasta. Not so! They have pizza, gelato, and just about anything Italian. There was so much I wanted to try on the menu, but I went ahead and settled on pizza. I had the Pastaria Hawaiian, which, as expected, was sweet and spicy. Since I was the only one in the restaurant, it was on the table not even ten minutes after I ordered! (Apparently the oven is 1000 degrees or something...) Pizza was delish - it was so runny that I had to eat it with a knife and fork! But I can't complain. It really filled me up! 

The server, Taz, was very nice and chatty. As little as I'm in the Clayton area, I'd love to come back and try some more items. A lot of Yelpers have suggested several, so it probably won't be long!

WARNING! Do not eat here unless you feel like running to the toilet right after you leave. Don't get me wrong lI didn't expect a 5 Star dining experience. I have dined at Jerry Bob's in Tucson a number of times so I knew what to expect. I order an omelet (which was cooked well) and my wife order the breakfast burrito (again cooked and tasted good) I went with cottage cheese and fruit for my sides. Big mistake, the fist bite of cottage cheese caused me to spit it out in my napkin. It was rancid. However we continued to eat being as everything else tasted ok. The waitress was nice enough to comp my meal for the bad cheese. Fast forward to less then 20 mins later, the rumbling in my stomach started and I instantly had to go to the bathroom. Fast forward to 1 hour and three bathroom trips later, my wife's stomach started cramping. Both of us have the exact same symptoms but yet she didn't eat my cottage cheese. Whatever cause my stomach problems hit her just a little later than me but I have always had a sensitive stomach. Now usually I can overlook one time as an isolated incident but both of us within an hour of consuming their food tell me that it's a kitchen problem. Something is contaminated in that kitchen so beware.

BW3s is a commodity, and generally speaking if you are going to one, you probably know what you are getting into. Beer, chicken wings, sports on TV... nothing crazy, but it's a casual meal that just about anyone who consumes meat and beer can appreciate.

At this location, I stopped in late and ordered a plate of the "new" boneless wings and a $3 beer special. Beer was great, the wings were terrible. Somehow being one of only people in the restaurant our order got cooked and then overlooked so we waited a very long time and got cold food.

I mentioned the food was cold but assumed that would be the end of it. But the manager swooped in, she comped our food (save $6 for beer), made us another order of wings that were scalding hot, and packed up our leftovers for lunch the next day. Long story just to say mistakes happen, but it's nice to see gold star customer service even in a casual restaurant in a strip mall in Castleton.

Anything less than 5 stars would be CRIMINAL for La Super Rica

It's...flawless. Always has been, hasn't changed. You can't go wrong here.

(#16) is very popular here, it's marinated pork topped with cheese and green Chile's. Super authentic and interesting flavor profile.

The Chile Releno de Verduras is also hearty and amazing!

Also, the fondue with chorizo is basically crack. Wonderful.

The oysters!!! The pasta!! It's absolutely delicious!
If you haven't gone you need to! Great for family!

I usually don't usually have a problem ordering and deliver at my work place. But today is definitely a lesson learnt, I started my online order before 9 am, and requested to be delievered at 10:45 am, my break is around 11 to 11:30. Around 11:10 I started to worry, I called the store the manager answered, he apologized  for the delay because they are short of drivers. He made sure that I'm in the priority list, he mentioned that it will only take 8 minutes, the driver will be on my location. This actually 4 to 6 minutes distance by car. I headed back to my work and didn't had lunch hoping I would get it later. I got back to my office and ask my admin secretary she hasn't received any sandwich from jj's. This is around 1:30, I was hangry and frustrated! I called them again to tell them that my sandwich didn't arrive but they charged me for everything, with a whooping $3.50 service delievery. The  driver talked to me on the phone, and told me she dropped off the order and somewhat accused me. I asked her where did drop it? She couldn't even tell me the details, and I told her no one in the office received it. As I was furious at the moment, they offered to remake the sandwich, this time delievered it like faster, in less than 10 minutes. Imagine I waited for my sandwich for 3 hours, I'm not even far from JJ's location. My other co-workers has having the same problems, they would deliver the food for more than one hour.. I understand the short staff. I wish they could  have called my number just to know it will be delayed. I finally Ate my lunch after my work hours.  I emailed the corporate because this  is not excusable. Even if they refunded me and comp my food. Imagine they would charge you for delievery fee 3.50 still not getting on a desired time..

This review is for their deli. Seriously how hard is your job. When a customer asks for cracked pepper turkey breast you give that to them not the sun dried tomato which they are allergic to but then label it as cracked pepper. Why to do your job. And these people seriously want to make more an hour. Learn to do your job first because seriously your job is not that hard especially when there is no line of customers and you only have to help one customer.

If you think this credit union is any more ethical than a big bank, think again.  They assumed my mortgage 1 year ago, correctly filed the lien on my property using the address, and mail me a mortgage statement every month, again to my address. however. they also slammed me into a share account which I didn't want or don't use.  Somehow, they mailed the statements to my unwanted share account to the wrong address, then began charging me bad address return statement fees, negative  balance fees, and monthly paper statement fees for the share account.  The account I never wanted, the account they required me to have, and the account I never touched.  Twice now, I called customer service and they waived 10.00 of 140.00 in fees as a courtesy.  Fees they caused by putting the wrong address on the share account I didn't want, and never used...  Fees that are a direct result of their slamming practices and clerical error...  I do not recommend nor would I ever do business with GTE in the future and I am currently looking into refinance options as I have complete distrust in them now to even handle my mortgage and escrow.  Its extremely disappointing to experience such incompetence and unethical business practices from a credit union...  This is the kind of BS you expect from Wells Fargo, not GTE CU...

Decided to give Philly's a try after hearing nothing but good things about them. I ordered the surf n turf philly that comes with shrimp and fries and a drink. Every one was so sweet as soon as I walked in I was greeted and asked what I would like to order. My order was made hot and fresh on the spot and took under 10 mins. The philly cheese sandwich had a great flavor, and the fries were fresh. I would dine here again!
Most unique coffee spot in Indy, in the lobby of a theatre! Great coffee too.

New look Crossroads now open.  New owners.  Been there and not impressed.  All 3 of our meals were wrong.  The corned beef hash was disgraceful.  Meats grossly over cooked. Prices increased dramatically.  You've lost us as customers.  The new owners of Crossroads better get it together. Bring back the real corned beef hash. 
Cook orders properly.
Wonderful wonderful neighborhood dog friendly bar. Cute, friendly staff. Cute friendly owners. Go if you are in the neighborhood or make a special trip if you love dogs.

What a rip off.  Went here for dinner so I ended up spending almost $40 after tip and tax. This place had a little more seafood than other sushi buffets I've been to (we have like 3 in New Castle County in Delaware) but at almost triple the price, it was not even double the quality or variety of seafood! 

There were many sushi rolls but they were so ladled with mayonnaise sauce and imitation crabmeat you could not tell the quality of real fish that was in there. The crab legs were cold--they could not heat them up that day for some reason or maybe they never do--and they were dripping slightly ammonia-ish water and the shell was very soft--not very fresh. A couple of the sushi just tasted plain sour or extra fishy. The ONLY seafood item that was worth the money here was the oysters. I really liked them because they dressed them with thin scallion and lemon slices and some hibachi sauce. Annoying problem was they were stingy with refilling the stock. Every time the tray of oysters came out, people would pick it clean in like 5 minutes and the restaurant wouldn't fill it back up for another 20 minutes!

The only unique part about this buffet was their petits fours and their green tea soft serve. They were actually good quality and really good! 

Wouldn't go back just for the oysters and dessert though.

We have been bringing our son to East Lake Pediatrics consistently since the day after he was born. He's two years old now and not always in control of his emotions. Sometimes it escalates into breath holding. After a recent breath holding experience, we decided to inform his doctors so they could establish a record of it.

Unfortunately, due to miscommunication between the triage nurses and doctors, it led to a very bad experience that put our family through a lot of heartache. Instead of clearly communicating to us that we needed to bring our son in for evaluation, they called Child Protection Services!

Unfortunately, once you've been reported, you have to go through with a whole investigation. We had to have our son evaluated by the CPS medical staff, who agreed with our assessment of breath holding, but wanted to differ treatment to his regular doctor, and so we scheduled a follow up examination with East Lake Pediatrics.

We met with Dr. Trudi Rash who was completely rude and unprofessional. She came into the room and introduced herself like she was a stranger who never met us before! She confirmed that she did receive the message about breath holding and that she was the one that directed the call to CPS be made.  We questioned why she wouldn't have called us first, or why the practice would not have reached out to us, prior to taking such a drastic step.  We have been going to this practice for two years and have a clear record of bringing our son into the office when needed and following the doctor's recommendations. Instead, Dr. Trudi continued insisting that they did contact us and that the medical note confirmed their version of events (she was unable to find the note, and it was omitted from the medical records when we later requested them).

After examination, Trudi agreed that it was indeed a breath holding spell and our son did not need to seek further medical treatment. We have since received clearance from a neurologist, who also confirmed that our son has breath holding episodes. According to the neurologist, there is nothing to be done at this time and he said that we demonstrated the knowledge and ability to handle these episodes.

We are appalled at how this was handled. We are NOT neglectful parents! We would certainly have brought him in. The practice took no ownership of the miscommunication, took no responsibility for casting aspersions on our parenting, and felt no remorse for failure to acknowledge the impact on our lives. Dr. Trudi was clueless about a patient she'd been seeing for two years, was defensive about how they handled it, rude and unprofessional, and uncaring about what we'd been through.

In addition to the frustration, humiliation, and time off work for CPS meetings/appointments and medical evaluations, my wife, who is a teacher, was unable to return to work until CPS satisfactorily closed the investigation because her school understandably has a strict policy regarding employees undergoing CPS investigation.  

Our family has left this practice for another one where we receive more individualized care from a doctor who is more communicative and personable with their patients.

We were looking for a place to get a quick bite to eat before touring the basilica and we found reviews for this place. It was good. I was torn between giving it 3 stars or 4, but our whole experience was good and the food was too, so I went for 4.  

My sister and I split a pastrami reuben and got 2 sides. One of the sides was mustard potato salad and the other was macaroni and cheese salad. Both were pretty good-not knock my socks off, but good. The macaroni and cheese salad was Mac salad with chunks of cheese in it. I would recommend this place for a delicious quick bite to eat.

Overated. Food is terrible and pricey.
If you want to spend like this go to a real restaurant with creative dishes and chefs not a mediocre chain with poor execution booth in flavor and presentation. 
Why are desserts 10 dollars? Are they even made there? My "french" burger wasnt that french... aka not good at all. I've had better burgers at chillis. The salmon plate dissapponting.
Fish and chips horrible. Why do people like this? Grow some senses tastesless sheep.

Really enjoyed the carne asada Benedict: poached eggs were runny which is good, carne was marinated so tastey, peppers were smokey, and the Hollandaise mixed with a pepper sauce FANTASTIC.

Might try French toast next.

One of my favorite places to go.  The goat cheese cheesecake is to die for, wonderful wines, the prime rib sandwich, Brie appetizer are always winners.  Love the old converted house, and the outside dining as well.

Sadly, my very favorite stylist has moved out of town, but I still wanted to give Cheri bibi a good review. I am a sucker for a good haircut as it is, but I count down the days to my next appointment at this salon because the whole experience is just lovely. The location is beautiful, they use Bumble & Bumble supplies, and they always offer beverages and cookies while waiting. Everyone who works there is pleasant, and they clearly work to build real relationships with their clients. I have been going here for almost 2 years, and I have never seen anyone leave with less than a glowing smile on their face!

The food is really good, but the price is higher.  It's a budgeted meal for a family of 5.  
My DH loves the smoked Salmon.  I like the pork and brisket.  The sides are good.
The only thing that stops us from going back more often is the price.
Great experience. Kids keep wanting to go back for quesadillas. Good tacos for adults

Went here recently, and was reminded why I almost never go to this location... Terrible wifi! Impossible to get any work done. I do like that it's much larger and has more of an "open" feel than the magazine location.
For whatever reason (but probably the awful wifi) I just never feel productive here. But they are open late, so that's good...

Ran in last night right before they closed after a really long day with no food. Everything I brought home for our late dinner was delicious but what really put a spring in my step was their customer service and kindness. Glad you're in my neighborhood, StlB!

It was tasty. I probably won't be back. Food was good but I have a problem with my food not being hot when I receive it. Lukewarm is not hot. I've chalked it up to it being I was part of a large party, but being in the industry that means nothing. Idk. Service was cool too. I was really disappointed in the food. Bisque, stew, steak, scallops all lukewarm. Scallops weren't seasoned well. Steak was tossed on the grill for a few seconds then pulled off...ZERO char. I can't.
Food was good cute place . You have to pay for water they don't have many bathrooms . Sourdough burger was good and on Tuesday you can get $5.99 burgers . French toast good

Quite possibly the worst Taco Bell I have visited, to date. 

Though this particular instance was visually appealing, inside and out, and actually very clean (the men's bathroom at least), the service and food quality certainly left something to be desired. We were greeted, of course it was to tell us someone would be with us and that someone did get to us pretty quick. But the enthusiasm, or lack thereof, was palpable.  I ordered a chicken burrito where my wife ordered a beef burrito supreme without beans. My order was serviceable if not exactly tasty. But my wife's order was a whole other matter. There was practically no beef to the burrito. I should have taken a picture, but forgot. 

I'm not in the habit of doling out poor ratings to places - I do try to find something endearing and focus on that. But the lack of food (not to mention quality) and the even more lack of care by the staff was simply terrible. 

Hopefully they rectify this soon, otherwise it's a waste of a good location and clean store.

It's been a while since we've been here and now I remember why. So, although the beers may be good, they can't seem to keep a bottle of Cabernet on hand.   Additionally, if you want a 20oz glass of beer, you have to order the correct one for the 20 oz glass. Maybe we're not quite snobby enough about our beer to care which glass it comes in. As for the food, it was "OK."  I got the chicken and shrimp skewers and the chicken was tolerable only because I dipped it in the spicy hot mustard which came with my daughter's pretzelwich. She loved the pretzelwich, fortunately. The service was sub-par. Our waiter barely ever checked on us. The food took forever to come out. My dad's meal had to be re-cooked because his was overcooked before it ever came out. They did, thankfully, comp his meal on their own and apologized for his meal being delayed. Overall, we won't be back.

I have been so pleased with the service at this spa. The employees are very friendly and easy to talk to. My massage therapist, Rachel, is honestly one of the best I have ever been to (and I've been to a lot of them). Their array of shower products and lotions are very soothing and the make your own bath salts are fun. The atmosphere is peaceful and relaxing and the business itself is very easy to find with adequate parking. Price wise they are on par with other massage therapists. I can in good conscience recommend this spa to everyone.

The seafood in New Orleans is on another level. My friend recommended this place which was walking distance from our hotel. We stood in line for about 15 minutes. Once we were seated, our waiter took our order quickly. I had the BBQ shrimp entree which was mouthwatering, full of jumbo shrimp and garlic. Delicious! My friend had the blackened chicken which she said was bland. I was happy though. Stick to the seafood!

Stopped by for a quick drink before going down the street for dinner.  Loved the refurbished interior.  The establishment was busy, but was able to get a spot at the bar.  The acoustics was a little loud.

I dream about their brunch that is how good it is.  It is a great off the grid place to go with wonderful food and an eclectic vibe.  Coffee is great too and then you can take some bread or pastries home for the rest of the week.  At times during season you can buy herbs and other things as well.
Very clean place! Love their food and raspados. Super friendly and fast service. Highly recommended

Bit into the Croque Madame and said, "WOW!", closed my eyes and was briefly transported to Paris.I don't know if their A/C was broken or what, but 84° is a little hot to be having doors wide open with ceiling fans going, even if you're sitting right under one. Still, this one gets bookmarked and added to a special collection.

Stop here for hot buns all the time... the rest of the buns are a lackadaisical approach, and the bubble tea is super-sweet (but the bubbles are some of the best).

Friendly staff, three tables, and a fridge of drinks, this place is best for the hot pork buns or pork and vegetable. You can also see on the LCD TV who's making what in the back, a nice touch.
Simply the best deep dish I have ever had!  The sauce is amazing and the pizza as a whole is a must have anytime we are in town.  The four cheese with pepperoni is our favorite!

I love crepes.  I would rather have a crepe over a pancake or French toast breakfast any day of the week.  Crepes etc has a great variety of both sweet and savory, but in the end I didn't leave too impressed.  

I had the Skinny Californian, but don't be deceived by the name, it was anything but skinny.  Packed full of chicken, more chicken, bacon, avocado, cheese and dice tomatoes.  I opted for it without the mornay sauce.  It was good but there wasn't any seasoning to help make the flavor pop.

There are not enough tables either, during the lunch rush I had to wait for a bit to sit.  The table turn over was pretty quick today, but it took a while for staff to clear off the dirty dishes.

I can't believe I haven't reviewed this place yet! 

Through hurricanes and all the place has not changed one bit and that is what makes it so perfect. The cannolis, gelato, coffee, macaroons, Italian cookies are some of my favorite treats, which makes it very hard to pick just one or 2 items per visit.  

I have memories of coming here as a kid after school and ordering a spumoni and cafe au lait (I had very advanced taste buds at the age of 6), some of my best childhood memories. I guess that's why if anyone doesn't like this place I instantly cast them as unlovable and eliminate them from my life.

I'll start with the positives: good location and friendly staff. The positives really end there though. The entire place is in need of a huge refurbishment. Carpets are stained, disgusting and need to be stretched. Wallpaper is peeling off of the wall. My keys kept being deactivated requiring me to go back to the lobby for new ones several times. When my friend and I sat at the lobby bar, the counter was dirty. The bartender served us but never bothered wiping down the bar. Beds were comfortable enough but clearly old and made loud creaking noises every time I would turn over. It's was an incredibly disappointing stay, which is a shame because I've had such great experiences with Sheratons before.

We love this place it's a local gem. Cheap breakfast with a simple menu. The waitresses are all super friendly and give great service.  My only complaint is they should provide flavored coffee creamer again.

Oh Fat Tuesday, what can I say?  

If I am in the Quarter and want a nice cool drink to sip while I walk or, for some unavoidable reason, I am on Bourbon Street and in the mood for a daiquiri rather than one of the many other sugary drinks of death, I head straight for Fat Tuesday.  The main reason I pass up all the other shops on Bourbon is because I know what flavors I like at Fat Tuesday and I know it will be the same as it always is at every other location.  

This location is also towards the Esplanade end of Bourbon so there isn't quite as much demand--or so I like to think.  In the afternoon, like most of the other bars on Bourbon, it is very quiet.  At these times, don't be afraid to ask for samples of flavors--they are happy to oblige and even locals haven't tasted all of the flavors.  Of course, they will give samples when they are busy too, they just might not be as happy about it.  I've never really stuck around to scope out the bar, so I can't speak to that, but I'm going to guess it's like most Bourbon Street bars: loud and full of highly intoxicated college kids and tourists so don't be surprised.

As far as alcohol content, I find it best to hedge your bets by getting a medium with an extra shot.  Then again, I live in New Orleans--drink at your own risk.  Also, you don't need a 190 Octane with an extra shot unless you are trying to burn a whole in your stomach or trying to be that frat guy in the gutter later. Basically, this isn't really a hangout kind of bar, more of a stop in and get an iconic New Orleans alcohol slurry place, and for what it is, I like it.

My husband and I order from here about once a week. He loves the wings and the pizza is just right for us, not greasy and the perfect crunch. We are never without coupons since they come about once a week, in fact I don't think we have paid full price for any order. We love there order online option and use it every time. This is a great location for us because it is right down the street. 

Negative that yes they do charge a $2 delivery fee but if you pick up your order, you get a free pint of ice cream and a 2 liter of soda. You really can't beat the price for a pizza and wings with a coupon and the ice cream and soda for free. The only time they didn't have may order ready when I picked up I waited about 3 minutes and they threw in a cheesy bread and those are delicious!
Called Trizzie on Monday my bangs were driving me crazy.  She said come in and now was fine!  She super nice and knows what she is doing.  I will definitely return.  Thank you so much!

I absolutely loved this restaurant. I ordered to go so cannot comment on that part of the service but my order was ready very very promptly. They forgot nothing and there was enough sauce for everything (something restaurants usually neglect) the duck sauce/mustard are not in the baggies but in containers. The egg rolls are large and very good. The crab rangoons are also large and amazing. Worth it. I had the garlic chicken, shrimp with vegs and combo lo mein. The veggies were delicious. The sauce was light and amazing. I will definitely be eating here again.
Great people and love getting my nails done there. My daughter love getting her nails painted there. They are so friendly.

A friend picked this restaurant for a Saturday lunch because it was one of his favorites. Overall the experience was wonderful. Our waitress was very nice and attentive. She made recommendations and answered all our questions. The head chef actually brought us our appetizer and ended up comping our meal because he said we "looked like nice people." I have never had this happen to me and I thought it was the nicest gesture. 

The food was good and the menu is extensive. I'm looking forward to coming back and trying something new.

Once in a while though my family will send for a delivery order from a couple of chains. I told them to please never ask for Domino's again but Papa John's is another story. It's pretty good pizza. 

They are still a fast growing chain and display as a logo, "Better Ingredients, Better Pizza" 

The place is clean and the pizza makers and counter persons are attentive. I like the fact that I am "recognized" as soon as I walk in the door. Nothing bothers me more than to be standing at a counter and no one has the sense of courtesy to say, "Hello" or "I'll be right with you". 

The very few times I have been inside our place, just a few minutes away, I've noticed the management has the current coupons on the counter. More about them later. 

I happen to like their pies. What I particularly like is the fact that in our place we can order the original or the Thin Crust style. I happen to like a crispy thin crust and theirs is good. I don't care for the regular that is just a bit to soft and chewy for me. 

The sauce they use is excellent and is the best part of their pizzas. They aren't skimpy with it either. It tastes like it has good quality ingredients in it. 

I also like the cheese they use. It tastes fresh and has a good flavour. 

As far as toppings go Papa John's doesn't hold back with the toppings, yes they charge you for additional toppings but certainly give you your money's worth. 

Beside toppings they have special pizzas on their menu such as Spinach Alfredo, Grilled Chicken Alfredo, Hawaiian Barbeque Chicken ( One I like. I never would have thought I would like pineapple on a pizza), and more specialty pies. 

Oh if you didn't know i'm a big Papa John's fan

Seating area is beautiful especially the garden which has a handy fan for the overly warm summers. The food however is not great. In all the dishes we ordered the taste of garlic was significantly stronger than anything else in the dish making them all taste almost the same. The broccoli in the bucatini was insanely bitter and ruined the pasta.

If I could give negative stars for my experience here I would.  I went here with a friend to get a massage for my birthday. The masseuse asked if we were getting deep tissue or Swedish massage. I was hesitant to get the deep tissue massage because I have heard they can sometimes hurt, but I was assured that it would not.  This is where I should've listened to my gut. This was my first mistake...This was the most painful massage I have ever received. I have gotten massages before at places like Hand and Stone and they have never felt like this. It was almost unbearable. My masseuse never asked if the pressure was ok and I did not speak up for myself (mistake number two). 

After the massage, I rejoined my friend and asked how hers was bc I know I can be sensitive sometimes. She agreed this was the most painful massage she's ever had and did not enjoy it at all.  Upon paying, my friend left her masseuse a tip that was slightly under 20% and her masseuse confronted her and told her she must leave a 20% tip. I was appalled as I have worked in the service industry many years and have never seen anyone demand a higher tip. My friend ended up leaving her the $2 difference. To my knowledge a tip is based on the service you receive, not determined by the person receiving the tip. It seemed extremely unprofessional to me. 

As the day went on my back became more and more painful.  When I finally looked in the mirror I had bruising and broken blood vessels all up and down my back.  I went back the very next day to let them know what happened.  They asked me to show them my back which I did. The one masseuse gasped when she saw my back while the other lady who had worked on my friend yesterday tried to explain that this was normal. I told her I've had many massages before and have never received bruising from a massage, let alone the extent to which my back was bruised and that I was really upset. The lady continued to laugh and tell me this was normal and that it would go away. I never even received an apology.  I told her that at the very least in the future she should inform people before they decide to get a massage what it will feel like bc I was told it was not going to hurt, and it left bruises on my body.  
My intent on leaving this review is just to make people aware before going here what you are in store for bc the people that work here clearly don't care. It was the worst experience I've ever had getting a massage.

I'm in town on biz.  Here because of yelp reviews and walking distance from my hotel.  Its saturday at 7pm and only a handful of people here.  Mosly guys on biz trips in small groups.  The bartender is pleasant and makes a good martini.  The watermelon shrimp salad is what i needed after a 12 hr airplane ride from Alaska.  I wish there were more people here as the prior reviews have indicated, but it is Saturday, perhaps they were talking about a work crowd.  Good eats and drinks!  Can't go wrong.

My husband and one of my BFFs are both from the StL area, so they're both quite familiar with Shlafley beer. I had not yet had the pleasure and I L.O.V.E. me some beer. So, when we were all in town for Memorial Day weekend, we headed to the Tap Room. I am a happy girl!

BEER: super awesome fabulous. Love the Hop Toddy and the Raspberry Heferweizen (I can't spell). Totally different beers and I would love to have them both in my fridge all the time for my different beer moods/tastes. The HT was carmely and hoppy and a-mazing. It only comes in 750 ml bottles and I bought 2 to bring home with me! I think I'm actually going to crack one open when done writing this review. 

FOOD: I have much better things to say than other reviewers. Pretzels were so good. I had the monte cristo for lunch and that was so good too. I've never had it deep fried before and well, how do you go wrong with that? Then the dessert --  the sticky toffee pudding. Blsgaheghewefhh. That is the sound my brain made when I at that. It was that good. 

Next time I'm in St. Louis, you know I'll be stopping here.

1st time visit but certainly not the last.  We were seated immediately and from beginning to end, Mario took care of our every need.  To start we had the chips and salsa and the salsa was perfectly seasoned and fresh.  We added the cheese dip to start and it was good without being spicy or greasy.  We ordered the sangria special and it was full of fruit and mixed perfectly.  The carnitas and chicken enchiladas were cooked to perfection.  Yes, it is a little whole in the wall but I definitely recommend you give them a try.
Excellent oyster po boys. Great place for lunch. Excellent service. The onion ring orders are massive.

This hotel is still under construction, but besides a little rerouting of the lobby, this didn't seem to cause any issues and the new rooms look nice.

Most of the desk staff were very kind. Except one. Mai-something? We used points to purchase the room for two nights and were told by reservations that we would have breakfast for $4 per person each morning. When explaining this at check-in, Mai told us that was impossible and that the people who worked in reservations were "just stupid." So no breakfast? Okay. Waffle House it is then.

The room was freshly remodeled which was nice. The bathtub did not drain. It took about an hour to completely drain after a shower. The faucets were also backwards (ie hot meant cold and cold meant hot). Until we figured this all out, we had a few showers of standing in 8 inches of ice cold water. Fun. We called down to the desk after the first shower like this and they said someone would be "right up." Two days later, we had yet to see anyone.

Finally did get the hotel breakfast on our last morning there, around 9:00am. The hot food was cold and standard. Depressing that we even paid anything for it. This would have been a free breakfast at any other hotel. 

The hotel gives you the opportunity to help save the environment by hanging a little card on the door that says not to change the linens. Apparently this actually means "do not clean my room at all." The beds were not remade, the trash not removed, the coffee cups not replaced, nothing. Also, that drainage problem in the bathtub noted above? Leaves majorly gross soap scum and piles of hair. Nasty. Never cleaned either.

So all in all here, the hotel was incredibly average. Not great, not awful. Probably would choose a different hotel if I ever returned to Nashville.
My waiter Mr. Shamus was excellent!!  Not just with me but all of the customers.. and the half off Mon-Fri breakfast deal is great!

Commander's Palace was one of the restaurants in New Orleans that kept popping up when I was looking up places to dine at. I ended up making my reservations 5 days ahead of time, and there weren't that many days and times available for the weekend.

My husband ordered the Soups 1-1-1 (Gumbo, Turtle, and Shrimp & Caraway), Chicory Coffee Roasted Texas Quail, and Creole Bread Pudding Souffle off of the three course offering, and I ordered the Commander's Crisp Romaine Salad and Pecan Crusted Gulf Fish. It was a lot of food, and everything tasted great. Even the salad, which seemed so simple, was fresh and tasty with the creamy dressing.

Out of all the soups, the Shrimp & Caraway (which was the daily soup) was our favorite. I was looking forward to trying out the turtle soup, which didn't taste bad, but my husband and I both thought the addition of sherry didn't help with the taste.

Both of our entrees were delicious and came in pretty big portions. The saffron sauce and crab paired nicely with the pecan crusted fish. The quail had a nice crust to it, but was cooked a bit unevenly.

I was so full by the time we got around to dessert, but the bread pudding souffle was delicious. It was rich and but not too heavy at the same time.

Service here was excellent. The staff was friendly, and all the waiters were very attentive.

I would come back here if I ever visit New Orleans again. If you plan on eating here, be sure to make reservations ahead of time!

Food was mediocre at best. The chips and salsa were the best part, but that's not hard to put together. The tacos were bland and fell apart. The bowl was colorful but yet again lacking in flavor. I'd have to pass on this place next time.

Authentic Philly establishment and a bit of a throwback (in a good way).
Tasty sandwich. Fun place to grab a quick bite.

This plain looking diner has an unexpected posh martini bar inside past the regular dining area. I dropped in with a friend on a drinking night and the place was packed, most people were devouring enormous piles of fries that looked like shoestrings along with other fusion type cuisine. I didn't try the food but the martini bar was really sweet, very chill.

Candy at Slice Salon is awesome! I've been going to her for my platinum blonde hair for 5 years and she always takes care of me! The salon itself is very clean and comfortable and they have a very chic atmosphere. Love it!
Great food. Nice location with outdoor seating. Very accommodating for gluten free diets

It looks like we finally have a proper coffee shop in Pennsport.  I'm a fan and I think as they are open longer they will hit their stride and prove to be a great neighborhood addition.

I've been in twice and I've had a decent experience both times.  The pour over I ordered was nicely done and their drip blend is solid too.  The garage doors as others have mentioned are a nice touch and make this place very accessible.  I've strolled my son in both times and have had no issue finding a place to wait for my coffee.

I think they have a high quality product but be forewarned, these are Center City prices in South Philadelphia.  You can expect to pay $3.75 and up for pour over.  I believe drip was around $2.25 at the time of writing.

One of these weeks I'll grab a bag of their beans to use at home.  I'm happy they are here and I like that they open early.

Welcome to the hood!

Sonny was a good man to talk to at one of the best Rib joints I've been to.

After trying these bones, dry rub is the way to go.

If you're in Nashville, this is a spot, I would say is a Must visit to get your grub on.

Look up Sonny and have a great Southern conversation with a good man.

Thumbs up from Southern California!

Quality of food and service deteriorating.   When I visited this restaurant last year, i thought the food was fairly good.  This time around, I was totally disappointed.   When we came in, the staff was busy.  No one was around to seat us. When I flagged down a staff, he pointed to a table and walked away.   It took some minutes before I waved another staff down to get the menu.  We ordered the congee, spicy chicken, and Choi sum.  
While waiting for our food, I noticed there where spilled scallion sauce on the floor by my my feet.  I alerted the staff to this.   He came over with an old advertising section of a newspaper to wipe it up.  Needless to say, the paper did nothing but smear the stuff around.  He then got a wet paper napkin to clean it but it was too small to really do any good.  He gave up and got another newspaper and left it on the floor by my feet.   He guess he was marking the spot.

When the food arrived, the waitress left without checking to see if we had any utensil to eat with.  We had to ask for that from another staff.  The congee was bland and tasted like they simply boiled rice in water and added the meat as an after thought.  The spicy chicken was crusty and did not have enough spice or schezuen peppercorn.  The wait staff never once came by to check on us.   We even had to get up to get the to go box and the bill.

Great online check in and check out process, seamless experience and nice choice of SUV's for our  vacation combining New Orleans and Florida.  We had a brand new, fully loaded Dodge Durango Limited that did everything great.  Great experience!

An old standby in the downtown area. After all these years, one of the first brewery restaurants to Indy continues to deliver. We started with firecracker shrimp. Lots of sauce on this plate and the ginger citrus dip is off the charts. Good to share! I had a margherita pizza. Great flavors. All of the toppings were essentially in the middle few inches so lots of seasoned crust to the outside edge. Others had chicken sandwiches with bottomless fries and the chicken nachos. It was a lunch visit and our server got a bit overwhelmed toward the end causing us to wait quite a bit of time for the check. A stack of app plates also had an errant jalapeño slice on one. Servers: Check each plate in your stacks please. Check it out!

Great location and nice (thought if can vary from unit to unit a bit).  The issue is weak management. Not very helpful with any issues that might come up.  In our case, there was a grill on the balcony in photos for our unit, but no grill when we got there.  The manager just shrugged and didn't care.  I'm really surprised the owners put up with such shoddy management. Just look at the website for them and it still lists the year as 2010-11.

My husband and I drove up from N Maryland to try Choolaah. It was worth the drive!  Food was fresh and very tasty.  We had the Tiki Masala with Chicken and the Lamb BBQ with brown Rice and a side of Vegetable Masala.  Everything was very fresh.  Best ground lamb I have had in a very long time.  All dishes were fresh, and flavorful.  Vegetables were not soggy or over cooked and color came from spices NOT artificial ingredients.  The dipping sauces were out of this world.  We will be back
Great food and atmosphere. Everything smoked and nothing fried. I had the wings with dry rub seasoning and bacon Mac n cheese and potato salad. Everything was awesome.

The sales people were nice. A little pushy though in trying to sell a car off the lot rather than locating the one I wanted. I had to be blunt with the sales manager in the little room and it worked and he was blunt back providing the price which was 7% off of MSRP. A nice service they provide is scanning their SubaruNet to find exact matches for the car you want and ordering it.

I became a member of the wine club last year and I've loved all that it has to offer.  All of the wine consultants are knowledgeable and go above and beyond with their customer service.
The food is decent, but I much prefer their appetizers.  The pork tostadas are my fave!
This place is great for girls night out, or chilling with coworkers after a long day (or not so long day) at the office :)

Ehhh...I've had lots of coffee in my day and theirs was just okay. The self-service concept is neat but I want a fresh cup brewed just for me. That's right - I'm selfish that way. I want my coffee to be hand-made specifically for me with some 'joie de vivre' - passion and purpose. I want my hard-earned money to go toward a cup of coffee that will leave me satisfied; happier than before I bought it. Not here. :(

After my review in April, we returned to Tucson Tamale to see if things had changed and again found that a side salad was not available as a choice with a tamale order. Also, they were out of pinto beans (for the 2nd time), so the choices were cole slaw, spicy beans or 2 rice dishes - one warm, one cold. The place was filthy. We went all the way to the back of the store to find a clean table. Who's paying attention? For the time being, if we desperately need their tamales, we'll purchase them frozen (without sides) and bring them home to heat in the microwave. Besides at their  restaurants, Tucson tamales are available, for more money and without sides, at Whole Foods. That is where I first got them. Diane

Super cute, clean and plenty of play stations to keep my 20 month old busy!  We have only been once but it was a day that the local schools were closed.  It was very busy (crowded) when we got there and there was definitely a handful of children who I thought were too old (and misbehaved) to be there with kids that are 5 or 6 years younger than them.  By about 11:30 the crowd had thinned out and it was a more enjoyable experience.  We will definitely be back!

I went for dinner with my boyfriend. We were asked four times if we were ready to order, once while we were in the processing of actually sitting down at the table, the next 3 times in the next ten minutes. I was asked if I wanted a to go box while my mouth was still full of food, and albeit I declined the bill was brought anyways. I know you want to turn tables, but we were one of three tables in there. I work nights, and that was one of the two evenings I had with my boyfriend, and I felt rushed. Please work on timing and reading body language of your customer.
The food on the other hand was spectacular! Although we don't go to Sakura anymore, we order in from them at least twice a month. And the potions are very generous! I usually get 2-3 meals out of one order.

Been here numerous times and although it's in a rough area, it's right off of hwy 70 on Goodfellow. They have great fried chicken. I usually get 1 of the wings+fries meal with extra lemon pepper seasoning, St. Louis Style (aka no breading) because it's fresher. I've never had a bad experience here and the food has always been as expected. I'd come here more if I lived closer so I only come when I have the time. If you want great fried chicken that's BETTER (yes, I said better) than Hodak's, this is the spot.

Unfortunately they ran out of lamb early in the evening but it was still a great experience. The halumi and hummus deserve their reputations. This place was full of wonderful surprises. All the meat dishes sang-- from the chicken shislik to the kofte to the lamb merguez. Definitely a great atmosphere, warm and cozy.
Came here for brunch and so EXTREMELY disappointed. Not what is expect from a top chef. The food lacked flavor and wasn't memorable. Avoid the short ribs Benedict. And way overpriced.

I went here with my girlfriend and two of my friends as Jim's had a really long line. My girlfriend had never eaten a cheesesteak from philly before so this was a first for her. We got the Regular Cheesesteak with whiz. The sandwich was massive and it was enough to fill three people. The meat was very lean and tender. The amount of cheese was perfect. I will definitely be going back here again, definitely as good as Jim's if you ask me and just across the street.

Disclaimer: this review is for the vegetarian ramen
I came into this restaurant with an open mind, but after being greatly disappointed, I can day this is the worst "ramen" I have ever tasted. I know vegetarian ramen can't be compared to regular pork ramen, but the bowl I got was the worst excuse for ramen I could possibly imagine. The broth, if you could call it that, tasted and smelled like boiled cabbage . No seasonings or vegetable stock had been added, and even loads of soy sauce and half a bottle of Sriracha couldn't save it. The vegetables floating around were overcooked and lacked flavor. The ramen noodles would have been okay of they hadn't soaked up the cabbage water. Honestly, I'd pick top ramen over this any day. For 10$, this is absolutely inexcusable.

When we walked into this restaurant, we were so pleasantly surprised at how beautiful it was and how many levels there were to enjoy a nice cocktail or dinner overlooking the water. It was relatively packed so we found 4 seats at the upper bar and sat down for what we thought would be a relaxing cocktail. Well, little did we know how awkward this experience would be. The bartender was an absolute nightmare of a person and kept yelling and giving attitude to all of the waiters and staff. She spent the whole time we were there, barking orders, rolling her eyes and just being so rude to them. I felt bad for the whole staff there. My mother in law even said she was scared of her. She made us feel so uncomfortable we would have stayed for 3 drinks if not more bc of the environment but she was AWFUL. Do not sit at the bar. She should be fired. And the poor old couple that left just before us that were also sitting at the bar made the same commentary. We discussed it with them and they were bummed about her attitude and didn't want to stay for another drink. Go for the view but don't get served by this woman.

My first experience with Pedego Electric Bikes was in Los Olivos to go wine tasting and it was amazing. I was instantly addicted. These bikes are fantastic !Now they are available in Santa Barbara! I highly recommend taking a tour or even just taking these out with a group of friends to go sightseeing around Santa Barbara. From one end of SB to the other in minutes ! These bikes are super fast and easy to ride !!

Kind of wish I could put this place in my pocket and take it to DC. Love how they took the single bottle carry out to the next level with individual buy and drink, taps, and food on site. Gone are the days where you order a beer and they are out of it- everything is on display for you to pick out on your own.
Love this place. Service is a 5. Food a 4, except the sushi and hot and sour soup. Both of those are a 5. Some food is better than others. The service makes up for that two-fold.

I was heading Thru the area and needed to pick up Pizza for dinner, Preferably Good pizza... So, I pulled over, opened this awesome Yelp app and asked for pizza...I found This Awesome place..I called, they took my order, I arrived within 2 minutes as I was driving that direction already, and these Wonderful folks were kind enough to Bring my order Out to me . They were Kind... The pizza was Hot And Delicious!!!!  And I am a Pizza Snob! .... So, Grateful to find such a Delicious Pie right on the White Horse Pike... Thanks for making our night  oh.. And totally a Fair price for Amazing food

Nice salon experience. Booked a haircut with Jessica after reading the reviews and was not disappointed. Not only is she a super friendly person but she takes her time to do her thing and listens to what you want. The staff were also really nice and welcoming, in a sincere way, which added to the experience. Happy to be rocking my long bob cut this fall!

My food came like they threw it into the bag. My Mongolian Beef had dripped all over the food and ruined everything. It was undercooked too, not to mention over spiced. The fried rice was ok, but nothing special. Did not like the Lo Mein at all. Really gross and I feel totally ripped off. The whole thing cost about $38.00 and there weren't even left overs, (not that you would want leftovers from there) I would not recommend it, and even though I live next door in Tanamera, I will never return. I give it an Eww!

I had to have several old negatives developed and tried this store because they were the only one I could find around here that would do this in an hour. Austin at the photo counter was great. He provided friendly, fast and fabulous service. Photos were ready in 15 minutes instead of an hour.

Went here to take advantage of their expertise, and I wasn't disappointed.  Very nice selection, and the prices were much better than a chain store, and the quality was leagues better.  Wouldn't hesitate to recommend it to anyone, and will definitely be back for more purchases.  Plus, you're giving money to a locally owned business, instead of corporate, and that is always a bonus.

I was really excited to try this place and after reading the rave reviews, I felt lucky to find an appointment that would allow me to take a late lunch and pop in on my last work day before a quick vacation. Upon reviewing the services and options, I saw the "Power Hour Mani" whose description reads, "No time? No worries!". I booked an appointment online for this service- 3pm until 3:25pm. In addition to the reviews of this place, I was impressed at the email I received confirming my appointment and then reminding me of my appointment. I thought that the place must be incredibly upscale and on top of their game (The email reminding me of the appointment also stated that the salon reserves the right to charge for missed appointments-). I ran from my office to the salon, arriving right at about 3pm (I'd shifted my schedule a bit to allow for my darting out a little later than usually for lunch-), I checked in, chose my polish, and was told that someone would be with me shortly. I should also note that there were 3 manicurists working and a woman at the front taking phone calls and checking folks in.

I would love to tell you about the phenomenal manicure I received and how I felt vacation ready. Sadly, I can't do that because I sat on a couch at the front of the salon until 3:20pm. Frustrated, I approached the woman at the front desk advising that I couldn't stay any longer. My appointment was to be from 3 - 3:25, which meant that if I was to even get in a chair right at that moment, I wouldn't be getting up until about 4... I needed to get back to work. She'd advised that the manicurist I'd been assigned was putting on a top coat for the woman she was working on and could take me shortly, but again- I still wouldn't be leaving the salon until about 4. I asked if there was any way I could come back closer to 5pm. The next available appointment they had was at 5:45pm... Given my current situation, that was telling me that I wouldn't see a manicurist until after 6pm which was a no go for me. The woman at the desk looked to see if she could "move things around" and then asked if I'd want her to call me if an opening came up this evening. I thanked her, but declined because at that point I was over it. While I 100% appreciate her willingness to look for any other open appointments, that still didn't change the fact that I'd made an appointment for a service and did not receive said service due to overall poor communication. If there weren't enough staff members to accommodate the number of appointments made in a timely fashion, I shouldn't have been able to make the appointment in the first place. At the very least, I could have been advised of the wait upon checking in. 

Why offer appointments, not bother to communicate delays, and then have the nerve to state that the establishment "reserves the right to charge for missed appointments" if they can't even keep the appointments that are made? I made the appointment for a service that was advertised to be quick and painless. I left wishing that I'd chosen to go elsewhere.

I'd save the time and effort and go elsewhere. I'm definitely wishing I did because now here I am scrambling to find an appointment/salon to squeeze me in right after work before I fly out tomorrow. Complete waste of time.

The food and service at this BYO are both excellent, and the prices are very reasonable.  We devoured several appetizers before settling into the shrimp special, that was superb.  People in the Philly area are blessed to have so many BYOs, and this is one of the best.  Can't wait to go back.

Xoom juice is delicious! Sometimes it's busy, and it can take a while to get what you order but it's most definitely worth the wait. I get the bowl of Acai and it is absolutely delicious! Great meal replacement and although a little pricey, completely worth it!
Love this place. Every time I find myself in the area, have to stop. All the curries are awesome and the lunch deals are great.
I need to update the rate I gave a while ago. It was disappointing this time. I presume a chef is a different. Very different quality of work and taste.

So... I have to say that though a little pricey... king's is a good place to eat. I just finished my plate from a delivery and I have to say that it WAS INCREDIBLE. Thanks for good food and great delivery service.
I said Denise but I meant Natalie, she's the bomb.com, I love her and I'll wait for her as I did today. I'm good with that

Stopped in for a lunch on my day off. We asked to be seated outside to take advantage of the weather. There cobwebs on my chair and we were attacked by a beetle throughout the ordering process. At least wipe down your chairs at the beginning of your shift, please. 

We ordered the calamari, the Appetizer was just perfect for two to share. Not knock your socks off but good. For my meal I got a pizza which I only ate half of and my husband got the pulled pork sandwich. Both were good, portions were large. Each of us ordered a beverage and our bill came to about 60 bucks. A little much for lunch but I would be interested to try them for dinner one day. 

They are doing construction currently so the outdoor seating is not great right now. Maybe we will try again once the construction is over.

Had a wonderful experience at this salon. I came in as a walk-in and was not completely sure what I wanted. My stylist Kayla was very helpful and had great intuition. You can tell that the employees get along. They even help eachother out by two of them working on your hair at once if needed. I love my new hair! Thank you!

What a pleasant surprise!  Visited this new restaurant for lunch this week and don't have a single negative thing to report.  The food was amazing and the attention to detail will set this restaruant above all the others on the block.  The servers were helpful, entusiastic and just plain glad to be there.  I can't wait to go back!
Very good beers. My favorite was the Bourbon barrel aged imperial stout, it was delicious. Also, they give you a fun, quick tour. Really great place, will definitely be returning!

A little cafe that you could miss even if you were standing right in front of it (we did), Little Vic's offers some excellent gelato in the middle of the French Quarter.

I would've liked more chocolate choices in their ten (or was it twelve?) flavors they offered, but the variety allows something for everyone. From sweet-tart fruit flavors of a cranberry/raspberry or a light and refreshing lime all the way to the chocolate peanut butter than I went with (thankfully not too sugary), you'll find something good. And we were offered two (or three) sample tastes before we made our choices.

A "large" was over $7, a "medium" was around $6, and the "small" was just under $5. That felt a little much even for gelato, but they piled the little cup enough that I had all I needed with the small size.

Our server was very polite and friendly and Vic's offered a nice break from the raucous streets of New Orleans.

I am still sitting here drying my toes after what was an exquisite pedicure.  I live in New York and the only bummer is that this place doesn't exist there! complimentary drinks.. very friendly people... a nice environment to escape from the world for a little while.. Truly wonderful. Maria was great and very helpful, got me a pillow to help me prop my phone and keyboard for doing work.  GREAT!

It's not my favourite pizza place in town. But in a pinch, and especially when it's getting late and other places are closed, Boston Pizza is fine.  I like the Zorba the Greek pizza - tomatoes, olives, onions, bell peppers, feta and mozzarella.  Very satisfying when you're very hungry.

I ate here on a Friday night with a friend and was not impressed. The food was mediocre at best. We ordered the chicken and andouille gumbo, oyster tacos and chargrilled oysters. The gumbo and chargrilled oysters were luke warm when they were delivered to the table. There are far better restaurants to eat at in the French Quarter in my opinion. On a positive note the restaurant offers balcony seating which is unique!

Yessssssssssssssssss. Met friends here for dinner last night and could not believe it had taken so long to check Monsu out. My husband and I live one block away and are huge fans of Paesano's -- were DVRing their Throwdown with Bobby Flay as we ate dinner! Monsu was awesome - the menu differed than the one I had seen online, but I was so happy. We started with the grilled mozzarella (amazing), the crispelle special (also awesome), and did two half portions of pasta: the gnocchi (be still my heart) and the bucatini. For dinner, I had the lamb done "in the style of the horse." I had to ask what this meant because it is a bit scary! I learned that in Sicily, horse is sold as street food and the owner of Monsu wanted to replicate the preparation style, but substitute lamb. I was sold and it was delicious. Other folks at my table also had the lamb, the osso buco, and the meat with the egg on it. I forget what it was called - but there were no complaints. For dessert, we split the profiteroles and flourless chocolate cake. I went to the bathroom before it was served and when I returned, it was almost gone. I WAS NOT GONE LONG! :)

Also, it is so awesome that it is BYO. With the four apps, four entrees and two desserts plus nice tip for our really awesome server, each couple paid 90 bucks. A little steep, but we ate a lot. :)

Philly you rock! This place is amazing. Came here for a few drinks on a Sunday night and it was packed.  It was a great crowd with an incredible atmosphere. 

There are hammocks up in the trees and a whole dock beach to lounge and enjoy beers on. They have pic nice benches and chairs making it casual and fun. Down by the waters there are nets over the water with pillows you can lounge in. 

This is my new favorite summer hangout. Great drinks, great food, great time.

Have eaten at 13th a number of times. Brunch, lunch and diner. The brunch buffet, beet salad and steaks are fabulous! The service when we were there was awesome. Friendly staff, prompt service, always feel comfortable and never rushed.

Nice, elegant atmosphere if that's what you're looking for, though part of the cafe is exposed to a walkway that can get busy and loud. If you want quiet, request seating in back. Cool jazz bar. I had the Caesar salad (small, but good) and a Kahlua and Creme cocktail (one of the best I've had).

I'm not a big fan of casino/resort restaurants, but Roxy's isn't bad if you don't mind a menu a little on the pricey side.

What a hidden treasure. Watervue is nestled in a residential right on the water. Food was delicious, inventive and perfectly prepared. Our server was great, ton of personality and solid recommendations. Desserts are worth the splurge.

So this review is just for their take-out service.  I was so jonesin' for a real burger and sweet potato fries - fast food just wouldn't do.  After looking up the menu and seeing that they had "glazed sweet potato fries," I headed over.  I got their blackened burger, which came fully dressed with pickles and red onions.  It was so good!  It really satisfied my craving with the seasoned patty that was blackened right, without tasting burnt.  The service was pretty quick, so I will definitely hit them up again for their Tuesday burger specials.

Bearcat is home to some delicious brunch! 

My friend and I came here on a Friday morning and were seated within 5 minutes. For drinks, I had the Cold Brew, which was perfectly balanced. My friend had the Matcha Latte, which she really enjoyed (and which came with some great latte art!)

To eat, we shared the Vegan Bearcat (Tofu scramble served with crispy potatoes and black bean sausage) and Vegan Rancheros (Sweet potato tortilla with black beans, house salsa, avocado, and cashew crema). Both dishes were delicious! 

If I find myself in New Orleans again, I definitely want to go back to Bearcat and try some of the other delicious-looking breakfast food menu items, as well as their house-made bottled drinks.
it was very good this time love thee soda machines !

Solid sandwich, very friendly service, nice setting.

I came here while visiting Philadelphia. I had the chicken picatta sandwich, and I enjoyed it. The bread is fantastic, although I wouldn't have minded it being toasted a bit.
