Service is very cool, as there is a team and they all come by and continue to use your name. Its formal but not over the top.  I didn't like that other tables seemed to get more attention than I did, maybe they were locals.  

The food was amazing but its heavy and it takes a lot of you to eat.  I'd come here for breakfast if you don't have a big morning planned or you will be slowed down. 

The apple is a great way to start the meal.  The fried porkchop was nostalgia on a plate reminding me of the chicken fried steak my Texas grandmother has been making for 70 years.  The red eye jus that came with it was the part, perfect.

Sad to see a place with such a great location with horrible food. I had a simple cheese and meat board and the meat was bad, the cheese tasted horrible. Even our dirty martini didn't taste good - how do you mess that up? Love the location, it has so much potential because they have outdoor seating. But was surprised to see such poor taste in something as simple as a cheese board. I had to cancel everything, and get a wine. NEEDS NEW MANAGEMENT/CHEF ASAP. Hopefully something will come out of this.
Food is outstanding. Starting with the salad, dressing, steaks, cocktails to desserts
Ahh Moes! Gotta love it. Simpson's themed, best Quizzo in Delco, HUGE beers, Amazing Nachos. Waitstaff are so sweet! Our waitresses name was Shana and she was super helpful.

Very bad experience....poor management and service.

Called ahead reservations for 15 people 11:30 and told her that we would be on our lunch hour and asked if I could put our orders in no while on the phone and was told " no"  that the kitchen wasn't open yet and it shouldn't be a problem.  

We arrived at our reserved time and got seated right away.  Our server was polite but not efficient and told him that we were on our lunch hour and said that we would like to order.  He had asked two to three times what we ordered.  20 minutes later brings out our drinks.  Another 15 minutes later brings out appetizer. 

While sitting there waiting on our food (which none of us ordered steak or something that would take longer, just sandwiches and soup), saw the whole staff of waiters in the kitchen clapping and carrying on for a good 15 minutes.  Server disappeared after that.  We had to hunt down a manager (which blew us off).  Our server finally came around after that and told us that our food should be coming out soon.  Told him don't even bother putting them on plates and asked for to go boxes two to three times.  After sitting there for an hour, still hadn't received our food and finally another manager came over and said sorry but food should be coming out soon.  I had asked her why all the servers were in the kitchen clapping and standing there not doing anything and her reply was that they were doing pre-shift changes (whatever the hell that means).  No empathy at all.  

Our food finally came out but on plates not in to go boxes like we had asked.

Have been to Chili's before where there were no problems whatsoever in ordering ahead and have the convenience of dining in during our lunch.

So this is what happens. They did it again. After my first problem with ZIPS, I am more careful about ask them to WET CLEAN my pants, and I do it ALWAYS. But this time I got a really bad surprise when they went ahead and DRY CLEAN my pants without my consent. Of course they destroyed my pants again, and the manager even told me that they DON'T wet clean anymore since a couple days ago, and that the girl that took my cloths should say something about it yesterday. Of course she didn't say anything about it. 
The thing is that I am not coming to this cleaners again since they don't really care about my clothes. For God sake, it is in the LABEL on the pants! It say DON'T DRY CLEAN them! But there you go doing whatever I want with your cloths, just because.
Please make yourself a favor and use any other cleaner that really care about you.
Regards, Carlos.

Staff was friendly and helpful, but the food was horrible. The cheesesteak and burgers were greasy, the fries tasteless and the salad wilted.  With a limited menu of unexceptional food, I wouldn't recommend then to my worst enemy.

Placed an order directly from their website at 11:46 am. Order status comes back with a confirmed time of 12:05. Arrived at 12:06 and waited in line to check on order, at 12:15 spoke with an employee who said they were working on our order. During this time, new customers arrive and order, and receive their food. We check back in at 12:35 and they say "it's in the bag."  3 minutes later, they tell us they are out of a few things for our order, which they now admit they haven't started yet. We give up and leave, almost an hour after placing the order and with no food. The bagels do look delicious, would've been nice to try them.
Hit or miss. Sometimes the food is pretty good, other times it's soggy. If you need something quick that's not pizza, it's worth a try.

I came here with my cousin after searching for a Japanese restaurant near her that we could both enjoy.  I drove up to Gloucester county for the day to go shopping with her and I used Yelp to try and find a place nearby that had good reviews.  The reviews that everyone gave sold me on going here.  The service was, yes, a little slow, but there was only one server/hostess and I guess she knew the group of people behind us.  Either way, I didn't starve and I didn't die of thirst waiting for drinks.

I had a couple of vegetarian rolls and a cup of miso soup.  The miso soup was perfect.  The rolls I had were very delicious and the avocado was perfectly ripened.  My cousin enjoyed her meal greatly as well. We split an order of tempura vegetables and they were lightly battered to perfection.

The price for our meal was fair.  The place itself was very clean, kind of small, but personable.  I can see how it could get busy really fast due to it's small size, but luckily we went at a perfect time.  I wish the server was a little more aware of her customers, but it wasn't too bad.  

I will definitely be going back again when I am in the area.

Their kitchen quality control needs improvement! I counted 6 yes 6 little red potatoes on my plate. They were supposed to be "roasted" but tasted microwaved yuck no seasoning or flavor at all. The roll sandwich came with was stale so quickly discarded that. I overpaid 10 bucks for a dried out chicken breast and the scant portion of potatoes!  I know A-bees is not gourmet standard but I do expect better presentation and portion for the money.

I've been in this place three times and finally had a meal here in mid-December 2013. The first two times I was here, the place was either so empty it looked like it should close, or the bar was completely full and the seating areas were completely empty. It just didn't make for an inviting space. This last visit, we managed to find two open stools at the bar and a handful of people sitting at the tables. 

We ordered a cocktail and beer and perused the menu. We decided on the three-napkin burger with a side of parmesan truffle fries. While we waiting, we both agreed that the ambiance was a bit off here: the music a touch too loud for the number of people, and the disco ball consistently strobed bright flashes of light directly in our eyes. If you've even had an anime-induced seizure, you might want to avoid this place. 

The food arrive and we quickly noticed that our fries had been forgotten... chips covered the rest of the plate. The bartender, to his credit, quickly noticed and said he would get them right out. We munched a few chips in the meantime and ate the burgers. The burgers disappeared, as did the chips, and then we were ready to go... but the bartender was set on extracting frites from the kitchen - which clearly had forgotten them and was in shutdown mode. The fries arrived covered in parmesan in the typical 'frite paper cone'. We now felt obligated to try them. We had high hopes, but these frites were nothing more than food service french fries with grated cheese, and despite having to wait 15-20 minutes for them, we were still billed for the upcharge.

The burger was really good, but I much prefer this place (the Zest side) for brunch.
Tried the rainbow and tempura shrimp and crab sushi wrap( sushi in the form of burrito) Both were amazing! Good service

Absolutely love this store! Have been to two of their locations, and have furnished most of my apartment with these unique pieces. Every piece is slightly different, so its nice to have something that no one else has. Also love that these pieces are solid wood. The staff is also incredible and super accommodating! The only reason they don't get 5 stars is because almost all of their furniture, especially cabinets and dressers, all have an intensely strong smoky odor that does not go away, and the staff does not know what kind of finishes are used on these pieces. Some people are very conscious of the chemicals being used in furniture, and i would like to know the exact source of the odor.

The salad platters here are just superb! HUGE, good , fresh, I don't have to spend 10 mins dissecting the white lettuce out of my salad as I do at most places. The tuna is very good . All the salads come with their homemade banana bread too. They have a great selection of beneditcs too! Gets very crowded, very fast so you have to time it right, be patient and move along when you're done! Only open for breakfast and lunch so that's fine though.
Great service and the food is excellent. This is definitely worth coming to. Here's what the inside looks like.

I chose Yoga Six as the replacement class that I'd dropped from the Grove/Urban Breath. My first class was with Alison, and she teaches a challenging series of poses while she spends most of her time at the front of the class showing how the poses should be done/transitioned through. This is a lot different than the instruction style at Breath & Body in Austin, but it was helpful for visualizing how a pose should be held. I couldn't hit all the positions, but Alison offers options to move into a modified pose if you're not an advanced student. The class I took was the Y6 Flow which is an advanced class so I didn't expect to be able to do everything anyway.

The other classes I've taken there were taught by Rebekka and I really like that Rebekka incorporates reading passages from her favorite tomes to the class to set the tone for the Flow. She has a gentle instruction quality and I liked that the resonance of her voice carried through the class. I was able to follow along easily even if I could not see what she was doing at the front of the class.

The studio is gorgeous! When I'm taking classes here I'm in town on business so the fact that Y6 has mats/towels and showers available for use is a big plus! The women's shower is fully stocked with shampoo/conditioner and body wash. Full size towels are available for use ($2) as is deodorant, q-tips, hair ties and a hair dryer for finishing up. This place is great, and it will be a regular haunt of mine every time I'm in St. Louis.

Getting good food at the beach is not easy but this place has it. We eat here at least twice a day when we come down to visit and recently we have been there three weeks. Will be returning again and will visit and grab the yummy chocolate chip pancakes for breakfast and the stromboli for lunch. Also make a great cheese pizza. If you want homemade meals and fresh salad, this place is very generous with their portions and the price can't be beat.
I think they're different owners from when I was a kid.  But the food is still quick and tasty!  They'll deliver as well but I like to sit at the counter and watch TV / bullshit with customers.

Another one of our favorite stops and going to Reno best restaurants in Italian restaurant very authentic the foods fantastic very nice very clean.... very good selection of wines hors d'oeuvres I recommend you give it a try most everybody there has a real nice demeanor unfriendly.. we come from California to enjoy their meals from the San Francisco Bay area so that has to tell you something first-class operation

Went to Syberg's (Arnold) for dinner.  We have dined at 4 other Syberg restaurants so expected the high level of service and food as the others.

They clearly did not disappoint.

We arrived in time for 1/2 price apps and decided to try the chicken dip with chips.  It was good and more than enough to please the two of us.

Our waitress Sydney was excellent.  She was attentive and very pleasant.  

My wife ordered a large house salad and I ordered the Lobster Macaroni & Cheese.

First the Lobster Mac & Cheese was FANTASTIC.  Good manners prevented me from licking the bowl. I most definitely will order this again.

The house salad had a few pieces of letttuce in it that had not been properly cleaned so she set them aside and continued dining on the salad.  A manager stopped by to inquire as to how ouur dinner was.  We just told him that he might want to suggest that they clean the salad a little more.  He began to apologize and took the bad pieces.  Sydney came to the table and apologized also.

No big deal.  

When she brought the bill she again apoligized and indicated the salad was removed from the bill.  

Once again Syberg's sets the bar.  They kept a loyal customer happy and insured our return.

If I could leave 1.5 stars I would.
I have revered Bistro Roxy as one of my favorite restaurants for many years. I've been here several times, too many to count. I've also recommended this place several times. The happy hour is excellent, as is the atmosphere and the service. 
Up until last week, I thought the food was excellent as well.  
Mainly, we ordered the crab cake, it was awful.  ( two of them )
It was cool and soggy and accompanied by a bell pepper purée and side of cumber slices. It had small chunks of potatoes inside of it and also seemed to have potato soup as the main binding ingredient. It was a HUGE disappointment.
The crab cake used to be one of the best things I have ever eaten.  I ordered it EVERY time I went to Bistro.  It was pure crab meat, crispy, in a hot sizzling skillet and surrounded by browned butter. What  happened???  I'm all for change, but only when it's for the better, not the worse.
We also had the goat cheese salad, which used to be phenomenal. Now, it's just bland with nothing to it.  We did have the berry soufflé, which was good.
Also, It seems that they have raised their prices.  Bistro Roxy is no longer stiff competition for places like Cactus Creek, The Peppermill or Western Village. 
I really hate giving bad reviews, but this one was necessary.  I really hope that Bistro can go back to doing things the way they used to. Don't fix something that's not broken. Or better yet, don't fix something that was already perfect! People appreciate good food at good prices.

True New York-Style Deli!  

    The sandwiches are huge and delicious with extremely generous portions of fresh meat and veggies.  

  It would be helpful if you check out their menu before you go because they have a lot of different offerings.

  Great coffee.  Fresh bread.
GO!!!

Hands down one of my favorite Starbucks locations. Staff is always friendly and work quickly to get your order. It's usually busy during the morning so if you're in a hurry, place a mobile order from the app!

I wanted to try this place because I heard the food was good. We were seated with menus and no one came back. We watched other wait staff working, rolling, silverware, ect. After 20 mins we asked for the manager. She was somewhat apologetic but not too concerned. I don't know how the food is because we didn't even get to try it. The service is terrible.  1 table was complaining about the food, and 2 tables walked out the same time we did.

Although I've never visited the south, I'm pretty positive this is the standard of barbecue they so often boast and Philly definitely lives up to that standard.  I got an ambitious full rack of ribs, the mac-n-cheese, coleslaw, a cucumber and tomato salad, and cornbread.

All the sides were fantastic and I would honestly order just them the next time I go back.  The cucumber and tomato salad was better than how most Mediterranean restaurants do it, the mac-n-cheese was creamy and delicious, the coleslaw was fresh and crisp, and the cornbread...let's just say the other reviewers aren't lying when they say it's the best they've ever eaten.

As for the ribs, they were definitely fall-off-the-bone and juicy and the vinegary sauce was spot on, but I wasn't crazy about the smoked flavor of the meat itself.  It was a little too heavy for me, but that's really just personal preference.

If you're looking for authentic BBQ in an unlikely (and I mean very unlikely) place, this is the place to go.

Went to The Common on a Saturday night for a late dinner - ended up ordering a pile of appy's instead. The atmosphere was really lovely, it's truly a beautiful place to go...however the food was not very good at all. We had:

Calamari - This was the best calamari I've had anywhere. Spicy mixed with sweet fruits and a lovely dip. Would order this again. 

Truffle Popcorn - A $6 bowl of semi-burnt popcorn. Was not impressed.

Antipasto Platter - Everything on the plate was so spicyyyyy. The 2 cheeses on the plate were blue cheese and another 'bitter' type cheese, so we weren't very happy about that. 

Brie Cheese - This was so disappointing. Brie is my favourite cheese, all warmed up and gooey. The plate of cheese we received were pieces of chopped up, hard brie with soggy strawberries. Not impressed, again. 

Drinks - We had a LOT of drinks, almost all of the drinks we ordered off the menu tasted very earthy, or like grass. It was not very good. We ended up just ordering plain drinks, not off the menu after the 8 we tried. 

Service - Server seemed unimpressed to be there, however was a bit friendlier after she got a good tip from the very drunk guy at our table. When we sat down she took our drink order, but walked away even though we were ready to order appetizers saying she'd "be back". We were hungry and I was confused why she couldn't just take both. 

The general consensus from our table was that The Common is spicy, moldy(cheese) and grassy. I don't think that we'll return.

So I got a large...not sure I can walk back to my car the husband is gonna have to roll me! Our uber driver said we had to come and we are glad we did. I had the roast beef which was excellent. Husband got the Reuben, also excellent but he wished he had gotten something else since he can get a Reuben at home and not an oyster po' boy.

My husband and I are staying on the North Shore of O'ahu and we're looking for a place for some good coconut shrimp. Did we score!! We stopped at Kahuna Grill, and boy did we pick right!! First of all, our order was taken by a lovely young lady named Alyssa! She explained our choices such as rice or home fries, additions we can add to our salads, the dressing and sauces. I had the Coconut Shrimp and hubby had a combo of Coconut Shrimp and Garlic Shrimp!! YUM!!! Alyssa came out to make sure all was tasting good and if we needed anything. If you want great food made and served by genuinely nice people, you need to visit Kahuna Grill, BUT MAKE SURE YOU LEAVE ROOM FOR THEIR DELICIOUS HOMEMADE CHOCOLATE CHIP BANANA BREAD that's also TO DIE FOR!!! You won't be sorry!!
Love the Gluten-free cupcakes here!  The icing is creamy and rich.  I even froze the cupcakes and thawed them later- still delicious!

As a lifelong Hoosier, it was hard for me to believe this kind of beauty was available north of Brown County! Wonderful park with lots of great trails and views. The lake is stunning, and the entry fee is extremely affordable. If you're an Indy resident who enjoys the outdoors, this is definitely a must see!

I took away 1 star because of the way every item (appetizers, soup & dinner items)was served within a minute of each other. 
All the food was delicious with the exception that the soft shell crabs were overpowered by the grease in the fryer.
The atmosphere/interior is wonderful. The server was very helpful and friendly. 
Will definitely go again BUT demand adherence to serving each course independently

TL;DR: Unremarkable food and spotty, inconsistent service. Made for a disappointing New Orleans night out. 

Had an 8:30pm reservation and arrived a little early. They seated us (party of 2) within a few minutes but strangely, we had to settle our bar tab before we could go sit down - why they couldn't just add the drinks to our bill is a matter. 

Things went downhill after we were seated. A parade of servers stopped by to introduce themselves and assure us we'd have water and menus right away. Took a good 10 minutes for the water to show up and another 5 for someone to bring a menu. One of the servers came back a few minutes later and took our order which included an appetizer. He promised we'd have bread right away. 20 minutes goes by, no bread, no appetizer. App finally shows up, I ask about bread again and am told they're waiting on it to bake. Someone finally comes with bread and - you guessed it - it's stone cold. 

Entree arrives a solid 45 minutes after we were seated (but only 5 minutes ahead of the 5-person table next to us who were seated less than 20 minutes ago). 

Food was unremarkable. I had Chargrilled Hanger Steak that was was over done; my daughter had the swordfish which was good but not above average. 

Server eventually came to clear our plates after we had been sitting for at least 10 minutes not eating. I asked for the check, paid and left. 

Overall a big disappointment for the one and only night I had in New Orleans. If the food had been better, I could have overlooked the poor service. But it was clear that a 2-party table was given intentionally poor service compared to larger (and more profitable) tables.

The dessert is not bad but not worth the trouble. We went here twice. The first time we enjoyed our dessert but several items were not available. 
The second time we placed an order and the waitress came back with parts of the order missing. She did not inform us that items were unavailable and seemed reluctant to provide any information as to which items on the menu were available. She reminded me that they close in 15 minutes and they have no time to prepare items on the menus. 
If you do not want to sell me your desserts, I will not be back!

If I could give this boutique no stars I would! I had the worse experience I have ever had in my life at this bridal salon. When I first picked out my dress the two ladies (Devon and Alice) were sweet nice and made me feel so comfortable with my decision! After looking for months I had finally found the dress of my dreams! My interaction with Alice the entire time was amazing; however I do feel as though I was racially profiled by the owner Ashley. When I would entire the store she wouldn't even speak, she treated me as if I was bothering her every time I came for a alteration. Today was my final fitting I felt so uncomfortable that I barely looked in the mirror to view my dress because I wanted to leave out the store so bad. I have never ever been treated this way especially after spending 2,000.00$. I noticed on other sites that every African American customer felt the same way as me, and despite being informed of this prior )because I had such a wonderful experience with Alice and Devon) I ignored it and I deeply regret it. After taking my dress home today I cried because the way she treated me made me feel like not only did she not care because she had been paid but I felt like she completely ruined my dress shopping experience something I have looked forward too throughout my whole wedding process. I do not recommend this shop to anyone especially African American women. You will not be treated well at all. Please learn from my experience. Alice deserves to work somewhere different she was a pleasure.

This Kingsway's Thai Express always mess up my order somehow and to be honest not sure why am I keep going this place. I'll make short. So far I got ; Fried rice without any flavour of salt, watery-mushy "fried" rice, tofu fried rice with fish taste in it, etc.
I love Thai Express and if you're a fan too, avoid this location.

I've been going to Anju Threads for the past few months now to get my eyebrows threaded.  I've always like the space (though small, always clean) and the customer service, both the receptionist and the threader are pleasant and courteous.  

However,  I'm really not impressed with Dimples threading skills.  I agree with other reviewers, she does an OK cleaning job, but doesn't really give a good shape.  I've also had issues with my brows being even.  One of them always comes out a little different and thinner than the other, which is really frustrating for me since it costs $13 to get them done.  

I've read that Anju does a great job, and since I really like the establishment I will consider getting my brows done by her in the future, but I'm no longer confident in Dimples's ability to do more than a so-so job.

I have eaten BBQ all over the states and I can say hands down one of the top three BBQ places I have ever eaten . I can certainly say this best BBQ in Nashville , bar none . Not comerical crap like the so called best ( Jacks ) over prices crap . This place is nice and cozy , settled in the up and coming area . Friendly doesn't even describe the staff and the owner whom we shared a cold one with while chatting it up with some local folks before leaving .  Must have Nashville experience .
Decent breakfast food. Chicken fajita omelet was great. Would recommend. Comes with fruit salad and potatoes which were surprise bc it didnt mention that in the menu.

The left half of my front bumper was torn off yesterday morning.  For insurance reasons, I was forced to run around to 3 different places to get estimates.  Central was my first stop and they were WONDERFUL!  Great customer service.  Skip got my estimate put together and even did a temporary (but still very secure) fix for my bumper so that I can drive it around until it is more permanently fixed.  All of this was completed in less than 30 minutes!  Considering the day I was having, it was a great experience.

Also, just in case it matters, I'm a young 20-something female with 0 car knowledge.  I was still treated with respect and things were explained to me.  I thought this might be an important thing for those of you who are car-clueless like me!

Beautiful, restaurant​ but a bit noisy​y.  I went for a business dinner--I guess I expected more. 
We started our dinner with two shrimp​ delicately​ placed on a plate.  Wedge of lemon and a smear of seafood sauce.​
Salad of field greens, cinnamon walnuts, Parmesan curl.  Hard bread with parmesan that had been melted. Warm rolls were served with butter.
Dinner I selected the prime steak.  I am not sure about you but I expected my steak to have marbling but a big piece of fat on the side--well not so much.  The steak was chewy without any seasoning.  I tried adding salt but the shakers were clogged and I was unable to add this seasoning.  
Dessert- Cheesecake with a slight drizzle of Carmel​ sauce.
For an overpriced dinner,​ I expected so much more.
For the price of this dinner,​ I could purchase a steak and cook it myself with some seasoning and eat in the privacy​ of my home.

This is your run-of-the-mill fro-yo place where you put however many flavors in the cup and then dump your toppings in before finding out how much of a pig you are as you pay $9 for your glutenous sundae.  (No offense- I speak from experience)

Here is my problem with this place- everywhere else gives you a sample cup so you can choose your flavor.  They used to do this, then they started making you request a sample cup, and now they have someone come out to the flavors and dole out the samples themself because some starving Penn student inevitably made their $9 sundae free of charge in a tiny thimble (...of course, I'm only theorizing).  
This wouldn't bother me except that I feel like if I didn't pick the flavor I want within a 2-3 attempts, I feel like a glutenous pig even before I tip the fro-yo scale...

I only gave this 4 stars because no one is perfect. I am a Boise native so I know how unappealing most of the Asian restaurants around here are. My husband is from Seattle by way of the Philippines so we have had some really good Chinese food and this place is the best Chinese restaurant by far in Boise and I'm pretty sure we have tried them all. The food is always fresh always tastes amazing the service is impeccable even on a Saturday night when the place was completely full!

I visited this spot on a Sunday evening... around 5:00 pm and every single table minus a table for two was taken.  We were seated promptly and our waitress took our order quickly.  She was great... very nice and friendly.  The pizza came to the table in no time and was warm, but not as hot as one would expected a pizza straight from the oven.  It looked really good and smelled great too.  I took my first bite and was disappointed in the doughy texture of the pizza.  It was not crispy as one would imagine when looking at the pizza.  The sauce was too acidic for my taste as well.   The pizza was not bad and I would consider visiting this place again, but I certainly would not go out of my way to eat at Zavino.  The atmosphere is great and the crowd was quite lively and attractive, but the taste of the pizza did not deliver on its visual promise.

I ordered the beef sandwich which was mostly fat and sauce and I did not like that whatsoever. I would have liked to have a lot more meat on that sandwich I guess I will try their ribs next time. The service was very nice and friendly however and that is what will make me go back and try the ribs.

I'm not sure how much of a difference a yelp review can make with a chain but I'm at this location almost everyday. This last Friday the computer never printed out my order that was made in store and I waited a long time for my things when I was asked what I ordered. They got right on making everything the machine had failed to print out and ever since they have since covered my coffee three times. They are the nicest staff who really cares about their customers. They care to keep their regulars happy and if something goes wrong they do what they can to make up for it. Nothing like this would deter me in general because ITS JUST COFFEE.

A great Groupon brought me here - woo hoo! 

Kathy is kind, sweet, genuine, a great conversationalist & an awesome hairdresser. 

She listened to what I wanted & gave me exactly that!   My color is perfect & I love my blow out! 

The shop location is great, as is the town it's in. 

Kathy didn't try to sell me on any of her products and gave me a nice price for next visit. 

She also made some styling suggestions Ill use. 

Lastly, we're both animal lovers.   Her sweet boy, Teddy, keeps her company at her inviting shop. 

A definite SCORE!

I am IN LOVE with this place! I already went there 3 times since it opened and I just can;t get enough.. This place is the ultimate relaxing spot for a nice summer evening. I can't say getting a hammock is easy (OMG this place is packed every time i go!) but once you get your hand on one of these hammocks or lounging chair, it is just awesome! The place is very clean, it has games for all and there is a lot of security which avoid the "crazies" to do their thing. 

This place is open every day during the summer from 11AM to 1AM. I love that they have events organized all throughout summer and I am very excited about going to one of their "under the stars" movie screening. 

FYI- Do carry alcohol out in the open in the park, they WILL kick you out, I saw it from my own eyes!

Question to all: Why are kids still out on a weekday after midnight?!

Let me start by saying the staff at Bombashe are awesome. They were very attentiveand professional. Second the restaraunt is very nice and very classy. 
With that said, the food was the worst I had ever eaten. We had a $35 groupon for Bombasha . So we gave it a try. The meats were fatty and greasy . The sides were bland and over cooked. The chicken tasted like the pork. The pork tasted liked the beef. And even after the $ 35 was subtracted the meal (for 2) was nearly $80 .
 I have never had a worst overpriced meal.

I never expected this place to be so good.  It's just the right amount of food and oh so tasty.  The atmosphere is the best for a cool lunch with clients or colleagues.  The location is one of Nashville transformation success stories, The Gulch.  I tend to be a plain Jane on my food choices, so I can only recommend the simple items.  They were still excellent!

As soon as you walk into the shop, you just know its going to be good! The cakes on display are nothing short of spectacular. Clearly the owner is extremely creative and can create just about anything! I left with a pink lemonade cupcake this time for my hubby, which I had to eat more than half of!! MMM MM. Also great place to buy treats for clients - talk about winning points! You'll love it!

I went to Red Door on a whim, I was on a girls trip from Columbus, OH and the bar was within walking distance of my hotel.  It was Superbowl Sunday and the game was on; the bartenders were really cool and the beers were nice and cold.  The bartenders gave us a free shot with our first round and later gave us bottle coozies with the bar logo.

I would go back in a heartbeat, it was a cool local bar that didn't mind having some out of towners bellied up to the bar.  Awesome prices 2 for 1 beers and well drinks.

Only reason 4 stars instead of 5 is that they allow indoor smoking (but, it was ventilated REALLY well, my clothes didn't even stink)

I decided to check out this nail salon in my neighborhood, and I am SO GLAD that I did! I had a pedicure with Lynn and a gel manicure with Tina, and I was PAMPERED! Lynn did an amazing leg and foot massage on me, and Tina made my nails look perfect for an upcoming event. The salon is very cute, and I had a relaxing time, which is essential. I will be back, and I will be telling my friends!!!

We ordered 2 slices of pizza and side salads

Pizza had lousy crust and was luke warm. Salad was mediocre.

Service was great, though. Very friendly.  
Maybe try something else... Or somewhere else.

Go to Vieux Carre Pizza for pizza.  

Gelato looked good.
Awesome. Bartender Ara is great- bar is the best seat. Order chowder, mussels, fish and chips!!!

I have enjoyed every trip I've made to Pearl Cafe. They get very crowded at lunch time, but it is worth it. Their lunch specials are a great deal and still have the quality (and are as filling!) as the dinner menu. 
Honestly, I've enjoyed every dish I have tried at Pearl. The more veggies the better, as their ingredients are fresh and cooked just long enough to maintain their crunch. 
I have not tried the spice challenge, but it is entertaining to watch when others try it.  While the location is out of the way for me, I'm always up for the detour north of 270. It's worth it.

Well the food was okay nothing to write home about the service was poor. Our bill was $80 for 2 adults and honestly it was not worth it. I don't mind spending money especially on sushi but for the quality of rice and fish it was not worth $80. Not sure we will be back.

Our garage door broke about a week after we moved in and I figured we'd need a whole new door. Needless to say I wasn't thrilled as I had used another service at our previous house and spent about $1,000. The tech showed up and was able to fix the door for the cost of a service call and a $10 part. He was efficient, friendly and could have charged me so much more and I wouldn't have been the wiser. Excellent, honest service - that's priceless. I'm a customer for life. Honestly, if I could give them more than 5 stars I would.
This Copeland's is brand new, built from the ground up. It's very nice! They've added a cafe to the entrance of the restaurant which is pretty cool. The food was good and so was the service.

This restaurant is in a nice location at the Santa Barbara Harbor. The views are good and the atmosphere is very vibrant. It is popular; hence, there can be a lot of noise. We found it difficult to have a conversation because of the noise, but we enjoyed the atmosphere nevertheless. The food was very good, especially the clam chowder. It was probably the best clam chowder that I have ever had. There were lots of clam pieces. The chowder had a lot of solid ingredients. The texture was great. The flavor was outstanding. I would come back solely for the clam chowder. We also had mahi mahi, sea bass, and a seafood pasta dish between the three of us. We were all satisfied with our dishes. We would recommend fewer noodles and more seafood in the pasta dish, but it was still a good dish. The service was fairly good and reasonably attentive. The prices were also reasonable. Overall, we enjoyed the experience and will return. I recommend this place.

I would give a 0 if I could. Walked in signed in front desk. There was only 3 clients in the back no one on the floor. I waited 20 minutes not one person said hello how may I help your or advised how long the wait would be. No customer service. Second time I walked in this place and walked out. Horrible service!!!!!

We've been here a few times with our kids and with family when they come visit. We have been doing a taco tour of Tucson and somehow end up just coming back to Seis. Their food is so good! And not just the tacos- which are fantastic- but also taquitos, nachos, fish, breakfast burritos, and drinks. Their meats and calabacitas are perfectly seasoned. Their sauces complete the dishes. And my son eats the guacamole like it was an entree. Seis us landed in our top 3 for best tacos we've found in Tucson. We are loosely following the AZ daily star's YouTube suggestions for which places to try. 
I live the atmosphere here at San Augustin plaza. Great little shops. Seating can be tricky on a busy weekend or during the gem and mineral show or U of A parent weekends. The plaza also has a streetcar stop and tugo rental bikes for easy travel around the downtown and 4th ave area. Lots of parking too.

I recently completed a month-long yoga/healthy eating challenge at Balance and it was a wonderful experience. For a measly $99 I got help cleaning up my diet, healthy recipes, and unlimited yoga. There are many different styles of classes, ranging from very challenging to deeply relaxing.  I highly recommend this yoga studio and the yoga/healthy eating challenge. It's definitely made a difference in my long term eating habits.

These guys do amazing work.  I had a 200 year old FQ home that they did the stairs and railing for.  The look period correct and amazing.  Turned it around from initial meeting to complete in less than 2 weeks at a price that was well worth it.  I highly recommend their services to anyone building or renovating a home in need of stairs, railings, or stair parts!
A++++ service and product!
Yogurt was bland and the girl behind the counter seemed annoyed that I interrupted her computer time - lost a sale.
Cheesesteak was dry and undercheesed. Service was extremely slow. Staff was really friendly.
My husband and I went here for dinner tonight. The food was fresh and delicious. The service was friendly and fast. We will definitely be back .

We had the worst experience at this 'resort' and we wont be returning. The water was off for 90% of our 3 night stay, the staff was exceedingly and constantly rude. We picked this spot as it was half way in between Solvang and Santa Barbara and as a nice relaxing vacation but it was the worst experience. I don't recommend and won't recommend this park to anyone.

We went there because if was on the FN best thing I ever ate. The food was good, but the ordering process was very unorganized. There are two doors, but you are supposed to go through the front. They should take two seconds and write a sign that says go to the front door. 

You we supposed to grab a number when you walk in. This was not clear and so the sweet lady at the counter had to keep explaining it. 

There were two sweet ladies doing everything  (cooking, taking orders, collecting payment, telling people to come to from door, explaining the number system) and one random guy working at the bar that didn't really seem to be going much. 

My sister and her husband arrived about 5 minutes before us and because a bottleneck formed within those 5 minutes, they ate and left about 45 minutes before we were able to order. 

Bottom line is the food is really good (not close to the best thing I ever ate). I feel bad because the Food Network segment was a blessing and a curse. They got publicity, but you can't keep outdated systems when you are drawing a large crowd.
Renovations are happening....Guiness and shuffle board what more could a girl want.

Real divey location in the Warehouse District but DAMN do they have some kickass BBQ.  I had the ribs and they were fall off the bone tender.  Delicious!  Beer selection was a bit pathetic but their draft box was broken so I'll give them a pass.  Oh and get the mac and cheese.  Its not on the menu but YUM!

This place was awesome! The service was great no complaints and the staff were so nice! The fried chicken.... OMG... the fried chicken!! It takes 25 minutes but it's so delicious! Brandon and I both had the same thing only he had the regular version which is a 1/2 chicken and i just had white meat so there were 2 chicken breasts. 
I had a salad to start and Brandon had the chicken soup both were very good, the meal came with a basket of various buns and corn bread :) which was very tasty! Our main course came with mashed potatoes and some vegetables but we opted out of those... after all we're eating fried chicken!
All that food and 2 drinks came to $23 !!!! THAT'S CRAZY!!!!!
Awesome place, and it's right down the street from us we will definitely be back!

I don't know what it is about the Copeland's Cheesecake Bistro in New Orleans but each year I go there around Essence Festival time the service gets worse. We arrived at 8:10pm Sunday 2nd.....I asked for a pager to be notified when table was ready...they had none....reassured us that we could sit in the bar and the hostess would come get us...25 minutes passed and upon approaching the hostess she informed me that our name was called twice......theme for the night...WAITING.....didn't get our food until nearly 10pm....appetizer came 5 minutes before entree...my sister was trying to get her free birthday dinner while she was in town and they told her to come back Monday.....REALLY after that type of service WHY would you come back....it's a shame because this restaurant WAS one of my go to spots when I'm in New Orleans....I hope they get it together.

First timer. Won PSL flag championship and went there around 1030. Absolutely amazing. I'm a Steve's steaks kind of guy but this has taken the #1 spot in my heart. Solid pricing. The service was fantastic and very welcoming. I will recommend this to everyone. Great establishment.

It was nice, well done.  A bit overpriced, but it was kitschy and fun.  Kinda dirty/muddy so don't wear your Sunday best.  But the food was plentiful and quite ripe.  We went in late July and the tomatoes, berries, squash, corn, eggplant, squash, peaches and nectarines.  Total price was like $70.  The market is really nice too, again a bit pricey but it was really neat.  Definitely worth a trip w the kiddies.

My prior experiences here were excellent, but after my last visit I have to write an update. We went for brunch on new years without a reservation and they told us we could sit at the bar or wait about 15 minutes for a table- we chose to wait. When they seated us, it was at a table in their recently renovated outside area which is now semi-closed in. There were gas heat lamps blasting us from above, and freezing cement chilling us from below. This was definitely a seating arrangement we should have been warned of before assuming we would prefer it over the bar or going elsewhere. When we mentioned it was cold, they offered to let us move further from the door, but still pretty much outside. At one point a member of the staff breezed through and ran outside leaving the door completely open. The food has fallen in quality here as well and they brought my friend the wrong burger and then didn't really remake it. They still have a pretty amazing cream cheese glazed sticky bun though.

Very rude management as should have listen to my friend Matt as this place is horrible. Very over priced for a run down apartments that have never been updated in years. The company they have bought them out is from Colorado as they don't care what the management team does. All this company cares about is money and money. All the pipes in the ground need to be replaced as storage rooms for washer/dryer hook ups. The roofs need to be replaced as they are all old. The dishwasher and toilets are not great as plumbing sucks in there. When you comment or make a complaint with them they always say the same thing. People let there kids do whatever they want and no parents watch there kids outside. People always doing drugs or drinking outside. Parents get drunk as no life guard or anyone bye pool area to watch people. People smoking right by buildings, which is a health hazard. When you want to move, then they start harrasing you with all charges on you and they try to ruin your credit. They charge you even when you give them more then 90 day notices. When you have problems with neighbors they don't care and all they say is call the cops. This place is a joke and it is sad because this is supposed to be a great neighborhood with district, but Monarch Investments is ruining it with making it to be run down Fenton in St. LOUIS COUNTY! SAD FOR THE GREAT SCHOOL DISTRICT BECAUSE OF THE HOOSIERS THEY LET MOVE IN. This place has been there since I was a little girl, but have been built a very long time ago and when I walked in for a tour it never changed as still the same exact apartment I seen since I was young as surprised they never update or even made it bigger with more bedrooms for construction.

So many "casual" restaurant have such similar menus, such similar price points, such similar uninspiring but decent food. Thsi is one of them, interchangeable with so many other (even chains). The wait staff was attractive, friendly and helpful. Other than that . . . My 71st Street Club Salad was actually deficient when compared to comparable sandwiches at other joints, but the burgers, wraps, etc. looked exceedingly edible but far from memorable.

First of all,  the atmosphere at this restaurant is very nice,  relaxed, clean and welcoming,  and the kind and friendly woman at the register, Sarita (Also owner) reflects these sentiments wonderfully.
The food here is very fresh and full of flavor,  the bread is soft and crispy in Just the right way to make your mouth water to have another bite, I am very impressed, and look forward to coming back,  do yourself a favor and come try it, it's so Good I'd drive up here from the San Fernando Valley to enjoy it again,  oh and I must not forget to mention the home made sauces they have,  and the in house kettle cooked chips that go Great with them, what sauces you ask? Come and try,  you won't regret it!  :)

No frills to this place, just some ladies who are basically cat whisperers and treated my cat so kind and loving during her first lion's cut. I had a few specifications on how I wanted her cut and they did a great job with them. They gave me great tips and advice and are clearly lifelong cat-lovers. Prices were a few bucks better than others I'd seen and they fit me in same day.

It was a little dingy-dirty inside which made it feel less professional and I'll knock off a star for it. I am very happy with the service, just wished they were a little more tidy.

This place is great! The owner as well as the staff is very friendly and always helpful. The food that I have tried is awesome; fried zucchini, pizza, chicken and shrimp basket, mozzarella sticks and wings! 

The games keep the kids busy and the beer selection is good. Last time I went a few games were down but there was still plenty to do.
Cute atmosphere and excellent food.  Highly recommend.  Healthy and unhealthy options, juice, wine, and unique food.

We were on state street and we stopped by here to eat something, and really regretted it. We wanted to try something new so we got the sea urchin and the jellyfish. It was not my preferred taste so I returned it. Once I gave it back, another waiter came by with the dish and scolded us for returning it, and made an entire scene. He said "so you are not going to pay for this? Someone is going to have to pay for this." It was the worst dining experience I have had in a long time. He belittled us, and made us buy something that we didn't even want. Not only was the service horrible, but the food as well. My friends got some sushi rolls and they were not good at all. Fish was definitely not fresh. I left the restaurant in a bad mood, and I do not recommend this place at all.

First, I LOVE that they are open late until 10. Before I started coming here, I tried to go to Pho & More 2 that took place after Pho Hoa closed down. Pho & More 2 closed at 10 as well, but when my friend and I tried to go eat there, it was 9:05 and they couldn't take us anymore, only if we wanted take out. Ridiculous! I don't even want to get into that. 

I work late, and I always crave for pho after 9. The first time I came here, they had just opened in July 2012. I came here with my family, and this was when Pho Hoa first closed so you can imagine how packed it was. All of the old workers even worked there! But since it was so crowded, I didn't appreciate their lack of service from their many waiters and I did not enjoy my pho. 

I came back to try it with my boyfriend this time last month since I did NOT want to visit Pho & More 2 again, I enjoyed everything! The owner is this adorable, short old man who welcomed us and sat us down. The waiters were excellent and I enjoyed the pho very much! The price is very reasonable too. Although they close at 10, I have seen people come at 9:50 and still take them! 

Ever since, this has been my go-to pho place!

Woman taking our order was unbelievably fucking rude - said they were closed and it was 9:10 pm. We understand that restaurants like to close when they put their hours on the door, but this was absolutely uncalled for. This was our third time in Santa Barbara and this was such a unbelievable disappointment.

My youngest son had surgery here Wednesday. I was terrified being that none of my children have ever had surgery. The staff was extremely friendly and accomodating. They made my son feel comfortable and did their best to ease his mind. The procedure was very quick. I sat in the waiting room for approximately 20 minutes begore they called me back to help awaken him. Once his surgery was over the staff thoroughly explained everything to me and answered all of my questions. A gentleman wheeled him out to my car and being that my son was numb from the waist down, he even lifted him and put him in the car for me. I left pretty relieved. This was a really stressful day for me and thankfully this place didn't add to it.

Im only giving it a 2 star because the waitress was nice otherwise it would be a 1! Maybe it was because the place was busy but it shouldn't be an excuse. #1- I ordered shrimp etouffee.. about 30 minutes later they come to tell me they are out of shrimp etouffee!! #2- O ordered the chargrilled oysters and stuff mushrooms.. both came back burnt!!! The oysters were charred! The mushrooms burnt and the cheese on the mushrooms was burnt. #3- we were a party of 3 and they sat us in a tight spot in a small table. #4-I ordered a Dixie lager and they were out. #5- we got there at 5pm and we didn't get our food until about 6:30 and we had to rush and eat because we had a tour at 7pm. So overall I was pretty bummed and irritated! Not worth the $156.00 tab.

We usually carry out from the Copper Chimney in St. Peters, but we decided to place an order at Kebab N Kurry for a change to compare.  We ordered Lamb Vindaloo HOT, Chana Dal, Chicken Korma and the obligatory Biryani.  I can't remember whether they had Bharta which is a very tasty eggplant dish.  The portions were good and comparable to other Indian places.  Food was very good and would definitely order from here again.  I think the upper hand goes to Copper Chimney but I am not kicking Kebab N Kurry to the curb.  I will be back here.  It is great to have a few Indian options in the St. Charles and St. Peters area.  Prices were good also, $$.

I'm excited for a new and more reasonably priced brunch option in the area. Their staff has already been very friendly even though they aren't fully functional yet. I can only speak for their beignets at this point and say that they rock.

So, there is this divey Penn bar called Smokey Joe's, which I used to think was a BBQ place. Maybe they used to have BBQ food, but I am not one to know. But on this particular day I was in search for a place where the pizza was good and it was sit down style. I have a good delivery place, but it's not a table service type of joint.

So, I came across Enjay's Pizza. Here's the thing, it's called Enjay's because it started out as a food truck by this name. Somewhere, the Enjay guy and Smokey Joe's had a beer (my imagination), and Enjay said, "Dude, it would be awesome if I could have your kitchen to make my pizza in. I am tired of working in a truck." And, Smokey replied, "Well, our food sucks, it's all yours." But Enjay was not ready to give up his name, so you go to Smokey Joe's, but Enjay wants you know, it's his darn pizza.

Well, good for Enjay for making sure to get credit where credit is due. The silver lining in this divey bar is Enjay's Pizza! It's some good stuff! Seriously, if I were still a college student, I might live inside this place. I love pizza. And, I used to love beer. But I am an old dude with a family who more likes beer these days. But I still love pizza!

I have been to Joann a couple times now and I love that they have everything!  I walked in and said "wow!"  Although, I do love the store and that they seem to have everything, their customer service is lacking. The store is very busy and the employees are not very helpful and I almost feel like I'm bothering them. Maybe they're not staffed appropriately???
Get the Bubble Waffle and the Grits. perfect combo.  Doesn't sound like much but this waffle was the best I've had. You won't be disappointed.
Best big-chain pizza in the area. Just needs a delivery service and it's a 5 star review for me!

This is my home-base shop. I get everything there. Mods, juice, advice. I would still be a smoker, happily on my way to lung cancer, if it weren't for the team at E-cigs. They're friendly and know a lot. Taught me how to have a safe RDA, taught me how to charge my batteries safely. Saved my ass for sure. 

Can't recommend this shop highly enough.

Went for lunch, ordered Ruben and substituted Ceasars salad for fries. Salad was good. Ruben had wet corned beef that soaked the bottom bread. sauerkraut was well proportioned cheese and dressing under proportioned. Service was slow and the waitress seemed overwhelmed. Took as long to get bill after meal as it did to get food.

Good cheesesteak - make sure you are ready to order - One Whiz With (Cheesesteak w cheese and onions) - priced right and fresh. Best w/ extra cheese n onions. Tight space and lines long but fast moving.

This is the 3rd (and most recent I think) location of the Carniceria Guanajuato grocery/restaurant chain.  I visited the grocery store yesterday and was impressed by their vast selection of hispanic products.  Prices seem very reasonable too.  I left with a good number of grocery items for under $20.  

They have a large restaurant space connected to the grocery store.  I unfortunately didn't have time to try anything but definitely want to go back.  I'll update the review with my thoughts on the food once I do.

Dadeo's has long beem a favourite restaurant of mine. This city seems to have few independent restaurants that offer a compelling product, have any character at all, and are priced very competitively. I believe that Dadeo's meets these criteria. 
There are plenty of neat, smaller, snazzy restaurants, but not too many that are priced well enough that they can be enjoyed frequently.

I have never been to the American South, so I have no idea whether or not their representation of it is "authentic" or not, but regardless, they offer a varied and interesting menu. I normally get the combination plate for a little variety or opt for a Po Boy sandwich with sweet potato fries. I can't comment on much else, but those options are pretty great. And if you come on a Monday or Tuesday, their Po Boys are discounted.

The restaurant itself is American South retro themed, but not in a cheesy way that you could imagine a chain doing. It's very narrow, with bench seats either accommodating groups of 2 or 4. They can also bring a chair for a 5th. Not sure if they have larger tables than that or not, but I don't think so. It's also very busy so try to make a reservation.

But any fault with the restaurant would be minor; especially considering that there are few, if any restaurants of its kind in Edmonton. Plus so many in this city have a love for junky chain restaurants, so the little guys need to be supported.

Great food and good service. 
However, we did wait a bit to order. When we did order, a gentleman in our group ordered tostadas but Daniel, the waiter either didn't hear him correctly or our gentleman didn't speak up enough. Either way, our guy got tostaditas which were nachos and not what he wanted. 
Now, normally a waiter would simply apologize and get the correct item. But Daniel made a point of arguing that our guy didn't order the right thing, then brought a menu over to "show our guy what he really wanted versus what he ordered. You know, for next time."
Daniel constantly made a point of telling our guy that our guy was wrong and that "next time he'll order the right thing". Even when he brought the check!
It put quite a damper on our lunch. We'll go back, but we will request to not be in Daniels section.
I love the food here. It's always the best quality and quantity. I love the way its decorated which is refreshing and calming. Best place to eat.
They treat my animals like I would treat my animals. Everytime they give great advice, plus it's affordable.

My girlfriends and I went here after one of our conference days. We shared many dishes and were not disappointed! The gumbo was so tasty and full of flavor! The jambalaya and étouffée really hit the spot. Rice and beans were ok. If they have bread pudding, get it. The portion is small so don't share that dessert! So gooooood!

We stopped in with friends for a pre dinner cocktail. Their custom craft cocktails were delicious! We each ordered two and were totally impressed. The bartenders are friendly and entertaining. The atmosphere is way cool and spot on for this area of town. We will definitely be back!

About a week ago I visited Imperial for a friend's 21st birthday.  I arrived early, at around 8 o'clock, on a Wednesday, and all the same the place was packed! The energy of Imperial is constant.  The ambience is fun and trendy; with friendly staff and modern brew-pub-esque furniture.  The food was decent at best, but the service was excellent!  The drinks kept right on coming at a steady pace right as we ordered them.  I would recommend Imperial to somebody who wants to be downtown in a happening place that's always full of people.  For Reno it is definitely pretty great.  Also, they have some pretty killer deals that my boyfriend really went for, like 25 cent wings on Wednesdays.  The place is comfortable, the seating is pretty expansive and the environment is fun and lively.

Take out or eat in, Mings is the top of my list.  So convenient and delicious food. Always hot!! Love the size of the dining room and the staff work so hard to get it right!! Well... you did!! I'm a fan when I come in town... Mings is my Chinese restaurant!!!

The food is amazing but for some reason they only offer decaf coffee via a pour over and it seriously takes them longer than anyplace in the city to make it. 

How about you just make decaf coffee?? And save us all the frustration of watching the baristas dick around. Tinker Street decaf blend is amazing.

I hit a pothole, blew a tire & bent the hell out of the rim. Had to be towed. I chose Tires Plus, because they took good care of me a couple of years ago, in a similar situation. Grey helped me today & in less than an hour, Grey sent me on my way, FREE OF CHARGE, as a "courtesy check" (unbent the wheel, re-aired the tire, & rotated the tires), and invited me to come back "the next time you have a REAL problem".  LoL, impressive!  Great customer service, Grey! We both agreed, more businesses should operate this way.  Excellent way to build your customer base, I'll be back, for sure.

Ate here months ago, started a review, forgot about it for months, and then ate here again with my wife last week.

TL;DR: Solid Indian, but nothing amazing.

In a slightly more detailed fashion; we got a pretty standard selection of curries and an order of palak paneer, all of which were good, but nothing stood out, as well as a naan, which was pretty good.

I've said this in virtually every review of an Indian place in the States but my scale has been permanently broken by a small chain of Indian-owned places in Beijing that redefine good food.

If I attempt to sandblast that memory from where it's etched in my brain, Kabob & Grill will do in a pinch for reasonably-priced and good Indian. You can do a lot worse around here.

Professional financial knowledge gauge of a Suncoast [Schools] Credit Union branch manager,

"What's Vanguard?"

Yep, we'll be closing those accounts.

If you like pickpocket bankers, who dun your accounts with fees, you'll love this place.  As Woody Guthrie said, "Some men will rob you with a six gun, some with a fountain pen."  Except, that addresses a professional depth not likely to be found at this CU.
Brand new and very clean! Great atmosphere and right next to Marina. Food was excellent. I had the Bistro Filet which was delicious !

Like this place a lot! Fan of local businesses with a homey/community feel. More than enough servers; both times I've went, someone came to ask for our drinks or our food twice. Food is good. Food portions match the prices well! Lots of menu options (as they serve all bfast, lunch, and dinner items!). Willing to come back.
I hear all the time when I come into the Marriott north is the restaurant inside the hotel they have great food good drinks beautiful waitresses highly recommended area restaurant.

My favorite burger! 

The only place that has my combination I put on burgers at home- A1 and jalapenos!

This is a regular breakfast place, nothing special or wow from their menu. Pancakes tasted regular, same as all other items that i order. I have tried multiple breakfast places including pancake pantry, The garden brunch caffe, among others and this is not one of my top choices. Price-wise is ok and service is good though.

Because everyone was so nice I'm giving it 2 not  1 star. But my nail polish came off in full large pieces a day after that manicure. The nail prep wasn't done right I'm guessing. It was awful to be peeling huge pieces of polish less than 24hours after paying for a professional mani, ugh!!

More modern appearance to the restaurant. Nice metals and earth tones. It's fairly noisy inside. Service is excellent. Plenty of waiters/waitresses around and they bring the food out all at the same time - a nice touch. 
It's on the expensive side. The meals were very good. I had a whole fish creole style that was excellent. 
The wine list is extensive, but expensive. So called sommelier was not particularly helpful. 
Chocolate peanut butter pie was a little disappointing.

I am usually a big fan of this St Louis based chain.  I will mindlessly walk through after work (after mid-night) and scan for the little yellow "sale" labels to stock up.

That is the problem with this location.  There is a 1 check-out grey haired guy working nights that goes against 100 years of grocery store logic plus trial & error.  He is the only cashier during nights he works so I can not avoid him.

On over nights he puts a shopping cart in front of the conveyor belt.  The first time I tried to check-out with a cart & moved his cart to unload he told me no "I have it there for a reason".  He would not give the reason.

On other visits with purchasing less I have used a basket & have been told to put it in the cart.  IMO- since most people are making small purchases at night his gotten tired of dealing with baskets.

The the problem is with a cart full of stuff there is no room to actually move to unload the cart. I ended up stretching across the cart to grab various items. This really annoyed me the other day I had a tweaked back.

Everyone else I have dealt with have been helpful.

The room is quite big enough. The bathroom is also clean enough. While there is almost no hot water can be used. Although we made the water run for a while and waited for several different times it's still too cold to take a bath. The price is high while breakfast and wifi still not included, which is very ridiculous. And the fitness is just at the very conner and very hard to find.

Fabulous. I love pastry and have tried all the uptown spots but these win hands down as the best. The almond croissant were wonderful, and there were other kinds of French pastry with names I don't remember but my taste buds won't forget.

Friday night: three 19 year old girls in and out within 30 minutes. 
As I am sitting at the table alone while my two friends were in the bathroom, our waitress comes to the table and without introducing herself asks if I would like a drink. 10 minutes later she comes back, and goes "all set?" Again, did not introduce herself, or ask if we have questions. Anyway, we finally get our food (not even brought by our waitress) Food was delicious and flavorful) I will give them that. Most importantly, our waitress did not check up on us once, and the bus boy was taking the plate away from me without asking if I was done, as I was taking my last bite. As we were finishing up, we noticed our waitress greet an older couple next to us completely different. She was friendly, and gave that table the time of day. 
If I can finish this review saying one thing, I would finish it with: "If you are under the age of 25, be prepared to be treated with disrespect."
Will not be back.

The potatoes tasted like they were saturated in black pepper.  My problem was that they did not have wines on their wine list.  I was told their wines were on "back order."  These wines can be purchased at a grocery store.  That is why I am giving them an average review

We celebrated a milestone birthday recently at Lacroix, and it was unlike anything else we have experienced in this area in decades. We were seated next to a window, an improvement over our last visit where we were placed in the elevated area. We also sprung for wine pairing (with the tasting menu) rather than a dedicated bottle, another enhancement.

First, the staff did everything conceivable to make the celebration memorable from start to finish, and without a trace of kitsch. Next, service was of a caliber I have rarely encountered since living in Europe several decades ago: always (except once) on the right, thoroughly professional, and unobtrusive yet attentive to a fault. The only problem is that this treatment spoils you -- our established haunts with excellent cuisine now seem coarsened by way of comparison.

Staff is also knowledgeable. Ask your server a question, and within seconds someone appears who not only has the answer, but clearly knows his or her stuff and can expound in as much detail as you could expect from a learned but genial professor.

As if this weren't enough, overall the cuisine was as credible as we have had in the area. Granted, once in the early days of Le Bec Fin we encountered comparable excellence, even if not in later visits. (Lacroix's service is also natural, inconspicuous and pleasant, in contrast to the stiffer, hovering and more formalized treatment at the erstwhile Le Bec Fin.)

An amuse bouche offering was a Virginia raw oyster nestled in a mignonette. It was the best either of us has had anytime, anywhere. Lobster prepared with curried persimmon, celery root and pumpkin was stunning, and the pistachio financier paired with an outstanding muscat came close. My wife's main course -- duck with parsnip dumpling, quince and huckleberry -- was a gift from the gods. I can but wish I had chosen it instead of beef, which was overcooked and thus robbed of most flavor. The foie gras terrine was the only other course that lacked excitement, probably because the night before we had feasted on Bibou's incomparable fresh foie gras.

Wine pairing was, overall, superb, both for quality and mating. The obviously talented sommelier explained each wine in at least as much detail as most folks might desire, with every glass being memorable except for the duck where the pairing was arguably more creative than optimal.

In all, this was an evening to remember even for a pair of long-spoiled foodies. Yet, there is one drawback: Virtually no time is left between courses. In France, and for any special occasion, the interlude between courses is central to the experience, as it gives folks a chance to interact when they are in an agreeable frame of mind (witness "Babette's Feast"). There is no way to put this gently: Lacroix rushes people through what should be a leisurely meal. Here, Bibou stands in considerable and positive contrast, although some who are used to our fast-paced culture might beg to disagree.

Withal, in our experience Lacroix is the area's top of the mark for food, wine pairing and -- pacing aside -- service. If you can swing it, polish off the evening's experience by lodging at the Rittenhouse Hotel if you don't live close by.

I went here for dinner last night on a whim, because the other chains close by don't tickle my fancy... We arrived, and were seated promptly, as the place was just about empty.  Our waiter was attentive, and nice.  So that was all pleasant.  That for me is where the pleasantries end!  First out is the salad, usually a treat for me, because I really enjoy their tangy tomato dressing.  However the salad tasted like it was rinsed off in a public pool.  It had a very strong chlorine taste to it.  I sent over half of it away.  Then my first steak comes out.  It was cooked okay, but this was one of the worst looking strip steaks I have ever seen.  It was about 40% fat, and the actual meat was so interlaced with fat/connecting tissue that it was like chewing on a piece of leather.  I sent it back, and they prepared a new steak for me.  This one comes out, and its like round two of the same damn thing.  I could have gotten a better cut of meat on sale at wal-mart than this monstrosity they call a steak.  They come over and ask me "Is it perfect", and sadly I have to be honest and tell them the hard truth that it was practically dog food grade meat.  They again apologized, and refunded my meal.  I was quite sad, because I was really hungry because I didn't have time to eat lunch yesterday.  I will say that their baked potato was pretty delicious.  That was the only positive thing I can say about any of the food here.  I don't expect this place to be like a high end steak house, but I do expect a lot better.  When I am looking at steaks in this price range, I'll be heading to Texas Roadhouse or Tuckers in the future.

10-21 stopped in for a late lunch. Lamb gyro platter and a small chicken platter . The gyro meat looked dark and old, but it tasted flavorful and savory- YUM. The chicken platter was similarly good and it was the small size. The portions were large and my wife and I  both had leftovers. Service was friendly, expedient and the store is conveniently located right down the road. Great value!

Ordered through drive through. A pretty large order. Inventorying the items after getting home, I noticed a burger was missing. So back to the store I went to get the missing burger. The person remembered me and filled the order. The manager asked if she could help me, and upon finding out the issue, turned around and avoided me. She offered no apologies and decided not to act on the discrepancy. At least the line worker apologized. Needless to say, BK is off my list, and I will drive farther to other options.
I can't believe the reviews that I'm reading.  I've taken 4 cars there in the last 7 years and all of them have come out fantastic.  I've also referred some people there and they were happy as well.

Came here on a weekday and got a table within 20 minutes. Got the goat cheese, walnut and beet salad for appetizer and it was AWESOME. Great choice that I would've never tried originally but will lol forward to trying again.

For pizza, we got the arugula and the Diablo. The Diablo was incredible- great level of spice and savory. The arugula was also very good with a great pesto crust. 

Loved the place overall!
Ownership changed. The pho was good, but the menu was a lot less diverse and the vermicelli bowl that my boyfriend didn't have a lot of meat portioned.

Well we tried them out on opening weekend.. What a disappointment...  Only thing that was good was the steak spring rolls and the beer... Service was horrible.. Food was wrong and cold... Waiter failed to tell us they ran out of bread.. We had to ask a bus boy why all the other tables had bread and we didn't..... Lets continue onto the second visit tonight... We said to ourselves they have been open a few weeks now the kinks have to be worked out.. Boy were we wrong... How do u mess up 2 $13 burgers... Both were the complete opposite of what we asked for.. Mine was so rare it was still mooing... Once again the cheese steak spring rolls and beer was great... We weren't the only ones dissatisfied.  The table next to us who was sat before we were and still didn't have their food as we were paying. They also had a bad experience. The $32 steak was not done as asked.. The well done burger was as rare as mine.. Well maybe in a few more weeks we will give them a third try.. 3 strikes and your out.. I hope that's not the case.. This place has some real potential.. I would love to make it our regular spot but with 2 horrible visits I'm not holding my breath..

I would give 5 star for the quality of the food, but knocking off a star for the limited vegetarian options. I had the vegetarian gumbo and liked the fact that they have small sized cup offerings as well. The gumbo was tasty. Also ordered the garlic potato side which was delicious as well. The service was quick and pleasant. The wait wasn't too bad either. Definitely worth a visit.

Drove by and decided to stop, needed a new spare bedroom mattress. So glad I did!!Knowledgeable and down to earth. None of the high pressure sales tactics that we all know and dread, AND no sticker shock or buyers remorse!  I will and do recommend them to my family and friends, which says volumes!

The staff was super friendly. I tried the Lotus and Whiskey Punch cocktails. Both were delicious! They only reason I gave 4 instead of 5 stars is the Red Velvet cake, which came highly recommended by the staff, was a bit on the dry side.

If you want a good burger, this is the place to go!  My friends and I go here for dinner occasionally and the food is always full of flavor and deliciousness.  I usually get the Tony Dungy burger that has mushrooms on it with sweet potato tots, yummmmm.  They also have an excellent French onion soup and their chili rocks!

I am such a fan of Chhaya, especially the elixirs the owner concocts for her hot and cold tea blends.   A blue lady hot tea with the added heaven sent elixir, which consistes of honey, lemon, ginger and black pepper is divine, and a perfect after a Yoga session at Wake Up Yoga.  I brought my son in this week and we had a beautiful cheese plate and baguette.  I got to try the Sage Mint Lime-ade that is hand made to order, so refreshing, clean and delicious.... now that I've written this review, I think its time for a little something something.  Don't miss the coffees eithers, fresh brewed, Chemex, French pressed or Siphoned, they are all outstanding.
Decided to carry out. Great service! The food was hot, tasty, and I will definitely frequent this establishment again. Great job Jockamo :-)

Omg awesome beach that is super dog friendly ! On our last trip to SoCal , we were so surprised that with the  miles and miles of coast line and numerous accessible beach fronts, that the majority of them were so against dogs !! Super disappointing. On our way up the coast , we were excited to find that Arroyo Burro beach welcomed dogs openly.

We arrived around 4 pm , so parking wasn't too much of a challenge because some people were already leaving the free lot , right in front of the beach front . Just a few steps from the parking lot the beach presents itself. As soon as our pup was free from his leash, he went straight to the surf to get his paw wet and then did a double barrel roll in the sand . It was awesome . We played for over two hours and watched the sunset as well. 

Afterwards we were able to rinse our feet at a little wash station. Bathrooms are available, and there is also a nice restaurant on site, which we got to try out and I will follow up with a review :) Looking forward to coming back again for a visit !

This is an excellent meal delivery program for anyone looking to maximize your time at home, simplify meal prep and get in shape! I don't know how they do it, but the steak is incredibly tender. One of my favorite meals is the spicy salmon.  I chose the Keto meal plan because I'm cutting back on carbs and the cauliflower mash is the best!  One of the best features of this company is that it's veteran owned and you can cancel and start anytime.  Try it!

I had my first tattoo experience here and it was great! I walked in there to talk to someone about piercings because I was feeling spontaneous and wanted to re-pierce my difficult ears. I walked out with a tattoo design and an appointment. I was greeted so nicely and talked to like an equal (sometimes people like to judge the girl with the pink flowery shirt and a bow in her hair in a tattoo shop, but I didn't feel this way at all!).  The pricing was much lower than I expected, but not alarmingly low. The design was beautiful and exactly what I had in my head, but couldn't put to paper. The day of my appointment, I was so nervous because I was getting it on my ribs, a notoriously painful spot. The guy working there that day gave me a nervous look when I told him that's where I was getting it, but as he could see I was getting more and more nervous, he distracted me. The best part was that he didn't acknowledge how nervous I was, so I forgot about it.
