We just started talking about other things that kept me distracted from not knowing what I was about to go through. When it was time to go over to the bench, he immediately asked me "what music do you want to listen to?" which was SO awesome because I was going to ask if I could put earphones in. He let me blast my favorite songs as I was getting tatted, which made this quite honestly the best first tattoo experience I could have possibly imagined. Sandy did my tattoo and she was fantastic. She talked to me and the tattoo honestly wasn't even that painful. I was super surprised, but my ribs barely hurt at all. She gave me good after care instructions and the tattoo healed perfectly. I even found out that my mom had told me the wrong date of her surgery, which I had gotten as part of the tattoo, and when I told Sandy about it, she told me she'd fix it for me for free. It's fixed now and you can barely tell it had to be touched up; it looks fantastic. High level of professionalism and I could not recommend her enough! I've caught the tattoo addiction and will be going back to her for any tattoo I get from here on out! 
Tattoo aside, every experience I've had in this store has been a good one and I've always been treated with respect.

The bottom line at this place is "Good service, bad food." I usually rate each place on a per trip basis and not really as an overall. I believe each time should be an experience.

Unfortunately, this experience was terrible. Some of our food came out burned, some of it came out cold. The good service actually came from 2 different waitresses fighting over our table. 

Since the food is really most important to me, I have no plans of going back.
Prompt,  professional staff. Very pretty hotel and grounds. I enjoy the finer things, husband likes it more casual- we were both comfortable here. Top notch, unpretentious service.
All I can say is YUM! I missed in when I was living out of state for sure... Tropical smoothie is good but just isn't blenders!

This place is SO cute!!! Newly remodeled and you can tell! Everything is beautiful, smells new, is clean and the staff is SUPER friendly. We checked in last night after making a last minute reservation. Danielle was extremely helpful, even went out onto the property herself to make sure our room was ready for us with the air conditioning turned on. This morning we had the oatmeal breakfast bar. Delicious oatmeal with tons of topping options!! Will definitely be back if we are ever in Tucson again!

Soooo to update you on things at TowYard Brewing....still LOVE the carnitas fries and their beers are growing on me. In other news, their chicken wings are amazing!  Don't picture your average weenie BDubs traditional wings--these things are HUGE, grilled, and delicious!  I was only able to eat 2 or 3 of them because they're so large.

Bad food n bad customer service too! The server who took our order was very nice lady but the person who bought food to our table was way too rude. She was not good at all at customer service.
After ordering main course we were looking for desserts in the menu & she almost snatched it from us. That was a bad experience.

In starters, we ordered fresh spring roll with tofu. It was good in taste. Egg rolls were ok! Wait time was too much to get the starters. 

Main course, I ordered drunken noodles n it was soo bland n tasteless without any seasoning. I had to ask for spice tray. I have never had plain white n dry drunken noodles in my entire life. Other dishes that my friends ordered was also just ok. We went for the first time n none of the dishes vowed us!

Dessert, we ordered sticky rice & Thai doughnuts. It was good. Prices are towards higher side. I don't think I will be coming back. Really bad experience!

The seafood is fresh which is a big pro. The con is that the "rolls" are the size of hotdog buns. Not worth it in my opinion. If you're feeling like dropping $$ on an eatery like this I highly suggest the taste of Maine. Come hungry or with a friend.

The lady at the front desk is WONDERFUL! She will explain everything if you don't understand it, they are very respectful and kind. 

Best repair place I have been to in a long time!

This was a place that I was excited to come to once I moved into the area. If my budget could support it,  I would become a regular. I love that the beer AND food menu changes frequently. The beer selection is great. 

As far as food goes, everything is great comfort food. Chicken fingers are not the typical breading and the honey mustard is good. (Although I came here on the weekend and the food was not up to weeknight par.) The avocado fries are deliciously crispy and creamy at the same time. Nice to try once, but aggravatingly small portions. I tried one of the seafood hot dogs once ... not for me but I was able to finish it. 

I want to try other hot dogs and the burger here.

Do NOT place an order through Yelp since apparently this location doesn't have the ordering system for a to-go order placed through Yelp, and you will be charged for it. Doesn't make sense why they even have the option available on the site. When I called to check the order, they just kept repeating that they don't take orders through Yelp and had no idea it was possible. I went to the location and got food but had to pay there regardless. The employees were kind about it and offered a free drink. The food was pretty sub-par though, and I wouldn't be inclined to go to this location again.

The whole experience was just ok.  We LOVED the hostess (with the mostest!), the fire dancer, Mr Lincoln (wow...what a voice!) and Swifty Deeds. The rest of the "burlesque" shows were cheesy. The supper part of the show was NOT WORTH IT! It's $50 a person for a meal that was nothing to write home about and such incredibly small portions. The 1st course was a cheese plate which consisted of 1 small slice of brie, a small spoonful of some cheese spread, a tiny slice of a pepper cheese, 1 tiny piece of pepperoni, small slice of ham and 1 piece of Melba toast. The 2nd course was 1 piece of shrimp on top of some corn salsa. 3rd (and main course) was chicken Parmesan (which was maybe half a small chicken breast worth), 1 piece of burnt garlic butter toast and dry noodles. Dessert was the smallest cup of creme brulee and 1 chocolate covered strawberry. We left starving! We will probably go back for the late night show but no way will be ever pay for the dinner show again!

I've lived here since late October 2018. My experience has been poor to say the least. 

- 1st it's very sketchy that they have no sample apartments to show before you put a nonrefundable deposit down to hold the next available apartment. 
- Once moved in you will find that the staff here will lie & deceive residents around every corner. They say just what's needed to get you out of their office with little to no follow through. You have to chase them to get things fixed. 
- Washer and dryer rooms are not secure. The locks on the doors are never working and teens are frequently using them as "hang outs". All laundry areas have broken washers and dryers. Despite reporting them via tickets.. 
- Move-in ready apartments smell like raid. STRONGLY. It gave us headaches. I was told it's something in the paint.. it took 2-3 months before I stopped smelling it. It was BAD.. 
- The initial apartment they tried to move me into had dead roaches in the kitchen cabinets and damage all throughout the apartment. The 2nd one, I found out after moving in, had roaches in the fridge.
- The apartment I ended up in had so many things wrong with it. Most importantly the shower knobs we're shocking my kids & I. It took them 4 months to get that fixed.. and MANY MANY headaches and chasing Randy, the manager, to get tjithi done right. Jobs are done by the cheapest means necessary & Randy will lie directly to you to cover up her lack of preparation/planning. She will say anything to get you out of her office truth or not.. 
- When I moved in my mailbox had no door and I immediately notified the office. It took me going to the office over 2 months regularly to get assigned a new mailbox. Up until then all my mail was being left in an open mailbox for anyone to access. 
- The fire alarm outside our apartment hasn't had a handle since we moved in. I've put in multiple tickets but nothing gets done. 
- Sprinklers are always broken and spraying on stairs, walkways & cars.
- Contractors we're scheduled to come to our house to refinish the tub and Randy expected us to stay in the apartment just hours after being sprayed with harsh chemicals. It wasn't until the contractor said it wasn't safe & I requested a hotel that she was willing to get us out of the chemical filled apartment. (Despite me expressing my serious concerns)

These are relatively quiet apartments. There's a lot of mixed class of people here. Some seem like section 8 while most stay to themselves and you never see or hear them.. 

If it wasn't for the staff's blatant disregard for resident safety and well-being this place would be decent.

Great experience for first timer. I purchased group on. Dr. Pham explained everything clearly. The Spa is beautiful. I did not experience an Up-sell on product. The service and ambiance up-sell themselves. Already looking at other services they offer!

Had my first experience of this place , with my in-laws and family, about a week ago now. I can honestly say, I am not impressed. I had the Chicken Club, was supposed to be on a wheat role, but was replaced with sourdough by there mistake. (I am not sure why you would put such a small piece of chicken on massive sourdough bread slices, but ok.) Next is the avocado, which is more like guacamole instead of sliced avocado. I understand that it makes it easier to stay on the sandwich, but not what I would like to see on a sandwich.

The fries were nothing special, an the onion rings reminded me of Burger King.

I am not a fan of shakes, or ice cream, so have no opinion. 

For the price, to food quality/ quantity, I am unimpressed. I could think of 4 other places I would rather eat, before returning.

As a native Californian who has been spoiled by so much good food for the majority of my life, I gotta give this place a HUGE pat on the back for being such a hidden gem in Trolley. Really good. Every single time.

I'm writing a review mostly on late night dining experiences, this is usually when I come here. Thanks for being open until 2:00am Hoshun! The food is great! For what it is it's excellent. The hot and sour soup, snow crab salad, and Crab Rangoon are some of my favorites. But I've never had anything below par. I've sat in the dining room and bar and service has never been less than excellent. The most amazing part of Hoshun is George.  I've been coming here for a few years...4-5 years or so and he has been there nearly every time! George is an amazing bartender. Not because of his fancy cocktails (which he can make) or wine knowledge (which he has)...but his attitude, work ethic, dedication, and general beast-mode persona. This man can handle an entire bar, and a section that most servers couldn't handle alone if they tried. His spirit and attitude are beyond pleasant. If you are hungry late at night, or any time, pay this man a visit. He will brighten your day and do his job impeccably. George, you rock!!!!

We love Leonardo's. Great food for the price. Never a long wait and open 24 hours. Breakfast burritos are so good and so big you can share with another person. We found this place a couple years ago and decided to try after the reviews and we were not disappointed.

I love our little airport.

In my opinion they've really stepped it up.  It's fast to get in and out, the security folks are friendly and efficient, and I love all the new stores with local gear.

Cons

Want to be a 5 star airport BNA?  Then get some signage in your parking lot.  I can't ever figure out where I need to go to park.

Also, it's 2013 which is the year of free WiFi.  It's time........

I like the cereal flavored ice creams. It's a good idea. The normal flavors are awesome too. The coffee flavor still stands out in my mind. Haven't tried the dogs or fries, and the home made caramels were a bit too expensive for an impulse buy... Still though, keep up with the good ice cream flavors and I'll be back.

Came here for morning brunch with a friend of mine who lives down the street.  Although it was blocked, we were luckily seated right away.  Right off the bat, I really enjoyed the decor of this place.  The wooden tables and the arrangements made you feel  at home.  I ordered the huevos rancheros which was tasty.  This place is cash only so make sure you have enough. We had to use the atm which took a $1.50 surcharge.
Awesome drinks and flatbreads. The atmosphere is very cool and has a rustic feeling to it. Good service and good food. Always come here when I visit my folks who live here.
Ummm.... I wish the Cuban was actually good so I could have enjoyed my lunch but it was awful and I did not.‍ would not recommend

Plaza Pastries is quite possibly my favorite doughnut shop in all of St.Louis, the donuts here are quality and filled with ingredients that match. I will admit that the fritters were are some of the best, but I cannot seem to stop without getting one of their amazing blueberry cake donuts, they are amazing. 

In the past I believe that the neighboring restaurant had also shared a kitchen with Plaza Pastries, however I think there has been a shift in management and the owners are now focusing on the donuts, which is good however the restaurant was much better with the quality home made breads from Plaza Pastries.

Commander's was the best restaurant I've been to in terms of good and delicious food. I had the blue soft shell crab and the bread pudding for dessert. I am planning another trip to NOLA just so I can go there for dinner again.

Came here multiple times and loved it every single time! Their gelato is made in house and tastes exactly like how they're named. I don't eat many sweets, but I have a soft spot for ice cream and gelato. The owners are super nice and treat everyone with kindness and respect. If anyone has any questions, they kindly answer everything and you can tell that they are passionate with their work! They also greet and say farewell to everybody like they're their own family friends! 

They have certain gelato flavors that are always available, but have a bunch of different flavors that go through rotation. Every time I came, there has always been a flavor that I haven't tasted before. The owners will never hesitate to let you try their gelato before you pick a flavor. If you can't seem to choose just one flavor, then you can get a flight of three flavors to enjoy! My favorite flavors of gelato here so far are Pistachio, Nutella, and Stracciatella! If you're not feeling a cup or cone of gelato, there are many other options to enjoy like an Affogato, Frappe, Profiterole, or Gelato Brioche Sandwich. Just ask for it and they'll take care of you in a heartbeat! My absolute favorite thing to get here is the Affogato with Stracciatella gelato. The combination of the espresso and gelato together was absolutely perfect! 

They don't just have gelato, they also sell piadinas and crepes if you're not feeling dessert. I had the prosciutto crepe, and it was totally mind blowing! Never thought I would see prosciutto in a crepe, but everything went well together! 

Overall, this place is by far my favorite dessert place in the town! It is a very chill spot to enjoy some delicious gelato, and the owners are the nicest people ever! Come check out this awesome gelateria!!!

This is an excellent seafood restaurant...my husband said it's the best blackened redfish/w crabmeat he's ever has and the crawfish rolls were to die for.   Great friendly service.....We will be back!! :)

Absolutely amazing. By far the best meal I've ever had. Great tasting menu! The staff is friendly and seemed to be having a great time. The drink pairing was amazing. You definitely have to get a reservation and try this. Unbelievable experience!

My new favorite place!  Tried the Texas BBQ Flatbread burger - it was awesome.  The flatbread was delicious but the burger was superb.  They also had 4 unique sauces to sample and their fire and spice and garlic aioli were addicting.  Their buffalo wings were also delicious. I was going to try their stuffed flatbread but I'm happy they convinced me to try their burgers first.  They're also opening a location in Newport Beach in about week...closer to work...can't wait to share with my work friends.

Was so excited to try this place. The beer is good but the service and food was some of the worst we ever experienced, we brought our toddler son ordered a chicken fingers kids meal along with our meals. It was only half full but waitress from the beginning barely wanted anything to do with us. It's clear they have a regular crowd that they cater to.  Our meals came out without the kids meal, it was clear the waitress forgot which isn't a big deal. The big deal is when the chicken fingers finally arrived we began to cut them up to give to our son they were completely RAW in the middle. We told the waitress who couldn't have cared less. On top of it all our food was meh, overpowering flavors and they upcharged $4 for switching out fries out as a side with no indication from the waitress or on the menu. We won't be back and do not recommend. They should be ashamed of themselves for serving undercooked food especially from the kids menu.
This is best Thai food that have by far !!! Ambiance is very nice with excellent service.  Seafood hot pot, clam basil, is amazing.  Definitely will come back

I was down in Brandywine Valley, PA and was looking for a good place to get a classic Cheese Steak.  A friend of mine found Delco's on line and I'm so glad she did because the cheese steak was delicious and I had the Italian Hoagie.  The staff is very friendly and make your meal exactly as you like it.  The ingredients are fresh and the bread is warm and yummy.  My friends and I were very happy with our sandwiches.  They have a great menu, lots to choose from.

It was so good I got another one for the ride back to NYC the next day.  I plan on returning to the area next year to see the Longwood Gardens and Delco's will be on my list to eat at again.  A+

Jamie did an excellent job even though it wasn't an easy one.  We had a few commnication issues at first, however he stepped up and handled those like a trooper.  We will definately use him again and refer him to our friends.  Thanks, Jamie, for handling your business with integrity!  Keep up the good work.
A little on the pricey side but worth the atmosphere you get and it feels very private. Very happy with my manicure- one of the best I've gotten.

JERRY BOB'S TREATED ME LIKE A THIEF & CALLED OVPD ON ME FOR DINE & DASH! 
But here's the twist; OVPD was able to contact me ONLY b/c I graciously & honestly left my name & ph # with the hostess after she kept insisting that my bill had been paid. Knowing they were making a mistake I made this hostess, in front of witnesses, write down my ph #!! 
NOT ONLY THAT, when OVPD called to accuse me of dine & dash, they 1st said my bill was $32.16 yet when I arrived to pay, the bill was suddenly $36. 
THEIR MISTAKE could have been solved professionally & respectfully but the manager was unapologetically smug & rude! I have never been treated so poorly by a business for their mistake & for my honesty! UNBELIEVEABLY POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!
NOT ONCE did the manager apologize for a misunderstanding, inconvenience, poor customer service... nor did he thank me for being honest & coming back to pay or for LEAVING MY NUMBER SO HE COULD CALL THE COPS!! In fact, he had the NERVE to act like he was kicking me out after the bill was settled. "Get out and never come back," he said to me!!

I went here to get something done to my car that was supposed to be a quick fix. The guy told me it would cost about $7-$9 to get my headlight fixed. When he couldn't take the light off he had the mechanics come check it out. The mechanic came to check it out and went back and told him it would cost me $53 plus whatever to fix the headlight. I was shocked at how much it cost to fix a simple headlight. After contacting several other places they were running about the same price due to having to remove something to get to the headlight. Later when I asked what's the total price the guy told me it would be $53 plus tax for labor and they went to check to see how much the bulb was and they come back telling me they were charging me 21.99 for the bulb after being told I will be charged seven initially but $9 due to having to go to the mechanics. I just went to these people to get my car fixed and spent over $500 on brakes and wheel alignment. As a woman I think that's completely ridiculous to do that. However I did not get my car fixed there I took it to another place and got it done at a better rate and I didn't have to worry about them raising the price and everything was included. This makes me sad because I trusted these people.

I called Joseph today to remove an old washing machine in a very challenging basement space. He responded and within an hour sawed it, removed it and left no trace of debris. Awesome friendly service!

I came here to get my rook pierced. I was greeted warmly by the girl at the counter and she was pretty knowledgeable about jewelry and pricing, and she even offered advice. My piercer was nice and made conversation and explained exactly what he was doing. The shop was nice, clean, and easy to find. I was comfortable throughout the whole experience and would definitely come back. I would recommend All-star for anyone considering a piercing! I got the barbell so my price was $50.

Perhaps I had heard so many great things about this fine dining experience that my hopes were set way too high. We love the hole in the wall type places around New Orleans, some down and dirty fried chicken, fried cafish po boys, prawns etc. but my husband talked me into trying Commanders palace bc who doesn't like a nice classy treat every once in awhile?

We started at the bar with drinks. The bartender was great, smart and witty with a great hand at cocktails. The mood soured when we were headed to our seats, and my husband insisted on holding the door open for a busboy to pass through, his hands full of dirty glasses. Once the busboy passed through, thanking my husband graciously, another busboy passed and said, you shouldn't have held the door for wait staff, there are cameras everywhere, you probably just got him fired. "I'm not joking". 
So.... yea.... A bit high brow here?

I ordered the blueberry salad per our waiters recommendation. It was OK. Could have made it at home. My husband had the turtle soup which everyone raves about. He liked it, I thought it had a sour taste to it, but not everyone loves everything, right?

I ordered the tuna for my entree and it was completely underwhelming. I was disappointed that the menu stated "served with with crispy potatoes" and the tuna actually rested on three small potato slices that were soggy underneath the fish. And the butter knife at my table struggled to cut through the filet. 

We ordered the strawberry shortcake in advance, which in my heart was the STAR of the show! Delish. I could have eaten two of them. Thank goodness for the shortcake otherwise I would have left commanders completely disappointed.  My husband ordered the bread pudding bc all reviews said he should- it was entirely upsetting. Very frothy, over fluffy, the whisky syrup our waiter doused it with before leaving our table overpowered the entire soufflé leaving it like a wet cloud in consistency. I wish we could have returned it. I love a good bread pudding, I should add. Oh well.

In closing , I should add the space is gorgeous. Impeccable service too. You even get your water "refreshed" mid  meal even if your glass is full. So that's Interesting. Also, I felt like the waiter was literally staring at us our entire meal. Waiting on if we needed anything. Great service is cool, but a bit of discreetness would have been much more appreciated. 

Overall- not sure what the rave is about. I'm by no means a good snob. But I was very underwhelmed here.

Aristocrat used to be my husband's "first date" spot...he took many a girl here for the fabulous Portobella mushroom appetizer and I admit, it worked for me! :) For lovers of NON-chains, this is a great choice...privately owned, offering unique American food selections in a great price range.

They offer a wide array of sandwiches and entrees that are well priced.  I really enjoy the chicken pasta choice with goat cheese.  AMAZING!!  For sandwiches, I am a big lover of fried tenderloin sandwiches and theirs with the fries is one of the best I've had in Indy.  I highly recommend it for lunch...yum!

The atmosphere is also warm and welcoming in an old building in Broadripple.  The wooden tables and chairs make for an old English feel that is hard not to love.  They have televisions with whatever sporting event is on and in general, is a fun, light hearted restaurant.

This is great for first dates (ask my hubby), group birthday dinners, families, affordable night out before grabbing drinks in Broadripple, and any other event.  

Check it out for something new and different.

If you're looking for an intimate, delicious seafood meal in New Orleans, I highly recommend Seaworthy. 

Our evening started with Octopus - I have had what I thought was good octopus, but seaworthy set the bar at a different level. The flavors and textures were perfect and left us excited for more. 

Our entree's were swordfish and redfish - both some of the best fish we have had in years. We are fish at Peche the night after Seaworthy and Peche's flavors and textures were not nearly as complete as Seaworthy. 

The environment was just what we wanted for a night out - it was quiet, intimate, and expertly crafted.

Excellent variety of crepes with outstanding customer service. The food is great and the restaurant has a really nice atmosphere. Feels like a family owned restaurant and the waiters/waitresses here are very friendly and courteous- great place to eat!

Best pulled pork I've had, and best brisket my husband's had. I value two things in meat more than any others: moistness and flavor. The pulled pork has both! 

I really like their pour over mac n cheese. It's medium-sized shells with a white cheese sauce. Their jalapeño grits are great, too! Love the craft sodas--I always have a hard time choosing, because they're all so delicious.

And the service is so friendly and helpful every time.  We've been several times since learning about Hogwood over the summer, and it's our favorite bbq place now!
If you want to know where the best vegetarian restaurant is, look no further.  Also the Vegan cupcakes will have you like  "NAAAWWWLL it can be".  But yes it is!!!

I found Ericson Dental on Yelp and decided to give them a try. I had my teeth cleaned and was very pleased with the level of detail. During my cleaning I mentioned some sensitivity that had recently developed and was scheduled to see a dentist. About a week later, I went back in and saw Dr. Brugnone. He found the issue and discussed options. He then did the work that I decided on. Sensitivity is gone and I am a happy camper. I was very impressed with Dr. Brugnone and his level of customer service and his chair side manner. They will definitely be my go to Dentist in SB!

I still don't know what the Plus is for.  We paid $450 for our room. We could hear cars on the freeway all night and the tv in the adjacent room.  While the Best Western is convenient it isn't worth the prices they are charging.

AWESOME!!!  They did an incredible job of detailing my car.  It looks even better than when I drove out of the dealer's lot.  And the people are the nicest folks you could ever hope to meet.  I will never have anyone else detail my cars.

Only ever been for lunch, and they have a great lunch special.

For $5.99 you get a main course (fake chicken with broc, lo mein, etc.) + THREE sides, one of which is rice. Every time I get the hot and sour soup, egg roll and white rice. The portion sizes are great and the meals fill me up for hours.

The service is very friendly, though a few times has been quite slow given we are normally the only diners there. I'm not sure I'd pay full dinner price here, but the lunch time specials are absolutely worth going for. And I love meat...so trust me when I say this place is great.

It was time to purchase a new mattress after we had our previous coil one for 8 years.  I had researched extensively coil vs foam and was reluctant to switch to foam.  I went to the store and Neil was very helpful in explaining the pros and cons of each type.  I explained that I wanted a firm bed and I was concerned about being too hot with the foam beds. He explained the plush, medium and firm color coded pillows on the beds.  I spent about two hours trying out different beds. Neil was very patient and answered my many questions.  I decided to leave and think about it another night. Neil did not pressure me at all.  I came back and purchased a foam bed.  It was delivered within two days.  The gentlemen were professional and efficient.  They respected my house and wore booties.  The bed ended up being too soft and hot and I exchanged it for a firmer bed. The return and exchange was very smooth and hassle-free.  I love my new bed and I would return to this store for a new mattress in 8-10 years.

Bonner's is a true family establishment, managed and owned by the legendary Danny Bonner who is always on the premises to offer his own special hospitality and to entertain both the regulars and newcomers with his knowledge of Philadelphia history, politics and the bar and restaurant scene.  
Danny has much to be proud of with a comfortable and authentically restored Irish Pub with a menu that appeals to all tastes.  He has two great chefs on staff, Bobby and Richard who prepare a choice of 6 specials daily in addition to the traditional bill of fair.  
Prices are remarkably reasonable which is why Bonner's has such a huge number of regulars.  I dare anyone to find a menu in town where one can get soup, salad, and a main entree for $11.95.  Comfort food is always available such as Bonner's famous open faced hot turkey sandwich carved right off the bird and served with fresh gravy and mashed potatoes.  Burgers are arguably the best in town.  Daily soups continue to amaze as to choice, quality and freshness.
Bonner's attracts a diverse and well informed crowd ranging from doctors, lawyers, Penn students and an eclectic group of neighborhood regulars.  They all know a good thing and stick by it. 
Bonner's is one of the best finds in the Rittenhouse area and definitely earns its 5 star rating!
located inside whole foods but independent shop. doughnuts made right in front of you.  lots of artisan flavors.  worth a trip.  gluten free options

An oil change costs about $80 here. The 3rd time I took my car for an oil change, I suspected my spark plugs may need changing, but they could not tell me if they did or not. For reals? An auto shop couldn't tell/read the gap and see any carbon build up? They also decided to rotate my tires and charge me $38 for that, without asking me! I get them rotated for FREE at Costco. Will not take my car back to them. EVER.

Let's put it this way, I was SO interested in trying Allegro after all the fantabulous reviews on Yelp, that I risked getting a ticket by parking illegally to run in and get me some gelato. It was def worth the risk, and I didn't get a ticket!  

Super cool interior+really unique flavors+very kind gentleman helping me=pure awesomeness! I grabbed the March flavor of the month (peanut butter) and chocolate and wound up with the equivalent of a frozen Italian recces peanut butter cup! It was bomb. If you're eating solo, go with 1 scoop, I could barely finish that! 

I do wish they were in a better location because I hate everything about Sam Hughes place. I hate the valet, I hate the parking lot, I hate the Brittanys and Chads that frequent Championship Dining, BUT, and for me this is huge, I'm willing to overlook all that, get a stomach ache after because I'm lactose intolerant, all for some amazing frozen treats!

Know Before You Go: Bring a buddy and have one person run in to order while the other circles! If you couldn't gather, parking is a pain!
The service was excellent. Mushi is an prompt and courteous server. She was kind and patient (I have a hearing loss.) I'll be back!

Food court has only 2 options and 1 line feeds both. Waited over 3O minutes to even get my order taken. Way way understaffed and staff there had zero sense of urgency. Don't go this casino if you plan on being hungry at all!!  I will not
Come here again. Other casino option in Tucson area much better!!

We were greeted and seated promptly on a Saturday before a show at the Ryman. Our server, Danielle B, was quite friendly & personable. I had the boneless wings (Sweet & Spicy) and the onion rings. Both were fresh, hot & delicious. Lots of menu choices. Would definitely come back.

Came here for a carnivore buddy's bday and was almost surprised at the quality of Barbeque only because it's so hidden among other sub-par restaurants.

Big Daddy'z Barbeque is underrated, you will not get the same quality or quantity from anywhere else for anything near prices. I had the dry rub half rack ribs which were finger licking good. Definitely ate out of my friends' brisket way too many times. This is now our meat-craving go-to. Famous Dave's who?
Freak good freaky fast freaky pricey

The first time I ordered from here for to go I thought the issues were a one off occurrence.  We ordered for a second time yesterday and same issues.   Orders were incorrect and missing items.  When we called after getting it home we were missing over half our order.  They did not seem to care when we called. We had to go back to get the rest of the order ( 2 tacos, queso, guacamole and missing toppings from other items) when we said one taco was missing onions and peppers they said "we are out".  When a customer orders and they don't have something it would be advisable to call them and ask for a substitution rather than receiving a sad looking taco that is half full. When we went back the manager said they had some issues there and filled the order. The burrito bowl we ordered lacked several items too. Which was not worth the $10+ it cost. I really wish it was higher stars because I live close to this place and I love Mexican food. I hope they fix these issues.    Update: owner did make it right with a refund. I did update stars for that. The ordering system is still not working correctly according to a staff member I spoke with recently.

Before Christmas I had the halloran dining room table delivered.   Beautiful table but horrible craftsmanship.  Did t have it a full week before the mechanism that causes the table to slide apart wasn't working properly.  One of the nuts wS stripped and couldn't be tightened causing it to lift and the table to come off the track whenever you tried to push the table back together.  It's also a self storing leaf table but I couldn't store by the people that delivered the table put it together wrong and a piece was backwards preventing the leaf from being stored.  The gave me a whole new table.  The new installers/ delivery guys tried to save time on their route by telling me they were just gonna give me the top of the table and they will use the bottom.  I said that's not what I waS promised and be the table malfunctioned under a week I don't know how the base would hold up.  They did give me a whole new table but I was angry that they were trying to shortchange me to save time.  16 years ago my sister bought furniture from there that she still has it.  Looks great and is solid.  This company has changed.  No way I'm gonna be able to keep this table for a long time.  I will not buy another thing from them.

Loved this spot.  We did an Italy trip this past summer.  I was on the hunt for true gelato.  So many different opinions on good gelato, true gelato.  Sadly, I cannot remember what makes gelato gelato and not ice cream.  In the end, I don't care.  I just like what I like, and I loved my dark chocolate from Piccola Gelateria.  I also loved Shari V's pistachio gelato.  The pistachio had the DOP designation.  You can look it up.  It's short for "Really fresh awesome" or "Delicious Italian food stuff". Something along those lines.  The flavors were deep and rich.  I am not a pistachio guy.  I always go chocolate.  Always. Piccola's pistachio had me doubting my core chocolate belief system.  It was unnerving but delicious.  Just writing about it, I want a scoop of pistachio.  

Our barista was super friendly and patient.  I had lots of questions about the gelato and this "DOP" thing.   She politely answered all my questions then served us up and checked us out.  No muss, no fuss.  

Aside from killer gelato and friendly service, the place is quaint and cozy.  We opted to sit inside and eat our gelato.  Here's my suggestion, go soon before lines are out the door and down Freret.  I will definitely repeat...probably tonight.

Very clean and safe place. Looking to visit on a budget and let's face it so much to do in philly just need a cot and shower wasn't on planning to spend much time in a room . But got so much more , super friendly staff and guests . Chris up front was amazing heck everyone on the staff was amazing . Will stay again next year ..
Not as impressed as the rest of this town, I guess. I can make better at home. Service is great though!

Another YEG gem! If you've been to Hawaii and have had the privilege of eating a freshly made malasada dusted in heavenly sugar, you'll understand why it's such a big deal to be able to get such a treat so far north. Ohana Donuterie does it well...you get to choose your topping (cinnamon sugar, chocolate dipped, vanilla dipped, or plain) and you get your choice of filling (vanilla, coconut or chocolate cream).
When you walk in, it's like a you're walking into a cool little Hawaiian beach hut. Lots of tables and even an area indoors for you to park your bike so you can keep an eye on it (this place is just a couple blocks south of Whyte Ave).

Super expensive album and custom usb prices. No wonder dealing direct with Alibaba is taking over. Beside cds and tshirts you can get much cooler original swag with your band custom logo on anything. You will experience a much higher ROI. I have experience fast turn around and shipping times. The quality was also great. Don't waste time with typical swag. Be unique and think for yourself.

Very busy place but we were seated fast. The host was very speedy and pleasant. Our server was a little slower than most, so our sitting time was longer than most (waited for our order to be taken and for the check). Huge portions for the price of the food. Drinks were a little pricey. All in all, a good breakfast/lunch place.

Steven and the Auto Zone team saves the day!  Having a dead battery at 9pm doesn't leave you with many options. Thankfully auto zone was open. Their staff was able to test my battery for free and confirm it was bad and needed to be replaced. The staff quickly directed me to the correct replacement. While they don't offer installation, their staff wasn't busy so one person came and took care of swapping them out for me. I was very thankful for the quick service and the extra care. Thanks Steven and Auto Zone!  Tomorrow would have been a really rough day with a dead battery!

Terrible service for vegans. Waiter was inattentive he could serve a process veggie burger patty with raw onion and pickle. Just because they double deep on butter.

Disgusting hummus appetizer tasted like unwelcoming flavorless appetizers.

Terrible costumer service no regrets.

Forced to do business because of a parent who had an account there.  Zero accountability.  ZERO customer service.  There are not even responding to a COURT ORDER.  I may need to now hire an attorney.  THE WORST!

I cannot praise Salon Orange Moon and Jake enough! He listens and delivers. Beautiful cut and color, every time at a very affordable price. I went from a dark brunette to a very subtle ombre blonde and am so happy!  Matt at the front of the house is absolutely charming and squeezes me in all the time!

Steamed shrimp and a view of the gulf, what else do you need for an enjoyable dinner. But wait there is more, the hush puppies are an awesome snack while you wait for your fresh seafood. The dinning area is pretty basic which I enjoyed. The patio area and the rear porch are well ventilated for the summer months but most enjoyable in the winter months. On weekends get there early or use the join waitlist on yelp.

Literally obsessed with this place!  So cute and girly inside with a pink and gray theme and chandeliers adorning the ceilings.  When you check in you are offered coffee, fruit water, or a mimosa.  When your stylist is ready he/she will sit you down at their station and go through the look you are desiring using a helpful style guide that basically shows you any kind of Blowout you could possibly want.  Then once you've dictated your desired style they take you to have your hair washed (which, lets face it, is the best part of getting your hair done).  Once washed the stylist dries and styles your hair.

I have a ton of hair (seriously, Kim K and i have the same amount of hair but all of mine is real) and I went in with a crazy lame mess of locks and left in 45 minutes with a gorgeous mane.  I walked out into center city feeling like a movie star.  Just be careful going shopping with a model status blow out because you can never know if you really like the clothes you're trying on or if you just have awesome hair at the moment.
The service was bad and so was the food. The atmosphere and decor was cute but the menu was super small and had little options. More of a bar kind of place . Would not get food here again .

Ok. Short and sweet (excuse the pun). 

Not only are the people behind the gelato friendly but the gelato is super tasty. We sampled a bunch of flavors and then decided on getting the medium cups. 

The medium cup allows you to pick up to 4 flavors. You might think that's a lot of sweets for such a small cup but don't worry your little noggin'. They pack that gelato into that cup well. I got 3 flavors thinking I'd get small amounts. But the server helping us squeezed the 3 flavors into the medium cup just fine. 

For just around $5-$5.50, you get quite a bit of gelato (and really tasty at that) for the price. Definitely stop by if you get a chance. We'll definitely recommend the place to friends and will be visiting again soon!
I ordered croissants with bacon egg and cheese. The egg was scraps and the cheese wasn't even melted. Do not go here!!!

I went with my girlfriend on a Sunday late afternoon for "build your own" salad.

They didn't have it on the menu at this location as they had a special menu from 2:00 to 5:00 on Sunday's but I'm assuming the manager saw us getting up to leave right after we were just seated and we told him we wanted the salads and he said of course you can order salad. He was a very smart guy to have said that. Excellent choice he made! 

My girlfriend always orders a Bloody Mary from there. Well it came out presented just so with all the garnish she asked for. I took a sip and no lie that was the perfectly made Bloody Mary I ever had.

We both ordered the salad with add-ons with grilled shrimp. The most freshest ingredients was used and ate every last bit.

Highly recommend this place!

Large variety of diy home improvement items. Came in search of tiki torches & citronella and was able to find it easily. Pretty standard organization and store layout. Employees can be hard to find but full of useful information if your lucky enough to find one, much like leprechauns!

After reading all of the positive reviews, I decided to see what all the talk was about. I went here with my two sons. One had the bacon cheeseburger and the other had the cheese pizza with seasoned fries. They both said the food was just okay. 

 I ordered the cheeseburger and it was just average. I was expecting an amazing burger since it was served on a grilled flat bread bun. The flat bread was underwhelming. The burgers weren't served with anything at all. In pictures shared by other patrons, I saw chips with their burgers. 

The customer service was great, very friendly staff. I don't think we will be back, I think we will stick to In n Out for our burgers.

I've recently moved to the Santa Barbara area, and to me finding a good mechanic I can trust is as difficult and as important as finding a good doctor or dentist I can trust.  

I took my car to another garage highly rated by yelp for my first Santa Barbara oil change.  Although I can't complain about their work, they charged $60-$70.  The manager said something like, "We charge more than the typical garage, but we check your car over from top to bottom so it's worth it."  A tire rotation was not included in the charge, and would have cost an additional $20.

Well, Meineke changed my oil AND rotated my tires AND checked the car over from top to bottom..... for $20.  I honestly don't know how they can afford to do so much work for so little money, but it's a fantastic value.  I watched the work being done, talked to the mechanic, and I couldn't be happier with my experience.

As other people have mentioned, everyone is friendly, helpful and knowledgeable.... and I trust them.  Benjamin, the manager, was wonderful.  As Arnold once said, I'll be back.

Rooms are clean bathroom has a tub as well as shower need to grab bars in tub has fridge about 8 ft.³ microwave toaster hot place coffee pot with coffee kitchen sink cutlery plates Nice TV with lots of channels ironing board with iron lots of storage space lots of electrical outlets for charging your phones NO HAIRDRYER 
VERY COMFORTABLE ROOM 
WOULD DEFINITELY STAY HERE AGAIN 
ALSO DENNY'S and other restaurants close by
Quick trip  has about a mile away  
Lobby and staff very friendly and accommodating 
Downtown Tucson is about 8 miles

I really don't get why this place has such a following. Got here around 1:30 and even the waiting area was packed; ended up waiting around 45 minutes. In my opinion definitely not worth the wait.  Service was seriously slow.  52 dollars for lunch for four with an appetizer and cup of gumbo wasn't bad to me so I don't understand the complaints on expense but with better restaurants out there I wouldn't wait that long again fro mediocre food. 

This "famous" seafood gumbo was bad I mean REALLY bad! I've never sent a dish back before in my life but I just couldn't eat it. 

The appetizer gravy and cheese fries were pretty decent.  Tried the meatball poboy which was pretty good. Didn't care for the spaghetti however. Roast beef poboy which is what we went to try wasn't that good. They serve their poboys on some kind of toasted italian bread or something that I just didn't care for. I just don't like my bread quite that crunchy! I personally had the shrimp poby with roast beef gravy which is my favorite at my usual poboy shop. The shrimp were huge and would have been great if there more of them but there was too much empty space on the bread , the bread was too crunchy and the shrimp were too salty.If I had to go back I'd probably try a fried shrimp plate though!

I have gotten two tattoos from Brandon. 
I just wanna say, thank you, thank you, thank you.   you are awesome

Brandon does not just great work, but exceptional work. you know what's great about him? he cares. he cares about your choices, and he WILL tell you if he doesn't agree. I am not a newbie to tatts. I have several, and I can honestly say that Brandon has been more honest and cares more than any other artist I have gone to (elsewhere, not at this establishment). He is great with small detail, which is very important to me, because I prefer small, feminine style tattoos.  I would recommend him in a heartbeat. don't hesitate to trust him, just let him do his thing.

I ordered the Mont Blanc and Nutella Chocolate with strawberries today and both exceeded my expectations.
The Mont Blanc had grilled chicken, mushrooms, red onions, and mushroom cream sauce in it. It is super creamy but it has the right balance of creamy and savory to it. I would highly recommend trying this one if you want a savory crepe. Then, I had a sweet Nutella filled crepe with strawberries and powdered sugar on top. Initially, I thought it may be too sweet but the strawberries added a touch of tartness to it. Both of the portions were generous and I had enough left over for lunch tomorrow. 
Also, I would like to add the service here was fast despite the long line I waited in when I arrived. The employees are very good at busing tables for new customers and friendly. The restaurant is quite spacious and has a cute sunroom with lots of tables. I am not a local here but I am definitely coming back here if I am ever in town!

I have lived in many apartments (this is the 2nd in St. Pete) and this is by far the worse ANYWHERE. I am paying over double what I payed anywhere else and am so unhappy. I moved in July of 2019 and believe me am counting down the days until my lease ends in 2020. Every since new management took over this place has been on a downward spiral. The elevator has been broken since August!! It's now January for reference. For example my refrigerator stopped working, I put in an emergency request and it wasn't until I went to complain in person everyday (for a week) they fixed it. How do they expect someone paying $1500 a month to go with a refrigerator for a week?? Not to mention they did nothing to compensate the food I had to throw up or make up for the week I was living in without a fridge during the holidays!! One night at 3am different smoke detectors went off all throughout the building from a "malfunction" they did nothing to ever fix mine, it's still disconnected on my counter. "Luxury" is an overstatement the amenities are garbage, dog poop lines the hallways, everything is broken and new management are the rudest bunch of people you'll ever meet. I'm disappointed because so far of my 13 month lease I've enjoyed just one month (the first one.) SAVE YOUR MONEY AND LOOK ELSEWHERE.

Update: other residents have pointed out that they're deleting negative reviews so believe the couple you've seen because there was more!!!!

My husband and I have been going to Dr. Fausset for about 2 years now and have greats experiences every time. Dr is patient, kind, knowledgable, and is always looking for patients best interest rather than his financial gain. Office staff is always sweet and helpful. Thank you so much!

I can't go to New Orleans without visiting here. The crawfish boil platter is my favorite. Especially with the raw oysters to start and a shot of patron to finish. I can't give them 5 stars because the bathroom is  a wreck every time I go. And it's the smallest bathroom stall I've ever experienced . If you can use the bathroom before you go, you will have a great experience.

Another great local brewery with its own character and charm.   Silverking occupies an old jail and firehouse.   The inside bar is dark and homey feeling since there are no windows.   Feels like a locals kind of place.   Their beer spans the varieties from IPA to Porters.  Off to the other side of the building is great covered outdoor seating.    If you are in Tarpon, avoid the tourity parts of downtown and seek Silverking out.   Well worth the trip.

I have been here twice. First time wasn't too bad. They offer a lot for a reasonable price. Second time was awful. I was with my mom who wanted to get a gel pedicure. I don't get gel during the winter because I don't wear flip flops during the winter - imagine that! The lady doing my pedicure WOULD NOT LET IT GO. She kept saying, "You sure you don't want gel? She's getting gel. You need gel. Gel lasts longer. Come on get the gel." Seriously like 5-10 minutes of this. No is no. To top it off she was rough as hell and painted my nails sloppily. I'm so sorry I didn't give you the $ for gel. I can take the annoyance about the gel, but taking it out on me because I didn't get it- is ridiculous. I'm leaving a review, but it doesn't matter because there's only this place and Walmart on this side of town. Just beware of this. Get gel nail and you are okay!

We were in town and looking for a good local bagel place. My family is very picky when it comes to bagels, but this place did not disappoint. With a variety of cream cheeses and bagel options, you can't go wrong. I ordered a simple egg sandwich on sourdough and it was delicious! The bagel had some crunch on the outside and soft inside. So beautiful! Definitely recommend if in Nashville

I was becoming discouraged by the donut scene in Philly (looking at you, Okie Dokie and Fed Nuts). The super dense, cakey donuts are not my scene and I prefer lighter, airier types. Welp, Dottie's has it down pat. Wow. These are the best donuts in Philly and some of the best I've ever had anywhere. I've tried quite a few (Triple Chocolate, Blackberry, Rosewater Pistachio, Dunkaroo, and Coconut Cream) and all of them have been incredible. The light donut with the spot-on fillings and glazes make for the perfect donut (or two). Great coffee as well. My only complaint is that the West Philly location is super out of the way and I would love to see them reopen their 6th St. location, if possible, instead. I'd be visiting a lot more if they did!

In a sea of nail salons, Athenian definitely stands out. 

Athenian offers a lively atmosphere and a full bar with a literal seated bar area that's perfect for girl's night. The place is more high-energy than your average nail spa and I was a little concerned as I wasn't feeling high-energy during my visit. However, the staff catered to my demeanor and offered a peaceful experience. The guy that did my nails and toes worked hard and he was meticulous. He took his time to make sure he worked through everything.

PROS

The nail polish is organized by color. Why doesn't every nail spa do this? Seriously. It should be the norm.

Fun spa menu with premium services that come with homemade scrubs and premium drinks.

Services that cater to guys so that you can take your man with you too.

The staff seems eager to please and checked with us several time to make sure we were happy. 

CONS

My husband's service (Hermes) seemed short comparatively. I got the Aphrodite which is a premium service so perhaps by comparison it's shorter than the Hermes? I'm not sure how much longer as I also got a manicure. In total my premium pedicure and manicure took an hour and twenty minutes longer than the Hermes. He was still happy but thought I should call that out in case you go for date night.

Went in today with my friend and got shredded Chicken with medium Bar-B-Q sauce, Deviled Egg potato salad, and green beans. 
The sauce was very tasty and just warm enough to let you know it was spicy, but not hot enough to make you regret eating it. The green beans were lightly grilled and salted. I really enjoyed the potato salad. 
Everything was Lovely!

Bought a recliner love  seat last fall, have had problems with motor, they made a visit or two, never fixed it, said new part had to be ordered & now it's May & all they've done is jerk me around on the phone & do not return phone calls when they say they will. Customer service at this company is awful & I do not recommend them at all.  I had heard similar stories about  about RC Willey so that is why I opted for Furniture Row & I ended up getting ripped off anyway.  My recliner is still broken, motor never replaced & I barely bought it 7 months ago & have been dealing with their poor customer service for the past 5 months. I regret going to this shady store.

Visited this location yesterday. As I was standing in line the older woman behind the register repeatedly messed up the customer's order and tried to overcharge him. After a manager stepped in to help her understand she was INCREDIBLY rude to the customer. I was surprised he said nothing. My turn: she was incredibly rude to me. Worse? I had to go back up to the front and SHE DID IT AGAIN! The food is ok but not worth being abused by staff. Will never return.

The nurses giving the shots were very kind and competent. The problem I have comes in with the billing. We were patients for a year and insurance covered the shots. Then the type of shot was changed and were told insurance would cover it. 6 months later were were told that this was inaccurate and we were left with a huge bill. I could understand if this was after 6 weeks but they kept adding to the bill for months without informing us.  When I asked what happened, they said they had a poor billing company that wasn't sending out bills but they have hired a new company now.  Even though the mistake was on their end, we were the ones who had to pay the price.

Had a problem that needed to be remedied immediately. Called and spoke with Trudy, who was exceptionally pleasant and helpful. There was luckily a tech who get get to me fairly quickly. When Zane-said tech-arrived, he was courteous and professional. I was instantly put at ease with his friendly demeanor and comprehensive knowledge of my problem. Zane handled the job quickly and efficiently, and the cost was surprisingly low! ZeeBest will be my new go-to if other issues arise and is definitely the company I recommend.

The employees were friendly but it seemed like just a fairly basic coffee shop. Great for grabbing some coffee while shopping for sure but nothing overly special. The lavender flavor was really interesting and floral!

The food that I've had from Sonny's  is always been good.  Be weary of the prices though.  Their sauce is great and the quality of the meat is decent.  I will definitely be going back there in the future.

Been wanting to come here for awhile and tonight we wanted salads so off we went. I had the classic cobb and Bobbie the Ceasar salad. Mine had romaine lettuce dressed quite well with ranch dressing, blue and cheddar cheese, eggs, olives and topped with crumbled bacon. Bobbies was romaine lettuce, Parmigiano shaves and croutons,  she got hers with grilled chicken topped with classic ceasar dressing also dressed very nicely. Both salads were more then either of us could finish in one setting so we have lunch tomorrow as well. We want to come back and try some of the other items on the menu so we will be back.

Horrible experience. We heard that the food was great. Unfortunately we could not even try this place. We sat at our table 1 hour and 30 minutes. All the Mexican customers were smiling and eating and leaving with a smile. I am an American I would like to not believe it. But this was what's happening here. I drove from Largo, Florida to this restaurant to be mistreated and the manager was 2 different people not sure what they had going on here. But I don't ever want to be treated like this again in life .

I have never in my life felt the need to post a review, but I felt it necessary on this occasion because it was truly appalling. The bouncer at coyote ugly is on a power trip. I asked the bouncer his name and he said "don't worry about it" followed by words I do not feel comfortable sharing on this app; instead I attached a photograph. He rejected me and my friends with valid IDs. After showing him extensive proof and offering to have a nearby police officer confirm our IDs legitimacy. He rejected us because we were women. He also said he "just wanted to reject us for the sake of rejecting us." This man rejected three 24 year old females. I am truly astonished that this establishment permits this kind of misogynistic behavior.  Perhaps he was upset because he was alone on Valentine's. However, never in my life have I been treated with such disrespect, and I truly hope that this establishment (@coyoteugly) reassess their staffing decisions. I cannot image that the owners of the establishment would be encouraging the bouncer to turn away paying, legitimate customers. Last time I checked, that was not the best business model! Do not waste your time going here unless you want to be harassed for no reason.

Yum yum yum! French food in the heart of broad ripple. Right on the canal and the coziest (that's cute talk for small) dining area. It's with the wait for the frites and sauces. The frites are such an essential part of the meal, they have Joel's in the table top to hold your cone of frites. That's dedication. 

I've been twice and first ordered the stew. It's a hardy, beefy soup that pairs perfectly with their homemade baguettes. I will say it was a little tooooo hearty the next day. But worth it!! 

The sauces you choose with your frites vary from from garlic aioli to maple syrup. You really want to try 'em all!

The second time I had to go for the steak and eggs. Two fired egged on a hanger steak with frites. C'est chouette! It was deloush and I was stuffed after half of it... but, of course, I powered through.

12h outage in Texas .104f outside ..inside after 12h 90f. After 12h they be no clue what the issue is. Incompetent is really nothing compared how bad this company is. Will be suing them in court. ..this is happening as we speak. Since 3 pm they delay with another 2h. It's 11 pm now they say 3 pm. Ripping off customers and they put no effort in repairs on maintaining their equipment.. no ac at 10f fir 12h and who knows when this will be solved. It's unbelievable ..not even in underdeveloped countries an energy call mpany can behave like this. Shame

Absolutely the worst customer experience I have EVER had.  Made our order.  The guy taking the order was doing 3 things at once and was totally distracted.  Then I repeated our order 2 times to make sure he got it which he did not so I corrected it.  Then they call our number and we are short 2 of our 4 sandwiches.  So I say thats ok can we just add them now.  Nope you have to go to the back of the line an order again.  Screw you guys.  I took my sandwich and threw it out won't even try your food.  Rude jerks.  Should have gone somewhere else.

I love these guys! They have been so helpful, kind and patient with my husband and I as we navigate having a new puppy. I never feel rushed or like I'm inconveniencing them. He takes time to fully explain everything he is doing and why. His own animals are in the building as well!

My family and I went early evening, having heard about it from others that live in the area (and Tina Fey).  We were seated right away and it wasn't crowded.  It was larger than expected.  We were seated in a booth which was comfortable.  One of us had the pizza and it was good-would have liked more cheese on it but it was still good.  I had the lasagne and it was quite good.  Service was good.  It was fun to try it.
Great Resturant to eat at! It's right in the heart of NOLA. Everything was super fresh! The crab fingers sauce was amazing! Highly recommended!
Excellent dinner with family last night. Chicken San Remo was amazing! Friendly, wonderful service! A neighborhood gem.....

First of I'd like to say I LOVE THIS BAR!! Chris has always taken great care of me & my friends! There have been times when I come in & there might be a whole bar full of people and Chris handles it with such ease! You wouldn't even know he had a whole place to take care of! The ONLY reason I would even CONSIDER giving less stars is because the past 4 times I've come in..... Jameson has been out..... for an Irish bar I think this is a little unacceptable. PLEASE BRING BACK JAMEO!!!!

The southernmost 4-5 miles of the Monon trail are always the hardest if you are casual bikers like we are. Once you get south of Broad Ripple, your food and/or beverage choices are slim, unless you want to brave some narrow cross streets. We found the Half Liter Beer & BBQ Hall to be an inviting oasis on this stretch.

If you enter trailside, you are first struck by the abundant bicycle racks and HUGE outdoor area. We counted at least 15-20 tables at the ground level, who knows how many more upstairs. My husband and I opted to sit inside and enjoy the A/C on this hot July afternoon. The self-serve water station was a blessing too.

We sampled three different meats and and the soy curls. Everything was well-made and tasty. They had 2 sauces to choose from. The Carolina mustard sauce paired especially well with the hot links. They have a large drink menu, including their own beer. On this day I preferred a frozen drink but my husband ordered 2 different beers and enjoyed both. 

Service was upbeat and prices seemed reasonable for the area. Half Liter shares the same building (and presumably ownership) with a German restaurant. 

This was a highlight of our long weekend in Indy. We will definitely be back.

Love it here! Great atmosphere and great food. Stuffed artichoke is sooo good. Seafood gumbo is also one of my favorites. Also, I'm a ranch dressing snob and they have one of my top favorites ranch sauces.

Everything everyone else has said is true. This shop is gorgeous and wonderful and you should go. 

I'm just going to add: oh my word the maple fudge. I'm eating some right now and it's SO GOOD. 

It keeps well if you put their box in a ziplock bag in the fridge. Like if you want to give it as a gift. Or buy extra for yourself. For example. 

Plus the prices are really quite reasonable, especially if you consider everything is handmade and, for lack of a better word, artisanal.

This place was GREAT - the servers were fun and friendly and food got to our table very quickly. The bbq was delicious with the Texas bbq sauce being the tables particular favorite. Overall, would come back especially with the patio layout.

Very disappointed. The menu itself sounds delicious. We had a boat ride scheduled at the dock so we decided to have dinner here first. Got right in at 5pm and it got packed right after that. Drinks were on point. I had a Pina Colada and my kids ordered smoothies. My husband just had a beer. We ordered a dozen raw oysters as an appetizer and that's where the disappointment started. Oysters were huge but had no flavor. Seems like they rinsed them after opening. I couldn't even eat more than a couple. Main meal: I ordered the Salmon Rockefeller. Overcooked to the point it was crispy. Kids had the mussels and enjoyed them. Husband ordered flounder.... said it didn't taste like flounder (this man grew up on the water and knows his fish), and it was overcooked as well. He did enjoy the clam chowder. Service was slow. You honestly pay too much for the quality you get here.

Walked in & up the stairs and immediately received very unpleasant looks/glances from the front of the house staff. 

Was not going to wait for a table if we weren't welcome. Won't be going back.

Great spot for a quick haircut! It was definitely the shortest time wise of a haircut I've ever got - I asked for more layers, a couple inches off and thinning out my hair. However the lady that cut my hair was very good at her job and did a decent job for a 10 min cut! I would go back for a quick cut or trim!
The Pantry Used to be very good, but once Brad Gates and his team left the service and quality of the food unfortunately went downhill.

If you are looking for someone to cater cold box lunches, this is the place! We ordered 60+ box lunches for a safe family gathering and everyone raved about the food. Extremely fresh and ultra tasty sandwiches in an attractive box with sides and a delicious chocolate chip cookie. Being a family who loves sweets, we also ordered two platters of desserts and there was not a single one left at the end of the day. Outstanding in every way, thank you!

We were here about 15 minutes and not a single sales associate talked to us. We were 2 of the 3 customers there as well. 2 sales associates walked by as well, looked our way, and not a single word. Glad there are other options for lights in Indiana.

Our favorite Mexican spot away from home!  Good, fresh, nicely spiced Mexican food. Unique offerings outside the usual Tex-Mex-- I had an awesome, deeply-spiced Mexican pot-roast and potato stew served w/rice and beans..mmm..usual suspects, tacos, nacho, etc., are here, too. All very tasty- my son's tacos were redolant of oregano and cumin, very, very tasty.  Odd note-- the rice has a frozen veggie mix- green beans, lima beans, corn, square carrots- mixed in; rice was nicely seasoned- don't get the veggies one bit! I ate them for the vitamins--but that kinda threw me off.  
Otherwise- prices and service are good, food excellent, atmosphere cozy and far more interesting than the bland store front would suggest!
I will add- we've been coming here once a year every year for about the last 5 years- each time, it's been very good. (first time for the frozen veggies, though!!).

I've been to this location several times without a problem,This location was closed during COVID-19, and has just reopened. In an effort to support local businesses, and because this was on my truck route, I decided to stop in for lunch. I drive a truck for a living and I don't often have time to go to the bathroom, I saw that there were three people ahead of me so I made a beeline to the bathroom area when one of the employees yelled out "sorry hon that back area is closed " not that the bathrooms were " out of order".... just closed. Now the area that she was talking about still had tables and chairs set up so I informed her that I wasn't going to actually sit I just needed to use their restroom. I often like to wash my hands before eating anyway. the employee just gave me a blank stare as if to say "you heard what I said the first time". So I left without buying anything, and I will not be going back. There are several places in the area to eat, there's a Winn-Dixie across the street I highly recommend going to instead of this Subway location.

For me I always take my car to the dealer when I need a tune up. I have been doing this every 3,000 miles for the last 11 years. I would have to say this is the best one I've been to in that time. Great flexible schedule allowed me to bring my car in for it's 100,000 mike tune up without me missing out of work or other errands. 

They were able to identify 2 recalls on my car as well and replace with the parts on hand. This was great considering I had just brought my car to another Ford dealer at my old home and they said nothing. Awesome. 

Prices were good, and they were able to get my car running like new. I can tell they have the properly trained mechanics and staff on site.  Also free coffee and WiFi, BOOM!!!!!

I am definitely going to be using this place for all car maintenance while I am in the area.

Hopefully this will be my last time ever renting from Avis. This visit was for personal reasons and not business. I used the "points" I'd accumulated over the past 20 years for a 2 day rental (BTW, almost all my points are now gone). I'm not sure how their points system works vs the 50+ rentals I have per year, but it doesn't seem to be a very rewarding program. 
Avis is probably best known for low cost, but many hidden charges. 
So I prepaid for my taxes of $20.59 back in August for an October rental which cost 4400 points for 2 days. The day before my rental, I'm notified that $100 is charged to my AMEX account. Yes--- this is just a pre-charge authorization which will be taken off after the rental. When I arrive, my contract states I will be charged $64.99 for the 2 days plus the tax which I'd already paid. I'm guessing that Avis may be a franchise business since the people there mentioned they didn't know how the points system and free rentals worked. They advised that I call Avis if the charge remained after the car was returned. 
The car I received was a Hyundai Elantra with scratches on the front bumper and side door. I returned the car within the 2 day rental period with a full tank of gas. The receipt showed that I was charged $64.99 for the rental and $4.95 for fuel. The attendant wrote that the tank was full in order to get the refund. The local associate was able to get the $64.99 removed from the account, but couldn't remove the fuel charge. I was charge for 0.4 gallons of fuel at $9.99/gallon plus taxes. 
I needed to call Avis directly for the charge. After spending over 20 minutes with them, they asked that I send proof of paying for the fuel which I did. Only then did they refund the $4.95--- 1 week later. Was it worth it? If losing customers is their goal, they I suppose it was.

Scheduled my first appointment online two weeks prior. I filled out all the information and everything they needed in detail from the luxury of my apartment so that I would not need to do it in office. Being self pay as well. I showed up at the appointment time today just to be told that I would need to do all paperwork again on the iPad in the office because they didn't have it... 
then after filling at everything they needed I sat..
And sat.. and sat.. for 45 mins past my appointment time I asked the girl at the desk if she knew how much longer that I would be waiting. She said she didn't know but that it shouldn't be too much longer.. so I sat for another 15 minutes (now an hour past my appointment time) before I finally got up and left. 
The woman at the front desk had no apologies or explaination. Terrible first impression as a new patient. I will not be back.

Place was super expensive.  I made an appointment for my daughter and the hairdresser got there 20 minutes late.  They barely spoke to my daughter and the coloring that they overcharged for faded in less than a week.  I will not go there again
The best spot in Philly  to get a great cut and have great conversation. Highly recommend.

This is the second year I've brought my car to these guys, and theyre fantastic. Just got the interior cleaned, and it looks like a brand new car! Just like the day I got it. 

They even gave it an exterior wash as well, and they totally didn't have to. Will definitely be bringing it back next year.

We LOVE Lucky Pet grooming. The groomers do a great job and are always careful to ask how we want the haircut to look. They are also very gentle and patient with our little rescue dog, who gets anxious and is not the easiest to groom. Staff is quick to respond to messages, very helpful and professional.  Overall, 10/10, wonderful small, family-owned business to support in our community. Here are some "after" photos of Miss Maude after her most recent Lucky Pet haircut :)

Nurse Ritchie is amazing!!! I am in the Goleta area and was suffering from a severe migraine last night, Nurse Ritchie came quickly to the rescue and was very attentive to my pain. He is covid conscious, and exactly who you want treating you. I have his number on my metaphorical speed dial now, 10/10 recommend

I could not be happier with AMS Entertainment. My husband and I were married at The Canary Hotel in Santa Barbara and AMS was on the list of preferred vendors. I am so glad the Canary has such a great relationship with this company because they made our wedding night all we could hope for and more. Saul was fun, professional, a great MC and DJ, as well as kept our guests dancing ALL night long. I had no concerns about our night once I met Saul and would recommend this company to anyone looking to get married. Thank you for everything!!
the new gas staytion has open. has fress produce and good grocery prices. pack on sunday afternoons.

I contacted Wardrobe Clinic after reading many positive reviews about not only beautiful tailoring, but also exceptional service. After two days of calling and leaving a voicemail for scheduling, I submitted an appointment request online. This seems to be the preferred method of scheduling as I heard back within a couple of hours. I arranged to attend an appointment the following day after verbally confirming the shop was open. About 3 hours later, I received a call regarding me not showing up to my appointment. I called to inquire being that my appointment was actually scheduled for tomorrow. The representative I spoke to in turn apologized and proceeded to verbally confirm my appointment for the following day. I found this to be strange, but was still excited to have my dress altered by the Clinic. The next day 1 hour before my appointment time, I received a text saying that my appointment was now canceled and that a representative would be reaching out to reschedule me for 2 days later. I called the number to verbally confirm as I was already in the city for the scheduled appointment. No one answered so I left a voicemail stating the nature of the call, my anticipation to be seen for the alterations, and a call back number to be reached at. Needless to say, I never heard back and ended up wearing my dress to a wedding sans repairs. Unfortunately, I cannot comment on workmanship, but as far as respect for a client's time, I think 2 stars is generous.

This place is an absolute hot mess. Called and placed an order for a rivet tray for my son's Halloween party. The person who took the order said no problem it would be ready at 8:30 AM. I show up to a line going out the door and employees yelling at customers. Once I reached the counter and asked for my order they said it was not there and that I had not placed an order. I know I have done some hallucinogens in my past but I am certain that I called and spoke to a young gentleman and also confirmed their location. I will never be going back to this location as I am too old for a mosh pit and being yelled at for being a customer

I only come to St. Roch for O! Vegasm, but because you have to order drinks from the bar separately and because I do on occasion indulge (that is, every occasion I've been there which is about half a dozen times), a review for St. Roch is due.

First, let's talk about that bathroom sign. I find not the misspell of "neighbors" funny, but the fact that so many people have taken it upon themselves to put in corrections or comments on the sign. I just imagine some new crusty come to town whipping out her sharpie and going to town on that thing before she realizes that she has bigger dogs to adopt.

Second, there's the great Ketel One Mystery. As in, for some reason, Ketel One tastes like gin here. First time I ordered it, I sent it back. I never do that. The bartender actually poured the drink in front of me to show that it was, in fact, Ketel One. But I know my gin better than I know my mother and because I order vodka with soda, any extraneous flavor is immediately noticeable. My friend, also a bartender, concurred that it tasted like gin. I figured that they just didn't clean the pour spout properly. A week or two later, I returned and thoughtlessly ordered my usual. Again, the flavor of juniper berries made me wish I had just ordered tonic instead of soda. This time I didn't send it back. I also barely drank it. Yes, you read that right (ever drink a gin and soda??? Ugh). I'd normally be hard pressed to stick to Stoli henceforth, but it's been happening.
