Regardless, I've gotta give St. Roch props for live music, cheap drinks, friendly (non crusty punk) regulars and the fact that they have O! Vegasm operating out of the kitchen means that there are good people behind the entire operation. It is what it is.

Finally, I think that from now on, I'm just going to call it St. Roach. Hey, it's out of fondness. Think of it as a cute mascot. I prefer them to crusties, if the truth must be told.

I had a similar experience to some of the other individuals who posted. As I write this, I am still completely amazed that this story actually happened and I didn't just dream it up.
I walked up to the store front yesterday and started looking at plants outside. A short, tan, older woman asked if that was mine(I had a pot of English lavender I was carrying). I said yes, I got it down the street. She responded, "thanks for nothing, we've only been here 36 years." 
I have one small side note: In my defense, I have previously tried looking for herbs at this shop in passing but I've never seen lavender.
Anyways, I kinda giggled I was so surprised and uncomfortable. I kinda figured maybe she was just one angry employee and I had never been inside the store so I went to walk inside and the lady wouldn't move from in front of the door. She then asked me to my face how much they charged me for the plant I was holding. I was so dumbfounded I turned to walk away and she yelled as I was walking away, "More than $5?!........... more than $5?" ......then she yelled "maybe next time." 

Needless to say this woman was a megabitch and I don't ever plan on even looking at this place anymore.
Super fast service and GREAT daiquiris! So many fun combos, and wonderful specials throughout the week. Best drive thru daiquiri spot in the NOLA area!

Pretty bad. Canceled the proper way. Which is jumping through hoops in itself. Got my confirmation. Then 6 months later was sent to collections. Brought my confirmation of the date I quit they tried charging me for all these extra fees. The manager apologized since I had all my cancel documentation and my last date I paid in full. Just be careful with this place.

I have been coming to this Barnes & Noble since I was a kid it still looks like how it was when I was 10 years old. There is a wide selection of books, of course, but yet spacey for studying. What I like most about this Barnes & Noble is that the cafe/Starbucks is in the center of the store and overlooks everything, which is a nice touch. Service is always hospitable. My only complaint is the overall cleanliness of the store and the cafe as well as the few outlets at the cafe.

Such a squandered opportunity. Nice interior, in a nice, cozy hole in the wall kind of way. Menu isn't great, service almost as good as so so, but not quite. I ordered the bratwurst starter. It was brought to me with no mustard. I asked for mustard and was informed by the waitress/bartender that it's not served with mustard. I showed her the menu where it says it's served with mustard, and she informed me that it's not normally served with mustard, and there are many other items on the menu that are not served with accompaniments as listed on the menu. 
Also nonstop LOUD HIPHOP. Too bad. What a shame. Won't be back.

UPDATE 09/2019: under new ownership with a new name. Not the same ... I got a very mediocre pedicure. She barely did any massage or cuticle clean up. I wish I knew where the old owners went ... I'd follow them to a new location !!

Great Thai Food!  Been there twice now and the flavor is fantastic. Great portion size and a really friendly owner/Mgr. One of my new favorite spots. Start with the Roti bread and get some "Drunken noodle."  I usually only post when I really like a restaurant and this one definitely makes the cut.

The manager of this place was absolutely horrible. There was a long line, he left to walk outside to take a break., When he came back he ignored his customers and even customers in line left because of the chaos... FYI, the ice cream is great though. As for the manager, he should not be working there.

Booked dinner for New Year's Eve, and came to the martini bar beforehand for a cocktail. THe happy hour deals (see attached cocktail menu pages from 12/31/19) really can't be beat. The live music is always fun and it is nice to see some folks dancing on the little dance floor. Our service was timely but entirely lacking warmth. She also made no suggestions despite my clearly being overwhelmed the the menu size and expressing my preferences. 

The restaurant service was impeccable. We never went without water, dishes were promptly cleared, and the waiter made suggestions and offered tastings. The food was a 4/5. The temperatures were a bit off on the desert and one of the appetizers, and the presentation was really not lackluster. My biggest complaint was that the feel of the restaurant was very commercial, since much of the space was open to the casino or kitchen, and the noise level was very high. We probably would choose a different steakhouse (Atlantis) or Row restaurant (La Strada) before returning to the Roxy restaurant.
I've been there twice and got signature bowls both times. The make your own looks really great since there were interesting ingredients from both. Everything was very fresh, and it's a good value.

Husband & I have been regulars for 4 years now. We just came back from our 2nd New Year's party here, which was very well done. The owner, Chris, is usually there when we visit (which is usually on Saturday nights about once/3 months). 

The things I love: 

1. The DIVERSE crowd. Husband & I have an obvious age difference and this is only one of 2 bars where we BOTH feel right at home. You'll see all ages here. You'll see a mix of white, black, and Latino, as well, which I especially appreciate as the DJ plays all sorts of dance music for all of us. The clothing is also diverse...husband and I prefer to dress up, but there are many in jeans & nice tops. 

2. The DJ(s) play a great mix of music on Sat nights. Old school hip hop, newer hits, a few favorites from the 90s, etc. DJ does a good job of flow, too.

3. REAL CUPS. So many clubs use cheap plastic cups like from your college house party days & I can't stand that. Not this one.

4. Five bathrooms, not just two.

5. Parking--they have their own tiny lot.

6. Attentive staff

7. Drinks are affordable & not weak

8. Heaters outside on the balcony & rooftop patio for the smokers.

9. The decor, it's classy & upscale without being pretentious. Makes you feel welcome, whatever style you're wearing.

10. The bouncer at the front entry helps us ladies stay in the correct order for the bathroom & checks if it's open for us.

Things I don't love:

1. Climbing those steps. Plenty of patio & rooftop for smokers, so they don't have to climb the steps all night. Just when you arrive & leave for the night.

2. The women's bathroom door right by the main entry. That door is heavy and the lock can be annoying. But there are other women's bathrooms there.

3. That hallway between the lounge room & dance room. People at the bar can sometimes block that area & make it tough for us to get through.
Got take out for Mother's Day.  Delicious as always.  My go to Chinese in town.  General chicken, pork fried rice, crab Rangoon and egg rolls.  All were great.

Overall the bright and Airy scenery was awesome in a cool windy day. The bartender inside pours heavy. She's Caribbean and we  her! 
Although new, I was disappointed in the flavour of the food, nothing really grabbed me... it was very bland. Hopefully as the newness slows down they add some flare!!
It is the tallest man-made monument in America and it is beautiful! Park grounds are amazing and well kept up. St. Louis did an excellent job when they built this

This is my local Tiff's Treats and I usually order a few times a month. Every time, my order is correct, the cookies are warm, and oh so good!! I was also told by Avery to sign up for the Elites program (thanks mom!) so I can get free delivery, extra perks, and to place advance orders. If you go to this or any location, the cookies are great, but DO NOT SLEEP ON the Peanut Butter Chocolate Bar. Be sure to get it warmed up and bring on the napkins!! It's the best thing. I always look forward to ordering from this location and will continue to do so!

I love Deke's! Been going there since they were in Roxborough, and now in Germantown. Great environment and quick service. Also love their food truck! The brisket is excellent with a couple sides, but I'll also get the brisket cheesesteak on occasion.

The guys there are super friendly and knowledgeable.
I had a cracked screen on a WiiU  gamepad that was fixed timely and is working great!

Very disappointed I made appointment to come in yesterday at 1. So I expected for them to start working on me at least by 1:15. Instead they wrap my fingers at 1:30 and sat me there. For about an half hour I sat with the gel wrap on my fingers nails. Then they finally sent a new girl, who evidently never did gel polish. Mind you someone came in after me, the owner skip me and worked on her feet. If you a loyal customer and give good tips. Would you have the new girl do your loyal customers nails? I would think not. Put her on the lady who came after me. She did my manicure wrong, she put the top gel in the middle now my nails are chipping. I'm very disappointed and I will not return.

We made a reservation for a friends birthday.  It's a big place on the lowest level.of a hotel (across the street from the new huge ferris wheel).  Thr place was packed due to people eating before.going to a.concert at the hockey arena nearby.  The food was good, though as much as I heard about their giant roasted ravioli I wasn't blown away by them. I had a steak with risotto.  They also brought out a complimentary dessert for the birthday girl, which she gave to me. I'll go back some time but mainly due to location.

By the way, Lombardos will validatebuour pariing if you park in the Drury Inn m UK lti level garage that is on the backnaidenof the hotel.  That's to the West (away from the ferris wheel).

Do not use! These guys are amateurs. Shaun is a nice guy but when my fridge was broken, they first replaced a part that did not need to be replaced for $160. When I called to check on the continuing issue they ordered the wrong part and when the right part did arrive it was not installed correctly. I ended up out $300 and with no working fridge for a month and the repair was so easy that I was able to complete it myself with some research.
Green chili burger is great! Drinks are cheap on Wednesdays but they do have specials every day of the week. Buckets of beer for 18 bucks!

I was excited about a new coffeehouse opening in my work neighborhood. Then found out it was Swedish,better yet. But, the espresso wasn't strong, smooth or spectacular. It was to-do tasting. I thought workers very nice. They also have pastries that looked good. This is tiny, corner spot with no tables but two bars with a few stools.
Great service and great food. Tanner was our server and he was great. Tacos and Vodka Shrimp past fantastic. Definitely a must stop if your in town

The bistro is amazing!!! Perfect date spot. Order a bunch of small plates and some cocktails. The short rib flatbread is very good. We also had some shrimp dumplings but it seems like the menu changes often. It's a very small menu, I do wish they had some more vegan/veg options but otherwise so good.

When we took my shoes, I was thinking it was a little pricey and  we had to pay cash when we left them! We picked them up and WOW, They look Fabulous! So glad that we decided to check them out, will use them again!

Looks was a bit Deceiving with this dish . The staff at the register were very rude which I'm going to just assume because they were younger. The shrimp on the pasta was good but it was really nothing to match the looks of it . My bean pattie was good, I wish it wasn't balled up in my bag though

Excellent experience!  Only four stars due to the food service.  The food itself was delicious!   I had steak n shrimp teriyaki and it was wonderful.   Our server was nice and came right to us when we got there however after we ordered we waited and waited and waited.   Very slow service.  The seats are nice and comfy and the theater is clean.  I would recommend the experience!

You usually don't find places this good in strip malls, but there it is. A friend of mine frequents this place and raves about it, so we went there a few months ago.

I've been here a couple of times since and gotten the same thing each time. The Clay Pot. You should too. It's a delicious combination of Asian vegetables and your choice of protein simmered in a spicy broth of indescribable complexity. It comes with a side of white rice that you slowly fold into the dish. In addition, it's accompanied by stuff like sriracha, Kimchi, peanut sauce, etc. Exceptionally good

You can get it at 3 different spice levels. Don't underestimate spicy the hot level is. It borders on painful. You'll pay for it the next day. But definitely stop here if you're in the suburbs looking for Vietnamese.

The restaurant was a recommendation from a friend who went to school in the area. When we got to the restaurant we noticed that it had a great view, but it was very crowded. To sit outside it was a 30 min wait (mind you it is about 2 in the afternoon on a Sunday) and they had one table for 2 left close to the kitchen. I was nervous I might get hid by the swinging kitchen door but the workers were mindful to watch out for us and the nearby tables. I found out from Yelp that the bar is open to anyone with no wait. As we began to look at the menu, the first thing that popped out to me was the crab cakes (special). Obviously, I ordered that and then the ceviche because it was hot outside; needed something to cool us down! My boyfriend ordered the fish and chips for himself. The ceviche came out first with crackers! Not chips, which I thought was so weird but it worked! the ceviche was delicious and it totally caught me off guard because it isn't a Mexican restaurant however I thought since we are close to the ocean that it had to be good! When my crab cakes came out, I was shocked! It came with only two, sauce, a salad, and a side order of clam chowder in a cup. I thought the crab cakes were not enough but once I took a bite of it, it was filled with crab meat! It was delicious and probably the best I've ever had. The sauce on the side is money! You need to try it with your order of fries too. The salad, I didn't care for it so I passed it up. The fish and chips were good as well. Not the best we've had but the fish was still really good. The batter was light and crunchy. My boyfriend and I came to the agreement that the best dish we had that visit were the crab cakes, hands down. We can't wait to come back with our friends who had recommended the place to us as we make our way up the coast again.

This is terrible. Despite the fact i had a reservation i had to wait outside for 45 minutes. Staff is terrible they dont even know how to communicate. AVOID THIS PLACE if you are planning a night out.

I got both ears and my navel pierced here. I walked in and had no wait time so that was great.  My piercer was friendly and got all 3 piercings done quickly and with minimal pain. The belly piercing was much less painful than I had expected and it was totally straight and it turned out exactly how I wanted it.

Well curve side is being offered only. They have a huge sign posted. To order is taking longer than normal only because we going online to get set up. Im assuming lots of action so the site is slow. Nevertheless I'm excited and thirsty the waitress arrived quickly with our drinks. The food nice & hot. Im extremely happy with my fire cracker chicken wraps and my cheeseburger. The husband loves his patatoe soup. We give 5 stars. We enjoyed supporting this location.

I called them for an estimate to get a timing belt change done, the first person that answered stated they couldn't give me an estimate, I needed to speak to someone in the office, so then I spoke with Kim and I told her my car and what I needed, without looking it up and without hesitation she said it would cost about $800 with parts and labor. Now, the timing belt costs about $15.00 alone, but even with the kit that includes all the tensioners, belts and a water pump, that's only about $150.00 (my cost a.k.a. retail) and the job should only take about 1-2 hours max on my car. So they are charging me $300+ an hour for labor? Or are they marking up their parts THAT much? It doesn't matter, I seriously call into question all the positive reviews for this company.

If I could give this place zero stars I would! I just left completely disappointed. I walked in with a plan in mind and walked out in tears from disappointment. I went to Paul with my plan and he suggested something completely different, the picture was nice so I agreed. I also asked him how long he he was doing nails for and he said 15 years. During the process, I kept telling him that I didn't like it. I wanted medium length coffin and they were long, thick and square. I kept telling him to fix it and he attempted but did not succeed. He said he was doing ombré French but let me tell you they looked just like French tip but the white part started wayyyy to low. I was going to take a picture but I was so upset I got home and took them straight off. DO NOT GO HERE! Waste of money!
This cute new place. European Tasty meets New York pizza.  When I m in the hood vicisitng my cousins I will stop in.  Greek sales was plenty and the steak fries are awesome.

A girlfriend of mine and I were a walk in 12.11.19, I can't remember the front desk agents name, but she was very nice and very welcoming. got us into our room quickly. We were going to go swimming but upon going to our room we ran into quite a few different "creepy" guys who just would not leave us alone. We decided to stay in and watch a movie, I went to the desk to ask for a dvd player, she told me she didn't know if they had any players, but didn't actually check for me. The room was great, I particularly liked that I could see my car from my room, couldn't hear any noise through the walls, it was very clean and super comfy! It was a bummer that the breakfast ends so early in the morning 9AM. But there was still coffee which is a plus. upon taking my car in for a tune up the next morning I asked if we could receive a late checkout (1 hour) and who I believe was the manager didn't seem to happy about me asking, interrupting me as I explained my reasoning and asking about their policy. I work Front Desk at shore lodge so I take pride in making sure to treat other hotels with the most respect I can, so it didn't feel so good being skepticated.

I happened upon this place as I was planning a weekend getaway for my boyfriend.  This cute hotel is definitely worth all the 5 star reviews it has received.  We stayed in a King size room with a patio although we ended up not using the patio because we were out exploring most of the time.  The room was clean...VERY CLEAN and the decor was nice too.  

Harry was friendly and engaging when we arrived and he was that way throughout our stay.  The best part about this hotel (besides its cleanliness, close proximity to the water and the train station, etc.) was the bed!  I haven't slept that good in a long time...the pillowtop mattress and the pillows were like sleeping on clouds and the black out curtains were excellent too.  We are now on a mission to buy a pillowtop mattress for ourselves.  

The lobby has coffee and water available throughout the day and in the morning, there were snacks, muffins, oatmeal, fruit and yogurt.  Our room had a fridge, coffee maker, safe, and a hair dryer.

Highly recommend La Playa Inn.  We will definitely stay here when we return to Santa Barbara.
Such a cute store with sooo many options. I loved looking around and took home some cute gifts for Mother's Day

I like the service and I like that they slice the lunch meats as you order. What I don't like is there new ordering system that asks you to tip and you gotta touch the screen and stuff. Then I gotta go sanitize my hands after because I had to touch something that is touched by every other person that goes through there. Kinda gross but it is what it is. Other than that I think the food and everything else is great.

An amazing community of people and instructors. Tons of convenient class times offered and easily the most knowledgeable coaches i have ever had the pleasure of training with. If you are looking to change up your workout, to get stronger both mentally and physically and to re-train your body to new skills this is your place.

Philadelphia Distilling is so absolutely scrumtralescent I will be telling all I know to check it out. The atmosphere is extremely chill, comfy seating, great lighting and an amazing staff that truly makes you feel welcome. Once we took our seat we were immediately greeted by our waiter who was extremely friendly, conversational and well versed in the menu and all they had to offer. The entire night we were here we were given amazing service and treated like regulars. The drinks themselves were phenomenal. They offer great gin cocktails with unique flavor profiles that I'd never had before.

Writing as the groom. I had my wedding in August, a few weeks ago, and at first The Falls seemed like the right choice, but we soon found out that we were mistaken. The Falls is a Beautiful hall located beautifully in Morrisville, PA, but the management (TC) really made the process difficult.

We understood that as the pandemic, things were going to get complicated and we still decided to proceed with our wedding. These are my reasons for rating this place a 1 star:
1. When we decided to continue with having our wedding at the Falls, TC has informed both our families that we would continue with our wedding indoors if it were to rain on the wedding day, three weeks before the wedding, TC calls us telling us that we would need for help pay for a tent (4.5K additional) but that he would split the price. At first we were bothered because prior to this, TC had given us a rate a few months before COVID occurred, then he decided to discontinue the rates and gave us new (higher) rates. He then advised us that we would be the only party in August that would utilize the tent , so we agreed to pay a portion of the tent. Come to find out later through another family friend that they had a party at the location a week prior.
2. On the day of, it was a nightmare... we had agreed with TC to come in earlier in the day to drop off our own decor and cake.... so on my way to the Falls, I had called him and he advised me that he will not open until 5PM (the wedding was scheduled for 5:30 at the church) so I could not possibly make it. 
3. On the night, we had set the tables the day before and informed the matron that we would need 12 tables and each table would be numbered accordingly to fit the agreed guest count.  We had a seating chart, TC had advised the workers to only input 11 Tables and took out only table 9. He then informed our families to pay for the extra table because there "was more people" , although we had already assigned a seat for every individual so there could not be extra individuals. So of course, we had a couple of guests whom were without a seats until our families agree to pay 500$
4.Among many other things, at the firework finale, we were told that the fireworks would be amazing and would last 15 minutes.... it only lasted 2 minutes. We have various videos that recorded the event.
4. Not to mention that TC never counted the guests nor took anybody's temperature at the wedding day, as we were advised that he would, which is why he would be charging more (to pay for the temperature gun, and extra staff members whom would he would be paying to take temperatures and sign waiver forms).
Overall, it was not what we had signed up for.

Please read, review the contract and make sure you have a CLEAR understanding of what you are signing up for.

It is a pub. In an airport. Not sure what else you might expect from a pub in an airport.

Clean as any other pub, beer/liquor selection as any other pub, food options as any other pub. TVs with various random sporting events as any other pub. There are better options in other terminals but this will wet the pre-flight whistle when waiting for your American flight out of Terminal A ad there isn't enough time to try a different option.

The buffalo shrimp comes in a little weak though...changed from 3 to 2 stars now that my appetizer is in front of me.

Another excellent gel manicure! Nga (the owner) did a fantastic job! I originally came in for a gel removal and basic mani, but for $10 more I could get a gel mani. I decided why not? That is a good deal, especially since the last gel mani I had here lasted for 2+ weeks and still looked great. Nga was very gentle with my gel removal and gave me a lovely and relaxing manicure. She then gave me an absolutely perfect gel mani. Overall, she spent 2 hours on me, making sure each nail was perfect! 

The price was just right at $45, with 10% off with an Axxess card. The place is very clean and the staff are lovely. They have a nice selection of regular polish and gel polish. The location is also great. I will obviously be back :)

Really appreciate All Star Plumbing. They installed our new bathtub today and of course we decided to go with a 315 pound new cast iron tub. Prompt service and very sensitive to the Covid situation. Nice and friendly staff.

I love the staff here! They went above and beyond to assist me in getting a perfect rug for my space pulling so many out and having to roll them back up. They never made me feel like a pain for taking my time to decide and every time I shop here their staff has provided valuable advice, advising for and against some design choices. Love this place! Great staff! My only complaint is I wish their online store or Instagram kept up with the products they have in store so you know when they get new products or if it's going to be worth the trip, but usually it always is!

Absolutely the most fresh seafood in Tarpon. And there take out through all this Covid is amazing. They say it feeds four but I would say it's closer to 6-8 depending on appetites. The Tiki Bar is amazing and a great place to grab a drink and watch the sun set. If in Tarpon this place is a must eat at.

We had to shut off the water to the house because of a shower that would not shut off, called Strongbuilt about 2:15 and was told they would have a repair man at the house after 3:00 pm, after four calls the plumber finally arrived about 8:pm. As you can expect I was besides myself but our repairman Caesar put us to rest,  with his professionalism and demeanor, Its what I needed at this time. He was able to fix our problem and did not try to upsell us parts which he said I didn't need, how's that for honesty from a business that at times are lest then honest. From this point forward I will always call Strongbuilt for our plumbing needs.
Thank You!

Very good, low-cost Jamaican food if you're in the area and have a taste for it. Their service is much quicker than other places like Hummingbird or Bamboo Grill. I came in during the middle of lunch on a weekday. No line at all, probably because it's not either downtown or on a major street.

Got the medium jerk chicken with rice and peas, plantain, and a beef patty. Jerk chicken was exceptionally cooked. A bit boney but really well-seasoned and tender. Rice and peas were great and so was the plantain (if you mess up sweet, fried plantain then you don't deserve to cook Latin American/Caribbean/West African food). Beef patty was flaky and good. Could have been spicier but that's just my preference. I'll be back!

Would never bring a group to this location. Waitress refused to split our bill. We were charged a $25 'cake' fee - although we were told this was okay when we made the reservation. Drinks were brought out at the end of the meal. Food tasted good but was over priced and left more to be desired.

The customer service at this location was nonexistent. Rolled eyes, comments under the breath... I wasn't just disappointed- I was appalled that this was a restaurant run by Maneet Chauhan. I've been to all of her other restaurants and have been amazed at the quality of food and customer service.
Really kind and honest! Best physician and dermatologisr I have seen! High quality service, friendly, and clear understanding of skin and personalized care.

My college chum and I had lunch Tuesday, August 13.

We both got a Reuben ($10.49): she with fries, me with no bread and broccoli. She was drinking iced tea. I was drinking water.

We always had two servers, so I'm figuring someone was in training. Good idea.

Her Reuben was beautiful. As was mine. I don't know what it is about a Reuben, but I can totally knife-and-fork it without bread and be perfectly satisfied. All the good stuff is inside. And the dressing was on the side.

Now . . . about the broccoli. It was a continent unto itself in a vegetable serving bowl. Steamed perfect tender-crisp. Absolutely spot-on.

Service was on-target. To-go vessels were delivered. And we both took home a couple more meals.
Service was bad. Pizza was mediocre and expensive. Supreme pizza all olives and onions.

Renee and stu are great! Very warm and welcoming people who realy went out of there way to make me and my dogs comftrable for there first time boarding and encouraged and help them open up and socialize with the other dogs while I was away! They sent me updates and pictures on how my dogs where doing! I would recommend them to anyone!
The food was incredible. I may have drooled looking at a neighboring table's pizza. Going to have to go back for that soon!

Wish I could give less than 1 Star.  Felt the need to leave a review after my garbage has not been picked up for the 3rd week in a row and multiple calls.  On one call was berated by the rep because we typically put our can out early morning of pickup and not night before. Advised her the issue has never been getting missed because the garbage was not placed out in time, the issue is they do not bother to come at all.  They ride by and miss the entire street on a regular basis. Our pickup day is on Thursday and was told it can be picked up well after 5p yet you cannot call after 5p to report you have been missed so when you call you are told they do not pick up on day it is reported and will be the next week sometime. (No refund when complete weeks are skipped. That $$ stays in their pocket). Have spoken with a couple of very nice reps and have spoken with reps that should absolutely not be working with the public.  I don't know how this company stays in business. Terrible service and does NOT care about the customer.

Fresh off the heels of a trip to Hawaii and Okinawa, I was happy to find the Aloha To Go food truck at the Cuban sandwich festival because they have a Hawaiian version of a Cuban sandwich.  Ingredients?  Kalua pork, SPAM, Swiss cheese, mango pineapple chutney with sriracha mayo on Cuban bread... Absolutely freaking face-melting.  This was the best non-traditional version of the sammich I've ever eaten in my life.

Is this item on the menu full time?  I don't know, but if not, it should be!

Truck owner is very nice as well.  She took time to field my silly questions in the middle of a busy rush without making me feel like I was being inconsiderate.

Anywho, 4 stars for now until I get back to try the Kalua pork and potato salad combo.

Been there 3 times, the first 2 were decent, summertime, the lake was pretty, it was fun to occasionally throw a piece of bread in the water and watch the animals scramble for it, and the food was average with good portions. Lately however we had some out of town guests and took them there and the other gentlemen and I both got catfish both of which were way undercooked. Like slimy and cold in the thicker middle of the filet. We ate the safe crispy outside and really good fries then, kind of grossed out, paid our check and left.
As another reviewer said, it is what it is, live music and good, cold beer with a side of finger food. I should have known better than to expect more. I might give it another try next summer but i wont be getting the catfish sushi ever again.

I'm from the N.Y./NJ area so I am a bit of a pizza snob. That being said, the pizza here is decent. Not the best, but it's good. What makes this place stand out to me is the friendly service, quick delivery and the hot wings! We have ordered from II Brothers twice now (once for a large party) and will likely be using them again!
My girlfriend and I both go to Alma - she is a great stylist for both men and women, and reasonable pricing, and we love supporting her.

This is a really good BBQ place if you're near the Vandy area. It's not "one of the best", but when you're in Nashville, that's pretty hard since there are so many great BBQ joints. Needless to say, the food here is really good and not overly priced.

I've been for dinner and brunch and both were very good, this place makes some great food. My only complaint is when I got here for brunch when they first opened it had such a smell, like dirty mop water or something. Very off putting. If I hadn't already eaten dinner here before and had it be wonderful, I probably would have left. I'm just mentioning in hopes someone sees it and will fix it because otherwise this place has been wonderful!
Recently purchased a sectional from this store and loved the experience we had. Great customer service from Susan! We will be making future purchases here for sure!!
Delicious eclair. Powerful iced coffee. Will return. Tiny place. No tables in use right now.

During this Corona Virus Crazy Time,fuel your body with the best organic food and TAKE OUT / CAR SIDE. JUST
CALL THE OWNERS CAROL AND NATALIE to treat yourself and family to the best organic restaurant in RENO. You must try their Hamburgers! Made with the finest meat and really yummy! Natalie's healthy salads will really spoil you. 
Folks this is the best of the best food in Reno. Support this local restaurant during this Pandemic and order some great food to go!

Been here a few times, and on average, the food is delicious.  They have plenty of outside seating for COVID (but their inside is lovely too!). The drinks, especially brunch drinks, are delicious.  They are taking precautions for covid.  
2 times, pre covid, they ran out of food (a lot of things were out) which is why they get 4 stars.  
overall, great local spot.
Customer service was great! That is what makes the food taste better...the Kim chi hotpot was full of flavor and the miso hot pot was pretty good...will definitely be back to try the house hot pot...

I went with my husband, kids, grandma and mom. Everyone really like their food. The pasta is great quality and delicious. There is a nice atmosphere inside and out. They gave the kids each a bit of dough to play with while we waited for the food, which they loved!

Was able to order thru  and have a loco moco delivered to me in South Reno which was nice as some of the restaurants pass McCarran do not deliver here in the Galena area.

Love the rice and gravy, and macaroni salad piece of the dish though I compared it to another one of my favs, and this dish was not as flavorful.  Good to have options, especially since I can get it on delivery.

Large quantity of food.

I will be back for more.

Still amazing. Pork chimichanga or flauta are my favorite so far. I've ordered about 50 times and it's perfect always. 
The bar is fun. The patio is amazing. 
The food is always spot on and quick. 
Can't say enough great things about this restaurant. 
If you're in Tampa try it.

We arrived at 5:59pm for our 6pm reservation for two. After a few minutes of a wait, a hostess checked us in and asked if we wanted a table or a booth; a booth thank you.

Shortly after sitting down, our server Chris came to the table to introduce himself. He took our drink order first and after bringing our drinks back, he took our food order.

We came during the second week of King of Prussia's Restaurant Week so we selected from the prefixe menu. 

I ordered a glass of merlot to accompany my romance Caesar salad (the salad could have used more dressing), planked salmon with green beans, potatoes, macaroni and cheese (lacked flavor so I wasn't too happy with this side dish), and crab polenta. For dessert, we had the choice of 1 of 7 mini indulgence desserts. I selected the S'mores cake. The S'mores dessert was eye closing delicious. I wish it was bigger it was so good.

[504]

I always love riding Amtrak.  It's a little more expensive then the bus BUT it's worth it.   The seats are roomy and clean.  It's always on time and the staff is really friendly.

Every row has a table and a charging port.  Each train I've used has a snack car which is great for longer trips.

I can do all my check in /ticketing via my phone so no more waiting on lines.

If you buy your tickets 2 weeks in advance you get a better price.

The stations are clearly marked and clean.

I'll definitely be back.

this store is far from a vintage clothing store.they are over priced for dingy stained, dirty clothing and shoes also.the owners are rude , nasty attitudes, and very weird.i would not recommend anyone to waste your time coming shop here.

I paid $20 for a gel polish manicure and I did not receive the hot towel, hand massage or moisturizer like I usually do. My polish was far from my cuticle and they looked grown out within a week... Definitely will try other places before I come back.

Went for the Musiq Soulchild show on Dec 26th at 9. Musiq was absolutely amazing and was the only saving grace of this establishment! We were at the table for 25 minutes before our waitress came over and said she would come back with the list of drinks available. 42 minutes later we still didn't get the book or didn't see our waitress again. We ended up walking to the bar to get drinks on our own. Once we finally ordered our drinks we were overcharged for the wine the price said 36 we were charged 39. 3 dollars isn't a big deal but at this point it was an issue of ethics. I see on here there are several people who were overcharged so is it the venue or the serving staff? The manager did take care of it but it should not have come to that. Tip- go for the show but eat and drink to your hearts content prior to waking into City Winery until they have better trained staff and stop overcharging.
We've ordered several times through doordash and it's been fantastic! Can't wait to try in person!

Went here because my girlfriend was feeling sick. The server recommended the "rattlesnake" because it has Ginger and can be good for a cold. After drinking it she felt much better. The tea is brewed fresh and the ingredients are mixed in a pestle & mortar on site. If you ever want some real tea don't hesitate to drop by, the people behind the counter are really helpful and can find you the perfect tea. The decor is also very fitting got a witch cafe.
Great new Taco place in Indy. Great food and the staff were nice.  They have a happy hour M-F 4-7pm - I also love that they're open 11am-2am. Tacos were great and can't wait to come back.

Such a great spot! I was on a business trip so my colleague and I went here for dinner one night and my goodness I'm glad we did! The spaghetti and meatballs were out of this world with huge portions! Definitely would be a go to place if I'm ever back in town!
The food is good and the drinks are better! Crafted quality cocktails at decent prices! Fun location to people watch. Staff is entertaining and efficient. Highly recommend.

Good service but bad food. Definitely a tourist trap. Royal House staff will stand at the door and hustle you in so that you can waste money on their low-quality food. They tried tempting me with a free appetizer if I left a 5-star Yelp review before getting my food. The only reason they deserve 2 stars is because the service was nice. We tried their crawfish beignets -- they were saturated in oil and gave me awful acid reflux. Afterwards, they brought us the fried oysters "piled high," they were not. They use low quality oysters for their fried oysters -- they think that the breading will hide the fact that they use the fowl-tasting mucus-secreting mating oysters. In addition, the breading was not very tasty, either. 

Don't waste your money here. Go to gumbo shop, mothers, Atchafalaya, acme, willie mae's, or mandina's.

If I would have read the reviews before coming to this shop, I would have never used this business.  It sounds like a lot of the same stories... 6-8 weeks turn time, losing equipment, and not placing orders when told otherwise.  

After 7.5 weeks I went to pick up our mower and they brought me out someone else's  !! They never found the mower I dropped off.  I believe they tagged it incorrectly and someone else got our mower by mistake. What else ... lost, sold or stolen ?  After arguing and getting nowhere, we left empty handed ( leaving the mower that they claimed was ours). 

I've never been treated so unfairly as a customer.

Interesting little bar that we stopped by on a Sunday. They had $2.00 shots and everyone from the bartender to the regulars were friendly and talkative. Bartender was even open to making drinks that she hadn't heard of before. If you're looking for a cheap drink, instead of one of those places that overcharge you - I would at least check out this place.

I have tried to really like this place a few times. I think overall the ambiance is nice and like the option of outdoor seating on Congress. The drinks are limited and so are the salads. The pizza is okay, I wouldn't say it is the best fired pizza I have had. I really wanted to love this place and so far, it has been ok.

Commander's is a very nice restaurant with great service. The atmosphere is classy, and it's in a good location in the city of New Orleans! I got the turtle soup with sherry, catfish, and ended with the bread pudding. It was all very delicious, and it's a great place for celebrations!
Service was extremely slow!  Food was over priced and portions were very small.  Won't be back.

The food here is authentic. The café con leche was so good. I ordered another one to go. The first one was so hot, I had to wait a few minutes to drink it, but I love my coffee really hot. The bf had 3 taquitos de pollo. He ate it all. I had a baleada that was huge. I forgot to take pictures because I love Honduran food and was so excited finding an authentic Honduran place. I ordered the tajadas con pollo frito. It was a very large plate. I barely ate anything off of it. It had about 3 or 4 pieces of fried chicken. So delicious! They also serve pupusas but we didn't order any.  Loved the restaurant!

I am thankful that I have a Starbucks close by my house for those mornings that I wake up and just don't want to make coffee. It's not often that you find a Starbucks where the employees aren't friendly and the coffee impeccable and this Starbucks is no different. I've walked in, mobile ordered and ask gone through the drive thru and each time the service has been amazing and quick. The only downside to this Starbucks has nothing to do with the service or the flavorful awakening coffee they serve but instead the layout. There are a couple of ways to enter this drive thru and neither flows nicely. If you are coming from the front of the store it's hard not to block traffic while waiting to enter the drive thru line and I've been cut in line a few times by drivers that just come around behind me apparently thinking I'm waiting on something else? Or they just cut you off coming from the backside. At this one, if there is a line I'll usually mobile order and it's literally ready within minutes. I've ordered from the line for the drive thru before and by the time I got around, parked and walked inside it was sitting waiting for me. Nothing negative to say about this place....Thank you for quenching my coffee cravings in a jiffy Starbucks....and doing it with a pretty amazing smile!

Our server, Katy was wonderful ! Kind and attentive. 
I was also happy they had an east coast selection of oysters. My only suggestion is that they install fans in the seating area they call the breeze way.
The burger & company were the high points... Not impressed when u put Bushmill's in a plastic cup... When others around are using glass... Not classy

Yes Yes Yes....I am seeing the light and I am not turning away!!!!!!  Ishkabibble is nothing but the truth.  This small cozy "hole in the wall" sub shop is the reason I come to Philly, honestly..I hear Philly has alot to offer but for me..all that doesn't matter, as long as those 5 star Philly Cheesesteaks shops (and they know who they are) keep dishing out those heavenly, sinnful sandwiches...I will keep coming to Philly!!!!

But this was my 1st time trying out Ishkabibble....some friends and I were on a Marriage retreat in Lancaster,PA and the day the retreat ended we all hopped in one car and rode about an hour and half to Philadephia for one of there infamous CHEESESTEAKS!!!!   Ok Mmmmmm I still thinking about it...bare with me as I try to explain this sinner addiction I have for these sandwiches....I have picture to show what I am not able to explain. LOL

YES ITS THAT SERIOUS!!!!

As I walk into this place...the smell of steak...cheese...Italian Sub roll...green peppers, onions...and all the other addition to this sub.  I didn't have to think twice about what I wanted just had to decide what I wanted to go with it... As I stepped up to the counter I said:
"I'll have a Cheesesteak Whiz w/ mushrooms, onion & muster....and a order of cheese fries and larger coke.  Just as quick as I order it was as quick as he started making it... it was a concert to watch the cook design and construct and build this beautiful peice of work. 

The taste of this sandwish match equally to the way that it looked as it was being made!!!!

Yeah this place is convenient and has some alright deals, but honestly i wasnt a big fan of there saff, and there attitude, i know some people can have some off days but eh, i think ill just take a few more minutes to drive to target that is nicer and has a lot friendlier staff than here....

My go to favorite eatery, I go here for breakfast lunch and dinner and get greeted by the best crew. Delicious food and drinks EVERYTIME I go. They are all hard workers and have not stopped once since Covid-19. I will always give them my business!!
Had a great time and in a very family friendly environment. The prices are reasonable and the black lights make the weekend extra exciting.

this was my first time at this location and everyone was very kind and personable. when she saw my hair growth she wanted to test it just to make sure it was long enough to remove and she said it was so she continued...it only took a little over ten minutes which was surprising...when i took a look in my car i realized it was patchy and in most places the hair had only broken and not actually been pulled out leaving it feeling stubbly...if my hair wasn't long enough i wish she would've just told me so i didn't waste my money...probably wont be coming back

edit: kamilla is extremely professional and lovely to speak with!

This place was great initially. I was so dissatisfied the last two times I was there. After the most recent encounter, I will not return. I am suspecting the poor service was since the owner was not there.

My gels were removed without soaking only with filing and the electric roller thing. I was picking out my gel color and thought she was just removing the top layer. 

When I asked, what happened she shrugged. I then asked for my nails to me cut shorter (since she had not asked what I wanted) and she immediately started speaking in another language to the lady doing my pedicure. I was so frustrated and immediately said is there a problem? 

Removing gels without soaking is just careless. Clearly they do not care about my nails.

Pak you? No, pak yue is the shyyyyttttt! I have NEVER had an egg roll and spicy mustard that good in my life. House special lo mein was delightful, honey walnut chicken was especially good, happy family was great although not as spicy as I'd like but they gave me some poppin chili oil which make up for it. I'd say, if you got da munchies order from pak yue!

I'm highly disappointed. The food tastes good but the employees on shift in the evening all had tasteless attitudes. If you can't take an order right or give the right food maybe this place should focus on drive through only. We've been here twice and both times we had the same problem. Really sucks considering all other locations are farther from us, but are willing to make the drive after this last encounter.
I will DEFINITELY order delivery from them again! The shrimp scampi bucatini was spicy with garlic, and the burrata was the freshest I've had in a very long time. YUM!!!

Loved this shop! Very aesthetically pleasing. I was able to ask questions and receive good information and answers about the plants and care.

I picked out a Rattlesnake plant. It's good for indoors and I love that the leaves almost tuck themselves into bed. So cute!

Let's not pretend that Ross is trying to be something it's not, because frankly that would be ironic and hilarious. Let us instead focus on what Ross does not do well in comparison to other retail shops in the area. At no point were there more than two cashiers despite the day or the hour (yes even big holiday shopping weekends). The store itself was dirty, things were not properly stored or arranged, team members were frantically being chased around the aisles while there were more than twenty customers waiting to check out. The narrative that a loss prevention specialist needs to stand around while the store burns down is also very questionable. I think that there must be some deep flaw in the way Ross continues to operate all of its stores and continues to think that this is okay. At the end of the day, the service/experience must be tolerable or the clothing/product selection and pricing must be adequate. Ross is neither, and the fact that everyone accepts this and lowers their expectations accordingly tells you all you need to know.

I used to be a happy member of PSC-Radnor.  I'm still a member but am looking to change, because concern for the welfare of their clients has declined in recent months.  For instance, I came in one day to swim, and the pool was closed indefinitely without notice.  In the past I've suggested keeping an email list of regular pool users to notify patrons of such events and not have people make the drive fruitlessly, but it's too much trouble for them.  I used to take an exercise class in Studio 1 where there's no air circulation.  There used to be a large fan which helped, but it's been missing for three weeks or more and the room is now oppressively close.  Today I almost fainted and will not be going back.  I think the fan broke or they moved it to a different room which was even more oppressive, and since they don't value the welfare of their patrons they haven't replaced it.  In the past I've given this gym a high rating, but things have changed.  (The trainers are still good!)

We called many furniture and mattress stores and were still deciding when we heard an ad on the radio and saw another ad on television and called. We called this store two separate times and got Brittany on the phone who expertly answered questions addressing my concerns because of my severe back injury from Vietnam. 
Then, because we thought this store had what might be the answer for my injury we came in the same evening for the red tag sale. Brittany was most concerned for my back injury and really worked above and beyond the call of duty to match the right mattress after I tried the ones on display. When it was found the red tag sale mattress had been sold she went to work to patiently go over inventory and found the right mattress and boxspring with accessories and we will be getting the mattress this weekend on Sunday if I80 isn't shut down due to foul weather from another location that had the inventory. 
We really appreciate what she did and will refer to other Vets at the DAV and people we meet at the VA hospitals because so many have injuries and problems finding the right mattress.

One night last week, my boyfriend and I were trying to figure out where we were going to have dinner and then it dawned on me- THE LIVELY is open now! I have been dying to try their food for weeks now and super excited to finally be visiting this establishment that we have heard so much about for months!  As a resident of Los Angeles for a near decade I grew quite accustomed to some serious eats and I heard lot's of great chatter about this place!  We arrived last minute and definitely not "dressed" for the evening, but as their website states...The dress code is as follows...

It's your party. Dress lively!

Love it!

We entered and we were greeted immediately by a member of the waitstaff and we were told that there was a 45 minute wait. We didn't plan ahead or make a reservation, so we sort of expected that and we had absolutely no problem with it! 

As we approached the swanky facade and opened the large glass doors, I was taken aback by the incredibly, creative and "Lively" space with it's open floor plan, tasteful furniture that was cozied up against the walls, hidden in nooks, and then there was that daring, monkey wallpaper that put a smile on my face! So fun! They asked if we would like to take a seat and have a cocktail and of course we said YES!  My man got a Negroni (which is not on the menu, but they were happy to make it for us) and I got The Bird. Flower. Fish. Cocktail made with Gin, St. Germain, Lemon-Thyme Syrup, Blueberry Preserves. They were divine!  

We started out with some appetizers and ordered The CROQUES DES BOIS which was a Country Style Duck Ham, Apple Butter, Face Rock Spicy Cheddar, Pickled Jalapeño, Acme Baguette and it was to die for!
The caramelization that they got on that bread and the combination of salt, fat and sweet was something to write home about! Seriously good!!!  Then we ordered the Meatballs! Not too brag too much, but It is hard to believe that anyone can match my Italian-American, homemade meatballs, but they did it! They were full of flavor, the sauce had dimension and you can tell that they cooked it down for a while, and the meatballs were super moist and flavorful. Then we got our salad on with the OHANA NO-TILL LETTUCES
Acme Garlic Croutons, Shaved Radish, Sprouts, Lemon-Champagne Vinaigrette!! The greens were so fresh and crisp and the dressing was so nice!! 

The ONLY -TINY little complaint that I had throughout the dinner was that the chef is heavy handed on the salt. I LOVE SALT and I use quite a bit when I play chef, but it was JUST A TAD too much in most of the dishes.   UP NEXT: Dinner!  YUM. I had my eyes on the  BUCATINI ALL'AMATRICIANA made with Tomato Sauce, Smoking Goose Guanciale, Chili, House Smoked Pecorino Romano (So good) since it's one of my favorite pastas and I was really looking forward to it! I was not disappointed. The sauce was gorgeous, (same as the sauce they used in the meatballs??) I think so. There was a tad bit too much oil that glistened on the plate for me, but because the dish was so good, I didn't care! I just swiped it off the plate with some bread and was good to go!  My boyfriend ordered the RISI e BISI made with Spring Pea Risotto, Prosciutto, Parmigiano Crisp, Lemon Oil, Tendrils and he was so impressed. It was creamy and cooked just right. I tasted it and the lemon oil just took it over the top! It was the perfect touch of acidity for a rich dish such as Risotto. 

This place deserves a HUGE welcome to Boise! We do have many great establishments with yummy food, but this place just took things up a notch! YAY!  I do declare that it is now my favorite restaurant!!!!  Oh I almost forgot!! We had dessert! It's a rare occasion that I actually partake but I could NOT resist the BLACK FORREST which was a Dark Chocolate Brownie, Bordeaux Cherries, Whipped Crème Fraîche!! HEAVEN! It was dark in the restaurant and my phone didn't like that, so the photos are not the best. My apologies.

We cannot wait to visit again!  Bravo!

Yard House has a huge selection and during lunch today they were still willing to make substitutions due to my allergies so I could have exactly what I wanted. I had a great Bloody Mary to boot. The service was outstanding. It was a good afternoon meal. The one con I have for this Indy location, it is often tough to get in there based on its proximity to sporting arenas and the convention center. That is largely a plus, but can also work against you when you want to go there.

Honestly one of the worst stays if my life. First check in was crazy and so much going on with very little staff. But the hotel room was semi nice we found walnuts on the floor AND a nail... but the noise from the elevators was horrendous. It was constant and  never ending at night. We couldn't even sleep that's who bad the noise was...

I've been to this location for a Brazilian wax twice with Eury and I was quite pleased with both experiences. The first time I went I was kinda nervous since it was my first time ever getting waxed, but Eury was very reassuring. The waxing job probably took like 15-20 minutes, it honestly didn't feel long despite the pain. After the wax job,  I wasn't given any directions for post-wax care so I had to do research online. 

The price is actually very good and very competitive for a man's wax compared to other places. The room was very clean and well kept. Everyone was friendly and service was great. If you're planning to get your wax done for the first time, be sure to check in on Yelp to get a first-time customer discount. Remember to bring your punch card anytime after if you plan to come back - I recommend it.

This would've been a 5 star only if it wasn't so expensive! The food is amazing. I'm a native Korean born and raised and this place serves some legitimate Korean food. I understand that it's rare to find a Korean restaurant around this area but it is quite overpriced. Any soup should cost ~$10 but you're looking at about ~$15 here. If you're only concerned about the taste/quality, hands down 5/5!

A huge thank you to Richie!! This was the first time we used the service and won't be the last. So appreciated his prompt response. Was right on time and super fun to talk to. 

We will use this service again very soon.

If you're looking for a top notch cleaning service this is the best! Easy to schedule, accommodates to my schedule,  trustworthy and professional.  I won't go anywhere else , my house is sparkling clean
Tacos were on point. Eloté was delicious. Margs were super fresh and strong. And the atmosphere was fun and chill. Definitely will be back!
Truffle fries and a flatbread pizza are my go tos here. Great food and open later than the average restaurant which is always a plus for late night cravings.

This park offers everything! Water, birds, fishing, pavilions (3), and a wonderful playground that (when the slides aren't broke) offers everything! One-of-a-kind equipment. The orb this place has is cool, and the up/down design of the main playground is unique.
Super friendly and beautiful place. Melissa helped my girlfriend to find her beautiful wedding dress. She was amazing. Made this bridesmaid job super easy!!!! Def recommend this place.
The racism exhibited by the bouncer was shocking. The management did nothing to address the concerns.
Valvoline was great! People were extremely friendly, respectful and efficient. As long as my car works, I'll be happy. Would recommend this place. Switched from jiffy lube after one bad experience.

Great place with amazing coffee. Tucked away a little but easy to spot with the signage. 
We pass all the time and will be stopping by often!!
This is a great place to have dinner for two or give a birthday party or just by yourself the food is great and so is the atmosphere

Takeout and delivery available during COVID-19

Cap's is a favorite post Costco hang for the fam. We love that the sandwiches are made to order with fresh toppings stacked atop perfect hoagie rolls. They make one of the best Italian style subs in town, but I also love the pulled turkey too. 

The best part of Cap's is that they offer both sweet picked leper's AND hot pepper relish as toppings. These are things I've only found back east, and in my book they take sandwiches from good to great.

Not that it matters at the moment, but This location has a remodeled interior, which makes it extra comfy for dine in. Cap's subs travel well and feee an army, so this is a perfect quarantine family meal!
ITS AMAZING! You just need to pre order an hour in advance. Just remember, you are not entitled to the best cheesesteak in Philly!
Best ice cream in Philly. Sandwiches are great! Lines can get long though so plan your visit accordingly

One of our favorite restaurants in SB, we've been here plenty of times.  We're from LA and love SB, the vibe the weather and amazing food.  Also cocktail here are amazing, very reasonable $ and customer service is great.

The massage from Don was amazing! It's a safe place, very comfortable with soft music and twinkling stars (if you can ever open your eyes...so relaxing). He even gave me some stretches to do to help me with tight shoulder and neck muscles. Definitely stellar!

Pretty good Pho. Very tasty and they do a great job at carry out. I've had problems before with carry out Pho but they did a great job. Spring rolls very fresh. Pleasant staff. Will be my go to Pho place

Been visiting Ishkabibble's for a few years now.. alway's a fun place to stop at there Spanish Fries with cheese sauce are a favorite of mine.. nice hot peppers onions fried together with the fries and then topped with cheese sauce aka Wiz... very unique but simple combination that always fill's me up and hit's the spot! Be warned though the Spanish fries are enough for 2 people to eat they give you that much. Cheese steak's wise I will say they top Jim's down the street if were doing a South Street cheese steak battle.. very good rolls, onions are outstanding and there cheese wiz is a bit tastier then some other establishment's.. I might even go far enough to say they can challenge other's down the street like Geno's, Pat's, Tony Luke's..

This spot is very unassuming from the outside, but it is everything I look for In a restaurant: clean, good food, fair pricing, and good service. 
This husband and wife team serve up some tasty dishes and treat you like they are truly happy to serve you. If you go for a late lunch or early dinner, you can avoid the crowds. I love it!
Linda was our server and she was amazing!!!! She was prompt, friendly and always knew what we wanted before we had to ask.
After calling for two days I finally managed to arrange for someone to come out and give an estimate. The guy never showed up nor did I receive a phone call asking to reschedule. No thank you.

I come here at least once a week! Everything is always so fresh and I absolutely LOVE the Lava sauce. Soooo good and extra spicy!!!! I get the regular poke salad with ahi tuna and spicy tuna with tons of toppings like cucumber, sweet onion, avocado, seaweed salad, green onion.....just to name a few.....and wouldn't have it any other way!!!!!

Real Mexican food. After eating here you will be telling everyone about it. Not many places to sit but what it lacks in size it make up for it in flavor. The tamales are the best I've ever had. The bread is so soft and fresh daily for their tortas. Do yourself a favor and go here

Tried this place out while driving through Santa Barbara this past weekend.

First off the food. I got a poke salad with a bunch of toppings. It was super fresh and the sauces were very good. What is good is they they let you put as many of the toppings as you want. The only thing extra it seems is the avocado but thats kind of typical of everywhere I think. Crab salad was bomb.

Service was good. I took it to go obviously but the employee working there was nice and was wearing a mask the whole time. It didn't take too long to make my bowl and pay. The place looks nice with all the lighting and stuff and I would eat from here again.

Don't ever eat here. It smells like absolute garbage. I sent my wine back twice because it had lip prints on the glass! They just kept bringing back glass after glass dirty! In the middle of a pandemic I'll definitely think twice about eating out again. Wow!! 
My mom asked for onions on her burger and literally got an onion the size of a quarter on it. The kids burgers were literally dehydrated, disgusting. 
I would have thoroughly enjoyed Culver's over this nasty place.  I asked for a side of rice and it was so hard I chipped a tooth!!!! No napkins, no silverware! I will be calling the health department tomorrow. Good riddance!

Had an early quiet dinner here tonight. We had the hummus, gyro platter and grilled shrimp platter. Everything was amazingly fresh and delicious. Very large portions so now we have leftovers for lunch tomorrow. First time here but will definitely be back. They had the tables well distanced and there is plenty of room. They wore masks and are offering curbside pickup. The only sad part was that the baklava was not done cooking but I am sure it is amazing!

Nice for something to eat while walking Broadway or something sweet after dinner. The case and display could be labeled better. Felt like I was bothering the staff to ask what was what, when they were already busy.
Amazing wings for cheap. The place is really homey and they welcome regulars. If you wanna just hangout and eat some bar food this is a great place to do that.

This is a decent Walmart, pretty well-stocked and convenient.

No problems here. Staff are useful, and the pharmacy service is excellent.

Be careful driving in the parking lot, as many customers seem to be enthusiastic speeders.

I was so happy to discover KDHX this week!  I absolutely love that I have FINALLY found a community radio station that plays music other than the same old stuff they play over and over again on the top 40 radio stations.  Today was blues day  at the station, which made for an awesome drive home.

Tune into this non-commercial, local station!!

The wait on Saturday was so long! (2 hrs) But luckily we still walked around while one person waited because Bourbon Street and French Quarter was a nice vibe. 

The food itself was good. We got the Gumbo and the shrimp.

PR, baby!!!

The Rock n Roll series have been lucky races for me. Every RnR race I've done (I've done 4 so far), I've gotten progressively better and better. What makes it even more awesome is the fact that for my 1st destination race, I got my best time. 

We were luckily enough to stay about a mile from the epicenter on St. Charles Ave. and we walked our way to the start line as our warm up. The weather luckily fared and although it was cold at 630a, it quickly warmed up within the hour. 

The start area was waaay too crowded, but several positives to note: Port-o-pottie lines were short (YAY), there was breakfast food to munch on, checking in bags was a breeze, lots of water stations along the course, and super FLAT course.

I loved the fact that we ran thru some cool areas: Uptown, French Quarter and at the end, the City Park. It was nice and shady running on St Charles Ave., but as soon as we started running thru the city, it got unbelievably HOT. Luckily, it wasn't muggy or raining (like the prior days) - it was perfect running weather.

A couple cons: the streets were so narrow that it was hard to share the road with 33K other runners, and lots of potholes!!! Watch where you run because the streets were full of humps and bumps. I almost twisted and rolled my ankles several times due to the uneven roads. 

The finish line was full of cheerleaders and it was an awesome venue for the perfect finish at the park. The park is beautiful and serene for the runners to stretch, eat and drink post-race. 

Bag check was easy to pick up, but the shuttle service was a little confusing as it's on the other side of the park. Very long line, but went quickly. 

I'm happy that my first destination run was very memorable and even more ecstatic that I had my best time in a halfie!!!

The two things that stick out of the most was the attractive country bar style atmosphere as we entered and then the horribly unprofessionally prepared food that was served to us.
With very few people in the bar it took the kitchen over a half hour to prepare the meatloaf for my wife and the rib nachos for me.  She said the meatloaf tasted good, slightly dry.   The nachos tasted good as well, but the whole thing was COLD.  Not just "not warm", but cold!
I'm fairly certain they took the rib meat from the fridge mixed it with the nachos, canned nacho cheese, shredded cheese (that wasn't melted), added the jalapeño slices and served it as was- cold.  Because they darn sure didn't place it in the oven.
The bartender asked how it was and I said COLD.  She just stared blankly then looked down and went about her other activities.  Why did she ask?
I can tell you this much, whoever works in that kitchen is NOT a professional chef. They are kitchen workers hitting that minimum wage.  Which is the fault of whoever does the hiring and owners.
If you're going for that country bar feel. Not bad.  Do NOT go for the food or drinks- unless it's just beer.
And that is 100% the fault of the owners and management

Thankfully I did not purchase my vehicle here but I came to Walker Chevrolet for an first oil change and they needed to do an update due to my radio would come on but no sound and no back up camera.  I talked to Greg on the phone and told him my problem who was very nice. But then on the day of my appt I dealt with TJ who I then had to explain the entire situation again.  Which I would have thought there would have been notes in the system.  I was told it would take 3 hours to work on my car which I was fine with and had the courtesy driver bring me back to work.  TJ was supposed to call me when my car was done and I never received a call.  The courtesy driver advised his last pick up was at 4:30 and I was so busy at work I almost totally forgot that they never called.  I called at 4:21 to be told that my car was done. Who knows if they would have called in time for me to catch the shuttle.  I picked up my car and I received no explanation from service on what was done or how my car looks under the hood.  I used to have a Honda and had exceptional service with their service dept.  They would greet their customers before they even got out of the car, and at the end of the appt gave you a sheet that listed all components of the vehicle and would mark a check mark in a red, yellow or green box to let you know what is good or getting ready to go bad like an air filter.  Even though this dealer is close to work, I will not be back to this service dept.

Recently our girl's night out led us to visit Bonefish grill on Tyrone Blvd. Our group chose this spot because of their Bang bang shrimp and happy hour. I was part of a group of 10 women and just about all ordered something different. I ordered the corn chowder and bang bang shrimp. I was very disappointed with my order. The shrimp had too much mayonnaise, it tasted horrible and I couldn't finish it. The corn chowder also tasted bland, there was no seasoning added. I was very unhappy with my meal. However, the other women loved their drink orders. I left wondering what happened to their food it felt like they had lost their edge.

Stopped here to pick up sushi Burritos to cap off a long road trip. It was a little out of the way for us but totally worth it. I ordered online which worked perfectly. The food was fresh and delicious. Service was very friendly.

I was so happy to find Dr. Castellano after my longtime dentist retired. The staff are very friendly. He is very experienced and professional, while also very friendly. Pricing is reasonable. He has always done great job for me, I have no complaints and am very happy with his services.
They're supposed to be open until 9 PM, but they locked the door at 8:40 this evening just as we arrived.

Went here at 11:10am just after opening with my 3 friends. We we were taking our dear friend who happens to have special needs ON HER BIRTHDAY. The person working in the back acknowledges us and rudely says "a little early to eat huh?" Like are we not allowed to eat here sir? After being so brutally welcomed into a food establishment which you would think has personable staff, we placed our order and decided to take photos of our birthday girl with her Starbucks. A now different worker from the back proceeds to scream out "GIRLS! You can't have those drinks in here!".  We sadly looked down at our Starbucks coffee and felt disheartened...on Valentine's Day...for bringing coffee drinks into a food establishment. Excuse me, what. Our birthday girl never felt more devastated. We sadly ate our food which was actually okay but this type of service was so bad it changed our taste buds, or maybe the food was still okay, but our perceptions were changed as a result of our melancholy mood.
Very good BBQ. The ribs are tender and flavorful. The star, however was the smoke green beans.

Road tripping from Nevada to Texas and Tucson was our mid-point. Traveling with a 90 lb German Shepherd can make it difficult to find a nice place to stay. We found Hotel McCoy on the Bring Fido app. Great find! It's a classic mid-century motor lodge that has been renovated and turned into a really cool local artist inn. We arrived at about 10pm. We were greeted by the employee. Very friendly and informative. She checked us in and provided us with two complimentary beer/wine drink tokens and information for the complimentary breakfast. After dropping off our luggage, we used the drink tokens. Excellent selection of local craft beers (draft and cans) and local wines. The room was very clean and nicely appointed. The breakfast was delicious! The tamales are extra, but they're a must! Absolutely delicious!! Anyway, this was an amazing find and we will definitely be staying there in the future when passing through Tucson!
Got the lunch special General Tso Chicken it was so good. Great containers I wish I had more broccoli but good nonetheless
No parking, valet only. Breakfast is an upgrade for Honors members as well.

I've been using American Collectors for my 1983 BMW 320i for almost 10 years now, and have generally been satisfied with the premiums and the customer service. I'm rating as 4-stars, not because of any negative experience with them, but because I think true test of any insurance company is when it comes time to submit a claim, which thankfully I have not had to do yet. But up until now it has been mostly positive. About the only negative I can think of is the driving restrictions. I'm limited to 2500 miles annually, but none of that mileage can be used for "general purpose" driving; it can only be used for driving in parades, to and from car shows, repair shops, and the like. I personally feel that with such a restrictive annual mileage I should be able to drive it in any manner I desire, short of ridiculous examples such as racing, using as a taxi, etc. So basically this ends up being my garage queen/weekend/fair weather car.

Not sure how replacing a battery has anything to do with this. I mean if you put on a mask and use rubber gloves, you should be able to alleviate your misinterpreted concerns.

I'm talking chug water while you rub the salt off, salted. We then got the bill, neither of us finished our fries (because again, pain) and somehow had gotten charged for 4 orders. I get that happens but the strangest part was that the server was like that's weird they didn't give me 4...and we made it clear we didn't order 4, but she insisted that the kitchen should've given her 4? It was just weird. Maybe third times the charm but as of right now I'm not rushing to return.
