The smell of fresh & delicious treats fills the air of the mall and leaves you wanting to buy the entire store- or at least crave it. I am always finding a new treat every time I pop into Godiva. My absolute favorite creation is the chocolate dipped macaroon. You also cannot go wrong with the sea salt caramel truffles. If you sign up for Godiva's reward system you can earn one free truffle a month! Heck ya ;)

We waited at least 20 min in line and there were only 2 cars in front of us. This DQ in particular is always way slower than others. I realize they serve food, but even when we get up to the window we have to wait forever. My cookie dough blizzard barely had any cookie dough in it and it was not mixed in well at all. I did not get one bite with cookie dough until the very bottom. My boyfriend's Mint Oreo blizzard was not green like the image on the menu, but we still had hope that it would be mint. However, it did barely tasted like mint at all. We were very disappointed. Also, at least two of the employees had their masks pulled so far down that they weren't even covering their faces at all.

Ordered a Seared Gulf Shrimp po boy that contained coriander lime spice, sriracha aioli, herbs, daikon radish, carrot, cucumber. I got the sriracha aioli on the side. Not a big fan of sriracha but that aioli was good.

The po boy was delightful. The bread was fresh, a nice crunch on the outside and soft on the inside. The shrimp were fresh, and every bite offered a different flavor combination. The daikon offered a refreshing bite. The lime was tasty and not overbearing. The carrots and cucumber added a nice crunch.

Overall, a really good spin on a classic po boy.
UH-MAZING!! Great sushi, no wait time, quick and EXCELLENT service. Definitely would recommend if you are looking for all you can eat that doesn't short you on good quality.
I had my brows waxed at the benefit brow bar. I'm not even sure how this happened that they were THAT uneven. Unfortunately I didn't even notice how bad they were until after I left.

Their boba is by far the best boba in town - SoCal approved. SoCal transplants or visitors, they even have mini boba and pudding toppings as well as pate chaud! My friends and I ordered the rose milk tea with egg pudding, Thai tea with egg pudding, Thai tea with mini boba, strawberry milk tea with coffee jelly, and rose tea with boba - everything was great. Not too sweet, no chalky or powdery textures, and, might I add, great service. The people are very friendly. Definitely a new local staple. Tea Leaf Cafe, you'll be seeing me often.

Well, up until today, we've had good experiences here. Today, with my kids standing front and center near the register, waiting to be acknowledged, nearly every server passed by, Some with food, some without, all made eye contact and not a single one said a word. When I asked if we should seat ourselves, someone pointed to a wait list in the counter. An employee looked the list over and said she wasn't sure if they were still using it, but to put my name down anyway. (We were the ONLY people waiting)

We ended up leaving because it was obvious no one had a clue as to what was going on.

Excellent food, we had tacos,  guacamole and salsa. I choose the coconut tequila it was so tasty! We also had a Bloody Mary yummy! Blue moon was also served in our party! Javier and Jose are wonderful hosts! This is a must stop for cocktails dinner and great food

The ONLY good thing I can say about this place is that Kevin does very good work and my nails have looked great the few times he has done them. HOWEVER, the logistics and service are absolutely horrible. The first time I went with my mom and we did not make an appointment. Guests were taken that arrived after us and we were informed that it was because they had made appointments (which was understandable). We ended up waiting nearly 45 minutes before they started on either of us. We were both finally done nearly two hours later from when we arrived. My nails looked great and I was happy despite the wait but let it go because I failed to make an appointment. My mom's pedicure, on the other hand, was sub-par and she even had to ask the woman doing her nails to remove a large clump of polish on her nail after she was finished and repaint it. With this being said, even though my mom said she would not go back, I was happy with how my nails looked so I decided I would give them a few more chances. From that point on, I always made an appointment (specifically requesting Kevin) in advance. EVERY time I made an appointment, however, my nails were started 45-60+ minutes after my arrival/appointment time (I normally showed up around 10 minutes early just in case they would be able to get me in -wishful thinking ) Even though I made an appointment with Kevin, every single time another nail tech would try to do my nails and each time I emphasized that my appointment was made with Kevin.   After becoming fed up with waiting, each time I ended up letting another tech start. This last time (which was the last straw for me) a girl started on my nails and then Kevin finished. The acrylic looked so misshapen that Kevin had to go back and add acrylic to even them out once he finally started working on me. Oh, and also, she dropped a nail tool on the floor and immediately picked it up and continued on my nails, which doesn't send me a great message about the sanitation and cleanliness of tools here. Overall, I know this waiting issue is large because every single time I have gone, there have been at least 5-10 individuals who have also waited an extremely long time but ended up walking out. I understand being extremely busy but what is the point of appointments if I can never get them done within a reasonable time? My time and other customers' time is valuable and it's frustrating to be deceived and waste your time as a result. They allow walk ins and don't inform customers that they probably won't be able to get to them (when it's extremely obvious), I have seen them tell the prices to many customers who were shocked and felt deceived because it was much more than they were expecting (I think they come up with random up charges in their head), and if you needed any more convincing of the unprofessionalism of this business, just read their responses to the negative reviews. My advice to the employees of this business: if you are going to allow customers to make appointments then maybe you should not allow walk-ins and make appointments a requirement for service. I have seen them answer the phone to customers making appointments and they never write down the time or the name or anything. Without any record of this, I'm sure they tell multiple people they can come at the same time which is where this issue stems from. Also, you should be a little more professional and respectful to your customers (especially in your public responses to criticism). Instead of taking it personally and responding immaturely, maybe you should take this into consideration to better your business! 

Overall, to anyone looking to try Chic Nails, if you value your time and sanity DO NOT go here. The nails may look good (if you get Kevin in my opinion) but it is NOT worth the hassle and waste of time and that is why I will not be returning.
The BEST!! Gave me exactly what I wanted and loved It! Kevin is very friendly and takes careful time with his work. He really knows what he is doing!

I love this place. Laid back and amazing food. My favorites are the pastrami and "famous style" chopped liver   The only disappointment is their big black and white cookies. The last 3-4 times we had them they were either stale and crumbly  or just not soft like we always enjoy.

I have been coming to Deor for about 8 years. They used to be located in the strip mall over by the Earls and have since moved to their newest location which is conveniently located in the McKenney Ave strip mall near the Safeway. 

The studio is well lit and the decor is modern. I always get my hair cut by Sam. He does a great job on the hair cuts. He remembers my style between cuttings so I don't have to explain it every time. The haircuts aren't too expensive (less than $20) not including tip. 

He used to take walk ins exclusively but he now takes appointments which is good. There have been some long waits to get haircuts from him in the past. Not because there weren't other people available to cut hair but because everyone waits for Sam to cut their hair. 

I take both my boys (6 years & 18 months) to get their hair cut here. Carly cuts their hair and is great with them. She's patient, kind and does a good hair cut with a fidgeting kid. 

Sam owns Deor and is great to deal with! I have ordered beauty products from him for my wife with great success. I would definitely recommend this business if you looking to get your hair cut in St. Albert.

I seriously love love love , bringing my children here . I love the fact every time i go is never crowded . Staff are friendly and very helpful. The only reason why i am giving them a 4 star is because i think it's a little over price . I mean am thankful i can afford to pay for both my children but if a family of 5 would like to go am sure it's not affordable. But either then that i have no complaints.

Like going there to get my meat, good selection and prices and almost always in stock compared to the family market down the street. Always out of paper towels in the bathroom though, could improve on that.

Another chain but a good one because of the LARGE menu. We love the sampler appetizer and have ordered it more than a few times and to go. The chicken avocado egg rolls are amazing and the grilled artichokes are also very very tasty. The Tuna Tartare is very good but really not worth it unless you NEED tuna tartare. Everything we have ordered has been consistently good. Shrimp Scampi, Steak, Angela's pasta, Burrito, Salads. The only question is what cheesecake to order. We sometimes don't eat that after the meal, but one should get a slice to take home. You really have to. The parking is mall parking and valet. The lines can be long, be strategic, not always the best time to go during Christmas etc.

Why aren't there more Chelsea's?  i had the fortune to have my hair cut from Chelsea.  Like the name implies, the cuts were super!

She listened to what I wanted, looked at the photo of what we hoped it would look like when she was done, then went to work.  From there she took artistic license to work around the all the nuances and issues of the head she was handed, including a less than perfect cut before. 

Viola!  Chelsea's cut far exceeded our expectations.  The only problem is we are only here visiting, and We can't afford to fly her in every month.  This review is the best we could do.  Thanks for the Supercut Chelsea!

This is a 4-5 star place when it's outdoors. However, now that it's indoors on Columbus Blvd for the winter (about 20 outdoor vendors - weather permitting), it is more of a 3-3.5 star. All professional dealers w/ higher prices than in summer. I still managed a few purchases, but not as many as in the spring/summer/Fall. Also, way too much Mid-Century Modern, jewelry and clothing vendors. 

I'll def come here when I'm bored, but look forward to it moving outside. 

Free parking/free admission.

the beer was mediocre and so was the hostess.

the seafood cheesecake was excellent and so was our server maryanne. 

now you may be thinking..."seafood cheesecake?!" and i hear you. but that's because you're thinking of a decadent, fruit topped and graham cracker crusted dessert. and so was i. but this is a shrimp topped, crawfish and crab savory deliciousness. give it a good shmear on the crusty french bread and enjoy!

oh yaaaa! also had the creme brulee which was tasty as well!

The only reason I am giving this 2 stars is my son was seen quickly his firstt visit. My son went to er with genital area issues that panic any 23 year old.(not Viagra related) The first dr did try to assist and seemed to help with issue but when we got home we had to go back an hour later for same issue and severe pain from needles to a particular area to draw blood. Different dr this time. The first Dr. DID NOT finish his notes before he left. This Dr. didn't see an issue..had no notes to what the first dr HAD seen and was rude and no bedside manner at all. Now, my son had just lost his Medicaid but had done responsible thing and signed up for Obamacare but this incident fell at a time before new insurance kicked in. So My son gets bill for both visits in same night to the tune of roughly $5000! No xrays,tests or mris..just a few pills and a needle to drain fluid. The dr services alone were $1094.00 each! The other charges are for one fluid drain and "emergency services"..one for $700 and one for $800 (remember 2 visits in same night).The second dr looked at him for a total of 20 minutes  and gave him 2 Tylenol and again saw no issue told him to follow up with urologist and had no notes to refer to from dr he had seen 1.5 hrs earlier! I am floored. My son called St francis and asked if they could lower it and he would pay it off and they said nope.They had already given him uninsured discount(that $700 bill would have been $1454.00 Again NOT including dr charges just for being in er and I suppose for nurse. So a full time college student who works part time  is $5000 in debt. Sad

I absolutely love Slyce!  I'm from up north and grew up on NJ & NY pizza... so when I moved to FL finding a good pizza place was a challenge!  

I heard of Slyce and was hesitant, as I tend to prefer local Mom & Pop pizzerias, not chains!  

I gave it a shot and I'm sure glad I did!  I especially like that they have whole wheat crust which is practically impossible to find!  I always get the margarita personal size and my husband gets the Here's Johnny, which is topped very generously!  (He asked me to add a note that if you don't care about your arteries the Chicago Deep Dish pizza they offer is beyond amazing!  So much meat... so much cheese!)

I find it to be slightly more expensive than other places, (something like $15ish for a personal 10") but the freshness of the ingredients and the whole wheat crust are enough to make me come back!

If I could give a zero I would. They gave rules but when people don't follow them, there are no repercussions. Multi times I've seen people wearing jeans when there is a no jeans rule. Jeans can tear up the padding on the machines.  People don't clean the equipment after using it. I've said something numerous times, about the same people and was told they can't do anything about it. They can remind the people, but that's it. I asked if they ever ban someone or send them home for violating the rules, they just laughed and said no. Why have rules when you don't enforce them?

I pay double the price here then other gyms. I left Planet Fitness for this reason and bad customer service. I may go back and save save money.

A cozy bar, massive amounts of food and cheap beer? Yep this is my kind of place. John and Molly's is your typical neighborhood bar. The kind of place where everyone knows everyone. Not quite a dive bar yet nothing that's going to get them a Zagat sticker on the door anytime soon, which is perfectly fine. 

This is the kind of place where you come to unwind with a couple of friends. If Yuengling, Bud, and Coors aren't your thing, you are in luck as they have Spellbound IPA on tap. Grab a burger or plate of nachos while you're at it. It will be money well spent and you will have enough food for 3 people. Thank you John and Molly for keeping it real.

Beware this place is a scam . Check your card a few days after your stay I have got charged a smoking charge without any proof with out any smoking in the room . Got hung up on a few times trying to inquire about it. Save your money

Since I was about 14, this has been the best place I've ever seen a show.  I've had the pleasure of seeing some of my absolute favorite bands here, which I'll remember for the rest of my life.  I'll never forget my first time seeing All Else Failed, or having my ears blown out by Boris or Torche/Floor more than a few times.  

You will never find a better DIY venue, and I feel spoiled for having access to this place from such an early age.  In the summer it gets a little hot, but who cares?  If you're there for the right reasons, the heat shouldn't bother you and the raw, uncompromising energy of this venue should fully absorb you.

This review is about Sinclair Moving & Storage-located in New Jersey.

First of all, they are a subsidiary of Mayflower-  the well known national Mover.

I had used Mayflower on a Coast to Coast move 2 years ago.

OK....let me state I needed only a short move, from Center City Philly to South Philly & wanted to be sure I got a quality Company that was dependable-

I want to say, I gave Sinclair Moving a 5 Star rating-!   They were terrific & if you want a mover with reputable people, know how to move, with great movers  (Not like some other "Fly by Night Companies that seem to get their movers off the streets)-

First of all I got a quick estimate from Company President, Robert Reeves.
He is the ultimate professional .   He looked over my Apt, wrote down each thing that had to be moved & within...12  Minutes gave me an estimate.  No "BS...No "Con Jobs...Just an Honest, reliable down to eath professional.

Just seeing him, his personality, his professional way, sold me !  I knew I was in good hands.

After  that..I was followed up by a charming, personable, efficient young  lady,  Julie,  who takes her time with any questions..ALWAYS get back, if you leave her a message & just made me feel very comfortable, like I was  in...."Good Hands" !

The day of the move the 3  movers...Sean , Rick & Kenji arrived at the appointed time.

I was not feeling well  (I had some minor outpatient surgery two days before)-

I explained things to the driver Sean...(What closet I wanted to be put in my storage area)--& then ...met the other two young gentleman--Rick & Kenji.-

Sean is a great guy, nice, good listener & an ultimate moving pro-!

And Rick &  Kenji are both clean cut, &  personable !    These were no  "Pot smokers"...or gguys off the Street,.      Robert Reeves must really screen his guys !

Not feeling well,  I headed down to my destination early,.totally trusting in these 3 guys !

Let me tell you--they delivered to my Destination...early---every item in good order-!
Nothing broken or even scratched !   They put the furniture exactly where I wanted it..(Even tho I changed my mind a couple times.)

So, the bottom line....If you want a reliable, efficient, honest moving Company.....anywhere in the Northeast  (They are in...NJ......do moves to PA.....Delaware....& other places...just ask Julie..she answers  all questions with no rushing )--I tell you....use Sinclair Moving !!!-

You will not be disappointed !  You will be happy & your furnishings will arrive on time..in one piece  !

I am very fussy about giving out compliments  (See some of my restaurant reviews..if something is not right,,.....I will say it !)

Gave them 5  stars,....IF there was a  SIX Star , I would have given them 6 !   
So, thinking about moving..?    Give them a call at  856-753-7400--press ext 15 to talk with Julie.-

I hope I have helped some of you make up your mind-- !
Sinclair Moving--  The best I have ever used.  Trust me, you cant go wrong-
Richard

We had reservations for Friday night at 630.  When we arrived it was not that busy and there were a few open seats outside and plenty inside. Despite the warm evening and outside seats available, our host didn't ask us if we had a seating preference and sat us in the back corner near the kitchen. I realize I should have asked to move elsewhere, but since the host didn't ask, I assumed the other tables were possibly reserved. They weren't, because the next two groups who got sat next to us asked to move either outside or elsewhere.  I should have asked to move, but a good host would also ask where we would like to sit. 

The restaurant is cash only, and with the prices of the food you should expect to need $100+  cash for 2 people. There is an ATM at the gas station across the street. It's 2017 and they should probably get a credit card machine. The host had an iPad, the food is not cheap, and it's a nice place so I think it's pretty ridiculous that they inconvenience customers just to get a little extra profit. 

The food was honestly just OK. I was really looking forward to eating here, as I live nearby and like to go out to eat, but I doubt that I will come back. I just was not impressed by the food. We shared the antipasti board, which featured mostly pickled vegetables, 3 meats and 1 cheese. You'd think the meats and cheese would be the stars of the plate, but the cheese literally tasted like plain old cream cheese. I couldn't really hear the server when she told us what it was because the place was loud. The meats were boring and bland. Next we ordered 3 of the pasta dishes to share. At $15 a plate, I assumed they wouldn't be huge servings, but the sizes were very tiny. They all tasted OK, but I honestly wasn't impressed by anything. We had the pappardelle, which was my least favorite as the guanciale flavor completely overpowered every bite. The cauliflower mezzaluna and gnocchi were alright. 

Unfortunately my dinner was overpriced and underwhelming.

Looked up this place online and was recommended to try it from friends. 
Just walked over. 
It's 8:35 and online it says they are open till Midnight on sundays.  
They are already closed. 
All their employees are drinking at a table and the whole place is shut down. 
Disappointed
I ordered a al pastor and carne asada tacos. So delicious and juicy not dry at all. All the flavors were there. Great price for delicious tacos.

Based on the other reviews, you don't need me to tell you to shop elsewhere, but I feel I owe it to you. We used a very pleasant La-Z-Boy decorator to select two recliners, a sofa, small area rug and fabric for cushions. She did a nice job for us, which is why I have given two stars.

Eight years later this very low trafficked room looks like a large family took no time in caring for it. The upholstery  looks shopworn and one recliner no longer reclines, so I called the company to have the recliner fixed.

After a 22 minute phone call of which 15 minutes were devoted to loud music on hold, interrupted only by a recording telling me I was next in line and would have a 1 minute wait, a sales person advised that it would be $124 dollars to reserve a time in 2 weeks for a repair person to show up between 8 AM and 5 PM, to service the chair, and that there might be parts to buy in addition.

She then told me she would place me on hold again while getting someone to write up the order and turn me over to the department that would charge my credit card immediately for the "service" that probably will show up in two weeks.

I was so tired that I went into the bedroom to sit down in the recliner I bought 32 years ago from a local store that has never had service, is used every day and looks pretty much as it did when I bought it. I sure wish I could remember where I bought that one.

Reminded me of the buffet from Vegas Vacation where cousin Eddie took Clark after he lost all his money. Very dated menu without a lot of selection. The only ok thing about is was that we got a 2 for 1 deal. On a scale of 1-10, I give it about a 2.5, I didn't get food poisoning.

Really excited that this location opened near me so I don't have to go all the way to Greenwood anytime I want some Chipotle. 

I ordered online and picked up using the Chipotlane. I went around 12:30 in a Saturday and I could see a long line inside through the window but there was no wait for the drive-thru pickup.  They also have a few curbside pickup dedicated parking spots.

I can imagine that this location gets very congested since this spot could barely contain the Starbucks traffic from right next door. But I didn't have any issues today around lunchtime.

Service was quick and friendly. I will definitely order again, especially with the Chipotlane option.

The chips were really greasy but the guac portion was decent sized. I do wish guac was not extra like other chains...but I need guac so I'll pay for it. The chicken was pretty chewy but I'll just get another protein next time.

Always great food when I go here. I'm going for a third time in November and I can't wait. The wonderful meal starts as soon as you get there with the bread and butter, it's to die for! The blue crab gratin is a favorite appetizer so far. We have tried several things off of the menu and have never been disappointed.

this is by far THE worst burger I  have ever had! DO NOT waste your time even going there. It cost over $30 for a family of four. No one finished their food and 2 of us took one bite and said " no way am I eating this" and we all felt sick after. All the food was cold, the pattys were dry and I am pretty sure my shoe would have tasted better. My husband ordered a strawberry shake and it was terrible, runny and had fake strawberry flavoring. Too bad they can't seem to have some consistancy, because the interior was real quaint and it seemed clean.  No Stars! Only reason you got one is because it won't post without...

UPDATED: 

Ended up at Osaka last night because the Margaritas wait was so long. What a nice detour! The sizzling tofu hotpot & side of kimchi were delicious. The kimchi was legit. We also had the shishito pepper happy hour app and it was great! And their happy hour pricing was good. Lastly, the kids chicken katsu meal was GREAT! Steamed veggies, sauce for dipping, and tasty chicken katsu with a side of rice. Great portion sizes. The kids' cup was also a nice treat because we forgot to bring our toddler cup. A very fun & happy dinner.

I never thought it would be so hard to find a reliable pool company...we literally had to change pool companies for 5 years straight when we first moved into our house that had a pool.  Finally, I asked a pool supplier who they recommended, and they told me about Cascade Pool Service.  This pool company ALWAYS goes above and beyond for me!  I have a huge pool, close to 60,000 gallons and they do a fantastic job every week servicing the pool.  Literally every friend that I recommend Cascade too, is so appreciative that they have them now.  Stop searching for another pool company, they are the best.

Used to love this place more than I do today. On XMAS eve, had the rigatoni bolegnese from the pasta menu.  Home, sick in bed with a stomach (both ends) ailment for over 24 hours - XMAS DAY was a no-show for me. Ailment began four hours after consumption. Just saying.  Will I return?  Absolutely! Would have been a good time to have scheduled a colonoscopy!

I never quite understood the concept of this place: Is it a bank? Is it a cafe? Is it Superman?

I had this crazy idea that if I went in all they would try to do is sell me something. Turns out the only thing they're actively selling is high quality caffeinated beverages.

After attending an event here I discovered that Capital One cardholders (me!) can get all cafe drinks half off when paying with a Capital One card. My life is forever changed. No need to pay Starbucks prices when I can get the same quality here for a better value. I came in on a Saturday morning and left my fate to the man with the southern accent behind the counter. He suggested the chocolate and caramel swirl Freddo, his will be done. It was delicious. Will definitely be patronizing this place often in the future!

They only have one shining star on the menu: coconut shrimp. They overprice it because it's their most popular item. Actually, the whole menu is pricey when the restaurant isn't much more than a tropical notch-above Red Lobster. 

Other than that, there's really not much to enjoy there. The vibe is tropical, of course, but it feels very cheesy to me. 

I won't frequent it. ‍
Uggghhh. The atmosphere is wonderful, the wine (try their sweet red) is to die for. Bought 6 bottles when we left and the Ginger Soy NY Sirloin, I will be back for!!

What a disappointment , I came for a luncheon the food had absolutely no seasoning and I was questioning if the fish on my plate was actually salmon. The "salmon" was supposed to have a Dijon sauce , it looked more like a paste and definitely didn't have any Dijon flavor .

Mitch Robles was fantastic! He enhanced our experience by adding hidden gems of wineries and restaurants to our tour. We liked him so much we booked him for another day and he did not disappoint. He's easy going, didn't go on and on but could answer any questions asked. And he loves dogs and knows dog friendly places! We would be at a winery and while waiting he would go check and secure the next place for us to enjoy. Superb.
Consistently good greek food.

I absolutely love it here!! It has the feel of being inside someone's house; comfortable and inviting. The food is delicious and the staff is very nice. As a vegan, with a non-vegan family, this place is perfect for a family dinner out! I recommend the Korean BBQ tofu tacos- so good!

Stopped in here with some friends, just looking for a quick lunch spot.   Formerly Apps & Taps.
Was greeted and seated by the owner.  Very jovial gentleman, let us know he's a terrible waiter and would send someone over right away.   After talking to him a bit, found out he's a big fan of cheesesteaks and recommended we order it.    I used to live in Philly prior to moving to FL seven years ago, so I was skeptical.  Let's just say I'm glad I ordered the cheesesteak.  I have had several "cheesesteaks" in Florida and they were disappointing.

This place is different.  The owner said he imports the rolls from Philly.  The steak is on point and the cheese and onions were just right.  If you are from, or just a fan of Philly, stop in here for a true authentic cheesesteak.

Highly recommemded!

Best place in French Quarters by far... if you've been to the French Quarters you'll know that it's not your cup of tea, only a few places worth going to... but this one is the best bar/lounge by far. Seating around the carousel is an attraction by itself, watching all the people fight and wait for a seat at the carousel bar... they might just get a hangover waiting for a seating as the carousel turns..

Eddie V's is another spot that should've had a review from me long ago! 

First night of my birthday celebration was at Charleys with my BF and friends. Go check out my review of them. Second night at Eddie V's was ladies night and it was everything and more.

It was packed out due to being Super Bowl weekend, but that didn't change their service provided. Valet kept me at the front and we were sat within minutes. Our server was attentive but not overly and made sure we were good at all times.

Alright, so let's talk food! We started out with their calamari (not pictured) which was spicy, but not too spicy! It was cooked just right, not too hard and not too soft, and offered more of the ringlets, which is right up my ally. 

When it came to the entrees, one of my friends ordered the Gulf Shrimp and the other ordered the Salmon. Both dishes looked great and let's just say there was a bit of a "moment of silence" while everyone indulged. Ha! Their meals did not disappoint. I was told the shrimp were seasoned great, a nice size, and the crab was icing on the cake. My other friend continued to boast about her Salmon in between bites and talked about the flavors mixed with the rice and spinach were perfect matches. 

As for me, I went with the Filet and Lobster Tail. I asked for my steak medium, and honestly it was a little undercooked BUT it tasted so good that I thought to myself, just roll with it. However, the lobster tail with a spruce of lemon dipped in the drawn butter was KILLER. I could've only ordered lobster and would've been A-OK. If you read my reviews you know I mention left overs so yes, I made sure to have some lobster to take home to go! 

Also not pictured are the sides we ordered of spinach and crab fried rice. I didn't try the spinach but my friends enjoyed it. Crab fried rice was tasty and something I would order again. I love when restaurants don't go light on the main focus...which was crab! 

Overall, Eddie V's did their thing per usual and provided excellent service along with some quality, well prepared dishes. Can't wait to pay them a visit again soon. If you have never been, give them a try! Ambience and setting are great for ladies night or date night and the price of it all is well worth it!

I worked with Cliff and Lance on a very tough move and they were fantastic and reasonable as far as cost goes! I would highly recommend Cliff for anything involving safes, he really knows his stuff. Cliff was also super flexible with scheduling and also easy to get a hold of. I plan on using them again in the future.

It was very hard to decide between 3 and 4 stars here.  I wish I could have gone 3.5 honestly.  The argument for 4 stars is that the chocolate and banana flavors are both incredible (and even better when they're mixed) and the prices here are solid.  The argument for 3 stars (and this is a big one for me personally) is there is no possible way that they were anywhere near as strong as some places like Fat Tuesday's or On the Run.  

I'll almost definitely go back to mix those flavors again either way...very tasty drink.

All the servers and bartenders at this location are great ...The owner Greg goes out of his way to satisfy everyone from me to people I hear him on the phone with ...  this is just like the bar CHEERS  from the show .. give it a try ...

Really do not know what to say... Harrison, the professional server was an entertainer and an executive of his craft. From valet to valet the food and the service was prefect... the physical aesthetics were superior, room was dim, music wasn't too loud but still lively..

Great night...

This is my go to breakfast spot for pancakes! I'll drive from Philly just to have their pancakes, their coffee is also amazing and fresh. The wait is never too long which is nice. I recommend the blueberry and pistachio pancakes. I do wish the bacon was hot and crispy...

Where do I begin? The only decent experience I had with this company was when I was booking it over the phone. I paid for a 16 person airboat gator tour with transportation for both my husband and I at the rate of $75/person. Not a problem. The entire process was very unorganized. The shuttle driver picking us up was very rude and the driver who dropped us back off to our hotel was completely oblivious to which passengers were supposed to be on his shuttle. He kept trying to pawn us off to the other shuttles even though our name and hotel was on his sheet. That wasn't the worst part. Here comes the worse part. 

The experience with our boat's captain. I forget his name, but I can describe him as a heavy set bald guy with gray beard (the details of his life I remember was that his family owned a gator business, he is 47 and he has four children, two of which are adopted). It started when we were getting ready to get on board the airboat. We kindly asked him if it was okay if we could sit in the fourth row for photo purposes and his immediate response was "I really don't give a fuck" While we were taken aback by his response, we brushed it off. 

One of the other captains came and told him that the boat would have 17 passengers instead of 16, so he told us to sit in the very back in the individual seats next to his captain chair. Not a problem, except the fact that there was no protective railing for the seat closes to the edge of the boat. The only form of protection was a seatbelt. After everyone was settled in he asked if one of us was okay moving to the front because someone wanted to sit in the very back. Considering we're a married couple and wanted to experience this tour together , we kindly told him "we're okay with sitting where we are." We definitely didn't have any desire to move especially after he cussed at us earlier. 

He then began interrogating us in front of the ENTIRE group. His exact words: "Do you guys have an issue sitting apart?" "It's not like you're a couple or are you????" "Are you married?" Our responses to each question was obviously "yeah..." To make matters worse, many of the people in group turned around and stared at us. Talk about feeling uncomfortable and not welcomed... But what we don't understand is why it had to even get to that point? Why ask anyone those questions? We did not pay for a tour to be talked to in that manner and humiliated in such a way. 

The entire experience was ruined because of our captain. We would definitely not recommend this tour to anyone and we intend to post our review to other sites.

I have used Stewart title more than once. I have never had rude experiences that others have complained about. Mary Lancaster is absolutely the best. I sold my townhome for cash and closing couldn't have been easier. I have never been kept waiting more than a couple of minutes. Doing business during covid19 was safe and clean. Getting ready now to close on my new home. And you guessed it, Mary will be assisting me with that transaction as well. If you want the best service in Tucson, Mary is in the 3939 Broadway office.

The process of renting a (pre reserved) car from the airport location was excruciating.  Not only did we have to take a 20 minute shuttle from the airport to an offsite location, we then had to wait another 60++ minutes for our car....and then ended up with a vehicle we didn't order or want.  

Possible delays were due to the pandemic, but it sure looked like a lot of staff standing around  while dozens of clients waited for their cars. Very unfortunate.

We recently relocated to this area and I was excited to have a little nail shop close by, but sadly this is one we won't be frequenting. I brought my little girl with me just to get a polish change, and was totally put off by how unfriendly the ladies were. They didn't even look up or acknowledge us when we walked in, didn't ask what we needed, and when I asked them if they could get my little girl in, they were reluctant to even tell me how long the wait would be. They told us 30 minutes, so we left and ran errands, then came back 30 later and they still weren't done. Said it would be another 10 minutes and so we left and went to another place nearby that my fellow yelpers suggested that was great. 
Overall, nothing special of a place, and the staff seem very unprofessional. Bummer because we would be here a lot if it were better.

Nice hotel that I stayed at while visiting Philly back in August. The overall visit could had been better though, as there was an issue with the pipes in the building. I was taking a shower there the second day of my stay and all of a sudden I hear pounding on the front door...then I hear someone trying to get into the room and I started to feel a bit startled. I had the block lock on the door just for safety security, so I run out of the shower to see what the hell was going on. So it was hotel maintenance saying that water from shower which hadn't been on long and of course the bathroom I was using wasn't flooded at all, that water had been dripping into the bottom floor bathroom. 

Of course had to let maintenance in to see what the issue was. They said that they had to fix a piping issue and I would have to change my room. So of course I couldn't finish my shower and had to pack my clothes and such very quickly to be moved into the next room. Definitely an inconvenience. Thankfully though the second room had a better view than the first. 

Another thing, that kind of left me meh with this hotel was that the pool was no available. Now I know during these times of COVID that for the most part that is to be possibly expected but it would had been appreciated to had known this upon booking the hotel which it wasn't on any of the hotel booking sights. Part of the reason why I chose the Hilton in this area in the first place was because they have a pool and being that I wasn't ready to take any beach trips at that specific time and NYC hotel pools weren't available, I had chose and thought this Hilton would be. Was a bit disappointed that it wasn't.

Other than all of that, checking in and checking out was fairly easy and the rooms were clean and beds were very comfortable which is always what I look for with hotel rooms, other than good plumbing and a nice view. We'll see if Hilton can do a little better if I come back for another visit.

Amazing food. My preggo belly was craving a "home cooked" meal and this was the closest thing to it. Stopped here on our cross country ride from Jersey! Definitely worth stopping in. 9$ a plate for great food

Sitting waiting and waiting and waiting. 45 minutes past my scheduled appointment.  I waited 3 months for it so I guess another 45 minutes is expected.  

Finally in to see the nurse. OOPS. She called Misa not Lisa. But she's going to see me anyways. 

Didn't ask about family history or anything. Guess she doesn't care that skin cancer runs in my family. Oh well. I should be thankful I am now waiting for the doctor, right?

Doctor comes in. It's officially 1 hour past my scheduled appointment. He zips through everything in about 5 minutes. I'm not exaggerating. Writes a prescription (which I find out later is not available in Edmonton due to a manufacturer shortage). Tells me the mole I have isn't worth removing. The scar would be bigger. That's BS. My doctor in Calgary removed my moles all the time. I guess he also doesn't care about the fact that skin cancer runs in my family. 

I will go back to my regular Dr and get a referral to a different dermatologist or phone up the one I saw on Calgary and make a special trip to see him. This was very disappointing and useless visit. I don't care how nice the Dr was it wasn't worth the wait and he dismissed my concerns like I was making a big deal out of nothing.

Oh I forgot to mention that the doctor told me I had "age barnacles" yeah I'm sure that's a medical term. What a quack!

Love the setting for this place. Laid back vibes and friendly service. We ordered the Calamari to start. It was my favorite out of the items we ordered- very flavorful with a cornmeal batter. Fiancé got the shrimp tacos with fries and I got the grilled grouper sandwich with grilled veggies. Appreciated the healthy alternatives that were still tasty. We brought our pupper for the doggie menu and also appreciated the pet friendliness and water bowl for him.
Delila was amazing if you had more servers like her you guys would be the best. Top of the line food as well. I am in love with Bang Bang Bang shrimp.

We ordered a large order for my office...every single one of the orders was just as it was ordered...which sounds easy but NEVER happens. The food was AMAZING and Guillermo was wonderful to deal with. The best tacos I have had...along with the nachos!!! Definitely will be returning!

Yes! 
Dive bar with a great selection of different liquors and beer.
When I was there the bar tender, first time a girl, second time a guy, was very friendly, chatty but not overly so. 
This place attracts an interesting crowd of out of Townes and locals. Me and my fiancé had a great time!

Nothing like the strip clubs I've been to, customer service sucks my honey and I came last weekend. Sat in audience away from the stage no one approach us no to mention we came looking and smelling like money... the girls were too busy on there phones or chit chatting . So we moved to The stage and blessed The girls dancing. The girls carry bags around to hold there money witch looks unprofessional  and tells a lot the establishment. Out of all the girls that had preformed Sunday night 3 were good the others were out of shape, not sexy 
Im I mother of 3 the only workout I get is running after kids so why is my body banging then majority of there dancers lol.

Americanized Chinese food that hits the spot.  I'm a fan of their Shrimp Egg Foo Young, out of all the local places I've tried they have the version I like the best.  Most of the time I get take out, but I have sat in the restaurant a few times (before COVID).  The service is lacking a little, the woman who works behind the counter is also the server and while she isn't mean, she's not nice either.   She tends to drop the food at the table and go without a word.  But since I get take out from here more often than sitting inside, I will ignore that.

The worse!!!!!! We as a family of Asians came to try Cambodian food. First of all there was barely anything Asian or Cambodian on the menu. The curry was decent the Pho no flavor just water and beef paste is all you taste when pho is all about the broth, nothing could of fixed the pho it was shocking, barely any Asian condiments. It's basically just a southern food place. Maybe it's probably decent idk didn't try it, but if you are going to advertise CAMBODIAN food why not have at least the basics? Sticky rice? Papaya salad? Was told to call ahead to let them know we are coming so they can make it?? WTH?? Never heard of that what's the difference calling to let them know or just ordering there? Such a disappointment... ‍‍

Should of given no stars....

this spot has been a family favorite for years, and continues to not disappoint! 
they're finally open for dine in!!  

the food: so fresh quality, and i love their set menus that come with a sashimi boat, jungol stew, and meat option. the fish is always super fresh and tasty without that gross fishy aftertaste, and pairs so nicely with some soju and spicy stew!!! they also slide in steamed eggs and other things on the house here and there, so grateful 

the service: sooo kind! the lady who serves there (short bob with blonde highlights) has been there since the dawn of time and she is the friendliest server on earth! will really love upon u and ur family
Used the pick up app. Works great. The egg sandwich actually had too much egg on it for me. What a switch! Coffee con Leche awesome as usual. Great spot. Continues to hold up it long held reputation.

Good solid people.  We've worked with them for four years.  Bought five different systems from them.  Good quality work.  Careful workers.  Respectful and top quality service and customer focus.  Recommend highly.

I started using Frames by Mail over 10 years ago when Michael's told me that it would cost $120 each to frame my 3 small pictures of Stonehenge (they were bought in the UK, so they had an odd size). Those frames cost me $60 total for all 3, and I fell in love.

However I recently made a purchase of 4 custom-made mattes in the color of white linen. Unbeknownst to me, white linen is not actually white, unless said white was meant to reflect the linens on a frat boy's bed that hadn't been washed in 4 months. When I complained, he said that next time, I should ask for the color samples (which apparently are tiny). He didn't offer me a coupon, discount my order or offer any remuneration. Basically he said tough shit.
I subsequently called the new Hobby Lobby in town, and asked them to price the largest matte for me. Price was a bit more, but when you factor in shipping, amounts to the same. The guy at Hobby Lobby was great and cut the matte while I waited, subsequently re-cutting when it was a bit small. 

Save the headache. There are big box craft stores everywhere. Don't send Frames by Mail your money!

It's hard to beat the price of this place! Went here on a Friday night and had the place to myself. Staff was friendly and got our order in right away.
The salad was good with a little kick of spice in it. The pad Thai was a bit on the sweet side for me but I still enjoyed it. 
I also got a Thai iced tea which was from a can and not homemade like it says on their menu. But the server did warn me when I ordered that it was from a can. 
Over all I think I got what I payed for.
Not sure what all the hype is about. Mediocre at best. Confused by the amazing reviews.

Salt.  That's all I tasted.  Everything. was. oversalted.

Ordered 2 Dos Equis, a chimichanga a la carte and shrimp enchilada a la carte.

The Dos Equis came out and about 1/2 the mug was head, there was slush all over the place.  When she put it down everything started melting and it was just one 'beery mess'.

The shrimp enchiladas were bland at best.

The chimichanga, which had shredded beef was like eating a salt brick.   I ended up so dehydrated after the meal I felt ill. My lips were dry.  All I can taste is salt.  Salt, salt salt salt, salt and salt.

Did I mention it was oversalted?  Sorry Murrieta's - I don't think we'll patronize your restaurant again.  The salt has just become too much.

Also, salt.

I went there on a Monday afternoon.  There was a Colts game that night which is only a block away.  There was a few people in there that day but no waitress to serve us.  There was a few guys behind the bar but they where useless.  I would go up to the bar and still have to wait 5 minutes to get service as they were busy doing other stuff.  There was no music or it would just repeat the song constantly. I went back after the game that night and it was fairly busy and the service was terrible.  There was a few girls waitressing and I they did not have designated sections.  They just wandered around and took drink orders.  Not once did they get my drink order correct.  I finally just gave up and left. I was sitting against the back wall and not once did any of the dancers come by and ask if me or anybody wanted a dance.  There was a few of us that were surprised by the crappy service and being ignored by the dancers,  

The next night I went back around midnight.  They told me I could not enter cause I did not have sleeves on my shirt.  It says on the rules that there is no tank tips allowed.  I had a sleeveless shirt with a collar but I guess they classify that as tank top.  They guy at the entrance was pretty rude about it and basically told me to get the hell out of the club.  

I would not recommend this club to anyone as there is way better clubs that are close enough to the downtown region to enjoy.  Stay away.
Tried to order a pizza twice. Cut off and waited 21 minutes before hanging up. WTF....nope, sorry.

The food is really good, the staff is nice and super courteous.
My favorite place to grab a quick bite to eat

The problem with this place is poor service. Asked for chili paste waited about 10 min, then asked again, then they brought it over. They charged .20 cents for a tiny spoon of it and didn't even inform us about it in advance. Terrible...

We have been eating here for years since this location opened but as of late they keep fouling up our order and have to wait to remake I have brought my concerns to the owner who seemed interested but today October 30th we had the wrong cheese on our burgers and another remake when I tried to bring it to Marty the owner he blew up at me and said he didn't want to hear it and said then don't ever come back.  The food is good but if we are too much trouble wanting our order correct won't be back.

Fritzel's is a fabulous spot if you like the live Dixieland-style jazz of old New Orleans. Fritz's is located on Bourbon Street away from all of the trashy sex clubs and expensive music venues in the French Quarter.

Fritzel's looks small as you walk through the front door, but the club is deceptively long with an outdoor patio behind the main bar and club area. The front bar has been there since the 1830s, and there's room for 20 or so to sit. Behind that is the stage and club with room for another 50 jazz-lovers, and then out back is a delightful patio to sit under the stars and enjoy the live music.

There's no cover to come in and listen to the band, but there is a 2-drink minimum, which is quite a bargain compared to many of the other live music clubs.

The house band is pure Dixieland jazz, and a tremendous amount of fun. The audience was clapping, tapping their feet, and singing along with the tunes, and the guys even took requests.

An awesome time!

My husband and I finished off his birthday here and had a great time. We love the divey atmosphere and we have gotten good service both times we have gone. We love the daily specials, what a bargain and delicious also! It was so busy we thought it was going to be a while but the food came pretty quick.
My big issue is it's not wheelchair accessible and the only thing that's good are the bulldog drinks

For me, a humane attitude of the personnel is in the first place and as a mother of two, I appreciate their very kind and friendly approach to me and my kids:)  it is always easy to reach them by phone and schedule/cancel an appointment.

Big fan for many years. We love the pizza, but my personal favorite is the Risotto Primavera. The salads and gelato are fantastic as well. Service is always friendly and efficient. We love eating in and carry out.

This place was.... underwhelming. I probably should have read the reviews first, but I was wanting to try it for the first time. Really the only notable food worth mentioning was the spicy pork taco I got. Everything else we got- the churros, fiesta taco, beef taco, rice and chips / queso -were definitely nothing to write home about. Staff was decent I guess but definitely could have been a lot friendlier. Also trying to keep the place clean was not a top priority of theirs. The only reason I'll ever come back is to try the drinks.

The magic....it's still happening! 

Neoteric, methodically handled ramen: hell ya! A touch of Japan, a splash of New York, and a dash of Seminole Heights Tampa all in one hot bowl. These artisan noodles and broth are amazing. It's crazy to think that the broth I sip now was cooking 18 hours earlier. The broth-less (Spicy Abura Soba) ramen is one my favorites too, it stands alone in contrast- perfect for when I'm in one of my moods. I'm no ramen expert but I can appreciate fresh ingredients, great noodles, a cool hangout, meticulous bar tenders, and excellent culinarians.  

Rumor has it these noodles were made special by Sun Noodle, exclusively for Ichicoro, and just for you and I. ~slurp~slurp~

Drinks, assimilated to perfection. The loud, funky bass from the speakers overhead make me wanna get down to a subzero sake cocktail....(s)!

From the minute I walked in to Benari & was greeted by Bob & Rachel, 'til the moment I walked out with my new Rolex watch, they all made me feel welcome & valued. Just as many years ago when I'd bought his-and-hers Tag Heuer watches from BenAri when it was in Media, it was an absolute pleasure working with Bobby, who remembered me. 

I was actually glad to buy the watch from here than one of their less-caring and less-personable local authorized Rolex competitors. 

They made a very difficult trade decision into a truly pleasant experience.  I look forward to BenAri being my go-to watch & jewelry store!!
I'm excited about all the veg food options! Two yummy foods in one spot? Count me in. I really enjoyed the tacos I had. Looking forward to trying the ramen.

This store was a great find, and the employees are super sweet and knowledgeable. The owner is especially nice. The energy of the store is super calming and comfortable. The crystals are super pretty, and there is a good selection. There's other stuff sold as well, like buddha statues, tarot cards, etc.

I've come here twice now on Philly trips and I think it's become a tradition! 
The only time I have had a Philly Cheesesteak has been in Philadelphia so I am comparing apples to apples, at least. Having just eaten a cheesesteak at the Phillies game, the cheesesteak from Geno's (with American) was WAY better. In fact, I couldn't stop myself from eating the whole thing! I loved it and now all other cheesesteak is dead to me (I've tried the Subway version...sad face).
When I placed my order, I was instructed on how to do so prior as to not make a fool of myself. It kinda felt like I was ordering from the Soup Nazi, haha. Cash only is slightly a pain, but worth it for this. 
The roll was soft and nice, and the meat was 'weird nub' free. (If you are familiar with my reviews, you'll know that is a big plus). My colleague ordered fries with 'wizz' but neglected to eat them until after the sandwich so they were kinda unappetizing and got thrown out. Not Geno's fault, though! This place was just as good my second time around 4 years later, so I know I'll be back!
Their Tom Yum soup hits the spot when your in the mood for Tom Yum soup. The crab rangoons are so-so.

Just don't. 
I left my car there for 3 hours before a bad feeling led me to check the reviews. First I was told that they wouldn't be able to touch my car until I signed a form they would email. But when I called and said I was coming to pick my vehicle up and did not want the $160 diagnostic test done, the woman said her tech was already taking it for a test drive. When I said I didn't sign the form giving them permission, she said they wouldn't charge me for that but I had to argue about my need and desire to pick my car up. My this time, my anxiety was at an all time high. When I got there, a man was wiping off my steering wheel and door. When I got in it, the drivers seat and passenger seat were covered in oil. I didn't think to look up until I got home. How TF am I supposed to get this out of the fabric??? Thank God I I got my van before anything else was done. I took it right to Snyder Transmissions, and he did the diag FOR FREE!! He was helpful and explanatory and kind. You shouldn't pay for a diagnostic test!!! What a ripoff and horrible place.
Amazing food and service. Went yesterday and couldnt have been more pleased. Everything we had was fantastic!!!
The best pizza in center city! All their food is incredible and they're always so quick!

"Yeah. She pissed on everything again."
--rugged thirty-something talking about....his dog?

And lo it doth occur in a man's life that verily he doth require the services of a laundry business, his own slumlord's ancient implements being nonfunctional and the slumlords, yes, unreachable. And thus, with Mardi Gras fast approaching, he turneth toward that dirty refuge, that haven of the unkempt but interesting and findeth himself in paradox: yay verily cleaning his vestiments in a dust heap.
--book of unfortunate circumstances 2:20-2:21

I mean, I've been in WORSE laundromats.
--Me

How about a photo with your head in a $20 bill? So fun, right? My family and I have visited many presidential homes and libraries in the past. This was the most recent. It was a cold December day, which made this the most perfect activity to do because most of it was indoors. We opted for the self-guided tour (with a handset of recorded narration). Upon entrance, there was a brief video and exhibits to follow. We did have to spend some time outside walking between the front buildings, mansion, courtyard and the original house. There were narrated spots all throughout the property. There was even option a narration option for children. I'm always super impressed learning about history in this way: living history with docents dressed in time period clothing. The exhibits were impressive and it was also neat to learn so much about Andrew Jackson's impact on Louisiana (hence Jackson Square in New Orleans). A couple interesting facts: Andrew Jackson was the 2nd president to be photographed and there was also an assassination attempt made on him. Be sure to take several hours out of your day to complete this tour. It's totally well worth it and such an awesome way for children (and adults) to get a history lesson.
I really enjoyed my experience here. They listened to what I was looking and suggested a great product. Didnt try to oversell. Very clean and everything is nicely displayed. Great!

I ordered a curry goat platter and escoveitch platter .... both were HORRIBLE!  Given the fact that Golden Krust is synonymous with excellence, this particular location was a major FAIL!  Will not be returning nor will I recommend this place!!!

Sea Chest is the idyllic beach motel.  Once you stay here, you don't want to go anywhere else.  And when you do return, it's exactly as you remember it.  I love that!

It's clean, and I mean CLEAN; it's family oriented, most folks have been coming here for ages - reserving the same rooms every year - but they also love couples and singles here, too.  Everyone feels at home here, and that's just the way Maria and Andy like it!  They are old-school owners, who bring old world charm to an ever evolving area.  You won't ever see riff-raff roaming aimlessly around here, as you do at other local motels in this area.  The patrons here are friendly and eager to enjoy their time at the beach!  You will see lots of grilling and cocktails on the patios and lounging at the pool; you won't wonder if your room is stocked with essentials - the suites with kitchens are fully stocked with household items; the beds are always clean and fresh; the bathrooms are spotless and welcoming, not like some places I've been where I hesitated to use the facilities...yuck!  Maria simply will not tolerate anything less than perfection in her guest rooms.  I truly appreciate that! 

Sea Chest is the epitome of Florida charm and hospitality.  Maria and Andy are always onsite, ready to greet you upon arrival, and wish you bon voyage as you depart.  They are the reason this place gets 5 stars from me.

We have purchased multiple vehicles from Walker Ford over the past few years.  Each time the sales, finance and management have always been very professional and accommodating.  Tracy Affrunti has been instrumental in each deal and a pleasure to deal with.  She is a great asset to the company.  The vehicles have been serviced at Walker.  The service has always been completed fairly and in a timely manner.

Guess where we celebrated our anniversary?!?!?

Right. Freaking. Here! Because... why not!

Celebrating three years of marriage adds up to two double doubles (one with grilled onions), two orders of fries, two shakes AND a special table setting arranged by yours truly! 

Yep. I got a rose, some cheap champagne glasses  (plastic ) and a split of La Marca proseco so we could toast to ourselves before, during and after dinner!

The memory is priceless, and the looks we got from others were just fantastic! 

The food I've come to see as 5-Star fantastic here. It's just a good example of a griddled diner burger and fries. I find the bun to be the perfect combo of fluffy and toasted, and the veggies are always crisp and fresh. 

Gourmet? Nah, but who the F cares when it's just plain delicious AF? 

Not me! 

Having the  here just goes to show it doesn't matter where you are or what you're doing as long as you're with the right person!

We walked here from our hotel on Haley st. Parking is as you'd expect - street spots available, I didnt see a parking lot. 

Dart coffee is an adorable spot with a mixture of decor that all comes together to bring in a quaint, trendy vibe. Due to COVID measures, we lined up outside, there was no seating inside. There is a bar along where the line forms and some seats too. If you're looking to sit and enjoy your drink somewhere, there is a garden right across the street from Dart. The workers told us the owners own that garden. There are seats there where you can admire the variety of vegetables growing, the flowers, and the beautiful SB weather. 

I ordered a matcha latte which came unsweetened, but I preferred that because I could appreciate the quality of the ingredients better without the sugar. 

The wait was short even though they were busy. The workers were very friendly. We loved this coffee shop and I highly recommend it to anyone who wants quality coffee/tea and a nice place to chill.

The best hoisin pork rigatoni. The pork was very flavorful and tasty. It is so tender, it melts in your mouth when you bite it and mixed with the tasty flavor sauce. It tastes amazing. Highly recommended.

I love trying sushi places I've never been to in Reno, so I was glad a friend recommended Ohana for dinner this week.
It was quite busy for a weeknight, which I took as a good sign. Despite it being busy, we were able to be seated quickly.  The service was great - prompt with drinks and refills, quick to take our orders and bring our our food, and attentive to us throughout our meal.
The sushi was good - what I've come to expect in AYCE sushi in Reno.  The rolls had fresh ingredients, good proportions, and good flavors. My only complaint was that the rolls were mostly the standard rolls you see at most sushi places in Reno - not many unique or inventive rolls.
All-in-all a solid sushi place.

The food was excellent here! I had the roasted beet sandwich & it was really delicious! It included both red & golden beets, I happen to love golden beets and you don't see them served anywhere. So I was excited for the addition. Service was not that great. Our waiter wasn't the most attentive though.

This place UESED to be my go-to for cheap and awesome Chinese food, however the last 2 times I was there, there was definitely something different. New staff and new ownership, and as I recently asked, new cook as well. I always ordered the same tried and true dishes to go, and have yet to notice much of a difference in quality as of yet, however the service is definitely lacking (not that here was much of it before).  I'd say still go and try it for yourself, but keep in mind that all the positive reviews you've read/heard is basically for a different place.

The French Press is my go to coffee shop in Santa Barbara. They use Verve beans (one of my favorite roasters from NorCal) and pride themselves in making great coffee (true to the name, their regular coffee is made from a french press) and espresso drinks. Everything that I've had has been very good. 

The French Press is a cool place to hang out with friends or do some work (there is ample room inside, but sometimes it's very busy!). The staff is also very friendly and I've noticed that many of the workers know the regulars by name. If you haven't been here, stop by. You won't be disappointed.

I love dresher nails!
I've been going there for five years now and I'm never disappointed.
The owner is so sweet and really caters to her customers needs.
One night she stayed an hour after closing to do my nails, who does that!
Also, they do great acrylic nails
I would definitely recommend Dresher Nail Salon

Hands down the most talented floral artist in Northern Alberta.  When you walk in, you notice that this store is unlike any other- beautiful items ranging from gold dipped pottery to an extensive Thomas Sabo charm line.  Now, when you order flowers, it's not like ordering from FTD.  Every arrangement gets the staff's full attention and is treated like a floral work of art.  For weddings, anniversaries, or just because you need to say you're sorry to your wife, this is the place to go for all of your floral & gift needs!

We stopped in to Pappy's tonight for dinner and were very pleased. I had the Italian Burger with potato salad and my husband had the Tucson Cheese Steak with fries.  Both meals were super-sized and really delicious.  When we are in this area we will definitely come back to Pappy's.

Great pizza and concept! It's like Chipotle with Mexican, Crushed Red with salad, etc. You build your own pizza live and their schtick is they cook it in 180 (!) seconds. There's lots of great extra touches such as seasoning choice or after bake add ons. Plus they check with you each step of the way - is the sauce amount good or the cheese amount? Which begs the question - is there a point they'll stop asking because it's too much cheese or would they charge you extra for cheese? Due to those damn social norms, I didn't find out (though I did ask for a bit more cheese at the first query). 

It's great for kids because it's so fast and easy! Pick up your high chair or booster by the drink station. And pick up a beer or wine that they serve (even some draught!) because you are taking kids out in public and dammit you deserve it!

Clean and modern interior was spot on. 

Ironically, our pizza was a little burnt. The salads had some bad leaves and left a bit to be desired but good flavors. 

Overall, Blaze is a fantastic addition to Kirkwood and we will be back!

Swanson's Furniture did the most amazing job helping my mom move from Tucson, AZ to Oceanside, CA! From the first call they were completely helpful, friendly, and extremely reasonable.

The move went extremely well - the movers and packers were efficient, careful and professional but super nice!

I highly recommend Swanson's and would use them in a heartbeat next time.

Really nice movie theater. The food is decent (comparable with the food from a Scottys, Applebees etc type of place) and they have a good beer selection. It is nice to have the option to order both from your seat and before you go in the theater. The seats were really comfortable and had nice space to put any food or drinks next to you. The employees were friendly to us. I have only been once so far, so haven't experienced any long waits or anything like some of the other reviewers have.
Edit: Changed the review to 5 star instead of 4 star. I thought they didn't have regular movie theater popcorn, but I guess they do based on the comment below... the person sitting near me must have brought microwave popcorn from home.

I like my local store. They do have a selection of laptops to browse through. I bought my projector here. Their copy center gets busy, so avoid traffic time. A lot of supplies to browse through. I like that there is parking. I get my printer ink here also too often. Time for me to get a laser printer!! :-)

My coworkers and I are obsessed with this place and visit a few times a week for breakfast or lunch. Always delicious, consistent and fresh. Bagels are made without any artificial ingredients and the homemade chicken or seafood salads are really excellent. Tip: Come early if you want a specific flavor of bagel, by mid-day they run out of the "rare" ones!

It's been over 20 years since my last tattoo- and I couldn't be happier that my return was at Tattooagogo. My friend and I went in with specific designs/ideas that were absolutely exceeded by Chris Blanchard. He was super accommodating and extremely talented. When we arrived for our appointment he greeted us with his drawings of our ideas. Seriously so much better than what we were thinking. He has a calm, easy going manner that put us both at ease. The whole vibe of Tattooagogo is pretty chill and relaxed- just what you'd want at a tattoo parlor. Very clean and everyone there was really nice. I'm so over the top pleased with my new art and the whole experience. I'll be posting a picture once the healing is done!
View was great. Service was a little slow. Food was better than what you'd get in Pier Parks big chains. Overall really good experience.

For those of you who have been anxiously anticipating the re-opening of our favorite taqueria, your wait is over!

La Vallesana's makeover is complete and you won't believe it until you see it.  The interior space, in some kind of wacky Transfomers-like mutation, has easily quadrupled in size.  No...that doesn't do it justice...it is humongous!  There is a very large high-chair wrap-around seating area that accomodates at least 50 inside diners.  There are brand-new mens and ladies restrooms.  And...wait for it...theres a separate kitchen!

I'm sure they are still working on the interior decor because the walls are sort of plain for now, but the work is very nice and you will literally be flabbergasted by how much this has changed considering that they incorporated the original structure in the redesign.

As for the outside patio, that is also tripled in size and has a nice covered area that will permit dining in the rain or possibly enclosed in the winter and the remaining outdoor seating is nicely shaded by plants and umbrellas.

There is still work going on out back...whether more seating or some much-needed parking I am not sure.

The food, or course, is still solid.

For all of you who used to go there when it was just the little taqueria at the old "Sip and Swirl" building, you'll be proud to say you used to dine there when...

I am so glad that there business has grown and permitted an upgrade.  It give me hope that things may be getting better.

Enjoy!
My experience there was GREAT!!!  The nail techs are attentive and very good at what they do. Place is very clean with quick service provided. Stop in and see for yourself. You won't be disappointed

I usually take my car to Carl Woods but he was backed up and referred me to Crawford Z Car since I own a Nissan.  Doug, the owner, was courteous and thorough and had my car fixed the next day.  I'd highly recommend, especially if you are a Nissan owner.
Awesome, quick service. Had several repairs. They were completed quickly and expertly AND reasonably!

I have always enjoyed the food when visiting for rehearsal dinners, so we ate dinner in the upstairs general seating area. The food was excellent. When I did not choose the waiter's wine recommendation, he was so confident that I would like it, he offered me a taste. I don't like Malbec. Well, I hated it, but he was so sweet to let me try!

My mom and I sat outside to dine today .. we felt like we were in Tuscany with the beautiful Italian music and the luscious garden surrounding us .. The waitress was a sweetheart .. very on top of our needs just great service .. I knew it was going to be a good meal when u start off with a crusty Italian bread and a pecorino olive oil and red chili dip ! The frito misto of artichokes , calamari , and zucchini was tender and crispy at the same time .. I could have drank the tom dipping sauce out of the bowl it was so good ! Had the vegetable pizza which was crispy and the vegetables fresh and slowly roasted ..  Highly addictive .. Gnocchi  homemade best I've ever had ! Light and fluffy with a gongozolo cream sauce .. can't wait to go back !

So, Friday evening, I understand that you are busy. I entered the restaurant, stood at the counter for fully 10 minutes. In that time: one lady was tallying something at the counter, right in front of me, three waitstaff walked past several times. Nobody bothered to say "hi" or "we'll be right with you" or acknowledge me in any way. So, I walked out. Some waiter lost a $10 tip. I might go back in the future, but not any time soon.
This business is exceptionally good. We've used them for about 3 decades and have always had a prompt response and very good service.

Sorry to say but the dirty silverware, plates and menus so turned me off that I wanted to walk out even before we ordered. If we weren't a party if 6 I would have done just that. Food was ok. Large portion of chicken parm was huge. Ravioli, rigatoni, and house salad were also good. Food was served piping hot as well.  But 3 rolled silverware setting had crusty food on them. As did 4 of our salad and dinner plates. The dessert menu had dried food all over it. 

I don't like to rate restaurants based on waitstaff because I understand that a person can have an off night.  But the young lady we had was so indifferent it was almost bizarre. Salad came out after the entrees. No napkins, etc. 

At $280.00 for 6 people I want a much, much better experience than this place. Never again.

Had another delightful dinner.  Great housemade garlic sourdough bread with olive oil for dipping.  Shared delicious brisket sliders for an appetizer served with crispy onion straws and sweet potato fries on sweet rolls.  Dinner was perfectly cooked salmon followed by  peach cobbler with home nade vanilla bean ice cream.  Quiet with soft music. Attentive waitstaff.  New menu for fall arrives next week.  Cannot wait to go back.

My first Philly Cheese Steak in Philadelphia, PA.  And it was great!  I wanted it made up the same way a local would eat it. The peppers, the onions, the mushrooms and yes .... Get ready ... Cheese wiz.  Really?  Who am I to say no. If this is what the locals eat - I'll try it. It was pretty good. Not sure if I'll do this back home - but here in Philly, why not.  You need to try it. The staff was really friendly, got to see pictures of the new born baby girl, very cute.  The place is a little  small, not many tables so get there early. Also -Momma's pasta salad is the best!!

Well deserved 5 stars. If you have the energy to fight your way to find a table and don't mind waiting a little bit then it is well worth it.  They are busy because everyone knows how crazy good they areI don't think there is an item on the menu I don't enjoy from the homemade granola, to eggs benedict (both ways), to the challah french toast, to the all of the omelets.

And O-O-OMG their carrot cake is to die for; I order it every year for my birthday. All the pasties and cakes are delicious but the carrot cake takes the icing (pun intended!). 

Cheers to Jeannine's for being one of my favorite breakfast spots in Santa Barbara.

Amazing food, amazing service. We will definitely be back. Such a great experience! The guy working let us sample the options since it was our first time there, and he was just so incredibly kind. So much food! I can eat a lot of food, and I couldn't finish almost half of my plate... Yummmmmmmmy!!!! I'm going to be dreaming of that Drunk Chicken
Back again and everyone loved their meals!  The cheese and grits, brisket,  collard greens and more where all phenomimal!  Todd is now an honorary Team Steve member!
We got delivery and it took over an hour. When the wings came they were cold. The size isn't that great and the sauces really weren't impressive either. I wouldn't order again.
Holy cow was this good    a little shack in the middle of the burbs.   Blue crabs and conch fritters oh my!!  I will be back in January

Superb!

Have lived in suburban St. Louis for 30 years, and have probably driven by this place 100's of times, but never made the stop to try it out.  My bad!

Celebrated my mother's 88th birthday last night at Paul Manno's Cafe, and we will definitely be back!  Small, intimate place, with a nice vibe, and filled up nicely on a Monday night, and now I know why...the food is superb!

Started with a couple of wines by the glass, and house salads for my wife and mother.  I tried the TAO salad (tomato, onion & anchovy) and it was terrific.  Not a huge fan of anchovy, but there was just a taste of it in this salad that made it delicious.

Entrees were superb.  Birthday girl had the rack of lamb ($38) with a very nice selection of lamb ribs cooked p-e-r-f-e-c-t-l-y!  Nice and pink and oh-so delicious.  My wife had a rigatoni & lobster special that she could not stop talking about, and I agree, it was great.  I had another pasta special, linguine & clams, and thought it was also really special.

Pacing of the dinner was really nice, yes it got busy, but our waiter (Adrian?) kept things flowing, never felt neglected or ignored, and he kept the wine flowing.  They gave my Mom a very nice chocolate cake with ice cream and candle to make her feel special, and she did.

Really can't believe we've not been here before in our 30 years in St. Louis, and I agree with all other reviewers:  I rate this place as the best restaurant in St. Louis, and in 30 years here, we've tried them all... will definitely be back.
