We WILL be back, and we WILL tell our friends. And of course, I'm telling everyone on Yelp!

BYOB, chocolate made on site, and arepas with corn literally flown in from Venezuela. 

The table salsas were awesome. The red sauce is amazing and smoky. 
The arepas are on point. The place is kind of out of the way if you don't live in the neighborhood, but it's totally worth the trek. 

The chocolate and churros are great. I literally spooned out the leftover chocolate sauce because it would have been a tragedy to let it go to waste. They have spicy hot chocolate, and you can buy pretty chocolates made there to go.

I love going to Titans games.  I've sat all over the stadium but Club Seats are the way to go. The club seats are wider and have a great view of the field.  I sit in section 237, on the 25 yard line.   

The club level has a special stadium entrance without lines.  The entire floor of the club level is a climate controlled, open lounge.  The lounge has a buffet, bars, food court, and is full of flat screen tv's.  It has a sports bar and grill feel to it.  The lounge opened up 2 hours before kickoff so we could get somewhere out of the weather to hang out watch pregame. They had live bands playing in the lounge as well as massage tables set up if you want to get a massage (little strange to me).  The bathrooms were clean with more flatscreens so we didn't miss anything.  The staff was pleasant and helpful.  

As expected the food and drinks are a little pricey.  Beer (around 16 oz) went for $8 for premiums (Heineken, Blue Moon) and $7 for domestics (Coors Light, Miller Light).  Mixed drinks were in the $6 range.  The buffet was $25 for all you could eat with pretty high quality food for a sports stadium.  I noticed they post a buffet menu on the LP website.  

Try to get tickets that come with a parking pass.  It's so much better to be able to park next to the stadium and not have to shell out the extra $40 and walk a mile.  

LP is right on the river across from downtown Nashville; always somewhere to go after the game.      

Had a blast, can't wait to get back.

It's nice looking, but most of the staff (not the kids' librarians) are nasty and disorganized.  They have put my account on hold twice in a year for losing books the library then finds.  No apologies, just nasty staff.

Best Mercedes mechanic EVER!  Tell him "monkey boy" sent you!  ps... that's his nickname for my son :)  Stuggart Motors has always made sure my car is in the safest condition so my kids are safe and for that I am very grateful!

Overall 2 star for the food and service. Me and my bf went in this morning and there where 3 groups in front of us. I checked in with the host and were told the wait will be 30 min. 2 more groups came in after us and got a table first!  I told the host she said she is going by the check in order（-.-）We finally got our table and I wanted to order something from their regular menu instead of the Easter menu, and the waitress kept saying no. The other restaurants I went to, server will always say let me check with the kitchen. We didn't wait too long for the food, normal time. We ordered coconut French toast which are good, but a little too sweet. He has the hanger steak, the steak is burned! Tastes so bitter he has to spit it out. I had the breakfast nook, just simple sunny side up and bacon. Bacon are pretty good and the pancake is great. But we were disappointed by the service and other people who posted pictures, you guys take great photos!!!!

I love their burger & booze special for $8 in the evenings, but I have never been all that impressed by Silvergreens. I like their tomato soup and that they have avocado as a burger option, but that's pretty much where my raving ends. It's not awful, but it's not awesome. The cleanliness isn't up to par with what I'd like to see from a food place. I saw fruit flies everywhere my last visit there. Gross.

Mike is a good honest guy!  He dropped by on his own time to diagnose my A/C problem - I needed a new blower motor.  He came by the next day with an OEM part and had it installed in about 1/2 hour.  Then he cleaned out the furnace area and didn't leave before checking out my whole system. All this and his final bill was well under the initial estimate.  Very professional and easy to deal with.

I was pretty disappointed in this spot. My man and I got two shrimp baja tacos, two carne asada tacos, and queso to go. When I asked him what he thought about his carne asadas, he replied with, "over priced trash". 
The shrimp tacos had so much sauce that the tortilla got soggy in the five minute walk from the restaurant back to our spot. Then, they gave you two additional sauces for them, as if you would want to further drench what should be such a simple, clean recipe in more bullshit. 
The queso, i thought, would redeem everything. Unfortunately, the greasy brick of cheese that came with NO promised tortilla chips disappointed us even further. We won't be eating here again...if we want tacos, we'll stick with tin roof, thanks. 

This placed robs you blind. Shit tacos for barbacoa prices. 

**only reason this isn't one star is because the bartender gave me great service while I waited.

I ordered the carrot cake smoothie and it was delicious!  I can't wait to go back and try their other offerings.  Place is nice and clean with a relaxed vibe and they have great health products.  But it is a bit pricey.  Only drawback.

Only go to this Dry Cleaner's if you want to pay to have your items RUINED.

Item: white lab coat

Directions: heavy starch please. I would like the creases to be very distinct. I need to pick it up Wednesday because I need it first thing Thursday morning. Thank you 

What I received: 
1. white lab coat 
2. Brand new blue stain on the front rendering it unusable
3. Less starched than when I brought it in
4. No creases WHATSOEVER
5. Fuzz of unidentifiable origin covering the entire coat making it look like a shedding grizzly bear had last worn it
6. Employee with a bad attitude, raised voice, and unwilling to provide a refund of less than $10 or reparations of any sort 

My voice was not raised, but I was visibly upset because I had brought this item to be cleaned and pressed. I wasted my time, money, and gasoline only to receive a ruined item and no way to replace it before I need it tomorrow morning.

After asking the man to stop raising his voice as I had not raised mine, he made an attempt to lower his voice because there was another customer present. His effort subsided rapidly, and he continued to raise his voice.

Yes, you have been reported to the BBB over an obvious mistake on your part that would've cost less than $10 to refund. Yes, I would have been satisfied if someone would have simply refunded my money.

Be prepared. If you go here, you will only waste your time, money, gasoline, and breath. Please don't even test it out.

The customer is never right at this Dry Cleaner's.

The Bagel Place came through!! I had a family member past away in the early morning and needed something quick for my family. I went online and came across "The Bagel Place." Their food in the pictures looked so delicious that I felt I should call. Because this was so sudden there was not enough time for the 24 hour in advance tray request. I spoke to Mary Smith and she came through for my family! She not only came through but with compassion. They made my bagel sandwiches to my request and found us a delivery service who would deliver in such short notice. The bagels arrived expeditiously and my family raved about them! Thank you again for doing such a great job!

Not a fan.  The bread is not fresh and the meats are flavorless.  The turkey sandwich at Subway might be more flavorful, AND PLENTIFUL.

I've had two sandwiches from here, and will never order again.  Sorry Warehouse Deli.

Great selection and great staff.  The constant rotation of beer options always keeps things interesting.  The place can fill up fast making finding a seat difficult, but usually people are good very friendly and willing to share a table

Been here a few times now and it's time to review!

First visit, we ordered the Vermicilli Noodles (Lemongrass) and another order of BBQ Pork Vermicilli Noodles. Scott hates bell peppers and we did not know this was included on it. Menu did say Vermicilli Lemongrass and it typically is just lettuce, some other veggies like carrots with the noodles but not this time! The bell pepper taste is also heavily in the dish so it was very hard to get rid of.

The BBQ Pork Vermicilli was very delicious though (for the moment before I switched).

Second and other visits, we stuck to Pork Vermicilli Noodles And Pho.

The new place is decorated really well and the service is really nice and will go out of their way to make sure you have a nice lunch and/or dinner.

I do not know why they are still in business. This is the worst run airline I have ever seen. Probably the worst run travel business. Worse than Amtrak. The level of hostility from the Frontier staff was something I have never seen. Everything else would have been ok  -- the 30 minute bag check line, paying extra for a carry-on, paying extra for a confirmed seat assignment, the dingy plane with hard seats, no wifi -- all of it would have been ok if they people running it were just polite. Instead everyone one in a Frontier uniform was either actively ignoring customers or berating them. They are just mean. I should have flown American, by the time I paid for all the 'extras' like a carry-on bag, it would have been the same price.

I've been using them to install a RVQ, roof fan covers, replace a roof fan, and an A/C, on my 21' Class C Motor home for about 12 years. They always do a great, thorough job and I've never had any problems with their work. I've gone to a couple of other local RV repair shops and Safari charges significantly less. Their parts are more expensive than mail order, usually, but they are well stocked so they carry and have to finance a large inventory. The A/C they installed was significantly cheaper than Camping World OR Amazon, to my surprise.

The Californian salad is delicious! It's only on the lunch menu though. Also ginger beer (which is apparently house brewed) is A+. Have had the burger with lettuce instead of the bun as a good gf option. The food here is always reliable. My favorite is their happy hour--cocktails are yummy and the pretzel appetizer is ADDICTING. 

Patio/roof seating is also really great when it's nice out. Parking is somewhat limited so often I have to find a spot on the street.

One of the best escape rooms my "team" has completed. (And we have completed no small amount!)  We have successfully completed their three current rooms and are eagerly awaiting their fourth. Their most difficult room (Dr. K's Lethal Injection) is my personal favorite of theirs as it includes a lot of unique technology. No matter which room you try, you're guaranteed a FANTASTIC time.

Well I knew I was taking a chance by other reviews, and The reviews are probably generous. Walked up the handicap ramp and the door was locked. Food came out slow, and it took 20 minutes of sitting around before we got a check after we had clearly finished eating. The food was so-so, my hamburger was overcooked, but my wings were good.

Ashley is a wonderful aesthetician! I am always so pleased with my facials, personalized to my skin, and I am so happy with how nice my skin has become since I started coming to her. I highly recommend Ashley!!

Please! The previous review must be from the staff. That's the worst apartment I've ever lived in. The apartments are really small and crappy! And the Manager is such a b.....! She says one thing today and another tomorrow and does't give you the correct info. I recently moved out and I told her I was moving out of state for work and I would have to break my lease. She said I would only have to pay the rent for the complete month and that was it. So I give her the check and a few weeks later she says I have to now pay the 2 weeks I'm staying in April. I told her I just payed her the complete rent for April and she says that's some other fees, which she never told me. I had a notepad when I first talked to her and wrote down everything she told me I had to pay, so it was impossible for me to be getting confused or missing anything. At the end she denied everything she first told me and I ended up paying around $1,000 for moving outta there. Even the leasing consultants think she's a crazy b....!

I went here on Valentine's Day with my date and they took us in regardless of no reservation, and it was a busy day for them. Place is very nice, perfect for a special occasion since the ambience is not completely causal, just classy but not extremely formal. The options are mostly Japanese and a small section of Thai foods. The food was amazing! I ordered 2 rolls and a Japanese steak. Our waiter was very patient and super nice! There is also a small bar to sit at. The place is relatively small so parties larger than 6 would be overwhelming. I would definitely come here again!!! A+ service!

Wow...
INCREDIBLE BBQ. Some of the best I've ever had! The Deviled Pog is a must try due to the sheer creativity of the thing but you really can't go wrong with any of the basics. Superb selection of sauces add to the meats that already taste great without any sauce.

I hate to give places such a low rating, but unfortunately Tucson Coffee Roasters did not deliver on my particular order. I got an iced decaf latte with oat milk. I was so excited to see they had oat milk, as I'm trying to reduce my dairy intake. I love oat milk since it's usually super smooth and creamy. My drink was anything but, and had a watered down kind of grainy taste. I'm wondering if that's because it was decaf? Not sure but many other coffee shops have made delicious decaf lattes. I couldn't finish my drink and that's a pretty bad sign. That being said, the interior is super cute and modern and would be a great place to study or get some work done.

Decided to try Bertucci's at this location after the grand reopening.  Party of six family members decided to try a Sunday late afternoon, the parking lot was nearly empty, I thought that it might have closed again.  My chicken piccata was just ok, pasta was overcooked.  Wife ordered chicken marsala, burnt chicken with a few mushrooms thrown on top, NO marsala sauce, and the dish was served 15 minutes after everyone else's dinner arrived, even though place was empty and also chilly inside.  The waitress did the best that she could, never offered drink refills, and how do two small glasses of wine cost $17.00?  Not sure what was done after the closing in 2018, appearance and quality as bad or worse, won't be returning.

.Love the place, and they have recently expanded and doubled their seating, greatly reducing the line significantly. I go here every time I am in the quarter, get the oysters and jambalaya...boom! You will enjoy, I gar-an-tee!

BEST BANH MI IN PHILLY! You will pay more than the little shops in Chinatown or South Philly, but the quality bump is well worth it. Your extra few dollars will get you a generous portion of protein your choice (I always get to tofu so can't attest to the rest), delicious sauce (I ask for extra!), cilantro, a heap of carrot slaw, jalapenos if you want them, all on the best crunchy on the outside, soft on the inside fresh roll. 

I'm severely addicted and have tried almost every banh mi joint in the city. Trust me, you won't regret it.

Yesterday was my first time at Banfield, they accommodated both of my dogs, even though I was late, the ladies at the front were SUPER nice, friendly and really helpful..... the gentleman with the tattoos was extremely knowledgeable and made me feel comfortable in signing up for the preventative care program that they have there. The Dr. was WONDERFUL as well, really answered any questions I had and was very professional, I was so happy I found my Vet! Minus 1 star because I JUST called... and I'm STILL ON HOLD. Maybe instead of saying may I place you on a "brief" hold, you can tell people to call back later or maybe just have a voicemail? Or grab peoples phone numbers and call them back??? 18 min is a little long???? Now over 20 min? And then i called back and I told her I didn't want to hold because I had already been holding for 20 minutes, and she said "I'm helping the last person.. hold on".... LOL! OH SURE why not lady I have nothing else to do! Then when she came back on the phone all I asked was if I could put my care credit card on the preventative care monthly payment and she said no.....which is totally cool, what bothered me was my question took 5 seconds to ask and hang up....well... technically almost 30 minutes for a 2 second conversation....

Had a wonderful dinner here with family.  Six people.  Calimari was excellent.  All of the dishes were good and the service was excellent.  Would definitely go here again.   Seems to be a family business and run very well.

I really want to like Mai Lee but I just don't get the appeal.

We've tried it multiple times and it is ALWAYS underwhelming.

1) the menu is way too extensive.  This leads me to always feel buyer remorse
2) pho is what they're known for but it lacks a real rich broth.  It's "okay"
3) every Vietnam's noodle dish we've tried has no definite flavor.  The chicken stir fry w vermacille was not worth the cost.
4) pot stickers looked amazing and homemade - were bland and doughy.
5) the price for the dinners is outrageous for what you're getting!!

Unfortunately I think people in St. Louis just don't know good Vietnamese food and don't have a ton of options.  It's amazing they've been around as long as they have but I guess if you have the market share...

Best eggplant parm I've had in a long time!
Very helpful and accommodating.

We order from here all the time, their pizza is hit or miss, sometimes it's amazing sometimes it's just okay. But overall it's a good place, I would recommend if you're in the mood for some dominoes pizza

Evangeline's quality of food NEVER disappoints (though the service was subpar once or twice). I've been here three times for lunch and three times for dinner. The food has never been disappointing! I even hosted a work event here for a large party. I would recommend anyone who likes Cajun style food to give this place a shot! Live music certain nights throughout the week, and tasty drinks anytime!

A few of my girlfriends and I came to Nashville for the weekend and had to stop by here! The kimchi spring rolls, pad Thai, cheese board, and avocado margs were to die for!! Definitely going to think about the food here back home and will have to come back for sure.
Truly beautiful and relaxing. The cottages are amazing! Enjoyed friendly staff and great food. Plus, they have complimentary bikes you can rent to bike around town.
I had been in pain for a week. One treatment with Dr Hove and I am back to normal. I think it would be beneficial for me to do regular spine maintenance and will be in good hands with Dr Hove.

I cannot stress enough how wonderfully surprised I was by this place. The fried chicken po boy was PHENOMENAL. Just the right chicken to bread ratio and the chicken was perfectly crispy and seasoned. The fries that come with were also fantastic; I love a good battered fry and for a very reasonable $10 price tag. It's right next to the French market so great for pre or post shopping eats and there's also love music which is always a pleasant addition to any meal. Truly a little gem!

I had my second visit here 10/17/18. 

I won't lie I'm apprehensive with line cook restaurants & salad bars due to my food allergies. However, they have made me a believer that places can be mindful. 

My first visit was in 2017. And due to my fear I had a chicken panini with cheese jalapeños. It was amazing. 

This visit I placed my trust in the staff and my tastebuds were greatly rewarded. I had a fiesta warm bowl with no avocado & a note that I was allergic to that and tomatoes...

My bowl was comprised of black beans, roasted corn, roasted onion, peppers, roasted jalapeno, cotija cheese, chile crema, with a blend of 100% whole grain brown rice, black barley and daikon radish seeds . . .Oh and I had them add grilled chicken (which was cooked to perfection)! 

I'm not going to lie, there's no picture because I tore it up! It was hot and full of flavor. I like my food spicy, so next time I'll ask for more jalapeños. I will be back just for this meal.

Chipotle makes my life better. 

I know using food as an emotional crutch probably isn't very psychologically healthy but there are some issues that can only be solved by copious amounts of salsa roja and guacamole (read: all of them).

I've convinced several people of this undeniable fact and now, I'm lucky enough to work with people who appreciate Chipotle almost as much as I do, meaning we order from the Lancaster Ave. location often. 

Every time I've tried to fax over an order, it hasn't seemed to have worked so now, we just fill out the fax order form and head over to manually hand it to the cashier.

At any other place, something like this would cause contention but we've done it several times to much success:

Me: Can we exchange this piece of paper plus cash for delicious, delicious Mexican food?
Chipotle Cashier: Of course! Would you like soda or chips with that?

Awesome. 

Great customer service and a machine-like efficiency. You walk in with an order for eight people and walk out less than ten minutes later, lumbering under the weight of burritos. 

I have but one, teeny, trifling lament and that's the fact that only dine-in patrons get to enjoy Tabasco sauce with their meals. They have a good range (from regular to jalapeno to chipotle) and a couple of tiny to-go containers by the condiments bar would be great because if there's one thing that could make Chipotle better -- it's more hot sauce.

This review is a long time coming. The only reason this casino is even getting two stars is because they have good food at the restaurants and it is decently kept. Personally, I only ever play the table games.. specifically blackjack and 9/10 I will walk away losing my money here. I should mention this is the only casino where you consistently lose a game that has some strategy to it. Furthermore, the minimums are HIGH.. especially for weekdays where if you compare parx to other good casino's like the Borgata, the minimum is only $5. So you think fine, maybe the table limits are high, lets play live dynamic blackjack for only $5.. well you're out of luck because its been down for a month now, leaving no other options but to play the unusually high $25 limit tables- which guaranteed you won't walk away a winner. Save yourself the money and the aggravation go elsewhere.

Taco heaven on 4th Ave! I like to recommend Boca to visitors, especially since they've been featured in the press and on tv programs. My favorites include shrimp and asada. The salsas add a good punch of flavor. The food consistently satisfies! The restaurant is spacious and the outdoor patio is dog friendly. I suggest happy hour if you're looking for drink specials. The happy hour tacos are smaller though. I wish the portions were a little bigger, but otherwise the tacos are very flavorful.

Another Dogtown winner! Even though Pats has been around forever, I just visited there a few months ago. It was worth the hype for sure. I went in knowing only one thing to order, their famous fried chicken. What a good amount of food for under $12. You get a leg, wing and breast along with two sides. The chicken is crunch and super juicy. It will probably be the only thing I order there. 

The feel is just like an old style pub which is cozy and very inviting. The staff is amazing, we have had the same waitress the few times we have been in and she is always joking and having a good time.

It's a good place for Sunday dinner or any night of the week for that matter. Don't be like me and wait to go there, do it sooner!

I never thought I'd review Massa's: Its a STL county staple.  No one even thinks about it.  You will always get a professional, authentic Italian meal with an authentic Italian attitude: graceful, pro service, inviting dining room.  This is STL, we appreciate Italian.  T&C Massa's is near my home so I frequent (the bar, mostly) there.  

So, why review now?  There was a sudden death in the family.  Through all the planning and organization, I was under the gun to host about 50 people.  I called and spoke to Corey who walked me through the meal.  He suggested a couple of pastas, reminded me that it was lent and there might be a couple of non meat people.  He suggested a little grocery list.  He did everything but stand at my kitchen counter and serve.  The STL ex pats were THRILLED to enjoy a Massa's meal again.  I am very very thankful.  

Go there, take a hearty appetite, and don't forget to get a pan of pasta for your next gathering.  What a relief.

We love this shop. We first rented bikes here last fall. The store is in a perfect location to cruise downtown, ride the Greenbelt, ride Harrison Street, and ride Camels Back Park. The rental mountain bikes were very nice full suspension bikes. They were also current models that were still sold in store for about $2000. The staff is fun and upbeat not pretentious like some other bike stores. More recently, I purchased a used mountain bike from a private party for my son. He was so excited to ride, but we needed a tune up, pedals, and a new rear tire for the bike. Toji was our service rep and he shared my son's enthusiasm and excitement about his new bike. It was a very busy day at the shop, but he was only focused on our needs. He completed the repairs the same day and my son was able to get in an epic ride before the rain came in. What a great store!

Assuming you have insurance that covers this visit, this place rocks, however my bill was $2,900 but the insurance negotiated rate was only $180. Apart from all the insurance drain talk, I am a nurse so I know good nurses and Physician Assistants when I see them, and they are here! I am a really hard stick (hard to put an IV in me) and my nurse got me on one try! They were quick and efficient with what I needed done and the place is super clean and nice.

My family and I are Longhorn.regulars and we visit this location often. Like most places in the north Philly area this location can be a bit busy but the staff and food are usually pretty good. Any issues are typically handled by the server or management promptly.

I received terrible service and questionable food at this establishment. I love Greek food but this fell very short of my expectations. I ordered the Moussaka comes with baked green beans and my son ordered a Gyro plate. First I recieved my soup after my main entree. My son's plate looked ok but then we noticed that the gyro meat was very dry. I did not like the baked green beans because they tasted more like canned green beans and lacked any salt. It was all just bad. I will never return. Save your money it's not worth the headache or the taste.

Went to BE for lunch today.  We really want this restaurant to succeed as we are big fans of Brophy Bros.  I had fish and chips and Deb had the fish taco app and onion rings.  We both had Bloody Mary's.  I didn't prefer my Mary as it seemed too strong from the pickling juice from the asparagus spear.

We really liked the fried garbanzo bean tasty bites and the onion rings.  The fish and chips and fish tacos were just ok.  The bar took a while to get our drinks.  I guess this fortifies my idea that we shouldn't review a brand new restaurant...

I hope they get everything dialed in.  Their menu is priced correctly and their location is prime.  I know if they dial it up a couple of notches they will probably be very successful.
OMG!! It is delicious! Even if your not vegan you'll LOVE IT! I had nachos and they were YUM!
Went for the first time today and absolutely loved it.  I am still thinking about my Rueben and looking forward to the next one.  It was WOW good.  Highly recommend.

Second time here and they are very consistent. The smoked wings and fries are our favorites. We sat at the bar and Chris was our waiter. He was very helpful in regards to me trying different beers. I enjoyed the atmosphere, eclectic music and the food. The burger was  so yummy! We met a few friends there earlier in the day for the St. Patrick's Day festivities and we had a good time. This just might be one of my summer hangouts. Check them out if you like a variety of beers, good food and a chill vibe.

We had an emergency and after leaving messages with 20 exterminators over the weekend, Joe was the first to get back to us. We spoke at 7:45 Monday morning, and he promised to fit us in late afternoon. 4pm comes - no word. 5, 6, 6:45pm - no word - I'm calling or texting every 15 minutes. Needless to say his promise was worthless. I took a whole day off of work and now have to leave town for two weeks with a house full of rats, all because I relied on the word of this company. Edited to say: I have the phone and text records to show that Joe and I talked-for a minute at 7:48am, then 20 sec a bit later when we got cut off. He said he was driving and for me to text him the address, which I did. Throughout the day I texted 1 more time, left 2 voicemails, and hung up on no-answer 5 more times. I'm sorry he doesn't remember any of this but I sure do-there's no confusion on my part.
Every taco was amazing! The coffee mezcal drink with the coffee ice cube was my favorite! Will return for Happy Hour and then some

I dream of the octopus and steak sticks! And ever since we went there for brunch last week and ordered the chorizo breakfast sandwich (forget the name) I think it's my most favorite brunch option. Hearty with perfectly seasoned potatoes on the side! Beautifully curated flavor profiles and a must try if you haven't yet.

The Clover Grill is your typical greasy spoon place to eat for those looking to cure their hangover from the Bourbon Street Blues.  Simple, cheap, no frills.  More of a Happy Days type of place that caters to locals and tourists alike.  Nothing fancy with the exception of a good crowd and good food.  I ordered a Country Fried Steak with eggs, toast and hashbrowns.  Felt like a typical down home kind of meal that is very filling at a reasonable price. Both the menu and the restaurant are small, but the experience is worth the time and money spent here.  I would highly recommend this place to anyone that is both local and from out of town.  Especially during those drunken nights on Bourbon Street.
Original floor didn't work out, but Chris helped us find a replacement floor at a comparable price. These guys work hard to help you find what your looking for.

I went in for a simple flat top and came out with the worst chop top ive ever had.. do not go here.. Jenny the asian stylist.. (if you wanna call her that) destroyed my hair cut... first of all i am a cosmologist and for a decent flat top it takes at least 45 minutes.. she took about 12 minutes she was very rude and acted like she did not give a f***... after the third time i asked her to fix the choppiness i realized she had no clue what she was doing HORRIBLE .she should have paid me for my time... so that being said if you want a shi* hair cut the go see JENNY

Service was great. Great menu options. Great for picky people who does not want sushi and still come and get other options. We all three ordered different items. We had Pad Thai, Beno Box Salmon and Sashimi and three different salad.

The wait is entirely too long but the food is good, service could always be better, especially if you are a single person dining solo (servers think they can get away without refilling your coffee or seeing if your food is good).  Used the Yelp app for the wait list and their were 51 parties ahead of me at 9am, asked me to check in at 10:16, which I did and still did not get seated before 11am and with the cold and the rain, just glad I didn't catch a cold! The spinach omelet and potato pancakes were delicious!
Big Sky our go to local restaurant! From the art to the service this is or hideaway in Webster!

Cute place right by Jefferson! I'm not sure of the names of the women working today, but I had the African American woman who got my eyebrows lookin RIGHT (I only make this distinction in hopes that she reads my review today and knows she did a fantastic job)! I told her what I wanted and she delivered, but made sure to check she didn't take off too much. This place had me done in less than 20 minutes. I'm very pleased and I will definitely be back!

Excellent service
Would recommend this shoe repair to anyone needing quick and great service






  
 
  
B

I ordered the barbeque chicken flatbread and it had 3 times the bbq sauce it should have, completely overpowered the pizza.  The cheese was melted but the flatbread and toppings were still cold to lukewarm depending on the slice.  AWFUL!!! Will NOT go back there.

Love this place. I always get a gel pedicure and it lasts me up to 2 months which is perfect and thats how i know they did and incredible job. Everyone there is super nice they make me feel like family

I was looking for a place in a pinch with three hungry and grumpy kids in the car. Came across this place. Kids portions are bigger than normal. Food came fast. Food was excellent across the board. Definitely a classic diner with bloodies and beer. Oh and the kids left happy!

My son and daughter-in-law had their Cocktail Party reception here and it was such a wonderful experience.  From the food, to the service, to the ambiance, to the location...all was perfection.  The event planner, Susan, was amazing.  She was so accommodating and very sweet and friendly.  The next day I received so many calls and texts from the guests who all had nothing but glowing remarks regarding the party.  I would highly recommend having any special event here...you will not be disappointed!!!

Sherri is amazing! She came in early to do my hair for a wedding even though she had an already extremely packed day. She does such a great job with my cut and style every time I come in and I love their products!

Central Arizona Block NORTHWEST.  Knowing little about concrete, I stopped here on a Saturday to get concrete mix where you mix the sand and gravel mix with whatever else you mix it with.  The man behind the counter knew about as much as I did about concrete.  First bad sign.  There was a little boy playing on a computer at a desk behind him.  When the boy said his computer wasn't working, the man responded to him very ignorant.  I should have walked out at that moment.  If he talks to the boy like that with people around, imagine how he is when no one is there.  He also had a very smug attitude.  I left with ready mix concrete bags.  Got charged $16 for a pallet and $1 for shrink wrap.  Neither was needed or wanted and no option was given.  I bought more concrete than needed and they refused to accept a return 2 days later.  The woman behind the counter, when I returned, said the man on Saturday should have told me I could not return unused bags of concrete.  Received only $13 of $16 back for the pallet.  Bought 38 bags and could have saved $70 if I would have gone to Lowes or Home Depot.

We were visiting and came out to Play two nights in a row. Drag show was great, and we loved the separate club floor. The patio was also nice and a change of scenery as well. Bathrooms were well attended and very clean. Staff were mostly friendly and service oriented. The only meh-side imo is that it is 18+ but at least the under 21 demo get booted around midnight. The bar pours generously also, this was pretty much what we were looking for, for a fun weekend!

This is probably the best Greek food in Boise. We came in late on a weekday. The cashier was super attentive and recommended the traditional pork gyro for first timers. I was hesitant to skip the usual beef/lamb combo but decided to try it out. We both went with the recommendation and both loved our gyros. The pork was great and paired perfectly with the tzatziki.  

We also tried the Meraki sampler and all three of the appetizers were great. 

Will definitely be back, if only parking was easier to get takeout all the time!

This is great addition to the Seminole Heights food scene. The food is great and the juices are refreshing. I still prefer the flavors of their St. Pete location, but the food here is still pretty good.

I would like to begin by stating that my experience with Frontdoor ended before leasing an apartment. I viewed, applied for, and was approved for an apartment in the Loop Lofts. Upon approval I was emailed about when I could pay the non-refundable holding deposit (the entire security deposit must be paid in order to take the apartment off the market, if one decides not to move into the apartment, the entire deposit will be forfeited). Considering that the deposit was considerable, I requested to see the apartment one more time and pay the deposit in person. Via email on a Friday I was told that this was fine and asked when I would like to see it. 

On Monday I responded that I would like to see it on Wednesday. I did not receive a response. On Wednesday, I emailed stating that I hadn't heard back and offering a different date and time. After close on Wednesday, I received an email stating that the apartment I was interested in was unavailable (rented to someone else) and that there would not be a matching one until August. When I called to voice my complaint I heard only a standard "this is the policy of any leasing agency" response. I was offered a slight discount on a unit that will be available after the date I wanted to move by and with a different layout. 

To summarize, I paid an application fee which merely allowed them to run a hard check on my credit without any hold on the apartment. I was told that the period of time I needed to feel comfortable paying the deposit was fine and then was not told when the apartment was leased to someone else contrary to the implicit agreement that had been made. 

This level of mis- and non-communication is not honorable. It is particularly worrisome when added to the numerous (but more dated) complaints about having difficulties receiving security deposits back. While the application fee is not major by any means, a lost $60 (2 applications were needed for my situation) is not pleasurable. I would advise people to be very weary of dealing with Frontdoor. I suspect that some of their prices are lower because they weasel so much extra money from non-refundable pet deposits, non-refunding pre-lease deposits, and kept security deposits.

Can't figure out why anyone goes here. The burgers are tasteless, overpriced and just a sloppy mess. Ordered a draught beer that was delivered to me just over half full. Sorry, for $4 a beer I expect it to be full. My wife asked for a knife so she could cut the burger in half. Waitress informed us they weren't allowed to give customer knives. Has our society become so bad that patrons cannot be trusted with knives to use for their dinner?! Our waitress apologized more than 30 times over the course of our experience. I now have a new rule. For every apology I will be deducting a percentage of the tip. If I could give 0 stars I would. Never again will I patronize this tasteless/overpriced "burger" joint. Better/cheaper burgers are just around the corner at any fast food restaurant.

Went to dinner here last Friday night the restaurant was busy! I sat at the sushi bar and my server gave me a heads up that if I ordered sushi there'd be a bit of a wait so I looked through the menu and ordered two roll. 
I also ordered a glass of wine and the crab rangoons.  
Crab rangoons are my fave and I order them anytime I see them on a menu! The description threw me off a bit, said it included broccoli, but I ordered them anyway. They were served similar to a spring roll. They were tasty and I didn't taste the broccoli so don't let that throw you off. 
My sushi rolls were served soon after, I enjoyed the first love and the Florida roll, both were very good

I only gave the restaurant 3 stars because I wasn't totally blow away. I plan to visit again and maybe try the pad Thai or something else from the kitchen.

Exceptional Surprise!  Beautifully decorated interior, friendly staff, quick service.  The surprise was that it was happy hour(Sunday). 50¢ smoked wings and half priced cocktails.  I ordered plain wings , glad to enjoy full smoked flavor and froze'.  Then had the City Park burger, shredded cheese, caramelized onions and hickory sauce. Next surprise was that it was a double patty with the Pontchatoula cocktail.  My friend ordered the 'Let the Beet Drop" cocktail... Not a good idea, but we did give out input on how to improve it only to find out we were the first to order it. Our server was sooo helpful and friendly.  Definitely returning.... soon!
Good food, cozy place.  Great for a night out with friends.
Great food!! Big portions. Awesome  servers! Austin rocks! Will be back again!!! What a find!

My favorite part of the show is the aesthetics of it. It's a nice looking store that displays the boards almost as if they're art rather than just because. The help was quite friendly. 

However, it's me, the customer and reviewer, that's the reason why  can't give it a five-star rating. I can't skate, surf, or snowboard and the majority of the items were directly related to those activities or t-shirts so I felt a little lost in there.

The seafood nachos here are AMAZING!! I would come back and eat them everytime I am in the city! This is a straight up bar with a few low tops but mostly high top tables. The service was pretty quick for a Saturday night. Pretty loud with TVs playing in the background. HUGE portions! Check them out real quick, I heard they may be closing within the coming wks .

Can't say enough about how EXCELLENT this cruise is for the whole family! 

It may seem weird that a cruise that offers unlimited wine, beer and champagne can also offer a great time for kids, but check it out and you'll be as pleasantly surprised as I was. 

As soon as you board you and your group are invited to take a pic with Captain Memo. Next up head str8 to the bar or grab a seat. Don't fret if you don't grab a great seat initially because as soon as the baot gets moving people move around a lot. 

Activities for the kids included Musical chairs, story time, and a dig in the treasure chest. There was also a water gun fights led by the kids but then adults are invited to join in. 

About halfway into the cruise the dance party starts. Begins with a limbo contest then goes into the Macarena, Wobble, YMCA and a Captain Memo original the Pirate Shuffle.  Lol

Aside from the complimentary beverages theres a full cash bar. Another great feature is that someone walks around with beer, wine and champagne 

Chips ahoy Chad was our favorite Pirate. When he broke out into the wrom during the dance party I almost peed my pants. Lol.

All in all a greattttt time!

Cheese steaks  are great, however I come here for their roast pork. This is my runner up for best roast pork in south philly. The lines move quickly and sometimes seating is a pain ( especially if it is a busy sports night). However you can stand around and once someone gets up make your move!! He owner tony is a really great guy and well and does a lot for the community. Food taste better when the owner isn't a weirdo. I suggest the Italian pork and cheese fries!!

Very pretty and well-kept park. We come here with friends and our dogs and sit on the lawn when there's a concert and it's so relaxing and fun. You have a great view of the Indians' stadium, NCAA, and the Marriott hotels. They have some nice trees that we like to throw our hammocks up on.

It wasn't bad nor was it "omg, this place is amazing". It's pretty mediocre. My family and I did go near closing time, but I don't think it would have made a significant difference as far as the food. The waitresses were on point with picking up the plates when we were finished. And they did cook up more Chinese donuts for the other family that was in the restaurant, which was nice since it was within the hour of closing.

I live in Florida and chose this hotel to have some friends from up north to stay at for the New Years party it hosted.

Most the staff was very nice except for the extremely rude man at the front desk named JC I believe. At check in he was so rude rolling his eyes at us saying "why me" under his breath. We showed up around 12 because that's when they got here. He then was basically yelling at us rolling his eyes asking why we're here so early check in is at 3. 
(Hello? We're going to hang out at the pool and we're hoping you'd let us know if our room gets ready early like any other hotel??) 

The second day we needed a room key which he was very rude about. We even told him he was being rude and he didn't change his attitude one bit. 

Stayed here with 7 people for 2 days-we took up 3 rooms plus the cost of the party tickets (meaning they got plenty of money out of us) 
he made me regret choosing this hotel and should not be in customer service. Wanted to make management aware of this.

Great brewery with a chilled out atmosphere with a great view of Lake Padgett. I tried a flight of beers that included a blonde, pilsner, browne ale and a dunkel. All four of the beers were good. The dunkel was my favorite. I was very happy to see a wide variety of beers. 
The back deck is large and has two fire pits. There's also a bocce court. There are a few seats inside, so if the weather is bad that might be an issue. They don't serve food, but they have regular visits from food trucks.

PSA they are closed on Mondays now!!! 

Hands down my favorite place. It is so underrated. No frill just inexpensive and delicious food. Everything here is good but their salt baked chicken wings are famous and rightfully so! It is soooo crispy yet juicy and piping hot. I eat these suckers like its popcorn. Food comes out so fast, everything is clean, and come on don't you want to support your local mom and pop? I will always come here as long as they are open for business.

DefiNitely the best place to head before a game! We were in town to watch the Seahawks beat the Eagles and were recommended this by some friends from Philly. We got there around 10am for a 1pm game and shortly after it got a lot more packed! There was a cover of $10 per person, which came in handy as we went back after the game and with our wristbands on we didn't have to wait in line and got to go in through the VIP line!

There are a ton of bars and restaurants here to choose from to find anything you may be craving. We had to indulge the crab fries at chickey and Pete's and were not disappointed! Definitely be sure to get the cup of cheese to dip them in as well. 

I will day after the game it's a completely different crowd as it becomes basically a club and you encounter all the 21 year olds who didn't go to the game and stayed there to get drunk the entire time instead. We encountered a lot of sloppy kids that needed to go to bed. Also seemed like they exceeded their occuoancy capacity and may have been a fire hazard. Overall good food and drinks and definitely recommend heading there before a game!

First time here. Reflected Mirror windows make it unable to see inside. But, once inside super friendly staff, various kinds of pupusas (11). 

We had a chicken and cheese pupusa, chicken soup, a chicken tamales (1 of 2 kinds here), and for my niece chicken strips with French fries which she enjoyed (she's not big on trying new things. All delicious!

3 kinds of hot sauces. All delicious as well.
The girl here is awesome! The only downfall is that she's the only one that does dipping nails. If you come in definitely call ahead to get a time frame. She does awesome dip nails

Was not a fan. There were 4 of us. I ordered the turkey burger. Was very dry and bland. My friend had the bacon cheddar cheeseburger. He ordered it medium rare and it was well done. They forgot one of our appetizers.  We had asked the waiter to split our bill 3 ways and he got agitated. It was not done correctly. Will probably not return.

First of all, if you get to have Allison as your server... you are in luck! She is an angel. She will answer all of your questions knowledgeably and efficiently.

Next, for the vegans - there are a couple (3-4) options on the menu. I went with the hummus platter for our appetizer. It was yummy! The pita is NOT vegan so you can substitute that for extra veggies. I used some of my potato chips from my main course to dip into the hummus and that was a nice combo.

I ordered the vegan tacos and they were pretty good. I didn't think that two would be enough to fill me up, but they actually did. They are double wrapped and have a swipe of hummus between them. It was a lot of hummus for me in one meal but definitely tasty.

Finally, my partner got the Rice Bowl entree with a couple of substitutions and he really enjoyed the peanut sauce. Even though it wasn't an app size, it was still a pretty small serving. Everything comes on huge plates that are probably meant to throw off the eyes! 

Anyway, we left spending $30 on food and were both happy full vegans! It was a perfect spot to stop off of on our road trip route!

Sat for ten minutes before anyone came to our table. Placed order and 35 minutes later my food arrived crusted over from the heat lamp and hubs got an order of fajitas that were far from sizzling. In fact I could hold it my hand without fear of burning because it was barely warm. 

The cook came out and offered to remake our food with barely an apology and no explanation as to how this was acceptable as food to serve. Uh, no. 

Subpar food, lackluster service, pitiful. 

Steer clear.

No complaints whatsoever.  Service & food were great.  There were so many items to choose from -- such a diverse menu!  I had the warm lobster salad and it was great.  My kids loved the ravioli and the baby cheeseburgers.
This is supposed to be a 24 hour location but they're always closed for unknown reasons. If they're open, the food is cold. Just close down and give us chick Fil a over here instead

The search for a great creperie in America continues...

I had hopes for Le Cafe Creperie to be more authentic but I was quickly dismayed. Upon entering the restaurant you see the workers there making crepes right in the center of the restaurant and some small tables all around. I love Paris and French things but the decor was even a bit tacky for me (not to mention the overly instrumental "French" music and La vie en rose...) 

Moving on from that... I came with a few friends to try a few of the savory and sweet crepes. My biggest thing is that I have yet to see a restaurant create a proper savory buckwheat crepe and when I saw it was an option on the menu to have a buckwheat crepe for $1 extra, my heart rejoiced! (Gluten-free friends, you too, can have a gluten-free crepe for $1 extra too)
Typically, people here use the same batter for savory and sweet crepes and that's just not right!! I ordered a crepe Breton with chicken, arugula, and almonds and wasn't totally wowed by the experience. The buckwheat crepe was wholly not what I thought it would be; it actually made my crepe more like a pancake than the thinner regular crepes. It was alright... the flavor was a bit lacking. My friends ordered simpler crepes such as Le Parisien, baked ham with jam and too much, overpowering, Herbes de Provence. 

The sweet crepes were pretty nice. The crepe sampler was a cute idea but it was more whipped cream and fruit than it was crepe... But the real winner of this Sunday brunch was the Crepe Suzette - shoutouts to Yelp reviewers for pointing this out. This is the real deal!! Very tasty and not too sweet for crepe slathered in orange marmalade. 

All in all, if you want to grab some sweet or savory crepes, there's a spot in town now. Sweet crepes are quite good but savory crepes leave something to be desired. It's a tad pricey for me but it is on par for crepes overall.
I came to this location yesterday. The employees were extremely friendly, and I highly recommend the Beyond Meat Taco. You can't even tell the difference, but it's much better for you.

Best sandwich ever. Super deluxe with extra peppers and oil. Damn I get one for there and one for the road.  Been coming to Tinos since I was a kid. Even though I moved to Los Angeles I still come home often for what many people consider the best sub sandwich ever made. It lives up to the billing time and again and has never let me down. Tino May have passed away and changed locations from de la Guerra but his sandwich legacy lives on!

We came here for a preschool class field trip, and it was a huge hit - for both the parents and kids! Our Play Place is an indoor play room for kids aged 1-8. There are tons of imaginative role playing toys, costumes and play houses. There are ride-on cars, and even a little slide. My 4 year old boys and their classmates were fully engaged the whole time that all the moms got a chance to have some quality chit-chatting time. 

They even had a Spanish language teacher who leads group activities in Spanish to give some valuable language exposure! 

You can also rent out the space for birthday parties as well (I'll probably do that next year!)

Hi Melissa thanks for your response. We did send an email to a Gordon Dinerman a manager at the restaurant and got no response.... yes that is correct
Mark

Waited half an hour for two gyros with only one other couple in the restaurant. Asked for waters twice and never got them, asked for extra cucumber sauce and they tried charging me $1.75?... worst service ever, not coming back!
We came here for drinks and music and were not disappointed. Beer was cheap, music was great, and it was packed enough to be fun, but not overwhelmingly so.

I took my sister and my mom FASTMED URGENT CARE twice, I am completely dissatisfied with the quality of care given to my family. They completely missed my sister's  pneumonia.   The Doctor listened to her breathing (lungs) for a total of .5 seconds.  I told him she was predisposed to pneumonia!  She ended up in the emergency room and hospitalized for 5 days (malpractice?).  I mean how do you miss such an easy diagnosis!  When I took my mom for not being able to hear out of one ear, she left not being able to hear out of either!  QUACKS!  NOT ONLY WOULD I NOT RECOMMEND FASTMED URGENT CARE TO ANYONE, I WOULDNT WISH THEM ON MY WORST ENEMY.

Visited twice while we were in town. Excellent food and service both times from Ms. Niki. I had the Crab cake sliders and the crabby Benny for breakfast with mashed hash. Also the Club sandwich looked delicious. Very impressed at how clean and orderly this establishment was. Great job and we will be back.

I contemplated joining the YMCA for a few months, but since my family isn't large and I'd have to pay the family rate to get child care I decided to check out LA Fitness. I originally was brought in because my health insurance covered this location at a reduced rate.  They were running a special for abbreviated hours during weekdays for only $24/mo that was better than what my insurance would cover.   The hours are morning until early afternoon before they get the night crowd. This is perfect for my schedule, since I was looking to go in the mornings.  Child care is only $7 a month and they were running a special on only a $50 initial fee, so I decided to give it a go! 

This is the first time I've left my son for any sort of childcare outside of the daycare he attended from 4-11 months. He's 2.5 now and very attached. I thought this would be a good medium to give me an hour or so of time and him to practice separation time. The first few weeks he didn't like it and cried the whole time. The staff tried hard to make him happy. I even saw a staff member hold him the entire time to try and get him to calm down. 

Miss. Kay was great and found a way for him to start enjoying his time. She also had a few suggestions to help the transition- coming more than once a week for example. After three weeks of him crying before we even left our home, I canceled my membership. It was just too heartbreaking to leave him but after a week I decided we should continue to try and go because maybe he would get better (you prepay per month, so we had a few weeks left on the membership after canceling). Within a few weeks he was tolerating it and not crying. The membership staff let me reactivate my account and now we go weekly and he enjoys his time in the kids klub. I'm so glad I kept going. Especially since baby number two is on the way, and I need a way to workout in this Florida heat! Also worth noting is my son has not been sick from attending the kids klub, which is one thing I dreaded.  It is always clean and well organized.

A few areas in the gym that could be better include, the water in the women's bathroom is always hot. There is no cold setting, which is not refreshing to wash your hands in after working out and could potentially deter gym members from washing their hands (eew). The kids klub has been unusually warm on a number of occasions. It's generally fixed by the next time I visit, but it's odd that it occurs so frequently. I also don't love the foam dispensers and paper towels for wiping down equipment, but I'm assuming this is a nation-wide LA fitness policy. I've also noticed staff walk around with spray bottles and extensively clean the equipment, so that's a good backup.  Overall the gym has been a great experience.

The place looks nice but as we waited for the store to open our kids were playing outside and an employee rudely told us we would need to get out of the way because she was setting up outside.  There are nicer ways to treat someone. If you treat potential customers this way, we won't be back...which is a shame. Please share with your employees that kindness and courtesy go a long way.

Brian Burger (our sales associate) was welcoming, kind and quick to answer all of our questions from the moment we came in the door. He helped us to pick the perfect Honda Pilot for us and helped us to get the best deal possible with Sandy Ware's help. Brian knew that time was an issue when we came in to sign paperwork two days later, and he and Ed Lage worked in unison to expedite the vehicle training and the paper signing in record time for my boyfriend to be out the door with time to spare to take an important business call he was expecting. We were both highly impressed and satisfied by Brian, Sandy and Ed's professionalism, warmth and prompt attention to details to expedite our transaction. This is my second purchase with Penske Honda and I can honestly say it's been the best experience in dealing with purchasing a vehicle I've had in my lifetime. Thank you to Brian and his team that supported us for the purchase!

One of my favorites in Reno by far! Loved the dark, old world ambiance right when we walked in the door. Facility has a restaurant side and bar side, good for whatever mood you're feeling. Aside from the good beer and cocktail selection, the food was the main draw of Brasserie Saint James. If you're looking for something a little different than the typical craft brewery, definitely recommend stopping by for the more atypical cuisine and awesome drinks.

Thank you to Nick, Anthony and the rest of their team.  We had a going away luncheon for work and they were so accommodating.  (Our group was well over 35 people). To boot, the pizza was amazing!  Would highly recommend this place to those looking for a great meal and awesome customer service!!

Went for the first time today with a friend because we loved the place that was here before. Tried a little bit of everything. Was not a fan. The waitress was super nice and kept our table clear and drinks full. The restaurant appeared to be clean and well kept, but it was the food. There was such a wide selection, but I didn't like any of it. The orange chicken and another type of chicken was so over cooked I couldn't chew it. It was like chicken jerky. Other types of chicken were low quality meats. The only thing I enjoyed was their chicken nuggets. Tasted just like McDonald's, but I could have spent $2 at McDonald's for them rather than what I paid for the buffet. The food overall was very low quality. The fruit wasn't ripe. We won't be returning and I don't recommend it.

Extremely rude employee working the night of 8/2/2017.  When we asked how much a particular cigar cost he said "did I f**cking say I had that."  Put prices that people can read! We walked out without buying anything.

Jesus is the man I worked with a Peformance Pit Shop... first let me say his customer service is outstanding. I've been getting my windows tinted every two years due to a new company year that often. I've NEVER had someone explain window tinting as throughly as he did. 
As a lady in a car shop, I never felt like I was being spoken down to or my opinions being ignored. I even referred my sister before my car was even finished. 
I was told it would take about 3 hours.... 1 hour and 1/2 later my car was done it!! 
They made my car look exactly like I wanted it to look, AMAZING!
Dang, Ruby's had been our go to burrito restaurant but we've had inconsistent quality and service lately (over the past 6 months). Gonna have to settle on a new 'go to'.

We were there on a Saturday night (late - which meant Sunday morning)...service was fine, however, two of us got really sick from the food.  I had a steak quesadilla and my friend had the chicken quesadilla.  I have eaten MANY of these at MANY different locations and I have never gotten sick.  However, my friend and I both were...to put it lightly...going to the bathroom over and over and over...we had queasy stomachs and 'lost a lot of water' over the course of the next 12 hours.  I don't think this was a typical "Taco Bell reaction".  I think we got some form of food poisoning.  Someone maybe didn't cook something all the way or something was left out too long.  I don't know.  I WOULD AVOID THIS LOCATION.

Went today and had the best experience ever in a Bath and Body Works store. The employees and store manager went above and beyond my expectations and were amazing all around. I wish this was the closest Bath and Body Works store to me, because not only was it stocked super well unlike the one much nearer to me, but all of  the staff were the kindest and most patient, I have ever experienced no one of these stores. Kudos to all of you and thank you again.

Legit amazing! Husband and I shared 3 empanadas and made 1 a meal so we could try the fries. We got the saltena, chicken tinga and el puerco and they were all amazing. The fries are I think the best I have ever had, we almost got more even though we were so full! We cannot wait for the Meridian location to open up. We will be going to much more for sure! The customer service was wonderful as well and very reasonably priced.

We got in, three of  us, took my Dad for his first pedicure, he's 76 and they took really good care of him.
The salon is nice, clean and the chairs worked well.

Had a very familiar experience as Juiliana however we went to purchase a puppy collar and toys for the puppy while our application was being processed with assurance from staff that there was not a reason why we wouldn't get him.  Came back within 30 minutes. Staff was rude.  And they had adopted the same puppy to someone else while we were gone.  We where not notified of this until after we gave the puppy toys and a collar. Will never go back and simply would not reccommend.

I love Peaches Skin Care!  I went for 6 facials/microderm with Taylor and she is just wonderful.  She spent about an hour doing extractions, microderm, hand and neck massage, pampering my skin, etc. and every time my face felt so wonderful afterwards.  She has also told me a couple tricks that have vastly improved my skin.  I am moving to Chicago and don't know what I am going to do without her!  She doesn't push products on you but can tell you what products would work well for you and give recommendations if necessary.  I have several items from their product line and am relieved to find that I can still purchase those products via paypal after I run out.  I highly recommend getting a facial at Peaches Skin Care....

I was a bridesmaid in my girlfriend's wedding, and my dress looked AMAZING thanks to these guys. They were so friendly, fast, and even threw in a complimentary steaming. Will definitely be returning for future alterations.

So yet another yelp recommendation for the win! It's our last night in AZ and my mom was wanting prime rib. We searched the all mighty yelp and found this amazing place. First note: it was pretty crowded for a Tuesday night- I'd recommend calling ahead for reservations. We waited about 15 minutes for a table, but our waiter was quick to arrive and ask us if we wanted to order drinks. The service was spot on. The atmosphere is lovely and very upscale. Our drinks were always full. Everything we ordered was amazing. I'm not a steak person, in general and I thought it was cooked perfectly and tasted great. We mentioned my moms birthday and they brought her a tasty desert. If you're looking to splurge and don't mind spending a bit, you definitely won't be disappointed.

They came like ninjas in the night and delivered a nice surprise for my 16-year-old.

In true Lecia fashion, I waited until the last minute to plan out the details of my son's birthday in March. I left a message for the company on a Friday morning, and they contacted me back within a couple of hours. I ordered a sign on Friday to be delivered Sunday night for a Monday morning surprise!

I was very pleased with the sign, and more importantly, my son was so surprised and loved it!

If I had a "negative", it would be that they came earlier in the evening than I had thought (it was around 8pm). Luckily, I saw them when they came, so I frantically ran through the house closing curtains as I wanted to maintain the surprise for in the morning before school. Really, that wasn't that big of a deal though.

I highly recommend this company and will use them again when my daughter turns 16 next year! Very prompt and professional.

Man, it doesn't get any better than Simple Ice Cream Sandwiches.  We have been to Junkie numerous times and never realized this place was RIGHT NEXT DOOR!!  But now that we have found it we stop by every trip to Reno.  I don't care if there is snow on the ground and it's 32 degrees below zero, I'm getting me some Simple Ice Cream Sandwiches.  

The donuts are outstanding and the ice cream is very tasty.

This is a good Italian restaurant chain when it comes to fettuccine, whether you order it plain or with chicken. Sauce is just right; not salty ... it's flavorful and creamy.   Mostly, I get take out from here.  Rarely do I sit down and eat.   

I will recommend that you do not try the pizza. It's horrible. I have tasted $ 1.25 Tortino's pizza that tasted better.. Stick with the pastas!!!

I had a great experience! I was able to just walk in and get my hair cut and colored. Jessie did a very thorough job with excellence. He also took the time to educate me about better practices when washing, curling, or blow drying my hair. He had a lot of knowledge on it all. I highly recommend him. I have dark hair and it's very hard to get high lights in jt. Not only was he able to put highlights but he also made it blend very well. I will definitely be using him in the future.

I came here for a big group dinner and they did a fairly good job accommodating all 9 of us. It's fun that you can pick out beer and wine in the fridge and then bring it to your table but it's not the best deal. I ordered the lobster ravioli and I was super disappointed to find out there was no detectable ravioli in my dish. I'm sure there was some small trace amounts somewhere in there, but to me it simply tasted like a normal ravioli stuffed with ricotta. One of my friends got the fried chicken and was sad to discover that it was mostly breading. The hummus plate was alright nothing special. The cheese and charcuterie plate was fairly good although very small amounts of cheese (think maybe 2-3 pieces of cheese for 3 types of cheese). The duck prosciutto was really good though. As for other dishes, one of my friends got the squash risotto and that was really tasty. Everything else at the table seemed to be average. Overall it was a fun place and good for a big group but the food was nothing special.

My husband and I recently had dinner at Verbena, and it was excellent. We shared the roasted beets as a first course; he had the ribeye, and I had the trout with pork belly. The ribeye was cooked perfectly to the temperature that my husband requested, while the trout and the pork belly were both absolutely succulent. We also shared the baklava for dessert. 

I understand that the menu changes fairly regularly depending on the season and availability of ingredients, etc., so I'm not sure the usefulness of reviewing particular menu dishes. However, I can say that we savored every bite and were very pleased with our choices. The service was attentive, and the hostess, who is the chef's mom, was very personable. It's BYOB, so we brought our own wine. Overall, we had a lovely experience.

This is my new favorite find! The portions are large and the flavor is off the chain. 

We ordered the tamales for appetizers - YUM! Comes with two and is perfect for your starter.

For dinner, we got one order of the chicken tacos and another of the goat tacos. Both were excellent and so different in flavors. Each had their own tray of 3 toppings that match with the meat flavor - amazing pairings! We loved them both (but the goat was my favorite!!)

We will definitely be back for more!

for the price this place is a steal! it's conveniently located one block fr bourbon and the staff was super friendly. it's nothing fancy (it's the holiday inn, duh!) but it's clean and quiet.  i'd definitely stay here again!

Great coffee spot, not far from Esplanade. Discovered while staying with a friend that lives on Gentilly and made the walk over. Coffee is a little pricey, but it's also fair trade coffee so worth it. I got a Cortado with Oatmilk. Ordered my boyfriend an Espresso Spritz. Both were delicious! I didn't order food, but glanced at the menu and it is very vegan friendly. 
All takeaway is compostable,  they also don't serve any dairy or almond milks to reduce carbon footprint. Will deffo visit again while I'm in town

Best wash n' detail in town, IMO. I'll start by saying the "money machine" gate is a bit annoying. I've pulled up before another car, and then have been passed up out of the gates because my bills were wrinkled and kept being spit back. Once you get through, it's a nice experience. The hand wash is very gentle, but more thorough than any machine wash I've had. Exterior always comes out perfect - even the tough spots often overlooked by other washes.

What really sets Wash N' Go apart is the interior service. While most car washes do the vacuum first and finish in the lot, almost as an afterthought, Wash N' Go has individual stations that you park your car at, and everything is done after the wash. They spend a good amount of time pampering your car; the interior clean is almost like a mini-detail and looks fantastic every time.

I have had full details done here a couple of times, with equally satisfying results. Easy to schedule appointments and my car came out shiny and immaculate. People here work hard, do a great job and really seem to care!
almost most chase bank , go in there to see rep. n it alway so long , at least 45min - 1hr , not sure why.

Sometimes I crave shitty Mexican food. Other times I want something more authentic than the "order by number" experience. For times like those I need to find real places that serve real Mexican food.  Typically, the best of those places are in slightly sketchy areas and this place is no different.   

FYI - my go-by for authentic Mexican food is the torta. Typically it is made with warm, fresh teleras bread that's toasted on the flattop before being stuffed full of the protein or proteins of your choice and fresh vegetables. 

I found this place on a bitterly cold day and stumbled in for an early lunch, yep - I ordered a torta.  I selected their Chicken Milanese principally because I have never had that one before and I like fried chicken.  They pounded a piece of breast meat to about a 3/8" thick before breading it and deep frying to golden perfection.  The reason I say "they pounded" instead of "someone pulled it out of the freezer" is that it wasn't an exactly uniform thickness like you get when you buy a commercially-produced chunk of chicken.  I asked for avocado on the sandwich as well and they put about an entire avocado into my meal.  Fresh lettuce, tomato slices, a shmear of both mayo and refried beans plus a little bit of onion completed the sandwich.  It was substantial, piping hot and delicious!

Absolutely delicious!!!! The staff is incredibly friendly and even though the place is cramped, it feels like home. I'm somewhat of a germaphobe but it all disappears once I'm in here. It's chaotic: Oil splashing everywhere, piles and piles of bacon sliding all over the griddle, waffle alarm going off. If you pay attention, they really skimp everywhere they can. The napkins are very basic, no real silverware, your sausage and bacon drip dries on the flimsiest napkins. But I don't care because the food is THAT good. Most of the people are take out regulars and that's what I did too. There's a dingy TV in the corner but I found watching the staff to be entertainment enough.

Of course I got the fried chicken and waffles! Cinnamon, sugar, side of bacon. May the chicken and waffles never change because it was delicious. I had to wait a while since it was made fresh and then I had a 15 minute walk home. Waffle was basic but perfect with hot sauce and syrup. Chicken was crispy on the outside (even after the walk!) and very juicy on the inside. A little salty on the seasoning but nothing syrup and hot sauce can't fix.

Side of bacon was perfectly crisp. They really know how to do their bacon insanely crispy here. It gets kind of thin and hard so if you like it on the meatier side, specify that! 

Sometimes the language barrier seemed to annoy some customers. It's VERY slight and I found the customers to be plain rude for no reason but the workers let it roll off them. BE KIND AND PATIENT!!! The food and service is worth it!

Let me start off by saying that i NEVER write reviews (i know that's terrible!) unlike my husband who is the king of Yelp (or should i say Duke?) And yet Yelp is the first place I go when searching for a new local place to eat or get my nails done. So the fact that I am sitting down to write this with a newly mobile nap hating baby says something in itself. (heres to the first of many reviews) I love Dr Ben from his great chiropractic care to his patience with all of his patients big and small (my baby loves him too.) I have seen him through injuries, pregnancy and postpartum, and for mobility work with exercising. He never pushes you to come see him and would honestly rather you stay healthy and pain free. Here are just a few of the reasons I love Dr Ben.

1. SI /Lower Back Injury: I had seen several chiropractors before Dr Ben for a serious lower back injury that caused me to have pain while sitting and moving for the past 6 months! I honestly wasn't sure I would ever be back to normal again. A friend recommended Dr B to me and I was desperate and figured trying another chiro wouldn't hurt. I have never  since looked back. He had me moving and finally sitting without pain within a few weeks. I am not saying that all injuries will have this turnaround but I am saying that he knows what he is doing and how to lightly adjust you and give you rehab exercises to do at home so that you will not have to see him as often. I am so thankful to him for helping me to function again. 

2. ART (active release therapy): If you have never had this treatment done before think of it as a deep tissue massage with mobility work. I had previously seen another chiropractor for this treatment and he would have me near tears every single time but I kept at it thinking that it must be doing something and yet I never really saw any improvement after seeing him 3 times a week for several weeks. I have since seen Dr Ben for lower back, foot, calf muscle, and shoulder ART and have never once been tempted to cry. As a crossfitter this has been great for overhead work on my shoulder. After just a couple treatments, or sometimes even 1, I feel more mobile and experience less pain. 


3. Pregnancy/Postpartum : I saw Dr Ben consistently throughout my pregnancy and had such an easy pain free pregnancy (minus the nausea, even Dr B cant cure that) and that is not an exaggeration. I was able to workout through 39 weeks and honestly felt better during pregnancy than I did coming back to workout postpartum. He was also  gentle and knowledgable when i came back to see him 10 days post csection. 

4. Babies and Kids: I brought my son to see him right after he was first born and would highly recommend it after any delivery but especially c section. Dr B was super gentle and patient and still is when this first time mom comes to him with concerns after her baby has taken a minor fall. 

Well that was a LOOONG review, maybe that is why I never write them? ;) All that to say if you are in need of a chiropractor or simply curious about what chiropractic care can do for you check out Dr Ben I know you wont be disappointed.
The water pressure was horrible. The hotel was clean but it wasn't thoroughly clean. The breakfast was okay but there wasn't much fruit selection. Hotel need better signage to locate.

I have been to NOLA many times and always went for my coffee down in Jackson Square. 

But this year, I found this place and wow! 

The food and coffee are amazing! NO huge line to wait for service. They come to your table to check on you and make sure you have all you need! It's very clean here and you don't have people asking for money at every turn! 

You will love it here!!!

I have been using Kate Weeks of KC's lawncare of Tucson,Az for going on two years now at my rental property. She is so reliable usually coming by the day after I phone. She even
sent photos of the lawn since at one point I was out of state. She does such nice work, the neighbors began using her too. She does an impeccable job in all aspects of
maintaining my desert landscape and many courtyards and fountain clean ups. I would recommend Kate with no hesitation. The best part is her prices are so reasonable
and she doesn't mind my small needs either. She doesn't push a monthly or recurring service, she just is ready to help for whatever my needs are. It's great to have someone that always returns phone calls and that needs no reminding, if she says she will be out there she will.  Very easy to work with! five stars as far as I'm concerned.
