This place is phenomenal!! The food was amazing and the huevos rancheros was spectacular!! Great sabor!! The churro French toast is out of this world!  The other dishes were equally great and the service and decor it make it a great experience.  You won't be disappointed!!

Love this place!!!  Anything fried or boiled is delicious and always fresh.  Daily lunch buffet is a great deal with plenty of good food to choose from and keeps coming out fresh and hot on the specials. Muffulettas are the best in New Orlearns

(to the tune of "Best Song Ever" by One Direction)

Maybe it's that extra crunch (wow!)
Biting into that big drumstick
That drizzle of the sweetest honey (WOW)
Eat so much, I thought I'd feel sick...

I said "Can I eat this every day?!"
They said "Just think of how much you'd weigh!"

But we both dug in, It had the best crunch ever
This fried chicken rocks, and I won't forget it
My mouth misses it, it'll always remember
Because these chicken chunks had the best crunch ever!

Oooh this is a tough one. I think the price is right, the food is delicious, and the location is convenient (really close to the Fillmore, to the Piazza, to all sorts of fun Fishtown bars) when you've gotta fuel up for a night. Unfortunately, the spot doesn't have much in the way of seating, so if you come while they're busy, you might have to wait (or take it out). Speaking of which, we saw SO many take-out orders while we were waiting/eating, so that must be a popular move. You might wait a while regardless, but that's just because they're cooking each piece to order (so think to call ahead!)

I love this food, I love the biscuits, and the staff is so friendly. If they'd get some more seating (tough in the space, so maybe we'll see them grow someday) this would be five stars!

Stumbled upon this sweet little cafe while out on a Saturday running errands.  The food was delicious and service was wonderful.  I had the Ham, Cheddar Pepper Quiche with side salad dressed lightly with a lemon vinaigrette and my husband had the daily special - a melt with cheddar cheese and jalapeño jam and potato soup.  Everything was delicious!

Friday night 10/22/21, wanted to go to eat at at Restaurant that has Good reviews for dinner. We get to the restaurant & realize that We have been here before & the Food is Excellent! The Restaurant is packed,  We made a reservation, we only waited 5 minutes. They eat us,there were 4 people in our party for dinner.We all Ordered Fish Dishes, Everything was excellent, we even had dessert. This is Definitely a Restaurant that you want to go to when visiting the St.Petersburgh area. You won't be Disappointed at all. We will definitely be back, again!
Helped me in solving my issue. I was assisted in setting up my new schedule of payments. Fast, friendly and overall a wonderful experience.

I have been wanting to go here for a while and finally my husband and I decided to go and so glad we did. First off the service is amazing. We felt so welcomed and love the intimate feel. We started with the oysters (blue points and another I forget) both were very good and super clean and fresh. For our entrees I ordered the special lamb with the brussel sprout au gratin that was very good and loved the flavor of the lamb. My husband had the ahi tuna which was also very good just a little on the medium side and he ordered medium rare but again flavor was great. The chef let us sample his homemade marinara and one of the best I've ever had. I can't wait to come for lunch for the meatball sub or try the lasagna the marinara was that good. Everything was super fresh and homemade. We will definitely be back on a regularly basis.
Tasty food, speedy service, and plenty of options for toppings and sauces. Love the specialty drinks available along with your basic soft drinks. Check them out!

Their customer service sucks! I called looking for tires for my motorcycle and was told "I'm sorry but we don't work on your bike, we only work on Harley's. Now if you get a "REAL" bike then we will do business". 
Seriously what kind of crappy reply is that, I was just looking for tires, what does it matter if it's a crappy Harley, Honda or Yamaha. Now as far as repairs go, yes I could understand them only servicing Harley's or Harley customs in that respect. And I'm sure they probably do exceptional service and repairs. But they've definitely lost someone that could have and most likely would have been a long time customer!

Let the buyer (or kennel boarder) beware.....

My fiance and I had high expectations for Molly's Country Kennels after attending an open house and perusing their website. However, based on a recent experience, I find them to be more interested in making money than in providing good customer service. 

Specifically, I prepaid $90.00 to have our dog Angel evaluated for 3 days ($30.00 a day) so she could qualify for their daycare service (and if you don't use the service at least once in 30 days, you have to pay $90.00 all over again). However, a bout of doggie parasites prevented Angel from being evaluated at her scheduled time, so we called to cancel and were told we could just reschedule once Angel was well again. No mention was made of a cancellation policy or fee. 

Upon further thought, we finally decided to use an in-house pet sitting service in the future rather than a boarding kennel. So naturally, I called the kennel to get my $90.00 refunded--a simple and reasonable request, I thought. 

To make a long story short, I've been jumping through hoops to get my $90.00 back because they keep telling us this deposit is non-refundable. Yet they have no written policy anywhere on their website to this effect, and they said nothing about this supposed policy to us when we initially paid or (as mentioned earlier) when we called to cancel the first time. 

The bottom line is that in our dealings with Molly's, we've gotten the very clear sense that this is about business (and money) over everything else, including the needs of potential customers. For that reason, I strongly recommend that you use another kennel if you must board your fur baby!

Adam + Spectacular Food & Cocktails + Justin Timberlake = The Best Birthday 

My kids and friends joined me at The Supper Club to celebrate my birthday. Our waiter was Adam. It would be hard to have a bad time with a waiter that is this much fun.  He was quick to explain the service style, which was that the restaurant takes complete orders up front, so that the kitchen can prepare everything from scratch and deliver the courses it appropriately, leaving the customer to sit back and enjoy the experience, worry-free. I love this style. No need to even think about what comes next.  Adam was very willing to share his opinions and guide us on his favorite menu items and he generously steered us in directions we did not realize existed. For example, the bread selection. Never forget the bread selection!  Also, the Italian wine selection!  We usually keep to our safe choice which is California wines, but Adam appropriately suggested Italian wines.  It was life changing and what a treat  to have the flavors described, as we sipped. Who knew wine had so many berry flavors?  

We were going to get the scalloped potatoes, however, Adam rerouted us to the mashed potatoes.  He was indeed correct.  Joley, Adam's spectacular assistant was there with affirmations to his amazing suggestions. Such a cool team these two. I was not, and am still not, a fan of Unisex bathrooms. Especially in the south! I am a Southern Belle, after all!  So, this is where it turns interesting.  After voicing my concerns to Adam, regarding the situation, he unexpectedly offered to personally escort myself and my girls to the bathroom,  as well as wait on us, while we were in there, and escort us back to our table.  What a true gentlemen, and a classic example of Southern Hospitality.  Chivalry is not dead!   To top an already amazing night off...as we were waiting in line, none other than Justin Timberlake walked by, in a Top Hat, no less.  Adam was made my night by introducing me to him, while making sure to mention it was my birthday, which won me a big Justin Timberlake birthday hug...a memory  that will last a lifetime.  On a side note: he is much smaller in person than I expected. Still super sexy, however. :) 

The Supper Club is without a doubt right up there with the some of the most spectacular dining experiences I've ever had.  However, good food is nothing, without an amazing staff to guide you in your experience, and I feel lucky my guides were Adam & Joley.  The total bill was well over a thousand dollars for the seven of us, before tip.  Was it worth it? Absolutely!
Money comes and goes! Memories like this last a Lifetime!

This is a great record shop nestled in Collegeville!  Adam is a great guy with an awesome selection of vinyl to choose from.  He stocks both used and new.  Excellent prices and is a flat out nice guy!

We stayed in king size room with a little courtyard at a great price considering the beach is within 5 min walk of the inn. The staff is great and super friendly!! Would stay here over and over again!! I'm sure that other people would say this hotel needs to be upgraded but it serves for exactly what u need!! You made our stay a wonderful time!! Thank u

Thank you Sierra Septic Service !! 
Cindy for your friendly and fast service, she was upfront with the information with both concern for my situation and her team (Distance and heat)
Russel came out, even got here ahead of scheduled time, friendly and helpful!! can't say enough on the service, he was more than willing to help us with finding the tanks and the troubles.
reality is you hope you don't have this kind of situation often, but nice to know a company out there with the team to take care of us.
would recommend them to anyone asking!

We returned here to celebrate a great weekend which began with our wedding. Anyway, My husband and I found this place walking through west Chester one evening. We have found that is the best way to try new restaurants and as I am a picky eater it's hard for me to like "new" places. We were extremely pleased about the menu size, so many options! Then the food came...My husband got the sashimi deluxe, wow what a presentation! He loved every bite of it and even ordered (and ate) more. I got the hibachi chicken and it was delicious!!! Today, we went back again, traveling a distance to do so. He ordered the deluxe again but this time got "the pink lady" roll and he was in love! I, again, ordered the hibachi chicken but also the hot and spicy chicken. The hot and spicy chicken had a light smoky flavor and was amazing. We met the owner today, Ming and he could not have been more friendly or accommodating. Needless to say this place has amazing food, great pricing and will never disappoint. Highly recommended!

I really enjoyed La Cocina, the courtyard was a gem! So there were a lot of complaints about slow service in previous posts. I can't comment on that because we showed up at 9:10 pm and took about 10 minutes to order. Keep in mind they close @ 10pm.

What I can tell you is that our order was out in about 12 minutes and had great service. We were not rushed and our waiter was attentive.  Ordered the chicken street tacos and taco salad. The tacos were good; however, the chicken was a little dry. You really couldn't taste it with all of the other ingredients but when sampled solo it was meh.

 They had a person singing and playing acoustic guitar on the mini stage. Sat next to the pond and really enjoyed my dinner experience. Would definately like to go back for drinks, to relax, and listen to live music.
Very fresh food, clearly made quickly and lovingly. Unique combination of healthy ingredients so it's actually tasty. Very big fan.
Very nice ambiance for your Japanese/ Korean dinner.  They allow you to BYOB and reserve a seat for this place.  The staff are friendly.

First time trying Nook and will definitely be back! The blueberry scones were perfect, the Hawaiian mimosa was well done, and the avocado toast had nicely balanced flavors. Compliments to the chef! 

I recommend you ask for a steak knife if you select the avocado toast, and I will caution you against sitting outside because of the massive amount of FLIES!

Great place for a quick breakfast or lunch! The breakfast bagel with turkey on an everything bagel was very good, especially for the price. This was my first time here, and it was pretty busy on a Sunday morning around 9AM. If short on time in the future, I think I will make use of ordering online ahead of time to pick up!

Someone ended up bringing us a staff meal from Zaika. We all received a three pack container of butter chicken, rice, and a chickpea dish with garlic naan. Everything was unbelievable how good it was. I can't wait to dine in at this bistro. We were

Ice cream was fabulous.  So many flavors.  My husband had to have sugar free ice cream and they offered over 5 different flavors of sugar free.  We have never seen that!  There is something for everyone.  Line was long, but moved quickly
Loved the food on a lazy Saturday. Great atmosphere and even better staff. Introduced an out-of-towner to awesome local brews. They also have a killer bourbon selection

This was my partners and I first time outdoor dining (we have only been doing takeout) since COVID and it did not disappoint. Everything was nicely spread out and the servers were great. We had the happy hour drinks, whipped ricotta (it's as good as everyone says), squid ink pasta, and budino. The food was so tasty! I definitely recommend and want to come back soon.

Visited this Kmart today. Aisles were very well-stocked and cashier was fine. Not overly friendly but not rude either. The store was a ghost-town. There were only probably 5 people in there. Which I kind of liked. However, the aisles are very narrow. I felt like I kept bumping into stuff in here. They also only had one check-out line open. Which to me seems odd.  All in all, it's an ok store. Pretty obvious it is on its last legs.

Nestled in John's Pass Village in Madeira Beach is a fun brewery that also serves up some unique and delicious food! Always a ton of beer and cider choices on tap and come on... They have a bus inside that they use as their pickup station for the food, how fun is that with all the cool artwork to look at and games to play? They had these delicious ranch deviled eggs on their menu as an app when we were there previously and I was sooooo disappointed when I recently went again that they weren't an option. I was craving them! And when you are done grabbing some food and having a beer, you can go support all the local businesses at John's Pass too!

Not much to say.
Yes the Sandwiches are pretty much the best around.
But the service was very slow.
I waited 20 minutes + for 3 Amighetti specials. 
Bummed that The Hill location is closed.

Presta is a local favorite of mine. They have two locations in town and their one on 1st Ave is a hidden gem. If you drive too fast by you could miss it, but for blending in once you get up close it's a beautiful shop inside and out serving up great drinks. Love their lattes and they are currently serving up some fun seasonal drinks. Right now they're pick up only because of COVID which is totally understandable, but their interior space is a warm and inviting area to hang out in normally with great music. I'm excited for summer when they have seasonal drinks with Topo Chico again!

The at atmosphere is hip and the food is very good. So why the 3 stars (3.5 if that was an option)... while I loved the cauliflower tacos @ $6 for one little taco it was way over priced. I did come at happy hour and while they have $2 tacos during that the one vegetarian taco they offer was not an option. I bellied up to the bar and while it was nice with TVs playing sports the service was not very good. It's a nice location if your hitting the sports stadiums and I will be back but know it's priced for the tourist market.

I did the Dead Sexy tour which is a combination of a cemetery tour (St Louis #1) and a historical account of prostitution in the French Quarter/Storeyville.   Our guide Karen, is absolutely amazing. Her knowledge of New Orleans history combined her witty sense of humor makes me rank this tour as one of my all time favorites.  The group sizes are smaller which allow for questions and more detailed descriptions of accounts.
I wholeheartedly recommend!

As someone who eats mostly plant-based, it's nice to have vegetarian friendly street tacos to enjoy in Boise on taco tuesday. I enjoy the vegetarian street tacos, either gringa or baja style. The tacos aren't super big, but 2-3 always get the job done for me. 

They have a bogo or some type of deal for their regular street tacos on Tuesday, but I don't think the specialty tacos (which include Baja and Gringa style) apply for this special. 

Employees are all wearing masks, and are attentive to guest needs while they wait for their orders to be complete. The only reason I am not giving 5 stars is because I've had several recent experiences with my orders being slightly mixed up/wrong- but it's no deterrent for me!

Amazing customer service everyone was so helpful especially a young lady named jill she is very fast and friendly!!! Definitely will be coming back here a lot more now!! Thank you for the great service and delicious ice cream!!

It's exactly what is says... Urban. Hipster. Atmosphere was nice, bar was nice. Bartender was pleasant and chatty. Cauliflower appetizer was good, wedge salad was good. Ordered the aged beef with what they call black and blue seared.  $55 for the steak.  It was not aged, it was soft and still bloody.  This would not be considered aged quality.  I feel this place was for me one and done experience. Overpriced for the quality.
Was pleased with my first service visit.  Jake Martens took care of me and was very thorough with all explanations. Would definitely go back and use Jake as my service representatives.
Racist and disgraceful establishment. This is a pitiful excuse for a college. This is a cesspool of racism and hate.
Green machine smoothie gone wrong. This is not a smoothie... I still see pieces of the fruit/veggies they use.. the Apple is not even blended. It's a slice piece of apple. Clearly not mixed at all.

This place doesn't even deserve one star. Absolutely horrendous experience here.  To start off our sales dude was not knowledgeable at all when it came to showing us the car, we had to show him how to do it ( neither of us have ever even owned much less been in a Honda before). We wanted to leave and go to west county to begin with and I really wish we would have. Financing couldn't get ahold of a bank so they sent us home with this car and still couldn't give us answers about it for FOUR DAYS!! We kept trying to return the car they kept telling us to keep it. Finally we get a call from our crap sales men after we had called those FOUR days and no one would give us an answer nor would finance call us back and he tells us it's worked out come up. We get there again shit is not worked out the manager comes out talks to us walks away to see what more he can do and then our salesmen tells us all about how we need to buy the car he's hurting his wife left him he's got a kid to raise, and pointed out he didn't like to wear condoms because it's like wearing a rain coat in the shower along with all this other bs and then the manager comes back we go into finance and they tell us zero down and sign the papers and leave. This was September. Here we are now in December getting threatening emails saying we owe a down payment and the finance guy actually even came to my place of employment! So we email the general manager. You wouldn't even believe I think he's worse than his employees! Called us a liar  about our experience there, completely disregarded any of the questions we've asked him, and ends with " I'm open to how you want to pay". Seriously, go to west county, this place is the worst place I ever been to and that's really hard for me to say considering I seriously thought  royal gate dodge in Columbia was the worst. Ha, this one passed that one up by a landslide.
We go to Coop's every single time we go to NOLA, it's a must. When you walk in, you'll find a bar, expect to have great food. I usually order the fried chicken. Love this place.

I cannot rave about Dr. McGeever enough.  I called their office at 7:30 on a Friday night to see if my animal could urgently be seen for a sonogram.  No other doctor in the area was able to do this at that time of day, not even the emergency clinics.  We arrived 10 minutes prior to closing and we there for 2 hours.  Dr. McGeever took his time to make sure that our dog got the attention he needed so that we would know if we needed to proceed with emergency surgery that night.  He never made us feel rushed or like we were putting him out for staying late on a Friday night.  He was thorough and explanatory.... didn't use medical lingo and was honest with us about how things looked.  If we didn't live far away, we would absolutely use Dr. McGeever for all of our animals.  Very impressed by him and grateful for him!

They were very responsive in terms of getting back to me, but were useless otherwise. Despite my second inquiry being totally different than the first time I contacted them they would not even entertain a discussion to try to understand why I had contacted them again. I was excited after seeing the commercial but would never recommend them to anyone. I was hoping to be treated like a person rather than being discounted over a matter that has changed my life forever. Very, very disappointing.

Recommendation from a friend, and it was just OKAY. 

1.) first we saw a long line, but they quoted us 30 minutes and they checked us in with this nice ipad. The ipad sends you a text that states how long you've waited. It was promising. We were in the front of the line when 30 minutes hit, and we were excited to get seated.

However, that was not the case, no one came to get us/seat us for 30 minutes. We saw many people come out. When someone finally came to call us in at one hour, we saw many empty tables inside!

They said we were supposed to come in when our wait time was up, but no one mentioned that in the first place.

Now to the food:
We both got the fried chicken and a side order with a dessert.

Now, my friend was eating from the bones and was commenting how great her chicken was, as I was eating, i realized I was eating chicken tenders.... But because I was STARVING, I ate it without sending it back. The chicken tenders were really dry. The fries were mediocre. The lemonade did not taste fresh.

When we ordered desserts, they ran out 4 out of the 7 desserts! we ended up with red velvet cheesecake....which was probably the best part of my meal.

Not the best experience, definitely won't be coming back.

I really enjoy honeygrow, the staff is always super pleasant, the touchscreens you order on are fantastic, and the food is always good. The line at lunchtime is LONG so if you can get there before noon, do so. 

Favorite combo = Shrimp, egg white noodles, broccoli, spinach, peppers, fried shallots in the Spicy Garlic sauce (Delicious)

They are a little light on the proteins (I had four TINY shrimp in my stir fry today) however I think the rest of the ingredients are delicious so it never really bothers me. 

I've only had once bad experience in which they made my to-go order with chicken instead of shrimp and I emailed corporate, who immediately sent my emali to the store manager, who immediately got back to me and offered my next stir fry for free. I really appreciate that kind of attention to customer feedback.

All in all, this is a great addition for the to-go Rittenhouse lunch scene.

My food was pretty good.  I got the mahi mahi sandwich but didn't eat the brioche bun, it was just too hard for me.  Fries were good.  My husband ordered the Nashville Hot Chicken and it was tasty but very greasy and messy to eat.  

My main complaint though it is that they put a straw in every glass without asking.  We don't use straws when we can help it and it seemed wasteful. 

Our waitress was super friendly and the building was cool, lacked a little ambiance but that's just my opinion.
I go here all the time and it's great. The employees are very helpful if you ask for help. I really like that the store is open year round. 5 stars.

This DD franchise approximates the mean of all Dunkins.  

Decent Java, but too dependent on the water quality.  Bakery goods sweet and addicting. 

Biggest issue is the location in the Lalor Plaza down at the bottom of Lalor Street, just off Rt. 129.  No problem during the day, but a bit sketchy after dusk.  But, this strip houses one of my secret lunch houses, Perfetto Pizza; so I find myself in this hood at least once a month.  

Big plus - Bilingual staff!

Don't get me wrong uniqlo has a great selection on clothing for mens, women's and kids. But there's just something very off putting, which is the staff more specifically the higher ups. I totally understand customer service is very important, but for them to treat the regular sales associates like they are not human is very disappointing. I've witnessed in the past at uniqlo a MOD was scolding a newer sales associate in front of a customer, because of something they did not or forgot to do/ supposed to do for a customer. I honestly hate that the fact they abuse their title and think they are allowed to treat their coworkers like trash. I will not be coming back here. I'm pretty sure they get many customers everyday but, I can't shop at a store where the high title workers are condescending. They need to re-evaluate their assistant managers.

Horrible hair salon and deceitful. I had a wonderful massage and see a sign when leaving that states "complimentary blow out with a massage". I question it. Girl checking me out says she does it. Complimentary wash and blow out. I say sure. While shampooing I told her great service. Do many take advantage of this free service. She stated it is $35 not free. I said it's complimentary. She said she did not make sign. What? Well what does complimentary mean? She has no idea!! What false advertising. She ripped down the sign and I left with a wet head.  Too many honest places. No massages there anymore. Who does that ?
Corner Bistro is good.  However it can fo with a little more diverse menu.  But what the do serve is good and reasonable.  Staff is friendly

First of all , under new management but to be honest this management is just as bad if even worst , this used to be my favorite Haitian food spot , after this visit I WILL NOT BE GOING BACK , we paid 21 for a large oxtail plate , that only had 4 oxtails in it , the large fired turkey was full of pieces that were mostly fat , seasoning was better so was the stew sauce but now let's talk about the service , I called in my order was given a time of 20 min it took an hr which they kept blaming on a previous customer because she had a very large order which she did but as an establishment being in the food industry especially international not everyday food you have to be prepared for these things rather than tell customers they got behind they kept pointing to the lady and saying well she had a large order so everyone is being pushed back rather than sorry for giving us the wrong time , then we call to get the manager who wasn't there and we were given his personal number we have yet to hear anything back from his ass , WILL NEVER BE GOING BACK UNLESS IM GOING BACK TO GIVE HIM A PIECE OF MY INTERNATIONAL MIND

Last night was soft opening. Joined the club on the spot. Staff is amazing and Angela is the best. If you love cigars and you want to experience world class service and an incredible selection of cigars then Cathedral cigars is the place. Awesome place top service and the best owner in Angela. Highly recommend .....

District Manager please tell me how a manager can leave on Labor day weekend Sunday night one waiter for the whole restaurant for 2 hours we went at 1030 pm super busy only 2 waiter now  staffing was Great attitude and hard workers cooks did  great job food perfect once again second time I'm here. But still No manager. That's wrong of him I saw a lot of people tired of waiting left.

Beautiful flower arrangement, it's really close to what I ordered, but I think it's a little sparse for a Premium price. It looks more like the Standard which is $20 cheaper. You all did a beautiful job, just wish it was fuller, especially since it was a Sympathy arrangement for our best friend who's Mom died from Covid.

Wow! This place is a hidden gem. The service is exceptional & the Sushi not only tastes amazing but the presentation is beautiful! I will definitely be back for more & can't wait to try out the hibachi!

I CANNOT SAY ENOUGH ABOUT THIS PLACE. 
I recently moved to ST Pete and so far this is my favorite sushi place and go to spot... Everything is amazing from the soup, the pad thai, the appetizers, and the sushi!
The sushi is so fresh and always is presented beautifully! 
Every roll is so yummy my favorites are the weezer, japanese bagel roll, and volcano roll! You truly cannot go wrong at this place! The customer service is always great too. All of the employees are so welcoming and friendly! Overall this place has good prices, amazing sushi, and great energy! If you are just visiting or live here this is THE place to go! Thank you Basil Leaf for being the best sushi in St Pete

My fiancee and I ate here because of the high ratings, and because we wanted to see the Delmar Loop neighborhood.

There was a line when we arrived (about 6:30 on the Sunday before Labor Day), which is generally a good sign. When we put in our names to be texted when a table was available, they told us an hour. From past experience with other restaurants, we presumed that meant more like a half-hour. Nope, they meant what they said. As we waited nearby, we noticed that there were a few open tables, mostly because they hadn't been bused yet. I think they may have been able to seat people a bit faster if they'd been faster in busing tables.

As we waited, we also noticed the workers frequently shuttling in bins and trays of meats from the smoker outside next to the restaurant. They were clearly veeeery busy, so we (more or less) understood the wait.

That said, once we were seated, service was fast and friendly. The food was very good and reasonably priced. We both had the sampler platter (I forget the particular name they give it) of two meats and two sides. Based on their reputation, we both picked ribs as one of our meats, and they were very good but not spectacular.

DO NOT USE THIS MORTGAGE COMPANY.  Incompetent group of individuals who love passing blame amongst themselves.  Zero accountability.  Potential buyers for my house who were using Greentree were not qualified.  Greentree took over 2 months to disclose this information! When pressed for info on buyer approval, Greentree repeatedly said they had all necessary info and everything looks good.  Now, 1 week prior to closing, I am told they are not qualified.  Meanwhile I missed out on other potential buyers and am now losing a new home which is being relisted.  Greentree cost me a new home, as well as thousands of dollars in rate extensions due to their incompetence. There are plenty of other options out there, look somewhere else.

I decided to give Roe another chance after 2 years! It's Thursday evening around 8pm. The restaurant is fairly empty. The menu is basically the same. 
Surprisingly the service and timing of food were very good. I ordered the stir fry rice with chicken. Since I just returned from Thailand I feel I have a trained palate on this cuisine. I would have to give this dish an A for presentation and taste. 

Bottom line. Roe is very nice now. I may have to try again on a weekend.

Always a great experience at Des Peres Smiles. Have been a patient of Dr. Niewdach's for several years. Everyone here is so friendly & professional. I especially like the newness of equipment, spotless office, and minimal wait time. I look forward to check-ups every time! Highly recommend!

I am amazed and incredibly grateful for the level of service that I received from David.  He has a very calming way about himself that helps one in a time of grief, sorrow, and confusion feel safe.  David was a great listener and I never once felt as if he was trying to upsell me.  On the contrary, he was extremely accommodating and made himself available 24/7.  Since the service was a bi-lingual service, he made sure that the prayer cards and dove release poem were in both English and Spanish.  He made me feel, as though, I was working with a family member arranging my dads funeral.  
I thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for the beautiful graveside ceremony we were able to give my dad.
This is the sorriest excuse for a parking company that I've ever encountered in my life!

If you work a night job and normally sleep in past 8am you're screwed if you live in this place. They schedule landscaping crews from 8-10am and will have multiple people with the loudest possible leaf blowers and lawn mowers ear f****g you bright and early to ensure you never get proper sleep.

To give some background I just moved 40 min from Pullella's. They have the best wings and the best pizza for the best price hands down and I gladly make the trip there regularly to grab food. 

  Now the other day when I went to grab food there I accidentally locked my keys in my car with my phone in the car. I was completely stranded. Every member of staff there treated me with extreme kindness. Allowed me to use their phones, and offered me drinks and good company. 

They are truly a great business who cares about their customers. Not to mention their food is good enough for me to drive 40 minutes for. Seriously, if you need a go to pizza place this is the one to chose.

Good...not quite great.  We ordered the tasting menu, which wasn't listed, but was chef's choice of foods; so, was difficult to say if we wanted to spend the $ or not given the unknown choices.

Food was on point except for the corn fritters, which had weird earthy, almost old, taste to them; smell was a bit off-putting as well, yet the yogurt sauce covered up some of the missteps in fragrance.  Pasta, steak and chocolate mousse were one of the best.  

Service was relatively fast, with plates picked up, and food delivered continually.  The waiter was "new" and a bit unpolished (to be expected).  He made an awkward comment about being sorry for one of the guests living in the location they did, then jokingly apologized.  This set a tone at the beginning of the meal that persisted till the end.  He also kept coming to us after dishes were served and described by another, asking if someone had described the dish, or said "enjoy," when we had already heard it 20 seconds prior.

Overall a pleasant and worthwhile dining experience, but could use more polish - I'm sure it will be there soon.

Thanks!
I get a pork roll and egg on a Kaiser roll for less than $4. That's what it should cost and that's what it should look like. Quality breakfast sandwiches for great prices.

I agree with previous reviews saying that when ordering takeout, the magic of Hymies is lost. All of the meat sandwiches were great per usual but colder which is expected. The cheese blintzes had an odd aftertaste and were definitely way too cold. All of the fries we ordered were cold and soggy and couldn't really be revived. The side orders were a little messed up as well but we also expected that for an order for 8 people. Overall I would recommend eating in at hymies for the full great experience.

Crispy and stuffed with meat!
The chicken had some onions inside and the beef one has some olives (reminded me of Piccadillo).
The outside flaky with a good crunch in each bite.

Delicioso!! Se los recomiendo!! Everything was very good portions and well done. 

Yuca fries, tamales y todo fue delicioso!!

The guys from MyMovers were great. They moved our four bedroom house from Avon to Brownsburg in a little over six hours if I remember correctly.
You could tell they all got along with each other and talked and made jokes the whole time but this never effected their work. 
We did have a pretty important/expensive piece of furniture damaged but thankfully we were able to make it work. They also forgot to give us some parts to another piece of furniture and accidentally took one of our drills with them - but they brought it back to us the next day when they found it. 

All in all it was a great experience and we would happily use their services again!

A true tradition of Jewish soul food! This bakery has been a true staple for many years. The best of everything in one little store on Castor Ave. fantastic fantastic fantastic - enjoy a true Philadelphia tradition.
Pulled pork was fantastic and full of flavor.  Potato salad was not so good....and the Mac n cheese was decent.  Definitely will go back for the pulled pork!!

Can't say enough positives about Dr Austin! I first went to him for tennis elbow as one last attempt before getting a cortisone shot. Thankfully, he fixed it so I didn't have to go that route. Since then, he has continued to provide the best treatment for my whole family. The office environment is friendly and accommodating.
This is the best burger I have ever had. The service was energetic and alert and picked up and joined in on some friendly banter. Highly recommend. You better be hungry when you come here.

Last night, I stopped here with two friends. We all ordered the same thing, decaf lattes. The place has an industrial-modern vibe, not exactly cozy on a cold winter night. The coffee was fine, with some de rigueur latte artwork on top (a pattern made with the milk on the foam). All in all, nothing to complain about, nothing to write home about.

Brand new restaurant with an incredible menu with a great drink menu also. Service was excellent and the Decor was very modern and clean. I was so happy to find such a great restaurant close to home and with such a reasonable priced menu. I can't wait to return, this is a new favorite for me.

I visited the Reno shop to get an alignment.  After about 30 minutes, I was told by the front desk guy that it needed a camber bolt on the driver's side.  I reminded him that I had told him previously on the phone that I had put one in, but he insisted that it did not have a camber bolt and will need extra 45 dollars for the bolt and 40 dollars to install it. We walked over to the car. I showed him the camber bolt, and he didn't have much to say.  The mechanic admitted the error and went back to work.  

I watched the mechanic finish the alignment.  He did a good job, but was not able to get the steering wheel to line up perfectly.  It was only a little bit off, but he explained that it would not affect tire wear.  I think he is probably correct.  The car drives well. 

I think that it is probably a good place to get an alignment.  They are polite and seem to have an acceptable understanding of their vocation. 
However, as with any auto shop, alignment shops in particular, I would say buyer beware. Do your homework and be prepared to ask questions.

This place should be called Quakertown We Hate Our Customers Market.

The vendors here act as if they are being held prisoner at their own stand and it is you who are the warden. It's true that some show appreciation that you stopped at their stand among the many others and purchased some goods.

I'll be more specific.

To the lady who makes sushi near the pet store: I used to look forward to your sushi until now, because of how you treated me yesterday. You scolded me for eating in after ordering out because you didn't want to waste a plastic bag! Did you forget that I gave you money and that you make a profit with that money? My apologies for inconveniencing you.

Yes, the California roll is only 2.75 and yes each piece is nearly the size of a hockey puck, but want to know the secret ingredient? Misery. And maybe tears added to the sticky rice. The lady who works there needs to throw one of those big blue tarps over her stand with a sign that says "on vacation." Or, if she wishes to continue doing work she hates, she should at least place a sign out front that says, "regular customers only." My guess is, she only favors those who know her by name. Which is ok at say a family reunion, but when it comes to running a business, makes no sense.

I don't like to rant about customer service. But q-mart has brought me to do it. If there's one thing I cannot stand or understand, it's when business owners act irritated when you give them business. 

Ok. Now that I got that off my chest at 4 a.m. you may be wondering why I still give four stars - I'm feeling nostalgic. I've been going to q-mart for longer than I'd like to admit, so when I walk through those doors and under the cold fluorescent lights, and I'm hit in the face with the scent of grease and stale air, I feel like I'm home. It may be home in hell, but it's still comforting.

Plus, the people who work at the Puerto Rican stand are very nice and helpful, and I love their empanadas. 

And I can buy tabloids for a dollar.

And tubes of lipstick for $2.

And there's never a shortage of villainous looking characters lurking in the hidden corridors, making it a fun and exciting experience. It's like a haunted house adventure!

Go to qmart, you'll leave with some stories, but avoid the sushi lady. You might leave with a bad taste.

The pizza was soggy, greasy and salty. Very disappointing. We wanted sausage and mushrooms. He said they didn't have any mushrooms and will put extra sausage on the pizza. Well, the sausage was thinly sliced and not put on the pizza by hand. It was cheap, sliced sausage. There was grease puddles all over it and the sausage actually looked like sliced pepperoni. The cheese was very salty. The crust was soggy. The whole thing was disgusting. Brooklyn Brothers? Don't let the name draw you in. It was more like Brooklyn, Alabama. Don't waste your money.

I have been trying to get to this place for a while based on a few recommendations from Yelpers and friends alike.  So what did I think about the place?? 

My choice for food was really fresh and good. My wife was let down a bit from her previous visit just a week prior.  I must say that from the moment we walked in we were greeted and seated.  (We made reservations about a week ago).  The place was hopping but there was no fuss and no long wait.  (Make sure you get reservations.) 

Our server was Quianna and she was not only very attentive but informative as well.  (Just ask her what the numbers on the silverware means.)   We started off with cornbread.  While it was certainly good it wasn't my favorite kind of cornbread.  That's only because I'm not a fan of actual pieces of corn in the corn bread. 

My wife had the fish and grits.  She complained to me about the texture of the grits.  She felt as though the grits were a little chewy.  She also ate them all and said they were delicious so go figure.  I had the Impossible burger because it is simply superb.  My side of fries were fair.  I prefer less salt but my wife enjoyed them as she snuck bite after bite of my fries.

To top it off we had a doughnut that wasn't really warm.  My wife raved about the warm doughnuts when she ate her last week and it was a bit of a let down for her.   We both took extra desserts home.  I bought a key lime pie and the wife got the bread pudding.  Delicious. 

So while I thoroughly enjoyed my lunch here my wife thought it was a bit of a let down.  I would give it 3.5 stars.  I hope to return again so I can change my rating to a proper solid 4 stars. 

I would recommend you try the place out.  I seriously think my wife just made some food choices that left her wanting.  Maybe next time, as in 2 weeks from now for me.

Update review:  
I changed my review from 2 to 4 stars solely due to the effort Jessica from their corporate office made to make things better. This is uncommon in today's world.  I will try again 

Sat at the bar with my son. I ordered a modela negra beer. Keg kicked halfway through the pour. Instead of saying something she started mixing it with glasses of other beer sitting next to the tap. Crazy enough my son ordered a Stella and exact same thing!!!  So she serves me this concoction of flat swill.  I did not drink beer and she never asked. We both ordered vegan mushroom tacos. Son got his with a large chunk of some kind of flat steak. This to me actually more forgivable than the beer. I add a star because the place is actually kinda cool looking.
I am half Salvadorian so I've eaten a fair share of pupusas. These totally lived up to my expectations. I'd come here frequently if I lived in Indy.

How one pharmacy can be so incompetent is beyond explanation. A script called in by the doctor over two hours ago is still not ready. Show up at the store, wait in line, only to be told they are running behind and it will be another 30 minutes. Get back in line and wait after 30 minutes to be told that it's still not ready. As a younger person it's frustrating for me to have to walk around the store or go sit in my car for 30 minutes and read my book, but for the elderly to be treated this way is in tolerable and should be illegal. CVS pharmacy deserves no stars. And I wish I could say this was my first ugly experience with their pharmacy, but it's a compilation of too many to even count.






As long as you steer clear of the pharmacy, you will do all right. Friendly staff are more than willing to help find products of suggest options. Decent prices and many coupon offers. Store is clean and offers seasonal items. They carry Hallmark products, as well. Parking is easy and numerous handicapped spots are marked.

Good for a kitchen connected to an older bar.  

This is the Popeye (I ams who I ams) spot you either like or dislike.  The food looks great, service was friendly and fast.  

If you're looking for a old (dive bar-ish) with food then you found your spot.  If  you're looking for great tasting burger and the bar is an afterthought then keep it moving.  I can't comment on their other food menu items so I hope people try it out for themselves.   

The burger was just a home grilled patty (panderosa meat), very little flavor, tomato slice gave up before it got to the table, iceberg lettuce (white and less green leaf), pickles where from a jar, and condiments out of small squeeze bottle that may have been around a little too long. 

The patty was placed on a sourdough (a bit odd).  The mayonnaise spread on a toasted slice so of course it turned back into oil and absorbed into the bread .  The tea was not great and probably bought in bulk, Tasted like bitter tea filtered through used barn yard hay.  The plain chip.... a bag of lays.  If they don't have the energy to make a good burger than just take it off the menu and concentrate on some of their other foods.  

Like a lot of places I've found in Reno that have been around a long time...they've given up and just count on their old faithful customers without having to work for a new group.  Similar to the hamburger this place left me wanting something fresh to rinse the stale taste out of my mouth.

This is such a fun little spot to catch live music. I was here a few weeks ago and the drinks were tasty and the music was great.   The band was jazzy and fun!!! Definitely a cool spot to check out!!!!

INSANELY RUDE!!!! Go somewhere else to eat. I stopped for a second to eat in between driving for Lyft. Safety Harbor is a great little urban oasis, that seems tucked away from the hustle and bustle of Tampa and Clearwater, yet is only minutes away by car. Once you turn off of McMullen Booth onto Main Street, or off of 580 onto Philippe Parkway, you'll feel as if you've discovered a secret little spot in Pinellas County.

The little town is nestled at the northern end of Tampa Bay, with a famed spa and resort, a well-used marina and fishing dock, and a fabulous little downtown area filled with charming restaurants, bars, and retail shops. The best way to see Safety Harbor is to park in one of the City lots, or find a place along Main Street, and get out and walk. There's usually a lot of parking near the library and near the resort, and you'll find smaller lots on either side of Main Street.

Almost all of the restaurants and bars are single location, Mom & Pop-type establishments. The food is outstanding, and you could spend several weekends driving over and searching for new places to eat in the area. A lot of restaurants sit inside converted bungalows, so you've got some real charming locations to go with the great food.

Safety Harbor seems to have special events happening every weekend, so you're likely to find a food fair or an arts & crafts festival going on all of the time. If you like running alongside the Bay, or riding a bike along well-marked trails, then Safety Harbor is the place for you. You can usually find groups of boaters, stand-up paddleboarders and kayakers, and fishermen near the town docks. They've recently instituted foodie tours of the city on weekends, which take small groups of people on a walking tour of downtown to sample many of the excellent eateries.

As if that's not enough, you can always cap off your visit to Safety Harbor with a visit to Philippe Park to learn about the native American history of this region, and enjoy some quiet time along the trails. Now, if all of this walking has you worn out, then schedule a stop of the famed Safety Harbor Resort and Spa for a relaxing spa treatment in their healing waters.

Safety Harbor is one of my favorite places to spend a lazy weekend afternoon, and enjoy the charm of this small Southern city

It's really hard to find good pizza in pa HOWEVER at new star pizza they make it just like in nyc!  wings could be fried hard however they made up for it with great pizza and heros!!!!! Thank you... I'll be back again.

My fiancé and I were apprehensive about our first time at this location. Walked in, and there were 3 ladies busting their butts. We had a wonderful time! The food was great, the customer service was even better. First time in my life I've ever had such exceptional service... Until last night. We went to the same location. Their were 3 different ladies (if you could really call them that). One brought her child to work, and that wasn't the issue. The issue was having a shoeless child behind the counter and by the grill. The... Lady operating the grill somehow managed to be rude, burn food in less than 10 minutes, and then proceed to yell at me when she asked how did I want my eggs cooked. Our Lyft ride has come to a stop on a mud puddled side street in front of a stark wood fence.  Happily there is to one side of what appears to be a gate door the painted "N7" we've seen pics of. There  is a single young woman standing there who tells us the gate is locked.  Within a minute though the gate clicks open and we enter.  We choose to sit inside at a table by the remarkably picturesque bar.  In the blink of an eye we are transported to a village cafe in the countryside of France.  The  ambiance is so remarkably cool.

We began with a couple of different Campari based appertifs.  Each very nicely poured.  A+

Next in line is the butternut squash with ginger soup.  This is nothing like what we do at home with butternut squash soup.  It is thin with a lovely ginger enhanced flavor.  Very, very good!  You haveta try this!

We ordered the mussels and the duck confit over risotto with mushrooms. I wasn't paying attention and thought the mussels were an app.

Hence both dishes came out together.  There were enough mussels to feed the entire French Army.  The mussels are done here in a white wine cream sauce and the flavor enhancements in the sauce are heavenly.

The duck confit was was likewise wonderfully prepared.  Silky tender dark meat beneath a melt in your mouth crispy skin. The risotto with mushrooms is the perfect compliment. Creamy risotto and I think a medly of various mushrooms.  

Our server recommended the perfect and very affordable wine to accompany these two disparate dishes.

We both agree that this is one of the most all around enjoyable dining experiences in a good while.  This will be a regular NOLA  destination for us.

Dynasty is THE BEST!! I cannot rate this restaurant highly enough. The people who work here are so kind, the restaurant is beautiful, and the food is exquisite. If you are looking for delicious food and fantastic customer service, then Dynasty is the place to go!!

I love this place, the food is so good. I have had Lobster Bisque and the Lobster Ravioli. All was flavorful and excellent. I have had Lobster Bisque from other places before that wasn't as good as this. I love the thickness of the soup and the sauce used in the ravioli. I haven't tried anything else yet, but plan on trying a couple of other things in the future.

We went for St. Patrick's Day and the place was a disaster.  they didn't have enough bar staff, they had only one server, there was no one seating people and there were actual fights over chairs.  the buffet was OK but certainly not worth $20 and no one was wearing a mask. I will not return here

MOSI was a fun place to spend most of the day. I had been there years ago when they had the huge Hurricane room but now it is small. Lots to see and do if you just want an interesting place to see for the day.,

But this particular location the employees seem to be more interested in having chitchat and conversations with each other and taking care of the customer. Delivered drinks ok, but let our food sit on the counter until everything was cold.  Took almost an hour to make  9 sandwiches.  Bathrooms are disgusting, smelly and filthy.

If you're even considering ordering from here, do it!! Their rolled icecream is always delicious & is delivered with an ice pack so it stays cold. But their boba tea is INCREDIBLE. Best milk tea in Philadelphia. 5 stars every time

I went to Ameristar to eat at the buffet.  It was closed for remodeling. I guess it is a good thing I came because one of the people I work with was taking a large group for lunch next week to the buffet.

We went here by default.  I ordered soup and a salad.  Most of you are aware that when you turn 60 the government sends you a letter that you must eat soup.  So not being a rebel I ate my soup.  The soup I had was chicken noodle.  This is not Cambell's soup.  This is the real deal home made and wonderful.  The chicken was plentiful and really almost a meal in itself.  I asked the manager to make sure it was homemade and he did confirm saying it was made in their man kitchen.  Still don't know what tha means but I guess it was homemade.

This place is a hot commodity so YES pre-Covid if you got there later than 2pm your service may not have been so great. Their brunch events are so lit on the weekends! From the live DJ and atmosphere to the scrumptious food to the fwineeeee ass bartenders who were respectful and as fast as they could be this place is hands down a place I hope won't die post Covid.
We ordered ahead. Our order was ready right when we got there. Delicious bagels! We got a bagel egg sandwich and it was so good! We will be back next time we are in the area.

Top notch skate hub! Cannot go wrong in here. Everything you want and need all in one.

Great workers and customer service. Cooper is the man!

Highly recommended

The name does not deceive here. You will leave this deli with a full belly indeed! These sandwiches are NO JOKE! Select meats, cheeses, and toppings piled high on house made bread of all varieties, are served up on a 12" pizza tin, likely because that's all these belly busting behemoths will fit on! To put it in perspective, that's larger than a personal pie at most places! 

I came on opening day because of all the buzz around about these sammies, and my own personal experiences with their pig pops at Reno Street Food. I was excited to give it a try, and honestly had no idea what to expect. I was really happy to see that the owners had done quite a bit to make the interior more warm and friendly. They have some warm wood hanging on the walls along with framed photos and posters too, and a few TVs. The menu board is hanging above the register, and there are options for just about everyone. As a Florida boy, I was drawn immediately to the Cuban, though naturally I asked the really enthusiastic staff member what she recommended too. My friend and I decided to share the Cuban and the Dirka Dirka. 

The Cuban comes with a mountain of thickly sliced mojo marinated roasted pork loin, ham, swiss, mustard, and pickles, and we ordered it on the house French roll. The Dirka Dirka is corned beef and pastrami, mustard, swiss, all topped with a jalapeno slaw, and we got this one on the house Jalapeno cheddar bread. 

I'm rounding up my experience thanks to the service and the staff here. From the warm welcome, great guidance, and the thank you on the way out, they worked really hard to make sure we had a great experience. 

Breaking it down though, I'd give the service 5 stars. This staff knew the menu really well and made some great recommendations! They were also friendly, fast and really positive. The atmosphere scores 4 stars with me because they really warmed up what was a bleak and very corporate place prior, and the sammies a solid 3.5 because the Cuban was massive but the pork was a little dry, and the Dirka Dirka seemed a little light on the corned beef and pastrami. 

Overall though, that's a 4 star spot in my mind. I'm excited to have this shop, and their interesting offerings, in town!

Had a great time today on a 2.5 hour bus tour of the city. Our hosts were Charlotte and Kesha who were both very knowledgeable and had great senses of humor. It was a rainy day and we were reluctant to go due to the pouring rain but so glad we went ahead. Would recommended this trip!

I lived in Detroit for a few years and one thing I miss is that you could find great local coffee shops all over town. Places that you could grab something in the morning and pump out some work. At the same time, you could grab a beer with friends and catch up in the evening. Indy has had some places pop up like this. However, GoldLeaf Savory & Sweet seems to take the cake. Opening in the middle of a worldwide pandemic cannot be easy. However, I swooped in to grab an iced tea and breakfast burrito. As I waited for the two, I looked around and looked forward to the day that I'd be able to post up in the space, get some work done, and enjoy their food. As for the food... it was great. A very strong breakfast burrito that focuses on freshness and flavor. My tea was amazing as well. Finally, their team was super kind and took all things "let's stop this pandemic" very seriously.

Hidden restaurant behind the Double Tree hotel. It's a little hard to find but worth the hunt! We parked in the Double Tree garage and walked to the back patio.  Perfect views of the sunset and such delicious food and drinks! Shout out to or server, Joyce, who made our first experience AMAZING and remembered everything about our preferences during our 2nd dinner there 5 days later. The chicken I will come back for if I find myself in NOLA again.

There is street parking available.

Brandon Auto mall had the exact car I was looking for so I contacted them via internet/text message and easily set up an appointment for the next morning. I also spoke with the used car manager about what I needed to get for my trade. It was a bit above book value but he asked me to bring it in so he could have a look to earn my business.

When I arrived I was immediately welcomed by my salesman Mike Reed. Mike was very personable and helpful. What are the chances he had just moved to Florida and had previously worked at a Chrysler dealer in Missouri. Therefore, he knew the car inside and out.

Like all car deals, now it came down to numbers. I had already known what I would take for my corvette, as we had previously discussed, and the sales manager was able to meet that amount. I also had a fair offer that I was willing to pay for their car. The process was a no pressure, easy agreement that I am very happy with. What more can you ask for from a used car deal???

I would definitely recommend Brandon Auto Mall and ask for Mike!!!

I sat at the bar and got some gyoza and a nice bowl of ramen which was delicious! The service was attentive and the food came fast and the price (for the area) was reasonable! Would definitely come back.

The location is clean, organized, and the staff is very friendly!  I shopped on the first floor only and was impressed by how nice the location is. 

This is one of the smaller locations I've been to for women's clothes so there wasn't as much to look through but I did leave with a new top and pair of shorts! If I'm in the area again I would definitely stop by for more shopping! 

I also did an online return here and had no issues with the process.

Absolute rip-off. I have bought a keyboard from here that did not work at all right out of the box. I also bought a pa system that does not hold a charge right out of the box. Strange thing about the pa is when i brought it back with the receipt i forgot a component of it so i had to bring it back. But before i left the store with it i set it on the counter to avoid suspicion of theft because i wanted to look around for a wall outlet. Strange thing is when i got home that receipt was gone. Someone took it out of the box. So i went back the next Saturday and they said I had to fill out a lost receipt form and they would call me that week. No return call. The guy told me the previous week he would work with me to get it returned for store credit but didn't. Now all of a sudden every number I call on there website doesn't work anymore.

Unresponsive ! Been trying for over a year for resolution on pool decking.  No one will take responsibility.
Tried calling our Design Consultant - Terry Devine, Noah Ingegneri, President and even the Founder and CEO Kathleen.

CEO came out finally after a year and offered suggestions and said I would have resolution and follow up in a week.  Hasn't happened yet, and I have left 3 messages since the CEO said she would follow up and have yet to hear back.

What happened to customer service and keeping your commitment ?  

Be weary of this company - they are all happy to get your business, but no follow through when something goes wrong.

ONE WORD: HIPSTER

I have known of this spot because it's happening, it's like who doesn't know about this place...

I've been a few times now and here's what I think about the drinks:
- Cubano: My husband swears by this. I think others swear by it to, but for me it's ok. 
- Iced coffee: I typically get this whenever I go to a coffee shop, my regular go-to. I wasn't blown away like I felt I should be. Perhaps it was all the build up like YOU GOTTA GO THERE. again, rating on this is just okay.
- Iced vanilla latte: I think the first time I got this it was just okay also, just mediocre all around, but the latest time I got this it was SO GOOD.
* I think I drank the "milk" or whatever the saying is.

Now I'm basically craving it. C'ya bye!

Great atmosphere and really liked our server. Not many vegetarian entrees but ordered a wild mushrooms risotto that was very good. Four stars because of the lack of veggie entrees but what I ordered was very good.

I agree with the above person stating this doctor's office is the home of Stepford Wives.  While there are some pluses, such as low wait time, access to the patient portal, easily obtainable appointments and ease of contact with the doctors, overall I would not recommend this practice to my friends.

For someone with serious medical issues, it felt very odd and uncomfortable being helped by a doctor in a mini-skirt.  I also can't help but wonder why I got charged such high prices for simple office visits, but one look around the place, helps me understand why.

I was absolutely appalled when I called one day to see how many pain pills I could safely take for my abdomen pain (I have Crohn's Disease), and the doctor proceeded to ask me why she didn't see a script for the narcotic in my chart, and started asking me over and over who wrote the script--subtly accusing me of some sort of drug abuse or criminal activity? (I personally hate narcotics, as I am all too familiar with taking them for extended periods because of the terrible disease I have.) I was extremely upset that she would infer such a thing.

As a last note--I did like Dr. Mazotti--she was spot on with some of my health issues and helped me quite a bit.

Overall, if you are looking for a superficially kind and unsettling environment, go to this office. If you are looking for a real, down-to-earth, understanding physician, I would look elsewhere.
Great chicken sandwiches and fries! Better than Chik Fil A for sure! I highly recommend this place...I wish their location was closer tho.

What an amazing a show! I didn't know what to expect since this was opening weekend of the resident show in St. Petersburg. I had read some good reviews but I wanted to be my own critic. Chris and Ryan are charming, funny and extremely talented..Their story is wonderful and the way that they have landed in St Petersburg through their world famous magic show is wonderful . The theater is not large at all, 4 rows of approximately 30 seats. They were sold out at this performance and I anticipate as word gets around, they will be sold out nightly so I suggest you get your tickets in advance. Another plus to this show is that it's family friendly and multi generational. No bad language or inappropriate content. My children and my mom and I loved this show. After the show they come out to meet and take photos with the audience. What a nice touch to show how approachable they are. There's parking on the street and a couple lots behind the theater on Arlington. There are also restaurants within walking distance if you want to make it a full evening of dinner and a show. They have two options for tickets, general admission or VIP where you get front row two complimentary beverages a complimentary popcorn and a Special Gift. The front row was included in several of the acts. I highly recommend this show, their grasp on magic is fantastic and it will leave you wondering WOW. How did they do that!

Powerhouse Gym is your father's gym, no nonsense, no yoga, no spinning, just working out.  It's open 24/365 and the membership is a bargain.  My main issue is that the upkeep of the treadmills is seriously deficient.  3 of the 5 machines have non working buttons or broken heart rate monitors at any given time.  I literally have to jump on each one until I can find one that works properly. Other than that, a great place to actually exercise and not have to look pretty.
This is definitely a place we would go back to NOLA for!! The food was amazing!! And the service was great too! Worth waiting on the line outside.

Wish I could say we were happy that we chose Sawmill for our annual Christmas friends party. We are not impressed at all. Firstly, two different people at two different times requested water for the table.  It took over an hour to get the water.  The meals arrived and out of 18 people, only three had a warm meal.  With the prices you are charging me for a 6 oz filet (38.00!) We expected it to be hot at least.  Not only was it cold, I tried to liven it up with salt, butter and finally tried your sawmill steak sauce to no avail. Cold AND tasteless.  Then to add insult to injury, an 18% gratuity was automatically added to the bill for "large party".  If we had non stop service and good food, I wouldn't balk at the tip but seriously, I am offended that your restaurant feels the need to make customers tip when it's not warranted. We will certainly never be back.

Excellent, authentic (insofar as a white kid like me would know) Mexican food at pretty reasonable prices. Having just eaten at El Primo up the street last week I feel confident in saying that this is better by a noticeable margin. 

Atmosphere is somewhere between cantina and small local diner, but the server was very attentive, friendly, and willing to suffer through my translating Spanish food names into Chinese for my wife. It took us about twenty minutes to order and she didn't rush us.

Business was not booming despite our going on a Friday night, so to my fellow Yelpers, get in there. I want this place to be here ten years down the line!

The LASPCA is such a wonderful organization! The facility is beautiful and so well kept.  Every time that I have been to the LASPCA all of the kennels have been nearly immaculate, which is very impressive for a shelter.  The pets are kept in spacious, indoor, climate-controlled crates and kennels.  The employees and volunteers are very helpful and also very honest.  While they are all interested in finding forever homes for the animals, they are also honest in admitting if a particular pet isn't the best match for potential owners.  I really respect and value that.

LASPCA has a variety of dogs and cats for adoption.  The turnover seems to be pretty fast--in a good way!  For those of you looking to adopt a dog or cat, I strongly encourage you to do so through a wonderful organization like LASPCA.  Why pay top dollar for a dog or cat at a pet store when there are so many animals in need of adoption?  

The adoption fees are very reasonable, given that you are supporting this wonderful organization and also receive the following: spay/neuter, vaccinations, microchip, rabies vaccine and license, de-worming, one month of heartworm prevention, one month of flea control, and a heartworm test.

Not only is LASPCA a great place to find your own furry friend, but it is also a safe haven for strays.  I had a positive experience a few months ago when I brought in a stray dog that I found.  I turned the dog in late at night, to the nighttime building manager, without any trouble at all.  I was happy to see a few weeks later that after his evaluation the dog made it to the adoptables section of the website.

I encourage you to support LASPCA in any way that you can. Adopt! Donate! Volunteer! Whatever you can do to support the organization's wonderful work.

Out working in our pub pass. This was our first stop. Great reviews so we are ready to dive in!  

So many choices but the Dino was calling my name. It was so good!  The bread was light and sweet and it was heated to melt the cheese and release the juices from the meat. Side of the pasta salad was a great combo. 

Deb had a meat n cheese plate that was nice and fresh. 

Great beer choices and decent wines as well

A great spot to chill with awesome food and great people.

Great service and atmosphere.  Dining upstairs is much quieter than downstairs.  The creamed corn is more of a Mexican street corn, but everything else was delicious and accurate in their description.  Good portions, good value, and full belly.

A couple of years ago, I used Olive Garden's alfredo and chicken to make my own chicken broccoli alfredo.  Also love that you can order the salads to go, with breadsticks.

Of course, back then I picked it up, so there was no issue with delivery.

Is there anything bad to say about this spot?

If you don't like seafood, don't come here. That's it.

They literally have EVERYTHING. The service is always so quick, even when they're busy. Everything is fresh. This is hands down our favorite spot to get fish in the city.

We've had their sushi grade salmon and tuna, both high quality and delicious. We've also had a variety of other things, nothing to complain about. All great.

Best fresh seafood spot in the whole city.

This was my first time ordering from here. I was pleasantly surprised how much Food was given. The portions were large. I couldn't finish my serving. Pad Thai noodles... mine was chicken and my daughters was beef.  We did specify to make it mild on spice because I struggle with really spicy food... they did accommodate. It had a sweet lime mixture that tasted really good. We also ordered pot stickers and  crab Rangoon. The pot stickers were my daughters favorite. I enjoyed the crab Rangoon personally. The food was still warm when it arrived and I have left overs  for later.

Every time we visit Boise we hit Dutch Bros..... all we ever get is Americanos but if the rest of their drinks are the same quality as their Americanos, I give them 5 stars!  They are friendly, fast and efficient!

Terrible breakfast!!! Burnt fries burnt hash browns. Whites on dippy eggs not cooked, slimy not good.  Server not friendly at all. This was my second time there and I will NOT go back. I should of went to my favorite, First Watch which is ALWAYS consistent.
$4 Bud light does not make a happy hour. It doesn't. No food specials. There is limited seating on the dock but be prepared to wait.

This was our third time eating here and every time it has been awesome! We have had a wide selection of items and have not found one we didn't love!  This visit I had shrimp and chorizo quesadilla. The shrimp was cooked to perfection and the portions were huge. Delicious!

Ate out during corona and this was my first time... really impressed! Service was great and the food was really good. The chicken and shitaki dumplings were sooo good and the authentic fried rice was amazing and fresh! Deff coming back here again. Not too expensive either.

Went here on a recommendation from a local tour guide. Little tiny place, had to wait only 10 minutes. Amazing food! Everyone is friendly!! It's a definite must go! I will return next time I'm in town. Jambalaya was the best! Get the taster plate, had everything you want.
A great Mexican place with tons of options! The best thing about this place is how late they're open on the weekends!

It was our first time to Robert's. The server was great! It was my birthday that day and she went out of her way for me. The music was good and the service was on point. It wasn't as busy as some of the other bars on broadway but it was by far our favorite!

Ok. What an amazing concept! Service and your check...not so much! It almost works better when they are busy at the bar. I had 4 bar tenders 1 coughing, 1 sweating and ONE smelling like puss n boots and the one thin fella stared hopelessly at my empty glass with me. *SIGHS* The last time I got charged for my friends bill and mine! Wouldn't be an issue but so did she. The manager ask me to email him my evidence I did and the email was blocked..WAIT, WHAT!? I adore the concept of my 3 favs beer, food and movies. I'm an actress for Christ SAKE! I go to a place about 3-4 times before grading. Well.. I'm at 5 for this one and BOOOOOO!!! Great concept, food and beer, great luck needed to get it to you and getting your bill and food right. *Eye roll, side bye, cross eye*  UGH!!! I'M TOO NICE! DAMMIT!

Lots of great finds in this store.  Just be weary of the beauty products. Allot of the "discount finds" are full of harmful detergents. Even their"facial rose water " lists rose extract as some of the last ingredients in what should be a simple spray. But there are times you can catch a great deal on some quality spf and serums. Just be on the look out on the ingredients used. 

Their clothes selection for the kiddos are always great. Name brand items at a discount.  Pick up small containers for packing lunch, a few items for the home and a outfit all in one place. Service is always great and with decent selections. Always makes me want to swing in to shop

Psst! I have a secret... There are AC plugs near the additional Women's restrooms hidden near the side exit on the right of the building. One, right by the condiments counter. 

This is especially useful if you're stuck in some crap bus without plugs. There's also free Wi-Fi. Again useful if your bus is circa 1980 and has stalled out twice on the NJ Turnpike. *sigh*

Went in here and people were not wearing masks. A few weeks later I ordered a meatball sub and all the meatballs were cut in half???? And there was so much room in the roll, it's not like they did that to make it fit. I had ordered through doordash so I didn't bother to call and complain. Very disappointing for

The best stop in West Philly....especially if you live or are staying within walking distance of Mr. Lee's then this is your best bet for an interesting crowd and a no-nonsense breakfast to get your Philly day started right.

Very delicious! Priced per person like a buffet, but made fresh per order. We actually ordered a lot more, but we ate it and then I remembered to yelp!! 

We will be back! Nice little Gem in Brandon!

I will never shop here again nor will I ever recommend this place to any one. Rude, abrupt and no concept of customer service.  

I initially went in to try on bridal dresses and put a $200.00 deposit down though I was undecided on a specific dress. I ended up buying a dress elsewhere and subsequently went into the store to purchase a veil and shoes and use my $200.00 deposit towards that purchase.  When I first walked in, a saleswoman offered to help me and then rolled her eyes when I told her that I already had a dress and was looking for a veil.  She was rude, acted inconvenienced for having to actually answer my questionsand abruptly left after approximately 2 minutes of showing me veils.  I found out later that she not a sales person but one of the owners.  Issues continued when I tried to apply my deposit to purchasing shoes.  I was informed that the deposit only applied to bridal gowns (not bridesmaids gowns, not veils, not accessories) and could not be transferred or refunded.  I asked to speak with one of the owners but they were too busy to have the courtesy to come out and explain the store's ridiculous rip-off policy to my face.  I left with very sour taste in my mouth from the experience.  They kept my $200 completely free and clear while I have nothing but a terrible experience to account for it.  They get one star because this place has been lucky enough to hire a few sales people who are gracious and helpful despite their rude employers.  I am so happy that I chose to order my dress elsewhere and they didn't receive the benefit of my order.

Not even midnight yet and they said they only deliver to regular customers and I was going to spend more than enough and they said no never mind we all want to go home then why answer the phone and start taking my order and then say they don't feel like it pretty much I m a regular customer I just usually pick up but I at work u just lost a customer for that bs worst customer service ever

For a first visit to St Louis, this is a great spot to come for good and drinks. The drink menu is extensive. I got the apple Barrel and really enjoyed it. Our group of 5+ enjoyed the wigs, ribs, and other appetizers. Their sweet tea was also really good. Another great part was the service, they were very in top of it and checked on our table often. There was no wait inside for a Saturday night, which was exciting.

Went for prenatal care for the name but to be honest, it's not even mediocre care they provide.
