My nurse would just say "oh that's normal in pregnancy and we don't exactly know why and I don't have any medications to give to you" when I spotted frequently and bled moderately a few times in the first trimester.  Why do I come to hospital in the first place then? 

I'm seriously considering to switch the hospital because Penn really doesn't seem to care about the patients at all. Also, they always make you wait at least 30 min even if you show up before the scheduled appointment time. Really not a great experience with this place.

Such a special place! The big tree and stage in the courtyard covered in twinkle lights really have a magical feel. If you are there to really hear the music ask for a table in front because there are a lot of people talking at times. The food and drinks are great. Definitely a top place to visit in Tucson.

My friend and I were out on Friday night watching March Madness hoops at a Rittenhouse-area bar when we made a couple new friends.  When the games ended, the guys insisted on a late night trip to nearby Byblos.  I will be the first to admit that I never would have walked into Byblos on my own accord, but since I wasn't buying and we were having a pretty good time, I went along for the ride.  

The place was packed and a table was out of the question.  As luck would have it, a group at the bar got up and left just as we made our way over.  Other yelpers have stated that the crowd is an interesting mix of attractive people and I have to agree.  

Our ringleader ordered a round of beers and a hookah.  The smoke was peach flavored, and the effects were much stronger than I had anticipated.  For a place I had always turned up my nose at, I was really digging it.  

While this was probably a one-time-only visit for me, I enjoyed the experience a lot and would recommend an evening at Byblos to anyone looking for something totally different from the regular scene.

Okay, I have to be honest. We had our phones out like complete losers using Google Maps when we walked right past this place. We did it twice. Why? Because Faubourg Bistro is located INSIDE the 700 Club, and I, apparently, CANNOT read signs or details to save my life. So don't be a dummy with your GPS tracking system of choice and totally miss this place. And now that that saga is over, on to the food!  

When we passed by (twice), we passed right by the scents of something glorious quickly overtaken by the UNMISTAKABLE smell of a steaming NOLA street in the French Quarter. (I'll let your imaginations run wild.) But back up, my friend. That's right, we FIRST smelled some fine comfort-food combinations being made right under our noses, which eventually led us to the back corner of the 700 Club where you place your order at a charming Dutch door and salivate over all the food coming down the line. Before we got to that momentous occasion of choosing a dish, however, we'd done our due diligence and researched the heck out of the menu and out of the reviews. We instantly knew that pizza mac 'n' cheese was in our future. Because we were on a tight schedule, we were only going to be able to eat a quick snack, which, BELIEVE ME, was very difficult to do--especially after we had our first forkful of piping hot cheese and pasta and pepperoni and ooooo, child, that marinara sauce!!!

The mac 'n' cheese comes served in a boiling skillet with a side of crusty garlic bread, ripe for dipping into the creamy marinara and cheese sauce. As I write this, I'm reliving that first bite--a marriage between crusty cheese, crispy pepperoni, and creamy, zesty tomato sauce mixed with the purest of dreams and goals and joys. I could've eaten three of those skillets all on my own and in hindsight, I'm mad at myself for not. YOU ONLY GET ONE LIFE! EAT RIGHT!!! I will most certainly be back the next time I'm in NOLA. It's a joy to eat something that hearty and I'm sure if that dish was that freaking fantastic, the rest of the menu has to be as well!

We absolutely love going to mulligan's!  As a matter of fact we go at least once a week.  The food is absolutely delicious. Whether it's lunch, dinner or just appetizers we are never disappointed.  Great place to meet up with friends for a few cocktails too The staff and owners are very friendly and welcoming especially Tyler.  I highly recommend it

Last night my husband and I had the chance to try Tampa's newest food truck addition, Tree Dog Roots. 

You may recognize the owners from some of the local farmer's markets in Tampa. My husband has always been a huge fan of their Ghost Pepper Iced Tea. The tea is not on the food truck's menu so be sure to ask about it!

Tree Dog Roots serves a "signature smash" dish that contains mashed golden Yukon potatoes, carrots, parsnips, chèvre goat cheese and butter. This delicious mix of root vegetables is amazing and comes in five different varieties: "4 Cheeses", "Chicken N' Cheese", "Bacon, Avocado, Ranch", "The Loaded" and "Walnut Basil Pesto". 

I ordered the Bacon Avocado Ranch Smash and my husband ordered a ghost pepper iced tea and the Loaded Smash. My dish came with bacon, cheese, green onions, avocado and tomato. My husband's dish was almost the same, but his also came with marinated chicken. We loved our meals, but my husband did mention he was hungry afterwards.

If you are looking to eat more veggies this is a wonderful alternative to some of the less healthy food truck options. I will definitely be following Tree Dog Roots food truck in the future so I can try their Walnut Basil Pesto smash!

Friendly location. Super convenient for lunch time due to me working right by this place. More often quick than not. Never had a problem with the food, besides wrong orders which happen at a pretty standard rate. (No better, no worse than other places.)

I was going to shop at the International plaza and noticed the car detailing service. I dropped my car and came back 2 hours later to a clean shiny looking brand new looking car. I don't know what they used but it looked so good! The inside was also impressive. The staff was very nice too. I'm planning to leave my car there every time I'll go shopping, it saves parking far away too.

From the same owners who brought you 10th Street Hardware on Spruce Street, 3rd Street Hardware serves Old City and Northern Liberties.  This place is pretty awesome. They sell everything from hardware to indoor/outdoor to kitchen and bath needs. My visit was simply to get a duplicate key cut, and I ended up buying wall hardware and a bathtub soap dish as well. They also sell a HUGE variety of my fav cleaner: Mrs. Meyers! Def going here when I need to replenish my stock.

Have IKEA furniture in need of repairs? They carry plenty of hardware to fix it. Need paint custom mixed or a cut of glass or wood? They do that too. They also rent drills and bolt cutters. 

Their prices are super reasonable. In fact, I was shocked they were as low as they are. I was expecting everything to cost $1 more than things indeed cost. 

The staff is helpful and friendly. They also feature a great playlist. Check out 3rd Street Hardware on 3rd Street between Arch and Race!

A couple of friends and I went here on a thursday cause we were craving hookah, and I will never go back. We had a coupon for a free hookah, which apparently the waitress resented. (If we're going to get an attitude for a coupon from your site, then why give out the coupon?). 
I don't want to spend a lot of time on the review because they don't deserve it. The hookah was ok, the drinks were horrible, my diet coke was flat and cost $5. And our waitress was a spiteful whore. If she smiled once I must've not noticed it. She was demanding, inconsistent, and an idiot. The hookah is also over $20. Ridiculous.
The only positive was that my friend Amanda D. walked in with a beer in her bag by accident, got it confiscated, then when we left, she swipped it off the stoop outside. She's gangsta.

Don't go here. Buy your own hookah.

Stopped in with #1 son  for a try-out of  T O H F. I asked what brand of dogs they use and was told that they are made especially for them. They tasted like all beef.

We ordered Chicago dogs, Detroit coneys, and an Atlanta XL footlong, the are all beef and the toppings are quality, and taste very good. 

My only complaint was that the bun for the XL was like a torpedo roll, way to much bread for the dog, the dog was big, but the roll dwarfed it. 

I usually get my  hotdogs w/o to many toppings but my son wanted to try some of them out. 

I'd go back if I am in the vicinity.

One of the hardest venues I've ever had to work with. 

I've dealt with this venue for several different events, and they do not make life easy. There are always roadblocks for something that should be an easy fix, or some crazy hoop that has to be jumped through to get things done. 

It's size and convenience to downtown are great, but over all i try to never work there if I don't have to.

My father in law lived here for 9 years and was satisfied with the location and  responsiveness of the staff. Certainly it is an old community but the maintenance staff is quick to come help with any issues. Brittany in the leasing office is particularly helpful.

I am usually a huge Olive Garden fan but this visit was just OK.  The food was great but the service was less than expected.  The plates were never cleared unless you asked the waitress to clear it.  She was not that attentive.  She was friendly but that was it.  I was really disappointed in the service.  We usually tip 20% or more and I only tipped the 15% due to the poor service. I usually receive great service at this particular location so I am hoping that this was a one time bad service experience.  If you are constantly looking for your waiter/ress to get you something then I feel that they were really not doing their job.

There are not enough words to describe how delicious the food is at Walt'z.  My husband had the Blackened Scamp with their famous beach slaw and I had the Blackened Grouper.  We enjoyed our meal with a full bodied Cab from Paso Robles, CA. For desert we shared a slice of the BEST key lime pie I have ever tasted!!  We just returned from our honeymoon in the Keys and this pie was far superior to any we tasted down there!  The ambiance in this charming beach "shak" is laid back and warm.  We cannot wait to go back. Do yourself a favor and visit this amazing seafood spot!

If you wanna rich creamy coffee, say no more! The coffee here is so over the top, you have to come. I love to have a coffee that's so strong yet without bitterness; this place definitely serves it right. Not to mention they really listen to you while they're brewing, so if you have a request the barista's right there. And I have one pet peeve with most coffee shops... There's never any were comfortable to sit. Most coffee shops cater to the people who are studying or using their laptops; but I like to come with a friend and just cozy up on the couch for some good conversation and warm brew. Once again, this place delivers! Lots of nice cozy corners to snuggle into with your coffee. The inside is big and beautiful and has places for everybody to find the right place to enjoy. I'm certainly putting this one on my bookmarks; and I highly recommend them to anyone who's a coffee fanatic like me.

This was a random bar stop heading back to home from the beach. Was looking for a cool dive bar and saw that this had great reviews. In a good location looks like it's an FSU and Patriots bar for sports. Our waitress was okay but not very attentive. Very disappointed that they did not have any drafts at all just bottles/cans. Me being a craft beer girl this just was t my cup of tea I guess. Cute little place but I just prefer fresh draft beer!

Some ponder the meaning of life. Me? I wonder how the heck Sitar wins best Indian restaurant in the Nashville Scene every year! What does everyone else know that I don't? Every time this place wins an award, I am left with a sour taste in my mouth.

The same foul taste also happens to result whenever I eat here. My biggest gripe with Sitar is that EVERY SINGLE DISH TASTES THE SAME. No matter the color of the sauce, no matter whether there is meat, or paneer, or chickpeas, every dish tastes the same. I swear, if you wore a blindfold, you wouldn't ever be able to identify a single dish you were eating! And the taste is kind of bland, and kind of sour, and generally just not very tasty at all. Certainly no complex spices or deep flavors that Indian food is known for. I am not exaggerating when I say that I have eaten Indian food out of a package that tastes as good, if not better, than the food at Sitar.

And yes, I have eaten at both their lunch buffet as well as ordering off their menu. It doesn't matter. The food is depressing and blah no matter what. Additionally, if you do come for their buffet, the selection is about as varied and large as what you'd get a mile down the road at Bombay Palace but tastes nowhere near as good. The area with the food is bigger so you may be tricked into thinking it's a larger buffet but it isn't. And in fact, Bombay Palace has a much larger salad bar area as well as a more appealing dessert area. I also think the atmosphere and service are vastly superior at BP, as at Sitar, the servers are always pretty cold and the restaurant, while spacious, doesn't really have any personality.

I guess the people who really like Sitar just really like that one sauce that they seem to use in every dish and so are happy that that's all they can get. Personally, I like a little variety and some actual flavor in my dishes, which is why I avoid this place whenever possible. I will say that they do have really good naan, but it's not enough to get me to willingly eat here. I'll go if others really want to, but otherwise, I steer clear.

Found JB through Yelp and contacted them via email for a medium sized job.  Mark contacted me via email quickly and set up a time for a quote.  He showed up on time and was in and out quickly for the estimate.  The price was reasonable and communication was again quick and easy.  

On the day of the work, the two plumbers arrived exactly on time.  They didn't mind my dog investigating their work the entire time.  The job was completed quickly and they cleaned up after themselves.  

It was exactly the experience you look for with a plumber and I'll be sure to contact JB with any future needs.

We had a great time! Our server was fantastic, we never had an empty glass. He was super friendly! The food was really good, I recommender scooby snacks! I had the cider chucke sandwich which I found had a little too much Brie cheese, and I really love cheese. It's a great location with a cute patio. Baileys chocolate ganache was SUPERB. Definitely recommend this location!

Atmosphere: 8/10 - It's casual, but nice.
Noise: Moderate
Food: 8/10 - Great taste; small portions!
Drinks: I just had water, but good selection.
Originality: 7/10
Service: 10/10
Cleanliness: 9/10 - Flies outside, of course.
Price-Quality Ratio: You pay more than you get.  It's good, but a bit over-priced.
Overall: 9/10

By far the best deli in this whole area.. Been going  here for a while, moved away and still come back! The hot roast beef is phenomenal. The cold hoagies are just as good!!!! Customer service is always top notch!!! You will not be disappointed!
Definitely my go-to place for brunch in Philadelphia! Tasty and giagant blueberry pancakes!

My views of the sales department giving my phone number to a marketing team, the rest of this place appears to be pretty awesome.  Good parts department, and honestly, they do have a bunch of bikes, just don't give anyone your phone number until you're ready to plunk down on a bike.

Thank you Erin/Irene (not sure how it's spelled) for letting me try on 5 different shades before deciding! Amazing job and customer service. Only $20 for the gel polish. Make sure you double check that the color on the sample looks the same in the bottle/on your nail! A lot of them are dramatically different. Manufacturer's fault, not theirs. Great place overall.

I have been a customer at Philip Johnson Salon for over 5 years and continue coming back despite the large range of options for spas and salons in St. Louis. I have seen Melissa, Megan, and Phil, and have been more than thrilled with the product each time. I have long hair that requires a good cut and color and am fairly picky. They listen to what you want and deliver each time. The largest thing with salons is to make sure you say what you want, because stylists cannot read your mind. I love that I can tell them what I want, and I get it done with a smile to boot! The front office manager Josh is on point and always courteous on the phone. I love the wine and coffee options, and the Aveda products are also a nice touch. Definitely a solid option if you are looking for a salon to return to time and time again!
Stopped in here based on Yelp reviews, nice local place had a hamburger with pork belly and cheese very good and really rich....... wow good beer selection worth the visit
Must try the Rabbit Pate even though i think they should serve it with something better than Saltine Crackers.
They are great! Lunch special is a great value. Crab Rangoon are the best I have ever had. Love this place
Loved this pizza. All that is good in the world of pizza is here. What else to say? Try it.

Ribs and pork shoulder were cooked well, but not very flavorful. 911 sauce is not hot AT ALL. Corn bread was probably the worst I've ever experienced and the Mac and cheese was mehhh. Potato salad was delicious, staff was friendly, and it has a fun and casual atmosphere.

It's hard for me to rate this place, because I didn't enjoy it yet it's a good museum.  We stayed for half an hour , until I couldn't "stomach" anymore. (ha ha, ok that was terrible)

I got noxious after the first 10 minutes.  However, after seeing this humongous colon that used to carry 2.5 big buckets of shi* in one poor guy, I felt like I should eat healthier and more fiber. So kudos to the museum for making me realize that eating poorly and unsanitary hygenic habits have consequences.

Don't go after eating a meal.

This place was not good. We also saw this place on Food Network so were eager to try it on our recent visit to Nashville, but didnt have the same experience Guy had. The sauce was too tangy and the pork was a bit dry. The coleslaw had no taste. I will admit that the ribs were tender & the white sauce was very good but their meat was lacking a smoked flavor it tasted like something I would throw in a crockpot! We wont be going here again.

Horrible! Purchased a pair of Electrolux Washer & Dryer. Based on a review on a different website realized that the dryer was not a venting one. Called them and asked to exchange. The customer service rep. cancelled my order and put another one for the correct set. They called me an hour later and told me they were not able to cancel the original order because they sent it to the shipping department and the only way to cancel it would be a $600 (six hundred) return fee! Holy crap! I cancelled all my other appliance orders with them and will never use their services again! Beware!

I always love the Cheesecake Factory. The fact that they are a well known and established franchise already makes this place great. With that being said, the largest factor that will differentiate one location from another is service.

I believe I have been to this location three times now. Once was to have some drinks and eat at the bar, another was to go, and the third was just to get cheesecake. The best experience of the three was definitely while I was dining in. The bar tender I had was very kind and attentive and of course, my food was great.

The one thing I would criticize thus far is that, especially on busy nights or busy seasons, the area in which customers go simply to order cheesecake needs to be better attended. I waited for probably 10-15 minutes before someone even acknowledged me. Not to mention, I was the next in line with several behind me. I definitely understand getting busy, but a quick "I'll be with you in a just a moment" will make the world of a difference to customers who are perhaps less patient.

Other than that... love it as always!

This was one of my favorite places in New Orleans.  I was definitely pleasantly surprised. We learned a lot about the history of Mardi Gras and what it actually entails  The best part was getting up close to tons of floats (in the process of being made and from years past).  I only wish we would have known about free shuttle before walking out there in the super cold weather.  This is a great place for all ages and surprisingly not the tourist trap that you might think it was....

Nice surprise to find this place here amongst some pretty bland food offers
Friendly staff, fresh tasty food and good value for money. 
We enjoyed Sushi, duck and sesame beef for dinner 
Wine list is small but both the red and white wines we picked for $8 a glass was acceptable, more choices would have been good.
We would definitely return

Excellent food, great service, terrible hostess.

Right when we walked through the doors, all we heard was a monotone "how many?"  The blonde hostess looked like she hated life and seemed annoyed that she had to seat us...she grabbed the basket of rolls and took off to our table. We had trouble keeping up with her! She never said one word to us, she just sat the basket of rolls down and took off.  Definitely not a good first impression! 

Good thing our server and her trainee were exceptional! They were so sweet, timed our apps/entrees perfectly, and were smiling the whole time. They checked on us the right amount; enough to where we felt very taken care of. The steaks, pork chops, and mashed potatoes were delicious!

We will definitely be coming back, we just hope the blonde hostess learns to smile a bit.

Service was absolutely horrible.  Our waitress never came back to check on us and I literally stood up to flag her down to get a drink refill.  I love outback but not sure I would go back to this location.

Love the healthy options and a great alternative to other healthy fast-casual chains if you get tired of them (aka Sweetgreen, Honeygrow, etc). The ingredients are high-quality and healthy, and the sauces are unique, tasty, and light. 

I chose "Create Your Own Bowl" with salmon, minted carrots, chickpeas & spinach, pickled beets and lemon tahini sauce. Very healthy and wholesome, but my only complaint is that even with the sauce it was a bit bland. Maybe deliberate to be light on the salt? Anyways I did takeout via Grubhub and ended up adding a lot of my own sriracha to flavor/spice it up a bit, and I have a pretty tame flavor/salt threshold - not a big deal though. 

I would definitely go more often, but as with other healthy fast-casual places, this will be a bit on the pricey side. I do like that compared to a salad from Sweetgreen for example, it's slightly cheaper and more satisfying.
This place has grown on me, and it's always been a pretty nice time. Tasty, strong coffee and hip, friendly baristas. Free wifi that isn't time-constrained.
Amazing opportunity to dabble in an almost lost trade. The owner is extremely talented and a great instructor. You have to try this out if you're out in Santa Barbara

I'm not a vegetarian. I have nothing in common with vegetarians. 

Except this quesadilla.

If I could eat this every day of my life I would be content, stuffed and 500 pounds. It is packed with delicious peppers, onions and cheese along with a generous side of sour cream AND freshly made guacamole making it heaven in a flour tortilla. I live in Washoe Valley and gladly make this drive to get it, it is that good! The woman who took my order was friendly, efficient and threw in a bag of freshly baked hot salty chips with both salsas-I was impressed with her accoutrements provided and highly recommend this item, can't speak for the rest but this quesa is da bomb diggety!

I had made a date with a young lady from Northeast Philly.  After looking into some local fare, I decided to go with Kellys Seafood. The reason being that any restaurant that opened in 1958 and was still in business had to be a good choice. What an awful mistake of judgement on my part!  If you check out my reviews, you will notice that I always try to find the positive in every establishment. The only positive at Kellys, was the waitress, who couldn't have been nicer or more efficient.  We started off with the fried calamari app.  This really was not bad at all. Very light, quite a large portion for the price, and a fairly good hot sauce as well. The waitress and the fried calamari almost made me go with two stars, but the entrees were so disapointing, I couldn't check the second box. I ordered the shrimp fra diavlo over linguini. When the dish arrived there were six shrimp floating on what appeared to be an oil slick similar to the now infamous Exxon/Valdez oil spill. I really thought they had forgotten the linguini, but to my suprise, somewhere about two inches below the surface was some really over cooked, oil soaked linguini. My date had about the same luck with her linguini with clam sauce. She was able to fill a small bowl with oil before locating her linguini. The server was so nice that I didn't have the heart to send this nautical nightmare back. Any cook that could send this disaster out of his kitchen, probably would have trouble boiling water!  It's a shame that a place with nice atmosphere, and great servers would present a meal like this. The last reviews on this place were over two years ago, and seemed to be positive. Hopefully, they can bring the quality back again.
Very good food.  Nice staff.  Best Chinese in Idaho so far in 1.5 years I've been here!

Cute little spot. The food was pretty good. I'd come back to try other options... the espresso, nothing to write home about. I got the Turkey sandwich on ciabatta bread that came with a side salad. Really good sandwich which I finished completely! The staff was surprisingly dismissive for being Uptown...

I have eaten here a bunch of times for dinner with friends, and have generally had a good experience. Good, typical pub food. Decent pricing. It is usually pretty easy to get seating. So, when I had to plan a lunch after my father-in-law's funeral, I called them and asked to have their private room for the 25 or so people who would attend. We got there, and I found out we did not get the private room. Well, ok, we were in the restaurant and had the section to the right totally to ourselves. But there was not enough seating and it was kind of cramped to move around and to get to the buffet. The whole set up just made it hard to line up and then you had to reverse and push  past everyone in line.  Very cramped. The food was pretty good, but they only put out paper plates etc. It was kind of cheesy for a sit down lunch in my opinion and for the price per head we paid.  I guess I incorrectly assumed that a restaurant that served all of its food every other time I had been there on real plates with real cutlery to do the same for a group gathering. I am sure I will go again with a couple of friends, but will not hold a group event there again.

Nice salad and food bar. 

Fish was bad.  Meats were just ok.  A few were good.  Loved the chicken. 

Service...just ok.  The servers kept missing our table!

Price was cheap but would have paid more for better food.

This by far the best paint store in town. They have Benjamin Moore paint which is as good as it gets as well as all the typical stains and finishes. They also have a great selection of metallic and other decorative paints as well as accessories for faux finishes. 

Finally, and this is the best, your name and the paint you choose goes into their computer so if you go back and need a bucket of that awesome yellow you painted your kitchen but can't remember the name--they have it. This is especially handy on custom stain and paint mixes which they also do. They will have the proportions in their system as well. 

Oh and fair pricing as well and great service. 

Don't go nowhere else , dawlin'. Ya wastin' ya time.

Have always loved Farotto's when Mr. Parrot was alive. The house salad is simple and refreshing with their house dressing. The pizza is one of the best I have had- obviously many others think so as I believe they have been selling pizza's in Rock Hill since 1949 when it was just a carry out hole in the wall.

Mr. Parrot passed away and I believe his son or another family took over. I think they thought the business needed a change as they changed the dinner salad and the pizza's were a little off meaning they were no longer very good. We had gone to Farotto's a couple of times & were highly disappointed on each occasion. Farotto's was a go to spot for those visiting from out of town & then the out of town guests mentioned the change for the worse as well.

I am happy to say that after someone convinced me to go to Farotto's despite my objection from recent disappointments I was pleasantly surprised that they have returned the salad & pizza to the old recipes. I had given up on Farotto's so I was happy to taste their signature food again. I don't know why new owners or management think they can reinvent the wheel on something that is already working. If it's working then don't fix it! One thing nice as well is they have expanded their parking and added an outdoor deck which is a needed change especially the issue's of the old days of trying to find parking.

My other Farotto's favorite is the Cod dinner- very good but it's hard to stray away from the pizza.

Very classy lobby, expansive yet inviting. The room I was in wasn't the biggest, but it was well-appointed and had amazing views. 

The staff here is professional and friendly. They are very accommodating and helpful, willing to go out of their way to make sure you get whatever you may need. 

Plus, you just have to go downstairs and you've got one of the best cocktail bars in New Orleans, The Swizzle Stick!

The tasting menu, my friends! Duck étouffée, turtle soup, and gumbo--eye-rolling. The latter two must be among the best in the city... We can't imagine improvements. The duck leg? Best I've ever had ANYWHERE (and that's on its own--both sauces are amazing too though!). And spicy shrimp with cornbread was phenomenal! Okay... And not kidding, the best pecan pie I've ever had, with bread pudding in the top three. 

Our waiter was attentive, patient, and helpful. Owner acts as hostess but will come around to see how your meal went, and she's lovely. Graceful, and truly cares about your meal. An overall wonderful experience. And all at a laughably low price, considering the quality. Must go!

Great sashimi (salmon & albacore) - Salmon was the best I've had in SB so far (buttery...hmmmm).
Ahi roll - really delicious (My husband really enjoyed this roll).
Vivid roll - really delicious
Rainbow dragon- really delicious (I liked this one a lot)
Old school - really delicious

Customer service - AMAZING

Overall, I would recommend this restaurant.  Very good quality to price. Fresh tasting.
Great Italian sandwiches. Stopped in Lambertville when we couldn't find parking in New Hope. Found this Italian deli.

Cake Boss vs Moreno's hands down 
Moreno's wins . The display case captures your eyes . You can go up and down or right to left you will want to taste everything . Large cupcakes to die for. I get the large cookies for my staff so much they get excited when I come in with a white bag. Apple turnovers  taste like apple pie . Add vanilla ice cream  and you have a meal.  Great stop in the morning. Oh you can get coffee juice and other things to get you through the morning.
Thanks Moreno's for putting smiles on my staffs face.

This is an OK hospital. By "OK" I mean that it's better than Aria, and it has excellent doctors and surgeons but you have to do some homework to find out who they are.  

Now onto the negatives: The nurses and staff seem rushed about everything and do not seem to care about their patients.  I have had multiple relatives of mine in this hospital and they did not have nurses that helped them and when you did ask for help the nurses acted as though it was a bother to actually do their job to help a patient. It was impossible to have the nurses do simple things for the patients like bathe them! This hospital is NOT as bad, or nearly as dirty as Aria is but that's a good thing.  I was once a patient at this hospital, and a person in the room next to me died! A person I know who worked with various hospitals told me there's a reason they call it St. Scary.

*for the 30th street station location*

Have gotten take out from here a few times.  Always enjoyed what I got.  I especially love their sweet potatoes and greens.  Decent sized portions, but I paid a little more than I was happy about.  Every time I go through the train station I stop for Delilahs, but I don't think I'd go out of my way to eat at another location.  But when I'm at the train station, I wouldn't THINK about eating anywhere else.  Very tasty and bad for ya!

Took my Trek bike there and the technician looked at it, and quickly informed me that the frame was cracked and that they couldn't do anything else beyond that.  Took my bike back for a second look where I bought it from in Phoenix, and they found no crack. Be cautious if you take your bike here and they say some major is wrong. Take it to get a second look.
Took an hour for delivery and the pizza crusts were burnt -I tried to take a bite and it stung my mouth-disgusting-had to throw away and ordered rustys

The review is for the food.  After well over five years as a customer, service has traditionally been anything but expedient but has greatly improved over our last few visits.  Negatives are no reservations, occasionally frustrating wait times (even with empty tables), slow service.  But you know what, who cares really!  I am there for the amazing food!  So, the pros now.  BYOB wine ($5 corkage), free bread sticks, salad included too with meal.  So just sit back and relax, sip on a nice zin and wait for the meal.  My go to is the Chicken Florentine, and the Eggplant Rolotini for the wife.  Another perk is that the owner is very sweet and always there.  Come out and enjoy another fine establishment that South Nashville has to offer.  Oh, and if you forget the wine, there is a liquor store about 50 meters away in the same complex.

Started out with some drinks on the tented patio and then moved into the bar to have an appetizer as it was a cool night. The bartender was just amazing with his chatter about the restaurant and what drinks we might like. He created some just for us based on a few key ingredients we suggested. Their complimentary bread is delicious and we also tried the goat cheese appetizer which was great and also the antipasto. Both took the edge off our hunger and then we were talked into trying their "world famous" espresso martini which was actually the best tasting espresso martini I've tried although that list is not long. I really don't usually like them because they are either too sweet or too bitter but this one just got the proportions just right. Would definitely stop back here again on our next jaunt to the area to have a full dinner.
I highly recommend Rachel! She listened to everything I wanted and it turned out great!

The best meal I had during our stay in NOLA. Great selection of Italian dishes (the crab cannelloni and chicken piccata were AMAZING and surprisingly affordable. We waited an hour for a table but the bar downstairs had live music and cheap drinks, which makes the wait fly by. I would absolutely come here again and again.

Ever since I left Japan I've been looking for authentic ramen. I just found it!
The charshu, the ajitamago, the noodles... all were authentic.
The only thing missing from the menu was tonkotsu ramen, but even in Japan not all ramen-ya serve tonkotsu ramen.
Eat here, you will not be disappointed.

Making a beverage shouldn't be rocket science. It just needs to be accurate and consistent. I ordered a Mocha Latte in the morning shift and it turned into a Cappuccino (not enough milk ergo the extra foam)... On the same day in the afternoon, I ordered another Mocha Latte and it came out as Caramel. Only at when it was night shift, did I get my order correct. I'm giving 2 stars because the last shift gets my order right everytime i visited Dd's. Everyone else, stop ruining my favorite DD beverages.

I picked this place to catch up with a friend, but found it to be fairly noisy between the music, the drink machine, and the occasional Chinatown firetruck. However, I did enjoy the availability of seating on a Thursday evening and loved my Honey Jasmine Aloe Vera bubble tea, which was not overly sweet and was not as heavy as the usual bubbles
45 minute wait from time of ordering, small portions and over priced food. Food tasted pretty good although some lacked flavor and was very bland.

One of the better grocery stores on the West Bank. It's staffed good and products are always available. I like that they carry organic fruits and have a separate organic section. Their steaks are great with huge problem 1lb# portions in the case for $19/lb. I was somewhat disappointed when I asked for a 3-4 rib prime rib and they guy handed me three boneless ribeye steaks. Despite that the meat department are always helpful. I'm not too fond of the bakery department. In fact we chose to get a birthday cake from WinDixie due to better selections.  We I find great here is the beer section with an abundance of Abita single bottle selections. Don't forget to box it up to make it easy to carry out. I come here almost every day so it's a good sign.

I had heard about this place a thousand times but never ventured in until the other night. We were killing time before a show at the ready room, so we were only drinking but I wish I had ordered food because it smelled and looked amazing. The inside is nice but the patio is where it's at. Super neat atmosphere and a bomb fire pit. I will definitely make this place a regular stop when I'm in STL.
Did not like their food. Way overpriced and rude staff. Burger had very little flavor and the bun wasn't good.

Definitely the best steak I've ever had. Can't say enough good things about the Sophia Sauce. Love that they also have a bar menu if you arent wanting to spend as much on dinner or if you are just wanting a nice dinner but want to relax in the lounge and not the more formal dining room. Literally have never had anything bad. Best thing to get? Brie, Hummus or Shrimp Alex for appetizer. Mixed salad (house & caesar), filet with sophia sauce and broccoli! You wont be dissapointed!

Wow! They took two nails out of my tire and patched it for free. I love the customer service and free wifi. This place is the best in Southern/Central California!!

A must visit. Free tshirt with purchase :)
There wings are good but the bread they use for there steaks is awful. Overall nothing special at all

I came here on a weekend afternoon with some friends and it was pretty packed. I got the Thai tea with 30% sugar no ice and half boba, and I asked before ordering whether they use powder or real tea. They use real tea, so I got it. The tea was really weak though, and they gave me ice and they did not give me half boba like I asked for. Their bubbles were quite chewy and good though, and the tea wasn't overly sweet which was good. Definitely need stronger tea though. At $3 pre-tax, it's pretty well-priced for a drink!

How have I lived in Indy for so long and never tried Shapiro's? I really have no idea. I guess I technically have STILL never tried Shapiro's since I've only been to the Twisted Traditions location, but I feel like I get the gist of it now.  

Holy German potato salad. Why was that the most delicious potato salad ever? I know, Shapiro's is known for their sandwiches and deli meats, but that potato salad was out of this world. Seriously great.  Their vegetable soup was also delicious and chock full of vegetables. I had at least three huge chunks of cabbage and carrots and it was seasoned nicely. I also ordered half of a roast beef sandwich on rye and it was very tasty too. Extra points for the mega pickle that came with my sandwich. 

Their desserts looked top-notch, but I was so full after lunch,  I couldn't eat anything else. Next time though. 

This stop will definitely motivate me to head downtown and try the original cafeteria style Shapiro's, but this one is closer to home.  Also, really like all the historic photos that are hanging on the walls, and it's pretty big inside so there was ample seating. I'll be back singing their praises soon!

Hubby and I were looking for a new place to check out tonight and randomly yelped Greek food near us.  We hadn't heard of Yia, but decided to check it out!  We were NOT disappointed at all!  We had yeeros (I had beef/lamb, hubby had chicken) and salads, and they were great! We also got the baklava which was so delicious, I almost bought another!  The employees in the store were so friendly, and I'm not sure if it was the manager, or the owner, but someone brought us out rice pudding on the house after we finished our meal. What a nice thought!
Super yummy! We got chicken chow mein, salt and pepper shrimp, ginger chicken, and beef broccoli.  All very tasty.

What I like about the freshly relocated Toggery: Its clothes are shoes are laid out and divided neatly. Best of all, there's a basket of candy when you walk in--and not just any candy, but Starburst and Dove chocolate bites. 

What creeped me out a little: The half-used perfume bottles for sale. I couldn't tell if they looked used because they really were, or just because these '70s-styled bottles had been around so long the alcohol had started evaporating. Either way, I'm not so sure these guys smell the way they're supposed to. 

But people must love this place: After all, it moved out of former digs by Canal Bistro on Guilford to a more visible shop on 62nd Street.

Ate here again like i knew i would fried pickles were pretty good all 5 of them cmon how much do you think 5 pickles the size of my index finger costs couldve thrthra few more in there. Might want to beef up on the cheesteaks guys. For someone whos restaurant name is philly cheesteak youd think they would be better. Not impressed at all. I can with all honesty say ive never eaten a cheesteak anywhere and not been stuffed until i ate theres. The only thing i liked was that they have cheese wiz. Cant find that in places outside of philly other than that not impressed. The bread was fresh but was not tasty at all eww tasted just like wonder bread from the grocery store the bread makes or breaks a cheesteak esp. When you nickle and dime on the steak. As you can see in the picture not very big. Honestly when i ordered take out i had to look in thebag before i left to make sure the cheesteak was in there because thats how light my bag was ! Lol. For $20 i feel like i got jipped. I got a med fountain soda too which was actually pretty good. I like how they let me get fountain instead of bottled which i hate. Honestly only readon they dont get 2 stars is because ive eaten here before on a couple occasions and there not terrible just a bit overpriced dont really pay attention to detail. Kind of one of those places where you get a banging pizza oneday then get a subpar one next. But overall they have a pretty big menu and the food is usually decent. Would definetly eat here again but probably wont be for another cheesteak. Sorry.
I did reach out to the hotel (as was asked) to give them an opportunity to understand my experience. Never heard back.
Decent brunch place. Have been to le peep elsewhere. Decent skillet breakfast. Kid friendly and they gobbled the chocolate chip pancakes.

As I read some of the previous reviews, I'm not sure how Giovanni's gets the reviews that it gets.  People say "it's a dying breed of old-fashioned restaurants with great service."  No folks.  Giovanni's died a long time ago.  Yes, it used to be a dying breed.  Now, they've lost their touch, and there are many FAR better restaurants (food, price, and service) to visit in the St. Louis area.  First, we (6 of us) never felt welcome at all.  Our waiter didn't smile once and wasn't nice.  Second, when we got our salads, my husband said, "There are Skittles in my salad."  I actually thought he was kidding at first.  Then, he showed me one red and one green Skittle in his salad.  He thought they were beans or something, so he put them in his mouth and then realized they weren't beans.  We had a good sense of humor about it with the waiter (who had no sense of humor).  He whisked the salad away, and we figured he was going to get him another one.  Meanwhile, one of the other gentlemen working in the restaurant said, "Oh, the chef loves Skittles.  They are all over the kitchen."  I figured it just fell out of someone's pocket and, again, we tried to be light about it.  Accidents do happen after all, and thankfully, a tooth wasn't chipped or anything.  We figured he'd get a replacement salad and that they'd take it off the bill.  We then got our meals after waiting quite a while.  They were just okay.  There were crumbs all over the table, and they had taken my fork with my salad plate (there weren't two).  Now in a restaurant that serves $10-15 plates, I don't expect prompt service, but when they charge $30 for chicken parmesan (my meal was $32 with no vegetables), I expect top-notch service.  The crumbs stayed on the table, and I had to ask for a fork to eat dinner.  My lobster ravioli didn't even have a garnish on it.  Everyone's meals were just mediocre (nothing knocked our socks off), and our bill came to $238 (pre-tip) (and that was with 1 kid's meal that was split)....so 4 1/2 meals.  When the bill came, guess what.  The salad that we paid for with Skittles in it that was never replaced was on our bill.  Unbelievable.  When we told them they could take the salad off the bill and then we'd pay it, they walked off fussy (as they had been the entire meal).  They never once apologized for the Skittles in the meal.  We all left very disappointed and decided before we were even out the door that we wouldn't be coming back....ever.  I travel a LOT for work and am a foodie/fine diner.  I know a great restaurant when I visit it once.  Giovanni's isn't it.  Don't waste your time and money here.  Trust the reviews and find the restaurants that are 4-stars or above.  For the price, this restaurant should be much better....food and service.  Their service was almost embarrassing.

This is a cute little place! The mussels were AMAZING! The food was excellent but the quality of the steak I got was not that great. My boyfriend said his was good though. The sauces on the steaks were also very delicious. They do not take reservations so if you don't want to wait get there close to 5:30 when they open. Overall a good experience!

Very impressed by the general manager Tod Michael who personally approached me and discussed a negative experience that I had had as a delivery person. Thank you for taking such great care with customer service I really appreciate it.
Yay for burritos that are fast but not fast food!!! We enjoyed picking up some burritos to go from this Chipotle & found the customer service to be muy buena!

Came down here for a quick getaway with my family and was pleasantly surprised on several fronts

Location: the Hilton is located right near the center of Clearwater beach, which makes it a great location for reaching restaurants, shops, etc. 

Room: we stayed in a run of the mill room with two beds. Room was clean and comfortably furnished. My only complaint is that the walls seemed a bit thin 

Beach: the Hilton is located right on its own private section of beach. The beach itself is clean and extremely wide. I've been to beaches from Hawaii to the Caribbean and I can safely say that this was one of the nicer and wider beaches I've seen. 

Staff: the staff were always pleasant and attentive. Never had an issue. 

Overall a great hotel on Clearwater Beach and at a reasonable price
Great thin crust pizza.  Classic institution in Gloucester City.

A must try for the best banh mi sandwiches! Joe B's sandwich is delicious for a vegetarian option, and the spring rolls are to die for! It's a cute little place off the beaten path, and definitely worth it!

This had been recommended by friends for breakfast and it was so good that we ate breakfast there two of the three days we were in NOLA.  Both times, we ordered the Sis' Soul Food omelet and it was one of the best omelets I've ever eaten.  Their biscuits are huge and delicious.

We just moved here and have been desperately looking for a cozy, non-commercial type restaurant and decided to try it for the first time tonight! We were more than happy! The food was delicious, reasonably priced, and the staff was friendly. We will definitely be coming back....soon!

I did not have sushi so I cannot speak for what truly counts. All 3 friends said their sushi was good. Service was good. Small place and need reservations on weekends but whatever. I had teriyaki tofu and it was delicious. I would go back.

I had to get an oil change and inspection for my 2012 Nissan Rogue. I called this place on a Saturday morning and was surprised that John told me I could bring it right in. I did so, and I was very pleased from start to finish. John is a very nice guy, and had me in and out quickly and painlessly. And for a great price as well. I highly recommend Northern Liberties Auto Clinic!!!

Super nice girls working but it took a while to get our orders. I would definitely skip their chai, tasted like flavored water. The salted Carmel latte was okay but not the greatest. May be a spot for muffins and regular black coffee

Would give 0 if i could!
They claim my package was delivered yet I was even out front at the time they claim it was delivered and there definitely was NO delivery!!
And there is no way to get an actual person on the phone locally!

Was in the area after a long and tiring day of Made in America festival. Hungry and it was late so my group decided to come here since it was one of the few spots that was open. Let me tell you, the chicken noodle pho was absolutely delicious and cooked to perfection. Reason for 3 stars is the lack of customer service. The man seemed to be working alone and was very stressed, which is understandable, but don't make your customers feel as if they're a bug or a burden to you. Felt totally unwelcomed. Other than that, delicious food and affordable.

Probably not much I can say that hasn't already been said. This place is great and they've got real, Italian specialty pastas that you won't find in any grocery store. I got myself one of their pre-made, homemade baked zitis and it was so good! (Note: they've got a great variety of these including lasagna). Their service is great and they're at a convenient location. They also offer up breads and cheese, so it's a one-stop shop for all your family dinner needs.

I actually came here on a class field trip. For Drexel Students who don't know, one of the owners of Duross and Langel is a Drexel Alumni. 

Any who, I was able to meet the man behind all the magic and get to see the soap kitchen on the second floor. There is no secret that they put a lot of hard work and dedication in making these soaps. They sell quality soaps that are worth the price you pay for them.

I had a great experience here for a concert. I was worried about parking and the lines to get in but with a little bit of planning, we found a great parking spot a few blocks away. Had time for dinner at Channelside and then made our way to the arena. The crowd and lines were intimidating but Amalie staff and security got everyone in at a good pace.

Once inside, they had plenty of bars and beer stands for drinks. We didn't have any problems with long waits. Getting to our seats was a breeze as well. They had personnel stationed at each entrance to let you know where to go. We were in section 301 and had a great view of the stage area and big screens.

Bathrooms are clean and leaving the concert was a breeze. No issues at all! So this was my first time at the Amalie and I'm glad it went well with no headaches. Had a great time and will now feel less stressed now that I know it's not such a headache attending events here.

Horrible service.  We had emailed a guy a couple times about a few cars we seen that were in our price range. My husband got off early from work, so we drove down there with our little ones from Portland Tennessee... it took us 2 hours to finally get there because there was so much traffic coming in... in the mean time aside from emailing we called to tell this guy we were on our way from Portland to come look at these vehicles. We finally get there and no one greeted us first off, we finally get a salesman and he was very very rude and nasty saying we didn't know what we were talking about and just very rude and nasty.  The original guy my husband had emailed and called of course was not there.  No one seemed to believe anything we told them and we finally just left and told them we didn't want to buy from them. I really hope someone else has a better experience if they choose these guys because if you are a car salesman you should be FRIENDLY AND NICE.. if you don't like your job GET A NEW ONE you never know what kind of day someone is having, and to be nasty like these guys were just ruined our car buying experience now... so thanks guys!.... not.

Our first visit to McKenna's Kitchen this morning...couldn't be happier.  We had the Irish Fry and The Chipper.  After many trips to Ireland, and many Irish breakfasts, I can say this was among the very best we've had anywhere (Ireland and Northern Ireland included).  The meats were tasty and prepared perfectly; potatoes, scrambled eggs, and beans were terrific.  Glasses of juice were served in charming handled mason jars, but more important, the juice was fresh.  Generous portions of food and beverage, and a total 2-person check under $23.00 before tip.  Excellent service from a server named Courtney.  We will be going back again soon -- for dinner next time (BYOB) -- as that menu looks quite authentic.

only i would wait to do laundry until it was absolutely necessary (read: down to the undies i loatheeeee) and then find out my building's washer and dryer are on the fritz. AGAIN.

u-do-it laundry to the rescue! i was pleasantly surprised at the set up and although the big economy sized washer freaked me out, i dominated a few regular sized ones without any problem. i usually hate doing laundry, especially when it costs me money, but this was not bad. i will recommend to others.

Exceptional. A very special place worthy of all of its accolades. The service is excellent. Ambience steeped in romance. Food = wow. Steak Diane. Yellow fin carpaccio and heirloom tomato soup. Yummy. Polish it off with a nice Cabernet and all my taste buds were satiated.

This place is amazing. I'm an out-of-towner, needing a place to hang and get some work done for a few hours in Philly. I wish this coffee and tea shop were in my hometown of LA! The spicy chai latte is amazing, real brewed tea latte (not some gross syrupy stuff), and just the perfect hint of sweetness. The tables are large, the seating area bright, music appropriate to the shop and the perfect level to provide a little background but not distract. Free wifi, electrical outlets galore. Simply perfect. I'm jealous, Philly!

So I heard about this place from a co-worker, she raved about how awesome it was !! I had to try for myself.  The place is actually very small but busy!  The staff were VERY friendly and welcoming!  I have to say I loved the special hot dog bun they used... Fluffy, soft, chewy, and thick!  Not like your average bun!! So worth it! Best I have had!

Eaten in twice, had delivery probably 2-dozen times with coworkers. I recommend folks stick to the Vietnamese dishes. Their Chinese fried rice is pretty bland, and their hot and sour soup is very...unique... and not in a good way.  

Every time I order their crab rangoons, I forget how overdone they are, 100% of the time. It's a shame because the filling is scrumptious- maybe the best in the city - but the actual Rangoon is alwayyyys overdone and it's like biting into fried stale cardboard with a delicious filling. 

Here's what I LOVE at Moon Wok: 
*Spring rolls
*Tofu Bahn Mi
*Vermicelli Noodle Salads

The delivery folks are *always* very prompt and always friendly. Nice job with that, y'all.  While the menu has hit-or-miss items that I wish they'd rework, Moon Wok is a FQ staple and you should give it a shot :-)

The only bad thing about this place was the 40 minute wait to be seated (even though they said 20 to 30 min) Was so worth the wait. Great friendly staff, love the little breads and the cinnamon butter they serve while waiting for the food. Huge portions we didnt get the steak we both had chicken I also had the pulled pork. I will be going again to try the steak. We prefer pinnacle peak for steak so we thought we would be cheating on them if we tried the steak LOL. We will though next time we go

Delicious. Great customer service and the place is always clean. The owner works hard at keeping the place in top condition. Free music on Saturdays and Sundays - gets crowded so bring a chair. They have specials - including a bacon flavored treat. The banana splits are huge and more than one person can eat. The turtle sundae is a great reason to visit. A family favorite.

I was really excited to try this place since it had such great reviews. I went during their happy hour, so I figured I'd save a few bucks. I was in no rush, I was off that day & wanted to treat myself before my upcoming trip to Miami. I booked a gel pedicure and gel manicure. They did both of those services at the same time which was very uncomfortable because I was unable to just sit and play on my phone like I normally do. They stated they did this because most people are in a rush and they can book more people throughout the day (makes sense, I get it) but there weren't even massage chairs to relax, so I felt more stressed than relaxed. Anyway, whatever, I paid $70 and saved $10 for the happy hour special so total would've been $80 if I didn't go for HH. Normally, I pay $60 so I was excited thinking my nails would hold up awhile, but that was not the case. My pedicure is still holding up, but they did not scrape or use a razor to get off my dead skin which I'm normally used to being done. So with that said, not 100% pleased. Now my manicure, I went in on a Tuesday and by Sunday my one fingernail peeled off. I called Monday when they were opened and went in to get it fixed. The woman said there was another nail peeling so she fixed that as well (Free of charge, which I was very satisfied with). She was awesome, she spent more time than she should've fixing my nails, because she knew I had a big trip the following day. Well here I am on Wednesday in Miami and a whole different nail peeled off. I know it's just nails and I'm sounding dramatic, but when you pay $84 for a service (with tip) it should last for more than a few days. Okay, rant over! I guess give it a try for yourself, maybe I just had a bad experience.

Breakfast and lunch only.    The food is very inexpensive.  I went there for lunch.

The restaurant itself is a bit of a dive but appeared to mostly clean.  The staff was friendly and unintrusive.   I had a side salad--very basic but the ingredients were clearly not from a bag.  The salad dressing was served on the side a most likely was not homemade.  I also ordered the pulled pork and angus beef sliders.  Pulled pork was homemade and delicious but came with a BBQ sauce that probably came from a bottle.  The angus patty was a bit dry but still flavorful.  They were $3 each and at that price was worth it.

Beer and wine were on the low-quality scale (Bud light, opened bottles of 1 liter wines) and are not recommended.

Three stars because the quality:price ratio was good.

Outstanding! Split the Batali with my husband and went downstairs for charcuterie for two and local beers. I easily could've eaten my own sandwich-/it was amazing! Ended our visit with the Spinoni and Baklava gelato. If we are ever in Indy again, this will be our first stop!
The tour was very interesting and creepy! One of my favorite things I did in Virginia City.

I googled breakfast restaurants & this place came up. I had the crabmeat Benedict & my son had chocolate chip pancakes. The food was so great, and the coffee is delicious and full bodied. I also had a grilled cinnamon bun which I was excited to see on their menu! Our server was very friendly and attentive. It's a relaxed atmosphere, you seat yourself and pay at the counter. I will definitely be going back to this place!

Burrito includes rice beans bell pepper and salsa for $7.50. That is not a lot of variety for the cost. Also they charge extra for a bowl. I paid for chips and salsa but they forgot my salsa and charged me for guacamole. I asked for the receipt but they said they don't give out receipts. 

I recommend going somewhere else. 

Taste was okay too. Not much flavor.

We ended up here for Christmas Eve dinner.  I waited too long and was unable to get a table elsewhere.  The place is small (at least the inside eating area) and somewhat inviting.  Could not really feel a "vibe" here.  The food was good, most of our party ended up with burgers and thought they were great.  The menu is not very extensive.  I had a heck of a time getting a simple salad ( that's what they are called on the menu) with some chicken.  I think if you like out of the way places with a somewhat natural menu this is a place for you.  I prefer to be in the hubbub of state street but can appreciate the lack of car fumes.  My only negative about this place is the waitress (with short brunette hair) referenced in other reviews
, she was a bit curt and unwelcoming.
Don't know why there are so many poor reviews. The waitresses and staff are the friendliest in the city!

I'm looking forward to making this 4 a 5 as Blossom continues to get settled into this spot. Great service. Very good food. There's been some transition recently, and I think it's for the better. Looking forward to eating a lot of noodles here.

I have to agree with the negative posters. This is the second time I have been there. The first time was enough not to make me go back...but I tried again. If you are not in a hurry and do not mind chasing servers for a refill or napkins or whatever....or If you like sandwiches with 2oz's of meat  (the turkey wrap) or a burger ordered medium and comes out well done Panache is for you. I think it's more of a happy hour bar crowd that will enjoy anything after a few drinks. The food/portions are fair at best. Noise level when busy is a different subject. In summary... trust the reviews they are real time. And sadly nobody likes to give that kind of feedback...however the restaurant earned it.

We came here today in a group of four, with two people who frequently enjoy Sangkee's lunch specials throughout the week and recommend it for the value.

I got the Beef Chow Fun after seeing it look incredibly appetizing in a picture from another yelp review - it definitely did not disappoint. The meal was HUGE! Everyone at the table was able to have a decent portion and we still had some left to take home. They didn't skimp on the beef, which was flavorful and tender, and the noodles had just the right amount of chew to them.

The Ja Jang Mein was also delicious, though much different than its Korean counterpart. It didn't come drowning in a overly sweet and thick black sauce; instead, it was lightly coated in more of a brown sauce with a spicy, sweet, savory flavor to it. I think it may have been the best dish.

We also ordered the roast pork soup with wontons added to it, and once again, huge portion! The broth was pretty mild but complemented the pork and wontons well. Lastly, we ordered the dim sum sampler and I thought every last thing in there was really tasty. The soup dumplings were even better than the ones at Dim Sum Garden!

I do want to give honorable mention to the waiter - he really made the experience for me. Quick, attentive, and super engaging and funny. Highly recommend this spot if you want some good Chinese food for an awesome price.

I visited the Presbytere, Cabildo, Old US Mint, and WWII Museum before coming here, and would rate this place above all of them. One reason may be that the founders (General L. Kemper and Leila Williams) left a sizable endowment which has been put to good use. The displays and interpretation are high quality, and there are very knowledgeable docents posted throughout to answer questions. Unfortunately our time there was limited, but I would have liked to find out more about Gen. and Mrs. Williams' role in the early preservation movement in the French Quarter; it sounds like they were instrumental. I would also recommend the house tour, what a deal!

Stopped by on a Monday evening to have a pre-dinner cocktail with Erin and Tim G. I really wanted to come to try the Dark & Stormy they raved about and also the summer salad, which Erin raved about. 

I was seated quickly and offered a menu. It isn't that big, but there area  couple things that were of vegetarian appeal. Since this was just the first stop of the night, I decided to try everything the G's recommended: Dark and Stormy, salad, and rice & beans. They came fairly quickly and they were all delicious. The drink definitely tasted like ginger ale. Yum! I was offered more but stuck to one so I could drink more at our next stop and be safe. The salad was fresh, full of fruit and cheese, and with yummy dressing. The rice and beans were spicy, but not too much. Good recommendations! 

The place wasn't busy at 5:30pm on Monday but more people were trickling in as we were leaving. Got the check when we asked and we were off to our next spot!

This place is surprisingly great for a liquor "superstore." Of course they have a huge selection from the cheapest stuff you could imagine to some really nice high end stuff, but the staff is also very attentive, knowledgeable, and helpful.

A perk of being such a big retailer is that they are more likely to get access to some of the limited edition products. This was the only place in the area I was able to find the Four Roses 2013 Limited Edition Single Barrel for my husband for our anniversary.

They do have a nice high gravity beer selection as well as a cigar humidor and beer store next door that has a good selection of beer that I don't see everyday at other stores.

I made a res for four for Saturday night. They seated us outside, which was nice. The weather was perfect. The sidewalk seating is LOUD. That should come as no surprise as you are seated next to the busiest street in WC. Anyway our server was perfect: attentive, she had the specials memorized, and could answer questions and offer advice on anything on the menu. The place has an awesome bar. The wine list is big, there are at least 10 beers on tap, and the seasonal cocktail list is creative. The choices we made were all great. I ordered the bucatini amatriciana, my wife got the lobster ravioli, daughter ordered the gnocchi, and my son got the grouper special. Highly recommended, and I will visit again the next time we need some awesome Italian fare.
Repaired a cracked iphone 5c screen and iphone 4 back. I came in at 4:45 and they were done by 6 for a very reasonable price. Cheapest I have found for iphone 5c screens. I would highly recommend.

I've been following Dedo's on Social Media for probably a year now, and finally checked them out a few weeks ago when they set up outside my work (Kudos to any food truck willing to come all the way out to Alberta Hospital!).

They had quite a varied menu for a food truck, but I was immediately drawn to the shwarma poutine.  It's like a jacked up donair poutine with a lot more flavour!  The garlic sauce they use is absolutely delicious and the meat is seasoned and flavoured really well.

These guys know what they're doing.  The wait was not ridiculous like it is with other food trucks.  

I'm definitely going to have to track them down again before the season is over!

I think this might be in my top 3 favorite places in Downtown East.

I didn't even think I'd ever get excited about calzones. But I get excited about these calzones. I've been here four times, and it's so crazy consistent.

This place is called what it is because you get sauces... on the side... of your calzone. It's great.

First time in, work lunch with a Magic Carpet Ride. I was like, "Can I take a magic carpet ride?" and the girl at the register didn't really acknowledge how funny I thought I was. I wasn't funny. But I laughed at myself anyway and then ordered a craft soda BECAUSE THEY HAVE SOME CRAFT SODA. I like that this is a thing starting to happen more commonly around STL now.

Anyway, that Magic Carpet Ride calzone. Ace. There's a lot of good stuff in that one, and I don't feel like I can focus in on any one thing. So I'll just let you know that it was ace.

I can't remember what I got the second time but I know I liked it.

Third time in, I carried out Figgy Piggy for dinner and ate it in my apartment obnoxiously fast and it only felt a little sad. It was awesome. I didn't think I liked figs, but figs and bacon and everything else shoved in that calzone were incredible. However, I missed something. It was the garlic butter sauce (on the side) from the Magic Carpet Ride.

So the most recent time in, I got the Carmen. Dude. The prosciutto and capicola were both gold. Meat gold. I think that one's my favorite one so far, and it comes with that Garlic Butter. This whole thing will make you fat and happy.

I feel like they give you just enough food where you're bummed that you've finished it but, realistically, you're not hungry anymore and don't actually believe you should eat more, for the sake of your health. Also, it's all just about $10. I don't feel like I'm spending too much or too little. It's just right for what you're getting. And it's not slow, but it does take a minute.

Also they deliver. Bonus! And also one time I watched a guy stare straight ahead while using a Google Glass. Bonus!

Get the heck in here and make yourself happy.

Andy's Deli is a quick service lunch line type place.  They have a ton of options - maybe too many to execute them all well.  The owners and employees are friendly and the long line moves fast.  The sandwiches I have had there are OK, but their portions are large and could easily be shared.  I haven't had any of their hot specials.  It is a good option if you are desktop dining and need to grab something quick.  It is not something I would go out of my way for.

This restaurant was our regular birthday dinner location for years, due to the consistently good food it offers.  The bread is excellent, the Bang Bang shrimp is a classic, and the twin lobster tails made a great dinner for two...they are actually some of the best lobster dishes you can get in middle TN. However, given the recent explosion of restaurants in the Brentwood and Nashville area, it might be worthwhile to explore a bit more for more creative dishes.  Bonefish Grill will serve you the standard fish, vegetable, starch combination and do it well, and their lobster is among the best in the area, but don't expect anything out of the box or particularly creative.
They've still got it. Big. Cheap. Don't order too much. Drink the bloody tea.

The lost of a star is due to the impact on my wallet. Delicious lunch options marred only by the price - $60 lunch was enough to make me shuck myself. And it wasn't that the food wasn't worth it but $14 for a burger or ruben... $3 to add a tiny cup of soup, and you're going to have to have waitstaff that can do back flips in order to earn my loyalty. But I guess with such a dedicated following of patrons and well-wishers, and a great spot on the Philly "Best Restaurant" list, they can afford to not be able to afford me. 

Still super cute, will be back for beers and oysters at the bar... I hear the happy hour specials are fab!

My craving for fresh pressed juice was calling and I wanted to visit somewhere different.  I intentionally passed up JUS right next to my house then made the long trek to Rawbry, which is in the heart of downtown. Robbery is right, this place is super expensive!  The juices were already pressed into bottles from two days prior and waiting to be sold for $9 in the refrigerator.  The only drinks they were making fresh were the smoothies.  This was on a Saturday and the store was very quiet.  The employee was friendly, smiley, and patient with all of my questions.  She said they press the produce into juices twice a week, Mondays and Thursdays.  Of course I love the look of the store, it's trendy, it's hipster, etc., but this is Reno. The thought of spending $20 on two bottles of juice when I can buy pounds of fresh, organic fruit for that price and juice at home just kills me.  The least they can do is throw in a free little sticker.  I'm glad I finally checked it out to see what all the hype is about.  I am a fan for the idea of what the business is and who doesn't love juice and smoothies!

I have been here twice with a group of co-workers, and I will summarize our experience with this: great food, not the best for being able to hear the person sitting two chairs down from you. It's a bustling place with attentive service and a menu that will have something for everyone.

Notable dishes:
Mortadella with hazelnut honey
Pecorino with almond honey
Swordfish meatballs
Monkfish
Branzino
(maybe skip the beef, it was over-seasoned)

My coworkers and I spent nearly three months working in a conference room here while our office was being renovated. My family loves Embassy Suites hotels, so I have been a frequent guest at many of their other locations, but never for this long! I am pleased to say I had just as nice of an experience as a daytime guest as I have as an overnight guest. We did not use guest rooms, just a conference room, but it was well-appointed and clean, as were the restrooms in the lobby and pool areas. The entire staff was very friendly, helpful, and attentive. Whenever we needed anything, like our trash emptied or our water cooler refilled, they responded to our request promptly (special shout-outs to Mariah, Mike, and the breakfast attendants--you went above and beyond!). We were not able to use the pool or exercise rooms, but the pool area is beautiful and the exercise room looked very nice. The breakfast is excellent and both the upstairs breakfast area balcony and the patio around the pool are a great place to enjoy lunch or read. This was as good as working out of a hotel can be!
I always have a good experience here. Staff is friendly and efficient. I've always trusted them to get my packages where they need to be, and they've always made it on time.
Russell houghton is  a bad ass mofo.....thank u  4 fixing my bike is a million times better and u didn't charge me a first born child SO THANK U

After touring the the public library decided to give Plow and Anchor a try. I'm so Glad we stopped in; I will definitely dine there again

Stuffed cabbage 
Fingerling potatoes in duck fat
Brussels sprout sweet and toasty
Grilled romaine 
Scallops all were delicious we did not leave a morsel of food on our plates!!

Best Italian food since we left Italy!  Fantastic!  This is our new favorite spot n SB.  We had the  homemade tortalini and the chicken
Piccata-
Both incredible!

The services was great, the food not so much. The piss clams were supposed to be littleneck clams and the fried green tomatoes were good but not tender. The mussles  were the only thing I had that was good. I also had the shrimp boil and for first time in my life I had the hardest time peeling the shrimp because they were over cooked, a lot of the shrimp was coming off attached to the shell. Out of three of us only 1 good meal was server it was the lobster boil and at $40 a pound thank goodness. The clam chowder was pink and  not New England style it was Cajun style so everything had a little spice to it. So if you are looking good seafood keep looking this is not the place!

What a great night! I called yesterday for a reservation tonight and even though the restaurant was booked solid, they worked us in. The restaurant is lovely and the wine collection is amazing. The staff was incredible. They made the experience. It was our anniversary and we wanted a night away from the kid. The food was fantastic. The mussels have a garlicky, buttery, fresh tomato sauce that is perfect for dipping the homemade focaccia bread in. The pork cheeks in Marsala sauce are delicious! Totally rich and dark without being too heavy. Mira was our server and she was so kind and attentive. The cannoli at the end of our meal was perfect. The most important thing about a good cannoli is the shell and it was crisp and fresh. The whole meal was wonderful. We sat and drank really good wine and ate a really great meal and enjoyed being together in a beautiful place. Highly recommend the restaurant and their staff.

We had a group of 10 to celebrate my 30th birthday up in Santa Barbara and my husband booked a bus to take us to and from a couple wineries. Ramon was THE BEST!!! He arrived early, was so kind and funny, AND he was always smiling. He did whatever he could to make our experience top notch. I HIGHLY recommend Luxe Transportation and make sure you request Ramon!!

This is a great venue to see bands, comedians and movies. They constantly have a great rotating selection of films and some big names that play there. I saw the one movie I have always wanted to see on the big screen..."it's a Wonderful Life". 

I am extremely happy that the Colonial is almost restored its full glory.

This is the kind of place that makes me wish I were better at review writing.  If I were funny or hipper this review might begin to measure up to the quality of the food and service at this place.

I had the magic carpet ride, which is a bunch of different kinds of mushrooms, garlic, and two cheeses wrapped in a delicious crust.  The Sauce on the Side was a garlic butter sauce that I could drink with a straw!

Seriously, if you haven't tried this place do yourself a favor and get there!  I ate there yesterday and am already daydreaming about when I can get there next.  Not too many places have me that hooked...

We've become regulars! It's the perfect place to watch a game, catch up with friends and family and the food is SO good! I would give this 5 stars, but we've had poor service (same lady) the past few nights (not typical, assuming she's new). 

Bottom line: GREAT pizza, subs, salads and the cauliflower nachos are stupidly good, don't pass on them! Also, great beer selection! Perfect kid area!

If there is anything that you need to know about this place, or about life in general, I feel like Adrienne H. has it covered.  That review nailed it.

I only need to add my two cents. I use the "flawed" human interface system when ordering here. And I love it. Somehow they know my face, my order, and even my family.
