Outstanding! Bring your appetite and prepare yourself for all you can eat. We plan on going back many times.

The best  Chinese Buffet in town, and maybe one of the top 3 I've ever been to. King Buffet has a great seafood selection. Plenty of crab legs, but so funny when the owner dishes them out to your plate during holidays; guess he doesn't want you to eat too many during a visit to an ALL YOU CAN EAT BUFFET?

They also serve the traditional  Chinese food items, and have a bunch of fried food options. Also have oysters, clams, sushi (eh) and the salad bar is good. The dessert bar has an ice cream machine, cookies, and baked goods.

You can save a few bucks if you get a coupon in one of the local fliers, but you cant use them during holidays.
We have had nothing but positive experiences with Peter and his company. They go the extra mile to please the customer.  You get what you pay for.

This place is very true to the yelp reviews...Definitely a 5 star hole in the wall!!  There used to be a Hawaiian food truck in this location, which moved to N. Dale Mabry and now it became Kombo Kitchen.  They also have the adjacent building so there are plenty tables to eat in.  There are about 10 parking lot for this place but you can also street park.  

Their food is fresh, and very tasty.  My friend and I ordered fried dumplings, spicy drunken noodle and crab fried rice with Thai ice teas.  Everything was delicious. The drunken noodle was definitely spicy even tho we ordered American spicy.  So do not go Thai spicy on that one.  That would be a mistake.  I was so glad I had the Thai ice tea on the side for my burning mouth lol, which needed a bit more ice.  

The service was awesome!  A young Asian gentlemen was so nice, friendly and attentive.  Also, the female chef said hi and checked on us if everything was good out of the truck window at the end :)  

I really hope this place will stay the same and keep up their food quality and service, because I will definitely come back!  Kombo Kitchen has now became my favorite Thai place in Tampa.

I've been a patron of this salon for probably as long as it's been opened (8 years). If you are looking for 1st class....this is it!  First the owner, Bill is very meticulous and a clean freak. You won't find any dirt or filth here. You will also be pampered. He will make sure that you have the right lotion you need for your skin type and when you are finished tanning, he will clean the bed.  If you are not a tanning bed fan, then come for a customized air brush tan.  You will be more even than any machine can give you.  And the customers favorites thing....NO CONTRACTS OR AUTOMATIC DEBITS! This is priceless! Your visits never expire unless you do unlimited starting less than $20 a month.
Super fun atmosphere - one of my favorite places in Nashville - but DO NOT leave coats/jackets on the railing on the rooftop. Others will take them and laugh when you ask for them back! #rude

Have held off posting, but yeah, this company is BY FAR the WORST "property management" group ever. I've been renting from them since last November, a laundry list of major items, some, that TO THIS DAY, still haven't been fixed. 1970's appliances were all falling apart, a fridge where the shelves fall off when putting ANYthing on them, missing shelves; a dishwasher so corroded and smelly (all I was told was "go to Home Depot and get ____ to clean it"); AC/heat didn't work - in fact I HAD NO HEAT the first month (Nov-Dec, even past New Years); and the stove - piece of crap electric stove that either doesn't cook enough, or scorches food. "Scheduling" the new dishwasher replacement was a nightmare to the extent the delivery company had to send the appliance back to wherever it came from because delivery date for some reason couldn't be coordinated within their 10-day delivery window, so I'm still without a properly functioning dishwasher, and because this awesome property management company tries to save money, they've been trying to coordinate to pick up old dishwasher, and old fridge at the same time - and of course there's NOwhere to put the fridge except in the garage, where now, I can't park both cars. At this point I wont' call out the "agent" i've been dealing with. Suffice to say "they" have already been called out. This company is so bad, i'm considering legal action. It's just deplorable to think companies get away this shit. I should have paid more attention to the Yelp reviews, and my own Red Flags (like required to sign documentation that I wouldn't convert this nice home into a meth lab) - really??? I was really looking forward to that! (???) crazy fucks.
So delicious. Everything I have eaten is wonderful and tapas is so fun and great because everyone shares all the food. Highly recommended!

I started buying their beans at Weaver's Way coop several years ago and loved the product. Their new cafe is bright, clean, and modern. Responsibility for the source,  consistent product, and best cold brew you can get make for a great mix.  I enjoy them at the local farmers markets, store shelves, and most importantly from the source in Lansdale.

Absolutely horrible! This is my second bad experience with them, I forgave them on the first....this time, we ordered a porkroll sandwich, just awful...porkroll was done to a crisp with burnt edges, very small piece of cheese and most of the sandwich was bread! Upon calling, they acted like it was brain science, passing me from one employ to the next, was on hold for five minutes, and all we wanted was a new sandwich! The girl, who barely speaks English, actually told me she wants the old sandwich back, now...I don't mind returning the sandwich, it was lousy, but...that's poor customer service, most places would say, just keep it, or not even mention it and just send you a new, better one...They acted like we were terrible people all because they can't make a sandwich correctly...as mentioned, second bad experience, first one was with tuna hoagie, which was dry , no cheese...don't go here!

Pets R Us stopped selling puppies!! This is wonderful! They are mainly a pet supply store with smaller pets like fish and spiders now. They sell organic pet food and other items like collars, leashes and pet clothes. I got the cutest collars for my puts and some great organic treats there. I am so happy they stopped selling puppies. It is a wonderful move for them. I hope they succeed like this and show the world that puppies exploited to have a successful business. There are plenty of other places to get puppies without having them "stored" in a pet store. :)

While in New Orleans we found out about this tour by doing some online searching for things to do. I was very excited to go on this tour because it is not often you get to say you went on a rum distillery tour. 
Upon arrival we were greeted by the friendly staff and a drink of the Cajun spice rum mixed with tea. It was fantastic!! 
Our tour guide was awesome and had a lot of knowledge about the distillery. It was great to learn about its history and to hear about how they were affected by the hurricane. At the end of the tour we got to try all four of the rums they sell! It was awesome and worth the $10. I did not buy a bottle for myself since I don't drink like that but I would like to get one to display. I did buy a shot glass for my collection though and will display it proudly. 
If visiting New Orleans this is a must thing to do.
This is a small Publix so they don't always have everything you need. Sometimes it's crowded and the lines are long. However, customer service has always been good.
Good bagel shop. Reasonably priced. Great customer service. Bagels are good but not great.

I can confidently tell you that Ginger Beard makes the BEST cold brew nitro in Tampa. I've even gotten into the habit of buying a growler for the week! I also have tried cold brew nitro from many other coffee places in Tampa, and none even hold a candle to these guys. Also, the gentlemen that run Ginger Beard are two of the nicest small business owners we've met!
Cannot recommend this place enough.

I went here for the first time on Tuesday for lunch and ordered the chef style pasta with marinara sauce. I told them I only had about 30 min for lunch and even though they were fairly busy they got my food out to me very quickly and it was delicious! Great service and great food.

This place is mediocre at best. If you have a hankering for seafood, you get what you want. However, it isn't well cooked. 

This location is extremely busy and made for half-assed service. We were placed in a high traffic area by the kitchen doors when there was much better seating that was empty and clean. I don't get this phenomenon in restaurants and it generally annoys me. 
We waited 40 minutes for our salads and received the biscuits at about the same time. 

I've had much better dining experiences at other Red Lobster locations. This one just misses the mark. 

Yelp 30 Day Challenge: 19/30

First time we went there sat at bar!!  Got served right away and met joe he was a great attentive bar guy he also had help from a another bar tender they were awesome....food was average crab cake sandwich very small wishing it was bigger !!  But very tasty ,.,second time my wife visited Friday night 8-31  .. sat at a table... ordered drinks took 15 minutes to get a beer and our friend did not get the drink the way she wanted it so they redid the drink for her only to be disappointed again ..? Manger came over to try to make it right ..  which he gave us money off bill but do not know if our friend will return .Because of her disappointment over a simple drink request.... thanks for trying to make it right ..p.s.  my burger was way over cooked and lacked flavor but I did not want add already dissatisfied feeling ..  will be back for another try when things get better ....

Loved the atmosphere. Hot Jerry was not too exciting: more like traditional caugh syrups. Too spicy for my taste.

NOTE: I EDITED MY REVIEW AFTER checking in more times. The service is poor. And, food is just ok. I'm going to give this place a last try. Hope that they don't disappoint me.

We stopped by because this coffee shop was close to our hotel and it already had some pretty good reviews on Yelp. The space itself is very cute and minimally designed. They have artwork on the wall for sale, and everything was very clean and modern. 

The barista was very helpful for answering our questions, and made some delicious coffee! I opted for the vanilla latte, and it was easily one of the best vanilla lattes I've ever had. It's probably because they infuse their own simple syrups, so the vanilla flavor was so much more real than the typical syrups at other shops.

My cousin is vegan and loved that they had both soy and almond milk, and loved her almond milk coffee a lot. We hung out there, taking advantage of the wifi and comfortable seating before doing more exploring of the city. Highly recommend!

From what I have seen, they sell everything at the same price as other budget-friendly places (Amazon, manufacturer website, Walmart, etc.).  In addition, the shopkeeper is super friendly.  I am not used to super-friendly stores.. maybe it is my neurotic southern California mentality but I tend to feel like shop keepers are suspicious of me if they approach me.  He was just very nice.  Great Bodum selection!!!  And when you walk in, it immediately smells of sweet, delicious coffee.

This place is the best! We love their breakfast and lunch! It is our go to local place. The specials are amazing. The chicken berry salad is my favorite salad anywhere. Soups are always good. The setting is not fancy or pretentious but welcoming and sweet. Perfectly cooked eggs and fast service. Great for lazy mornings with takeout from here is a nice start to a weekend.

Yum! I had a mini sweet potato pie, and my friend got a slice of coconut cake. The pie was excellent and I could've eaten 5 more - should've got a larger one. The cake was great, but I'm not a fan of coconut cake in general so I'm not a great judge.

The Iron Abbey is a woodsy midevil  nook set on the hills of Horsham next to Na'Brasa and The Wings of Freedom Aviation Museum. It's easy to miss on the outskirts of town but it packs some serious food points, and though it's pricey it has an ideal happy hour for food and beverage.

Most importantly Iron Abbey stands out by having a huge and remarkable craft beer selection and very responsible and knowledgeable staff. At happy hour the best of the best prices are cut in half and trimmed down to a ten beer selection giving you a little bit of everything, even sours! In addition they have the largest amount of half price appetizers at happy hour compared to all, and I mean all, local restaurants.

This place is pretty cheap to get your eyebrows done ($7) and they do a pretty good job. Rina and Ruby are pretty nice and sweet. The only thing about it is, it's right in front of the open where people first come In.  I wish it was more in a private or not in the open like that.

I have used the SWSG for a battery change and for an estimate on some watch repairs.  The battery change was done quickly and professionally -- the right way, with pressure testing.

I made the mistake of having my swiss watch battery replaced at a "jewelry store."  I wound up with water intrusion -- leading me to need the repair estimate mentioned above!  Never again...

I look forward to using SWSG for all my battery and maintenance needs on my swiss watches.

Other than a cafeteria with food ready to go, I've never had food served to me so fast in my life. This place was PACKED and finding a seat was tough. But before 2 of the 4 of us sat down, our food arrived.The building is amazing. The live entertainment was great. The service was top notch!

I had a full rack of Heaven-Lee Ribs with collard greens, mac n cheese and slaw. It was a big serving for lunch and probably should have only got half, but I ate the whole thing because it was delicious. I wish I could remember the sauce I used, but it was so tasty too. Oh, even the cocktails were nice. I would eat here again and again.

I used Royal Custom Tailor for years before moving out of Philly.  They're head and shoulders above any other tailor i've used in town, and i've used a number in Center City.  I have used them for alterations to dress shirts and suits, and i have always come away happy.

They're not expensive, but they're not cheap either.  That said, if you need something done by someone with actual skill and not just some fool with a sewing machine, then i wouldn't trust my clothes to anyone else.

On top of being an expert tailor, all the people there are very friendly and professional.

As to the other comments on getting things done on time, yes, they sometimes over-promise their turn-around time.  Definitely call ahead before picking up.  When i've had a strict deadline, i called a day in advance and simply confirmed that the work would be completed by the next day.
Average, at least for dinner. BBQ meat over cooked and fried chicken undercooked and underwhelming.

We were looking for a great cheese enchilada in Reno. Tried Yelp and found this place.  Good reviews, why not? Nice salsa bar, but the chips tasted old. We ordered the cheese enchiladas, chili rellanos, and a papusa. One chile rellano came-cold and cheese not melted. Three enchiladas-the cheese was the Cotija style-crumbly-inside the tortillas. Awful! The toppings were ice-cold. I have never had a cheese enchilada made with that style cheese. Garnished-yes-main ingredient, no. The papusa was good, but greasy-that gave it the one star..

Just reopened after renovations. Looks nicer but ambience is not what this is about. Food is as great as ever as are prices. 
Chinese comfort food. Fish slices in congee was so delicious, not fishy smell, just fresh slices of meaty fish fillets in flavored rice porridge and hint of ginger and green onions. I also ordered shrimp cheun fun, steamed cannelloni but rice flour pasta so delicate that it's like a veil. Stuffed with whole shrimp and served with a aromatic soy sauce topping. Hit the spot on a rainy day

I enjoyed my food. I went with other guest. I can eat breakfast any time of the day. It's my favorite meal. However there were not that many options for my guest who are not into eating breakfast late. The atmosphere is casual. We ate outside. I was happy and the prices are fare.

We had a great dinner here. The seating area was warm and cozy, with a little fire, the service was friendly and efficient, and the food was excellent. The arugula salad was one of the best salads I've ever had. The entrees were a tad small (big eaters might be disappointed), but I asked if they had any sides, and they made me some Brussels sprouts, so I got fullish. Great cheesecake, too. Go.

I love everything about this salon. Over the passed few months, Dana has taken me from dyed black hair to a gorgeous silver! She made my dreams come true! Plus, everyone in the salon is super friendly! 6 stars if I could.

Wow! Every place should be like this. I just wish I liked oysters more. Everything about this place is wheelchair accessible and convenient. It was my first time trying raw oysters and it wasn't a thing I was crazy about but I would definitely go back. The staff was helpful and full of recommendations for a newcomer. My date is crazy about oysters so we tried a lot of things and our waiter made some tastey suggestions. Great place.

If you happen to come through Millersville/Whitehouse this place is worth stopping for. The food is awesome I had a bbq sandwich with potato salad and it was awesome. The meat was so tender and flavorful. Also, the staff is very friendly. You can tell it has great food since all the local law enforcement come here lunch daily. They keep bbq sauce on the table for you. The only downside to this restaurant is that there not much space for a lot of people. Other than that this place is amazing and deserves 6 stars

This was a great place to enjoy the Irish festival.  Shaded, spacious and friendly outdoor café.  Immediate, professional waitress table service.  Generous portions.  We enjoyed their Montreal corned beef in honor of the day--great as a side with a wedge salad and delicious on a pretzel bun.  Wasn't fond of the coleslaw thrown on the sandwich instead of on the side.  Side salad was big but lettuce not cut up well-enjoyed the cilantro lime dressing.  Sandwiches ran about $10.  Great grainy mustard aioli. Decent bathrooms, too.  had security bouncer at the door.

Went the this evening 2/18 and had dinner with some family. Dry burgers....but what was worse was the rude waitress. Short with dark frizzie hair. Wow! You should learn some customer service and some etiquette in that line of work. We still tipped you at least 15% even though it was not deserved.
If I could give them 6 stars I would. The food is amazing!!! What really sold it for me is the great staff... Very helpful and engaging. Thanks!

Been coming to the Brewhouse for a few years now. The beer is excellent and the food is second to none. The bartenders and servers are very educated to the brewing process and the Brewers are always here to answer all your questions. I've been to a few breweries and this one is my favorite. I drive 2.5 hours to get here. Any stay the night locally. They always give you the best service!!!

This place kind of confused me because it's like a sports bar but then it serves some random Asian things on the menu? But they have a good beer selection. I like beer and I like spring rolls so I enjoyed it but I would only go back if I needed a place to catch a game.
Great food even better service my waitress Jordan was amazing she will definitely be the reason I return

Open your mind and also your mouth during the next meal you find yourself prone to doubts and biased to your preconceptions. I found myself needing to do just that on my recent visit to Legal Sea Foods, where I ordered the Portuguese Fisherman's Stew and it seemed like something I wouldn't enjoy upon actually seeing it. Why, you ask? The ingredients summoned up a terrible stew prejudice in me, one of the worst sort. There were a bunch of mussels, cod, and chorizo in a thin tomato saffron broth, accompanied by a thick slice of buttered bread that spent too much time in the oven. My initial thoughts were this isn't a "stew", the bread makes it way too caloric, there's no decent starch (bread for stew is a clear violation of stew creation laws, no?), the broth isn't thick enough, I don't really like mussels, the list goes on. Well, I decided to calm my jumpy mind, since I practically ordered the entree off its name alone without paying close attention to the details. No sense jumping to conclusions when the so-called stew was staring me in the face, especially since it ended up being pretty close to menu description (checked later); me not liking disclosed ingredients is certainly no fault of the restaurant. So begrudgingly then, I opened my mind to the dish, and it turned out the stew was very good! And even more contrary my initial thoughts, when I gave in to the siren's song of that buttery bread, the stew was exceptional. I broke the bread into pieces and mixed them throughout my stew, and the meal suddenly became all the more stew-like and far tastier--a wonderful combination of flavors and textures. My expectations of the at-first questionable meal were far wrong, and I left enlightened. So after my questionable meal, will I be back to Legal Sea Foods? You bet.

Excellent food and service. Pleasant ambiance. Meet the owners and the chefs. They will come out and spend time with you to make sure you are having an enjoyable and memorable culinary experience. You will come again and again.
Great takeout!  I love their curries and my 4-year old inhaled the chicken satay and pad see you. Fun dinner for the whole family!!
Delicious cuisine (try the Salmon), excellent service and beautiful ambiance, but you already knew that! Four star chef & now finally the crown jewel of Newtown that was really meant to be!

This is a nice hotel, even though the address is incorrect.  I stayed at the 2nd Extended Stay America located about 400ft. from this one.  (The one I stayed at has no Yelp page but can be found at 500 Diemer Dr.)Anyway, the rooms were clean and spacious.  Mine had a full kitchen, microwave and toaster oven.  They even had dishes and silverware in the drawers. The bed was comfy, although I'm not sure I agree with having two down pillows and two regular pillows in the room.  In the middle of the night I would wake up to the sound of the heater rattling, and have to turn it off before I slammed my head down on a feather sticking out of the pillow. Aside from that, the staff was very friendly and helpful.  I would definitely recommend this hotel.  There is one strange thing though.  The maid only comes once a week.  No one cleaned up my room for the four days I stayed there.  I guess that's how this place is, but it didn't take away from my stay at all.

Rapid service, mostly mediocre food. Nothing made me say, "Yummmm!" I also didn't want to spit it out and leave, either. Large selection of beer (which they also deliver). Friendly staff. Clean with appropriate decor.

I got the chicken ranch wrap, my partner got a cheese steak  (which was tasty, but they skimped on the meat) and my kid got the cheese sticks (basically pizza strips with no sauce).

In response to Tommy's comment (since for some reason we can't do that on here):
Yes, definitely service was lovely. What "high end restaurant brand of ranch are you referring to? I hear you that you have pre-portioned meat... I'm sure that is helpful for you guys. No disrespect intended as I understand you are running a business, just not what I am accustomed to and not something that screams, "EAT AT TOMMY'S!"
This was an AWESOME time. Jackson was a fantastic tour guide and kept us very safe. So so so incredibly happy we went. We saw dolphins in person up and close for the first time :) thank you!!!

Moderate food in a pleasant environment. If you know how British style fish and chips should be, don't order them here. 

Worth the eat but don't expect fine dining.
By far the best beer bar in SJ.  The food is above average pub grub.  Always efficient services.

Fast and friendly

I was taken care of as soon as I drove even close to the garage. I thought these guys did a fantastic job of being courteous, professional and quick with their service.

I came during the morning when it wasn't too busy but I can imagine the service is the same during all hours.

Wish we checked yelp out first... Surly girl who answered the phone. Obviously hates her job and that should have been our first cue. Fairly fast delivery but I can only surmise that's due to the lack of care, quality and quantity. Gyro should have said "salad in a pita with 1/2 oz dried meat-ish" (or less), cheese sticks were about a buck a piece and not worth it, fried mushrooms were soggy and falling apart, and the skin was still on the eggplant in the sub. Obviously still in business because of hungry sucker tourists like us... Sad night in Tampa. Still hungry. Round two at Mama Rosa's...

I want to single this place out for two reasons. 
First, we recently had my son's rehearsal dinner there. Everything was perfect, from the help in planning, to the room, to the food, to the service. I would recommend them without reservation.
Second, for their integrity as business people. My vehicle was damaged that night by the valet. The valet company said all the right things about paying for it but then went radio silent. Merchants management took quick action (they had fired the valet company shortly thereafter for other reasons), and when the other company still refused to pay, Merchants sent me a check. All of this happened in short order. 
We don't always see this kind of honorable business behavior and I wanted to salute them for it.

Living in Tampa, Thai food is a pretty touchy subject.  It's a very difficult town to find Thai food worth talking about.  That's why I'm so surprised it took us two years to find out about Sawatdee.  It's the best Thai I've had so far since we moved here.

We arrived around 6, so it was just before the dinner rush and we were able to be seated and waited on fairly quickly.  However, the place is small with a limited staff, so by the time we were leaving the place was filling up.  Otherwise, the staff was friendly and attentive, and I enjoyed the decor and intimate size of the place.

We both ordered Thai iced coffees and decided to share fried tofu as an appetizer. The coffees were great, though a little on the small side.  The tofu was slightly underdone, but personally I prefer it that way over the super puffy fried tofu.  We received the appetizer fast and we got our food before we were even done with it.  Our server regularly checked if we wanted water or anything else.

For the main course, my fiance decided to get the standard pad thai.  Pad thai is something she likes a lot and is usually a good indicator of the caliber of a restaurant.  If you mess up pad thai, then the rest of your food probably isn't going to be all that good.  She enjoyed hers, though her one complaint was the lack of vegetables- only bean sprouts to go along with the noodles.  

I had the green curry with beef and was very pleased.  The mix of chile oil and coconut milk was spot on, so it was the right amount of spice without feeling too heavy.  In contrast, my plate also had a lot of veggies including peas, carrots, eggplant and bamboo.  I was very pleased to have such an enjoyable green curry again after so long.

With our coffees, appetizer, and two entrees the bill came out to around $30 which is pretty standard for around here.   Portion sizes were big but not enormous, and I feel that I got my money's worth.

So long review short- most Thai restaurants in Tampa are forgetable at best, but we really look forward to giving Sawatdee another try later to see if they continue to impress us.

This won't take long. Are you really that hungry?  

Service, slow and not at all attentive. Food, on by very strict definition. Cleanliness, not so much. Coffee, sickening. 

Can you give less than one star. It's an airport, we don't really expect that much. Unfortunately they didn't deliver even at that reduced level.

I live around the corner from this place and have gotten pickup a few times since they reopened. It's always done by the time they say it will be and the food is hot and fresh. Their sauce is really good, the inside of the shop looks nice since it reopened, and the owners are always friendly. I would definitely recommend this place!

Donuts and coffee are my two favorite things. I have been known to pay 6.00 for a single donut in NYC. I stumbled on this place next to my hotel and don't know where to start. The coffee is local rich and yummy. The donuts are nothing less than sublime. I started shaking when I saw a selection I had never seen before. The friendly person helping me recommended the hipsterberry. OMG I am licking my fingers and typing this while I eat. YUM! I'll be back for breakfast and later for a box to take on the plane Score!

I cannot say enough about how wonderful a day Sandy (and Dee) created for my group. From the moment we were picked up to the every last moment of the day  (9 hours later) we laughed and enjoyed ourselves immensely. The value of this trip far exceeds the very reasonable price. No detail was left un attended to and the bonus of having a local guide mix-up the choices of where to go based on our spur of the moment decisions was absolutely tremendous. Many more stars to you DeeTours.

Most of this review will probably echo what reviewers before me have said: the spring rolls are good, but the chicken wings are FANTASTIC (beware, you'll be washing your hands after enjoy the gooey, delicious mess): seasoned and flavorful and different. 

As far as the pho itself, other commenters are right--it's not traditional Vietnamese nor is it meant to be. The options for meat are more expensive, trendy, varied and well-cooked than you'd normally get, but the broth for me was a little disappointing (blander?), although I can quite put my finger on it.

All in all, any "complaints" about the food aren't complaints at all--everything was quite good. The most disappointing part for me was the atmosphere of the restaurant. Something cold and stark about the interior made everyone whisper. It just wasn't that comfortable or inviting. That said, I was there for lunch so perhaps it is livelier for dinner service?

I went to the RTM on saturday 1/19.  I was in the mood for some different cheeses as I love to try new things.  I asked the guy at the counter if he could help recommend some good cheeses.  He went and got another worker that proceeded to put together 4 different cheeses for me and kept it within my budget.  I told him i wanted to try interesting cheeses but not break my bank.  He asked how much i was looking to spend, i told him around $20.  After putting together a nice selection he rang me up and it only came to just over $17.  He told me that putting together cheeses for customers that aren't cheese experts was what made his job so enjoyable.  He also suggested another cheese shop around the corner that had a must taste cheese.  All in all a great experience and I will certainly visit this shop everytime I am in RTM.

I had a couple of small projects, the sort that it is often hard to get anyone to bother with really, but Christian came right over and gave me an estimate and took on the projects immediately. His crew did a good job, despite some weather related delays, and I felt very comfortable having them in my house and around my dogs while I was at work. Christian maintains good contact throughout the job and always either answers the phone or returns calls promptly (a rare trait in contractors).

Highly recommended.

I fell in love with little cafe on my first trip and will certainly be frequenting it in the future. 

I ordered the Rancheros Crepes with fruit and it was just delicious! I'm no expert on crepes but mine filled with black beans, eggs, and cheese (plus a perfect amount of avocado, sour cream, and salsa on the side) hit the spot! Also, I chose the fresh fruit as my side which can be hit or miss but to my pleasant surprise the fruit was extremely fresh and had a great variety. My favorite part though was my own personal french press for my coffee. Such a great addition to an already great meal.

Highly disappointing dining experience. Food was three stars, but the service was undesirable. We had a group of eight and one dinner order was completely forgotten to be placed. They were very unapologetic for their mistake, and we were still charged full price for the forgotten meal (it came out about 30 minutes later when others were already finished). All the other meals came out very sporadically, so don't expect to be able to actually eat your meal with those you are dining with. The atmosphere was very cozy! But because of the service, I would solely recommend this place for take-out.

Ninja has become such a bummer since it changed ownership. Recipes have changed, corners have been cut, and there just isn't the same exacting quality. Cucumbers in the ninja salad aren't sliced as thin as they should be, the seasoned snow crab filling in many rolls has been replaced with plain crab stick, no more lemon slices on the rainbow roll, sushi rice is of variable quality (sometimes it's great, other times it doesn't hold together). 

It's too bad. This place used to be great. But, the new management just doesn't have the same commitment to quality.

I went here yesterday and had an hour long deep tissue massage.  The massage itself was great and the masseuse was very nice and professional.  The glass of wine and dessert at the end were nice touches.  I was however, turned off by the location of the spa inside an office building.  There were no signs from the outside from what I could tell and I wasn't sure if I was at the right place until I went in the building and found the listing for the tenants.  It just didn't have that spa feel that adds to the experience for me and I felt rushed towards the end to get out of there. I also found the robes to be too warming; I was sweating the entire time I was there.  All in all, 3 stars because of the atmosphere although the massage was great which is the most important part.

This is a really small grocery store. They do however, have a good beer selection and are open kind of late.Their produce, especially the fruit is actually pretty good. They also have some food 100 calorie snack selections. I don't usually use this for my full on grocery shopping but it's good for quick things.

This was my first time coming here because my boyfriend said it was very good. IT'S TERRIBLE. The service was bad. The waitress was rude and over charged me for my food. I should of not paid 30 $ for a slice of pizza and cheese fries and sandwich, and two sodas. I will not be coming back. Also after I posted this review I received a message  from someone that may or may not work at this estimate. I am just giving my review on my time at this restaurant and if you review is different then mine then so be it. This is a American and we all have the freedom of speech. I am not the best english speaking person or speller but no need to make me feel stupid. so thank you for pointing out that your better then me.

10% off yelp deal was icing on the already delicious cake. Lobster tail was delicious and so we the fried pickles, great view and atmosphere right off beach boulevard, waiter Thor was friendly and prompt. 5 stars for sure.

Locals place. Everyone seems to know everyone.  They get swamped and stay swamped as people from other tables visit with other tables. Not a fast turnover especially in the bar. Good food. Not to die for but better than most.

Wish I could give 0 stars. I was told over the phone that a hair trim (I did NOT say bang trim) would be $25. After I was seated, the hair dresser seemed befuddled and asked me what my definition of a "hair trim" was. I told him a trim is just taking off the ends of your hair, stating, I've never paid more than $30 without someone blowing out my hair. He said "ok, have a great day" and proceeded to walk away, leaving me to sit there embarrassed in front of a group of spectators.

To follow up, I received a voicemail from an incredulous manager, criticizing me for leaving a review rather than "following the proper protocol." I was never oriented on this "protocol," nor am I an employee of Crave who needs to follow any such "protocols." Rather than apologizing for her employee's unprofessional behavior, she told me it was "odd" and "unfortunate" that I went to social media to leave a review. It seems as though her willingness to "rectify the situation" was rendered null by this review. 

I hope future clients won't have to endure a similar level of discomfort. I hope that, for Crave's sake, their manager will eventually learn that handling reviews is as much a part of business as is running the business itself.

Great weekend brunch, both Sat & Sun, 11-3.  I like the variety of seating areas on 2 floors, including a big covered outdoor roof garden. Solid beverage selection, local craft beers, cocktails.  Diverse crowd of all ages, professions:  hipsters to capitalists. Eating and drinking in harmony. Gastropub food, everything's no was delusions and well-priced. Friendly servers.  Worth the trip to check out this rapidly gentrifying neighborhood.

Nom Nom Nom! These people know what they are doing, there is no question about it. After spending close to three months in SE Asia, the majority of time in Thailand, I am always on the look out for some delicious Thai food. As soon as I saw Thai Phooket had Mango Sticky Rice on the menu, I knew they were legit. 

I think the crappier a Thai restaurant looks from the outside, the better the food tastes. Our server was great, he was really friendly and kept making sure we were doing alright. 

We started with the veggie summer rolls. The mint and cilantro added a great flavor to these rolls. And who can forget the tasty peanut sauce that came with them. I probably could have eaten this sauce straight up with a spoon. For lunch I ordered a dish I fell in love with in sitting on a beach in Thailand, Panang Curry. Their version was spot on! The milky spicy flavor instantly brought back some great memories. My girlfriend ordered the drunken noodles which were delicious too. 

One word of advice is that their "hot" is not very spicy. Next time I'm there I will for sure try the very hot, maybe even the Thai hot. I loved every minute of my visit to Thai Phooket! I think its pretty obvious that I will be back to taste more of their awesome food!

I had the chance to take a couple of classes at Body B Fit while I was in town for my wedding. The studio was conveniently located to where I was staying in the CBD. Inside, it reminded me of many boutique fitness studios in the NYC area - clean and bright. There are showers and towels available. The front desk staff was extremely friendly and welcoming. The studio is on ClassPass, but I also purchased one class, which at $15 felt like a steal compared to NYC prices that I'm used to paying.

I took a VersaClimber class and a Megaformer class - both were great workouts in different ways. It was my second time on the VersaClimber, and I thought the clear instructions were so helpful, particularly when changing hand positions. I had never taken a Megaformer class before, and when people say that it's challenging - it's CHALLENGING. Even though I wasn't jumping around like in a HIIT class, I was sweating because my muscles were working so hard on the small movements.

I would definitely recommend this place for anyone in NOLA looking for a wallet-friendly NYC or LA feel for their fitness routine! I plan to go back the next time I'm in town.

We were out shopping around for power recliner chairs after our father's recent spine surgery. The staff at this location, Sam and Dennis, were very helpful and when the chair we were looking at was out of stock they allowed us to purchase the floor model and offered us a nice discount. This was very much appreciated as it will save our father a few sleepless nights as opposed to waiting for a delivery to arrive. Highly recommend this store.

My family including a critical chef from California enjoyed a very nice lunch. Highlights were the service, beer cheese soup and most of all Eggplant Crab Stack salad. The salad was delicious and very pretty.
Now that the new owners bought it (Benihana) you can no longer bring your doggy. Service was much slower. And quality is staff went down. Sorry.

Not only is this place a great library,  but the campus and building  are beautiful. Very relaxing with many nooks to sit and read books or meditate  while  overlooking  the grounds. The staff is always  helpful and pleasant  to deal with. Various events are held throughout the year for both adults  and children.

CON: Can get a bit loud at times.

I like that this Publix is smaller. You can get in and out quickly and it's never terribly crowded when I've gone. As far as I can tell, it has everything that the larger stores have. Convinient, great service, and BOGO's!
Super good food . Cozy place ! Grab the fish dip as an appetizer cause food might take a minute but worth the wait . Homemade cocktail and tarter sauce is delicious
I ordered from out-of-state, they did a fabulous job! The pictures I saw of the arrangement I ordered was beautiful. I differently will use this company again.
Consistent service and quality of food. My daughter and I shared a veggie pizza and beet salad. Tasty! The bartender/server was great and made a yummy gin and tonic to boot!
Great hotel... Awesome service, look out for the scorpions if your room is on the first floor.... Yes... I had a scorpion in my room.

This was my second visit and I absolutely love this place. I wish I could go once a week and sample everything on the menu. Let me honestly say, the interior and exterior of the Vietnam Cafe is absolutely beautiful. It is impossible to miss right on the corner of 47th and Warrington and is easily accessible from the Septa Trolley Line. 

The spring rolls are to die for: crispy with the chili vinegar dipping sauce and for my main course, I had Curry Chicken. It was a filling portion and served nice and hot. Also, I recommend the tea, if you are a tea drinker as I am, its Gun Powder Green Tea. YUM!

Walking into Hot on D Spot you instantly feel like family. Very hospitable staff with delicious Trinidadian food. I had the pleasure of having the boneless chicken roti and a plain doubles. I sat with my cousin and we enjoyed the soca playing on the background as well as the food. Very flavorful, I'm in love with the mango-tamarind sauce. I'll be back when I am in the area again.

I walked here for my morning coffee from my hotel after finding it on yelp, and was not disappointed. The man working was very friendly to myself as well as all the other customers who came in. They offered most kinds of coffee drinks you would want as well as blended drinks. There isn't a lot of food to pick from, but he does have some muffins that looked good and some different types of bread. That was fine for me as I was only there for coffee. The table along the back wall had a great view of a bay (or lake? it's not the gulf) and a small courtyard. There were also plug outlets to plug in electronics along the wall. They have free wifi available, too.
This was truly a fantastic dining experience.  While not the cheapest, it was by far a wonderful gastronomic journey!

Modera is a wonderful place to live. We found a sublet unit to rent as a short term solution in between moving to Tampa and finalizing construction on our new home. It was the perfect location, a beautiful apartment, and the staff went above and beyond day in and day out to ensure your time spent there would be a good one. I highly recommend this community to anyone looking for a completely easy and devoid of hassle moving experience and then home life. I highly suggest giving the community a look and touring what could possibly be your home for the next few month/years of your life! 

You won't be disappointed what-so-ever with these ladies and the lovely atmosphere they have created!

Came to Santa Barbara for the night with our black labbie.  Walked here from our hotel and was able to have him on the patio with us.  The staff was SO friendly and the atmosphere was very relaxed and welcoming.   The food was amazing as well as the service.  Started with the chips and guacamole.  I got the turkey burger (amazing!!!) And my husband got fish tacos.  The fish wasnt deep fried which is awesome and he said they were the best fish tacos he's had.  Ended with the apple pie and vanilla gelato.  We honestly could have just sat here all night people watching and talking to the staff.   Definitely a favorite.

Uh oh!  Look, I'm just going to tell the truth, okay?  I thought everything was fine when I walked out the door, but when I got home and actually took a look at my hair, I was SHOCKED!  Dwana messed my hair up so bad!  I went in with a head full of luscious locks with a lot of THICK, not thin and damaged, new growth.  Other clients were in awe of how thick my hair was. First of all, she linked some of the locks in the back together like a chain linked fence!  She joined locks that I didn't want joined.  Joining locks is a very personal decision that I wanted to make on my own.  She didn't have the right!  I only wanted the extra small locks joined, not the thick ones!  Secondly, I paid $160 for interlocking, but she grabbed hands full of locks and palm rolled them! Now I have a huge parts that are the size of a fat man's thumb, while the rest of my locks are small.  She palmed rolled some of my mircolocks and that is a big no no!  She even two strand twisted and braided the new growth instead of interlocking.  I have broken hairs and never has this happened when I do my own hair.  I texted her pictures of the mess she made and she agreed to "fix it".  However, my intuition is telling me not to go back and I'm going to listen to it.  She'll probably mess my hair up even more!  I've been doing my own hair all these years and the first time I go to a "professional" and she ruins my hair!  I can't believe she did me this way because I thought she was very nice, but it seems to be all about the money.  Apparently she learned early on that you attract more bees with honey than with vinegar.  She is NOT skilled when it comes to interlocking microlocks or Sisterlocks, so stay far, far away!  Dwana, if you're reading this, I hope you take this as constructive criticism.  Don't bite off more than you can chew and you need to be trained on how to interlock micro locks, okay sweetie?  Also practice patience, because you rushed through my hair and tangled it up like a spider web!  I went for a consultation and you saw how much hair I had BEFORE the appointment, but you still messed my hair up. If you couldn't do it, then you should have said so instead of messing up my hair.  Lastly, she never apologized for her awful work and didn't offer to return my money.  She is very unprofessional, lazy, and doesn't care about her clients at all. She's going into real estate with this terrible character, so good luck to all you home buyers!

If could give 0 stars I would. Their customer service is nonexistent. I called over 9 times to get someone to come out and fix the blinds they put in. The did a terrible job installing and have yet to send me the new blind I had to order after the first one broke because of their poor install. Do NOT use them under any circumstance.

Visiting from California and I know authentic Mexican food. So when I wanted some good Mexican food this place was recommended by a friend who lives in STL. Gotta say the food is authentic, great portions, and prices are fair. I would recomend.

All of the Barbers are 1st class A1 artists.  Dawn, Sharon, George and Pete are my barbers.  You're lucky if you can find one or two good Barbers in town.  I can go to Pete's and use any of the crew and get the same GREAT cut, and I AM PARTICULAR about my haircuts.   Friendly, funny and reasonable prices.  GREAT PLACE TO GO.......PERIOD.

For our 7th anniversary right off the plane we came here first , we were first timers ... raw oysters were the bomb 5 stars. However the so call charbroil oysters were burnt had burnt taste 1 star. Other items on menu not so great 3 stars. They kept the AC blasting bcuz employee were hot rather than accommodating the customers 1 star. I personally was freezing in the establishment, they moved us from under the vent was the resolution. Over all for $75 with 2 alcohol drink it was okay for an experience but I wouldn't return.

HANDS DOWN, BEST CEVAPI IN TOWN!!!! YUMMYYYY
Super friendly customer service,  the have basic groceries as well as homeopathic medicine.
Went there for lunch a few weeks ago. Very clean and cheerful atmosphere. Wide variety of sandwiches. Excellent service, average prices. Lots of ice cream choices, too.

I just wanted to show some love. I have been getting food from this location for over ten years and never ONCE have I been dissatisfied. The service is attentive and friendly and the food, dear mother Mary the food!!! So very delicious. I heart you guys. Thank you for being there.
Love their gel manis! The only place I've gone where the mani has lasted over a week.

Great spot - super healthy options.  A little jewel on Haley Street! As a local, always looking for tasty but healthy plant based options-this is a good one. Service can be a tiny bit slow so don't go if you're in a huge hurry.
This place is the best! Their prices are very fair and the job they do is top notch each and every time!!

I went here wanting a correctly applied color. I had previously went to a school, at the school I asked for a mahogany red and was sent out with orange hair color. I like to be able to describe something and the stylist take it from there, I know it is a school and they are in training, however I was disappointed that the instructor let me leave knowing the paper said Mahogany red. I had been searching and after reading all of the reviews decided to go here. I had an appointment with Chelsea, she was very nice and accommodating. They do provide coffee and other beverages, not sure if they are free as I didn't accept either. I got a partial balayage. I have received so many compliments. My only con was that a cut was $50 bucks, however I didnt get a cut I got a trim, I was still charged the $50 bucks, but that was perfectly fine, as I should of asked how much a trim was. I will definitely be returning, it is not cheap but I think I can splurge every other month! Thanks Element!

Went in on a busy Friday night. Our meal was pretty decent: we decided on the meatball appetizer (five stars), the housemade sausage pizza with broccoli rabe (bland sausage and felt the peppers didn't add much), and the prosciutto, arugula, lemon and cheese, which we've enjoyed more elsewhere but was still pretty decent. Our service was fine, but we kept noticing how unhappy everyone around us seemed. One table complained about their calamari appetizer; another had their arms crossed and scowls on their faces as they waited for their checks; another had to deal with two wine glasses shattering at their feet; and still another was picking something they didn't like off their pizza (I'm hoping mushroom and fearing bug). 

Maybe it's not fair to knock a star off because of the reactions of everyone around us when our food was satisfactory, but for that many people to be dissatisfied, something was going on. 

We may try it again, but would be fine if we didn't make it back.

Not the best food I had. Did not care for the crawfish mac & cheese. Had better fried green tomatoes. Jubilee Shrimp  was okay. And the hot tots were nothing special. Do not waste your money. There are better places in NOLA to dine.

They have amazing pizza and calzones! The dough they use has a really fresh homemade taste to it and the pizza sauce is super rich and flavorful as well. Overall just really fresh and tastey ingredients. Not heavy and greasy like most pizza. I found my new go to pizza place. Honestly much better then Dominos or Pizza Hut.

Absolutely amazing! I loved my tan- it was the perfect color and lasted a long time. Abby chose the perfect shade for my skin tone- I had the most beautiful glow!! Will definitely go back and I highly recommend!!

Love,  love,  love this store.  I was so happy when they opened.  Selection,  price,  and staff can't be beat.  I just have to avoid the prepared foods,  bakery,  and cheese sections so i don't go broke.  Their selection of organic produce is excellent.  I had bought moldy raspberries and customer service issued a refund,  no questions asked.  Between the lobster tanks,  train, donuts , and rooster,  my kids beg me to take them food shopping.   My twin three year olds even  asked to have their fourth birthday party here!
My husband I eat here or order take out at least twice a month. Everything we've ever tried has been delicious, and the service is fast and friendly.

Great food. Slightly pricey but understandable. Just can't get over the the DAMN HEAT in this place! I'm not sure if they don't run the AC or what but it's almost always too hot to dine in which really sucks because I work in an office building not even 2 miles away. Would love to bring family and friends here but simply cannot. Other then that, if your getting it to go, 5 stars!

My propane pool heater was not working, I called Leslie pools. They sent out a technician who told me he fixed it, the next time I turned it on it did not heat the spa. He also put in two pieces of pipe which were leaking. Called them back they sent out another technician. He basically told me he did not know what was wrong with it and left. I called Leslie Pool back again for the third time and a manager named Ed Smith came to my home. He gave me an estimate to repair, I had already paid $110 for a service call. Their quote was three times higher than the company that DID know how to repair it. I called back Ed Smith and requested that they refund my $110. I had to pay the other company to fix the pipes that were leaking also which I mentioned to Ed. He was very rude and arrogant and told me it was not leaking. I could not get a word in edgewise and ended up hanging up the phone. They have not refunded my money and I will never use Leslie pool again!!!

Worst experience ever that I'm still paying for. My out of state move never made it to it's destination. They only went half way.  They were real quick to take your money, now they say they are not responsible. The truck was late, and the loader and I waited 2 1/2 hours for him.  Then the truck broke down in Vegas the day it picked up.  It didn't move for 9 days.  Then they ended up dumping my belongings in Nebraska and telling me to deal with it.  Which I had to PAY another moving company to take it from there.  My moving tubs, not boxes, were smashed.  When talking to their corporate office about any kind of refund, they added bogus charges then took them off stating they took money off my bill and that was my refund.  When I called them on it, they said they considered it a successful move.  This move cost me $5000 for an underweight and undersized load, plus my family unloaded the truck!!  I asked for a $1000 refund to offset the cost of getting another company to finish the move, and they just plainly say no and keep transferring me from supervisor to supervisor.  I'm disgusted by both companies involved (Bekins and the broker they paid commission to get my business).  THIS IS THE AMERICAN WAY ANYMORE.  That kind of money for ending up doing it myself anyway?  That could have been a nice check for a friend or family member to pay their mortgage, instead of paying a company to take your money and screw you.

Had the little sister's 3rd birthday here. kids loved it!! we just ordered pizzas and let the little ones run around in the play area. Parents are welcome in play area as long as they have socks on.  Kid parties come with all day play and sitting area for the littles to eat or have a snack.

I did 4stars out of 5 only because we ha e only had one visit with Dr Jarvis. Very friendly, and the office got my boys in very quick. We are new to Boise and they were very welcoming. The process for becoming established as a new client was very simple.

TL/DR:  If I could give less than one start I totally would.  Mildly interesting items...  RUDE STAFF.

I wish I had read the reviews before coming into this shop.  
DO NOT SHOP HERE.  

I would not buy anything that I was concerned about retaining negative energy because it is in abundance in here.  The staff is rude and uncaring.  We have had a wonderful NOLA experience everywhere else EXCEPT this place.  I understand that they have to deal with tourists every day but the level of the bad vibes was ridiculous.  I had a question about which Voodoo book we should get and the response was begrudgingly given in a "figure it out yourself" tone like she was annoyed I was asking.

If you must go here, I would just look at the couple of mildly interesting items here and then leave...  Seriously....  I will repeat in case I want clear:

DO NOT SHOP HERE.  RUDE/UNCARING STAFF.

Go to Hex on Frenchman street nearby if you are looking for Pagan or Wiccan items.  We had a wonderful experience with the helpful and very friendly staff there.

Food tasted really good.. they give you a good amount of food for the price.. order with a touch screen.. staff very friendly.. only complaint is that no one comes around to clean the tables after people leave and drinks are overpriced.

My daughter had her 12th Birthday party here today and it was absolutely fantastic!  The entire staff was so attentive, from the wait staff to the general manager who checked on us regularly. The food was delicious and there was so much of it, we could have fed twice as many!  They had a magician who engaged with every child and had them laughing from start to finish!  An amazing feat with 13 kids in all. Every child was laughing the entire show. It was my daughters favorite part of the entire party.  Magician if you're reading this, you were FANTASTIC!

I had bought glow necklaces and bracelets online and that was a great idea, if I do say so myself. Helps you keep track of the kids when it is game time. 

I can't thank the entire staff enough!  Thank you for an amazing birthday party for my daughter!  I highly recommend!  Worth the money!

We can never leave the mall without getting a few Starbucks for the kids and some hot tea for my husband.  I appreciate how they have some many different variety of drinks including caffeine free choices for kids.

This is my 4th, and last, visit. This place is the same all year around, and nothing has improved, actually got worse.

Overall: 0/5
Service: 1/5 rude
Food: 1/5 plenty, but tasteless
Seating: 1/5 plenty, but clustered together.
Atmosphere: Humid, and fishy
Price: 3/5 Cheap, but I'd prefer to add a few bucks and eat a better quality of food.
My advice: Do not waste your money, unless you can tolerate to eat plastic and junk.
My very first tamales and I thought these were delicious. The place was clean, the people were very friendly and the service was great. Definitely will be returning.

I became a lover of Tulip Tree after taking a Gouda cheese making class.  I highly recommend taking a class.  It is very hands on and you learn so much while doing it.  Like how to really pronounce the name of Gouda!  

For our class we all got a huge wheel of cheese!!!  The cheese had to do its thing for 30 days and then you go back to get it!!   While there you will also get to sample... who doesn't love sampling?????  My faves are Fromage Frais, Nettle and Hops beer cheese!!!!

Bottom pic is the before(at the class when we were down) and the top is our wheel when we picked up.  You get a # so u get the wheel you actually created.  Very cool.

The jambalaya and catfish were great! My husband had the chicken gumbo and said it was also amazing. The staff was super sweet and kept worrying that we were ok since we chose to sit outside (it was a cold day!) Recommend for sure!
This is my happy place.  The salsa is delicious, the atmosphere is festive, the servers are attentive, and the prices are affordable.  I love the mariachi band and margaritas too.

Food was delish. However, apart from the food and the experience, they really need to control that parking guy. I get that maybe he's patrolling for out safety, but can he stop literally looking at us eating because it makes people and me uncomfortable.

Good diner type food with some local twists and influences. Food was good but not exceptional. Customer service was great and wait staff were pleasant. It's a popular place for breakfast on the weekend, but the free coffee was a great touch during the wait for a table. Parking is tough and a bit frustrating as even the overflow parking areas were packed. I'd go back again for breakfast.

I go there quite often. Went for Thanksgiving dinner last year and planning to go again this year.  Pat is wonderful and always welcoming.  Love the menu!  Plan to try every entrée eventually.  Have a love affair with the shrimp and scallop risotto!!  Bring your own and sit and enjoy your meal!  It is definitely worth it!!!!!

I visited last night and had high expectations based on online reviews. I was sorely disappointed. The pizza was ok, not awful, but far from exciting or stellar. The sauce was bland and my dining partner used the term "katsup-y" ha. I also read about the travs... Enh is all I have to say; Pretty mediocre. The place is nice, the hostess very pleasant, service was not great. I'm not picky but when I'm spending $60 on dinner, I kind of expected a bit more personality and maybe a thank you?? .. The parking stinks here also.
I was happy with my experience.  The dinner came out a little fast and that's the only reason for a four star not a five.  The waitress was excellent.  Good food at a fair price. I left satisfied.

This restaurant is a gem! Great service, cool ambiance, full bar, great variety of beer, and excellent food! The dining room is huge with lots of seating but it feels intimate and easy to carry on a conversation with table mates. The servers are extremely attentive but not intrusive and the food was delivered in a timely manner. The Kobe burgers were delicious and the salads are large with fresh quality ingredients. We'll definitely be back!

My husband and I stopped in on a Saturday about an hour before closing time. The place was still hopping!

I chose a pecan pie cupcake, and he chose the turtle cheesecake. Wow!  I loved the little pie wedge on top of mine. The cake was moist, the filling was delicious, and the icing was piled high. No way I could finish it. The Turtle Cheesecake was awesome, too!

Definitely a place for a special treat. I'm not in the habit of spending $5 for a cupcake, but they were great!

After reading a few reviews I had mixed emotions about going to this location for a casual breakfast. To my dismay, the service was awesome, especially for being crowded. The food was as good as I expected, but I was most pleased with the speedy service! We ordered and waited less than 10 mins before our food was on the table. It was also delightful to see the store manager working with the staff ie; serving and taking orders! He even made a "good team effort," comment which I found to be an excellent way to increase employee moral. I would definitely visit this location again!

For what it is, a local hometown bar, it's pretty awesome.  There are two areas, the bar on the first level and an eating area a few steps up.  It's pretty basic, but there is plenty of room and they do have bar service up there.  Cool old jukebox and the food is pretty darn good for a bar, and very well priced.

My buddies and I come here often and usually sit at the bar. They have some great beers on tap, bartenders are friendly,
Especially vivienne. Try the pretzels.

I was fitted for and ordered a bridesmaid dress in October and it did not arrive until March.  They measured me and allegedly ordered the correct size based on my measurements but when I tried on my dress, it was HUGE.  At least one whole size too big.  I live out of state and when I called to request a smaller size be ordered, they told me there was nothing they could do.  "That happens sometimes," they said.  No returns, no other sizes available.  Alternations are to be expected, but this is beyond an alteration; this dress is much too big.

They were nice enough in person, but the order came in so late and their customer service leaves much to be desired.  The dress does not fit; it's their mistake.  Yet they were not willing to do anything to fix it.

I came here today to get my ID/Camera Card updated and renewed since my address changed and to get a more current photo taken after losing a significant amount of weight.  I came on a Saturday and it was very busy, I was there for about 2 1/2 hours total, which to me is a long wait, that's the downside.  The positive thing is I won't have to do this again for 4 years, the center is conveniently located in Center City, for the most part the staff are helpful and friendly.  I'm glad I talked with the lady who took my photos, she said they do Camera Cards on Monday's but no other services.  She also informed me that Tuesday's are busy, which I wouldn't have guessed.  I wish I knew that they do Camera Cards on Monday's because I heard that they were closed Monday's, I think the other services are closed Monday's.  A few suggestions on how to improve would be to improve wait times, possibly add free WiFi and have the bathrooms cleaner.  I do think it's good that you can purchase your money order across the street, along with a snack or beverage to have while you wait.  They accept money orders, but not cash.  I really like my new photo!  I think it turned out great!

Solid 5 cause it's good southern bbq and I like the variety of sauces available. I prefer the Nashville sauce. It's a bit more vinegar-ey and just how they make it down south. Perfection. Brisket falls apart in your mouth. It was my favorite!

Once I heard about this place and it's concept, I made immediate plans to have a solo dinner there. 

I was cheerfully greeted by the wait staff and was impressed w the pastry and fresh teas in the glass display case, the second I walked in. Because it was already evening and dark outside, the lighting set the entire mood. The decor is Tucson/Sonoran rustic with a touch of contemporary. It was classy. 

The menu was pleasantly simple, because the food is simple; a huge plus!  I ordered the raisin rose tea (to die for) and the slider trio. Toasted open-faced rolls w butternut squash, grilled eggplant and marinated oyster mushrooms, along w a delicate bed of greens. I loved my waitress, she was happy, pretty and helpful. 

I can't wait to go back and try the pumpkin doughnuts and chai pudding. They are even in the works of brewing and tapping their own kombucha. Dang!

We ordered food to go from the drive up window and when we arrived home only half our order was in the bag. Sucks! And we don't live close. Girl taking the order was extremely nice, but the guy handing out the food definitely dropped the ball. They offered food credit but that doesn't help. Check your bags before you pull away!!!

Based on reviews saying the Eagles Nest being a romantic place, I took my lady here for a romantic dinner with a surprise planned. Set the reservation just early enough to hopefully catch a pretty sunset. We were apparently the first guests to arrive and were quickly seated. They have a very nice but not spectacular wine list, we chose one of our favorites, Decoy Cabernet Sauvignon. Our server, Trace, was very cheery and helpful, suggesting the Shrimp-cargot appetizer, prepared similar to escargot, it is shrimp cooked in garlic butter with Parmesan cheese on top. It was excellent! 

I decided the sunset was right so the time was now.... I asked Trace to take a picture and surprised my date with a ring and a proposal! What a great evening!! And Trace got the photos! 

On to dinner! We both did caprese salad that was well done with very nice, creamy fresh mozzarella. Based on his recommendation we had the prime rib, I the large cut medium-rare, her the regular cut medium, served with whipped potatoes and Brussel sprouts. This was one of the all time best prime rib I've ever eaten. Tender, juicy, flavorful, with a wonderful crust. Melted in my mouth. Wow. 

We finished with a chocolate cake dessert that was great. Trace, our server was fantastic and the meal wonderful. Better yet, she said yes!!
fast service. nice customer service. Free wifi. Clean eating area. Lots of people usually here for their nice drinks. Would like to try their other drinks. Not too expensive

I really enjoy Palapa. My favorite time to go there is on the weekend for brunch. They have someone making fresh tortillas on the spot and everyone gets one free, served with Oaxaca cheese and grilled tomatillo salsa. Divine... 

There's a lot of glass in the restaurant and it can get chilly at night or in the winter, so bring a sweater of you're a local. Lots of restaurants in town have this problem for locals. If you're a tourist, you'll think it's warm

Chili Verde and Fajitas are two of our favorites. It's a solid restaurant.

It's a nice building, but you have to park your car very far way, almost in  Pennsylvania. Their main constituents are people who are sick or have health problems, so wouldn't you think they would want to offer parking in some proximity to the building? But at this place, you have to walk a VERY LONG DISTANCE to the parking lot. It's great if you are training for the olympics,   but if you are coming there to see a doctor, and are not 100 percent, health-wise, be warned that you will have to travel a very long distance on foot to get to see the doctor.

Great manicure last evening. Wish I lived here as I would be back regularly.  Wonderful back, neck and shoulder massage while my nails were drying.      After I left I mangled a nail and stopped back and they happily fixed it for no charge, can't recommend them highly enough.
The food is fine but way overpriced for what you get.  More than $15 for a skimpy Greek salad with a few slices of Gyro meat.  Disappointing!

I went here with a friend to help her pick out a dress. Dana helped us and was super attentive, listened to the bride's wishes and she found the dress of her dreams. Dana definitely helped with useful tips and she is a spunky fun little gal. She was awesome!

Hit this food stand up after our first night on Broadway and was very excited that they offered veggie versions of the hot dogs. 
I had the LoneWolf vegetarian. It was pretty good- my only gripe was that the dog to bread ratio was overwhelming. I just took a chunk of the bread off and ate the rest. 
Great nightcap.

I put out the word I wanted Debris Fries, and Jen B. (https://www.yelp.com/user_details?userid=kQX4IZc95PkbkMcS9UbYOQ) answered that call...recommending this place and even offering to be my "Uber." Would anyone turn down an offer like that? Not I. And I'm so happy I didn't...it's been more years than I can remember since we've been to the lake, but I won't let that happen again. It's drop dead beautiful, and looking at all the boats was an extra bonus. 

Jen had tried to book a table, and was told they didn't take happy hour reservations. Really, when you're booking for a least a dozen wouldn't it be a benefit to plan for that? So five of us showed up at once and they scrambled to get us a table "for at least 12" on the patio. And they did!!! So that was good.

Usually I get so wrapped up running my mouth and drinking at a function like this I ignore the food. Not this night...OMG those debris fries were killer. Love at first byte. I saw lots of raw oysters, garlic fries, and calimari. And it all disappeared in short order while everyone had a smile on their face. And that wasn't just from being together, tho that was the best part. Bob wanted something sweet, and ordered a Key Lime Pie. It was odd with a strawberry sauce drizzled over it, but not unpleasant. Just odd.

Happy hour pricing on beer, wine, Mai Tai's and some other fancy smancy thing I can't remember. And these were real happy hour specials...it was a little difficult getting our checks (we were a large group) but our check was so little I challenged it. How could it be that little? 

If I lived here I would be a regular...yes, it was that good. So thank you Jen for making this happen for us. And if you're staying in New Orleans, don't hesitate to make this a destination. It was a beautiful drive and so worth it. I'll be back...you know I will.

The lines can be awful, especially when there are a million kids that none of the bourgeois parents feel like dealing with, because they're too busy posturing to try to look like a Real Housewife, and working hard to stare at everyone else around them (which they think intimidates people and makes them cool, but which really is just vile and offensive).

This people-who-live-in-the-little-houses-but-act-like-they-live-in-the-big-houses complex is a real turn-off, and actually a bit of a deterrent for us, BUT Handel's works to process the line quickly, to cure this pain, and then you have ice cream at the end of it!  Besides, most of the anorexic-wannabe women don't order anything big or time-consuming anyway (they get a child's cone and take one lick because they're so mentally disturbed).  What a relief.

That said, all in all, Handel's is still a great place for delicious ice cream!

At Handel's a cone is not big enough, a pint is not big enough, noooooo, it takes a QUART (each) when Handel's is concerned!  Excellent, excellent, excellent ice cream!

This is probably why, despite the fact that they are 3 miles from our home, we cannot allow ourselves to go too often, lest we fail to fit out the front door for subsequent trips!

Seriously, we don't finish a quart in one sitting, but we do each get one, and greedily guard and savor it for days after, like rabid children.

This is some of the creamiest, richest ice cream I have ever had.  Cold Stone, I would say, is creamier, but theirs is so creamy it makes me a little ill.  I would place Handels' creaminess between Cold Stone and Brewster's.  But for us, the freshness and overall taste of Handel's exceeds anything else.

I tried cookies and cream (I believe they call it vanilla Oreo, or something) the first time I went, and in many many trips since, I have not changed to anything else.  I am not yet ready to be over this flavor, and I may never try anything else.

My husband tries something different each time, and is always thoroughly pleased.

The employees are normally very friendly.  The owner's family is most professional.  One time we had an issue with the quarts not being packed very well, but Buck, the franchise owner, called back, immediately, and took care of everything, with generosity.

The service was good so was one "special" appetizer (thus two stars), the atmosphere was poor (too many people stuffed in a room) and the rest of the dishes even worse. No flavor, poor food presentation, just a bunch of non tasting tomato sauce thrown over pasta...This experience will be stuck in my head as one of the worse. Would never go back there and not recommend this restaurant.

Went in to purchase a hitch for my car earlier today. Assistant Manager Sara was on the phone and seemed annoyed when I asked her if she was free to help me. Was also unwilling to look up the information for the hitch I needed installed. Bad experience overall. Go elsewhere.
Omg, stumbled upon this place, what a great surprise! They have a wide selection of Mexican beers AND their cocktails are sooooo good! The pineapple cilantro margarita is to die for!!
Meat is ok. Too expensive. You spend $30+ here, you can go somewhere else and get a better quality steak for the same price. Flies flying around salad bar... gross

I've visited Old National Centre twice now. Once for Craig Ferguson in the Egyptian Room and the other time for Bill Burr at Murat Theatre. This review is for Murat. 

I can't complain about the show at all. Bill Burr was funny as ever. It makes me curious on why comedians would tour here and not tour The Palace or The Brown in Louisville. I'm sure this venue was nice way back when. 

When entering Murat, it was much nicer than the Egyptian Room so I expected a much better experience. The overall experience was bordering on unbearable. I'm just glad Bill Burr had me cracking up the entire time. This theatre at least has chairs and not fold out chairs like the Egyptian Room. 

On to the peeves:
1) Beer - 16 ounce can - 11 bucks! (Drink somewhere else before hand)
2) Very little air conditioning. I thought it was an Egyptian Room issue, but it carries over to this theatre as well. Very stuffy. There was a couple sitting beside me that had to leave before the show was even over because it was so hot. 
3) Seat numbering - Confusion! Even the staff was commenting on how weird the seats were!
4) Congestion - This is a tiny theatre. Getting in and out was interesting. Very clogged. 
5) Cell phone camera flashes -- I hope this isn't an Indy thing! When Bill Burr hit the stage, there were literally tons of people snapping pics with their flash on. This went on for at least 5 minutes straight! After that, there were only some flashes here and there. I think it's up to the act on stage, but Old National Centre should really control that. It was blinding. 

I will go back to see what the other venue in this place has to offer, but in the future... I'm not sure if I'll make the drive from Louisville unless it's someone I really need to see.

Was craving something that would fill me up and was honestly going to go to Rosepepper. There was a huge line of people waiting to get in Rosepepper so I opted to walk across the street and see if SG was busy. 

I walked in and of course, asked for a table for one. They were very accommodating and cleared a table for me within minutes. The staff were attentive. I got the "Tango" which was a trout seasoned with some good flavorful spices and rice. I forgot to take a picture of the menu so I know it may sound lame "spices" but it was incredibly delicious! I cleaned my plate. 

I then got talked into dessert by the waitress. I got a chocolate Torte which I later found out was called the "Reverse Cowgirl" which is the most awesome name for a dessert! 

loved the food! such amazing flavor! the decor was nice too. Staff were friendly. What more do you need?

Love everything about this restaurant.

Pues [well]... I can't believe I wrote a review three years ago only commenting on their frituras and haven't updated yet! Settle in, y'all...
