From the start the dimensions were WRONG. The custom cushion was too big. They tried to fix it, backpedal, repair it - but the damage had been done.  They took my $600, destroyed my fabric and left me with a non-usable mangled mess.

I offered to purchase the fabric AGAIN (at no charge to them) to start from scratch. So that I could recoup some of my $800.

They refused to fix it or refund my money. They swindled me out of $600, destroyed my $200 fabric and left me with nothing!

The owner is a greedy, disgusting human being and the tailors are inept.

Save your money. Save yourself A LOT of heartache and take your special project somewhere else.

This place is unbelievably low rate. 

They don't have a clue about quality or modern design.
I love silk city!!! PLEASE bring back the breakfast fried rice as a permanent menu item I promise to buy it at least twice a week!!!

I don't believe that words through yelp review can describe the meal I had. Simply put amazing great company great food great service. If you're looking for some good... Scratch that if you're looking for some amazing food come check them out. I believe they've change their name to Ramen 4 real and they are for real. I'm coming back ASAP.

Wait was about an hour on a Saturday night due to Covid. Once we got in, we were seated by a friendly waitress. We noticed right away the food menu was pretty lacking, so we opted for ice cream instead which is basically the point of this place. Friends ordered the Golden Girls themed shake, "Thank You For Being a Friend." Boyfriend ordered a chocolate/banana shake and I ordered just plain vanilla ice cream which came served in a cake cone and bowl. Took about 20 minutes for our order to come up, but the shake was super elaborate. Friends enjoyed it. Shake was good, but not memorable. Same with the vanilla ice cream. Merchandise was cool, so I definitely feel like this is a good destination spot if you're visiting downtown. Right next to Ferris wheel if there's a long wait.
Trendy, delicious, different. Would recommend to those looking for a nice lunch spot with tons of delicious options.
Great food..on time service.. Recommend for native indian food in Nashville/Franklin  area

I have been very disappointed lately. The problems I have experienced lately are not necessarily the fault of this specific Taco Bell. I have tried to purchase two mobile order through the app. As I confirmed the orders, the app would crash and the order wouldn't go through. BUT, I was still get charged on my card. So as of right now, the two orders combined, I am down $15. I have already emailed customer service and have yet to receive a response. When I would go to the location and explain to them that I was charged on my card, they would say that they didn't have any mobile orders and that I would have to just order and pay again. So basically overall I paid two times for only one order. On top of that, the location likes to only give half the amount of nacho fries and chips that you ordered.
The best hummus and the best pita I've had anywhere. I didn't even know pita could be that soft and tasty. It was eye-opening. Saving this place for my next trip to philly

The food is standard; it's a chain. So one star for the food, and one for being near my home. However, the service here is terrible. Like, really really bad. Wait times are long, but there are open tables. The staff seemed bothered that we walked in. I thought it was just a bad night, the first time. But it's happened twice, so no need to waste a baseball analogy and go for a third time. The place is not well maintained, like maybe they should encourage people to eat peanuts and throw the shells on the floor. That way it won't be as noticeable that this place hasn't been swept in a minute. I eventually just got an order to go  instead of the "70 minute" wait time. Food was decent. So I would consider a to go order, but wouldn't choose this place for a nice dinner out.

We have not been to Jakers since the location moved from ParkCenter.  We decided to go for our Anniversary. Mistake. 
We were disappointed in the food and the service we received. 
I dropped $60 on a Rib Eye steak and chicken dinner and I could've made the same cut of meat on my grill with much more flavor for $15. Our server sounded like she was half asleep and offered no suggestions of what to eat after informing us that you were out of our first choices of meals to eat. It was exhausting trying to figure out what to order.

The retro vibe, good music, and the deep reverence for the art of male grooming is what should draw you and what will keep you coming back. Hawkins was recommended by a friend when I moved back to the area and I haven't even considered going anywhere else since then. Ian is a master and you can tell that all the folks here take pride in their work, but for me once I find someone that does good work, I stick with them. A true five star establishment in East Nashville.

Bottom line; friendly and good service

I just found out that these guys were shutting down which is huge bummer because they have worked on my ZX6 a couple times.  They were always fast and professional.

I know that Victory motorcycles also just closed their doors - not sure how much influence that would have over this place closing but I'm sure it has some effect.

I always hate to see a local mom & pop type place close.

 : (

This is a decent place to go for a night out with friends.  I echo the other reviews who have commented that the food is lacking - my square burrito was bland and tasteless.  I can honestly say that I've experienced much better at food trucks and chain restaurants. 

Overall, I recommend coming here for the atmosphere.  It's lively and fun, and the drinks are great.  Just be sure to grab a bite to eat before you head over.

Ok , So I wrote a 1 star review for here 2 years ago . My friend took me for my 40th birthday. It was the absolute worst meal ever . Down to the service and drinks . We always came for their amazing brunch so I couldn't imagine why it was so awful . Now fast forward to last night my husband made a reservation for Valentine's Day here since we love their brunch and he forgot about  our awful dinner experience. Well last nights meal was fantastic. Appetizers, dinner , dessert and Lisa was our server and  she was the best ...

I and my wife liked their 20.20$ lunch special. Charbroiled garlic oyster was delicious. Trout was very good option for seafood. 25cent cocktails very sweet deal but it is okay. Very helpful and positive crew. Service was very fast.  I am giving 4 starts due to table set up in restaurant. It should be more productive to show culture/history and decoration.  Thanks for great experience.

One of my favorite Bubble tea places in Tampa. There's a lot of bubble tea places in the USF area but this definitely remains in my top 3. I love how flavorful and NON artificial the teas taste, as well as the size of the cup you get. Super reasonable priced and such a great spot to just hang out with friends.

What a difference time makes. My original review was when they first opened and I really didn't enjoy my experience, and now, dare I say, it's one of my favourite Korean places in town?

The best value is the lunch combo for 2. For $35 or $40 you get a hearty spread of a bunch of different items and it's delicious. Only available until 3pm. Which sucks if you're working during the week on the other side of town, but is an option on weekends.

Other favourites include the army stew, the bulgogi fries and obviously the honey bread. Obviously. 

Service is still a little spotty even with the bell you ring from your table, otherwise I'd have given it 5 stars.

Stumbled upon this restaurant as we were buying a boba drink in a nearby place which is . So glad that we found Alesia just in time for dinner. First, the outside patio seating was pretty. It could be a good place for dinner dates. We didn't know what to order so my husband asked the server which soup he would recommend. My husband got the beef soup which was really good! I had the cold noodles with the pork skewers. Oh my, the pork was really flavorful. Our Asian tongues were pleased! My picky son devoured one of the pork skewers. We were pretty full for dessert but we saw they have a raw honeycomb on the menu which got our attention. It was pretty good. It was served with strawberries as they ran out of grapes, then there was a creamy bleu cheese and candies pecans on the side. I'm drooling just thinking about it. I would say, Alesia is a must-try spot when you get a chance to drive at st pete or treasure island. Will be back for sure!

This is the best place to get your new buddy! All the animals here come with a nurturing or spaying , shots and a chip ! They're set up and happy to go home with you ! Please get your forever friends here love this place , super nice staff and facility as well

I love how big the theater is and how much food options they provide compared to others. I go there a lot mainly for the cheap tickets of $5. If I don't feel up to Galaxy Ill drive the miles to go to this one.

Their food is always good and exactly what you except. Nothing crazy fancy, but if you want some good cheesy pizza, you got it. The cheesy bread, great. Ceaser salad, hits the spot. So yeah, the place is pretty casual looking and the food isn't anything crazy gourmet, but it tastes great and hits the spot. I'd recommend

Nice place and owners I'm kinda surprised to see some reviews saying otherwise. They have a nice selection of cheeses and meats with fresh rolls. They have alot of items here to if you're ever in need of anything and don't feel like running into the market. The owners are always friendly and the prices are reasonable. I like this place.

Promising new place. Similar to Cedars but more spacious and newer. The falafel wrap with fries was flawless. Definitely worth checking out. Serves lunch and dinner. We have had dinner here twice and based on the excellent, authentic Lebanese food an upgrade to five stars is in order. The wrap sandwiches and the Lebanese style pan fried flounder were superlative. Best falafel and baba ganoush anywhere.

I go to J.J.'s everytime I visit my friends in Reno (and not just because my name is J.J.).  My friend met his wife at J.J.'s when they both worked there years ago.  I have been to Reno about 5 times in the last 7 years and I've been to J.J.'s on every trip (I think).  They have great pizza and wings.  There is tons of interesting stuff on their walls too.  To me J.J.'s is a must-stop for anyone visiting Reno or anyone who lives near downtown who loves good pie.

Our server Mark was cheerful and outgoing. Keep checking on us. My friend and I come here at least once a month. 

Nice atmosphere we always have a good time.

thank you Serena Wang,  your amazing expertise and warm professionalism makes me a loyal customer of Bank of America. I wish corporate would make your life smoother by employing more tellers. It would benefit them tremendously. I have watched you be very patient with disgruntled customers and long lines. You are an extremely efficient manager, corporate needs to listen to you and perhaps with your help change the face of Bank of America to modern and fresh.
Best Chinese food around!!! We love their food! The staff are great and friendly every single time.

I reserved the Friday Night Special $69.99. It included 2hours of unlimited bowling for up to 6 people, 1 large pizza, unlimited beverage, six 30min. Game cards. This was a great deal and so much fun. The staff was super friendly and helpful. The facility was clean and kept well. The restroom was also clean. My family and I had a great time. I definitely will return.
Seemed kind of odd to try this "muffuletta," but it was definitely worth it. The flavors are one of a kind and it's a must try in NOLA. Definitely haven't found anything like this anywhere else!

First time dining at Cracovia.    The hostess desk at front of the restaurant was an antique cabinet. It was beautiful but had a computer on the floor with unconcealed wires about.  That could be improved.  

The interior is interesting with high ceilings, large beams, large paintings in gilded frames, velvet drapes.  The air conditioning came on during our meal. It was loud.  Almost Airplane loud  

The restaurant was busy for Sunday 4:00 pm.  

The menu is limited.  The service was ok - the bar makes the iced tea so be prepared to wait too long for tea. Flimsy straws (too short), long Pilsner style glasses and sugar cubes (no sugar substitutes available today) don't work well together.   

Appetizers took a while to arrive.  The potato pancakes and cabbage roll were both very good. 
The pancakes had too little sour cream and applesauce.  The odd orchid flower used as a garnish was different, and unnecessary.  The cabbage roll was delicious.  The filling was light and flavorful, wrapped lightly in cabbage.  The tomato sauce was fresh, flavorful, not spicy or sweet - delicious.  

Entree prices are about 16 to 25 dollars.  I had the pork tenderloin and enjoyed it.  It comes with a vegetable relish - separate areas of the plate had lettuce, coleslaw (good crunchy), carrot salad (tasty, sweet), and chopped pickled beets (amazing).  I have no clue what plain chopped lettuce would be good for. The pork was very good, nicely cooked.   The entrees had sliced cherry tomatoes as garnish.  If they were roasted they would be good, otherwise unnecessary. 

One of my dinner partners had a pork chop.  It was fried, over-coated and dry.  Not enjoyable per my friend.  

Another diner with me had the beef roll.  It was flavorful and enjoyable.   Mashed potatoes were hearty and fresh.  

Desserts are priced 8 to 10, cheesecake and apple pie were the only two offerings today.  We didn't try desserts today. 

Service was fair, friendly and learning their way around.  Lots of dishes (used) were left stacked on tables instead of being removed.   The waiter asked us to return and explained a wider variety menu and extended hours were coming soon. 

I may go back but others in my party weren't really loving it - mostly due to the cost/enjoyment factor.  

We stopped by the connected deli next door.  They have a fun assortment of items.

Enjoy your sandwich in person. Enjoy human robot don't get delivery. There is nothing wrong with delivery but you may catch them at a rush an the deliveries can't keep up. I won't deprive myself of greatness in person ever again.

Dropped in while waiting for a flight. Wasn't overly impressed with the service here. I didn't expect the best service at the airport bar but the server didn't even know what was in the drinks we ordered and was trying to charge us for things we bought in a different store that they didn't even sell at the bar. Other than the service the drinks were good and the beer was cold. Not a bad place to watch some football while waiting once you get past the service.

Flamingo has been a beloved dance spot for my friends and I since it opened. Yet, they recently have changed there dress code, without notice, to cocktail attire:aka then would not let friends in with nice tops and jeans. Feeling frustrated and NO sense of inclusivity here. Is this what we are becoming? Come on Nashville

We went the first Sunday after their grand opening around 2pm, and there was a 20-25 min wait for a table of 3. That was about accurate for the time we waited. 

Our waitress, Sage,  was super nice, she was very attentive and explained the different options that were available on the menu. 

We ordered the Fit&Focused Acapulco Scramble with side of 2 pancakes, Denver Omelet special order with Egg Whites and a side of 2 Chocolate Chip Pancakes, and Chicken Avocado Club.

Our food seemed to be taking a little longer than we expected, so we kindly asked our waitress Sage if we could order an appetizer and have it served before our food and she said she'd see what she could do. To our surprise we were able to be served our order of onion rings which was a great!.. Sage was pleasantly surprised she was able to pull it off and we were appreciative of that! 

Our food was served shortly after we dug into our onion rings that were perfectly fried. There was no excessive amount of oil and were nice and crispy!

I ordered the Fit&Focused Acapulco Scramble which was really good! The chicken cubes inside the scramble was more than plenty for the serving! The hash browns were delicious. 

The Denver Omelet looked delicious, my boyfriend who ordered it said it had just the right amount of cheese and would order it again. 

My mother ordered the Chicken Avocado Club and she enjoyed it. I was able to sneak some French fries that seemed to not be fried to crispy but were still good!

Now the pancakes!! They were AMAZING! The size of them are a little bigger than the typical IHOP size. They taste like yellow cake that you make out of a box, so they're just the right taste of sweetness! The outside is nice and crispy with a super fluffy center!! I would highly recommend ordering the pancakes!

All in all, I will be returning to this restaurant for their pancakes and explore more of the omelets on the menu. I can't express how delicious the pancakes were! Our waitress did a good job in serving and attending us!

So disappointed. This is my special place to go to. Last night we ordered carry out. For the two of us the bill was around $40+. My husband drove from Affton to go pick it up. When he returned back home he discovered his food had not been included. He called and was told that there was another bag that had not been included. When he got back to pick it up he was to ask for Rosa. So as my food was getting cold he drove all the way back from Affton to get his food. When he arrived Rosa was unavailable and no one else knew anything about it. Finally his bag, which had been sitting there getting cold, was finally found and he headed home. No apology, no remuneration, nothing. By the time we started to eat everything was cold. His bread was soaked with coleslaw juice and unedible and his pulled pork was ice cold. We don't get the opportunity to get carry out a lot and it's a special occasion when we get my favorite. We were so disappointed not just in the food but in the lack of compassion for the fact we had to make two trips, our food was cold, and our inconvenience.

Chace and his team were excellent from beginning to end. They gave us a very reasonable quote and were very responsive about scheduling. The job took them longer than they expected but the cut no corners- the house is cleaner than when we left it and the paint looks amazing. Would definitely hire them again and highly recommend.
Had an amazing brunch here.  We all loved our food and the service was attentive.  Will definitely be back to try dinner!

Tonight was the third and final time I attempt to receive treatment and help in your emergency room department. This is the 2nd time in feeling the need to sign myself out because of the attitudes and shear lack of care in your emergency room. Your nurses and doctors have attitudes that show a very strong lack of empathy. I am a post op patient. I was told to go to the er because of the symptoms I told my doctor. I decided in giving St Mary's one last time. Never have I ever been treated like less like a patient and more of an inconvenience. My calls for anti nausea medication went ignored 3 times over 30 minutes. I was throwing up in my room, in pain, not knowing if I'm tearing my stitches internally all because your staff was gossiping. It took me telling your staff that I want to sign myself out to do their job. To get my results and to finally give the medication I was asking for. Shame on you and Shame on your awful staff. I wish I could give less then one star.

Leaving a positive review for Emma. So happy to have a proper haircut after more than a year at home! Emma listened to my ideas and delivered a really great haircut! She asked questions and was a good listener. I would definitely request an appointment with her.

Thanks!

I thought two of the men working the front were pretty rude. Their attitudes were terrible. Looked so irritated when I asked for avocado. Then I heard them shit talking the customer in front of me who left. I almost said something to the manager. She was very kind. I never take time to write reviews but I was not impressed with their behavior. Grow up.

BUYER BEWARE: this club uses deceptive sales techniques and will hit you with fees they do not disclose when you buy a membership.  The front desk staff will tell what you're signing and you are presented with a signature pad without seeing the terms and conditions.  They tell you they are waiving the joining fee but don't mention that you are going to pay an annual fee 60 days after you join. 

They also tell you that you can use any Crunch club with the full membership.  That failed literally the first time I tried using another club.  When I called back to complain, the story I got was that the club I wanted to use was a "Signature" club.  The story that club gave me was that they are independently owned and operated and do not honor club memberships from other areas.  Point is, this club uses deceptive sales tactics.  

The manager I spoke with at Crunch was kind enough to tell me that they would be happy to cancel the membership after they bill me for 90 days and hit me with the annual fee.  Despite never seeing the paperwork when I signed up, they are enthusiastic about telling you that they have your signature.  

My suggestion - pass this club up and join one that has a better club model and less deception up front.

The Greenwood Park Mall food court presents a solid variety of inexpensive eats.  But if you're feeling like getting your chicken on, head on over to the place where chicken sandwiches were invented.  

Here's the run down: LOTS of registers (7!), quick and friendly-ish service, and quality chicken!  There's a private dining area, too, with about 20 seats for those who don't want to sit in the main food court.  Refills are free, as always, so  grab a soda or sweet tea and drink it while you shop, then come back for round 2.  

Other than the fully-loaded registers and the private dining area, expect the normal chick-fil-a treatment.

Authentic Neapolitan pizza done at a slightly higher price tag that falls somewhat short. Had the chance to visit Diavola Pizza during Devour Indy and was excited to explore their authentic Neapolitan pizza coming from their imported Italian oven. 

(Almost) Everything was wonderful at Diavole. The knowledgeable and friendly service staff greeted us with a smile and provided insights into the menu. The decor and ambiance was beautifully light and modern, perfect  for an intimate evening and/or date. And the variety of the menu showcased their attention to detail and straightforward approach. Though they seemed to check all the boxes needed to be a great restaurant, Diavole fell short in a few small but important details. 

Neapolitan pizza is known for its light and soft crust which helps accentuate the fresh ingredients included on the pizza. Our two pizzas at Diavola were certainly pillowly soft and light, but were not cooked properly as the middle of the pizza was undercooked and rather doughy. This was made even more apparent as the bottom of the pizza lacked color and those characteristic brown spots. Additionally, though pillowly soft and light, the dough of our two Neapolitan pizzas lacked any sort of distinct flavor, tasty more like "air bread" than a high quality pizza dough. Thus despite the addition of excellent toppings, the vessel and primary component of the pizza fell short.

Lastly, I understand artisan pizza and fresh ingredients will often require a higher price tag, but considering what was provided and the amount of joy I got out of my experience, the prices at Diavola are a bit high. Thankfully Devour Indy gave us a great discount, but I will most likely not visit Diavola again because of this so-so experience.
Delicious food, nice wine list, beautiful atmosphere. Easy to eat healthy. One of my favorites.

Grabbed a quick slice here when I was in the area recently. 

There's not much to say. This place defines the term "nothing special". I had a decent slice of eggplant parm pizza, but I wouldn't exactly drive into town to eat here.  

Nice selection of toppings though. They have that going for them.

Hello all! I had an awesome experience with Danya and her crew!!! Upon getting ahold of her, she promptly answered me and set up an appointment to come to my home and show me what she could do for me within my price range. I don't have money for top of the line blinds and I was worried that there would be no options for moderately priced moderate quality (you get what you pay for) blinds. She was able to outfit my entire home when I had feared that on my budget I would only be able to do a couple of rooms. Even the moderate priced ones I could afford are beautiful! I would also like to mention that Danya helped me choose colors that I liked that would match each other and my decor! And they are helping with my electric bill because it is much cooler in here than with my former blinds. Once the sun went down the first night- I realized that one of the blinds was off color and didn't match the others. I sent an email to Danya for her to answer the next day rather than waking her- but she answered anyways! She assured me she would come and get pictures for the manufacturer and would make it right. She showed up days later at our agreed upon date/time and did what she needed to do. Weeks later when the company sent her the replacement blind- the mismatched blind was changed out and without any sort of hassle or extra charges.
I would also like to give a special shout out to Andrew! He was in on both my whole home installation as well as showing up here on a Saturday to ensure I got my replacement blind as soon as possible. I'm picky over who I trust and who I am comfortable having in my home- and he made it easy to do both. He was polite and personable and confident.  This company would do well to keep him employed with them as he made the experience, along with Danya.
Thank you!!

I have a German bed so I had to order a custom made mattress. When they were going to deliver it, it was a mattress that was supposed to go to California. When my delivery came, the measurements I gave them were totally wrong. I called and they said they would make a new one and to give the wrong one away, because it costs over $ 300.00 to ship it back. Finally I got the mattress and it was fine...for a while, then it started making fuzz balls on the material, which you could feel even through the sheets. When I called them about it, I was told to send it back, paying for the shipping (over  $300.00) myself or buy a mattress pad . SORRY, BUT I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND THIS COMPANY TO ANYONE. Instead of using nice strong material as a cover, they must have used some kind of cheap polyester to cause these fuzz balls.

Seriously...2 hour wait?  It's only going to get worse as people need real ID.  I heard it gets a 3 and 4 hour wait at times.  I am sitting in the waiting area right now as I write this.  I want to blow my brains out.  I am number 1043.  They are up to 1029.  It has already been a half hour.  I don't get this waste of everyone's time.  
Later that day....Finally finished!   I wanted to ring a gong bell as I walked out from enduring the horrible boring wait.  Overall, it took exactly 2 hours at 10:30 am on a Wednesday morning.  A few people ahead of me apparently did not wait therefore my number was called a little faster.  
One really good thing is, I have been wanting to switch my Political party (Democrat vs Republican) and I never knew how to do that and just let it go.  As I renewed my drivers license and got my real ID changing political party can be done at this time.  That was awesome.  
If you are applying for a real ID...make sure you have your social security card in hand!!  You cannot proceed without it.  
The staff I came in contact with were friendly enough.  Once your number is called it takes about 10 minutes. 
So glad to complete this chore.  My 1 star rating is based solely on the 2 hour wait.  They give you a deli style ticket number so you can leave for a bit and come back which I did for the first half hour.  
Good luck...every man for himself on this one!
Nice and chill night environment, decent wine options, good wood fire pizza. Would go back for a late night option.

Doughnuts are a guilt passion, I've tried them (or a local equivalent) all over the world.Guru is on par with the best. You can put all the bells and whistles on a doughnut that you want, unless the fundamental doughnut is good it means nothing. Guru is fantastic from the ground up.

Complete chaos. Scheduled a mani/pedi appt. I requested 10am, but person on phone asked if I could do 9:30. I agreed. I showed up to locked doors and waited outside until 9:45. Lots of chaos inside. My technician kept stopping to answer phones and do various other things in the salon. Deluxe $45 pedicure isn't worth it. No attention to quality or details. Give your hard earned money to a different salon.
Just finished. Looks like a blindfolded 5 year old did my nails. Too pissed to go back inside. 
Seriously, just drive the extra 10 minutes to a different salon

This was the worst BWW we have attended. Our waitress, Trina, said they serve food once it's done and don't wait to serve all the food at once. Seemed like a good idea at first, until we received an order of fries, then 5 minutes later 1 kids meal. Then 5 minutes later another kids meal. Then my wife received her wings 5 minutes later. And then I received mine 5 minutes later. So now our fries were cold since we wanted to eat them with our meal. Trina was friendly and seemed overworked for Amy he amount of people in the restaurant. 

I ordered a Moscow mule and it was not balance, and had too much alcohol. The wings were decent but the overall operation was not good. I don't know that we'll be coming back to this location.

As a Realtor - Bent Nail is my FIRST choice when it comes to having my buyers homes inspected! William Brooks is amazing - as are all the insectors really - but they are super detailed and always explain everything they find - and typically what the best fix is if applicable. I've used them for years and will continue to do so. Their follow up is awesome and they always go the extra mile! You can't go wrong using them and they have the best reports for the buyers to keep and review and they include lots of photos if needed. I've had many buyers thank me for the great referral of Bent Nail Inspections!

A cheap bus line is a cheap bus line is a cheap bus line.

At least this one has its own station? Go through the station to get to the buses. Not all doors work. They also may or may not be concerned about checking your e-tickets.

My bus from Philly to NYC was probably older than me. At least they had space above the seats to store small luggage, unlike Mega and Bolt. You also aren't forced to stow your bags under the bus.

The leg room was barely thing and the ride wasn't too comfy. The bus also didn't leave on time. That may not be a bad thing based on your punctuality. 

I liked that the NYC drop off was Port Authority. Another convenience Mega and Bolt don't have. 

Prices will also fluctuate, so book sooner than later. There are a lot of different Philly to NYC round trip options, so there's not extreme pressure of not getting a seat. I like that flexibility.

Overall, it's just one of the cheap buses. Someday I hope to win the lottery and take the Amtrak.

All My Sons sent a crew of three outwardly pleasant but actually lazy, dishonest and manipulative rascals to do our move. They did a totally unprofessional job. I put myself through university driving and "swamping" for a van line in Canada and I know what the industry standards are. These guys are not anywhere near those standards of professionalism and are far worse than the rival of our van line, whose name we turned from Tippet Richards into Tip It and Rip It. All My Sons should be named All My Scums. I spoke recently after the move with Zac, the Operations Manager. I had complaints about being double billed for virtually everything and for the shoddy packing his crew of goons had done. He told me his opinion of his workers was reason to argue that the bad service and overcharging were not likely. He ended the conversation, which, although ostensibly polite, was really like talking to Donald Trump about the million dollar service he has been provided which he refuses to pay for. "So sue me". When I tried to point out his opinion of his own workers had no logical bearing upon my argument that they had ripped us off, he used my comments as reason to refuse to listen to anything further on the matter. This is either a very ignorant home-schooled Southern dolt with no experience in debating and the rules of civil discourse, or a man who is given to self-serving sociopathic behaviours. His tone wasn't in the least conciliatory, helpful or concerned with the damage and doubled expenses he and his band of incompetent thieves perpetrated. I will be interested to see what the Tennessee State complaints service does with this matter.

If your experience was anything like mine, what you save on your mani/pedi you will end up spending in medical bills when a careless technician chops off your cuticle. 
Skip this place, it's a total dive.

Hole in the wall with 3 picnic table next to highway. Tacos, burritos, tamales, nachos, fajitas-all packaged to go. Take home and make your own margaritas cause this stuff is GOOD! Steady customers the whole time. Beware the sauces, red hot green not as hot.

LOVE this dispensary! They always have good prices and good quality products. I went in last night and Sarah hooked it up! She knew exactly what she was talking about with what I was looking for. She definitely knew her shit and was hella cool. She's the go to girl there!!
What once was a great gem when it opened has fallen  off. Sad bc I really did enjoy this place now it just feels like the oops Garret Ale House!

I ordered from this Burger King last night, part of my order was 2 milkshakes, The milkshakes never came, so when I reached out to the manager, he was very rude and raising his voice, I'LL NEVER EAT OR ORDER FROM THIS BURGER KING AGAIN

The food was really good and reminiscent of a European bakery, excellent chocolate and short wait times. Everything is served in takeaway containers which is convenient if you're on the go or busy. However the aura of one of the female staff was horrible, she needs to see a psychic healer.

I can't say enough good things about our cats' stay at Kitty Kingdom.  We boarded them for 2 days while moving to a new house, and Vivian made the process very easy and stress-free.  Her communication from the time of my first inquiry to the pick up at the end of my cats' stay was amazing.  Her facility is clean, quiet and stocked with toys and cat furniture.  She is passionate about what she does, which is evident. I highly recommend Kitty Kingdom. It is the perfect place to board your cat!

WORSE HOTEL ANYONE CAN BOOK. I had my belongings stolen my room was broken into twice spoke with Carlos and he was no help very rude supposedly the manager told him I get very insecure staying in that room and he said I had to face it he wouldn't even change my room second time I come back my personal stuff where on the floor someone went through them and the bed wasn't even fixed I had no explanation about it and all they kept saying is I will run the key report while I was reading the report it said someone went in at 3:40 am while I was asleep  and the managers are not helpful whatsoever please becareful this place is not safe!

I love the food here. The southwest black bean burger is my favorite! All the floats are really good and enormous proportions. Our waiter, Kyle was the best waiter I have ever had made our dinner an experience we will never forget!

Pizza was hearty and full of veggies!  Crust was a tiny bit soggy but I think it's because we got a veggie pizza.   We had a groupon and we got a $20 certificate for $10.40...and then paid an extra $17.    But we got a large size pizza, a large beer, a regular beer and one fountain soda.   Good value and we will be back !!

Another great find in the Garage Food Hall! Both of these arepas were incredibly fresh and flavorful! The arepa dough itself is creamy and almost similar to polenta. I highly recommend trying this next time you are downtown!
ME AND BOYFRIENDS FAVORITE PLACE TO EAT !!! Cajun grill is hands down our favorite restaurant we've driven over 40 mins just to get for dinner several times

Love this Starbucks. The crew working is so kind and fun (usually) and they want to get your day started right!  Thankful for Starbucks black coffee not breakfast and lattes or tea for lunch. 

Up for something different, try a matcha latte. 
Up for something new, try their Nitro brew. 
Up for the most delicious tea, try Peach Tranquility!  
And if you aren't feeling the best, ask for the Medicine Ball Drink -- it's delish! 

Love Starbucks for its typical consistency

Pretty new and it is clean. Some staff wear masks, one did not. Hanging a mask from your chin does nothing. Mandatory 10% fee added for takeout orders. And I tried to call in my order, but they did not answer. Cashier told me they get too busy on the weekend. And yet there were at least 6 to 8 staff members and 3 customers. Food was good.

sushi is always good, however, beware of takeout sushi! for some reason my sushi was ready about 30 minutes early and no one had contacted me about it. Kinda gross to have raw tuna sitting out not refrigerated and getting mushy. It's good food and good service but I would appreciate a more accurate take out time or a phone call when the sushi is ready! :/

Well, it's Eegees. If you're thinking about going here, you probably already know what you want because it fills that little niche that you'll only find there. 
As always, the drinks are great and huge, sandwiches are expensive, and the ranch fries are topped with that lame dried bacon bit stuff from the grocery store. 
This location in particular seems to have staff who aren't completely there for whatever reason. Last time we were there, the cashier charged the family in front of us for 30 orders of fries when they wanted 3, and then seemed totally confused about how to fix it afterwards. 
You know...normal Tucson stuff.

Currently 9:10 PM and the doors are locked and no one is answering the drive through, all while no one is answering the phone.

All signage shows that closing time is 10:00 PM.

I wouldn't normally complain about this because I understand some businesses run out of inventory.
But this is not the first time this Particular establishment has closed an hour before (or sooner) than what their closing time states.

Definitely poor business management when you lack the skills to know that some form of communication should properly be displayed with new store hours, or  reasoning to why they are having to close an hour before normal and listed business hours.

Some of the best seafood I've had in St Louis. Crab roll, brisket po boy, shrimp po boy, raw oysters, lobster bisque and hush puppies are all a rave for me. The only thing I had that I wasn't a huge fan of was the lobster frito pie. It wasn't bad it just wasn't for me. They also have a bourbon slushy and a seasonal slushy, when I went it was something along the lines of an apple cider slushy, that too was delish.

Great place.  They have a very good beer selection, tasty food and friendly staff.  The drink specials are great and they are one of the few places that have Strongbow on tap (which makes the wife very happy).  I've had the burger and tried the blanket bangers, both were very good.  The fries are amazing and the curry sauce they serve with it even better.  I haven't been for trivia night yet, but it looks like a lot of fun.  All around great addition to Fountain Square.

I have had nothing but amazing experiences at kahootz. It is my go-to restaurant for my birthday meal with my spouse. The prime rib is always delicious, the sides are great, and the mud pie is off the charts. Everything I have tried has been cooked perfectly and delicious. If you haven't been here yet, do yourself a favor and stop in next chance you get

I wanted to get several of the cheaper rolls, but when I started asking my server what was in the different rolls he had no idea and made no effort to go and find out for me. I thought I'd start with a simple shrimp tempura roll bc that's usually a safe bet but unfortunately it was not good. I was glad I only ordered 1 roll, I got the banana tempura and left. The dessert was just ok. I was very disappointed in the service and the food.

This review is for their take-out, which we ordered shortly after the restaurant opened at 5:00. We understand that getting help is an issue and could forgive the two hour wait for our food (although we were told it would be an hour) if the food had arrived with any warmth at all. It wasn't even lukewarm, but rather room temperature. 
The antipasto had a huge center area of brown, slimy lettuce. How that could be overlooked is impossible.
We were told bread would be included, but there was none.
We reheated the food in the microwave and then called the restaurant. The explanations: It was the driver's fault that we didn't get bread. They can't be responsible for traffic and traffic lights. We live one traffic light away.
Their offer to keep us as customers? They'd make us another meal that night. No thank you. 
As parents of a chef, who once owned his own restaurant, we are very sympathetic to the restaurant industry, especially in these times, but cold food, slimy lettuce, blaming the driver for missing food, and traffic lights with not even an offer for a coupon or something on a future order will mean we'll be supporting other areas restaurants.

Wow. What a bummer. This place has completely changed in the past year. I've probably sent 10-15 people here with high recommendations over the past few years, but unfortunately that's over. For starters, I went there in a rush a few weeks ago for new tires, paid for 4 new tires and like an idiot I didn't check them. Blind trust I guess since I used to love this place so much. Somehow I now only have 2 new tires and 2 beyond old ones on my car.  in between by realizing this, I took a buddy of mine here for a patch/plug. This place used to charge $3-$10 for these. Now, somehow the price almost doubled. But regardless, the guy said his tire was beyond plugging, and he'd have to get a new one but he didn't have a new one in stock so he'd have to come back the next day. The guy said he'd put his donut on for him. After being almost complete with the donut, he told him it would be $10. We were actually discussing throwing the guy a $10 tip anyways for being a nice guy and putting the donut on for us. Especially considering we're both more than capable of putting a donut on a car. We made a joke asking if the $10 could be used towards the new tire purchase the next day and the guy flipped out. "Ya'll coming in here at midnight and now ya'll want a discount too!?" Mind you, this place is 24 hours. Long story short, he literally took the donut off the car, put it back in my friends trunk and put the old damaged tire back on and told us to change it ourselves. Lol completely unprofessional. Not sure if Eagle changed hands within the last year or not, but either way...bummer.

All of the employees were so friendly!! I loved that you could order food right from your seat. They gave us free drink tickets since they just opened. It was a little toasty in there and the chairs don't recline but otherwise it's a good bang for your buck!
Very large store with no employees on the floor to help or answer questions.  Customer service certainly isn't on the top of their list.  This was my first and probably last visit to a Hobby Lobby.

I have had their char broiled oysters with cheese .  Excellent . Barbecue shrimp and grits excellent. So now I tried their hamburger and fries .  This is one of the freshest burger I have had ! Fresh bun , nicely dressed . 2 patties with cheese between the patties .. soooo good . Let's not forget the Bloody Mary i had .  Not too Spicy ..just right !

Going n a Yelp food tour with Hilton (https://www.yelp.com/biz/yelp-elite-event-with-hilton-philadelphia) made me realize that there was a couple of places that I've been slacking on reviewing. And between its incredible list of beers, its dedication to featuring various food trucks within its confines, and it allowing many different local artists to turn its bathroom into their canvas; Love City is one of those incredible breweries I've been to that is long overdue for recognition!

When I first walked in Love City instantly had me with some narwhals from Faithsfunnn (https://faithsfunnn.bigcartel.com/) on the wall, and an IPA paying homage to the Eraserhood among its impressive draft list. But walking around the HUGE interior also led to me coming across an ample amount of board games to play, dartboards, and Baby Blue BBQ (http://babybluesbbq.com/) parked in the back ready to serve me some delicious brisket. And with it being in such close proximity to Union Transfer, Philamoca, Underground Arts, and other music spots, I've found it to be the perfect meeting point for several more visits,

Well priced beer flights have made it easy to enjoy many an IPA, stout, lager, porter, Oktoberfest, and more good types of beers. Add in rotating food trucks a couple nights a week, featured artists displaying on the wall monthly, and the best art bathroom ever featuring mini murals from local artists like YomiGTMB and Bear215, and you have a solid brewery!

Been coming here for seven years. Tried a few other places when I first arrived in Tucson but I ended up having to go to Sportsbuzz to have them fix a bad cut twice. Barb is amazing and always leaves me feeling better than when I walked in. You guys are awesome! Keep up the great work!

I have been eating sliders from White Castle for decades! White Castles have been a part of my life growing up. I love their burgers. When we didn't have a White Castle, we bought the frozen burgers. 

Today, I did something out of my norm. I ordered a breakfast slider. I ordered the sausage egg and cheese slider. I actually ordered two. OMG! These are very good! The breakfast sliders are better than any other fast food breakfast sandwich.

We went for lunch. I got chicken fingers, didn't come with fries. My bf got a sandwich. There are two sizes. He asked the difference and the waitress told him "men usually get the one size and women get the other" ...? What? I heard it's only good for breakfast.

My family and I walked in and right away we were asked if we could be helped looking for anything specific. We were asked again by another employee if we had any questions about anything. Staff seemed to be at a good pace assisting customers. This is great for a Sunday.
They did the best they can and they tried to help me with complementary services! Thank you.
Best tacos in the city hands down!!! This place is a must try. Any and everything on their menu will be well worth it!!!

Went here with intentions of replacing a leaky windshield. Travis was so much help and come to find out windshield wasnt the problem. Consult was free and he recommended another garage to find my leak. I believe the dealer wouldve just replaced the windshield and I wouldve been out a fortune and still have a leak. I highly recommend this place. talking with Travis is like having a convo with a friend. VERY helpful.

We came here on a Saturday evening for dinner and so much fun! There was a live band playing and be prepare to make new friends at your table. It's a picnic bench and you're seating with strangers so it's good to interact with your neighbors. This is my first time having German food and beer. It was delicious from the sausages to the soup. The soup and sausages is a must, thanks to the travel channel.

I have been seeing Domenique and she is amazing. She is super friendly and literally a god at doing hair. She makes you feel beautiful when you leave. She's the only person I'd trust to do my blonde now. Also she doesn't push products on me to buy but she does give amazing recommendations that I have purchased and actually work for my hair. She's amazing!
Rincon Pain Management is a factory and money-making machine. I would look elsewhere to find a caring physician to perform ESI, facet blocks, and rf procedures. Try UMC.

I seem to be the only person who does not love this place. I considered it just average. 

Service was slow, even though the restaurant was only 1/3 full, and there was only 1 server on a Friday night. We were seated next to the soda fountain, which blew hot air on us in the already warm restaurant. 

The food was Americanized Chinese. My spicy shrimp roll was average. The egg roll was good, but the spring rolls were very greasy. They did have good spicy mustard. The seafood delight was tasty, and the medium-sized shrimp and scallops were well prepared, though the dish was not spicy as ordered. The Kung Pao shrimp was average. The Pad Thai, while tasty, had too much of an unidentified spice. 

Overall, it is decent but average. Better than Wild Rice, but not nearly as good as Pin Wei. I will likely be back with friends who do not like spicier, more authentic Chinese food.

Background:  I have stayed in this particular hotel at least 10 different times over the last 2 years.  I travel to NOLA frequently for work and was looking for a high-value deal.  After some disappointing experiences at a nearby hotel (read my other review for more info), I visited the Quality Inn based on a friend's recommendation.

What I like:  The customer service is great.  After my first stay, the staff all knew me by Mr. (enter my first name here), which is a nice added touch.  The rate is probably the lowest in the surrounding area and location is not compromised, as it is just a block off of Canal St and a brief walk from the French Quarter.

What I don't like:  Depending on what's available, you may end up with a very small room.  Also, rooms on the interior of the building footprint have a view of a narrow shaft that tunnels through the building.  So essentially, there is no view.  But for what you're paying (which is probably 50% less than other places) its understandable. 

Recommendation:  If you'd rather spend your money on Hurricanes and Po Boys, this is the place to stay.  For bargain hunters, go for the kill.

I love Houston's! The spinach dip is amazing! But I really just have to rave about the Hawaiian steak. This is the only thing I get here and it's never been short of perfectly cooked. Not even once. It's consistently amazing. They also have live music here and a nice selection of cocktails! The Apple walnut cobbler was pretty good, it just had a bit too many walnuts for my liking.

I didn't know you could eat hummus without pita until today. The hummus with couscous and tabbouleh was delicious and the homemade, oven baked pita only enhanced the dish. The Sunday only Shakshuka, a dish with poached eggs swimming in a  flavorful filled tomato sauce in a personal skillet, was a win and complemented the hummus well. The environment was relaxed and small, but the food was 5-Star quality.

I brought Flokati rug  to Tinney Rug Cleaners  to have it cleaned and it was inspected by Robert the manager,  he said yes we can get out the pee stains and it will be fine. 

We paid upfront when we picked up the rug it was hustled into our car all wrapped up we thought it would be fine we took it home and inspected it. 

Our white rug was yellow we immediately  went back and spoke with Robert and he said there's nothing they can do about it that's just the way it came out. 

Of course being a business owner I know certain things go awry depending on who does the work and how they do it. 

obviously they used the wrong chemicals because as our white rug  turned yellow

I asked to have the owner to call us he never did, when we picked the rug up Robert was quite rude and said there's nothing he could do. 

I told Robert I was totally dissatisfied and  I would like our money back because we paid up front expecting quality and we got none . 

This is an example of an old school business that is living on this past reputation and  is not taken care of new customers,  it's a shame, I hate to report this but do not take your valuable rug  to them to be cleaned.

During 2020 pandemic months and through the hot summer of 2021 we have shifted our patronage of Bodacious Pig from dine in to take out and in that use not so much for ourselves but as gifts for friends or neighbors who needed a meal as thank you or because they were injured and unable to feed themselves.  Just as from our first visit as inside diners here in May 2014, the first of dozens of meals, in this 'all people are welcome' inside space delivering consistently good service and delicious food, Bodacious owners have managed a business and team of people to deliver top notch experience for take away too.  Orders called in have always been right and ready on time when we go to get them.  (Yes, you can order delivery via 3rd party app like Grub Hub but small businesses pay big fees for that and it eats into their already narrow profit margins so picking up yourself supports the business better.)  And food to go is as delicious as food eaten there.  The pick up window is outside and so easy to park, pick up and go.  A tip:  If you're ordering cold sides like slaw or green salad to go with the hot meal ask them to put the cold things in a separate bag so they aren't wilted on the way from hot package.  Another tip:  The wedge salad and Cobb salad made here might be the best version  of those served anywhere in the Treasure Valley and they also 'travel well' as take out.

My husband was retiring and last minute decided to do a very small dinner party at our house since I couldn't throw him a big party.  Hired Catering by Jessica Lee on a recommendation from a friend and WOW so glad I hired them.  The food was AMAZING.  I would definitely hire/recommend  them if you are having a party.  Excellent customer  service and food.

I have previously complained of how horrible this complex is.  It has taken new ownership and there are all kinds of promises to improve from Bonita-the manager.  While I think they are trying, it may take 10 or more years at the pace it is going.  I have a ton of examples of the issues from dog poop everywhere to dirty pools, broken pool furniture, beaten up gym, garbage everywhere, dumpster always broken, overflowing recycling and a main lobby that was all torn up for reno and would be down 2 weeks.  I stopped counting after about 5 months.  The list goes on.  The last straw was when I moved out.  I moved out of state and had an 8 hour drive so I left early in the morning before the office was open.  They claimed that the toilets were not cleaned and charged me $30.  That is completely false.  That apartment was pretty much spotless when I left.  They claimed they had pictures but those were never produced.  This is either just a plain rip-off to get extra cash or they waited at least a day to inspect and a ring formed from non use of the toilet due to the terrible Florida water.  Either way, they stole my $30 and now won't answer any emails or phone calls.  Don't move there. They asked me to write a good review because they need help, but I, in good conscience, cannot and warn others before they sign the lease.  Message me if you want more info on this complex.  I will share all the good and bad.  The good---they have some very nice people who work there.

6/27/16 Update-I have emailed Bonita per her response to this commentary and there is STILL no communication.  How can they possibly make things any worse?!?!  I am extremely disappointed in this management style and ethics.

I always count on Yelp so I figured since we were JUST there I should write a review. I liked the table side Salsa quite a bit and the taste of my enchiladas with the mole and then the cream sauce were both out of this world delicious  Hubby enjoyed his Carne asada burro and so did our Son. I'd give this place a definite 9/10 with slow service bring the only downfall but hey, even that is relative, when you're sitting with a giant margarita and some chips and salsa, waiting is so much more doable, right?

We ordered takeout and it was an exceptionally quick turnaround for food that was quite delicious. We got the beef pho, chicken drumsticks, and the pork belly bowl with coconut rice. My boyfriend loved the chicken drumsticks, they were huge, crispy, and the Mopho original glaze was tangy, sweet, and sticky (good thing the servers included an abundance of moist wipes with our order)! The pork belly was packed with flavor and full of fatty good-ness! The meatballs in the beef pho were delicious, but the beef slices were a little chewy and not as flavorful as the rest of the food we got. Overall good - we recommend the chicken drumsticks and pork belly bowl with rice! Those two dishes we will not pho-get!

I wanted to grab something for an upcoming camping trip - it didn't need to be new, it didn't need to be nice, I just needed it CHEAP.  Things were fine in here, nothing unusual.

But the reason I am giving this place four stars is because I saw an older gentleman screaming to staff about not getting a refund because he had no receipt. As the the manager tried politely to tell him several times, "If you have no receipt, we don't know how much to give you back in store credit."  Apparently this gentleman gave this item as a gift to his wife, he tore off the price tag, didn't keep the receipt, and now he was verbally abusing staff for not giving him money back for something he had no proof he even bought here.

Kudos to the store manager who even after repeatedly, politely, and professionally explaining their policy, stepped in after the nasty customer began to spit out racially slurred comments about staff.  I'm glad they called the police and I hope his old nasty prejudiced butt got hauled off to jail.

My car was hit and caliber fixed it to where you would never know it was in a wreck. Caliber even went as far as helping me deal with a dispute from my insurance company. My insurance company denied waiving fees and contacted me two month later after not paying caliber telling me I had to pay. Luckily caliber has documentation that USAA contacted them saying it was waived and only contacted me because they failed to pay Caliber. I am glad to have a company that has my back when my insurance failed to have my back and my insurance gets a lot more money from me. Lesson learned always document. I am thankful Caliber had my back during these tough times. :)

Sweet tap room, great group of people working and hanging out there, and great beer selection. Some cool t-shirts and swag as well. I always go for the beer flights since I can't be happy with just a few when there are so many options. The Dirk is my favorite at the moment.

Food was solid, however we thought the chicken schwarma was dry and could have used sauce. We asked for garlic sauce that the waiter provided for us. Fries were perfect and hit the spot. Gyro was also solid, and very juicy! 

There is nice indoor seating in here, although it does get hot during the summer.
Another wonderful meal....great service.....excellent atmosphere.  No chain can compare!

Great pizza, great calzones, great meatball subs, chicken parm is awesome! My favorite at the moment is the cold cut sandwich! Staff and atmosphere is perfect! I have been eating it all my life and have never been disappointed! Oh yeah and the wings are on point! I wish they were open now! Writing this review made me hungry!

Do yourself a favor and visit this lovely restaurant in New Orleans. The service is unmatched. The staff truly cares about your experience. From the time my family and I walked through the door the team from the greeter to the "DJ", to the servers, to the manager, to the cooks were amazing!!!!

The food is absolutely amazing! I don't even know where to start... of course with the chargrilled oysters with garlic butter and Parmesan! There are absolutely no words to describe these oysters!!!! We were trying to figure out how to get them back to Houston!

The crab cakes, fried fish and seafood nachos were delish!!!

I now have a apple music playlist named after Mr. Ed's!!! The music was soulful and sultry.

We watched the 4th of July fireworks from Citygarden and it was perfect because my daughter could play right up until the fireworks started. 

It's an interesting enough space and I love that the jet pops are lit up and they go off constantly unlike the ones at Tower Grove Park that take forever in between spurts. 

I think there are some issues with the place. The wading pools are surrounded by marble retaining walls. Marble is extremely slippery when wet. This is a serious safety hazard. My daughter was playing in the water and fell and when I went to pick her up it was impossible to not slip around on the marble wall. A lot of other parents were complaining about the same thing. It makes it dangerous for kids getting in and out, too. 

Another issue is that there are no barriers keeping kids from running out into very busy traffic on Market.

Despite these issues, we love Citygarden and would like to see more places like it.

Fabulous! I work just down the block and was getting really annoyed with the expensive breakfast/ lunch spots that are rude and close at 10, right when I need breakfast! Commerce has been a breath of fresh air. Coffee- $1 !?!? Biscuit with egg and chz, $2.50 ?!?! Fantastic customer service, everyone there is so friendly and the food is reasonably priced. My first visit I was just looking for a new place to get coffee, and they talked me into the aforementioned biscuit. It saved me that day, and has many days since then! I have turned many of my co-workers on to them and they have thanked me, so I thank Commerce for providing a solid spot that boasts a positive atmosphere.

I give 4 stars only because they use styrofoam to-go containers.

Okay so first of all wow! This place always does me good but this is on a whole other level! Hidey did my nails tonight and even stayed an hour overtime just to make them look super good (Ik I'm a jerk of a customer) but she made me feel okay about it and reassured me it was alright. Love the service and the finish results. Hidey has a customer for life, please go and visit her for the holiday season!!

Second to none.  Remarkable service.  Hawkins Barbershop is a gem.  This place is preserving a dying piece of our culture: the mid-century American barbershop.  It's old school.  This 6 chair shop is manned by exceptional barbers who deliver beautifully executed classic men's haircuts, as well as any haircut or bald fade you might have seen on Instagram.  They are not intimidated by shaping a beard or providing a proper straight razor shave.  These guys are dedicated craftsmen.  Michael Martin is my barber.  In my opinion he is one of the top barbers in Nashville and his skill and attention to detail sets him apart.  He's given me the best haircuts I have ever had, and he can cut a mean flattop.  That is important to know for guys who like flattops.  John is another barber there I would recommend.  Call the shop to make an appointment.  And they carry Reuzel.

Came in prepared to drop $2k on a couple of devices.  The customer service involved was sketchy at best.  
Alberto (yep, calling you out)... when I'm about to spend that kind of money, I expect good customer service.  Your socialization with other employees and your boyfriend on your phone should come a distant second to helping the customer who's paying your paycheck.  If you make commission, you just lost out buddy!  

Go elsewhere and find a store that is willing to help you, or better yet, online.

Cheers!

My boyfriend recently got fitted for a tux here and Danielle was so helpful. She helped him get all the right sizes that he needed. I would highly recommend getting a tux from Savvi. Be sure to ask for Danielle!

We sat outside. We were in a hurry. Our waiter was rude and lazy. It annoyed him to have to keep our water glasses full and to bring our food to the table. My friends wanted to go, not my favorite place.

This is Place is the best Mexican Food in Tucson rn! I can go as far as top 3 places in west course for Authentic Mexican tacos, tortas, quesadillas, birria my family will be back! Pull to this place Cynthia doing that for sure

Not good? More like deplorable!  The table was filthy and waitress got miffed when asked to clean tabletop. The tomato sauce on the entry was served BOILING clearly microwaved. Could only eat one bite. When the bill arrived the total was too high. ONLY at that point was advised there is  $4 cover charge during entertainment.  When seated in dining room, there was no entertainment. When ordered still no entertainment. The entertainment did not start til presented with the bill.  I have lived here 7 years; was always told don't go Alpha House lousy. Now I know first hand why this place is awful.
Mediocre. Definitely downhill from years past. Love the wedge salad but it's half the size. Menu subpar, service rushed. Pizza good but not worth the price.
Great outdoor seating! The pizza was delicious and we LOVED the mushroom toast. The owner was very accommodating. We would definitely come again!

The place was great and clean, service was nice and friendly. The food was good, good portions, good taste. Some things were not so good like my mashed potatoes, they tasted a little sour but it's just a side so it didn't affect my experience eating their entrees, I had their baby back ribs and they were good, big as well, my wife had their chicken fajitas and she loved those, the chicken was grilled to perfection and my mother-in-law and father-in-law had their steak and steak chunks and they enjoyed them, Cody's also have early bird specials and happy hour specials for those that want to have some beverages. Our waitress was awesome, she was totally on point.

I'm not the type to leave someone a negative review but if I'm spending over $100, I would at least like to see results. I requested forehead, frown lines, and brow lift using 20 units. It was the quickest injections I've ever received...like less than ten seconds for the entire thing. Then when I got in the car I noticed that my frown lines were untouched. So I called and was instructed to come back in. I came back in only to be told that it was impossible to address all three areas with only 20 units and so she decided not to do my frown lines. I've never had this issue before. This is was never mentioned in our conversation prior to injecting me. So even then, I was disappointed but blamed myself. But this morning I woke up with zero change in my face whatsoever, still wrinkles on my forehead and droopy eyebrows. I am super disappointed and feel like I just threw $150 down the drain. The two stars are for the lovely receptionists at the front desk. Top notch!
We have tried the Rougarou( Alligator) and crawfish dog. While they were both very good the Rougarou was simply amazing and delicious. Definitely recommend.

Check it out! Authentic delicious Mexican food 
This establishment is hidden, but the family takes care of you, My go to Mexican food quick easy always has be coming back

Ordered 150 shirts last minute for an event because this other vendor we used couldn't complete our order in time due to miscommunication. We came came across Teevision and they gave us a better price than other vendor and they were able to print 150 shirts on time for our event. The workers here are very nice and professional and the quality of my shirts were amazing! I am so glad I found this place and if anyone needs t-shirts Or hoodies definitely use TEEVISION!!

Fried Calamari was Restaurant Depot quality pre-breaded and inedible. We sent that back and tried the clam chowder. The chowder was ok. Nice flavors but basically just the cream broth and a handful of potatoes and bacon. I don't think we got one clam in it. Also the kid's menu chicken fingers is $6.00 and it came with 2 pressed chicken tenders. My son took one bite and asked to leave. I think this place is geared towards tourists as the food it not nearly the same quality as many of our other local places.

I grabbed a couple of slices.   Pizza was average.   For those not aware,  Vinny D's is 100% take-away.  There is no seating.   The counter is two steps inside the front door.   Seemed like nice people.

I waited nearly an hour and I would wait an hour every single time for this food. The service is very quick once you are seated so it all balances out somehow. I ordered my food and received it in less than five minutes along with hot biscuits. The biscuits come with three homemade preserves: strawberry, blackberry and orange marmalade. Devine! The biscuits are small so you can try each preserve on a different biscuit guilt free.

I ordered the pulled pork platter with fried okra and sweet potatoes. I am positive it was a pound of pork. See the picture for proof. It was flavorful, not overly sauced and juicy. The cornbread cakes are under the bbq soaking up all the pork goodness. My fried okra was cold but I didn't care because I was starving. The sweet potatoes are creamy and not too sweet. They were piping hot! 

I got pecan pie to go. Let me tell you that this pie is the pie of pies! Wow. My tastebuds sang harmoniously in an angelic choir when that pie came to play. I'll be back Loveless. I'll be back

The world would be a better place if this establishment disappeared. This trash pile blasts music on weeknights so loudly that surrounding residents have to suffer until the 'party' disperses.

There are so many other bars in the area that are clean, classier, and have far better music that I just can't see a reason why anyone would use their free will to choose this dump.

Red Bicycle is my new go to breakfast spot . Crepes are freaking amazing and the staff is super on it . Shannon already knows my order and I've only been coming here recently. Highly recommended. Give that girl a raise !!!

It has taken me a few weeks to write this review. I want to make sure I didn't for get anything. I recently side swiped my suv in my parking structure. I went to a couple different places in the area before I landed on V&J. As soon as I walked in Brad greeted me and was extremely friendly. We spoke for a min about my vehicles condition and my insurance information. V&J isn't in the preferred network for my insurance company so I had to call them first. I explained to Brad that I had other cosmetic things I wanted done as well since I had it in the shop I might as well get it done. His quote was very low. I was shocked I was sure I was going to spend a ton. I called the insurance company and they insisted I go with a preferred provider. I felt very comfortable with what Brad had told me and the additional work I wanted done that it didn't matter to me what they said. I called Brad and he told me what to tell the insurance company so they wouldn't pressure me to use their provider and I could use who I please. He was right. I called the insurance company and they agreed and I dropped the vehicle off. When the rental car company came to pick me up they were extremely late and it was getting really dark. Brad wAited with me for a while and kept checking on me until they finally arrived. It was a few days before the big snow storm here so I didn't expect to have my vehicle any time soon. I ended up having to get a rental for two weeks due to the storm conditions. Every time I called Brad to get a status he was always very friendly never rushed me and always answered all of my questions. When the day finally came to pick up my car it was better than imagine. All the work was done including the extra work I wanted for less than he originally quoted me! I was shocked! He even fixed a switch in my door that had been acting up included in the price. I am very very satisfied with the service and work done by V&J. Every time I have a chance to tell someone I do! My car looks better than it did prior to my accident! I would recommend them over and over!
I like the product lines they carry. The only place in town that has so many Celsius flavors and Jocko products. The staff that helped me was very nice and answered all of my questions.

In Nashville for a conference and hotel concierge told me the ACME was a good place to get the flavor of Broadway downtown. A good place for music, certainly. Not so good for food. I ordered the fried catfish. The fish wasn't fully cooked and hush puppies were still dough in the middle. I told the waitress I didn't really want a replacement (why would I want more bad food) and they didn't even offer to reimburse.
I've been going to indo since my first year at UCSB since transferring from Orange County. Whether downtown is packed or if it's a slow night, indo always has the best music with emasculate vibes.

Rude and unprofessional customer service at this Silverside location. I make the trip to go to the Wilmington store on Union Street or any other location. Their food is better, everyone and they treat their patrons with respect. Just FYI, AVOID this location at ALL costs. 

Let alone, their health inspection for food handling and sanitation is not satisfactory. It utterly shows, since 7 employees stand around doing absolutely nothing slacking off, on the cellphones, and horse playing around the food preparation area.

Got this Hotel on an Express Deal and still felt cheated. This hotel would be considered a party hotel. Especially for children. Three pillows for a king size bed. You do get an extra suite but no glasses or any other amenity. The pool and hot tub were loaded with children unwilling to get out of the pool for adult swim which starts at 8; and no one seemed willing to enforce their ejection. Although they went through a remodel one year ago, they didn't do enough to be competitive with lux expectations. The one plus is the 15 minute walk to the Arch. Do not recommend unless you are planning a children's birthday party.

Let me start by saying we went on a busy (Covid restrictions lifted night). Food was amazing! Amazinggggggg. We ordered about 6 appetizers including the feta n olives, kibby, labna, cabbage rolls, dolmas to start then had 3 entrees so we could have some left overs for the kiddo. Anyhow here is my opinion:

1. Food was excellent but the lamb kabob was under marinated under seasoned. My lady loved it though. 
2. Beef Shawarma was amazing but is pan fried or sautéed on a flat top. Not sliced off the trompo or rotating tower that I prefer. To me shawarma should only be done this way or else it's just sautéed meat. The flavor was exceptional though. A little greasier then I would have liked but none the less still amazing. The lemon, fresh herbs, garlic all danced with the beef harmoniously. 

3. Beef kabob with lamb was good but a little dry. 
4. The star of the show though for me was the hummus. You could taste the freshness. The tajin, garlic, lemon, garbanzo beans, salt puréed to perfection. You could tell that they soaked those beans for a minimum of 12-24hrs before boiling with baking soda (which releases the tough shell and then usually rinsed away then boiled until the wheels fall off. They really put a lot of love into this. I could go on and on for hours about this hummus. Literally.
5. First point of contact was with a lady who approached the table without introducing herself and asked what we were drinking. Kind of rude but I understand because I've been a chef for 20 years. I get it your slammed. Especially during things opening back up so no big deal. This was the only point in our service that we didn't like.second girl came and was sweet and accommodating. They were freakin busy as hell. 

6. This part is to the owners of Lebanon's Cafe and listen to me very closely if you care to: during peek hours such as a Saturday night at 8:00pm you absolutely need to turn off doordash, waiter, Uber eats!!!!!! This destroys the cooks, backs them up, your servers are having to stop every five seconds to deal with the stupid people that work for these apps Just looking at their dumb phones. They are the worst. And the alerts for the apps???? Come on! No one wants to hear that when you spending your hard earned (not stimulus) money. This slows down your whole operation for what? $800.00 in profit for one night? You could have made $3,000 in profit if they had time to reseat, reset, do side work properly (girl rolling silverware back by bathrooms with no gloves on rolling silverware. You gotta get the little things right or you'll never get the big things right they say. They missed some small things that would have led to me giving another star, spending another $30.00 but we didn't get dessert offered to us. TURN OFF THE DELIVERY APPS DURING PEAK SERVICE TIME!!!! Duh!!!!!!

7. Sodas were flattish. Not dead but not great. Get coke to come out and calibrate the lines, flush them and get your co2 tanks in tune with said soda machine. I ordered two sodas for myself. Coke and a root beer. Both were a little off. For a place that doesn't sell liquor you should get this right. 
8. The Lebanese tea? So delicious with that rose water. Yum yum. And the pine nuts were delicious. I had never had this before.

Stopped in for pizza with my daughter.  Ordered a pizza.  Service was great up till our pizza came out.  Toppings were pretty much shifted to one side.  I mean really shifted.  
We had ordered half without mushrooms, they were all over the place.  Barely any black olives, I could count on my 1 hand, over cooked. Seriously, I would not ask for reorder but pizza was not pleasant looking   

I asked the waiter about our pizza being that I believe he should have looked it over before serving us.  He called over his manager who was another young lady.  Looked at my pizza, said its suppose to be that way  it happens.  I inquired about the topping and she said " well it's not enough there I agree".  She took a while looking at it, I wondered what she doing. I asked her if we could get a new pizza and she finally responded she would. 

New pizza better but not much. 
We liked the thin crust, sauce tasty not over done, but they need to evaluate the cooks pizzas a little more.

I'm not big on giving one star reviews, but this will probably help a lot of people.

I showed up in Tucson for a birthday, & spent some now wasted money, on an outfit.
Before leaving Arizona, I decided to get the clothes I had just bought, dry cleaned, so I can go home with all clean clothes.

Not only were they closed early (w/ other very angry patrons outside) the following day when I came back, was even worse.

You did not dry clean my clothing, you washed it, and not only did you wash it, you washed it in hot water.

My jeans, & my shirt came back faded; not only that, but also a few sizes smaller.
