I didn't need the explanation (that was bogus) on how my 3 day old Levis, that I had worn once, were faded, & the legs could barely fit my arms. I dry clean my pants on a regular basis, & that has never happened after one cleaning.

Not only did I not get my refund, I had my clothing ruined, & both times I showed up, someone else was there with a complaint.

Find a small local dry cleaner, & avoid these chains; my clothing got ruined, my money was wasted, & it burned a lot of my time.

This bar / restaurant is in a great location on the Riverwalk next to The Armature Works Restaurant Complex. It should be the perfect place to enjoy some light fare and cocktails while watching the sunset over the Hillsborough River. BUT....it's not because there are two bartenders that are HORRIBLE. One blond who wears ponytails thinks she is doing you a favor waiting on you with a very pretentious and condescending attitude usually. The other is a tall white guy with a beard who is equally as bitchy in his own way. Both work the busy evenings during the week and weekend, so it is hard to avoid them. Everyone including their coworkers know about their nasty dispositions but the management obviously think they are good for business in spite of their poor customer service and sense of entitlement. It's a shame because the other bartenders are great. 

Avoid this place if you can during the busy times if you wanted to be treated like a valued customer.
Everyone who works here is so painfully incompetent and slow, I can't stand it. The worst.

I've been coming to Oggi for a few years. I get eyebrow wax service from Yelena S. She is very thorough, patient and nice.

The room where I get my service is always clean, sanitary, smells good and is super relaxing.
We had a lackluster experience. Quality of the food was OK. Maybe a step up from Food Court food. The server was nice.

Finally, a good, quick Mediterranean spot in town!

Tried out this new place after seeing a BOGO deal with the SB Axxess app. I know that it had recently opened so figured it give 'em a try. I was not disappointed. 

Ordered two entrees - dinner and then lunch for the next day. The falafel pitas I ordered were wonderful! Fresh, flavorful, colorful, just perfection. The menu was fairly expansive and I look forward to trying more of their items in the future!

Fala Bar is in the popular SB Public Market, a spot which attracts good eateries although most don't seem to last long. Fala is a small chain from what I'd gathered so I am hopeful that they do well here and continue making great Mediterranean fare for the local patrons. 

Give this place a try!
Dr. Jenkins is the best PCP I've ever had. He's so thorough, caring, and wise., not to mention the hardest working physician I know.

Ordered pizza and cheesesteak sub. Pizza tasted good but was warm, not hot. I don't live very far away so not sure why it wasn't hot since delivery was 10 minutes early.
Cheesesteak was not as requested. Specifically requested "no mushrooms" and even said 'Please'. Don't give mushrooms to someone who hates them, it can make them not ever return. It's really hard to pick them out of cheesesteak. On the fence about returning.

We had the BEST experience adopting our little Maltese from Animal Kingdom in Tucson. We drove in from Phoenix after Amanda sent us all of the information about the puppy that we were inquiring about the day after we put our deposit down. When we got there we were taken to a play room to get to know him a little bit. He had obviously been well taken care of while he was there because he was very comfortable with us and loved treats! When we brought him home he was so comfortable with our dogs and made himself right at home. We also had two people follow up to ensure that he was adjusting okay. I would highly recommend Animal Kingdom in Tucson if you're looking for a new addition to your family.

Sooooooo good! Went here for dinner on a Monday evening & was so impressed by the food!

We started with sake and a guava cider to drink. For appetizer we had the brussel sprouts, they were delicious! They had a salty yummy sauce with bell pepper and onion, I highly recommend. For the entree we had the seafood udon and the seafood stone pot, both were excellent! The udon had shrimp, mussels, crab and some veggies in a really good seafood broth. The stone pot had rice, a variety of seafood and an egg, it was perfectly spiced. We ended with the lava cake that came with a scoop of green tea ice cream! Don't leave without having the dessert it was so good!

The service and food were all excellent, we will be back
for sure!

This location is absolute shit like literally shit terrible customer service they always get orders wrong fuck this place and the degenerate pussy ass people that work there especially the ugly ass bald guy with all of the dumbass tattoos all over him

Good relaxed environment. Dog friendly and awesome staff...they have doggy treats by the way. :) It can get very busy there so just be cautious bringing your pups there during those times. Good prices on drinks and a pool table. However, you may have to wait awhile for a turn to play.

Will try to fine and harass you for everything. From a garbage can left one day over and just an overall bull of an association at Fishjawk Ranch. Will make sure your life is s living hell when asking for records that they can't or do but want to produce along with excessive fees and preferential treatment to certain homeowners

IHOP has shrunk their pancakes significantly! They are on a small side plate and are still smaller than the plate. On this visit, they overcooked them too which made them hard to cut with a fork. The rest of the food was okay.

This train station pretty much sucks But the train ride itself was great It was clean it left exactly on time and arrived exactly on time the workers were friendly and polite The train station in Chicago was so much nicer than the St Louis one It was much cleaner had more food options and the people working were much nicer and more professional. And i wasn't terrified of getting shot mugged or car jacked on the parking lot unlike the station in St Louis

The name Il Retomo is Italian for "the return," a reference to the fact that Chef David Benstock returned to the Tampa Bay area where his culinary career began after many years spent abroad, in New York, California and Colorado and everywhere else he worked to perfect his skills.

The name just as easily speaks for what most of the downtown St. Petersburg restaurant's patrons must think after dining here - how soon they will return. 

With its exposed brick wall, high ceiling and discreet lighting, the 40-plus seat restaurant is quite comfortable whether you are enjoying a casual night out or celebrating some special event. 

The food is described as rustic Italian and features inventive and unexpected combinations of ingredients that will only be offered as long as they are in season and really fresh. Then other inspired dishes will take their place.

To really do justice to the menu, and not deny your tastebuds of the adventure that awaits, it may be best to order the Chef's Five-Course Tasting Menu and leave your dinner up to the discretion of the chef. You won't be sorry and you certainly won't go hungry.

I really took notice of Il Ritorno when it landed on the the 2016 Tampa Bay Times' Top 50 Restaurants of Tampa Bay list. Out of all of the restaurants reviewed that I had not yet tried, it was at the top of my "got to go" list.

How good was my meal? I ate - make that devoured - vegetables I never touch. I was more than full but the food kept coming and I did not leave a single morsel untouched. I wanted to attack each course as it came out but consciously forced myself to take small bites and chew very slowly to make it last as long as possible.

I only know that I, too, will return. And it can't be soon enough.

Hey - the One More lounge has a corn hole tournament on Thursday nights....fun...fun.  Are you any good?  Are up for some competition, or you scared?  Ha!  Hope to see you there.

Also - here lately they have had some kickin' bands in house with drink specials and killer food.

Check 'em out!!
Great service and great food. Anthony complaining about his tip and his Groupon was trying to get something for free. You get what you pay for and Mineos is amazing. John does a first class job l.

Allow me to share my most objective review despite my frustrations with the apparent staffing issues here. The other customer's food looked great, the location was very nice as well as the ambience. That said, I didn't get to actually taste the food or coffee. I stood in line for 25 minutes and simply ran out of time. There were only three customers ahead of me and the one person working the place seemed to do a good job handling them. Oh did she take her time. That said this place really can benefit from having another person working there there. Might step in later if I see that.
The eggs and hashbrown did not have any flavor, it lacked seasoning and the biscuits were extremely dry. The sausage was also dry and taste store bought. The freanch toast was soggy.

Worst experience ever. Every time.  I don't know why I have ordered from them more than once because they can never get an order right. I complained to the "manager" & he was talking over me the entire time and yelling at me. Never. Ever. Again.!!! Spend your money elsewhere :)

Very inattentive trainer. Arrogant. Thinks way too highly of himself and his training lacks quality and motivation. Save the money and go elsewhere. Or watch a YouTube video for workouts because the quality is about the same.

I have regrettably rented with this company for the last 3 years at the same location. I've dealt with rent hikes, broken "hand shake" deals(because they refused to put the terms in my lease) outrageous fees, numerous eviction threats because of their incompetence(not accounting for rent that had already been paid, going back on "payment plans" for their fees)I could go on and on really but my latest complaint is with their "maintenance hotline".I've spent the last 3 days without a working toilet and have called repeatedly to put in a work order. When I call to find out the status or how soon I can expect someone to show I get the same answer "I see your work order here, I'll make sure to tell the property management" yet here we are day 3 with no working toilet. I don't think this is a large or outrageous request but somehow it's being treated as so. Stay far, far, far, far, away from this company. They are a greedy, joke and could care less about their tenants.

Absolutely terrible service! We were seated for 20 minutes before our waiter brought us water and only after we spoke to the manager did our waiter take our (watered down) drink order which easily took another 15-20 minutes to get to our table. We were at the restaurant close to 1.5 hours before we even got our food which was mediocre and bland. I ordered arepas, they were more like mini rock hard polenta disks (couldn't cut into 2 of them) with bland shredded beef over top. The live music (which also started 30 minutes late) was the only positive of our entire experience. I will NOT be returning or recommending this place!
Friendly service and great pizza!  Definitely a place to return to when I'm in town!  Plus the decor is super cool!

This place rocks!  There are so many exhibits to see here.  It is a lot of hands on for the kids and adults both.  Admission is Free except for special exhibits.  One special exhibit we did was the flight simulator.  It was fun flying our fighter jet! (two people per flight).  We didn't need to do this though - there are so many things to do here, you can fill your day without spending a dime on the special exhibits and still have a great time.  

NOTE: Although admission is free, parking $12 per car (in 2017) - unless you can snag a street spot like we did.

I have always had a great experience here. Danielle Bueno is super sweet and an amazing hair stylist. She goes above and beyond and has never let me down. My hair is hard to style. This last time, I needed last minute appt for photos - unable to come in when DAnielle was available so I tried my luck. Brooke Kennedy did a fantastic job- did exactly what I wanted from a photo. Super sweet. Try one of these 2 stylists for sure! You will not be sorry!Nan Case, who is over cosmetics is amazing! She used to do makeup application but no longer does. She does a great job managing the cosmetics, though.

I am so disappointed in this place we looked at the reviews before going and we still decided to give it a chance. We got here and as soon as we sat down we waited at least 15 minutes before a server came and acknowledged us. Finally after acknowledging us we decided to place our order for our drink and our food at the same time. We waited another 25 minutes before our drinks came and then when our food came it was cold. When I asked the person who served me my food if they could re-warm up the food she took it to the back and then our server shrugged his shoulders as if it was annoying to him that we made him rewarm our food up. After about 30 minutes of eating my friend ordered a margarita and it never came when we told our server that it did not come he seemed confused and we just asked for our check. Terrible service, the server was attentive to every single one of the tables around us except our specific table. Disappointment is an understatement.

What a great experience I had at Howard's this week!  My Honda Metropolitan's battery was dying so I called this bike shop, spoke with a very friendly man who quickly checked inventory and said that they would be happy to put it in for me at no charge.  I arrived after work as they were closing, but the owner was most accommodating, gave me a great price on the battery, offered me birthday cake!, had the garage remove/dispose of the old one, checked my charging system to ensure that there were no issues there, checked my tire pressure (and filled them), and sent me on my way in less than 18 minutes.  Super nice guys, professional, and knowledgeable.  Customer service doesn't get any better than this.

Very professional & skilled. Put in a very good ac system that they do scheduled maintenance on. Working exceptionally and really keeping the house cool plus filtering air well. Really happy with our new ac system!
Great food and service.  Nellie, our server, was so friendly and did a great job!  The food was hot and perfectly cooked.  Nellie checked on us often and made us feel welcome.

My boyfriend just moved here from Massachusetts and we've set out on a quest to find the very best pizza in Indianapolis. NY Slice was on our list as we've driven by many times and have been dying to try them. 

We stopped in this evening while out running errands. I had trouble entering the pizza shop as the door was closed but the sign said open. I called in to the shop and the owner informed me that they were open but having trouble with the door sticking. The restraunt was not really decorated which I found unpretentious and wondered if it perhaps was meant to let the pizza do the talking. The owner was very friendly and talked to me while he made the cheese slice that I ordered. 

The pizza slice was huge! We found the price at $3.50 a slice to be a bit pricey. However, the pizza was delicious. My boyfriend said it really tasted New York style. NY Slice has been the best tasting pizza that we have found in Indy!

In conversing with the shop owner, I mentioned that I had heard pizza trucks were the new wedding craze, he confirmed that he has catered some weddings!
None of this size ring is the hotels that you know after the remodels and everything is there room for a fabulous we are to see it sticks concert and they are fabulous as well always a go

The staff is rude and makes no attempt to resolve their mistakes. They are slow. The only person who displayed any sign of customer service was the onboardi g sales agent. I would never use them if the auto dealer hadn't selected themfor a low rate.

I know it Covid time but these folks are UNETHICAL!!! 

ZERO.

This place is great and clean. It used to be called something else, but since it's been. The big event the quality of the place is much better. The staff is friendly and it's easy to get a lane.  I think the old name was playdrome

Great food, reasonable prices, Friendly family orientated. It has genuine Thai food with a fantastic variety. Every time we go there, my wife and I have something different. There is nothing we wouldn't recommend. Their three flavor fish is my personal favorite. Take out is just as good as when you dine in.
Excellent food, always great service, one of my favorite places in Tucson.

I've had nothing but solid interactions with Justin.  They took over my pool when I'd been struggling with it for a few months, and got it stable right away.  They check my cartridge filters, notice when there are problems with the equipment, and make adjustments when necessary (without me having to manage the process.)  They do service calls for problems that are exceptions (e.g. my heater and pool light were broken) and they are reasonable and knowledgeable.  They also have done landscaping projects for me, and when there was a problem, not only did they fix it, they also gave me a credit because the problem had cost me money.  I think that any service/contractor/vendor you use, you have to approach it as a partnership because you have to have good communication for both parties to benefit and to be happy.  Plus, with any contractors, it is the nature of the beast to sometimes encounter problems because you're dealing with equipment that breaks, or like in the other post dated 09/10/2010, they are having workforce issues, or for any other number of reasons.  I know that Luna, and the folks I've encountered that are working for Luna, all want to do a good job, and make the effort to do so.  I really recommend them.

Cellairis is great. Easy, fast, and affordable. I would highly recommend.
My screen is back to normal.

Forever and a day my girlfriend and I have been huge Iron Chef fans. We often marvel at Chef Morimoto's skill and the dishes he comes up with on the show. We never ever thought we would have the chance to actually dine at one of his restaurants. This weekend we traveled to Philadelphia and I just happened to come across this restaurants as I was trying to find a special place to celebrate my girlfriend's birthday. I called and was lucky enough to make reservations. From the minute we arrived we were treated like a million dollars. Our server was Alejandra, she was tremendous. She expertly took us through the menu and she was so personable. Even suggested some sake which would pair with my food and my taste. For starters we had the Salmon carpaccio, it was out of this world. Sliced so thinly and yet packed with flavor. My girlfriend ordered the Miso soup, I am normally not a fan but I tasted it and it was good. For our entrees I had the 12 oz. American NY strip served with the Caulilini Gomaae which essentially was cauliflower fried with bread crumbs. I love cauliflower but this side was outrageously good. The best I ever had!!! My girlfriend had the Kalbi lamb chops with the Wasabi fried rice. The chops were cooked perfectly and the fried rice was so good. The Wasabi have the rice an amazing flavor. At first I thought it would be too hot but it wasn't. She loved it. Since we were celebrating a birthday we had to get dessert and boy was I so glad we left room for dessert- we ordered the Fiery Chocolate. The Fiery Chocolate is flourless chocolate cake, raspberry ice cream, toasted meringue, sesame. Bottom line if you come here, you have to order this dessert. It was unbelievable, I could eat this every day. The dessert was served, they poured a cup of grain alcohol over the chocolate sphere and as it melted it exposed the chocolate cake. What an amazing display which tasted even better. The whole meal was perfect, if I could give 10 stars I would.

Perhaps the best fresh roll I've had in a long time ( our app. ). It was a Monday evening and not many diners, the service was good. I had pumpkin curry. Repeat, pumpkin curry. It was amazing. My companion had mixed seafood with ginger sauce, he loved it and it did look very good with fresh veggies and mushrooms. Thai basil was evident in the dishes, giving it that distinct yum. New fave Thai place.

We got 2 plain pies pickup. And let me tell you: when they say thin-crust, they mean THIN. Thinner than most crackers I've had. Think two standard paper plates together-thickness. Maybe its just not my thing, but boy was it dry. For $15 per large plain pie, not a good bargain either. The only reason they don't get 1-star is that its organic, and the restaurant had a good atmosphere and friendly service.
Loved the falafel sandwich! Cannot wait to walk over for another, maybe today, if they are open post Zeta.

We love this place. All locations, but love having one near our home. I'm not much on sports bars, but the food here is truly good. Really good. Love their chicken strips! Service is always good as well. If you're looking for reasonably priced good food in a fun atmosphere, this is your place.

All we needed was an estimate for a replacement exterior door. Just come out and measure it, and take my money. Nope... my wife had to be there as well, plus it would take an hour and a half for the "meeting." Jeez, just replace the door. Never got past this point and said so long! If you value your time, call someone else.
I have found that AJ is the best guy to go to at Coastal Dispensary. Did I mention that coastal is the premier shop in town? Go see AJ and he will get you what you need!!

Wife and I went for dinner this past weekend and the place is beautiful. Cool design and furnishings inside. Barstools are comfy and bartenders were very attentive. We started with wings and fried green tomatoes - both of which were great. I would say they came out too fast. Literally 5 mins after ordered. But hot and tasty, not under a lamp that I could tell.

Bourbon list is lacking many of the better bourbons that you'd expect a place like this to have. I was however impressed with their house bourbons (the higher proof). 

We ordered the Wagyu steak, which was the reason for only 3 stars. I could not chew it enough to swallow. It was tough and inedible. The waiter properly asked if I wanted something else, or to provide another. I never send anything back, so he took it off the bill. I appreciate how well he handled it. 

We will be back and hope this was simply a bad piece of meat.

Great food! Great customer service from friendly staff! Always quick service, too! 
I order corned beef and Swiss which comes with their hot chow. So delicious! I have had many sandwiches and salads and all are awesome!

Fantastic customer service and a beautiful location! No complaints whatsoever.

Our food came quickly and our server was quick to make amends for one of our drinks being made incorrectly.

This is a chain that we frequent often for date night and based off of our experience at the South Tampa location, we intend to return.

Specials: 
- "Tempting Tuesdays" with $10 tickets and $22 3-course meals (this is all day every Tuesday)
- "Wine Wednesday" provides discounts on wine in the lounge all day every Wednesday

Loved this place! Food was AMAZING, very flavorful wait time was short even during a busy time. Staff was friendly and nice! Not the biggest place for seating but for just two and a baby, it was no problem getting a table. Definitely looking forward to going back!

Along with the delicious food the staff was very welcoming. If you are in Santa Barbara and craving for "paella" this is the place to go. 
Churro is a must try dessert. Their vanilla ice cream goes very well with churro.

I can't recommend this place enough!  I was visiting from Las Vegas and heard great things about the shakes.  I'm so glad I listened!  The food is incredible and the service is too.  My server made sure that everything was how I ordered and my soda was kept full.  I had the loaded grilled cheese and ordered the cheesy tots.  I debated since I already had the sandwich, but it ended up being a great choice.  The tots were sitting in this amazing cheese sauce (no canned nacho cheese here!) and melted shredded cheese on top.  My favorite part was feeling like I was in an old school diner complete with Formica tables and glass Heinz ketchup bottles!

I was in an accident and had to get a rental. I was asked if I wanted waiver damage and so I asked if the insurance company usually reimburses this. I was misinformed by the clerk and told yes. It was $560 for 33 days. The insurance company will not pay for this. I called and the manager told me NO insurance companies don't pay for this so she gave me a slight refund for the misinformation, but I am still out hundreds of dollars due to being misinformed by someone I Trusted. I am sick over this and feel a full refund for the waiver damage should be issued.  I also had to pay for the regular off the street price and the insurance company will only reimburse for their discounted rate , so altogether ( after some slight refund from enterprise) $800 altogether.    Enterprise says they can't help me any more than the slight refund they gave me of $468 out of the $1200 difference, but I am sure that they can make this right. I will delete this review once I am fully reimbursed.

I've been here twice.  The fist time I would say it was nice.  I've never eaten dinner here but it's nice to get a drink, have a big relaxing seat and no kids.  I have no idea what happened last night.  Everything was fine until I saw the ladies room.  Before the show there were towels on the floor and the stall I walked into, of course, had no toilet paper.  There was stack of paper towels which tells me this didn't just happen.  So after the show I was in the bathroom again, I figured they needed time to clean after the last show.  Nope, towels on the floor.  I opted for a different stall since it looked like no one had cleaned in the two hours I was in the theater.  No toilet paper in that stall either.  For the money paid, how about cleaning the bathroom?  Very disappointed as it takes from he upscale feel of the place.  Especially since my date and I (and everyone who orders) had to pay a 17.5% tip just for popcorn and soda.  The bathrooms at the Westshore mall theater are cleaner!

To agree with a previous review, this is definitely just an average bar.  There's really no appeal.  I usually just stop in when some of my other regular spots are packed.  It's got a big bar, but it's kinda odd.  If you're sitting at the farthest end of the bar, away from the regular door, you feel like you're sitting at another bar.  Everyone always comes in from the parking lot and settles down at that one same end all the time.  Don't get me wrong, the place really isn't packed regularly.  You've got a good chance to find a seat.  I've never had the food here, so I can't give any advice on what to get or avoid.

If there is one thing I know about, it's cheeseburgers.  And this place does not have good ones.  The "lacey" patties lacked flavor, there was nothing great setting it apart.  The French fries were harden soaked by grease.  Definitely go to five guys, or even wendys, before this place.  Did not try the custard.

Friendly staff, however, the food seems pretty over priced for the average person. Lattes were bomb, but the breakfast sandwiches were dry and kind of bland--basically the food was mediocre (I'd rather go somewhere like Panara for food like this). I recommend going for the experience though, the atmosphere was awesome. 

If the food tasted better, this place would've gotten five stars.

Just called for carry out and they were too busy to take a carry out order. the price is always 2 or 3 dollars higher than the on line menu when you pick it up. must be struggling...give this one a wide birth.
This is my favorite brunch spot for Sunday Funday in the warmer months! I order either the gringos or Smokey and the Benedict!

I ordered take out from here on Friday afternoon. I ordered the sushi lunch but I wanted to get a tuna roll instead because i'm allergic to avocado. I explained this to the woman on the phone multiple times and I still had to repeat my order over and over again. On top of that she seemed to have no idea what was even on the menu. I get there and pick up my food. Once I sit down to actually eat they just gave me a California roll with tuna added and got the rest of my order wrong as well. I guess don't order take out from them because the people who answer the phone are clearly incompetent. Food was okay though so that's why it gets 2 stars.

We stopped in the other night and were concerned that Apna might be closed as the place was empty. Thankfully, an employee came in to greet us and ensured us that they were open and the food was delicious. He was right. We both enjoyed our meals, the paneer butter masala and the lamb kebab, and thought the value was great for the price.

Unfortunately, we do not live in the area but I would recommend Apna for their buffet. Reading the labels, it looks like they have a great assortment and for $9.99 you can't go wrong!

All your NFL Saints, NBA Hornets, and LSU Tigers memorabilia.

Mon - Sat open at 10 am. 

Tons and tons of Saints clothing and plenty of other knick knacks:  cozies, golf balls, beads, luggage, cute baby onesies.

Prices are steep for below par items, read:  cheap counterfeit-like  clothing.  Poor material for a Saints polo shirt - $40!  no way....

Attached is the Purple & Gold store with loads of LSU outfits as well.

The store is all bare bones with just racks and hangers.   But it obviously didn't matter as it was 3 days before Christmas and merchandise was flying out of the store.

Eh, whatever....this store is for the true Saints fan...which I'm ashamed to admit not being.
The best experience I have had.Rudy at Lumber has been my angel when things were falling apart.Great service,great communication,great people ! Go Rudy !!!

Quick in and out. What makes it great? Southern hospitality of course. When I was there they had live jazz and a songtress belting out music. Smells of southern cuisine fill your nose and bathrooms are always clean and picked up. I rented a car ons the spot (shoutout to AVIS) to push out to NAWLINS and was glad I did as the line for taxis was fierce. I will be back NAWLINS soon!

I've been waiting for this deli to open all my life! My mom has been buying bread from here since before I was born. Historically, there were places that served their sandwiches on Sarcones bread throughout the city. And these places always had the top rated hoagies and cheesesteaks. Finally, they opened up their own deli to serve hoagies and sandwiches on their own bread. My gosh are they good. The deli is not far from Gino's and Pat's steaks. So if you find yourself in Philly doing the tourist sandwich rounds then be sure to head on up to Sarcone's deli and grab yourself an Italian hoagie (or rendition thereof). You will not regret it.

I know this review is going to look bad by a lot of comparisons, but I don't want it to deter anyone from going to Café Lift.  The place has its own charm.  It's on the first floor of a loft building underneath a bridge passing in a not so nice neighborhood, which for some reason is appealing to me.  Mainly due to the fact that every other brunch place in the city has a long line out the door... unfortunately , enough people have found about Café Lift to add it to that list.
As for the food... the S.S.S is good and the lemon ricotta pancakes are sweet and delicious, but it seems like most everything else on the menu has four pounds of eggs overwhelming anything else in the dish, slapped with a mound of lifeless potatoes.  Why do Philly breakfast/brunch joints do this?  It seems way too common to me; Sabrina's is the worst about that crap.  The specials are usually pretty good, but I hope they break away from the Frittata craze, because I don't think anyone else has it.
The staff is pretty unaware of their surroundings, continuously passing by people who need service and rushing people when they finally show up to take an order.  Yet for some reason unknown to even myself, I still kind of like this place.

I've recently traded my Acura for a Honda Civic EX 2017 and the person to assist me with the trade & gave me a great deal was Isaac Santana, who was extremely helpful and super awesome! My experience was such a breeze due to his assistance, I would definitely recommend doing business with him at the Honda Kuhn dealership!

Went there about a month ago with a buddy of mine to try it out. WOW, outstanding. As we ordered & we're waiting we noticed so old familiar pictures on the wall, when the owner delivered our food we questioned him about the pictures & come to find out that he use to cook for the establishment in the pictures on the wall. It was Womacks out of Lake Tahoe which we had been going to for 35yrs. When we tasted the food it was the same recipes from there which he got to take with him when Womacks closed. Outstanding, including the Sweet Potato Pie.

I would normally  give this restaurant a awesome review but Saturday November 4 2016 I took part of my family there for the breakfast  menu. I have to say the Bacon and Sausage was  so salty it wasn't  fit to eat.  The whole table had commented about it.  The server wasn't around to address and we were in a hurry. When I paid I had to tell the cashier we didn't get our tickets. I just knew that I would call back and speak to the manager and they would make it right.  WRONG... the Female Manager came to the phone and was very rude and  said it was my fault for not saying anything. She Wouldn't or couldn't understand I had NO time to wait for a redo. She needs customer service training... I told her that my experience with her was worse then the awful meat. I asked for the owner and all she would say is the owner is out of the country.  Because of her attitude I will never eat there again and I recommend that you don't either.  A few miles away is a nice pleasing Cracker Barrel that is half the cost.

Have been going to Chubby's for years with no complaints - Went last weekend - and had a horrible experience - arrived home with my steaks with nothing on them that I asked for (no mayo on the bread, none of the cheese I asked for) , and the meat was flavorless

Also - Really disappointed that the pickles and peppers have been moved behind the counter - and having had to ask for them instead of a sign being out that says they are available upon request 

I know weekends are busy - but hoping you guys will improve - really disappointed

Worst indian food I've had in the US. The mysore masala dosa was very average. Idlis were like stones and vada was undercooked. The chutneys are bad. Sambar is decent. Didn't try the kati rolls but will not be coming back here. I don't understand why this place is popular.

Were staying at the Hyatt and the concierge recommended it as being the best restaurant in the area.
We decided to go there but I would have rather gone to MacDonald's. The place looks classey but the food was far from that. I ordered the new York strip and scallops.  The steak had not a drop of seasoning on it except parsley flakes.  I thought I was eating a plain steak.  Don't go there stop at MacDonald's or Wendy's at least you know your paying for nothing.

I wasn't raised to like lima beans. In fact, the mental image I carry of these legumes is accompanied by severe freezer burn. But when I ate the lima beans at Cochon, I felt like I had been transported to my grandmother's kitchen on a hot summer day, just relishing the taste of these beans obviously braised with pork and buttered until they cried 'mercy.' Cochon doesn't feature an extensive menu but everything on it is exquisite and its waiters are extremely knowledgeable about pairings--what to eat with lima beans, for example. My husband and I enjoyed a leisurely lunch here in February topped with a great dessert of checkerboard cake (it was my birthday) and some catdaddy moonshine. Cochon may be reviving this long illicit spirit and I hope they do. The moonshine (80 proof) was sublime. Discovering new tastes and remembering old comfortable flavors is an unlikely pairing when dining out. Cochon hit both marks with ease.

This is the 4th locally owned breakfast place we have visited during our stay in Reno and it was by far our favorite!!! The food was fantastic! I ordered the cinnamon roll waffle. It was cooked perfectly and the taste was excellent. The coffee is yummy. The service was great--very friendly. The atmosphere is retro and fun. Great place!!!

Great experience! We just stepped out of the restaurant, and my only regret is not trying Davio's sooner. Restaurant week 2 lunch menu lured us in. Noteworthy choices were the tomato soup with goat cheese crostini, shrimp scampi, beef short rib with spinach and crispy polenta, gnocchi with mushrooms and truffle oil, lemon meringue, and blueberry panda cotta. Our server Joey was personable and helpful...went above and beyond in offering tastings of two wine possibilities and in replacing boxed leftovers that got lost in the kitchen. Atmosphere is special, but not stuffy, and it is nice to have an environment that allows conversation. We have eaten lunches and dinners at MANY Center City restaurants, and Davio's is up there with the front runners.

Quality has gone down. The food simply isn't fresh. The onions in my sandwich looked like they were sliced a day ago. The fries were soggy and over-fried. It seemed like they were day-old fries that had been refried. It's sad when a place can't even make decent fries. The matzo ball soup seems to be the only good they they make.

For the restuarant to be a "4 Star" is definitely a NO NO, quality of the food, service not so great, and extremely price for what you get. For a restaurant to be right by the beach, 4 star rating & prices we were expecting more from it. Not coming back.

Great atmosphere, great music, and most importantly great beer! They have a variety of games to play including giant Jenga, connect four, foosball, darts, shuffle board, ping pong, and more. Great place for an outing with friends!

The Windsor Court is a fine hotel but it feels like you are staying at your wealthy grandmothers house. The service level is very high but I don't think the overall experience matches the Ritz. The color palate of the rooms is a beige-blue with taupe trim and the curtains at are all flowery. Rooms are large and you often get upgraded to a suite when they aren't busy -- which is a plus. You can tell they updated he bathrooms and put in more contemporary stand up showers but closet space is sorely lacking -- which you might expect with a suite. 

Another particular nuisance is the speed of the complimentary internet. If you are going to offer it for free, it should be able to work consistently. It's painfully slow. Emails take forever to send and webpages crawl to existence. Forget watching Netflix. Proof of painfully slow speeds. http://www.speedtest.net/my-result/i/2232276872

The plumbing in the hotel is frustrating too. Showers will drop in water pressure when a toilet near you flushes. Hot water can be spotty at times. Our shower drain was clogged. I can imagine things like this are a challenge with older hotels but I would expect more from a hotel at this price point. 

The staff at the hotel is a bright spot. They seem very loyal and well trained. They do little things like add flowers to your suite (which were clearly leftover from an arrangement) but it's a smart touch. 

The bar is very good and the staff in the Polo Lounge is knowledgeable about cocktails and things to do in the city. You can tell they are passionate about New Orleans and it's exudes into their suggestions as they give you ideas of things to do in the city. 

Valet parking is $44-50 a day. Park elsewhere as this is ridiculous. 

Beds at the hotel are large and comfortable. The pillows are down and a favorite for the picky traveler.

Was in NOLA the last day of Mardi Gras through Friday.  The jambalaya is the best I've ever had!  I didn't care for the etouffee, but it wasn't because it tasted bad, more just a matter of personal taste.  I ordered the combination that included jambalaya/etouffee and while it was a bit pricey (19.00), it also included beans/rice, greens, and potato salad (huge scoop - excellent and I'm picky about my potato salad).  It was two meals - lunch and dinner.  I also ordered a side of Mae's File' gumbo.  At first when I tasted it I thought it was lacking something - and then I added the tabasco sauce... BAM!  That was the missing ingredient and man did it sing!  Also, one of the best gumbo's I've had :)  I was a very happy girl after this meal(s) lol.  My son had the po'boy fried chicken sandwich - it was HUGE!!!   He ate the whole thing, not sure how, but he did :)  Finally, while the ordering process is assembly line, we ordered to go and headed to the very back area to wait for our meals.  While we waited, a very nice gentleman came over and chatted w/us.  He even offered to go to the main area and get a glass of wine for me (the area we were in had a bar, but it was not open at that time).  I thought this was exceptionally nice and combined w/the food it was a very fine experience.  We went  to Dickie Brennan's the night before - another excellent meal/dining experience, but Mother's rates right up there for us!  Well done and thank you Mother's, you will always have a place in our hearts :)

I don't know. When I first got to Philadelphia i was all about Cosi. I would even fight with friends about how wonderful Cosi was in comparison to Panera Bread. 2 years later, I'm sorta Take it or Leave it. As my pallet has become more sophisticated I have grown bored of the menu at Cosi. But it's not all that bad. Some of the good things are that they are open late, and change into a restaurant at night time with a wait staff. They have a liquor license, so you can get a grown up drink there ;) And they are consistent, with a menu that is approachable and not intimidating.

Lisa saved my hair! I had a series of terrible haircuts  - moving to a new area is just the worst for finding a good stylist. 
Lisa took a horrible cut and made it great! She asks all kinds of excellent questions in your consultations to help you figure out exactly what you want to do. 
THANK YOU LISA

The first thing I'll admit to you is that I live directly across the street so it's a proximately 45 second jump across the street for me.  I'm probably a regular when it comes to picking up foods I am craving but did not want to pick up at the regular grocery store because I had a disciplined brain during the grocery store visit. 
There are plenty of things you can buy that are not in bulk, such as a single container of whip cream or a bag of grandma vanilla cookies.  I also occasionally buy a box of inexpensive chicken burritos or a huge bag of pasta shells that I can boil. 
 ( when I move away from this apartment ,I'm sure I'll do a lot better on my keto diet, which yes, is low-carb )
Not a fan! Very inexpensive BYOB but to many other places with better good. It's small and very cramped. One and done kind of place.

Server was awesome she knew her stuff!!! Definitely a keeper! Food was really good. Yes it's pricey but what we had was good.  Now the BUT they charged us more for our beers than what was posted on their menu. One of our beers weren't on the list as it replaced one that was out so we don't know about that one.  The only reason we knew the prices was because we still had the beer list.  We pointed it out and they did refund $2.00 which really should have been $4.  The server apologized but as I told her it wasn't her error.  They have a POS system, management should have been responsible not let her take the fall.  So if we were over charged how many others are overcharged? When I told Gretchen she wasn't to blame she still totally took responsibility because as she stated they are all a team.  Give that girl a raise. She was awesome and totally a team player!!  So word of advice check your bill!!

Friendly, professional, and clean branch.
Wish SUNCOAST participated in shares service banking, though!!

Nice sports bar with plenty of TV's. I came to watch a playoff game and was promptly seated. The waitress was great. We ordered the wings, which were  good. I had the gumbo. This was probably the worst part of the night, it was bland and tasteless. I also tried the burger of the month. It was a tad dry and need some seasoning. Overall good place to watch the game, but the food needs improvement.

I'm documenting my second time I was here. Trendy, hipster-ish place that isn't large enough to meet its popularity. Place can seat about 8-10 people comfortably in the wait area. We got there around 11:30ish on a late Sat morning, and my friends and I had to wait about 10-15 minutes for a table of 3. There's a small space at the bar/counter by the register for about 2-3 people if you wanna hurry up.

Food took about another 15 minutes to come out. Not bad, place was full, if not very close to capacity, so they had to be bustin tail at this peak time. I had the Huevos Rancheros with a side of potatoes for $9.50. Portions are more than fair and worth the money. Roasted red peppers was a different spin than what I'd eaten elsewhere. Came with quartered, red taters were super garlicky. The whole dish had flavor, nothing bland about this dish at all. I enjoyed it with my 2 cups of coffee, and I didn't eat for 5 hours after that meal and I have a fast metabolism.

Service was friendly. Although, before I was finishing my last 3 bites, all pre-cut like my steak when I was 5, our 1 of 3 servers places the check on the table....."No rush", she said and walks away. Really?? Then why did you put this here? What if I wanted more coffee? I hate that passive-aggressive bullshit. I did swivel my head around (my back was to the waiting area) and the line was going into the entrance stairwell. So I get it, but I frigging despise that move!

That said, I did enjoy my food. My friends cleaned off their plates too. I bet if I came here at an off-peak time, I bet my experience would be better. I'd give them another shot. I hadn't been here since '08 when they were still Cafe Lift and there was close to no wait.

P.S. - Their ventilation system is not adequate. You come out smelling like the aromas of the food. I recall this both times I've eaten there.

P.S.S - Lots of eye candy. Couldn't really see them until my second cup of coffee though : )

I've never had a bad experience with this bar. Everyone is so friendly and the atmosphere on a Saturday night is always lively! It's a neighborhood bar so you'll always see someone e you know. Also, there pizza is awesome!
The is one of my top 3 breakfast places. For lunch grab the stuffed baked potato. They have delivery and  pick up which  is very handy.

Not sure if I've never had real Indian food in all my years of eating it, or they just messed it up. Not what you expect for Indian cuisine, can't speak for the rest of the menu. The mango Lassi was ok though. Service is slow as well. Garlic naan look good but since they didn't give me any edible curry to dip it in I didn't try it

Hard to beat Hattie B's. I'm a huge fan of spicy food- the hotter, the better. Naturally, I love this place. Good southern cooking is hard to come by in a lot of cities, but not here. One of the must-try spots in Nashville

I usually have a good experience at Nonna Mia, but tonight was different. Ordered a shrimp pasta and chicken parmesan (took 45 minutes for the two dishes to come out when there was only two other tables in the dining room) and the chicken was served cold and extremely chewy and crunchy. It was completely inedible and I had to send it back. Service throughout the meal was subpar. The waitress did not present the specials, refill our drinks, or check on the table very often. However, two different servers did apologize about the chicken parm and asked me if I wanted anything else. I declined and asked for the bill, feeling grossed out by the crunchy chicken, which took another 10 minutes to be brought to my table.

My friend and I waited a long time in an almost empty restaurant for food - I found out the reason why - everything was extremely overcooked.  The bacon, eggs over easy, toast, and the hashbrowns were dark brown and crispy.  The food was not inedible, but I expect more from an IHOP where entrees are more like $6-10 for a basic breakfast!  Worth the drive to Oracle and Roger.

Visiting from VA and stopped in for a quick dinner. It was quick and tasty but nothing special. Had bbq nachos and a pork sandwich. Definitely canned beans and nothing was jumping out with flavor or originality. Staff was friendly and they have a 99 health rating but when looking around the corner from the window I didn't see anyone wearing hair nets or gloves. As other reviewers said the bbq sauce is pretty sweet but not over powering for my taste.

If I lived locally The Island Grill would be our go-to restaurant with nice menu selection, setting on the water, service and of course, the food....Pleasant, low key and priced right. We paid $48 for two of us with one drink each, 3 course meal from early bird menu. It's a 5 star to me, Rated 4 stars only because it's not a fine-dining restaurant, and more shaded tables are needed for outdoor seating.
Great fresh squeezed OJ, cappuccino and fruit bowl.  Service with a smile even while they were opening.   Great neighborhood joint.

I love love looooooooove going to the Tacos Don Memos truck in University City, so I was excited to try this place.  I picked up take out from here, and got the same thing I always get from the truck, pork quesadillas.  Completely different, and not in a good way.  We got 1 seasoned pork and 1 marinated pork, and they were both bland.  Also I requested no added cilantro on mine (it tastes like soap to me), and it still came topped with it.  It wasn't a tortilla either, it was something different, that I didn't like at all.  I ended up just eating the filling out with it.  And to boot, it was more expensive than the taco truck.  I guess I'll just have to get my husband down to University City so he can try it for himself, the better way.
Very solid burger and fries.  Cool atmosphere, plenty of dipping sauces to choose from.

Great selection! The staff, although not all together knowledgeable about craft beers, is extremely friendly. The selection is vast, also a tad more affordable than the Foodery or other alternatives when you want to purchase by the bottle and not the case.

I just love the food here.  It is rich but not overwhelming.  The drinks are to die for.  The atmosphere is charming and not at all stuffy.   All around I think this is my favorite restaurant in NOLA.

Just started going here and I'll never go anywhere else for my nails again! Everyone is super friendly and I never feel rushed when I'm there. Plus they have lots of dip powder colors to choose from unlike other nail salons.

We just happened by this place on our last day in NOLA while we were buying shirts to bring back home. We stopped to look at the menu and someone sitting there said its really good you should get one. We had been wanting a muffuletta anyway and they had a vegetarian option AND mimosas and sangria. SCORE! Let me just say that this sandwich was unbelievable. The vegetarian one was so good (a little messy, though) I love olives and the olive spread on the sandwich was perfect.  My husband got the meat one and he said his was also amazingly good. They sell them in quarter or half except the veggie only comes as a half. I saved my other half for later and it was just as delicious. Definitely worth stopping here if you are strolling through the market!

This place is a gem. Their BBQ sauce is thick with a really nice flavor and a touch of spicy. The brisket is lean and tender, the pork nice and moist and the sausage has a nice snap when you bite into it. All of the meats have a great smoky flavor. My only disappointment is that I have yet to eat on a day when the peach cobbler is available, I guess I'll just have to keep going.

I so love this place and the Enjoy Center! We came here on a weekend with our kids in a double chariot jogging stroller. Our kids are 3 and 1. No one batted an eye and mentioned that there were some kid's items we could order. I wanted to sit down in the restaurant so they led us to a table with plenty of space to park the stroller and brought a high chair. The servers were friendly with our kids and brought the children's meal straight away as we had requested. You gotta ask for the kid's food right away if they're hungry! The kid's pasta was a bowl of penne with tomato sauce. It was a healthy portion and could have fed me. The atmosphere, service, food and price points make us want to return for another lunch or possibly dinner in the future.

Let's just say I hope I don't get food poisoning. The burgers we ordered were put together sloppily by the chef who I'm guessing by their inability to craft a burger that they are about four years of age and only have one hand. If you're at the airport in Boise save yourself the money and time and take your business elsewhere.

This review is for the cafeteria. Straight forward, no fluff food. Got the chicken and rice with plantains, and it was awesome. Portion was so large, I had enough for dinner as well and all for 8 bucks and some change.  Customer next to me ordered the special Ox tail and I was envious. Definitely coming back!

I have always had good experiences here.  Customer service was great today too.  We had a birthday party for my kid and the service was much more than expected.  Jacob was especially great in coordinating our party.  This is no knock on this theater alone,  but most theaters in the area can use yearly touch ups as this theatre does.

I wanted to do something away from the more touristic area of New Orleans , so I decided to spend an afternoon here.  Bad idea... I really should have planned to spend the entire day here!  This place was truly a find, and well worth the $14 admission.  After four hours the clock ran out on me, and I had probably only seen 3/4 of the exhibits.  

Of course, it's not too difficult to put together a compelling narrative when WWII is your source material, but this place does a particularly great job of it.  My favorite part was probably all of the paraphernalia posters and other assorted wartime "marketing materials".

I'm not particularly compelled to go back to NO any time soon (though I did enjoy my time there), but if I do go I'll definitely return to the museum and complete my tour.
Really pretty terrible food. Great diner ambience but worst omelette ever. Nothing fresh. Just dumped bad salsa on eggs and called it a Spanish omelet.
I'm glad we discover this place. Owners are very friendly welcoming. The food is really good, and friendly people. We definitely recommend this place for breakfast.

My husband and I visited Pinewood on Christmas Day and were unbelievably pleased with the entire experience. Being a holiday we wondered if it would be crowded, however the crowd was low (but not so low that it felt dead!). The ambience was so warm and inviting, and the host and hostess were friendly and informative.
We ordered the fried broccoli as a starter, and the catfish and meatloaf as our entrees. The catfish filet was enormous! The accompanying hush puppies were crisp and delicious as well. 
As for the meatloaf, I've never had better. I opted out of the sweet potato purée because of a personal aversion, but ordered a side of the jalapeño mac and cheese to accompany the dish. The Brussels sprouts were cooked perfectly, and had large pieces of bacon that provided the perfect amount of saltiness to the whole plate. 
We finished with meal with a cup of the Tahitian vanilla soft serve to compliment the outstanding coffee cocktail, Southern Limerick.
Our server, Erin, was very polite and professional, even making suggestions on menu selections. 
After perusing the entire menu, we can't wait to come back for brunch! Thank you Pinewood for a spectacular Christmas dinner experience! This may very well become a tradition.

Was recommend to us while in Boise for a tennis tournament. We had heard about the amazing nachos and drink selection. They were a little slammed due to a bike race on the street out front. The service was a bit slow but great staff. Next time hopefully they don't run out of deserts.

Amazing. Hands down, I have been to numerous other tailors and I have never had my pants done to my liking. This place is great, drying cleaning here is also excellent. As long as I am in Philadelphia I will go to Master Tailor!

My jeans were tailored perfectly, not too short and not too tight on the bottom, he listened to what I asked for and provided a great service!

My FAVOURITE!! Tons of vegan options (including the highly coveted Fricken' Delight Donuts) and other produce and ready made foods! Stopped for lunch and goodies today. Go early!! Before 10 to make sure you get what you want.

The very friendly staff gets credit for answering the phone without giggling. I ate there for a rehearsal dinner last weekend and again for brunch that Sunday. Both meals involved yummy food and a friendly atmosphere. The brunch has so many options that I think I gained 5 lbs. And I didn't even touch the cakes and pies that lined an entire wall. Make sure you're in an eating mood.

1.  Place appears clean and well kept

2. You will pay for parking any where near it
     We paid $10 for parking.  This is not valet. 

3. The pizza is fantastic! Like pizza heaven.   Generous toppings.  But beware, you'll pay for those generous toppings. We, 2 ppl, got 2 sodas and an 18" pizza with several toppings and bill was $45.00. 

4.  Great food, service was ok.  But due to costs of it all, I dare not give it a 5 star.

"Meh. I've experienced better" is how yelp defines 2 stars, and exactly how I'd define Styer Orchard Market.  I've been here 3 times, the first time the apples were fine, the other 2 times they were mealy and not very fresh (got different apples both times local to Styer).  

Outside of the apples they have baked goods, apple butter, the usual.  The apple butter is fine, the baked goods have all been very dry and bland.  I tried banana bread, apple bread, and their donuts.  The donuts were the only ones of those 3 that were decent.

I will say their prices are okay, but there are far better Orchard markets in the area, or a short distance away.

I have been to many Italian restaurants. Piccolo Trattoria is by far one of the best Italian restaurants that I have ever had the pleasure of trying.  From the exterior, it seems like a regular restaurant one might find in a strip mall. As I walked in, I was pleasantly surprised by how beautiful and upscale the place was. 

As soon as I walked through the front door, I was immediately greeted by a pleasant young lady behind a very well kept counter. As I was walked to the bar, I noticed something interesting about the layout of the restaurant. They had a cafe-type of seating area towards the front of restaurant where patrons could walk up to the "pizzeria" section/ carryout section of the restaurant and enjoy their pizza without being even waited on. There's more of a fine-dining seating area towards the back of the restaurant where patrons can enjoy more of a full service experience.

I ordered a caprese salad with kalamata olives (without the prosciutto) and an individual Brooklyn pizza (pics are posted). They were incredible. Trust me guys, this place is worth a try. You will not be disappointed.
Nice place. The drinks were strong! I felt a little out of place being the only women there but I think it was my own personal insecurity.

I dig Italian grocery stores, so on a free afternoon in Nashville, we headed to Coco's. I enjoyed perusing the shelves and bought some pistachio pate and a jar of their house marinara. I also had a single scoop of raspberry gelato, which was delicious. If I lived in Nash, I would probably go here for some specialty grocery items.

One negative to the experience was definitely the customer service--the man who scooped the gelato and checked us out was curt bordering on rude. I don't know that it would deter me from going there, but he doesn't seem to be very customer service-minded.

I love the upscale pub/bistro atmosphere.  I was a HUGE fan of Ludvigs (even with the dust/web-covered animal heads on the wall) but am reluctantly just as in love with Time.  The bartenders are friendly, chatty (but not overly) and informative.  The food has been spot-on for me every time, and I really like the fact that they have live music.  

The absinthe bar (upstairs) opens at 9 or 10 on weekends (I can't remember) and we recently took advantage of that by having a big 30-40 person birthday dinner up there before the lounge opened.  They didn't even charge us for the room.  Great selection of scotch and they even let me taste some.  Definitely one of my go-to's when I'm feeling "pubby."

My name is Teisha and That's Good HR helped me find the position that I have held for almost a year (August 2014). It took a few months and several interview attempts with various companies, but eventually I was matched with an organization where I fit in well. Had it not been for the ladies of That's Good HR (Lindsay Barnhart and Lana Bobb), I probably would not have found this great opportunity on my own. I am very grateful to the entire smart-working team of That's Good HR for assisting me with a successful job search. Thank you TGHR!

Great New Place!

Just build up and completed in 2009!!

There are several things I love about this place:

- Pet Friendly (countless pet play dates)
- Awesome Community! (Everyone is friendly down in the courtyard)
- Gym (I love doing my pre-workouts here prior my regular routine)
- Lounge Pool Table and Grills (Cha Yeah!)
- Parking, Parking, Parking
- It's located walking distance to everything in town!
- Highway entrance is down the block.

I would go on, and on.... you just need to live here and see for yourself!

First night in NOLA and I was so excited to get some authentic food. Coming from NY, I expect a lot for a sandwich I am paying 13 + dollars for. The roast beef with gravy sandwich (PO boy ) was ICE cold, soggy, and just distasteful. This place couldnt even be a pimple on Brennan and Carr or Roll n Roasters butt from BKLYN. Not to mention it would be a 4th if the price as well!!!!  Rice and beans tasted like cut up hot dogs with rice. It's safe to say I will never go to Mothers or have a PO BOY again. Save ur money... 40 dollars for two sandwiches and rice and beans ... I mean seriously ???

My spouse and I came in to check out the space.. we're looking at venues for our wedding.. The space is beautiful, however we chose not to go with Talula's Garden. Mainly because the manager (I'm guessing that's what he is) was rude and stone faced. Didn't even speak one word or greet us as we were talking to the host. He preceded to just kind of stand there with his nose in the air. Didn't say thanks for coming in or anything. You can tell a lot from people like him. You lost out on making good money. Needless to say, we won't be spending our money at this establishment. If you're that antisocial and dismissive, how are you a manager? Beats me. If I could give zero stars, I would have. You don't deserve my one full star.

I found this salon through yelp and all of the great reviews provided on yelp. I was very happy with my experience at Love Salon and with my stylist, Nicole. I had a color and a cut and she listened to exactly what I wanted and the color came out awesome. Everyone was very attentive there and wanted to make sure that all customers were happy and offered drinks while waiting and getting your hair done. I'm pretty sure I found my new spot.

We just had lunch at Oldsmar smokin BBQ. It was a great experience. All the food/barbecue was delicious, as well as the sides. Our waiter I think he's Irish because of his accent was a great waiter. I recommend this place to everybody. Hands down the  best barbecue experience I've had in years.

My boyfriend and I have been dying to try bimbimbap as we love ethnic food and have surprisingly never had it. As we wandered down the street, we noticed Giwa and decided to give it a shot. We thought the prices were pretty high for a self-serve place ($6.75 for 6 dumplings and about $12 for chicken bimbimbap).  We were pleased with the vegetable dumplings, but totally disappointed by the bimbimbap. The chicken was totally flavorless and poorly cooked, and the dish itself had no flavor. The chili paste they included was OK, but should have been used to complement a different sauce, and not as the only sauce. We definitely would not come back here.

Although this restaurant is at 35 Bethlehem Pike in  Chestnut Hill, you should know that its entrance is from the parking lot. It's not quite visible from the street. We sat outside because it was noisy inside, and everyone seemed happy with their choices. We had vegetarian summer rolls and shrimp summer rolls for appetizers. Everything was fresh and nicely served. For our entrees, we enjoyed a mix - Penang curry with salmon, tofu and ginger curry, and two other entrees, one with chicken and one with seafood. Portions were generous. My Penang curry was a bit spicier than expected, but I didn't think to ask for it to be mild. 

We chose the restaurant as halfway between our two houses, but we would definitely go back for another meal.
Wonderful service & food! Definitely will be returning.. They had a set menu for Valentines Day and it was perfect! Atmosphere was nice and our server was professional and very nice..

In town on business wanted to go to the beach and eat.  This place accomplished that.  
So the food is a solid B
Has the berry and pecan salad with grilled salmon.  Boeing wow but pretty good

Environment C-  So the restaurant smelled like piss, the silverware was clean but still felt dirty, bugs landing/crawling on me to include what I believe was a flea, the chair was dirty with the lasts guest food still all over it.  The view was ok and it servers it purpose. Beach and food 

Service C+ the waiter was ok but when I asked about a dish he didn't go into detail and I felt kind of forgotten.  It wasn't bad mind you just lacking 

Over all this is a C restaurant but if you are in the area want to go to the beach and eat this works
Food was good; however, service was poor (waitress complained about other customers), counted over 6 flies at our table alone plus ants on table and in window sill. Doubt we will go back.

This is it, the most authentic pho ga outside of my mom's home and Saigon itself.  OK, maybe at least in Philadelphia, but it's very good.  The entire eating area might be the size of your living room and it gets crowded with the tune of people bantering and steady thumping noises from the kitchen; chickens are pulled from the stock and chopped to serve.  With so many birds taking a dip into the never ending vat, Cafe Pho Ga Thanh Thanh creates one of the most robust, chicken-y soups I've ever tasted.

Also, just by saying "I want a large pho ga" in Vietnamese and without even asking for it, they included organ meats (a liver and heart) and a chicken blood cake, along with bone/skin-on chopped chicken plus a dipping dish of habanero, salt, pepper, and lime.  Completely rustic and traditionally ornamented.  Although, if you're using English, I would imagine that you may need to inquirer about the add-ons if you want them.

A large bowl with a sweetened iced coffee rings up $11.

We love the food at Veekoo. Whether we dine in or take out we are never disappointed. We love asain food but often with take out you dont get the freshest tasting meats and often shrimp will be small and not fresh. That is not the case at Veekoo. I regularly get shrimp and broccoli and am never disappointed. Their pork steamed dumplings are very good - fresh tasting and a favorite for us!

Dark Crescent Tours was the way to go for a spooky supernatural tour of new orleans.  Thomas was our guide and he was incredible, told us all the stories about the French Quarter and the spooky stuff of New Orleans and it's related history.  Was super knowledgeable when answering our questions, while being all around friendly and personable.  The tour itself is a great walking tour, I thought two hours was going to be too long but time seemed to fly by and you aren't "quite" walking a full two hours so never fear, your feet won't get too exhausted but wear comfortable shoes! It was raining on and off during our tour so it was nice to be in the smaller sized group (6 people) so we could hear everything.  I would've liked to try their other tours if time had permitted!

The customer service at this Holiday Inn was some of the worst I have seen in the industry. Pushy, rude, sarcastic. Had initially planned to stay here but after the rude treatment on the phone on multiple occasions I have pulled the plug and decided to take my business elsewhere.

My first time at Stout and we will definitely be back. Very comfortable atmosphere, excellent service and the most incredible veggie burger I've ever tasted.  This burger didn't taste like 'real' meat...it was better than meat. I had the tots as my side dish and they were on par with the burger. This place was the most pleasant surprise I've experienced in a first time visit in a long time. This one will not disappoint!
Great food, great service, and beautiful views. Service was perfect, ample choices on the menu, and drinks were tasty.

Great new nail bar w/ literally all the nail colors you could want of QUALITY brands; Essie, OPI, china glaze only. But they did NOT offer us a drink nor a shoulder massage. My lady "sahm"? was nice enough but rushed to get a new customer. The special was great though, 12$ for a mani so it's ok. My sissy in law got a eyebrow wax for 8$ and was very happy with it. Linda, the waxed and manicurist was sweet and thorough. The man, I assume was the owner (maybe Linda is owner too?)kept repeating "if your nails chip in 2 or 3 days we will fix it. If you get gel nails and they chip before 2wks time, come back we will fix it. Amazing!
I've been going to Mirame for years.  Angelica does a great job and their prices are very reasonable.  I'm a man, so i can report that you guys will feel comfortable going here.
I cannot come to town without stopping here. The best crab Rangoon I have ever had, and I always get the shrimp St. Paul sandwich.  LOVE LOVE LOVE This place!

they're a godsend.  i had 3 young squirrels blow out of the top of 40' bamboo onto rock-hard cement in a strong storm the other night.  they all 3 weren't moving.  i googled "squirrel rescue;" the first place i spoke to told me to put them near the base of their nest for the mama to come and get them, which was helpful (the mama didn't come back & i had to turn the hose on a hawk & a stalking tomcat twice), but i had concerns after i read the first place i called reviews.  so i called my vet who said to call avian, which treats wildlife.  i had to do something rather than just watch them die of dehydration, etc.  avian took them in immediately-- the staff was sweet, kind & reassuring, they put the 3 squirrels in an incubator and told me that they seemed good.  the staff asked for a small, voluntary donation (i donated a little extra to help folks that maybe can't donate), the 3 young squirrels then went to a wildlife rehab that avian works with & which had about 450 very good reviews.  again, avian was a godsend.
A little bit of a wait but understandable! The food was SO GOOD. The waffle was the best I've had! And the pour is generous on the mimosas!

I love this place.  I live around the corner and come here all the time when I want a slice of pizza or a shake.  

For the 2014 Super Bowl, I ordered 2 pizzas and found out they gave me one of the wrong pizzas.  When I went back, they took the pizza back, which I'm pretty sure is 100% against health code.  

Also, their loaded cheese fries only have that fake nacho cheese stuff on them, no real cheese as other pizza places in the area do.

Went to Sampan last night for restaurant week. I understand that restaurant week is a busy time but the service was not good. First I was 5 minutes late and they refused to seat my party of 5. Additionally once seated the waiter was abrasive and unfriendly. I asked for another/larger glass of WATER and he said I hadn't even drank that one yet. Really WATER?? Then they made all 5 of us agree on EACH menu item and we couldn't order individually. That's very hard to do with 5 people especially when one of them doesn't eat pork or beef. The food started coming out very quickly (they actually portion out exactly two dumplings per person) and we asked the waiter if we could hold off on the next few dishes for a couple of minutes and he was very rude and annoyed by it. I know they need to get people in and out and space is limited but really? The table was tiny and there was barely enough room to get comfortable much less have that many dishes. The food was so so, portions on the small side and dessert was TINY. We spent over $300 on food we didn't even want since we couldn't order individually and the lack of interest by the waiter led to a negative experience. With so many good restaurants and options in the city don't waste your time here.

I've taken my clothes here for cleaning and alterations.  The owner is incredibly friendly, personable and welcoming.  She's always chuckling over something.  And who doesn't want to help support a chuckling business owner? 

My alterations were perfectly priced, hemmed and finished quickly.  You may occasionally wait in a small line, but it's worth it.
The parties themselves are very flavorful but you can't really dress the patties the way you want to besides adding bacon or an egg. If you want fancy toppings I would go to charcoal
This P.F. Chang is pretty much the same as any P.F. Chang. Great food, nice staff and fast service. We like especially their Chicken Wraps as appetizer and their Orange Chicken.

I came for dinner with a girlfriend and we loved it! The waitress was able to answer questions about the menu as well as make great recommendations. We shared the octopus as an appetizer and I had the sea bass as my entree. IT WAS AMAZING! Next time I'm in St. Pete I would be happy to go back for the delicious food!  Two thumbs up!

I am a recent member of the gym and I must say I love it!!! it offers a great variety of group classes in the mornings, great caring staff and a family feel. They are continually adding activities and workshops during the weekends and it never gets stale. I specifically like all the yoga and pilates classes they offer and that they are introducing some cool dance classes (yeah belly dancing!!!).

Yumm! I'll start there. Came here on a Friday and was told the wait would be two hours.. my gf and I decided to kill time and drink over at Rosepepper. Well it only took 45 min and we received a text that our table was ready. We sat a table with two other couples but that was fine even though they were pretty awkward. I'll take that over a 2 hour wait.
Basically food comes out in small courses here. 
We started with the JFC (Japanese Fried Chicken) that I was crazy about! My gf wasn't as crazy for it but said it was good. I loved it. Next we got the gojiri roll that was pretty good. We followed it up with the garlic noodles that were the bomb! Strong garlic taste. Stayed on my breath for hours but totally worth it. We ended with the ramen bowl: tonkotsu which has a pork broth. My gf and I split all 4 of these and were satisfied. We also had drank beer and eaten chips and salsa right before... I know very unhealthy haha. But this place can be a bit pricy so splitting really helped the bill and we were both still full. Can't wait to try more here!

I'm a big fan of the Troc. From watching a movie in the balcony with it's old-school theater feel to the downstairs that feels as natural with a mosh pit as it does with acoustic hangout music... Drinks aren't cheap, but won't kill you, either, especially considering location.  Might as well drink the real stuff cause you'll pay almost as much for a draft domestic as for a Harpoon.  I know people have complained about staff/security but I've actually felt less intimidated here than at many other venues.  At least they're friendly while they're checking you out.  My stepdaughter went to her first concert here last year and I was jealous that her first concert was one of her favorite bands at an intimate, charming little place like the Troc.  I haven't been to a movie night in ages (and I'm sad I wasn't able to stick around for the late night Hedwig showing when I was there for a concert last weekend).  I think it might be time again soon.

Yummm.  As others have said, this place has delicious and unusual homemade flavors I had never seen before.  I played it safe with a combination of Chocolate Brownie and Strawberries and Cream.  Much to my delight, they were willing to give me two flavors in the small-size cup (how could I possibly narrow it down to one?).  

While not as decadently creamy (as in: fatty) as my fave Franklin Fountain in Philly, both flavors tasted natural and delicious and were clearly made in house.  The Strawberries and Cream was vanilla with a fresh, intense strawberry puree ripple that made my mouth water for more, although I wish the ice cream base had a stronger vanilla flavor.  

Next time, I'll have to be more adventurous and try some of the more unusual flavors others have recommended.  I can taste the corn and peach already...
The food was delicious and visually appealing. Great service. Tasty desserts. Everyone in our party wants to go back. Too bad we don't live there.
banh mi's decent.  owner's a jerk.

I stopped in to Jim N Nick's for a quick lunch.  The service was friendly and prompt.  I can best describe the restaurant as the Applebee's of BBQ.  It feels like a chain restaurant in every way.  The menu has some interesting choices, but I always go with pulled pork at a BBQ joint.  The pork was good but not great.  There were two BBQ sauces at the table, a sweet BBQ or very spicy Habanero.  The sweet was tasty, but the Habanero was a bit much for my taste.  My favorite part of the meal was definitely the cheddar biscuits... mouth watering perfection. I could have filled up on those alone.  Once you get over the chain restaurant atmosphere, Jim N Nick's isn't a bad choice for BBQ.
I love coming here to have lunch! Quick and excellent customer service! Everyone that works there is friendly and always smiling! The food is great!

The second time is the charm and so it was with my second trip into Ruby Slipper. I love their byo omelet, mine is the veggie omelet which is great. The grits and the biscuit do need improvement but the buy one get one mimosas surely makeup for that.
