Still the third choice on my Marigny brunch list behind Elizabeth's and New Orleans Cafe and Cake but to be on the list with those two is great company.

I had a business dinner with a party of 7. Overpriced hipster restaurant with mediocre food at best. For appetizer I had the pork cheeks which wasn't that bad. However, my main course dish rabbit dumplings was bland, heavy on the carrots and potatoes with little to no rabbit. What rabbit that I could find was very tough. 

Bar menu was lacking and desert was a pass since dinner was such a disappointment.

If I had a better experience, I would have picked up the check on this one...decided to turn it over to the one who recommended the restaurant. That will teach him!

1 star for your desserts. + 1 more for the other MEH food.

Bread pudding was good. Apple pie w/frozen yogurt was good. Carrot cake was good. Cheesecake was good. Cupcakes not good. Chocolate cake was NOT good. Most of the cakes had a weird texture and were lacking in flavor. Avoid those but stick with the custard-ish desserts. 

Prime rib = Salty.
Shrimp = Mushy.
Crab = Tiny & salty.

The usual buffet stuff. Salad, fried shit, crappy ass pizza, etc. I'd avoid it.
Best Ice Cream I have ever had......Chocolate Chunk cookie was amazing as well. We love the fact that all milk is from Grass Fed cows. Wish they had this on the east coast.

Not worth the price. The favor of the sauces were not as good as served at other wing stop locations 
Won't visit this place again

I wouldn't know if the food is any good. I ordered my pizza for pickup, and I was told it would be 20-25 minutes. I arrived 40 minutes later, and it wasn't done yet, even after I waited in line for over 5 minutes to attempt to pick it up. So, needless to say, I left with no pizza, and will never be back. I knew that I should've gone to Amici's in the first place

Here is how I would rate the restaurant:

Ambiance/Decor:  2 stars.  It includes both indoor and outdoor seating but I would say it is functional, similar to a school cafeteria but dimmer.  

Customer Service:  2 stars.  I actually called to make a reservation since it was my wife's 50th birthday and I wanted to make sure we were able to get into the restaurant without a wait.  We ended up getting there early on a Sunday so there really wasn't a wait but they would only take my reservation if we had a party of 6 or more.  Since I only had a party of 5 they wouldn't take the reservation.  Guess what, they still had to set us up for 6.  Was it really too difficult to put our name on a piece of paper?  I almost didn't go to the restaurant because of this.  Since it was my wife's birthday I also asked if they could put a candle in the cheese cake she had for desert - guess what, no candles.  First time I have ever gone to a restaurant and asked them to put a candle in a cake where they told me they didn't have one - disappointing.  Our waiter however was pleasant and nice but seemed to lack training.  For example, we asked for desert menus and got 1 to share between the 5 of us.  Maybe I'm picky but I just didn't feel like I was an important customer and since it was my wife's 50th it sure would have been nice to have a candle in her cake and sing her happy birthday.  

Food:  3.5 stars.  Was good, especially the bruschetta which I would strongly recommend.  Skip the calamari.  Was okay but from my perspective a little below average.  I had the Tortolini Ellostin which was very good.  The bread provided with the meal was good but a very doughy type of italian bread.  Food was reasonably priced.  The deserts were very good.  We had the cheese cake, the canoli's and the Chocolate explosion cake (which was awesome) - all were very good.  

Bottom line - if you want to have a romantic italian dinner - either order take-out and eat home or don't go to the restaurant.  With just a few small enhancements this place could be awesome and I would recommend the following:

1. Take reservations regardless of the number of attendees. Make the customer feel special.  

2. Invest in the dining room.  Put some nice tables and chairs in there and put some candles on the table.  It would really warm things up.  

3. You have pictures of Italy on the 6+ flat screen TV's but you play classic rock music.  How about some Bocelli. 

4. Train the wait staff.  They should give everyone a menu for dessert.  

5. Get some birthday candles.  People actually do go to restaurants for special occasions like birthdays. 

6. Try a different fried calamari recipe. 

Please note, I am not trying to be critical here but just provide an honest opinion of the restaurant and some ideas for improvement.  We went here because of the 4 star rating and I really think many have been too generous in their ratings.

Service was superb and 1st time going I'll be back weekly for lunch! In and out in under 3 minuets. Fair on prices- no more than Steak 'n Shake and these guys options are way better. Btw Monday's special: grilled cheese and soup. Love these guys!

Gotta go with 5 on this one; solid beer and drink selection plus a decent selection of food. Now I'm a meat eater, but my love bug is a vegan, so yes, she ordered the cauliflower again. I know I know. You just read my review of la peg and silently mumble something about not learning a lesson. But this was actually on par with my expectations for cauliflower ; fried, rubbed in spices, sprinkled with onions and peppers, and totally edible. Love bug thought it was pretty solid and I was impressed by the 8 buck pricetag. It's still cauliflower people, but much more palatable and easy on the wallet than the poor excuse for a vegetable served by la peg.
I don't think I will ever be able to find pho this good in Chicago. This was one of the best things I have eaten in my life and I swear I'm not being dramatic.

We were extremely happy with Rock's Moving Co. The team they sent were so efficient and conscientious. They took great care with our furniture and followed all the condo rules. We have moved at least 15 times over the past 26 years and Rock's is truly the best we have had. I highly recommend them.

Food tasted gross today. This is our second time. First time was good. Chicken inside burritos tasted raw and fish smell. Our order was made by putting all raw ingredients and then micro wave for about 5 minutes. We were shocked to see our order came out so fast. We hated the food and will never go back for food we can microwave and not do anything.  Our both plates were so hot that our server did not bother telling us that " It is hot and be careful". This is ridiculous.

This place is a great find!  When we got there it was packed and for good reason.  The bagels are awesome.  So is the chili.  I'm making a point of going back early enough for pancakes in the morning.  When you have guests in from out of town, take them here.  Especially if they're from the SFO Bay Area.  It's SFO good for a lot less.
This place is very good, clean and reasonably priced. Dont need to write a long review

This little event has really grown over the years! 

I love how big of a presence the art community has in Reno and it is never more apparent then when you are down in Midtown. This bright little area is full of amazing shops, gorgeous murals, and an overall arty feel that I love! Midtown is by far one of my favorite areas of Reno. It is quite the picturesque little area.

This event is a great way to get people down to Midtown to really explore and interact with the area. There was so much to see and event art you could participate in yourself! If I had remembered to bring cash with me I definitely would have made some art myself. 

Things I loved:
seeing dancers, painters, singers, and artists of all kind performing all over Midtown
art for sale
shops open in the evening hours
families enjoying themselves
feeling like a part of the art community

Things that needed improvement:
information on the website should really disclose the need to bring cash to buy most things
easier parking options
better walking flow- they really should close down the street to allow better access to all the pedestrians 

Overall, this is an absolute must attend Reno event! Put it on your calendar for next year because you'll regret missing out on this one.

I have never had such an explosion of wonderful flavors! From the drinks to the food, everything was AMAZING!!! Jeri (the bartender) is fabulous! He'll help with any pairing needs! One last thing--YUM!!

I've been here three times since it opened. The wings are really good, the other items (burger and a wrap) were just average. It was really loud but I suppose as a sports bar, that's expected. But the one thing that has turned me off the most is the Cage fighting that has been on each time I've been there. People were getting beat to a pulp and blood flying everywhere while I try to eat my lunch/dinner. It was on so many TVs that it was impossible to avoid. Having sports on is fine, but it shouldn't make people nauseous. This was late afternoon, early evening, too, and there were a lot of families and young kids. Seemed inappropriate.

The food was out of this world. Went very last minute and they made us feel welcome. Each of us ordered something different - curried lamb, chicken curry, chicken korma, a vegetarian dish and the appetizer assortment. 
Each plate was cooked carefully & to perfection by the server/owner's wife. Don't expect "fast food" here. But the taste & quality is fabulous. Ordered to spicy-taste so as to not scare away timid explorers while satisfying the adventurous. 

Our only so called complaint was the lack of substantive AC, especially when ordering some spicy dishes. Otherwise we are looking forward to a return trip.

This is one of my first stops when I hit Tucson.  I've only ever ordered the Sonoran Dog and a real Coke - yea! for Mexico! The US should take a listen.  I take my dog with everything and then load it with salsa and other varied condiments.  Really, if they don't have what you want on the salsa bar, you probably don't need it.  Also, the staff is friendly and the service is quick, even when it's packed.  I am fixin' to hit AZ up again in a week and will be stopping in.  See you there!

We have gone a few times just to see if a band was there we liked. The place just stinks of smoke. They have a no smoking area but it doesn't matter. I go home and my hair and clothes just reek. They offer pizza on the menu. We've tried it twice. It's something but it's not pizza. I think they make it with velvetta, it's orange very runny. Seems to be a hang out for guys that work together. Wasn't comfortable there. Lots of foul language. Won't go back.

Satsuma is another gem the I can truly appreciate for healthy and delicious fair with decent vegetarian options. Love the fresh-squeezed juices. Food is really good. There might be a little room for improvement (I got a fairly bland vinaigrette o my salad, for example), buy the food is fresh and some items are really tasty. I'll be back, for sure!
Basically this place has the best burgers ever! Awesome beer selection with lots of hoppy IPA's.

They have all the good stuff! Broad Ripple Potato Chips, B Happy peanut butter, 3-Birds bakery, Circle City Sweets, and on and on and on. The vibe is great too, with a fresh open atmosphere. The space is very small but packs a deceivingly large inventory of different brands and niche products. Very specialized and high quality products, zero pretension. 

Go here to explore products that are novel and high quality.
Really good Cuban food with a American flavor flavor. Kid friendly, several local restaurants, always friendly efficient servers. A good value for the money

I'm sorry to have to report after a year of great service here that it was a supreme disappointment tonight. I waited 20 minutes for the bartender to acknowledge me, and that was with two customers in the whole establishment. He said he didn't see me. When you come in, the dark lit bar is flooded with light on door opening. He was at the end of the bar, polishing silverware. How did he miss me? Drinks were slow in coming, and my to go order of Reuben Egg Rolls took way too long and were poorly presented. I waited for the manager to come in from a smoke break to tell him this, and it was the same bartender who pretended I hadn't been waiting on him to see me earlier! He was totally unresponsive and unhelpful. Too bad, because we've had a lot of great happy hours and sent many folks here. But there are too many great bars that want your business to put up with crappy service and poor attitude.

Mother's is worth the wait! The system they have keeps the line moving and tables available, so don't let it worry you! I've been waiting years to have this again: The Ralph w/Swiss and sweet potato pie!!! No need for dinner after this lunch!

The Japanese version of Chipotle.  You order or create your own sushi roll and they make it in front of you.  Fairly inexpensive, service is fast and the restaurant is clean and modern looking.  I think if you are looking for a quick sushi fix without spending lots of money, this is the place.  Highly recommend it for just those times when you crave sushi.

Good beach bar and beach party atmosphere but the food I ordered was not very good. I ordered the fish tacos and the fish was tough and tasted very fishy. It doesn't tell you on the menu what the fish is and I should have asked before, but when I asked after they said it was pollock. For a Florida place on the water they should not go cheap and instead do Grouper. Especially since it's $12 for two tacos. Disappointed.

This place is a train wreck. My "Shalhoob" steak wasn't suitable for my dog. It was in 2 little, fatty pieces and was the weirdest steak I've ever seen. My wife had the same thing and she couldn't even cut the damn thing. Ridiculous. I can't believe Jerry Shalhoob puts his name on this steak. My son's pasta with chicken came without the chicken. Without a doubt this place is going to shut down. Pascucci is 0 for 2 now in Goleta. Just stick with your downtown location where you can feed the tourists sub par food and get away with it.

Am I seriously writing a review just based on croutons? 

Yes I am. Its like crouton cotton candy. 

I ate there 3 times when I was in NoLa for a week, and staying close by. Second time I went, the line was redonkulous, and yes'um I waited for it, had a lil John Daly outside while I waited. The food is great, and the staff give great service. (Hint: If its busy, it means they *really are* busy. They are not trying to ignore you. Say please, smile and make eye contact. Be patient - have a John Daly!) There are a few other good spots on that section of Magazine, but this one, I found, was the best.

Such a great go to place for breakfast in Nashville.  I had only been to the cool springs location prior to this, but being the orignial, it is so much better.  The staff was friendly, service was amazingly quick, and of course the food was great.  Parking wasn't as bad as I had expected, and the wait time was really short which suprised me because there were so many people waiting when I got there.  
Nothing more to tell you than trust your instict and go!
We have the all meats pie and it was delicious.  The service was great. I called ahead because it takes over 30mins to make one. My family enjoyed the experience, definitely will be back.

Amazing menu with lots of options! Fell in love with the black and blue salad- wonderful tri tip- it's only strange how they have different people every time- but I have to say Seneca took care of me the best- come often and never disappointed about the food- but it took a few visits to get service outside on patio- first time we sat with our food and no silverware which felt like forever- second Time there was no server and third time it seemed like no one knew what was going on.... I've worked in the food service industry and I know how confusing it can be.... But I've thankful they have stepped it up a notch on my recent  visits- the food is what kept me coming Back- I'll be recommending it for sure!

This apt feels luxurious, fresh, new and truly like a small home. I have owned homes and rented apts in my last 18 years and this place is my favorite rental! We moved to ID and didn't know where to buy, so we rented the 2 bdrm, 2 bath apt. It has been great and with WiFi and TV included in the price, its a steal! Close to the Village shopping and food and coffee galore, FG is a place to call home and convieniant living! Plus if you are new to the area, Boise is 10 minutes away to the heart of downtown.. Take a look and see if you feel as happy as I do:)

LOVE this place! Great food!! I came here for the first time after living in Carp for 8 months now and regret that I hadn't discovered this hidden gem earlier. I ordered the Hangover special. It was so good! The fruit that came with it was extremely fresh tasting and consisted of strawberries, grapes, and bananas. Yay no melons!! The Capachino was amazing too!! Lots of room to sit, and very clean inside. The staff is really nice too!They definitely get 5 stars! Great job guys!!

I really like Hi Point.  The coffee is good, and the wifi is good too.  However, the real selling point on this place is how friendly and helpful the staff is.  I must have driven past Hi Point a hundred times before noticing it was there, and I'm sure glad I noticed it!  It looks like they have a new regular customer!

I got my certification from AO and could not have been happier.  My dive experience was scary for me but it was my fault not theirs.  In fact, my diver master Captain Dave and his wife Maria were very patient with me and help me through my fear and assured me I would be able to complete the course.  They were right.  Had it not been for Capt Dave and his one on one with me I would not have been able to do the dive.  AO is very helpful, professional and above all SAFETY CONSCIENCE! Capt Bill, the owner, is very concerned about the safety of all the divers regardless of level and his dive masters reflect that same attitude. I have recently been on a snorkel trip with this dive shop and had an amazing experience. My wife accompanied me and she is a beginner and she was put completely at ease by everyone involved.  From the first time I walked into this shop I was told they would take care of me and they have not let me down yet!  If I go out on a trip with anyone of the dive masters from AO....I know I will be coming back safe and sound.  I can't say enough good things about then at the shop...Leann, Capt Bill, Capt Dave, Maria, and especially Charlie...you guys rock!!!
Jan Lowe
Gulfport, FL

Place is just a stand in line brewery. No servers, no formal menus, no table side service, not kid friendly. I just wanted a water and it took 20+ minutes on a Tuesday afternoon to accomplish that.    This seems more along the lines of a beach bar, yet it's in downtown Tampa.

Edmonton seriously lacks places you can go to get a decent breakfast, particularly those long-established independent spots cozy enough to show up to on your own without feeling ridiculous and take your time eating over-easy eggs and toast while absorbed in a book. But luckily, we have Friends & Neighbors. The service is always pleasant, the food (though I can only vouch for the most basic of breakfast) is good, and the wood paneling and last-reno'd-in-the-'50s decor make it feel just like I'm eating in my grandma's basement.

I visited Nashville from Southern California for 5 days and went to Frothy Monkey 3 times. I got the honey rosemary latte with  almond twice hot and once iced. I enjoyed the hot latte the best. I also tried the morning bun and GF lemon poppyseed muffin and I liked the muffin the best but the morning bun was tasty and filling. Lovely service and tons of great places to sit and enjoy your coffee!
I had some eye issues late last year and went to Dr. Hearne for treatment. He was extremely patient, correctly diagnosed the problem, and got me on my way. Follow up was excellent.

Simple burgers and fries. Pricier than In and Out.(Sorry, I'm an Arizona transplant) It is what it is and the review is based off of "fast food burgers" I like "Big Judds" as the better, local option.
We went to Talula's Garden for Brunch and it was amazing.  Tiptop service, spectacular food and great garden seating . It was the best brunch I have had in years....years.  Highly recommended.

Upscale atmosphere, upscale presentation, average everything else.  I deleted the rest of my sarcastic posting to remember that for a $23 entree, I was paying to a dining experience, not the cost of the food.  ( just dont ask for bbq sauce).

This place is awesome. Great food, ambiance and service. The prosciutto and mushroom flatbread appetizer is sooooooo good. The shrimp and orzo entree is healthy and delicious. Only negative is that the dessert menu is not that great. Overall excellent.

First time here!! Such a darling place....the cups and spoons are a cute touch. They have a great selection as well. However only 2 choices for non dairy ice cream (sorbets)  makes me sad :(

It's located in Lenox Village with all the other cute stores :))) 

Prices go by weight so they can be a little pricey but it is so worth it!!
Highly recommend for matcha lovers coz' the matcha really strong and bitter. Prices reasonable, for me the taste so perfect .

Mangia had been on my list of places I wanted to try for a long time.  When we finally did make it there for dinner, it didn't disappoint.  

We decided to sit outside, it was a great night for it and now that the construction on S. Grand is over it was nice and quiet.  I was so excited to see that not only did they have Urban Chestnut on tap, they had my favorite Urban Chestnut, Delta Hop, on tap.  We were off to a great start. 

For an appetizer we tried the toasted ravioli.  Being new to St. Louis I am just now really understanding the amazingness of a good toasted ravioli.  These were great.  We went for the traditional variety (rather than vegetarian), which had beef, spinach and cheese.  They came with three dipping sauces, arrabbiata (spicy marinara), pesto and garlic aioli.  All three were great compliments to the ravioli.  There were 6 raviolis in an order, which seemed like a pretty perfect portion size for 2 people.  

For dinner, both Colin and I wanted to try the mushroom ravioli in a smoked tomato sauce with steak tips because of Erin G's rave reviews. Along with that we ordered the spaghetti with bolognese. Both were great.  The mushroom ravioli was hands down my favorite, I will never order anything else there again.  The portions are very hearty.  We had plenty of the spaghetti to take home and enjoy the next day.  

While it is a little pricey, it's worth it.  The pasta was amazing.  The texture was a perfect al dente and you can completely tell it is fresh.  The spaghetti tastes about a million times better than that nasty dried spaghetti in a box.  

Had we not had pumpkin bread pudding waiting for us at home, we probably would have tried a dessert..  They looked pretty fantastic. 

Our server wasn't overly talkative or friendly, but he made up for that with very quick and attentive service.

Ask for Tammy! She's the best, had an appointment and was waiting for less than 3 min to get right on in! Excellent customer service, everyone so friendly!! Highly recommend if you live on the Far East side!! Thanks Tammy!!
The food is great, but the desserts are beyond great. The best gooey butter cake anywhere. And don't forget the carrot cake, coconut cake and the chocolate port wine cake. All of them are to die for.

This is a very narrow review but I don't care. If you want someone to dissect every part of the experience you're reading the wrong review. I accidentally ate here because I wanted pizza on my birthday a couple years ago (I have a carb problem...sue me). The sausage galore pizza (not the real name) changed my life. Andouille, Gator, and Italian sausage all on one pizza, smothered with cheese. I have never tried anything else on the menu and I don't need to. I've returned every time I'm back in New Orleans to get my fix and I usually order one to go on the way out the door. Must try!

Fantastic! A very very thorough narration of the New Orleans battle and the war of 1812, given by Carlos (Charles). Everyone in the ship provides excellent service and the food was laid out to munch on the entire trip. Simply fabulous.
Memorable meal!  I will be drooling over the Benedict Louisianne in my dreams for months to come!!!!!  Also don't pass up the cornmeal cakes - so delectable!

Can't really go wrong with Pho. Really nice price for it. 8.50$ for a regular size and $2 more for a super size. Both were big enough size to fill you up! We also tried the veggie fried rice and it was delicious! Would definitely come back
An absolute must-see!! You will surely be missing out if you don't stop by and treat your eyes to the amazing art available here!

Very pleased with our stay at Hotel Oceana. The room was nice and clean. The decor was cute. The bed was super comfortable. The only downfall was the wood floors. We could hear the person above us walking around which was a little annoying in the middle of the night when your sleeping. 

Perfect location right across from the beach. The staff was extremely friendly. We walked around the property (its a big place) very clean. We did not get to go into the pool or spa area due to rain but did check it out and it was nice and clean and had little private cabanas. The free continental breakfast was great. They even had bicycles you could rent. 

I would totally stay here again.
Not therapeutic, not relaxing,  I did not feel comfortable. The masseuse was unprofessional and making excuses for his behavior.  I do not recommend any woman to see him.

this place was pretty good. Coming here i was really skeptical being that i come from an area notible for italian food, but i was suprised
by the food. I order the cantaloni and i was very impressed the filling was delicious, i think it was veal and pork. also the corn and crab bisque is worth trying.

Would definatly come again

Simple decor and food is simplistic but full of flavor. The lamb ribs is packed with jerk spice and moist. The sauce keeps the heat down and yuca is nice complement. The charred eggplant is smoky, creamy, and crunchy bread goes well with it. The papaya salsa has mint and basil to cut the heat. The plantains were over cooked and burnt.

Drive thru experiences are not expected to be elevated dining, and I get that.  How hard is it to get a hot fish sandwich and fresh french fries?  Down the road before I realized it, and almost no ice in the coke was the topper.  Now I am as disinterested in returning as the obviously bored kid at the window who handed me my food.  Too many better options out there to waste money on such a lousy experience.

After visiting Karma and ordering takeout on a semi-regular basis for the past year, I can say that the quality of the food has gone downhill and is nowhere near as good as it was about a year ago when I wrote my first review.  After ordering take-out from here numerous times, requesting our food spicy, and returning home to find it mild and completely devoid of spice on many occasions, we will no longer order from Karma.  Additionally, not only is the overall quality of the food extremely inconsistent, but all of the vegetable dishes we tried have an unpleasantly gritty texture to them.    I'm sorry to say, don't bother with Karma, there are other much better places for indian food in Philly.

Food was mediocre (standard chinese fast food) service was good. 

Had the szechuan eggplant (would have again) and the sesame beef (forgettable). 

Nice people, pretty clean, not a bad location.

This was a fine hotel, the hotel room itself is nice and clean. if you're flying in for a quick trip and need a place by the airport by all means this will do. But, I wouldn't recommend staying more than one night. I stayed two nights here and the first night the man next to my room snored all night long and it truly sounded like he was in my room with me. The second night I felt like I was eavesdropping on the next room because i could hear every word of the woman's phone call, even after turning the TV volume up continuously. To say the walls are thin is an understatement. Beyond that, their market food is limited to hot pockets, stoffers lasagna, and some snacks. Great cookies though! And a nice free breakfast buffet!

It was Easter Sunday and the service was really slow, we waited an hour for our food to arrive but the restaurant was not that busy. Our waitress was really nice and gave us a heads up that the kitchen was backed up. Food was good, not great. We got the chicken and waffles and brioche French toast. I also got the bottomless mimosa which was much smaller and more expensive than surrounding restaurants. Overall, it was a nice brunch but it's not a place I'd go out of my way for.

If you're traveling to SB this is a local favorite and just a very fun place to go. It is very loud though because people are drinking and talking and laughing, pretty much like Mardi Gras if you have been to New Orleans, however I have to be 100% honest with you, if you are looking for an authentic hot and spicey fried cajun meal, you may not want to come hear for that because it really isn't the best Cajun Food that I have had but it is very good. If you make it in on a Friday or Saturday night you will get to see the famous magician who...well I can't say (Spoiler Alert) you'll see. I have never once in all my years heard anyone say that they did not have fun here. Cheers!

I took (6) 12 yr olds there today. We escaped Gold Rush with only 10 seconds to spare!  We had a great time and I helped, but they figured a lot out on their own. It was for my daughter's birthday party and we all had a great time. It is difficult for adults too, and the clues are useful and helpful. I'm intrigued by the "Nashville" game and would like to go back and play it. I highly recommend.
Our family always has a great time. We enjoy the interactive experience! Great, friendly staff and prices are fair.

Awesome guys.
They have been great with my bike. Explaining things about the bike that I need to know, making recommendations. 
They have a wealth of knowledge, they are super competent, and they are very friendly

Waitresses watched us until we got up and left after not being acknowledged for over half an hour. They were not busy at all. More than 50% of tables open and waitresses standing around. However, they were very polite and said thank you when I returned their menus as we walked out. They knew exactly what they were doing.
This is or go to Thai takeout place. My wife and I live in downtown and have a few options for Thai but we keep coming back here. Recommend the pad Thai and the drunken noodles. :)

This was my first experience with "debris" and I gotta say I was pretty happy. I moved outside my comfort zone with a non-fried po' boy and it did better than I could have hoped. It was like a french dip but naughtier (in a good way). I'll be hunting down this kind of asndwich again.

Best chicken ever had!!  Couple it with the collards and Mac and cheese, it's incredible!  If the line is long, I recommend take out online.  Super convenient and equally tasty.  If you don't like this chicken, then sumpin' wrong wit chu!!'  I'm usually not a breast man and prefer dark meat (don't go there ), but every piece is equally crunchy and juicy.  We chose hot and it was perfect!  

Not enough accolades to describe their hot chicken SO GO GET 'CHU SOME!!!

Very very nice. The wine selection is good, the drinks are very tasty, the service is awesome, the place is pretty and the atmosphere is great. Feel more like a New York kinda bar, not Philly. 

I had the grilled heart of romaine which was great, not as good as 1518 Bar and Grill though... , the Grilled shrimp salad was tasty too, but 3 shrimp? seriously? The salad is tiny to begin with - for $16; the crisp potatoes concept was good, but way too salty. honestly, everything was too salty, but consider the fact that the place was opened 24 hours earlier - pretty impressive job. 

The bartenders are SOOOOO nice and knowledgeable. Their classic drink are just right, not too weak, not too strong, not overwhelming flavor - perfect. 

Def going back for drinks.

I started going here in September of last year and was really excited about their level of creativity. They do a great job with nail designs. The first few times I went I was really impressed and even recommended them to some coworkers (who also don't go there anymore). The reasons I won't go back are: the salon is dirty - it is dusty, not organized, nail trimmings everywhere, dirty sinks, some of the employees have bad attitudes, and the customers are treated like cattle. The last few times I went there I was disappointed. I called before-hand to make appointments but when I walked in my appointments weren't honored I'm guessing because they don't greet you professionally nor do they ask your name or if you have an appointment. I was bounced between nail techs (one started my pedi, another finished my pedi, one started my mani, 2 others finished my mani). Bottom line is yes - they do a good job and your nails will look pretty killer, so if you don't mind subpar customer treatment and an unkempt salon, then this is the place for you.

After a previously wonderful visit to Apolline, a friend and I decided to stop in for a drink and an appetizer before heading out to dinner.  

We were thrilled to see that Apolline offers happy hour on Saturdays!  I love restaurants that offer this and he the only other ones that I know of in the city are John Besh restaurants.  Apolline's happy hour is every Tuesday-Saturday, 5-7 pm and offers 1/2 price beer, wine, and well drinks, as well as small plates for $2, $4, and $6.

My friend had a glass of Prosecco and I had a glass of Trivento Malbec.  Both were delicious and reasonably priced at $5 a glass.  

We both ordered the small plate of Seared Diver Scallop with a Grilled Gulf Shrimp over Corn Maque Choux for $6. It was absolutely delish.  I had ordered this as my entrée on my last visit to Apolline, so I was already in love with it.  Several other tasty small plates are offered for reasonable prices during happy hour, but we only had the scallops since we were having dinner elsewhere.

I really enjoy the atmosphere at Apolline too.  It's quaint and warm and beautiful.  I would say it's perfect for a family dinner, or a date, or dinner and drinks out with the girls.

Our waitress was attentive and provided great service.  She was the same waitress I had on my last visit.  It was nice to see a restaurant holding onto its staff!

On a board outside on the sidewalk they were advertising bottomless mimosas for $8 for brunch!  I'm a big fan of bottomless mimosas with brunch and it's hard to find in New Orleans.  I can't wait to visit for brunch.

The service is downright horrible. I've been to Figs twice and the service was not great the first time and it was just blatantly awful on Friday night. I was told it was a 10 minute wait for 2 over the phone, made the reservation, and ended up waiting 30 minutes with a table open for 4 staring at us the entire time. The waiting period was brutal since the restaurant is small with no real waiting area and the place was packed. The male server seemed annoyed that we were awkwardly maneuvering around him and the tables and made that clear with his service to us. Once we finally sat, he said nothing to us, opened our wine, left and came back saying "You ready??" No hello, no sorry for the wait, nothing. I'm not asking for special treatment... just good old courtesy would have been nice. We ordered the baked brie, salmon pizza, apple walnut salad, and seafood risotto all of which were good, but the food was overshadowed by the service. After receiving our check and trying to finish our wine, awful waiter comes back and barks to us "We need to close the check. We are closing." It was 10:40, people were still eating, and they close at 11. He sucks. I will not be coming back.

The staff was incredibly attentive and friendly.
The dishes (we ordered quite a bit between 6 of us), were all delicious and wonderfully presented!
The atmosphere was rustic elegance and lively.

We had dinner there for my sister's bday on a Friday night and went back for brunch on Sunday (the short rib sweet potato hash was crazy good btw).
The staff remembered us from Friday and surprised us with desserts after our meal!  So fun!  We will for sure be back and recommend to all visiting Santa Barbara.

Tonight I had my first bad meal at Hamilton's Grill Room, a place I go to about 2-3 times a year and generally gush about. Granted, I had salmon, which is not always the best choice, but in the past it has been. The service was spotty and the bread was stale. They also ran out of the desert that I ordered. The server was unaware of it. I am not sure I will go back anytime soon. Bummer.

The absolute best and freshest coffee in the Burg!  Great atmosphere, and the owner is a  "coffee sommelier" who really knows the art and knowledge about the history of coffee, such as types of beans, roasting and brewing methods, and how to make a true latte.  A must stop for a coffee aficionado.

Stopped here for lunch on way down the coast, based in Yelp reviews. They were not wrong. It is that good.

It's small - 6 tables inside, 4 outside. It's family run and the service is fast and friendly. There are a half dozen salsa choices from the self-serve unit. They have a over 10 kinds of tacos, Mexican sodas and seem to go a very brisk business. I had the chicken enchilada in mole sauce and my daughter had the fajitas. They were both fantastic.

I arrived right at 10:00, after a 15 minute drive, and was ecstatic that I had made it before they closed, as the "Open" sign was lit up and the drive-through menu board was still on.  After 30 seconds of sitting in the drive-through, instead of being helped, the lights were turned off and I was simply ignored. (A year ago, they did this to me at 9:55.) I believe if the customer has arrived even a few seconds before closing, they should go ahead and serve him/her. I was really angry!

This is without a doubt my favorite get away in Santa Barbara! Being a student with all of the stress this place is full of joy and fun! The instructors are very professional and they really take the time with each individual person and think about their skill level. They make every class available for every student and create different practices for every level of skill. Had to pay for a membership because I fell in love with 7th dimension. Not to mention it's a total confidence boost to break out of your shell. I walk out feeling so much confidence and joy every time

This is our new source for Chinese/Japanese good.  Decor was beautiful.  Buffet had many items.  The sushi selection was good.  

We were there on a Tuesday, and it was crab legs.  They also had a large section of mussels.  

We were seated quickly.  And the staff was great at remembering our drinks for refills. Will definitely be back.
Ox and Fields has great cocktails and food, and a happy hour that runs from 5-7 on weekdays where their specialty cocktails are only $5! So good. The service is great, too.

Great group... brought my Camero in for a fuel line leak. They kept it a few days to make sure that was the issue (intermittent leak). They have a super clean shop (says alot) and they are a military family (really says alot)! They fixed my car and the price was spot on. As I am new to the area, I lucked out with them. They will get all my business from now on.

please note: this review is specifically for "movie mondays"

the troc is the ultimate classic venue. slightly dingy with graffitied bathroom stalls, creaky floorboards, dim lighting and as much character as that rusting bicycle-built-for-two lying in your garage (sooo a TON).

not only should you come here for an intimate concert experience, you should also check out the movie mondays as you really, truly just can't find a better deal in town.

allow me to break it down for you:

+ admittance to the feature presentation, a wooden token worth $3 at the bar & a raffle ticket for prizes after the show (plus they have a game of movie trivia) ...................................................................................$3

+ bag of popcorn & can of pbr ................................complimentary if you arrive before 7pm

+ casual atmosphere conducive to laughing out loud and clapping along with movies such as wet hot american summer .......................no additional charge

+ realization 5 minutes into the movie that a girl from your middle school FREAKING STARRED in wet hot american summer*..... priceless

but seriously, best.deal.ever. it's like they are paying YOU to come here. 

*this is a true statement. i am absolutely baffled that i got through the 13-14-15 year old days of gossip, rumors, and hearsay without ever learning of this.

Fine dining at its best in St Louis. This is where I take my most important clients in the St Louis area. Great innovative cuisine. Nice wine selection. Great overall. Even better if someone else is paying for it :)

Havent been skating in yrs. Nice rink, clean, great for a goddaughters bday party.  My daughter had a blast for her first time roller skating. Will definitely visit next time in that area. Pizza did look like chuckue cheese old pizza.

So glad we tried this new restaurant out. The food was excellent! I couldn't believe how busy they were having only been open one month. If they keep serving food like I had last night they will remain that busy. Even with a full house, our food came out quickly and our server Jamie was very attentive and a pleasure. Our table shared the crab cake and BBQ shrimp apps, both were so good. I highly recommend the entree I had called eggplant Barbara. Fried eggplant round served over Cajun creamy pasta LOADED with crawfish and shrimp. Delicious! We'll be back for sure!

Chose the firm to help complete our purchase transaction on a new home.  I didn't want to use the in house company affiliated with the real estate firm although our agent pushed us to.  I am thankful we chose WW as the staff was great.  They have attorneys that are readily available for professional explanations and what was best was that no email or phone call went unanswered or not responded to with in minutes.  Very well organized and courteous and will certainly use again, although do not plan on moving for a while.  Totally recommend!

The store was very organized and clean. Was greeted immediately and staff was knowledgeable. I went in and selected a weight bench and weight set, the rep advised me if a similar weight set used that was about $75 cheaper.

I've been here before. I like the building, ambiance. It's really nice and comfortable. I typically go first Friday of the month with a group of friends and have a ball. The drinks are really good, especially the Blueberry Basil Lemonade...just be careful because it will sneak up on you...as in you won't taste the alcohol. I will warn you, that it is super sweet, but it's sooooooooooooo good. I also mess around and get Crown Apple with Lemonade...you don't know what you are missing. The staff/servers are extremely nice, you can always find better, but not when they treat you like home or like family. They are super great!!!! My waitress, I don't remember her name, but she was very attentive, super friendly, very considerate, timely, the whole 9 yards (she has locks in her hair). They have talent or guest artists that come in and sing on Fridays and Saturdays with a live band. There hasn't been a moment where I've been disappointed with the talent and drinks. I ordered the Shrimp this time and the cornbread. Both were really good. My only concern with the cornbread, don't over cook it because it will dry out faster. Not sure what recipe you use, maybe add a little more milk or something, I know there may be food regulations or concerns with certain things like vegans eating anything outside of soy and veggies, etc...just using it as an example. I really like this place. The staff is so great! I can't stress that enough. They really treat you like family because you become family to them. They know what you like (depends on your server) and how you like it!
This place is great!!!!  I usually get Pho but this time I got the sushi burrito. It's the equlivent of about 2 rolls for $10. It's great!!!!!  I have been coming here quite often.
Great front desk and breakfast staff. Very helpful with suggestions on things to do in the area. Keep fresh hot coffee throughout the day and a great breakfast selection.

My family has enjoyed New Delhi Palace for decades. Our usual order is Chicken Tikka (sizzling, fresh, delicious chicken with grilled onions), either Vegetable Korma or Subji Aam Mughlai (Vegetables in a succulent mango sauce), Nimmakaya Annam ("lemon rice"), Naan (freshly cooked bread, not unlike a good sopapilla), with mango chutney and Raita (a cooling sauce of yogurt and cucumbers). We aren't sure how they do it... but every time we go (nearly weekly), the food is better than the last time. Highly recommended. Service is friendly, respectful to our family elder, and formal enough to reflect a deep respect for their food. We have taken friends and family who never had Indian food and they LOVED IT.

This place embodies the classic American diner, by far the best one i've ever been to. The service is fast and friendly; when my wife and I showed up the place was packed but we were still seated in just a couple of minutes. Despite the number of customers, our server was quite friendly and attentive. The food was fantastic and CHEAP! I got an omlette and my wife got a breakfast platter, we both had coffee, and with tip we got out of there for $20. We look forward to returning to try more of their breakfast items, as well as their lunch and dinner options as well.

Very cool Cajun place! Has a great theme inside and a very relaxed atmosphere. The food is great! Just the right amount of spice and authenticity!  Drunk chicken is my favorite! Prices are also great! About $8 for a whole order! The menu changes so its nice to see the variety of options. A definite must try!

Stopped by SB on our way down to LA from SJ. It's big and location is great. However, service was slow and food (pho & rice dishes) were average at best. I don't think there are other choices for Vietnamese food around that area so no competition really.

Fresh grocer is right there at 3 stars, because there are cases that argue for a 2 star establishment, and certain characteristics that make it a 4 star. Here's why for me:

PROS:
-- $4.99 Rotisserie Chicken. Really good -- every time I've gotten it, it's moist and well seasoned. For $4.99 so worth it, it's cheaper than buying your own raw chicken and starting from scratch. I also use it to cook my own chicken stock at home with the bones once I'm done eating chicken
-- Validated free parking for grocery purchases over $10

CONS:
Generally higher prices when compared to Supreme for example.
Service -- be wary of coming here around 5pm to 7pm (when people get off of work and school) the lines are NO joke. 
Unreliable stock -- usually on fresh spices/ herbs. There have been a few times I've gone and they don't have basil or mint in stock for example.. can totally ruin my cooking plans if I'm set on something

NEUTRAL:
Cheap finds! Cheap finds are great, but be wary. They often have 40% off fresh foods ( usually a day or two old). Just take a close look at them. There were some greek pasta salads that looked watery because the veggies started wilting/dying in there.. and I wouldn't eat it even if it was 100% off. There have been times I found pizza for $1.00 slices, and sushi is cheaper during " happy hour" times as well. I consider these pluses and minuses as neutral since you get what ya pay for.

DO NOT EAT HERE! Ordered delivery from here tonight for the first time. I ordered a chicken salad and taco salad. They had to be the worst salads I've ever been given. The taco salad's chips were stale and the tiny cold precooked balls of meat were disgusting. The chicken in the chicken salad was pretty tasteless, along with the whole salad. If you need food late at night, just get fast food.

Only been to the cafe for desserts. And they are great!

This is a nice stop on a busy stretch of restaurants where you can grab a fancy coffee and dessert and take a load off.

I stop by here almost religiously when I'm down at the waterfront.

I've found their desserts to be quite good.

Croissants are flaky and buttery - just as you'd expect from a french bakery.

The macaroons were too easy to eat.

Add a foamy cappuccino, sit under an umbrella, and watch the people stroll by.

Great for coffee but I can surmise it's a solid dining option too.
Best West Tampa food, ropa vieja, yellow rice, black beans, cuban bread were all delicious and authentic tasting. Service very good

Yes - as good as it gets. After a prior good experience with the predecessor Gilson Auto Body, I drove into Caliber today with my MBZ that had a bruised my front fender. My wife gave me a full ration of hard times as it was definitely my fault. Anyway, their estimator (Charlie) came out and banged a distorted plastic part back into place, then he told me to pull up to one of their roll up doors. When I arrived there, one of their guys (Ernie) took a rag with some lacquer thinner on it and rubbed vigorously on the "bruised" area. Magically the bruise and the transferred grey paint came off the bumper. Wa-laa! No more damage except a very small crease in the plastic. Too small to bother repairing. Caliber could have stiffed me for $600-800 on a repair, but their honesty and integrity earned all of my future business. Kudos , kudos, kudos!
Not exactly Tsukiji quality fish, but hey - you're 168 mikes from an ocean.  if you're feeling sushi in Tuscon this place is priced right. (All-you-can-eat for ~$20)

The best chicken we've ever eaten. Hands down. The line was long but WORTH THE WAIT. I got medium tenders with baked beans and french fries and my husband got a hot small white plate with pimento mac and cheese, greens and french fries. Everything was AMAZING. The heat is not that bad, we love spicy things and even the hot was not hot to us.
Nice decor, pork belly tacos were good but any good Mexican place needs to have carnitas.

It's $5 for all you can eat, it's not going to be the best of the best, but it is good. I love going there and they help support the local schools which always is an awesome thing!
They also have kids nights two nights a week!

OK this place is so much fun. I wanted to drive all these cars home! its so cool how they have some of the clothing that goes with the era of each car. i had a lot more fun here than i expected i would.

The one star is harsh but i'm not a person to hold grudges but i won't be going back to Margarita ville. After going to New Orleans a few times i decided i need to go just to go and i went and well i'm not sure what the real problem was. But there was one waitress that did it all and it took 45 mins to get a drink. And another hour to get alligator bites but they were cold. We decided to just get the check and go. Took another 20 minutes. Not worth it.

Spicy pork kimchi is pretty good -- it's tasty and saucy.  The kimchi & onions absorb all the flavours and get all soft.  Main problem is that there's not enough rice served with it to accompany all the sauce.

Salmon BiBimBap is not so great. The salmon's not fresh enough to eat raw.  Veggie ingredients are fresh.  This dish is more like a salad than a regular BBB -- there's very little rice served with it.

It's nice that you can choose between white or brown rice.

The chiefs' cooking are not consistent. Sometimes good, sometimes were awful. Recently I ordered a lamb dish and the meat smells stinky, not fresh at all.  My main complain is about the meat they served such as chicken，pork and lamb. I didn't try beef yet. That was not the first time I found the meat was not very fresh! I really hope they could pay attention on that! Overall, the same dish tastes different every time which really bothers me a lot! Xi'an is my home town and that's why I give two stars, otherwise would be one.

Was walking around down town and wondered into bodo and spotted this place. I remember being told about this place to we stopped in for some refreshing ice cream on a hot night. We should have got some samples first and maybe things would have been better but we just went straight for it and I got the mint chocolate. The chocolate was great but it literly tasted like I was chewing on a mint plant. The mint was so strong I could barely eat it bit since I paid 5 bucks for a scoop i powered through it. Towards the end the mint faded but I think I was just becoming numb to it. It always looks like the sell beer and wine which I don't get cause never wanted beer or wine with ice cream but whatever floats your boat. I think this place is a fade and will probably not make it through the winter..

They have a groupon special going on right now and it makes this place even more worth it. We got the combo with the dungess crab and crayfish. Crayfishes are currently in season so all the crayfishes they use are fresh. If you've only had frozen crayfishes than you're clearly missing out and need to give this place a holler. Dungess crab as always was delicious. We got the combo sauce with both the creole and garlic butter at the spicy level. The sauce was A+ and savory. We also got the chicken heart on a stick as appetizer and that was also delicious. I would come back again.

We were there for nearly an hour before we were brought any bread.  We watched a much larger party who was seated after us, get their starters and pizza before we received ours.  When I mentioned it to the waitress she became rude and told me the party had been there for awhile.  As if I hadn't noticed when people came and went.  I had an hour to observe.  The food was okay but the slowness in the service at the end of two hours we didn't care we just wanted to leave.

Today is my first day visiting New Orleans. The main thing I look forward to is finding a good local bite to eat. Moments after smoking a blunt in an alley I was ready to do just that. The atmosphere as I walked in started off undeniably uncomfortable but later grew into a more relaxing feel when we seated ourselves in the back room with good lighting. Our food came out fairly quickly, although not having expected much because I merely ordered the catfish. Our waiter wasn't familiar with a dish my friend ordered and had to bring out different parts of it multiple times. Shortly after we realize she had given the meal to us that was to go to the table next to us. Being blazed and having no expectations this was a good place to grab a bite but I wouldn't expect anything you haven't tasted before.

This is no Boiling Crab, but it will do for Santa Barbara and save you a trip south. 

Finally checked this place out on a Sunday evening with a party of six and I had no complaints. Our server, Cody, was very attentive and offered great suggestions including a $40 special they had going on. He also made an effort to ask us if we had been there before as people that are unfamiliar with this dining set up may need a little help. I did over hear Cody explaining how the restaurant works to a table nearby and he did an excellent job making the guests feel welcome. 

We ordered a variety of food including shrimp, snow crab, clams, and combined all three seasonings (Cajun, Garlic Butter, and Lemon Pepper) in Medium to Spicy. I strongly recommend this combo if you like a variety of flavors all in one, otherwise just stick to your comfort zone. The food arrived in a timely manner and everything was cooked appropriately. We did order two sides of rice that were forgotten but we addressed this immediately with our server and he brought out the rice right away and apologized as he did not catch that part of our order. A very minor and dismissible error, we're all human. One member of our party ordered the clams with the Drunken sauce (tomato based) and it was great.

The vibe was very comfortable and allowed for a laid back dining experience, especially when your getting down and dirty with the food. The restaurant was very clean which I appreciated. There were a fair number of TVs as well so that you can enjoy a sports game while you dined. Overall, it was a very positive experience

Reserved tables. Won't let you sit down where you want.  Grumpy guy at the front doesn't seem to care if they get business. Anyone younger than 60 years old will bring the average age down considerably. Go somewhere else.

Decent and cheap sushi with a no nonsense atmosphere. Good if you want to go out for sushi and try a few different things and not break the bank. Got 3 rolls (6 pieces each), seaweed salad and a green tea for about 14 dollars.

We came here again in a group of 7 for Megan A's graduation dinner, and I was again impressed! The downsides this time were the heat (sweltering) and the service (our waitress was a little dry, and did not try to sell us more drinks or dessert). However, neither of these things were a problem the first time I went, so I'm still calling it 5 stars, especially with my food this time, which was even better!

I started with a Riesling. Very refreshing and just the sweetness I like. I would've had another, but wasn't asked if I wanted one. This was the same for several of us with alcoholic beverages. We weren't asked if we wanted more. Water, however, was a different story. The guy who was helping the waitress (bus boy seems too chain restaurant for this place!) was on his game and probably refilled my hubby's cup about 15 times. We were joking with him about it because my husband drinks a lot of water, and he really kept up! 

I had the house salad, which was AMAZING. I am going to go back for lunch just for this and soup. Beets, feta, olives (not for me), onions (nope), sunflower seeds and more. And delicious bread. Yum! It was so delicious, and the perfect side for a starter salad.

I had the semolina tagliatelle this time, with tatsoi (a green), red peppers and fresh mozzarella in a veggie stock reduction. It was delicious! So much fresh mozz and very flavorful. I couldn't eat it all as it was very filling. I love the bread they serve on the side of each entree. It's soft and flavorful. Yum! 

Even though the waitress didn't try to sell us desserts, we wanted them. We ordered a bread pudding, lemon tart, and chocolate mousse cake with salted caramel ice cream to share. The bread pudding was delicious. The lemon tart, while not my favorite flavor, had this caramelized brulee on top that was fab. And the chocolate mousse cake... OMG. I ordered it because the last time I was here, my dining partners got it and it looked SO good. I'm not a huge chocolate person, but I devoured it. It's like a little fudge ball, not cakey at all, just mousse. Paired with the caramel ice cream, it was the perfect decadent ending to my meal.

The prices here are reasonable for this caliber of food, no doubt. I can't wait to go back! No really.. I think I'm going to go back this weekend for lunch! I hope they serve dessert then!

My daughter wanted to eat at a burger place and Beefy's came up at the top of the list! We had the Breakfast Burger, the Onion Burger, the Stetson, and the Kansas City. We did not regret coming to Beefy's! The restaurant is cozy and small, and I would recommend Beefy's to any burger lover!

Bought a car here almost 10 years ago.   125,000 miles later I am still driving it and still bringing it here for service.   It's a bit pricey at times but you can wait for most work to be done, they're polite and they don't upsell you too badly.  The work done has always been great.

I was looking around for a late-night meal and came across this place. The music was loud but I managed to clearly communicate my order of the shish taouk plate which already looked expensive at $15. After waiting for twenty minutes, I received an average-sized plate with rice, chicken, turnips and a few McCain frozen french fries. As I was eating, the owner came along and gave me about three pitas and a bowl of tahini. He did not ask me if I wanted this and the music was too loud to ask if it was extra. Still, I didn't expect that it would be too expensive anyway... However, at the end of my meal, which came when the music stopped abrubtly and people were being ushered out because it was closing time, my bill came out to almost $30! DOUBLE what I expected to pay. The pita and (very bland) tahini dip alone apparently added up to the price of my chicken plate! I tried to dispute the bill but I was being forced out and the owner refused to reason. This was one of the worst dining experiences of my life. If you're hungry and it's late, go to the Denny's around the block. For this disgraceful rathole to call itself 'mediterranean' is an unforgivable insult to the mediterranean people and their culture and cuisine.

From ordering to when I received my meal, it was fast.  The meal tasted fresh and piping hot.  

First time ordering Chik-Fil-A, I'm hooked!

Too bad they don't open on sundays due to the CEO's religious beliefs.

I have been seeing Inna ever since I was a little girl before she opened Salon Stage. Every time I try to do my hair myself, Inna always fixes it and it turns out beautifully. Now when I go to Salon Stage, I put my trust in her completely and let her do what she thinks will look good. It always turns out amazing. I've gone from black to blonde and Inna has the expertise to do it all. She also does awesome makeup and hairstyles for events! I don't think I'll ever be able to trust another hair stylist as much as I trust Inna with my hair.

We, people of a certain age, we're walking around Bourbon Street looking for a good place to have a drink that was neither a rip off nor so over packed with people that you need to ask someone to move to take a drink.  

Imagine our shock when. we turned a corner and saw wine barrels!!! And cute little wine bar.  And best of all, a place with some very affordable but very good house wines.

If you are looking for a cool place near Bourbon Street and aren't into excessive noise, drunkenness,  and beads thrown toward women that no one wants to see flash, defiantly check this gem out.
Ok bakery. Lots to choose from. Very pricey and baked goods hit or miss on flavor. Asiago bagel tasted like pizza bread and cinnamon raisin bagels tasteless.

I finally checked out the pool area. It wasn't anything special or over the top. Let's face it, it was a pool at a budget hotel, not a Las Vegas casino. The only thing I really noticed about it was that a couple of the decorative colored tiles at the water's edge were broken off and missing. I never had a chance to check out the breakfast offerings. By the time I woke every morning breakfast service was already over.

These folks are very friendly- they were accommodating when my sister and I came in as walk-in's. The one very big issue I take with this place is the rushed pedicure. The woman that did my nails very obviously rushed through it, she was almost panicked while doing my pedicure. I wasn't sure why- the salon wasn't full and there weren't any people waiting. My sister's woman was dressed like she was going to the gym- wearing a sports top and yoga pants. I thought that was unprofessional. Additionally, she had a hard time doing french tips on my sister's toenails and the gentleman had to take over and finish. Overall, I left disappointed. I don't think I would return here.

I wanted the black beans and rice but they ran out and I am so happy they did, because the only thing left was vegan gumbo and it was DELICIOUS. Literally one of the best things I've ever eaten in my life. AND they give you ice water and orange slices while you wait...super refreshing in the humidity of New Orleans. If I lived here I would eat that gumbo at least once a week. SOOOO GOOOOD!
Absolutely one of the best Chiropractic and Massage therapy offices you will find. Very accommodating and pleasant atmosphere. The staff is very professional and go out of there way to work with you.

5 stars for good reason! Came across this place on yelp while looking for food after the SB zoo and i must say, it did not disappoint; not one bit! The pastor tacos were delicious, dare I say best I've had? Not over the top greasy as usual, yet full of flavor!! I love finding amazing "holes in the wall". If you do too, give it a shot!

The haircut you'll get at Hair Saloon for Men in Webster Groves is a crapshoot.  It all depends on the stylist.  If you get one of the Kims or Judy, you'll probably get a pretty decent cut.  But, if you're unlucky enough to get Becky or one of the others, you'll look like you've come from the butchers!

And, the receptionist, Amy...........seriously lacking in personality, and if she has to get up off her chair, she's not going to do it, whatever it is!!

No Call, No Show.

For a cross-country move scheduled months in advance. Seriously.

I was in regular contact with Mark Cordle (Guy-N-Truck) in the weeks leading up to the move; he stated that everything was a go and even got into the details of securing parking permits for his truck in the city. Three days before the move, I couldn't get a hold of him. And I've never heard from him since.

I was forced to forgo all my plans and rent a uhaul truck at the last minute to move everything 1400 miles by myself.

He'd better be dead. There is no other excuse to have done this to my family.

DO NOT attempt to use this mover. You will regret it.

We went last evening with a party of 6 for a 7:00 reservation.  The table we were to be seated at did not vacate until 7:40; thankfully we were seated at an alternate table on the first floor by 7:10.  Overbooking seemed to be a constant battle through the evening with little to no lobby or space to wait.  The team coould definitely improve on scheduling and a space to wait.  The service by our waitress Noelle was above par once we were seated - attentive, quick, thorough, etc.  We ordered a series of homemade appetizers, salads and pizzas to share family style and could not have been more pleased.  We had the Zia Rosa and Arancini and the Via Ottagio salad to start.  The Zia Rosa and Ottagio salad were delicious, the Arancini lacked any real punch and was more rice than pancetta.  We enjoyed the Bellapigna(eggplant), Giuseppe E Charlene(cabbage - the table favorite), Bisnonno Nicola (eggplant sliced), Mama Francesca (hot sausage and broccoli rabe), and Nonna Guisepina (sausage and sun dried tomatoes).  All were delicious, but the cabbage stole the show.  For desert we savored delicious gelatto and sorbettos made on site; pistacchio, toblerone, hazelnut, cherry, white chocolate chunk, etc. and delicious Italian coffees.  Greta ambience and definitely mobbed and trendy.  Be prepared to wait, but you will be glad you did.  BYOB.

Yummy is all I can say.  I first went to a Fat Burger when I was living in Westwood and the burgers were great even then.  Brought my girls here for the first time in August and it was the first time I saw my 7 year old devour an entire burger.  At McD's I had to fight to get her to even eat half but here, no problemo even though the burger was much bigger the McDonalds kids burger.  I just wish they had one closer to monterey.

A really great place to listen to some live music, drink and have some decent food.  When we were there the bar tender helped us out and was very friendly and attentive to our needs.

Cam, the bartender answered all our drink questions, suggested a few cocktails and helped us out with the menu questions we had.  We were really happy with out experience there and will definitely come back because of the great service we got from him and the other staff.

Foundation Grounds has cool atmosphere. That is if you're wanting to meet with friends and have lunch. I came here one day to study but it was not the type of coffee shop I was expecting. It is a small area so you can hear everything going on around you. I'm usually able to concentrate with some noises at coffee shops but the volume levels were higher than what I was expecting here. I can imagine it's usually busy but I didn't think it would be by late afternoon, which is when I went. 
The decor however was unique and the baristas were friendly! I ordered a cold brew coffee which was good and a strawberry scone which was alright, but not worth the $3.25 for it. 
If you're looking for a coffee shop to meet with friends and have lunch, I'd say this is a spot for you (the food people were ordering looked delicious). But if you're looking for a coffee shop and you want to be able to concentrate on work, I wouldn't suggest this is the place.

It's been a long while since I've been back to Casa Ramos after poor service on a consistent basis but returning tonight was a huge turnaround!!! I was seated immediately & my waitress Lorena was friendly, quick & very professional! Seriously I was amazed on how great the service was & blown away on how amazing the food tasted. I had the carne asada and it was cooked & seasoned perfectly. Oh and sangria was 2-4-1 ! Very good! Chatted a bit with Lorena & found out they have new management & seriously I can tell the huge difference from 2 years to now. If it's been a while since you been here, please try again because this place is back on track! #LorenaOnPoint #CarneAsada

I really like this store, it's probably the best tobacco store in New Orleans! Although I don't smoke myself, I come here to purchase tobacco for my father. They've got a great selection of loose tobacco, cigars, lighters, etc... I also like that they carry a great range in quality of their products. In addition, they are very helpful and patient as I open many jars to get a sniff to make sure I choose the right tobacco for my dad. The pricing of the tobacco is also pretty fantastic, much cheaper and more reasonable than many of the other places I have checked out around the country.

I also find the indoor seating and outdoor patio seating to be a very nice touch. It's also sort of cool that it's located at a former orphanage?

I visited Fetishes for a formal dinner with my family and I can safely say it was one of the best meals I have ever had. The food was incredible and the staff was welcoming and pleasant. The small restaurant atmosphere was peaceful and enjoyable and the A la carte aspect was something I had never experienced but thoroughly enjoyed. I would recommend to anyone who visits St. Pete beach and would like a formal dinner.

Great food and great conversation.  I was in very early and the owner made me feel right at home. If your using a gps it'll take you into a residential neighborhood. Use your geosense and don't fall for it.

Though I haven't had great success with their customer service, what can you really expect from the dmv? 

My prior experiences would have warranted a worse review. However my last two visits were greatly improved. The reason why I have given a four star rating is for the fact that they are changing and improving the experience. The virtual wait is very effective and a huge step in the right direction.

Just the fact that they have made this change is enough to realize they are making an effort! In a world where things never seem to improve and places especially like the dmv are just one headache after the other of chores and to do lists,  change can be so refreshing.

Maybe it's that they realized that doing the same thing over and over again and expecting a different result is the definition of insanity... And they were driving us all insane. But whatever the reason for the change, I think we can all be grateful for not going insane at the dmv anymore.

Hard to find. But well worth it. Service was great- personal and accommodating. Food was superior quality and clearly made to order. Great lunch specials and we didn't have to wait very long for our lunch. Only complaint: they need a sign out in front of the building!
Great place for wine, cheese, meet! Romantic atmosphere inside and out. Outstanding and knowledgeable waitstaff. Delicious wines and good beer selection.
Addicted to this place-- vegetarians and carnivores alike will love it. We don't know where to find better Bahn Mi sandwiches, and after sampling much of the menu, recommend it to all

Came here with friends this past Jazz Fest (2009) for a break from their Bud & Miller Light night outs.  I'm actually more of a wine guy, so having a glass here from their decent wine list, was refreshing.  The place was charming with high ceilings, warm ambiance and housed in an antique building.  A bit of a ways apart from the livelier section of Magazine.  The menu looked amazing.  Regret not having the time for dinner here.
one of the last standing bookstores here in santa barbara, thank baby jesus. please stay around forever!
Excellent family style restaurant. Great food, large portions, very friendly staff and service. Large diverse menu. Its always very busy but usually seated quickly.

AVOID: Just got hosed on an iced coffee and an iced macchiato. Bartender didn't even know what a macchiato was. Iced coffee was leftover coffee this morning on the rocks. Asked to top them off with a shot of Bailey's each, and got maybe one shot total for apparently $9 a piece. "You're in a bar in Nawlins, brother." Yea, but even in NOLA, I wouldn't expect to get hosed by an incompetent, rude bartender. I'd avoid this place if I were you. I'd five them no stars if it were possible. Thanks a lot for nothing, Stacks.

The Tampa Bay area is severely lacking in vegetarian options, much less vegan ones, and this place was a pleasant surprise. We made the hike from St. Pete and it was worth it. The decor leaves much to be desired, but the flavors are delish and the prices are AWESOME. We pigged out--two appetizers, two entrees, two (vegan!) cheesecakes, and a coffee--all for about $36. Unbelievable. My husband got the vegan "pork" which he loved. I had vegan pho which was pretty good, though nothing to write home about. Lots of good vegetables though. We had some spring rolls (the fresh kind) with vegan "pork" in them which were delicious, and the papaya salad was good too. We were given a non-vegan salad by mistake which we nearly ate. It looked "off" so we asked and they quickly corrected the error. The desserts were awesome and very affordable as well. Overall, a very good value.

My first Brazilian at another salon cost me $75 (not including tip) and was done a by a man (gay).  He was very nice, but I prefer the rude Russians.  
Listen to some music during the chocolate experience of your hair removal and it will be fine. Wear loose clothing and bring Neosporin so you don't chafe during the rest of your errands.
The husband and I loved this place ..first time there tonight ..ice cream and fudge was amazing...Darwin helped us he was super nice! We would definitely come again and recommend to others.
Great happy hour. Jeremy was my server. He was very kind, had great recommendations (try the peppadew). I'll be back for you Jeremy (and the half priced burgers on Wednesday)!
Very clean. Great service too bc they were actually speaking to me and not one another

We just bought our 2017 from these guys and the experience was fantastic, from our sales rep, Stacy, who was very knowledgeable and friendly, to the finance manager as the service rep who we also met. The dealership is nice and clean and the lounge with free sodas and coffee while we wait is a nice touch. We'll be going back to Bill Pearce for future purchases and all services as well! Great stuff.

I came here because I was participating i Glorify Women, an expo that was said to feature a lot of things. The hotel confrence room we were in was small. There were tables set up with quite possibly every MLM except beach body or VI and thats because 2 others were there. There wwre vending tables that were reserved,but not taken.

We were told there would be a runway... There was not. The only presentations were us, our Belly dance school,and one makeup demo by one of the MLM groups. There were no talks,no speakers as promised. 

So back to the hotel.. The room was small,water was only provided outside rather than inside and easily accessible. The room was warm. Overall it was meh.

Jesus' tits! How did writing a review of this place escape me?

Mea culpa, baby. This dark den of decent cocktails and indecent patrons offers most anything and everything you could ask for from a bar. Great bartenders who are passionate about their craft and take no crap from anyone. Not one, but two fireplaces for  nursing a drink, catching up with friends or tryin' to get your romance on (BTW, Bacon Bloody Mary is fun to say, but I'm not drinking one anytime soon.). 

Geez, now I want to go to there.

DO NOT EVER ORDER FROM THIS PLACE! They have the worst customer service I have ever encountered. 
I found a hair, which appears pubic in nature and I called and they refused to give a refund. They wanted me to bring the pizza back to them (it was delivery) despite that it was freezing and after 9pm. When I said I don't understand - I didn't want to bring the pizza back and I definitely didn't want another pizza I was told I was being "difficult" and I had to bring the pizza back to make sure I "wasn't lying". I said I can send you a picture, however that would not suffice. The manager was just plain mean!
So, attached is the picture here and I'm really sorry they lost my business and any referrals.

I lived in the lovely Philadelphia as a child and still have family in the area so I visit every once in a while. I live in New York City now and have become a, admittedly, spoiled-rotten food snob. On a friend-visit to Philly, I was taken to Vernick's and promised amazing food and innovative cocktails. WTF Philly, why have you been hiding this place?!? Friggin' fantastic! 

Highly recommend: the mozzarella, mango, basil & sea salt salad, the hamachi with ruby grapefruit and jalapeno, the pumpkin butter toast, and the white cheese and sweet pepper toast. I absolutely loved the Pegu club cocktail. Yum yum. 

Service was friendly, prompt, and organized. Ambiance was mellow and soothing. Could not be better for a late-night girls dinner and catch-up. 

Highly recommend!

Best tacos in SB. Good value. Awesome family run establishment. Wish they were open longer and on Sundays.

("Looks like your review is on the short side"??? Ha. I mean... Yelp would be more useful if all the reviews were shorter, not longer.)

Good food, terribly maintained store. Very sad to see such nice patio brick work covered in grime. Bird poop on the patio walls, the trash receptacle outside looked like it was from a slum. The men's room was a mess (literally-ewe on the toilet porcelain), and the fixins bar was messy. The manager needs to invest some money on keeping this place up.

One of the best brunches I have ever had!  The spot itself has so much character. A quaint charming spot away from the madness of the quarter.
