We arrived to a live band which made the meal even that much more special. The bloody bar was amazing and well worth the price. I had the duck hash and my wife had eggs treme both were exceptional. Do yourself a favor next time you are in NOLA and check this place out. You will not be disappointed.

The apartment homes looked nice. My husband and I moved in after being told they were sound-proof. They are far from it. The walls are all dry-wall so you can hear the traffic.

 The maintenance came in to do a repair, broke our shower curtain rod hook and put it in the trash without telling us. Another time maintenance had to come out for the bathroom fan, it was left hanging out of the ceiling by the wires. 

We were told to change our own light bulbs. So, I did. Only for the outsides ones to be taken and replaced with uniform bulbs. 

Management doesn't do anything when you have concerns and there is no communication. When we first moved in, a maintenance guy opened the door with his key and let himself in. I was not clothed on the couch. He said no one informed him anyone moved in yet.

I would not recommend this place to anyone who wants to live comfortably.
Amazing Montreal Smoked Meat Sandwich.... this is the best you will find anywhere. You gotta try it at least once.
Our entire family has gotten food poisoning from their sour black bean dip on Saturday, March 16. The rest of the food was tasteless.

Food was good. Tastes authentic. Waitress was quick, good - did her job fine.  But indifferent did not make us feel much welcomed. Another minus seats are wood and uncomfortable... Which I know they do so people eat and go... :))) but I felt uncomfortable right when I just took a seat :)) I'm giving 4 start for overall experience was nice I just know that it can be better in other korean restaurants :) I would recommend this place to others. But personally if ill be back to Tampa I could give a try to other korean restaurants.

I've only gotten three things here: ribs, catfish, and brisket. The ribs are seasoned so well that they don't need sauce, which to me means they are perfect. The catfish is excellent: freshly breaded and fried to a golden brown, flaky and light, like it ought to be. The brisket, which I've only had once, is okay, not great -- a bit fatty, but good enough. 

Sides are all fair to good in quality, except for the fried okra, which is the best I've ever had. (It sadly doesn't stand up to take out orders. It steams itself and turns into a soggy mess. Eaten fresh, though, it's magnificent.)

The service is friendly and familiar even when I stopped by for my first try, which has successfully brought me back a couple of times when I need a BBQ fix on my lunch break.

Hank's Catfish and BBQ will not take your breath away, but it is consistently solid. There's no other word for it. Dependably good service and quality food is worth applauding.
Solid variety, cool vibe and a killer cheese plate.  Good for beginning tasters and experienced alike.  Check it out.

Yang's roast beef is different from any other I've tried in NOLA. The gravy is suspiciously similar to gravy you'd find on New Orleans "Mandarin Chicken". Its a light colored, thick gravy, thats heavily seasoned. 

The beef was moist and plentiful but personally, didn't care for the gravy.  The fries were expensive given the size and the small amount of gravy. They also use a thick (cheap) nacho cheese on the fries which I think is gross. 

The atmosphere is a bit odd. If you didnt know they serve traditional New Orleans poboys, you'd think you were in a Chinese restaurant,  from the sketchy looking counter where you order, to the random Asian decorations scattered around...


Not on my top list of places for roast beef poboys.

was going to eat there today i seen they had good reviews on here, so i thought it would be good, it might have been good but they were out of half of thier items, not really a way to run a business, I've worked food all my life and a trip to the grocery store would of fixed that, i guess making new customers is not worth it tho.

Wilko, you're officially back on my radar. For the most part, every visit was A-ok but on this last visit I am super happy to say that it was as good as it gets! I tend to avoid the University area because it's do darned hard to find parking! But with the construction of the trolley over the Summer, many businesses all the way from Downtown to the University are suffering, so I've made it a point to support these places as much as possible. I mean it's not their fault that the streets are torn out and there is literally no parking anywhere! Wilko happens to be one of the businesses affected by the trolley construction, so I chose them for dinner last night.


My boyfriend and I rolled in around 9pm and were greeted right away. We took a seat at the bar and were surrounded by multiple friendly faces and fabulous service! Since I was the one with the appetite, I started off with an order of the Vietnamese meat balls. This meatballs set the tone for the night; they exceeded my expectations. Each meat ball is served with a crisp piece of butter leaf lettuce, so that you can roll it up in the lettuce and dip it in the spicy/sweet chili sauce served on the side. Each bite had a mix of spice, sweetness and tang from the lemongrass. I ordered a glass of the Gruner and it was the perfect pairing. As my entree I went with the Chunky Med salad with chicken. My boyfriend who initially said was not hungry, quickly changed his mind after his first bite of the meatballs. So, we ended up with 2 orders of the meatballs!

The Chunky Med was equally as tasty and crisp! Served with escarole, cherry tomato, cucumber, onion, mint, feta cheese, kalamatas, lemon vinaigrette, this is my new favorite of pick for summer salads. The mint was the super star ingredient in this dish. 

Both of these items have earned a new regular customer at Wilko. And with the Summer heat in full gear, refreshing flavors like the lemongrass in the meat balls and the mint in the salad will keep me coming back for more!

On past visits I have ordered the Sonoran Brat, a cheese plate, Napa Cabbage salad (my least favorite), and the herb fries. You really can't go wrong with any of these items. 

Wilko is serving up simple, good, lite fare and I like that. It's a place to go grab a coffee, or enjoy a snack, a glass of wine or a full meal in a rustic and laid back setting. 

I hope the wait staff keeps up the good work, because their quality of service really enhanced the overall experience.

so, thanks to the peeps at Wilko!

Well. I feel really bad giving this place 3 stars. I almost wanted to give a 2, but they did nothing wrong. It just wasn't my cup of tea. It does get a lot of hype. Maybe that was part of my disappointment when I did not enjoy the food. I've had Po Boys before elsewhere and well, this place sure has unique types. I don't think I would say it's a must try. Unless you are curious, like I was.
this location, though always busy, is always fast and delicious. i enjoy the upstairs loft area for relaxing and having conversations, checking work e-mail, or reading a book. Love this location!

I read the reviews before I had my gel manicure, was a little worried, and I had a very good experience and an excellent manicure.  The tools were clean, and Ricky painted my nails with expertise.  I definitely recommend this nail salon!
Great food.  Local establishment specializing in roasted ham.  Had soft shell crab ok boy, can't go wrong with anything in menu.  Reasonable prices.

I did the Chamelette Battlefield historical lunch tour. The buffet was small compared to some that I've done here in Chicago on the lake front cruises; and especially for the price. I ate the Jambalaya, Gumbo, Cajun Chicken Pasta, and Bread Pudding. I wish there was a meat like Chicken (fried or baked), Beef, or Fish. There are free soda drinks which for some reason that day tasted super refreshing! The tour guide was a native and former history instructor. She was very informative and the views were great.

By the way, Google wasn't pointing to the right direction on my phone. It showed somewhere north of the French Market area. You actually have to go to the Outlet Collection at Riverwalk. at 500 Port St # 39, New Orleans, LA 70130. Outside near the riverwalk area is where the boats are waiting for patrons. The ticket lady said that taxi drivers and tourist always go to the wrong spot.
Love this place. Have gone many times and shown it to family as well. Very casual atmosphere. A lot of food for a great price and everything I've tried has been delicious!

Bad news first, then good news. Good news about the bad news is that you're probably smarter than I am. You wouldn't decide to get a bikini wax at a place that's named, "NAILS and spa."  Clearly the concentration is on nails, not spa services.

I got a Brazilian bikini wax.  I shouldn't have, but I figured that I needed one and I should just knock it out at the same place while I got my nails done (before, not simultaneously).  The wax I got is maybe not the worst wax I've ever gotten, but definitely one of the worst.  Perhaps they're better with faces, arms, legs, armpits, I don't know.  She used hot wax, but not the kind that hardens (hardening hot wax is the best to use for the bikini line) and consequently a lot of hairs didn't come out or broke instead of coming out. The wax was unevenly applied, and she used the same stick every time she dipped into the pot.  I had a lot of patches of hair that was totally missed and -excuse the indelicacy- she didn't get anything around my butt.  There was lots of wax still stuck to me when she was done.  She was very fast, which is nice, but fast isn't really much of a bonus when I've got to get the hand mirror out later and finish the job.  When the hair grew back in later I had a lot of ingrown hairs.  Another point for the negative is that a wax here costs the same as it does in other area salons that do a better job.

Good news next!  Great pedicure and great manicure with acrylic tips for a very reasonable price!  My technician asked for my preferences and did just what I communicated.  The basic pedicure included leg massage, moisturizer and hot rock leg massage!  They had those massage chairs that we all so love, as well.  Two weeks later and my toes still look great!

My manicure looks good as well.  I got acrylic tips in French style (yes, yes, not classy, sue me).  Technician told me that they have these neat white tips for French.  This means the color is part of the nail foundation so your white tip won't fade, discolor, or chip off.  You can choose to paint another color over them later if you get tired of the French.  Getting the fancy white base tip is the same price as just getting the French painted on.  

I could tell that the technician didn't think much of how short I like to get the acrylics cut down, but she did it anyway.  When she finished I thought that the tips were a little too square, so I asked her to round them off some more.  She did this without complaint, even though that meant she had to redo some of the top coat.  The only thing I don't particularly appreciate is that she was a little careless when she tapered the acrylics at the base of my nail so she nicked the cuticle on my pinky and three fingers have divots in the natural nails that I can see now that they're growing out.

All-in-all a positive experience and reasonable prices on the nails.  Technician was really friendly (I wish I could remember her name...started with a T?).  I would definitely go back for fast, inexpensive service.  Would be 4 stars if I hadn't foolishly tried the bikini wax.
This place was okay. There was a lot of hype surrounding this place, & the food was just average. The coffee wasn't good either.

Concealed pretty well down a small alley a block from the County Theater Bobby Simones is well worth the search.  The restaurant is fairly small and very comfortable and offers a terrific dinner menu and is also a great place to grab lunch or just drinks.  Its located only a block and a half south of the court house in Doylestown.

You cant go wrong with any of the meat selections,  Bobby's does an exceptional job of finding the best meat in the region and I have never eaten a piece that wasnt cooked to perfection.  A great dining experience for me is a combination of great food, atmosphere, service and attention to detail.  There are plenty of places that do well in 2 or 3 of these areas but most fail to hit the mark on all 4.  Bobby's attention of detail is incredible.  Here's an example:  while having lunch there one day I ordered a Chicken Caesar salad,  I happen to like anchovies, many don't.  Bobby took pride in telling me that he only serves white anchovies and explaining to me the difference they make.  He was right;  anyone can make a decent Chicken Caesar,  but these really changed the flavor of the salad and made it an experience.  

There is a private room in the back that they are happy to set up for you if you want to host a party that is quieter than the main part of the restaurant and is just the place for a business or family dinner for 10 or less.  Adding Mike Conti to oversee the restaurant has only taken this place up.  Mike is the consummate professional and you are pretty much guaranteed a special time when you go.

There is seating outside in the summer months and a bar across the alley that are also part of Bobby's but each area seems to offer something different and stands well on its own.  

If Bobby is there you will know, he is like an old time restaurateur who takes real pride in meeting you personally and making sure that your expectations are surpassed.  If not, they will be immediately.  Pride goes along way to making this spot one to put on your list of "must go's"

My husband and I stayed here after our wedding and it was perfect! They allowed our friends to go into our room and decorated for us! They were so nice! They were able to put all of our wedding party in rooms right next to us which was perfect! Thank you sandman inn for making my wedding stay wonderful!
Amazing coffee I'm ahuge coffee drinker and thus place is amazing. First Romney's get free coffee because they know once you have those stuff you will definitely come back
Food was truly awesome. Service is truly the best also. Worth the money! I love the service where I can order and pay and then wait for the food
Excellent brunch! Great value. Excellent LaColombe coffee. Will certainly return. Neighborhood place.

Came here for late night dinner with some friends and really enjoyed the food! The burgers are very good and there is a such a variety of them to choose from, plus the option to build your own! The specialty drinks list wasn't very long, and some of the drinks were a little expensive, but there is a lot of beer to choose from! Our server Phil was very attentive and even brought our leftovers that we almost forgot outside to us. I also would recommend the Lasso Fries as an appetizer to anyone, very good!

Hey! I just found out that Deb also offers strip tease aerobics classes! I took a demonstration from her this weekend (she offered it as an option to some of her class regulars) and it was in.sane. 

I would definitely take it as a regular class if she offered it (hint, hint, if you are reading these reviews!) because, like Zumba, I think it would be something that helps me just feel more in charge of my body and body movements, which I personally like. It's a workout, as my aching thighs can attest to.

I also think it  could be something really cool for a bachelorette party, methinks. My only concern for a bach party is it is a workout, so that may seem odd before going out to drink, or whatever, but I think she would probably be able to adjust the class so you get the sexy without the sweaty.

Overheard in class: "I haven't spent this much time on my knees in a long time." "Maybe we'd date more if we did."

Great place to wait out a rain storm. Excellent Happy Hour!

A little off the beaten path for tourists, which is why we went there, this is a small intimate bar with a ton of top shelf drinks. The bar menu lines all the walls with great $5 daily specials and $6 Happy hour that lasts a good part of the day. If you are looking to avoid the cheap, strong for the purpose of dunkery places on Bourbon, this place offers an alternative. Strong but well made drinks, chill company, and friendly staff.

We have been here several times. The shrimp fried rice-amazing, the red curry chicken-amazing and the pad thai is just ok.  Nothing spectacular about the place itself...prices are not mind-blowingly cheap. And I recommend medium spicy as that is pretty spicy, but if you want to light yourself up, get hot.

Good take out option. Ordered the Sicilian definitely feeds more than a few. 8 slices buy they're huge and you can slice into 16 and have plenty with the density of the crust. We easily fed 5 adults and a preteen boy. The Caesar salad was fresh but average just seemed like store bought croutons make homemade it would go along way for sure and seem more authentic. We will definitely get another pizza there again and maybe try pasta or a Stromboli or calzone next time

This place makes McDonalds food look good. I got the tiny burger it looks like it was pure pink slime, it was hard and had no flavor. my kids got the short stack the only good thing about it was the side of bacon that we added on for an extra cost. my husband got the chicken fried chicken sandwich and he said it was not nearly as good as it was the last time when he went 5 years ago. 
Not only was the food horrible but after tip we spent close to $50
This money was not spent well.

There products burned my face and I'm still getting a bill from their billing office. I had spoke with someone who told me that, the bill was taken care of and I didn't owe them anything. Going to this office was a huge mistake, this practice is a joke and very unprofessional. IM WARNING PEOPLE DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY. My skin is still messed up to this day.

Went to Friday night happy hour out in the back of the place--haven't been there for awhile so the covered tented areas were a nice upgrade from the last time I was there. Five of us got there before 6 and snagged a place in the corner of the bar to post up, there weren't any tables left.

They were out of Brooklyn summer cans (womp womp), but all other beer was in stock and good. Tasted my friends red sangria and was pleasantly surprised. Service was a tad slow but it was busy for the night and they kept tabs on you. Overall a great experience!

This is a hole in the wall back street location. The owner helped us with our occasion as he was the only person working. The place is clean and pleasant. 
The important part is the meat. I sampled all the meat they offer. They have a sampler plate to give you that chance. The pork entries rib and pulled pork we very flavorful. The sauce is sweet but not too much. The beef rib and brisket both had a rich dark flavor as expected. The chicken was easy to pull from the bone. All the meats were very tender and the coon was perfect. All meat had good moisture. The overall was a very nice place to get barbecue.

The guy serving coffee was very kind. Everything else was not good at all. The food was like early 90s local health food store stuff. Just lots of grease and blandness.  I had the monte cristo and it just tasted like Wonderbread dipped in coconut oil. There's no waitstaff whatsoever... you need to hunt for a table, get silverware for it, pickup your food from the kitchen, and then bus your own table while other diners wait for you to leave so they can sit down. 
I can't recommend this place when every restaurant on Passyunk Ave has vegan options. Maybe if you're in the Midwest and this is the only vegan place for hundreds of miles... but you're not. You're in Philly. There are much better places to eat.

Not going to fully rate yet as this was a first visit for a quick takeout and stroll through their market. 
I bought lupini beans which look good ( bottled) and took out baba ganoush and some chicken samoosas. The baba is delicious and the samoosas, although a little dry and lacking in flavor , were a delicious crunchy texture just how I like them. We will go back for a sit down meal sometime.

PLEASE! Please think twice, or in fact, don't even consider this company for your cleaning needs. I pre-scheduled three cleaning dates for Buy In Bulk Housecleaning back in November. Their website asks the client to call and confirm the appointment before the reserved date; which I have for the past three days! No answer; just a voice who refers me to an e-mail. My first cleaning (scheduled three months ago) is a no show on their part. Typically, I do not report these kinds of things; however, with the many cleaning companies in the greater Nashville area, they are a waste of time! Consider a professional company who desires the business. If you have bought the Groupon, simply call the website and ask to be refunded. It is worth every penny back! If you are a new client looking for good cleaning services, run away and DO NOT consider them for your needs.

Love this place. Love the ambience, the staff, and the incredible beer! I relish in it's location. Located on the outer edge of downtown you get a different crowd/feel than you would if it was a couple blocks closer to 8th street. A great place to hang with interesting people and enjoy a flavorful beer.

No beach on Gulf of Mexico. It on the channel!  

It's like swimming on a river. 

Rooms were clean, 

Free breakfast terrible! 
Took one bite of 2-3 things and threw it out!

Ceviche at restaurant was really good for $14.00!

Valet Parking took forever to get in and out garage...

Rhonda gets 5 stars for being hospitable at Front Desk. Daytime Front Desk -they were disorganized.

Came here for a weekday lunch and ordered the sashimi lunch special. The fish was frozen and had a bland taste. Luckily, instead of serving the normal room temperature vinegared rice with this, they served regular warm rice so I could thaw the fish before eating it! How thoughtful...
far from the best haircut i've gotten

Been looking forward to going to Jimmy Kelly's for more than a year. We were seated upstairs in a room to ourselves, the atmosphere was eerie and it looked like a haunted house. The waiter told us it had just been renovated, wow, wonder what it looked like before???The salad and baked potato were excellent, but the steak  and service were mediocre, prices were outrageous! Will never go back!

Mark is amazingly helpful. I've tried calling dozens of local companies to help me - all of which seemed rude/annoyed in some way or another - and this was the first experience where I was treated with kindness. He's the first guy I'm going to call if I have any other issues.

Despite its convenience it isn't the City's best burger.  It's good enough but $24 for two single burgers and a small onion rings (no drink) hardly stacks up to the fresh ground burgers at Port of Call with a baked potato and table service !

After having spent a month traveling throughout Mexico and trying the best tacos I've ever tasted, I was beginning to doubt whether I would be able to find anything comparable in North America. I know that my hometown (Toronto) has nothing close so I was very pleased to discover that my trip to Philly would not just have mediocre Blue Jays baseball but also the best Mexican food I've ever had outside of Mexico.

This place is legit. They make only two types of tacos and a simple consommé but everything is perfect. The meat is tender and flavorful, the tacos are perfectly baked and the accompanying sauces and other condiments are done just right. If you are a lover of Mexican food, get here immediately.

We dine at Boston Pizza frequently, but usually for wings and beer. 

Today, I had a hankering for lasagne and ordered today at the West Edmonton Mall location. What I received, does resemble lasagne at all. 

It's a plate of noodles, with pizza sauce and pizza cheese melted over top. If the call it lasagne because there are broad noodles with ruffled edges, they are not honoring what this deep dish is supposed to be. 

What ever happened to a few layers of noodles, flanked by ground beef, tomato sauce, cottage or ricotta cheese, with a top layer of cheese on top?

It's not an expensive dish to make, but I may as well have had a plate of spaghetti. This $14.99 dish was not worth it. 

Won't do that again, and will probably steer clear of Boston Pizza for a while. Clearly cheaping out, making every dish basically the same with a couple different pasta shapes does endear me to return. 

Disappointed.

Came here for happy hour for drinks and appetizers. The food was decent as part of the summer sips special but nothing spectacular. The beef meatballs topped with crispy shallots and paired with herbed tzatziki and the spinach croquettes were my favorites (though the latter was a tad bit salty). The fries with their spice blend came out piping hot and crispy. 

I didn't care too much for the pita nachos though. The pita itself was really dense and hard to bite into. The toppings were good: brisket ragu, hot peppers, scallions, tomato-cucumber-onion salata, and greek cheese. We also ordered a special of the night, a crab dip layered with mango, strawberry, and avocado. The dish was slightly bland and was, to our dismay, paired with the really hard and dense fried pita. 

Opa's ambience and service was good, but the food doesn't necessarily make you come back wanting more.

What a great night. Barry the bartender serves a fantastic drink along with an amazing personality. Alex is a manager that went above and beyond to make sure that our visit in to Nesso was the best that it could be. Every dish that we ate and every drink that we consumed was outstanding.

I really like this place.  Each time I go lately I end up paying for the special of the night.

I met a group of guys for dinner one Wednesday night here.

The wait was long (border war night Mizzou vs. Illini basketball), but the food was worth the wait (we had 5 people- they have mostly tables for 4 or less).  The bar is nice sized for a restaurant and the beers were on the expensive side for me.

I had the special, a pan seared chicken with salad and pasta and came with a glass of wine.  The salad and pasta was both very good, but the chicken was great.  The glass of wine did not last past the salad.

The bill was high, but the experience and service was worth every penny

As I sat there I remembered this was the first real restaurant I took a girl out to just because she came out of her parents house in a dress.  She looked good, but afterwards she said she was underdressed and embarrassed.  I am a guy so a dress was a dress and sometimes a man gotta do what a man gotta do.

(OK- I went there because I was told to by a old boss from "Sleep Station" (after he made me manager) because "pasta house/ olive garden are halfway places because they are halfway between fast food and a real restaurant" and now I agree.)

Food was sooo good. We had the fried alligator, oysters (sauce is amazing!!), Mac n cheese and smothered greens. Excellent wine recommendation by the server as well. Everything from the decor to the ambiance was spot on. Overall great experience. Will most definitely return when in town again. Thank you Cochon!
Stopped in for cheese cake Saturday night. They never seize to impress. The cheese cake is amazing. Enjoy

My husband and I have been coming to Hacienda with our families for over 10 years. While I've never been thrilled by service or food, I've previously found it acceptable. 

Tonight my husband and I decided to go for our one year anniversary dinner since he was craving Mexican. Obviously that was our mistake. Service was abysmal. We showed up, got seated, and ordered our drinks. Drinks came within a reasonable time. We then ordered our food. Thirty or so minutes went by without us even seeing our waiter. Our neighbors, who arrived after us, received their food. After this we finally saw our waiter. He said there was a "really big order" before us and he was so sorry. He brought us queso and a margarita on the house, which would have been very kind, except that all we wanted were our ordered entrees - and we weren't planning on drinking much on a WORK NIGHT. After another 10-15 minutes our food arrived. EXCEPT I I don't eat beef, and my previously bean burrito had miraculously grown beef. My husband's shrimp quesadilla had little to no shrimp when received. When we pointed out the burrito issue to the waiter he looked overwhelmed and didn't comment. At this point my husband just asked him to remove it from our bill. To his credit, he agreed and did so. We paid our bill, left a significant amount of paid and free food on the table, and left as quickly as possible. It will take something quite significant to get us to return. To compound this, we arrived before 6pm and most of the tables were empty. Not the best anniversary...
Wonder if this is the same-or related- to the long closed Szechuan Omei in New York City.... used to LOVE that place... Then in the blink of an eye they were gone...
Family owned and operated.  The pizza is pretty good and the prices are low.  Delivery can be a bit on the slow side.

123 S 39th St is worst apartment I've rented so far, which is owned by UCA. They charge you a good amount of fees for a room with a leaking sewer pipe, uncleaned floor, broken internet wires (I have to share the Internet with a neighbor), a small and a frosty fridge and the smallest bathroom you could ever find. No AC, broken mail box lock, rats in the kitchen, and what's worse, the maintenance service never fixed those big problems, saying that the building is just too old. 

Some of the campus apartments staff are actually helpful. But there are some who are really unpleasant. In short, it's not worth wasting so much of your money on lots of crappy apartments they offer.

We really enjoyed this restaurant.  It's casual, but they have really good food.  My husband and I both had the Steak Quesadilla.  It had great flavor with the JOLTS toppings.  We also tried many of their sauces.  Delicious.  Service was great and quick.  The employees were very friendly!  We left stuffed.

It's been a while since my last review of this place, so I'm just coming back to say that this place is STILL amazing and they're STILL my favorite restaurant in the Philadelphia area. Over the years, I've gotten to know the owners and staff at Indian Garden and they are friendly people that care about their customers and are passionate about making great food. If you like or are even remotely curious about Indian food, you owe it to yourself to try this place.
They crew at Image Complete Auto Repair do a great job.  I got my truck smoged and was out quickly for $18.95.  They were friendly and professional.

This morning I waited 26 Mins for a breakfast sandwich I kid you not! I ordered at 9:03 got my sandwich at 9:29am The staff is slow and so rude especially the woman who runs the front! Gestapo Tactics ! This isnt the first time this happened! Very upsetting because its great food but if this is the service then I will not be returning nor will I recommend

Chaucer's bookstore is by far the best bookstore in Santa Barbara.  It is full or character and very well stocked.  Not to mention well staffed, with extremely knowledgeable people available to help you find a book or order one.  Their children's section is excellent too, with many unique and special books and cute stuffed animals, coloring books, and sticker books.  

Each section of Chaucer's is well developed and their newer current affairs section is full of the most recent publications on foreign affairs and politics.  I think the most impressive section is their novels though, with  signed copies (Chaucer's often has local authors, like Sue Grafton and T.C. Boyle, come in for book signings), and recommended books.  You could spend hours in Chaucer's and not even realize it

My experience was pretty good but I can see how so many other Yelpers had something go wrong. I feel like a lot of the quality depends on who's working there at the time. You can't go wrong with a Chicago dog and tots. It's a little pricey but, surprise!!!, you're in the airport!

So my husband and I have come in here many times and we just got small plates. Mainly my craving for something not technically on the menu... the Crab Fat Coleslaw on top of French fries. I'll post a pic. But anyway, I had the Triple tail tonight and it was heaven! My husband loved his Bahn Mi, said it was the best he had!  We live in the neighborhood and are very pleased with this restaurant and the creativity & flavors the chef offers. 
Again..... crab fat coleslaw on top of French fries.. eat it w/a fork. Your welcome!

Bought the ribs and pulled pork with some sides for Father's Day. First time trying and I'm hooked. Delicious, ribs were perfectly smoked, sauce on the side, hearty and flavorful. I'm impressed. We need to support this local place. Terrific service, must try!

This is one of my favorite restaurants in Santa Barbara! I'm a student at UCSB without a car so it's a bit tough to get there but whenever I go downtown I always make sure to order something. Their Himalayan chow chow and chicken biryani is amazing! The food is a bit on the pricey side but definitely worth it in my opinion.

Delicious meal. Friendly and helpful staff. Kind of loud. Maybe the acoustics are off, but it's really loud for a fine dining establishment. It was hard to hear my fiancée who was sitting right next to me. Other than the noise, Provision provides a lovely dining experience. We had steaks and shared sides. Everything was perfectly seasoned and served quickly. The desserts are a showstopper and I recommend the lemon coconut cake. Heaven! Great for a date night. A great addition to the area.

Full disclosure: The two stars is just for the veggie burger, as I've only been once and with all the vegan options in Philly don't plan to return unless there are more options added. 
With all the great new clean meat options (like the Beyond Burger or Impossible Burger) restaurants don't really need to make their own burgers any more, particularly if they are like this veggie burger. I know some folks like the bean/grain burgers (yuck!) but this one fell apart, tasted chalky ... not good. I DO fully appreciate that they make an attempt and just suggest they try one of the ready-made varieties above and make it their own with the toppings. 
The staff working was nice/friendly.

A very solid steaks house with a gift: their prices. Very good steak house at fair prices. They have very good wines too at, again, very reasonable prices. 

I do have to say that I don't think it's the best steak house in town. That honor goes to Harrah's steak house for me right now.

I'm off to do more research but this is a great place and if price is important this place will do a great job.

Was super excited to try this place. My friend and I  ordered the chicken biryani and the tandoori chicken because it would've taken some extra time for the beef items to be made, which is totally fine. The chicken biryani was nice! However, the tandoori chicken was raw on the inside. Completely inedible, and that dampened our experience. Overall I'd order the chicken biryani again but I was not very impressed.

Good drinks and the outdoor patio is perfect for a summer day.  The fries and Fontana sauce are AMAZING.  

Haven't been back to this place, since it's been updated.  The menu is a good mix and the atmosphere is nice.  Location is certainly a prime.

I can't say enough absolutely amazing things about this place! Especially the front staff. I called and i was a new patient and Megan got me in the same day! I couldn't be more grateful that she took the time to get me in! I will definitely be back!

We had time to kill prior to our flight out of Tampa so we looked up Ray's thru Yelp. Fantastic.  Would go back in a second.  We had huge shrimp and oyster po boys. Fresh and perfect.
Great fish spread and the best conch fritters I have ever eaten.  
Dont eat at the airport go here. 20 minutes from the airport.
Tasted our friends Cuban and grouper Reuben. Thumbs up on both.

We went in right before closing and we were so impressed with the place! The selection of items was great and the staff was very sweet and informative about everything. They could use some more toppings like Yogurt Mountain, but honestly their selection of baked goods kind of offsets the shortage of toppings. So it's a win/win for everyone. Try the tart yogurt! And the peppermint fudge!

This place is awesome! I was at the dog beach and not the dog park. Plenty of room for dogs to swim and play. There was a water station and a dog wash station. I was there at noon on a Sunday and there was around 20 dogs. It does get busy but I trust my dog and was able to keep an eye on her as she played.
Love the vegan options, decor and STAFF!! Thanks for being awesome. Great place for meetings or dates

What a wonderful place!

A convenient location by the intersection of Frankford and Girard. A cool, moderate sized location with attentive, friendly staff. 

Food was really good. Got the octopus balls, which I really enjoyed. Their appetizer menu looked really good - wish I gotten more. The people next to me got the chicken katsu - which looked crispy and delicious. But I was very happy with my choice - crispy on the outside, warm and yummy center, with perfect toppings of spicy mayo and bonito flakes. 

I forgot the name of the ramen I got (oops) but it was really good. The broth had lots of flavor. The chashu was tender. I enjoyed the other toppings of bamboo, marinated egg, and bean sprouts (which I normally don't like - but worked well with this). 

Five stars. Would bring friends here and then head right over to Garage next door.

There's no fried chicken in the world like Gus's. I've been a huge fan from back when I lived in Memphis, so I was over the moon when I heard they were opening up a location in New Orleans, and it did not disappoint!! Fried chicken is juicy on the inside, crisp on the outside, and perfectly spicy. Baked beans are just as tasty as I remembered, and you can't go wrong with a 40 of beer to rinse it down. Service was amazingly fast and friendly. I will be back way too often for my own good!

Was a party of eight. Ordered every small plate from the menu. Pork belly special was cooked perfectly, plate was over sauced. Roasted oysters looked amazing. Unfortunately, for me there was a drizzle of chili oil all over them(not listed on the menu). Chicken Livers with pepper jelly was a solid hit. The grits and the mac and cheese were also exceptional. The only reason for me to not give them five stars, is because we might have had one of the most sullen waiters ever. She never smiled. We all engaged her and as all being members of service staff ourselves, were not demanding, but polite.

I'm from out of town and decided to get my hair cut and colored because mixing it up is always good. Glynn is a rockstar! I found this salon and opted for her based on the reviews on Yelp.. I was hoping it wasn't just all her friends  and it truly was NOT the case! 

Salon was beautiful, great products and staff and Glynn were 100%+ amazing !!!
I just had the most amazing dinner here at buffalo's wild wings the food was so fresh and great service! Wings were so delicious! I live this restaurant!

TWO WORDS: EGG CHAIR! 

That space is freaking cute! The cocktails are amazing, the service is spectacular, did I mention they have an hanging egg chair?

The drinks are stupid good! I love a great zombie cocktail AND THEY DONT DISAPPOINT! Probably the best zombie cocktail I've ever had! (Strong too)

Susie was bartending that night and she was so sweet and super excited to explain all the the delicious cocktails! 

10 out of 10. 5 stars.Two thumbs up.

I love living at Waterford since 1997. Writing just about today; the grounds are beautiful. My neighbors watch out for each other. I have had celebrity neighbors. I enjoy reading by the salt water pool. It's true there have some maintenance issues, but current team is trying very hard. Major projects have been completed; like replacing all the retaining walls, & all the staircases. I like everybody on Lauren's team. So, I recommend WD people new to Saint Louis, transitioning, or like me don't ever want to own a home.

To my motorcycle in and they repaired it cost a little more than I had thought but there was a lot more problems than we ever imagined Big John was honest shop was clean service was excellent give me details all aspects of the work that was getting done of my bike I was very happy with Big John and his mechanic and then join my bike right now I recommend this service department mechanic

Great soup and pork bun. Little bit pricy, but it's acceptable. I did both eat in and take out. Eat in of course better, but take out is not so bad too. It took them about 30 mins to delivery. I heated the soup up a couple mins. It was great! I'll do it again.
One Of the best tacos for the price. I HIGHLY recommend you order tacos here to your thanksgiving.
Delicious chicken. My first hot chicken and I'll be back for more next time I'm in Nashville! I was surprised by the delicious mac'n cheese, get it!

And the bread...Toma is my favorite restaurant in SB!! I recently started a biz here and I haven't found many restaurants that satisfy my foodie palette as well. Many places try too hard or just don't have the elusive "it". Food: Tuna Sesame Rolls in ice cream holder were table fav, personal fav Stuffed Zucchini Flowers, Endive w Pistachios w perfect vinaigrette, Cioppino (and the crostini on top w rubbed on roasted garlic (I think), Black Spaghetti w Seafood that finicky husband ate, Flank Steak. It was all excellent. Servers were all on top of it (including owner), host ran down street to gather chairs for us, water was always filled (a husband thing). Couldn't have been better. Prices were good too (another husband thing). Don't miss it!

I called and spoke with Ernie over the phone about getting a Grohe kitchen faucet. I was explaining to him that I had ordered a spray head replacement for my kitchen faucet and the finish didn't match. He said that Grohe had been having a problem with that particular finish. Ok starting out well then it went downhill. He was very difficult to communicate with. He kept talking over me! Literally I'd be trying to explain something and he would just start talking over me and keep talking. I asked him to please stop talking over me and he kept insisting he wasn't. Can only imagine what it would be like to work with him in person! It was the craziest thing. I worked in retail for 25+ years and would have NEVER treated a customer this way. Anyway, will be heading off to Ferguson to get what I need.

Excellent food especially tandoori chicken & gajrella and great service....both servers were humble with welcoming attitude-- addition of few more items will be great. all in all great food & good ambience.
Singh family (Livermore, CA)

I'm not sure where to begin.. bottom line; horrible experience. 

To simplify the reasons on why I'll never be coming back to this hotel, I'll itemize. 

We stayed here during Thanksgiving week, Wed-Sat, and was hoping that, because it is in a prime location and close to everything, we would have a wonderful stay. But from Day 1, it was a disaster. 

1. Electricity goes out in the entire hotel (while washing up in bathroom at night)
2. Because the electricity went out, that triggers issues with their alarm system that goes off EVERY single morning around 5:30am. 
3. The first night, the evacuation alarm goes off and says to be on alert as we may be asked to leave the building. 
4. The restaurant by the lobby on Thanksgiving was "out of order" because they couldn't get the gas going to cook anything (just before leaving for a 3 hr trip, I was trying to get something to eat). 
5. Worst of all, I had to take an icy cold shower, and there was nothing that could be done. (I've never had to do before, much less in a "prominent" hotel).

Other little things, like the fan being broken in the bathroom or the shampoo dispenser not pumping anything out, just made the entire stay laughable. I am making sure that I, nor anyone else I know, will stay here.. maybe my worst enemy.. but yeah. I just had to vent. 

And at the end of the stay, while checking out, the lady didn't ask how my stay was. I probably would have only stated, it could have been better. But, if anyone at this hotel cares, I think it would be beneficial to get feedback from your customers. 

Helpful tip: don't stay on the 11th floor in the corner. You'll be glad to have asked for the highest possible room (if you must plan to stay here) as sirens and loud patrons exiting the El Dorado will almost certainly wake you up at 3am as it happened to me every single morning...

Pros:
Delicious food (IF not 86'd)
Cheap booze

Cons:
Shitty service
Slow bartenders
Max bet on bar video poker isn't 5 credits, but 10.

Took the shuttle over from the Best Western in need of some late night drinks, grub,  and entertainment.  The place was pretty packed, with locals crowding the dance floor at the nightclub setting in the middle of the casino floor. The bars were packed but it's probably because if the bartenders were any slower,  we would have died of thirst. On the upside, one dirty martini with Sky vodka and one double Knob Creek old fashioned only ran 11 bucks so we couldn't complain about the price.  But, seriously,  the bartenders were so slow that we only tipped them 2 bucks instead of 5 for that round.  We hit a different bar and the barkeep was a little faster but nothing special. Turned around to see our flight attendants and pilot partying it up after they got off work.

The only restaurant open was the cafe and, although many open tables, there was a 10-15 minute wait. Surprisingly though,  the manager sat two ladies she appeared to know within a few seconds while several parties waited for the server to seat them several minutes later. The waitress was new and we ordered a killer prawn cocktail for like 12 bucks - even poured the cocktail sauce on the lettuce it came with and ate it up. We also ordered a specialty cocktail - they were out of the ingredients. Then ordered a large Dos Equis off the menu - they were out of two of the three beers on the menu. Ordered a Coors Light michelada - then had to explain and wound up with a Coors Light and a side of bloody mary mix. Whatever; it worked. Then we ordered hot wings.... waitress came back and said they ran out. Finally,  we asked if they had pizza in stock and the answer was yes. So we went that route (pepperoni, jalapeños, and bacon) and it was awesome. One of the best pizzas I've had in a looooong time. 4 good slices, nice medium thick crust, good ingredients, and hit the spot perfectly.

All in all, we wouldn't go back

My experience at this salon was very unprofessional and disappointing. I arrived for my appointment on time and was told to have a seat and wait. After about 15 minutes I began to get frustrated and proceeded to inquire where my stylist was. I was told she was not currently in the salon. I was slightly worried, but was quickly assured that they would get in contact with her. I was told that she was on her way and would arrive in about 10 minutes. I continued to wait another 25 minutes, yet she was no where to be found. Arriving 40 minutes late to an appointment is extremely unacceptable. My time felt incredibly disrespected and I realized she would not have enough time to do my hair without rushing and that I would not have enough time to make my next class. I voiced my frusturations and the receptionist mumbled an underwhelming apology.  The fact that I was not notified of my stylists tardiness is frankly shocking to me. Being a college student without a car I had to Uber to and from the salon. This uber was a complete waste of my money due to the fact that my stylist did not show up. A stylist that doesn't show up on time and with no prior notification can't be trusted to professionally do hair. If you are looking for a salon to get your hair done I would certainly not consider Stardust. Very disrespectful salon and will not be returning.

I would have given this place 4 stars but because there was zero soap in the women's bathroom giving a 3. Like where is our waitress and the kitchen staff washing their hands after going to the bathroom??  The bathrooms as a whole were actually pretty gross. If you still want to eat after that their menu has a great variety of hot dogs, pretty good and not expensive at all ( probably because they don't pay for hand soap that helps the restaurant cut costs ‍). The service was good, the waitress was very nice and attentive, which is always a plus ! That's all, enjoy!

OH MY GOD YOU GUYS THEY HAVE SANDWICHES ALMOST AS LONG AS MY ARM

So....maybe there are better places downtown (Planet Sub is p. good~) or in the Loop, but otherwise Bellacino's is my favorite sub place in St. Louis. Their pizza is pretty good (I haven't had the salad in literal years, but I remember it being like salad under this inch-thick layer of cheese under some grilled chicken), but their grinders -- 16in long toasted sandwiches with thick bread and fresh veggies -- are the main attraction.

And they're really, really good! Fresh veggies and fillings and such, meats and cheese that don't taste like GUMMINT PROCESSED MEAT AND OR CHEESE PRODUCT that you get in 25lb boxes or whatever, and light menu offerings that don't taste blah (and while the light section is a little small, they'll use fat-free cheese/mayo on other subs if you ask~)...

Friendly staff and clean restrooms also a plus. But yeah! Go here, get your astonishingly large sandwichin' on. (Pssst, the Bayou, Italian, and Chicken Light are really tasty.)
Consistently good food and service. Love the homemade breads, corned beef hash, and pretty much everything else.

Worst living experience of my life. My boyfriend and I moved into Urban Style Flats in December of 2016. Our apartment had no usable water. It was so hot that we could not even use it to wash dishes, which meant showering was out of the question. We told management about it repeatedly and time after time they were not able to find a fix for it. After six weeks they ended up moving us to the 13th floor of another building. We hoped that our next unit would be problem free, unfortunately this was not the case. 

The floor we moved to was filled with the smell of animal poop and urine. It was absolutely disgusting and embarrassing. The smell was so foul it made your eyes water. It was inescapable. On April 15 we finally received an email from the community manager who emailed everyone on the floor about the problem. He wrote the following, 

"Dear 13th Floor Residents:

The condition of the carpet in your hallway has obviously become a concern. It has become clear that someone is allowing their pet(s) to urinate in the common area hallway. We have cleaned this carpet repeatedly and even contracted with an outside vendor, but the condition continues to deteriorate. I don't need to tell all of you that the smell is unbearable. We will, at a great expense, replace the entire carpet. However, this problem must not continue. If you own a pet, please make absolutely sure they do not urinate in the hallway or your apartment. If you do not own a pet but might be able to assist us in identifying the offending resident, please contact the office. If this issue is not resolved, rest assured, once we are able to determine who is responsible, it will result in a lease termination. Please reach out to us with any information or questions".

After receiving this email we hoped that it would be resolved, but it never was and by May we had given up and decided USF was not a livable place. We contacted the managers Pam and Shelby and told them about all the problems we had and that we wanted to move out. Pam ended up telling us that we would have to pay a two month penalty. We thought that we would not have to pay the two month penalty to leave the lease early because we had faced so many issues at USF and that they had not held their end of the lease by providing a safe and clean living space. We talked to Pam about this both in person and through email and she never got back to us even though she said she would talk to the community manager and the owner. We emailed her three times and never got a response. 

The issues with our own units were not the only issues with Urban Style Flats. The elevators were constantly broken. My boyfriend even got stuck in one once for fifteen minutes. There is dog urine and poop all over the property. I cannot count on two hands the number of times I have gone into an elevator only to see urine all over the floor. If you pay money to park your car in the lot don't expect it to be a private parking lot. They let Rays fans pay to park in there as well. This place will do anything to make money and do the least amount possible to fix its issues and get back to you when you have concerns. We left there extremely disappointed and feeling like we payed a place that did not deserve our money. Don't do it.
Great atmosphere! Very informative and personable bartenders. I enjoyed the art including the blue penguins. I would HIGHLY recommend the okra!
Fantastic day at the tavern! Won tickets to the country music festival. Get here now! More tickets being raffled off! Great food, great management and appreciation to their customers.

Dr. Solow and staff are the best!  I have been bringing my three sons here for years.  Always accommodating with scheduling and wonderful with answering any questions I have had over the years regarding dental and orthodontic concerns.   Wouldn't take my kids anywhere else.   Absolutely love this office.

I've been a client of Kingsbury for 12 years. I have always loved the vet and grooming here. But today I arrived for our 8 am appointment which I booked two weeks ago (because I had to have an 8 am appointment and that was the first) and they told me my appointment was at 10 so I'd need to wait. I can't get my dog in the car by myself so I only book an appointment first thing so my husband can lift our dog into the car. I got no apology for the vets mistake - just a 'we will try to fit you in.' So my dog who is here for a hacking cough is waiting in the waiting room potentially infecting other dogs. It's been 40 minutes.

Khadi panner and khadi chicken! AMAZING...the curry is not your typical "orange" curry most places have. You taste all the spices and it's fresh! Plus they make it spicy when asked! It has become our GoTo Indian restaurant! I think the naan can use a little improvement as it could be little thinner, but this is totally a Personal preference. Only thing we weren't impressed with was the Rasmali, it tasted as it had gone bad. Overall, definitely give this place a try, you will not be disappointed.
Haven't had hot chicken in forever. Still love it. Hattie b's knocks it out of the park. Perfect pieces of chicken and the sides were amazing.

I just wanted to say what a professional staff they have here. The woman Beth behind the desk was a breath of fresh air. So many businesses have staff that do not know what customer service is. She was polite and had a smile on her face although it was quite busy last Sunday.  She helped each person professionally and took her time answering each question each person had but was efficient. Great job Compass for having such a great staff. Beth deserves Kudos.

I couldn't believe that a place like this existed in Reno. The atmosphere and feel of this awesome little bakery is something I imagine only to be in a big city! I love supporting local businesses and this one is definitely at the top! Delicious blueberry cheesecake and chai tea. Yum yum! This will continue to be a spot I come back to.

We were visiting from out of town (Omaha) and honestly came here for the fries (duh) but left super impressed with all the food overall. I wish I had some of the blueberry ketchup stuff they had for my home because I am still OBSESSSSSSSED. Great place that also played the best jams over the radio. I would've taken photos, but we consumed it so fast it honestly wasn't possible. 
Few things about this place - there are endless combinations. 
-- Different types of potatoes to choose from, different cuts of fries to choose from, different seasoning to put on your said fries and different sauces to dip 'em in. I could've spent all day trying them all. 
-- It's also a shared location with a waffle place so if you wanna get a waffle - go for it. But hey, I'm here for da friesssss.  
-- atmosphere = bomb. Played all the best songs, simple not too crazy atmosphere and great employees. 

If we ever are back in Boise, you betcha we'll be dining with you folks again!

The nurse who did the blood draw was very nice and professional. The receptionist could not have been ruder and more unprofessional.  She acted like we were inconveniencing her. If we can avoid this place in the future, we will.  I am giving one star for the nurse. Otherwise place gets a thumbs down.

Couldn't honor our reservation, sat at a table for 15 minutes without any acknowledgement from staff so we finally asked who would be our server but were told "no one knew".  A waitress came over and said she would take our order but she didn't like "taking someone else's table"....thanks but no thanks! Tried to speak to the manager but she was the same useless hostess. A well-established institution should be able handle a busy Saturday night. Need better management and staff training!

Like the others that yelped it before, this place earned its low rating. I've eaten lunch here a couple times and the food was marginal, and had a happy hour here recently, and the appetizers are anything but. They had Flying Dog on tap, which was a redeemer. But to be honest, there are several places within a three block radius that are better.

Sat at the chefs station which i feel is totally worth it. You get to see how hard the chef and cooks all work to make our food. They def put in alot of work. Wait staff is all super cool and knowledgeable too. Thanks Desmond, Chef Link for the convo and everyone else. Our food was daaa bombbbb. Ill send bill for the weight i need to lose.

Visiting Reef has always been a joy, and a breeze to say the least. Always a smiling face to greet you at the door, and their selection is quite nice.  Plenty of great smelling and even better tasting flower to choose from, and the same for the concentrates! High in terps and THC. The staff are so nice and helpful with anything you might need or want to know about. 
It's the fastest I've been in and out of all the dispensaries so far, very pleased

We had a very nice lady taking care of us, she suggested the tomato Basel artichoke soup which was very delicious. Also the chicken Caesar wrap was excellent! One if the best airport places we have ever eaten in

I went in here last week for a quick bite for lunch. Server was too busy talking to her regulars so I just kind of stood there awkwardly for a bit, unsure whether I sat myself or someone else did. I asked for a table in the corner and she ROLLED HER EYES at me. Super rude, but I was hungry and had limited time so I just let it roll off my back. She gave me a menu and walked off, not even bothering with a drink order and went over and continued her conversation with her regulars. It took her 10 minutes to get my drink order and I was asking a few questions about the menu and she loud sighed at me and said the descriptions were underneath. I have food allergies and I know not everything is listed; so I have to ask for my health.

I ordered the chicken fajita wrap, which was supposed to come with salsa and sour cream. It came out totally dry, the chicken included. What I assume was the owner kept coming out and talking to all the regulars, and I tried several times to get both his and my server's attention in order to get what was supposed to come on my wrap. Both ignored me. Finally, the server came over to ask if everything was ok, and I told her I needed the sour cream and salsa. I was polite and respectful about it, but she still rolled her eyes and said it was on it. I opened the wrap to show her it wasn't and she walked off into the kitchen and came back a few minutes later with my requested items...that I shouldn't have had to request in the first place. Getting a check took even longer and I had to wait for her to stop her conversation to pay. Not good when you're in a rush.

The prices are excellent for downtown; but if you're only going to take care of your regulars and not acknowledge additional guests, why should others even bother grabbing a bite here?

Okay, I'm not saying this is a five-star restaurant like a Chef Ramsay restaurant... but for a McDonald's... this is hands-down one of the best ones around here. 

Staff is always friendly.  
They rarely make mistakes on their orders. 
When they do make mistakes, they make it right. 
They do an excellent job of keeping it clean.

Example:  

I ordered a plain cheeseburger as part of a drive-through order. Got home and found it had condiments. I called, was told to come back.  I went in, and the staff manager gave me both a new sandwich and new hot french fries - and also refunded my money (which was a welcome surprise).  

But the point is - they get it.  We're going through the drive-through in the first place because we need to pick up something quick, to be home or elsewhere on a time schedule. Getting it right the first time is important, so if they make an error - they know the customer is probably going to be irritated not just because of the error, but because now whoever was going to eat their food with the rest of the family can't.... and of course, there's the wasted time and gas for the driver to go back and get the issue resolved.  And so they do their best to make the an infrequent error right. 

This is our favorite McDonald's, by far.

Eh...it's ok.  

The location is convenient (right off the casino floor) and the food is ok but the scope and scale is somewhat lacking.

Also, as with most buffets, deserts are something of a mediocre afterthought.

So, this was our third (and final) try for our neighborhood restaurant. As much as we cheered on and wanted it to succeed, it's just not worth it. The staff is not engaging, knowledgable or helpful. When asked common questions about the food or beverages, a blank, non-descript stare does not suffice. Food was mediocre, at best, and the advertised "Nashville Hot Chicken" had zero spice on a scale from 1-10. Very unfortunate, as the building is so stunning and there is nothing more we could ask for than a local place with good fare and ambiance, but unfortunately, this does not come close.

Very OK breakfast joint. Our waitress was nice but failed to pay attention to small details. Told her I wanted fried eggs and they came out scrambled, my boyfriends eggs were supposed to be over easy and they came out fried hard (which was very apparent even without cutting into the egg). The espresso drinks are very sugary, probably going to get the French press if we return. Got the country shrimp skillet, the shrimp was very low quality, wasn't properly cleaned and WAY over cooked. Neither of us liked it, but we got it so we didn't waste it. Avocado toast was good and the cinnamon roll pancake was okay. Over all an ok experience. Unsure if I'll return.

Don't be fooled by the casual approach of BokBox.  The food quality, execution and value rival any brick and mortar in Nashville.  It's refreshing to eat takeout that not only satisfies your hunger, but nourishes your body.  These fellas are the Kings of coal roasted chicken!

Where to begin...the service was impossibly bad. Couldn't get the server to come back to the table throughout the meal without tackling her or another employee. She did not bring our change from the $50 card we had from our bank rewards and we finally gave up getting the $6.79 back because, as we told the manager, we wouldn't be returning anyway. The meal was average but extremely expensive for a cafeteria experience. The main course was served before we had finished the soup/salad course. The wine is so marked up as to prohibit ordering a glass with dinner. I had just bought an identical wine at the grocery store for $11 and they wanted $48 for their bottle. That's not a "mark up" that's taking advantage. All in all there are just too many great restaurants in Tucson to waste time at this one.

Decided to have a group of friends over for dinner.
With little interest in cooking, I decided to order from friends/dolce Carini.
Chicken Francais, eggplant Parmesan were two great trays.
Price was reasonable, on time, rave reviews from all.
Makes sense for me to have Friends cater future meals, even for 2.
We were here for Thanksgiving. 2019.  We hadn't been back since the Post hurricane remodeling.  Both the food and service was excellent-  We'll definitely be back!

Amazing been going there for over25 years absolutely love the service and the food. Never leave there hungry never leave there unhappy with what I ordered. Love the fact that team has been together forever! Best food I've had from coast to coast!

Fabulous!!!! This cuisine is out of my comfort zone but it was amazing and I'll be back. Great atmosphere,  7 course meal for $25 and it wasn't a rushed experience.  They have an upstairs for larger groups and the owners are so friendly!!! Definitely will go again!!!

This is not vietnamese food. Not even close.  I don't know what else to say. I'm vietnamese and this is not it.  

Service was hectic to say the least.  They didnt bother removing the menu off my table so they kept trying to take my order. Egg rolls came out slightly warm when it should have been hot.  It's not as if they need to garnish the plate or anything...so why doesn't it come out hot?

Noodles in the pho soup was undercook. I didn't finish it because I know that noodles cook like that will give you an upset stomache.

The bathrooms are quite small and smelly. If you want a cup of water they make you pay. 

But, the airport attendants gave great customer service, there was a band playing at baggage claim, the airport bus driver paired nicely as a tour of New Orleans. Security on the way back was super quick!
The food is aightttttt. The atmosphere is really nice and the bar was playing The Office so I was happy.

I got an appointment at 11, it was 11:35 I walked out. I feel like it's disrespectful to do that to people. 10 to 15 delay is the most I will wait. If people are running late,  they get service within their alowed time. Definitely not going back. If they had called me to let me know,  it would have been different.
The best meal I've had in New Orleans so far. Go all the way - appetizer, entree, and dessert. You won't be disappointed, I promise!!

2 stars for the prices, meat selections and deli. That being said I hate shopping here. The layout is ridiculous, and the customer service is deplorable. They dont help bag, and just Keep ringing while your items are being squished, and broken. Had my infant with me, needed another cart, they wouldnt even get me a cart! I had to unstrap my infant carry him to the front Door for a second cart, and not one person offered assistance! Had to manuever two carts out and a baby. Fuck you winco. Keep your employee owned crappy custoner service.

I really love the bakuteh "meat bone soup" here, and I was initially excited about this place because they make Japanese ramen. As someone who has had a lot of restaurant ramen in her life, and friends with people who make it from scratch fairly regularly, I enjoyed it but it wasn't very authentic.
The ramen here actually tasted closer to pho in my opinion, which made me like it better but both my fiance and I noted that it lacked the rich creaminess of a typical ramen broth. 
The pork buns appetizer is delicious and well made, too and the owner seems super nice. It's nice to see more Asian fare in StL, and especially a unique menu with Indonesian/Malaysian touches. 
I've been twice and so far, I still crave the bakuteh more than anything else. It's perfect for winter!

Some of the best ice cream I've had! Check out this place if you are on State St. Tons of crazy flavors. I got the Brazilian Coffee and Pumpkin Pie (you get two choices for a single serving). Single is close to $5 but quality is top notch. They have milkshakes but I did not try. Normally a little line but it moves fast. Enjoy!

Very hip little cafe in the Bywater.  Good menu with lots of options.  Had a wonderful Cuban with pickles made in house.  It is a little pricey for the fresh juices- my sandwich was only $10, but two lemonades set me back another $8.  They were good but not great and not very big.  Would stick with the water from the beverage station in the future.  Don't go if you are in a hurry.  Food and atmosphere great if you have some time.

I probably wouldn't go into Fado if it were not for the fact that my stepdad's Scottish and likes to watch the football.  Oh, and I went to a Texas Hold 'Em tournament there too.  On a weekend night it has a pretty big fratly crowd, which I tend to want to avoid at all costs.  I think that every frat boy in America wants to be Irish so that they can have an excuse to drink.  But most of these people are amateurs and should not be given the quantities of alcohol they often imbibe.  At Fado, this can lead to fisticuffs or just ornery behavior.  

Pluses: European Football. Large quantities of Irish whiskey.  Including Powers. Some decent British beers.

Minuses: Heavily macrobrew beer selection. Lots of annoying, loud people.

This Nordstrom has amazing service! The items in this storm are out of the price range I usually shop. However, when I want to treat myself to something nice this has been a good place for me to go. I particularly like how helpful the staff is and the make my experiences there so much more enjoyable. They have helped me find some great items to add to my wardrobe.

My friends and I were served raw chicken wings and when we tried to return them the older lady was beyond rude and it was a huge inconvenience to her because she had to go through the process of refunding the money. I rather not eat the food here anymore than having to deal with a refund ever again.

One of the BEST puertorrican restaurants in the north east.
Service is excellent!!!!!! Willito you were amazing as our server.  
Food has authentic puertorrican flavor with beautiful presentation. 
Great family restaurant!!

Caution! Stay away! My wife reported a huge crack in the concrete at the bottom of our stairs. They had a million excuses, but used a soft caulking to fill it in. One day she came home carrying groceries.l, too many to watch the ground for flaws of a poorly maintained apartment complex. She caught the crack and fell. To the hospital we went. Big bill. Reported it to management.  They laughed and acted like it wasn't their problem. My wife sent notice of our finding safer shelter. We figured it wasnt worth the fight and sent them 60 day notice, via their online communication system . Two years later they sent us to collections , for a month of rent.  They will promise the world until you sign their contract. Sign it and you are just a monthly check. Run , run , run.

Why have I delayed in expressing my love of Memphis Taproom?  My praise is long overdue.

The first time I went here was coincidentally the same weekend that Craig LaBan reviewed it (positively, I might add).  I enjoyed my jersey tomato and tofu salad and the fabulous beer selection, but I *really* enjoyed the saturday afternoon patrons.  Girls doing knitting? check.  Random locals of all ages watching sports in the bar? check.  Couple with a baby? check.  But my favorites were the little old lady and man who came in separately and just wanted to take a look at the renovations, and the woman from the neighborhood who sat down at a table by herself.  She was about 60-ish, wearing a pink sweatsuit, and she ordered a bloody mary and sat there reading her book.  A few minutes later, the owner came by, sweeping the floor.  She looked up from her book and asked "Are you the owner?"  He nodded, and she beamed at him, saying "This is my second time here!  I just love this place!"  Then she went right back to reading her book.  Later, her waiter came by and asked her if she wanted another bloody mary.  She looked down at her empty glass, paused as if thinking it over, and then said "Hey, sure.  Why not live a little, right?"

Was it nosy of me to observe all this?  Yep.  I'm a nosy girl.  But, weirdly, I couldn't stop thinking about her for the rest of the day...it was amazing how happy the presence of this establishment in her neighborhood had made her, and her joy was contagious.

So yeah...Memphis Taproom fills a unique niche, in that it seems to be highly appreciated by both hipster transplants and native fishtownians.  And the fried pickles are killer.

The girlfriend and I have been wanting to try this place out for a long time. As we drove by the ambience was pretty casual and decided to give it ago. The menu is relatively small but that is because they specialize in the items they make.  The ladies behind the counter were very friendly and helped explain some of the entrées. After salivating over the menu the girls behind the counter sent over a couple free starters just so we could get a taste. The pork bun and crab Rangoon are awesome. Our food came out and the presentation was just as awesome as the taste. Highly highly highly recommend this place. I will definitely be going back. Heads up, seating is limited and is all outside. But on a warm summer night in St. Louis it is all good.

I agree with the other review that they give a very good pedicure and it was a relaxed atmosphere and everyone was nice.  I was shocked at the price though.  I came in to get the calluses removed from the bottom of my feet and she did a very nice job but I have never been charged more than $25 anyplace before today.  When she said $35 I had to ask again.  I know $35 may not sound like a lot, but compared to every place I have been before it felt like a 75 cent jump in gas prices; kind of gets your attention.  I think I will shop around some more and maybe ask about the price first.  I've got full body massages for $35 before.

I travel a lot, so I've had the opportunity to be treated poorly by a lot of airlines, but this one takes the cake. We had a flight booked from Nashville to Orlando (#1684) today that was cancelled two hours before it left because of "weather," though we later found out that the location the plane was coming from to get to us was not experiencing bad weather today. We figured fine, we'll go to the airport and have them rebook us for tomorrow morning. Somehow, there was nothing going out on Frontier until Saturday, which is six days from now and also overlaps another trip that we have booked. This is how we discovered that Frontier is the kind of irresponsible airline that has no agreements with other airlines to redirect passengers in case of cancellation. All they can do is refund your ticket, which doesn't help you at that point, as airfare (shocker) becomes more expensive when you need to rebook the day of (you do not, by the way, get this refund right away; it takes 7-10 business days and they refuse to give you a confirmation receipt...what?!). They also told us they couldn't help with a rental car (which we're splitting with two other irate passengers to get to Orlando before NEXT WEEK) or hotel expenses, even though their brilliant suggestion was that we stay in Nashville all week on our own dime to get the next flight out. No. That's not how this works. We held up our end of the deal as customers; we paid for tickets, we were at the airport on time for our flight. If you don't deliver the promised services, your job is to make it right. At the very least, you pay for the CAR that is now going to take us TWELVE HOURS to drive to Florida to get there so we can go to work on Monday (because otherwise, your company is now eating our military leave days, too--it was that or miss seeing my family, whom I do not live near because of where I'm stationed, and whom I therefore see for about four days a year). The complete and utter lack of regard for customers is astounding to me. Truly, I have never seen worse, and I think that many of us who were supposed to be on that flight today learned a valuable lesson: not Frontier. Not ever again.

Wooooow!! Amazing! Came here as a friend recommended for cocktails but dinner was sooo good also. Focaccia as an appetizer was totally delicious. Got short ribs and chicken as entree but chicken was my favorite; risotto to be exact. To die for!! The combinations of flavors was totally fantastic and the service was impecable. We didn't get the tasting menu as we were hesitant because it was our first time here but we definitely will next time. Totally worth it! Be sure to have a reservation; this restaurant is in high demand. Delicious!! Had an amazing time! Can't wait to come back :) Also venue is adorable; specially for outdoor dinner on summer.

My favorite go to lunch spot with my co-workers! Staff is great, quac is great, tacos are great, margs are great, atmosphere is great. All around great experience!  I also love bringing my family here for lunch when they come to visit me and so far I've had no complaints ;) My grandma keeps begging to go back!

Fun night out with the hubster started with a trip to barcade. We each order beers and played plenty of games. Their beer selection and arcade games are extensive and impressive. I was glad we got there early in the evening because it can get pretty packed later on. I'm not too good at old school games so lots of quarters were wasted on me. I do wish they had some more games from my childhood...I think lots of these games are older so I don't have any experience playing them and die really quickly :/

Breakfast is a pretty straightforward affair. I don't need anything crazy, just a hearty, solid start to the day. This place gets it right. Nice ambiance, with bright morning light streaming in through a wall full of windows. Friendly staff. And to top it all off, a surprisingly tasty omelette! Had the southern omelette, and it was hearty & delicious. The coffee was very good as well, one of those smaller details that some diners overlook. I won't be in Nashville for long, but I'm glad I found this place!

I went here for my birthday this past summer. While the service was excellent and the waiter was extremely knowledgable. The only dish that didn't seem needlessly complicated was the roast chicken (which was AMAZING). Would go back for the chicken, but nothing else really stood out for me.

I went here tonight for dinner, craving a good salad bar and some pepperoni and bacon pizza. The yummy ranch did not disappoint. It looks like your favorite pizza place inside, big tables, two separate rooms and a TV. Pizza was chicago style deep dish... a little cheesy for me, but it tasted good.
