Next time I might try the thin crust and ask to go lighter on the cheese.

This has to be one of my least favorite airport in the whole world.  

It has very limited Wi-Fi if you can connect and really crappy choices places to eat!

The best that you can offer... A little fast food restaurant called grounded where they made crafted custom hamburgers, They were fast and very good.

I WOULD go back to eat a burger there again and this is the only place that I would recommend!

Wish I could give it 0 stars.  Walked in today after driving 45 minutes one way to look at campers.  First impression:  my wife and I get out of the truck and a mechanic is repeatedly F bombing in the maintenance bay.  Excellent start.  We walk around the store a bit, then go to the girl at the register and ask about looking at the campers.  She makes a call for someone to come out.  We wait ten minutes, all the while listening to the register girl complain about not getting a lunch break, eating cold soup from a can, etc.  A guy walks by for the second time and she asks him if someone is coming out to show us the campers, he makes a grunting sound and continues walking away.  At this point I told her "we're just going to give up" and we left.  Nobody followed, nobody cared, not surprising really when I look at the whole experience.  I see why this place is rated so low.  I tried to complain on the rvcampingworld website and that doesn't work either.  Comes back as undeliverable.  I'll be spending my 20k elsewhere.  Just trash!  Look below at this response below, that is clearly a caring message and not the same thing he posted to all of the one star reviews.

I don't want to say their food is an 'after thought', but you mainly go here for the shakes and soda, not the food.

That being said their shakes are awesome. Not too thick, not thin either, in almost any flavor you can think of. Yesterday I had a fluffernutter shake and it was amazing! Not to mention when I go I typically get a wide assortment of odd flavored soda since it's free refills. (I will say avoid the chocolate banana soda, believe me).

The food here isn't bad, I've never been disappointed with my two go to orders; a Texas Tommy or their buffalo loaded fries. The fries are a huge meal I would only suggest if you're ridiculously hungry or sharing with others. The only good item that had severely let me down are their onion rings. Yes, they look really good from afar but they don't have typical batter on them, they're coated in mozzarella stick type beading. They just taste like corn meal.  

This location isn't as spectacular as the now gone Bensalem location, but it's worth checking out for their drinks.

I absolutely love this place! I travel to Reno for work and look forward to going to Rounds from the time I land! Their vegan sausage and bacon is the best- super flavorful. The doughnuts are absolute nonsense (a good thing!)! The flavors are very creative and extremely well executed. Highly recommended!

I was so excited to have found Juanita's!  It's a cute local spot with extremely friendly staff.  The food was excellent and the prices were very reasonable.  I think they must have expanded their menu, because, while not an overwhelming selection, there were plenty of options available.  And it's a BYOB!

Terrible communication, made reservations for 2 dogs and at the last minute they cancelled  for no good reason. Had to cancel my vacation, disappointing multiple people. Don't use this kennel. Owner is dishonest and rude. Think they discriminate against older pets.

WOW!!! This place is INCREDIBLE!!! the staff is just perfect.. they are very polite but not so much as to seem intrusive. The sushi is OUTSTANDING there is a great selection. My wife and I ordered the Robert Roll, Calamari Tempura, Eel Crunch Roll, and the Dream Roll everything was perfect. The sushi is more of a California style sushi which is hard to find here on the east coast. Coming to Tampa from San Diego this place was a welcomed delight. We will be returning to try their many other rolls. Best sushi we have found in Tampa HANDS DOWN!!!

This place is too hyped. Their food was good, their fries are crispy, the burger were decent, good. But this place is a bit over price (I can go somewhere else for cheaper). Workers were nice (I would give them 5 stars).

Went a few years ago on Halloween,

Hands down... the best shrimp and corn grits app i've ever had and could image, some kind of iron chef competition must be going on in the kitchen. 

yummmmmmmmmmmmm, good recommendation from the server!

They know shoes. And boots!

Brought in my cowboy boots to make them "dance" boots. With the right materials for the soles, my broken-in boots are amazing. They look new and are the best on the dance floor!!

Pisano knows their craft and I'm very impressed. Recommended them all the time.
Went to Los tacos locos tonight. Wow!! The food was fresh and wonderful. Our server was great! Thanks Kevin and Monica for a terrific dinner! We will be back!

This company is amazing! Small owned family business who love what they do and are truly compassionate. They installed a full house system for us and it was worth every penny spent. From the start of the first phone call to Tony coming out to Brian the technician installing we love our new system and the experience we had with this company. They do not work just to take your money, they come to your home and educate you and help you pick the best product for your home. We were kind of skeptical at first because we knew how bad our water was in Fernley, NV but it is affordable! 

Brian, our technician came out and left our house clean. Every hose installed was hidden and he did an amazing job. A week later on a Sunday, we had a question and Brian answered the call late at night. These individuals are dedicated to their job and love what they do. We love the product we received and would recommend Pure Water to anyone! If you are on the fence about getting a system, do it! Its worth every penny! Throw those bottled waters away!

Delicious sushi- very fresh!! It seems the quality of sushi restaurants in this area have been declining and I was on the hunt for my new go to spot... this is it for me! Cute little restaurant and delicious quality sushi at a decent price!

Love this butcher whenever I make a trip to the italian market in Philly I make a stop to Esposito's.  They have stuff like pork chops or steaks and my uncle always gets a meat ball mix which I think is beef and pork and veal which he always raves about.  The service is pretty good the place is really clean and the location is easy.

Early entry into the Philly tapas world albeit the South American version.
South Street Graduate Hospital neighborhood spot offers good choices. Black rice, shrimp and squid dish for $19.00 gorgeous and delicious.  Their lomo and Cabrales appetizer plate excellent and reasonably priced.  Care taken to prepare and present plates.  Quite different and appealing with outstanding coffee a definite wake up.  Friendly BYO with tiny backyard patio.  Churros dense, authentic and delicious take a little time to make so give the server a heads up if you want to order them, which you will.

Love this place, go here for all my piercing and tattoo needs. I've been treated with respect and they always explain the subtle changes that are needed to make my ideas into tattooable designs. They're always accommodating with ordering the jewelry I want and have suggestions for what will look best in all my piercings. Can't recommend them enough.

Great subs.  Busy store.  Order with the helpful sandwich builders behind the counter and await your world-class hoagie.  Terrific bread.  Lots 'o meat.  Among the Delaware Valley's finest.

Order ahead and bypass the line.  Sides include an assortment of Herr's potato chips.  Drinks are all the bottled variety from the cooler.  No seating, and take out only.  Parking in the small, shared lot is at a premium at peak hours.

Located just off Route 13 on Basin Road, around the corner from the Wilmington Airport and minutes from the twin bridges and 95, this place is worth a detour.  The tough decision is whether to go to Capriotti's or Ionnoni's nearby.  My suggestion is to go to Cap's for subs and Ionnoni's for roast pork or roast beef.  You pick 'em for cheesesteaks...

It is with great disappointment I feel the need to write a negative review on a restaurant with a 4.5 star rating. My girlfriend and I were excited to try a new restaurant that was near to home and had great online reviews. To our disappointment, it did not live up to our expectations. Overall, the food was over priced and mediocre. Firstly, an average bottle of wine is almost doubled in price. Secondly, the flatbread.... was not so flat. It was a fluffy, over sauced, soggy pizza. Thirdly, the Alfredo pasta is cooked pasta with cream. Taste? I'm sure that's an extra charge. Overall, unfortunately I cannot say I plan to pay another visit or recommend this restaurant to others.

Delicious! For $20 my friend and I got the chicken tenders, baked beans, potato salad, coleslaw, mac and cheese, and the hot chicken sandwich. The chicken had a great crunch to it and was very juicy. The medium sauce has a little kick, but it's not overwhelming. The baked beans had a little bit of a punch too them too, which gave them a unique twist. The mac and cheese and potato salad, though, were the best sides we ordered. Plus, if you order the chicken tenders, it comes with two sides and then you can get a third side for $1. There was a long line out the door when we got there and waited about 10 minutes, but the line moves quick because the service is very organized. Overall, I highly recommend this place if you're looking for some tasty fried chicken and sides that compliment well.
Love this little spot what more can I say? Food always fresh, friendly employees and on the spot with delicious delicious sweets and more ahhhhhh

Chicken tenders are absolutely huge and very crispy and juicy. Cooked perfectly. I had the fries and coleslaw. Both were good. The only reason I didn't give it a 5 is it's very pricey for what it is. 3 jumbo chicken tenders fries coleslaw at a drink was a bit over $15.

What separates Sam above all other agents in the Tampa Bay Area is not only his understanding of the local housing market but his willingness to go above and beyond just selling you a home. He has built a network of connections in the area that we use regularly for home renovations and upkeep! I would also mention that his recommendations have saved us THOUSANDS OF DOLLARS (anywhere from new flooring to Air conditioning maintenance).  It is guaranteed that he will get the deal done at the lowest price possible! Thank you Sam & keep up the great work!

Royal Tavern has a great energetic vibe and healthy, yet delicious fare.  The Mezze plate offers a creamy hummus & smooth baba ganoush, savory stuffed grape leaves that are so tasty and warm inside, marinated olives, toasty pita, mild feta cheese, and lovash chips.  The Mezze plate is the perfect pairing with a Bacon Bloody Mary from their extensive bar!  The Mixed Greens Salad is another favorite of mine, The salad tantalizes the pallet with bacon & grilled asparagus, tangelo, shaved fennel, & grana padano, with a light & refreshing limoncello vinaigrette.  My favorite day at Royal Tavern is Sunday.  They always have a variety of brunch specials and there's usually not a long wait.  

MmMmmmMmmm....stuffed grape leaves!
This place does not have premium frozen yogurt or fruit -- I don't know what they're talking about

Sweet Potato Waffle Eggspress: spicy pecans, cinnamon butter, caramel and Chantilly cream. This was absolutely amazing but only for a limited time. Unfortunately it's no longer on the menu but they still have a lot of good choices. It's a must try place to go!
It's hard for me to think of a time when Love Handle was not part of my life. :') Absolutely delicious and right to the point. I come here at least once a week and highly recommend!

quick and relatively painless for my annual blood draw.

PROTIP: make an appointment. they technically take walk ins, but the lounge was so busy (almost every seat was filled) when i walked in on a mid-morning friday morning. thank god i had an appointment and was seen within 5 min of my appointment time or else the wait probably would have taken forever!

the man that drew my blood made it quick and was friendly.

Nice big servings and deliciously made injera. Also priced super reasonably. It deserves more business, it just isn't in a great location. Support Merhaba! Bring your friends and keep this gem in an area that needs it.
I love Hattie B's. I eat there a lot. However I do thing it is a tad over rated. Folks talk about it like it's the second coming, and it's not. But I will still go once a week for lunch or dinner.

We came here for an early morning breakfast. Good that the place opens early as there weren't that many other options around.

We got a crawfish etouffee omelet which was average. Grits were a bit undercooked and had no seasoning. Much-hyped buttermilk biscuits were underwhelming. Service was extremely slow and slightly confusing about what we were supposed to do (help ourselves or get served?). 

Lackluster.

The most amazing breakrunch spot in the Bywadda. Great food, local/organic everything, and a cool if contrivedly eclectic interior. Downside: dirty smelly gutter punks who seem to live outside, but who thankfully do not congregate inside. Upside: the staff, which manages to maintain a semi-professional smile, flash a warm and welcoming attitude (which the punks don't always have), treat regulars like friends and keep the dirt outside, out of sight and off your plate. The music selections celebrate New Orleans culture (impromptu Second Lines often erupt on the block), as well as the East Coast 1980s in every way (although the staff is clearly not old enough to "remember" all that music).

The coffee is ON POINT!!! Kleinpeter milk (no 'mones) makes orgasmic foam. Do the Green Sandwich if you can't decide from among the many offerings--you'll find yourself dreaming about it. The salads are truly divine and surprisingly filling. The specials are a sure hit. Love the pancakes and French toast! They really know how to fry an egg right. And they make me feel welcome even though I'm usually one of a kind (male, brown, showered and without ink). I've grown to love them and their food.

Yum. Everything is always terrific and the smell
Inside is intoxicating.  Great selection or meats an cheeses and specialty foods.

Went here for breakfast on the 4th and me m the Mrs. Were the only customers in there. Clue # 1. We were sat in the back where there was no air and plenty of flies. We both ordered the jamboree which was pretty good. There was a guy in a wheelchair that seemed to be keeping the waitress company which was cool at 1st till he started wheeling himself all over with a portable urinal on the back of his chair that had no top. The food , really good the ambiance , really horrible.

A lot of people rave about this place, and I kind of get why. They do have really unique hotdogs that you won't find in many different states! The sonoran hot dog is delicious with so many condiments to choose from to add on top. The seating area is similar to a cafeteria, with a condiments bar. The food is great - but it does take a long time for it to come out - which just means it's made fresh! I've been here a few times and unfortunately a few of the few times I visited this establishment, they messed up the order. I still go back though!

do noooot please do nooot rent from these scum people tony the owner short bald guy (biggest liar) ladies in the front super liars! they kept my property deposit and they kept utilitys in my name after i had to move out of a mold infested water leaking roach place on 7 th street. dirty places got a letter that i didnt pay rent and i did they said mistake they r fraud. they will get whats comin to them. noooooooo starrrrr nnnnnnmooo dnt messdd with these people

I happened to come across this place on Yelp, and since they have a really convenient online booking site, I was able to book a last minute appt for nails and lash extensions. 
Gabby did an incredible job on my lashes--I wanted an "enhanced but natural" look so went with a classic set. Gabby really took her time perfecting the lashes and they came out exactly how I wanted them! I also had a gel manicure by Erica who did an excellent job with my short, brittle nails. I'll definitely be back.

This is a brand new nail salon that just opened up and it's so beautiful. Each pedicure station is equipped with a sanitary bowl protector for each client. You also get brand new nail files and clippers right out of the package for each client. They offer shellac manicures and my favorite the dip with many color options. There are also several different luxury pedicure spa treatments as well. Oh and the cherry on top is they serve free drinks.....including wine. I highly recommend this nail salon! Very affordable prices as well!

You walk in and a person with a disability takes your order. Another person with a disability brings it to your table. The food is delicious, my large party ordered about half the breakfast menu. Enjoyed everything but the ham , which was plain. And the oatmeal was especially good. Great coffee. And then a person with a disability cleared most of the table. And people are complaining about slow service? Well, ok then. Not sure what to say. Anyway go here for a great experience. Be sure and read the article on the wall about the charity that runs it.

I have been here many times and enjoy the setting and the wine.  The menu for a small dish establishment needs rotation and recognize the season we are in.  It's has innovative dishes but to stay innovative one needs to continue to create.
Getting stale.  First and second timers will love it

This store never answers the phone forcing me to go into the store which is such an inconvenience. The manager was supposed to get something done for me but unfortunately he always happens to be on some conference call. I love it when I go in and I left waiting for an hour only to be told they can't help me and I have to call customer service.... THANK YOU JAVIER!!!!! The only thing you guys do right is messing up accounts and have the customers figure it out!
Shrimp buns were great. Will come back to try the chicken buns. Very good experience.

Lisa is a great massage therapist. I lift and my shoulders and neck are very tight. My Cardio routine is riding bike and my quads and hamstrings get really tight. She dig a deep tissue and worked out all the knots. Definitely will be back because this was a satisfying experience.

This is the second time I've attempted this location, and it will be the last. For starters, the staff is completely standoffish and unfriendly. Their indifference and carelessness immediately invoke feelings of discouragement and regret, and leave customers feeling that choosing Popeyes, more specifically this location, was a mistake. This feeling plagued both of my experiences.

My first visit started with me being immediately greeted and asked to wait a moment before placing my order as they were a little backed up, which is typical during peak hours. Of course, I had already been waiting 5 minutes for the car in front of me to get their opportunity to order as they had also been asked to wait. However, after an additional 7 to 10 minutes, with no communication from the drive-thru attendant, it was clear that I needed to find nourishment elsewhere. I understand being backed up, as I realize it takes time to bread and fry chicken, but zero acknowledgment or communication about this after the initial greeting is just plain poor customer service.

I returned today to give them another chance, and experienced the same malaise of a less than energetic staff. Her question regarding my interest in their current special was lifeless and monotone, causing it to be indiscernible. Naturally, I declined. She asked that I continue with my order, although I'm certain she didn't care either way. I began placing my order, and she quickly interrupted me to tell me that they were out of this item. I asked if they were out of a specific ingredient or if it was possible to make substitutions, checking to see what options I had. She responded with the EXACT same statement, and completely disregarded all of my questions. Confused, I decided it was best I take my business elsewhere, thank her, and drove off.

This caliber of service is absolutely ridiculous, and an extreme disservice to the Popeyes brand. It is similar service that caused the Bagger Dave's, just down the road, to close their doors only months after opening. Myself, nor customers in this area, will tolerate such poor performance, and I can't imagine that this location will be around for very much longer at this rate. 

Zaxby's and KFC are just down the road, and I will be taking my business there moving forward. I would encourage other Yelpers and Popeyes fans alike to do the same. This type of service should not be rewarded with future business.

I do not share in some of the negative reviews on here. I manage a medical practice (a smaller one than FOI), and truly their organization, customer service, and dedication to positive patient experience is amazing when you consider the size of their practice. I sustained an ankle injury and a knee re-injury in May. I started at the S. Tampa Urgent Care (truly a godsend when you can skip the ER!), and have seen Dr. Sanders & Dr. Gasser, both of whom are incredible! You can tell they really enjoy what they do; that their passion is to help you. The waiting room is always full, but when you are with the doctor it is as if you are their only patient that day. They take their time, answering your questions and going over your options. 
The scheduling team has gone out of their way to find me a follow up appointment after an MRI. The MRI tech was friendly and put my mind at ease. The doctor's administrative assistant calls back when she says she will. 
From top to bottom, I am impressed with FOI. As patients, we have a choice, and I'm grateful I chose them!

This is my new favorite Ford dealer! Alan was excellet when it came to helping me get my vehicle repaired under warranty. They were fast, friendly, and thurough! I have every confidence that when I leave my vehicle will be good as new, and that if for some reason it's not, they'll take care of whatever may come next.  Ellis has assembled a great crew. These guys don't know it but I'm a customer service consultant by trade, and is what customer service is supposed to look like! For that, they get all the stars.

Good take out place by my house, I love their wonton soup. It's kind of a take a while for order to be ready. Always order way ahead before you are hangry. Food is good as well compare to most Chinese place.

Love Extreme Pizza! Just ordered a family sized salad today for lunch! Yum, it was delicious, fresh, and filling. It will last a couple days for sure! Their pizzas are unique, several extreme flavors! Highly recommend!!
The chicked was spiced deliciously and cooked really well. Service was fast and good. I've had better pita and hummus at other places.

I really enjoy watching the dogs race they are awesome animals and have lots of love to give and receive. Super  people and staff. I will be back soon to visit them again. Love the dogs and the customer service.
Great first time experience at this location. Everyone was very friendly. Clean place. Marie was amazing. I haven't felt this good in months! Highly recommend this location.
OMG what a great hole in the wall that we stumbled upon. The food was delicious, the ambiance reminded me of my grandmas house, and the service was great!

I've been looking forward to checking out Philly's latest venue!  It's located in an absolutely gorgeous building, which was the highlight of our experience.

However, if you don't want to sell your soul for a drink, you'll need to pregame!  The only place I've spent more on a drink was on a Manhattan rooftop bar.  There were bars located everywhere so the lines were short, but having to pay all that bar staff might be why it was so expensive.  And good luck sneaking in a flask with bag checks and metal detectors to get in.

We had tickets in the Mezzanine, which is 4 flights up!  I meant to check out the merch, but we got to our seats first and I was NOT about to walk back down before the show.  After the show, we were herded out a side door.

The venue was large enough to hold a good crowd, but even on the Mezz we could see what was going on and they had huge speakers right above us for excellent sound.

It's also conveniently located, a block from the Broad Street Line and close enough to our apartment that we just walked home afterwards.  Lots of people were clearly just walking back to center city, especially because it was crowded enough that we couldn't get an Uber home.

Decided to try this spot for breakfast based on the good reviews and convenient drive through. 

For a place that is named for their biscuits, I found them to be super tough and chewy. They did not taste homemade. Same can be said about the chicken on the biscuit. I'm convinced it was previously frozen.

The sausage gravy was just ok. As were the home fries. All in all, I was thoroughly underwhelmed. 

Two stars for convenience and service.

Cinder Bar is great! I've been here a few times, and each time Ive had great service and great food! The pirogies and empanadas were delicious and all of the pizzas Ive tried have been amazing! Last time we were there, my server's name was Kaitlin, and she did a great job and was super welcoming despite being busy!! She deserves a raise! Anyways, definitely check out Cinder Bar the food is delicious!

Dropped about $1500 at 11 Eleven Tactical USA over the weekend.   Absolutely zero regrets.

First off, the store is located in Sparks, Nevada which is right next door to Reno.  Easy drive and easy to find -- although, the neighborhood is not the nicest.  

Secondly, these folks have great inventory for all your tactical needs.  From range bags, to pistols, to holsters -- it's like walking into a candy store for gun owners.   I picked up rounds that I needed along with some magazine extensions.  So glad these guys had what I needed.

Finally, the service!  Both associates who assisted me were very friendly, knowledgeable, and welcoming.  If I'm not mistaken, it's family owned and they just opened up their shop a couple months ago.  Not the greatest time to open up any new business but these guys will carry a supply of what is most in demand right now so perhaps, it wasn't a horrible move.

Anyway, check this shop out when you're in the area for your weapon needs.  I would suggest calling ahead of time to confirm they have what you're looking for before making the drive.

Looking forward to visiting again.  I'm a happy camper.

Maya was my nail technician and she did a fantastic job. I came in with a beat up gel full set and she made them look so fresh and nice again. The staff was super friendly and welcoming. The place was very clean and well kept and up to standards with COVID-19 rules. I will for sure be coming back!

Went to Embermill for lunch with a few coworkers. It was delicious and everyone enjoyed their food. They recently introduced a lunch menu and the prices are good. The place was practically empty and I want it to stick around so please go check it out!

Was driving past looking for a pizza place and came across this place. It was very nice on the inside and the food was good too! I got one of the wraps with the gyro meat and it was delicious. Definitely a great place to grab lunch with the coworkers. Glad I stopped by Freddy's would recommend!

The new airport is nice, bright and offers a lot of good NOLA food options But, the floors are full of dust and very dirty. We arrived at 9am, so Flores obviously weren't cleaned the night before. We can do better!

This place is pretty good!
I ordered the fajita nachos with beans instead of a meat since I am a vegetarian. The nachos come with grilled peppers and onions along with cheese. The fact that they charged me extra for the beans when I got no meat is the reason for 4 stars instead of 5 as it seems to me this should be a free substitution. Tired of being penalized for not wanting to eat animals. The salsa is mild but good. Prompt and friendly service.

Have brought my car here for a few years until recently. When they changed my oil, they stripped the oil pan causing all the oil to leak out of my car! I had my car repaired somewhere else and it cost me almost $750.00. When i went back to speedy lube they refused ti reimburse me for something that was clearly their fault. I would recommend not using this business at all!!
Worth the wait. Awesome chicken. Good prices. Lives up to the hype. Definitely recommend going somewhere around medium on the heat scale.

Seoul Taco is amazing.

It's one of STL's few trendy restaurants with vibes that make you think, "Yeah, I AM a cool person for eating here." It's probably the comedic graffiti style art and electric blue lighting but it makes the food taste better, I swear.

Seoul is split between fast casual and sit-down. I've only done the fast side but want to do the sit down in the near future. The burrito is the way to go, but most recently I tried the nachos with Bulgogi Beef.  They were nice and cheesy, like extra cheesy. Which is what you want from filthy comfort-food nachos but the burrito is still my favorite. 

If you haven't been here then you're missing out on some decadent and delicious Korean fusion. Get your butt in the door!

This restaurant never fails!  We had appetizers and the fish--grouper--was massive, which I had thought I remembered but ordered anyway!!  I was happy to take the extra home!  Pastas cooked to perfection, salads a dream.  You can expect nothing but a very fine dining experience here!  We took pictures with our out of town guest on the terrace for sunset before dinner...will
return again and again!

Jeff and Nancy have gone above and beyond to get us into the house we wanted. They were very patient working with us for months before we finally found the perfect home. They are always available and never make you feel like you are asking too much or bugging them. They are always willing to go the extra mile to show us a home and never acted pushy or rushed. I loved that if we walked into a home we hated, they immediately said we could leave, they didn't want to waste our time and weren't upset if we didn't like what they showed us. They are extremely thorough with their contracts and making sure we are getting the best deal possible. I can't say enough good things about this amazing team. 11/10 will definitely use them again and refer them to all our family and friends!!!

Hey, Not everyone enjoys the dentist office as much as myself ... but this office is over the top. EVERYONE is totally professional and very pleasant.  From the time you make the appointment (usually with Donna) until you leave they ensure you are "not hurting" and comfortable.  The office is very clean and modern and always have the latest equipment.

I recently joined as a Foundation member and been able to take advantage of their classes during their soft opening. My experience has been incredible! Every class I have taken has been a killer workout and the trainers pay close attention to the member's form and assist those that have pre-existing injuries.  F45 Largo East is by far the friendliest atmosphere with the most positive reinforcement environment I have ever had the pleasure of working out in. 
I highly recommend this location as each employee is also very friendly, extremely knowledgeable, and truly cares for its members.  Speaking of members, they are all fantastic as well! During the brutal workout sessions, don't even think of slacking because your buddy working out alongside you won't let you! Constant encouragement coming from all directions.  I never heard of F45 until a couple of weeks ago, and it has already become a HUGE blessing in my life.

We were quite surprised with the number of vehicles and it was laid out very nicely. The staff were amazing and helpful and we appreciated the in/out privileges as we had a nice meal before coming back in the afternoon
Ugh - this location is meh and I accommodating of anything. Restrooms are closed to customers and staff is unfriendly

It was Friday night about 6:30pm. Braves were playing in the World Series. Place was almost completely empty. Should have been packed.

This was our first time trying ATL Wings.

Wings were 10/10 delicious. Deep fried, juicy and prepared perfectly. Somebody knows what they're doing. "Gorilla Bites" are a classic chicken-and-fries basket. Those were very good. 

ATL is now my go-to.

Thank you and we'll be back.

There was a fucking BLADE in my to go order of french fries. Nick Najum the owner/manager acknowledged that yes it was from their kitchen and his best remedy to the problem was a gift card to Flamme Burger as if I have any interest in subjecting myself to more life threatening food. He only suggested that after I vocalized how upset I was and still am about the situation. The careless acts of the kitchen staff could have killed me. They are now avoiding my calls and everyone in the restaurant staff is aware of the situation. I had yet to even get the simple respect of them comping my meal let anyone anything else but a dismissive apology. The customer service is disgusting as is their health code.
Food was severed hot with a wonderful Smokey wood flavor!   Park fries are excellent!
Always so good! And with this coronavirus going on, we wanted to support the local businesses. It said it's be a 50-80 min wait but they got here in 30 minutes!! And it was so hot and delicious!!
Long wait for bad service, and lies about payment!!! Cash only!!! Apple Pay rejected, debit card rejected credit card rejected!!! Reporting to bbb and the city!!!

its not bad... its not good... it was pizza? 
if you dont like a lot of grease avoid the pepperoni.

A group of three had dinner, we sat on the back patio and had a fantastic experience. Our waiter Josh was friendly, knowledgeable and was a fantastic waiter- all the servers wore mask. The menu is fantastic, we ordered filets and the grouper- all were excellent. I was surprised they had Banshee Pinot Noir on the wine menu (by the glass). We had a fantastic dinner and highly recommended.

This is usually one of our favorite places to stop, sip some beers, watch some games or eat what is normally good food.  This Saturday, Nov. 8th, was not so enjoyable.  Turns out they had rented out the lower party room to a group with a DJ, and the music was so loud the floor and bar vibrated.  We were in the bar side, with 18 TV/s and piped in music, but couldn't hear any of the music.  The poor folks on the other side, having family dinners or dates, had it much worse than we did.

When I mentioned to the bar person that perhaps just a slight reduction in volume would be nice, she went to the manager, and instead of going down and correcting the problem, they cranked the bar music up much louder.  Again, the poor folks in the "fine dining" side had the worst of it.

Moral of the story, if you are going there for dinner, call and check to see if their is a Party Going on Downstairs, and if there is,, think twice.

This place deserves 10/10! The Doctor on Duty is so pleasant and GREAT with the animals. Our Cat was a handful!! Very mean and uncomfortable and he handled her so well I was impressed! The staff is super friendly and knowledgeable. The prices were outstanding!!!! We always went to a different Vet in downtown Safety Harbor, and we will NEVER go back- They're overpriced & not friendly! Thank you to this Vet Visit for taking care of us and our kitty!!!

The coffee drinks and donuts are solid. There is easy and free parking in the retail portion of the garage they are inn. The area they could grow is staff can look confused at times like they don't know what their task is and they could take a little more love in ensuring the clothes are  clean and they look happy to be at work. Overall not a coffee  shop feeling  but a good place to get a  fair priced cup of coffee.

Today I had the pleasure of meeting and working with Tom the owner. My issue was not a hardware issue but one with a Microsoft Program. I had an issue with SharePoint on Office365.  Within a few minutes he diagnosed the issue and showed  me how to take care of my problem.  We talked for another 15 minutes or so and it was clear what a knowledgeable guy he is. He had a nice selection of laptops and tablets at far better prices than I would have guessed. His prices rival or beat Best Buy.  I would definitely recommend calling Tom or stopping by.

I hate to give this restaurant such a bad review, but the service was some of the WORST I've ever had! We came in around 4:30pm and it wasn't very busy! We waited over 30 minutes for our drinks. The food came out about 20 minutes later and was room temperature at best. The creole shrimp and grits was delicious, but it didn't redeem the terrible service. It was so overpriced and overhyped! Don't add this to your must try list in NOLA.
Pro Tip: Bring Cash! They don't accept cards; they do however have an ATM inside with a $2.50 charge to take your own cash.

BAMBI! We had Bambi as our piercer and he was nothing but patient, professional, knowledgeable, and kind. We were a group of four and he took his time on every single one of us. I would highly recommend Black Hole to anyone looking for a trustworthy atmosphere, yes prices are a bit higher than what you would usually see in Reno, BUT you get what you pay for and it's TOTALLY worth it! Will definitely be back!
Wonderful outdoor dining when weather permits. Friendly staff, convenient location. Generous drink pours and diverse dishes. Great for the family and for friends. Terrific business.

This was one of the worst Wendy's I've ever experienced. They were very rude over the speaker. When I arrive at the window to receive my food, my burger was sloppy and thrown together. I returned the burger and they gave me another type of burger. Also they gave me the wrong sauce for my nuggets.

Great service and $21.95 was a reason I visited this place for the first time. I will definitely be back. I had a toddler and an infant with me so it was awesome to not have to unload them since he took great care of me right at the car. It's wasn't easy to find the first time but now I know where to find them, right next to moana nursery!

For starters, they ran out of food.
6pm and their main menu item was gone. Second choice was the 10 ounce ribeye for $18. It was hard as leather. Definitely Not Fresh. I ate what I could not wanting to embarrass my family who was taking me out for Father's Day. It was the worse steak I've ever had... and I eat a lot of steaks.
You can get a better steak at Waffle House, which is sad. I don't usually give reviews, but this was so bad and dissapointing I have to say something so you don't make the same mistake. Service was good... but don't get their low end ribeye and ask first what food is still left from their menu specials.

Bad value. This place charges twice the price of any other nail salon but don't expect to get half the services of other places. We booked our appointment nearly 2 weeks ahead of time and were super excited for it. When we arrived they gave us a very rushed and not so relaxing experience (lasted only 50 minutes, we barely got a massage, etc.). When we checked out they surprised us with higher prices than communicated when we booked our appointment. We then looked at their website and found the prices to be correct, however our services were supposed to last much longer than 50 minutes (1.5 hours for my husband and 1 hour for me). Highly overpriced, bad service and communication.

Love the molcajete bowl!  My husband and I share this every time we come here. The parking can be tough and the small strip mall next door boots/tows anyone parking from ElPayron, even in the evening.

I hate writing this review because, at one time, I would have given this location 5 stars. However, the last few times we've been in, our experience hasn't been that great. We've visited so many times now that we've had almost everything on the menu, but items we typically order are the soup dumplings and steamed pork bao. On more than one occasion, we have gone after the lunch rush, only to learn they are out of pork bao and we're left with beef as our only option. Not a huge deal, but it's a bummer when you aren't able to get what you want. I would expect to be able to walk in at any time and be able to order any type of bun, but that seems to not be the case. Also, an issue that has happened more than once, I hate to say, is we've ordered pork buns and been given beef instead. I'm assuming they were out of pork, but gave us beef without saying anything and maybe assumed we wouldn't notice? I can't say for sure, but it's disappointing either way. Our most recent visit to this location left us questioning if we'll be back after so many bad experiences in a row. Once again, we ordered pork buns for the table (6 to be exact), soup dumplings and Thai boba tea. The buns tasted like they had been sitting around for a while, and once again, we had a couple of beef buns mixed in. The soup dumplings were good, and honestly, those are usually the only item that is consistently good. I hate that we've had such bad experiences recently. This was once a favorite, but now I'm unsure if we'll be back.
Showed up on time for the estimate and they were able to get me in earlier than expected to perform the work. Trees look great!!

This has always been the best Steak 'n Shake around. Which is why it's one of the only places around still open. The restaurant is clean, the food is fantastic & the bathroom is always clean. This location reminds me of my childhood: a decent place to eat! So glad they have excellent staff with a great work ethic. Thank you!!
The food was really good but the service was good awful. There were only three patrons in the whole restaurant yet I got crappy service a dirty table and negative looks. Not sure why.

What a joke this place is!

They really are one step above McDonalds!

In fact McDonalds might put them to shame! At least mcDonalds is cheap and consistent!

These people are a fast food chain that pretend to be an upmarket Italian Restaurant!

Total frauds! Go to little Italy in Manhattan and they will show and tell u how to be authentic!

The food was tasteless and my dogs wouldn't eat it!

My pot belly pig wouldn't touch it either and he has been known to want to eat all sorts!

The waitress Natalie was a total joke! She couldn't bring me ice tea refills but yet she could interject on my conversation!

It's apparent she isn't a waitress but an interloper on conversation and is clearly not matched to a waitress job and she really needs to learn how to be quiet, know her place and deliver food and beverages for which she should be qualified to do. She obviously can't get a job in the profession she chose due to Covid but if she is a server, she should be seen and not heard and just serve customers!

Tip for Buyers: Try to communicate by text messaging or email, so that you have proof/paper trail when they try to flip the script on you. Edwin (salesman) tried it on me. Also, take pictures!!!



Bohn Toyota (Salesman: Edwin) DID NOT respect my time, or my family. It took time for us to get there. They will play games with you, and your emotions. He told me the car was sold AFTER  I wasted the time getting to the dealership, when he could just tell me ahead of time before I came in.



So, I came in on Tuesday, March 9 for a test drive. I took pictures of the truck, and the truck's detail sheet and vin #. After the test drive, I told Edwin my offer and left, so he can talk it over with his manager.  He got back to me the next day, Wednesday, March 11, and said that they agreed to my offer. 

My dad, who is suppose to come with me to sign off on the truck,  wasn't able to come in that day, so I asked Edwin if he works the next day. He said it was his day off, so I respected his time off, and we both shoot for the day after, Friday. Friday came, but we were not able to come in, and aim for the next day, Saturday.

Keep in mind, Edwin never mention the truck was sold yet or anything. He only wants to know when I am coming to the dealership.


Saturday came. I was finally able to gather my siblings to come in with me, as we going to be the one signing for the truck instead of dad (gift for dad). We got to the lot, and went straight to the truck. I texted Edwin that we were "here", and were going to the truck. I believe he was ready to play games, as he wanted us to come in, instead of going outside to greet, and let us check out the truck. When we went inside, that is when he broke the news that the car was sold. At that time, it didn't cross my mind that if it was sold, why is it still on the lot? Why didn't he  inform us, but waited for us to come to the dealership to give us the bad news? So, we left.


I went home, and texted him why he played games. He texted back at me trying to play the confusion game on me, saying the truck is not for a V6. I guess he didn't realize I keep proof/paper trail, as I was prepared for these type of moment. He tried to play it off as a "misunderstanding". And came back with a higher offer. Bait and switch.




PS.,  the truck, with the same VIN # is still on their website as of today, March 15.

I really do not like to give this low of a rating, but by my standards this was the lowest quality and poorest tasting sushi I have had in New Orleans area.  This restaurant starts by serving everyone a small bowl of noodles... They seemed to be in a mayo-y sauce. I did not care for this but it's complimentary and unique to this spot.  I went for lunch & had a lunch combo which consisted of miso soup, a small salad, and 2 rolls (I had tuna avocado & crunchy).  Did not care for the miso but I rarely enjoy miso. The salad & orange garnishment a were the only other two items I was able to eat at all. The avocado tuna rolls was the worst- the tuna looked grey in color and tasted very fishy/ bad. I'm concerned it had actually turned bad or had not been stored properly. All of the avocado was also quite old looking. In addition, the rolls (rice) were just extra slimy and falling apart. My guess is this was not kept at appropriate temperature.   The crunchy roll was the same, falling apart & drenched in mayo.  To be polite, I was able to stomach a few bites of the crunchy roll..taking comfort in the fact that none of the ingredients were actually real fish & that it would not make me sick.
Overall, it was a terrible experience.  However, judging by the lunch crowd (it was busy), people must like this place... Or just have very low standards.

Just moved to the area and stopped by this store's location for a quick single-item purchase. I was impressed by how big, neat and well stocked the store was. 

Returned when I had more time to shop, and was even more impressed at their selection, prices, and so many helpful and kind employees. (Sadly, I'm too used to the opposite. Too few and counterproductive employees.) 

They literally had everything I needed, and several "gotta have it" items for the new house. I'll be back, often!
The gyro salad was absolutely delicious and the staff was super nice.  I'm new to the neighborhood and will definitely stop by again.  I'm looking forward to trying their scallops and falafel.

Recently went to NaBrasa for our 3 year anniversary celebration. All the meats were delicious. There were so many options. I loved that they served salmon also, at no extra charge. I even got to try alligator meat - a special for that night. The waiter was extremely friendly and polite. And for dessert we ordered the cheesecake xango, which is basically a churro with a cheesecake inside of it. AMAZING. We will definitely go back!

We had the seafood pasta and grouper filet.  Staff was very friendly and accommodating.  The seafood pasta was excellent. Loaded with squid, calamari, shrimp, scallops, and fish. Very large portion. The grouper was nice and big too. We will defiantly go back.

I had ordered a mobile order and it took over twenty minutes to get it. They were slow and forgot my order. Plus, I saw the lady behind the counter lick her elbow over the food right at the counter! This place is disgusting, slow, and I will never be going here again.

I think we went in the first week it was open. I usually give a lot of Grace to new restaurants since they have to work out a few bugs. This was not an issue at Sadie's. This team is experienced restaurantuers.  The service was excellent from Holly. She was great and friendly and made excellent recommendations. The restaurant ambience is fantastic. Beautiful chandeliers and very classy bar set up with a great bourbon and whiskey selection. Not too disappoint the food was excellent. We ordered the salmon kabobs. They came with two different sauces and a spicy hummus that was delicious. Food, ambience and service contributed to a great evening. This restaurant also attracts a cool and trendy crowd. If they're doing this good in the startup phase they're going to be an excellent choice going forward and will be a hotspot ongoing. The restaurant filled up pretty quick so I'd recommend reservations.
It was ok, we were in town for the night and thought this would be good for dinner. It was nothing spectacular. We all ate and were full but nothing to brag about.

There are positive and not so positive points to my experience. So lets start with the good stuff... 

Our reservation was for 7 on St Patty's Day, but were seated early which was greatly appreciated. Servers were somewhat attentive in the beginning and very friendly. 

The decor is really nice, but where we were seated half of our booth was against a partial wall with the bar on the opposite side. This was a bit rough because the noise from the bar made it to where I couldn't hear the conversation from the other two people at my table. 

The complimentary bread come in sourdough and corn muffins with seasoned hawaiian butter which all were amazing. My daughter and i split a Cesar salad and my son in law had a green salad with honey citrus vinaigrette, both were phenomenal. I had the Mauritson Zin which was very impressive. 

For entres my daughter and i both ordered rib eye medium rare, son in law had aged NY strip medium rare. My son in laws steak was perfect, he did share a bite and it tasted as good as it looked. My daughters steak was slightly over cooked... mine... was well done. The server was gracious and understanding, took the steak back... it took about 30 minutes to get the replacement. Once received I asked for horseradish... this took another 20ish minutes. When they brought it i found they only had creamed available. 

The side dishes were amazing!!!! Pureed Golden Potatoes, Broccolini, Mac and Cheese, and hand cut fries. All sides are served family style and come in a portion large enough to feed at least 2. 

Ahhhh dessert.... my daughter had vanilla creme brulee, i had poached pair tart, and my son in lae had the ice cream and sorbet assortment. The desserts were as delicious as they were beautiful in presentation. 

The only reason i offer 4 stars is the overcooked steaks, when this is your claim to fame it should be the star of the meal... also the delays in getting a replacement steak out and the horseradish. Maybe just a rough night in the kitchen... i do plan to go again, if it better i will revise my review... 

Happy Yelping

Because it was the last day of the deal, I missed the consultation step that would've been included, but the physician's assistant, Meredith, was still very thorough. I didn't experience any extra charges, my livingsocial deal covered everything, and they did every tiny vein on my legs. The coupon even included a pack of Bromelain Extract (from pineapples) to reduce the swelling over the next few days. They have the broadest selection of services I've seen at a spa and I'm already planning on trying a facial or massage next month.

They're affiliated with Bryn Mawr Skin & Cancer Institute (and in the same building, only one suite down), so I also scheduled a dermatology appointment. Very convenient if you see a dermatologist and esthetician for your skin.

During all of this quarantine , I placed a mobile order and no where does it tell you can do curbside . All their signs say drive through only . So after 30 minutes in line . I see they're doing curbside . When I got to the speaker they said it was ready . When I got to the window . The lady handed me a drink . Then asked why I'm sitting there .. umm bc you didn't hand me my food . The blonde behind the counter was super rude . Just a terrible set up of people .

We sat in outdoor dining on a cold and windy afternoon, in addition to the heaters they have to warm the tables, staff provides everyone who asks for a blanket which you get to KEEP! Such a nice surprise and personal touch. Pretzel Dough Beignet  and crispy Brussels are so unbelievably good! This business has done an exceptional job pivoting since COVID, and has even turned their indoor space into a wine shop. The owners are really nice and it makes me feel good to give them my money.

Went here for my birthday dinner during the week. My fiance and I were the only ones in this section of the restaurant. Our food was reasonably priced and delicious. We had a fantastic conversation with the bartender about bourbons. She was very knowledgeable.

Superb food, excellent service. The dishes we tried were fresh, so delicious & flavourful, and presented with flair. Our server Kam was warm, attentive, and professional. The prices here are very reasonable for stand-out quality like this. One of the finest dining experiences we've had in Edmonton.

Absolutely love this place! I've been going for 10 years. the staff is always so friendly, I absolutely love how they do my nails, they remember everyone and i switch it up every time, and they take their time! My full set lasts waaay longer than at most other places.

Wonderful things to say about the people that work for this company,  today Cornell helped my mom from one of his job sites (she's an elderly women "Ruthie")  he took the time out of his day to make sure she was safe, helped and okay.  
It was an incredible act of kindness. :) 

Thank you again Cornell, 

Cherie (daughter from California)

Nicholas and the other mover were both wonderful - they showed up on time, were professional, fast, and friendly. I used Bellhops when moving in to my house a few years ago and also had a very positive experience with them then. Can not recommend Bellhops highly enough!

I had an incredible vet in the Bay Area and when I moved here I was afraid I was not going to be able to find a vet nearly as great as the one I had, but WOW! Dr. Cassie is amazing and calms my nerves everytime I am worried. The girls who work at the front desk are beyond friendly and also made me feel comfortable leaving my dog. I have a 2 year old Black Lab and dropped him off today to get looked at for some cuts. Now, I am a crazy dog mom and didn't want to leave him but the girls made me feel so much better. Dr. Cassie called right after she looked at him and helped ease my mind about leaving him there while I finish at work. I feel extremely lucky to have found Dr. Cassie and the staff (especially Hannah) to help me take care of my baby. Thank you Kings Row!

love coming to this shop for my dog's favorite treats but seeing that it was a bakery i knew i had to get her birthday cake here! 

i got a custom cake and it was so cute and perfect! my dog loved the cake and i loved how soft the icing was for her to lick off. the ingredients are clean and you can tell so much love and care goes into baking it with the attention to detail

You don't come here for the food. It's all pretty basic to be honest. But it's the experience that makes it real fun! The entire experience is to go with a bunch of friends, chill by the pool, play some bacci ball and even an hour of bowling. As for food, I would avoid the brussell salad. I tend to get the 12-16 dollar plates and all those are around average. Don't see why you would spend $20 here. Not at that level. Service has been great both times I have went.

A co-worker brought these to my office for her going away present (she was the one leaving so why did I get cupcakes?!?!?) and ever since then I have been hooked! They are so good and I love all the different varieties offered daily! And now they are expanding to include cookies, bread, and gluten free options daily. 

I love the mini's because I am not suppose to have that much sugar at once but even when they do not have any mini options, I'll just buy one cupcake and cut it into fourths. I know, that sounds crazy but hey you gotta do what you gotta do to enjoy these little bits of heaven. I actually enjoy getting the emails from them to see what the new items will be and what they will look like, especially the holiday designs.

Probably the best casual food in the French Quarter. When I visited for the first time, I wandered in by chance. During my week long visit I stopped in three more times. Great for a quick lunch, but it stays open late too, so it's great for stopping in for a bite after a long night of over-21 fun.
Excellent fish, fresh grouper broiled with a perfect crust and flaky inside. The sides are very plain though, rice and veg not seasoned at all.

Go to Ruth Chris for this price and get steak that's good.  It had atmosphere but the steak was over cooked (I had read several reviews that had said this happened to others...and it happened to me too!).

Just got out of movie with two kids. Infestation of ants in the cup holders in theater 12 and let guest services know on the way out. Her response was "thanks for letting us know-- they should be gone by this time of year!" That's disgusting and also terrible customer service. Kids couldn't sit still-- jumping around because of the ants. Bad experience.

We didn't know what to expect from the reviews. I had the oyster po'boy and my wife had the steak and cheese sub. The oysters tasted fresh and it was huge. Really good. 3/5 - If you're not vegan then I'd say come here for the experience not the food

We were in the area looking for a brunch spot nearby to grab-and-go some takeout, and this place showed up after looking around for a bit. It worked out as this place is currently take-out only and doesn't provide any eat-in dining options. It was in walking distance to where we were going to eat anyways so I figured why not?

Before rating the food, I just want to make mention that I'm not vegan or vegetarian. I've had a lot of good vegan food on the west coast though and I dabble with frozen non-meat alternatives (shout-out to Aldi's).

Breakfast Burrito Deluxe:
Probably my favorite thing we ordered. The spicy mayo on top was really good, and the overall presentation of the dish was very nice. It tasted okay. I couldn't taste the "meat" very well though because the flavor of the tofu was very strong.
It came with a side of fries, but they were pretty bad. The larger pieces weren't boiled all the way leaving them pretty dry and unpleasant to chew on. They didn't taste like they were seasoned either.

Dirty Jersey:
I'd hard pass on this one. I didn't enjoy it at all. It had this mushy texture in my mouth that made me feel unpleasant. It's not how a sandwich usually feels like in your mouth. I wasn't a fan of the tofu they had in the sandwich, and the "meat" was not to my liking either. My partner thought it was pretty good though and actually liked it more than the breakfast burrito.

Passion Fruit Hibiscus Tea:
It was pretty refreshing, although the flavor of hibiscus is pretty strong in this be warned.

Chai Latte with Almond Milk:
This was a pretty good chai latte. I read a review on here claiming to be the best chai latte in Philly; let's not get ahead of ourselves. It was good but I definitely wouldn't say it's anywhere near being the best. I'd come back here to order another chai latte though if I was in the mood.

The service here was excellent. The woman working was very polite over the phone and she handed us our drinks while we waited for the food to be prepared.

There's a nice little bench outside the restaurant to relax on (it does look like it's falling apart though so it might not be there anymore at the time you're reading this review). The window decorations are quirky and funny, and I appreciated the inclusivity posters they had displayed.

The Tasty is not a place I'd recommend for their food if you're not vegan. Their drinks might be worthwhile checking out though. The surrounding area is nice and there are good vibes. Take a stroll with a drink but skip out on a meal.

Don Fite at County Brake does things right.  He has a fantastic cast of technicians with a wealth of experience to resolve the toughest problems.  He is honest and treats his customers fairly.  In a word, you can trust him.

On a road trip from Texas to Wisconsin, my 2002 Suburban broke down on the interstate not far from Don's shop.  County Brake towed my vehicle and resolved multiple issues stemming from a wire short (probably the result of a previous repair not quite done correctly).  Don put his top mechanic on it and methodically worked through each system impacted by the short.  The impacts were extensive, time consuming, and costly, but each system was tested, each solution verified with me before repair, and only performed because it was necessary to get me back on the road.

I was really in a position where Don could have taken advantage of my vulnerability of being stranded, but what I experienced instead was quality work, care for my well being, flexibility, superb communication, and extra diligence to make my vehicle reliable.  He even gave me a significant discount to help offset the circumstances I was in.  

I am grateful to have found this shop and it hit all the high notes of what I look for in a repair shop.  I learned through experience County Brake is a shop run by people you can trust.  They got me back on the road and safely to my destination.
Cute little place, excellent breakfast bagels. Their chia is amazing. Staff is always willing to help with suggestions and or recommendations. Easy for a quick grab and go.

I'm just waiting for the owners to realize they aren't charging enough! The food is soooo good and portions are  huge! 
Also, How is every server sweet and friendly? We had the pleasure of having Melissa tonight:)
She was friendly, helpful and patient with our indecisiveness. Thank You!
When they closed at 9pm, we were not rushed out and that was appreciated. 
You can't go there and not get the parsley potatoes.. I'm sorry, but when they ask you which 2 sides you want, you need to say double potatoes! Thank me later! The apple cake is delicious (we forgot our ice cream :()
The ribs fell off the bone, per usual... Brisket sandwich was tender Tender.... They also offer a 20% off Military Discount every Tuesday. A hidden gem in Tampa!
Covid Updates:
All servers wear masks and they continuously clean
You must wear a mask to enter the restaurant 
Reduced hours- call ahead!
I love this place!
Nice market. Lots of vendors. Plenty to choose from on eating and drinking. Great atmosphere. If your in Soulard on a Saturday you gotta go.

This place is a Must Try!!! Their ramen noodles are amazing and the pork buns & edamame are incredible.  The owner and the chef are remarkable people.  They truly care about each person's experience at this restaurant.  Highly recommend!

Fast service, great prices, good quality used tires. Highly recommend! I called ahead to se rid they had my tires size, which they did. Was in and out in less than an hour with 4 gently used tires. Staff was all very friendly, I will definitely return again.

The cinnamon toast is life changing. I could see myself coming back again and again and just ordering a plate full of cinnamon toast and a cup of coffee. It's soft and buttery, thick and cinnamony, sugary but not overly so. Writing about the cinnamon toast is making me sad that I'm not eating any right now.

The other food that I ordered was not as life-changing, but still great nonetheless. I got half of a curried lentil pate sandwich -- which was not soft like I expected, but instead it was a thick, cold, toothsome veggie patty -- on wheat bread, and a small cup of matzo ball soup, because I was there on a Friday and they only serve matzo ball soup on Fridays. Both my vegan sandwich and my non-vegan soup were amazing. The sandwich came with a side of kettle chips.

This Cafe Patachou is located downtown by the government offices, so it can get crowded during lunchtime. I went for an early lunch, and although there were a lot of people there, I didn't have to wait for a table, and the service was fast and efficient. By the time I finished my meal, though, a line had formed for tables, so I think it's probably wise to get to this location early, if you're looking to have lunch.

Fast and excellent service. It may be pricer like other reviewers noted; however, I would pay a little more for better customer service. In addition, I've sent out many expensive items, and never had an issue with it getting to its destination. Trustworthy and reliable!

Food was ok but service was great. Ordered the Cobb salad with some buffalo chicken on it. The salad was a good portion but not a lot of chicken. Also ordered the mayo tacos and those were pretty good. If you want something quick then you this is the place to go.

Great spot for authentic Turkish cuisine. Owners are wonderful and the chef comes out and spends time with each diner. Highly recommended. Suggest you either follow your craves, or let them recommend (my choice and it was killer).

Just be careful when you get a quote about how much they will pay for your silver or gold (and other metals).  When I first called them, they told me they paid spot for the recoverable amount of precious metal, in other words spot for 100% pure metal.  What I sent them was .800 silver, which means the weight would be reduced by about 80%, which means I thought I was getting 80% of what they would have paid if what I sent them was 100% pure.  As expected, they first refined the metal, recovering about 80% pure metal, or 80% of the original weight.  But THEN they multiplied THAT amount by another 80%.  The net is that I only got about 64% of the spot price on the original weight of the silver.  They had not explained that their "spot price payment factor" was 80% of spot, no matter what the purity was, AFTER the weight is already reduced by recovering the pure metal (coincidentally 80% in my case since it was .800 silver).  Now that I understand how it works I can live with that; I just wish they had been more transparent about it in the first place.

Overall, I enjoyed Mother's and would come back next time I'm in town. Ms. Pat is definitely a gem and made my experience what it was!

Definitely a must see! Admission is very reasonable. The museum has a lot of exhibits. They are done very well and they provide you a dog tag that you register with your email address so you can continue to learn more while at home. The dog tag assigns you a WWII story of an individual. The museum doesn't have enough room to show all the stories so it's a great way to learn more. You can touch your badge on areas around the exhibits. You pick up the phone and listen to the story. 

I remembered a lot of things I read in the museum and learned about a lot of things. There are stairs and escalators to take you through the floors of the museum. There are videos through the exhibits to watch. The staff is very friendly.

There is a gift shop, American Sector restaurant and bar and Jeri Nims soda shop to grab a quick bite.

Pictures and reviews are not giving this museum the credit it deserves. Go check it out if you're in the area so you can be blown away.
