I finally had a chance to really check our the Irsay Family YMCA at CityWay, one of the nicer YMCA locations in Central Indiana and a YMCA that is located in the same building as my primary care physician. 

This location is, I believe, the newest YMCA in Indy having opened on 12/15/15. It became known as the Irsay Family YMCA in 2016 after a donation from the Irsay Family. 

This YMCA offers 87,000 square feet on 3 different levels. There's a lap pool, recreational pool, sauna, whirlpool, and over 80 different classes on a weekly basis. They have an instructional teaching kitchen (Really!) and an outdoor balcony area, as well. 

I seldom, if ever, go to my doctor without seeing a crowded facility that offers free parking for members and/or a paid parking lot. There's quite a bit of accessible parking. The YMCA is, as you could probably guess, in the near-southside CityWay area and also really close to Lilly. It's super convenient to a variety of housing and restaurant options and, of course, Franciscan Health including adjacent physical therapy. 

They offer some day camp options and with the pandemic still impacting programming do offer virtual classes. There's also before/after school programming along with early childhood and pre-school programming. 

YMCA is a faith-based non-profit organization with a mission, taken from their website to "put Christian principles into practice through programs that build healthy spirit, mind, and body for all." 

They are following current regulations around the pandemic and when I've seen classes being led, individuals have been masked and social distancing is being enforced. 

This tends to be a bit of a higher-end neighborhood and you can definitely see that in the facilities here. They're definitely nicer than you might expect, yet they also encourage wellness and self-care. All three floors are accessible by elevators and front doors are automatic. There's plenty of accessible parking and I've generally found staff to be disability aware and friendly. 

While YMCAs do definitely still have fees attached to them, I generally regard them as affordable and one of the best options for folks who want to focus on wellness in an empowering, accepting environment while being fiscally responsible. You can do all that here and likely make a few friends along the way. 

However, to this day I've yet to enter this YMCA without breaking out into song. Yeah, you know the one.

Even if you spent your entire weekend eating and drinking your way through Nashville, you should save room for Monnells. 

This place is like Sunday dinner after church. All you can eat. Cornbread, fried chicken, fried cat fish, Mac and chz, potatoes, and pitchers of sweet/unsweetened tea and lemonade! Cat fish was amazing. 

Follow the no cell phone policy and make new friends at your table! However, I snuck a photo at the end for all you yelp-readers. #cleanplateclub #that'smy4thplate

HORRIBLE!!!!!!HORRIBLE COMPANY...The claimed to have delivered my package to my door step I was home all day no one rang my bell. These assholes stole my package and god forbid you should call customer service you will be on hold for hours!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! STAY AWAY FROM LASERSHIT!!!!!!!!!!!!!

This local bistro offers open air seating on their second level and has great fresh pizzas, salads and cocktails. Always friendly and prompt service. Perfect for a night out with friends or a light lunch.

It was always a dream of mine to "be good at cooking fish", but what I didn't realize was that the (obvious) secret to making great fish every time is starting with top quality seafood! Going to the fish market always felt overwhelming and a trip out of my way, so I didn't make it there very often. Now the seafood of the week is selected for me and packaged in the perfect portion size for my family. Every week we feel like we are eating a restaurant quality meal; its led me well outside my comfort zone in the kitchen, but every meal since we signed up for Get Hooked at the beginning of this year has been a home run. They also send an awesome newsletter with the info on the species of the week, fisherman who caught your fish and recipe links. Honestly planning for and enjoying our fish has become a highlight of our week, and it sure is nice to have something to look forward to these days!

Yoooooooooooooo do yourself a favor and go try EVERYTHING up here. My suggestions the first time is to ask their opinion for available options. And make the sandwich as they suggest. Very friendly staff as well

We had a leak at the main line for the house and irrigation that we didn't know about and then saw significant water pooling near the main line. It was a Saturday of course and Michael's Plumbing was the only one that could come the same day. Eric arrive around 5pm and managed to determine the leak and order the parts for the repair.  We were lucky that we could still use the domestic line until they could get back out on Wednesday to do the repair. Eric came at the designated time and completed the repair but would still need to come back the next day to make sure it sealed properly before we turned everything.  Thurs comes and at 7pm Eric is knocking on our door to confirm everything is working.  I was beside myself that he still showed up and didn't come the next morning. After determining everything worked, he still had another job to go to!  Eric and Michael's Plumbing were amazing and I highly recommend them!

Come for the ambiance but stay for the creme brûlée. This place is thee cutest off the beaten path find I've ever been to in a long time. With excellent service and an even better ribeye you won't be disappointed. Also seriously, and you'll thank me later, get two creme brûlée's. One to eat there and one to go

Wow!  Very impressed with the staff here. They were able to squeeze me in last minute shots for boarding the same day.  Extremely helpful and Beau did the best he has ever done in a Vet clinic(since he is dog aggressive). Prompt and succinct. Heather and Dr. Cole were absolutely incredible.  I have found Beau's forever vet.  Thanks guys.
Super great tastin burguh! Best employees and even better food, burguh was solid, meat a little bland and soft with no char, everything else is good and high quality. Very Shweet 7.5! Toight job!

My second favorite donut place in the area! Everything is freshly made and there are tons of toppings and glazes to choose from. You'd be hard pressed to not find a combination that fits your tastes : )

I hate to give this place 2 stars, but after my experience today it feels warranted. My family and I came here for Father's Day with a reservation for 3pm. As you can imagine, the place was pretty dead - maybe half a dozen tables were filled. We were sat at a table that wasn't ready for us i.e. 2 place settings instead of 3 and an empty jar where the oyster crackers should've been. After a few minutes we were greeted, by our waiter, received the extra place setting, and we placed our orders. My parents both ordered a pan roast while I ordered the seared ahi special. He then brought us some bread and disappeared for about 30 minutes. When he came back around, we were wondering where our food was. He said it would be out any minute and that the seared tuna takes a while to prepare. Um... what? Seared tuna takes about a minute and a half per side. We asked for some more bread, and he ignored us and asked my dad if he could get him another beer. My dad said no, but we would like more bread. Honestly, I don't think this kid was old enough to even be serving alcohol. Anyway, a few minutes later he brought us more bread. 15 more minutes go by and we've now seen 2 other tables arrive, order, and finish their meals. My parents were completely fed up so we told the waiter to cancel the order because we were leaving. We didn't receive an apology or an explanation. 

The only reason I'm giving this 2 stars instead of 1 is because my dad has been here several times before and loves it - which is why we wanted to dine here on his special day. The bread and butter was good, but not good enough for me to come back. Very disappointing dining experience.

It's what every supermarket should be. Truly the perfect supermarket. Fresh, healthy, organic, you name it they have it. The cheese selection in this place is incredible. Awesome service, great wine, great bakery, hot food on the go, all the nuts you can possibly think of. Even the lighting is wonderful. All this goodness doesn't come cheap, place is overpriced indeed. Come in for wine and cheese and maybe a few things for the home, bring the rest of your shopping list to Trader Joes or your local Publix.

Awe-some service today!  I've needed some keys duplicated for 6-9 months but no place could I find a place that had the right blanks.  The parts desk at Camping World recommended THIS particular Ace Hardware and I was thrilled as they had Both blanks.  Cashier was sweet too.

So why only 4 stars?  Because store entry  FORCES entering patrons to pass by  within 12" of folks standing in cashier line.  Not cool in COVID!

Love this place. We're new to the area and looking forward to being snowbirds on the island. We have dined here many times since November with the food,drink and service being very consistent. 5 stars

My favorite sushi in town was tarnished by a very preventable situation. I ordered take out, 5 rolls @$75. Fine, no problem. My 4 year old son asked for the little complimentary chocolates that come at the end of the meal. As Im paying the bill I noticed they charged $2 for the chocolate? WTF? They are complimentary when you dine in. Im a regular, eating there 1 or 2 times a week. I expressed my dissatisfaction with the charge, expressing how its like charging for a peppermint, it's insulting, & ridiculous. The owners who make sushi, DID NOTHING. Super rude, zero customer service. They are talented sushi chefs but definitely lost my respect. I will cut back my frequency, & spend money where it's appreciated.

The sandwiches here are fantastic. The customer service is terrible. The women here are short and rude and will shake their heads when you request anything. The purposely leave their phone off the hook so the don't have to take togo orders. Believe all the reviews. The people here are so nasty it's not worth the good food. Just go get a pub sub.

I discovered this place about a year ago shortly after it opened.  At that time, my friends and I would come once or even twice a week.  I like their ceviche, queso fundido & I LOVE their paloma.  I've also tried almost all of the tacos- I like the chorizo a lot & carnitas.  The duck enchiladas were interesting too.   Their salsas are great and I would recommend the plain guac (not the loaded guac!) 
It's a relatively small, cozy space inside but we always opt to eat on the front patio- it's really a nice, relaxing place to enjoy a meal & cocktails.

Signed up to take an injectable class with these clowns!! $1600 up front, class was to be April 15th in NYC. I live on Lon Island, March 22nd quarantine for the Corona virus shut everything down and as of this date there are no alternate classes scheduled.
New Yorks schools may not even open in September.
Im an RN and my daughter is a PA. We each shelled out $1600 for basically nothing. These people are crooks and will not refund our money!!!
They have not suffered any monetary loss on my daughter' or my behalf. Everyone is financially suffering now and to hold our money hostage is unconscienable!!!!!

10 minutes after a very poor experience at Caruso's, the staff at Malibu Farm completely changed our evening! Service was perfect from everyone we came in contact with and our meals were across the board spectacular. Our servers name escapes me but she was attentive without being overbearing, gave us several excellent suggestions, and made my wife feel very special on her birthday.

Thanks to the great staff here for turning a night that started badly into one we'll always remember positively. We'll be back for sure!

I was billed almost $140 for wax removal, a procedure that took literally 5-10 minutes.  I drove there just to double-check they had the right insurance and the amount was correct.  $140 is fine with me, I have an incredibly awful high deductible plan and I expect something like this.  However, I asked the woman at the front desk to check and she had me sit and wait for the manager.  The manager - a tall black woman with braids - then came out and immediately and impatiently dismissed my question and said that's the amount I am required to pay.  I made a simple joke in the split second she yielded me that if I made $140 for 10 minutes I would be a millionaire in a week's time.  Her reaction was to tell me that I then should have become a doctor (!).  Additionally, she said she thought $140 was "cheap" for a 10 minute visit.  I am sure it is cheap for her.  The lady at the front desk sat the whole time like a deer in the headlights, even when I told her her boss was rude.  No concern.  Is this professional behavior?  Were I a doctor I think I would have enough sense to treat my patients - people who pay me and keep me in business - with respect rather than condescension, even if $140 to me is equivalent to pocket change.  Not everyone is doing as fantastically as she and Gabay and the rest of the millionaires are in this office.  I felt like just another piece of cash for them.  BTW, Gabay is a decent enough doc, but beware that that he doesn't wear a mask, which is odd, as he asks all his patients to wear masks.  They had Fox News running on their television so I guess that explains the cognitive dissonance.

Absolutely loved my experience here! Had a subpar time at a restaurant near by and needed to grab a bite to end the night on a good note. 

The staff was highly courteous and dealt with our random clutziness that night ( spilled water everywhere twice ) while keeping the whole situation lighthearted/humorous. The prices of the food are amazing if you want a nice date night, but on a college budget! 

They have a great vegetarian menu which we opted for but have heard raving things about all their food! When I come back, I'd definitely get a couple orders of the tofu tacos because the purée that's paired with it is AMAZING! The cucumber salad was just something new we wanted to try and it was great as well along with the noodles.

For desert, we opted for the flourless brownie and it tasted just like a snickers bar ( can't complain)! For next time, super excited to try out the mango bar for dessert, chili crab, and Szechuan chicken stir- fry!

My initial impression was pretty good .. at least better than the other Residence Inn I stayed in a few weeks ago in Tampa. But then after two nights here, I have decided to downgrade the score. Here is why: we returned to the room at around midnight and found it had been only half cleaned. They took the towels but did not return any new clean towels or anything... so how are we to take a shower. The dirty dishes in the sink were still there ... and had not been washed, nor had the trash been emptied. But the bed was made and that was it. Our sink was stopped up when we had checked in, so we called and asked for maintenance to fix it. Nope, that was not done either. So I call down asking for fresh towels and am told come down and get them yourself. So I get dressed and go back down, well the counter person is heading down the hall somewhere, and but the towels are sitting there ... so I grab them and head back upstairs. Cool, now for a shower ... nope the water is off, and that also means the air conditioner is not working either. DUDE!!! We finally get to bed around 2 and the air conditioner comes back on ... only now it is spitting water out of the vent. By the way, even without this, there is so much light that floods under the door that it is hard to sleep ... and as someone else  said, the bed is really hard. When we checked out, they did not so much as even apologize for their poor customer service. I will not be back to this hotel again.
Came from out of town based on previous yelp reviews. Great value for what is served, along with taste. Huge portions along with side salads, soup, and bread. Shoutout to Samantha-she was great!

Went to Farm and Fisherman today for lunch and really enjoyed it. I live close by and am so happy we now have this gem nearby.

Upon sitting at our table, we were warmly greeted by our server, Katrina. She was AWESOME. They have a really nice cocktail and craft beer selection so I definitely want to visit the bar for happy hour next time to sample some of those. We had Bloody Maria's to start and they were made really well..not too spicy but just enough kick. We shared the Burrata plate and it was delicious! It was served over crusty bread with roasted delicata squash, brown butter and topped with some crispy sage and roasted pumpkin seeds. Super yummy! For entrees we had the Seared Salmon salad, Beer Battered Fish sandwich, and the Industrial burger. All three were delicious. The salmon was crispy from the searing but had a texture as if it was poached - perfectly cooked and served alongside a delicious salad with roasted squash, cauliflower, farro, and pumpkin seeds. YUM! The fish sandwich was lightly battered and fried and was topped with oven roasted tomatoes, iceberg lettuce, and tartar sauce. The fish was super fresh and flaky and served on a soft bun. The burger was a kicked up version of a Big Mac (without that extra layer of bread) - two smashed brisket patties with special sauce, pickles and American cheese - perfection! The fish sandwich and burger came with perfectly cooked french fries. 

I can't wait to go back for dinner - this place is a keeper!

Place is  amazing. Should be a requirement for every citizen to come here at least once and watch the Tom hanks 4D movie. So much to do and see
Loved it

I just recently made a visit to Legends in Smyrna. I wish I would have read the reviews before I went. I understand now why they only have three stars.  It took 25 minutes before someone to take our order!! When we finally receive service, the waitress had an attitude as if she didn't wanT to be there. The manager just walked around and when we said something to him he told us Someone will be there to help us shortly. I know it' is tough times to find help, but the management team could've been a lot more supportive In taking care of the customers!!!

I wanted to give it five stars because I love their pizza, but today I spent $22 on a Greek pizza and it had about two inches of crust around the edge. So this meant not slot of toppings. On top of that, there were so many slices cut into the pizza that eacb slice was about two inches wide at the top. It really bummed me out cause last time I ordered here I got burned pizza and about three pepperoni on a lunch pizza. This was my "let me give it a try again" and was let down again. For the price, I just expect more.

Tried Nesso for the first time and it blew my expectations out of the water! We shared the pane, prune secche, spaghettini, tortellini and for dessert the zeppole and cannoli sundae... everything was absolutely outstanding! 

And to top it off, the entire staff was so friendly. Visit my new friend Matthew - highly entertaining and be sure to ask for the Blood Orange Chello.

I went in for a pedicure with four other girlfriends on a Saturday afternoon. We called a few hours ahead to make sure they could accommodate us and they assured us they'd be ready. They did not have enough techs to give us all pedicures at the same time, so three got pedicures while two of us waited with our feet in the tubs, with water getting cold, for over 30 minutes. I know it was over 30 minutes because the massage chair times out after that amount of time, and I had to restart it. Finally, after completing one of my friends pedicures, a tech, Tommy, came to work on me. I have never had such a rough, or hurried pedicure in my life. He clipped my nails without even looking at them and almost took a chunk out of my big toe but I jerked my foot away in time. Then, when trimming my cuticles I was distracted and in conversation and he cut a large piece of skin, making me bleed. He then quickly put that foot back in the tub so I couldn't see it bleeding. This was all because he was moving so quickly trying to get me done, since most friends' pedicures were already completed at this point. He did not buff my nails at all, and filed them minimally, and they are not shaped or even. The paint was put on so sloppily that he had to go back and clean up with a brush and acetone (which then burned badly where he cut me). 

All I was in the spa an hour, 20 minutes, at most, of which were spent giving me a pedicure - and this was for the Posh Pedicure, not just the basic. 

All that said, my friends had good experiences with their techs, but I will not be going back.

This is one of the newest restaurants in the area and my gut tells me that they will be around for a while. The atmosphere is energetic and slightly upscale with a very contemporary look and feel. The bar area is bustling in the evenings and the windows allow a good look out to Mass Ave while you're dining. The menu has a mixture of meats and seafood with your typical veggie, starch sides. As much as I wanted to try a meat dish, I went with the ahi and was NOT let down. The flavor was amazing, the fish cooked to perfection and the amount of food perfect. This was a great first experience and I hope to be back again soon. Make reservations if you can because it can get busy.
The pizza from this place is pretty good , but the Chinese food is so so. And waiting time for pick up is way way too long .

Paper plates and red solo cups with a crappy plastic fork. 14.79 for dinner with 2.89 for a soda.  Food is okay but not worth the price. The restrooms and trashed, there's a big hole in the lobby sofa, and overall there was only one waitress cleaning and trying to make the place look decent.

p.s. the bathroom looked exactly like the photo in Eric's post on 3-3-2019. Horrible!

I gave them my car on Wednesday after calling on the previous Friday and scheduling a repair. I called them the Friday afterwards not necessarily expecting it to be finished but I expected there to be some sort of progress. The guy on the phone explained to me that they hadn't touched my car yet and they probably wouldn't until Monday. Now this would be understandable if I had just given them my car but I didn't. I scheduled it to be repaired days previous. These repairs are desperately needed and I haven't been able to work in about a week because of it, and it seems like they've overbooked themselves or are just jacking around on their time. Unfortunate because the other good reviews made me think that I finally found a solid mechanic. That's not the case as I now have to go pick up my car, drive with it overheating and hope it doesn't explode to the next shop I take it to!

Solid BYOB. We came here to celebrate my cousin in laws 50th birthday. We had a private room for the twelve of us. The first thing I noticed was that it was extremely hot in our room. The restaurant has central air, but it was roasting. They must've had broken AC when we went on 6/5/21. They had an oscillating fan located towards end of the table, which was quite funny. We were all sweating through our clothes for the 2.5 hours we were there. I didn't have any bread, but the people in my party reported it was very good. For appetizers, we had the calamari and antipasto, both we thoroughly enjoyed. For dinner I had the seafood scampi, but I asked to sub the vegetables and potatoes for a side of penne. My husband ordered the Vitello Al Mare and raved about it. I will say my portion of penne was quite small, compared to another dining companion who ordered the Penne ala Vodka (his portion was huge). Our servers were nice, but sometimes they disappeared for awhile. Overall, the food was excellent (albeit some of the portions varied greatly dish to dish), but the dining experience was extremely uncomfortable. I'd come back, but not with a large party in an unconditioned room.

Definitely delicious and I can't wait to go back. I ate at the chefs counter which is exciting as you can see the chefs prepare the dishes right before your eyes. Everything looked wonderful that was coming out of the kitchen.

Started with a amuse bouche which was a chilled soup (I think it was mango) and a small piece of cornbread.

Next up was the crab toast. The crab was fresh but there was a bit too much olive oil on the toast so it was greasy and the olive oil flavor overwhelmed it.

Next up was fresh squid ink pasta with a red sauce. It was simple but SO GOOD. this was the highlight of my night as it was homemade and very flavorful. I would come back for this.

Finished the night with fish in a broth. I probably was too full at this point and I ate a little bit of it, but it wasnt very memorable. It came with broccoli that I wasn't a fan of.

Dessert I had the petite brownie which was a perfect size after my multiple course meal. It was great to be able to taste this without having to have a full dessert or someone to share it with. 

Overall a great experience, good service, a fun show to watch as well. I would change up my order next time and probably stick to two courses, but it was great and I will be back.

I recently moved to Carmel and I have got to say one of my favorite things about it is this park. It's such a nice area to go on walks and explore a little. My boyfriend likes that it has a pond for fishing too. Pretty sure my dogs favorite part of the week is Saturday mornings spent here!

Great place to grab dessert or just an afternoon pick me up. They have numerous flavors of ice cream and homemade churros! Their Paletes come in fruit flavors, mixed fruit flavors, and mixed with ice creams. Again, the flavors of their Paletas are endless. My favorites are the raspberry, Dulce de leche, and strawberry with cream center. 

The proprietor is helpful and patient, especially in explaining the flavors and combinations available to choose from.

I've been back several times already and I plan to make Paleteria Del Angel a regular stop. Five plus Stars.
Authentic...delicious....where else can you get a gator burger? 13.oo frosty beverage and tip. 21.00 out the door ...stuffed.

Took my wife on a small birthday surprise to "Get up and Go Kayaking" & what an exciting experience! We were both a little nervous going kayaking for the first time since we were little kids, but Chris made us feel relaxed and comfortable. We chose the shell key preserve because of the wonderful scenery and the clear water. Highly recommend coming here for that perfect Instagram picture! Our tour guide Chris was nice, patient, and knowledgeable and gave us awesome information about the preserve. The entire experience lasted about two hours and we all took about 20 minutes from rowing to visit "shell island" which was great! Highly recommend this tour with Chris. Make sure you mention his name before you go! :).

We've had a service agreement with Pestmaster for nearly 6 years, and have regularly scheduled inspections and outdoor treatments. Always on time, and the products are effective and eco-friendly. This time, Joe came out to check on scratching sounds in the attic (which we decided were birds). He found a small gap where the stucco did not go all the way to the roof. He repaired this, and we have had no other issues. No charge for this service!

I would like to start with the good things. The staff that does the work on your teeth, are absolutely amazing! They are friendly, kind, and very personable. They take care of you in a timely manner, explain what's going on, and let you know what you need to do to maintain the health of your mouth. Signature Smiles has also done an exceptional job at handling COVID, and all the changes associated with it. I would also like to say that the staff behind the reception desk are also nice and personable however, it is the reception side of things that warrants my three star review.

I know that Signature Smiles has undergone corporate changes over the years, and unfortunately this means that the way they schedule has also changed. I had an appointment that I was scheduled for for 4 PM, I even received a reminder text with the 4 PM time, however on the day of my appointment I received a voicemail while at work saying, " We're so sorry we missed you for your 3 o'clock appointment. If you would like to reschedule please give us a call at... Hope all is well, and we hope to hear from you soon." As soon as I was able to respond, I called them and explained that I hadn't gotten off work until 3:30 PM and that I had the reminder text to prove that my appointment was at 4 PM. I will say that they were professional in the way that they kept my appointment, however when I got there I was informed that the dentist was no longer there and that I would have to set up a separate appointment in order to see her. This was quite frustrating, as my schedule is very tight. I would also like to say that I find it quite frustrating that they send you almost 7 text messages reminding you of when your appointment time is and allowing you to confirm your appointment, but none that allow you to cancel. Not only do they send you several reminders through text, they also call you about five different times, as well as send you 2-3 emails. The texts and emails are sent not only during their business hours, but while they are closed. This is quite frustrating because the only way to reschedule or cancel an appointment that you might have, is to leave a voicemail. This side of the business is quite frustrating, and with all of the compulsive reminders, quite overwhelming.

You just need to come here.  Go now. It's okay. 
The milkshakes are amazing.  And they have every flavor you can imagine.  The food is just like a 50s diner.  Nothing amazing but good.  The cheese fries are the best thing on that menu though.  you have to get them.  The staff could not be nicer.  

On the downside though, it is always loud!  They only accept cash.  And alot of teens come here and they are annoying.  But that is not the establishment's fault!  You need to come here.

I've been using Spots and Dots for the past year at two different residences.  I've used several cleaners over the years, but now ONLY use these guys for these reasons:

1)  Always on time.
2)  Job is done right the first time
3)  Extremely thorough

Other cleaners and cleaning services haven't been nearly as reliable, so I'm loyal to Spots and Dots nowadays.

They really, really like Dufy here.  If you're a Dufy fan this is where you need to be.  

We visited on a rainy Sunday and were impressed with the museum.  It is actually a lovely place, well laid out and a good size.  Completely worth the $17 admission fee. I was particularly excited about the Monet to Matisse exhibit but it should've been called the Dufy exhibit instead.  There were maybe 4 Monet's in the museum and I saw 2 by Matisse.  Dufy's abounded in every room other than the Japanese Wood Block exhibition upstairs.  It was exciting to see 2 Renoir's though, as that was my first time ever seeing one up close.

Staff is quite helpful and surprisingly friendly, no stuffy museum-type people.  Just know that if you walk in with an umbrella a big burly guard will make you check it so you have to keep up with your claim ticket if you want it back.

Parking is a nightmare.  I don't even know what to tell you other than to wear comfortable shoes and be patient.  You may have to park far away and even then you may have to drive around for a while to find a spot.  Not sure why a parking deck hasn't been built somewhere.  It is a lovely area for walking though, so not too bad.

I don't understand the rave reviews. This place smelled like someone had recently used the restroom in the entire place. It lacked order and cleanliness. The staff was friendly but it left so much to be desired. There weren't any prices - $16 later we had two ice creams. I believe the nitro was on too high because it was more icey than creamy so it cracked when they attempted to roll it. Presentation was lackluster. The staff should either have uniforms or aprons they wear.  I'm beyond confused for the rave reviews. The only plus is you can have a variety of fillings and then toppings with no charge. I won't be visiting again and would recommend you give another place a try.

The guys were nice, but 6 cars in line and 2 men working makes for very inconvenient convenience. Expect 45 mins/oil change, then include the hour+ you'll wait in line before serviced.

I came by yesterday and it was staffed with just one guy. He suggested I come today when there is 2. I imagine this is the norm here.

Dr Bonaldi is a very personable guy. He explained everything to me in simple terms that I could understand. He told me I would have scars and exactly where they would be. Then I visited with Tamara who gave me the pricing for the procedure I wanted to do. Very pleasant schedulers and financial responsibility lady. Once I'm financially ready I will have him do my surgery and I will follow up with the rest of my comments. Thank you

I am a big foody ,we stumbled across this great Irish pub with hardly anybody there but the food was awesome so good that went back for lunch the second day and then had dinner the lamb shank the short ribs awesome . Staff was very friendly. By the way lunch entrees were only $8 where can you find that

This is a great company.  Mike is very professional he actually picks up the phone when you call.  Mike is all about customer service and doing the right thing.  This company is awesome I would highly recommend them to anyone looking to have a home inspection done.  Thanks Mike!!

I purchased a Group0n coupon for the Abbey and it gave us the opportunity to try it out.  I may be boring you with all the good reviews but I have no where to go but join the followers.  Firstly, the ambiance was comfortable upgraded casual and just perfect for any occasion.  The staff was on their toes and could explain all the dishes to a tee.  The menu is small but included some comfort foods that you might not expect.  I had the Crusty Salmon on a bed of mashed parsnips and shredded sprouts.  Very tasty and satisfying.  My hubby had the Chicken legs in a wonderful rich apricot sauce with white beans.  When you  are seated they promptly bring over a small cup of yummy popcorn.  Cute idea!!! Then the waiter presents 3 slices of the best ever brown bread of an unknown origin.  I could have eaten an entire loaf.  Of course, I asked for more.  They also have an extensive drink menu and a small but distinct dessert menu.  Didn't try either because I was quite full from the bread I consumed.

I'm a fan of Ritz-Carlton (RC)brand as there reputation in customer service and accommodations are well exceeds par. Disappointingly, the Philadelphia RC did not meet my expectation.

The highlight was there were 2 weddings on New Year's eve so the hotel was festive, lively and decorated accordingly. The club lounge was small and the selections were limited for those with healthier dietary preferences. The beauty in the club level was the backdrop of the vintage wooden walls carved to mid-century specifications.

We were upgraded to a suite and without coming off ungrateful, I was underwhelmed as the room did not seem modern or updated. So, I was a bit underwhelmed. Additionally, the water temperature was luke warm at best and for the reputation and cost, this was utterly unacceptable. The best part of the stay was the mattress was divine as I sunk into a cloud of firm fluffiness. Additionally, we had a great view of the Mummer's Day parade on New Year's day.

So, if all of the above was not enough, after I checked out, I was billed for items I did not have. Even after I spoke with front desk staff who was to make the correction, it took multiple calls for an actual correction to be made. 

Sadly, the stay at the Philadelphia RC was disappointing and I canceled 2 future reservations as I think there a better options in the city.

When I was looking online for a shop to work on my newly-purchased 2000 Boxster S, I knew from reading Schneider's website that they were the one to go with, and I was right. I wanted to start restoring the Boxster into top condition, and I am delighted with the work they did for me. The customer service is outstanding, and I am looking forward to the next stages of working together. 

It is such a great feeling to have trust and confidence that you are working with the best.

Been waiting for this place to open forevvvver and so glad it finally is! I had the best mani/pedi yesterday - so relaxing! The place is all new and modern. Love the "adult" but relaxing environment (wine please and thank you ) . However, the best part of this salon was the service I received from everyone who took care of me. Not a traditional nail salon where you feel rushed, misunderstood, or have to wait forevvvvvvvvver for a service. Can't wait to go back again!

The store is clean and well organized and the staff are super helpful I always stop by when I am back in the area of the city. But the dollar spot always seems to have new items. That's a big selection of clothing books an electronics.

I wish I could justify a higher review for WKND Hang Suite because my friends and I plowed through some of the most amazing chicken tenders, fried pickles and loaded fries any of us had ever had, but the service left something to be desired. The bartender was really helpful, but our server once we moved to a seating area seemed overwhelmed by the number of orders for food our group of 10+ ordered. Chicken tenders came out within ten minutes and yet fries inexplicably took over half an hour to arrive. Also, every surface in the place was incredibly sticky, from the bartop to the tables in our seating area.

The vibe at this place was awesome, and I'd love to go back to try their hookah and have some more of those chicken tenders, but I'm not sure I'll be back.

After being discouraged with the other local hobby shop in Tucson, I decided to switch my business over to Hobby barn. I walked in the door and saw two employees, neither of which acknowledged I was there. I stood in front of the counter for 6 minutes and watched them help two people who walked in the door after me and one guy who they were helping took two different phone calls and left the store, returning both times and they picked up right were they left off. I don't like being ignored. I don't need a red carpet welcome, but if I walk in to buy three Lipo batteries for my short course trucks and a range of parts, I do expect to be acknowledged. I left and decided to try HobbyTown again after a year of not going in ( similar experience a year ago) This time, I was met with a welcome as soon as I walked in the door ( she was even helping someone at the counter at the moment) Immediately an employee came over and helped me with my purchase. I even learned a few new things abut Lipos that I didnt know. I will be returning to HobbyTown in the future. I may give Hobbybarn another shot, but their customer service better be much improved.

I don't know where to begin. But quick summary: great prices, delicious tacos, chips and guacamole and perhaps best tacos I've had outside of San Diego!

My friend and I ordered chips and guacamole first and the chips were warm, nicely salted and tasted fresh. The guacamole was thick, and well seasoned, also tasted very fresh! The tacos themselves were amazing and I wish I had stopped to take a picture but as soon as I remembered after biting into the first one I said, no this food can't wait. The al pastor was good, but the carnitas and chorizo were fantastic. Some might call them a little spicy, but I think it makes it even better. I love that they also use two tortillas (I went with corn, but they also give you the option of wheat) so that the loaded tacos don't fall apart on you.

They have several options for drinks, including various flavors of Jarritos, but we opted for just water. 

Would definitely come back here next time I'm in PA. They should just open up one in MA.

Oh emm gee! We went to this location and the line seemed to not be moving. Then it started to move so we we committed to going through. When we finally make it to the lady to give our order, they said their grill was down and they only had fries, chicken, and nuggets. We literally were in the line for about 45 minutes if not more! What in the world! At that point, we couldn't even escape if we wanted to! When we got our food, there was ketchup packets in my daughters nuggets box, an extra fries wrapper, and my husbands fry box was all smushed

I went to Reilly's for FOOD for the first time not too long ago, for a friend's birthday party. All in all my experience was fair. The staff was very accommodating, albeit the service was definitely on the slow side. However, I will acknowledge that it was a bustling Saturday evening with a full house. For the table, we all shared a couple plates of their Brussels sprouts. I loved that they have some hot sauce mixed in with the sherry vinegar, making for a bold, in your face acidity that was very addicting with each bite. For mains, I tried their pasta special of the evening, which featured a pork sausage pasta with red squash sauce adorned with mascarpone. Unfortunately, I cannot recall the type of noodles. The flavors were pretty good, with the mascarpone adding a nice soft textural component contrasting with the crisped pork and al dente noodles. In addition the mascarpone helped cool down the hot pasta in a beautiful way. However, it felt like there was just something missing from the dish to elevate it to the next level- some spice perhaps?- to cut through the sweet richness of the sauce and cheese. Reilly's overall seems like a great place for celebrating an event or someone's achievements/birthday with solid food, but be aware of the higher price point.

I initially wanted my kitchen cabinets refaced but my husband decided in maybe redoing the whole cabinetry and layout. We already have an open concept so don't need any demo, have new flooring throughout - strictly just a concept and execution. I found them through Instagram, put in information and Rep came the next morning. For a small kitchen 12 cabinets total.. tile backsplash, farmhouse sink w/ white countertops- he said that would be $25,000 ( and that was doing me a "favor"). I was approved for the credit w their financing - but I still could not wrap my head around the fact that he quotes me a price without sitting down with a designer to pick styles, I had not chosen cabinets nor had he made any measurements.  When I said that to him, he cut me off numerous times and insisted it was the best there is, and no other company could match. Then when I asked about the bad reviews he said they were his competitors making them up. 
He called me the next morning and I continued to tell him to cancel any other credit lookups- I needed to look at other companies etc. He was practically arguing with me on the phone just to cancel my inquiry and to stop any other plan with him. He used wordage like "calm down" , "im anxious", and cut me off numerous times. How unprofessional!?
Decide for yourself if you use this company- but if I can't get a quote for a job without signing documents/ setting work in stone without seeing any pictures of work (besides your personal home kitchen that is nowhere near size or style)
or simply a layout design for my kitchen size- then I am not interested.

Some sandwiches are so good, that you take a bite, and before you can even swallow, you have to announce with a mouth full, "Wowwwwwww"
:

The St. Patty's Day Massacre from @bluelinesandwichco is an amazing remix to a classic Rueben, and it certainly made me have the aforementioned reaction. :
:
It's piled high with house-made corned beef that takes two weeks to make and a duck pastrami that is also made in house with duck breasts. And all that goodness is smashed together between incredible marble rye bread from a local bakery. :
:
They also make some more minor substitutions that create an extraordinary flavor.
Beer-braised (Canebrake) cabbage for sauerkraut.
Rémoulade aioli for Russian dressing.

This sandwich is a must try! Hope you enjoy.

My wife is a big fan of BK because she is a vegetarian and they are one of the few fast food restaurants that have a vegetarian burger on the menu. She goes quite often and is usually pretty pleased. Tonight she went to this location and just opened up her food enraged. 

Most pathetic looking medium French fry.

Burger was missing ketchup, onion, pickle and tomato. Clearly someone had no regard for the product they were selling or the customer. Avoid this loc
Love this hotel. Will come back here whenever I go back to New Orleans. Service was great rooms were clean. It was easy to get to conventions from the hotel.
Fantastic coffee, although there is a little vibe from the baristas -- if you don't know the secret hipster handshake, no friendliness.

First off, me and other renters were lied to about having a pet at 600 red lion rd, philadelphia.  We were told that the non refundable pet fee would go towards any damages or cleaning caused by the pet.  The form we signed said neither that nor did it say that is was just to let us have a pet, so in hindsight  neither is documented on the form...but either way at least one person in charge of accounts is lying to people saying that it goes towards damages and cleaning.

Upon receiving my exit bill when we moved out, I had a few questions, including the pet fee.  The person at collections was horrible rude and ignorant towards me and was not helpful or willing to answer questions I had.  I just sent an email to Kim...the person helping out on yelp but we'll see.  My bill is due this saturday and I don't want penalties for not paying it onetime wile I wait for them to get back to me.

We'll start with the good: The ambience, the location, the food. 

Black bean burrito came with a basket of well seasoned, perfectly hot and salty fries. SO yum. 

Crabcake sandwich was on point! A generous size, fresh, seasoned and hearty. You definitely get your money's worth for food vs. money price.

Now what I didn't like: our waitress. Who was SO uninvolved in her job I almost thought someone was playing a joke on us. She was less than thrilled to be there. Shuffled to the table, shuffled away. If I didn't know better, I would have assumed she spent the night drinking at her own bar and had a hangover. 

Second: they had every beer in the world there. So, I figured I was safe with a Sam Summer and my friend ordered a Mike's. Nope. Okay. She went with the Granny Cider. I ordered a Blueberry Ale. Nope, try again. REALLY?! After my boyfriend went to the bar for the 3rd time,  I jokingly said "If they don't have this one or this one, I just want water." 

So, minus a star for not having beer that I wanted (twice) and a really odd/intimidating waitress. But, not enough to detract from what B and B really is. 

I'm stoked there is someplace solid in Hville AND with good food and beer. My Philly Pale Ale though, was amazing. 

I just want to point out real quick I notice a lot of people mentioning things about pricing. I was born and raised in PA and moved to CT 15 years ago. I come back to visit often. This place is a dime a dozen where I am HOWEVER, you'd be talking $18-25 for these dishes that people would happily pay. I honesty thought $13 for a sandwich with fries was cheap. Obviously I've lived in CT way too long but man oh man, appreciate what you have. I'd kill to have a place like this up there with these prices. They'd do a killing!

Such a great addition to downtown. Popped in for to go blintzes last week (and made my entire office extremely jealous, that vanilla sauce though!) and just grabbed the chopped salad, and a delish apricot cookie I can't remember the name of, for lunch today. Everything has been so delicious so far, and I can't wait to try the whole menu. Also a big thanks to the gentleman working the deli take out side today for letting me sample the maple/sea salt bagel chips, they're my new favorite thing.

We wanted something to eat near the condo we rented.  Being on the water and having an outdoor seating area, this sounded like a perfect spot to watch the sunset.  The bartender was attentive,  the food mediocre.  My crab cakes arrived like warm.  My husband had The nutty grouper, it was okay. The atmosphere was divey, but the live musician was great!  Good place for a beverage and sunset watching.

I love doing yoga here! The staff is very friendly and will adjust your positions if you are doing them incorrectly.  Also, they occasionally use aromatherapy and every now and then will give you samples of essential oils (if you want them) during your savasana.

Went here last weekend on the recommendation of a friend. We are both from the east coast and have high expectations for our seafood! The sushi was better than average, although not the best I've ever had. The restaurant itself was cute and family friendly. The reason I'm only giving this place 3 stars is the service. We waited almost a half hour for our order to be taken, and another half hour for our food to get to the table. It wasn't very crowded either so no excuse in my opinion for the slow service. Maybe next time we'll try the take out to bypass the long wait of eating in person.
Love the Halibut with crab on top with lemon rice!  Light and refreshing. Wine list was fantastic!

Holy cow!! I have tried most of the barbecue places around St. Louis and this was hands down the best! The people were friendly and helpful. The restaurant is fun and interesting. I had the pulled pork and it was so amazing. It was tender and smokey. The sauces were unbelievable. They have a white sauce with horseradish in it that is so incredible I considered taking the bottle home!! The sides are pretty normal and they also have dessert including a White Russian milkshake. I was too full to try it but I will be sure to go back for more!! Do yourself a favor and try this place soon.

Excellent fast service. Had soup of the day-spicy tomato bisque. It was outstanding. Had the filet with shrimp. Both done just right for me. Blueberry cheesecake cobbler for desert.  I'd recommend it any time.

Same food as all IHOPs but great service. They we not busy when we went for breakfast, but as we got our food i noted all th etables filled quickly. Ther service did not suffer, and the manager came by for good measure to make sure everything was ok. Pleasant staff and clean. For the most part the clientelle is well behaved. Though there was some guy who was yelling on the phone with his doctor's office about him needing a prescription, but otherwise no rif-raff.

I was really craving some Thai food today, and I was hoping this would hit the spot. I was partially correct. I started out with Thai Toast, which is pretty much deep-fried pork French toast (absolutely DELICIOUS, highly recommended if you want to try something different) with a sweet/spicy cucumber sauce. I had high standards for the curry, because it is something that I love very much and this place had decent reviews. I ordered Massaman Curry with beef, medium. The sides (Tom Yum soup and a veggie spring roll) came out first. The spring roll was delicious, served with a sweet dipping sauce. The soup was good, nothing special. Needed more fish sauce. My friend had Pad See Ewe, which was also alright, nothing special. Then came my bowl of curry, which is served with rice. At first, I was taken aback by how dark the curry looked. Normally it's pretty light in color, but this was a reddish, caramel-y brown and looked too thick. Already I was weary. I mixed some with my rice and it wasn't what I was expecting. It was almost sickeningly sweet, if you're eating a whole bowl, as if someone had finished it with a jar of peanut butter (turns out it was peanut sauce). Curry is supposed to be thin, and Massaman curry is supposed to have peanuts, not be an overwhelming bowl of beef, potatoes and peanut butter. The service was okay, the waiter was nice. I was overall unimpressed.

I have been back regularly since my review.

Having overcome my hesitance about the quirky advertising with cows asking humans to eat more chickens (that's another dissertation about social morality), and eaten a few other things beyond the Sausage, Egg and Cheese Biscuit (5 Stars), I achieved the realization that I was too harsh in my evaluation before. 

The sandwiches are good, the shakes superior, and the playroom for kids, unique.  I don't have to agree with corporate politics to appreciate the grub. 

Okay. I am a fan. I am willing to admit it.
I've been here a few times and they were always fast, friendly, and the food was as ordered.  The catfish is as good as any I've ever had and better than most.

Very affordable and amazing food. I had the ropa vieja and the short rib was so moist and flavorful on recommendation of one of the waiters. My friend's eggplant parm was huge and so good he said. Definitely shareable portions. The empanadas were crispy and Cobb salad was super fresh. The food came out in less than ten minutes piping hot and it was a Stellar and affordable meal!!

I wanted to inform you of the poor customer service I experienced today (10/27/2011) at your Philadelphia store.

Early in the day, I found a men's raincoat that I liked and planned on purchasing on my way home from the office.  The big bonuses were that a) I found something that fit me b) was reasonably priced and c) was 20% off thanks to signs posted throughout the store stating "20% off all outerwear - excluding shearling and leather".  (see attached graphic that I received in my e-mail this morning as well).

I placed the jacket on hold and went back before I got on my train to purchase the coat.  When it was rung up, it came up as regular price.  I asked the cashier (Gladys) to find out why it wasn't coming up with the discount.  A manager came by and said that raincoats were not included.  I asked why, and she stated (again) that raincoats were not included.  Unhappy with this, I decided to leave and catch my train.

As I was walking to the door, I found myself very unsatisfied with this explanation, so I went back to the counter.  This time, a male manager was at the counter, so I asked him why the raincoat wasn't considered outerwear.  His response to me was that the signs said it was on women's outerwear only (which they did not state).  I asked why the signs were in the men's department, to which he replied that raincoats weren't included.  I asked if raincoats were considered outerwear (as they are in every other store, and by common sense, and rarely do people wear raincoats indoors), and he stated that that was just the way it was, and raincoats were not included.

I consider the customer service I received to be disappointing, especially when I was correct in the assumption that raincoats are outerwear and should have been provided the discount.  Apparently, the managers at the Philadelphia store are more concerned with turning away a sale rather than the old adage of the customer always being right.

(10/30/2011 - still no response from e-mail or voicemail that was left)
Can't believe I haven't been here sooner. Any spice I need I found. Great selection and prices!

My boyfriend and I ate at Snapper's last weekend on Sunday the 20th on the last night of our getaway weekend. We came in very late, about 15 minutes before close, and were concerned and apologetic for being presumably the last guests of the evening. The hostess was super accommodating and seemed genuine when telling us it wasn't a problem. We sat outside and were quickly greeted by our server Melanie. She helped us choose a bottle of wine and walked us through the menu and giving us recommendations. We ordered the seared tuna and stuffed grouper and added on a crab cake both entrees were served with a dinner salad, which was delicious and a nice portion. We had just enough time to enjoy a little wine before our entrees arrived. Both dinners were fantastic. The fish was fresh and prepared beautifully, and the portions were huge. The crab cake was one of the best we've ever had. At this point, the restaurant was closed, and we encouraged Melanie to feel free to work on her closing responsibilities, but she continued to be attentive and make sure we were taken care of. She didn't flinch when we wanted dessert and a glass of port, again taking the time to make recommendations. We had the most wonderful dinner. We were hoping to take our time and really enjoy ourselves, and Melanie really made that possible. The food and wine were incredible, the atmosphere warm and comfortable. Snapper's was perfect for our last night of vacation birthday date. If ever in the St Pete area again, we will certainly return, and if you are looking for a nice restaurant for a nice evening out, Snappers is where you should go!

Been in a lot of airports in my lifetime so to have a decent bite to eat before a long flight is vital. The Green Iguana is the place for a good burger or sandwich before boarding. A Southwest bacon burger with sweet potato fries is my choice and theirs is decent. Price for two people with soda was approximately $41 without tip, a little pricey however food was freshly made and not the usual grab and go microwaved food from airport kiosks. Staff was competent, friendly and assured one was comfortable. Will make it a point to stop there in my future trips.

Thompson's claims to be America's oldest mail order cigar company, and I must say I think that it must be true, because the speed at which they're processing and shipping my order certainly reminds me of a time before the internet, when companies could survive with turnaround times measured in weeks.

I suspect that visiting the store in person gives customers a very different experience, as clearly, a lot of the happy customers are those who enter the store to make their purchases. As for mail order, sadly this company lives up to its reputation for glacial speed, so I advise those who demand better to go elsewhere.

My wife and I came to celebrate our 29th anniversary as we have been here quite a few times through the years and have really enjoyed ourselves.  Tonight was not one of those nights. It was a Sunday night and we arrived about 8:30 pm. The restaurant was mostly empty so we were seated right away but that's when things started going south. 

It took forever for the waiter to show up. "I didn't see you guys tucked away in the corner", he said. So after waiting for him to show up, we felt rushed in placing our order. The waiter took our order without writing it down (impressive I thought but wait). We ordered the crab cakes for an app and my wife ordered the copper river salmon and I ordered the chicken and spinach pizza. 

After waiting a while the waiter shows up with the entree's. I asked where our crab cakes were. He said he forgot. I was so tempted to say, "I guess you should have written it down!" but I didn't. So we did not have our app. 

My wife's salmon looked and tasted great (it should have, it was $38). My pizza was 3/4 burnt. I mean burnt, not toasted. 

This place screams for help.

I've never eaten inside, but I've gotten takeout once a week for almost two months now. I moved to the neighborhood and decided to order some pho, now I get it all the time. The spring rolls are amazing too. It's always ready in about ten minutes!

Irritated.  Woefully under prepared for lunchtime.  Not ready for the open of business.  Taking orders and no money in the cash register.  Food for preferential customers (guys that work for the Beer distributor that were making a delivery) was expedited before my order even though I had paid and was sat before they finished paying.

That said.  Food wasn't, "knock your socks off". Just an average taco, with an emphasis on clever sayings on t-shirts.

This was a great place for a corporate event.  We had about 40 people there, and we had out pictures taken with an Indycar in front of a green screen.  Sounds kind of silly, but people loved it!  It's amazing how quickly the camera bug bites when there are props involved... Especially when one of the props is a cool-looking car.

The space itself has some great cars in the front area.  They then take you back towards the factory to watch a short movie about the history of Dellara Automobili.  When the movie is over, they open up a garage door for a tour of the factory.  It's really amazing to see how clean and relatively sparse it all is.  It doesn't seem like a "factory" like you'd imagine it (or at least not the way I imagined it), but it's pretty impressive all the same.  They also showed a giant hole in the ground, which doesn't seem that cool until you learn about the cool new state-of-the-art driving simulator they are going to install there.  It's only the third in the world, and it will be the first in the US (the other two are in Italy).

When we finished the tour, we got to play around with some slightly less cutting edge driving simulators, which was a lot of fun.  What was even more fun was watching how competitive some of our group became (and how many of us were "disqualified" for reckless driving).  There's also a great coffee bar attached, which serves really delicious Italian coffee.  The staff was really nice and answered all our questions, even though most of the people in the crowd were definitely not super knowledgeable about racing.  The space is brand new, so it's really modern and airy.  Definitely highly recommended for any racing fans or wanna-be fans, and a fun and different spot for a group event.

We took my cousin here for her 21st birthday. We made reservations, and when they seated us they had put confetti on the table for her with a birthday card. The waiters were friendly and the food was delicious! We had oysters rockefeller for an appetizer and for my entree I had a filet mignon special. It was really good! We also tried a bunch of their desserts, which all tasted as good as they looked. I would recommend this place if you are looking for a more upscale restaurant. If you're gonna spend tons of $$ at the casino, you might as well spend some to eat a great meal!

I go here before movies at the Ritz or other Old City outings. I love it! Most recently I went on a Sunday night and had some excellent beers. My bartender knew his beers and gave me wonderful recommendations. Will definitely go again.

Jax has some really great reviews and showed some great potential. The menu is definitely new and interesting and the service is good. Our server was always available to answer our questions about the food and make recommendations on what to eat.

We ordered a nice variety of their dishes to try: duck street caramelos, steamed mussels, heirloom spinach salad, house made french fries, roasted cauliflower and the red velvet cake.

As promising as it all seemed, I can not say that the food really impressed me. The duck street caramelos were a little on the greasy side, the mussels were ok, the heirloom spinach salad was kind of weird, the french fries were standard and so was the cauliflower. While is was well touted, the red velvet cake was nothing spectacular. 

I really wanted to like the food here, because of the upstanding service we got, but it all fell flat.

.One Eyed Jacks once upon a time used to be the Shim Sham Club and I would go to 80's night most weeks. I don't remember when the name changed, but the vibe is pretty much still the same. The front room with a bar is isolated from the man room and is a good to spot to grab a drink and relax. The main room is great for small scale concerts and has a large circular bar. I've seen some really great shows here as well as had fun nights just hanging out and listening to music with friends.

The only down side for me is that it's in the French Quarter, which means it's often a hassle to park and, well, it's the Quarter. At least it's off the main touristy area. When bands I want to see come to town and have a show listed at OEJ, I definitely have to see about clearing my schedule for that night.
Nice people. Good coffee and croissants. Good bread. I became acquainted with them at local farmers markets. Hope they keep it up

Went in to this location and had a blast. Had an issue with some hats I had purchase that didn't fit and after a resolution with the manager they resolved the issue. Good customer service. 

Clean place, very cool golf, and great food and drink. 

Their flagship location in Vegas is a must see too. Highly recommend checking all locations out.

Excited to go to my first Emeril LaGasse restaurant.  Great atmosphere and decor.  Best dish we had was the crab fettuccine.  Steak was in the cold side and underseasoned, missing the smoky taste of the robata grill they have.  Cornbread muffin was good, my husband loved it.  Calamari was fresh but missing some seasoning too.

Wine list was great and the desserts kind of disappointing though the cotton candy seemed popular.

Joe is very honest and knows bikes.  I will give them a 5 star once they open the new expansion and increase the selection.  right now i buy based on best deal ($) and have Joe service my gear.  

Adding the soda fountain will make stopping by to say hi even sweeter.

This is not my first time getting a brazilian wax, but it was my first time here and I WON'T be back. First of all, they did not ask whether I wanted a "landing strip" (which I already had), and REMOVED mine without asking. And once they put wax on the hair, you can't "no that's not what I wanted." It's too late. And you'd think that if I already had a landing strip, you'd just touch up and keep what I already had. Makes no sense. And afterwards, I texted a friend who I found out had been here and had the same experience - they didn't ask if she wanted to maintain her landing strip and just removed it without asking.

On top of that, the room was dirty. The floor and counter just looked disgusting and unhygienic and there were long pubic hairs on the ground. Not confidence-instilling.

Third issue was that they asked me about medications that can make your skin pull off (accutane, etc) AFTER my wax when I checked out. Not before.

Went because of the price, but it's cheap for a reason. Will not be back and will definitely recommend others against going here.

I hadn't gone to a "real" salon for years--I've never loved my hair so I always just tried to do the minimum. I was really tired of my style, though, so I went to Volume on a friend's recommendation. I didn't ask for anyone in particular and I got Kelsey for coloring and Natasia for the cut. Both did an outstanding job.

Kelsey understood that I wanted to blend my roots and ends, and was very careful about planning and then adjusting as she went to make sure the effect was strong enough but not over the top for me. She also made it clear I could come back in for a correction if it felt too bright after a few days. We finished early although she was very attentive. I haven't noticed any damage at all from the color.

Natasia was great about advising what cut would work for my hair texture and how much effort and product I'm willing to put in (almost none!) I came in with an idea and she frankly told me it was going to require a lot more maintenance than I wanted to do, so I really appreciated that honesty and did something safer. A week later, however, I was still wishing for more of a change, so I called back and stopped by for a bang trim. In 10-15 minutes Natasia took a little more off based on some photos I brought in, and now I have EXACTLY the look I want with zero additional maintenance to do! I actually woke up this morning with my hair looking precisely the way I hoped. That has never happened for me before. For the first time, I actually feel like my hair adds something distinctive to my look, and I have a style I feel is worth keeping up with the salon. Bonus points to Natasia for the fact that my photos were weird and I was asking for something that didn't look pretty per se--she didn't bat an eye.

Thanks so much, Volume! I'm a very happy customer.

So I came in here with my wife and we both ordered lattes and shared a pistachio ice cream. Based on my latte I would give the place a 3.5-4 stars because it was light and easy to drink with a mild flavor. However, consistency of lattes is an issue. My wife asked me how I was liking my latte and I said it was okay and described it exactly as above. She was surprised and grabbed my cup to taste it and then forced me to try hers, which tasted like burnt coffee with dirty water, it was terrible. She had been trucking through it only because I seemed to be enjoying mine.

I'm not too sure if we're going to come back. Maybe for ice cream, but not for coffee.
Thai food and Japanese food? Perfection. Panang Curry and Pad See Ew make a glorious combination. Yes, please!

After hitting Victory for round one, and having no where to sit.  we decided go to west bradford.

It's nice to go to a bar, that isn't all full of itself.  

We had some great Beer, and I ordered buffalo shrimp.  atmosphere is VERY laid back. I would say it's not a "hip" "cooler than you" place.  it's relaxed easy going with a "cheers" neighborhood bar feel.  your not there to be seen, but to have a good time with friends.

Based on reviews I flew to Philadelphia to have a birthday celebration.  I've never been more disappointed in food.  Had a party of 11 and with tip it was well over 700.  Food is not good Italian.  The signature Gnocchi dish was fist sized dough balls. Hard to believe but even bread was bad tasted like stale rye never had that in Italian restaurant. Despite the reviews it was awful

We came to Tampa for an impromptu vacation and wanted to find a non-chain coffee place.  The coffees were tasty; the staff was courteous; and the facilities were well kept.  We liked it so much we went twice!  Added bonus - there is also a Pokéstop nearby.
This is one of the worst Goodwill's around. Dirty. Not very nice items inside. I go to alot of Goodwill's and this one I would not go back to.

Went to Pats to check out the hype about the inventor of philly cheesesteaks :) The chessesteak itself was ok, didnt live up to its hype. I loved the round peppers that they have outside that you can put into ur sandwich. they were absolutely delish and well worth the trip there! We went around 5 pm on a sunday so there wasnt too much of a wait..

I heard of St. Elmo from word of mouth and decided to give it a shot.  This place is huge and has a lot of seatting.  My hotel set me up with a reservation, which you need.  We arrived early and told us that if I gave them my phone number they would text me when they are ready.  That worked well and they texted at the orginal reservation time.  We got seated in the basement and it was quite loud.  I looked around and saw everyone from familys with kids, adults drinking on wine and being loud, and businessmen looking at their phones the entire time not saying a word to eachother. It made me laugh.   

Options of food was good and classic.  Everything was just perfect and very filling! I will go back again.
Great area and great service. Clam chowder was great and so was the miso salmon. Not sure about the crab cake. The scallop was really good.

Forget Pat's / Geno's / Jim's / Steve's / most other places, Cleavers has one of the top cheesesteaks in the city. Sure their menu is all encompassing and has some pretty unique options, but when you get down to it, their steak is one of the best. I've gotten to the point now where I'll go and mix it up and get the Papa's Favorite, or the Pizazz, maybe throw in some Waffle Fries for good measure. Oh and did I mention, they have almost a hundred bottles of beer behind the counter that you can buy and drink upstairs while eating (and watching a game on TV?) Make that 99 bottles.

I have not visited this winery yet, but I have tried some of their reds. I must say that it was one of the best bottles of Pinot Noir that I have ever had! We enjoyed it so much that we will be ordering more so that we can share with our friends and dinner guests. Will definitely make a point to stop by Summerland when I am in the area. I especially want to acknowledge Shannon Slaught for assisting me with my purchase. She is very personable and pleasant to talk to.
New in the neighborhood, really nice decor, hard to see from street, in back next to Wendy's. Friendly staff, nice bar.

This is the best bar I've been too in Philly. A perfect place for birthday drinks with my boyfriend. The entrance is hidden, below street level so you really feel like you're at a speakeasy. The interior is beautifully decorated. Lovingly restored to 1920s charm with wonderful tiles and sumptuous colors. Dark with candlelit intimacy, this bar is a perfect place for a date. A relaxing evening indeed. 

Our server was excellent. Friendly and answered questions as needed. He was not overbearing and verbose as some servers at other high end bars and restaurants can be. I think if we'd wanted him to, he would have told us about every drink on the menu in painstaking detail; but, he saw that we were on a date and just wanted to relax together and gave us space. We each got two drinks, though I don't remember what they were called. All were delicious and unique. This is mixology at its best. I like how the menu is organized into different styles of cocktails (traditional, strong, daring, etc.). 

We will definitely return. Drinks + service + ambience make this a perfect bar.

This little place is such a gem. It's charming and candlelit, and look up, because the light fixtures are really cool. 

We started with the mussels, which came in this nice sauce. Delicious. I got the lobster ravioli, and it was also divine. Creamy and the perfect temperature. I hear that toasted ravioli is a St. Louis thing, but this was even better. 

The service was great. They have these tiny glasses for water and even though I was going through them fast, there was always someone filling up my glass. Loved it!

I've been in here a few time it's severely convenient to trolley area but unfortunately the fro yo is not so good. Didn't like it the first or second time I was in there. The second time I was there there was a customer and employee yelling at each other. Not sure what it was about I wasn't trying to get in on it but it was not customer friendly during that time. Inside the place looks old and doesn't have comfy seats. This place has potential but just not there yet. Also very small.

My father-in-law turned me on to the Scotsman a few years back.  Excellent service from a non-pushy staff---buying and selling couldn't be easier.  If you're interested in keeping regular tabs on bullion values the gold and silver trading sheets are a great tool.

Decent Chinese food but not impressed with the sushi...the sushi is put out in such large quantities for each type of roll, that it takes forever for the turnover such that a new, fresh roll is created.  Koi, in Hermitage, is much better for sushi.  I did not try the Hibachi part of this restaurant, although there was a pretty long line for it, and it looked like there were quite a few options to put in your hibachi order.  I will say that there were quite a few non-Chinese things particularly if there is someone in your party that might not care for Chinese, sushi, or hibachi.
Super friendly staff and a great spot for lunch. Salad was a little weird but not bad!
Really long line, get there early.  The chargrilled oysters are awesome!!! Friendly staff!

I loved the Read and Eat. Friendly staff, really cozy, perfect place to spend a day working from home. There's tons of space to spread out, lots of outlets for laptops, and I actually loved the coffee (plus my apple muffin was DA BOMB!!). My only complaint was that it was a little too chilly in there for me to hunker down all day. But it's still a work in progress, so I'll be back! It's so nice to have an alternative to Starbucks in Roxborough.
Mediocre pub atmosphere with no redeeming qualities and incredibly rude staff. There are much better neighborhood pub options nearby.

Oh my goodness what a magical day! My appointment was on time and Audrey was as sweet as could be and very attentive! It was perfect to go mid week! She helped me and another client but it feels like VIP one on one! They had undergarments and shoes and everything to try with the dress. We even had time left over to look at brides maid dresses. I did come prepared though! Use their app and save dresses they carry to your favorites to streamline your visit. The price was amazing too for beautiful satin with lace overlay and beading,  silhouette. Thank you Audrey and David's Bridal!

#AlmostFamous

I visited Famous Steak & Lemonade on the recommendation of a family member. While I'm not s huge fan of fried food, sometimes the mood just strikes me. Famous is decidedly ok. The staff are quite friendly, and the space itself is clean and well maintained. I was surprised by the various goods for sale in the storefront restaurant. I've never been inside a bodega, but I imagine that Famous shares some of the same features and items available for sale. 

The food is well cooked, but slightly under-seasoned. That was disappointing, as I asked for additional seasoning on my order. The food is fresh, and orders are prepared quickly, which is a plus. Famous wouldn't be my first choice for this type of cuisine, but it will certainly do in a pinch.

I will always be amazed at the extreme incompetence most of the pharmacy staff here have.  Once I switched to a different pharmacy, I haven't ran into a single issue.  Here, it was always problems and extreme rudeness.  I actually pick up one of my prescriptions now at a different CVS (on 7th) and they have been awesome, so it must be the staff at this location,  not CVS itself.

Stopped in today after church to have lunch with my bride and one of the men serving at Royal Family Kids Camp this year.

We've been here several times in the past and always enjoy the pizza. You can buy a slice and drink for a reasonable price. I love the simple layout in the dining area, benches and tables (cafeteria style). I was looking forward to our visit today, which is why it pains me a little to write this review. 

The first thing that hit me about the place today was the heat, it was hot and muggy in the restaurant providing no relief from the heat outside. In fact, it was a relief to walk out after lunch because we were able to escape the humidity/mugginess.

When we place dour order, the guy behind the counter was a little less than enthused to be there. Granted, it is probably because he had to be there without relief from the humidity in the room so please understand this is not an attack on his character. In fact, when I ordered a pitcher of soda he was nice enough to remind us that when buying a slice of pizza we receive a free drink. I think he did his job to the best of his ability. Customer service could use a boost, but I think that issue would be resolved if they provided a cooler or more suitable environment.
