After my manicure I got my eyebrows waxed and I didn't feel a thing. The woman who did the waxing, has a technique to stop the pain. She even did my lip and there wasn't any pain either. 

I'd definitely come here again and recommend this place to everyone!

Wow! I was so amazed when I came into MOD's and starting eating my custom made pizza! It is also kid-friendly because you can order a small pizza! I was so amazed! Customer service is absolutely outstanding! You must come here or else...

I loved my pizza! I just needed to have more when I was done! I would obviously give this a 5 star! I would recommend this pizzeria to those all time pizza lovers!

Everything about On Swann was fresh, updated, modern, and inviting. The staff started our experience out perfectly. We were greeted with friendly smiles and were seated right away. 
The restaurant has a totally open floor plan, so the chill vibe resonates throughout. 
The menu is detailed with an option for everyone. Our server, Skyler, was VERY friendly and knowledgeable.  He suggested a few of their signature cocktails to start - the blueberry Mojito and a cucumber drink that was to die for (although we were there a week ago and I can't remember what it was called)
We had nibblers, a starter and entrees. The kale salad is nothing short of fantastic and the scallops just melt in your mouth. The portions were just right that you leave feeling totally satisfied but not stuffed. 
We cannot wait to get back there and try a few other menu items. 
From the locally sourced decor, to the farm fresh food and amazing atmosphere, On Swann is definitely going to become a regular spot for us.

Came here for lunch and they were out of the 2 things I wanted. The server (young guy with long blonde hair) was awesome and kept checking on us. 

Came back Sunday to watch March Madness after brunch and bottomless mimosas were over and the service was TERRIBLE! The girl brought out all 6 of our food at different times and gave my husband half of his meal and said they were making more of the sauce for the other half. My mimosa (that I was now paying full price for) was 85% OJ. 

Nice for games because of the big TV but the people working there seem to care about hanging out with their friends that are there than serving the people. There are better places in Nashville.
Great place for Friday Night! The winner wing are the best chicken wing that i ever had in my life! It's soooooooooooooooooooooooo goodddddddddddddd!
Excellent food.  Had the St. Peter's dish. The Peach mimosa is outstanding. Sidewalk cafe allowed for people watching. Gets really packed after 10:00am. Lance was a great waiter.

Awful service. After 30 min no one had served us and the bar tender gave us attitude. 
After a long day at work the last thing I wanted is not feeling welcome and that's what happened

We went for dinner tonight. They food was outstanding. We got sexy fries and fried pickles to start. The sexy fries had hollandaise sauce, truffle oil and parmesan cheese. They were so good. They put the sauce on the bottom so the fires don't get soggy. 
My son had a bacon burger which was great. The bacon was cooked perfect and the burger was juicy. I had the crab cake sandwich it was very good
My husband got the chicken fried steak. And said it was amazing. 
The owner came around to check on us. He was so friendly.
I will say it was 30 min wait. But totally worth it. The food came out so fast. It was the fastest service we have ever had. And the waitress was super helpful and friendly. 
We can't wait to go back.

The service is poor. The food is fair to good. The décor is good. Lunch prices ok, but dinner expensive. Staff seems confused too often. Walked-in for one time for takeout and took 30 minutes, only 2 other tables. Today I got overcharged for my take-out, just a buck for shrimp, but I got chicken, ticket says shrimp, but got chicken at shrimp price. I'll give them another try, but cannot recommend without warning.

Pizza is good not great - again, the wisdom ultimately prevails; even if pizza is bad, it's still pretty good. Here's why you like this place. Open anytime a person might want pizza, despite their condition. Actual conversation with staff: "When do you close?" Response: "We are open all times." Dangerous, but thank you.

My husband and I go here fairly often and we have always had excellent, friendly service. This past Sunday we needed a meal on the go, so we went to our favorite fast place, KFC! The person taking our order was so friendly and delightful that my husband and I got caught up with talking about how nice she was and that we were going to make a point of posting a review later, that when she handed us our drinks we were like, "Great, thanks!" And happily drove off without having gotten our food yet. Haha! Our fault, not hers. We had to loop around and go in to get our meal. The staff laughed and and joked, "Were you not hungry anymore?" All very positive and friendly. We make a point of going to this specific location whenever we get that KFC craving. :)
Hands down the BEST frozen yogurt ever. Try the yogurt with the semisweet chocolate sauce and strawberries. That's the Bamba. Will definitely be back.

Went there with my family during our visits in Tampa. Our server was super nice, didn't get his name, but he has a lot of earrings :). The food was fresh, loved the fact that everything was grass fed or organic. We had the tavern burger, acorn squash plate, chips and fish and the F...ck Monsanto salad. The last plate was mine, I took it because of the name ;-). It tasted very good, but the portion was too small in my opinion. 
The reason I didn't give it a five star, was because of the smell when you walked in.   It's not bad, it's just weird. We decided to sit outside, it was a beautiful night. 
I definitely recommend this place to anyone.
This is an amazing taco place. Very casual but great street tacos. It's cash only and there are no options for vegetarian options but if you are a carnivore you should definitely try it!
This is a place people in Reno enjoy? I'm confused! My wife makes better chicken wings at home! This was a huge disappointment. I've had better from my deep fryer which doesn't get used often.

Popped in for a quick easy lunch after a visit to Sunken Garden (across the street).

This location has plenty of seating and was kept nice and clean.

The staff was friendly and we were able
To place our outer pretty quickly. Food came up right away.

Each of us did the pick two - my husband did a roast beef panini with broccoli and cheese soup. Pretty good but the sandwich was pretty light for the price. I went wit the seasonal turkey, apple and cheddar with squash soup. Soup is a little too sweet for my liking and the sandwich was OK the cranberry wheat bread is kind of doughy.

I like the lower sugar drink options, some of the teas and lemonades are really refreshing.

Truthfully, the three star review has a lot to do with the value for price paid -
The food here is amazing! They actually grow their own vegetables! One of the best Asian restaurants Tucson has to offer by far!

I'm here right now...Dinner took waaaay to long to serve and while we were waiting, no one refilled water or removed empty wine bottles...calamari plates scalding, but calamari obviously sat in window before being served...chewy, really chewy...food only warm...and flavorless and bland!!! Had to use so much salt to add something to flavor!...been here before and all was excellent...not tonight!!!  Server brings "free dessert," but states "some people get it and some people don't"...never looking eye to eye at me...

Pretty good handyman.  They did decent quality work for a reasonable price.  They were polite and courteous, which I really appreciated.  Not all handymen/ contractors know the meaning of good customer service but these guys did!  

If I need more work done in the future I wouldn't mind giving these guys a call again.

I needed a rubber stamp made for my new business cards. I decided to order from a local company instead of finding something online.

I called first and was given an email address to send my artwork too. They also do in house design if you don't have your own artwork. The stamps are made within a couple days after your artwork is sent. You can rush it and have it same day for only 10 extra dollars.

I actually asked if I could watch the stamp process from start to finish. Debbie was happy to ask if I could. I ended up going in on Thursday morning of last week and watched Carol, the stamp master, at work. It took about an hour start to finish. The whole staff was more than accommodating. I asked so many questions and the staff was happy to answer.

I would recommend this company to anyone looking for stamps, signs, badges etc. 

Thank you again Indy rubber stamp!

So this is for their delivery.. but from reading the other reviews, I'm definitely going to walk over and try it.  I love all the new restaurants popping up in the Lower Garden, and this one is no different. 

The breakfast my friend and I ordered was absolutely amazing. I'm a sucker for any kind of breakfast sandwich, and theirs was ridiculously delicious. And make sure you order the bacon. So. Good. It's cash only for delivery, but that's no surprise for New Orleans. And they were pretty quick compared to a lot of other restaurants that deliver  in the area.  

..and even though it was a great hangover cafe, it's definitely a good everyday kinda meal as well.

I've been to the BBI two times in the last 8 weeks.  The service has been average/adequate.  Noise level is a bit high.  Food has been very good.  Love the look and feel of the place.

I agree they need to figure out the food service/server thing.  Level of competence needs improvement.   At the patio, I didn't notice a real willingness to serve people cocktails...rather I had to go to the bar.  Should be licking their chops to get cocktails in hands of customers.

They will figure out the bumps...but all in all, I am a fan!
We have been eating for here for many years and the food and service is always the best. One of our favorite places to eat great Thai cuisine.

I had not eaten here for a long time, and since I was in the neighborhood, i thought I'd stop in as I remembered it as being a pretty good steak shop. It was started by the guy who was one of the originals at Jim's. 
 Well Jim's (or almost anyplace else) has nothing to fear from Abner's. The place has really gone to seed, and my sandwich was undersized, the roll was doughy, and there was a vaguely funky taste that came from the onions. It looked like the grille could use a cleaning, and the rest of the place seemed a little hygiene-impaired. Oh well.
Food was delish and fresh! Service was great! Oyster appetizers were off of hook.. blacken catfish was excellent!

Stopped in for a little lunch date with our baby, staff was friendly and accommodating and food was very good. Simple well crafted menu, lots of cocktails to choose from- we will have to try next time. Small but well selected beer options also. Loved the atmosphere and decor and our waitress was pleasant and knowledgeable. Would recommend to foodie friends and will go again.

Believe the hype.  The roast beef sandwich is better than anything I've had before.  The sharp provolone and broccoli rabe are the perfect complement   Just the thought of the provolone is making my mouth water, and the broccoli rabe add a bit of bite, but not overpowering.  The bun was fresh and soaked up the juices without falling apart.

There was a long line even at 3pm when I was there, but I only waited about 20 minutes.  It was worth it.

I owe a review to one of my favorite beers in Indianapolis. The Rail Splitter. This is a great place to stop and relax after a bike ride, trip to the farmers market, and shopping at the surrounding boutiques. Though for me, one trip to Triton did encourage a trip to the boutique across the street.

This is place is great for it's patio, service, and food offerings. You can order food from any of the neighboring restaurants, which is something I particularly love. Or you enjoy the snack bags they have laid out. These snacks can be pretty dangerous. 

The inside can be a tad loud for me but you should really come here on a beautiful day outside. Sit on the deck with a great beer, great company, and great people and dog watching.

Vietnamese beef sandwich - delicious and refreshing. Ambience was also quite nice, rustic and romantic, but also great for big groups. 

Service however, not so great, but I would still go back for a meal.
My meal and service were excellent! Colossal shrimp app, lobster bisque and the main entree of North Carolina Whale soft shell crab were all great. Definitely go here, you will enjoy!

I really want to like the Franklin Institute Science museum...really I do, but after going to the special exhibits such as the Game Master exhibit and The Terracotta Warrior exhibit earlier last year, I think this museum caters for a much younger crowd with parents with larger wallets. I think despite the large size, much of the exhibits are awkwardly arranged at far corners of the museum, making the journey to see each small exhibit seem more of a chore than exploration. The entry ticket is also not cheap, and in comparison to the Boston museum of science, I think the Franklin Institute has much more room to improve.

So after a few attempts to eat here, during peak breakfast/brunch hours, I finally made it inside....hip hip hooray!!!! Right? Nope, not much to celebrate about. I ordered challah french toast, potatoes, fried eggs & bacon. I think the French toast was over cooked bc it was dry & tasteless thank God for the cinnamon, powered sugar & syrup. If blindfolded I would have had no idea what it was that I was eating. The potatoes were ok as were the eggs, but the pork bacon was to die for!!!! The best bacon I've had in a very long time. Oh & the coffee taste like I smoked a cigarette & I'm a non smoker....

My date ordered the Foccacia Breakfast sandwich which she enjoyed & I must admit looked quite tasty. 

Maybe it's just me, or maybe the cook was having a bad day but overall I did not enjoy the food here BUT I'm willing to give it another try in the future. According to the other Yelp reviews the food here rocks & that was one of the many reasons I wanted to eat here

Best strip mall Chinese you will find. You order at the counter and pay, then they bring the food out. So it isn't a full service place. 

But the food is the best.  Their broccoli chicken, orange chicken and General Tso chicken are unbeatable. Better than any sit down, full service restaurant I have been to.

Their soups are very good too.

Highly recommended. Good, fast and cheap.

I have been to Philadephia Chinatown so many times before, but I didn't try this places. I read the reviews about this restaurant last week. And last Sunday, I ate there!
         Their Pho is awesome! My husband and I both ordered extra large special pho, and it costs $6.5 each. This thing was HUGE! This was the biggest XL  Pho that I ever had. The broth was so delicious, and lots of different meat in side. They gave us much more basil and bean sprout than any other places I've ever been. I really liked it. I love lots of fresh basil and sprout in my soup. 
        We had their Shrimp rolls too. They are larger than the ones I had before too. So even I do have big stomache, this time, I tried my best finished all the solid stuff in my pho. And this was my first time that I had lots of broth left.
        I will definitely go back there again! I will go there tomorrow again, exciting!

Never thought I would review a casino place but never say never. Peppermill has had a good rep for food for a long time. This didn't disappoint. Chicken fried steak and eggs was outstanding...if too much food. The missus had veggie quiche with fruit. Also excellent. Skip the buffet and eat here.

Lovash provided both my first and my second experiences with Indian cuisine.  Although I don't have much experience with this type of food, I absolutely must sing praises for this restaurant.  I was so impressed...I ate here twice in one week!  My friends, who ate at Lovash with me, are both veterans of Indian cuisine and they were very pleased with everything we ordered as well!

While we were waiting for our food, the server brought out papadum with mint and tamarind sauces.  Both times, I had meat samosas for an appetizer, which came with the same sauces.  The mint sauce is very spicy, but has a wonderful fresh flavor.  The tamarind sauce was absolutely phenomenal.  Sweet and earthy.  I couldn't get enough!  The meat samosas are seriously to die for.  Perfectly crispy and filled with ground meat and veggies.  I could make a whole meal of them, if the appetizer came with more than two.  They're pretty hefty, though!  

On my first trip, I ordered chicken tikka and paneer naan, which came out with my main course.  The chicken tikka was wonderful.  It was served, still sizzling, on a wood and metal platter.   The veggies were flavorful and the chicken was juicy and absolutely amazing.  The paneer naan had a bit too much cilantro for my taste, the plain naan was absolutely delicious.  Hot and tender.

On my second trip, I ordered chicken vindaloo.  I much preferred this dish to the chicken tikka, but it was a significantly smaller portion, which is really unfortunate!  It's heavenly.  I ordered it as a 1 on their 1-10 heat scale, with 10 being super spicy.  Overall, I really appreciate the option to not have my food unbearably spicy.  I'm a total pansy when it comes to that, so I was happy to be able to enjoy the flavors of my meal without regretting every burning mouthful.  I had to ask for extra rice to take home with me both times.  I had leftover chicken tikka and vindaloo, but they were definitely a little light on the helpings of rice!

The first time I came here, when we were all finished and ready to go we ended up having to wait a fairly long while for our check while the servers were just standing around chatting.  That was pretty frustrating.  The second time around, our server was clearly new to waiting tables and was a little flustered and scatterbrained, but still on top of things.  Even so, the manager himself came by at the end and gave me a coupon for 25% off for my next time there, as well as making sure that everything was fine with our meal.  He was delightful, friendly, and helpful.  The staff here is great, for the most part, the atmosphere is fun and relaxing, and the food is really tasty.  I plan on returning often!  :)
Loved the chicken Mofongo. My hubby liked the Cuban Sandwich. We tried the empanadas. Too dry for my taste. Overall a good experience.

Our family stopped here every day during our stay in New Orleans! They have a fabulous bar upstairs called the "Black Duck" that was perfect for a midday drink and snack! The hummus trio plate was delicious!

The staff was very friendly the few times I have stopped in. Today they rewrapped my handlebars for free. The clothing is reasonably priced, but I wish there was just a bit larger selection for the ladies. Will definitely be going back.

I love this Target. It is always very neat and orderly. I love that I can get everything I need in one stop. The shelves are always stocked. The parking lot is never crowded with carts. They keep up on it very well. The staff is always friendly and happy to help. The restrooms are also always clean which is a huge plus in my book.

One star for being local, one star for being delicious, one star for having tons of drinks to choose from (both alcoholic and non) and one star for having homemade deserts like pumpkin gooey butter cake!!! Actually I would have given three stars just for the last one.  

Great little place with simple, tasty options and enough cool treats to keep you coming back for more!

The sandwiches were much better than any chain for the same price or less, the desserts were homemade or local, and if you like beer you'd have a hard time being able to try them all!  

I agree with the other reviews that they are slow but its the kind of place you want to go to when you aren't in a hurry.  If you are a rush rush person you probably won't like it anyway.

I pass this place up all the time and have never actually stopped in to eat. Since it was a nice beautiful day outside, my coworker and I decided to stop here and sit outside for their $13 - 3 course lunch meal. Although, we didn't end up getting the course, we both decided to go with sandwiches. And they were DELICIOUS!!! 

I had a really delicious chicken sandwhich while she had some Mexican sandwich. 

I'll definitely be back!!

I've never been a fan of this restaurant or the "all you can eat" concept. On past the food was okay at best.  The service was descent. Nice servers. But the food was just awful. Dry rice. Dry crystal shrimp. Not all the ingredients were present as stated in menu. We ate maybe 1/4 of our meal, complained and they did nothing to make us happy. We'll not be spending our hard earned cash here again.

Oysters are on point and their drinks are intense. 

Such a hidden gem to non locals. I'm happy I found it!

I eat at this place all the time whether I'm on my boat on my motorcycle or in my car off I lived here 20 years and that is absolutely the most comfortable and most enjoyable food I've ever eaten downtown
Pretty awesome, definitely recommend the peppers and steak with whiz and fried onions....  they give you chopped steak while genos across street does not chop up the meet.
Had some awesome tacos recently at Food Truck Friday in Reno. Great value, very tasty and quick service. Will definitely have this again.
Here for $2 off Tuesday and getting the lobster tails. Silvy is getting ribs. Glad to be home

Just opened almost a week ago and I already have written this place off. The restaurant was dirty and had homeless squatting in there. The cashier was extremely rude and incompetent. Forget the listed specials and corporate discounts..... the fish and chicken boxes are a dollar more than the advertised company special. Me and my best friend brought four sandwiches.... all of them was shorted on cheese and quality. The customer behind us didn't have cheese put on her sandwich, and I kid you not they took the sandwich back, slapped another piece of cheese on it, and handed it back to the customer. 

Now its been a few years since I worked in the food service industry, but even I know that is a MAJOR no-no!!!

The fish and fries was overcooked and everything else tasted bland and rushed. 

I would be more apt to return to the restaurant at 44th and Market before I would be willing to go back. That restaurant is completely disgusting and I had better customer service from the DMV!!!

The three stars are based soley upon their chinese bbq chicken salad.  (Reeally good.  So good, in fact, that I'd risk having the snootiest service EVER just to eat it.)  This place is located in Plaza Frontenac, snootiest of snooty's when it comes to malls.  Watch out for 16-year olds having really glamorous birthday parties, and also people who think they own everything including you.  If you need to impress someone at lunch, I guess take them here.

**Note: Cardwell's original location is in Clayton, and it is still there, and has a more casual bar area where you can enjoy the chinese bbq chicken salad without snooty people.
Quick helpful bartenders & barback! Welcoming atmosphere & happy people. Recommended the Grasshound & a local Amber beer, 10/10 :)

If we had let the reception we received by the greeters serve as a determinant of good places to eat- we would have left! Very rude and pompous young lady there!
Thank goodness we proceeded and had an excellent server- Kelly as well as great food.
As a vacationing executive, I highly recommend you make front desk changes!

Bud and Marilyn's is the midpoint of hip and classic/comfortable. The decor takes you back to your grandparents living room. Everything is super comfortable and feels like you could stay there all afternoon. I ordered the fried chicken, a staple at the restaurant. The presentation is fantastic. The chicken is served in a "KFC" style bucket, and comes with pickles, and fries, and your own bottle of hot sauce. Everything is thought of and has a purpose. Can't wait to come back.

Definitely recommend this place.   Grabbed the Schezuan spicy beef for dinner.  The portions are HUGE and filled both of us up.  We also got the wonton soup which is FULL of wontons, not just the 3-4 you usually get.  

Great find in the Tampa area!

A couple of days ago my wife announced that she could go for a steak, which we generally don't have at home as we reserve it for special occasions when we go out. I *love* the dry aged porterhouse at Butcher & Singer, but $50+ isn't something I'm gonna shell out often. So I decided to check out some local butchers and see what I could find to cook myself.

After some research on options in the Italian Market, I settled on Lombardi's at 18th & Packer since it's close to my office. The store feels a little out of place amidst all the homes in that neighborhood, but I suspect the folks who live nearby don't mind one bit! Plenty of street parking is available on either side of Packer.

Inside the store is roomy and there's every cut of meat you could possibly want along with packaged and frozen goods. I asked for a porterhouse which was hand cut on the spot (Mr. Lombardi checked I was ok with the thickness before sawing), and another guy got me an 8oz. tenderloin from the cold room in the back.  Everything was packed up in a brown paper bag and the total damage came to $25.

Lightly coated each cut with canola oil, seasoned with copious amounts of salt and cracked blacked pepper, and put a nice hot sear to both sides of each til they were both medium. Rested for 10min. Served with chimichurri and a salad.

Wife nodded happily while having her tenderloin and I grunted approvingly while working thru my porterhouse.

Friendly, attentive service and great quality products. I'll be back!

I can't believe this place has a line around the building at 3AM.

Was the wait worth it? Yes :)

My only complaint is that Philly cheesesteaks are obviously in PHILLY, which means, a whole bunch or arrogant Phillies and Eagles fans chanting extremely loud only hours after they got their asses whooped by the SF Giants. Me being a go-hard Yankee fan from NY it was quite annoying. 

But yeah...good cheesesteaks...honestly probably something I could make at home but ehh...It was worth eating a REAL Philly cheesesteak,

I have yet to try Geno's!

If there were more stars, I would give them. Delectable fried crawfish stuffed onion. Soft shelled crab Marie is savory and unexpected. Charming, helpful locals will steer you to food that meets your culinary adventure level. Finish dinner with bread pudding or sweet potato molasses cheesecake- this place is a winner!
Took Wayyy to long to greet us with menu and beverages.  We ordered basic food- took forever and didn't ask us for refills on beverages until we asked.  Will not be returning.

I have eaten here many times and although there are several authentic Mexican restaurants in the area, including many food trucks, this place seems to provide some of the most consistently best tasting food, with good service. I have had many items from burrito's, taco's, to quesadilla's and it's all tasty! 

You can dine in the bar area at a high top table, outside on the patio, or in the main dining room. There is sometimes a wait on weekends or during peak dining hours, which is expected for any popular restaurant. But most of the time I have eaten here I have been able to walk in and get seated immediately.

This hotel is untrustworthy! We booked through Expedia for the night before the eclipse 2017. We booked in June of 2016 for $75. We were notified by email today that our reservation has been canceled due to "maintenance"! Maintenance on the night every hotel in Boise is charging $500-900 a night?! The email seemed like a mass email since it didn't have our name or reservation number on it. I think they canceled all the people's reservations who paid the least so they could make more money. What a horrible business!

Terrible service, unhappy, miserable looking and acting employees, rude owners  and over price food. It's the Essence Festival here in New Orleans so I go to Riverwalk to get some fish & fries. After standing in line for 15mins, I walk around to the other counter  and ask the gentlemen if he was the owner, he said "No, I'm a co-owner and owner son" so I said can I ask you a question, "What is it?" I bent over the counter and discreetly  asked him is their a reason that he only have one person preparing the food. His reply was "YOU DON'T TELL ME HOW TO RUN MY BUSINESS, I BEEN DOING THIS FOR YEARS, IF YOU DON'T LIKE IT DON'T BUY IT." I said " I'm not trying to tell you how to run your business I just ask a simple question, you didn't have to get upset nor raised your voice at me and you're right I will not support your business." He yell something else as I was walking off. This older lady stop me in said "honey make a complaint", I told her "There no question about that."  So while the lady and and I were talking amongst ourself away from the counter, another man walk up, and  said "can I help you" I said no. He stayed within close proximity of the lady and I listening to our conversation. He ask me a question again. "I said are you the owner?" he said "No., but if you have a complaint you can go to management down there and make one or I'll give you their number." I said "no thank you, I'll complain to the BBB and online" then he said "I'm the owner, are you the one who tried to tell my partner how to run his business?" Keep in mind that he told me at first that he wasn't the owner. I  explained to him what transpired and he said "He's exhausted and I'm trying to be polite to you if you don't want our business just go somewhere else." WOW! I said " First of all sir, you jump and our conversation that we are having amongst each other, you are really ear hustling because we are speaking in a low tone. Second, you ask me a question  and I don't care how tired he is he should never be rude to a customer or get made because they ask a question, it's a big festival you should've been prepared for this event, now that is telling you the truth about your business, and last but not least I don't need you to try to be polite to me, you and your son should be polite to everyone who patronize your business or people in general." He mumble something in I walked off. I'm not about to let him or anyone else ruin my  festivities nor am I'm about to sit in a New Orleans jail for arguing and possible hitting this disrespectful white man with something. 

THIS PLACE HAS NO RESPECT FOR THEIR CONSUMERS AND DON'T LIKE TO ASK QUESTION. EVERYONE THEIR LOOK AND ACT LIKE THEY DON'T WANT TO BE THERE! THIS IS ONE OF THE WORSE EXPERIENCE I EVER HAD IN NEW ORLEANS!

Breakfast at Hinge is a steal if you happen not to work during the week and can get down there Monday-Friday. The top of the menu includes entree (such as pancakes or eggs/ bacon/ toast or a breakfast burrito, etc.) and coffee for around $5 or less. 

On the weekends expect to pay an average of $8-12 per person. This prices brunch at the top of the market in Port Richmond and even nearby Fishtown. 

The food *is* consistently good. And plentiful. The breakfast bruschetta, for example, could be halved and considered plenty for one person. My favorite weekend dish is the Southwestern Skillet with chorizo sausage, peppers, onion, and eggs. 

Relative to other bruncheries, the great thing about Hinge is the attentiveness and consideration of the wait staff. Even when the dining room is packed they are present without hovering and quick with refills.

I've eaten lunch at Clear Sky twice, and breakfast for the first time this morning.  All that I can say is "wow"!  The menu is huge and has so many things that I would love to try, leaving it difficult to choose!  The shrimp tacos with goat cheese are ridiculously good.  I would have never thought of putting goat cheese on a shrimp taco, but it's SO delicious.  You have the option of shrimp, lobster, or grouper for the tacos.  This morning my husband tried the lobster benedict and I had the lobster omelet.  My husband thought that the benedict was good, but lacking flavor.  My omelet was very good.  This place does not slack on lobster!  My kids ordered the Nutella french toast, and Nutella crepes.  They both really liked their meals.  How couldn't they? NUTELLA! 

I love this place, and wish it wasn't an hour drive from my house.  Actually, it's probably best that it is, for my waistline's sake!  Can't wait to go back.

Awesome local haunt. I always come here when visiting NOLA.  Local atmosphere with no crazy lines and fantastic oysters and sandwiches!  Great tap offerings too!  My NOLA trips aren't complete until I come to Cooter's!

Earth-shatteringly good "turf" burger. 

The turf burger came on a thin, soft, and chewy brioche bun that yielded nicely to the beef. 

The beef patty was gargatuan in size (likely 8-10oz) and cooked to a perfect medium. I'd wager the meat was slightly on the lean side (I'd add maybe 5 percentage points of fat.) However, the beef tasted fresh and had a dense, but still crumbly and juicy, mouthfeel. 

The toppings were an explosive heap of flavors. There were crisp julienned onion strings that were savoury and slightly caramelized.  There was lightly crunchy bacon that still had a bit of chew. There was deeply savoury and salty yellow American cheese (this is the only context where I think American is an appropriate choice.) There were lightly pickled and lightly charred jalapeño coins. 

Oozing over all these toppings was a creamy, goopy, flavor bomb of burger sauce (something like thosand island dressing).

This burger was a perfect concatenation of flavors and textures. The soft and delicate bun. The crisp onions. The savoury and sweet dressing swimming with melted American cheese. The bite of the jalapeños crying through the fats. The oozy, juicy burger dripping jus as you caressed it between your lips. There are few things more enjoyable than discovering an excellent burger.

I had the hibachi lunch special awhile ago, it was great!  The food is very fresh and it is a fun atmosphere with friendly chefs preparing the delicious food.  I have wanted to return, I think I would if the price were a little lower.  Still, it is a nice restaurant, friendly service and great food.

I don't know if I'll ever feel comfortable giving five stars again if five is all I can give to City Museum.  I want to meet the creative geniuses behind this place some day.  I also want to meet the people who are willing to give them insurance.  The lack of obvious safety precautions, like "no running" signs and "don't do this" and "don't do that" signs was refreshing and liberating.  I definitely exited my comfort zone numerous times, largely because I needed to in order to follow my three year old.   

Here's an example of the genius of their usability design: they have a 10-story slide.  How do they make sure only people who can handle a 10-story slide go down it?  Not with signs and security people, but with a ramp enclosed in a cage that you have to climb up in order to go down.  I could have climbed it, but my three year old couldn't have, and that was perfect.  My three year old would not have been happy on a 10-story slide.

I hope this place gets super popular.  They have so many pool tables I lost count, netted-off ping pong, darts, and probably a million other awesome things to do I have yet to discover.  Add a huge beer selection and a stage in the corner for live music, and you have arcade-style perfection.

1 hour and 20 minute wait thanks to Vickie. Asked for a table away from kitchen and bathrooms, she gave us a table as close as possible to both. Thanks to our waiter Mason's hospitality and good natured conversation he made things better. Try to arrive after 6PM and there will be little to no wait if any.

Hour wait.
$9 appetizer was smaller than I expected.
Bread was so dry that it just fell apart into crumbs on the table.
Service was barely nonexistent.
Two subpar entrees.
$65 bill. For WHAT?

I'm not one to write reviews very often, but Arirang is so deserving of one.

The atmosphere in itself is wonderful. It's a quaint Korean restaurant that feels very homey! Misook is the absolute sweetest too-- I felt welcomed into her restaurant before I had even ordered.

I came to the restaurant for budae jjigae, and it was EASILY the best I've had since I was in Korea. It was also the only place I've been to since I left that even made budae jjigae! The banchan (side dishes) were a great assortment as well!

If you want authentic Korean food, then I highly recommend Arirang. It will not disappoint. I plan to spend much more time there.

Dined at Guppy's last night, after a wait of 40 minutes or so. Well worth the wait. Grouper was delicious. I had the jerk rubbed one and my father the blackened one with guacamole. Both very fresh and well cooked. Also had carpaccio which was good. Only complaint is that the restaurant isn't the cleanest. They turn tables over quickly.

On a Friday this place felt like a pick up bar for 60+, with many folks dressed to the 9s.  The facility itself is an expensive build out, so I guess that's why our very modest portion of fries were $7 with our expensive beers.  Based on the food that was coming out, it didn't look very good so we left.  I would expect this place to suffer the same fate as the previous John Henry's....  86ed.

Wow. Absolutely delicious. The dish I tried was richly flavorful, thoughtfully crafted, and expertly prepared.

I had the Guilin spicy and sour. The flavor was spot on--a perfect push and pull of tang and heat, all swimming in a thick, satisfying broth. And I'm a sucker for good ol homemade noodles--the texture of fresh noodles is just too good. I especially liked the texture of the dish. The fresh noodles, bbq pork, roasted peanut, and greens all came together to make a really fun dish to eat--really satisfying to get this spectrum of chewy and crunchy. 

The restaurant is compact and lively. It has a fun vibe--good lunch with a friend or two sort of feel. 

Noodleholics, I'm an instant fan.
Great down home cooking. Cafeteria style. Portions are generous and staff is friendly and welcoming. Our tummies were very satisfied.

Yummy, Yummy, Yummy, Yummy!

Best Thai food in town, at least I think so! They are so nice and the restaurant is adorable even if it is next to a XXX bookstore...

My favorites: Curry Puff, Pineapple Fried Rice, Green Bean Legacy, Spicy Summer, How Mok, Panang Curry, Phad Ga Praw and Brown Rice Pad Kee Maw! BUT, everything I've had is absolutely delicious!

This place is a must go and fall in love with!

Wonderful customer service.  We had a couple of issues that were dealt with quickly and professionally.  Dana the front desk supervisor was exceptional in her dealings with our group.  She genuinely wanted to solve our problem.   This is our lodging of choice in Santa Barbara   Thank you to all the staff.

NO POINTS FOR YOU - If you book it on www.opentable.com and arrive 10 minutes late.

I booked a reservation at Sterling's  when I was in town for Cyndi Lauper in 2011, and my party was just 10 minutes late, and they canceled my reservation,  What the hell man!
 
My mouth was salivating while enjoying the Fillet Mignon (any size is just too small), and the Cosmo's were top shelf (Belvedere or Chopin).  The dessert of Creme Brulee trio was amazing, each bite was ecstasy.

It would have been a 5 star review if I had received my dining points.

I needed to find a place to live right away as I was in town for only a week to secure a new home to rent. I visited a few places that were clearly recently trashed foreclosures for a fee!! that just had a coat of paint thrown on them - including the tubs & tiled showers (duh!) I was going to settle for 1 of their homes and contacted the agent. After filling out the leasing application for both me and my wife for $45 each the agent took nearly 2 days to get back to me & this delay forced me to sign a lease on another home. In utter disbelief of the lack of responsiveness & losing out on disputing the fee for them running a background check that certainly didn't cost $90 to do.

Purely amazing! So many toppings I can't tell what's what. End result = me smiling! Dinner is served! I don't eat pizza much but I have heard so so many good things about this place I had to try it! 

They did not disappoint.

I was so happy with the service I got here,I have 3 senior dogs ,it could get really expensive ,their rates were great ,its the first time i didn't feel overcharged.My dog Sophie was really sick ,and Dr Loertscher and Dr Baxter and  the staff were so kind  to her and me,this is the first review I have ever written,I wanted to tell people about this  great vet care ,found my vet care for life.
Not kid friendly.  No kids menu. Food was good and fairly priced, but when I got the bill there were changes for extra bread for our table and drink refills, neither which appeared on the menu.

After touring a little, Our Daily Bread caught our eye, and having an inability to pass by any quaint, cute or homey bakery, I strolled in to peruse the baked goods. I couldn't help not buying anything..

We bought some of their muffins, which we enjoyed, but the cookies were definitely the stars in our selection.

ESPRESSO ALMOND COOKIES.
i don't know how they pack such an intense flavor in such a small cookie! a little pricey, but delish with coffee.  :)

HONEY GRANOLA COOKIES.
Small mounds of granola baked in a buttery dough. Subtle honey flavor. Again, delish! 

I would definitely come back.  :D

*WOMEN BEWARE*  Ace Plumbing Will Suck Your Money Right Down The Drain!

I am pretty typical of most women in that when something needs to be repaired around the house, I have to call a friend or a company to come out and fix it.  My handy-ness is limited to changing light bulbs.  So, when I discovered a wet spot that wouldn't go away, I called Ace.  I had gotten friendly service in the past and I was happy when a plumber came out the next morning.  

He assured me that he had found and repaired the source of the leak, handing me a bill for $355.50 before he left. All I cared about was that the downstairs carpet wouldn't be soaked anymore and I could stop worrying about busted pipes, mold and a rotting house frame!  Yay!

Fast forward a few days and the wet spot is B-A-C-K...it never left, I guess!  I called Ace right away and spoke to a very sweet woman, telling her that the issue was not yet resolved.  She made me feel like Ace understood and would take care of everything.  I decided to stop using the downstairs tub to see if that could have been the source.  Sure enough, after a few days, the carpet was back to bone dry!  

So you can see my issue now...here I have a bill for $355 for a repair that had NOTHING to do with what I called Ace for...and I still might have a leak somewhere!  Back come the worries about a busted pipe, mold, rot, etc.  Plus now the added worry of a $355 bill for a drippy faucet. Ace was supposed to make things better...not worse!

I called Ace again to let them know that I would like my bill adjusted or for them to come out and fix the actual leak.  I had to speak with the owner, since this was a bill adjustment / warranty issue.  Mike said that the bill seemed high for the work they did, but that he needed to research the issue and that in the meantime, he would send someone out to see if they could find the leak.

A plumber came out and turned off all the water and said that there wasnt a leak.  He said that the wet spot was probably caused by someone stepping out of the shower or water getting through the curtain.

That was especially frustrating for me...why didnt he state that last time?  Why did he fix a drippy faucet and tell me it was the cause of the leak when he is now saying it is just water from the shower?

To make matters worse, I received an invoice in the mail from Ace this week.  It showed that I owed them over $400, when my original invoice says $355.50.  I put another call in and learned that the plumber had added things up on the invoice wrong, but that they would honor the original $355.50.  While I appreciate that they are taking some small responsibility, I will not use them again because I like to be treated with respect, and for them to earn their money.  They took advantage of a single women by fixing the first thing they saw wrong and charging me an arm and a leg.  Dont go to Ace unless you want to end up on a payment plan like me!

I am giving two starts because, despite this fiasco that I am dealing with, I have gotten good customer service from the lady at the front desk and the plumbers have been very nice, clean and respectful.  So one extra star for the great attitudes of Ace employees.  

If you know exactly what needs to be fixed, then I would recommend Ace.  
If you need someone to help you figure out what the problem is, I would absolutely not recommend Ace. 
----

Guess what?  My water heater totally busted this morning.  And guess who I'm calling...not Ace!

I am so thankful for Yelp because at least there is SOMETHING I can do when things go wrong to save others from a similar experience.
This is where to go in Largo for sports. Enough TVs to show any game you want with cold beer and good food to go with it.

So let's just get right down to brass tacks. Showed up for lunch, got the flautas plate. I got taquitos so I was a little disappointed. As a side note, I realize that in a lot of latin cuisine the terms are interchangeable so it's really my bad. Unfortunately, they were way overcooked. I think they would have been really good otherwise so I might try again. I also got a papusa and honestly, that was pretty good. There was a really good salsa bar with all the fixings that was clean and in good order. The side of rice and beans was passable and overall the service was good so I'll definitely go again and if it's better I'll adjust the rating.

Great food and service! We were quickly seated and our server was very friendly. The food was very fresh and hot, definitely worth the price. The sushi was amazing! They had all the rolls that I liked. I will definitely be back!

Love, love, love Lee's chicken..wish we had one down here in Texas! Best fried chicken I've ever had besides Mom's. It's the recipe Colonel S wished he would have had!
The potpie is good, too...good size!

Wow! The apartment was not as pictured. I had to scrub the bathroom floor, it was black. The apartment was very dirty. There is all kinds of stuff under the couch and bed including fingernail clippings. The refrigerator is covered in sticky stuff. The window was broken. All the lights were unplugged. Wow! My husband and I both have bites on our lower legs. Hoping they are just spider bites. The apartment definitely does not look like the pictures. Walls are horribly dirty. I was looking forward to a bar and bar chairs like the photo. I'm a travel agent for Oasis. I'm always looking for apartments with an accurate description along with accurate photos. I probably would not recommend these apartments.  I was told we have a nice courtyard when I initially booked. Bait and switch.... The is not a courtyard. Cold water shower for the first two days. We've stayed at Stay Alfred in Portland. It was wonderful this apartment does not compare. I thought you should know about my concerns. Hoping the apartment will be in better order for the next guests. 
Thank you, Diane Room 408



Hello! Stay Alfred here.

Thank God there are places like this! Such a respite from the stresses of the world. This is where I go to get the best chocolate croissant in town and some Cafe Au lait. It's so nice to go somewhere in the morning that is not oppressively busy. The staff is always courteous, mellow and attentive. I'm so grateful.

What to write about Acme that hasn't already been read?  Like the location in the Quarter best - even with the block long line.  Super large oysters cooked (or not) in every local style.  Platters are enormous as are the po boys.  The seafood is so fresh and tasty.  Cool dining area - prefer the bar because it's fairly tight quarters - remember the long wait.  Small aisle-ways zig zag through tables of patrons.  Waitstaff file through the maze with the efficiency of ants through a mound - very good at their jobs.  Come ready to eat and bring a drink to sip to pass the time.

Jacqueline was amazing! First timers get a sampler platter of some of their best dishes free of charge! Visited by the manager at the end of our meal. All food was piping hot and the beers were great! Service positively excellent. Not a dirty table in sight and the entire staff interacted with us throughout our meal! Highly recommend this place!

This place is amazing, the service is great! The food has immense flavor and the presentation to match. If you like Indian cuisine give it a try you will not be disappointed. My favorite has to be the butter chicken it melts in your mouth. I hope this quaint establishment sticks around!
Food quality and service are not a priority here. Rude, slow, terrible food. Risky to visit here.

The Whiskey selection is great and I love Whiskey so that is good for me. It was very busy when we got there with an hour wait for a table (I would suggest that the Valet should let people know what the wait is before they take the car). We were able to find a nice table on the patio though. The three dips appetizer was not great. The salsa tasted like pureed tomatoes, the hummus was good but a little weird to eat it on tortilla chips and the queso was just OK. We also ordered the burger to share. It was great. The beef was nicely seasoned and the Brie cheese on top was a wonderful addition. The fries were OK- nothing to write home about. I ordered the Jamey Ginger first which was too sweet for my tastes. My second drink was a shot of Elijah Craig 12 year which was nice. 
The atmosphere was young and loud on the inside and skewing middle aged and quieter on the outside. The music was fun. Overall it it was another one of those trendy, gulchy scenes that seems cooler from the road than it is on the inside. I would return for lunch though. Seems like it would be a great place for lunch.

Michael and Hannah were a delight!! After a long day of shopping Cajun Mikes was a well deserved stop!! The alligator sausage poboy and oyster poboy were AMAZING!!!!! I felt like I walked into the most friendly neighborhood pub in New Orleans. Michael and Hannah made us feel very welcomed and shared many local tips with us! A MUST stop for future vacations to New Orleans!!!!

Had dinner here again tonight and the food was excellent as always! Love that we have family owned authentic Mexican food so close to home. The portions are huge I always have a snack for later.  The staff is very friendly and the atmosphere is pleasant.  We've gotten timely delivery and visited with both large and small groups and never a reason to complain. 
Try the food for yourself I'm sure you'll love it.  Let's keep this family making their fresh and delicious food in souderton for a long time!

I have come to this theater number of times and never had a problem. Tonight we went online and got tickets via a directed link from the theater site to fandango.   We bought tickets online and it said that you do not have to wait in line and we got a confirmation number showing that we had two tickets for the Martian. When we got to the theater they informed us that they don't accept Fandango confirmed tickets without us getting in line and getting physical tickets from the movie agent. It was a disaster here, and even people who bought tickets directly from the theater site got a terrible hassle!!! The manager was a young woman who simply said the situation "was disappointing!!!" We were very annoyed at the poor customer service, lack of customer concern and failure to resolve the problem!  When we got up to the agent he didn't even want to accept our confirmation # for tickets thru Fandango. Just a disgrace!!! Many we're complaining but we are sending an email to Mr. Harmon himself! This is an unacceptable situation!!
Love this place. Friendly vibe and service. Excellent food and drinks. Off the beaten path but definitely worth it.

Always very clean, the staff is very nice. The only draw back for them is that it is always very busy. Sometimes the lines inside can get kinda long. I stop here daily for fuel and breakfast. The food is good, same price as fast food and is for the most part quick.

Don't go here terrible quality, woman literally ignored what i told her i wanted for my nails and then left?? two other technicians started working on me but the lady that ruined my nails just disappeared.. do not recommend don't go here the quality is just bad

Shelby the bartender was awesome,  she recommended great beer and the the Effin hot cheesesteak she recommended was awesome!  It was my birthday and she went out of her way to make it a good one for me.  Thank you Shelby!   
Check this place out,  you will not be disappointed

The atmosphere and food were fantastic tonight. We started with the charbroiled oysters and the raw, both tasty and fresh. for entrees we got the Mahi Mahi special, Flank Steak, Ahi Tuna and Meatloaf... All very good. We ended with chocolate ice cream and local plant city strawberry ice cream, delicious. This is a place we will take out out of town visitors and possible lunch outings on a nice day. Service was also fantastic.

Really liked this spot! They have an option that you can go in with already washed hair and they willl do a quick blow out. The place is beautifully decorated! They have so many options, to suit any needs. I was happy with how it turned out. Staff was really nice and welcoming. My one problem was they gave me a complementary blow out but get this... I can't use it on myself. So I pay for my blow out and a lucky person gets a free one????  That BLOWS

The pizza is the best I've had in philly. Being a Chicago girl, I was not a big fan of ny style thin crust. But the quality of ingredient  are so top notch that it comes together quite wonderfully. You must give it a shot.

My husband and I came to the restaurant today to have our anniversary dinner. We arrived at 3:40pm. The door was already open and guests were seated and being served. My husband went into the restaurant ahead of me to ask for how long there would be a wait for at a table close by in the first section. He explained that I needed to sit as close to the door as possible due to not being able to walk far. He was told that there were no tables/booths available in the first section because they didn't have a server available for that area. I cannot walk to the opposite end of the restaurant. We had to leave very disappointed and frustrated that this is not the first time this has occurred. 

We were there the night that the restaurant offered free meals for guests while they were doing a training day. We had to sit at the back of the restaurant as I require a table, I can't sit in a booth due to a disability. On this occasion due to there being no available handicapped parking I was dropped off in front of the door and my husband parked nearby. I went in while we waited for our table and sat on one of the benches. We had about a 45 minute wait due to needing a table or half table. I had no issue with that however there are none of this type of seating anywhere except for 4 tables at the back of the restaurant, as far from the door as you can get. When we went to leave there was nowhere that I could sit for a few minutes when I got close to the exit of the restaurant and had to walk to where my husband parked. He wasn't able to pull the car up near the door due to many cars blocking that area. Walking out to where our car was parked caused me crushing chest pain. I had to go to the hospital as I was having a medical emergency room. I have since been homebound except for visits to the many doctors I am now receiving treatment by in relation to that incident. 
I must say I am extremely frustrated and upset about the restaurant not making accommodations for guests who can't walk as far as the other side of the restaurant. Apparently our desire to enjoy a delicious dinner and pay well for the food and service that Texas Roadhouse locations in Wesley Chapel and Lakeland Florida have always excelled at. I don't believe we will ever consider dining at the new Riverview location. It is also unsettling to know that a restaurant that opens at 4pm and not earlier had many tables already seated and being served at 3:40pm.

I was so excited when Olive Garden came to Franklin, but was quickly disappointed by the quality of food I received, it always annoys me when you order something for carry out and you get half the size of the entrées that you would when you come in to eat but your price is still the same as when you dine in!  I took home Chicken Marsalis and garlic mashed potatoes and if I had a cup of potatoes on my plate I would be shocked. The flavor of my chicken was not up to par with what I've had here before.

Brunch was amazing! 10/10 recommend the grapefruit mimosas. They were a perfect balance of the bitter and tart of the grapefruit and the sweetness of the champagne. I got the short rib omelette (subbed goat cheese - again, 10/10). My friend got the classic eggs benedict and she enjoyed it too - flavors on par, but she'd probably try the crab cakes instead of the English muffins (too much bread). All around, we'll be back for the "almost endless" mimosas ($14 carafe + $1 for each glass after) and satisfying brunch.
ALSO - shout out to our waitress Misty, for being attentive but not overbearing, much appreciated!!

I love this place, yum. The type of light healthy meal that you won't suffer from a food coma after, and you actually feel refreshed afterwards.

They have a few signature bowls on the menu, and all of them are delicious. I love the one that has the tuna, and the salmon is good as well. And there's a nice warm layer of rice underneath it all.

If you are looking for an adventure, head to the 3rd floor of Cuddy's any weekend night after 11 PM...

On a serious note, McGillicuddy's has some solid happy hour and game specials and there is never a cover charge.  Three floors of fun include a dance floor on top and plenty of bar space to grab a drink.  The food ain't all that bad either, but the bathrooms need some work.

Absolutely incredible service, and food! We had the charbroiled oysters, okra fries, and quail as our appetizers which were amazing, our entrees (allegedly) took longer than it should have from which the manager came and apologized for, and offered dessert on him. My girlfriend and I have nothing bad to say about this restaurant and its staff. 5 stars.
The food was great. Megan our waitress was great. I recommend eating here if in the city. Geaux Tigers and who dat saints

My order arrived without the extra sauces and soda that I had paid for. The driver was not back for an hour with the soda, and still did not bring the sauces. She told me nobody at the store informed her that she had forgotten the sauces as well and needed to bring those too. I called the store again and they told me that they had informed her multiple times that she needed to bring the sauces as well. I used to love Dominos, but this terrible service the first time I've been able to order them in years will be the last time I order.

This salon is fantastic and I always feel so welcomed and refreshed during my appointments. All the stylists I interact with here are so nice and the space is so inviting and relaxing. Dominique has been amazing. She does great things with cuts and color. She has been excellent with my short extremely thick hair. I often do an asymmetrical cut and she nails it every single time. She really provides special attention to what my hair type needed for that style as well. I highly recommend her to anyone. Make an appointment here, you will not be disappointed!
Great stadium, location and the community is welcoming. I have been to this stadium several times and has not been disappointed.  Warm and welcoming stadium

Wings were good. Nachos were good. View on outside patio was nice. Chairs were comfortable. Overall a pleasant experience. Docking one star because I witnessed a server not wash their hands after exiting a bathroom stall and returning back out to serve. Disgusting. Also parking is limited and they reserve their closer spots for their valet service.

I finally found oysters that rivaled Dragos. The Bangkok Thai oysters are to die for. I got to meet MeMe and she assured me I would come back before I even ate. Well, she was right. Seriously good oysters.

I have an unusual vehicle, a truck with 4 wheel steering. I went to another well known shop in Reno with the initials DLGS, and they did not want anything to do with re-gearing my truck. A friend recommended Just Rear Ends. They said that they had done a couple of quadrasteer trucks and didn't have a problem with modifying my truck. They called me everyday and gave me updates on the status of my truck, and the parts that were needed, as a result of internal damage that they discovered when opening up my differentials. Jim had an incredible knowledge of the rare quadrasteer axles that I couldn't find anywhere else in Reno. I am glad that I found this shop, and wouldn't take my truck anywhere else for gear work.

Great food great atmosphere with spectacular service. We came before the crowd and got to enjoy the early bird specials. He got a steak and she got the fish, both were incredible and we will be repeat customers for sure.

Found this place while searching for a good Asian restaurant in the area.  Reviews were really good so we decided to go.  There were 7 people in our party - 3 adults/4kids and we all ordered different dishes.  All of the food was outstanding.  I had the Thai Cashew with chicken - it was amazing.  My husband had the Thai Cashew with beef and he also loved his.  My friend had the pork fried rice and she said it was the best fried rice she had ever had!  Everything was delicious and fresh.  The decor was nice and it was very clean and inviting .  We will definitely be back!
This place is just the best. Not a huge selection but who cares when the selection they have is perfection

Beautiful store.  

I've been to many Victoria's Secret stores and this one is one of my favorites. 

The store is well lit and well laid out. Pretty and sorted. Full of friendly staff and helpful smiling people. 

The panty boxes against the wall are not handicap accessible on one side but that was the only concern I had. 

My wheelchair wouldn't fit on the side of the bin by the wall. 

Very pretty store and clean. Perfumes are laid out and shiny ready to be sampled. 

Very neatly folded and designed store with easy access to items.  

The store itself is very well lit and is one of the biggest Victoria secret stores I've ever seen. 

Staff was very helpful and nice willing to go out of their Ray and help customers with many things.  

:)

Prince's was the third stop on our hot chicken tour of Nashville, and it just did not compare to Bolton's or Hattie B's. We ordered a mix of medium and mild wings with fries, and they came out promptly. But they were so so greasy. They soaked through the white bread and container, and it was not appetizing. Maybe they were just having a bad night since it was about an hour before closing. Also the heat rating is all over the place among the 3 different locations. Bolton's medium burned but Prince's medium seemed like extra extra mild, and the mild was basically just regular fried chicken. If I came back, I'd get hot and maybe go to the original location once it reopens
Went here for happy hour. Drafts on tap are $5, and it was 2$ off of apps from 5-7. Everything is really good & flavorful. Bar staff is extremely nice. You won't be disappointed.

Had a great day on the ocean with a boat rental from Tierra Verde Boat Rentals and our boat assistant Jake. We had a few hiccups as we started but Tierra Verde Boat rental and Jake helped get us back on track to ensure we had a great day.  We have rented from other marinas in the area but this was the best experience yet and we will be back.  Had a great day hanging out at Shell island.   Ask for Jake he will make sure you have a great day.

Love this place! I often stop by for lunch when I visit a doctor in the area during the week. The place is quaint, the food delicious, and the staff is very friendly. I see others have complained but perhaps it's a weekend crowd issue or even that they've hit during rush hour noon. I am there usually between 1 and 2 and get a great seat, fantastic service, and refills of my tea without asking. No complaints here except that they aren't closer to Rox/Manayunk where I live.
Paul es no bueno

It was just okay.
Ambience was nice and my meal (fried fish) was good but overall was not worth the price point.

My husband and I really enjoy this place for a morning get together. It is located tucked away on Haskell, so it is a little hard to find but a gem of a spot. My husband is such a coffee connoisseur and this is his absolute favorite place to come to talk business or bring friends.  In the summer or spring, you can go outside and enjoy your coffee in the front of the store. Really relaxing. He always enjoys the espresso and spritzer. I am a plain Jane kind of girl where I just get a Vanilla latte, but is is so good. The depths of flavor and the vanilla they use does not over power the coffee.  You still taste the deliciousness of the coffee and it reminds me very much of traveling to Austria and visiting the Italian cafes for coffee there. This is such a great place that makes Reno truly unique.

Being from Southern California where there are a ton of Asian restaurants, it was amazing to find a dim sum place in STL that isn't dwarfed in comparison. This isn't the best I've ever had, but it is definitely as good as it gets. All the dishes tasted fresh. The consistency of the wrappers for the dumplings and rice noodle rolls were spot on!!! Asian food this good in STL is RARE. Eat here!

I tried this restaurant for the first time last night and I had one of the worst restaurant experiences I have ever had. We ordered some steak and shrimp. The steak was supposed to be medium but when we had it was really raw. Also we ordered shrimp with our steak but we never received it. Then the shrimp was added on the bill. The broccoli that comes with the steak was boiled and cooked way too much. Overall I am really frustrated with the service and the food.

Love it! Highly recommend the plantains and corn sides. Tacos are tiny and all come out together when you order as a group so very hard to tell whose is whose and staff is only soso at that part. Otherwise top notch location, food, & atmosphere!

Max is the only guy you want to give you a bayou tour. Not only is he a gem, but logistically he was able to accommodate our last minute purchase and ten minute delayed arrival (he had us meet him at the launch site, making things easier for everyone involved, and keeping everything running on time for other guests). I recommend!
Food is good. Service is great. I've never had a real problem there. I usually get the cheesesteak and I enjoy it anyway. Looking for a good hot sandwich at a fair price then no reason to not to go

Holy Cannoli! I always have said I don't like cannolies for years. My one and only exception is if they come from Cipolli Cannoli, I will devour it. I have heard of how fantastic this place is and how they have kits that people love and adore. 

The pink little cottage-style shack sits behind the train tracks (closer towards the WaWa) and is owned by a husband and wife duo for 13 years. They both are a simply sweet duo. The hours are limited so check to make sure they are open. 

Since I live around the corner I happen to notice they're open sign was lit up. I stopped by and it turns out they forgot to turn off the light so out I went but the owner called me back in. He gave my fiance' and I samples to bring home, warned us to eat them within 3 and a half hours and they were AMAZING. I had traditional, amaretto and pistachio....each were delicious whichever one you try but my favorite was the amaretto.

I will definately be back to buy a kit and share with family at dinner.

UPDATE: I used their kit ($12 for 13 small or $12 for 6 large) for a business potluck and it was a hit!
UPDATE #2: During the holidays they offer special hours but be forewarned a 13 person line outside in the cold weather could really ruin your plans of running in and out quickly. My best suggestion is to order ahead of time, print your order and hand it to them so they do not have to look it up.

i really liked the decor of this place.  it feels very trendy and the staff is very friendly.  the only reason i'm not giving it 5 stars is because i have had better chocolate that i would consider in the same tier as this.  For example, Moonstruck I feel has slightly better quality along with variation.  the salted caramel i got at Bissinger's was a bit too salty.  However the other pieces of chocolate I got were pretty tasty.

I would give more stars if I could! The food here was sensational, very very reasonably priced and arrived with an overall wonderful experience. Good music playing, nice vibes and an even nicer proprietor who assisted us in selecting some delectable dishes. We had the Avocado everything spice pizza, the wild mushroom pizza (the mushrooms looked, smelled and tasted very wild!) and the peach arugula salad. We wiped the plates clean and it was plenty of food for 3. This place is a hidden gem right now as they've only been open for two weeks. I suspect they will be getting very busy very soon! Keep up the excellent work here :)
So yummy!!! Hong Kong style cafe with fantastic choices and great prices. This is going to be a restaurant we frequent often.
My new favorite place.The guys there are really cool and thier food is excellent,I recommend the Brooklyn tomato pie and thier pananies.Keep up the awesome work guys.

Ok first thing, no real iced tea.  They had one of those syrup blending machines, not the real thing and it was out of order.  Minus a star there.  The burger was good, not particularly great.  I liked how they put the side items on for you, and the fries were good.  Oh yeah, and not the cheapest burger in town either, it was 20 bucks for my partner and I to eat.  Final verdict: go to Rotier's and get a real burger.

This is amazing place! Good food great staff! Kiki is who drake was talking about, in actually, I love her and she definitely she showed us love! I proposed about 3 times tonight, she said no, but don't worry, I'll be back tomorrow.

A great burger place on 4th Avenue across from the Bobby Hotel. The portion size is generous and the sauce they use is amazing. The decor of the place is a little kitschy, but I like it and it fit well with the food.

Ehhhh....not better than Froyo in terms of bang for buck and set up. Convenient because next door to bath&body works and the flavors are cute but i found the yogurt a tad more creamier. It will do but not impressed

Not happy at all- dinner was poorly prepared and I was super nauseas all evening. The seafood from the paella smelt spoilt and the meal was super salty; perhaps a lot of salt was added to disguise the spoilt/bad taste. We sent the dinner back and came back and found that they had still charged us for the meal. Never eating there again,

After another firm canceled 2 weeks in a row, they were the only cleaning service available on a Saturday, and even with just 3 days notice. We had company coming and wanted to have our spring deep cleaning done beforehand. A team of five cleaners showed up on time and got right to work. Ms. Katherine showed up later to check in personally, which was a nice touch. The team went way above and beyond what we had expected and we are planning to use them for regular service. I definitely recommend this firm.

Really cute place. The pizza and wings were excellent! They have an outdoor patio that I will definitely go hang out at. I just picked up our pizza this time. Also can't wait to try the different flavors of wings that were posted on the board.

I've been to Friday's hundreds of times. Maybe even more. I'll have to say, however, that this experience has probably been my best thus far. The sandwich was cooked perfectly, I could not have asked for anything better. Waitress was kind and very attentive as well, give her a raise!
Decided to go with the Jack Daniels grilled chicken sandwich with sweet potato fries: delicious. My buddy got the same sandwich but went with the Mac n cheese as his side as well, and I obviously had to try it. It was pretty bomb as well, so so good.
The tasting boards were absolutely delicious. My date and I each got one and so we were able to try 6 different items...very fun! Their bar does a wonderful job, too.

This place is outstanding. They were so kind and sweet on the phone and in person. Great selection of music playing and they even turned the channel for something we wanted to see on tv. We ordered 4 rolls total and they all were so fresh and good. The Hawaii roll was so good I wanted to eat it all but I just couldn't eat anymore. I was disappointed they didn't have miso soup (normal), but they did have miso ramen. I will be back to order more rolls and maybe even try the ramen. It is super clean here, doesn't have a smell like some places. They keep everything spotless. I can't say enough!

I went in to apply for a new Social Security number (moving from Canada). The process was efficient and simple. The wait was not too long (I arrived at 8:55 and was out at 9:50). The staff was friendly and courteous. What more can I ask for?
Dan is the man. BEST acrylic guy in all of Arizona. All freehand, thin, and last way longer than 2 weeks. HIGHLY recommended.

JINXED!!!!!!!!!!!!  Jinxed is the best.  Really and truly, I love all three Jinxed stores.  If you do not follow them on Instagram, do it.  Now.  Or better yet, don't, because most wares are scooped up within seconds of being posted as it is.  

The jinxed team (helpful/nice/awesome) does an amazing job curating the stores, but the best part are the prices.  With how in vogue vintage items have become as of late, most "hip" vintage places want an arm and a leg for pretty much everything.  Jinxed is the exception.  The prices are so reasonable it's almost scary, even on items that are potentially "valuable" from an antiques/collector perspective.  

I really can't say enough good things about Jinxed.  Most of our house is made up of inherited antiques, thrifted items, and Jinxed goods, and there's no end in sight.  I'm so happy to see the Jinxed empire growing and still going strong.   A Philly gem!
The food great, the drinks is even better. My cheesecake I love. The hostess we loved however she had to deal with my friends friend soooooooo sorry you had to deal with him.

This place is a scam. There was a hair in my food, food was cold. We were not offered a menu then after eating at the buffet the waiter said coupons don't apply to the buffet. There are sooooo many different places to go. Don't go here.

Nice location on the beach but considering the cost of our stay, not a great value.  We expected a higher end hotel, but if it has the Doubletree name don't expect much.  Breakfast was expensive for simple fare, wine by glass wasn't cheap.  Highly recommend staying at another hotel.  There are many nearby with better accommodations.

Our family has eaten here MANY times; mostly around lunch, and a few times for dinner.  I've had nearly every plate on their menu, and everything I've ever had has been very flavorful & filling.  The servers have always been very nice, attentive, and expedient with drink refills & any other requests.

Nearly every visit, one person in our family has ordered the all-you-can-eat fried chicken because we have small children who don't normally finish everything if we order their own plates.  Also, with nearly every visit, our server has repeatedly brought out more & more chicken - more than we could eat - and gave us a to-go box for any left-overs.  

This was not the case, however, with our most recent visit.  We were waited on by a "lead server" who, in my opinion as a former server, had very poor customer service skill.  She never refilled my drink, brought only 3 pieces of chicken out (they normally would bring a plate-ful), and at the end of our dining experience, refused to bring a large to-go box for any left-overs.  What I don't understand is, if the food is already on our table, and I've already paid, why wouldn't I be allowed to take it?  Is the restaurant planning on putting it under the warmer & serving it to someone else?  In every restaurant I've ever worked in, we threw away food left on plates.

If this is the current policy (or just now being enforced), I would urge the restaurant owners to re-think their strategy.  After such a poor experience, I doubt our family will be returning.  I will also - regretfully - let all of our friends & neighbors know of the current policy.

The food was pretty good. The veggies were fresh, the gyro was tasty. Wife enjoyed the salad. Daughter (5 yrs old) liked the cheese pita. Overall, I would come back. The staff was friendly and attentive. Good !

AMAZING! Best octopus dish we've ever had! The ravioli special was amazing! Biscuits with crab fat also delicious as were the cracklings. Service was top notch as well! We will be back as we saw many other items we wanted to try! I would say that Toups is a must do for brunch! We will try it again for lunch or dinner next time we are in town.

If only this place was a little cheaper then I would be a regular. I mainly come here if I want some healthy food options like the $12.00 sashimi options. From the onset I wrongly assumed that 6 pieces wouldn't be enough, but they were really quite big and filling. Yellow Tail is my favorite. Add a side of grilled asparagus and avocado salad with dressing removed and you have a nice and healthy meal.

I went to get my car services today for the recall on one of the parts in my car. 

Their overall service was horrible and deserves ones star. However, I will give them one star for their complementary ride back home after dropping my car off at their dealership.

They left my car dirty on the inside and outside, with a very noticeable thin film of sloppily dried water droplets covering the outside. On the inside they tracked small pebbles and dust around the front seats. 

Jim Clock also failed to check the air pressure on my tires. It was returned with low air pressure and the inside warning light has gone off. 

They were generally hasty and careless about the service on my car, and I would not recommend them at all.

Excellent service. The people here are very professional and courteous. They try their best to make you feel comfortable and the salon had a very relaxing atmosphere.
