I Went in for a haircut and got exactly what I asked for.My stylist took the time to make sure the cut was perfect and she was friendly and knowledgeable.
FINALLY, La Playa gets breakfast together for the weekends, so if your at surrey's?  and its too busy?  you can hop over here now for your shrimp and grits!
Just go, this place is cool, get some food to share too - it's excellent, what an experience you'll have!
This was a fun place to hang out and listen to music. Bartender was friendly and helped us find another BBQ restaurant that stays open later than our original choice.

Something about a very wide selection of local beers on tap housed in an old temple...

The Creation Café introduced me to the largest wedge salad (Manly Style) I have met to date.  Quote from my 11-year old: "If you put all the sections in a pie chart, they would add 400%!"  (Great, you are learning something in school, Honey!)  The crispness of the "pie chart" sections was well obscured by blue cheese and smaller ridges of pulled pork making the dish look a mini mountain range on a plate.

Pumpkin flavored brew definitely puts you into a fall spirit.  An Italian Kiss Gelato adds a different mood flavor...

Laser hair removal tech was very knowledgeable and professional. She did not rush the service. The room was very clean. She explained the service in depth and let me know about proper after care. 

Very good package pricing (6 sessions) on laser hair removal.

I went to Two Sisters for breakfast today because they now open at 7am on Saturdays. I was surprised to only see one other person there at prime breakfast time, 10:00am. I got two eggs over easy with grits and pork chops. The pork chop was delicious, they totally nail breakfast. Plus everyone there was so friendly I can't wait to go back. I hear their Shrimp and Okra is incredible!

My boyfriend got the cubano sandwich and I got the media noche. He asked for rice as a side. It took an hour to get our sandwiches and they were both ice cold. My meat did not taste good at all and he got beans instead of rice. I'm disappointed since all of the reviews were so good!
Love this place. Everytime I come here I'm waiting i  line for my cbarbroiled oysters!!

My credit union statement shows a social Security payment to me on March 1 2015.. I had a negative balance. After the deposit it shows a balance of $200 and  a debit of 18.00 on the 2nd of March The  balance drops to  about $180 and some change then a $6.00 overdraft fee is assessed and a balance of $174 remains.  I questioned the credit union and they claimed the social security check was not released till the 3rd of March. I often receive  it early and there is no hold so I check regulations and they state that funds submitted electronically are available on the day of deposit. I then recalled the credit union and the teller then states I had pending transactions when the Social Security check came in. Right I tell her and they left a balance of $200 which more than covered the debit. After a 10 minute phone hold I am told the $18 dollar charge went through on the 1st of March at 3 am and the Social Security check posted at 6 am. My monthly statement clearly shows the $18 transaction going through on the 2nd. This happens repeatedly and the bank issues fees which they  refuse to refund  or provide proof of their claims. Why would the bank statement not show things in the order of occurrence? Although only $6.00 this is a recurring event. The credit union claims they report all transactions in real time but continue to charge excessive fees. They also "hold " funds when you make a purchase but do not remove them from your account so sometimes you spend them ? HUH?

Emily did my hair and makeup for my April wedding, as well as the hair for my bridesmaids, flower girl, Mom, and mother-in-law. She and her associate, Cheryl, came to our Santa Rita Hills venue to get us all ready for the wedding and I couldn't be happier! She did my trial a couple weeks before the wedding and I love the look she created based on some hair and makeup styles I showed her. She is a great listener and a great stylist! She was professional and gifted! My hair and make-up stood up to hours of eating and drinking, dancing and kissing! It was even a windy day, but Emily's work persevered through the weather! I highly recommend her for any event you have!

Great casual, fast food dining with a friendly staff. Amazing Mexican salsa and condiment bar and excellent steak tacos for a reasonable price. Being from California, I couldn't get over that you can BYO tequila for their Marquita mix or your own beer and wine. Large dining room in the back would make a friends and family party a snap. We sat in the front area overlooking the street and enjoyed the waitresses conversation.
Best donut ever!!! Ingredients were delicious but felt light and didn't make me feel sick after like some donuts! They have the CUTEST details ever- love this sweet spot!!! Highly recommend!

Attention-Attention-Attention, the Napoleon House is not a Tourist Trap! In fact it's a pretty cool place.

I've always had a soft spot for this place mostly because the building is great to photograph and the story behind why it was built and for whom is pretty cool.

My friends and I stopped in on Saturday night, there were no huge lines and it was not packed which is unusual. When you step in it's like you go back to a place frozen in time. Take the time to look around and enjoy the patina on the walls and frames. Look closely at the bar and how appears to be alive in this decaying structure. 

If possible sit in the courtyard and order their famous Pimm's Cup which now comes in different flavors. I had a watermelon one and it was the perfect drink for a hot humid evening in New Orleans. 

We paired our drink with the Artichoke Dip and a Charcuterie board, both were delicious. The dip was perfectly balance and the boudin balls were perfection.

They can get very busy and the waiter can go MIA for a bit but they always come back and usually with whatever your last request was.

So if you're bar hopping in the FQ make sure to put The Napoleon House on your list.
Very hit or miss depending on who is working. The lady today put a hole in my eyebrow by trimming too much and then pretended it was already there! Stay away, will stick to my normal spot in Brandon.

Stayed here as they offered a nice suite sized room with free cruise and parking for a good price. This is a well appointed hotel with very friendly and accommodating staff. The only down side is that off site breakfast options are limited and their hotel restaurant, while offering a nice buffet is a bit on the pricey side.

Love this place. Can't go wrong with the frozen Granita, just make sure you get it primo. Also recommend the primo ice puccinos as well. Free wifi always works at this location. Restroom is clean too. Recommend this place.

Service was great.  However food was pretty salty, the lobster included shells, somewhat misleading descriptions of dishes (1/2 chicken was new take on fractions!).  Come back, doubt I'll ever be back (for a local, speaks volumes)
The early bird special was a fabulous value the food was good!!!  The service was great.
Great food. Great food. Great food! This place just opened a couple weeks ago and we have tried it a couple times. The owner was friendly and happy. Clean place.

My friend and I went to lunch at St. James and both desperately needed a mani/pedi. We walked into Jade's and were immediately at ease. You know how some places can be a little awkward or creepy when you're the only customer in there? This was the opposite. The decor is very tranquil, the place is new and fresh and clean, and the nail techs were something I rarely experience: personable. We had some hilarious and lively conversation with our nail techs. Everyone was so friendly and authentic that we left feeling like we had been hanging out with people we know well. I am so happy to have discovered Jades. No more will I feel like yet another customer who needs to be hurried through a service. If you're ready to get quality work in a beautiful setting with wonderful people, come here! You won't be disappointed.
Red beans and rice was amazing, service nice, great happy hour specials. The blackened chicken salad was the best thing we had, their salad dressing was just perfect.

ZERO stars. After 15 minutes we knew it would not be good. 2 tour guides. 1st one was probably in training, but he was SO bad. Awkward pauses during the narration, poor narration overall AND he forgot his lines several time. Corny jokes, sure. Poorrrrrllyyyy executed corny jokes? Geez. Zero enjoyment. Was very annoyed. Second tour guide was slightly better. We peeled off before the half way mark. The city was full of these tour groups telling different stories in front of different buildings. After we left my friend was being silly & mocked the tour by tellling his own made up story. He did a WAY better job than tour guide #1. It was utterly frightening & bone chilling so many people paid good money for this, myself included.

I love Yakitori Boy but my most recent experience is something I really need to warn others about. I booked a room for a birthday party, made reservations through email about a month in advance, discussed prices (2 hours free if spending limit was reached), their free birthday champagne promotion, etc.

The staff was extremely friendly, the room clean, and the food and drinks were EXCELLENT. 

HOWEVER, when I mentioned the free birthday champagne, the waiter informed me that they would not give it to me unless I had mentioned it when making my reservation. Lucky for me, I had, and I printed out and brought my emails as proof. They thanked me for the "proof", and brought the champagne.

Upon checking out three hours later, I'm not sure if they were hoping to catch us all drunk and unaware, but looking at the bill, they had charged us for 3 hours, when the first 2 were supposed to be free. I noticed, told them it was discussed in the email contract/reservation, and then they fixed the bill.

Long story short, if you make a party/room reservation, do it via email or have the details in print, and bring it with you!! They will try to add on charges later or hope you are too drunk to notice. It was quite annoying on my birthday to have to double check everything they charged me to make sure they weren't pulling a fast one.

Extensive wine list, great food and friendly staff... That pretty much says it all. I enjoyed the very relaxed, comfortable vibe and moderate prices. I highly recommend the burger and paired with a nice glass of wine, what could be better? Give Rumours Wine Bar a shot, you won't regret it.

I was expecting a really great meal. It was just ok. We had the crab cakes and it was more cake than crab with a mushroom crawfish sauce over them. Was not impressed. We also had the BBQ shrimp. Again just ok. Mr. B' bistro blows these shrimp away. We had the chargrilled oysters and they were again....just ok. The Cajun fries were my favorite thing to eat. I will say the Bloody Mary was one of the best I've had in the city. I was expecting a flavor explosion in my mouth and I a food orgasm. I got neither.

I went in last night at 6:30pm and his place was completely empty. I was a little skeptical upon seeing this, but realized that it could be because of the location (its behind a chevron next to Joe's Chicken Palace) and the fact that it was ungodly cold last night... Anyway, the food was spectacular. My friend inhaled her burrito in record speed and my order of chili was to die for (they use shredded beef in it! NOMS!!). You will not regret a trip to this joint. Two thumbs up from me!

Tommy DiNic's is a great restaurant located within the Reading Terminal Market. The market itself is pretty decently sized but you will find Tommy DiNic's right in the middle. I came at around 11:30 on a Sunday and was able to pull up to the bar immediately. By the time I had left, there was a crowd of people looking for a place to sit so I'd recommend coming early. Brunch plans anybody?

FOOD: Get the roast pork + broccoli rabe + sharp provolone. You can get your sandwich au jus if you'd like to make it more wet and juicy. Will say, sans jus, it's still very good and moist. The portion is huge, but as much as I love eating, I finished the whole sandwich in one sitting. The brocolli rabe has a slight bitterness that's complimented well with the richness of the roasted park and the slight saltiness of the provolone. Each bite was just as good as the one before! 

SERVICE: Attentive, great, and fast!

Definitely a must visit in Philadelphia!

The City Museum is St Louis' #1 tourist attraction, and with good reason.

You've never seen anything like this before, and you probably never will again.  Guests I've taken have likened it to a waking dream or an acid trip.  It's totally surreal.

Wear grubby clothes (I've snagged and ripped my favorite jeans on the outdoor structure!), wear shoes with good traction, and if you have knee pads, bring them.  I've ended up with re-bar shaped bruises on my knees a few times.

If you happen to be here in the evening and with no kids, find the bar and enjoy some adult libations.

On Feb.10th Dutch Hollow held a open house to promote their business.  What they failed to do was clear off the bottom parking lot, it was a sheet of ice.  They have little parking on the upper level maybe 15 spaces.  So if you didn't get a spot on the upper level you had to park on the bottom level and hope you didn't slip on the ice or  get stuck.  Not very well planned,maybe the owner should have thought about her customers.
Great for drinks as you're waiting for the ghost tour to begin. The bartender was very knowledgeable when it came down to the rum.

Have been shopping here since this store opened many years ago. They have some really good sales, especially in November and December. If they happen to be out of what you came in for, they will try and track the item down in their computer to see what other store has it in stock and have it transfered for you (can take a few weeks) but at least you get the item and of coarse they honor the sale price. They pretty much have it all when it comes to sportinggoods and even somethings you wouldn't expect them to have. Nice people and lots of parking in the shopping center.
2nd ever stop at sonic first for Breakfast a few months ago and now for lucnh,both time the food was fresh service was great and it was out fast.will be back.

I ordered the Kafka kabob and was blown away with how flavorful and pure the food tasted. It's very rare to find quality authentic Middle Eastern food in the USF area, but this place is by far the best. As if the food wasn't good enough, the service and hospitality delivered by the owner, Abraham, was even more phenomenal. You can tell he has a great heart and it shows in the food. I will definitely come back here more often.

Was really happy with the food but disgusted by their lack of consciousness for the environment. How do you charge that much money for food and then give styrofoam to go containers? This is 2019 and we as a society are well aware of the harm styrofoam causes the environment. It does not cost that much extra to buy containers that don't harm the environment. The business is trying to penny pinch. Will not be eating back until they become a little more environmentally conscious.

This was recommended to me by a hip Local.  The name intrigued me!!!  I was shocked at how limited the menu was.....but then I realized that's the point.  Simplicity. Ease. You could choose ANYTHING on the menu & be blown away.  The atmosphere was so funky, laid back, welcoming.  I ordered the Pork & Peppers on Roti.   The Roti bread is literally the stuff dreams are made of.  I could have just had the bread & I would be writing a 5 star review.  But the unexpected flavors of roasted pork, crispy pig ear, raw onion & pickled peppers elevated this sandwich to the most unique sandwich I've ever had.   If you want something truly unique, please try them out!!!! You will not be disappointed.   UNEXPECTED is the best way to describe it.
My first time in Indianapolis IN and I went here for dinner. The food was absolutely delicious and the service was top notch. I would definitely recommend this restaurant.

Following a left breast mastectomy I was left without a nipple and
went to Veronica hoping she could tattoo a likeness on my reconstructed breast.  Her artwork exceeded my expectations.  I look and more importantly FEEL like my whole self again.  Will forever be celebrating her art whenever I glance in the mirror! So talented!!   PW

Extremely friendly bartenders, free beer sampling, great atmosphere.  When in Goleta do yourself a favor and give this place a try.  Ooh, there's also a great outdoor patio that reminds me of Costa Rica!

Even with good food this restaurant cannot get more than 3 stars because of its service. Yes it's new. Yes it's only been open a few weeks. Buuuut it's service is inexcusably awkward. I'm fairly certain we were forgotten because we chose to have drinks and an appetizer at the bar before we asked to be seated. We waited for at least 20 minutes at our table and then had someone we thought was a guest based on his outfit ask us if we were planning on ordering food. The food is good-not great. Cheese platter was nice but I've had better (47 Scott etc). Steak was good.... Sea bass was nicely cooked but very very salty. Drinks were good but not exceptional. I really wanted to love this place more. I'll give it a few months to figure itself out before patronizing again.  

Ps. Decor was confusing .. Mix of JBar and whatever was hip two years ago.
Lunch was excellent and the price is more than reasonable for a buffet. Interior was on the down side, definitely not upscale environment but service was quick and on point.

Just fell in love with this awesome garden center. The have very unusual plants. Petunia's galore, in every color, even spotted ones.
The staff there is most helpful and very friendly.
I asked if there offered a discount day or a senior discount, and was very happy to find 10% off for seniors everyday.
They also have cute gifts inside.
Check it out!!

This will be my new garden center in Sparks.
Just love all there plants.

I ordered their feast designed to feed 4-6 people for Easter dinner at my new apartment i dont cook lol. I ordered online Thursday picked it up Easter Sunday. Food was great, was hot fed all six of us and we had leftovers matter of fact its two days later and we are still eating it! Best part it was only 65.00 dollars now thats a great price and the people were super nice.

A friend told me about this place.  We got there just before they opened and were able to get a table and the food arrived pretty quickly.  The deviled eggs with fried chicken skins is to die for!!  I don't eat pork, but was able to try a bit of my friend's cabbage salad.  If they had a non-pork option, I would easily put away a plate of that, as well.  I had the fried chicken pot pie.  Not exactly healthy, but also delicious.  The cocktails are good as well.  I'll definitely be back.

Emily was super nice. I had an order to go. I really needed some of your delicious soup. When I got to my hotel she left a little note telling me to get better. That made my night. The soup was delicious and I hope to get rid of this cold. I'll definitely be back again. Thanks Emily!
I've been here 4 times and would recommend it. Service is very good. Tito and Mackenzie are top notch. We enjoyed the cocktails. What a pleasure to not be price gouged!

I want to like this place more, I really do. The TVs are great, nice setup, bars are cool and the vibe is good. Unfortunately the food is very inconsistent and the signature drinks are not good. The service has been consistently awful every time. While my server was really nice, he was way too busy and had too many tables.

The first time I got the Hot Chicken B&B it was pretty good and very hot, the next time I got the Chicken and Dumplings and it was wonderful. My wife got the Brick Tattooed Chicken and it was just bland. The next time I went the Chicken & Dumplins was inedible and salty.  

The Southern Gentleman drink was fun to watch them make but it tasted like pure smoke. It was awful. I like Jack, whiskeys and charcoal/smoke, but this was like someone was breathing a cigar into my mouth. The smoked margarita was better but still a bit too smokey.

I'll go back but I can't go above 3 stars.

OBSESSED with this place! The store is adorable and very easy to navigate. The owner is awesome, she used to be a chemist. She knows all the products in the store and offers some great recommendations. She also just lets you browse and is there if you have questions which is nice. We spent 30 minutes in here just looking around. They have some really great products. I got a curling spray that I love. 

This store is a perfect addition to the neighborhood. I am going to come back and try more things. It's also great if you need to get some unique gifts. The prices are reasonable, especially for being sourced from all over the world.

I have always been scared to try this place for some reason. There are a few of them in the Deep South and none of them ever look appealing to me from the outside.  We went here because a client of mine insisted. What a nice surprise. I had the wood grilled chicken with the yams, and it was amazing. My colleuge had the rotisserie special, which was brisket, and it looked amazing.  If you get their "2 can dine for $29.99" deal, it's a real bargain.  Bayou balls as an appetizer were excellent, and for dessert, we had the creole style cheesecake. I was in awe at how light it was, but later found out that what makes it that way was mixing the cream cheese with Cool Whip. Overall, a very nice experience. They have a really great menu and I will not be afraid to try the other locations in the future.
Truly the #1 pho in Tucson to my standard. I really like their spicy beef pho, the broth is very rich.
Great prices and wonderful staff. Be sure to get here early because it's always busy, rightfully so.

Fabulous little spot! Nothing fancy but Always so fresh and delicious. White dragon roll is out of this world. We have eaten here and got take out bunch of times . They never disappoint. Highly recommend !!!!

Typically speaking I enjoy coming to Hooters. It has the sports bar atmosphere which I love. I frequently visit this location. Unfortunately I have discovered that the management teamSpace or shall I say a particular manager does not value me as a customer. 

On Memorial Day I placed an order to go. A total of 20 wings and some fries. When I got there The time it took me to get to the location was approximately 15 minutes. I made no stops between my house to the restaurant. When I got there they gave me my order and I went straight home. I opened up my bag and took out my wings only to find that they were somewhat cold. I took them downstairs and placed them in my air cooker and heated them and gave my wife a portion and myself as well. There is no expectation of the fries being awesome because it's hard to preserve fries. However the wings although they were hot from the air cooker were somewhat stale. I was disappointed because normally on "to go" orders I never have to reheat them and to my liking they are at the right temperature when I get them home. I called the restaurant and spoke with a manager and he told me that he would write my name down and when I decided to come back they would replace them. A couple of days later I called the restaurant only to speak with another manager who said that my name wasn't written in the book. I'll take some of the responsibility because I should have remembered or wrote down the managers name that told me that but I didn't. However they gave me no assurance that they would look into it. I then had to ask them to check with the manager that worked on that particular day. 
On yesterday June 2 I called again and asked them did they find my name. The same manager that told me they did not see my name spoke with me. He shared with me that he had spoken to the manager that was on duty and he doesn't remember any complaints they had on that day. This particular manager who I spoke with seem to me didn't really care. No additional assistance no nothing. I got off the phone with him feeling devalued as a customer that frequent this establishment on plenty occasions. I made the decision to go back up there to speak with the manager personally. I wanted to assure him that I did not want any wings nor no credit for wings of that nature. I just shared with him that as a consumer I feel as though they do not value me as a customer. I believe the waitstaff does an excellent job. I believe they serve some delicious food. However the manager that assisted me showed me by his actions that they did not or shall I say he did not value me as a customer. I shook his hand and said that I bet Buffalo wild wings will value me as a customer and I also told him that I will share with people on Yelp about my experience. At that time he apologized. I told him that he had two occasions to apologize and now when you've lost me at a customer that's when you decide to apologize?

These tiny little biscuits pack a big punch! I didn't know what to expect since it was my first time venturing inside but I've always wanted to go to the Seminole Heights location but each time we thought of going it was after hours and I was already headed to chop chop shop for dinner. So, I was happy to learn that they were opening a South Tamp location and was eager to try them. 

When I had my first week day off  I  made a beeline straight for them. They've only just opened and they are primed and ready for guests to stop by and try all of the selections they have. The decor is low-key and absorbs with bistro tables and a counter bar table with ample seating at the window. 

There's a pumpkin biscuit for the October special  and an assortment of jams to try which they say will be available for purchase in the near future for take home -yay! It's definitely the season for that. I had already seen a sample menu online so I knew I wanted stand alone biscuits and biscuits with meat but didn't know which flavor. 

I went with the cheddy chive biscuits (2 for $3) and the biscuits and gravy (2 for $5) to go. They're sold as a pair only and they do have to be the same flavor in the pair. The gentleman helping me said he loves the cheddy chive WITH the sausage gravy so naturally I tried them together when I got home. Fabulous flavor combo ! Such a big cheddar flavor and the gravy was delicious and homemade packed full of flavor. 

Don't be fooled but their small size because these biscuits will fill you up - I am stuffed! I made my own cup of coffee but I will be getting the earl gray lavender tea from Teabella (if I'm recognizing the containers correctly) that was available in store on my next round. It is by far my favorite tea flavor and who doesn't want tea and biscuits! 

I think I've found a new favorite munchies spot in the South. Yet another reason we don't need to leave South Tampa because let's face it - we never want to anyways!

Went in to get a beer, had one of their employees cat call my girlfriend, and made her feel very uncomfortable. I would usually leave it at that and not write a review about it, but this guy would not stop even after we walked away.

Their beer is average, I understand it is Bourbon Street, but man keep that stuff out of your workplace if you want business.

I'm guessing that the name derives itself from the Latin, "res ipsa loquitor," that is, "the thing speaks for itself." This seems in line with a modest menu and the café's clean, simple decor, complemented by thoughtful delivery and friendly service.

My Philly days long behind me, I'm always eager to try out spots when I come back to visit because it's all new to me. I've enjoyed hipster breakfast sandwiches across this great nation, so I fancy myself a connoisseur of hipster breakfast sandwiches. I had only modest expectations for an affordable offering at Res Ipsa, a charming, minimalist, yet welcoming and unpretentious spot in a historically mostly charmless stretch of Walnut St.

The breakfast sandwich, laden with a square-formed egg, sautéed spinach, and house-made fennel sausage, and on fresh, quality bread, was excellent-- a sloppy mess without being greasy, its individual ingredients carefully seasoned to perfection, and well-proportioned. The coffee was great.

I would love to go back and try the rest of the menu!

My son really loved the movies of Dolphin Tale and he really wanted to see Winter (if he was behaving all day). It was located in Clearwater next to high rising condos and open waters. It had beautiful views from the outside. The aquarium is for Injured sea animals helping them back to health. I wasn't expecting that. I should have read its mission before going because I was expecting a "Disney experience". It was very crowded on a Saturday. We did get to see Winter and Hope. These dolphins are famous! Food and beverages were only at the main entrance. Also this place wasn't really stroller friendly. It was hard to find ramps to go up and down the floors.  Overall good for kids.

Just completed a transaction and totally agree with previous review.  It was the worst experience I've ever had buying or leasing a vehicle.  We were told one story on the phone regarding the financing and payments, and a totally different story from the finance manager when we went in to sign the papers.  Absolutely bait and switch.

Food was AMAZING! Very flavorful! I mean the pickled celery and carrots were so good! The wings were fresh and had a nice crisp! The meat pie was spicy and flavorful as well as just all around good! They didn't have duck for the nachos so the did it with pulled pork.... didn't care for cheese but that pork was so tender and a little sweet! The manager was super nice and kept a convo going with us. They forgot to give us fries but it was okay we were full! But they are hand cut fries!!!!! Def try them out!

Fantastic! Fantastic!  Stuffed grouper and blue cheese encrusted filet were DELICIOUS!! House salad dressing, a must.  Homemade hummus was so good it convinced a hummus hater to change his mind.  Service was spot on- go TARA!!!

We had wonderful time here. The beers were awesome, and the bartender mixed a great drink. Did not have time to eat. But the thing that stood out the most was that I left my iPhone charging at the Bar, and had not realized it until we were on the way to the airport so we could not turn back. Travis one of the Managers was just wonderful! He mailed my phone back to me right away, didn't charge me a dime, and was just so attentive and gracious about the whole incident! I am from the East Coast and I find it hard to believe that I would have a similar experience here. We will definitely be back!!! Thank you Travis!!!

7 if us Went there for lunch on a Saturday.  Place was not crowded at all. Waitress had a slight attitude, not friendly at all. Food came out sporadically. Two meals at a time.  My wife got a salad with grilled shrimp. Salad comes out with no shrimp. 10 minutes later I get my salad and the waitress brings 3 tiny shrimp on a plate.  Many things were du jour but we were never told what they were. Needs better customer service. Would not go back. Too many other options in Old City.

I don't know.  I've done A LOT of Quizzo around the city.  Much of which is not very exciting.  Quizzo with Johnny himself though...  He always has interesting and challenging questions.  He has great taste in music.  Good sense of humor.  Plus if you read his website, he's a true fan of the trivial.  (And a true Phillies fan too.)  Check him out.  (Johnny, I don't see the review here that you're "pretty lame."  Oh well.)

Nasty....we went for dinner late Saturday night about 1.5 hours till closing. All the workers were standing around talking amoungest themselves....we ordered drinks one had a large fly in it and that waitress said she couldnt see it but took it back anyway...food was so gross....microwaved pre cooked meat and veggies ...blah...never again

pretty chill place. arrived here around 930pm because we looked up wine bars and they close at 3am. they just stop serving food at midnight, just a heads up. we ordered the hummus and it was good! 
i had a full bodied cab (forgot the name) and that was good. my friend had the smore stout and napoleon stout (i think they're both stouts, not too sure) and he really liked it! 
oh, he also got the brownie/cake bar. it had walnuts and chocolate in it. too sweet for my own liking, but not bad! he liked it. good atmosphere, helpful service, quiet place to talk.

Great prices and great food. Not 5 stars because it isnt perfect food, but it is very good and sure beats chains like On The Border. Very good service as well--you will be dealing with authentic Mexican staff.

We loved everything about our stay here. I arrived pretty late (around midnight) to the Boise airport so was very happy to learn there was a free shuttle still running! When I checked in I was given the choice of what floor I wanted and when I asked if there were good views they said oh yes and gave me a Capitol facing room on the top (10th floor). 

The room was huge and the view was great! I loved seeing the Capitol on the backdrop of the mountains. The location was fantastic- we walked to the Capitol and the Saturday morning market and were within walking distance of a bunch of restaurants. We also appreciated the included breakfast. We didn't use most of the other amenities but did do a quick walking tour and it all looked good! I would definitely stay here again if I visit Boise again.

I have been Dr. Kelly's patient for approximately 7 years.  She is a great physician and her office is very efficient and well organized.  My appointment times always been prompt.  Dr. Kelly is very thorough as well as kind and patient.

Seriously some of the best service in a long time at a Steak N Shake. Our server was great. Everything right and then we went to pay ( cue waa waa waa ) We stood up front being totaly ignored by staff. I know it was not as long as it seemed but it was too long. Three men up front two cooking and one doing nothing but talking. The three of them saw us and never spoke a word. The manager was making shakes and never looked up or down toward the cashier area. I was embarrassed my husband had to go to the corner and wave our check and money to get the attention of anyone that cared. The manager did apologize for the wait but she needs to train her staff to at the very least acknowledge customers. One minute, somone will be with you in a moment, any thing would work. 5 stars for our Server 0 for manager.

Coming from NYC and going to LA and Miami every month means I take my sushi very seriously.  I never expected to find such quality and consistency in a small town like Doylestown, PA. 

Me and the Mrs. love going for lunch (when the kids are at school) and it brings back memories of when we lived in NYC.  The bento boxes are a great deal and I love the Yellowtail with Basil oil and the White Tuna.

Don't forget desert.  We love the deep fried banana with Vanilla ice cream.  I seem to also remember enjoying the red bean ice cream.

Smells like fresh chopped wood as soon as you walk in. Fried pickles  overcooked, over fried, VERY SALTY Grilled chicken salad was bland and dressing was nasty. Sausage was okay.... family said they liked their bbq sandwiches but didn't sound convincing. Get up and get your own drinks. Food is very bland.
Wow lots of folks in a tiny space. Fresh bean sprouts in the fridge in back. Just watch sell by date on some packaged good were very out of date.

I couldn't eat a lot of things here (gluten, dairy, oh wow) but I have to mention it for the mocktails! Few places bother to list non alcoholic drinks on the menu, but Bud & Marilyns did. 
The atmosphere is nice. There are tables for meals, or a wrap around bar with seating where you can see the kitchen and all the cooking that goes on. Really nice spot for a first date or after work nightcap.

It's pretty smoke-filled inside of Harrah's, but I guess it's a good place to go if you're into gambling. 

I've been here twice in my 3+ years of living in NOLA. Once was for the Wheel of Fortune auditions, and then the fiance and I recently attended a fundraiser for the kidney foundation. The Harrah's staff was very accomodating and poured lots of fantastic free drinks.

We gambled a little bit with the penny slots, using the $10 voucher that we each received at the event. After losing that money, we wandered around for a while. The club in the middle of the casino had some women dancing on some platform thing... surprisingly, not many people watching them. I'm not sure if this is a regular thing or not.

I should have read the reviews before coming here, so I would have known to order a drink from the slot machine. Oh well. Something to try next time.

I'm giving this 3 stars. Not because there is anything wrong with Harrah's, but because there isn't really anything overly spectacular about Harrah's compared to any other casino I've ever been to.

This is a review for a party I attended here. I think this is a more personalized option to the regular Chuck E Cheese birthday party, since you get the privacy of the whole room and don't have to have your child dive into a pit of dirty balls.

Pros:
1. Gym staff provides guidance and supervision for some fo the kids to do some cool tricks
2. Kids ages 2 - 7 will LOVE this place
3. Safety is key
4. They have a parking lot for guests 
5. Waiting room for parents who don't want to participate

Cons:
1. Time spent playing is super short (like 1 hr)
2. Staff in the party area are just like in Chuck E Cheese and have very little common sense, so come prepared with everything you need.
3. Party room is kind of dungey looking, no music, and standing room only for adults.

I was impressed with how smooth a 3 year old's birthday party could be and considered opening up my own Little Gym after realizing what a sweet hustle it is to charge $350 for a party that last only 1.5 hrs.

New health issue been messing with my energy. My 5 am's are now 9am. That 5 miles that helped get me to and beyond my weight loss goal (148# down and not from the new issue yet) has been unreachable for almost a month. Time is slow but beats being unable to do it at all. The gym, lots of renovations that were really needed. Water heater being replaced today, water fountain been out of service for at least a week. No showers today limited locker room at least a week. On the other coast renovations were all done overnight,  when it's least busy and completed in two days. Coping! The staff is awesome, I'm sure they didn't make renovation decisions! Been coming here for over a year and have yet to meet the GM. 
The 4 stars are earned by the employees, Rihanna and Mark are always so kind, helpful and are always keeping busy the entire time I'm here. Not a lot of smiles on any of the staff, that is typically a management issue. Happy employees in any service industry results in happy customers more often then not. Thanks team for helping me reach my fitness goals.

If you're going .... to New Orleans ... be sure to stuff some oysters in your belly.

For lowdown, stuffing your face without regrets it doesn't get much better than the Acme Oyster House.  Whether your preference is to eat em raw or fried w/ parmesian (my personal fav) or in a Po Boy, this is the best place in America to eat oysters.

If you are going at lunchtime try to get there a little early because once the line starts forming it is hard to even get a spot at the counter on a weekday.

A trip to the Big Easy isn't complete without a stop here.
Niaomi is amazing. This is the only Walgreen's we shop at and save all our drug store related shopping for here. The store is really well organized and clean. Always friendly service.

This is my favorite location. The staff is always very friendly. The cooks prepare AMAZING, and I mean AMAZING food. There is one server in particular who is just great. She knows my order-  and some of my moms order even  when we walk in. This location is truly beautiful. I wouldn't ask for any place better.

I'm glad we tried this pizza place. The food is pretty darn good and the people that work there are very nice. I love the fountain in the center, it makes you feel like you've entered the Garden of Eden of pizza and hoagies. They keep the place pretty clean and you can tell they strive to always do their best. They have a Ms. Pac-Man arcade game as well. Nice place!

I've been here 2-3 times, and I've always ordered the Lil Chuy.  The Chelsea Handler is a little too big for my appetite, but the Lil Chuy is just right.  The food is consistently good and so is the service.  I've had a chocolate malt shake, but you can get it without malt if you're not a fan - my Mom is not a fan of malt apparently.

There's tons to look at in this place!  All the shark-themed items, like shark squeak toys by the soda fountain.  It's just such a cool environment, and there's always a movie playing on the TVs.  The owner is super nice and friendly.  It just makes it such an inviting experience.

It is cash-only, so just make sure you have cash on hand or hit the ATM before you come.

We stayed here two nights on 9/6 and 9/7. The staff were very friendly and helpful.  The views from the room were beautiful.  The lounge was modern looking,  but comfy.  Staff was always offering waters.  The bed was comfy and room was perfect. I would definately stay here again. Great location, walking distance from bourbon st, harrahs casino, french market and st. Louis cathedral.

Highly disappointed.  My friend and I went for pedicures.  The service wasn't great and the leg massages were short, the whole pedicure was short.  We typically go to Signature in Green Hills which has never disappointed.  I will not be going back to Nail Bar.
I went on the vampire and ghost tour with a group of six. The tour guide was very friendly and informative. It was affordable and fun! Must do!!

After reading the previous reviews on Yelp, I decided to give this place a try - specifically, the Singapore Mei Fun lol. 

I remember one time I ordered pork chops with rice at a food truck and was greeted with fried chicken wings, rice, and some bitter broccoli when I got back - FAIL.  So of course, I came to this place with big hopes but little expectations.  

Now, let me just say hat this was one of the best food stands/trucks type around Temple that I have ever encountered. 

I was totally surprised by the amount of chicken, roasted pork, and shrimp in the serving!  Trust me, it's not just a deceiving few laid on top, and you'll never have to dig through it to find some meat.  With that said, I thought the chicken was a little dry...but the pork and shrimp made up for it and the portions were definitely generous for only $5.50!!!!  I haven't tried its other dishes but I can testify that the Singapore Mei Fun is well worth the price. 

Also the food comes in a decent sized aluminum plate with a plastic cover, which I think is much more convenient and healthy than the cheap styrofoam lunch boxes.  And instead of a plastic bag, you'll get a paper lunch bag, yay! 

Anyway, the service is fast and efficient; I went a little past 1 and there was not much of a line when I got there.  If you're unsure about what to order, try the mei fun!

Oh, and the guy indeed yells SING MEI in a very cool manner.  :)

Oh my goodness! Mama Nita's was such a sweet little find! We went to Fishers to shop at IKEA and wanted a good place to eat afterwards. Yelp had this at 5 stars which we don't really see in Muncie so we thought we would give it a try. It's in a little strip mall looking area and isn't overly appealing from the front but once you get in those doors, your know you're in a friendly place! 

I've never been the biggest fan of buffets because you have to come at a certain time and the food is always cold. That's not the case with Mama Nita's! The pizzas are all small so they have to constantly make fresh ones to replace them. The buffet is all through their hours so you're guaranteed to get food, you can order out, and ALL the pizzas are extremely flavorful and unique! I'm upset we don't live closer so we can make this our new spot but we will definitely be back!

In from Phoenix and checked out this place based on Yelp reviews.  We had an amazing dinner.  Ambiance of restraint and decor was great. Service was spot on. But the star was the food. I had Frutta Del Mar.  the seafood was delicious and the saffron rissoto mixed with the white wine and lemon garlic butter sauce of the dish was beyond delicious.  My husband had the Pork Ossobucco.  Tender - fell off the bone. Great flavor.  Finished with the pizza cookie which was a crowd pleaser with the kids.  Next time we are back in Tucson this will be our dinner spot.

I needed a new key fob for my car. I tried getting it from a different place and they were a mess - only one person out of the six employees was trained to do it and he was never there. The one time I did get him he could only do the key, not the fob. And the key took him almost an hour!

AAA had the entire fob in stock, the employee that was there was able to help me, and he was done in under 15 minutes. Polite and helpful through entire service as well.

I use to love eating here but this place has turned to shit within the past several years and even more so in the past 3-4. The old guy that owns it is insufferable. His younger kid Lou doesn't care about anything. The food has gone down in quality 10 fold. Over done pizza, dry sandwiches, barely any sauce in the steak sandwiches. When you complain they just brush it off. I would highly recommend passarelios in moorestown over this place

The food was absolutely amazing! After looking on Yelp and being disappointed by lackluster reviews for other brunch spots, we took a chance on Ruby Slipper. I will be back every time I'm in NOLA. I checked in on the Yelp app and was seated with no issue after checking in again in person. Please get the filled French toast and know that you can customize things on the menu to your liking. Also, I appreciated the size of my mimosas as many places did NOT give us our money's worth. Very glad we got to eat here. I'm still full!

I love how easy it was to make an appointment online, even for appointments later the same day.  The worker showed up on time, and even called a half hour beforehand, so I didn't have to leave work any earlier than I needed to.  Diagnosed and fixed the problem right away.  Great service!

Diana and her staff are fantastic. I am thrilled with how she is helping me transition to my natural gray hair. She made sure my expectations were realistic and that I understood the process. My initial results were better than expected and I will be using her to help me maintain this look. She is friendly, knowledgeable and very reasonably priced. I highly recommend anyone at this salon!

Awesome new venue for music! I was here last weekend to see Lake Street Dive and Grace Potter perform, and the experience was great. There's standing room in the front, ticketed lawn seating in the middle, and standing room and tables at the very back. Acoustics are great. Apparently there's been some complaints about the noise from nearby residents--I guess that's the price you pay for living in the middle of Music City.

Ok food but portions seemed a bit lacking. We had the jambalaya and it tasted ok but the platter of rice was small and not filling. The shrimp po' boy was pretty good but wished it came with some sauce (tartar maybe?) and some side dish (like cole slaw). The charbroiled oysters had good flavor but were a bit salty, you definitely need to eat the plain bread slices with it (wish I had some butter to put on the bread). The bill added up do to the small portions of food.

The place smelled like an old musty bar.

Very cute, family owned and delicious food. I wish the place was a little bigger, it tends to feel cramped but there's nothing they can do about it and it doesn't stop me from going there to eat. Amazing cookies also, definitely must try the cookies!!!

This is street version of the regular red mesa. The seating is outdoors and is covered. The food menu is different than the other red mesa's as well.  The food is pretty good but not as outstanding as other  mesa spots. It's still pretty good but when compared they fare better.

The service is quick to order and the prices are reasonable. so far I tried chicken quesadilla,  chicken enchilada, tacos( chicken, shrimp and pork), Churros and flan. Personally I loved the quesadilla the best and churros are churros.

Harahan finally has a decent BBQ Joint!!!
A non-descript location (it is next to Kim Ahn Noodle House) in a wee strip mall, Smoked can play with the big dawgs. Their Brisket (Burnt Ends) is legit, and flavourful enough that they don't require sauce - unlike a certain chain that is closer to the Huey P. Long Bridge. Their sides are hella good (I've had the Mac & Cheese; Beans, and Mashed Potato's so far). 
They will outgrow this location with a quickness!

Well first off. Saturday at 5:30 must not be the time to go. After we waiting for the 35 min we were told plus an additional hour, We were seated. We only had a party of eight. Not too hard to handle. Our orders were pretty simple. Nothing to fancy. And two of them came out wrong. After asking for more coffee twice were got our check and ready to leave and the coffee finally showed up. Thanks but we were done by then. 

My family and i will never be back to this place.

We really like this little lounge and have been there a few times.  The interior is spectacular; you could get lost in the blue on the walls and the vibe is hip but very comfortable.  The lounge can mix up any drink you have in mind and they have a good selection of draft beer and wine.   The star, however, is the food.  We love the satay, the crepes, and the tacos.  We have not had anything that wasn't really good.  It's all easy to share or eat for a meal yourself.  It doesn't seem to be real busy when we are there and I cannot figure out why.  It's just a bit off the track but across the street from 10  Barrel so it's easy to find.  Definitely check it out and support this unique restaurant.  The atmosphere and the food and drink are all worth trying and coming back for.

Came here on a Friday for the late night happy hour (10pm-12am everyday). I had the "what the buck",!which was pretty basic cocktail. The real reason to come here is the beautiful patio deck - lots of tables sitting under string lights and garden themed decorations. Definitely worth the visit if you are in Rittenhouse!

Two stars for the service and beer selection. We were excited when we walked in and saw the place was buzzing. The hostess got us seated quickly and the waitress had us sipping on cold beers in minutes. It was downhill from there. We started with the "jumbo" wings, which arrived soggy and without any attempt at presentation. These were grocery store wing sections without a crisp served on a white plate. Overall, seasoning was Ok and the house blue cheese palatable, but they looked more boiled then fried. With past restaurant experience, we started to look at other apps. They all seemed pale and without any gusto. Disappointment continued with the main course. The tots were atrocious. The freezer burned taste was strong and these were cold and rubbery minutes after arrival. The candied bacon burger lacked pizzazz and the back served it without any of the listed condiments. The meatloaf was dry and flat, saved a bit by the slightly over salted gravy. I'm a big supporter of local establishments and don't demand the finest. Being opened for les than a month may be to blame, but if the menu doesn't improve there may not be a lot of chances to get it right.

The dinner was very disappointing !  We had visited the Inn many times over the year and were very happy with it  We had moved out of the area and wanted to enjoy the place for old times sake! 
I booked it for a special occasion this time and sorry I did. 
Sadly the food was average and the service was weak!!!
Sorry to say we won't be back!

This place's food is absolutely terrible. As a Jamaican I am offended by what they are calling jerk chicken. The chicken is bland lacking salt and general seasoning. The rice is laughable at best but could be described more as a casserole of green peas and kidney beans. I doubt there is a single Caribbean or Creole person that is involved in the restaurant particularly the kitchens or the recipes. I would ask for my money back but honestly would I be happier just never mentioning this place ever again.

After watching Girls trip, I wanted to go to Bourbon Street. In the movies it looked like so much fun. But in reality it was filthy!!!!!! I guess I'd If liked drinking and seafood this would be an ideal place for me but sadly it wasn't. It was just dirty to me. It didn't help that the trash growing on the corners smelled unGodly. The homeless population is depressing. I was discouraged from coming back to NOLA because of my lackluster experience on Bourbon St but we discovered the French Marketplace which I thoroughly enjoyed. I don't have to do Bourbon Street again.
Typical Starbucks experience. I'm a simple order Americano w/ room for milk. Can't really mess me up.

I love wine, I love cheese, and I really, really love atmosphere.  What can I say?  I am a sucker for a cool place to sit and have a bottle of wine...or four...with friends and eat some cheese along the way, while fun music plays and the doors stay open, and happy people come and go.  

However, a good wine and cheese selection typically speaks for itself and raises the question:  does good taste make for a five start experience?  Perhaps.  Unless you're a mid-range wine drinker who looks for, oh, fifty dollars a bottle and isn't quite sure what she's the in the mood for--all the qualities that would make a quotidian bartender very uninterested.  

Not at 33.  Every experience I have ever had here has literally made my day as far as service expectations go.  Every time I think I may be neglected--slightly tipsy and indecisive; alone with a computer and a cheese plate I literally ate by myself with my laptop out like a dork -- nothing keeps these gentleman from providing a genuine service experience.  They are consistently, openly suggestive, asking insightful questions about your preferences and assisting you to decide on exactly what you are looking for.  Always patient and always helpful, always genuine and always striking in their presence, this is service as I wish I could have at any given restaurant.  To boot, their sense of self-awareness, their humor, and their sincere goofiness (see:  crossword puzzle, map quiz, etc. on the chalkboard above the bar) make you feel as if you are back to see old friends any time you stop in, and don't dare feel intimidated.  These are not snobbish wino's!

Please visit 33 not only for the atmosphere, the vast selection, and the experience of drinking wine and eating cheese at a place deliberately intended for such activity--but also to support a group of people who care about what they do as an establishment and to support a business representative of the best of Saint Louis.  I will be returning again and again and I hope you will be with me.

We love Bettina. Sitting at the bar chatting with customers. The food is delicious. Service great. Meatballs. Little gem salad and pepperoni pizza. Don't leave without trying the olive cake!  Wonderful ambiance inside and out. Best to make a res.

This place deserves better reviews than it has. I went with a couple of friends, and we were very impressed by the tacos, nachos, and quesadillas (we didn't try out a burrito). Particularly the chips, salsa, and fish were some of the best in town.

My advice would be to get the fish nachos. Like I said, the chips and fish are both amazing, and at only $11, it's kind of a menu hack. The tacos range from $5-$6, so for the price of two tacos, you could get a massive plate of nachos, easily big enough for two people to share and be satisfied, for the price of two tacos. The tacos are definitely good but overpriced.

At the end of the day, Bajo Sexto is a fast, tasty place to get a great lunch. I'd definitely recommend!

We came for our anniversary again but this time we had our 10 month old with us. We made reservations early (5 pm). The bartender (we sat near the bar) made jokes that people shouldn't have their kids in the restaurant. I thought that was rude. 

I was a little nervous bringing the baby since Yelp indicated it wasn't a place for kids but we brought the baby anyway. I'm was glad to know that the restaurant has high chairs! For some reason, I didn't think they would. 

The baby started signing "milk" and the owner asked if he should bring a cup of milk for the baby. That was sweet but she wanted mama's milk. 

The food:
The food was great, as always. But the desserts were not as good. Well, we ordered bread pudding which was delicious and we also ordered creme brûlée. The sugar on the top of the brûlée was burnt! It tasted really bad and the fruit served with the dishes was very tart. 

Overall, we had an okay experience. I'm not sure if I want to return next year, though.

This is a great place for some authentic Cuban coffee. I loved the atmosphere here as well. Watching the people up front roll cigars was a cool experience. The coffee tasted great and was really strong.

This store is the worst. I'm not even sure why they have a store front. The associates don't know the product or even the promotions they have right now. They are also extremely unhelpful. 

Fortunately since I have apple products- I can go to the Apple store and get the help I need. 

Stay away if you 



UPDATE:

Went in again- and was turned away AGAIN. the store manager Gracie would not let me return products that were delivered to me today!!! The order was cancelled an hour after I ordered and the items were not to be delivered. So now I sat on hold for almost two hours just wanting help and wanting to give back 2500$ worth of iPhones and iPads. Wtf is wrong with Verizon!

This review is based only on my check in experience. 

I had a good 4 hours to kill before my flight so fambam decided to check in all my bags early. This was a great idea because who wants to be rushing through a brunch... 

My GodNephew (who is the resident in this state) advised it shouldn't take long since "Boise Airport is rarely crowded." It sure didn't look like it was when we got there. 

Parked at the curb. I told Big Bro to wait about 20 seconds confident it would take longer to walk in toward the SWA counter than the actual check-in process. Big Bro declined and said, "Nope. We're gonna go around." 

(Good decision. There were a couple of squad cars ahead.)

GodNephew and I walked in and sure enough, a few of the kiosks were open. I didn't get the chance to use any of them, though, since their attendant decided to just help me directly. He took my last name, tagged my bags, verified my identity and, "Thank you for flying Southwest! Have a great flight!" 

Walked out of there less than a minute. 

I should have taken that attendant's name. He really was efficient. 

All airlines should be like this ALL THE TIME! 

(I'm dreaming, I know, but WHO KNOWS! It could still happen!)

Pizzeria Beddia gets a lot of hype and for the most part it delivers!

Located in the trendy Fishtown neighborhood, the façade is a mix of its previous open air space at the entrance followed by a new, covered, and formal dining space. It's a nice nod to its roots and also it's future.

Of note, reservations are recommended. We had a 9:15pm reservation. We checked in on time but weren't seated until 9:40pm. The service staff were aware they were behind and did their best to keep on schedule. We ended up grabbing some wine and hung out in the outside space. There are heating lamps and picnic tables outside, but it is limited. Since it was a Friday night, for our purposes, it was standing room only. 

Inside is open, light in color, and bright. There are booths available towards the back and a large bar when we first walk in. It is rather raucous inside and the acoustics didn't help, as some times it was hard to hear each other. 

Once seated, our waitress was quick to offer us drinks, the menu, and to recommend an appetizer as it would take a bit for pizza to come out (each pie is baked fresh.) 

The menu is pretty diverse (for a pizza place), with options for many different diets. They also had a special running that night. We ended up ordering the special - a white pizza with shallots and kale, as well as their "angry" pizza - which we were warned was spicy (made with Serrano peppers  in the sauce!)

For an appetizer, we ordered a cheese platter. The appetizer was pretty tasty but the bread it was served with was ill proportioned. The waitress did give us another bowl of bread to help balance it out. 

Once the pizza came out (took about 25 minutes), it was warm and ready to be devoured. The white pizza was very savory but a little heavy on the finishing oil! The amount of napkins necessary does not exist! The "angry" pizza lived up to its expectations - spicy but SO good! 

There were four of us and the two pies definitely left us full with spare slices left. I liked that they hand out aluminum foil when wrapping up to go containers - environmentally friendly. That being said...the pizza is pricy so I'm sure they could afford to option actual boxes to use as to go containers. 

We ended up ordering their espresso ice cream - which really cleansed the palate! We just ordered one helping and extra spoons - it was enough for all of us without feeling like we were in a food coma! 

The service was good and the food was delicious so definitely a place to try and even return to. It is on the pricier side for a pizza parlor, and the wait times can be lengthy - it's not an easy option for pick up and go :(. 

Enjoy!!

We love custard and Deters does not disappoint! Lots of choices to pick from and fruits are fresh.  I would give 5 stars but I think the prices are a wee bit for the proportions .  However, we love going there and the staff is very nice and helpful!  It's very convenient to where we park  our RV so we always come to Deters after we get home from trip. Yum!

Excellent! Real Sichuan Chinese food outstanding, service is outstanding and the place is super clean!
And on top of this service is fast!

Stopped by on a Sunday morning to grab donuts to take back home after going by another establishment that had a long line out the door.  There was only one person in front of us which was fantastic for someone who loathes waiting in long lines.  The girl who filled our order seemed annoyed that we were ordering a dozen donuts even though there was only one other group in the store who was being waiting on by another gentleman.  
There were several choices so we got a little bit of everything.   We were underwhelmed for the most part.  The chocolate icing used on long johns and some of the other donuts seemed like it had been sitting there for awhile.  I'm not sure if that is the norm for this place or if it was just a fluke, but it added nothing to the donuts.  Their yeast donut holes were delicious.   
While I don't think I'll rush here next time in town visiting family, I would still give it another try.

I just moved to San Francisco from Philly, but have always gone back to my parent's home in Minnesota to have our family dentist provide my oral care. I have always enjoyed the dentist and never wanted to become one of those people who hated the dentist because of a negative experience.  That being said, I was forced to visit the dentist today because my permanent, lower retainer came unglued from my lower incisor last night while flossing.  In addition to re-securing my retainer, my mouth was overdue for a cleaning. I called a lot of dentists and orthodontists shopping for rates and nobody could give me a firm quote.  I called Avenue of the Arts Dentistry and was helped by Jennifer on the phone. She was so kind and helpful and promised to get me a firm quote as soon as her boss arrived. The cleaning with ex rays was $100 and the repair was $50. Other places were going to charge me between $90-180 for the repair alone. Another place wouldn't do their $125 cleaning unless I also got ex rays which would cost an additional $125.  All of a sudden I was going to spend $250 plus $90-180.   However, Jennifer promised everything could be done for $150. I was a little skeptical that they would try to sell me extras once I was there but I knew I could deal with the annoyance if that came up. 

I got to the office and Jennifer was so friendly. Isaiah, Dr. Mark's assistant, introduced himself right away. We talked about how much we all love Philly, I filled out my forms, and they ushered me right back. Isaiah took my ex rays and Dr. Mark arrived immediately after. I could tell the two had a rhythm with their process because they didn't even have to communicate much to repair my retainer. I could go on and on about how meticulous and gentle Dr. Mark was but I'll let you discover that for yourself. Dr. Mark cleaned my teeth and taught me some new things about oral care that I will implement moving forward. He explained that sensitivity is normal around 25-30 due to age, and he never tried to sell me anything or try to convince me that extra things needed to be done.  I left the office paying exactly what I was quoted. When I move back to Philly in a couple years, I look forward to knowing I have a dentist here that I trust!

I was visiting Tampa from California and decided I wanted a Frisco melt from one of my old favorite fast food restaurants. Let's just say it's been 10+ years that I've been back to FL and I am not missing anything. The Frisco was greasy and tasteless and those fries sucked a@*. I am truly disappointed on the quality of the food.

Was looking for a good salad (not fake lettuce and croutons) and wine. Turns out it's hard to get those things at the same place....but not here! I got to enjoy my delicious arugula and beet salad AND some good Pinot noir at the same place. Ahhhhh satisfaction.

What a great addition to downtown. Iron John's tasting room has ~35 seats comprised of small tables and a long bar. The buildout was very nice and its a very comfortable environment. They offer bottles from the cooler, and also 4oz, 10oz and 16oz pours of ~9 beers on draft. The bartenders are very friendly and they have great operating hours.I went the 1st Wednesday they were open at ~4pm and it was busy! Congrats John & John!

I get my haircut regularly by Armando, an excellent hair stylist. He takes great pride in his work and shows the utmost care and effort to give me the best haircut time and again. He strives to please and I highly recommend his services.
No!!! We want this just for us. It's bloody brilliant. We live locally and you'll never meet anyone disappointed.

This place is a wonderful addition to the Tampa food scene. The food is great but the service is what separates them from the rest. The waiters are extremely attentive and engage. The hostess and manager are fantastic.

There was a power outage and they were able to notify me extremely early and when the power came back on they were able to accommodate my large party again- even pushing the reservation back 25 minutes to accommodate some of our long distance guests. 

Laura, your assistance was GREATLY appreciated!

I am unbelievably lucky to be able to walk to Craft Alliance in the U. City Loop.  My pocketbook, eh--maybe not quite as lucky, but who's asking that thing, anyway? ;)

Craft Alliance offers some stupendous art classes--everything from pottery to weaving, from flamework (for making glass beads) to metal-smithing, from drawing and painting to wood-turning...  You're bound to find something that gets those creative juices flowing.  And if you're too busy or too afraid of commitment to sign up for a lengthy class, they offer intensives as well.  I took a wire-wrapped jewelry intensive at Craft Alliance and learned some nifty skills right quick--and it left me hungry for more!  Once I figure out my 5 month old's schedule (ha), I hope to jump into another class as soon as possible.

The free exhibits at this location are really quite good.  I love the annual teapot show and there's always something new and interesting to check out.  And it's FREE. 

My favorite thing about Craft Alliance (and this is a dangerous thing) is the gallery shop.  Oh.  My.  Goodness.  There are far too many fabulous items in that shop that I'd like to buy.  Gorgeous jewelry.  Functional & beautiful pottery.  Unique stationery.  Lovely scarves (the t-shirt scarves are so soft and comfy!) and felted handbags.  All those hand-blown glass ornaments that decorate the shop's picture window during the holidays...  A girl could totally go broke shopping at Craft Alliance, but you know, artists have to make a living, too, right?

If you need a gift for just about anyone who's even remotely cool, hit up Craft Alliance.  If your desk job is sapping the creative life right out of you, sign up for a class.  If you're just wandering the Loop and want a quiet spot to stop and see some fabulous free art, well, here you go.  And if you want to make fast friends with me, buy me some fab jewelry, will ya? ;)
This place is great! It's the closest thing to pizza from the Jersey shore that I've found in Tampa. The staff is great and the food is spectacular! Just like back up North. Love this place!!!!!!

I joined because my parents joined because a friend of an EMT joined.  Anyway, I guess what I'm trying to say is that it's not that hard to become a member. You just have to know someone who is a member.

Aside from that, credit unions really are amazing. They have great rates and the staff are friendly and are truly trying to help you!  Once you're a member, it's not really that difficult to get your banking needs taken care of.

Cons:
1) Main complaint is that there isn't much parking. It would be great if they had a parking lot for customers...
2) sometimes they have long lines
3) their rates aren't the lowest I've seen at a credit union, but I think they are the second lowest, so still great! And their auto loans are the lowest!
4) no drive thru ATM (but its outside and you can access it 24/7)

Pros:
1) great phone services and can view account online
2) friendly and helpful staff
3) ATM on location but also at the other 10 pffcu locations. They also have ATMs through certain networks where you can withdraw and/ or deposit cash from places like Wawa, 7-11, pnc and certain, small local banks (see ATM locator page -- http://www.pffcu.org/about-pffcu/atms.asp )
4) great rates for loans 
      - auto loan as low as 2.25 for new and 2.50 for used!!
5) great hours! Open on Saturdays!!  Monday - Wednesday until 6pm and Thursday/ Friday until 7pm!

Great product and great service.  I was hesitant to purchase because I was afraid I would mess up the template to create my table pad. The person I spoke with (Mike?) was so helpful. He even offered to walk me thru tracing for the template if needed. I sent in a sad mess of a tracing but less than 2 weeks later received a perfect table pad!  Great customer service and quality product.

A very soft three stars. When you see the name Westin attached to something it usually means a great hotel experience in all aspects. This property, not so much.

First off, bellman and valet parkers are almost non-existent. It's a large property and self-parking is far away and hilly. I've never been to any property of this sort that didn't have a team of bellmen and or valet parkers at the ready to help the guest. Really bad first impression and last impression, too!

Check-in can get bogged down because of lack of staff at times. I will give a very enthusiastic thumbs up to the front desk staff, though. They do a terrific job and have great attitudes. Shout out to Cosmo at the front desk. He was extremely helpful and professional. 

I had a difficult time finding where my room was located. To top it off, the elevator was out of order so had to lug my bags up the stairs. The elevator was still out of order the next day too.

My room was OK, but there was a sticky stain on the floor. See picture.  I have no idea what it was, but you don't expect to step on a sticky floor at ANY hotel, much less the Westin. Gross!

The free Wifi they offer is really slow. It was only 3.9mbps. Good enough for email, but not much else. 

All the staff I encountered were very friendly and professional. 

I was there for a conference. The conference room was nice but the lighting is very poor. The lights were turned all the way up and it was still only dimly lit with a few bright spots that shined directly down on certain parts of the room for no reason.  

When people are at a conference, they are usually listening and watching speakers up front. The stage area is as dark as the rest of the room. Not good.

I was at this property three years ago, it seemed to be a lot better run then.

Great atmosphere underneath the yellow umbrellas across from the car shop. It's a great place to order and sit down without having to go through the whole waiter ordeal. The Carnitas were mouth wateringly delicious. I think I could eat this everyday without ever getting tired it. My mom polished off the kale salad too...aka she loved it. Definitely a place to come with a group of friends to chill.

MVG only cares about excellent customer service when you are about to shell out money for their products.  Try to get help after the purchase and you get rushed, annoyed or downright rude replies.  AND, I never get the same answer to the same problem from multiple employees.  They seem to base advice on opinion not fact.  I had an issue after purchasing my citrus trees and called and visited many times.  I brought samples and photos.  Every employee had a different answer each time; one said too much water, one said not enough, one said too much sun, one said not enough. one said the way it was planted, one said that they sold me the wrong trees for the climate.  Thanks for telling me after I shelled out $400 for 4 trees.  Only 2 lived and I took the same care with each one.  IMO, you are better off gambling with a lower quality tree from Home Depot; at least they will accept refunds if the plants don't survive.

I decided to give them one more try in preparation for the upcoming hard freeze.   I just tried calling and I was hung up on 8 times; they just picked up the phone and hung up.  When he finally had the time to answer, he lied and said there was a phone problem.  Which is a lie since I could hear him pick up, there was a few second delay, then I could hear the receiver being put down and the line disconnected.  I wrote a review on MerchantCircle and promptly received an email from the GM.  I emailed her my issues with their customer service and got an equally snippy reply.  She basically told me that they can't make everyone happy all the time and that mine was not the only opinion and told me that Home Depot needs shoppers too.  I would have expected an apology and a request for details to improve the customer experience. But as I expected, horrible customer service comes from the top down; obviously the employees are only able to get away with their behavior because it is acceptable to management.

I just tried there NEW fried chicken!  It's perfectly spicy, super crispy and juicy inside!  I'm a fried Chicken girl and this is right up my alley!  AND....AND....it's available every day!  Yippee!  If you like fried chicken, check out Cracker Barrel for their new super crispy, excellent fried chicken!  It comes out in a metal plate with pretty blue printed paper!  Well done you awesome folks at CB!

We came here to wind down some time before the night tour trolley bus. Very Spacious and wall to wall flavors of moonshine and whiskey.  Different merchandise you can buy.  The customer service wasn't the best. The staff was standing around talking and not paying attention to their customers. I tried to get 2 of the employees attention only to be ignored. One guy just stared and turned around and continue his conversation. No greeting no smiles and awful customer service. One of the worst places I visited in Nashville that gave out No Hospitality

Delicious Pizza and the drinks are perfect!! We are visiting from Minnesota and Georgia and loved this restaurant. Extremely convenient location if you stay at the Hilton Garden Inn and Convention Center.

Ice cream is as expected from Bassett's. So what this amounts to is a review of the the shop itself. Looks nice and appropriate for Old City. I really wanted to like this this shop but the employees are off-putting. The two ladies working tonight did not greet us and when we asked about flavors they were texting and told us to "hold on." Their English was very rude, with improper grammar and dismissive to say the least. Will not be returning sadly.
This place is my new favorite!!!!  Huge beverage selection and the appetizers...we had a hard time choosing.  The smothered fries are fabulous.  Nice staff and kept clean.
Their bagels are delicious, if not quite the New York gold standard.  And they make their own great cream cheeses. We've always been happy with our breakfasts here.  And the service is lovely.

So disappointed. Took 1 hour & 15 minutes to get food, which then had to be boxed up bc we all
Had to leave to get back to work. In addition, my entree was ok, but not great.

This is a new small business trying to make a go of it. I'm optimistic because they're trying so hard, and they have a great product. The burger is really one of the best I've ever had. Fries are also amazing. It's a tough location At the end of the strip, and raised above the street. Get better signage, guys.  Spend some dough on marketing, I know it's tough when you're just starting out. These guys, when you go in and talk to them, have such a great outlook and really want to succeed.  Just the best customer service. They fixed up the interior, it's really nice and inviting. Us locals really have to go here, and you'll be glad you did!
Their food is delicious and the folks who run the place are wonderful. We're going to keep coming back for takeout, no doubt.

Ed T. was wrong. There are quite a few men here.  Of course, they are either confirmed bachelors working on crafts, or married husbands with their wives.  Either way, its a place to go for lots of arts and crafts stuff.  Of course, if you are looking for Testors paints or a model rocket, you aren't going to find them at Jo-Ann.  If you are looking for Fabric or Frames, you'll be thrilled.

Breakfast is so fabulous. We had the savory porridge and the burrata - both were wonderful.  And then meander around the shop.  I felt like I stepped into a Nancy Meyers movie walking into this place.

What a HORRIBLE experience!!! This was by far the worst customer service encounter I've experienced in life!
