Let's just say the moment my mom and I walked in, we were stared at for about 15 seconds and no one said a word... one of the sales associates even looked back down at his phone and we stood there waiting to see who out of the three people would help us... once we were finally helped by the African American lady, they refused to use our voucher as "they didn't know how to do it". We waited over 30 minutes for them to tell us they couldn't help us! On top of that, the other male employee greeted every single one of the next customers and even provided them with discounts!!! TALK ABOUT THE DISRESPECT AND DISCRIMINATION!!!! They even had the nerve to tell us to call customer service FOR THEM so they can know what to do... excuse me???!!! & even still we tried googling the number since they also, didn't know what number to call for their own customer service... to do their job!? We wasted more time attempting to call at 10pm at night! I'm pretty sure they new they were closed as well!!!!

After vetting 3 sod companies and 1 that would only do drainage bcuz we don't have an irrigation system we went w/ Saeed and his crew for nearly 6000 sf of sod and extensive drainage work. We were impressed w/ Saeed's communication from start to finish. Abel, the 'lead' s a master at drainage, tremendous hard worker, as was Lewis. They worked 4 days in a clean, orderly humane way, a stark difference from the team who had replaced our seawall. When asked, their referral spoke highly of Saeed, his team and her own extensive Bahaia sod installation. I refereed the crew to a nearby neighbor needing St.Augustine and she, also, was pleased. Genuinely happy to have worked w/ such a consumer-conscience professional company for what was a major investment in our property.

Came here for a planning meeting. I came here several years ago and remembered it being much nicer, but the rooms were just okay this time around. The location is beautiful! Adjacent to the hotel, within walking distance is a beautiful stretch of beach that was so nice and serene it actually opened up the creative beings that lived within. Not far from the location is the pier/fisherman wharf which is equally beautiful. Can't complain about Santa Barbara though, well even if you did nobody would give a s!&@!

We eat here so much it is a problem!  We have never once had wrong food brought to us or bad service.  This place is top notch in all regards.

Everything on the menu is great!  Even though I have my favorite 3 I constantly order I do venture out from time to time and I'm never disappointed.  My favorite by far is their veggie wrap with the burger a close second.

This place is amazing for families which is lacking on this side of town.  They have a kid's eat free deal on Tuesdays but I avoid it, way too packed.

I'll never eat here again. The staff seemed nice but pressure washing floors during business hours IN THE KITCHEN while preparing food is unacceptable. And wouldn't kill them to take out the trash as opposed to it overflowing while bagging the food. I never want to see anyone lose there job but the cleaning protocol for the kitchen needs to be changed to AFTER hours! Mind you they do not have indoor dining either so this mess is all them! If it wasn't for my pregnant wife at home craving it t I would have turned right around. Disappointing all around.
It's not Chicago pizza.   There is a film of something on the top.  Which chicago pizza doesn't have.  The beef and hot dog are good though.

TERRIBLE!!! I was looking for a very specific used Jetta, on VW's website it listed one available at this location. When I called the dealership they assured me they had it in stock..however, when i drove up there it was a different story.."Ohh we just sold that car"..very dissatisfied with the level of customer service and professionalism shown by members of their sales team. I was blatantly lied to about the car to ensure i visited their location, where they tried to haggle me into buying another car, one I did not want to buy, and did not want to take my NO for an answer. So I went to another VW dealership and got the car I was looking for! In summary, I will NEVER be visiting this VW location again.
Plenty of parking, secluded, clean great views of clearwater. Hard to find something like this in Florida .

I couldn't believe my lucky stars when Robert and I confirmed Felicity Church for November 11, 2017. 

I had never planned on getting married in a "church". My dream was to marry on a beach with my toes in the sand or surrounded by beautiful flowers in a garden pungent with the scent of blooming jasmines. With the wild inconsistency of New Orleans weather, plans change. 

More to kickstart my venue hunt, I booked viewings at a number of places as well as Felicity Church in the summer of 2016. While I've enjoyed beautiful weddings at The Elms Mansion, Latrobe's, and Rosy's Jazz Hall, I wanted something different as most any bride would. 

Felicity Church hadn't been an official venue for that long, and I had yet to go to any events in the space but had seen great pics on Instagram. Owner Chris Jones greeted me when I arrived. I think I even told him that church weddings and New Orleans traditions weren't my bag when I walked in. He enthusiastically told me the history of the building and about how his wife, Jessica, and he renovated the space (even showing me the lovely stained glass window in the ladies bathroom). I loved how much HE loved the space with its authentic architecture and thoughtful updates. 

I fell in love with it all. The way the colors of the original stained glass windows were painted on the altar's wooden floorboards, the perfectly distressed staircase, the intimate courtyard strewn with lights...the fact that both wedding and reception could all be held at one lovely place. I was sold and looking to book. 

Unfortunately, I was big on equal opportunity, and my fiancé wanted to peruse a handful of venues before pulling the trigger. As we were led through other spots told by owners and sales managers how our wedding would go because that's how it had always been done and that we'd have to use their in-house catering chock-full of "authentic Cajun/Creole cuisine", I realized it wasn't just the venue I appreciated, but the openness there was to Robert and I making our wedding our own. 

We were so happy to have booked this space for our special date. Chris was always quick to respond to any communications and help with any logistical needs including table/seating arrangements and getting on the same page with our vendors. 

The venue has so many wonderful nooks and crannies to add your own flair. You can go big or be budget-minded, and the space will still look amazing. I loved that we were able to say our personal vows one minute and shake it with our band Where Y'acht the next on the altar after Chris and our vendors transformed the upstairs. 

While I could continue to gush about Felicity Church and my wedding, I think y'all get the point. Chris, with his wonderful enthusiasm and professionalism, can help you make your special day everything you hope it will be at Felicity Church!
The food and the service was amazing. I really enjoyed it. I ordered the wings and a philly and OMGGGGG . The calzone was absolutely amazing . Toasted to perfection.

Worst Indian food I've had. Didn't deliver our food when we ordered delivery. Called to ask why we hadn't picked it up and then they finally delivered it. When we got it, you could tell it had been sitting for a long time and everything tasted terrible. The sauces had huge chunks of raw ginger in them. And the seasoning just tasted off. Will never go back. I will usually give places a couple chances but this is the rare occasion that I can't justify going back.

Save your time and your money. The staff here is very rude and they don't like to be bothered. I was looking to landscape my whole back yard. I guess this isn't the place to do it. They wouldn't care if you stayed or left. I was really hoping to buy locally grown plants considering they would already be use to our summers. 

I will not give my money to companies who don't appreciate my business. Take your money else where.

Crap job! Got the "Super Wash" and the guy didn't even clean or vacuum cup holders! Dash was not wiped either. And what's with the stink in the reception area? Smells like sewage? It would also be nice if they could spring for a sun sail to give customers a bit of protection from the sun while waiting. Not going back again!

This is definitely the place to go if you are looking for Asian buns. They have a great selection and every baked good that I have tried was pretty good. It definitely wasn't the best I've ever had, but it is the best place for Asian buns that I have found in Reno so far.

Unfortunately, I was really let down with the drink that I ordered. I probably will never order a drink again. The "fresh" boba had a really weird taste and texture and the drink itself was made using a magic bullet blender which left it very icy and not all that flavorful.
Ok ive been here 3 more times since my first visit with burnt pizza.   Its been awesome every time.  The crust is so buttery and delicious.    So freaking good.   Best deep dish around here
Now this place is great. The two GM's of the place are very nice. I just some other Einstein Bagels where this great like this one.

We were thrilled to see that this location had switched things up a bit. We've been wanting to give it a shot for a little bit and now wish we had done so earlier! The food and service were both on point! We started off with the Fresh Rolls and we gobbled them right up, so good! The Pho was very tasty,  full of flavor and the meat was super tender. My GF got the Grilled Pork Bun and it was some of the best she's ever had. We will definitely be back!

China Gourmet is a very pleasant surprise if you, like me, love a traditional dim sum Chinese brunch every once and a while. 

Situated on St. Vincent Street in Northeast Philly between Brous Avenue and Roosevelt Boulevard in Mayfair, it is a large house in a developing Asian neighborhood that puts out trolley carts loaded with small dish treats both savory and sweet, at reasonable prices and with the expected hussle and flow that this dining style uniquely delivers. Admittedly, the aggressive nature of the cart ladies hawking their delicacies takes some getting used to. You have to be able to say "no" when you feel overwhelmed by the surrounding din. But, know that slowing down the onslaught is proper, and multiple opportunities will present themselves. Just take what you want in the moment and let the trolley women return when you are ready for more. 

The most important thing at China Gourmet is that they know from dim sum. There are dozens of choices and most of them are good to great. Shrimp and pork shumai, shrimp hargow, beef rice rolls w vinegar, fried stuffed buns, various dumplings, fish filled chili peppers, egg tarts and many others are well prepared and served hot or cold as appropriate. My bowl of congee was also decent with plenty of ground pork and fresh cut scallion on top. There is plenty more, but you get the picture. 

What's even better is the availability of FREE PARKING right in front of the restaurant, and the large Asian supermarket and Vietnamese kitchen right next door. The money saved is like getting a 25% discount off your check! Hard to beat! 

Now that we've experienced the fun and convenience of a strong dim sum morning with grocery shopping for dessert, Chinatown has lost some of its cultural luster for us (not completely). 

Gotta love it!

Oh. My. God. Amazing! This place is so beautiful! The owner is a wonderful person. The food is absolutely amazing!!! Not one thing on the menu is bad. They offer gluten free options, and you can buy entire loads of their incredible bread. The employees are so friendly and so helpful. The coffee is so so good. The pastries are impossible to resist. The breakfasts and lunch options are plentiful and all so so fresh, delicious, and served so nicely. I always thought I'd take a to-go bag, but I never did. It was too good. Located on a part of State street that makes it so easy to go up or down or both and still get great parking is a thing of ease. The environment is a mix of modern and cozy. Everything was always so clean and beautiful. I loved watching the cake-makers decorate cake or the bakers slice fresh loafs of bread. Their cake decorating/baking skills are out of this world! So beautiful. Can't say enough good things about this business, it's employees, and it's products.

Went here for breakfast and was impressed with the quality and portions of the food. I ordered the chicken skillet and it came with three eggs on top (not sure if this always happens, but was pleasantly surprised!) with a side of pancakes. Coffee was average, as well as restaurant ambience and service. There were only two other tables and the service was a little slow. Nonetheless, we did not have any issues other than that. Would recommend this place if you've never been!

Fabulous restaurant!! Great food & atmosphere. New extended menu with delicious burgers, wraps and salads. Love their banana pancakes too!! Open 7am to 2pm. Kevin, the owner is an outstanding entrepreneur.  He goes above and beyond to please. New staff is wonderful too!!
The atmosphere is perfect for breakfast/lunch. The food is very delicious and unique.
Good food! If you go enough they'll start to know you! Great service! Highly recommended by my wife and I.

Most people are crazy, but can hide it and live a normal life. Not our server at Trailhead on Saturday night. He mighta been on some type of speed, which would also explain his manic/nutty behavior. 

They messed up two outta the three orders at our table.

The beer is good, at least.

Wanted to support a local bookstore while traveling in New Orleans - but the lady at the register with red hair was way too rude rolling her eyes and talking with her back turned to support this establishment. Stay away!
Great setup for COVID. They took guest temperatures. Outside tables in a great setting. Food was great and quick.

Ate lunch here on a weekend trip to NOLA and I don't get the hype. I grew up in the middle east and north africa, and the best description I can rustle up for this place is : unobjectionable middle eastern food in a modern setting. 
The Israeli chef offers an unexceptional, slightly-modified version of classic dishes from across the region. For example: hummus (Lebanese/Syrian/Palestinian) with harissa (Tunisian) on top. The hummus was creamy but bland, and the harissa didn't have the kick it should have. Another example: Tabbouleh with almond slivers and too much Bharat spice.
My best guess as to why this gets good reviews is good PR and perhaps a lack of other good mideastern options for a crowd inexperienced in the food of the region. One comment from the table next to us: 'the shakshouka is amazing, it's great to be able to have authentic Israeli food, I've never seen this dish on the menu at any other restaurant!'. Really? Shakshouka? The Tunisian dish cooked probably for centuries across the mideast that you can find at pretty much any mideastern or north african restaurant you can walk into???? Lame.

Many of the restaurants around St Pete's beach were not impressive, most looked like they were old and dirty!  We drove up and down the main street hoping that we would find someplace to eat, but each and every place looked lacking.  Finally we decided on Snapper's which even the name sounded like it was a low end restaurant.  What a surprise; this restaurant was a hidden gem!  Really elegant inside and the food was beyond our expectations.  Whenever we go back to that area we will certainly make sure we revisit Snappers.  One suggestion on marketing, I would consider changing the name, as this restaurant  is a high end establishment and the name does nothing to let people know that.  We almost didn't go in because of the name.

We had a party of 6 but was Waiting on 2 people to arrive once they did they ordered drinks waitress was nice and then we all ordered food. We waited about 30 mins and food hadnt came out. We asked wat was going on at this time restaurant was empty  and one said Jokingly we should just go somewhere else. And the Owner who claimed to be a dishwasher/ chef answered back "I dont care if you guys leave" he sounded like d owner but denied it and then continued to say, " go ahead uf you prefer to leave, we were like it was a Joke" And he said," no no Ill pay for ur drinks go ahead" and made we tried talking to him but he Wouldnt Listen to us. The manager didn't do or say anything thats why we know it was the owner. NEVER going back! Wouldnt even give customer a chance to speak or Care that Our Food was talking to long!

Quite possibly the most unorganized and rude front of house staff I've ever encountered. After ordering behind a friend who received their food in 20 minutes, I proceeded to wait for nearly an hour for two entrees. Only after telling everyone in line to be prepared for a wait was I finally served my food. 

Come to Nashville and definitely get the hot chicken, but avoid this place like the plague!

We live in Sparks, NV and have a wonderful Panda Express here in Sparks on Los Altos.  We unfortunately ordered from one of your newer places yesterday and had a bad experience we thought you should know about.  We were taking some food to a friend that's recovering from a back fracture.  My wife ordered on line from the Panda Express located at 547 S. Meadows Parkway, Reno.  When we got to the restaurant 40 minutes later our food was not ready.  I was told we were waiting for the Chow mein.  I waited almost 10 minutes and when the Chow mein came up the girl behind the counter served a gentleman that came in after I'd been standing there for 5 minutes first.  When I asked about my order, I was told we were also waiting on Orange Chicken.  After waiting for almost 15 minutes (don't know why we ordered ahead) our order was ready.  

My wife had ordered a bowl with Chicken with green beans on rice. When we took the bowl top off we found exactly 3 small pieces of chicken and 4 beans... Hardly a portion at all and certainly not what we get at the Panda Express by our house.

I had ordered orange chicken.  I don't know what was done to the chicken but it was way over cooked and hard.  It was like eating chicken jerky with a candied orange coating.   Horrible.

Showed up tonight to order some takeout and absolutely loved it! The girl's at the counter were happy and cheerful... the food same out promptly... I got him to find everything I could want or need having been added to the bag and my order correct... and is was completely yummy! I had kung pao shrimp and a side of crab wontons. I will definitely be back here.

Bottom Line on Top: Completely adequate and worth more than they charge. [GrubHub Order]

First off, it's about time that someone came up with fries that stay yummy for GrubHub delivery. However, these are NOT those fries. Stick with the o-rings; they travel far better. The gyro was good, not excellent. The Philly was very good, about one soggy hoagie roll and a limp lettuce leaf from 'great'. I would imagine that, in person, the food is quite good. 

The saving grace out of a sea of mediocre is the price. This meal, delivered to my door, cost less than a much skimpier meal in person at most local places (and, frankly, it got to my table just as quickly as many sit-down joints). Nothing here screamed, "Eureka!" but nothing was less than "okay". For this price, that's a home run. 

What got this place the fourth star was the Greek salad. HUGE and with a really good flavour. Much better than expected.  

Overall, this place should definitely be in your family's meal-delivery rotation. It might not become a favourite, but it will satisfy for a very reasonable cost.

Wow! This might be my favorite BBQ. We started with the smoked chicken wings in original BBQ sauce. Definitely choose a sauce because the sugars caramelize and give a crunchy and sweet exterior. I would order the 20 wings next time, ha! 

For the main event, I had the Smokin' Chick sandwich. The chicken was juicy and tender. This sandwich has got it all: caramelized onions, spicy peach chipotle bbq sace, and habanero queso. It was spicy, but SO good! I would order this again in the future, maybe with jalepenos on the side to tone down the spice. As my side, I tried the breakfast taters. They were sliced thin and cooked with onions which imparted a ton of flavor. Serving size was large, we left full and it didn't make a huge dent in our pocket.

We came in on a Saturday past noon, and they were serving brunch. I was hoping to have the "fuller" regular menu. I also was disappointed in the kids menu. We have a picky eater and the mac and cheese was too spicy and there weren't chicken tenders available. So unfortunately, since this is such a long trek from Odessa/Trinity, we won't be able to dine here with our kids, which limits our availability to come back at all.

The only thing we wouldn't order again are the baked beans. In the future, I hope they change up the kids menu and add more items to brunch, or allow patrons to order from the full menu at lunch time on weekends. Also note, the menu online seems to differ from the one in the restaurant, so keep that in mind if you have your heart dead set on one particular item. Hopefully they update it online soon!

I have called numerous times to obtain records for my pet.  Got part of them and called back to get the rest and they just don't follow through.  There non-veterinarian personnel are the worst when it comes to the public.
One of my favorite sushi spots in Philly! The all you can eat is dangerously fantastic! They have never let me down! The drinks are wonderful too! Don't sleep on Aki, I'm telling you!

Red Mesa used to be my favorite restaurant in DTSP. The food is amazing and the drinks are great... the service however, has steadily gone downhill in the last 2 years. You used to be able to come in, be greeted, your waiter or waitress  was on point, and service was fast, accommodating, and efficient. Now, you're lucky to see your server twice within the first 30 minutes of having been seated. Sad, since the restaurant itself is so good and the atmosphere is very relaxed and enjoyable. Perhaps new management or waitstaff is the cause... either way, terrible service 3x in a row.
Good food, I ate here a couple of times. Just don't show up 15 minutes before they close cause they won't let you in regardless of how many times you've been here.

overall a disappointment despite having good experiences in the past. my family wanted milkshakes but they couldnt because the restaurant was out of ice cream. i ordered and the cashier didn't hear me. i ordered two more times before he got my entire order, even though i asked him before the third time if he had heard me. he said he didnt even though he actually did. all three times i ordered the Barbecue Bacon and Cheddar burger (the exact words on the menu) with a side of Smashfries. despite the cashier hearing me twice all i got were two burgers and one order of smashfries, and despite using the exact same wording each time the two burgers were different -- one had onions and one didn't. despite the name having 'barbecue' in it i actually forgot that there was barbecue sauce because i didnt taste any until the last three bites. altogether, of the three burgers my family ordered none were hotter than lukewarm and the fries were soggy. it's also worth mentioning that i found some weird, thin, brown oval that smelled like herbs in my fries which must've come from the grease trap. 

tasted decent but service and quality were very very poor. 

P.S.: "Family, food, and Coca Cola make for a good time" should not pass for a Smashfact.
Great ice cream and fast service. Drive through was convenient. Will be back soon.  Toppings are always taste  fresh.

I've been getting massages for a while, and always considered them a luxury. Everything about it was perfect. I pretty enjoy the hot stone and sauna, and the therapists are nice and professional. There is no better feeling than leaving after a massage--refreshed, relaxed, and calm!

While there isn't many Japanese restaurants in St. Albert to choose from and whenever I'm at work and craving sushi this is where I'd order from. It's actually a pretty good decent place as price point is about the same with other places, and the taste and quality is pretty good as well. Overall, it could be better, but this totally satisfied my sushi cravings.
Great finds and Taylor was a great sport with my try on bonanza of denim!  Will check back here frequently great size selection with a trendy eye!

When in Philly ...

It was time I went and found out what all the hype was about, so I made it a point to also try Geno's, which I did before I hit Pat's, only because I was feeling lazy and hungry and my car was parked slightly closer to Geno's. 

I left my experience from each place giving a narrow edge to Pat's. It seemed the steak was a tad more seasoned here, or perhaps it was the fact that this place seemed slightly grimier than Geno's and whatever lack of deep cleaning gives a little more character to their cheesesteaks. In fairness, however, I ordered provolone versus whiz at both places, which I'm sure is a violation of the rules according to most cheesesteak experts. 

I hate that they're cash only in 2016, but I see they have no problem getting away with it.

Beware!!!   This Firestone dealer does not accept coupons or special offers like a regular Firestone store.  He sold us some really junky tires for over $100 each and they only lasted 17,000 miles!!!!  (and they were rotated and balanced every 5,000 miles with a front end alignment check every time also).

Lee's? Yes, please!

If you are looking for amazing pizza and local craft beers with a neighborhood hangout, this is your place! The pizza is delicious with a flavorful and thin crunchy crust. The one downside is if you come on a packed Friday night it does take a while (45 min) for the pizza to come out, but with plenty of craft beers to choose from the wait isn't bad!

Recommended song pairing: Kiki, do you love me? - Drake
It was ok. Much of the underwhelming service and certainly the salad bar was due to covid protection measures. Not much fun Uber the circumstances.
Was able to get an appointment same day I called in.  Alex is a great stylist, listened to what I wanted, offered suggestions, and took her time.  I was very satisfied.

I'm new to this area and so happy to find this place. The service is excellent, i was seated right away and my order came out quickly. 

They offer lunch specials and beautiful cocktails but no bread while you wait for your meal :/ The food was great though, no complaints!

I got the ahi tuna salad which was some perfectly! The dressing was light and the tuna cooked well. I also got the cheeseburger which was huge and so so good!

I'm looking forward to coming back and trying something new.
Paid 90$ to get cut /bleed and bad sloppy nails. Do not go here ! It literally has only been a few days and one of the nails have already popped off

I stayed at the Mar Monte Hotel (Hyatt) for two night this week and stopped at Cafe Lido for a beer. I don't think I've ever seen a slower bartender. It took 15-20 minutes for him to prepare two cocktails for the party in front of me and he forgot to pour my father in law's beer. Maybe it's because they automatically charge a 20% tip so why put forth the effort if full tip is guaranteed? Won't be back.

It takes 20+ minutes to get your food (if you are lucky). Have been here multiple times because I wanted to give them the benefit of the doubt, sadly disappointed each time with their service. The food is great, but I could grow a beard waiting for it.

Driver almost ran me off the road went into the opposite side of the road next to the shell on clear acre and McCarran  looks like he was distracted on his phone I honked at him at flipped me and spat all over my windshield. I guess it doesn't take much to get hired on

It's December and I'm still waiting for group varsity tennis photo taken of Marquette High School's Varsity team. Repeated emails to "supervisor" Tom Kopp have been ignored. This company makes Life Touch who use to lose my kid's photos look like Ansel Adams

I'm usually wary of places that fuse two different types of cuisine, especially when one of those cuisines is Asian.  Restaurants usually use it as an excuse to butcher Asian cuisine.  (I'll make an exception for expensive fusion restaurants.  Those chefs usually know the rules and, thus, can change them).  However, Nitally's is not an extremely expensive restaurant and is still a great fusion!  The owners are actually a Thai/Mexican couple, which makes this fusion pretty authentic.

I always get the Thai Tea.  it is superb here.  You can get tapioca in most of their drinks, which is pretty novel for St. Petersburg.  I've had boba cha (Milk Tea Tapioca) from tons of places in San Francisco, but for people who are not used to tapioca, it is fun to put in drinks here.  However, I still prefer my Thai Tea without it.

I've tried their Tofu Chipotle Stir Fried with fresh veggies and it was delicious.  I took some home and it was even great the next day.

I've also had their Thai Peanut Chicken Tortilla Wraps and it was spectacular.  

It was pretty warm inside.  I'm not sure if they keep the air conditioning down or if they use it at all.  It was not too bad, but it was slightly uncomfortable.  However, it is a small price to pay for such great food.  This is a great place to take a date to lunch to impress them or to go to chat for a while with a good friend.

Get more professional cashiers/employees! Chicken was both dry and greasy........ Chicken was hot, but not much flavor. Biscuits were delicious I should have just gotten a box of biscuits.  Would go back for biscuits only, If I didn't have to see the "why did you come in the door? We trying to get off", face of the employees. SMH, my people.  Come on New Orleans I'll try more restaurants tomorrow. Hoping I can get some delicious food and decent service while first time visiting!

This store has the cutest stuff! I know I won't be wearing pieces that everyone else has when I come to shop here whether it be in person or online. They get new items in every week from what they post on Instagram. The shop itself is big, modern, clean, and welcoming! One of the ladies Immediately started me a fitting room when I only had one item in my hand, so nice!  Everything is under $100 and of extremely good quality. It's worth spending your money here than a big fast fashion chain store. Support local boutiques, especially DFTI. I can find an outfit for any occasion here. I have also gotten many cute statement earrings and necklaces here too. Btw the owner is extremely nice and has worked super hard to run this boutique. She works there herself non stop and every time I've gone in she's there working the counter and helping customers out. I don't know her personally at all but seeing a few comments on how rude she is I personally never experienced it.

Went in for flu shots.  It took 30 minutes.  The (female) pharmacist who administered was nice / professional.  Another (male) employee in the pharmacy was wearing his mask around his chin - mouth and nose totally exposed.  He should know better and walgreens should enforce their policies.

Hi, I just moved to Tampa from NYC. I needed an oil change, why did I choose Jiffy Lube? To be honest, I had a coupon. 
I must say, it was my first time at a Jiffy Lube and I was not disappointed.  Spoke to the guys and all was nice. I only got Robert's name and he explained clearly everything I needed. 
Jiffy Lube, you won another customer for life. Thanks Robert and all the guys at Jiffy Lube #377..

Our road trip may have been ruined if not for Harvey and Rene. We got a nail in our tire on a Friday night at 6:30 and Firestone was the only tire store open. These guys did not hesitate a second they took our vehicle in fixed our tire and sent us on our way with a smile!! Thank you guys so much for the friendly service and for working late!!
Great preaching, very friendly and welcoming church. Visited while out of town; would definitely attend again
Best breakfast  in Tucson for flavor and price.  Get the chicken fried steak you won't regret it.  The portions don't disappoint.

I grew up with a bakery in my neighborhood in Philadelphia so I am very keen on bakeries. I used to smell the pastries being made early in the morning as I walked to school. A Long time ago, one of my co-workers told me about this bakery. Since then, I always order my birthday cakes from here. I am no longer with that employer and have since moved to another county (in NJ) some distance away but I still order birthday cakes from this bakery. Anytime I bring a cake from L&M Bakery to a function, it gets rave reviews. Kudos L&M Bakery. I love your pastries and YES!!! your cakes!!!!
Half way through, I realized that the chicken is not fully cooked. I saw blood is coming out from pinky flesh, which I just took a bite. Horrible.

Kona Grill has a pretty good happy hour. If you sit outside, you get to enjoy the happy hour from 3 pm to close from Monday to Friday, plus all day Saturday and Sunday. They also have a good selection of sushi, other than the traditional sushi rolls, they also have special Kona rolls. Each sushi roll costs between $10 to $20. 

My friend and I came here for dinner, didn't utilize the happy hour because it was cold outside. I got the avocado chicken club, and my friend got the poke bowl. Each of them cost less than $15. Our food came with a nice presentation, and my chicken club tasted pretty good, the bun was puffy and warm.
Nice venue, but the price gouging is beyond unreasonable.  Plan ahead with a big budget if you plan to partake of anything ... $13.50 for a 16 oz craft beer

I have tried to keep my patience with this dealership because I have to keep bringing my car here, but I cannot keep silent about this any longer. Since buying my car in 2013 I have spent no less than two hours wasting my time in this delearship every single time I have had to get anything done. One Saturday all I asked for was an oil change and a car detailing. I left my car there ALL DAY because I figured if it takes 2 hours for an oil change I can only imagine how much more time a detail would add. I received no call about it being ready for pick up so I went down at closing time and I STILL ending up waiting over an hour, AFTER CLOSING, for my car to be ready. In late October of last year the cruise control button stopped working on my car. They diagnosed the issue and I was told I would need to come back once a simple button was ordered to be put in my car. I never received a call. I finally called them and they said the part was in. I asked if I should make an appointment to have it put in, as a vain hope to avoid wasting time, and was told "Nope, It'll take just a minute bring it down ANY TIME. I took it down that Friday and was told there were NO TECHS available to work on it. I repeated to the service person what I was told and he said, "Sorry all of our techs are in training." REALLY?? So, furious, I put off going back in for another month. Granted, that was my choice, but I was never told if I don't rush back in there that the part would no longer be there. Well, that is what just happened today. I was told not only that the part was no longer in the facility, but that they would need to REDIAGNOSE THE PROBLEM. How is it possible that you people do not have the technology available to keep record of the same exact part that was need only a few months eariler?? I can tell you what the problem is....I NEED A NEW CRUISE CONTROL BUTTON. So...after waiting nearly two hours this morning I asked if I could just have my car back because I needed to get to work. I was told the oil had been changed, but that they had not had enough time to REDIAGNOSE the same problem I STILL HAVE. I was asked to, please, bring my car back when I had a few hours, TO WASTE, so they could rediagnose a CRUISE CONTROL BUTTON ISSUE. I cannot even imagine how bad it will be when my car has a serious problem. 

By the way, all of this is nothing compared to the four hours I spent in an Atlanta, Georgia dodge delearship to have ONE TIRE CHANGED, but that is neither here nor there. 

In summary, I strongly discourage anyone from tying theirselves to the service department in this dealership. I almost cannot wait until my warranty is up so I can take my car elsewhere. And Jim Brown, please hire more techs so I can spend more time enjoying my life and not sitting in your waiting room.

I read all of the previous reviews about this place and most of them were negative regarding the food and the service but I think that they were made before the new owners took over.  My friend and I have eaten there at least 4 times the last 60 days and have found that the service was good to outstanding!  We have tried a number of their entrees and appetizers and found that they were quite tasty.  I personally liked their French Onion Soup and have enjoyed their garden salad.  My friend normally gets a strip steak or prime rib and I opt for the filet.  Every time that we have gotten these items they have been cooked to perfection (of course we prefer our meat to be rare to medium rare).  If you haven't been there for a while I would strongly suggest that you give them a try.

This is the perfect store for all of your organic gardening needs!  I came in to buy some supplies to start my first organic garden, and was greeted by Stephanie (just one of the family members of this family owned shop). Stephanie was super helpful and made suggestions regarding what would be best for my needs.  She even saved me money by telling me to wait until the beginning of September to start planting.  However, she did encourage me to build and set up my garden with soil, compost, and peat moss- stating that it's better to be prepared, than to rush and put everything together at the same time.  Thanks for the help Stephanie!  

I took a bunch of pictures of this cute store, so everyone can see how much this family has put into their business.  We definitely need more reviews here because this place is a little gem!  I will be coming here for 99% of my gardening needs!

My wife and I have chosen to have our first baby here and we couldn't be any more pleased with the care that we have received thus far. We have attended many free baby classes that are offered and it has been very insightful. 

They also offer other services and classes for a fee, but they are well worth it. Some of these include water birthing class and baby wearing. 

The layout of the rooms is very comfortable and it's great for people who plan on having a good amount of support (family and friends) attend the birth. Everyone if very knowledgable and friendly also. I will update even further when we have our baby in December!

This isn't the easiest review to do because it came from such a hard experience, but I do have to acknowledge this clinic and how truly wonderful they were last week when I had to put my dog to sleep. She was ready. She was old. She was sick. And the staff there agreed that it was what was best. They were so kind, they were helpful when deciding about the final arrangements. They let me sit with my dog for as long as a I wanted and I held her until the very end. The vet was so nice. He answered questions and walked me through the process as it happened. I hope I won't have to do this again for a long long time, but if you're looking for a compassionate clinic, this is it. Thank you.

Without a doubt, from top to bottom, this is a tragedy. 
1. Location: sketchy part of Stone, north of Speedway. Business is hard to find because their signage is so small and the building looks like an old El Taco.
2. Get a new hostess. We got there for early dinner and told her we had reservations and she said she couldn't find them. Really? This is mid-week and how many people were you expecting at 5:30 p.m.? Mind you, the restaurant is empty except for one table. She finally finds the res and while the rest of our party arrives and is getting out of their car and coming in, she decides to march us to the table. I told her, let's wait for the rest of the people, but she just keeps on walking. I stood my ground (the table was close) and again said, lets wait for everyone...crickets...she turns around when she gets there, looks at us and starts to walk back to the front desk and by that time the rest of the family is inside. We had 2 children in our party (4 & 10). Miss Thing then informs us they don't have any children's menus! She didn't know where they were...whatever...shortly, our waiter comes over and suddenly she YELLS across the room that she found ONE child's menu. He very quickly runs over to her and tells her not to yell across the room. She then comes over, without said menu, and proceeds to read off the items that she has written down. Oh my word...
3. Get a new chef. Now, on to the food...
The boys ordered mac and cheese. Completely flavorless! Not one grain of salt to be found in the dish, small shell macaroni cooked to death.
I ordered a rib eye steak with Bone marrow compound butter. Hey! looks like I found the salt for the mac and cheese! It's ALL in the compound butter! Completely inedible. Let's talk about the steak. They choose to serve the cheap, bone in (NOT a cowboy cut) rib eye barely a 1/2 in thick which we got to pay $34 for plus additional for the butter...did I mention that it was inedible? the steak had NO flavor...what a disaster. 
The creamed spinach side was also a casualty of the salt storm in the kitchen.
I have to mention, the wait staff is VERY attentive and super nice. They couldn't explain the problems so here comes the owner...
Asking how we "enjoyed" our meal we proceeded to tell him. When he told us they also own and run Saguaro Corners, it became clear what the problems are (see my review of Saguaro Corners):
there is no leadership in the kitchen or in the front of the house. They just go along running the place without a clue.
He was gracious enough to comp a lot of our bill but we'll never go back again.
There's a lot of good steak restaurants here so don't buy the hype of the Spaghetti Western to cover up bad food.

Customer service here is awful. Rude and unfriendly staff. 

I dropped my jacket off in May to be waxed and stitched. They said it should be returned in 6-8 weeks and would call when finished. I didn't hear from them and even called a couple of times last month to check if it was back in store. I was heading to Ardmore and decided to give them a ring in the off chance it had been returned and nobody called. A gentleman answered the phone and put me on hold. Before I knew it, a woman got on the line and immediately started telling me they left me two messages that my jacket was back in an annoyed tone. I told her I never heard from anyone, hence the reason for my call and she told me she "has the notes right in front of her and they are strict about holding jackets because they don't have the space." Again, I reiterated that nobody gave me a call or left a message and I just want to know if my jacket is ready for pickup. She insisted that I was contacted twice and rudely let me know she wouldn't have the "message notes" if it wasn't in store. She then proceeds to read off the phone number listed for me, which was incorrect. All of a sudden she gets apologetic for the mix up... 

I will not be getting my jacket serviced here in the future. There is no need to treat customers with such an accusatory and unhelpful tone, but that seems to be the norm here based on other reviews.

Short:

Best AMC in Tampa, big reclining seats. Spacious, clean.

Long:

My Go-to theater, they are clean, large reclining seats.  The people running the concessions stands are great. Service is fast.  I recommend you get the AMC Stub Premiere membership. For 15 dollars a year, you get free reservations, $5 dollar Tuesdays, points to go toward your purchases.

You can reserve seats online to avoid the lines and also guarantee a spot in the theater, this works great on opening nights of popular movies.  If you have the Stub Premiere membership you can do this for free.  

Overall, great theater.

Everything was going smoothly at my stay at the resort until i found a centipede under my bed as i went to look for anything i missed while packing. i feel violated and disgusted. i understand that's it's one bug but the housekeepers should be cleaning under the beds and everywhere in the room. this comes to my next complaint the housekeepers would make every bed except one. after all of this chaos  the pool was very nice and we had big waves. the food was ok but i will definitely be checking under my bed from now on.

Tried the Donut Sunday!!! Had a warm donut with vanilla soft served ice cream chocolate chips, graham cracker crust and warm chocolate drizzle!!! Best thing ever! Service was great, asked if it was my first time? Yes it was! So they helped so much! 
Fast,Affordable & Great service.
Had a company meeting here and loved the service and food! Plan to make it a yearly trip!

What a disappointing start to 2020. We came here for the first meal of the year because it was in the neighborhood and seemed cool. The place was moderately crowded -- far from empty but not packed either. We were asked to seat ourselves, so we picked a centrally located table -- and waited, and waited, and waited. Five minutes, 10 minutes, 15 minutes passed. We spotted the waitstaff chatting amongst themselves, having drinks, and clearing and setting up other tables while we discussed whether this was the kind of place where you had to order at the counter. We tried unsuccessfully to wave over servers as we debated whether menus already on the table always means someone will come to take your order. We were hangry and getting hangrier. I didn't want to do this for fear of being seen as passive aggressive, but finally, we got up and approached the counter, where we were told that yes, somebody was supposed to serve us.

By the time they took our order, I was already upset not just about the service but about the menu, which was quite thin. I'm not one for egg sandwiches, and that was pretty much all they had besides lunch items, which looked potentially good but not at 9:30 a.m. (A glance at their website reveals a far superior brunch menu, but that wasn't being offered on this New Year's Day, a Wednesday.) I ended up cobbling together a strange breakfast of a chocolate croissant -- not on the menu but present at the counter -- turkey sausage and a hash brown with ketchup. (I never eat hash browns with ketchup, but "hash brown with ketchup" was what the menu said.) I was also desperate for orange juice, which was not on the menu, but I figured I'd ask anyway, and the server told me they had it.

The chocolate croissant was good. The hash brown was bland enough that I resorted to using the ketchup in addition to liberal amounts of salt and hot sauce. The turkey sausage was pretty tasty. Except for the average-sized croissant, the portions were smallish.

After I finished this rather small meal, the server told me they were knocking the croissant off the bill due to the wait, and apologized profusely no less than three times. Because I probably would have done exactly the same thing in her position, I feel like a hypocrite saying I was a bit annoyed by this -- it made me feel pressured to tell her it was OK, which it was not. I generally have a strong impulse to smile and tell someone who's apologizing to me that it's no problem at all, even if it is, and I was fighting that urge big time, which I suspect is why she kept trying. Again, not blaming her, but it led to more bad feelings on my part instead of making me forget the ones I already had.

With the croissant having been knocked off, I was mildly shocked to see that the bill, including a decent tip, ran north of $40 for two. It was less food than we typically get and I was nowhere near full at the end of it (in fact, we got a couple of donuts elsewhere not long afterward). A major culprit seemed to be that unadvertised orange juice, which turned out to be $6 a glass! I'm not averse to paying $6 for orange juice in the right situation. New York's Norma's, a beloved brunch institution, has a glass for $9 that I'd order over and over again, because you get free refills and it's the best damned orange juice I've had outside of the stuff at a Florida orange grove from oranges picked minutes earlier. But this orange juice tasted like Tropicana at best.

Bad restaurant experiences make me sad and given that I was on a fun New Year's trip to Philadelphia, I really wish we'd picked something else to start off our year. Hope the rest of 2020 goes better ...
When you're seen, the doc and staff are great ... but it just takes absolutely forever.  They need to make some serious adjustments to calendar management.

*Updated Review*

This is my absolute favorite place to get my nails done at. Staff are attentive, polite, and very patient. Was not able to book Nicole today however the gentleman that did my nails did an amazing job, and worked together with me to make sure I was getting what I wanted. 

Thank you again Pure Nail Bar Spa!!

Okay, I'm just going to say it first, this place was weird and my husband swears someone was...loving herself....during our cave session. Now that I've got your attention, let me go backwards (that's what good writers do after all!)

Last summer, I was refreshing my Yelp app. from the freeway (a common occurrence for me on car rides) to see if there was anywhere I wanted to stop while driving through the area. This place came up with a good rating, so I clicked on their website and was immediately taken with the beautiful pictures of the pink salt caves! Definitely looked like my kind of thing! Unfortunately, the "cave sessions" start on the hour and we had just missed it and didn't want to wait around, so I took a pledge that we would 100% do this thing THIS summer, and now here we are, 5 days after having had the "experience".

It may be important to note now that this review is solely for the $25 cave session, we did not get any other services (massage, scrub, etc.). 

So when you look on the website, there are these beautifully lit pictures of the pink salt caves that make them look magical! They look huge and as if there would be different nooks and crannies that you and your party could sidle up into for the 45 minutes and just relax or maybe chat at a low volume while the salt "takes away all your breathing and skin imperfections". THAT IS NOT THE CASE! Instead of a cave, it's a small room (like living room size) in which salt chunks have been glued to the walls, hung from the ceilings, and ground down into small chunks for the ground (which hurt to walk on barefoot as they insist, BTW). 

Upon entering the small space, you see approximately 12 reclining beach-type chairs in a perfect circle which you're told to sit in with the blanket that they give you (because it's cold in there for sure!). So, we walked in doing the ouchy-dance because of the sharp pieces of hard salt that are burrowing into our bare feet and sit in the chairs. There are no nooks, nor any crannies to sit in, just this weird sacrificial-cult circle LOL. The session is supposed to start at 3pm, but it didn't start until 3:15 (IDK why). So we're sitting in there as people enter, and all in all, our session had a total of 9 people in it. The lady finally comes in, tells us some salt facts (yippee), and then says "your 45 minute self meditation begins now" and she shuts off the lights and some dim lights go on, turns on the chanting cave music, and shuts the door...and that's it. That's what it was. 

My favorite parts?

1. How about the fact that you're put in a circle facing complete strangers in close proximity and left to stare at them for 45 minutes. Why weren't the chairs facing the walls?

2. How about the guy who was snoring throughout the entire thing? Um, it was really hard to do my self exploration of meditation during his snorefest 2017.

3. How about...the fact that my husband is positive that he was watching a woman mastur...love herself...during the session? Now that's what I call self-exploration! I think there was mix up there!  No more explanation needed ;-)


So after 45 minutes of the quiet stares of desperation with strangers in the darkened salt mines and the panty dropping sounds of snores and cave chanting, here I am, writing this review.

I'll end with this, thank god I was smart enough to look on Groupon before we paid full price. The session was $25 a person, but groupon allowed for $16 per person with an extra $10 per ticket toward gift shop items. I bought the salt hair spray (which was free with the discount) along with a salt/pepper shaker. So I got about 25$ worth of merch. for $4 something plus the $9 discount on each ticket, without those discounts, I would have been pretty upset. 

After looking at a lot of these really good reviews for this, it seems like the really good reviews were for their services which we didn't get. 

I definitely wouldn't recommend the cave sessions though.

I had sandy today for my lash extension appointment. I got a full set (versus the half set they also offer). Sandy was amazing. She was kind, gentle with my lashes and explained the process and how to maintain them. I would absolutely recommend the lash extensions here! Great affordable price and wonderful work!

Cheddars has been a favorite for a while since I've moved up into greenwood and started exploring the scratch kitchen options and they had never disappointed. I haven't been back since before March and all the COVID started and I'm very sad to see how changed their menu is. They don't have the same dressings or appetizers that made them stand out differently from other restaurants. I hope they go back to their full menu. Friendly staff and the food was great as ever. Bring back the whole menu and it's a 5star on my list.

My wife and I caught Beth Hart on a Saturday night.  First...get there early.  We came in 2 hours before the show and still were about 150th in line.  Suppose it depends on the show.  Most main floor tables and balcony tables we full.  There was plenty of  space on the main floor to stand, but we were looking to sit for the night.  We grabbed two high top seats along  the bar on the right as you walk into the venue. Even with being 75-100 feet away the seats and sound was fine.

We split a  veggie quesadilla, chips and salsa, and fries.  The quesadilla was fresh and filling.  Beer was cold and readily available.

The staff at the bar was very busy, but still found the time to quickly check in wiht us often.   

Will definitely go to another show at 3rd and Lindsey when the opportunity arises.
Wonderful place! The sauerbraten was delicious. The red cabbage was very good. The Apple strudel work vanilla sauce was excellent- not too sweet. Will be back.

My husband and I went for dinner. Loved the cheese stuffed mushrooms and bread but everything else was so over seasoned. So salty and hot with pepper we couldn't eat it. Decided to try a burger and soup for lunch to go later in the month and the same thing the burger was to salty to eat. The soup was good a little over salted but at least you could eat it. What is with all the salt????  Texas Roadhouse is noisy but the food is excellent and the prices better so guess I'll stick to it.
First time eating DQ and the last. Our visit was 6/10 at 5pm. Food was soggy, tomato slices thinner than a paper sheet. Yikes. Sticking to the neighborhood Wendy's for the fast food craving.

Absolutely great service. The staff are honest and will not try to sell you a part you do not need (be warned - some other HVAC places will do this). I had an issue because my condo complex mislabeled the AC units on the roof (my upstairs neighbor unit was labeled as mine and vice versa). After their first repairman worked on the wrong unit (through no fault of his own), the owner personally came out for the next two mornings unti the issue was fixed. He gave me a discount and did a lot of extra work (including a free minor repair on my neighbors unit).

Please note, despite the similarity in name, this company is NOT affiliated with Baker Bros, which I have heard some dubious reports about.

I was so excited to see rouladen on the menu. I chose to stop here for an early dinner because of it. It is one of my very favorite German dishes, but I do not make it often as it is somewhat labor intensive. I've had the pleasure of eating it back when Schnitzelhaus was open in Tampa and at the Edelweiss Inn back in Chicago. A well-made rouladen should be tender from a long braise.  The onion bacon, pickle, and mustard should marry together in each bite, blending those bold flavors together until they are more than the sum of their parts.

... but this one had none of those qualities. It was tough and dry. Even the sauce was not enough to save it. It was ridiculously under seasoned. As a rule, I do not salt food in restaurants because I expect that it comes out of the kitchen with enough seasoning to make the dish sing. When the server offered me salt and pepper, I found it odd and declined it.  Then I tasted my food.  It was like they were cooking exclusively for people who cannot have salt in their diets.  Even a liberal sprinkling of salt couldn't fix it.

The spatzel was no better. Somehow, what I was served was chewy. I can only imagine that the dough was overworked or the spatzel was over cooked. Certainly, there was no salt in the dough or in the water it was cooked in. Sadness. 

I make a pretty mean spatzel. Even Chef Mike at Schnitzelhaus praised my recipe and technique. I felt like I should've gone back to the kitchen and given them a quick run down. 

Really, the only saving grace was the red cabbage. It was pretty darn perfect. That was the one thing on my plate that I gobbled up. 

The service was fine. Ambience was good, too. My hang up is that the food was generally lackluster.

I don't usually like how dentists act, but your staff is excellent!!! I will be getting my wisdom teeth out, plus one at Westwood hopefully soon, following getting 5 cavities filled by Irving, and I am already rested assured that I will be treated nice. Definitely writing reviews elsewhere once done. 5 star dentist, and I don't usually give them! Definitely recommend

First time here, spent $30 for 2 people. I placed the order online and we only had to wait ten minutes to go pick up our to-go order. This was a Saturday night, with a huge line of people waiting to order, so I was happy I got to skip all of that. Got about ten minutes away from the restaurant and realized my gf's order was wrong, so we went back. Now there was barely a line, and the cashier apologized for the inconvenience. We stood in the cold outside for THIRTY minutes waiting for my gf's burrito while my tacos got cold. Even after all of this, they still got my gf's burrito order wrong, for the second time, so we left. I should have checked my own meal because my order was wrong as well. We ended up going to get fast food. Will not be returning :/

This shop is locally owned by down-to-earth and hard-working people. They helped us get exactly what we wanted. We were in and out in less than 15 minutes and love their transparent prices. They aren't always the cheapest, but they stand behind their products. Supporting local companies is always a priority to me and I'm glad we choose to purchase from Sargents.
The french toast with berries over top was delicious. My kids loved their pancakes. Thank you for a fantastic breakfast experience on our vacation to Clearwater

We started our morning at Pulp & Grind, a neighborhood coffeeshop that sells bottled fresh pressed juices, hot and iced caffeinated beverages, oatmeal, and baked goods. 

The cashier Julia helped us clarify and answer questions about the food items we were about to order and start a loyalty reward card for us.

For drinks, we purchased two Satsuma branded fresh pressed juice (Immune Booster and Cleanse), Hot Chai Tea, Hot Tea, and Hot Coffee. 

Since I'm getting over a cold, I decided to get the Immune Booster, which consisted of orange, grapefruit, apple, fennel, and grapefruit seed extract. I'm glad it wasn't tart or bitter. The hot beverage came in two sizes - 12oz or 16oz.

The Hot Chai had a foamy top but was cinnamon. It wasn't very sweet when compared to a Starbucks Chai Latte. 

For teas, you can pick from English Breakfast, Earl Grey, Lapsang Souchong, High Mountain Green, Lemon Ginger, Plum Oolong, Mandarin Orange, Honey Bush, Tulsi Vana, and Lemon Gunpowder. 

For breakfast, we shared two Sweet Walnut Muffin, Sweet Potato and Black Bean Taco (Vegan), and Sausage and Egg Taco. 

I highly recommend the Sweet Walnut Muffin. This muffin was a brioche. It was crispy, airy, and buttery croissant. The cashier said the Sweet Potato and Black Bean Taco didn't have much flavor and she suggested that I add hot sauce and salsa to it but I disagree. It was quite flavorful without the additions. The taco consisted of sweet potato, black beans, red pepper, and green peppers. It was a bit to spicy for me. The other guests in my party enjoyed their Sausage and Egg Taco with Salsa.

Sorry to go against all of the great reviews this place got, but I didn't have the same experience as everyone else. We came for Sunday brunch because it was highly recommended by some of the employees at the hotel we were staying. 

Our wait time was like 20 minutes longer than they quoted us, and we ended up sitting out a community table that was in the outdoor patio area which was quickly bombarded by a tour group that came in and from everyone gathered around while they were waiting for a table. It was so loud that even though we were sitting right next to each other, we could barely hear each other talk. 

The food: really nothing we ordered was very good. The fried okra needed salt. The biscuits and gravy were flavorless had the consistency of mayo. There was also no salt + pepper on the table for me to even try to save it. 

For my entree, I tried the meatloaf sandwich, which was not bad, but also not great. However, I ordered the mac and cheese with it and it came out already congealed; clearly they'd cooked it earlier and reheated it. Disgusting.

The french toast that my friend ordered came out soggy, like it'd been sitting there for a while before it actually came to the table, which is very likely since our waiter was pretty scarce the entire time we were there.

With so many great restaurants in Nashville, I was really sorry to have wasted our only brunch on this terrible experience. Maybe brunch isn't their forte and they're better for dinner and that's why they have such good reviews.

I visited yesterday at the Ajun Cajun. they had outside seating as well as inside. they are doing takeout with updated corona virus hours. the pictures on yelp looked great and the food in person was even better. there was 4 of us and we got a variety of things all DELICIOUS. I had the to tonkostu ramen it was absolutely yummy. I didn't take pictures of the food just because it wasn't in its regular presentation for sanitary purposes and I didn't want that to take away from their business aesthetic! the poboys r tasty and juicy the ramen is full of flavor and the noodles were great as well. they have a variety of drinks non alcoholic as well. I had a creamy strawberry mochi to top it all off it was a great choice. make ur way down here bc this place is so worth the visit !

Talk about the whole package!  Beautiful restaurant with an amazing view of the beach. The sunset was straight out of a movie.  Devin our waiter was wonderful. Knowledgeable , professional, accommodating, and enthusiastic.  Everything we ordered was delicious!  A note  of caution... beware of the bread basket. You may not be able to stop once you get started  !  I can usually stop at half a roll or a small piece of a baguette... not this time.  My tuna was seared to perfection.  The sides were unbelievable.  Oh and the dessert? Well let's just say I have a new fave...limoncello tiramisu.  The menu is inspired by seasonal items  which just means that I'll have to do a quick getaway to Clearwater come autumn.  There was one little glitch, ( my boyfriend informed the folks  at the front desk that it was my bday and they dropped the ball) but It just wasn't enough to affect my rating.  Besides Devin made up for it in the end.      hands down.
Great place to visit, atmosphere was nice, it was raining outside but that didn't stop the fun and great experience on the inside! First time going and won't be the last!!

I REALLY wanted to like this place, but I think it's the fact that I'm Chinese-American and have had my share of superb Chinese food in China, Hong Kong, Macau, NYC, Vegas, and the Bay Area that I just cannot bring myself to endorse the food here. 

I love the name and it was really easy to place an order online for pickup, which was ready to go upon arrival. 

Husband and I ordered the eggplant with garlic, pan fried lamb with cumin, fried noodles with shrimp, and the Xi'an Oil splashing noodles. 

- Eggplant with garlic: way, way, waaaaaaaaay too oily and unexpectedly (not in a good way) too sweet! It's supposed to be a savory dish, not a sweet dish. I could barely taste any garlic as well. Since I had leftovers of this, I drained the excess oil from the takeout container, sauteed the eggplant with extra minced garlic and hot sauce, and it was still soaking in oil, which I dabbed off with a paper towel. The extra garlic and hot sauce barely did a thing to take down the sweetness. The amount of oil in this entree was just utterly grotesque. 

- Pan fried lamb with cumin: I have a sneaking suspicion that the lamb was actually beef, because it sure as heck looked and tasted like beef. This dish should be dry pan fried, in order to crisp up the lamb and highlight the cumin, but no, it was unfortunately almost as oily as the eggplant dish. 

- Fried noodles with shrimp: this was more lo mein than chow mein, which I guess is fine, since it's called "fried noodles." The amount of noodles was large, but there were literally 6 shrimps in the entire entree.

- Xi'an Oil splashing noodles were the best entree ordered; the flavor was unique and delicious; however, beyond the spice and green onions, it's really just a load of thick, flat rice noodles. 

These entrees are really overpriced for what it is. Anyway, gave it the ol' college try, but I don't think I shall return.

Not sure why this location of this popular grocery chain is so dismal. Oh wait, the cashiers are rude & angry! I have yet to encounter anyone working here who is pleasant. Except a man who appeared to be management. He said "hello" to everyone he passed. Meanwhile the cashiers act as if you're bothering them when you're trying to make a purchase. If you have a problem being pleasant, you probably shouldn't seek a job where you come in contact with people. 

If you're a friendly cashier working here, I really do apologize but I've never seen you. The place needs an employee overhaul. Only the pleasant need apply.

My bro had this same surgery with another dr, and it took over 3 hours and had dietary restrictions.  I was really amazed that Dr. La took only an hour and was really able to go back to my regular diet within less than a week.  He did an excellent job and cannot even tell after a month that I had anything done.  The office personnel were great and worked with my insurance company.  I cannot say enough about my experience.  I had such anxiety going in but was so greatly surprised at the outcome.  He was phenomenal!  Kudos to the entire team!

I went to Dr. Hargrove this past January for my yearly pap, exam, and to talk to her about trying to get pregnant soon. We met in her office before my actual physical exam, for about 15 minutes to talk about my history, etc. She was very kind, didn't rush me, answered all of my questions. We did the exam, she found something abnormal, and helped me schedule an ultrasound IN her office and said she would be present to go over the results that same day. Ultrasound came and she was there, explained everything she saw. I ended up having a large grapefruit sized tumor on my right ovary and I was panicked. I thought I had cancer, I thought I'd never be able to have kids, etc. She stayed with me and helped talk me down off of my ledge of anxiety. She again, answered all of my questions, was very patient with me, and was very comforting as I was not expecting to hear what I heard. She referred me to a great surgeon (Dr. James LaPolla) and I had surgery. She followed up with me a few weeks after surgery and I can't say enough how much I appreciated all of her kindness. She is one of the only doctors to spend as much time with me as she did. It was a very scary moment in my life, and she was there in person, and over the phone to ease all of my anxieties. I will never go to another GYN. She's always on time, her assistant Dana is so sweet and returns all my calls in a timely fashion, and is very knowledgeable. They are a great team.

Had about 7 of their menu items over 2 meals, from salads, sushi, fish entrees etc. 

Everything I had was excellent. Also very reasonably priced.  Ate in one of the meals, service was great. I believe our waiters name was Dave. 

9.5/10 would def recommend if you're ever in the area 

The Parmesan crab stuffed hogfish one of best meals I've had. Just wish it was bigger!

Was in Nashville looking to get away from Broadway for some patio dining, in a cool relaxed setting...this place was awesome.  Located in the 12 south area, we spent the night drinking fresh squeezed lime margs, eating almost every street taco offered, my faves being the tuna tatako, crispy oyster, and the spiced chicken verde.  Ambiance is cool an inviting, music vibe benign and encompassing, and the margaritas....yum.

Terrible experience.  I had Mr. Plumber come out for a quote and to hopefully fix the issue.  After receiving an EXORBITANTLY high quote, I politely asked the representative to leave.  I can't say for sure, they may be good at what they do, the there is no way to justify the price I received on the quote.  For just the quote, THE QUOTE, I was charged a $79 "service fee" for having them come out.  I could have applied the $79 toward the repair, but their estimate was FOUR TIMES as much as I ended up paying to get the work completed.  Thankfully, I decided to cut my losses and lose $79 rather than MUCH more by having Mr. Plumber perform the work.  Needless to say, I am not pleased and posting this for other consumers who are in need of a plumber.  There are several reputable businesses/plumbers in the area who do not charge a service fee to come out, give you a quote and let you know how they will fix your problem.  Do your research and save yourself $79 at least, if not MUCH MUCH more.

I saw this restaurant on DoorDash and wanted to check them out.

I love the idea of the different types of donuts. We ordered half a dozen Cream filled donuts.

My husband wasn't a huge fan of them, he thought the donuts were a little dry. I thought they tasted okay, but not AMAZING. Maybe since we got them delivered so they weren't exactly fresh/hot.

They're understaffed, the guy at the front turned his back on me as soon as I walked in because he was on the phone he was gone for more than 6 minutes and didn't apologize. There was no one I said and I was literally waiting for 20 minutes tops for my order. And the frozen coffee suck and taste like water.

Fresh & DELICIOUS food. Warm, genuine people, clean & accommodating environment- they really stepped up safety measures for this covid stuff. 
HIGHLY RECOMMEND. 

MUST TRY.

This bar is such a hometown hidden gem. They have not only survived COVID, but have come out on top. We came in late on a Saturday night, and the bar tender made sure we still had a excellent dinner, even thought the kitchen was closing. What a great family friendly place!!!!
I ordered a 6th birthday cake for my dog!   They did a great job!   Very very happy it looked amazing and the dog loved it!
So good. So happy to order there every time that I can't decide what I want. Tum yum soup please!

To be 100% honest, Novi was a place I visited once and then avoided as much as possible. 2 years ago it was cliquey and boring. It took a lot for my friends to convince me to go back.

The selling point was that there was a new DJ on Saturdays. Now Dustin is there on fridays and Saturdays and the nights are more lively!! He plays a great mix of music and it's never boring! Definitely a little something for everyone to dance to.

Red Cup Friday's is a great deal and makes for great nights out without spending an  insane amount. I haven't done the dance lessons, but it seems to help get newer people out on the floor, which is always fun! I mean,  who wants to dance alone?! 

I took one star off because the dance floor is kinda small and can get a little congested when the people who aren't dancing crowd around the floor. It usually doesn't get too crowded till about 11 or 12 though. 

All-in-all, Novi is a fun place to go, whether you're a dancer or not.

I occasionally get Vito's for take away when I'm looking for some good Italian.  They do a great job with their to-go orders and always have everything packed up nice and neat.  I usually stick with the spaghetti and meatballs or lasagna, both of which are consistently good.  Spaghetti and meatballs isn't something I'd normally order from an Italian restaurant, but Vito's version is always so good! They also throw in a container of fresh baked rolls with my order which is a nice bonus.  The pizza here isn't my favorite, but overall I still enjoy this place. I'd say that Vito's falls somewhere between 3 and 4 stars.

We made reservations for 13 for New Years Eve at the beginning of December. They called today to cancel our reservation saying they needed to get the room ready for their NYE party. Confused as to why they even let us make the reservation in the first place. Don't waste your time!

What a fabulous spot! We loved everything about it! We went on a Friday afternoon for lunch. We were a large group there for the weekend and everyone there loved what they ordered. Our server was fantastic. She was very knowledgeable and helpful. We had bloody Marys which were fantastic! We started with the cheese curds and fried pickles. Yum!!!!!! And then we all ordered lunches- one better then the next. A few that stood out were the fired green tomato BLT, rocket salad, boursin chicken BLT and the pulled pork. We all left happy and full!

Chi chi's revisited in 2021!  The food tasted like most of it came straight from a can. Either over seasoned or tasteless, processed, colorless. Service was mediocre. Large but super sweet margaritas. Very disappointing.

John somehow heard our small birthday cheers and gave us all a round of birthday shots in celebration of Serena's birthday. It's our first time coming to dubliner but I know for sure this will be a new normal when we got out in soho.

Manny's has solid lunch specials (they were from 11 AM to 2 PM Mondays through Fridays, last I checked). I took advantage of a $5 special where I got an impressive 3 oz. shrimp puff (Grade A), sizable crispy onion rings, and cole slaw. The puff was delicious, the shrimp tender, with a creole sauce on the side. Breading peeled off the onions, but their massiveness made up for that. With my drink, total was about $7 (credit cards accepted, but $10 minimum).

Their interior's spacious and attractive, and service is friendly. Eat there or get everything to go. If you stay, there's Wi-Fi but no idea if it's free.

I'll be back for their crabcake hoagie.

We came to Jack Rose for thanksgiving and had the most amazing experience. Our server was so kind, and fun, and didn't let the fact that she was working on thanksgiving affect her service in anyway. We really enjoyed her, she laughed at all our jokes, and was extremely thorough and attentive, and even ended our meal by taking our picture in front of their gallery wall. The food itself was amazing, a huge 4 course meal. I of course had the turkey, and it was so good and moist (we had been worried it may be dry) and the sides with it was so yummy. The portions were incredibly generous and the drinks we had were also delicious. They had a lot of original drink combinations that we really enjoyed. We have also come here for bottomless veuve brunch and I have to say they are really good at providing a special experience. I would highly recommend checking them out.

Olive Garden is our favorite Italian place to go. Menu is fantastic. Most of the tine you get amazing people who loves and wants to provide excellent service. Occasionally you end up with some morons who will destroy your dining experience. All chef's hard work can be destroyed by these morons who are not fit for service industry.

I love this place! Food is always fresh and tasty! I've tried several items but typically always go back to their enchiladas.

Great for groups (once groups are safe). Because everyone can order individually at the counter and then find a table to all sit together. No castle of splitting the bill at the end.

Have great COVID protocols currently though - can order ahead to-go or dine in at tables separated by plexi glass dividers.
來到亞省愛城旅遊多天，我一直想尋找一家吃上海點心的地方，在本地的免費週刊「光華報」裡無意中看到這家"大上海 Shanghai Grill"的廣告，於是我滿心歡喜決定去試試。我一開始並沒有寄予厚望，但我真沒想到會有如此令人失望的菜餚和品質。價錢方面不單止比我在溫哥華吃過同級上海菜館貴上一倍，既吃不飽，結果還要去找其他食肆醫肚。我不喜歡這裡的食物或及服務，也不會向任何人推薦這個地方！

un servicio fatal las meseras te atienden de mala gana y aceleradas no contestan las preguntas adecuada mente ellas solo quieren cobrar y atender a las personas que van a beber alcohol eh ido por dos veces a este lugar y las dos veces eh tenido muy malas experiencias " fui mecera en un tiempo y ese trabajo lo ame  " pero con estas chicas las verdad que dan un servicio fatal tanto me enoje que hasta mi cabeza me empezo a doler no lo recomiendo literal el servicio y la comida es arrebatada
Gel manicure didn't even last 24 hours, waste of time and money. First and last time I'll ever go.

My waitress was very nice and perfessional. Her name was Tiffany. Speedy service food was excellent! I will definitely be going back! I ordered the chickenchanga and my friend ordered the chicken and chorizo tacos.

So excited to see that there are more boba places in NOLA now!  I've been to this location a few times now and it has not disappoint!!  The boba is cooked just right with the right chewiness every time I've been there.  The traditional black milk tea is fragrant and handmade  taro fresh milk is also decent.  The boba fresh milk is also good, although not as good as the ones from Meet Fresh or Half & Half (but lucky for Sharetea, no need to worry about those competitions here!).  

Staff is friendly and even though sometimes the line might be long, they are efficient in taking orders and getting the drinks out.
