I stopped here on my lunch break with 4 other coworkers. We did not think the staff was friendly enough. We wanted to say hi to Ray just to congratulate him on his business, but they said he was busy with business stuff. They did not even let Ray know we wanted to say hello. 
The cupcake was good, but extremely expensive for the small size that it was. $6.25 for one boozy cupcake. I got the Kahlua vanilla cupcake to try. The icing was a bit too sweet for me. It had a butterscotch flavor and very light kahlua flavor. I think it would be more reasonable for the cupcakes to be $3.50-$4.

Place is an institution. 
My dad has been going there for 70 years.
Truly a special place. 5 generations strong.
Keep up the great work fellas!

Good intentions,  poor execution. 
FOODIES BEAWARE: even though it has the same name, its not one of Thomas Keller's restaurants. 

Service was very good, decor was really nice but the food was not good and way overpriced for what you get. We ordered:
Mushroom Ragu (3/5): they overcooked the mushrooms and probably used cheap truffle oil instead of real truffles. 
Trio of scallops (4/5) - great idea, good quality scallops but lacked flavor. 
Wagyu Ribeye (1/5)- definitely not Wagyu and definitely not a ribeye. Cheap sirloin steak, cut with the grain, chewy, one of the worst steaks I've ever had.
Rack of Lamb- bad quality of meet. The chickpea puree was good.

This place is a hot mess. We usually make a pit stop once every couple of weeks while we're out makin' the rounds. So we went in last Saturday at approx 3pm. There were a fair amount of people just standing around. Line wise, we were 3rd from the front. The ordering went fast, no problems there. Then I noticed that everyone standing around were all waiting for their orders. Half were take out, half were dine in orders. It took OVER 15 MINS for our order to come up. We ordered a box meal and some items from the dollar menu. Half the soda machine wasn't working. There was a piece of paper on one side saying "sold out". There were NO napkins out either. I told a person behind the counter it was empty, and she handed me a few. That doesn't fix the problem. Eventually someone did come out to refill. 
Oh and while I was waiting, I overhead the cashier asking people if they could pay with cards as they didn't have any $1's.
Roasted Oysters were amazing! A must try while here! We stood in line about 20 minutes, and had the best experience! Food was great! Staff was friendly! Won't be our last visit.
Disgusting food, lacks flavor. Taco Bell is better. This is not authentic Mexican food.  I can't stress it enough skip this place.
The food is okay. The people are very friendly. Their service is 5 stars. The veggie fried rice wasn't as good as usual. I think they've changed the rice or something.

This food was AMAZING! THE service impeccable our Server Salvador was one of the best we ever had. I am so grateful! Everything we tasted from the drinks to food was AMAZING!! He had so many tables and was ON TOP OF IT!! Our food was so good and plentiful we had to bring some home and we can EAT EAT!! I can't wait to go back. Many Vegetarian options and combos! 
The drink prices were bananas I got a 23oz Blue Moon for $5 on a Sat?? With a Blood orange?! I ADORE THIS SPOT! I shall be back with friends in tow!

I have gone to Lapel's several times with my suits and coats. I like that my items do NOT have any chemical odor after the cleaning. Also, the colors of my clothes stay intact.The price is up there when compared with some other dry cleaners; however, the difference is that this place is using an environmentally-friendly product for cleaning. They have a pick-up and drop-off service, which is nice! The owner, Burt, picked up my items and I had the sense that he cared about his business and his customers. I wish him and his family well.

Two stars for the meals. We had dinner last night with pies for desert. The experience was spoiled by a rather obnoxious waiter who appeared bored with his job. If we return, we certainly will not be seated in his section.
Such a fun experience! Will definitely be doing more in the future. Host and hostess were superb and extremely accommodating! Our whole group had a blast

All I got to say is AMAZING!!! So mad I didn't know or try this place out sooner!!!

Came in and the look of the place is very modern. They greeted us and they were super polite. Chairs were kind of small but maybe my butt was just too big idk ..

Any who, I ordered the hand shaved noodles with chicken. When they brought it out, it just looked like dull noodles and the chicken kind of looked weird ... BUT I took a bite and fell in love. Was genuinely some of the best noodles and chicken I've ever had. Hands down. 

on yelp everyone was talking about the fluffy ice....
So of course I had to try it. Ordered a small strawberry and it was beyond amazing. I was actually mad at myself for not ordering a bigger size plate. So good!!! So so so good!! 

Over all I would HIGHLY recommend trying. It was seriously so good and I am so mad I wasn't eating here sooner.

Went a couple weeks ago. Was disappointed. Our server was great, super nice. But we we're put in one of the  booths in the back so we we're often forgotten or the server wouldn't come around as often as I thought they would. The food however, was not great. I ordered shrimp linguine Alfredo half size. The noodles itself was pretty tasty, BUT the shrimps were so so so so tiny. It was very disappointing, especially  in comparison to the endless shrimp's shrimp. Def not worth $13.99. when my friend ordered endless shrimp, he asked for a second round of garlic scampi shrimp, and the server came back with another dish of shrimp, a long time later, with only 6 shrimp in the dish. It was not worth the wait. It's endless shrimp, but I guess I'd be there all night waiting for more. This was my first time at red lobster, so I wasn't sure what to expect, but I know I will not be coming back.
Best Cuban sandwich in the area.  One of the few places my 13 year old son will let me take home that is not a fast food joint.  Good service and reasonable prices also.

I've been going to Lunchbox wax for about 8 months now and couldn't be happier with each experience! While prices are slightly higher than your average nail salon, it's definitely worth the extra cash for the professional service, clean (and gorgeous) facility and the top notch waxing experience. I highly recommend Carol for any of the services!

The memories Of my experience here is sad.. You would've never thought I had just lost my mother the way I was handled here. I'd expect a certain mannerism and professionalism when dealing with those whom are grieving.

I wanted to try this place for some time but honestly, the menu was a bit confusing for takeout.  Finally went and ate in yesterday. It absolutely deserves the five stars it has all over Yelp.  Outstanding food.  We had Gyoza and Fried Shumai to start.  I never liked steamed shumai but fried they were awesome.  Everything had great texture and flavor.  I had Wonton Ramen as my main.  Loved the Charsiu, which BTW is a slice of BBQ pork.  Melted in my mouth. The wontons were good and broth outstanding.  My friend had Hot and Spicy Seafood Ramen, which reminded us both of Tom Yom Thai soup.  The heat was spicy but not overly so. The seafood was cooked perfectly. The portions were huge and we both took home a bowl. I absolutely will come again, probably getting Hawaiian style BBQ and Grill. Highly recommend the restaurant.

Restaurant can get crowded at times, but for the most part during this pandemic they try to keep it safe by giving everyone their space. The food is good, the menu can have a little more selections I must mention. The food came out really fast taking Into consideration that it had a nice size crowd our last visit. I would recommend the Mardi Gras pasta add a crab cake or a side of fried catfish to the dish

I had Trugreen years ago and now I know why I cancelled. I am totally disappointed!!! Such a great deal to start the service - and they had no problem running my credit card!! I signed up for the whole program - sprinklers, sod and treatments. First things first The sprinkler guy comes out and does ABSOLUTELY NOTHING!! And charges $89! 
The next guy comes out and is missing a part and says he'll be back the next day - that's been 3 weeks! Another $200. Waiting on sod until the sprinklers are done! Worst part - NO ONE will return my calls - I've spoken to customer service twice and they said they contacted the managers - no return call! Now - if I can only get this poor service cancelled once again!!!

The hostess was so incredibly rude and insensitive to my elderly mom that it prompted me to write my first Yelp review. We had made reservations. When we arrived there was a couple waiting who had said they did not have reservations. The hostess came out and immediately sat them. When we tried to explain that we had reservations, the hostess interrupted us, saying she would be back and see to us. When she did not appear for 10 minutes, I went inside and the hostess told me to go outside and wait. Another 5 minutes went by and my mother, who is in her eighties and visibly frail, and who cannot stand for long, went in to talk to her. The hostess directed her to go outside. When my mom said she cannot stand any longer, the hostess pointed to a bench INSIDE the restaurant and told her to sit. My mom  began to explain that that was not acceptable and again, the hostess cut her off.  Finally we went outside and simply sat ourselves. The waitress was lovely and the food was good, but our stressful experience at the beginning with the hostess really dampened our evening. I called and emailed the manager a few days later and did not receive  a reply. My mom lives at a nearby 55 + years community and  has shared her experience at Anthony's with quite a few of the residents there. I would not recommend anyone who is elderly or medically visit this restaurant during Covid.

Played there today June 25. Front nine played at about an hour and 45 minutes. Good pace with no delays in play. Arriving at the 10th hole without a club house visit we found ourselves fourth to tee off. Where did these groups come from that didn't impact our front nine play?  It's like the pro shop sent groups off 10 that didn't play the front. This continued backup continued the full back nine. Poor course management without a ranger to manage play. May never go back

Call center is in India. Horrible company. Could not comprehend why I didn't have a W-2 or pay stub from a volunteer position! I provided them with a reference & multiple emails explaining this. Every day they would call ask pay stub or W-2. LOL!

My daughter learned to read with TLC when she was three years old. Her abilities with reading and other skills taught at TLC allowed her to be a top student through out her schooling. At 18 she became the youngest person to earn a stock brokers license.
My twin boys were also taught with their program. They both read beautifully by early age four ! This established a strong academic foundation for them.
The program really works!

Absolutely love the atmosphere at Itri. Always have a good time there, and thoroughly enjoy their food and drinks. The server named Emily has been our waitress the last few times that I've been there, and she is always a delight and makes the dining/drinking experience an enjoyable one! Would highly recommend Itri to anyone visiting the area!

You know when you are about to do something, you know it is not a good idea, but you do it anyway.....this was what we did the other night when it was dinner time, we were hungry and walking out of a store next to Bonefish - we knew it was a chain, we knew this one had bad reviews, we gave it a shot anyway.  A mistake.
Had the muscles as appetizer which were good - however about 45 seconds after they hit the table someone brought out our entrees and said 'oh guess you don't want these yet' and left.  Ok so far - however ~10min later when the appetizer was finished, they brought out dinners again -  THE SAME PLATES - yes, everything on both plates was cold, steak, shrimp, fish, fries was all cold - it was obvious it was under a warming lamp, but thats about it.  Horrible - best part - the waitress came by to ask how things were i said 'cold' and she just walked away.... love it.  So - wont be back.

This place used to be an awesome finish to a night of going out downtown. Seems to have gone downhill lately. I understand that after a few hours of dealing with drunk idiots it's not going to be easy to remain polite or friendly. This isn't a review of the staff or service. 

However, the food was always awesome. Until last night. I ordered my usually chili cheese fries, which used to be a huge pile of crispy crinkle cut fries, smothered in a meaty chili sauce, and drowned in cheese. Last night I got a portion that was half the size, more than likely microwaved, since they were mostly cold in the middle, and a small cup of greasy chili and cheese on the side. So disappointing.

Absolutely the best! Diane and Emily are perfect. I have been to a few nail salons but this is now my "go-to." Both Diane and Emily take their time and are very professional. Aside from their customer service, the location is beautiful and always clean.

Decided to give this place another shot, nothing has changed except now the portions are cut in half. You spend an additional $2.80 for "double meat" and a only receive what should be a "normal" portion at any other location. Never have a problem anywhere but at this location...

Upon arrival... Kylie was the most respectful and helpful person! Professional beyond her years. She is going places!  Rami...amazing server. On top of his game! So considerate and responsive   A+++ experience!

We opted for Charlestons to celebrate a special occasion based on a previous good experience here.  However, this visit totally squashed my celebratory mood.

All 5 appetizers had elements that were dariy based...not so good for a hubs that is allergic to milk.  No Moscato?  Settled for a $7 small pour Riesling that was decent.

I ordered the Chicken Piccata and it tasted sour.  When I told the server that it tasted a little off, he made no attempt to ask if there was anything he could do to make it better. Instead he just said "enjoy" and walked away.  When he returned at the end of the meal, my chicken was basically untouched and he asked if I wanted a box to take it home.  I told him that I did not care for the taste of it, and he took my plate away without offering an alternative nor was it removed from our bill.  On an up note, the side of Okra I got was decent and the plain angel hair pasta on my plate was the best part of my meal.

Hubs got the chicken and ribs combo and raved about the small side of baked beans the most, followed by the ribs.  

2 Dinners and 1 glass of wine = $50 better spent elsewhere.  The hubs felt so bad that he took me to Coldstone Creamery for my 'dinner' instead.

If I could leave 0 starts I would let me say this it's a nice looking hotel but that's where it ends the staff was rude and unhelpful I reserved ahead of time for a  double
Upon check in I was advised that there were only kings available how when you are only able to reserve what's available the staff was not understanding nor accommodating and of course I had to take the king as it
 was past the check in once I entered the room there was hair in the shower and dirt and debris on the floor where it hadn't been swept or mopped but if That wasn't enough my car was vandalized and broken into what an experience to say the least

I called AAA Chimney Experts when I needed to get the chimney inspected for a house I am in the process of buying. John was very helpful and was able to come out the very next morning. This was especially helpful since time was of the essence. The price was also very reasonable. Afterwards, he sent me a report complete with pictures that I am now able to use to make an informed decision. Thanks, John!! I truly appreciate your excellent customer service. I will be recommending you to anyone who is in need to chimney work!

I was lucky to find this spot after I left a game at Nissan Stadium. The chicken tenders had a great flavor. I ordered the collard greens. I can honestly say they were the best collard greens I've had in a restaurant. They had a little bit of a spicy kick on them which I liked. The collard greens could definitely compete with a soul food restaurant. I ordered the Mac and cheese as well. Very good too. It looked and tasted like it was made with a roux which I definitely enjoyed. I didn't care for the comeback sauce. I ordered the tender sauce which was definitely my preference. I loved that the patio was heated. It was warmer outside than in the restaurant. Definite plus. I will be bringing my boyfriend along on my next visit.

We are a new law firm in the area, I recommended 
of 10 of my coworkers to go eat lunch at this place. We each placed our orders and left a tip on the card.  Before we left, one of the lady workers chased us out on the parking lot complaining that we didn't leave a tip on the table. I asked if we were supposed to double tip since we all had previously gave one on the card when we prepaid for our food. Not to mention that 2 of my coworkers got their order wrong and wanted them to pay again to correct their mistake. More than anything i am sadden about the no-profesional attitude. My coworkers have all expressed how this was their first time here and they will NEVER come back here again. I am sad and disappointed. I love the food but to the mistreatment we have decided not to eat here again. This place will miss out on 40+ people from our firm since the word quickly spread about this place so sorry for TACOS 46.

Crabby Patty is great! My family and I have made this place our new weekly stop..for my husband he sneaks in a couple times a week! The staff is very friendly and inviting! My daughter who is eight and a very picky eater I might add, also is a big fan. Not only do they have great seafood but great kids meals with desserts! 
When we walk in we always know we're walking into smiling faces. It's the small things that count!

Great food! Definitely make a reservation though, we were walk ins and were seated right away which was great- but the second we paid our bill the manager told us we had to leave because they needed our table. We had been there for less than an hour so I felt a little embarrassed, and having to leave abruptly put a damper on our experience.

My favorite little spot in Chinatown. The soups are great, AND it's BYO. 

One thing to note - the meats in the soup are pretty fatty, depending upon what you order. I realize it's a cultural thing, but definitely not for me. That said, order a leaner meat if fatty's not your style either.

The food here is really delicious! I got the Side House Salad combination plate with turkey, Smoked Meatloaf and brisket. I ordered a second salad because it was so good. Simple yet delicious. Very plentiful and filling. Anyway, Our server, however, was quite unfriendly, and seemed occupied during our time. We asked for recommendations and he said something to the tune of "just get what you want." Ummmmmm ok thanks???????

We would literally say "excuse me" 2 to 3 times to attempt to get his attention and he would act like he couldn't hear us! The restaurant is literally not even a large place so I don't know if he was purposely ignoring us or what. I'm not going to mention his name because I'm in a good mood & maybe he was having a bad day. But if I come back and get the same subpar service, I'm dropping the dime on errrrbody. 

I'm definitely coming back for the food.

Just tried the Dog Wash Depot for the first time this morning. It was a lovely experience for me and my Annie. She is a small dog, 11 years old and seem 
ed to enjoy the experience . She was done in an hour and it's very convenient to my home. Will definitely go there again. I was able to make the appointment online - very convenient. Staff was very friendly and engaging with the dogs also.
I have to say this place has grown on me.  If you ask them to toast your bread and that improves the sandwich for me.  Good quality meet and good French Fries.

Love, love, love the new bar at 404!! Fabulous bourbon selection, great cocktails, nice servers. Adore that you can have the whole kitchen menu at the bar - such great food in such a Fab spot. The decor is so hip, and it's a wonderful addition to the Gulch. My personal favorite cocktail is the Vesper. So delicious and balanced. And a big thumb's up to mixologist AJ, who really knows his stuff. Please, get yourself to Gertie's for a cool drink in a chic space.

I got a call from a man named JOAL. Not only was he rude and abnoxiuos but after I explained our siding project he said " YOU NEED TO GET A HANDYMAN FOR YOUR PROJECT, WE ARE TO BUSY FOR THAT"

We ended up using a great local contractor recommended by two neighbors.

Not only did TriState Remodeled not get our $9800  but will definitely NOT get the business of anyone we know.

JOAL, if you read this review please take our advise and take some business ACUMEN classes with "all the money that you make from your BIG projects"...And another advice from a business owner, NEVER underestimate your potential customer's projects.

The place seems to be run by kids. After attending an event at the CC on Sunday, I asked for the draft beer list and she rattled off what turns out to be only half of them, so I picked Sierra Nevada. What I got was a very full glass of carmel colored something with absolutely no head and it tasted watered down and had a distinct metallic taste. Undrinkable for $6. When I spotted the beer list on the wall, I asked for a substitute Guinness which actually arrived with a head and tasted good. We were there for apps and a few beers to watch the Eagles lose again, and got cold, chewy calamari and reasonably decent but lukewarm buffalo wings. Our server was prompt but unapologetic for it all and charged for the awful beer. Oh well. Just because it is a sports bar shoudnt mean lousy food. This place has its ups and downs; this time it was a downer.
Best part of our experience was Derrick!  Service was amazing! Great recommendations for the city.  The food recommendations were great as well!  We really enjoyed our experience!

Before I dive into the food portion, I'll cover the atmosphere and customer service. Our waitress was super nice and accommodating and everyone who worked there seemed to be in a good mood though they seemed slightly understaffed. I sat outside and it was such a chill space. Also, menu is HUGE. 


Michelada - delicious mix with a nice smoky touch and generous portion. 

Salsa- too easy to finish (but not much of a kick for spice lovers)

Al pastor tacos the best al pastor (pineapple marinated pork) I've had in Indy yet, so flavorful.

Rajas con quesos tacos-  these are sliced peppers and cheese. I asked for them without the cheese and it might have been my favorite. It was the perfect spicy/sour combo for me. Definitely a good option.

Cabeza (cheek meat) -not as chunky as I'm used to, it's more shredded but still delicious and tender and bomb especially with chopped onions. Beware though, it's heavy! 

7 seas soup- damn this is a huge bowl of seafood, with a tomato base of some sort. Hearty and full of seafood. Not sure if it's fresh seafood so don't ask me, I just know it tastes bomb. Especially with the onions + chiles they give you on the side.

Chilaquiles- the family chilaquiles lover didn't love these chilaquiles. The green salsa was a little too bright for their taste but the carne asada and eggs were yummy. 

Next time I'll definitely come back to try the other drinks + the other food on the extensive menu.

Got the thai iced tea, tasted super watered down with the 80% ice I apparently paid for, what a cup of disappointment.

Only stars are for the mochi ice cream that they import from Bubbie's of Honolulu, my absolute fave ice cream mochi maker like ever.

Don't get me wrong. I love Sugar Moms and I've been going to it since I first went there on my 21st Birthday. it's been my general First Friday and all around bar for quite sometime now. But Moms has been getting a lot more crowded of late, which gets extremely cumbersome due to the fact that it's essentially an Apartment basement. and it doesn't honor the smoking ban which can get extremely irritating sometimes (also due to it being a basement).
But I have a soft spot for sitting in the bumper cars, playing it's fun games (they have a lot more than just a pool table), and listening to the good tunes on it's jukebox.  and the food is actually pretty damn good.
I just prefer Skinners and National Mechanics when I'm looking for a good watering hole in Old City.

I want to like this place, I really do. And generally, their food is okay. But each time I go, I want to chuck a box of kosher salt across the counter and say, "Here! This stuff works! Use it!"

First, their food is expensive. A taco is $5.25, and I thought I left those crazy prices in DC. They're big, but c'mon. The Buenos taco has slaw, mango salsa, and fish, but there is so much stuff that the tortilla rips by the time I eat it. Add that to the fact that in the meanwhile I've emptied the salt shaker into both my taco and the guacamole I ordered as a side. 

We had the fajitas once and those are pretty good--but skip the chicken and order the shrimp, you'll thank me later. 

The guacamole is actually a pretty good deal for the amount of guac that you get, but again the fajitas are a little pricey for a casual dining place.

I like Buenos because I feel like I'm eating healthfully (even if I'm just kidding myself), but I hate that it costs me a mint to do so (and that I have to salt everything in front of me, water excluded).

TERRIBLE Walmart and customer service! Specifically all the managers suck and have power trips. We tried to return a Christmas tree (before Christmas) because we changed our mind and they told us that was okay. Once we got there, The manager made some fake excuse about the mayor not allowing returns on Christmas trees...just embarassing for them. He made it so difficult till finally we asked to take his name down and then he let us return it.

We LOVE Mission's, we originally found them randomly for our wedding and went for a tasting with Melissa Serraro. We fell in love with Missions and Melissa right from our tasting. We had never had missions and actually never even heard of it. Well, I can tell you that up until the day people are still raving about how amazing the food was. They set delivered, set everything up, made it all look cute and tore it all down and sent us home with the leftovers. We now have used them for numerous other parties we have done and everytime it is just an phenomenal. We will keep on using them for all our parties because we love them that much. They were so reasonably priced and you literally can't get better food.

Tony's is the only place in Edmonton where you can find authentic New York style pizza. I find the crust to be a bit too thick at other places but Tony's nailed it down perfectly. It comes down to $21.50 for an XL OG New Yorker pizza but their menu has a lot of different variations if you want to add a little extra like some salami or mushroom. 

I'm also a big fan of the dessert here, especially the tiramisu cake. It's soft and they sure didn't skimp on the Kahlua...I appreciate that a lot. 

If you're looking to get a taste of New York, come on down to Tony's. You definitely won't be disappointed.

Super cute shop! The girl working looked a bit bored and slightly bothered that my boyfriend and I stopped by, but I understood as it's the beginning of the warm season and it can be a bit slow. The popsicles are very unique and range from creamy to fruity. Vegan and dairy free options are available. 

My boyfriend got the green tea mochi popsicle and it was FANTASTIC. Sometimes green tea/matcha foods can be overpowering to the point where I get a stomach ache, but this was spot on. I got the vanilla bean with jimmies and it was tasty as well, but left a weird film in my mouth. I'm assuming it's because of the high fat content.

I am always on the look out for delicious and authentic Mexican food in the MontCo area and I am so glad that I came across San Antonio Mexican Cuisine!

The food was absolutely delicious and the service was phenomenal. We ordered 3 tacos (al pastor, carnitas & lengua), an al pastor burrito and a big ol' glass of watermelon water. The meats were all very flavorful but the al pastor here was out of this world, especially topped off with the variety of hot sauces available right at the table. Our waiter/server was super attentive and kept checking in on us to see if we needed anything else. 

I'm very excited for many return visits - they have lunch specials Mon-Fri and also a sweet variety of desserts that I'm looking forward to trying next time. 

This restaurant is situated in a strip mall right next to not just one but two equally awesome eateries: Sahara (Mediterranean) and Sai Gon 2 (Vietnamese)! One of these days when I'm feeling extra hungry and/or crazy, I'm gonna hit them all up back to back to back.

I ordered for a 3:30 pick up. The pizza was ready early and hot, common LC pizza. The review is primarily for misinformation. I have gotten take out a few times and was impressed with their mask requirements. Signage is posted outside and in. Their employees have always been masked properly before today. I asked for the person at the register to please put hers on, I am immunocompromised. She did- only to remove it once I walked away. The people constructing the pizzas and boxing them had masks around their chin. An unpleasant experience this time around and unfortunately I will have to miss out on my crazy bread. Vaccinated I may be, but Covid isn't picky. I don't need a side of it along with my crazy sauce.

WOW, Surprised to find this place tucked away in a random strip mall. Super good food. Having lived in the south this place competes with some of the best BBQ in North Carolina. I'll be sure to revisit next time I am in town!

We moved here from NC in 2019 and have have to say that this is the best Philly steak place in this area. There are not a lot of great restaurants here that we have found so far and coming from a southern state where there were plenty of home cooking eateries and restaurants, it's been somewhat disappointing.  Well low and behold! Finally! This place is off the hook consistently!  We've tried different steak subs and they have all fit the bill! Nice restaurant inside too although we usually do carry out.  Keep it up Best of Philly!

Always a successful spot to enjoy a work lunch with colleagues! I love working so close to Vito's because it has great food and the service is always so great! 

Since COVID, they have not offered their lunch buffet. Instead, they have a lunch menu where you can order pizza, pasta, apps, and they have a pizza/salad combo meal that works for me! This past visit I went with the house salad and a chicken pesto pizza. The server brought over some bread with oil and vinegar for us to enjoy while eating our salads which was nice. My pizza was a little larger than what I would call a "personal" pizza so I ate a few slices, but packed the rest up to take home for dinner. It's a perfect meal for lunch and dinner to be honest. 

The lunch special is a little more than the cost of the buffet, but who cares! I got my own salad and pizza and didn't have to wait in line. It was a perfect meal. For $16, it's a great option for lunch. 

They now even offer a pay online option so that you don't have to stick around and wait for the server to run credit cards; I love being able to scan the receipt to pay my bill online. What a great perk!

My friends have been talking about this place for over a year. Since I am from the Caribbean (and cook the cuisine at home), I wasn't in a rush to try it. But, during an impromptu girls out day, my friends were excited to eat here for lunch, since we were in the neighborhood. WELLLL, the food was so good, that I had to take the time to tell you about it. 

Between the three of us we had: ackee and saltfish with fried dumplings; the pulled pork sandwich with fries, and BBQ ribs w/garlic mashed potatoes & string beans. We also had fresh ginger beer (not soda, this was the real deal!) and for dessert the freshest bread pudding that I've had outside of my own kitchen. We sampled each others dishes and were all very, very pleased with the quality, preparation, flavor, and presentation. 

I also noticed that there was a lot of take-out traffic with lots of people enthusiastically picking up their orders. Also, the owner came over to ask about our experience and it was a really nice touch. 

I look forward to returning to this restaurant and bringing more friends with me. 

Compliments to the chef!

Our A/C repairman recommended this service provider and we were so impressed with their willingness and persistence and communication!  They helped us resolve an issue that had been baffling to several other contractors.  We will absolutely be making MR Electricians our first call for all future needs. Thank you MR Electrician!
Pizza is the best!  Delicious!  And the owner/manager has heart. I truly love this place. The people that work there are exceptional. Get there early. It's always pretty busy on the weekend.

I went to Bangkok Cafe for valentines dinner and it was exactly was I was hoping for. I was immediately greeted and seated on one of the busiest nights for restaurants. We were seated in the back where it was quiet and warm. 

The food was spectacular and the servings were generous. I love the amount of peanuts in the papaya salad although it wasn't very spicy which seemed unusual. The noodle dishes we ordered were very tasty and I already want to go back. Since it was Valentine's Day we were given heart cookies as a complimentary desert. 

To top it off we received 7% cash back. Thanks yelp!

OK food. We stayed at the hotel across the street and wanted to grab something quick and filling. I got the lasagna special and it was pretty good. The garlic bread was a little hard and the marinara was very salty. My friend got the pizza, which looked must tastier. The guys were nice, but I don't think I'd go out of my way to eat here again.

Omg! I pray I don't get food poisoning
The wreak of old seafood the minute I brought in the house 
Over $100 order in the trash 

Do not order from this nasty place

We have eaten here 2 times. Both times. Chicken RAW!!  How do you Not cook chicken Enough?? 

The issue is that they have so many customers. They STOPPED caring If something comes Out Wrong  or Not cooked enough!   Not sure why they can't cook food long enough. Or get a knife and cut into it   
Check it. 

I'm only here because my husband wanted this place for Valentine's Day.... Smh ( shaking My Head). This is insane.

We found this place on yelp and thought we would give it a try. Excellent burgers and fries. Chicken was great to. Highly recommend the flight to try 3 different sandwiches. Very friendly.  Highly recommend.

Not bad! 
I've ordered take out twice now, including fresh rolls, Pad Kaeng & Thai Basil. I did not have a good first experience, as the Thai Basil, which I asked to be a 2 (out of 3) on the spicy scale, was so spicy I couldn't eat it. This is partially my fault, obviously, but be mindful of the spice level when ordering. The fresh rolls are huge and well worth the price. The downfall with them was that the purple cabbage was extremely hard and almost sharp. I don't know if it was bad or frozen, but I did not enjoy that. The Pad Kaeng was amazing and my favorite thing so far - I'd give that a 5! The garlic sauce was light, sweet & packed with flavor - one of the best sauces I've had in a Thai dish. 
Overall, it's a good place, but not my favorite. I highly recommend the Pad Kaeng though!

This is a great place to be for dancing, food and sports. Not your average gay bar by any means. They have 3 bars, a decent sized dance floor and wall to wall televisions in their sports bar section with any kind of sport you can imagine. This is a non smoking bar which is really nice but has a comfortable patio for your nicotine needs. 
And although it is a gay bar, everyone is welcome and there is a nice mix of people The best part for us was running into Halcyon when they do their monthly show there. This is the spot if you like to dance.

I did NOT have a good experience at the Canopy Hilton in Philadelphia.  I was there for a business meeting. Several things went wrong. We were told the wrong room in our initial reservation. Breakfast was over an hour late. This was very embarrassing as we were hosting a meeting for clients. When breakfast finally did arrive. We had to ask several times for proper accompaniments with the coffee service (like milk!!!) which was not initially provided.  Cream cheese was also not provided, although bagels were served. Again, we asked several times for cream cheese and it never came.  Toaster was not working. Asked about this as well and it was never replaced or fixed. 

On a personal note.  My credit was charged twice for the room. I called for a refund and was given the run-around. Initially the refund was issued on a Mastercard which was an error because I paid with a Visa.  When I called again to resolve the matter. They claimed it was "just how their receipts are done." I suspect there is some kind of credit card fraud going on at this hotel. I would urge management there to look into it.  After I called again and again, finally my credit card was refunded correctly, but only after I asked to speak to the Front Office Manager at the location. I was supposedly transferred to the Front Office Manager but I was diverted to a voicemail which I'm not certain was his at all. I nevertheless left a message but never received a call back.

DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL. I SUSPECT CREDIT CARD FRAUD.

Its not my first time using INDY TIRE in Carmel, either its for alignment or tire patch up. Love the place, wonderful customer service and fast reliable service. Its hard to find dependable auto repair shop these days, but Indy Tire in Carmel is one of them. Good prices and defiantly deserve 5 star service. I would recommend this place to anyone.

We've been sitting waiting for breakfast for an hour. It doesn't matter if the food is the best... this is beyond unacceptable!! NOTHING in the breakfast world takes this long! Wait... are they slow cooking the corned beef as we sit and wait?? 
This was a first and this is absolutely a last!  

I should note that the servers are great. They walk around amongst the tables apologizing for the wait times totally embarrassed.

This is our go to pizza place! The ingredients are fresh and the pizza is delicious. This place gets busy on Friday and Saturday nights it seems so either go early, before the dinner rush or sort of late. It's a tiny place with not much space. I'd probably try to call ahead if you have a large party,for this place over 5 people is a large party. Great place for a date also, decent wine selection also. If you like pizza, go to this place!

My friend and I shared the cheese fries, which were amazing. The cheese sauce is made with a very mild white cheese, which goes amazingly well with the BBQ sauce they provide at the table. My friend got the roasted chicken and mashed potatoes. I got the pulled pork sandwich and green beans. Both entrees were excellent. We also each got a piece of carrot cake for dessert, which was one of the best carrot cakes I have ever had in my life. I highly recommend trying The Shaved Duck!

In the days and stresses of COVID-19 96.3 Capital FM the breeze has become a favourite of mine.  I wish they had proper government funding as they are doing an insane amount of therapy for the masses.  Although the commercials are sometimes a bit monotonous they do sets of eight songs.  The advertising is understandably how the radio survives so I pay attention to who funds it.  Time to put the reel to reel away and just run the best rack of records on the air today.  Very good, very fine, very therapeutic, very thoughtful, and very good broadcasting Stacy and fellow casters.  Six stars for radio. Seven for effort. Relaxing Favorites.......

Great bbq. The service was fast and friendly. I stopped in for lunch and had the pulled pork sandwich, and my mom had the pulled chicken, and both were very good. Ribs smelled and looked fantastic--excellent choice for BBQ. Coleslaw was fresh and crisp. I will be back.

I... love this place. I've only ever ordered delivery through Toast and I've only tried the crunch dogs, the veggie crunch balls, the bulgogi melt and the fries, so I don't have an extensive knowledge of the menu, but my god are the Crunch Dogs addictive. Heed my warning. If you have an addictive personality, try something else on the menu. I'm pretty sure they are one of the only restaurants in Philly that makes them and that's why I tried them to begin with. Believe the hype. Personally, I love just a straight beef dog with ketchup, mustard and potatoes or a cheese dog with hot Cheetos and spicy mayo, but feel free to mix it up. There are several possible combos. 

I must admit, I have three cons. 1. I don't absolutely love the fries, they're usually undercooked and lacking seasoning, but they're fries. I can always pop them in my oven and add seasoning once they get to me. 2. I wish you could order Crunch Dogs through Uber so I could order with priority delivery in order to maintain the cheese pull in the colder months, but I know it's probably difficult to add to Uber with all the combo options. But if you ever decided to do so, I'd be elated and 3. I wish you didn't sell out of toppings or ingredients for crunch dogs as frequently as you do. I haven't ordered several times because you were out of stock of potatoes, or spicy mayo, or hot cheetos.. but that means you guys are in high demand, so, I get it. I'm just jealous.

The recommendations citing the biscuits do not lie. It was the crowning glory to lunch, but mom and i went for the strawberry shortcake biscuit and it was this glorious mound of fluffy biscuit with strawberries and whipped cream and jam and awesomeness and it's a -really- good thing we didn't order one each, because its huge.

We also got the 1/2 sandwich 1/2 salad options because it is the boon of the indecisive [which is me, all over] and holy moley, guys. If that's half a salad, I sort of fear the whole ones. Everything was fresh and bright and crunchy with a nice ratio of dressing to lettuce to other veg and cheese and it was a big enough portion that I actually felt like I'd had a solid amount of produce instead of some places where the half salads feel more like garnish. The sammiches were hot off the grill [or possibly panini press] and were melty and well-seasoned without being too salty or drippy.

The decor is, overall, a bit hipstery [red-painted bull skulls honestly just look evil, guys], but that is easily ignored if it isn't your style and the sweet staff makes up for any visual oddity. They have excellent recommendations for the uncertain and are determined you'll enjoy your meal, so if something isn't right just let them know. I'll be back the next time i'm in town, definitely.

Hattricks is famous for good reason. Their wings are incredible. The atmosphere is the perfect blend of comfortable and fun. 

Surprise win for me were the sweet potato fries. They were so thin and crispy. They were served with maple syrup which is one of my favorites. 

If you are in downtown Tampa and you want to watch a game, drink a beer, and eat some wings, this is your best option.

Only thing to keep in mind is that they do offer carry out, and they get absolutely swamped. This can make pickup times kinda long if there there is a big game or event. My suggestion: sit back, get a drink, and watch the game because the wings are worth a little wait. Plus the staff is very friendly.

Only tried the popsicles thus far, but they really are fantastic.

Fresh, cute, unique, made with love.  There's standards like strawberry smoothie, to more interesting like matcha-mochi or coffee-oreo.  I've had the matcha and kiwi yogurt and both were refreshing and tasty bite-- smooth texture to the core and no sign of freezer burn or funky freezer taste (which I detest at frozen treat spots).  They're not overly sweet, either, but still enjoyable to those with a sweet tooth such as myself.

The duo in charge are sweet, as well.
Highly recommend this place.

Planned on doing my due diligence with laser surgery and had made appointments w/ Updegraff and a competitor in Tampa.  Very impressed w/ the staff at Updegraff.  After an initial consultation w/ Updegraff, cancelled the Tampa appt. and had laser surgery on my right eye several days later.  It was about as difficult to undergo as a tooth cleaning; maybe because they provided me a Valium.  Had perfect vision that afternoon, donned a mask and went spearfishing the next day.  At 55 y/o, I had used a contact lens in my right eye and none in my left which allowed for vision both closeup and at a distance (monovision).  Worked well w/ the contact and works even better w/ the lasik vision.  Couldn't be more pleased.

Don't eat here. Save your teeth! They don't wash their beans. I was told I was wrong there aren't rocks in the manager/owners food. I at no point asked for my money back. The female associate offered which when I was told by the manager or owner, I was lying about what I chewed on, so I just decided I don't need to deal with as a customer. I told him to keep my money it'll be the last time they ever have me or my office at their establishment again. As opposed to saying, "Sorry, our mistake how can we fix this problem?" I was treated as though my being a residual patron of this place is a nuisance. Well problem resolved. I'll go and support someone else. You don't  to tell someone to take your refund and get out. That's not appropriate. It's just plain rude. Someone needs to learn how to speak to people or your business will go the same way your attitude has - it will sour.

When you are looking for a home cooked meal, be sure to leave time and room for great food at a great price. Owner Ray prepares the food using Jersey fresh ingredients and Dietz & Watson meats and cheeses. 
This is our second visit here. We so enjoyed the food from our first visit. The breakfast and fish tacos are delicious. The stuffed french toast is artfully presented and you get to decide the sweetness by adding syrup. The Princeton salad is a very generous mix of baked ham, roasted turkey, swiss cheese, chopped eggs and tomatoes over a bed of varied lettuces. We plan to come back and try other items on the menu and support local business!
Great food. Only complaint is they don't have any child seats or boosters.  I'd highly recommend the gyro.

1) walk in. no one at counter.
2) counter help sees you, ignores you.
3) same person comes back 45 seconds later
4) no "hi" or 'hello", just that "dead fish eye look"
5) she takes order. gives change. doesn't say amount, just dumps receipt and change in hand. no "thank you. turns and walks away and starts chatting with drive thru clerk.
6) fries put on tray on counter. fries sit on tray on counter for no less than 5 minutes.
7) burgers come. placed on tray.
8) order sits on counter for another 3 minutes before being "called out"/announced.

sucks out loud. just close already. this during "lunch rush".

I stumbled on this bookstore by accident as I was walking the area while waiting for my car repair.  Bookstores are among my favorite stores to browse and Grassroots Books has it all.  New and used.  Hardbound and paperback.  A nicely organized shop with no stale smells and no cats in sight.  I love cats but my allergies do not.  I was lucky enough to be here during one of their warehouse sales and picked up an armload of books at $1 each.  Check out this place.

This place is okay, but what Starbuck's has no venti-sized straws. I literally have to go to Jamba Juice to get a fucking large straw. Just be warned, if you buy a Trenta or Venti or any large sized drink, they will leave you hanging. Better work on the customer service.

If you're a fan of that Snarf's that is by the Starbucks/Chipotle spaceship, do yourself a favor and venture a little bit further off the highway to try this place.  

I walked in and was greeted warmly.  They were patient with me being a newbie and waffling about what I wanted for lunch.  They walked me through their process to make sure my sandwich was just like I wanted it.

I had a combo with the #2 ham sandwich and the baja chicken soup.  While the food was not large, it was plenty for me.  The sandwich was tasty - this is going to sound weird but the bread I think made the sandwich.  It just had a different taste and texture that I really enjoyed.  The word "baja" must translate into "so spicy your eyes water" in Spanish:) - really couldn't eat much of the soup.  I am a big wimp though when it comes to spicy food so probably most people would like it.

I did think it a bit odd though that a place that calls itself Pickleman's did not serve me a pickle with my combo.  Still, I would return.

Had a great experience at Haverty's Furniture. After moving here to the Tampa area we had no idea where to shop for our furniture. We stumbled on Haverty's and met with a great salesperson Ray. Ray helped us along with their award winning designer Rodney. The price was right and we will go back there the next time we buy furniture.

Great sandwich shack.  Everything looks farm to table with quality gourmet ingredients, artisan breads and crafted cheeses!   It's fresh and delicious and has a cool and friendly vibe.  Check out their building wall, all made out of pennies. The portions are generous but not outrageous. I recommend.  Careful with  their homemade kettle chips. They got a bite to them ... Yum !

i love this place.  it's a happy little greek food place, with happy guys, and happy tasting lamb gyro meat.  (in a not so happy looking plaza area in mt. juliet--just ignore the surroundings).

my husband and i try to frequent this place pretty regularly, and always get the combo plates. it's a lot of food, i always have leftovers, for not a lot of money.  
get the cucumber sauce on your stuff! on everything! get a side of it to dip your fries in.  

the gyro meat is tender and moist and all around delicious and the rice is perfect. 

go here. often!

We've been to this beach a few times and it never disappoints.  The beach itself is white sand, clean and includes amenities like volleyball courts.  As a backdrop you've got the pier aside the beach and park area's in back of it for the kiddo's.  The walk way that separates the parks has seating, vendors, entertainers and plenty of room for a bike ride, walk or jog.  The immediate area also boasts quite a few restaurants, retail and bars.  So..beer and chow is close.  Be sure to catch a sunset here too.  Cheers

Best liver n onions in town  Make sure you order rare, because it cooks on your plate. 
I have searched throughout SB and this is the place   Don't wrinkle your nose, if your not fond of liver n onions, there are other great menu items to choose.

First, we love this theater!
And the intros given by a staff member are only good if they are 1) well spoken and 2) have something valuable to add re the movie.
MOST important, as we come in with our cell phones to be scanned, inform staff to STOP touching each phone! Not necessary and it spreads all sorts of nasty germs. This is cold and flu season and some are dying from the flu, which changes shape every year.
This is a simple yet critical step to take in protecting your customers and your community.
Thank you.
The wine tasting and beer selections seem​ vast and varied. If you're​​looking for good food and service, I would continue to search, both were poor.

Worth the forty mile drive for an outstanding sample of Nawlins' hospitality.  Where else can you nosh on an oyster po boy that rivals Parkway or smoked brisket as good as Tujagues.

The gumbo and red beans are a treat you won't find without a ticket to the Crescent City or in my kitchen.  What a treat, enjoy the bananas foster bread pudding on the way out.  You won't be disappointed.  Did I mention the crawfish pie?  I can't find it in Nawlins but it's great here. Tables are a treat after crowding the counter at Booths Corner.  Thank you!

Holy moly that was an amazing sandwich!!! My group is visit from Texas and we stumbled across this gem and had a great experience! The employees were very welcoming and very willing to answer all of my questions! I had the chicken and pesto panini and it was delicious. They have the bread toasted perfectly and the cheese-chicken-tomato ratio was on point. I would highly recommend this place of you are looking for unique sandwiches that hit the spot!

This is the best place to go get your hair done! They're always so nice and accommodating to YOUR needs. Everyone here does wonderful color jobs and I'm never unsatisfied. All the hair stylists are like sisters to me!!! I recommend them to 100% of people who ask me! Thi and Angel have always been such great hairdressers to me!

While I was waiting in line a lady told me that she buys one of their donuts everyday.  I thought she was a bit crazy until I sunk my teeth into one.  It was the best doughnut I've ever eaten...seriously, ever.  I can't believe it was only $.90.  The next time I go, I am definitely buying a full dozen!!

Very disappointed in this property.  Our bad for confusing it w the other location that offered free parking.  With all of the questions and contesting I was doing it seems they would have concluded that was the error and offered us the chance to relocate.  This property is quite dusty and dingy for the rate they require.  Nonsmoking room request is a joke considering the floor we were placed on had several smokers and the carpet and walls revealed smoking didn't just begin being tolerated!  The rooms are ample in size but again the dusty and dingy feel of the space did not encourage me to allow my family to lounge about.  The two stars are for the kind valet/bellmen we encountered.

From a girl from New York, this is definitely does not come close to it as far as the pizza goes. They also had a ham calzone,  I can tell you this was very very good. From the flavors of the crust and the cheeses in it. Hmm, delish. The place was packed but line went quickly.  Servings were huge proportions.  You can order pizza by the slice. The pizza we had was burned at the bottom from being reheated in the oven so that's why it gets the review. Also they have a good selection of gelato available.

Clandestine did an amazing job for a family party in NOLA this January.  Though just a guest, and not the organizer, I can say with total authority that everything ran like clockwork.  Kelley was on-site and massively attentive to every detail, but it was also clear she had spent a ton of time and effort preparing and organizing ahead of time,  She was like a duck on a pond...maybe she was paddling like hell, but it all looked smooth and calm from up above.  The party was a total smash, and everyone had a great time. 

But an important part of visiting New Orleans is getting a little help on where to go, where to stay, where to eat...and where not to.  Weeks before the event, Clandestine emailed all the guests suggestions on lodging, restaurants, music, museums, etc., so even first time visitors had the inside track on the 'best of the best.' 

Kelley recommended Hotel Mazarin for my wife and me--what a find.  It was a perfect little oasis, just a half block off Bourbon that we probably wouldn't have chosen without her prodding.   

At one point, the day got away from us (imagine that) so at 4PM on Friday we realized we'd forgotten to make dinner reservations.  I texted Kelley and within 20 minutes we had a 7:45PM reservation for 6 people at Muriel's @ Jackson Sq.  Think about that:  the height of dinner rush, on a Friday, at a popular restaurant, on the first weekend of parades, and with great weather...and she nails us a reservation in less time than it takes to smoke a cigarette.  How the hell did she do that?  Without Kelley, we might have ended up eating Lucky Dogs on the street. Not that there's anything wrong with that.  We've all been there. 

She's is a true insider who knows the city and its people.  If I were coming to town just for kicks and giggles -- or throwing a huge event for the Board of Directors, Clandestine is now on speed dial. 

Thank you Kelley!! We'll be back soon.

Been there a couple of times over the years and the one thing that has not changed is the consistently bad service from behind the bar. My last visit was ruined by the old broad behind the bar who kept asking us if we were done... If you are trying to get rid of us just say so. The attitude from the staff is just something I dont need.
So long...  too many other places selling great beers and food.

I read the reviews before I met a friend here for dinner. My expectations of the food was very low given all the reviews on Yelp. So I wasn't surprised that my "brisket" sandwich tasted like paper. I've never seen brisket sliced paper thin. OBVIOUSLY the brisket was some frozen item they heated on the grill (or microwave) and stuck on a piece of bread. I think my favorite thing about my meal was the bread.

Although the food was awful, the service was great and we enjoyed interactions with our server.

On the bright side, my dinner with tip was like $14. And that's exactly the kind of quality food you will get. 


I am disappointed because the owner also owns my favorite dive bar, Old Eagle, in Manayunk which serves amazing gourmet sandwiches at the same price. CHECK THEM OUT.

I ordered a brisket salad because I wanted something light and honestly I was more excited for my side of sweet potato fries. The brisket is great and I topped it off with the original bbq sauce. The sweet potato fries were amazing. Im pretty sure it had brown sugar. I'd say it was reasonably priced. The service was nice, it gets pretty busy there but the line moves quickly.

I docked one star because my friend and I didn't feel so great after.
Terrible customer service, goto any other branch. They are not capable of exchanging bills that came out of their own atm.

I can't always say that I am wowed by the service but usually it's alright. I can always say that I am a BIG fan of their pho, (I think it is the best in Tucson by far) and that their  fresh spring rolls, (I really like the tofu ones) are awesome!! Tai Pan's is not fancy but it's a great place to go for some excellent pho at a fabulous price!

This is a good spot for a get together... you can set up a group happy hour for 15 people or more with a reasonable cover for apps and open bar for 3 hours. I think $35 per person is pretty reasonable for something like this in Center City. 

Often you have to wait for a beer, even when they are not particularly busy. There aren't particularly good happy hour specials but the prices are okay. The food is just okay but not outstanding.

Otherwise, the place is okay for a quick drink after work. I don't go out of my way to come here.

Another staple when visiting the in-laws: close to Busch Gardens & always so tempting. I can't complain; the cheddar biscuits always do me right, despite the fact that I can never detect a hint of cheddar in them. I do, however, detect plenty of tastygreasyfat, which is what I wanted. 

The fish is never that great, but it doesn't make me sick. Everything's a bit overpriced for the quality, but you always end up taking home leftovers (see cheddar biscuits, above), which helps in the bang-for-buck department.

Service is always very good here, and they keep the cheddar biscuits coming. The place is tidy, the bathrooms are clean, and staff is attentive and prompt. Can't complain.
every beer under the sun....knowledgable bartender....professional...friendly...great atmosphere.  i will go back for sure.

Was able to call and get my battery reserved. Although it did take them a while to find it. Decent prices. great place overall. My only complaint, the older gentleman helping me wasn't wearing any deodorant, and ohhh boy could you tell. If you can put up with the smell, this place is a great place to do business.

Loved the food and the atmosphere.  Servers were great and even went out of the way to make additional recommendations for the area.  Fried chicken was great and so was BBQ sapler.  Great atmosphere.  Lots of room at the bar and live music a few nights a week after 9.  Definitely worth the visit.
Went Sunday after church and have to say the food was delicious, service was quick and attentive, and all for a great price. Will go again.

The ambience was good but I expected significantly more from the food itself. Ordered the gloc as the appetizer and the chicken enchiladas for the entree.  Nothing wrong with them but no better then on the border...

Great restaurant to eat at along with a fantastic vibe. It is right in the dead center oh Philly which, in my opinion, makes the place that much better. Very friendly staff and a porter house steak to die for. If i had the money I'd dine here every single night.

I was born in France and raised in the US and Little Gourmand is like being back in France. They have so many amazing French staples and the atmosphere is so pleasant. It's by far the most authentic French market in Nashville!

Was totally thrilled to find this place.  Price was very reasonable.  The food was fantastic.  Both my wife and I had steak.  Came out perfectly  for both of us.  Extremely tender and juicy.  The sides were the type of things usually offered as an appetizer only.  I was able to get a great tasting yam and sauteed mushrooms for my sides that came with the meal.  We each had an alcoholic drink that was not watered down.  Would and will go again.  Wow!  First time using Yelp to find a place to eat.

I really enjoy this simple vegetarian friendly place.  They could use more flavoring in their dishes, but I am a fan of a light veggie-ful dish.  I had a soup and noodle dish for under 10 bucks.  I'll be back for sure.

First, I should say that I've been going to MUD for several years, but after my last experience there, I will not be returning. I popped in one afternoon for an impromptu cut and was so sad to find out that my favourite hair dresser, Tammy, was no longer working there. She gave the BEST scalp massages, was a real professional, and I loved the way she cut my hair! So, I decided to go ahead and get my hair cut with someone else. The young woman who cut my hair was very nice and very chatty, but not only was I not offered tea, there was no scalp massage and barely even a consultation about how I would like my hair cut before she was chopping it off above the shoulder- which I did not like! Toward the end of the cut, I asked her if she was going to do my bangs (which needed serious attention) and she said she cut them already. She did not. The  whole thing was over in minutes and I found myself forking over $75  (including tip) for a hair cut I didn't like.

Well, I lived with it for a couple of days, and when I decided I hated it, and that my bangs looked no different from the first time I went in, I went in again to have them fix it. The woman at the front desk was quite snotty with me and acted as if my coming in to have a touch up was a huge inconvenience. What made things even more awkward, was that they gave me the same hairdresser again and said, "Well she messed it up, she can fix it." In the end I did get my bangs re-cut, but she did not ask me how the rest of the cut was working for me. Both times I felt rushed through and it was a far cry from the previous experiences I'd had in past years. I will never be returning!
Hands down the best pho in Delco! You can order take out with fast pick up then reheat At home, delicious every time

great baba ganoush and humus.  Tasted fresh but they don't speak enough english to confirm.  The baba ganoush had a good eggplant flavor with big pieces of eggplant but no bitterness.

Tried 3 yemeni dishes, the vegetable Saltah, the mendi chicken and the lamb  haneeth.
The lamb was most and delicious with great flavor.
the chicken had moist and dry bits and not as tasty.
the veg was curried and similar to indian.
we'd order everything but the chicken again.

service was good and wait reasonable (not more than 20 minutes).

planning to go back

I haven't been here in a couple of years and I now remember why. Aside from the quality of food being slightly above McDonald's or burger king, the store is filthy! During the 45 minutes I was here 7 tables were never bussed. The servers seemed clueless and stressed. My black beans and rice were served on a hot plate but the food was cold. Very disappointing.

Still love this place. They get the job done. Some places may spend more time on massage, etc., but the folks here do a great job for a good price. I got my first manicure this last visit and the guy was definitely a perfectionist. A couple weeks and my nails still look like new. 

No gel on pedicures, but when I got a mani-pedi with gel nails, he topped off my toes with the coating when he was done with my fingers. They've lasted through a trip to the beach in San Diego with nary a scuff.

I've brought my mom and my friend here on separate occasion and they were both pleased, though perhaps my mom is more for the finer spa experience with long massages and all the perks. As for me, I love the chance to have spiffy toes that don't fade, and on a regularity that fits within my budget.

This is a little bit nicer than some of the other taco bells I've been to. Its very clean looking and I would definitely come back. What I love about Taco Bell is that they always keep their food very fresh

I wanted to be in love with this place. A girlfriend invited me for much needed mani/pedi time and booked 6pm appointments for us both. I got there a few minutes prior to her. I was asked to sign in and select my color, standard stuff. I got walked over to the chair for my pedi. No one asked how I was, if I had been in before, my name, anything. I was seated without the massage chair being on, something I don't frequently use anyway. A lady came over and started my manicure by putting a pillow on my lap and wrapping towels everywhere. She asked if I wanted to use the Essie nail color and I said I didn't want gel or to pay any extra. I liked the color I chose. She said it would match the color, would last longer, and didn't cost any more... hmmm... more on that tale later. Then another woman started on my feet, all before my friend even arrived, I know it's a busy time but I was sort of unprepared as I had never been there and wasn't sure about their services. My friend joined me just in time to say she had previously gotten the $40 pedi. I told them I probably needed the $30 one with the callus removal but was told I would get that for free with the $40 pedi. So I selected a lotion scent (mango) and we were moving at the speed of light. The place was busy. Hard to find parking. It is an adorable, little, let me repeat, little shop. The owner, Lucy, is cuter than the law should allow any pregnant woman to be. Everyone was very stylish and professional looking (looking). I got finished about 10 minutes before my friend because they actually removed the callused, dead skin from her feet, not mine. I did get a massage and lotion but I would have rather had the dead skin sawed off as it was why I was there. My manicure cost an extra $5 because she substituted the OPI for the more expensive? Essie polish. It was extremely hurried and not all the cuticles were attended to. I may try it again when it is not immediately after work hours so it might be less busy and I can ask questions or at least tell them what I would like. It was an expensive lesson but still reasonable by spa standards.

Epice was an absolutely amazing spot for lunch this past Sunday.

I came to Nashville for a mini girl's trip Friday-Monday.  My friend and I wanted to wander up and down 12 South, but needed a bite to eat first.  The BBQ spot down the street was packed, as were a few of the more casual restaurants.  My friend's aunt highly recommended Epice, so we opted to go there instead of waiting elsewhere.

First - the atmosphere was great.  We received quick and friendly service.  And the food... OMG.  Amazing.  My friend got the open-face salmon sandwich.  The salmon was so moist-- really delicious.  I got the lamb wrapped sandwich and thought I'd died and gone to heaven.  Seriously, it was so flavorful, moist, and there was not one thing about it that I didn't like.  Came with a side salad (also good) and potatoes (had to hold myself back from scarfing them all down).  I probably could have eaten two sandwiches and still wanted more... because it was delicious, not because it wasn't hearty.  I actually only ate half the sandwich and ate the rest the next day.

We also shared the hummus, and it was delish.  Definitely go to Epice--not just to escape the crowds on 12 South, but also because it's awesome.

Visiting Tampa for a couple weeks during work trip and had a really hard time finding quality healthy food. Didn't expect too much and was very pleasantly surprised by this place. Absolutely delicious salmon, specialty rolls, fantastic service, and amazing happy hour. A must try for the pickiest of sushi lovers!

This is always out of the most common doughnuts, like the sprinkle doughnut and the glazed.  I usually avoid this one, because it's so inconvenient when you want something and they are out of it, but this morning I was not in a rush and it was early enough, so I thought I would try it.

Of course they lived up to their reputation.  At the drive thru speaker when I was finished placing my order, the man said "that it?", as if I should be ordering much more.  Then the woman at The window clarified my order by asking me if I had "the orange one", to which I replied, "no, I had a vanilla sprinkle doughnut."  Then she said "same thing".  When I got my doughnut it was upside down in the bag with about 10 napkins piled on top.  Then I asked for my receipt, since no one told me my total, and the girl at the window pulled my crumbled receipt out of the trash, handed it to me, and said "this one is yours I think"

I won't be going back.  No thanks.

I can't say that the food was bad because we never got ours. We were told--after we stopped the waitress who had not been at our table for 35 minutes--that it would be 15-20 minutes because the cook that was supposed to be there wasn't there yet. 
We left. 

There were hardly any people in there, the waitress was less than friendly, and this will be a place that I shall never attend again.

The staff are very friendly. The issue is there are spiders in the majority of rooms. I'm not one to get bit by insects but I am covered in bites after repeatedly staying here. An exterminator is desperately needed.
Love this place.  Have for over twenty years.  Never had any bad experiences.  Was there today for lunch.  Reasonable prices.  Friendly service.  Great food.

I really wanted to like this place since it is a new addition in Mt Juliet. The Buffalo Cauliflower was good. However, the fries were cold and I was charged for Ranch. Who does that? I ordered a Buffalo Chicken wrap...that came out with no buffalo sauce. Overall, the experience was lackluster.
Absolutely the best burger in town!  Tried Brew Town for the first time today and will definitely be back!!!
They let me use their tools to fix my broken rented bike so I could get back to the French Quarter safely. Thank you guys so much for being kind.

Thank you, Kim, Jim & Saturn, for taking such great care of us!! Made a reservation for a group of 8 bridesmaids and couldn't be more delighted with the service and our fine looking nails!  Had the place to ourselves and enjoyed pedis & French manicures! Highly recommend Nail Tek!!!

I love the beer selection here. There is always a good variety of styles. The prices are typical of say a center city bar, but it's located kinda far from the action to be priced in such a way. The food is consistently good and of high quality, and worth the price paid. I love the French fries with the pickle sauce!

I am not at all satisfied, from the beginning to end of my transaction, it has been nothing but a nightmare. I am currently waiting for them to either come pick up the furniture that they lied to me about when I was making the purchase or figure out the solution to the problem. I asked numerous times that the frame I was purchasing with my headboard was exactly what I wanted and to make the sale they said of course it was. Upon arrival today it is far from what I expected and wanted. Now I am playing phone tag/dealing with the worst customer service I have ever dealt with. Telling someone you will call them back in a half an hour and it now being two hours later and still not hearing anything is unbelievable!! I have called twice and whoever answers the phone tells me they will get the manager to call me and here I still sit waiting on the call 2.5 hours later. Ashley furniture, you have lost a loyal customer forever...I will never shop or waste my time dealing with you again.

Coming back again and again. Authentic Italian every bite is worth it. As a picky eater I was worried that I wouldn't like it, but after trying the first bite I was blown away. Every bite was savory and worth every penny. Definitely  bringing others to try! 5 stars easy.

I live right down the street from the home plate, i've been there maybe three or four times. I loved their breakfast. In fact I ordered a scrambler that was just one of the best breakfasts i've ever had. It was one of the specials; scrambled eggs over potatoes and sausage gravy. Pretty disappointed when I returned and was told I could not order the same thing. I didn't see why?? I'm still confused as to what the big deal was to put scrambled eggs on a plate with their potatoes and sausage gravy?? So I ordered the breakfast burrito, which was good but messy to eat and nothing compared to my scrambler. I had raved about this place to my aunt and her friend, and we all went for lunch. To our disappointment, it wasn't the best. And I had been there for lunch before that, and again my meal was very messy and the bread to my sandwich was crumbling and falling apart. I guess it's just a place for breakfast (in my opinion) but I have been thinking about going there one last time in attempt to get my scrambler. Or at least it's parts!

We had breakfast on a Sunday, the place was packed, but the staff was super attentive. There were a few people ahead of us on the wait list, yet we were seated in about 10 minutes. Our waitress was top-notch - very accommodating, courteous and always kept a sincere smile on her face. Our food was excellent, and everyone in our party of 5 was extremely pleased. Our kids ate ALL of their food with no problem, which is highly unlikely, and we think the highest compliment there can be.  This is a wonderful, medium-size, family restaurant, and I would highly recommend it.
Great jazz and atmosphere! Environment is intimate and cozy. A great fine in the mist of the craziness of Bourbon st.

French truck makes my favorite coffee in the city. I usually stop in a few times a week, but at least one of those days is an extended stay. They have free wifi, good food (I love the white bean toast), and a very friendly staff. Even at their busiest times the atmosphere is relaxed enough to get my work done and have a good meal. The service is quick, the food is tasty, and the coffee is delicious. Highly recommended.

I've eaten here a small handful of times and there's nothing spectacular about it, a little less than subpar.

I've come during lunch a few times and for dim sum once.

The lunch specials would be pretty decent if the food actually tasted good!  For about $10 you get a salad, cup of soup, rice, and your main plate.  

The mongolian chicken is bland and tastes like a can of crisco with meaty texture.  

The pulled pork plate is dominated by bamboo so really it should be called the bamboo plate with essence of pork bits.  I don't like bamboo.  I asked the waitress what was in it and she mentioned everything BUT the bamboo.  The pork is not pulled either, just thinly sliced.  It's not the end of the world but it is a deceiving description.  

The egg drop soup has tofu and tomatoes in it. I like good ol fashioned egg drop soup that just has, well, eggs in it.  The additions are hardly creative and a weak attempt to put a new spin on an old classic.  

The steamed vegetable dumplings simply don't taste good.  

The scallion pancake is dry and bland. 

The kung pao chicken and kung pao fake chicken are pretty enjoyable.  Heavy on the oil and saltiness though, so your stomach may not appreciate it.  Your mouth will, so screw you stomach!

The dim sum is decent.  Overpriced but decent and will do when you're not in the mood to drive 30 minutes or more just to satisfy your dim sum craving.  I give the dim sum alone a 3 because it is tasty enough and there is a wide array of things to choose from.  You have to order it from a menu which sort of takes away from the whole dim sum experience for me since I'm used to going to places that putt-putt little carts filled with the little steam cans the dim sum is served in.

If you are going here for your lunch break I suggest getting your check with your meal even if the place is practically empty.  Once you have your food, you're pretty much forgotten about so if you're in a hurry to get back to work, simply waiting to get your check will eat into your precious lunching minutes.

I haven't had anything here that has been vomit inducing, but none of it has been tasty either.  If you come here out of desperation for Chinese food and realize that you're there simply to fulfill the basic human need to eat, then this place is tolerable.

Im a big fan of this place. I would frequent it more often If i could know in advance the type of wait Id have.... specifically when you wanna grab a couple quick drinks before/after a show at the troc or dinner......
A girlfriend and I went before after dinner one night. We waited patiently with a crowd of 3-4 other small couples/groups. The door guy came out once and the owner twice, to either heckle, advise of the time wait or tell one couple specifically they were told to leave because there was no room for them. Basically he said if we all had a plan B- go for it because it was a long wait. We waited about 15 minutes and got it. 
SO worth the weight. The penny floor in the shoe shine lobby inspired me to make one in my kitchen. The ambiance cant be beat and the drinks are strong as hell and super creative. The wall of Whiskey... well its inviting and terrifying. 
The servers are kinda demigods.....

On a plain ol' Friday night a couple weeks ago my friend Kari had a brilliant idea to do a pub crawl to all the little dive places we drive by every day, but never go in. Trophy Room was stop #3.
