This was my first time and it was delicious!!! I had the loco polo tacos and they were flavorful and they had the just right amount of spice!!!!

First time here, ordered "seared" mahi mahi with "roasted vegetables".  Fish was not seared, not fresh and overcooked.  I would have rather eaten a McFish sandwhich.  The veggies were so overcooked they were sloppy.  I had one bite of each and then left.

Great food, great service, friendly employees and a suitable location for a bris 
Not really, but grab your honey and bringm on down your gonna wanna share cuisine like this. 
The food is outta control. Apparently "European style" but I can't confirm due to my inability to leave philly

Did not have everything my daughter was looking for but she found a few things she couldn't get antwhere else. I had a great time wandering around looking at everything and picked up some local raw honey with the comb. I have to agree tho with some that the front of the store looks like a bad neighborhood grocery and it smelled like pee but since I didn't see a restroom or pee I imagine it was some kind of dried fish or something, which I saw in the African foods and although it was packaged in plastic it was still smelly. The back warehouse area where all the food was wasn't bad. I would shope here again for hard to find items, cheap spices and cheap large packages of specialty rice etc.

The Caesar Chavez guacamole was fantastic and the shared tacos (chicken and portobello) were delicious! Quick, friendly service and dynamic environment. Will definitely come again! Also, that guava mimosa DAYUM.

The last 2 times I've rented a car at Avis - it's been horrible.
I gave  them a buy last time due to the construction. But the construction is over and they still don't seem to know what's going on. I'm a preferred member .., that doesn't mean anything . I spent over 90 minutes in line at the counter, loading and unloading my stuff into a car with a dead battery, loading and unloading my stuff into a car with no key , or at the exit where they have to process my paperwork since there was none in the car last Monday 4//7/14. My recco- if you can avoid taking your business there then you should do it

Four stars for a diner! This is the one of two diners that my family will go to. This is a large dinner, so the table turn over is fairly quick. However the weekend breakfast wait can be up to 45 minutes. I can shop and make breakfast for my entire family during that amount of time. 
I have been disappointed by many diners. Because of that I have diner order rules. For example, if the diner can't get pancakes and eggs right I don't return. We have never been disappointed with the service or menu items. I would definitely recommend this place.

This Prix fix lunch may be one of the most fabulous lunches I have had in a very long time, and for $20.12 is a STEAL. It sincerely trumps some of the set course menus at NYC restaurants. 

First off, the decor is gorgeous. Set in an old building with exposed brick and crystal chandeliers it is very elegant, while at the same time cozy. The wait staff is extremely attentive. More attentive than I'm used to, but I suppose that's a nice touch. 

My friend and I are big splitters, so we knew everything we tried would be tasted by each of us. She ordered the Pork Pate, Pork Belly, and Eclair; I went with Acorn squash soup, Panseared Sheepshead, and strawberry dessert. The savory dishes were each a standout! The Pork pate had so much flavor and paired very well with the toasted brioche and mustards. The Pork Belly was pretty much perfect. Being a pork belly virgin, I deferred to my friend for her thoughts and she said it was one of the best cooked she had ever had, with the skin being crispy and a nice layer of meat along with fat. I thought it was quite unique, particularly with the Louisiana smokey bbq flavor. Everyone MUST order the acorn squash soup. From the moment I tasted it, I referred to it as "a bowl of happiness," and my dining partner agreed. It was just so flavorful and the nuts and creme fraiche were fabulous additions. My sheepshead (white fish) was cooked quite well, but the real show stealer was the farro vegetable succotash and corn custard. The broth had so much intensity that permeated the farro and made each bite more and more delicious.  

And now, unfortunately, we come to dessert. The reason for the lack of a fifth star. The dessert was not very good...like at all. My strawberry dessert was fine and refreshing after all the heavy food, but not particularly memorable. Kind of like a deconstructed strawberry shortcake. On the other hand, the savory eclair was relatively unpalatable. My friend actually returned the dessert because it was just bad (think cheese wrapped up in semi-burnt pastry, with nothing to add any sweetness). We were once again very impressed with the wait staff though, as seeing our reactions, quickly whisked away the plate and brought out the third dessert on the list... a take on "affogato" that was actually very interesting and tasty, but after the eclair disaster, could not really salvage our opinion of the desserts. 

I do not want to end this review on a bad note, so I will say that all in all, this was a really amazing lunch that surpasses some dinners I have had in my life, I will remember for years to come. Just enjoy the savory and don't expect much from dessert.
Great food, the staff is very flexible if you want to create any combos with any of their ingredients.
Great food friendly staff... Can't say enough!!!! We had the seafood gumbo and the blackened catfish that was excellent.

Ever have entree remorse--like buyer's remorse, only irreversible, where your meal arrives in front of you and after a few bites, you turn your longing to your neighbor's plate? Last night at Teresa's, where eight of us came to catch up and eat a slow meal, my sister ordered the filet and I, feeling like seafood, ordered the artic char. With salsa verde, an heirloom tomato salad, and wild mushroom polenta, I thought my order was a sure bet, certainly more interesting than a steak-and-potatoes standard. 

When our plates arrived, I found myself confronting a hot (?) and oversalted stack of tomato wedges and a stodgy, nearly-mushroom free square of polenta; my fish, while cooked well, was half naked, and the half covered in sauce was so salty (think olives, capers, and then a hefty dredge from the salt shaker) it became difficult to eat. My sister, on the other hand, ate what appeared to be a standardly tasty meal, only letting me sneak scant bites from her filet.

This place seems to be better for Italian mainstays; at the least, stay away from the char. A bored waitress but otherwise-good food, as my dinner-mates sampled everything from the pizza to the chicken to the pasta with clams.

Yes, Dr. Cole, whom I refer to as MY periodontist, is friendly, large and perhaps somewhat loud, but that is what I really liked about him.  He is just down to earth, and fun, but above all else he is extremely caring,  knowledgeable and is up on the latest greatest such as stem cell growth.  During my procedure of gum surgery and the pulling of a wisdom tooth, Dr. Cole and his staff definatly set me at ease.  On Friday Dr. Cole called 3 phone numbers and finally reached me just to insure I was doing well before the long week-end. (YOU GOTTA LOVE EM) I just love this guy.  The staff are very friendly and competent. I highly recommend Dr. Cole

Matt and Linh were at this corner Vietnamese Restaurant for lunch. This place is located across the street from the Silver Legacy, but not on the busy strip of South Virginia Ave. It is a Great location for people who doesn't want food from the restaurants in the Hotel/Casino.

She has been here numerous times and ordered the #5, which is the Seafood Noodle Soup. Her $6.00 soup was one of her favorite soup. Matt ordered the XL Beef Noodle soup. Since this is the only Vietnamese restaurant within the radius of the neighborhood, the Beef Noodle soup was $7.50. 

Normally dealers or casino workers don't date with strangers, but she trusted Matt, when he told her his profession from Matt's hometown. We've chated extensively and saying that she wants to find someone for a second marriage, but Matt told her the bad news, that he is happily married. She was hurt from the news, but complimented Matt that he's lucky and a great guy. She said sadly, "I wish I can find a great man just like you."

Matt replied, "There will a man for you, don't give up!"

Her lunch was only an hour, so she went back to work, and Matt went back to sportsbook to continue to watch the NCAA Basketball Tournament.

Great experience last night with my family. We came here during RW since it's $35/person. If you want more meat and dessert it's $50/person.

Our favorite part of Chima is the salad bar lol. It's so fresh and has a variety of almost everything you want in a salad bar. The meats are delicious as well. It's so juicy and flavorful. You get to pick from various kinds of quality cuts of meat like beef, pork, chicken and sometimes exotic meats. You pick the from medium raw to well done depending on how you like your meat to be cooked. 

Will be back again in the near future. Chima is great for date night, large parties, family dinners and more. I wouldn't recommend bringing young children since servers are walking around with a knife and skewers of meat.

Food was pretty good and pretty cheap considering what you get. There are many many better places to eat in New Orleans but this place is alright if you're around. I had the breakfast sandwich, which was probably worth it's 3 dollar price tag. Nothing special though.

The manager is an absolute jerk!!!  I go to other Dunkin' Donuts and get a vanilla chai with almond milk with no problem. This moron says he can't make it. I have to us either regular or skim milk. One of the employees stated she has made it with almond milk before, but he's the manager and she has to do what he tells her. I will be contacting Dunkin' Donuts regarding a manager who does not understand what false advertisement is!  You cannot advertise that you use a product but not state only certain beverages can be purchased with that product!!

I can tell you one thing about this place they have the best chicken shawarma in NOLA, I tried so many places no one does it like them thier chicken shawarma is full of flavor, Me and my whole family love's this place we always order on the phone and our order always ready when we get there.
Love the choco-chia cupcakes and the Carrot Bomb! Can't wait to try the rest. Finally a restaurant that is truly healthy, organic, gluten free, not processed, and gourmet tasty!

Finally a clean place in New Orleans!  This place has everything!  No need to roam streets.  Excellent place for kids with play area and small tables for lunch.  The only place I would go to again in Nola.  Excellent food choices in food court.  Great shops!  I would get there right when it opens at 10am when things are clean and no crowds!

Went on Wednesday for buffet. Long wait but overall a decent experience. The food was good but the service wasn't that great. I always had to call the person for Naan (Indian Bread). Tandoori chicken or drumstick was cooked well with proper spice level. It was better than the rest of the Indian restaurant. For desert, I will give may be 3.5 stars
The food here is exquisite. The garlic knots we're the best I've ever had. It was somewhat busy for a Saturday night and thus the service was quite slow. However the bartender was also kind of rude.

The food was nothing special. Not truly authentic Thai flavors. I ordered their "P C U" noddles that's lacked in flavor and texture. The noodles where broken up and not long and beautiful as they should be. I also got their Panang Curry. That was delicious but extremely sweet for a curry. They also forgot to include the basil and no care was taken into cutting up the tofu into smaller pieces. I literally got a giant block of tufu creased but not fully cut through. Overall, this place lacks attention to detail and balance of flavor in their food.
Hands down the best authentic wood fired pizza within at least 50 miles. Great deal on the larger take out pies too

Bennett Compost is a great business and I have been so happy with them. They pick up compost in a bucket the same evenings we put out our trash, so it's easy to remember. They are very accommodating as well, and have picked up extra bags of compost (i.e. leaves, remnants of container gardening, etc) at no extra cost a few times as well. They even offer free compost to their customers in the spring/summer, which is great if you have space to garden. They are reasonable and I filled up my bucket every week with no problem (think coffee grinds, fruit peels, veggie stalks, etc)--so glad these products were composted and not hauled to a landfill. I highly recommend them, especially to the first-time composter since Tim, the owner, is very helpful with any questions you may have and very accessible.

I went here with my wife and kids and had a great meal.  I ordered the shrimp and grits.  The shrimp were really tender and the grits were creamy and delicious.  My wife ordered the jambalaya which she said was really good.  Kids meals are standard and fine for the kiddies.  We all shared an order of beignet and they came hot and crisp on the outside fluffy and hot on the inside.  Service was friendly and quick. We had a nice meal, great beer menu.
If you live in Boise and you know the nearest In and Out is in Reno, Nv. If you are looking to skip the six hour drive, look no further... This place is as close as it gets. Delicious!

Don't waste your time.

We had lunch there for the second time in the past two months and each time the experience is worse and worse. On our first visit we waited a good fifteen minutes before anyone bothered to stop and take our drink order, despite the fact that multiple servers made eye contact with us and walked directly past our table. 

Today we were promptly greeted and our drink order was taken, but then after waiting twenty minutes for a piña colada and a rum runner our server stopped by to let is know it would be a little while longer since our ticket had "somehow not printed". That would be a reasonable excuse if we hadn't watched his other tables receive their cocktails in a timely manner. I can't believe that somehow only our drink order didn't print out, but everyone else's did. To his credit he did seem to be the only person taking care of their entire outside patio for the first hour we were there. He was clearly overwhelmed and there was no one else from the establishment helping him out. 

When we finally received our lunch after a 45 minute wait time and no stops to see if we'd like a water refill or another cocktail, we were sorely disappointed to find our medium rare burgers came out well done. By that point we were too hungry from waiting to bother with trying to flag down our weeded server.

Both times I was there I never once saw a manager or anyone who looked like they cared about the guests experience. As a manager of a well known restaurant in the heart of St. Pete I am constantly getting asked to recommend other local restaurants and the Hurricane will now be one I advise people to stay away from. Their only saving grace is the benefit of free parking with purchase. Go to the Brass Monkey instead, they have much better service and food.

THIS COMPANY IS NOW TOWING AMERICA! My review from Towing america:
ZERO STARS! THEY ARE THE ABSOLUTE WORST! RUDE & UNPROFESSIONAL! My car had dirt all over the interior and the entire inside after they had towed it. It was just cleaned and it looked like a pig went thru mud on the entire interior of my car. DO NOT USE THEM!

We have been here several times over the past couple of years. It was really good when we first started going. It has really gone downhill and changed a lot over the last 6 months to a year. Last night we went again and I am sad to say it will probably be a long time before we go back if at all. There was a huge party seated in the restaurant but they had plenty of waitstaff so I don't know what the problem was. However, their service has always been a crap shoot so this wasn't surprising. The staff is mostly unfriendly and does not check back to see if you need anything like drink refills or napkins. They are also very bad about bringing menus back so you can reorder. Many times there is a long wait between orders and items are forgotten off of your order. We had to go up and ask for the little "cups" that you put soy sauce/wasabi in and to get more  menus. The sushi has been subpar lately too.  Too bad, because even though the place wasn't much to look at, the sushi was always good.

This family owned and run Restaurant has friendly service and authentic non-commercialized Greek Food. My family and I would frequent it often when we lived in the area and everything was always fresh and on point.

ROACHES!!!! Staying here for ONE night and found THREE roaches in the last hour I've been here. They already took the money out of the account and said they couldn't give it back until management takes it up for consideration 2 Days from now. I'll be out of town by then!! They offered a new room but couldn't guarantee it wouldn't have bugs too and said "well ma'am, it is Louisiana" - as if that's a reason to have ROACHES in a hotel room. One bug? Whatever.. but three? And looking at the reviews this isn't the first time this has happened.

Can I give this place zero stars? I just returned with my nova special bagel ordered specifically without egg with egg on it. I watched the young lady at the counter write down my order without egg on the slip. I also ordered an iced coffee, total came to $10.80. 

As I was waiting, close to about 20/25 minutes, I observed numerous people after me, get their bagels, observed 3 gentlemen in the kitchen standing around doing nothing, and sipped on my extremely watered down iced coffee. 

Normally, I get that a place like this is busy on a Saturday brunch time. However, when I notice orders just being slopped up on the line in no particular order, I get upset. I know how a kitchen runs, I know in what order orders get taken. Twenty minutes for a bagel is insane. 

Fast forward to me now, my bagel with egg on it, no nova salmon spread, 3 measly slices of onion and a horrible looking tomato, I have a $8 bagel I can't eat. Thanks Spread, I'll never be back, and I'm starving.

My girlfriend and I just finished eating here. The service was very good. The spring role appetizer was served in a neat spam box and was terrific. The reason the review was 3 stars was that the entries were awful. My girlfriend got the chicken adobo. The coconut rice/ banana rice was delicious but was overpowered by a very salty and bland brown sauce that ruined the dish.

I got the Pancit Malabon. It was $20 and it sucked. One of the priciest things in the menu and it was small, very very salty with two small shrimp, a small peace of overlooked fish and rubbery calamari (must have been frozen recently). Overall it was fine and maybe I just ordered poorly but the Pancit was terrible. 3 stars and would not go back, other than to maybe get the coconut rice to go.

Clearwater Beach is one of the Best on the Gulf of Mexico! The weather has a way of making the experience amazing amazing and there's so many ongoing construction projects. Clearwater Beach brings so many tourist and vacationers to the area to enjoy fishing and the beach. I actually visited several of the restaurants along the beach and the strip in Clearwater Beach. Staff has the area clean and free of trash which was impressive. There's something for everyone here from fishing, boating, eating, bar hoping, shopping and sightseeing. To explain the difference in the texture of sand wouldn't give it justice. There's a huge difference in the sand along the Gulf Beaches as to sand in Ocean City, Md., Va. Beach, and Myrtle Beach, SC. Some of the best places to park are actually the parking in the smaller motels who offer rates that beat the community parking. Consider securing a room if you are planning a ALL day affair in Clearwater Beach. The drive back toward Tampa can sometime be brutal after enjoying cocktails or the sun has taken it's toll on you. The people are from all over the world and you will meet some great people during your stay. I encourage you to visit more than once as you will fall in love with the Gulf Beaches!
Certainly divey but there are better ones not that far away.  The TV game is pretty good and the prices are amazingly cheap.  Almost every beer in the place is priced between 2 and 4 dollars...
Nice ambience and service. However their pad thai and soup are too salty. Lay off on the salt please!!
We came here on a rainy weeknight so it was perfect for a  quiet, romantic dinner. Excellent service and food. Easy to get takeout beer at nearby Oneals as this was BYO. We will definitely be back!

Always love this place. Had to come back for their fried chicken and papaya salad. And also to try a few other stuff on their menu. 

Spring roll- really, it's called an eggroll. It was mediocre. Try nice and probably won't order again.

Mees- Korean noodles.... Uh..... Uh.... Yeah won't do that again. Had 2 bites and it was just strange. Kinda had a rotten taste to it. And it was grainy. My sister didn't like it either. We literally left the whole bowl there when we left.

Fried chicken & papaya salad- always always always great! My favorite dish there!

It's a hit and miss kind of deal with their menu. You love some you dislike some. 

But service is always great! Friend girl there!!

My friend and I ended up at Fine Palate thanks to a brunch event another friend was hosting there. The interior is trendy and well-decorated, but laid back enough that you could pretty much wear whatever you want and still feel comfortable here. The seats are really comfy (we sat downstairs - I'm not sure what the upstairs seating is like). It's a definite upgrade from the restaurant that was previously here. And for the event, they had a DJ and projected the Eagles game onto the wall - huge plus.

As far as food options, my friend is vegan and I'm vegetarian. The restaurant was offering a modified brunch menu (due to the event, I presume), but we were both able to find something to match our diets. My friend also asked to adjust her meal slightly and it was no problem. After brunch and mimosas, we ordered a few glasses of wine. Their wine list is pretty decent. I didn't try their cocktails, but from the descriptions on the menu, they sounded delicious and worth trying next time.

The staff is extremely friendly. Service did get a tad slow at times, but the place was completely packed, so it was understandable. Even so, our food arrived on time and the server continually checked on us for the entire four hours we spent there. I'll definitely be back.
Luz is the truth!!!!! My hair always comes out beautiful and it lasts for a good three weeks- hence I have natural hair.

Poorest  service  i ever had anywhere. 14 mins for waiter another 17 mins for our drinks. 19:39 for our food to come out. Completely lost my appetite for this place.  Heard such great things about this place. The food was good.  The service well that was something to be left to the imagination.

You know, being from California, this place is 10X better than the DMV's there. They are fast and efficient. Even the majority of the staff there don't seem like they want to kill themselves because they hate their job. SOME of them even have a sense of humor. I'm amazed.

Lots of parking in the attached parking lot.

First of all, the beignets are like pillows of heaven.  Really, really amazing.  I'm glad I don't live in New Orleans because I would eat these every day.  They have good coffee and the sandwiches are good (not amazing).  They do have mini bottles of champagne which was a highlight of my morning (another reason to not live in NOLA).

The octopus starter is a must. It wasn't on the menu but as a verbal special. Never have I had octopus so tender before. My group had a variety of pasta dishes and they were all very nice, not heavy at all. The pesto was so fresh! And the bread was perfect (I'm a sucker for great bread). FYI this place is byob and cash only.

I stayed here for two nights on a Business trip. The staff was extremely friendly the rooms were clean and very nice. The noise level was at a minimum. The amenities were top-notch. I was very impressed. The location right next to I 55 made it a breeze getting to my meeting in the other areas in St. Louis

Daily breakfast was hot and flavorful. The breakfast area was clean well-kept with fresh food. Every night they had milk and cookies which was the cherry on top of this wonderful stay.

So disappointed! Gummy waffles that were 1/2 cooked. Tasteless omelets. They tried to make our first order better (raw onions in the omelet and a cold waffle) and  was what we got was even more disappointing. A tasteless ricotta and feta(?) cheese over cooked omelette with strips of sun-dried tomatoes floating in the white mess oozing out and a hot waffle that was crispy only on one side... the back was undercooked and gummy. No coffee refills without an additional charge too.

Stopped in for a Cupcake and Coffee, wound up takin a half dozen cupcakes home!!  This place has a great atmosphere for a quick snack and, based on the displays and pictures, they do some amazing cakes for weddings, events, parities, etc.  Staff is smiling, friendly, and helpful.  Cupcakes have some interesting flavors that are worth taking home.  Great place!!!

BEST breakfast place I've EVER been to!!!! Me and my boyfriend always go eat breakfast at different spots, and this by far has been the most amazing and pleasing diner I've ever been to. I was expecting the food to be just like any other breakfast I've ever been to, it was super fresh, non-greasy and every single bite was amazing. My boyfriend can't stop saying how BOMB it was and that he cannot wait til we are back here. PLEASE TRY IT! We live 30 mins away and look forward to driving back here again.

Hard wax is the best thing ever. I never knew! It hurts less and seems a lot more thorough (which is good for the Brazilians). Also, my skin doesn't seem to be ripped off using the hard wax, and that is also a plus.

I know I shouldn't be spending so much on getting my Brazilians being a broke student, but I'm addicted, and my boyfriend is too, so I'm sticking with em. The cool thing is that if you go and make your next appointment when you're leaving, they'll knock $10 off your next Brazilian. Deal!

And, yeah, the rooms are small and not exactly zen-inducing, but the procedure is quick, and I'm so happy with the result that I don't mind.

If I was only critiquing the bar itself, they'd get 5 stars. It looks beautiful and modern. Food wise, it's a whole other story. I was here for an event and I ordered fries and a friend ordered pretzel bites. His looked amazing while I got a huge pile of overcooked fries.

Their website also claims that if you park in the garage behind the hotel, they validate your parking and give you a discounted rate. However, one waitress told me she could do it and then disappeared, the bartender told me the front desk could do it, and the front desk told me the event host (already long gone) had to do it. So beware if you happen to be driving; apparently no one wants to make sure you save money in the garage after patronizing their business.

Is it okay to write a review for a croissant?  Well my wife really wanted one and this was the first place she spotted so we went in.

There are many tasty-looking pastries to choose from here.  The decor was... interesting.  Like a tea house.  A little over the top but it matches the food offerings so it works.

We asked them to toast the croissant and they kindly obliged.  It was delicious!
poor hair cut from this young man, needs more training

Loved Square Peg!!   I'll be dreaming about those fried chicken tacos ...and  the mac/n/cheese grilled cheese sandwich was so yummy!  The food is reasonably priced and there is a good selection of beer on tap.   A great place to eat dinner prior to a play at Lantern or Walnut St Theaters.  Recommend!!!

Meh. Good but not worth the 1-1/2 hr wait. Grilled Caesar salad wasn't very grilled and waaay too much anchovies (and I like the little guys). Beef ragu not as tender as expected based on the reviews. No offers of cheese or EVOO. Pumpkin fettuccine good, as was veal. Service good. Overall, 7.75/10.

this is our second time here and we still love it! it's definitely a locals' joint, very farm/country-ish since it's in the middle of Berlin. the service was definitely better the first visit then the second visit. but, this is once of those places were the food is more important then the service. we got a double order of chicken bites, 10 famous wings, 10 honey jerk wings, and krickle cut fries. you get so much food! the chicken bites were covered in their famous wing sauce and they were delicious, you get so many bites for $13! i really loved the honey jerk sauce more then their famous sauce. the boyfriend loved both equally. you get more then 10 wings in each older. definitely worth the money. it was under $8 for each order of 10 wings. we've never tried anything else on the menu because the wings are just so good. on Wednesdays & Thursdays, they have all you can eat wings for $8. cannot wait to go back!

Visiting Philly for the A-10 baseball tournament....found this amazing restaurant with the help of Yelp.  Everyone in our party loved their meal! My husband said he would come back to this area just to go to Spasso!

I bought a skirt steak and it immediately began smelling up my refrigerator the next day (I planned on cooking it that night). I opened the package and sliced into the meat, and it looked like marbled mold on the inside. I will never shop here again.

I love spread! It's one of my favorite places in the city. All of their bagel sandwiches (I've had each at least once) is delicious. I only had issue with the lox, it's layered pretty thick to the point that I had to pull some out. But that's hardly a thing to complain about. 

The service and experience is always exceptional and the seating options are great. On clear days you can sit outside in the sidewalk, but inside there is also seating in the front or a quieter more private area in the back.
The best Mexican food in town...bar none!  I eat there all the time. Weekend brunch is nothing short of phenomenal every time and the salsa bar never disappoints.

I have eaten here twice now. I ate here for dinner once, and ate here for brunch today. The first time I had the french burger and it was nothing special. Had I rated the place on this alone, I would have probably given it a two or three star rating. However, the meal that I had today was the Brie and Pear French Toast ($11). It was amazing and probably the best tasting French toast I have ever had. Even the syrup was special and I was dipping my knife in it and licking it off. Quite the sight, I assure you. They could have made this a lot better if they doubled the size of the serving, however, because I was still a little hungry afterwards. 
Also, last time I was here I had sweet potato french fries and they were great. Unfortunately, some clown decided to take them off the menu, but the bar tender mentioned that if enough people request them, they will probably bring them back.

The interior is pretty nice and it is connected to a nice hotel lobby.

There is FREE WIFI here.

Food Quality/Taste = 3/4 Stars
Portion Size Given Price = 2.5 Stars
Price = 3 Stars
Service = 3 Stars
Experience with Staff = 4 Stars
Decor = 4 Stars

Love love love this little shop!
Used a coupon my friend Pauline gave me to get 3 Bundtlets for the price of one! 
All the workers are super nice as well! 

CAKES:
I ordered the Marble, Red Velvet, White White Chocolate, Chocolate Chocolate Chip, and Mocha!
They were all really good, moist and delicious!

*hint* they have a free sampling right near the entrance, make sure to try some!

Overall: A
I love the taste of the cakes, and they also work great for gifts! Make sure to stop by and try some delicious bundt cakes!

Let me start by saying this has nothing to do with the wait staff, they were excellent. I sat down to have an awesome lunch with the wife and watch the Pack game. 

We were quickly seated then ordered food. So as a precursor I have Reactive Respiratory disorder. Which is a fancy term for asthma like symptoms brought on by smoke and other chemicals. So shorty after sitting down I started to feel my chest tighten and told the Wife we need to bail fast. I think this was brought on by the open fire that they use to cook some of their food. Now let me same I'm not blaming them for that, or the attack. 

We quickly told the hostess to please cancel our orders and we had to leave because of my breathing. She said she was sorry then we left. Then as we were getting in our car she came out to ask us if we wanted our food to go because it was already ready. The Wife went in to grab it while I used my inhaler. She mentioned that the manager was upset that we ordered and weren't paying. 

Personally if I was running the place I'd have just let it go. Regardless the Wife paid, and tipped our server (none of this were her doing we think she should still get tipped) then they said the food needed a few more minutes. The Wife watched as one of the cooks slowly (like a snail she said) started to assemble our food. After a few minutes she said this is crazy my husband is having an asthma attack I'm not waiting and left. I had such high hopes for this place and the food looked great. I'm not blaming them I couldn't breath just how they dealt with things.

A really nice old re-use of what appears to have been a bank in a past life, for a gallery space.  I was here last night for the Hidden City Unsilent Night which began and ended here.  Unlike a lot of galleries, this one is truly spacious and can accommodate a big crowd without squoosing folks into each other.  There are also a lot of levels, different sized interior walls, and the like to set off different sizes, shapes and pieces of art.   My only issue (save for the awful Christmas carol music that was playing in the background immediately when the Unsilent Night performance piece ended, which to be honest I don't know if someone in Trust or the crowd was playing it ) is that the bathrooms seem to be tiny.  I was in the womens and it was clean and cute, but was one stall, one sink, one person.  If I had a big crowd in for an opening, all drinking and chatting, I'd think the lines might get a bit long and oppressive.  So, pee before you attend.  Other than that, lovely.

Flying Saucer St. Louis Edition provides another outstanding option for the craft beer connoisseur. I was particularly impressed with the service given this was the first opening weekend and FS-StL was slammed with the MO Valley Basketball Tournament peeps in town. (I didn't get food but my friends did, and the food came out promptly - in line with this positive review.) I particularly enjoyed the "flights" of beer offered...St. Louis, Around the World, e.g.  Keep in mind that while I do like beers with body, flavor and other attributes more than what a Bud Select or Bud Light has to offer (as either of those are my "go to" beer beverages on a night out with friends) I don't normally do a sampling of beers.  But for an excellent "Craft Beer" venue that's an up n coming chain planting a flag in St. Louis, check out the Flying Saucer in St. Louis.

My favorite Pho place in Reno!.  Service is friendly and quick.  Food is always excellent.  Why Pho anywhere else?

Start yourself off with an order of spring rolls or a bbq'd beef/pork vietnamese sandwiches.

soups: 12, 23 and 25

cold noodles: 50

finish the meal with an iced coffee.

Okay, I love Ruby Tuesday's food. But the service at this location sucks.

Not only that, but when we ask the server about the problem, we were given the "what do you want me to do?" act. 

I've been here at about a total of 6 times. 4 times, it was just sad.

I also don't understand why the bartender can make drinks, and in order to put the lime in the drinks, he has to dip his whole fingers in there. It really bothered me. 

I love the salad bar and chicken quesadillas here. I wish there was another location close by. I cannot stand the service at this location!

This McDonald's, at Midway Plaza, is only a few miles up the road from McDonald's in Prices Corner. Yet, all the breakfast items here are more expensive. Even the sweet tea is $1.19 instead of $1. I can see no reason why this is so. In fact, it is the most expensive McDonald's in all of New Castle County.

Pricing aside, I thought service was okay. The cashier actually miskeyed the item I ordered but it was in my favor. The food was delivered reasonably quickly and the place seems overall well-maintained. Parking could be a bit of a problem. Once the row of parking spaces around the restaurant fills up, you'll have to park somewhere in the strip mall area.

Unfortunately, I probably won't return due to pricing alone. Everything else is pretty much the same at all other McDonald's locations in the county, so if there's another one along the way, I'd favor that one instead.
Great service.  I liked tuna bowl. Lots of tuna, though the rice didn't taste like authentic Japanese rice.  Busy on the weekends, but a good Tuesday night choice.

Nice atmosphere, super friendly staff awesome menu.  
The owner walks the place greeting everyone. Her signature line "Thanks for not cooking".

2.5 stars

Came here to grab a lemonade but got charged prices saved for fresh squeezed uber rare, single-origin samphire juice from the Devon coast. The lemonade itself was fine but awfully normal for the price tag. 

If you're an all organic, gluten-free flexitarian then you should definitely come here. If you're a regular person, take an extra turn around Reading Terminal to find a Snapple.

i like getting the soups and sandwiches at panera bread, but its a hit or miss here. depending on who makes the food, sometimes it turns out delicious, some days the sandwiches are extra dry and lack flavor. they need to get it together

Two lovers emerge from underneath a blanket of mist in the Saint Petersburg sky. Their long awaited reunion had served them well. She was famished. 

"Ciros," she whispered, as a clap of thunder punctuated her request.
 
In a flash, a black sedan whisked them across the causeway into the city. The destination easily found via GPS, leaves the entrance tucked away, unbeknownst to the rest of the world. A door - a password - and they were taken back to the days of Prohibition.  A copper lined ceiling crowned the bar. Curtained rooms, veil privacy for whatever your heart desires. Tonight it was tequila for the lady and cognac for the gentleman, perfected by way of The Bonita and The Vieux Carre.


Only Ciros can take uneventful appetizers and transform them into a tasty sensation. If only movie venues served popcorn graced with truffle oil, patrons would frequent more often. Fries, prepare in duck fat, are elevated to a new level.  Each dish is just enough to whet the palate before entrees. The couple fed each other Charred Octopus and Grilled Wagyu Steak prepared to perfection. Tender, flavorful, each bite, a sexy Tango on the taste buds. 

"More," she whispered.

Throw caution to the wind and name your favorite spirit. The bartender will create a cocktail for your pleasure. For him, a Hemmingway Daiquiri. Who knew Ernest was a diabetic. For her, The Sorrealist. No desert is needed to finish the evening.

In the wee hours of the morning, a sedan whisks two lovers away through the empty streets of Tampa.

Ciros, a gastronomic memory.

3.7. Great Pina Colada. A perfect mojito - my favorite drink. Fantastic tacos/fusion taco and we're NOT in California! A locals joint! A loooong wait, think about when you go. VEGAN & Vegeterian yummy options. Might be spicy for some. Hard on my in-laws as is all of New Orleans because they can't do peppers and the holy trinity.

It was so busy but our waitress was awesome!!  Great drinks and food!
Super long lines to get the membership card. We will have to wait til the next visit to hit balls. Really had a great time!!

I absolutely love this place and am so glad it opened in University City. Bobby Flay has long been a well-known chef famous for his delicious southwestern grilling techniques and style. I don't think that this restaurant puts his name to shame at all. It's a fun place that is easy to order from and serves up delicious food. Order your food, get a number, find a seat. The burgers are served medium/medium-rare unless otherwise noted by the customer. They come out perfectly juicy and absolutely tasty. Even more fabulous are the milkshakes (Bobby's even serves up spiked alcoholic ones)!

On a downside, the menu is a little pricey and you have to pay for fries/onion rings separate from the burger. And the milkshakes are $5 and are somewhat on the smaller side (but it's okay, because they really fill you up). Additionally, they should have put in more seating, but the shortage is due to its popularity. Opening week was rough because there was always a very long line. However, now I never have to wait more than a few minutes.

I'm all about good food - this place is worth it.

[Also while the survey says beer & wine only, there's only one choice from each, both being BBP selected wine. Bobby also serves up a really good-looking margarita.]

The parking is atrocious, the rolls are way overpriced, the fish isn't the freshest and the rice is under-cooked (aka hard). Also, the avocado was WAY too soft and was browning in some spots. There is much better sushi to be had in this city, for nearly half the price. I could also do without the "air of superiority" that the wait-staff exuded during my entire dining experience. (Seriously - you serve fancified fish to people, you're not Ghandi. Chill.)

The ONLY plus - the Purple Haze sake had a great price-tag AND it was tasty as hell.

Regardless, I would just skip this place. I don't intend to ever return, even IF Groupon does their deal, again. Not worth it!

Price breakdown: four rolls (three "regular priced" and one fancy overpriced), vegetable tempura and a regular sake for $53 pre-tip. Ouch.

Parking sucks if it's a nice day. Take MetroLink if you can. It's well known that entrance to the zoo is free. There is plenty to see. The puffin house and the ape exhibit are great.  There are food and concession areas but prces are steep.  You're better off packing a lunch and eating in Frest Park

I went for the last penguin parade. The birds were adorable, but there were only a few that were sent out... I think 10 or so in total. One tip if you go to this event next year... as with any parade with animals in it, there is a trail of excrement. Watch your step as you leave!
Went to the phoenixville location so many times without writing a review!!! But!!! This company has the best soft serve ice cream ever!!!!! Ever!!! If you haven't tried it, go now!!!!

In Tampa for the night to board our cruise in the morning. Hotel shuttle driver recommended this steak house. I've heard of the 'rodizio' format and we were starving. The hostess was very helpful and explained everything for us. The food was amazing!! Their salad/hot bar had a nice selection of items, without being over whelming. The servers were prompt and very friendly with requests and serving new items. Highly recommend this place.

Being out of town and having vehicle issues is always a nightmare - especially when you have a diesel, requiring a little extra care and tech knowledge. 

My TStat had been acting up and causing my truck to overheat in idle/below 10mph forcing me to pull over every few minutes to let the engine cool down.

I limped into Big 3 at 3:30 pm fully aware that I was most likely not going to be able to get my truck in and out by close.

I do all my research on my trucks so I have a pretty solid idea of what is causing the issues I am having when they arise. 

Spoke with Joe and told him the situation I was in and what I believed the issue to be. He was able to get one of his techs to install a new tstat and get the coolant drained in an hour and a half, getting me out the door with a perfectly running truck by 4:45. 

Thanks so much Joe and I'm extremely thankful for the quick, on point service!

This bar reminds me of the bars where I went to college: small, smokey, lots of character, and no college students. You can fish for porn, stuffed animals, and sex toys in their claw machine. Bar service was quick even on a Friday night. There was a cover band (they were fine), and between sets the crowd packed onto the small dance floor to do the Wobble. I adore the "alone games" even if I'm with someone, and I like that theirs is at the corner of the bar instead of up against the wall. One of the first sentences I heard when I came in was "Yes, I am a card carrying member of the NRA!" followed by a hearty handshake. All the NRA members seemed friendly enough. I'd say over 50% of the clientele was wearing camo or something sports-related. There was a guy...the overweight version of Mr Clean...who stared at me in the creepiest way. Usually if you're staring at someone, and they look up at you, you stop, right? Not this guy. We're talking MINUTES. Gross. So don't go here alone if you're a girl. This place is a genuine dive though, definitely. I'm going to go eat their food sometime. It's ridiculously cheap, and I love bar cheeseburgers.
How can you screw up breakfast? Then staff had a yelling match complete with profanity

Love this place! Very clean office, super friendly and helpful staff. Cynthia is the sweetest and helped me out a lot with scheduling and financing. Dr Singer is such an amazing doctor and I'm so happy to have found her. She made me feel so comfortable since day 1. Thank you to everyone who helped me along the way! I highly recommend

Decent but overpriced dim sum. But it is the only place in this area for dim sum. I have gone to this place for years for the food and have tolerated the bad, bad service. However, this last time I went in for dim sum, two of the dishes were undercooked (the shrimp was partially raw) - when I showed the server, she argued with me that it was properly cooked. At first, the manager told me I had to pay for the raw dishes, but she quickly removed the items from my check when she saw that I took pictures of the raw food being served. Forgiving if the staff had been nicer about it, but I definitely suggest that you be very careful, especially if you bring small children to this place.

Summertime is here!!!! Thank you, Thank you, Thank you Cheshire for making my first summer back in MO one to look forward too! This has become my favorite new place to sip and sun poolside....along with my girlfriend and friends. The poolside service is extremely attentive, my drinks never run dry and thankfully, neither do I!!!! I was thankful to find a pool in STL that offered bar service and the best surprise was no day pass fee!!! I would recommend it to anyone but I fear once the secret's out, it will get too crowded;)

Pipers was unexpected and would be very difficult to categorize. It looks like a local family-style restaurant that is way too classy on the inside for families to actually patronize... Or maybe it's an affordable fine dining restaurant cleverly disguised in the restaurant-chain-infested landscape of Indianapolis' southside. I've been there, and I'm still not sure. I've passed this place, literally dozens of times, and if not for an event here, I would have never considered stopping-in based on the unremarkable and commercialized exterior of the building.

The Mahi Mahi Tacos  were delicious!! (Full Disclosure: I've rarely met a taco I couldn't love).  The Wedge Salad, Ahi Tuna, and Shrimp Scampi were all definitively A-OK. (Thus, the three star rating). I liked the idea of the small plates. The food options were eclectic and came out of the kitchen looking fancy.

Apparently, the tea cup bread is pretty good... Sadly, I just watched others enjoy it while I made longing eyes at them. There were however a variety of dishes that could be made Gluten Free (even though they did not have a GF menu; the server was willing to check into it with the kitchen). Unfortunately, there were no Gluten Free dessert options.  :(

I'm in love with the fish tank! Especially, since it seemed to have live coral, a variety of Red Sea saltwater fish, and of course, Dory.

Urban Chestnut is a relatively new brewing company that emerged in the past two years and quickly moved to the head of the class when it comes to the St. Louis craft brewing scene.

Their original location in the Midtown area was too small for them in their explosive growth so they moved into an old paper warehouse on Manchester right in the central corridor (props to them for staying inside the 270 loop! Always love businesses that don't propagate urban sprawl. Plus the Grove is just a fun place to be, and fits with the mood/atmosphere they're creating.

I don't claim to be a beer connoisseur, so I really can't speak to the quality. But the rapid growth of their production has to mean their doing something right. I recently went on a tour of their facility and they have capacity to more than triple their production, so like a smart business, they're planning for the future.

I tend to stick to lighter (dare I say safer) beers, so when I go to UCBC, I get the schnickelfritz. This beer is fairly benign but I get full off a pint, so I'm not sure I'd call it "light." I love how UCBC separates their beers into Old World (Reverence) and New World (Revolution series) - shows me they actually put some thought into their menu, and the names of the beers reflect that. Also, whenever I've talked to the bartenders, they can always recommend something, and will offer heavy tastes of whatever you like. Kudos - keep it up, UCBC.

Great restaurant from a chain. The Bobby Rahal Ribeye is yummy.
Wood fired ovens and a nice selection of wines.
The only local sushi restaurant in the bay area that has the freshest fish consistently.   Everyone completely friendly this is the place to come for sushi!  Amazing......

The ambiance of The Schnitzel House is like if your grandma's living room somehow ended up in the middle of a diner. I kind of liked this feeling (home-y, familiar), but it also confused me.

Now for the reason you're reading this review: the food was very on point. Authentic. On point. Sauce yes.

Service was excellent. Very informed servers who were thoughtful and attentive.

Usually our meals are very good but last time we went (Sunday), food was a little skimpy. Only one very thin tomato for my sandwich and a shaving of a pickle. Wings and calamari were very good as was the service. Just disappointed with the dressings.
Everything is made fresh from the bread to the main entree to the dessert, every bite was delicious and the service was great.  Loved it!

I frequent others Paneras, particularly the one in Drexel hill which is beyond impeccable!  I am so disgusted with this location.  My sandwich came directly on the dirty tray with no napkin/barrier between in.  Very unsanitary!  Salad only had literally a drop of dressing.  Nothing like eating dry kale.  On a good note, the cashier was very friendly.

Meh. It's a cemetery with the graves above ground. Not trying to sound disrespectful but it was nothing special. Worth checking out, but I don't get how anyone could be here more than 10 minutes. At least it's free.
Great Italian place that isn't too pricey. The shrimp scampi I had was deliciously spiced! I would definitely come back here on a date or with friends!

Stumbled across this while going to Jimmy Buffet's Margaritaville. By first glance, it looks to be just a sundae shop. We decided to have dinner here, and it was quite tasty. I tried the chicken breast on foccia and potato soup. Sandwich was good and had nice flavor from the horseradish sauce.  I topped it all off with a smore's sundae. It was good, but big! I could not finish it all. Interior is cute and plays 20's music.  It also has a violano-virtuoso at each table so for just 25 cents you can enjoy self playing violin and piano music.

I have tried Campo 4 times and each time is consistently inconsistent.  Servers/bartenders are still running around like it's their "soft open" in total chaos. I had the burger the first time and it was pretty tasty/salty but tasty however the rest of the food is bland and lacking any kind of seasoning.  When asked if I could have malt vinegar for the fish and chips since it was tasteless and ketchup for the fries, I was told no, "the chef won't serve it".  The  "ketchup" served is some very sweet tomato sauce, a mere tablespoon full. Another time, ordered the pizza with sausage.  Pizza/more like flatbread had a smear of a mushroom sauce on it, no sausage.  Then a bowl of sausage was served...then an entire pizze with sausage was served and immediately sent back by the bartender all in a 20 minute time period.  Risotto with scallops topped with lemon sauce next time...very bland and no lemony taste to it.  I asked for lemon wedges and the manager asked how my meal was.  Told him it was bland and need lemon and salt.  Next and final visit was the cioppino.  Goopy pasta with 3 shrimp and 2 mussels served with little or no sauce.  I asked for more sauce, bartender in her condescending tone said, "extra sauce is $4".   On my prior visits with the dismal food, the manager either comped or took half off of my check at his discretion for I never requested any compensation.  The cioppino visit the bartender, again in her condescending tone, said, "well, don't we always comp your food?"  That so pissed me off...how dare her?  And what is up with giving  your tab in those books?   I left to never return again!

The brunch was delicious.  The macaroni au gratin, French onion soup, and the Bercy Omelette were excellent.  The atmosphere is wonderful Julian , our server, was very nice. The hostess was very friendly. We felt very welcomed.

Awesome time whenever we go for lunch. From the nacho and guacamole to the chicken sandwich and burritos, everything is delicious. The photo booth is a nice feature so don't hesitate to have some fun with it.
Fun place to go for jazz music!!! A bit loud at the place,I think they should close the doors at the time of the show!! But overall great night fun show!!

Overpriced by at least 40%. However, portions are huge in all fairness. But why in God's name would I pay $18 for 5 slices of lox, even if the lox was of high quality?

Nice restaurant ambience, clean, with lots of seating, convenient long restaurant open hours.  Service adequate.

I really enjoyed Freebirds, it seemed a lot like chipotle but with a few more options. The great thing about this one is there are tons of college kids walking in there like the living dead zombie style filled with booze and drugs looking for a late night snack. It really does make for some entertainment while you eat. If you're really lucky you'll see a fight, although most of the time it posturing more than anything, dudes talking shit making sure their friends are holding them back. I saw this first hand which was quite funny. One white kid was claiming Crenshaw Mafia, which I found quite hilarious. Anyway, if you go to Freebirds at the right time you're basically get a full dinner theater experience for under 10$.

I didn't know how bad my previous stylist cut my hair until the owner, Claudia pointed it out. The contrast of the layers was horrible! She fixed it up and also gave me tons of helpful tips on how to care for my hair type. The rest of the staff were also very helpful and professional. Would definitely come again.

We went there for dinner on Saturday night.  When I walked in, I liked the ambiance.  It was warm, casual and inviting.  My husband, son and I all ordered the Spencer steak dinner.  The dinner comes with soup, salad, bread, veggie, and a choice of mashed potato, baked potato, rice pilaf, or spaghetti.  When we saw that, we decided not to order appetizers, and it was a right decision.  The portion was just right to satisfy the big eaters like my husband and my son.  The steak was cooked to the perfection and seasoned just right.  $26.95 for the complete dinner with 14 oz spencer steak was a great deal.  We discussed if the steak was better than the ones at Ruth's Chris or Morton's.  For the price we paid and the quality of steak, I would choose this restaurant in a heart beat.  The final tab was only $185 with five of us who all ordered steak dinner and cocktails.  We brought in a bottle of red wine and the corkage fee was $15.  I like nice fancy steak restaurants too for special occasions.  But if I lived in the area, I would come here regularly to enjoy the complete steak meal.

I'm on the hunt for my new go to place for nails,  my lady sold her shop.I went to her for 5 years. I was right next door at America's Best for a follow up appointment for my son.  Well, this place caught my eye so I decided to walk in....WOW! Glamorous atmosphere, fit for every woman.  Men pay attention! If your girl, wifey, shorty, your mama, or anyone special in your life you have to treat them to services at J'adore! What better way to show them that you appreciate them. Also,  this place has a private room for bridal parties, girls day, private parties, its absolutely stunning in here! The staff is professional, kind, and so welcoming! My nail tech was Wen and I will be back! I just found my new spot!  You will not be disappointed, also all their first time clients got a great surprise. Whatever I spent today,  they have me the same amount back in a gift card! Who does that!?  What a great way to gain return consumers.  Thank you so much!  Keep up the great work! LOVE THIS PLACE!

Doughboys has arrived in Sparks! Went this morning and got a half dozen for $6.25. I recommend the Orange Glazed but you cannot go wrong with anything in this place. Best donuts, soft and moist yet fluffy! Th Dolance was
Packed but they moved through the line fast.
Unique, friendly little sushi spot. Don't let the location fool you and try the Donburri!! You wont be disappointed

Seriously consider before bringing your animal here for any surgery. Not only were we grossly misquoted for all of her consults (3) leading to the surgery, once the surgery was done and we PAID we were notified SIX MONTHS later that some of our info had "fallen through the cracks" and we actually owed them an addition $1,300 on top of the thousands of dollars we had already spent. 

Mind you we had been in several times between the surgery and this confrontation and there was no mention, and the balance always came up as $0 when we checked out. When have attempted to contact their financial department to discuss this charge because we believe it is an error. Not only has VSEC not returned our calls, they sent the charge to a credit collector and now I have a permanent mark on my credit score for a charge that is fairly disputable based on the fact that it was brought up after being told that we had a zero balance.

The receptionists always order the wrong medication for my dog, and after my dog had surgery she had dark markings on her that were concerning me. I was told to send pics to their office and a vet would get back to me. They never did. Take your pet to Penn. Its such a shame. Dr. Spiegel is an AMAZING dermatologist and we will miss him!

I find the meat to be tough, but flavorful, the sausages spicy, but fatty (great as the meat for a stew or sauce), and the mild smoked veals to be particularly handy to have around.  So nice to have such friendly people in the neighborhood, and he can cut you up what you want.

I came in with my family from NJ on 10/16 for my Nieces Weddings the next day. I took a shot in the dark to see if I could get my hair done up. Not only did they get me in the day of my Nieces Wedding Day but they also got my three daughters in also. My girls were delighted with their hair & my hair was amazing. Thank You so much.
I brought some frames in to have mirrors put behind them and they did a great job. Jason was super nice and super helpful and got the job done.

One word to describe: Outstanding! Front desk set the tone, very polite, greeted with a smile. Service from Susan and the other staff members during dinner was exceptional. Hummus plate was top notch. Dining area for breakfast was organized neat and clean. Greeter was helping in explaining the point system to me. Server was fast and friendly. Room had a great view from the 13th floor. Perfect room for my stay.Lastly, modern, clean, and spacious gym was pleasureful. 
#hiltonRocks #FiveStars

The best plumbing company in NV hands down!!

I had some issues with a filtration unit as well as leak issues that the former owner of our house left for us. So on a Sunday evening I had pipes rattling and leaks and I needed to get someone out here so I called Precision Plumbing. 

With in a few minutes Bill came out to my house and assessed all problems and got things under control. He gave me the list of issues and said for me to call the office in the morning and they would be able to take care of me. 

So the next morning I called in and they sent out Mike Connors. 

Mike was fantastic!!!

It's so refreshing when you call a company and they send out a (professional)

Mike toured through my house and assessed all things wrong and gave me options. After a plan was put together Mike went to work and began fixing said problems and was done before you even know it. 

On a side note Mike was also from CA as I just moved up here myself so we compared notes about CA and NV and he told how awesome NV has been to him. 

(I agree I love NV great place to live)

Precision Plumbing has all my future work as well as my bathroom remodel / Upgrade in the spring of this new year. 

I will also be giving my family in town there information for future work. 

Thanks again folks at Precision Plumbing!!!
Delicious burgers and great owners very friendly and great prices. Bang for your buck all around!!!!

I was only recently exposed to this restaurant by some of my friends who live in the area.  I can say that it is one of the best casual restaurants in the South Tampa area that isn't affiliated with a chain.  They have Trivia Tuesdays, which my friends and I like to frequent on occasion and it has also become a staple for brunch for our group.  Everything I have tried off the menu is great and the wait staff is always pleasant and cheery.

Great food. Had the fish tacos. Amazing all the way around. The atmosphere was great. Had a wonderful waitress. Aldo enjoyed our sushi and grilled artichokes (cooked on an open wood grill) appetizers. Great drink selection. You can spend as little as $15 or as much as $50 a plate. Worth the visit!

Today was my younger sisters graduation party. Paid for a hundreds of dollars bottle "service" yes we got the one bottle that would normally be about 15 bucks at s liquor store store, which is completely ok if you actually get the "SERVICE" part. The employees were incredibly unhelpful and acted like we were normal guest while standing in our "VIP" section. Lol now about the "VIP Section" which I guess used to be the smoking. Area constantly has smoker trying to argue their way into the section to smoke a cig lol. Not to even mention the fact the the "VIP" section only consists of patio furniture.  to say the least this is the worst excuse of "VIP" bottle "Service"  I have ever wasted my money on. I strongly recommend looking else were for your celebrations like crown room across ball park village. I repeat PATIO FURNITURE! On top of all that the only time they came to check on us was to ask if we wanted to spend a few more hundred for another bottle lol we all know how the question got answered.

Love Crabby Bills. They have good food and it's always a party.  

The Bloody Mary was great as well!

Avoid this place!
Waited over half an hour to seat 7 on a Sunday morning. Receptionist had a "so what" attitude. We tried twice to get seated, watching 8 groups after us get seated before us.  Receptionist turned and laughed with one of the waitresses because they could see we were getting annoyed. Spoke to the manager and the precise words out of his mouth were "Uh, OK."
Food is pretty crummy, even for a buffet.

I really like this place. Everyone is always friendly. On my last visit, we got a personal escort to show us where the bathroom was which I thought was adorable. I love the buffalo shrimp because it's not too much buffalo sauce and smartly uses blue cheese crumbles. It makes a better combination with the buffalo sauce rather than what I'm normally used to with blue cheese dressing & buffalo sauce on chicken wings. I've also had the pork tenderloins/butternut squash ravioli: the meat is the right degree of tender and the ravioli provides a good balance.

This place is fantastic!!!  We enjoy the facility and staff!  But the icing on the cake are the gym dogs!!  They make the gym unique and my kids LOVE when they are around.  All in all, fun place to visit over and over again.  Keeps everyone active and happy:).
Great. Order to work all the time, they always ge the order right, comes very quick and delicious! thank you!

Do not go here! Wanted a french mani/pedi and it took this girl an hour and a half and my mani was so bad that another girl had to fix it. Turns out she was just licensed Jan. 14, 2019! They have no heat lights to dry your nails, only a little fan. Most places I've been to do your mani first, not them! It's worth the extra $10 to go somewhere else!! NEVER AGAIN!!!

Went in to buy a car, found a sweet deal on a BMW, and then encountered road block after road block when trying to finance said car. The kids at the dealership rattled off my man's credit score (including intimate details) right in front of me, which was unprofessional and highly unusual. It embarrassed him and made me feel awkward. We switched salespeople and Saul (sp?) was much better, but at this point we are buying our car elsewhere. Not impressed.

A great place. They have 'White' pizza. 
Great breakfast offers. 1/2 lb. burgers. Extensive menu offerings. 
Outdoor / gazebo area for smokers.
Parking is tight.

I was just walking around and Denise's Painting caught my eyes. I think the way she uses colors and the loud color backgrounds she uses is very good on my eyes. I am not a Big Art Person, however, her paintings made me question my life. It awakened a color in my soul to be honest. The staff here is amazing. They allowed me to walk around and they explained the artist and allowed me to look at her other pieces. It was very refreshing. I almost bought a painting.....

Whenever I'm in Wayne, I stop at Elegance Cafe.  They have a terrific assortment of breakfast and lunch items, baked goods, and first-rate freshly-brewed coffee.  I've never been disappointed with any of their offerings.  In addition, the staff are always friendly and helpful, and will answer any questions you might have about their food.  This place is a gem!

I went to see Dr Hyten this morning to get a tooth surgically removed. This was my first time ever being sedated for any medical procedure. He was very thorough when explaining all my options and his whole staff made me feel very comfortable. Wonderful experience!!

An update to my previous review. Pizza and sandwiches are good here but do NOT order seafood. My wife ordered scallops which I could smell before they got to the table and was very ill for 2 days after. A restaurant like this should only serve the freshest good but that wasn't the case
I don't even like cupcakes but their chocolate bliss was amazing. It melts in your mouth.

I've been consistently going here to see BEBE, she listens to what I want and is very thorough and consistent  (and that never happens) some nail techs I've had in the past do great the first time then not so much for the follow up appointments. Very happy here!

I have to say I was wary coming here, I have bad luck with neighborhood type family restaurants in that the food is usually pretty bad. Walking in Erio's looks like any other family italian joint but I was willing to give it a fair shake. I must admit I was surprised at quality of the pizza, it was very good. Nothing special here, just tasty family style pizza that is quite satisfying.

Everything seemed very nice, I went with some people that have been regulars for years so I assume the food is reliably good.

A 4 in Philly but a 3 for just about everywhere else. Superior international selection for the average grocery store, and while the Fresh Grocer at 40th has recently tidied up a bit, the few items I've selectively compared (mostly canned goods) are cheaper at Supreme. I also find the produce section to be slightly better stocked at Supreme, YMMV.

We found this spot during our vacation in New Orleans. We stopped by because they were hosting the premiere of game of thrones season and we were really impressed. Cool drink selection and the food was philly themed. We're from Philadelphia and the food was pretty spot of for not being a philly restaurant. I had the cheesesteak with wiz and my boyfriend had the Cuban. There were also a few different screens to watch the show on which was awesome. The owners stopped and spoke with us, and after teaching us how to properly eat a crawfish, they sent us home with a container of them! Highly recommend if you're in the area and want to stop by a chill laid back bar.

The hotel looked very new.  The staff was extremely helpful.  I loved how good the breakfast was for a budget hotel!  Breakfast sandwiches you could microwave, Belgian waffle maker with buckwheat, good coffee.  I was very happy about the value for the price.

The hotel is about 25 minutes from downtown so you can save quite a bit of money if you're willing to drive/Uber into the city.

We went in for a drink and to play games. Beer selection was "okay" but I enjoyed my pineapple cider which was local. I gave it one less star bc the it seemed kind of grungy and the bathrooms were kind of gross. The idea of the old school games were def cool. I would go for a beer again but not to eat.
not happy went out looking like the same style I had going in , the stylist did not listen or even look at the pictures I had

WOW. Popped in here last night for some after dinner drinks after finding them on Yelp. I've been away from the area for a little while so had no idea about this place but they opened pretty recentyl. Great drinks and spirits, something for everyone (gin,vodka, whiskey etc - if you give whiskey go with the Aged). Bartenders were very friendly and hospitable and made excellent drinks, and the place had a nice chill vibe. Prices were also pretty reasonable for cocktails especially quality hand crafted cocktails.  I will definitely be back next time I'm in the area.   Best of luck to this new and great addition to the area. If you like a good drink check them out!

Cheese burger is awsome. It is good location and clean! 
Next time I want to try different burger. Drink is slightly expensive.

A truly classic diner breakfast. I've come here for a few years for their $4.99 breakfast special available until 9am. It's up to $5.75 but still worth it. Two eggs how you like them, four triangle pieces of toast (white, brown or rye), your choice of meat (bacon, ham or sausage) and some of the best hashbrowns around. Deep fried real potatoes with fried onion. They are amazing. At this price I would rather come here than go to any of the other chain breakfast restaurants. 

The location still has work to do to get a higher rating. It is a little rough around the edges, both in appearance and service. Worth checking out all the same.

Absolutely wonderful! The breakfast is soooo good. The French toast and pancakes incredible, eggs cooked perfectly, sausage is really nice. The service is very friendly and it has a nice atmosphere. Highly recommend.

very polite m sweet staff...always helpful...tons of comics to go through and in amazing shape...lots of collectible figures....my favorite comic book store ever...if u havent been GO!!!!  u will not be disappointed

This is the kind of place where literally everyone knows your name or at least tries to. I went there on an offer from my future father in law and was not disappointed. If this place tried to be anything other than a neighborhood bar, then it would fail, but tucked away in the quiet streets of St. Charles, this place has found a home.

When we walked in there was nobody else there but you wouldn't know it. Greeted and introduced and had our drinks before I even got warm from the walk. I'm a stranger there but the talk quickly turned to regulars and what they had been up to lately. We weren't doing food so the very modestly priced drinks shook off the cold and made for a great, albeit short visit.

I can't say that this is gonna be a regular stop for me because I'm coming from the city, but I know that if I'm ever in the mood for a good drink and good company when I'm in St. Charles then I'll just head to the Pine Room.

We eat at In-N- out quite a bit in Oro Valley the employees are never in a bad mood that I have ever seen always trying to be helpful like take care of your garbage and just stopping by to chat with you. The only gripe about the place is it is so cold when you sit in the center booths the AC blows right down on you and your food have to hurry and eat if you don't like cold food

My husband and I went to Just Salad after work the other day, University City location. As I walked into this bright, clean restaurant I was warmly greeted by the young lady behind the counter. Jerome helped me put together my salad. He was so helpful, patient and pleasant. Glad we stopped in, I will be back for lunch. Just Salad! Great experience!!!

I came to this place the very first day it opened. I was excited about the potential to have some really great food! Unfortunately, I think the price is high for basically a small chicken thigh and a lot of rice and hot potato salad. I generally don't pay almost 8 dollars for a couple hunks of rice. If there were two chicken thighs it might be a different consideration.   Will not go again.

Great breakfast spot. 
Tried corned beef hash it was great
Crapes were very good also
Fresh orange juice

Fear the beaver! Tahoe prices in a Reno bar and grill! $31.00 for one burger and two iced teas (I can't imagine how astronomical it would have been if we were drinking)!!! The staff is nice and very accommodating and the decor is very nice but, we won't be back or telling our out of town friends to venture there!

I'm gonna be SO BRAVE and go against the Yelp grain on this one... 

This is a hipster's dream; it's a bit off the beaten path, it's tiny, ethnically authentic, overpriced, and best of all has no advertising (not even a sign out front). It looks like somebody's house.
That's right, there's no signage whatsoever; just a pretentious little red paper lantern. It's like their whole business model is based on daring you to show off what a cool foodie insider you are by simply knowing that they exist. 

Even forgiving that, there is honestly nothing special going on inside the joint. The food is decent but the portion sizes aren't worth the cost and the service was inattentive at best. It's a dive bar with overpriced Japanese, nothing more or less.

UPDATE: For laughs, see Alphonzo's "compliment" on my page regarding his opinion of this review. If anything, he has entirely validated everything I said about what's wrong with this place.

Had a tire blow out on 38th ave, made an emergency pit stop here. The tire was off the rim. Two workers came out, I thought to offer help or just to see if all was ok. Nope. He simply pointed to our OBVIOUSLY immobile car and said. "You need to move that.. it'll cause an accident. I've seen some crazy shit" and walked away. I spent the next 20 minutes w/ my wife and daughter changing the tire as the staff gawked from the showroom, while texting. No customers... just rude, lazy employees. I'll be sure to pass this knowledge around to a few million people on my social networks. Nice job guys!
I love this gym! It's so affordable, has free childcare, great fitness classes with awesome instructors and is always nice and clean. I tell all my friends to join Eagle Fitness in Reno!

I am a Wine Thief.

No I do not steal wine, that just means I am  a member of the Kalyra wine club. Have been for more than five years. 

Kalyra make yummy wines. All of them the whites the reds the dessert wines. They are all great.  We use to get strickly red but recently switched to a red and white shipment. If they had a red and dessert combo I would be a happy boy.

We usually go to this tasting room as it is closer to us. The servers are always nice and we get the Cheers treatment as they know my wife and me.

Do you like wine? Are you in Santa Barbara? Then get your keaster over to the Kalyra tasting room.

Awesome dog park. Easy parking. Fun people. Open yet shaded. May get a little muddy after rain and it's a little inconvenient to cross the street coming from centennial park parthenon area but minor detail.

I met up with a friend to try this place which is also called Taquiera El Gordo. I am glad I put the address in my GPS because I never would have been able to find it based solely on the name because it's located on Rock where the old green Landrums Cafe sign is. 
Once you get inside its set up like a 1950's ice cream parlor. There is no table seating just a counter with about 20 or so seats. The sun shines right in and it was a little warmer in there then I would have preferred because you are quite close to the griddle. 
The food though was worth the warm atmosphere. I ordered the fitness enchilada with red sauce. It came with a side Refried beans and spanish rice. There was a man there raving about the potatoes so I asked if they could reduce my beans and rice so I could try the potatoes. They obliged and did not charge extra. The enchilada was hearty with mushrooms, cheese, and a few other veggies that I don't remember now. The spanish rice was not too spicy. The Refried beans were good with cheddar melted on them. The potatoes were country style with green and red bell pepper and onion cooked to perfect crispness. This place is great for a lunch with a friend or two. I felt immediately welcomed and the family of employees were attentive in making sure my water stayed full. I recommend this place to anyone that is looking for affordable good mexican cuisine.

First time. Got the chicken thigh/chorizo tacos... full of flavor.  My colleague got the corned beef and eggs and said it was the best he's had.  Since it was our first time our waitress brought us a plate sized pancake with streusel topping amazing.  Will come back the next time I'm in Tucson.

I contacted Brandon while he was still working in California about saving a 1965 CB77 Super Hawk. I had researched a couple other shops to take on the project.
