I knew very little about vintage Japanese motorcycles. I got the bike for next to nothing, he informed me that the super hawk was worth salvaging. He told me, up front what he thought it would cost while explaining that once he got into the bike the price could change. We sent the bike to CA. The shop Brandon worked in was well reviewed and as such  very busy. I wasn't too worried about turn around time as we had other two wheeled vehicles to enjoy. Brandon got on the inspection and told me what was going to need work and I got it in writing as well. We got timely updates and pictures, some good, sometimes the pics were disappointing. He did his utmost best to save us money when he could without compromising the quality of his work. We got the bike back late Dec. of 2015 Brandon brought it to our home. We're looking forward to putting some miles on it this spring the bike starts immediately and idles great, were currently working on cosmetics. I would recommend  Brandon and his company Rawhide for vintage Honda service, repair or if needed, full  restoration. He cares about the details and functionality.
Menus were disgusting and dirty had left over smelly food stuck to them . Decent prices and happy hour . Great Shepard's pie.

Very nice restaurant, the ambiance was pleasant and the service was great. We chose to order only from the appetizer menu and it was an excellent choice. Here's what we got:
- panzanella salad (tasty but heavy on the dressing)
- louisiana shrimp and crispy grit cakes (the sauce was the best part)
- jambalaya risotto (highly recommend!!)
- crawfish gratin (good overall)
There were just two of us and this amount of food ended up being too much but it was all really good. We'd come back again!
It's amazing how fast they are. We order from here a lot when we can't decide what to eat. Can't date it higher.
So happy to have found Leah and Trina. Great pedicure, convenient location, super friendly - you've gotta give them a try!
This place is GREAT!!!  Daily specials, super-friendly staff, AMAZING wings.  LOVE IT!!

I lost my sushi-virginity here, and never regretted it a second after! This place is one that I wish could be franchised in more cities than just St. Louis. I was a student in the area, and after moving I still have random cravings for sushi from here. I still haven't found anything quite like it, though.

Of all the thing's I've tried and remember, I loved the TIGER ROLL.... and pretty much any other roll I've ever tried. 

My favorite drink: MR. MIYAGI. I love that they have drinks big enough for you to share with a group of friends. This place is one of my favorites in St. Louis, and I truly miss it dearly. If you love Sushi, you'll love Drunken fish and the drank they offer, too. :)

This place is probably the best philly cheese steak place I've had in years! Yummy!! I always get the cheesesteak with mushrooms, bell peppers, and HOT peppers.  It's to die for! They only accept cash but it's well worth it.

This Restaurant was a big disappointment on many levels. My mother used to be from this area and she highly recommended it. 
We had an inept waiter with no personality who kept making mistakes and we ordered premium drinks but received inferior well drinks. We were charged for premium drinks. The food was so so so I gave it 2 stars. I do not recommend Rexy's.
Great food! Great staff! Our server looks like Justin Long. His real name is Mike! Super nice guy with great service! We'll be back!

Had a bad experience going through drive through after work, called and spoke with the store manager Jessica. She was VERY understanding and nice. I will definitely return because of our phone call. Thank you Jessica!
The hot chicken was so juicy and flavorful! I got the Nashville hot but it wasn't that spicy, I probably could have gone up a notch. Would definitely eat here again!

I really can not say enough about how great our driver, Corey B. was. He was SO great that I reactivated my Yelp account just so I can leave this review. 

I was planning a surprise engagement for my now fiance that ended with a driver driving us 3 hours to the beach. I was a little nervous about riding 3 hours with a driver I did not know but Corey could NOT have been better. 

Corey waited and watched around the corner as I popped the question. As soon as he saw everything go down - he perfectly timed pulling the car around, opening the doors and handing us champagne. He was as professional as could be the entire ride and treated us like royalty on this special day. I can not imagine it being any better of a ride and we were so lucky to have Corey as our driver. 

The booking process was very easy and Chandra that helped me out was also great! 

I could not recommend Limo Livery more and would request working with Chandra and Corey!

Come during busy time and order carefully. You should already have eaten being you're in a foodie town. If you are stupid enough to pass on the terminal market or Koreatown and all the great local places, bakery just down the street, and you end up here to judge Philly food by, you're just stupid. If you get tanked and need to fill your soggy belly, come up here, have your last two beers, and hang out with a great bartender and food to fill your void. You did that, you missed everything and chose hotel food, dummy.

Called tonight because service is out again, it rained 12 hours ago. 
Technical services said there was nothing to do but schedule a service call, since they can't make it work when it's cloudy. 
Amazingly they tried to upsell me into buying device protection for my cell phones and tablets. They can't make their basic service work and they're trying to get me to give them more money for additional services?
Fuck you AT&T you assholes! Handle your business before you upsell, you douchebags. I wouldn't trust you with a wet fart let alone my cellphone. 
Cut the cord!!!

Waited at the counter for 5 minutes with my mom to order. Was ignored by 3-4 employees running around frantically and desperate to avoid eye contact. All we wanted was a pastry from the counter and a lemonade but I guess they were too busy to man the counter or even say "be right with you". Finally we left and said thanks on our way out to which they said thank you back- knowing full well they didn't serve us, which is pretty shady. We went next door to Starbucks and were greeted and served immediately by pleasant employees.

One of my favorite places in Nashville.  Very nice inside and the food was absolutely amazing!   Try the Mac n Cheese.  You'll thank me later!

The rooftop deck was a fantastic place to enjoy happy hour while listening to some great music. I would absolutely go here again.

I recently held a bridal shower for my daughter here and was extremely disappointed in the service. Two servers were assigned to our party of 28, but after initially checking in with us they were nowhere to be found. I had to go searching for them to take drink orders (practically no one was served drinks throughout the whole event), take the entree orders, cut the cake ... I was searching for them the entire time! The entrees took an hour to be served. When I went to pay the bill (which included a 20% gratuity), I expressed my displeasure to the receptionist/manager, who explained that the restaurant was busier than expected and my servers were needed to serve other tables in addition to my party. I waited a few days before calling to speak with the banquet manager who I had made the arrangements with. When I called she explained that she had been standing at the counter when I was checking out and heard my complaints. I can't believe that she didn't step in at the time or reach out to me afterwards!  Anyway, no offer of a discount on the gratuity, no offer of a gift card, nothing. I do not fault the servers (in fact I gave them an extra gratuity because they were so nice before the shower started). They should never have been assigned to so many other tables that they could not take care of our party.  

I would not recommend this restaurant.  Management leaves a bit to be desired.

My wife and I just went here 20 minutes ago. Even after making a reservation, we stood and waited inside the entrance for several minutes without anyone even acknowledging our presence or arrival. One waitress even walked right past us with menus for a nearby table, again without a word or glance at us. No problem. We left and went to Bouchon nearby, a much classier place where we were greeted immediately.

Martin's Bar-B-Que Joint delivers the best BBQ in Nashville. In town for a vacation with my family, we did extensive research on where to find the best BBQ. The answer was Martin's. After a short wait in line we placed our order at the counter. Menus were handed out while in line by a gentleman who laid out the ordering process and rules about ordering alcohol. (Only bartenders could take drink orders not food runners). He also gave suggestions on his favorite menu items. After ordering and paying we were given a "GPS" device so food runners could find us at our table in this two story establishment. We found our way upstairs to the beer garden where there was live music, plenty of large tables and two more bars. There was also ping pong, shuffle board and some other games to enjoy. Our food arrived pretty quickly for a place that probably had at least 200 diners in it. We all agreed everything was delicious. We ordered a full rack of baby back ribs, brisket, whole hog pork, and 12 wings with two different sauces. Sides were ho cakes, fries, and baked beans. The brisket was the best I've ever had in a restaurant. The ribs and whole hog pork were delicious. Even the sides scored high marks with all of us. We all even commented on how good the fries were!! Glad we made Martin's a stop on our trip to Nashville. You will too.

Advertised as a jazz brunch... arrived after making a reservation and they only had outdoor seating with NO music... why would I make a reservation to sit outside in the cold without any music?? They told us that we could wait for first available for inside seating which was another 30-45 minutes,,, bad planning on their part to not accommodate those who made reservations in advance

He didn't show up.
I'd booked him over a week in advance. I texted to confirm at 915 pm the night before that he'd be there for my 430 am pick up. He confirmed. 
He did not show up. He didn't answer his phone or return texts. 
I had to drive myself to the airport for a 3 week international trip and I almost missed my flight. He refused to reimburse me for the parking charges I incurred that were his fault. He called me later that day to tell me that he'd lost his phone the evening before at a restaurant (mind you, he was texting me at 915 pm) and that he had also broken down on the side of the road en route to me. 
You're significantly better off with Bats or with ExecuCar.

The famous corner bar lives up to their reputation. It isn't the fanciest place by a far shot, but the place is great. The people that are there are your typical blue collar people just eating good food and drinking a few coldies. The food is very good and they have lots of choices to wash it down also. 
Give this place a try... you won't regret it.

I've only been to this location once although others that I know have been  quite impressed (which is why I came). I had a positive experience - the restaurant was clean, the staff was friendly, and the food was good. On the day that I was there, there was a couple that was clearly having a hard time and I was extremely impressed with the young lady at the counter - she didn't judge them in any way and treated them with complete respect. THAT was so awesome and made me so happy!
The location and guacamole are superb!  I've also enjoyed excellent seafood here and look forward to going back ASAP!  This is my go-to for a relaxing evening and meal at CW beach.

I used to come here when it was the Crabby Bills. When we went, the remodel looked amazing! We sat on the third deck and had the most amazing views. Our waitress was Taylor and she was amazing! My best friend and I split the crab cake and Mahi tacos, and had the Crab Trap Bucket to split. This was one of the best restaurant experiences I've had in a while:)

Just went here for Sunday lunch. That food is good but a bit salty. Sat at the bar the bartender is not to friendly unless she knows you! Most of the draft list are IPA beers which is great if you want a lot if alcohol! I don't! Then they ran out of Stella! Probably won't be back!

Location is great and the staff is welcoming and friendly. Unfortunately, the food was not good.

I've had Johnny Rockets before and like it but I would not eat at this one again. I ordered the spicy Houston double patty, diet coke, fries and onion rings. My burger was not delicious but it was warm-ish and tasted like it was safe to eat. The fries on the other hand were stale and the onion rings were odd, it had a rubbery texture.

The diet coke didn't taste good either. When I drink soda I prefer it to be bubbly. The diet coke was not completely flat but also not quite carbonated. 

Fast food is supposed to taste amazing, or at least delicious enough to make eating an unhealthy meal worth it.

All in all, I couldn't finish my meal.

On my way home from a long fishing trip, I stumbled across this place. What else more comforting than a hefty plate of BBQ!!!

At first glance of the menu I couldn't help but notice the unique side items. In my head, I thought that this is a bonus finding a place with these unique sides that set themselves apart from the traditional and sometimes overlooked side items. On second glance of the place and menu I then note that they didn't come off that they used a specific BBQ technique meaning southern, Memphis, Kansas City, Carolina etc... Also, I didn't even get a smoky note emanating from this place. Maybe the smoker was on wayyy early in the morning.

My go to item when trying a new BBQ restaurant would be a pulled pork sandwich.  They offer it traditional and Carolina styled meaning coleslaw on top. Sandwich alone was about $8 which is on the pricier end for me when it comes to a pulled pork sandwich. To make it a meal I ordered 2 sides including the truffled mac n cheese and baked beans and which topped off my meal at a little over $13. Not to put a price on quality food but this is about the most I've spent on a pulled pork lunch in the Bay Area. 

I couldn't wait, this bad boy wasn't going to last long and I was not about to let transport mess up the integrity of my meal. They have pick nick tables beside the building, so off I went with my container.

The breakdown: they offer their sauces on the side which include Carolina which was liquid in consistency and Kansas City which was thicker and tangy. I grabbed both since I like my pulled pork oozing with sauce yet the the pork done perfectly to absorb the sauce like a sponge and not have too much sauce dripping out. Visually looking at the sandwich I could not appreciate a smoke technique to this pork. And the cole slaw on top seemed inadequately dressed. On first bite, confirmed lack of a smokey note to pork and no flavor to slaw. I would rate this build of a sandwich at 3 stars. Carolina style should have some sweet notes in the slaw and that sauce I felt should be a sugar or molasses based than more of a liquid consistency.

The 4th star came from the care to detail they placed in their side items. The truffled mac n cheese was rich, creamy,  hearty by using a bigger pasta and had that earthy note from the truffle oil. 
The baked beans had its own identity as well. They used the traditional baked beans, black beans and red kidney beans. I like the bean variation for the aesthetic appearance but more importantly the different beans gave a contrast in texture. Round it all off with bits of bacon to give a smokey note. 

In the end, I felt like the side items were the star and the pulled pork made a guest appearance on my plate. I still feel BBQ is a technique where you highlight your proteins the way you choose to get some of the classical elements into the meat. A smokey note is a big one for me when BBQ comes to mind. Hopefully, my next visit I will note the BBQ as the star and not the side items.

Upscale with a young professional vibe. My hubby and I are Seniors, but have stopped for coffee or have  eaten in their restaurant. Food and service were good. Their two shops are very expensive but are filled with diverse and interesting merchandise and books. Sophisticated air about the lively meeting place.

Fun sports bar! Lots of seating options and areas. Fun atmosphere. Lots of televisions for all of the games. 

My drink was a weak and didn't really taste like a Moscow Mule.

Yo Havertown!  A nice little place to take the family on a warm summer evening.  A wide selection of frozen yogurt to suit everyone's taste buds.  I enjoyed the Mint & Salted Cashew.

The candy bar allows you to top off and complete your YoCreation masterpiece. Beware though, as you can transform Gummy Bears into Rock Bears once they are dropped into your frozen creation.

Some neat decor that you would probably only find in a frozen yogurt shop.  Bench seating area has neon illuminated panels.  Yogurt machines feature LED screens to inform you of flavor as well as run advertisements. The staff was very friendly as well.

The price can be a little hefty as they do charge by weight.  It will be interesting to see how this establishment will do in the colder months. Prime piece of real estate on Darby Ave that may not sustain well over some dormant months.  I wish them the best of luck!

The kids loved it and are now on their way straight to the bath tub to get cleaned up!

if you're like me and always crave ideally guilt-free junk food or just have too many dietary restrictions, green table in downtown sb is THE place to go to!! lots of the menu items are vegan/gluten free and pretty tasty-i got the vegan and gluten free mac n cheese, and my friend ordered a cauli pizza. the mac n cheese is made with a nut-based cheese, so it tastes a bit different, but personally, i loved it because i'm allergic to the ingredients in normal mac n cheese and really craved some comfort food. 

the store is a bit hidden (it's near breakfast culture club;)) but aesthetic-wise, the food and store interior are a solid 10/10!! however, green table is a bit steep for pricing, and the portions aren't too big :( minus that, i would definitely recommend coming to green table occasionally to treat yourself to healthy noms and desserts!!

I am hoping that my girlfriend and I ate at Lindy's on a bad night. It was the first time we have been there and have talked about going for a long time. To sum it up the service was fine but the Mac and cheese burger was lack luster at best. Maybe I messed up because I tried it with bacon. All I tasted was bacon! The burger itself had no flavor, and it had little pieces of gristle that made it very unappealing. The mac and cheese was ok and the onion rings would probably have been great if they would have been less than well done.  My girlfriend had the OG, but it too had little flavor. The price was ok but I had buyers remorse. One word of caution, if you have to brave the restroom be careful and check your shoes lest you slide out the door from the grease you may have collected on your way. Ladies with heels be especially careful.

I've been craving good sushi and my husband found this restaurant on yelp. We looked at the menu and were impressed by the selections available. We ordered the Vegas Roll (AMAZING), the volcano roll (good) and rainbow roll (AMAZING). My husband and son got the P5 (beef, meatballs) and I got the P9 (seafood) and we were ALL very please with our food. We will definitely return and are all full!! 
Filling and worth the money. We highly recommend this restaurant.

I frequent about once a month and it is delicious.
The food is always perfect whatever I order.

There fried chicken is to die for but they only have I believe Tuesday and Saturday and call prior as they sell out.

Staff are always very friendly and attentive
Best Italian restaurant I've ever been. Beautiful place, very friendly staff and owners. Good quality food and wines are the best.

came here 3/2/20 
it was supposed to be open at 9:03am, i have waited 20 minutes (until 9:23) for smoothie factory to open and it still wasn't open. better off walking 3 minutes down the road to go to jamba juice.

Truthfully I hate bbq, I mean hate it! I hate ribs even more than I hate bbq, so when my husband wanted to take some out of town visitors there I was not looking forward to it to say the least. We showed up at 1030 AM on Sunday and they opened up pretty early. Our wait time was minimal which is great. We got the sweet potato fries, corn, Cole slaw, brisket, ribs, and burnt end. And I have to say I loved it all. I'm new to St. Louis so maybe I just haven't had this kind of bbq before but I was great. The ribs had a seasoning that was so tasty. The sauces at rd table were great too. The burnt ends were what surprised me the most! They were so tender and delicious. The sweet potato fries were such a good surprise too!  They put brown sugar on them so they are like dessert! I'm definitely happy my husband made me go here, so tasty'
If you're in downtown Clearwater go here. All the bartenders are friendly and you can sing karaoke on Wednesdays.
Taste just as good as the one located in Camden and you can park.  Love this place!  Every bite is an explosion of flavor.
Sparkling clean, up to date equipment generally friendly staff. Ass't manager was sleeping though. Overall my favorite PF

Ordered ckn nachos and ruben sandwich then went to Tonewood. When it was delivered there were no napkins and the food was unexceptional for the price. Sandwich was untoasted bread and was basically a deli sandwich of the quality I would throw together while running out the door. Ordered there before and found the meal overvalued for the experience.

Great food and presentation. Fried Oysters and Oysters Rockafeller appetizers were some of the best we ever had. We sat on their patio- very nice atmosphere. Our server, Dona was very pleasant, helpful and prompt. We will definitely return to this place!
what a gem....Talked to Franklin for a good bit...amazing stories pal...Fabulous Whiskey and great people at your distillery....

So while visiting my parents and sister in Saint-Petersburg Florida, we did something that hasn't been done in a while. Go out to eat at a fancy steakhouse with only us four. My sister made reservations for a Saturday evening and the earliest time we got was 9pm. This place is very touristy and was jammed packed! 

We ordered way too much food but were glad we did. I had the 4oz wagyu beef. I don't remember having such a decadent piece of beef. It was delicious! Everything was delicious. Their wine list is huge! The downside because there is one, unfortunately, was the service. Our waitress made so many mistakes such as forgetting my bottle of wine. We were served entrées and I still didn't get anything. I had to ask the manager what was up with it. Another mistake... My father ordered an extra side of foie gras to go with his steak. She forgot about that. All in all, it was a fun dining experience. Next time I visit, it will be with my husband.

I so badly wanted to be a huge fan of this place. In fact, I'm soon moving to Broad Ripple and was going to be bummed to leave this place behind.  But after my first experience I'm not too upset about it any longer. 

Cute atmosphere and friendly servers, yes. But we sat without being greeted for about 15 minutes as we saw others sat after us be greeted and get drinks before we were ever even recognized. We had to end up asking for someone to take car or us. 

Once we finally got service things were just ok. We ordered the beets (the best thing we got), ceviche, meatballs and hush puppies. The ceviche is far overpriced for what you get. Nothing to eat it with such as a chip or bread or anything. Just a pile of things thrown together. 

The beets were delicious, however. As were the hush puppies. Meatballs were tasty. 

Drink wise i just for the hedge row white. I probably wouldn't get this again. The bf got an old fashioned which he said was just ok. 

Desert was sold to us as a butterscotch creme brulee but was for sure more along the lines or a pudding. 

I'll just say - not the worst place I've ever been but I won't be itching to go back anytime soon.

This place is awesome! I definite must if you are in the area. A local little place with amazing service and even better food! The could tell we were "out of towners" and made us feel right at home. The salsa is good,but the cheese fries were the best I have ever had.  The root beer is also a must. The portions are huge and the prices are reasonable. We will be sure to go again next time we are here.

I've been using Acid Flyers for a fews years now. They have fair prices, excellent sale specials, quick turn around and fantastic customer service. 
I'm not that computer savvy so it's nice to have their assistance with sending print ready material when needed.

Standard local coffee place. There always seems to be a "type" that works at these places, in a hurry and absolutely no chit chat or smiles, except for each other. They are steering away from straws, and the lids for the cold drinks are really good for sipping. No outlets in the shop, not sure about the outdoor seating. Rocking chairs on the front porch.  The coffee is strong, probs because most people order lattes or some specialty coffees from these places. Good for a quick stop on the way to the street car stop.

We previously stayed at the Cheshire several times over the past few years but never again. The Cheshire used to be kitschy but fun. Now it is just run down, with worn carpets and dirty rooms that need cleaning and painting. They have taken "dog friendly" to a whole new depth, with dogs literally off leash and running around the sitting room by the fireplace. Every visible surface area needed vacuuming or mopping. It's a bummer, as we travel to St. Louis often and this is a good location. But never again will we stay at the Cheshire. The only redeeming feature is the staff, who are unfailingly polite and helpful.

My in-laws live close to Giovanni's and tend to order a variety of items. I've enjoyed everything I've eaten and have experienced dining in on one occasion. 
They make a bruschetta stuffed garlic bread that is absolutely delicious. Their broccoli and chicken Alfredo was also a delightful option and came with a fresh side salad and garlic bread sticks. The bread has a very rustic feel..  cut into rather uneven strips, but delicious, none the less. 
Their pizza has a yummy sauce and salty cheese, which is perfection. The garlic knots are covered in hefty chunks of garlic. Great for those who don't mind smelling like they're trying to ward off dracula.. which I do not. ;)
Any of the pasta and chicken dishes that my in-laws have ordered for catered events have been spectacular and taste great as leftovers. 
The only issue I have found was dining in. The parking lot is a mess and people park on the sidewalk. Not kidding. The restaurant gets very busy and the wait staff has a hard time keeping up.  It seemed a bit of a disorganized mess.. not much synchronicity. Perhaps the experience is different when the crowd isn't nearly as large, but Giovanni's seems to be a very busy place.
Despite that one downside, I would highly recommend checking this place out. The food is awesome and that's what's most important.

Best banana cake in the world. Every dessert amazing. I have been here three times since the opening a few weeks ago, and it's getting impossible to get in, the food is so good. Nice diverse crowd, a little noisy.
Plenty of vegan selections. Much appreciated. 
Closed Mondays.

Dennis is the best!  I can honestly say that before I met him, my car karma was the epitome of me having be Gen-gas Khan in a former life.  I had more problems than I can even tell you.  My wheel house got destroyed....my oil pan got a hole in it...my engine seized, you get the picuture.  One day, Denis said Get rid of this car and buy a Honda.  I'm not even going to charge for this patch so you can get a new car.  Harvey the Honda was purchased a month later.  That's HONESTY.  That's Dennis.

They will make you wait forever for repairs. I have been waiting over two months to have my new dishwasher since my old one was broken. Then my new one came in, and that didn't work either. So I called to let them know that the new dishwasher was not working and they still did not come to look at it. I reported that my dryer was not working properly over 3 months ago and they still did not come to fix it. One of my neighbor has a broken stove since June, it is now the end of September and her stove is not still fixed. So she has been using her microwave and she haves a child to feed. Let's not mention that your utility bills will skyrocket because the AC units do not work properly and the windows are not energy efficient. There's a lot more I can say about this place but then I'll end up writing a book. The owner is more concerned about the appearance on the outside of the apartments then the function of the apartments. They expect us to pay full rent and uphold your end of the contract when they will not uphold their end of the contract. Do not move here you will regret it.

Went there on Father's Day for some take out. Host took my order along with my phone number and promised it will be ready in 25 minutes and she will give me a call to pick up my order. 45 minutes later I came in asking if my order was ready. It took them additional 10 minutes to find my take out bag that was sitting right in front of her. So what's the point to ask for a phone number?? Unpleasant experience. And they gave me a baked potato and french fries instead of baked potato and salad. So instead of nice dinner my dad got overdone steak, tons of fries and burned potato that had to go straight to garbage.  I guess I'm fixing dinner next Father's Day.

I think I've eaten at this La Casa over 10x now and i'm always satisfied with the food. Service is also great and the servers and kitchen work fast to get the food on the table. I have never finished my chips and salsa before my food arrives at the table, super fast! Everything from steak to Tilapia is on the menu as far as meats go and all are cooked deliciously.

So, why do I like this establishment? It is predictable! Every time I have gone here I have received what I ordered. Well, duh? You would think, but I cannot say that about the Wendy's over by the Walmart, or even McDonald's. In fact, Burger King is one of the few fast food  establishments in which I have always gotten what I expected. And, the service, which is a BIGGIE in my book (no pun intended), is always great! For fast food, this Burger King is at the top of the list when in this area, especially on Sundays, when Chick-fil-A is closed.

Must try! Cafe Amelie was definitely a great choice that my friends and I made while in New Orleans! Brad was an AMAZING server and made the visit superb. 

When we first got there the hostess told us it was an hour wait so we put our name down and wandered before heading back. The courtyard was pretty spectacular and we enjoyed sitting there while we waited. We even saw a wedding parade that stopped in front and enjoyed it for a little while. 

We eventually got seated outside and there were space heaters that kept us warm and toasty. 

For appetizers we ordered the brussel sprouts (MUST HAVE) and something with bread and cheese (I didn't order it so I don't remember). The brussel sprouts were so good so I ordered more. 

I decided to get the shrimp and grits as a meal because it was highly recommended and I was not terribly hungry. It was pretty spectacular. It wasn't super hot but nothing to be disappointed about. The shrimp was perfect and the sauce on the grits were amazing. Other folks got the pasta of the day which was also delicious and other delicious plates. 

We then told Brad it was our friend's birthday and he brought us shots of something and a lemon cake. Lemon cake was a little too sweet but still delicious. 

The evening was very pleasant and we really enjoyed our experience and would definitely recommend for a visit !

We ordered the grill with sushi combo.  The Sushi rice was dry and not soft at all.  It broke apart and was just ok.  Grill portions were small for a party of 4.  It was like they gave only enough for one person to eat and we had to constantly ask the waiter for more.  The waiter was really nice though.  Gave 3 stars for the service but food was just ok.  Nothing great to rave about.  I think I will stick to Nineting in Chinatown.
Get the Duke and you will keep going back! Period!!

if I could give 0 stars I would. I ordered mashed potatoes and they gave me French fries. ive had stomach surgery and can't eat French fries. I called to speak to someone and asked why they never called to tell me. I spoke to a manager and he said they just did what they wanted. I asked for a refund he told me take it up with Doordash. i didn't order with Doordash. I ordered through them. horrible. could have hurt me badly.
Local fresh and creative cooking. BYOB. Modern atmosphere.  Specials nightly.  Monday fixed price locals night.

Come on now Mt Holly you don't get to have two of the best breweries in the world in your town.  OK, I'm not mad at you, no one could be mad at you for that.  Village Idiot Brewing Company has the single greatest pumpkin beer in the entire world... there, I said it and I stand by my statement.  Don't believe me?  Come in here and belly up to the bar, while you are doing that look around.  You want character?  This place has character..... it is so charming in here, even the bathroom is decorated with style!  That my friends is attention to detail and it is found all over, especially in the beer.  
     Did you know that they recently won an award at an international beer competition?  Yeah this place is THAT good.  Pick a beer, any beer (go with the pumpkin, trust me, you're welcome) you can't go wrong they are all delicious.  So to be clear, I claim to only like IPA's.  This is THE ONLY brewery where I have stepped out of my comfort zone and tried other things.  That says a lot because I am a creature of habit and I don't deviate when I find something I like.  Don't even look at the menu, just tell the bartenders to give you something, you'll love it no matter what it is.  
     If you are here on Saturday, ask for Dave, he is a great guy and very knowledgeable about not just Village Idiot, but all of the microbreweries in South Jersey.  He is a fun guy to talk to and yet one more reason Village Idiot is one of my favorite breweries in the state.

Went last night, it was really scary. I was the only one in my group that wore the glowstick but ended up dropping it. There were 6 attractions & you had a little break outside in between each. Actors definitely take it seriously, lol.

Before and after photos here. I couldn't be more impressed! Naieem brought my hair back from a mishap at another salon & a mishap I created at home. Everyone that walked out of that salon today looked fantastic! Every one of the stylists knows what they are doing, and have fun doing it. Love love love it. They are all very friendly, and the whole place has such a easy and comfortable atmosphere. I'm really looking forward to coming back to Naieem. I don't have words enough to praise this place. A++

Average. Not sure if I have seen anyone actually eat inside the restaurant. I typically order off Grubhub. Chow Fun, sliced Chicken with Broccoli, Sliced Chicken with Chinese Eggplant in Garlic Sauce are all pretty good. I would stay away from the Egg Drop Soup. It's probably the most unnatural, gelatinous thing that I have eaten. The rest of the appetizers are solid. Nothing bad at this place, and also nothing that really sets it apart.

Went to urgent care because I was feeling extremely sick. 

After my initial exam I was told that the only thing that would help me is advil and mucunex (which I was already taking, and it was not working and told them this). 

SAVE YOUR MONEY DO NOT GO TO THIS PLACE 

The previous two nights I was up all night with no sleep and feeling very fatigued with headaches and an extremely bad cough that prevented me from sleeping. I asked to be prescribed an antibiotic but the Doctor  said it was not necessary. I also asked to be prescribed some sleeping pills since I had not been able to sleep. They also denied my request and said sleeping pills wont make this go away, which I do agree, but it would help me get much needed rest.

I went to another doctor the next day and I was put on antibiotics because I ended up having strep throat and a 102 degree fever.

This has been by far the best service I have had in Reno. I was treated with nothing but respect and the mechanic was there to help with all my questions and he showed me what he was doing every step of the way. Thank you guys for the awesome service. All my family and friends go here and we all love the service.

I told their desk person I was leaving town, and wasn't sure if I'd be coming back. They suggested freezing my membership. I said sure.They said nothing about a $20 fee associated with this process, and apparently it was in the fine print of the paperwork I signed.

I guess it's shame on me for not reading the fine print. But I am certain they said nothing about it verbally, and honestly, who reads the fine print?

I called to resolve the issue, and they said they would have a membership person call back. They didn't. I called again later, and they hung up on me. I called a third time, and finally got someone. When I said I just wanted to cancel the membership instead, they said ok, but I'd have to come into the gym to do it (even though I was out of town), and I'd still have to pay the fee. When I said I didn't want to pay it, they immediately threatened to send it to collections.

This is shady, deceptive business practice, and terrible customer service. 
Oh, did I mention they've changed ownership twice in a year? 
Don't even bother with this place.

True craft cocktails- and deceivingly strong(so the very best kind). The burger is simple, but one of the very best I've had anywhere. The shrimp and grits is a meal in itself, and so rich. Beef tartare- excellent and good for something lighter to share. My only underwhelming dish after nearly six or so visits has been the catfish- under seasoned (likely a fluke, but I haven't bothered to try it again). The bartenders are all attentive, receptive, and excellent taste in music. I've never bothered to try the dining, as I'm far more pleased with the company at the bar.

My husband, son and I visited Pipers on 5/25/16.  The waitress came to our table and my son noticed that she was chewing food on her way to our table--not good.  My son's entree salad was extremely disappointing.  For $11 they should be serving better than bagged salad, raw broccoli, and chow me in noodles -- very few other veggies!  I informed waitress it was my husband's birthday and she said Pipers does nothing for birthdays.  I ordered their "Swiss steak" while it was good--it was pot roast with gravy and NOT Swiss steak.  Swiss steak is a thick slice of steak dragged in flour and pounded browned and braised with tomatoes and onions--misleading menu.  Overall, low rating for quality of food, lack of attention (waitress didn't ask us once to refill our waters and the restaurant was practically empty), and also for lack of making you feel welcomed and not having something special for ones birthday as most eating establishments do.  I felt bad that I had chosen this place to celebrate his special day.

EPIC failure. .. Monday Blues! Came with my kids & little sister to be riped off & deeply disappointed. Do NOT I shall repeat DO NOT come in ever for their Crab Legs deal. It will steal away your $ money & time. If anyone at all who knows me know that I am 110% honest.  Please save your $ & time dining elsewhere!!!!! In the mood for Crab Legs ? - go to Hard Rock on Fridays or Saturday.  Sure as hell bets it here. It's late - I shall continue this in detail tomorrow. .. (sighhhh)  so sad

The ambiance is amazing, but to be completely honest it was not worth and hour and twenty minute wait (and we were there around 2 in the afternoon, it was even more busy at 5 when we walked by!!). Wehn we finally did get in there open tables left and right!! I don't understand the wait. Plus most everything on the menu was close to $20. 

From the outside it looked like the restaurant was UNDER an aquarium, but it is not. The fish are only in the middle. We were lucky enough to be close to the middle, but there were some people along the edges the were no where near the fish.

The food was really good and is comparable to food you would have at Joe's Crab Shack. For the price we paid you would think you were getting Bone Fish quality! We never really saw our server, he stopped by a couple times, but he wasn't even the one brought us our food, it was someone else.

I think it was a good place to expirience to have, and I am glad we did it once, but we probably wont go there again.

I've been here 2 dozen times over the past few years and will continue to go back, here's why:

The Eggs Benedict is the best I've had, probably anywhere although it is rivaled by the cafe at the Wynn in vegas. Of the 2 dozen times, I think I've ordered something besides the eggs Benedict twice, and was definitely pleased, but my regular is in my opinion EASILY the best breakfast in town.

The pastries are also phenomenal, although too big usually to order by yourself.
To die for. I chose the one plate instead of being able to go back. Good choice cause I would've pigged out ! Everything delicious!

Service is very slow. Don't expect to get coffee in a timely fashion on your way to work. Maybe a nice place if you have an hour or more to sit and relax inside. Communication with staff is very difficult.

Ciccio Water is my favorite of the Ciccio's concepts. Their cocktails are awesome. They have the usual slamgrias and maxmosas but then also have some delicious craft cocktails. The cucumber martini is made with cold pressed cucumber juice from fresh kitchen and it's delicious! 

For food: The garlic lime edamame is crack. I order this every time we go there. The chicken Marsala penne appetizer is out of this world delicious and big enough to count as a meal. I also love all of their bowls and their sushi!

I am almost hesitant to review this place because I don't want to draw attention to it, because I want to be able to buy all the wonderful, unique pieces myself! This is vintage heaven right here, folks. 

We were guided straight to exactly what we were looking for by the friendly and intuitive saleswoman who works here. She was able to give us the history of the piece, and ideas for how to use it, and when we were hesitant to buy because of the price tag, she chopped the price in HALF. In half, people. I almost cried. Now we have a beautiful, well-crafted mid-century modern piece of furniture that we will love for the rest of our life, and we got it at a steal. 

We arranged to have it delivered, and it was delivered without a ding or scratch by their staff. And they even showed up exactly on time! I love this place.

This gem of Nashville is definitely worth a visit. By far the best food we had while we visited Nashville for the Bears game, which is saying a lot! From the filets (medium rare and cooked over charcoal!) to the oysters and the smoked pickled devils eggs (who would have ever thought about this!) this place is a must visit. If waiting is a problem, you may want to go early on weekends for dinner as I think the secret is out!

The best Italian food and pizza around!

Baked from scratch italian pastries and cakes!!!

Giovanni bread for the hoagies...all the best.

Visit the best place in Collegeville for any food you hunger for.

Nutella bar for desserts...yum!

I've had a hard time starting this review. I am unsure of why. I'm 29 and I've been coming to the pub since I was 18. Whether or not this is something to be proud of or not, I am unsure. However, I have observed over a 10+ year course it's decline over the years. Not only does this apply to the Pub but I use this as a general description of the gay scene of New Orleans in general. It has certainly seen its hey day. Its decline, I believe, begun after Katrina. The accelerated decline of the pub began with it's new owner (who is from California and a New Orleans bar can not be run like a California club). 

As my palate has evolved and my taste/needs have changed, I have a hard time giving this establishment or any gay bar in the surrounding area a 3 star or higher rating. While prices have gone up up up, quality has gone down down down. As I become a young professional and advance my career as any young money hungry career driven 30 something usually does, I find a void in what these bars have to offer. So much like New Orleans, I find there is not a healthy young, gay professional crowd. To me (and I could be wrong) it seems that there is the really old, established, queen and the really young, retail working, "let me move to New Orleans from my po dunk small town" gay population here. 

I couldn't but help reminiscing of my week vacation in New York and craving a lounge like G-Lounge. There is nothing like that here. Without sounding bitter (and I know it will), The New Orleans gay scene is pretty washed up. 

While this bar may seem appealing to the typical bachelorette party or the young, retail worker making ends meet to buy his next bump of coke/ecstasy looking for a sugar daddy, I find it does not meet my needs. The closes thing to meeting my demands is the upstairs at Goodfriend's Bar (and still there is much to be desired).

However, I will say that Sunday Tea at the pub is fun. It's more of a local crowd.

If you like Starbucks this is a good one. Not a whole lot of space inside, but if you are looking for a quick coffee and friendly staff who even remember your order this will so the trick. 
There are not many coffee places in the area so this is the best option.

You can read all the reviews, but as a true testament to how good they are there's usually a line of customers waiting to get Cafe Vino Tinto coffee and they have a Starbucks within walking distance of their location. I'm sure the story has been told before in other reviews, but this family owns the farm in Costa Rica the grows the beans, they roast the beans, and serve it there in Safety Harbor. The iced coffee drinks are a special treat. They make the ice cubes out of coffee as well, so you get a little extra caffeine kick as the ice cubes melt.

We went to Seasons 52 for lunch today and I'm really glad I did.  For those of you unfamiliar with their concept, everything on their menu is seasonal (i.e. they change the menu every quarter or so) and everything is under 475 calories (so pretty healthy).  We started with the roasted beets with wasabi dipping sauce.  They were a special & were pretty good.  I then had the blackened fish tacos which were delicious.  There were 3 tacos with a perfectly cooked piece of mahi mahi in each.  They were flavored perfectly & came with a chipotle sour cream & pico de gallo.  YUM!  My dining companion had the scallops with asparagus and said it was really good too.

For dessert we each had a mini indulgence.  Mine was a caramel, mocha, brownie concoction and hers was Meyer lemon.  Both were really tasty and just the right size.

They had an extensive wine list with many many wines available by the glass.  I didn't have any wine but plan to when I go back.

Seasons 52 is definitely worth checking out!

Good burger. Good Fries. Good Shake. Slow service. Took forever and a day to order the food and even longer to get said food. Glad I brought a book with me (I'm not kidding). Runner was very nice once we got the food and even apologized for the wait, and brought us extra stuff as an apology. Like the sauce selection though I thought they used to carry sweet Thai chili sauce? All and all a good meal that left me happy and satified.
I'm not a coffee person and yet I've been here 3 times since it's opened. Every employee I've experienced has been super kind and have even offered some new drink ideas. I will definitely be back !
I had breakfast here today and it was delicious. $25 for the buffet is a good price in NOLA. Cheese grits were outstanding as was the pepper crusted bacon.

One of my favorite places, regardless of cuisine.  I've been dining at HoW for 7+ years and am always delighted.

Last night was no difference...good food, solid service, fair pricing and a good atmosphere.  

As you can imagine, Christmas night would be a real challenge but, we didn't experience any let down at all.  And, as you would expect, much of Jewish-St. Louis was there, enjoying (it's really fun seeing people you don't see throughout the year and catching up).

We ordered crab rangoon (mmmm, plump and crispy and filled with crab), egg rolls (average) and Cold Sesame Noodles (good but pricey) for appetizers.  They showed up within 5 minutes of ordering and were perfect to start the meal.  Our 2 daughter's are watching their carbs so they ordered Wong's Lettuce Wraps.  All reports were that they were very tasty although the iceberg lettuce was wet - and I mean WET.  

Entrees included Beef & Broccoli (I love the way they slow cook their beef and the broccoli was perfectly al dente - the sauce was average but otherwise tasty), Sesame Chicken (very tasty and just the right amount of spice to keep things interesting), Chicken Lo Mein (it looked a bit overcooked to me, but my Mom said it was well seasoned and tender), Spicy Green Beans (very tasty, perfectly cooked and just the right amount of sauce) and the Shrimp and Chicken Combo (again, a bit pricey for what you get, but the quality and taste were just perfect).

As I mentioned above, the service was very good and attentive.  Our drink glasses were never empty - literally - and the entrees arrived within 15 minutes of ordering.  We never felt rushed (even though the restaurant was PACKED) and our waiter was very observant to our table.

So, with all of the 'good' why only 4 stars?  Two reasons:
1) There was a tremendously annoying ringing/buzzing coming from the kitchen the entire night.  I have no idea what it was and if it had been a consistent annoyance, it would have been better than the on-off-on-off seemingly for our entire 75 minute meal.  I wish the manager would have either unplugged whatever it was, put a big heavy towel on the thing or even just come around to the tables and apologized for it...but he was too busy talking on a phone, I'll assume trying to get someone to come out and fix it. 
2) We purchased Groupons and called ahead of time to make sure we could use them.  When we presented them, we were told we could NOT use them because it was Christmas (we told the waiter we'd called three days before to make sure) but he was adamant that we couldn't use it.  Didn't destroy the meal, or our budget, but the inconsistency is annoying.

Still highly recommend. . . really enjoy House of Wong and will continue to go there, likely 3-4 times per year.

Typical Hyatt Place layout which we really like.  Spacious rooms with a really functional layout for business travel.  Excellent bed/bedding and decent shower.  Fast wifi and large TV with HDMI hookups if you want to connect your laptop to the tv.  All of this is pretty standard issue for Hyatt Place.
The biggest downside to this particular hotel is the absolutely pathetic breakfast offerings.   They also lose ground for the staff who didn't speak or acknowledge us unless we were standing in front of them.  This isn't typical for HP as generally their staff is well trained and personable.  It doesn't cost anything to greet a hotel customer when you pass them in the lobby.
All in all a good hotel for an airport focused property.

Well I might be able to give a better review if my party was actually allowed inside the bar.  Unfortunately, the bouncer was a huge jerk with a "power complex".  While the building was clearly not at capacity, they continued to allow about 7 people out and 2 people in.

We had tried earlier to set up a private reservation like they have advertised on the website, for a bachelorette party.  What they fail to tell you is that you must be there before 8 pm to do this.  Who goes out at 8 pm on a Saturday night, I don't know.  Very unrealistic.

Also, the bouncer would not let the bachelorette in because (quote) "she took too long to take her ID out".  Oh, did I mention the manager was standing 5 feet away smoking a cigarette, listening to the whole thing?

I admit. The shop is a little odd looking and quite dated. And a couple of the team are less approachable than they probably should be. But this place was great for a few reasons. Firstly, the ladies at the reception were helpful, great fun and attentive. The lady who did my eye test was very nice and very professional. And the glasses that I went home with were just what I wanted and were the result of good advice by the team there. So overall, perfectly happy and willing to recommend!

I have been coming here since I was 7 years old.  Literally for 20 years (they have been in business since 1955).  Same guys Bill, Art, and Enzo.  Always a great haircut.  

This is a traditional barber shop, equipped with the necessary trophy animal heads, an array of Playboy, Field and Stream, Car and Driver magazines, and of course decor that dates back to the early 70's, all of which in my opinion are necessary for a proper haircut. The only thing that changes in this place is the nudie mags and I swear, there's something about the combination of looking at a nudie mag, staring at a dead animal while getting your haircut, and the smell and feeling of warm shaving cream that just exudes manhood.  I once saw an eight year old get his haircut here and by the end, he had a five o'clock shadow and an ex-wife.

As buffets go, Golden Corral is at the top of my list. It has become a tradition for my wife and I to head here for Thanksgiving dinner. I am amazed how they can prepare for the onslaught of people that invade their establishment for thanksgiving. Turkey with all the fixings as well as their regular menu. The staff is friendly and hardworking on a day I know they would rather be home with their own families. Keep up the good work.
Terrific Reuben sandwich. Incredibly nice and helpful people behind the counter. Next time I am in New Orleans, I will be back.

I've had the Mediterranean pizza here twice, and it's always delicious.  I am going to try a different one this weekend.  The crust and sauce are always perfect, and even the artichokes on the pizza were cooked perfectly.  My go-to pizza place!

I love the patio in the summer. I love the snowflake decorations in the winter. I love the way the place is looks in general. I love that I never run out of water and the servers are super attentive. And of course, I love the pizza. My favorite is spinach, shrimp, feta, on pesto, whole wheat crust, although I often branch out to other things. 

The only thing I hate? Eating here with a boring food person, who says "Let's just get pepperoni." THIS ISN'T DONATOS!!! Why would you eat something you can have anywhere when there's pesto, feta cheese, oysters, crawdads, shrimp, spinach, eggplant...just about anything one could want on a pie! Have an adventure when you eat, not just a repeat of yesterday.

We went to the minute clinic at this location today because my husband was not feeling very good. Dr. Michelle was great, she was very professional and helpful. She gave us good advice of what we needed to do about my husband's sickness. Then she called us later to check how he was doing :) we will definitely go there for minor illness.

You will not meet a more professional, or nicer mechanic than you will here. Nick and John are incredibly knowledgeable but almost as important, wonderfully accessible. They genuinely have your safety and best interest at heart.

My oldest grandson and I thought the 2014 and 2015 Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon for $80 a bottle was excellent.  They also have a couple of very good red blends for a more reasonable price. Their wine was also a big hit with both of my daughters on an earlier trip after trying it at the SY Kitchen in Santa Ynez.  Tasting fee of $20 is waived with a purchase of three bottles.  Very good service.  Wine tasting room is crowded on the weekend.  Public parking is available within a block or two from El Paseo in downtown Santa Barbara.
This is my favorite restaurant in New Orleans. The food is amazing. The cocktails are solid. Happy hour prices are great and the grand piano makes the atmosphere.

The bean "dip" served with the chips is awful, and the salsa isn't much better. Their iced tea tastes like it's instant and the glass was filled to the brim with ice. The chicken fajitas we're worse than anything on Taco Bell's menu. The fajitas tasted as they'd grilled onion, bell pepper & mushrooms and used they either Kraft fajita mix (if there is such a thing,) or ketchup & chili powder.  My dining companion had Chile Relleno Veracruz and couldn't  eat it because there was enough salt in it for a five-gallon pot of Chili. It's not the worst Mexican joint in the Boise area I've eaten at (that would be Casa Mexico in Eagle) but it's not far from the worst. I don't see how this restaurant will be able to stay open, they should never have any return customers.

This place has the *best* bubble tea smoothies I've had *anywhere*, and I've been all over the USA.

They use fresh fruit, and get the sweetness *just* right.  Whenever I go to the New Orleans metropolitan area, I have to make a special trip to get my Frosty's fix.

On top of the bubble teas, they have some darn good Vietnamese food as well.  I'm especially partial to the Vietnamese Poboys.  They have a wonderfully spicy kick!

Kittens are given basic vetting spaying testing and appropriate things needed to adopt no different from any shelter
Application says take cat to your vet ASAP no guarantee of health given
Like all rescues they do the best they can
And the one who posted about cats spreading hepatitis what the heck ate you talking about
Go buy a cat for hundreds of dollars rom a cat puppy mill and see what you get
They are for adoption,rescued ,give them a break

Update - after writing to their customer service address, I did hear back from them and received a gift card with their sincere apologies.  I also received a personal phone call from the manager of the Collegeville restaurant with her apologies.  It looks like they take this very seriously and so I'd have to say that I will try them again with the gift card and hopefully will have a much better experience.

Had dinner here because there's a lot of hype and had to try. It is over rated in my book. We had the popular brussel sprouts 3/5, oysters 5/5, quail 5/5, pappardelle 1/5. Pappardelle had too much truffle sauce and was very rich. Brussels were mediocre. Oysters and quail were the best dishes of the night. Service 3/5 - our server was very nice, but things were forgot and they are all running around like a madhouse. Cheers

No one in my party had ever eaten here before, so we wanted to give it a try, and what better than late night White Castle. I'm glad we did, because I was definitely a fan!

The drive thru was pretty full, so we went inside where it was completely empty. The employee taking our order had to be pretty new (at least I hope so) because he kept having to ask what buttons to press to take our order. We got a cheeseburger and hot chicken slider, and the fish nibblers. I went in to this expecting everything to be disappointed after the White Castle hype I always heard about, but all of them were good.

The cheeseburger was pretty generic, but it's hard to be unbiased about fast food burgers when you have Whataburger around. The hot chicken slider was quite good, and the fried pickle was a nice touch. The fish nibblers were outstanding. I grew up eating fish nuggets in my elementary school cafeteria, so this was a major nostalgia moment because the taste was just like I remember way back then.

Uneventful, boring, unmemorable overpriced meal - unfortunately that's all it was.  In today's day and age, place like this need to stand out by offering unique menus and memorable meals. None it it could be found here. Just a bunch of random ingredients quickly put together to create what looked like and tasted like a left over meal. Highly disappointed.

I was a little dismayed to find the hotel on one side of a mall where the anchor store was a Big Lots. 

However, the hotel itself was clean and actually quite nice inside.  The room numbering system was quite odd, but at least there were signs to tell you where to go.  And there were these fountains everywhere with their tinklng water....The rooms were also faced away from the swimming pool, so you could take a dip at ten pm and not worry about making too much noise. The rooms were clean and spacious and the air conditioner worked very well.  

I am a sucker for waffles...good thing Comfort Inns invested in those rotating waffle makers for their continental breakfasts.  I think I refill my waffle level for months after staying at a COmfort Inn.....

The staff were super nice and helpful, especially the guy in the morning.
Excellent customer service all the food was delicious! good location & the workers are very caring and make sure everything is how you want it Make sure to come try their delicious food

We came here two days in a row, although the place is small but it's clean and as hygiene matters a lot to me so I was happy. I have tasted almost all the kebabs on the menu, my favorite were chicken Chapli and chicken seekh kebab. The Haleem was really good as well. The food is full of flavor and their chai though takes long to be prepared,is completely worth the wait. I would recommend it to everyone who lives here or is visiting!

Been going to Feraro's on ivory for years. Occasionally a malfunction but tonight a fiasco! Air conditioning not working while it was 100 degrees outside. Waited an hour for salads and pizza came out all wrong. Fixed it by adding  the topping and additional cheese. Pizza was mushy! When I told the server I was not paying for the second pizza she said sorry no manager on duty, not sure I can do this. Eventually the pizza was taken off our bill after 2 hours of sitting there fuming! Go to Deweys where everything would have been comped! We go every Thursday night and watch the employees as well as managers come and go constantly. They let Jen go who ran the place and did a great job. Steve and Henry make an excellent pizza. I think the entire staff was over whelmed tonight.

We have had nothing but positive experiences at Drexel Hill Pediatrics.  We love the on call nurses and doctors - always friendly and willing to help give advice when I'm worried about something at home, no matter the hour.  They let you stay in the room and nurse after appointments if you need to, instead of rushing you out.  We were even able to meet with a lactation consultant when we had some questions and she was so accommodating.  We have chosen to see the same Doctor throughout my son's first year - Dr. Matt.  He makes you feel welcome and heard. They are opening new offices this Spring so the facilities will get a face lift.  We simply love this practice!

This is a GREAT salon - I'm devoted to Martha but vouch for entire place with great support staff, wonderfully centralized location, and good reminder calls!

Still recommend Martha after they moved in 2017, but the receptionist quite unhelpful as  I recall this function being before About Faces joined in.  The parking at this location is a disaster - so i had to leave the salon.  If you can walk here, it's worth a try.
Just thought this was a great place to Have brunch.  The service was excellent and the food was delicious . Would recommend a visit

Finally visited SkyGarten for the first time a few weeks ago. There was a $5 cover for admission and it was a little awkward to find. We had to ask security where exactly we were going. Inside, it looks exactly like you would expect a corporate building turned bar would look like. The real draw is the outside space, which is stunning. The views are unbeatable and really the only reason to visit. The beer selection is decent, although a couple of the kegs were kicked the night we went. We ordered some food, soft pretzels, which took about an hour to get (after asking the server multiple times where they were) and tasted like frozen pretzel bites. 

Great place to go on a nice day to have a couple beers but I wouldn't recommend much else.

Party of six sat on the restaurant side for dinner.  (The other side has food/sane menu but more of a pub atmosphere.) You can choose which side you're seared on when you arrive. 

Service was mostly good. Our glasses didn't stay full which is something important to me. Food arrived in a timely manner and staff was friendly.  

The food...we shared several items.  Breaded mushrooms were generous in proportion but lacking in flavor without the horseradish based dip. Onion rings, delicious and I'd order again.  Syskins (loaded skins with chicken strips) were a fun item in the mix but not amazing. Signature chicken pizza (with ranch) was delicious and we wished we had ordered a larger one. The Frisco melt was disappointing and dry.  Over all the food was good and came out hot. 

Family friendly and large so I would say short wait if any even when really busy.

Short review or maybe a rant for this place...

We've been here many times before, it's a staple for us, we have friends that work and hang out here.

On Mother's Day we were out like everyone else enjoying the river and the kayaking event that may or may not have happened.  

5 stars for the fresh squeezed orange juice mimosas.
1 star for the terrible bartender that can't keep track of who is waiting for drinks at his bar.  

The guy seated next to where I was standing related he had been waiting 20 minutes and couldn't get a bottled beer.  Plenty of the obvious bar friends walked up and were served immediately while others of us waited and waited.  Fortunately for me, my husband walked up to another portion of the bar and was acknowledged, by the same bartender ignoring me and the other guy.  I was unhappy and voiced my displeasure.  The rude response I got was it was busy and he couldn't keep track of "who was who" at the bar.  Unacceptable and unprofessional to say the least.  It's Reno and I know a busy bar and I know you can keep track of who's been at your bar for 10+ minutes without a drink.  Whatever, I guess "location, location, location" beats out crappy service every time because I know we'll be back and not every bartender there is bad.

THIS PLACE DESERVES TO GO DOWN THE GUTTER! 
Other times ive been here it has been alright, but tonight was a disaster! The waiters were absolutely terrible, so bad that they actually spilled a whole trey of drinks on my brother! They also got all of the orders incorrect bringing our party food that we never ordered. WE WILL NOT BE RETURNING HERE worst place ive ever been to
If you want a plain pizza you go to city view down the block. If you want toppings you go here. Salads are hit or miss. Staff is ok. Cleaner and more professional looking than its neighbors.

Perfect spot to watch a game and get a good brew! 

The bar staff friendly. They're knowledgeable about the products the bar carries and helpful when you're looking for a new beer to try. Plenty of TVs are throughout the bar and the staff is more than willing to make sure you don't miss the game you're interested in watching. 

The bar also offers a variety of seating options. You can sit on a stool at the bar or a high top table, hang out with a group at a table & chairs or lounge back on a comfortable sofa. Don't want to sit inside? The Bulldog Mid City has one of the best courtyards in the city. It's big. You can sit at a small table with a friend or two, or take the whole group and make it a party. There is also a private courtyard should you decide to reserve it for a special event. 

The bar food is delicious - but  you may have to wait a while for it. Don't worry, it's well worth it and there's a fully stocked bar to hold you over until your order is ready. 

My personal favorite thing about this bar - you can bring your furry best friend. It's dog friendly!

Legit gourmet coffee shop, offering oatmilk and foam flower cappuccinos. I ordered the fruit toast with the mascarpone cheese - delish! Upstairs seating and bike rack out front. They make their own chocolate too!

We couldn't afford movers for a full move, but we were moving to St. Louis from out of town, and didn't know anyone here. Thus we needed help unloading our stuff. 

Two Men and a Truck did a phenomenal job unloading our truck. The three movers were very professional, and we were amazed at how fast they were able to move our stuff up to our 2nd floor apartment. We had over 50 boxes of books (I counted 52), a number of pieces of heavy furniture (7 not including beds), lots of kitchen equipment, etc. Our 20' Uhaul was packed tight, and very little of our stuff was light. Yet they were able to finish in just a few hours, and the only casualties were 2 dishes that were poorly packed, which was our fault, not theirs, and might well have happened when boxes shifted when I was driving over. They were even able to squeeze our couch into our apartment, a feat we would have been unable to accomplish on our own. Finally, they were very friendly and helpful. They gave us tips about how to move our stuff and how to clean out the Uhaul. They were patient with us when we changed our minds about where to put things, and were more than happy to try to put the heavy furniture we would be unable to move ourselves in the locations we wanted them to end up. This was the first time we have ever been able to afford movers, and the experience was great! We are likely to have to move at least one more time, and when we do, if we can afford it, we will definitely hire them again!
Went again and got the same thing but this time the lobster was overcooked. I guess you can't relive a great experience.

I had a great experience here. I love how the place is designed and their color selection. Lee was very thorough and did a great job. Everyone that worked there was very friendly as well. I will definitely be back.
I couldn't imagine a better place to visit while in town. Wonderful selection of beers and great company. Don was wonderful! Will be returning soon.
Take the dogs here,  I love it! Recently a car was found in the water,  don't know what happened but it's a peaceful great getaway.

Worst service I have honestly ever had in my 43 years on earth.  WOW!!!!!  I have been sitting here for 25 minutes waiting for a drinks that does not even include the food we ordered.  I get it's an airport establishment, but if you are going to put your name on something that should carry some weight.  All Michael is doing with that place is running his name through the mud.

We checked in and left to check out the town and gambled till 3:20am. Came back to our room and find our 2 pillows were stained (see photo) I called front desk to have someone replace the pillowcases or give us another 2 pillows. Whichever is easier because we were super tired and it's already early morning the front desk said she will send someone up. My fiancé finished showering and no one came. Until next day still no follow up. So I asked the housekeeper to change everything the next day and she did. I was happy thank you Housekeeping lady.

Definitely one of my favorite quick lunch spots. The steam table options are the go-to, coconut curry chicken, basil chicken, stir fried tofu, sweet and sour chicken on either pad thai or fried rice for only $6 (cash only) It's a steal and it's filling. On of the best pad thai!

Worst IHOP I have ever been to. Showed up only one set of guest in the restaurant. Still took over 5 minutes to be seated because the lady working was sitting in the far back of the restaurant with a Male friend with her back to the door. After ordering food our waiter Tyler b  disappeared. We could see from our seat that our food was in the window but no server to be found and other lady still sitting with her Male friend. After about 4 min or so I started a timer on my phone. The lady sitting talking to the man got up and came to the door because some other guest showed up. She sat them down. She walked by are food 4 or 5 times and never picked it up. 8 minutes went by on my phone stop watch before she picked up our food still with no sing of our waiter again. She brings the food to the table. And the pancake order was completely wrong. She said she would have it fixed. So we are our other food while waiting. Our server finally showed back up and walks by the kitchen . Cook said here is your on the fly order. His words it will have to wait. He goes and takes the order from the other guest that came in and rings in the computer ignoring the food order he put in wrong. He goes to the kitchen talks to the cook for a few min then grabs the food. At this time my pancakes have been sitting in the window for over 5 min. Of course they where cold. While eating cold pancakes the cook starts yelling out the kitchen for Tyler . He says you have to wait so she yells from the kitchen  we are out of Hamburg buns. He goes the the guest he took the oder from and says sorry we out out of buns but we will still make it but with no bun. Really  the guy starts to complain about this is the second time that has happened. So we go to leave and have to wait to pay as the lady working is back sitting with the man in the back. Timmer in hand we wait 7 minutes for the server to finally come ring us up so we could leave this horrible nightmare behind us. This is the reason IHOP is declining service like this. I am in the hospitality business and know what to expect and this was not it at all. Complete lack of supervision of employees and employees that have no clue and dont care.

We made an appointment and then our consultant spent the whole time with a different group. We pulled our own dresses. She never introduced herself or tried to get to know us. She came up at the very end after we found a mother dress to make the sale. Very disappointing and terrible service.
I've been to a few classes now and in love. Great instructors and a very open, calming space. The groupon offer has been great and I will definitely be continuing to go!

The first time I came here was by happenstance. I had went to another salon and was told it was going to be over an hour wait and they had just opened. On my way back home I noticed this salon so I stopped in. 

I've been going back every 2-4 weeks for almost a year now. I have never had a bad experience here and I recommend them to everyone. I've had everything from dipped nails to acrylic nails, pink and white, gel and colored acrylic. 

My nails look amazing every time. I get more compliments on my nails from here than any other salon I've been to.
Thank you so much for taking the time to help me fix my glasses, I cannot work w/o them!

This is a great little hidden gem of a coffee house. Coffee is great, I know how to Steep tea to give it the perfect flavor, to music choices are very welcome mean if you need to get some work done and Blake and 'Mark are two really awesome guys Taking care of you and to have a conversation with. If you're in or passing through downtown Clearwater you owe it to yourself to check it out!

Excellent choice for dinner tonight.  Sat inside and the smells were fantastic.  Went with three kids and had the short ribs Ragu,  bolognese pasta, pasta pyramid and the crab garganelli.  Appetizers of octopus and meatballs...the grilled octopus was absolutely amazing; highly recommend it.  For me the pasta pyramid and the ragu were the beat of the dishes. 

The place is a little loud, but the staff made us feel very welcomed and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for great Italian food!

Pizza Pie Cafe is located in a rather spontaneous spot in a strip mall right near the highway off Broadway Avenue. It boasts very little attention to itself. But, this may not be the kind of place you want to miss.

If you've ever been to a Primo's, or (if you're local) to an Idaho Pizza Company, you're probably familiar with an all-you-can-eat buffet of pizza. That's exactly what you have here at PPC. However, the buffet also includes pasta, which is a bit out of the ordinary. Not to mention dessert pizza (yum). The price is pretty good for a buffet. PizzaKen and I paid $18-ish for the two of us (and I scored a free drink off our Yelp check-in, ha). That's $9 a person, I guess. I went to Chuck-a-Rama earlier last week and that was $17 a person, so that's pretty good. Again, you're getting pizza and pasta with this one.

So, how's the pizza?

It's...good. As good as you can expect. The slices are cut a bit small, but, that's to be expected. They really love their oregano here.

I can't really break down their slices by type because it's just grab what looks good. The pepperonis are cooked correctly, the ingredients exist. It's nothing great but it's nothing bad neither.

The thing about PPC that sets it above Primo's in my book is not only the nice price, but the atmosphere. I really loved the interior design and look of the place. Very open, very chrome. Something about it spoke to me and it felt easy and welcoming to be there. I couldn't tell you why.

The oreo dessert pizza is a must-have, by the way.

-The Verdict-
Wanna have a LOT of pizza (or pasta) that is good? Try out Pizza Pie Cafe. Do you REALLY love oregano as a seasoning? I'd also highly recommend the cafe.

The pizza really kinda feels like a 2 out of 5, but for the price, quantity of piz available, and the pleasant atmosphere, we decided the overall experience was a step above the pizza on its own.

3 slices out of 5

Eat here while on a business trip.  Cool vibe. Eat the halibut fish and chips and it was moist and delicious. Also had a dozen oysters that we shared as a table group. After flying for double digit hours to Boise it was nice to sit and have a good meal with friends. Atmosphere was hip and the place was a cool place to have dinner and drinks

Fair is fair come check this place out to see what you think. Located near the Grove hotel where the Steelhead Hockey arena is.

Horrible experience . Shame on me for not leaving when the over powering smell of seafood hit me upon opening the door. Drinks were lousy ~ watered down is my guess. Sherry Our waitress was awful . My husband asked for more tarter sauce. She went to get it and stood shooting the breeze and drinking a beverage in the kitchen instead of getting it and bringing. Downside of sitting near kitchen door. I watched two other girls eat, drink and redo their hair while standing in the kitchen. My husband had to ask another server to get it after a 5/10 minute wait.
