I was in a hurry to an appointment and I finally said, "I know what I want, I'm ready to order"- the manager said "well there's a line" and I feel like by keeping me waiting, that could have been handled better, if someone else took my order, but alas, the service was slow again...

I hope that they can hire more people and that they can have a better, more efficient customer service experience.  It's a cute cafe with good potential.

Just picked up my food from here and didn't even make it out of the parking lot without having to stop and try a little of everything. This maybe the best brisket I've ever had. No other way to describe it. The wings were recommended and are so good! Both the wings and pork ribs are fall off the bone tender. The cornbread is perfect too. Don't sleep on this place, this is some of the best BBQ I've had. I was only there briefly picking up the order but everyone was incredibly welcoming!
This place is incredibly slow. No car should be waiting at the order speaker for 15 minutes. Unacceptable.

This is one of my favorite restaurants and have heard many people call this place their favorite restaurant around the city. The ambience is very dim and romantic. It is a bit loud but that just adds to the social aspect, every table was booked. The food was spectacular. You must try the edamame dumplings and the shanghai lobster. Both are extremely delicious. The lamb chops were also very good besides it being just a tad bit too saucy. Honestly all of their food was just great. Would definitely come here again!

I loved Tijuana Flats until today
 I work at  Freedom Mortgage down the road from the restaurant. I've missed getting lunch from there so much that I drove from Sunnyside Rd  out east to get my  favorite Blackened Chicken  Chimichanga. So I get back home and started eating the queso and I was absolutely starving  and had to get on a zoom call so I dipped my chip in the queso and it was very salty but like I said I was starving and had to get on my call so wasn't able to eat the Chimichanga until after the call. Once I g ok got off the call I ran to my Chimichanga and lo and behold it was just as salty as the queso. So I call and speak to one of the owners the lady and I tell her and all s she says to me is thanks for letting me know. As I told her I eaten there often and it's never been that way again she says thanks for letting me know she didn't offer to replace it or any type of resolution just thanks for letting me know 
I wonder what she would have said if I was white...uhm and yes she knew I was black just like I could tell she was white. I just know when we are back to work at Freedom Mortgage Tijuana Flats will be cut from my lunch options

Don't waste your time.   You'll get stranded in the drive thru for 30 minutes or more and you won't be able leave until the cars behind you finally give up and leave.   Employees stand in the back of the building and complain within earshot.  I decided to give this place a second chance and it was the same scenario.  It's a shame.   I love Steak and Shake but I won't be back to this one.

Our last meal (lunch) in NOLA and we decided on Welty's again!
Welty's Deli hasn't changed much...it's good as ever! Don't Change!
Tina was manning the front and Donald was in back, working his magic but came out to say "where y'at".
This time I had the Welty Melty special, hamburger patty w/cheese panini with a side of potato salad. She had the roast beef au jus with Zapps chips. Both were very tasty, fresh and good. Btw, Tina was kind enough to offer us a plate of sweets (cookies & pecan brownie) to go with our delicious meal (we love the oatmeal raisin cookie!). She also knows most of her customers and finds time to chat and check each table...nice friendly southern hospitality!
We feel Welty's is excellent for tasty fresh food, generous portions with very good prices and service. There are many good and different restaurants in NOLA but you can't go wrong by dining at Welty's Deli!
Oh, like last time, we also ordered their famous AK sandwich to go for our plane trip home. It was so well packaged, huge and delicious that we'll need to review it separately!

Everything I have had here is absolutely delicious, the atmosphere is cozy, the servers are friendly and make good recommendations...some of my coworkers didn't know this place existed when I suggested checking it out, and now we go every week!

So far I can safely recommend the burgers, biscuits and gravy, tenderloin sandwich, mozzarella sticks, shrimp po boy, french dip sandwich, LOX, fried potatoes, the fries, the chips, and grilled cheese.  I get something new every time I go since everything's been great so far.

Dr. Bianco and his staff have taken care of our dogs for over 20 years. I would not trust another vet to provide the same courteous and professional service. He has given excellent care to all of our pets, and he has always taken special time with each one of our dogs to ensure us they are being treated with the best possible care. I don't know about pricing because when it comes to my pets I don't care how much it cost as long as they receive what they need to be healthy and happy.

This place has such a fun atmosphere and decoration. Large outdoor seating for now since Covid, hopefully we can keep the space sitting on the street has allowed. Plenty of good wines to choose from, and their cocktails are tasty too. However, I don't need the goofy table side cart to watch my server essentially make my drink, it seems harder for them and unnecessary when there is probably plenty else to get done for them (it's always busy). 

Some rotating plates which makes it fun to keep going back. Jamon and Manchego croquetas are one of my faves, along with the meatballs. Very tasy bread. 

Honestly I could just go here for wine, meat, and cheese. I have gotten the large plates a couple of times before and honestly I think it is a better experience to stick with meat, cheese, and tappas. Connor, is my favorite server here. 

Another staple on my passyunk bar hop.

Good restaurant.. I like the way how you choose your sushi.. it a menu and you cross which one you want. Plus you can have suggestion. The waiters was good nothing else to say. We first order the tempura shrimp and I was disappointed because it's come with 3 fried shrimp only and all the rest is vegetable (seriously ?) but the gyoza was super good ! I seriously recommend the Geneva sushi roll super good !

I have struggled to find a nail place for years since I moved to Tucson. Then I decided to try this place, and I haven't tried any other place since. They are always so attentive, and if they are running behind they always check in on you and let you know where they are at. They do amazing work!

Looking for a seat by the water?!  Look no further than here. The menu  can be overwhelming as the options seem endless but when you want fresh seafood, you will go to the ends of Earth to find it. 

I ordered the Captain's platter to allow myself to try more than one seafood option. Very nice portion. The Seabass was flaky and flavorful with decent size shrimp. I was not a fan of the crab cakes as they didn't have enough seasoning for my liking but very attractive. The grits were definitely the worse part. I consider myself a grit connoisseur and this tasted like powdered mush. It consistency reminded me of the flake imitation mashed potatoes. Eeek. Hard pass on those. The Broccoli was cooked just the way I like it.

Even while skipping the cheese grits, I would at least put them on the radar of seafood options. Atmosphere is nice and the seafood didn't disappoint. I actually didn't feel guilty about cheating on my summer body goals. Check them out...I bet the fried options are really good.

BEWARE!
1 (855) 626-8585.
Copy it, because you'll be searching for that number, while you wait for the ghost bus that is destroying your day and plans.

I have used the FLIX bus four times.  
Sure, it's way cleaner than the greyhound, and doesn't smell of funk.  
You get intermittent wifi for your trip, and they usually are only 1-4 times as expensive as their quotes.  
They surge their prices, by the way, and i have heard, that each bus driver can decide if they want to drive a bus, based on how many passengers they will be paid for, kind of uber style, i guess... 

They pick you up... (MAYBE... more on that in a sec) at the UofA and on Speedway and the Freeway at the AMPM.

Two of the four times i have used FLIX, they were over 45 minutes late.  When finally picked up, the driver will look directly through you, and not acknowledge anything was wrong at all.  Never offering an apology or reason, or... anything.  I saw people miss flights.  I saw people miss appointments... I saw people tired, and once, pretty cold.  

The app said, the ENTIRE time, that the bus was on schedule.

The third time i used it, it came AND left, that same half hour early. 
That time, when we got to the AMPM in Tucson, the driver just told a man, who was waiting for his daughter, that she would be able to pay for another bus, since she had missed her scheduled bus, and though he couldn't tell him when that next bus would be, she MIGHT just be on it, and he was super sure that probably another bus was coming, that night.  It was pretty late, by that time.   

The fourth, and the last... The FLIX bus just never came at all.  
App said bus was on schedule.  When i called, along side, the other seven people, calling, we were told in a prim, lovely accented voice, that 

"Lately, we have beeen answeriing the phoone in thiertee fieve mienutes." 

They did not.  Answer in thirty five minutes.  Or ever.  
Or respond to my email or my request for a refund.  
At all.  

At the time when the bus was an hour and twenty nine minutes late, i called Arizona Shuttle, or Groome, as it is now called.  They were leaving the UofA Wildcat metra on 6th, and took my reservation as i ran full track racer, from the FLIX pick up to the market.  Another girl was sobbing, as she was going to miss her flight, from Skyharbor.  I dragged her with me, and when we arrived, the driver was loading up.  He allowed the other girl to board and pay with her credit card, on the way, so that we would both have a better chance to get where we were going on time.  

Seriously, it doesn't really matter if the bus is clean, you can get on social media or charge your phone, if YOU MISS A FLIGHT... or something else.  

It's been several days, and all i got for my $30 supposed ride from Tucson to Phoenix, are crickets chirping, a darn good sprint, and reason to believe that i could maybe win, at the reality show, The Amazing Race.

I'm just adding to the chorus of praise because, like other reviewers, I've had such great experiences. We moved here several months ago, and, based on my experiences in other states, I was dreading the necessary trip to the DMV, or BMV as it's called in Indiana. However, the lovely folks at this branch made for such a nice experience that it felt like an alternate universe. There were friendly, competent, and efficient - and even had a great sense of humor. We had to make a couple of trips to get our driver's license and license plates changed over, and both visits were pleasant, painless, and surprisingly quick. Three cheers for this BMV branch!

I have to assume that Goozy stands for Gooey and Oozy, because that amply describes the status of their delicious sandwiches. I took my son yesterday, and our lunch chest were so yummy. I got the BLTC - imagine a perfect BLT enhanced by melty cheddar. My son had an ooey gooey turkey melt. It was a big sandwich for a little kid so we took some home, but it was delicious. 

We just had waters yesterday, but in the past I've had one of their creamy shakes, and what a "Goozy" treat it was! 

Staff here is nice, the food is consistently tasty - it's a welcome spot in the food wasteland known as green hills Mall. That said, two notes: 1) it's a bit pricey. For very good sandwiches that come with a bag of chips, I'm obviously willing to pay for them, but everything seems a tad more expensive than needed. If nothing else, I hope Goozy doesn't raise prices - it would make a quick simple lunch less desirable there. 2) the seating situation isn't ideal. There are a few tables but that's it. It's not quite a food court, but if the tables are full you don't have a lot of options except to take your schedule over to the Nordstrom area and hope for seating there. I'd rather see fewer luxury vehicles parked in front of Goozy so more seating could be there.

Otherwise, a perfect spot for a quick bite during retail therapy!

We've been here three times. Once for dinner with friends, twice for breakfast. Dinner was excruciatingly loud, the meal was ok, but not very inspired. 

Breakfast has been a hit for my wife once, a miss the second time. Both of my breakfast experiences have been the same - room temp meal accompanied by potatoes that have been sitting on the flat top way too long. The wait staff spend more time in the kitchen talking to each other than they spend doing their jobs. 

I'm sorry to be so direct - but our waiter never checked on us after serving our meals... not an offer of more coffee nor an inquiry into how our meal was... after finishing our meal - and 10 minutes of looking at our dishes - we had to get up and ask for our check... and still nobody asked how our meal was. 

$25 for breakfast for two is fine but one should expect basic service. It will be a long time before we give it another chance. 

That being said - your experience may vary - hopefully it will be a better experience than ours.

Primera vez comiendo en este restaurante y no será la última. Ordene tacos de carne, puerco, pescado y una quesadilla de carne. Todo estaba riquísimo y los tacos tienen un tamaño considerable teniendo en cuenta su precio. Quede encantada y con una sonrisa en la cara luego de comerlos, lo único que mejoraría es la cantidad de sal, un poquito salado para mi gusto.
También quiero destacar lo fácil que fue ordenar por su página en Internet y lo rápido que estuvo el pedido, todo fresco y caliente.

Talk about an experience. half the time I end up coming here it's with a band who have absolutely no idea what kind of crowd their getting ready to play in front of. after all it's a frathouse so you can expect the usual meatheaded drunken idiots who could put a huge damper on an otherwise good show.
But by the end of the night the bands have a good time, and Pi Lam really does offer a good alternate concert viewing experience. they try and give a lot of different musicians a shot. and for a frathouse it does offer pretty good sound and a damn good stage.

There are a lot of choices for sandwiches in Saint Louis.  Your conversation for great lunch stops all begin AFTER Carl's Deli.  This is an old school cool meat eater's joint.  There is no fluff at this small shop across the street from St. Mary's hospital.  A quick line will form at lunch time and the brash, but totally professional sandwich jockeys will assemble the your meal in seconds.  
The pastrami sandwich will change everything you ever thought about deli meats.  The corned beef will make you re-think your drive on the home through Clayton.  
The restaurant serves Billy Goat chips and Fitz's soda.  Plenty of other  kosher options available.  The shop itself is a neat experience.  
For under $10, a person can leave with a wonderful sandwich so large it may take two to finish, a bag of chips, and a bottle of pop.
All other delis  are playing catch up.

I had heard great things about this place, but left disappointed after dinner here. The environment was very cool and the fireplace at the table was a nice touch on a chilly night. The appetizers were tasty but a bit pricy, I would have appreciated more pita bread too. Unfortunately, the rest of our dinner was underwhelming.

First, the service was quite slow. Our table was not ready when we arrived for our reservation, it took around 10 minutes past our scheduled time to be seated, which was unpleasant considering the chilly weather. You wait for your table at the bottom of a set of stairs on the sidewalk in a very unorganized manner. People who arrived after us were given a table before we were because there was no clear line out front. Our waitress was quite friendly but it took forever for her to come to our table at the start of the meal. When we finally received water after 10 minutes, the waiter didn't even pour it into our glasses, just placed a bottle without ice on the table and rarely refilled it. There are of course many restaurants that do something similar, but the prices suggest this is a high-end restaurant, so I would've expected the service to be better. Our food also took a while, it seemed like the restaurant was very understaffed as everything just moved very slowly all night. 

The next issue was with the menu. They have a relatively small menu to begin with which wouldn't be an issue normally. However, on the night we visited, they were all out of at least half of their 8-10 entrees. I believe there were only 4 dishes to choose from, which is frankly unacceptable. They somehow didn't have any kebabs, which was puzzling considering we could order a lemon chicken dish, but not a chicken kebab (was it a skewer shortage?). Anyways, I have never been to a restaurant that was all out of half of their menu on a typical Sunday night. Our waitress was apologetic but many members of our party had to settle for a dish that they were not very excited about. 

I ordered the Lemon Chicken. The chicken was alright but was absolutely drenched in buttery lemon sauce. The sauce was overwhelming, but would have been tasty if they used a lesser quantity. The other issue with the chicken was the knife actually. This knife had no serrated edge, thus it was extremely dull. Cutting through even a chicken breast was extremely challenging. I would have honestly preferred a plastic knife. I'm not sure why they decided to provide knives that couldn't cut through butter, but at least the children at our table didn't stab themselves? Again I have never been to a restaurant that provided knives like these to adult customers, it was very confusing.

Other members of our party ordered the Mixed Shawarma and complained of it being extremely dry. Between the soaked chicken and the dry shawarma, it certainly seemed like the restaurant needs to reconsider their sauce distribution. Anyways, the sides of salad and french fries were both tasty. Based on the positive reviews, I am sure that the kebabs and other unavailable dishes are quite tasty, it would have been nice to try those.

Zaytoon showed some promise, and I might consider giving it a second chance. But the issues with the service, food, menu, and knives would make me very hesitant to do so.

The drink specials are pretty good but the food can be iffy. I live close by and Tattooed Mom is my favorite bar on South St, Manny Brown's is my second favorite​. There isn't much on the menu for vegetarians, especially vegans. 

The staff is welcoming and energetic, the drinks are good! Would recommend when watching sports.

Tried to call the store on Sunday to find some paw patrol buckets for my baby bday. Some guy answers the phone with an attitude and kept me holding for ELEVEN MINUTES.... this really boiled my blood right? So finally a nice lady name Melinda picks up and she got me calm and went out of her way to get me what I was looking for. Thank you Melinda I give you stars but the other dude... well he don't deserve anything!!

Monica kept us entertained and well-served during our week in the French Quarter. A great little pub just off Bourbon Street - so, close enough to the action, but also far enough away that you can actually enjoy a drink. They've got a great little juke box and a wide selection of adult beverages, but Monica kept us coming back. Thank you, Monica, and enjoy that speed opener in good health. ;)

After visiting friends at Barnes Hospital we found this cafe to eat a late breakfast. Wow! The atmosphere was friendly and welcoming and the food was delicious. We even had time to explore the 17th floor skyway for a view of the city! Can't recommend it enough. I had the Tex mex omelette.

The burritos and quesadillas are solid. First experience was 5 star, second was 1 star. They need to sort out some workflow issues. Part of the reason Chipotle works so well is the simplicity of menu options and choices. Freebirds has more topping choices--perhaps similar to Moe's--but the workflow seems very inefficient. There are too many cooks in the kitchen relative to the people in the restaurant. With high staffing levels, you would think that the line with the fast and customers will be happy. Perhaps it is because it is new or the workers are new. Hopefully it evolves.

As a comic novice, I was able to get sound advice from Ray, about a collection I needed to sell for my brother. Ray was patient with me and gave me solid advice, I would highly recommend him and this store!

So this review is long overdue, but I cannot emphasize enough how enjoyable the experience was at Peluso's! I was in a bit of a rush when I got there but recognized I would likely have to wait for a bit considering this wasn't anything like a Little Caesers but it actually wasn't that long of a wait; the pizza tastes authentic and the employees were all super nice! TLDR: The pizza was great, the price was right, and the employees were really cool :)

We ordered a two meat plate and some wings. They were out of ribs at 8:20 on a Saturday night. Wings came out hot, plump, moist  and tastey. Both the pulled pork and  brisket were well smoked and very good as were the sides. The portions, however left something to be desired. That includes the sides. At least fill the small styrofoam cup. Maybe they were running out of those meats too. We will give them another shot but not a four or four and a half star experience this time.

The BEST coffee in St. Pete - especially the pour overs. They brew super fresh-roasted Metropolitan (one of the best from Chicago). The friendliest staff. Always open when I hope they will be. And a good place to work.
Response time seemed about under 10 minutes and gentleman operator very helpful and sympathetic. Professional guy. Glad we got a friendly person during such a traumatic event.

So hibachi is always fun for dinner and special occasions or group outings but this one was just okay. Maybe Benihana was overhyped for me a bit. Our 'chef' was not very enthusiastic which made our table vibe pretty mellow. Also, we were there for a birthday and had specifically asked for a fun show so we're kinda let down. 
As for the food, other smaller hibachi places definitely give you more portion-wise. I was expecting more food for the price. Also, my salmon was overcooked so I wouldn't order hibachi salmon again. The noodles were also very salty. My husband liked his spicy hibachi chicken tho. 
I would def recommend making reservations. The place was packed on a Saturday night and waits without reservations were about an hour.

The good thing about having a bike at work is that I'm not confined to the greater Rittenhouse Square area for lunch anymore. Even though most of my favorite's are in Rittenhouse, it helps to feel a little free. Today, for example, I thought I'd enjoy a warm bike ride to Chinatown to try what QT has to offer. When I worked in Market East, I remember walking by QT when it first opened and being intrigued by the idea of bahn mi, but the shop looked a little bare and beat. It is quite the opposite today. It is bright and pretty lively. The service is fast and super friendly, also.

I ordered a lemongrass tofu hoagie. The roll was crusty outside, soft inside, and not too doughy in the middle. The lemongrass wasn't overpowering, which I appreciated, but it was definitely presen in the tofu. I asked for just a few jalepenos (the fact that they ask earns bonus points) and they were delicious but crazy hot since the seeds are left in the slices. I am full after my sandwich, but I feel like it was somewhat healthy, right?

On my way down Filbert St., I saw a guy throw a crumpled up napkin at a couple of pigeons for no reason while he was walking down the sidewalk. Littering is like breathing in Market East, but it was a particularly angry gesture. I rode by and I'm pretty sure he tried to spit in the direction of my bike and MISSED. Just like how he missed the pigeons. Because they're birds and they can fly. I was annoyed, although not surprised, and after I picked up my inexpensive and somewhat substantial sandwich and hopped back on my bike to trek back to my office where I sit in an ergonomic chair while Dr. Litterbug aimlessly wanders around the bus station for the rest of forever, I felt much better about everything in this world. Worth it, worth it, worth it.

I'm not sure where all the bad reviews are about. I've had nothing but good service and great food in at least 10 trips to this restaurant. I've been there for both brunch and dinners and loved them both. It's not going to be the cheapest meal but besides that I don't know what there is not to like. I wouldn't recommend leaving without dessert.

The workers were so sweet as soon as I stepped in to the Deli. It was just positive vibes everywhere and they brought the food outside when it was ready. 

Good service and good food that didn't make my stomach hurt. I would come here again
Dirty, trance music playingx smelled slightly of bad meat or good cheese: neither of which was being served. Crappy all around

Horrible experience. We booked jet ski and we had to wait for 3 hours. At the end they told us the jet ski does not work. The people who work are unorganized and do not care about customers
I definitely advice you not to go there

Like going here better than costco. Yes I know, costco has different brands and other charm about it. However, I can get everything I need and can be in and out if SAMs club in 1/2 the time. I like buying paper products for the home in bulk here. Also, great discounts on gas!

After being disappointed for the recent closing of Big Lots right off Bush Blvd, A friend of mine told me about this one around Florida Ave intersection. They have big selection of almost everything at low price, which what you expect from Big Lots. I was impressed because they carry big variety of organic and gluten free soup, at least half price from grocery stores.
Best burgers in Nashville. Get there early, as the wait times climb into the stratosphere as the evenings progress.

Peluso's Apizza is good.  I'm stoked that it's super close to my house and that they usually cook the dough until crispy.  Thank goodness there is finally good pizza that comes out of that building!  Their wings are decent too!  Would love to see some good salads, that would be the cherry on top, a great spring mix salad close by!

I'm a bigger fan now, 4 years after being the first reviewer, now as a breakfast customer. I'm thankful they're still here so I could re-assess. The salmon cakes are crispy outside, soft inside, and delicately flavored. Two pancakes will fill you up. The hash browns are an interesting reformatting of tater tots, seasoned well and crumbled. 

This is a spot where people seem to come often, if not daily, though I don't feel excluded.

My only warning: You will walk out with your clothes smelling like something fried. It's a great reminder of what you had, but be sure you're not going to a formal event after.

I've never had a bad experience at Yard House and I've been here every time of day. Had the day off so I figured I'd come for a late lunch with two friends. There were plenty of open seats around 2pm at the bar. In no time at all, I was handed a food menu and beer menu. I ordered the turkey sandwich with a pint of Evil Genius Stacey's Mom (IPA) - delicious. Fries were hot and crispy. Happy Hour has some great apps and beer/cocktail deals.

We were in the area and wanted a quick, yummy, non-fast food lunch.

Einstein Brothers offered us everything we wanted.  I as able to have a breakfast wrap that was very tasty and my husband had a reuben he was pretty happy with.  

I have to say the selection was better than I've had at that other bagel place :)  The staff was friendly and the food was made quickly!  It was just what we were looking for and we will return.

Marketing a lie of being a prime spot to see and hear the bands and singers of the 4th is not possible from even the $6000 seats or even the $3000 seats so of course standing and leaning against the wall for $25 dollars will only get you pissed off but happy you weren't stupid enough to waste as much money as the other misled by the media blitz.
I love Halloween.  Busch Gardens doesn't decorate like Universal Studios does but it was fun.  I'd go again.

I agree with dave, its right in the heart of Chinatown. Really great people, they'll even park your car if you arent sure how to do it. Prices vary with events and so forth. Plus they have phonecards and an ATM right there on site.
Go to happy hour. Enjoy some small plates. Rejoice in the cocktail selection. This place was a classy, fun time.

I love this place the staff is always friendly, but the place is cold in the winter time . I always go with my fiancé and we both get a slice and 30 winglets. The cheese pizza is delicious and the crust is amazing. The wings are fried perfectly

The restaurant has a nice family oriented seaside feel to it. The peel and eat shrimp were awesome and they were not the cheesy and cheap small shrimp either. The shrimp were a good size bite or more. My server Michelle was attentive and helpful, especially with helping out with my dietary restrictions. Great service and food!
Love this place.  they let you sample all the yogurt you want!!  Love the toppings bar too!

just tried their pizza.  very impressed and happy with it.  my wife and I are trying to decide if its the best in the area.  the fact that it enters into that conversation and has been open for a very short time is a very good thing. the things that stand out to me are the obvious quality of ingredients, and the seasoning. It tastes phenomenal.  and that has to do with seasoning. very happy and will absolutely be headed back for more pies.

Have you ever wondered what a true southern plantation looked like (slave cabins, etc)?  Then this is the place for you.  We really weren't interested in the tour, we just wanted to look.  We walked around the house, checked out the slave housing and the smoke house.  We spent about 15 minutes here.
Went to Lester's to grab a bite to eat and watch the Kentucky Derby.  Had a good time with a bunch of friends!  The food was just OK...

I went for Happy Hour and I had an overall good experience. I was promptly seated, my food was brought out quickly, and my water was never empty for more than a minute (and I drink a lot of water).

I ordered the pulled-pork sliders (2) and the chicken wings. The sliders had great flavor, but even for sliders they were pretty small. The wings were pretty good; they were medium-sized, filled up the plate but more on the dry side. 

Considering that my buddy and I were able to get 2 appetizers each and a beer for only $25. I would definitely visit again.

We are here from Phoenix and wanted to take the grandkids horseback riding. I chose Pantano. The youngest child was a little apprehensive about riding alone but we were told they don't like to ride double. Our guide, Alicia, was great, confident,interacting all thru the ride and assured our 6 year old would be completely safe, as she was. She loved it!! So did our 12 year old grandau and her friend. Hubby liked the military discount they give. I went along just to be with them but it wasn't too bad. Dusty but eh, so what - its Tucson!! This was the highlight of the whole trip. Girls love horses!They are already talking about coming back.

If you haven't been here in awhile, give it a go!  Just this week, they introduced a new menu and a new executive chef - the guy from the Blue Duck.  We stopped in to try it out since the posts on Facebook sounded yummy.  The food was awesome!  It would definitely be a 5 star rating except that they are still working out some kitchen kinks and we had to wait awhile for the food to come out.  But at least it was worth the wait!  We'll definitely be back to try the other menu offerings like the pulled pork egg rolls and the funnel cake.  Hoping I can up this rating to a 5 star!

Disappointing after two breakfasts and a dinner I won't go back- service fair to mediocre and twice the omelet was rubbery. Nothing special compared to our first brunch at Sabrina's in the Italian Market

DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND TREAT YO SELF. This ramen is so legit and flavorful. Get the tonkatsu ramen and get it spicy! We're from out of town and found this joint on yelp as they're open late night. Would 10000% be frequenting this place if we lived here.
My favorite morning treat on cheat days! They had a text coupon available so my HOT original glazed was fresh and free! Can't beat that! Great start to the morning

I'm here in Tucson looking for a home, relocating from LA.  I stopped in here looking for a nice dinner after a lot of driving around in the heat.  I was looking forward to a delicious pastrami sandwich with potato salad.  

I was really disappointed when I took my first bite of the sandwich.  The pastrami was thick sliced instead of thin which made it tough.  The flavor of the pastrami itself was only mediocre.  Then, there was the rye bread itself.  A good rye bread has a hard crust.  This was mushy.

The potato salad was definitely not NY style.  It was pretty dull overall.  

So...  I am definitely not impressed with what I've seen so far.

This is historically a fun place to come on the St. Charles trolley for a cheap and tasty meal. This time the meal (pancakes) was still tasty but the service was pretty much nonexistent. We sat at the end of the counter and no one approached us for drinks or an order until my boyfriend flagged someone down. Our waiter (#519) barely made eye contact, didn't engage and pretty much made our short stay a disappointment. This place used to have a reputation for being fun and lively but the people working here today (and maybe in general, I don't know) just look like they hate their jobs. Maybe they do - dealing with tourists probably isn't fun. But damn, I'm happy to tip well for a job well done and it just wasn't here. At least the trolly ride was fun.

If you're used to typical spin classes, this a lot different. I couldn't get used to the way the bikes move with you. The Real Ryde bikes don't keep track of your speed or time or anything either - I prefer bikes that keep track of which gear you're on. The gym is also much less formal than I'm used to.
Always great food but closed on Sunday. I just got a large veggie pizza, it cost over $21. It was really good, but I'm not sure it was worth that much.
tried the chicken, pork meatball, and shrimp banh mi ...all were amazing....love the chili garlic mayo too....bread is perfect

Delicious food, interesting decor, entertainment and music. The guacamole was the best I ever had! The smoked salmon quesadilla was awesome. I would also recommend the heavily garlicky fish, so garlicky u can smell it! Yum. Overall wonderfully eclectic and yummy pina colada.
I don't get what the hype is about, its typical mass produced cafeteria food.

If you are into farm house decorations and ambiance then this is the place for you! Beautifully decorated, very clean kitchen (which you can see from dinning area), super friendly and helpful staff. I pre-ordered our meals ahead of time so I wouldn't have to seat for a long time with the kiddos, food came out quick, looking great and tasting delicious! Everything was very fresh. 

I asked the waiter if they had a microwave because I need it to warm my babies milk bottle, and he mentioned that they don't have in their kitchen any microwaves, deep fryers or heat lamps, everything comes out fresh and healthy out of their kitchen which was actually a good thing to hear even though I didn't get to warm up my baby's bottle! 

I would totally recommend this place and wish there was one close to our home!

Really happy with the work performed. Able to come out same day and work done before the day was over. Really clean work and great results. All debris cleaned up. Everyone here was so nice and personable. Totally recommend these guys.

Best breakfast burrito  I've had! We were on a weekend vacation and was looking for a nice place for breakfast burritos.  I wanted something quick and fresh. You choose what you would like. I had egg, avocado, bacon, mushrooms, spinach, potatoes , cheese. It was delicious and fresh tasting! Going back again this morning!

Solid beer choices and friendly staff. Atmosphere is decent as well. They have a good selection of beers. I have yet to try any food selections. It's in a plaza and does have some outside seating. But it's still a good place to stop and have a couple good beers and avoid huge crowds of other bars and breweries.
Gorgeous interior, friendly staff, delicious food. Parking is kind of hokey but we didn't mind walking a few blocks. Will Definitely go back!

Really nice upscale bar/restaurant. We only came for drinks and the fried sweet breads which were super tasty.  Fried Louisiana style and the sauce was very nice, just enough spice.

Drinks were pretty good, I had a moscow mule, which was pretty standard tasting, which works for me.

Stood in line for 20min mainly the fault of a group of 8 that did not know what the wanted to order only to sit for 40 minutes to find out that they did not know what happened to my order. I do know what happened though they gave it to another person who complained because his order was wrong after. Correcting his they then tried to give me the food they took from him. People say the chicken is good but I would not know because after waiting for almost an hour and them trying to give me food that been on another customers table I asked for a refund and left. I would hate to see this place when busy because there was not 20 people in the restaurant I will not be returning I'm a Hattie B's fan for life they can have a line out the door and around the block and they are faster and don't forget your order.

I was here for new years dinner, and they did not disappoint. I Ordered the  22oz churasco and it was delicious! 
Our waitress was a tad slow, but then again they were packed that night, as it was new years eve. So i wont hold that against her. 

If you're looking for wood grilled meat, this is the place!

This place is pretty damn good.

Came here a few times and have yet to be dissapointed. Arista with long hots is my go to.

Small space but I usually take my order to go. One of the best in philly.

We went out yesterday for a 2 hour ride. We were treated great and had a wonderful time. Our guide was Mandy, she couldn't have been more perfect for our skill level and interests. The entire suppport staff including the young gilrs who volunteer over there were all sweet and patient with us. I highly recommend this experience to anyone!
Great juke and Great Happy hour specials..... Perfect place to start the night's drinking.

The two girls that greeted us at the door told us it would be about 15 minute wait (no problem considering the time of Saturday). About 3 minutes another guy came and grabbed menus and sat us.  We ordered drinks, they didn't carry mine yet. My wife's wasn't like the description. Tasted more like like lemon flavored dishwater. The poor waiter (Spencer) was running around trying to take care of his tables. The person delivering the food wondered around, asked us and other tables a couple of times if these were our orders. Seems that it's unorganized. Spencer tried, and was a good waiter.

Last time I came ln was on Mother's Day came in today again at 1pm an the cook from my previous experience coming was there an forget to ask for his name I just know he has lips tattooed on him
I just love the way they treat me here
Gheghis grill rocks

Was in the area shopping and remember seeing this recommendation, so gave it a try.
Got the two recommended sandwiches, crispy chicken and brisket.   While we waited, they gave us a sample of bacon and jalapeno hush puppies.  They were the best I've ever had.
The sandwiches were excellent!  Chicken was crispy with a slight bit of heat.  Brisket sandwich was tasty and juicy.  The homemade chips were also excellent.  They were mini waffle cut chips with seasoning that was perfect.   Will definitely be back!

They have a great variety of cheeses that you can't find just anywhere.  They also have really good sandwiches, but they don't have very many, so get there early.  I always get mine grilled which makes it all that much better.

I came here for a private dinner.  We ordered tapas for 20-ish people for a solid two hours.  Everything that came back was delicious.  The staff was super nice.  I'm definitely coming back so I can dig deeper into their menu.

This place was INCREDIBLE! My kids had a GIANT sized club and finished the whole sandwich. I had a philly cheese steak sub and it was awesome! This place will definitely eat our new lunch spot after soccer games.

This place is great... While I wasn't sure what half of the stuff was, I tried everything during multiple visits... I usually stopped in for breakfast.. You gotta love the fact that the place is very clean, and everyone that worked there are exteremely friendly... I can't say that I ever had a bad meal there... Probably the most addicting thing there is the deep fried pork belly... They serve it with a side of hot green salsa, and a baked potato that had been rubbed with pork fat and salted completely.....

Great pedicure and service. This is coming from someone who really HATES getting pedicures because I'm very sensitive about my feet. The salon was clean and had an excellent nail color selection. The male nail technician who took care of me was gentle and really nice about re-touching my nails after I smudged two when I was walking towards the drying lamp table. I'll admit the price took me a little by surprise, but I would usually do my nails myself so I probably missed the increase in average pedicure rates. I was in a lurch because I'd missed an appointment at another salon, and this salon takes walk-ins so the convenience made up for the slightly higher price. And for the quality and service, definitely worth forking over the extra $5.

We went for breakfast and much like any restaurant, were offered water when we were seated.  As many have experienced when living in southern Arizona, water is always welcomed and typically 'free" unless otherwise indicated as bottled water.  The container they used was reusable and we were not told we would be charged.  I was surprised to see that each clear container of water provided was $7.00, I left that place with a charge of $14.00 listed as "Spring" on my check.  I would have rather had a mimosa.

Now, on to the food. People in my group ordered the steak and eggs and french toast. Both were beautifully presented and delicious. The steak was very tender and cooked perfectly to a medium well. The french toast was served with fresh fruit and creme freche. 

I may go back and try it again.

never a bad meal or bad experience.
its a bit smokey in there and it is a bit of a dive.

needs new bar stools!!!

but the food is good cafe/bar food.  service is friendly and so are the other patrons.

some recent updates include outlets under the bar for your laptop/smart phone which is great.  i heard under-bar coat hooks are coming for winter finally - yeah!
Delicious! Never had a snowball before but the cheesecake was an extra something special! Sno-La favorite was my fav.

This is probably the worst UPS Store I've ever been to. The manager is rude and the employees are incompetent. I went to drop off and they claimed my tracking number wouldn't scan. Then wanted to charge me $4 to reprint the tracking. The manager told me in exact quotes "That's not my problem" very rude man. If they tell you they can't scan the label and want to charge you $4 to reprint the label DO NOT DO IT. THIS IS A SCAM. They can put the label in manually by typing but they will refuse to make $4. I went to another UPS store and they entered it in manually no problem.

If I could give this review no stars I would. I originally placed an order with 1800flowers and then had to change the wording of the gift message. I emailed with the new wording, got a confirmation but it still wasn't changed on my account. Then I made other arrangements to get flowers elsewhere and emailed 3 times in one day to cancel my order. That still didn't work. Then I decided to call and speak to someone hoping that would get a supervisors attention. I was on the phone for 15 minutes and finally got my order cancelled. 15 minutes to cancel an order!!!!! That is unheard of. How hard is it to cancel and order. They didn't need a reason. They need to make their customers happy so that their customers will keep coming back to order more flowers with them. Not me! I'm going elsewhere for all of my flower needs. Never again with 1800flowers. They have lost a customer!
Amazing praline bacon!!!!! Super Gumbo!

Had the double cooked pork belly. The dish was pretty good but some of the pork pieces were overcooked and a bit harder to chew.  Drinks were good and the ambiance was good too.  I'd say this place was more fusion than Szechuan especially since the dishes weren't even all that spicy. Service was good and the staff was friendly (even late into the evening when I'm sure everyone wanted to just go home).

I expected a drive into a war zone the first time I went there but since it was a Sunday summer afternoon, it wasn't so bad - parked in the front - walked in -- applied for a card and went on my way to try my luck.  The security guy at the front was a sweetheart - and so helpful - he helped me play the large prize game screen when you get a card and the woman that gave me a card was super helpful and sweet.   The GUESTS were another story - 90% of them scared the hell out of me --- I don't know WHERE these people came from!?!?!?!?!   However, I hit $250 took it and left....   Went back one more time to take a little more money from them - this time, not so lucky - I still kept some of their money though.... however, the guests got even MORE strange --- not enough security - NOT NEARLY ENOUGH ---

7 years ago, this Location was the only place I was devoted to because of their fabulous colorist Eric, a talented hair magician. But he went into the military and my next attempt to have color done just did not work- Pumpkinhead is a movie, not a desired haircolor for me.
Fast forward to years later, and I'm much older- and look it. My hair is long, faded with a lot of outgrowth of my natural blonde-grey (now) hair and a lot of faded redness from my own at home dye attempts. This mop wasn't going to impress any potential new employers, so I had to act fast. I crossed my fingers, and they were able to fit me in. When I arrived, I was checked in by the woman who said she was playing receptionist and I tried to explain I wanted a color weave- darker overall with lighter caramel highlights. They explained the pricing and fully understanding that my hair is quite long now, I said, "Yes, please, let's do it. Please. Yes. Let's go." And so we did. Elysse (I hope that's spelled correctly)  went back to mix the color (and she had to use a LOT of color!). For a long time that seemed to pass very quickly because she was quite entertaining while she was painting- she painted and foiled and painted and painted some more. The color was rinsed, but it turned out the blonde parts were a little on the too blonde side and the dark was a bit darker than I expected (though it was wet, so that's not a good way to judge it.). She noticed before I did and almost immediately put a toner on to bring the blonde down a bit. About 15 minutes after that, I sat back in the chair while she trimmed and blew out my new hair. I have to say, it wasn't exactly what I expected, BUT it was better than I could have imagined. I thought the darkness would wash out my pale anemic face- but it actually seemed to take some of the tired and aged look away from the face I came in with. And as it dried, I found myself becoming more and more in love with my new hair. The highlights were even and not tooooo light, the dark was darker than I had anticipated- but it actually worked better than my first choice and I'm glad that Elysse made the suggestion. I walked out of the store with a new look, fantastic looking hair and a big smile. She was a very personable stylist, skilled and engaging and talented and because of her personality, it really turned my day around. I am thrilled with this look and I am looking forward to going back to her again when it needs a touch up or in case I feel like something different. There was zero disappointment and I am Grateful that my expectations or hopes were far exceeded!!!! I highly recommend this stylist.

First time eating at Casa Tina and the Enchiladas Salsa Rojo were excellent!Flavor was  California good!Sat at the bar and Ryan was awesome!If you've lived in Texas,California,New Mexico or Arizona,you know good Mexican and Casa Tina is that good..I will definitely be back!

Came here for a scheduled happy hour for my graduate school program. The place is dimly lit, the atmosphere is very pub-y, and the staff was super accommodating when I requested reservations earlier that day for our large party (15-20 people).

Our tables were already set up when we arrived. The happy hour special was decent, and the appetizers everyone had were really good. I really liked the fried pickles (and I'm super picky about fried pickles!). 

Our waitress was also a graduate student at another local school, in a similar program, and stayed to talk with us a while about our shared interests. It was really nice of her!

We'll surely be back for another happy hour in the future.

Love this place! Great Italian food with a variety of different sauces they specialize in making. Order a pasta with up to 3 different sauces! Love the marinara and blackened chicken (white sauce) the best.

All ice tea is unsweet but the have a unique way to make yours sweetened.... It is liquid sweetener in a syrup jar that you pour into your glass... Sweeten to taste.... Perfect!!

If you are new... Ask to sample the sauces! They used to bring them all to your table with bread to taste them..... Free appetizer! Not sure if they still do this any longer!
Great servers!

You can have a long wait if at dinner hour.  So be prepared... Worth it!!

Hands down the best Indian restaurant in Nashville and I've tried all of them. I've been eating Indian (more specifically Punjabi) food my entire life, so I would know :) you really can't go wrong with ANY dish here!

I am not a fan. However because of the location I normally run in here when I need small grocery items and I don't feel like going to Giants. The most annoying thing is that there is normally only one line item regardless of the time of day you visit the store. In addition, the cashiers normally have no priority to keep the line moving, as they sit in their chair and casually ring up the groceries. I've also found that the shelves normally are not organized, which makes it hard to shop. Also, they don't always have what I need so it is normally a hit or miss. The produce normally doesn't look fresh to me so I normally would not purchase any from here unless it was a one off and it looked good. You also have to pay for carts and bags which is another reason why I normally do not do serious shopping in here. However you can sometimes find deals and items cheaper than the larger grocery stores.

The last time I came the food tastes like it comes out of a can and today was not any better. Came for brunch and the grits had no taste. I got them because the potatoes where precut and not fresh. I returned them for the potatoes for the lesser of the 2 evils. I also had sliced tomatoes that had no flavor and taste like they were grown in water. My wife had a veggie omelet that was bland and generic. We will not come back again.

Quite good. Creative menu and OK ambience. I may have to say the dreaded term' for the area' there still is not a really fine Cajun place that I have found in West Chester/Phoenixvile. If only Cajun Kate at Booth's Corner was a real sit down...

I know that this Schnucks has a bad reputation, but I think the store has really improved.  It is the closest large grocery store for me, so I shop there frequently.  I am certainly not scared to shop there - I don't think it is scary, and it is a police substation, which is a good thing.  The baggers and checkers are friendly.  They have remodeled their produce section, and now it is a lot like Whole Foods with the green veggies/lettuces on shelves instead of in bins.  I find that the produce is usually fresh.   They now have the Full Circle line of organic foods and have a lot more vegetarian choices, although they still need to stock the Amy's line of vegetarian frozen foods.  They have more sample stations.  I think they have attempted to improve the store, and I think they have succeeded for the most part.   In fact, since they are now stocking more vegetarian/organic items, I do not feel the need to shop at Whole Foods very often, which saves me a lot of money!
I've been here to this location numerous times and have always had great service. Staff is very friendly and prompt and it's not to expensive.

Came here for breakfast - we laughed almost the whole way through wondering why the hotel concierge recommended this place. We Love diner style breakfast, the eggs and bacon combo and all that...but this breakfast was nothing above average...I could make this myself at home and probably better. The place is tiny and it doesnt look very tidy but we didnt care....the food is served on paper plates with plastic cups and plastic utencils...I've never seen this before. And we got two seperate bills, one for me and one for my fiance instead o putting it all on one, why would you do this? It was so medicore, the whole thing. The only good thing is that it was cheap.  I recommend this place only if you have a hangover the next morning and need food that is close by....dont go out of your way for it thats for sure. 

ONLY had breakfast food...maybe the lunch and dinner is better??

Acceptable for the money, the food at Lorenzo's is inexpensive, but it is not exceptional in any way.  I agree that the elderly lady working there could be a bit more gracious, but I might be ticked off as well if I were in my late 60s - early 70s and I still had to go into work most every day.  All in all, Lorenzo's will do in a pinch.
Not very good. The service is pretty bad. The food is very bland. Ordered chicken and sausage gumbo and red beans and rice. Not impressed. Don't waste your meal.

Anthony Wayne House was the second venue my fiance and I visited. As soon as we walked through the carriage house, we knew this was the place we HAD to get married at! This place has so much charm. It is beautiful! The brick house appeals to the historic part in me. The farm house tables are one of my favorite things, it give the venue another unique quality you don't always see. But, the overall backyard/ garden feel is what sold me. Anthony Wayne House is so intimate (even if we did invite 190 guests). There is plenty of room for the ceremony, cocktail hour, backyard games, fire pit, reception, and AWH tours. Nothing feels too close, everything has it's own space. We are even adding an outdoor lounge! I can't wait for my wedding next month, I know it is going to be a night to remember!
Had a great brunch here, classy place without being too stuffy. Like the proximity to the bay and sort off the path.
Fun downtown ale house with decent food and great atmosphere.  A regular spot for locals.

The best tacos in Tampa hands-down. This is the newest location for Lolis Mexican Cravings - Street Tacos they are currently in training but still training to make the best Mexican food in town. 
This is definitely the go to for delicious Mexican food in the area.

Have to say this dinner was enjoyable and the service was great.  A little historical on the restaurant was that it was in the 20% of the city that was not affected by Hurricane Katrina, but it was vandalized and looted during that time and required a complete renovation.  The jambalaya and the crab au gratin was sooo good.  Two Hurricane drinks and I was happy.  Downside is the inside is a little worn with a bit of a funky smell.

Short Story: Really bad customer service. 
Long story: I called in a couple weeks in advance to reserve my appointment and clearly mentioned that I need a loaner car, as I live an hour's drive away, and my servicing would need several hours. A few days before my appointment I receive a call saying my appointment has to be moved because the loaner car was booked by someone else! I agreed and pushed out my appointment by a week or so. A week goes by and I drive an hour after work to land up at the service center, only to be told that my appointment had already moved, as the loaner car was book by someone else again!! When I told them I was not informed, they mentioned they did not know how it got updated in the system.They mentioned they could not do anything to accommodate and I had to drive back an hour uselessly. Total waste of my time and extremely unprofessional work! I'll be servicing my vehicle elsewhere from now on.
Had a great Sunday brunch, fabulous cocktails..the gin mule is highly recommended.great good and atmosphere
Picked up 2 pizzas. An error on one of the pizzas but quickly rectified the error. Gave us the additional pizza at no charge. Pizza was delicious!

My co-workers and I order from here roughly 1-2 times a month.  Delivery can be very slow - up to an hour around lunch time.  They do allow you to substitute brown rice, which is always a bonus!  My favorite here is the Vegetable Fried Brown Rice add chicken.  It's a good price and the food is tasty.  My co-workers usually get one of the lunch specials - General Tsao's, Kung Pow, or Shrimp and Broccoli - and occasionally we'll share dumplings, egg rolls, or scallion pancakes (I refuse to call it Chinese Pizza - wtf?!).  The lunch specials look loaded with oil, the dumplings are sometimes doughy, and the fried appetizers are extremely oily...  But when you don't feel like leaving the office for lunch, it's a passable alternative.

GREAT PLACE!! 
My mom and I went there for my birthday. Our server was extremely nice and the food was delicious! Many places not offer free deserts anymore but when we mentioned   that it was my birthday, he brought me a piece of YUMMY cake with a candle and then took a picture of my mom with a Polaroid camera..Food was great and the bread is awesome! Great place
quality food at a cheap price!

Old review overdue. I like that this place has street parking that was easy for me. That was the only reason I went. Food was okay & a little creative since it is Chinese and Japanese combination, which I can do tummy wise. I kind of want to go back and try more. I forgot I even came here until I saw it on Yelp.
Big fan of the place and the man. A great fun place to eat.  Quality service and memorable times. Highly recommended.

Time for an update. We gave them a second chance, again mostly due to the convenience of being right next to the theatre. Either my last experience here was just a bad day, or they've really made an effort to improve.
We tried the "Fried bean curd with peanut and sesame sauce" and it was delicious! We also really enjoyed the "Double vegetarian delight" which was a mix of veggies and mock duck in a garlic soy sauce, fried up and served on a sizzling skillet. Definitely worth a try.
The service was attentive and friendly and our waters never went empty. Overall we had a very good experience and I would return again.

So this is what Chinese food tastes like... 

With over 70 of them already yelped, I am writing this review to agree with anyone else who gave a five star rating. Like many of you out there, I know diddly about Chinese eating (except that the rubbish I've had tends to make my plumbing work faster), so having Han himself order for my table meant I expected the best, and he didn't disappoint. 

A crew of 11 stopped in on a fairly busy Saturday night with bottles of wine in hand and began planning our orders; luckily, this is when the master himself stepped in. The Dynasty must have seen we were ordering enough grub to satisfy the first and second strings of a professional football team, so the friendly and patient fellow took over and made sure we were getting meals we would actually eat, at the proper spice range for the entire group to enjoy, and in the right amount so that we wouldn't be left with mounds of food on our Lazy Susan (that useful center piece entertained us all night). Here is a list of all the stellar dishes we got down on: 

(No description simply means it was absolutely great)
*Noodles in Sesame oil 
*Dan Dan noodles- Damn good, but nice and spicy too. I was sweating when finished..... just thinking about it makes me want more 
*2 orders of wantons in chili 
*Spicy crispy cucumbers- Spicy, yes, but cool and pallet refreshing as well... a nice way to break up the other hot stuff 
*Taiwanese sausages- a very good and sweet plate of sausage that i could have happily eaten all of myself 
*garlic sauced beef 
*Scallion chicken 
*Black bean chicken 
*?Chicken with dry pepper?- (I can't recall the name exactly, but it came from the popular last week portion of the menu) very good, it came breaded and seems as close as you can come to a general tso dish on the menu. A definite crowd pleaser as well 
*Some type of shrimp dish that never made it to me (because I don't eat sea life) 
*String beans with pork 

All diners were very pleased with all aspects of the night, especially when the bill came to under $20 each, tip included. 

The whole ordering things everyone could handle kept me from getting into the super hot entrees (I am looking at you dry pepper chicken and dry pot pork & rabbit, and possibly even the tripe), but it will happen. What also will happen are frequent missions to score me some Dan Dan to go; it was soooo good. 

*****Extra points given in rating for no urgent next day bathroom runs!!!!*****

Absolutely amazing food.
Has the beef cheeks .... to die for!
The only thing I didn't like was the size of the glass my juice came in...very small....I mean I am a big boy..
This cute little hangout place is one stop you need to take! Their foods range from sandwiches, paninis, bakery items, and many more! They are quick and have great prices!

This was the phattest burrito I've ever had and probably will be for some time. I don't even eat burritos, but I was feeling adventurous. If this Signature burrito wasn't so phat I'd be giving this place 2 stars. I'm really turned off by 2 things...

1. Happy hour (half off everything is from 3-5... or something) I get there at 5:30 and this is my first time there. I should've left then. Strike 1.

2. The drink prices are robbery. $2.20 for a Golden Peak iced tea. Really? I read in an earlier review that bottled water was $2.00. I would've been ghost on that strength, but it was a dollar for me. I ran with the water. Strike 2. They need more options. Get some aloe pomegranate! It's 2011!

Freshii doesn't get a strike 3 yet, because the burrito was HUSKY and had an interesting taste (read: sweet and cheesy). I couldn't even eat it all. And while I like this location, I probably won't be back unless I try a soup. I should've tried the soup.

This is a great place to chill any night of the week. I'm sure their lunch crowd is a happy group as well but I can't speak beyond that as I haven't tried them at lunchtime. Great beer selection and really good comfy casual food offerings are paired up with a really happy atmosphere. Bone Appetite.
The pizza as well as the service was great. I had the  porky fig gluten free pizza and it was delicious. A lot of interesting specialty pizzas to choose from.

As a die-hard carnivore, I had to try the mixed grill with 4 meat dishes at Chef Alisah's restaurant.  The restaurant is located on the ground floor of what looks like an apartment building, but the inside is nice and spacious, if a bit plain.  Chef Alisah himself came out and took our orders as it wasn't very crowded yet, and the wait wasn't too long until our mixed plate came.  A huge platter with sausages, beef patties, grilled chicken breast, steak, balls of seasoned rice, vegetables and pieces of bread came out.  Chef Alisah himself is very friendly and came out to our table multiple times and chatted with us and teased us about how slowly we were consuming our huge plate of meats.  Each piece of meat was juicy and delicious, but my favorite was probably the steak and sausages.  We had to take half of the meat home with us, so for $28 (2-person portion) you can get at least 2 full meals for 2 people.  Chef Alisah is friendly and attentive, the food is huge and delicious, well worth your money.

I know there have been some mixed reviews at this location but I had a big order for a party and everything was spot on and delicious. The service was great too. Hope this place stays in business.  P.s. love the diablo sandwiches.

I eat here all the time and everything I have tried here is great! Almost all of the food is made fresh in house, including the burgers which comprise of three different cuts of meat that they trim and grind everyday. The staff is extremely friendly!

Finally a good chineese food spot! They have some amazing walnut shrimp and everything was fresh. I typically do not like the soups but both Eggdrop and hot and sour where spot on. The pricing was not expensive and the place was packed for lunch. This is now my goto place!

Yikes this place is awful. If there wasn't live music I would have no stars if that was possible. 
I'll start with the positives: 
1) There is really good live music

Now for the negatives:
1) The food is not only amorphous, but also nearly tasteless. Everything is fried and breaded to a painful degree so that there is barely any meat left to taste. 
2) The food is ridiculously expensive for what you get. Sure, the portions are large, but they are 80% bread. $30 for a plate of fried food faintly resembling seafood is not my cup of tea.
3) The service is AWFUL!!!!!! It would take 30 minutes for the waitress to return with anything. That is not an exaggeration, and to eat a meal here took me 3 hours. 
4) The management are rude at best and everyone is difficult to work with. You can't keep a bar tab open while at a table, and you can't have more than 5 tabs for each table, so group dining is automatically a pain. We each started a tab at the bar then moved to a table where the waitress told us three different things about the difficulty of keeping a tab open. We eventually ended up going back to the bar and waiting 10 minutes for the bar tender to get back to us and tell us that the manager had already closed our tabs without asking and set our cards on the table. We went back to the table but couldn't order food until the waitress processed our bar tabs and this took her 30 minutes to do. Needless to say, this entire process was some of the worst service I have ever had and extended our 1 hour dinner to 3 hours.
Don't come here. It is awful.

A hidden neighborhood gem! 

Don't know what I would do without  You Dirty Dog. Really. My apartment is not set up to wash my energetic, rambunctious chocolate lab. And yet she needs to be rinsed down at least 1x a week after our long hikes. Ryan, who manages You Dirty Dog, is unbelievably helpful and has quickly become my lab's BFF. If it's after hours and we happen to be walking down 3rd Street past You Dirty Dog my dog will sit on the stoop and wait for Ryan... convinced he's simply right around the corner and will be right back to entertain her. Now, what dog WANTS to be bathed?!?! 

All in all, thumbs up for You Dirty Dog! See you Saturday morning, Ryan, after our trek through Wissahickon! 

[NOTE: not easy to find. Took me a few trips around the block to even notice it. It's right across the street from Liberty Lands]

One of my coworkers suggested we go here for lunch today and I am glad we took his suggestion! We work in Ybor so it is not too far and we got street parking close by.

There are a lot of Vietnamese dishes and other Asian dishes to choose from as well as a lot of different teas. I ordered the Beef Pho and a raspberry muddled iced tea.  When you place your order, if it is for dining in, you sit down and someone brings it out when it is ready and calls your number. One of my friends ordered the meatball pho and the goyza appetizer and the other got a bun dish and an avocado roll. It did not take long for our orders to come out. Everything looked very fresh and good. 

The pho comes in giant bowls, really more than my friend and I could each finish! We both added some extra spice, they have hot sauce on the table and they have a stand where you can get some extra pepper sauce to bring to your table as well. 

Thanks to other people's pics on Yelp, I ordered the muddled raspberry mint iced tea and it was awesome! So good, I would almost run over there for an afternoon pick me up. They have a lot of other hot and iced teas that do not have berries in them as well. I love tea and drink all flavors so plenty of good options. If you just want plain water (not bottled water) you can get that too.

There are a lot of items on the menu that I want to try on future visits, including the ice creams (green tea, ginger, red bean) and my friends are also fans so I know we will be back!

Recommended by a friend as a great new restaurant.  Food and service and ambiance all very good.  Appetizers: Oysters and brie = delicious, and marinated crab claws = also delicious.  Both recommended by our server and would get the again.  Entrees: Two specials we had were grilled pompano and a filet with chanterelle duxelles = both outstanding and the filet was about the best I have ever had for taste.  Other entrees: slow roasted pork shoulder and black drum.  The pork was so tender and flavorsome.  Sides were black eyed peas, hash brown brussel sprouts - which were sliced and sauteed - yum - and cauliflower gratin.  The entire dinner experience would feature in the top ten we have enjoyed over the past two year in New Orleans. One reason for not giving five stars is you cannot swop starch for a veg - all the veg are al a carte.

Another great experience at BOB.  Love this place - the decor is funky and the atmosphere is fun.  It was hopping before the Cardinals game but the service was great.  The alligator and shrimp cheesecake (appetizer) is not to be missed - rich, creamy and delicious.  Very reasonable prices too.

Only because people told me to try this place out and I never knew it was on the food network. I give it 1 star for the environment. I don't care how good or bad your food is, but if you have a cake layer of dust on counters where people have to eat and the counters and floors are sticky, you can see the grease build up in the kitchen I can not trust my food coming out of a dirty place. As for customer service, it was our first time in there and the man " Finch" who took my order was not nice and kind of a rude a'hole. The food I will give 2 stars only because the fries were the best part of the "awful" burger. It's really nothing special with that thousand island like sauce everyone likes to mimic into every burger. So my entire experience was uncomfortable, unwelcomed and cramped. I should have just turned away the minute I had to walk through a dirty small smokey casino. If you have STANDARDS, this is not the place for you.

Awesome... Awesome... Awesome
2meat combo beef and ribs... Some of the best I've ever had!!!
Mac and cheese fabulous!!!
Brutal spirits... My heart. I'm in love
Black eyed peas and okra... To die for
3 good sauces...I was craving for a Texas based sauce but the jerk was my favorite.
The kicker were the brisket nachos. Unbelievable. 
I wanted to give it five stars but I reserve 5  for my"LAST MEAL"

BTW apple pie was good but very heavy on the cinnamon

One of our favorite lunch stops after Reality church. Have been there many times and the food & service are always excellent. It's relatively small, so there is a wait most of the time. Sitting out on the patio is our favorite. The beer is very good too. The staff is young and energetic and attentive. I would go there again and again.

Not a big fan of the staff there but the burrito is good if not great. They seem to be very unflexible when it comes to variation with the food. I realize y'all get busy but thats not a reason to get rude. But the chicken burrito is really good. So are the tacos. Avoid shrimp taco though. Unless Asian style shrimp tacos from a Mexican place is ur deal. Shit service but good to decent food. 4 stars. Oh $8 for a burrito and 2/$6 tacos.

The food here is really, really GOOD.  Everything is always consistently great (IMO).  Must haves are the mussels they run as a special.  They're done in a hoegardden sauce that's to die for, great soups, pork sliders, and just about everything else on the menu for that matter.

Sunday brunch is fun and again tasty!  Enjoy a complimentary mimosa or bloody mary.

Good people and good times.

I would have given this establishment ONE star but I didn't have a chance to try out the food (we left so quickly).. So I decided to give them the benefit of the doubt.. 

Where to begin?..... First, the jappy little hostess that greeted us with "I don't think there is a table available. Do you care if you have to wait" was just so warming and inviting that we ignored her and just walked to the bar.. Then, after waiting 5-6 min to get our first beers (hoegaarden), it just so happened to be the last two beers in the keg.. It actually spit spit spit out the last half of the second beer and she still gave it to us.. Normally, I would return that junk politely but I decided not to be that guy on that particular night (Fri night).  The final straw was when I went back up to get another beer.. Usually bars want you to keep drinking and spending money.. Apparently, not this place.. 10 min to get another drink.. Mind you, it was a Friday night but it was only 7pm!!!  At the 9 min and 30 sec mark I decided to ask for check and get the BLEEP out of there.. Best decision of the night.. Avoid this place.. I have read some other negative reviews on it and they are also very accurate..

Horrible location. Earlier this week I went through the drive through the drive through and ordered my coffee and an egg and cheese on English. What I got was cold, rubbery, and just out right gross. After tweeting my picture, corporate told me to try again. So I did today. This time I went inside. I asked them to make sure it was toasted. Before I left I checked the item, and same thing. I even gave it to the guy who took my order and he seemed curious as to why it was not toasted and cold. The guy cooking, insisted it was, and that he wasn't going to argue or fix it! What?! So I left the item there ticked off that I just paid for something that wasn't edible. 
They should be ashamed at this location. I grew up with DD in New England, and this is by far the WORST! The manager doesn't even care and they are usually slow. Over it. Don't go here.
One of the better burger places in the Burg. Juicy and flavorful.  You can also bring your dogs if you sit in the patio.

holy crap spicey- i had the chicken in a chili sauce.. and honestly, when you see nothing but chili seeds and chicken and oil, you better be prepared with a few glasses of water-- or better yet milk! dont get me wrong, it tasted fantastic, but HOTDAMN!

in the future, im avoiding that, but i did enjoy the other dishes. tons of flavor!

Great new discount supermarket that took over the Ralphs on De la Vina. Redid the entire store. Very open and organized. Have some very good deals on your everyday items plus some specialty items. Definitely will be coming back and getting food, drinks and other items from here as well as Trader Joe's up the street. Perfect addition to the neighborhood.
Great burger, with plenty of topping options. Garlic Aiolo and Beer Gravy are two of my favorites.

Came here to celebrate, multiple family members birthdays.  We had a good time, our waiter was nice and did an ok job, but it was exactly what we expected!  The food was good not great but we enjoyed it, the atmosphere was just as if we had visited anywhere else in the country.  For visiting a chain restaurant such as this one we enjoyed it and will probably come back again, but not often maybe once or twice a year.

Very disappointed. Our 4 sandwich order was completely wrong. Unfortunately it was a to-go order so we could not get our order fixed. 
The veggie was supposed to be on wheat, the sprouts on it were brown. All sandwiches were overly saturated with mustard and mayo to the point where the bread was soggy and inedible. Horrible.

I took my Uncle, Aunt, Mom, Dad, & Grandmother here when we were touring the City. My Uncle and Aunt were visiting from Lanzhou, China. They really enjoyed the food. I basically ordered like every traditional spicy dish. Finally, got to drink a beer with my uncle since I haven't seen him since high school.

He really likes Yuengling. He thought it was a Chinese beer cause it sounds Chinese lol.

This place is bomb. The place has a great atmosphere. I would take anyone to this spot to eat some authentic food. It's not the best Sichuan food I've had in the States but it is pretty bomb. 

Service is above average for a traditional Chinese place. lololol

I drive from Muncie to eat here; THAT is how good the food is! This place is SO popular in Texas (and Texans know about some good wings) I urge any Yelper that has a craving for some fresh & delicious wings to go to Wing Stop!
Also, I have to mention the fries at Wing Stop. I do not know what kind of yummy crack they sprinkle on the fries, but OMG, the fries at Wing Stop are the BEST!! It's hard to explain how delish they really are. They are fresh cut and they have almost a sweet-salty spice that they are seasoned with. OoooWeee, those fries plus those wings... you can't get any better!

Seriously, Buffalo Wild Wings is just average. Wing Stop blows them out of the water. 

Go support your local business owners and eat at Wing Stop!!

We had breakfast here at Bella Vista. The service and the views are fantastic and the only reason why it gets any stars at all. Simply put the food is not good. It's on par with much cheaper breakfast restaurants like IHOP.

Good cup of coffee! First time here for a breakfast date with my daughter. She loved the cream cheese on her cinnamon bagel. I enjoyed my breakfast sandwich on poppyseed bagel. We will definitely come back.

I was looking for a unique kind of tour for my family's recent trip to New Orleans and  I had to see what all the five star reviews were about at Confederacy of Cruisers. (Okay, I also picked it because of the literary reference. Guilty!)
