My sister was a little apprehensive because she is on the short side and had a bad time with a too-large bicycle the last time she attempted a bike tour, but the staff assured me they could accommodate her.  I booked the Creole New Orleans tour a couple of weeks in advance of our trip, which was quite easy. I was asked to provide the height of everyone in my group, and when we showed up at Washington Square Park on the morning of the tour, our guide Keith had five bikes sized accordingly and made sure the seats were all adjusted to our comfort. 

The cruisers were pretty comfortable. It took some getting used to as I had not been on a bicycle in a good five or six years, and I hadn't experienced a fixed gear bike since childhood, but it came back within a few minutes.  Keith started out by giving us the most amazing 8-minute history of New Orleans and we were off. The tour focused on the Marigny and Bywater with a few minutes in Treme toward the end. It was equal parts history and local color. This was my seventh trip to New Orleans and I've been on several tours and visited so many historic houses and museums. I was surprised how much of the tour was new information for me, and it was a totally different way to see New Orleans.  

The tour covers about 6 miles and includes a bar stop. (It's not illegal to ride a bicycle while intoxicated in Louisiana, or a horse, incidentally.) The terrain is flat and there's not much traffic in the area, so it's not too challenging for those that don't regularly ride a bike. If my extremely risk averse sister can do it, you probably can. Our group ranged from 29 - 69 years in age and everyone loved it.

A few practical details: a $20 deposit is required in advance, which can be paid via  PayPal. The balance is paid after the tour, which is only payable by cash or check. They make a call an hour before the tour if the weather is iffy.  The staff is very responsive via email and text. 

I'd recommend it to anyone!
There's a lot of these bougie taco joints poppin up in Nashville. While not particularly inventive, the food here is tasty and the portions & price points are good, esp for midtown.
Really great place, great atmosphere and service was spot on! Didn't try the beer but the margaritas were BAM!!  Food was fabulous. Great time!

Cute place with a fun vibe. Came for brunch and enjoyed everything we had. Started off with the fried grits, which were even better than I thought they were going to be. For my main order I had the Red Neck eggs. The fried green tomatoes on this dish had some amazing seasoning. I could have enjoyed a couple more slices. I did have a Blood Mary. It was pretty good, but I've had much better. Overall this is a place that does food right & has great service. I'll come again!

Windshield replacement is not a very exciting experience but I was really impressed with the customer service I received from the start with Abbey Glass -- this is not something I can say about many places anymore. The level of service from the phone to the installation technician, actually made me realize I have to write a review because I think they should be recognized for how great they are!

Went to Han Dynasty last night after reading all the great reviews on Yelp. If you love spice, this is the place for you! We had:

Dumplings in chili oil: Delicious with just the right amount of spice. The dumplings were very delicate and light..not doughy at all. 

Cucumbers in spicy sauce: This cold appetizer was very refreshing again with the perfect spice. 

Chicken in Dry Pot: This was rated at a 10 on the spice scale. The presence of the sichaun peppercorns made your tongue numb. It was a strange sensation but delicious. You get a choice of white or dark meat. 

Pork in hot sauce: This was also very good with a spicy red sauce. 

Shrimp with garlic sauce: This was our favorite dish and was slightly sweet but with a nice heat ( rated a 4). It was a great way to cool down from the intense numbing of the peppercorns. 

The three of us were stuffed with plenty to take home. For dessert we were offered complimentary fermented rice. This was a strange dish but good dish. Han Dynasty is the real deal and we can't wait to go back for more!

A lot of the museums in Indianapolis are free, for this place to charge admission is ridiculous. Even if it were free it is not worth your time.  
       I suppose if you have kids, they might enjoy it more because there's a few interactive games. Other than that, there's just posters of some athletes that I have never heard of.

Been wanting to try Elizabeth's for quite some time. Finally had a reason as my friend came into town and wanted brunch. Got there at 12PM and there was no wait. (Whole party must be there for you to be seated, btw!) it got packed fairly quick as I was waiting for my friend to arrive. 

Bloody Mary - wouldn't order it again. But it had pickled green beans and I love pickled green beans. My friend and I both felt like something was missing but couldn't put our finger on it. Maybe it wasn't spicy enough. 

Fried chicken liver with pepper jelly on top ($8) - we had to send this back. It was very burnt tasting and dry. The pepper jelly could not save this dish. I read great reviews about it so I'm hoping this was just an off day. 

Eggs Florentine ($16) - poached eggs on a bed of hash browns and fried oysters. This was really basic, but really good. I enjoyed it and the oysters were a good size. Love how some potatoes were crispy and others were not.

Basic two egg plate (not sure if that's the name or not) with wheat ($6) and breakfast sausage ($4) - I could have made this better at home. Lol. For some reason, my friend's potatoes were really dry and not that great. I told him to dip it in my hollandaise for some wetness. He said his breakfast was really disappointing and expected it to be way better than what it was because it was such a simple dish. 

Overall, I'm really disappointed because I was so excited to try this place and I brought my friend thinking we would have an amazing experience and it was quite the opposite. Better luck next time!

Like any Popeyes, the food was fabulous. They had really great biscuits at this location specifically.

HOWEVER, the service was awful. It took me TWENTY minutes to receive my order, which is completely ridiculous! The staff seemed very aloof and moved with no haste whatsoever. They were just standing around that whole time, and I could see that my spicy tenders were ready! I even had to remind the lady to give me cups. It was one of the worst customer service experiences I've ever had.

Went to Cee Bee's for the first time the other day. They had a wonderful selection of rare citrus and a nice selection of fresh produce that is grown in their greenhouse on-site. The young gentlemen who assisted us was extremely knowledgeable and welcoming. We decided to get a vanilla and orange swirl and it was delicious. Wow! Great flavor profile (so I definitely don't agree with some of the previous reviews), nice portion and very creamy. Soooooo refreshing! It's a local family owned grove, which is always a plus for me as well. Make sure you stop by. Worth the trip. :)

Finally someone found a way to combine the obnoxious assault-on-the-senses ambiance of Abercrombie & Fitch with the culinary equivalent of day-old bread!!!
The music wafting through the restaurant at top volume can best be described as a diarrhea-inducing mashup of Christian rock and Asian techno pop, and it bounced delightfully off the sterile walls decorated only with overpriced coffee mugs and t-shirts.  The clever slogan "Resting Brunch Face" emblazoned on all the merch seemed not only a borderline offensive slogan, but also a company mandate that employees shall not smile under any circumstances.  
One waiter did apparently feel comfortable enough, however, to set up shop at one end of our party's table to conduct his busywork, which unfortunately was not overseeing the placement of love in the biscuits, but organizing stickers for proper arrangement on a sale rack.  
One would assume that an eatery named Biscuit Love would take pride in the biscuits they serve.  One would be wrong; our biscuits were stale and not even warm.  Where's the love?  Not here.  

Highly recommend (if you're in the market for an expensive logo coffee mug, or if you have to buy a biscuit for someone you hate). 

My egg was good.

I was recommended to the salon by my esthetian because a client of hers mentioned how clean and nice this salon was. I was impressed by the cleanliness, everything was sterilized in an actual sterilizer ( I work in dentistry and it is an actual sterilizer) unlike all the other salons who bring it from the back or side of the salon, out of an oven. This is out front for all to see, the tools are opened in front of you, the files, buffers are disposable to boot!

My technician was very nice, took her time but to much time. I was there for two hours in the end, which I appreciate but had other errands to run and time was short. This is the only reason I left one star off. 

I loved that you get a deluxe mani and pedi as the basic service, they have other botanical services as well. My basic mani & pedi cost me $45, a little more than most places but well worth it!

I will definitely be back to this salon.

Finally got to stop into Bandana's BBQ today for carry out, just to sample their fare. I'd been hearing their catchy jingle all the time on the radio, and people have told me that it's a main destination for BBQ in St Louis. Though I didn't sit down to dine, I was received ever so courteously by the wait staff, and they assisted me in what to get. The waitress even offered me a glass of water while I waited for my carry out, and I thought that was an incredibly kind gesture of her; really who does that nowadays. I haven't had much luck with Barbeque before, especially pulled pork. This time around I got the pulled pork dinner plate with baked beans and slaw, and after taking it home and eating it, I was pleasantly delighted. The pulled pork is more hearty and thick, instead of being usually very watery, and because it was done in this way, I was able to get a good aftertaste of the pork. They have 6 different kinds of sauce for you to put on there, and my Memphis style complimented the meat quite fine. I really enjoyed my meal, and I thought I'd given up pulled pork. The inside of the place looks stellar! I will take my family here when they are in town again. I'm happy I stopped by, it's a bit tricky getting into this stripmall, but it's worth a stop!

This is the best bakery in North Wilmington and I am so happy they are here! As a long time resident, I have often had to go to Wilmington or Newark for my bakery needs. A few months ago, I discovered Bread and Buttercream. The bread, cookies, pastries and cakes are all excellent. My personal favorite is the chocolate croissant. It's the closest thing I've had to France in many years! Highly recommended.
The Caramel croissants are delicious! I've never had anything like it. I love that it isn't to sweet. I will be back for more!

(I started this review on my iPhone in October 2010 but only now am just posting it) Given the explosion of self-serve frozen yogurt joints on the Main Line in the past year, I had to try the newest addition to see how it compared to Yapple Yogurt in Wynnewood and Kiwi Yogurt in Haverford. I stopped on my way home from center city and found the place empty (not surprising at 4pm) except for someone chatting it up with the girl behind the counter. Top This is exactly like its competitors in that you take an oversized cup, fill it with any flavor(s) of the cold soft stuff, add toppings then weigh to pay. All 3 places charge $0.49 per ounce so if you're not careful you can easily create a $5 dessert. None of the fro-yo places provide a scale for you to see how much dessert you've accumulated before the check out counter. They should. But I know why they don't.

Whereas Yapple Yogurt and Kiwi are bright, shiny and clean places with attentive employees that are constantly wiping off the toppings bar of stray chocolate chips or blueberries, Top This is depressing. Even though there were no customers in the store and it was clearly downtime, the toppings bar was a mess. The labels were falling off in some areas and the floor around the bar hadn't been swept; crumbs were just strewn on the dark floor. The checkout counter was piled with textbooks and other personal items, apparently because the employee happens to also be the co-owner and she's in grad school. I understand her need to study, but using your checkout counter as a desk? Really? The small counter against the wall behind the checkout counter was also cluttered with stuff. 

It was clear the owner wasn't serious about being a business. When I asked her how business was doing she admitted it was slower than she and the co-owner expected. I think she thought this fro-yo resurgence would make her and her partner easy money; people would flock to them because, why not, everyone loves fro-yo, and she's a local!! (She was a school teacher who grew up in the neighborhood). But, people also love a clean, well-kept business that is serious about serving, and keeping, customers. Her store should be pristine. She needs to keep her textbooks and personal effects off her counters, assiduously clean up the toppings bar and floor and simply make her investment a priority. 

Maybe since I was here in October it's improved. It can only go up from where it was (or it could just close its doors, which may be easier).

Always love Irene's. We went with some family on a Tuesday night. Several of us got the softshell crab and my hubby got a whole red snapper? Not sure if that's the right fish. Almost as good as always. Much prefer sitting in the back room with all the wine bottles instead of the front room.

This is Allen's favorite fast food taqueria. He's going primarily for the regular taco supreme, which was awesome. They put green onions on their tacos which makes a tremendous difference. The food is a step up from Taco Bell, plus they have a delicious salsa bar. The restaurant itself is nothing to write home about (actually, it's a little creepy and depressing which actually added to my enjoyment). I'm looking forward to another trip out to Metairie to go again!

Best hardwood floor repair and installation in Tampa. My bungalow in seminole heights needed to be refinished and refurbished. What an amazing job with excellent customer service!  I would recommend their service to anyone in Tampa bat

This is one of my (and my wife) favorite restaurants in the Hendersonville area (or Nashville for that matter).  We will usually go in the evening and split the Nachos Supremos (I think that's the one haha).  It is $10 and fills us both up, and with drinks, we can get out of there after tip for $16 for 2 people.  The service is always good, the food is very consistent, and the chips and salsa are very good as well.  Oh... and the margaritas... pitcher anyone?

I am back AGAIN! So YUMMY! I have constant craving for their fried chicken breakfast special! It's so delicious you will want more! Best of all, their service is excellent! We had a very outspoken and attentive waiter who introduced us to their new menu for Thai as well. Being an Asian, finding a Thai food restaurant was "YAY!" - and we immediately added green curry to our order. I will definitely be back for more now (breakfast/ lunch or dinner) - YUM!

Tried it for the first time June 1, after reading all the good reviews. I am not at all familiar with any African cuisine, but I'm usually willing to try anything. I was not disappointed. 

The restaurant is quite small. When my sister and I came in for lunch, the owner/chef was the only other person there. We were greeted pleasantly and our questions about the choices were answered patiently. 

My sister had the Kedjenou Sauce au Poulet. I tasted it also and thought it was good, although the chicken was dark meat and I prefer white. My choice was Sauce d'Arachide, goat in a delicious peanut sauce. Both meals came with a generous serving of white rice. I thoroughly my meal. The owner offered hot sauce, which I at first declined, since I don't handle it as well as I used to. But I felt the food needed that little extra punch, and indeed after using the hot sauce with it, it was even better- spicy enough to feel, but not painful. I had the ginger drink, which I found much too powerful for my taste, but after diluting it with water, it was OK for me. 

All in all, I enjoyed my lunch very much and would gladly go back to try some of the other choices. I believe the prices are reasonable considering the quantity of food you get. My sister could not finish all of hers. I did, but I was at my limit, but happy.

Just had dinner here and wasn't expecting much but it was delicious!! The happy hour had good prices and the server was so delightful. I would definitely come back. The sushi was half off and I can't get over how cheap it was for such good sushi.

I thought by looking at the food pictures on facebook before they opened that mayyyybe theyd off some other items (ex: calamari). Nope, its the same stuff, same tacos, same apps, sandwiches, and dinners. Its like the owner has a stranglehold over his chefs and doesnt let any of them try and change up the menu. It would be awesome if i could go to another two stones and they have a multitude of different items(that would so make it worth the drive). However that doesnt and wont happen, i tried the two stones in lantana, its nice, but theres no reason for me to go all the way up there. I want to, but why would I if its exactly the same as newark. 

Its like this place is trying to become a chain, it seems they are to scared to change anything.

People want change! Slow it down a little bit and listen to your customers and chefs.

Oh Brennan's, how you disappoint me. Everyone says you have to go to brunch at Brennan's, you just have to! Well, let me be one to tell you, really, you don't have to go and it will miss out on some hidden treasure. Yes, the bananas foster is good and not many places have it. So if you want to go, order dessert and leave it at that. 

We sat in the back corner of the restaurant down a dimly lit hallway near the kitchen staff break room. Our waiter had a young assistant and it took both of them about 15 minutes before taking our coffee order and another 20 minutes before taking our food order. Ok, I'm probably exaggerating, but its breakfast and it was a long wait to order some eggs. The food was alright, but for about $25, it was certainly not worth it for some sausage and eggs and a long wait. We had to flag down a busboy to tell our waiter we needed our dessert and check which totaled more than most of our dinners in NOLA and we didn't even drink!

Save your money and go get a coffee and beignet at Cafe du Monde.

About two years ago I first went to this Pep Boys after picking up a three inch nail in my tire. The guy saw how flustered I was and was extremely nice and did the job in under 15 minutes.

Cut to this past Friday I picked up another and remembering my positive experience previously it was the first place I thought to go. Upon entering there was a room full of people waiting yet the guy at the counter said it was a quick job and would take 15 minutes. Half an hour later I asked him what was going on as over half the people had left. He said he'd move my car up next and it would be 10 minutes. After another half hour and having to remind the mechanics in the back three times to stop standing around and just put the tire on the car it was finally done. Still took five minutes just get my key back. I'm fairly certain $20 was taken off my bill after some complaints but it was still a huge waste of money and time. 

It would have been far better and good business if the guy had just been honest with me in the first place and two other people also had to speak with him to move things along. I've never seen a garage with so many cars up and so many people just standing around trying to do the least amount of work possible. I'm no mechanic but if you're lucky enough to get a quick and easy job why not make it quick and easy?

Awesome place to take children and teens. 
Good variety of animals to see. Decent parking space. Not expensive. Gift shop inside with light snacks and refreshments available. 

Very educational as well.

I called around 10am and the lock was changed by 11:30am. $163 including parts and labor and they took credit card. Super fast and very professional. The tech called me to verify the address as he was leaving, and then again to let me know he was outside. Probably not the cheapest, but I'm happy with the service.

I've only ever ordered takeout from here, so I can't comment on the service or ambience or presentation of food. 
I'm a regular customer for their broken rice with beef short ribs. The marinade they use on the short ribs is phenomenal - highly addictive!  The wings are good as well. Not a fan of their chicken or pork.  
The prices are competitive and the staff that greets me when I pick up my food are courteous.  I will continue to be a patron of this establishment...mainly for their short ribs ;)

So we came here because of the 4 star rating. I have to disagree though. The ambiance was wonderful but the service was sub par. The waitress was fast but so fast we could not ask for anything!  The food was so so. I ordered the sea hag's brew but got a pineapple screwdriver instead. My husband had crab cakes and said they were alright but would only order them again if he was really hungry.

Green Door Gourmet is my farm! Well, not MY farm, but my go to farm, I suppose. It's where I go for my CSA, fresh veggies and local foods. I've been visiting Green Door since 2010 and watched it grow from a small shed to a larger building that gives it a country grocery store feel. 

The best thing about Green Door's CSA is that you sign up for it weekly instead of making a huge commitment upfront. This appeals to me because there are weeks where we're not at home as much to eat all of the goodies from our CSA box or times where we can't make it out to the farm to pick up our box. It's what truly makes me want to be their customer. 

They also offer jams, jellies and pickles canned especially for them, as well as a co-op program to offer additional products from other local farms like Jolly Barnyard, Kenny's Cheese (AWESOME!), Gourmet Pasture Beef and West Wind Farms. It makes for a great one-stop shop to create an excellent meal. 

Green Door also has events throughout the year, so be sure to sign up for their email to find out when their events are or check out their Facebook or Twitter. 

I've recommended Green Door to many friends, so my fellow Yelpers need to get in on this action, as well :)

If you're reading this, did you know they serve brunch here on weekends?! I know right?! I was floored too when I found out and happily surprised to have been invited to a Yelp Event here this past Sunday to taste some of their brunch dishes.

HIghlights include their scratch-made waffles. Yup you heard right - they make these bad boys from scratch (not frozen like other joints!) and this time 'round, they were topped with fresh peach compote made from BC peaches and topped with chantilly cream. Everyone who tried these at our table raved about the consistency, texture and flavour of the waffles.

The other highlight for me was "The Cure" which is CSH's take on hangover poutine! Made with crispy shoestring fries, topped with red wine gravy, a signature roasted poblano and white cheddar sauce, cheese curds and poached eggs which you break and ooze yolk everywhere! This was another big hit from our samplers and be warned - it is hearty and will definitely cure any hangover you are nursing from the night prior. In fact, share these bad boys because the portion is pretty large!

Some other dishes I was able to try but weren't big fans of: Italian sausage and mushroom skillet and  The Oil Country Bennie. Mostly because the taste profile was quite similar (they both use the same roasted poblano white cheddar sauce and Italian sausage and poached eggs). Mind you, the Italian sausage they use is made by the Italian grocery store here! Nice! And the eggs in the dishes are locally sourced as well.

The hospitality of CSH was great! We had the pleasure of meeting Jesse (one of the partners and local Edmontonian); as well as their executive chef - Ruben! Both great guys, easy going and passionate about CSH and what it's bringing to Edmonton's entertainment and dining scene.

Note: free parking out back evenings and weekends! So no excuses.... if you're looking for a new place to brunch in Edmonton - check out CSH!

So very impressed with Lock Man and Bill who helped me. Other local locksmiths either said it was not possible  to open my 500 year old chest or quoted $500+... Bill had it open in 20 mins for $25! The key had been locked inside when shipped. Honest and capable business....friendly too. Use them! Jeff P

Pizza to die for (and huge HUGE slices); fabulous beer selection (loved the Tangerine); and homemade ice cream. I almost cried after the peanut-butter chocolate chip ice cream. Service was incredible as always even with a large party on a sweltering afternoon. Thanks again 1702!!

The Tacos here are standard and fresh but the HORRIFIC  rude hipsteresque service causes Honest Tom a customer. My fiance and I stopped in around 3pm on a Monday and ordered 3 tacos and a burrito---the damage was only $18 but the blonde who took our order 1. rolled her eyes and audibly sighed when we walked in 2. took our order while not even making eye contact 3. raised her voice and said "yeah, we take cards" although we were 10 inches away from one another 4. rudely YELLED "No CREMA" at the Mexican man who was visibly on edge . It sucks because Tom, and the other guys are so so friendly, but you can't honestly be Honest Tom's with such ridiculous service. Tacos--steak was a little over done but guacamole was fresh. My fiance's chicken burrito was delicious...not exactly Mexican. More like a heart chicken and rice dish wrapped w. a tortilla.

Spaddy's is just plain cool. We stopped by after hitting Ichicoro across the street, and it was such a perfect cup of coffee, I don't even know what to say. I normally drink espresso drinks because I can rarely find a good cup of coffee. To be honest, I don't even know what made me order drip, but it was easily the best cup of drip coffee I've ever had! Not even lying! I wish I lived near here because it would be my ONLY source for all things bean! 

My son got a hot tea, and said it was great too.

Love the cool outdoor set up too. The decor is so cool. Even though it's outdoor seating, there is plenty shade and a great breeze. 

This is a must visit if you are in the area and even remotely like coffee. Get on over!!!

Aaaaa mom's place. The gyro is awesome, the breakfast is awesome, the servers are extra sassy and the owner spilled a water on my buddy and didn't give a damn, in a good way though! She was great. It's a diner and you might have to wait a few minutes to get in, but worth the short wait.  BRING CASH. That's all you need to know.

BRING CASH.

This place was packed for a reason!! A cute little restaurant right on the beach with great food and killer bloody marys. Service is exceptional. The perfect place for dates, family dinners, getting out of jail celebrations, etc. Basically, use any excuse you can find to come here because you are gonna love it.

I know majority of us dread the thought of visiting a local DMV. However, this by far is a very efficient operation. I really like the set up and flow of system they use to limit the time. I know I've said it before, but I wish other states ran the same procedure to minimize the agony of waiting. Just want to be in and out!

I had to change my title and registration from NJ to DE. Although, I went on a Wednesday because they opened later to accommodate people with a daytime work schedule. It was crowded but lines went by fast. (31 Stations)! It was an easy process. Quicker than I thought. There's also an online live feed of the waiting seating area and inspection lanes if you are curious. They also added photo booths kiosks that you can use yourself for renewing ID/Licenses. I can't wait to use this new feature in the future.

I had a Rolex circa 1993 that needed to be serviced. A chain jewelry company in austin TX sent it to Rolex. Rolex claimed  the case needed to be replaced due to corrosion for the small sum of $4000. I asked Adam to evaluate the watch and he was able to service it and repair a component for less than $1000. Though I live in Austin my Neighborhood Watch Company is in Philly and Adam is the only person I want working on my time pieces.

Gibt es die Möglichkeit 0 Sterne zu vergeben? Falls nicht, seit ich dieses Hotel gesehen habe, bräuchte ich sie. Zimmer unsauber, mit eindeutigen, noch feuchten, klebrigen Flecken, alte, benutzte Seife in der Dusche. Habe dann ein anderes Zimmer bekommen, aber denkt ja nicht, dass man sich um den Umzug gekümmert hätte, drei Mal musste ich mit kompletten Gepäck nach 20 Stunden Anreise durch das Hotel ziehen. Für den Zimmerpreis ein no-go!

Truly delicious ice cream. The line is long when the weather is nice, but it's worth the wait. The sundaes are pretty decadent (try the Mt. Vesuvius) and the scoops are generous (hydrox is great--it's their cookies and cream). Cash only.

I've been twice - once with a group of nine ladies and once with three ladies. The wine machines are big hits with friends and the food was outstanding. Perfect for a date night! We had the spinach artichoke dip, charcuterie plate, pesto chicken pizza and fondue! I recommend it all!!

When I go for thai food I really stick with the same thing. It's always red curry. (I have tried other things this is just my fave) I know I need to broaden my horizons when it comes to thai food but that's ok. I like red curry so I'll stick with it. 

The red curry here is good and they even add zucchini for me since I like more veggies besides the peppers.
Music was great but food horrible.  Service good but food so bad not worth eating there.  Just drinks and music.

I can't say enough about this salon and it's stylists. The staff is very knowledgeable and always friendly. The salon itself is beautiful and I loved the location. The owner Clare is amazing! I had Great Lengths extensions applied by Clare ( who is a trainer for Great Lengths ) I was amazed!! Not only was the hair amazing quality but, they lasted me about 6 months with only a few strands that fell out. I did take great care to follow the instructions on daily maintenance but, what an amazing investment! Very happy, will be back!

Had dinner here about a week ago on a Saturday night. We sat on the patio, which was lovely. Service was great, the food was good although a little overpriced for the quality. I would go here again but only once in a while.

If you want different, and I mean you are an adventurous eater, this is near the top of the list. In fact you may be hard pressed to have seen a similar menu in all of Pinellas county.

Atmosphere           75      Dated and musty looking, yet comfortable
Service                    75      Nothing to write home about
Food                        85      Eclectic and very interesting international cuisine
Value                       75      It was a tad high - depending on your choice   

I can not emphasize the creativity of the menu  - from Korea to Morocco.
I didn't particularly like my choice but, at the least ,it was interesting and initially
had potential. The Livingroom is an experience, albeit it does have plenty of competition in the area.

A word about serving. It is a Tapas restaurant ( everybody shares the choice) so dishes are served when each tapas is cooked. Impossible to serve everyone at one time unless, of course, they share the served tapas dish. Interesting!

Try it. You might like it.

Agree with those who said nice looking shop but subpar haircuts. And the wait time can be ridiculous here. The review that said if you want a subpar clipper cut you can do that yourself nailed it. Sadly, that seems to sum up the St Pete barber shop scene and not just Tim's.

My family is in the bar and restaurant business. Simply put I look for things and pay attention to details some others may miss. This is a place to bring the family and friends. The food is fresh and the service is off the charts. I have not had a bad time here ever and we just recently moved here. Today they had a tailgate party for the start of the NFL season and it was great. We met a lot of great people and made some new friends. The owners are hard working and have made this place a destination for all. My family and I will make a lot of memories here. DO not miss this gem and stop in.

Julie from Deluxe Nails moved to Vino Nail Bar!  I am so thrilled that I found where she went.  The salon is relaxing, pristine and  every one is so nice They have fabulous choice of pedicures. Gel nails and refills look so natural. A must place to go to!

The cheesesteak had good flavor but not enough meat compared to the roll thickness. The Italian hoagie was tasty. The salt and vinegar fries were...weird. I expected fries with actual vinegar and salt. Instead they were dry dusted with a salt and vinegar flavored powder. Strange!

I'm simply in Amazement and grateful for Jenotta!!! After a 1 hour flight delay was released by SWA I roamed the terminal and found this place. Little did I know that the young lady whom checked me in to the lounge would be the person to go out of their way for me, when I found out my I-pad slipped out of my bag and was still in the rental car. 

I was on hold with Hertz trying to figure out if I should make a run to Hertz or not and then just after hanging up on another auto response I approached Jenotta and asked if I could re-enter if I left. She said yes, but then continuedto inquire. I explained that I needed to go back to the rental car place and get my IPad. She said don't go, and that she would take care of it.  Being that I'm almost 2 paragraphs in, I will cut it short and say that she DID. 

She went above and beyond for me. She filed a claim, and pushed forward, calling the location, calling the desk at the terminal, she did NOT give up until she located it. Then she went to security and picked it up for me from the Hertz representative that was brining it here. There is no way I Could've accomplished this. 

She didn't not have to do any off this but she did. When I paid for a single "day pass" I became one of her members and she went above and beyond for me. But I know why my heart that she did this also because of who she is, and amazing person that takes her job and humanity seriously.  

BTW this is my first yelp post and WingTips also has Delish cookies.

Nice restaurant and for a hotel restaurant the prices are reasonable.  Had the lasagna and it was very good.  The wait staff was very attentive and friendly.  The lasagna was recommended and didn't disappoint.

How can anyone resist these baby cakes? They're so cute in their little jars! If they weren't so pricy, I'd buy so many of 'em. But instead, I just bought a pumpkin.

Ate that thing in two minutes flat. Didn't mean to time it.

Considering how slow I eat, anyone who knows me IRL might be writing this place off in their heads right now. But I rebut with: no! Those were two minutes of heaven! Really!

So, yes. It's a small portion. And yes, you pay for that small portion. But you get what you pay for! They load buckets of flavor into those jars and top it off with frosting -- and, in my cake's case, a candy corn. It was adorable.

What a great gift idea too.
All work was done in a clean, professional manner and a friendly attitude. I recommend very highly.
This was the best deli sandwich I have ever had. Wish we could bring the cafe home with us to Ohio! Wonderful vacation lunch destination.

I absolutely LOVE Barbacoa. It is now a takeout staple in my house. The food is DELICIOUS. I've never ordered anything I haven't liked, and neither has anyone else in my family. It's all very reasonably priced too. 

It is a small place, so there aren't many tables, though we usually order takeout anyway. It feels very cozy, and everyone that works there is incredibly friendly. The owner's kids were there drawing pictures and begging me to try things the first time we went there. 

Overall, it's just a great place. Great atmosphere, great staff, and GREAT food!

Worst atmosphere I've ever experienced! Three men, talking extremely loud in their native language, soccer on the TV.  Come on!!! Not what women are looking for in a nail salon, not to mention the pedicure I got was OK at best. Not relaxing, not professional, and not a good experience!!

First class place-great gym, great pool and bars, great outside bar on front patio, great restaurants etc. I really appreciate how they maintained some of the old original hotel (which we used to sneak into as high school kids when it was shut down in the 70's) like the tile floors as they re did this place. 

The country club and golf course are fantastic as well-about a mile up the road. Golf course is always in fantastic shape and also always undergoing changes (like it ain't tough enough already)! Better pack an extra dozen balls if you don't hit it straight. Some interesting double greens and clever holes and it's not a short course either off the blues. I do enjoy it-especially when I remember the simple old Sunset Country Club it formerly was....but I wax nostalgic. This is a much better course (and playable in wet weather. At Sunset you could lose a ball to water in the center of the fairway after a summer rain). 

Of course there is the classic Groucho line-any club that allows me as a member I want no part of-but I love the hotel and country club both. First class!

Go here often for lunch working downtown.  I usually get the fresh rolls, but the soup is great also.  Perfect portions, prompt ordering and fresh veggies make this one of my favorite places downtown to eat.
Food was good but only having one register to check people out is outrageous. The line had 10+ people waiting, and took about 15 minutes to get through.

I love this place. Everytime I go to the CMA's I stop here for some Karoake.

Of course you may need to wait a little for your turn, but the crowd is fun and kind, plus I have seen some pretty good amateur talent.

Hello It's Dairy Queen... Who doesn't like D.Q. We stopped by for some ice cream on Saturday. Other then it being just as cold inside as outside, we enjoyed our ice cream. While we were sitting there we looked over the ice cream cakes as well. Now everyone loves the ice cream cake right? However, who can eat a whole one by themselves? My idea is why does Dairy Queen sell the ice cream cakes by the slice. I know I would sure grab one.

First time eating here, but it was so yummy!! Owen the manager was so nice and helpful too!!  
We ordered the goat cheese and almond and chicken caesar salads which were so delicious!! Had I not wanted to eat on the light side though, I would have opted for one of their amazing looking sandwiches!! We will definitely be back again!!

Stay away!  Owner claimed my AmEx card wouldn't process so I gave her Visa instead - I ended up with charges on both cards.  She hung up the phone when resolution was attempted. Plus, pedicure peeled within days of service. Beware!!

South Grand is arguably the best place for international cuisine in St. Louis, and The Vine is yet another exemplar.  

I'll cut right to it: the food is excellent, and the value is tremendous.  While the prices appear middle-of-the-road to the uninitiated, what you get for that money is an absolutely insane amount of food.  It's easy to over-order, and if you're dining in, you can safely assume that you'll be taking a substantial portion of your meal home to enjoy again later.

Pretty much everything I've tried at The Vine has been excellent, with the only exception being the baba ganough, which I found to be excessively pureed and a bit bland.  But that's about the only thing that disappoints on a menu full of standouts, like the hummus, lebneh, and all of the entrees.

Dining-in can be a bit hit-or-miss due to the service.  Some of the waitstaff seem at times to be more out to lunch than their customers.  While the servers are friendly, a few of them seem to be very absentminded, and have a tendency to disappear after the food has been delivered.  Carryout orders don't seem to suffer the same fate, which is why I generally exercise that option unless I'm meeting someone for lunch or dinner.

Stopped in today for lunch and once again the service and food was excellent. I had the grouper sandwich which was fresh and delicious. Another person had the lobster roll; a very generous portion and she said it was wonderful. We finished the meal off with their different than the rest and oh so lite and fluffy, Key Lime pie. I just messaged Sea Critters and requested their recipe for the pie. They said "no way" that I would have to visit for a slice. That's fair...but if anybody knows the recipe plz pass it to me. Lovely atmosphere and doggy friendly!
Very friendly and prompt service with good value. I'd get my oil changed there again.

I have to say. The owner is one of the nicest people you will ever meet. Professional, family oriented, believes in his food.

Their food was so good. The hoagies were packed with meat. Their homemade rolls were so tender.  

The buffalo chicken cheese steak was my hubby's favorite. I loved the tuna, my son loved the turkey. The wings had great flavor. Their fried Oreos. Omg Amazing
Don't judge from the old look on the outside rooms are updated granite counters fridge n microwave in rooms very clean and quite I come in town often always stay there employees are very nice
This place is always dirty.  They clean the tables but do not wipe down the seats or sweep the floor.  It's just gross.

I got my hair dyed pink here and it is the happiest I have EVER been leaving a salon. Maxshell did an incredible job and was so much fun to spend time with during the many hours it takes to dye brown hair pink. I am still obsessed with my color and would highly recommend Max to anyone looking to color their hair. LOVE!
This is one of my fab breakfast spots after an early morning walk on the beach.  It's homey and quaint and I love the tangerine juice.  Owner is very nice too.

Today was my first visit!! LOVE the salon it's very upscale and chic with reasonable prices!! The staff is friendly,warm and very welcoming!! I had the pleasure of having Jan as my technician today! She was wonderful!! I have found a new salon home!!

I'd definitely recommend a stay here if you are travelling either to the city (as an alternate) or northern parts of Philadelphia.  The cleanliness, customer service, quality of staff is great.  Really no issues and they even have an indoor pool.  The WIFI was a little slow but hey its Free!  Great Stay and highly recommend.

This little gem on the beach is phenomenal.  I would have never expected to find such an amazing place for happy hour literally right on the beach. The wait staff and bartenders were all nice and helpful and weren't too pushy about the "open seating policy" for the outside patio.  The jalapeno basil gin martini was fantastic, and I'm not even the biggest fan of spicy things. The ambiance is nice and the view is to die for. I highly recommend everyone needs to check this place out, but don't tell too many people, as it is a nicely kept secret ;)

I looooove this place and wish we stayed closer to downtown Indianapolis to visit more often. I personally have never had the drinks (had to drive every time) but they look really good. They also have complimentary chips and salsa that you can help but snack on while you wait for food. And most importantly, the food is extremely good. 

The portions are HUGE for the price, and definitely something you have to workout after. Ive had the fajitas which are decent, except for the fact that the plates are always wobbly. The portion is pretty big, but I wish there was an easier way to eat the fajita.

The second time we went, I got the chipotle chicken and pork burrito (could be totally off with the name). Although advertised to be spicy, it really wasnt spicy at all, but very juicy. Definitely recommend this place for the future.

I would agree with Gabe, the heat level is a little all over the place, but it also means that the food is actually being made fresh, obviously not out of a bag here!!

I have only grabbed takeout from here, but have done so 4 times in the last few weeks and everything was delicious, they have a huge variety and everything I have had was really good.  The smell alone is fantastic, actually tastes real, very strong flavors.
Good meat and 3. Had to spend a couple of hours waiting for car to get an oil change and was recommended to come here. Had eggs and country ham and it was good

Just went back last night... the sandwiches were made so freaky fresh and fast that as soon as I paid they were in my car ! Shockingly fast ! They were fresh and good and the dude at the drive thru was kind and polite. This place is a go-to when dinner is a disaster ! Thanks jimmy johns !

Great little mexican place. Love the food and generally good service. Been here many times, their casero is delicious. Get it and the cheese dip every time. Normally would do ala carte burritos and tacos over a main entree. 

The chicken nachos are good!

This place is awesome the food is the best we have had in long time. The owner and wait staff is supper friendly something that you don't get with the bigger food establishments. The fish is really fresh and delicious apps are great can't wait to return to try the pizza.

not much of mix drink guy but had a few sips from the gf and friends- pretty good i guess but i prefer a proper drink like a pint of guiness. Either way I like the vibe- relax not crowded on a fri night with a little roof deck.  music was loud enough but not so loud that my friends could not hear my witty and life altering comments. the dj was really good although i could not name one song he was playing. drinks are pushing nyc prices but one of the bartenders has a pretty cool stache so its ok in my book.

If you want classic, old school Italian food that's good for the soul, the Saloon is an excellent choice. Walking into the Saloon, you feel as though you are traveling back in time! Their food is outstanding, and definitely competes with Philadelphia staples like Dante and Luigi's and the Victor Cafe. The service is attentive, welcoming, and friendly. The parking situation is accommodating as they offer valet. No need to worry about trying to find a place to park in the area. I will definitely return to the Saloon.

I just discover dharma during my last semester of college, since they delivered to the library during finals week. Since then, I've experienced poor customer service over the phone and poor face to face communication. What's most irritating is that they say they're open until 3am Friday and Saturday and that they deliver until midnight, and multiple times I've tried to order food at 11:20 to be deliver to my house, and the website says the store isn't open. Then when I try to call, they don't answer the phone. 

I really did enjoy my first dharma experience. I think their menu is small yet tasty, but I'm very frustrated with he horrid service.

Very flavorful although some dishes heavy on the MSG; grilled meats.  It doesn't cause headache (It's been proven.) but for some people, it can definitely cause major stomachache if eaten on and empty stomach.

i've been getting the pizza here for a few years and really like the taste.  The crust is not super thin - but is more on the thin side - the way I like it.  I always get carry out - I wish they would deliver a little further up in NE St Pete (gandy area).  The staff is friendly but the times they give are just strange.  I expect to hear about 20 mins to pick up a pizza  but sometimes they will say 30 mins or 40 mins to pick up a pizza.  They are near a Publix so I figure I can get some  groceries while I wait.  Every time I've stopped to check on my pizza first - it has always been ready (about 20 mins).  I'd hate to think that if I took them literally it would be sitting in the warmer for 20 more minutes  This has happened several times (at least 50% of the time I order).  One star off for that.

Truly and honestly the best meal I've ever eaten. 
My boyfriend and I visited this past weekend. This place came highly recommended from a few online sources and it lived up to my expectations and more! We ordered the crab catfish special and the crawfish fries. Everything was made with such love. The sauces were creamy and rich, but not greasy or fatty. The whole restaurant is family run! The chef's daughter was our waitress and she was so sweet and accommodating. The chef himself even came out after our food was served to ask us how it was. I'm still amazed at the service and the food! If we're ever back in the area, you can bet that we'll be back.
The Bo-buts are the hot of the menu but I don't think you could go wrong with anything.

Really bad Mcdonalds. The restaurant wasn't clean and did not have much seating. When we walked in we noticed that there were a lot of homeless people just sitting in the restaurant and not eating. The staff wasn't friendly and it took over 15 minutes to get our two meals and it was not at all busy. They also gave no napkins and did not want to give any ketchup. Very trashy Mcdonalds.
The best margaritas, chips and salsa, and fajitas in town. Love this place. I just wish they had a patio for nice days.

The disclaimer is that I am not a beer fan. The only beer I have had at Monk's is Allagash White which is like a typical Belgian wheat beer. I get excited about going to monk's because of the food. 

What I love:
1. Mussels, mussels, more mussels: I really like Provence ones. It also makes a pot of delicious dipping for the bread. 
2. Frog legs and veal cheeks: they don't taste as strange as they may sound. Veal cheeks is rather tender and it makes a great dish to share among a few people. 
3. Duck salad sandwich: it's something I would never expect to be made so well here. But they did it. Always a safe option for people who are not into shell fish. 

Overall, this is a great dining/hanging out spot for anytime of the day. 

My only question is: why don't they have outdoor seating?
Yummy food and super friendly staff. Has a fun vibe and they've done a great job remodelling. Though they have some normal opening night issues, their hospitality and attitude totally outshine them.

I have been to this place multiple time and although I always try to order less, it still too expensive to be a sort of grab-and-go restaurant. For the same money, I would just rather have food somewhere else. I'm not coming here again. There are similar places in the area way cheaper. The pastas are good though.

The couple here are two of the nicest people I have ever met. No matter how long it has been since I've been I to drop the boyf's or my clothes off, they'll take a few minutes to ask about your day and make sure you're ok with their recommendations. 
I had a chiffon-y dress that needed to be shortened so I could be outside comfortably and the seamstress promised it by the end of the week. When I popped in a few days earlier to pick up some clothes, the dress was ready and fit perfectly! She also made me a scarf out of the extra material as a wrap if it got chilly :) plus I had a leather bag that had a small rip, and they sent it to a leather repair shop nearby. When I got it back, it wasn't perfect, but it was such a hassle free process that it's worth it!  Thanks for everything and I'm definitely never going to another dry cleaner!

Love this place. We moved to the area about 6 months ago and found this place. We have been there at least 10 times since. It's a small quaint location. It's very cozy good place for dates or family dinners. My family loves it too. We have enjoyed every meal we have gotten there. Definitely recommend it the foods great, the service is great and the ambiance is great too!

Why I like Oro Valley bikes:

-Competitive prices-not much cheaper or more expensive than the rest
-Super friendly service. Not at all pushy. They recognize that bikes (at this price range) are a big purchase and don't make you feel rushed into buying. 
-They are flexible to giving you deals on the spot (at least in my case).
-Gorgeous area of town to try out bikes (they will let you try out before you buy, as most bike places do)
-Cheap repairs on bikes you buy in house

Would definitely give them my business again

There was a lot of hype to Yangming which led to disappointment.  It definitely didn't live up to it's reputation.  I have to say that the food was good and the twist on the menu was exciting.  Unfortunately the portions were pretty small, making it over priced for what you get.  I never appreciate a place where I spend a decent amount of money and leave hungry.  
    The other issue was that the decor was very dated.  I don't usually comment on decor but at this price point I would expect a more sophisticated vibe.  I guess for the suburbs it's fine but to be honest, I've had just as good at half the price with twice the portion size.  I doubt I'll be back.

Very small little place in the botanical gardens. Not a very big selection, but the food was really tasty! We got a beef sandwich and a carrot/butternut squash soup, with an apricot bar for desert, and I'd order any one of those again.

I came on a Sunday morning, right at 10am, when Rx's brunch officially begins. (This was a fluke-- my friends and I just happened to plan to eat at 10). Well, yay for good timing, because we got seated immediately (which I was grateful for, since I've read about the long waits for brunch). We sat outside, and enjoyed the lovely sunshine and the quietness of the Sunday morning atmosphere of this quiet, tree-lined section of Spruce Street. Ah. And the food was delicious. There is a limited menu, but I think that's because everything is totally homemade and unique, so you might not get a lot of choices, but everything is made with care, it seems. So. Homemade and healthy and bursting with flavor-- what more can you ask for? My friend ordered french toast with berries, and it was amazing. And the orange juice was some of the freshest freshly squeezed orange juice I've ever tasted. It tasted like the oranges had been picked that morning and squeezed freshly into a glass just before being served to me... My mouth is watering... In any event, I highly recommend this place. Come, and come early.

The food was actually pretty good.  Unfortunately, that's the only positive and why I gave it a high mark of 2 stars. After being sat outside, took about 8 minutes for someone to greet us and take our drink order.  Returned a few minutes later to take our food order. Had to go inside to get refills of our water.  When I inquired about our appetizer, about 20 minutes had passed, she said it was coming.  About 40 minutes after ordering, we got our app and 2 entrees all at once.  When I asked why they app wasn't brought our earlier, she said the kitchen was backed up.  I looked around outside and inside, about 4 tables total.  I told her that the restaurant isn't even 25% full.  Never checked back to see how our food was or to refill drinks.  We were clearly finished with our food, and she just walked by, I had to ask for the check.  I left the card on the table, and after about 10 minutes, she still didn't pick it up.  I actually had to go inside and ask for her.  The bartender said she will be there in a few.  Another 6 minutes passed, card was still on the table.  We got up and left, I wasn't going to sit there (especially after going inside and looking for her) for another minute.  Do I feel bad about not paying, absolutely not.  I shouldn't have to beg to pay a check.  The management should make her pay for it since it was that horrendous and 100% her fault.  I do not remember her name, hopefully she found a new profession.  Will never go back, or recommend.  If someone talks about going there, will definitely steer in new direction.
I like the atmosphere of this starbucks. Plenty of different options for seating- comfy chairs, high top, long tables, small tables!

I stumbled on Chic-Hog-O's while my colleague and I were looking for lunch after a meeting up the street. What a find! I've been back again since, and everything I've tried is delicious. I especially love the warm olives, roast potatoes, cauliflower, and the roast beef sandwich (which they did up for me gluten free with crackers on the side!)

The service has been wonderful both times I've gone, and the patio is amazing on a summer day. Highly recommend this new Edmonton gem.

Pied Piper doesn't quite deserve all of the hype it gets from the locals. I think a lot of the accolades come from the fact that it is a local business rather than the actual quality of the ice cream.

I live a few blocks away and have swung by to get ice cream a handful of times over the past year that I've been in Nashville. The ice cream sounds better than it actually is. The flavors are inventive and if they actually delivered the taste that their names implied I bet they would be pretty good. As it is, I usually order something that sounds amazing only to be slightly disappointed once I actually get it.

I guess with local ice cream parlors I tend to look for quality and a feeling of indulgence, I just don't get that at Pied Piper. It's kind of like cheap ice cream in flavors you won't find anywhere else. To be honest I prefer Blue Bell from the grocery store.

Came here with a group of friends for the Kehlani concert a while back, and it was an interesting experience!
 
Pros: 
-The venue isn't too huge so you're fairly close to the stage wherever you decide to stand
-The acoustics are pretty good, so everything was heard very clear
-Bathroom line wasn't crazy long (guys, sorry ladies)

Cons:
-The floor was sticky like glue, not sure if it was ever cleaned or what, but my feet were sticking to the floor like crazy
-The concert was almost an hour shorter than advertised, not sure who's fault but that was a little disappointing
-Area is pretty sketchy late at nights so be careful, and there's like no parking 

Overall: C
It's a decent size, but the floor is sticky with something, so that's kinda gross. It's an ok venue considering there aren't many in Reno, hopefully more open up soon though!

For years, I went to the same salon, owned by a family friend.  After a few bad haircuts, I realized you should mix never the two (I could never bring myself to tell her I hated it).  So, I cut the cord and shopped around for a new stylist.  

After being non-committal and not trusting people to do more than a trim, for about a year and a half, my hair had gotten pretty long. So I decided to donate to locks of love, made and appointment at Aveda, and prepared to have 10 inches chopped.  To my surprise, when I left the salon I had a great haircut, but Kim had talked me out of it because she was positive I would hate it, and didn't want to give me a cut I would hate.  She scheduled me for an appointment in a few months when I could cut that much off and not leave in tears, and I'm so glad she did (the glasses of red wine she offered also eased my anxiety).  I still prefer my hair longer, so she has been AWESOME in working with me to have manageble styles in the transition.

Even though I have moved to Center City, I will not go anywhere else.  The customer service is phenomenal and you can't beat the products.

This was the #1 most favorite Chinese restaurant in Pennsylvania! I feel like this place has a good menu. They have both American-Chinese and Authentic Chinese. The staff was always polite to is when we went! I think everyone should try the scallion pancake(which are my most favorite item on the item)!!! If you get a chance to go I guarantee that you will love it!

I have written a review before and I can not stress how amazing Market Street Gold is. Anthony is truly an amazing business owner and he is so thorough with his work. He gives you the best deals and is truly an honest worker.

I found this menu and this food to be amazing. As an out-of-town visitor, I'm excited that I found it and would recommend it to any traveler. The only downside is that it is a bit expensive, however, I can see that their prices are in line with their expense and did not feel like the prices were out of line. Were money not an issue at all, I would be delighted to become a regular diner! Highly recommend!

Thank you ITA101 for a lovely evening!! Everything was perfect.  Reservations, table, service, and of course great food and desserts.  Thank you Paula and Patrick for taking very good care of us.  We are very lucky to be able to dine in a cozy local restaurant and get world class food made with the freshest ingredients while prepared in a very creative and delicious style.  Not to mention the fantastic home made desserts.  I was particularly impressed by the table side tiramisu.  It was almost as good as mine. lol 

Very well done
Molto Buono!!!

Great service! Windshield got cracked pretty bad after some debris flew out of a semi with open top, the tarp had come loose, and the crap inside was flying out on the highway! Awesome! Anyway, called the make an appointment, got a reasonable price quote as far as paying my deductible went, got started a few minutes late (no big deal, there were several people in the waiting room), and my new windshield is perfect. Front desk people were nice, low key, and checking out was a breeze. Waiting room was like sitting in a freezer, so that made me tense during my two hour wait, but whatever... Glad I know this place is on 86th! It's scary driving around waiting for your windshield to fall to pieces in this pothole ridden city.

This place is perfect. It fits a niche that was seriously lacking in this area. The beers are fantastic and can be appreciated even if you are not into craft beers. The menu is limited but everything on it is local, so delicious, and pairs perfectly with their beer selection.

Very good Mexican restaurant with reasonably-priced dishes. Our server was very friendly and courteous. It's a cozy setting with only six or so tables on the main drag of Phoenixville. Parking lot is just around the corner, but not next to the restaurant per se--probably about a two-block walk. It's cash only, so bring your dough.

I expected a bigger place but it was rather small,I estimate about 10-15 people can fit in the shop. At first I was confused with their menu, the lady should've helped me since I kept staring at the menu for a long time ( not like the menu was very long). When my bf asked if we could mixed flavors, we were told there was only one flavor-plain yogurt, then things started making sense. We shared a medium froyo and topped it with dolce and sweet wafers, black berries, kiwis, and sprinkles. The total came to be about $6.50. A bit pricey but the froyo was creamy and very good. I cant say i'm a fan but ill come back .

This is the first time I felt compelled to write a restaurant review because I was so impressed. the food was not only beautiful to look at, but it was delicious.  The atmosphere was way above what you find at a normal Thai restaurant and the service couldn't have been better.  The firecracker shrimp were delicious and cooked perfectly, and we highly recommend them. We will put this on our favorite restaurants list.

Im gonna try to keep this brief:

The food is delicious, but absolutely not worth it. Not worth the price, not worth the time, not worth the crowd, not worth...it.

Excellent thin crust pizza. Big portions of well-cooked and flavorful pasta. But seriously, what is the big deal about this place? Go on any night...at ANY time...and there's a long wait. Like minimum 30 minutes and quite often over an hour. No reservations allowed, so go fuck yourself. Appetizers are like 10 bucks, and some are even more. Entrees between 12 and 25 bucks. Dessert, another 10 bucks. Its virtually impossible for one person to eat here for less than 20 dollars. That would not be unrealistic if this were a classy place or medium upscale. But its not.

The decor is cheesy. It was a bit more appealing in the mid-90s I think, but its grown old. Its like they want to be seen as a classic italian restaurant but also as this hip new place and the two just dont work together. Its dim lit and still manages to be distracting. They almost exclusively hire hot 20-something waitresses, which under normal circumstances I would enjoy. Here it just adds to the wanna-be pretentiousness they serve up every night.

Finally, there's not enough parking. I wouldnt care, but I swear they did this purposefully to add some sort of pseudo-exclusivity factor. Fuck that, its just annoying when you have to park a quarter mile away only to wait an hour to be served over-priced, slightly above average, identity-confused Italian food.

I had summer in a bowl!  

We found this place because it showed up 1st when looking for "restaurants" in Santa Barbara, CA  on Yelp! after not getting into another restaurant for an hour even with a reservation.  There were two people in our party.  We shared an appetizer, each had entree and our own desert, an espresso and a glass of wine for  less than $75.

I highly recommend the Linguini con Gamberoni, it is summer in a bowl!  Sauteed onions and garlic in a light (really) saffron sauce with grape tomatoes, arugula, and several large prawns tossed in linguini.  They only have it on their dinner menu, but we showed up for a late lunch and they were happy to make it available.

Several flavors of gelato available along with a wonderful array of other desserts.  
The food is 5 stars all the way, the only drawback is the space.  You need to be okay with sitting close to your neighboring tables.

So I finally got to test out what all the buzz is about thanks to a buddy with an office across the street. And it was really good! Got the Razorback N'Forth, which is a baked ham & swiss cheese, Dijon mustard with extra swiss and parmesan grilled on the outside. It was excellent, and just enough food where I could eat it all without needing a wheelbarrow to get outside. 

They also seem to have a great beer selection, and even some funky sodas to accompany you for lunch. Would like to try it out for dinner as well, as some of the entrees looked super awesome.

We did have to wait for a bit during a Friday for lunch, but I guess that's to be expected. The location isn't huge, and obviously the food is really good so it does get crowded. And I did pay $12 for a ham and cheese sandwich, which does seem a bit high. But overall I really enjoyed it and will return.

Very effective treatment.  I always get good fast results.  Cheerful, friendly, inteligent, very experienced, knowledgeable doctors.  Low prices.   Little or no waiting.  I wish they were in LA.  I only get to see them when I am in Florida.
Nothing special. Mediocre burgers. For some real good burgers try the Dairy Inn...

Quiet coffee off the beaten path.

A quaint spot with good coffee and a few treats.  The seating area isn't overly large and when I was there, there was a real menagerie of folks -  no dominant subculture from what I saw:
A woman feeding her child
A foreign family from the former eastern block
Two book worms sneaking leering glances
Yuppies in fuzzy sweaters and sweater vests with fuzz
A hipster with thick glasses drinking a trendily small cup of espresso, probably between cigarettes
And us

I love how it is off the main streets in a pretty cool alley.  I would like to go back.

Carry out service is extremely poor. Told 10 to 15 minute wait when calling in my order. Go up and sit for 30 to 40 additional minutes.  Then the next time I decided to wait at home for 30 to 40 minutes before going to pick up and  then I sit and wait 15 to 30 additional minutes. So after multiple times of this game I ask the girl at the counter the trick to this because my time is valuable.  She said that they won't make a carry order until it is paid for in the store because they dont want extra food.  What the heck. ...why...I called for carry out for a reason. ..for the time waiting I could have eaten at a restaurant and left...and no other non-fast food restaurant makes me pay before they make my food. Not good customer service and I won't be a regular customer any more!

Always a home run! Such an amazing restaurant and it is in the Quarter. Their cocktails are fantastic, they are patiently crafted goodness. The food is also really great, I have not had a bad item yet. 

If you are coming for dinner, especially with 4 or more, make sure you make a reservation. This restaurant is busy and there will most likely be a good wait if you do not have one. There is a great atmosphere there and they have always provided me with an enjoyable evening.

I adore this coffee shop! As someone who has spent countless hours here working on everything from blog posts to my master's thesis, I have nothing but good things to say.

The coffee is phenomenal. I usually opt for a classic cappuccino, but everything else is just right too. You can also save a bit of money with their loyalty card, which earns you a free drink after every 9 purchased. I am also a huge fan of the food. The Grilled Eggplant Panini and Salmon Lox Bagel are divine. The portions are great, along with the prices.

Still, the best part of all is the ambiance. In the summer, I love to soak in the sun on the outdoor terrace. Inside, there are lots of other tables to choose from, which plenty of outlets and natural light pouring through. 

This will be one of the places I miss the most when I eventually leave the Main Line. It is cute, cozy, and caffeinated--what more can you ask for?
Pretty good. Fun place, but pretty dirty. If the bathrooms are that dirty, it scares me what the kitchen looks like.

The food was tasty, but the service was AWFUL!!! The busboy did a great job & should be promoted to waiter and the waiter should be fired! He never came to our table to see how things were. Had to ask the busboy for coffee refills and water.

We have tried a couple times to eat here...it's always so darn crowded...doesn't matter what time either! Finally we picked a night we could get in! The sushi did not dissapoint! The salmon was like butter, the tuna was very fresh and the seaweed salad was flavored just right! One of my favorites items to order is the hand rolls. Typically they can be a little tricky to eat if the seaweed paper they use the wrap everything up in can be tough...which in my 30+ yrs of eating them is the case,  but not at Hiroba!!! It was perfect w/a little crunch so as not to destroy it while enjoying the spice tuna w/avocado. ...I do feel the sashimi pieces were way to thick...Enjoying the whole piece of fish w/out having to bite it in half is much better. I thoroughly enjoyed the BBQ eel, yellowtail as well. Poke is always ways a standard for me but I found theirs a bit on the salty side. Although I did list a few negatives, the food was in no way what earned them 4 stars. Unfortunately it was our server/service. She was nice and pleasant and all but I must say her waitressing skills was truly the worst I have expierenced ever. It leaves me to believe she is simply oblivious. So, this will be one of those places (which we all go to) where the food dictates over the service. Look forward to our next visit!

Had lunch here with my brother the other day.  I hadn't been to Red Robin in years.  This was honestly just a choice out of convenience.  Coincidentally, I'd recently heard some good things from a person who is into food.  I mean not AMAZING things, but just like "eh, if I'm in the mood for a good burger, I like Red Robin".  So I was  a little interested b/c of that.  Kinda disappointed though, b/c, honestly, it was just an average burger and fries.  Not awesome or anything at all.  Not really even better than Steak n Shake but definitely a few bucks more...  The service was fine.  No complaints about that...

Terrible customer service, the food is extremely bad and expensive. Also the woman cashier doesn't even know what she is doing. And she was rude and careless, wish the owner fire her. I would never come back to this place. I'm wasting my time and money here.

Easily the best thing I've eaten in New Orleans. My friend and I both had All That Jazz po boys, and it was the meatiest, cheesiest, most bang for your buck sammich you'll ever have. 
Honestly it was so huge and dense my friend and I could have shared one. 
It's one of those places you could easily pass by and never know that magic that comes out of there--it's just a little kitchen/convenience store combo. Nothing fancy at all. Just good soul food. 

PLUS they're 24 hrs.

We had reservations at SoBou and we're really looking forward to a new dining experience there.  We were there to enjoy the Reveillon dining experience.  When we asked if we could do a shared plate (we are two women and cannot eat a 14 ounce Porkchop apiece), we were met with a, "no we cannot do that" kind of attitude which really set us off.  There was nothing appealing on their menu.  We have had dinner at several restaurants since then that we're totally accommodating to the ReVeillon menu plus additions a la carte. I am a travel agent and and sometimes asked by my clients for referrals for good restaurants.  I will not be recommending SoBou as one of them.

The service here is terrible. Takes forever to get a drink. The one dude bartender takes his time with everything while the woman works her butt off. Nonetheless on Tursday there are $2 tacos in the bar area all night. The food is great and it never takes long after you put in your order to get your food. Has good happy hour specials.

We love this place for lunch.  The service is fast.  The food way above anything else close, and the prices are reasonable.  We hit this place at least once a week, if not twice.   The pasta changes daily as well as the soups.  We are particularly found of the celery blue cheese soup, the turkey rachel, steak quesadilla.

For dinner, I love...  I mean LOVE the sweet tea brined pork chop.  The only thing that could make it better is if they used heirloom pork.

Southern comfort food AT ITS BEST! You would not expect it from the location exterior but this place has some of the best comfort food I've ever had. Get the grits at breakfast time. These are like no other I've ever had. It's like they're made with cream. Best mashed potatoes, collard greens, and the meatloaf- yum! The staff is always super friendly and you can't beat the price!

Well, I guess they couldn't put enough lipstick on this pig...CLOSED! We rode by last night and I noticed the building was vacated.  I ate there once, and had to grumble internally as we had guests, so this comes as NO surprise.
Great selection and prices.  My Mom was looking for a dress as a wedding guest.  Trish was extremely helpful, patient and made many suggestions.  She rocks!

One of my fave spots since moving here a couple years ago. I always recommend SouBou to people passing through. The location is great, the service is friendly, and the decor is fun. A good vibe, overall.

If I'm coming in for a quick bite, I highly recommend the burger on the small bites menu. Boudin balls are delish, and the pork cracklins are just incredible (and only $1, so you might as well just order them).

It's also fun to come with a group of people and order all the small bites. You won't regret sharing and nibbling little bites. Just do it.

A group of 4 went to Arde last night for dinner.  We had a reservation at 8:15 and were sat at 8:30.. But these things can happen. It was extremely busy and was a Friday night, so I understand a little wait.  The ambiance of the restaurant is cool-- something you'd expect in downtown Philly.

It took a little while for our waiter to come over to us, but again it was really busy.  As for the food, we got calamari as an appetizer and it was good, especially the dipping sauce.  One person got the short ribs as an entree and said they were good; another got a pizza with sausage (salsiccia) and it was good as well.  But two of us got the arugula and prosciutto pizza and were very disappointed.  Our waiter explained that it was more like a calzone than a pizza, but were more than okay with that.  It came out and it looked interesting- basically a ring of stuffed dough surrounding an arugula and prosciutto salad.  The disappointing part was that there was very little ingredients stuffed into the dough.. It was mainly dough.  So if your favorite part of a slice of pizza is the crust, please get this dish.  But if you're like me and like more taste and variety than a ring of crust (albeit tasty crust) stay away from this entree!

We most likely won't come back here, as we weren't too impressed with the food that we found to be overpriced for what it was.

What else can I say about Slack's? It's my go-to place whenever I'm looking to order out. If you haven't tried the "Wild Thing", you haven't lived. They have awesome fries, hoagies, pizza and burgers. Their wing sauce is delicious. It's also a nice, spacious place to catch a bite to eat, especially on Saturday's when WIP tends to host an afternoon show about every other month or so. The customer service is top notch as well. Nothing but good things to say about Slack's.
Amazing tacos! The tempura avocado taco well exceeded my expectations and the queso was delicious! Staff was very friendly, as well. My husband and I will definitely be going back!

There were flies and topsy tables but the food is so good I didn't notice them when I started eating. The plates are big so come hungry but even then I could by eat it all. The candied bacon is also very delicious, great place for brunch
Food is amazing.  Only complaint is the drinks are bottled only.  No fountain drinks or iced tea, except in a bottle.

My husband and I love Kyoto.  We try to go every week.  The fish is fresh and delicious and the service is fast and friendly.  Whenever we have out of town guests, we make sure to take them out to dinner here.  We also like that it is family run (very nice people) and the prices are very reasonable.

I've been to Vgë Café twice & I can't wait to go back! The 2 times I went, there were different staff members working and all of them were so friendly. One of them recommended the falafel wrap/ sandwich and it was absolutely delicious. 
Their vegan pizza was pretty good but their soft serve vegan ice cream that was my favorite! I wouldn't recommend their kale chips- they didn't have much flavor. 
A ton of their options are vegan and the rest are vegetarian. This is a must try for anyone but especially for vegan/vegetarians

Let me start by saying this review is solely based on customer service. Never made it past the horrible service to actually order my food. It began by the young girl starting off with an attitude, then I handover the coupon that I had just purchased from Verizon and was quickly shut down by her.
