I was told the new owners do not accept these coupons even though I just paid for it. Then once I asked for the owners name she said "don't get me in a bad mood" after that I had no urge to give them my business.

I love Oregano's! The food is always great, and so is the service. There's usually a bit of a wait to get in, so be prepared to hang out for awhile. I think 20-45 minutes is pretty average, but it's worth it. This place has a fun and cozy atmosphere, and it's always an enjoyable time. My favorite is the Bowl O'Pasta, and the pizza is excellent too. You can't visit without getting dessert, and the pizza cookie and cheesecake are delicious. I'll definitely keep coming back!
Wonderful hotel!  We stay there every year for our anniversary which happens to be New Years Eve!   The staff is so friendly and we enjoy the convenience to downtown.

The manager refused to turn the heavy misters off even though half the customers were soaked to the bone and complaining.  They comp'd my meal, I tipped the nice waitress 60% for trying to handle my complaint.  So, maybe don't sit outside under those misters. The beer list was excellent, but we had to leave before I could finish my flight. Since we were only in Boise for one night, this put a big damper (hah) on our Boise stop, so one star.

edit update 8/11. the manager made things right later on,  and it sounds like the misters should be more fine tuned by now.  Raising from 1 to 3 stars because the owner does care. Will try to stop by next summer road trip.

I don't know why, but this is my least favorite Village inn.  I know the decor is drab and unknowing and servers are abrupt and act entitled.
I guess,  I know the food is the same standard quality, but  I never really enjoy eating here.
It has to be the atmosphere and me, just not a good match. I always try to avoid this location, but sometimes it is the best spot to meet.
The line " it isn't you, its me" seems to apply here.
I guess when you are eating diner food in a dingy locale, it can take it from the possibility of exciting right down to almost a duty.
What's a girl to do? I love most dives and diners, but this one just doesn't make me happy.

Love Love Love this place!  Their pad thai is to die for.  Light, flavorful, fresh and I can't get enough of it.  Their dumplings are also excellent.  If you're looking for something different try the indian pancake appetizer.  The dipping sauce is thin, but flavorful.  Be forewarned- their lunch menu has some different options from dinner.  Ie. the general tso's chicken is delicious for lunch, but they don't offer it at dinner.  The wonton soup is also good with homemade noodles, but also not offered during dinner.  The ambiance of the restaurant is also nice and modern.  Try this place...you will not be disappointed.

Worst experience I've ever had at a restaurant and it takes a lot for me to say that. I've worked in the food service industry so I am pretty understanding when it comes to bad service, but this was a whole other level of bad. It took 10 minutes before we ever saw our server and then he forgot part of our drinks (oh and a kids milk cost more than an entire gallon of milk at the store). One item came out 10 min before everyone elses and as the food runner brought our food, he asked if our server let us know one of the items we ordered was out (he hadn't of course), so we ordered a replacement which took over 30 min and was missing part of the ingredients. Oh, and don't you think if you're going to have a restaurant outside with heaters, that you would make sure they all work? They don't. A bunch were broken and it's mostly outside seating. All that aside, the ambiance was cool and had the heaters all worked, it would've been really cozy for being outside. Also, the kids area down below is really great so there's that upside.

This yearly event is held in downtown Tucson every October.  It is a great way to learn about other cultures and especially the food. I enjoy all the dances and entertainment too.  I would recommend riding your bike or taking the bus. I think the parking would be limited nearby.  I would not know since I always bike downtown.
Really tasty breakfast sandwich and friendly service! Cool little spot with a great mission.

pro:  fun game room. 
con:  for the food and drinks we received ~ expensive!  some staff seem unjustifiably 'uppity'.  staff also shameless in their attire; we could see the hostess's bra thru her invisible blouse, for instance.  made for an uncomfortable visit.  we won't be back.

Great burgers, shakes, and atmosphere.  The only downside was our 1.5 hr wait.  This happened to be on one of the coldest days in Nash, so that didn't help.  We had 3 people, so finding a seat at the bar wasn't as easy, but probably would've been better instead of waiting that long.  The hostess wasn't exactly the friendliest either, but not bad.  It could've been due to all the people waiting, not sure.  But once we got seated, it was great food.  Very filling.  The chocolate malt was fantastic as well.  Laid back atmosphere.

Best brewery in town. Food is always delicious. Bar tenders are on point great wait staff that gives off a great atmosphere. The lamb sliders are off the chain. And the Caught Inside their double ipa was amazing. Definitely gonna keep coming back

Although I've lived around the corner for a few months, I went to Bacchus for the first time this weekend, and man am I glad. I had a veggie panini and my pals had meat panini's. We all agreed that they were delish, and we'll be back. The wait was a little long for a sandwich. And for all those who didn't pay attention during middle school mythology, (like me), Bacchus is the Roman name for the Greek god of wine and intoxication. Thanks, wikipedia.

This Credit Union could have some of the worst customer service that I have ever experienced. On today they were supposed to open at 9 a.m., due to the weather they have a sign on the door that says they will not reopen until Tuesday January 17th. But there are at least five workers inside diligently working. As people approach the door to get in no one acknowledges anyone. I called the main office they said they will open at 10 a.m. can someone please explain to me why out of five workers they couldn't at least put a sign on the door that says we will open at 10 today instead of 9. At least there is a bank here I guess. They also are one of the slowest Banks during normal business hours. If you could locate another Neighbors Credit Union I would visit that location instead

This place is killer. Super friendly staff, great atmosphere, ample seating, and great coffee. Pretty much my ideal. I am sitting at the window, watching the city pass by in all of it's flurry of activity while nonching on a tasty bagel dish. 5 stars.

This hotel met my expectations! The hotel is well maintained and the staff were friendly and helpful (Marilyn was great in banquet services as we rented out the lilac room for two days). The room was nice and clean although the carpet and bathroom seem a bit dated. However the room offered a microwave, fridge and Keurig coffee machine which I put all
to good use! They offer coffee until shortly after breakfast (it would be nice to be available longer throughout the day). But they have cookies and fruit infused after in the lobby all day. 
Luggage carts were usable but not great for the parking lot as they are flimsy and it was icy and snowy out. Would stay here based on location, free accessible parking and the rate. Would recommend!
Worthless. Missed 2 pick ups and left me with my 5,7 and 9 year olds stranded in the middle of the night without any chance of getting home. Horrible.

A beautiful salon to walk into. Has a great first impression. That staff all seem friendly and professional. I enjoyed a shampoo and blow out this morning leaving me feeling pampered and beautiful. My stylist was sweet, beautiful and very good at what she does.

The Yelp reviews are not wrong: this place is the real deal. Fantastic food, charming and personable owners, and a real little slice of Philly in Clearwater. They have a great menu, too. Beers are served frosty and cold, salads are generous and fresh, and the food is genuine and delicious.
Great company, great doctors, that runs a straight forward business.  The chiropractors are great to work with and will leave you comfortable and informed.

It's been awhile since visiting P.F. Chang's. This visit was so delicious, I think it will become a weekly ritual. 

We began with a shared appetizer of lettuce wraps. Definitely a portion big enough for a meal. We then enjoyed the dragon roll and ended the evening with the Mongolian beef. The only change I wished for is less green onion in the beef. Next time I'll request a sub of peppers. 

Love that they offer both white and brown rice. Evening was capped off with fortune cookies that delivered the perfect message!

I had a great experience with Mr. router. I am a small owner operator of my own business, so I'm hesitant to call corporate or franchise companies to perform work for me. I called the Company around 1030 on a Saturday and had someone out around noon. Upon arriving the service technician was very kind and professional by the name of Pablo Gonzalez. He was very presentable and his equipment was clean. Pablo made sure he had on booties before he walked into my house. The drain was cleared and he gave me a 30 day warranty on the drain and honored the $79 Internet price. Pablo included a quick camera check of the pipe and called Dan another technician that was in the area he came over real quick. They were not too heavy on the upsell of other services so overall my experience was great and I would recommend using those two gentlemen

Yes, it lives up to the hype!!  Yes, it's a bit pricey, but the service and food were all wonderful.  We saved this as our last meal out on our visit to NOLA, and it did not disappoint.  The front hostess was very welcoming, and no pretension attitude either. :)  

Our waiter was prompt, attentive and offered great suggestions from the wine list to the menu.  

Wine list had lots of great choices...it was actually hard for me to choose!! 

Appetizers: Tuna Tartar--very good, reminded me of sushi flavors, and beautifully presented.  Also had the Pear & Roquefort Salad, which I enjoyed.  

For the main course: I had the Chilean Sea Bass w/ hot & sour broth, mushrooms & baby bok choy.  Perfection!!!  The Drum fish w/ mushroom risotto was also delicious & well prepared, though I only had a bite.  

Dessert:  Our waiter was kind enough to inform us upon ordering our dinner that the chocolate cake and apple pie takes about 20 mins to prepare, but I decided to order the Salty Malty Ice Cream Pie.  HOLY...that was SOOOO GOOD!  

Just make sure to make reservations, as this is a very popular place!!!
I have had Mongolian barbeque all over the world.... No comparison here.... Not worth the effort definitely would not take a friend here.

I'm STILL on the hunt for an overall good Mexican restaurant in Smyrna/LaVergne. Let's start with the salsa - bland (that's all I can say about it). I ordered the Steak Chile Colorado, one of my favs that I've eaten many times,  and it comes out with what I can only describe as pot roast. I can deal with that, I suppose, but the meat was also bland. The sauce was decent and probably the hottest Chile Colorado I've had - I love heat so no complaints from me. The rice was undercook and crunchy/hard in the center. The beans were typical. 
I won't be back.  There wasn't enough to make me want to come back and try again. Where can I find some good salsa around here!?!? I am moving to Murfreesboro next month... Maybe I will have better luck there.

Likely my favorite Mexican/Tex-Mex restaurant in Cool Springs and regular weekend dinner hangout. For this trip, we arrived before 5:00 pm on Friday night to avoid the typical large crowds and wait. We were seated immediately and served promptly.  I know that I cannot resist their chips (best when warm) with creamy jalapeno and fresh salsa. The creamy jalapeno, in particular, is addictive, while thd salsa is very fresh and with a bite!  Two of my favorite dishes are the Southwestern Enchilada with blue tortilla, hand-pulled chicken, and fried egg, along with the Elvis Presley Memorial Combo. But countering the "donut effect" I went with the dieter's special, Tortilla Soup (bowl), which is delicious and filling.  My wife loves the "Big As Yo' Face" oven roasted chicken burrito.   Altogether, a great dining experience, with delicious food, filling, reasonable prices, and great service.  Happy eating...

Love this salon! 

They use animal friendly products and if you ask they can use all vegan for you. Always friendly and clean. 

In the past I've always come home to redo my hair because no one ever styles it in a way I'm comfortable with. However, Kira not only gives me a great cut she gives me the best blow dry/style! You'll come out looking like a celeb!

I cannot speak on other items on the menu but their breakfast was trash! I ordered a western omelette, homefries, and grits. Let's get to the omelette first: wasn't bad tasting but thin as hell. Most standard omelettes come with 3 eggs. Clearly they skimped on the eggs. I asked for onions and peppers in my homefries... yeah, that request was ignored. The grits were just a big old mound of tasteless corn meal. I asked for butter and pepper on the grits... no butter and oh yeah, they gave me a pepper packet but that's not what I asked. And on top of all of this foolery, they forgot my wheat toast. This restaurant really needs to pay attention to detail and not do whatever the hell they want.
Best service around. A+++ no where else to go around USF excellent service and good food

I have been here a couple times and each time I have left with a bad taste in my mouth...both metaphorically and literally. I really didn't flinch when we were told the wait would be around 45 minutes when we arrived for Sunday Brunch. What did bother me was the fact that we stood there waiting to put our name in while the two hostesses were chatting up friends that happened to walk by the stand. Literally we stood there awkwardly hovering as they talked about their previous night's escapades-- it wasn't until they hugged their friends good bye that they turned to acknowledge us. 

While the food may be decent ( I will get more to that later...) the management at Green Eggs certainly don't believe in any sort of customer service. It took 15 minutes for a server to come over and get our order. As I was perusing the menu I noticed in fine print that there is a "take out container fee." Granted it's only 25 cents per container but REALLY? I have to pay extra to take home food that I already paid for.

 Luckily my meal was so bad, I didn't have to worry about the quarter fee. I went with the special pork cutlet sandwich. The bread and sauce was good but the pork was served a tad on the pink side. After waiting 30 minutes for our food to come out I was hesitant to send it back..then I saw sitting on our table a letter informing customers that under no circumstance will an item be taken off the bill regardless if there was an error in preparation. It said we could send it back and they would re prepare it. 

Come on Green Eggs...you clearly are making bank- here what with your line around the corner, your cash only policy and quarter surcharge for to-go containers. You REFUSE to EVER take something off a bill if you mess up?! 

Needless to say I didn't send it back because I didn't really feel like waiting for them to re-cook it and I knew I would have to pay for it anyways. I did eat the homemade kettle chips which were unevenly cooked, with some downright raw potatoes. My husband had the chicken and waffles benedict. While he said it was good it doesn't hold a candle to Silk City's chicken and waffles. 

All in all I will not be back to Green Eggs...and I recommend you avoid as well.

I was skeptical of Furusato because of the whole, you-can't-see-in-through-the-windows thing. It's also past the tracks, and almost directly under Candy Spa. So, y'know, it's a bit iffy when you're walking by. But I'm very glad I decided to venture in.

This is definitely some of the best Japanese food I've ever had. We started with complimentary fish balls (I didn't try, but my husband loved them), then mixed tempura (pricey for a full order, but delicious), and a couple of big plates of maki that were pretty tasty, too.

The whole place feels very authentic. It's got a cool, wood-and-bamboo typed decor with lots of kitschy Japanese decorations all over the walls.

Our waitress was friendly, service was fast, and overall we were very impressed. Pro tip: get there early! We scored the last two-seater and the next couple that arrived had to wait 20!

What happened to this great restaurant?   I started dining at the Carmel café in 2011 into Tampa on North Dale Mabry.  They had an awesome menu, great food, great atmosphere. I moved to Clearwater and have been to the McMullen Booth Rd location a few times. It appears Carmel Cafe has been bought out, changed their name and their menu has become stale and low quality.  No more cozy atmosphere and sofas, No more beef tenderloin, no salmon with quinoa, no fabulous pound cake ever so crispy, warm and delicious with a wonderful taste of almond with strawberries and whipped cream..........  Stick a fork in me.... I'm done.  Won't be back... Thanks for the memories.

Scott is the best! Thanks for teaching me how to be safe while having fun. I appreciate you coming back and checking on us before you left, thanks for being so upbeat and positive. You made our experience great. 
- madi's

If I could give less then a one star I would. Slow service, bad service, small and watered down drinks, uncooked waffles ( my kid can make waffles) and really just subpar at best. Save yourself and don't do brunch here. Maybe dinner is better, but I would never try it again to tell you if was.

My husband and I were feeling homesick for NYC last weekend so we did a search for a NY style deli on yelp and it led us here.  Great pickles!!!  

The interior decor reminded of of Juniors and Stage Door (now closed) deli's in New York. 

We had a hankering for chopped liver so of course ordered that, salads and he had the tongue sandwich, I had the stuffed cabbage and we shared macaroon for dessert.  

The liver was good, not what we get in NY but good, best if eaten with the french fries instead of the pita chips they serve it with. Could use some simple rye bread and sliced onion instead of the chips as they break when you try to dip or spread the liver on them.  Salads were nothing special--but decent. Sandwich was fabulous, Boars Head meat is always the way to go-and they do!  The stuffed cabbage Vito style was scrumptious and HUGE--we ate it for 2 days following!  The coconut chocolate macaroon, while not in the traditional style, was fantastic. 

Service was good!!! Our waitress (Michelle) was sweet, accommodating and willing to make recommendations. Attentive without being overbearing which is a tough balance and she did a great job.  (Since moving here we are still trying to get used to the Tucson style of waiting tables, VERY chatty-she wasn't and that was nice )
 
Definitely heading back to try the chicken pot pie--
This is one of my favorite  breweries around. The selection  its  outstanding  and their beers are spectacular.  And the owners  and staff are very nice and friendly

Stopped by evening of 4-28-17 about 8 pm. The gentleman behind the counter said "all that's available is in the case as they had already shut down fryers." I asked then chicken livers and tenderloin not available? He said fryers are shut down. It was 8 pm and they do not close until 9 pm. Kinda like going to the store and cashier tells you we close in one hour so we can't ring up your purchases. Glad this clerk doesn't fly a plane and decides to quit flying an hour before you land. Went to another business and purchased our meals as they seemed happy and courteous to have customers.

April - We heard bad things about this place, but I wanted Mexican, it was late, and we live just down the road. It was taco night and I had the pork tacos. The pineapple in the salsa reminded me of mango salsa but a bit different, not in a bad way. My wife had the pork verde with some soft tortillas on the side. We both thought the food tasted fresh, not bland, had some distinct and wonderful flavors. Overall it was a great restaurant - The staff was friendly and attentive. They had some drink specials and since I like tequila so I was happy. We told them it wasn't bad, especially considering we heard bad things, they said they made a lot changes recently. It's good to have a great Mexican restaurant that doesn't require 20 minutes of driving. I think they need a bunch of homemade hot sauces to dribble here and there as you eat. Who doesn't like interesting hot sauces, plus they are cheap to make - so make on! Just print your own crazy labels.

A few months later, and two more meals under our belt lead to this review edit-

May - Meal two the pork verde changed some sides, ok, my wife missed the zucchini it had the first time, but I understand, use what you have fresh. The fajitas that my friend and I had were great.

6/7/17 - Third visit the pork is no longer slow cooked... Its not tender at all, grilled, and present as large chunks of meat that are too dry,  and swimming in light green super spicy verde sauce that look like slop next to the beans and rice. It's too hot, I wiped a lot of the sauce off and added sides to each bit. I like medium to hot Thai food, visited Thailand twice and didn't stay at resorts - I can handle the hot!  It just didn't taste good. Come on management - pay your staff to prep and cook the food the right way. Grill the tomatillos, slow cook the pork, stop adding tomato paste to the salsa as filler. Really still no signature hot sauces on the tables/ to sell when I ask, tourists love taking home hot sauce. If you give the cooks frozen pork and expect them to do something 30 minutes before opening, it's going to be bad. I felt bad I told my friend she had to try the pork verde, she couldn't eat it and switched plates with her husband. The fajitas were still good. 

Now I know to get the fajitas, non-pork tacos, don julio margaritas, etc, but you lost us on the pork verde :) The Pork Verde was our favorite dish when I wrote the original review.... If you want people to keep coming, you have to let cooks make the food the right way, or you will just loose more clients and fail.

The wait staff saves this place, we thought our waiter tonight should be at a four star restaurant - professional, knowledgeable, acknowledged our complaints, but still served us with no attitude.  In the past the bar tender and even what seemed to be the manager were very nice as well. But I can see the corners being cut with staffing/prep, and quality of food, and I'm in the medical field not culinary. 4 stars for the benefit of the doubt, it's up to you on the next visit if it goes to 3 or back to 5 stars.

Pardon the grammar of my phone's voice typing.

So I had a mocha craving this morning. The drive thru lane was empty so I decided it was the perfect time. 
The employees were very pleasant and even though I could tell they were tired, got what I ordered with a smile:) much better experience than previous ones I have had at this location:)

If you're drunk, add a star.  I guess you could say that about most greasy spoon places like this.  It's open 24 hours in the heart of downtown Reno, so this can be a great destination in the wee hours of the night after hitting the bars/casinos.  Trouble is, it used to be a better quality, cheaper place than it is now.  If you've never gone though, I'd definitely recommend it as a good dose of sleazy old school Reno flavor.

I know what you're thinking, "Thirst D., get over it.  It ain't 1999 anymore.  Things are more expensive, and usually not as good."  True, however, the prices were reasonable and the quality was high until about 2006-2007 I'm guessing?  So this is a fairly recent decline of a classic establishment.  

The Nugget is a very small casino with a two-counter diner (no tables) in the back area.  As everyone knows, the centerpiece of the Nugget diner is the Awful Awful.  It's a cheeseburger with a half-pound patty, special sauce, onion, lettuce, tomato, and a GIANT basket of scorching hot fries sprinkled with seasoning salt.  What used to be a screaming deal @ $3.50, then a good deal for $5.50, is now a so-so deal for $6.95 that can't measure up to other burger places in the area.  The atmosphere hasn't changed though, cheap and sleazy!  Don't expect the friendliest of service, especially when it's packed with customers at 2 a.m.  Don't expect a clean counter.  Sit down at the greasy counter, give it the obligatory napkin wipe down, and prepare yourself for a greasy assault.  Also prepare for a completely random, generally seedy assortment of locals, homeless, tourists, and downright unclassifiable people.  When I went at 4 p.m. on a weekday, I sat next to two crack whores who twitched and picked themselves as they waited for their food to fry.  Love the atmosphere, I'd almost bring it up a star just for that...

What pissed me off on this last visit was that I asked for the burger to be cooked medium rare.  Then I watched as about ten patties, including mine, were grilled into well-done, smoky oblivion as the cook disappeared completely for a good seven minutes during the cooking process, apparently for a drink or a meth break.  After seeing the uncooked, barely thawed-looking patties come out of the fridge though, I may have been better off having it burnt.  The quality of the meat seems to have declined.  What used to be a fat, juicy patty is now a flat version of its former self.  The onion roll that it's grilled on is still pretty good, and the fries are the same, but the meat makes me want to try the version at the Wolf Den instead.  There are actually small cards advertising the Wolf Den scattered around the Nugget counters, so the owners may be aware that this version of the Awful Awful is the cheaper, lesser quality one.

You could still do much worse for seven bucks though.  I remember their other items being pretty good too, like the Awesome Dog, which used to be $1.99, now it's at least $5.  The fried calamari sandwich, which sounds good, used to be about $5, now it's $10!!! Word on the street is that it's a pretty disgusting item, at least the modern day version.  It seems like the best deal going is the Hangover Omelet, which is a four egg chili cheese omelet with hash browns and toast, served with a Bloody Mary--all for around $8.  I've had this in the past, and it's a great hangover cure.  

What I miss most are the daily specials, which used to run about $5.  Prime rib, half a chicken with the trimmings, London broil...and all of them cooked to perfection.  The casino used to be a lot busier then too, and they used to play that crazy "double jackpot" song where lights above all the machines would flash and the locals would play furiously in the hopes of hitting the jackpot at the right moment.  Good times.  The bar is still pretty cool, with 99 cent drafts, and no-bullshit, no-nonsense bartenders who have to double as bouncers due to the unpredictable clientele.  

This is still a cool place to go if you've never been before, but now more for the overall experience rather than the food.  The good ol' days will have to exist in my head...

This place is great, especially if you are looking for a nicer salon. I went because I wanted a place that didn't have the acrylic dust and fumes. There was a 30 minute wait because I didn't make an appointment, but they did a good job and were friendly enough.

I enjoyed looking around at the items they offered. Good prices, and the clothes I found all smelled fresh and not like someone just donated them and they hung them right up. The cashier was so nice and told me about a couple other thrift stores in the area and what their missions were.

Walked through City Park and then headed over to this lovely little place. We had some delicious white sangria and a nice bowl of paella in this cute, cozy restaurant. It was a nice quiet place to eat after a few nights of French Quarter frenzy. You can also BYO beer or wine for a minimal corkage fee. Good deal!

Wide selection, moderately priced, fast, and clean. Convenient location between clayton road and hwy 40. Italian beef and gyro were excellent, chicken chili and chips were average. I will absolutely return.

Whenever I'm in Boise I alway come here!  The people are friendly and simply just great people!  No fake wannabes here. 

I'd also like to call out an employee that has served me twice in the passed two months!  

Tyra, makes sure I'm seated next to an outlet so I can work and dine at the same time!

Tyra, also had me sample a new beer...  I went for it and was a great addition to their menu. 

Tyra, thanks for making the dinner worth it again... cheers
Had the lavender rose latte and avocado toast both were delightful! Friendly atmosphere would recommend!
This place never let's me down. Great service and great food. The Chicken Parmesan pizza style is just what the Doctor ordered.  Who ever has room for cheesecake? ? Take it home and eat it later.

Go. Just go. We tried this place for our anniversary and were pleasantly surprised. They did a great job giving this spot a facelift post-Ela! The vibes are good, it's busy but you don't feel like you're waiting forever and service is on point. We over ordered but that's life. I suggest the tagliatelle and the Italian salad. Also, grab the mezcal cocktail (or 2). Fair portions and affordable. You'll be happy!

We were there for Memorial Day weekend to celebrate a 85 birthday 
Staff was so helpful, kind  and friendly 
Maids worked hard with a smile
Food was good
Gym had some good classes
Great place for a large group 
We will be back
Ryan and Larry came to my house to fix ceiling lights that were not working. They promptly diagnosed and fixed the problem and also gave me advice on another light issue that I had. Thanks guys!

Horrible. Was hungry looking for something new. This was not it. Tried the Chong qing spicy chicken and cabbage and pork dumplings. The chicken cut was the worst cut. Couldn't even tell you which part of chicken it was. It came with fatty skin and on bone with ligaments. The spicy sauce was super overpowering and soaking the meat in an unflavoring way. This sechuan recipe was poorly executed in every way. The dumpling filling was good not excellent and the dough was wet and not appetizing. Couldn't even finish it.
Good beer and good food.  Service was OK.  Nice open air surroundings, would return again.
my burger absolutely rocked!    i got the monkey burger.    cooked to perfection, good fresh toppings.   fresh cut fries.  i would recommend this place 100% to anyone wanting a delicious burger!
Great taste, filling and healthy options... I love the simple butter and sugar.., but the vegan options are fantastic...

I have had nothing but superior maintenance and customer service from Chapman since I purchased my vehicle from them in Sept 2015. I would highly recommend them for both buying and servicing of your vehicles.

Of course, I love Evolutions Yoga Studio, I have 62 check in.  The classes are wonderful and all the instructors are helpful and encouraging.  Going to yoga for 3 to 4 days a week has changed my life.

We had dinner here tonight after my convincing the wife, as she is not a huge fan of Vietnamese food. It couldn't have gone much better, except for a minor snafu when the spring rolls came out just after the entrees. Our server, Chris, offered that they were on the house as a result of the mistake and we should accept them, which we did. We were glad that we did because they were really good! The entrees were spectacular. We took Chris' suggestions and he was right on the money. My wife had the Saigon Udon bowl and it was that complex blend of favors that I look for in Vietnamese food. It looked and smelled like it could have been overly spicy but it had the perfect blend of heat and sophistication. I had the La V vermicelli bowl and it was another hit, right out of the park. I wish we had had room for dessert because what we saw looked great, but it leaves us something to look forward to on our next visit. Excellent!

I don't think this place will be open much longer.

The food is along the lines of a chain restaurant around any mall in the Philly area.  The bar was out of the one high grade IPA listed on the drink menu.  Alos ran out of the wine one of our party was drinking.  At that point I noticed that the booze bottles behind the bar were awfully thin and spread out, all tell tale signs money is tight.

Service, although friendly and attentive (at times), was not very good.  Beer served without a glass.  A plate of cold food.  A forgotten request of a round of drinks.

A comfortable place and rather nice inside.

Nothing here is real good.  Average at best.   For the owners, this is one of their better places, but still has many of the flaws of the other places, Public House, Field House and City Tap House.

So unhelpful- bagels aren't labeled and the kid was very annoyed that I asked what kinds they had. There were about 5 others who could have helped and it was empty. NO BAGEL TOASTER?! They MICROWAVE your bagels. The cream cheese was pre made into slices. I have a cold bagel sandwich. Sad. I won't be back.
Soooo good! Not a long wait considering how many people were in there. They quality of the food and service is perfect. It's a nice kickback spot with dope music to match!

I have shopped at Redners since I was a child when I would go with my parents. I remember Redners reputation for having the best sales on butter and sugar. In my adult years I grew to appreciate redners for their cheap frozen food options, however their produce section would make me break out in cold sweats at the shear over-pricing. I recently visited my local redners because it's the only store I can find fresh crab meat not in a can. I needed it for my mango crab salad recipe. My final missing ingredient was a mango so I caved and went to the treacherous produce section to get a mango. I found one that seemed good by the feel. Fast forward 2 hours, I am making the dish and cut open the mango. It is rancid and smells of rot. I cannot put it in my beutiful salad in knowlege it will taint my salad.  All the other over priced ingredients I purchased from this grocer were fine and I will return for the crab meat assuming other markets do not resume carrying it. No more mangos though!

Smaller salon  but most of the staff that works here is nice! There's one girl in particular who has a super strong thick southern accent and she is just as nice as can be. I've taken notice that at this store, they are doing their jobs. They are always behind the counter or folding towels or cleaning a bed when they aren't up front. I also appreciate that they don't push me on sales. I don't like that and I like that they just get me in and out efficiently.

Hands down best place to get coffee on the east side. 
It's roomier than it looks from the outside. There is plenty of tables to work at or cozy chairs to relax in and outside tables to enjoy on a nice day. If the line is to the door it's worth the short wait, the workers are always quick upbeat and know what they're doing. The coffee always taste fresh and the tea selection is pretty good too. 
The food is simple and fabulous. The scones are always perfect they flavor is amazing (my favorite is the bacon and cheddar but the rosemary and pear was to die for) even the bran muffins are delicious!! 
Definitely a place to check out and a coffee drink is a great compliment to Jenis ice cream.

We have been members for 4 years.  This is a very friendly club, it seems like it would be a good socializing spot for singles, couples or families...We chose the Cross Bay tennis and athletic membership. This allows access to Club Corp's 4 clubs in the Bay area plus Tampa's Centre Club for dining.  
Countryside currently has an excellent chef (Roger) and a new, modern dining room and bar.  Friday nights are packed with live music and a full dining room. The 14 clay tennis courts are meticulously groomed and the fitness center is spotless clean...The golfers tell me the 27 holes are very well maintained and challenging.
Great club!

Ahhh bagels my comfort food!  Daughter took me here for breakfast on my birthday unfortunately we were disappointed.  

The best part of eating a bagel is the cream cheese that goes on top.  My mother used to say that she liked a little bagel with her cream cheese.  Well, that's certainly not the case here.  I have never had a bagel with so little cream cheese on it.  Spread thinner than butter and didn't even cover the bagel.  Prices are not cheap for these bagels and there is no excuse for such stinginess.

Regis past year, I've really gotten into Kava and Kratom. It's such a great remedy for the mid day exhaustion that truly hits. Or the morning or night exhaustion! 
Some days, you just truly need a pick me up and the healthy alternative is Kratom or Kava.

Right in the heart of Downtown is Kava Culture, a place I found by complete accident. From hanging egg chairs to couches to tables- this place makes you feel home and comfy. A place you can bring your furry friend and they even have a bed and toys for them. 

The staff is knowledgeable and extremely friendly. I've been there MANY times where I've had no clue what I want, and they walk me through different strains and tastes.
Had a quick bite with accounts, not easy to find a lunch place in Reno. The cobb salad is tasty.

We stopped in on Sunday around 1230, only option was the brunch. Not sure if it just was the day, but what was offered was not worth the cost. Plates were out both times someone from our group went up, there was nothing to indicate what the items were (I realize most are obvious), the salad was wilted, eggs out (they were replenished)....the selection, for the price just didn't make sense. There are brunch buffets in the STL area that you get more bang for your buck. We should have asked the price, our mistake. 

On the plus side the Bloody Mary was decent.....

Ordered delivery of four large pizzas for a kids chess tournament at 2:40pm on a Thursday afternoon.  Told it would be 40 minutes.  Called at 4:10pm to ask if the pizzas were coming, told the driver just left the store and was on his way.  Called again at 4:45pm and told no pizza was coming.  13 kids went hungry.  Thanks for nothing.  Will never use them again.

Ahhh Sonnys! Most of us have been here before when we want some BBQ. I always get their turkey, baked beans and Mac and cheese. All good stuff but have you ever had those onions rings?? Tried them for the first time and I stopped eating everything else.  Hmm who knew how long they were hiding that delicious surprise???

The food is right on par for what you'd expect around here. Its not horrible, but not particularly memorable.

All of the food is of the pre-processed frozen variety. Just what you want to buffer the overly hoppy beer that they serve.

The food is a notch above Denny's and the beer is decent.
If you want to get the Great Basin experience at home, snag some takeout from red robin, grab a six pack of fat tire and invite some annoying 20 y.o. co-eds and their moms to your house and throw on your 'favorite' Rev Horton Heat album.

Good sushi, horrible service. We had a reservation for 7:15 on Friday night and arrived at 7:25 when we walked in we were ignored and when we tried to get our table they just brushed us aside. We waited 15 more minutes and then asked again for our table and they still brushed us aside and told us to wait. We had time sensitive plans after our dinner so we were getting impatient. After finally waiting 30 minutes after our reservation we were seated. Disappointed because the sushi was great but our experience was tainted by the horrible service.

Great place! Locally owned and owners who make you feel at home. Treats and nail trim for my dog and feeders and food for the birds and hummingbirds. Bulk items like cracked corn for the ducks that are reasonably priced. Terrific!
Best beer selection in the country, but definitely always too crowded and the bartenders are a tad angry.  No tolerance for beer idiots!
Fairly typical of hotel restaurants. Food was fairly good and you pay extra for the convenience.  Was more impressed with Rusty's at the Sheraton across the street.
My wife and I stopped by for a quick lunch. We were not disappointed. My wife has been several times before but this was my first. Highly recommended for quick wholesome food.

Sorry to say this but your new patio does not work. It looks like people are sitting in the middle of a parking lot..because they are. The design resulted in what looks like a corral with no room between tables to have a private conversation. We watched while the patio was being laid out and were concerned that it would end badly and in my opinion it did. Sorry but no more weekend mornings sitting outside Brewed for us. I am guessing it will survive just fine but it bums me out. 0

Beautiful place and gorgeous aquariums. However the staff here could care less if you come in. Not sure how they do any business. No one said hello when we walked in or acknowledged us at all. I'll spend my money elsewhere. Never going to this place again.

Clay Glover is an exceptional real estate professional. The conditions of the sale of my mother's home in Saint Petersburg were complex because I had to coordinate on her behalf from across the country. Clay understood the issues and dynamics of working with seniors and showed great patience and empathy during the process. He was always available and responsive by phone or text and maintained a positive outlook even when minor details arose which made my mother anxious. Nevertheless, she felt very comfortable working with Clay. His vast knowledge of the Tampa Bay market and outstanding negotiating skills helped us secure an offer for our asking price within two weeks of listing the property. I would not hesitate to recommend Clay Glover. He is honest, customer focused and a pleasure to work with.

I came in with high hopes for the Abbaye, and while it was charming, it did not live up to expectations. The atmosphere was quaint and charming, and the waitstaff was excellent. 

For a place so proud of its beer, though, the impressive was somewhat limited. They only had 10 choices on draft, and I struggled to find a good match. Fortunately, the bartender let me try several samples until I found my beer. 

Even though it's located just off of 2nd Street, it's far enough from the beaten path that it's likely to stay intimate and cozy, rather than being a destination bar. It's a solid spot for those in the neighborhood, filled with good food and good people, but didn't quite live up to the hype.

The Two Hearts Sunday was amazing!  I'm not much of an ice cream person, and I loved loved loved the ice cream.  It's not too sweet, and the strawberries were sublime.  I'll definitely be going back again!  If there is no seating available, you are required to receive your dessert take-out only.  Not a problem - the ice cream is sooo delicious!

I have to admit that I was super pumped when our friends made reservations at Margot for an after symphony dinner.  Since moving to Nashville and hearing/reading all the good reviews could not wait to see what culinary excellence awaited.  However, the entire evening there was a total let down.
Basically,
Service:  Our reservations were for 9:30pm and arrived at 9:15pm - the waiters acted like they did not want to take a late table and our entire meal was rushed.  The server was obviously ready to get the heck out of there - she did not explain the menu and we had to flag her down for drinks.  Once the drinks arrived, she proceeded to spill about a 1/4 glass of wine on the table while reaching across 2 people to pour and knowledge of bar items was less than stellar.  "what bourbon do you guys have??"  "Well we have jack daniel, crown royal..." "What??!"
The appetizers were barely on the table when she brought the second course.  To top it all off, the waiter began to smell more and more like an ashtray while dropping things off at our table (which I think is extremely disrespectful to smoke outside in between handling people's food).
Food: Everything that we ordered was well made and tasted great.  However, thought it was extremely overpriced for the ingredients included.
Atmosphere: Small and cozy, but too rushed to enjoy it.

Bottom line:  With tip a dinner for 4 people which included 2 appetizers, 4 second course items, entrees, 1 dessert, 1 bottle of wine, and 2 drinks was close to $300 dollars.  I left feeling totally deflated and disappointed because for that kind of money the service and food should be impeccable.  Maybe I am too picky but it will be a very long time, if ever that I dine here again.

This place is awful. As soon as I walked in, I was swarmed by salespeople and you could tell that they were sizing me up. 
So I politely tell them that I don't need any help. I know what I'm looking for. I have a feeling I'm going to find it. All I need is for folks to leave me alone for a few minutes to think things through on my own and they're probably about to get a sale from me.
It didn't happen, though, because they wouldn't leave me alone. When I started shuffling the hangers to get a look at the sizes and prices on a rack of shirts, the owner starts giving me a lecture about how I don't need to look at the sizes because I can tell by the color of the hangers.
His actual words are, "There's a very simple system in my store."
He was really getting hostile about it.
At that point, I just walked out. 
I THINK I saw a sign that said "please don't touch the merchandise" on my way out. Not sure about that, but it definitely squares with my experience. 
This place should have died with the 70s, because that's the era it's stuck in.
I found what I wanted at another store down the street where they left me alone after I told them I was fine to look on my own.

Made a special  trip  downtown just for the Awful Awful burger and it was just that awful, the burger was small and tasteless, the fries  were cold and stale.
This was not the burger I remembered from the past. Don't  waste your time.

A great shop! Jason did my tattoo and it turned out amazing! He is extremely talented and confident in his talents. Jason was able to do exactly what I want with the tattoo to cover up multiple deep scars.

Oh the flavors! This place is fantastic- tried several different items on the menu to share; steam buns, pork dumplings, wings and the monster sushi roll.  Everything was so flavorful and fresh- I'm still dreaming about those dumplings a week later! The drinks are fun too- I had the drink with the layer of Nerds on top and although the candy was sweet the drink itself was very earthy- it was a great balance.  Can't wait to go back next time I'm in Tucson.

Don't overthink it. Just order what appeals to you. I got the Mac and Cheese and it was so well done!

And order LATKEs! 5 small to a plate, so you might want to order your own!!!

Visit the store last weekend, found it to be a really nice store.  The sale people did
ask a lot of questions but it was fine by me.  The items were really nice all American made.  I really like that personally.  A bit high in price, but the jeans were well worth
the money.  Will visit again, because they have some very fashionable items.

DSW a great spot for the the shoe shopper  from man to woman even for the kids this is where you want to be at. This saves you from outrageous priced stores in the malls, or even downtown. Great  big a shoe outlet for all ages and races with  reasonable prices , and a friendly staff. 

Sad to see this  business is about to  fold up for what reason I have no idea. DSW saved you from the madness of mall shopping.

The staff here has always been helpful.  The wait can be a little long at certain times of the day if you're in a hurry (I'm probably just impatient).  They've got every supply you could possibly need to ship just about anything.  Even if I've brought my own box, I invariably forget something like packing materials or tape or whatever.  They've always got me covered and the rates are reasonable.  The cutoff time for dropoffs is also relatively late.

I picked up Taco Bus today for my Cinco de Mayo party at work. This was my first experience with Taco Bus and had received a recommendation from a co-worker. The food was fresh and taste great! They were so kind and packed everything in individual boxes with two tacos rice and beans. They included napkins utensils and made sure that we had everything we needed. They packed up the queso and chips and salsa in individual servings so it was easy to pass out at the office. Everything had been done with such care. The management team was so kind and the employees were very helpful. Amazing experience. I would highly recommend this Hillsborough location. I will definitely be back!

I loved the vibe, the staff, the craft cocktail and food options. So I bought my membership on line at https://www.messinasocialclub.com/ months ago and then summer happened. I finally stopped in on my way home last night. The woman at the door processed my membership card, explained my membership privileges and then let us in the door. No photos and limited phone use allowed. Inside we found a dimly lit early 20th century-vibed space. The bartender Shamus said the club had the second oldest liquor license in the state and that we sitting in the front of the original 1909 bar. But what was cool was while there were some key original character features, they painted the walls a trendy dark blue and added brass and gold sconces and chandeliers and art. Music was awesome. The drink list was fabulous- a mix of traditional cocktails and newer creative ones- not too creative to be well balanced. We only had drinks, but food menu was similar to the cocktail menu having a blend of styles of food at varying price points. Definitely going back.
Drove up, got dry ice and block ice and the guy even helped me lift my cooler into the car. Easy peasy! Highly recommended.

Came in last night while my parents were playing horseshoes. Great customer service, my chicken salad w/honey mustard dressing was AMAZING & I enjoyed the atmosphere. Also my
Dog gives it a 8/10. So he approves.

We USED to love coming to the WRG. It was one of our favorite spots in Reno. We recommended this place to all who asked us about good places to eat. Well my YELPERS I am speaking in past tense because, although it has a nice atmosphere and good service, the food now sucks. Found out (as we guessed) that they have a new chef... too bad!

We went to Two Sisters today-very cute shop....however they open at 8 we got there at 9 and they were already out of donuts.  The muffins were good-cupcakes very cute but  they didn't have any drinks for the kids (I was expecting cold drinks in a cooler etc.) but just coffee....so I guess I was expecting more...I know it was a busy day for them-but we all left a little disappointed.
I always enjoy Chick-fil-A! And today I tried their new macaroni and cheese, it's absolutely delicious

For full review please see
 http://eternity-ply.blogspot.com/2011/03/nomiya-restaurant-review.html

My first impression about Nomiya is very positive. The decor is very nice, new, and the color scheme is quite relaxing. The place is quite small (sit about 30 people or so). I got there are 7pm on Tuesday night and the place was still packed. Luckily my friends were there already, and I didn't have to wait to be seat. The music in this place is very subtle and is not overwhelm the conversation we had. The waitress was quite attentive and the service was good, except that our food didn't come at the same time, and certain item took really long (see below, Saru Soba). One of my friend came late, and the waitress didn't rush us at all, she was very friendly also. Their menu can be a little bit confusing. Food are categorized in type (appetizers, tapas, sushi, and rice), however, ramen menu was on a flimsy piece of paper. I wish that they could have done better than this. The price was not bad considering big bowl of noodle only cost 8-10 dollars, some might find that their sushi can be expensive compare to other place around town.

.... see website for full review :D

I have taken my son Cooper her sense he was 10 months old 

Always a very good job for a toddler hair cut!! 

Old style barber shop with typical barber decor

I don't get my hair cut here myself as I'm Bald but if I did have hair this would be the place!

It was late, I was in the mood for Japanese, and there were few options for takeout. I ordered hibachi, and it was so-so. This place is located in what used to be a Mediterranean restaurant, not sure how long ago that was... They have a dine-in area and small bar area to pick-up takeout. 

I didn't get any sushi, so I can't comment on that, but I wouldn't come back for the hibachi.

While I have not tried many Chinese establishments in Philadelphia - the food here is as authentic as it gets. Their Dan Dan noodles were so good, almost as good as the same dish in the Bay Area! The seating is plentiful and the staff is extremely helpful. 

The neighborhood is quirky and filled with character. The only reason I didn't give it five stars is that the general feel for the place leaves much to be desired. So, perhaps this is not the best 20 year anniversary dinner spot.

The service is spectacular!
The menu is short but diverse!
Every dish is executed well. 
I get the ramen or the NY steak salad usually. 
The price is way cheap for what you get!
And yes you must be a Church member to enjoy this restaurant unless there is a special event.

I had read about this new poké restaurant in a foodies Facebook group where it had just opened and several people were raving about it so I had to try it myself. All of the ingredients were so fresh and well presented. Everyone was helpful and really wanted to make sure I had a great experience. Well, I did! They offered samples of whatever one I wanted of their 6 or 7 sauces to decide which one was best for me and made recommendations so I would create my best bowl ever! Well, I did! Prices I felt were good, portions were just right. I was stuffed, but happily stuffed! I can't wait to go back and try different items on the poké bar that I didn't have this time. They also offer a Sushi Burrito which is basically a poké bowl but it's wrapped in seaweed like sushi would be and it's BIG! Very fun and different! 
The restaurant itself was so clean and well kept, something that is very important to me. I could see that I will get cravings for their food, it was that good!

I love going to the Reading Terminal market during my lunch break. The food for the most part is good, interesting crowds. The only thing I hate is how rude the cleaning staff in the green shirts are. Other than them, the place is awesome.

Their chicken is the best! I come here all the time and it is by far my favorite spot to eat in the Doylestown Burrough. The lady with the short hair was very nice. I love their student discount in the school season. Better then chick fil a, Wendy's, and Burger King combined!!!!!!
Wowoowowowo amazing food amazing people. I even got candy after! Been here twice and plan on being a regular from now on!

This is an unassuming little spot nestled in the middle of a strip mall in Carmel that specializes in breakfast, brunch, and lunch. I met a friend there for lunch during the week, and we had our choice of tables and no wait time. The inside layout and decor reminds me so much of another breakfast/lunch spot in St. Louis called Red Oak Biscuits. 

I ordered the BLT because goat cheese. Nice touch, Rad's! Nice touch, indeed. I paired that with a mug of coffee and thoroughly enjoyed my lunch. Reviewing the menu, everything looked to be pretty health and freshly made. I also took notice that their kids menu had real food on it! There wasn't a chicken finger in sight! 

I don't head north to Hamilton County very often, but this quick lunch trip was very much worth my time.
Excellent service. My mother is super picky, and although the hotel is older and perhaps not as well decorated as it could be, the level of care provided by the staff more than made up for it.

LOVE this restaurant. Great happy hour deals and turns into a club-like atmosphere at night. Gorgeous big two story interior. Has a little bit of a romantic ambiance with a cool vibe. Plays AWESOME music- popular alternative hits. Great delicious food

Well, it was carry out Thursday and H&I fit the bill.  Sounded like a mngr or bartender that answered the call.  -was courteous, & professional, taking my order in detail.  It was great because at one time, the less trained hostesses were taking their calls, which never worked.
We ordered to share:
  French dip sandwich--so good with lots of meat on huge toasted roll, extra au jus, and a small but adequate portion of horsey sauce.  We reworked it a bit, reheated it a bit --was goodness big enough to share, or not!   O Yeah  
  FF-Well, I'd forgotten about their fries, -they always tasted burnt & the texture is soggy.  -not my cup of tea  -no problem, I made a salad.
  Calamari---delish! and that's a compliment for carry-out.  -crispy, not over salted, no covering with peppers etc. and a nice spicy sweet sauce.  Hubster is a connoisseur and trys it everywhere.  This was 5*
  2 filet sliders and 1 chicken slider--perfectly done, couldn't ask for more

I like going out, I live to stay home and cook, and I like to stay home & enjoy a good meal without getting my kitchen dirty!  Thanks H&I

This place is fun. Not fussy like other karaoke places. June is the owner and she insists you have a good time. This is a nice place to gather with friends and sing your heart out. The prices are great. The clientele is fun. June has a great place and is the nicest owner. She is part of the experience!  There is a great Facebook coupon for one free hour. Don't hesitate and check it out!

What a fantastic restaurant off the beaten path-  the service was 5 stars, drinks amazing,  the make some killed mock tails which is always nice and the food was awesome-  plus they even have happy hour until 7-  get the carnitas,  and crab - we did lots of small plates instead of a full entree and boy did we make the rout decision!

GlassWithATwist was wonderful to work with! Their communication was outstanding from the moment I contacted them. Casey was patient and offered suggestions as we comminicated back and forth to get it perfect. Their prices beat local shops and they offered more leeway in creation. I ordered just two engraved hurricane glasses that arrived in perfect condition. The artwork is beautifully done. These glasses are worthy of their place at the head table of my daughters wedding!

This place was great! The restaurant is very cute and has a warm farmhouse vibe. They serve homestyle food but also have several vegan options. Everything was delicious! We especially enjoyed the "Blueberry Hill" blueberry pancakes and "Veggie Skillet" which had loads of veggies over home fries topped with an egg.

Incredible museum and we learned so much about this incredible painter. The staff however  (save for a great volunteer giving tours) left something to be desired. In general, they treated us like we were a hassle instead of guests...from the parking attendant ($10 to park???) yelling at us because he thought we didn't have our parking pass (we did!), to the lady at the register not honoring our coupon as per it's conditions, to the security dude telling me I couldn't sit somewhere while 7 other people were sitting in the same area. The place was packed due to rain outside and instead of acting glad for the business, they acted like it was an inconvenience to have us there. Too bad you don't have a museum without us! I suspect the management must be difficult to deal with. I can't think of any other reason for such pervasive negativity.

Absolutely incredible!  A true highlight of our New Orleans trip.  Food and service were perfect. Our gumbo and fried oyster salad were perfect starters.  The main event was the redfish court-bouillon, as good of a meal as I have ever had.  Cannot recommend enough!

I got a transformation pedicure $27. I am totally satisfied. I've been looking for a normal salon since I've moved here and I finally found it. Reasonable prices and friendly workers. I came on a Wednesday and was helped immediately. This will now be my go to.

I had what amounts to a full mouth restoration by Walter about 15 years ago, and have been going to him ever since.  he's done very creative work for me.  Very highly skilled!

Disclaimer... I've known Walter since 1978.  He was a flight student at the flying school I owned.  He got his FAA Private Pilot certificate there, and earned 100% on his FAA written exam.  He was later one of the sponsors of my business and technology radio talk show on KZSB.  I think the guy is just great!

Nord does an excellent job with providing many recreational activities for all ages!! I am always impressed with the classes they offer and how nice the staff is. 

This particular location is unique as it offers canoeing, family camping and archery! I brought my daughter to try the archery today and it was pretty neat. All ages were there, I'd say 50/50 adults and children. 

There are regular park amenities such as playgrounds, basketball courts, trails, and I think I saw an indoor pool. We loved all the greenery and even saw a wild bunny. 

We talked to 4 separate staffers in different parts of the park and they were all kind and helpful. We will definitely be back!

BEWARE!!! I've made many purchases from UJ and was fairly happy with their customer service until recently. This was probably my 5th or 6th purchase and will most definitely be my last. I ordered an expensive pair of earrings online I used a discount code that was being offered and when I received the earrings they just did not look as I expected them to. When I tried to return them they told me anytime you use a discount code the item becomes final sale. So ok I need to read the fine print I guess but- what an unfair policy and clearly they aren't interested in sustainable long term customers because they were unwilling to work with me. I'm also bothered that none of their jewelry is sterling silver, the cost is outrageous for the lack of quality.

I met friends here for lunch. It is located in the heart of Broadripple in a neighborhood. They do have some parking which is a plus for this area. Cute restaurant inside. We sat outside as it was a beautiful day. The restroom was sweet. I love to see the restrooms in any restaurant I go to. Especially the places that are not a chain. They are usually unique. My Omni friends were happy with their meals. One had a mega salad and one chicken. I had the portobello burger which was excellent.  Next time I will have the dressing on the side. The French fries were very good.
A super peaceful environment with a friendly, handsome staff and delicious environment. Have yet to try the munchies but they looked amazing. 10/10 would do.

Finally got into this place, and I have to say for the most part it was pretty damn good! Service was quick and efficient, and my food came out in a reasonable time frame.
There were a few issues however, first off my burger was supposed to come with romaine lettuce, there was none on the burger I was served.
Next the tomatoes on my burger were almost non existent, they were super thin and very small. But the burger was cooked exactly as I had requested, and the bacon I added was plentiful and crispy not soggy!
The bun could have been a tad fresher but it wasn't super stale either! Prices are a bit high, and trust me avoid the side salad, it's basically mixed greens with 450,000 croutons and sun dried tomatoes, that's it! Not worth the $2.75 price tag.
The burger though was delicious, juicy and flavorful, one of the best I've had in the Dirty T!
With the exception of a few miscues, overall I enjoyed this place and my meal, I'll go back!

Not gonna lie the food is great n good prices. Order anything basically and it will be just great. The ladies that are their during the day are always great. Its nice to have a place like this in the neighborhood you can call any time for a great sandwich anything like the delicious 3$ burger to A special turkey melt! Breakfast especially,try the bacon egg n cheese on a long roll.
Pretty much everything you could want in one place. Tons of energy, awesome food, gift shops, restaurants, produce; it has it all. Must stop when in Philly.

BEST PIZZA NEAR UNI! I love this pizza company. Always so fresh with just the amount of grease! 

Also, best food to get after a long night out at the bars! I like to say it prevents hangovers from happening...but that's just me lol. 

They have a small little to go window that is open until 2am or maybe even later! Love it!

My wife and I came to New Orleans for a visit and heard about this place for many resources. It lived up to every expectation from the minute we walked in the door and the hostess and manager greeted us and made us feel extremely welcome. There was a jazz trio playing who were fantastic and the ambience was spectacular. We started out with great cocktails and had the oyster appetizer, gumbo, and I had the red snapper (catch of the day) blackened with the bbq shrimp, and my wife had the  duck. Every bite was amazing and the service was spot on. The finale was an amazing Bourbon bread pudding. This place has it all. I would definitely come back here again next time we are in town from northern Virginia.

I have tried many gluten free crusts and this place offers one of the best I've tried! Cool atmosphere and friendly staff. My only qualm is the price was a bit high in comparison to other places offering gluten free crusts. 

I would definitely go back but only on special occasions.
Awesome buffet! Has everything you would ever want and the pho station is the best part of the whole thing! Really really good! Also their desserts are awesome also!

I don't usually yelp, but with this constant attitude , thus was a must . This Walmart sucks . The employees have the worst attitudes . They stand around in groups and just stare . Only like 5 lines be open . They are disrespectful and rude . Not friendly at all . This isn't a welcoming place . Great products with all the worst employees .

The food was good but the service AMAZING! Only down side is that the food took a long time to come out. Not that busy so didn't really understand what took so long. Can't wait to come back and try the seafood pots.

The roof top bar has incredible views of the Tampa skyline and overlooking South Tampa. Beauty place to be while enjoying a cocktail. The parking situation isn't great. The parking garage spots are so tight with big cement columns. Sometimes the $5 valet parking is the only option.

I'm very happy to have such a nice salon in St. Albert!
Firstly, the decor is fabulous. The salon looks immaculate and modern. 
I came in to see Jill by referral, and what a fabulous referral it was. She seemed to completely understand my hair without me having to explain anything to her. She managed to cut off a substantial amount of split ends (I went far too long in between trims) without it even looking much shorter. She is probably the first hairdresser I've ever met who has actually convinced me to keep up with my regular trims.

My fiancé and I had such a great experience at Friday Saturday Sunday. We were celebrating an anniversary and had never been here before. Our server was knowledgeable about the menu and answered our questions with detailed descriptions and had great suggestions for cocktails and food. 

We ended up ordering Brussels sprouts and mussel toast to share first. I was seriously baffled by the mussel toast because I had no idea it would be as good as it was. I would never come back here without ordering it. After this, we both ordered entrees which were the perfect size after sharing two small plates. I ordered sea bass and he ordered the NY strip. The sea bass was in a lobster cream sauce that had a hint of lemon and the potatoes that came with it had a mustard flavor which I was loving. The strip came with mashed potatoes and everything was cooked perfectly. 

Because the food was so amazing, we knew we needed to try desert and ordered the brownie and 2 espressos. The brownie was almost deconstructed and had crumbles on top and toffee and vanilla ice cream. Again, amazing choice. 

One of the best parts of Friday Saturday Sunday too is that even though it's a smaller restaurant, we never felt rushed through our dinner and the service was really wonderful. I cannot recommend this restaurant enough and we can't wait to return (hopefully very soon!).

I should have read your yelp review before ordering Jules.  I have never been so sad in my whole life as placing a well executed  order this morning.  I truly thought this was my day today but McDonald's proved to slap me in the face.  I firmly took 2 steps up and clearly explained my love for a number 8 which translates to a sausage mc griddle, hash browns,  and coffee.  Much to my udder dismay as I dove in for my tasty breakfast treat it's hard for me to express what happened next.  I chose to polish off my hash with my left hand I unfolded my greasy mcgriddle paper wrap with my right. There was NO cheese! I thought to myself how could this possibly be happening to me?  Did I hurt someone recently or not give them the time to lend a helping hand?  A waterfall of thoughts of clear black and white metaphorical road divides rushed my visual brain play back device.  I couldn't think of anything recently that would have caused this catastrophe. At that point when I thought nothing else in my life could go wrong I realized that not only did I not have cheese but there was no delicious yellow folded egg. I sat in the car 6.4 miles away from where I had just purchased the worst breakfast know to all mankind in all of history! No egg and no cheese! I knew at that point there was nothing I did wrong that would have giving me the results of what had just been placed in my right hand. My whole meal was ruined as my body started rejecting my hash brown.  My only hope is you use technology at the tip of your fingers to review yelps about McDonald to avoid mine and Julie's pain!  Learn and go forth my fellow earth walkers!

This is one of my and my husband's favorite places to go for a quick dinner out and a great margarita. The staff is always friendly and accommodating. The drinks are fantastic, and the food is very reasonably priced. it's always hot and the portions are perfect. Even though it is a Mexican restaurant, the menu has a lot of variety. You will not get bored of the food. Also, the tortilla chip are hot and fresh and I love the salsa... great taste and a little heat. overall great place to dine.

If you are looking for authentic Italian food I would avoid this restaurant. I ordered the carbonara expecting the rich flavors of cream, egg and pancetta mixed together, but I got their Alfredo sauce with bacon dumped into the sauce as an afterthought. They could of at least added the  Alfredo sauce to the same pan they cooked the bacon in to get the flavor into the sauce. Not to mention the fact that the pasta was nuclear  hot which means at some point a microwave was used.  I don't mind paying $18 for a good pasta dish but this was highly disappointing and completely undeserving of the price tag. 

If you really want a truly delicious Italian pasta dish go to Piccola Italian Bistro. It's a tiny hole in the wall where you can bring your own wine and the chef and  owner is from Italy.  His carbonara is amazing.

Right after we ordered our food, we found a giant roach next to my mom. We motioned for a server who grabbed a napkin and took half of the roach off the seat and didn't even try to clean it. We motioned for yet a second waiter and cleaned it but still left the other part of the roach. The food took around 30-40 mins to arrive and my burger was cooked wrong. We were presented the full check for the order! We won't be coming back. Also there was a spider web on the lighting fixture. It just shows the lack of effort that the staff puts into tidying up the restaurant. As a result, we won't be returning to this restaurant.

I've been wanting to visit Sur La Table and do their cooking classes for FOREVER and was finally able to go and LOVED EVERY MINUTE! 

If you're looking for a date night that's different AND delicious, this is your spot!  They are very well organized and have a menu that you will be preparing as a group with other people that are there for the Date Night as well.  The chef (I cannot recall her name at the moment) was amazing and so friendly and helpful.  She floated around to all of us to be sure that we felt supported and that we knew what we were doing.

The coolest part... whenever we dirtied up a dish or a utensil, all we needed to do was put it to the side and someone picked it on up!  How cool is that?!  I wish we could take them home as I could use that service FOR SURE!! haha!

The food we prepared was fresh and yummy and each step of the way we were guided in making the dinner for that evening.  The time went by really fast and we even met some new friends who were in the group.  Cooking and eating really brings great people together!

Oh!  Here's a great tip - be sure to build in enough time to go a few doors down in Hyde Park to get yourself a bottle (or 3) of wine to enjoy during your cooking experience!  They allow you to bring in outside wine to enjoy and sip while you are cooking.  Sur La Table also provides 20% discount on anything you purchase in the store the evening of the cooking class.  

All in all a fun and different experience and one everyone should try!

I really appreciate that Joel is always professional and courteous. He is very good about helping me find coupons relative to the services that my Toyota Camry hybrid needs. I will not go anywhere else. The staff in general is always very friendly, even when I have to call to get an asap. They also are accurate on the service time for repairs, and often finish ahead of schedule. I've never had any problems. I feel confident in my decision and will only ever take my car to them. -Kimberly Purcell

Tried the Korean Cauliflower taco on a recommendation from a yelp review and have to add that they are absolutely the tastiest! I also tried the brisket taco, while good, doesn't hold a candle to the Korean Cauliflower ones. Would give 5 stars for the food but the tables were wobbly and I was afraid I was going to wear my drink
Food was good, but it took forever to get the food. Also the customer service is in need of some refinement. May try again in a few months to see if it has improved.

Took my car in for Missouri inspection. After determining it had failed, PJ and his team spent more than an hour diagnosing it and then recommended I get the repairs done through the dealer, not him, as it would be more cost effective for me, and charged me nothing extra for the diagnostic time.  I offered to pay for the time and PJ insisted on taking nothing.  He informed me of the codes so that I could share that information with the dealer and save myself $ with diagnostics at the dealer.  I paid $36 for the Missouri inspection.  I have never done any business with this shop but will in the future.

Only froyo place in at least a 20 mile radius that has original sour frozen yogurt! Their other flavors are amazing too, but finding the original from my youth is a win for me! My next fav is salted caramel pretzel
The service was extremely slow tonight, 2 hours from sit down to main course is a bit much.  The food was good, just lost interest with the looooong wait for the main course.

We went into this move with high hopes. Bill King moving was recommended from a friend and they had a great experience so take it for what it's worth. This is just our experience. We moved out of our condo, left our stuff in his storage for two months and then moved into our townhouse. 

The move out was fine. His workers are professional and they work hard. They didn't damage anything in the way out and did it all in a reasonable amount of time. The price was pretty close to the quote so no problem there. 


The move into the condo wasn't THAT bad. The problem is that they were 4 hours late. We had people show up to help us and the. Sit around for hours. Eventually they had to leave and we were stuck by ourselves. The movers showed and did a good job. A few plates and bowls were damaged but that's normal for any move. We had paid for mattress covers but they never installed them. They refunded us but still, our mattresses were uncovered for months in storage. When I called to ask about why he was 4 hours late he literally told me "well that just happens. There's nothing I can do."  Yes, there is. You run a professional business. Be professional. Show up on time or compensate us for YOUR lateness. 

I won't say you shouldn't use them, but we won't for our next move. I guess it's just hit or miss with movers.

I visited McMenamins Tavern last night for dinner. The place is always hopping which is a good sign. Me and the missus were able to get a seat in the rear dining area. They also have table tops in the front of the restaurant and seats along the bar. There were plenty of televisions to view the game. The draft list and other specials were written on a large chalk board. I tried the Lagunitas Saketumi a double IPA aged in sake barrels. I enjoyed my selection which was very tasty. We tried the fried oyster appetizer and the beef short ribs. The missus and I both thought the oysters were fantastic. They were lightly breaded, fried perfectly tender and juicy. The short ribs were very tender and were topped with a nice light sweet sauce. We both ordered the shrimp and chips for our entree. The plate had plenty of fries which were delicious. The shrimp were tasty but I would disagree with the menu which called them jumbo. The breading was not done well and fell off easily. My wife also pointed out that the shrimp had not been deveined. I ordered the Evil Geni IPA for dessert. It was light, smooth and had a slight fruity taste. My wife was surprised that her Captain and Coke was less than my beers. I noticed that the waitress was swamped with trying to handle the entire back dining area with only help from a busboy. She handled it well and our service didn't suffer. To sum it all up McMenamins is a solid bar selling decent bar food.

The 5th Quarter was recommended for the Cowboys/Rams game.  It was totally an awesome experience.  The atmosphere as well as the company was pefect.  There is a restaurant next door, I forgot the name but you can order food there and they will deliver it to the 5th Quarter.  The food was fantastic.
