I ordered a catfish platter and the fish was so fresh and fluffy.  It was seasoned to perfection and although condiments were provided they were definitely not needed.  I will definitely be back.  

Thanks for an Amazing experience for someone who is awkward in social settings I felt right at home

Food about 3 stars, slaw was very good paired with "grits" healthy alternative to rice and beans... Read reviews on margarita's people were "raving" about and in MY opinion they were not THAATTT great.... My husband and I have had WAY better. I'm a fan of the art & atmosphere that's about it. 

Service was excellent!  But we won't be back.

Our private wine tour with Paul was truly one of the most memorable days of my life.  He curated the perfect mix of tasting experiences in Santa Barbara and ojai, we were blown away each step of the way. Paul is so knowledgeable and passionate- and has incredible connections in the wine industry. Can't recommend enough.
Love, love, love this place!!  Did I say I live it?  The staff is so friendly and knowledgeable!   The plants are healthy and appropriate for the season.  I really enjoy shopping here!

I used to go to this small Indian lunch buffet when I was working in the Westshore area. I have a general affection for Indian food and haven't been able to find a good spot in Brandon...until now.  I was minding my business going to my tailor when the smell of this placed peaked my interest. 

It's a smaller place, not something I really had noticed before in this small shopping center.

When trying new places for the first time I try to stick to common dishes that I'm familiar with so I can get a true sense of if it is good or not. 
The curry flavor was not over powering and the sauce was creamy as expected. The spiciness was a good balance of the sweet creaminess as well. 

I ordered it to go and it took about 10 minutes, so I know it was fresh. 
My sense of smell is what drew me in, but I will return due to my sense of taste. This dish was delicious and I'm excited to go back and try others. They also had some good specials for lunch, late nights, and other random days.

Hmmm... I have mixed feelings about this place. I will start with what I love.

I LOVE the décor - so amazing. I walked in (and down the stairs - so it is not wheelchair friendly) and felt like I was in Montreal or Paris. The whole bakery has a cute Parisian vibe and the smell of fresh baked goods was marvelous.

This was my first visit and I let my eyes do the shopping - I purchased several items and even ate a warm caramel orange sticky bun while a staff member filled the rest of my order. The cheese crisps were melt in my mouth delicious, the granary bread has been great for French toast, and the sticky bun was finger-licking good.

The BEST items that I purchased (and I will for sure be returning specifically for) are the scones!!! They had two flavours when I was there - apricot ginger and cranberry - and both were phenomenal. Mmmmmm my mouth is watering just thinking about them as I type. I honestly cannot wait to go back and have another one. 

The only item I bought that I wasn't happy with was the apple cinnamon brioche. The apple slices were so thin so the ratio of apple to bread was way off (too much bread) and the amount of cinnamon would hardly be classified as a sprinkle (maybe they were running low?).

So now onto the disappointing part - the staff member that assisted me. I am not sure I can convey in words exactly how I felt but I came out of there disappointed about the place just due to the service. She was rude and almost acted like I didn't deserve the items I was purchasing. Unfortunately I do have to take this into account when reviewing the whole business. Hopefully she was just having a bad morning and this doesn't happen again.

I will be returning and cannot wait to see what new delicious creations they dream up.

Very fun alehouse with tons and tons of goodies, many of them good for you. Which is the unique part.

Plenty of televisions if that's your thing. 

Amazing service, and crazy amounts of micro brews, what more can you ask for.

Food wise try the smoked trout salad, very uniquely made. Oh horseradish dressing,  god love it. 

This must be Idaho. God bless Idaho. In a sea of choices in central Boise this one is ultra comfortable.

I feel a little odd writing a Yelp review about a tree, however it was an enjoyable stop so here we are.  This tree is massive, no amount of photos seem to portray the size - I took several panoramic photos and still feel I couldn't capture it's size or presence.  Standing beneath it is oddly magical.  I found it a great addition to our trip as it was nice to do something quiet and slow after being on the go at all hours for several days. 

The tree is located in the Audubon Park near the Labyrinth walking path, just behind the zoo.  It's several hundred years old and has a lightning rod to protect it from storms - there's a sign about how it works near the information marker.  Surprisingly, there are no signs prohibiting climbing and if you're comfortable doing so, I recommend it.  I climbed a few of the limbs to get a better look at the tons of moss and ferns growing from the crevices of the tree.  We went around 11am on a weekday and were the only people around the tree, however there were locals jogging and playing with their dogs in the park.

Love this store: always helpful staff and unique gift ideas.  If you are looking for a specific Hallmark item that they don't have in stock, they will call around and get it sent to their store for you to pickup.  I appreciate that and their convenient location, and always friendly smiles!

I don't think I'll be keeping my membership here, which is disappointing. The last two times I have come in I haven't been seen until 20-25 minutes after my appointment and it is blamed on other clients backing things up. There was no explanation or apologies. The facial today was very rough and I am not sure if it's because she felt rushed or angry. I unfortunately have a scratch on my forehead because of it. All in all, I am looking for somewhere more reliable with time, experience, and results and if hasn't been met here. I am not sure if it's the location or staff but hasn't been a stress free experience so far.
The food is so fresh and so tasty. The family inviroment is amazing and I love the place!

My husband and I stopped in here after we landed in Santa Barbara. I got the pickles and Swiss and he got the Venetian. The food was so fresh and authentic. Totally would recommend if you're looking for something outside your regular deli sandwich.

Abdul, taijee, and omar made my moving experience very easy and efficient.  I was given a smaller truck than what i requested from penske but  Abdul, taijee, and omar from all my sons cherry hill were able to make the smaller truck work.   If i ever have to move within their area again i will make sure that request them again

Who knew going to the dentist could be such a joy?! We are new to town and selected Sullivan Partners based on a recommendation from friend. I can say without hesitation this was the best dental experience of my life. The front desk staff we on it, and very accommodating. My hygienist Kyndall was a doll and very gentle with my sensitive teeth. The entire facility is state of the art it really made the whole experience much more pleasant and informative. Dr Rick was attentive and personable. I have another appointment next week and I am actually looking forward to going to the dentist. Crazy!

4.oo eclair = diabetes!!! On serious side. White chocolate  mocha coffee was delicious..prices are as expensive  as starbucks...  pastries were beautiful  to look at yet way to sweet ..slow wait time and workers were less than enthusiastic... .

Several times I have admired my friend's nails and she invited me to join her for a gel manicure $35 and pedicure $32. Despite the subpar reviews and "in the mall location" I decided to give Trix a try. We arrived on a Friday night shortly after 7 pm., greeted by staff with a handshake and smile, and then she directed us to the pedicure chairs. 
Annie Luong did my services and she was friendly, humorous, and wasn't too chatty. After a long work week I just wanted to relax with little to no interruptions.

I previously had 3 week old dipping powder so for some reason the top layer was hard to remove but she was gentle and tried not to be too abrasive with the nail file. She began the removal process and covered my nails with cotton ball acetone, aluminum foil, and a plastic bag. Honestly it killed me that I couldn't use my phone- no Yelp, email, etc. but in 25 minutes I had beautifully pedicured toes and soft feet. 

Next I carefully moved to the manicure chair. This service included: nail soak, cuticle push back, trim, file, gel polish, and a light hand massage. 

Overall I enjoyed my experience. Trix is in a good location near the Off Broadway Shoes entrance and is in close proximity to the restrooms as the restrooms in Trix are for employees only. 
Pros: Closes late and offers a good selection of polishes and services. 

Cons: The prices are a bit pricey. I don't mind spending $72 with tip for service, quality, and relaxation. 2 out 3 isn't bad but it is the mall so you have to deal with customers holding  conversations on their cell phones and mall traffic. Also, they do not offer beverages with service. 

After four days of jogging, weight training, and housework my gel manicure and pedicure still look great. ;-)

I can't speak more highly of this place. I had heard good things about it, but finally after trying it for myself I can attest that this place is amazing. 

I've been several times now and the food has always been excellent. I'm not typically a burrito person, but their burritos are unique, fresh and delicious. The elote is also amazing and a must try - a mixture of corn, mayo and crema. 

Once when I was picking up an order to-go they forgot to give me the Mexican Cokes I ordered and I made it all the way home before I realized. I walked back and they were very apologetic saying "oh, next time give us a call and we'll come drop it off." Even in spite of this, their service has always been great and the food has always arrived on time. 

I couldn't recommend this place more. If you haven't added this to your list yet, you must!
Delicious brunch, great option for kids and adults. Cozy and fun atmosphere and a great spot for quick service.

One stop shop but don't have any other plans for the rest of the day. It took more than 3 hours to complete the appt and that was after being brought back to the back. I thought they had forgotten about me. I had to open door and stand in hall to get their attention. when the doc finally came in the procedure was quick and painless.
L O V E IT! Best authentic Mexican food around. Always fresh and lots of options. My favorite is the tacos al pastor.

The pizza at Brooklyn Pizza, was amazing. The chicken wings were tasty and customer service was great. Everyone enjoyed a different meal and our waiter Justin, was Knowledgeable and could tell you what was great on the menu. LOL, so everything on the menu is great
I love the torta here. The one with the friend jalapeno.  I think it can get pricey if you go very often but the food is good.  It taste fresh

I went there today just to grab a quick bite around 3:45 pm. The personal Pie was better than I ever expected. Best pizza I had in a very long time. I wish I would have taken a picture of the pie before I ate it but the smell couldn't keep me away from eating it. Thank you. You'll see me often.

I went to Han Dynasty and tried the dan dan noodles and dry cooked pepper chicken. I've eaten these dishes at several competing restaurants, and must say that the food tasted just as it should. The dry cooked pepper chicken made me slighly perspire - mmm mmm good! The waiters were very attentive and offered me napkins and more rice when both ran out. As for the atmosphere, the place was nicely, but unmemorably decorated. The food was priced competitively with similar Sichuan restaurants in Chinatown. To conclude, if you want to get Sichuan while in Old City, come here!

I was a big fan of Fat Cat Bar & Grill at Tahoe City, so as soon as I saw that they opened one here, I couldn't wait to try! 

They are located at Midtown and it is a new construction building, meaning, looks super cool and modern! The decor was very appealing and the food was amazing! We both ordered the lamb burger, mine on greens and his with the bun. To go along, we also got fries; sweet potato and garlic Parmesan, one of their signature fries. 

Service was excellent and we even got a visit from the owner making sure we were enjoying our meal. 

If you have not tried this place, pay them a visit!! They are a must go restaurant for Burgers!!!
What a great shop! I stop in here every couple weeks and they always have new trinkets and goodies around. Friendly owners/staff and easy browsing.  5 stars.

Bonuts make me go nuts.... these things were great! I live in the gulch but just finally made it into biscuit love to try them out. Definitely did not disappoint. You get 5. They are rich and filling, can either be a personal breakfast or a great treat to share with your group.

I went in at 7:30 midweek and there was no line. This place is extremely popular and is a tourist spot on the weekends, so be prepared to see a line when you go anytime after 9am Thursday - Sunday. From what I've seen, the line does appear to move quick and they usually have a staff member outside answering questions on the menu so people are ready to order when they get to the counter.

They also have a water cooler outside for people waiting in line to rehydrate from the night before 

I have not tried any of their other food besides the bonuts, but will definitely be back soon to give some of their other famous menu items a shot!
Dr. Kim is the best dentist out there! She is thorough, quick, and so caring towards her patients. I will never go to another dentist!!!
Very nice market!  Of course it is crowded but they have a good guide/map. Everything looks and smells good! I sat to eat at the Dutch Dinner and got delicious cookies! Everything was GREAT!

Came here today for lunch and my meal was very good. I ordered the shrimp and grits. We also ordered the swamp bites as an appetizer and apparently I like alligator! I will say, however, the Mac and cheese was disappointing. It was not done and tasted like sour cream. The waitress was really cool about it and offered another side to replace it. No love lost, I'd return. I want to try the key lime pie because it looked delicious. They also served king cake today (Fat Tuesday), and wooooooow,it was so delicious!

Great decor. Waitress worked hard with lots of customers needing her all at once. We had breakfast. Raisin toast burnt on one side.  Don't get the ham with your breakfast. It was pressed ham and was also very salty. We would have brought this to the waitresses attention but she did. It check back with us after bringing the food.

I cannot say enough nice things about the owner and the staff and the food, of course. We missed their closing time by 15 minutes and they responded and made us food because they're just that awesome. You should definitely check it out if you want a sandwich or salad

Caitlin was recommended by a mutual friend, and I couldn't be more thankful for the connect! I moved to STL for a couple months and needed to maintenance my weft beaded extensions and also needed a color touch-up. 

Caitlin scheduled a free consultation to talk through what I wanted / needed, and then she talked me through what we would do at my appointment. She provided a quote and time estimate for how long I'd be at the salon so there were no surprises. We booked my appt., and now I have a fresh look that I am OBSESSED with! Her color work is fabulous - I'm incredibly impressed with the dimension her color has given to my blonde hair.

I'll definitely be a client for life - Thanks for the fabulous color and extension maintenance!!

Never again. Super!!! salty!!! Lady on the phone had an attitude because I re-read my order making sure she heard me correctly SINCE THEY PREVIOUSLY MESSED UP MY ORDER. Ordered two boxes and barely ate the first one. WASTE.

We were warmly greeted by the hostess downstairs. She told us the wait would be 45 minutes. We decided to wait it out. 

They were busy and quite slow getting the food out, but everything was delicious. Theresa, our server, was polite and courteous. We had the Pot Roast Cheese Fries and Buffalo Chicken Rolls to start. The Pot Roast was bursting with flavor and the Buffalo Rolls were perfectly crispy. 

For Dinner, we had the Crispy Caramel Chicken and the Wood Grilled BBQ Burger. Everything tasted so good. 

I could see the kitchen from the table and noticed that every single person was wearing a face covering.

The absolute worst. Two delivery orders in a row wrong. The first was a couple of weeks ago, we ordered onion rings, they forgot the petal sauce. Tonight, we ordered a black and white shake, they sent a strawberry. Both times they delivered the forgotten or correct item after a phone call, but when everyone is finished eating what's the point. Lesson learned we won't order from there again.

I'm posting this review so they have feedback that might help them improve their business. I've been waiting patiently for them to reopen after the pandemic. All other gyms reopened two to three weeks ago, yet they remain closed. I joined Crunch and cancelled my membership at Youfit. Their inability to open says a lot about their planning and operational leadership.

First time at Revel and definitely coming back!! Fresh healthy ingredients with lots of options. I had the build your own bowl with cauliflower rice, veggies, chicken, and cilantro lime sauce. The bowl was fresh and very large, I had leftovers. The cauliflower bites were also very good. It's great to see a healthy restaurant in the area!

Ordered carside to go. Parked in the designated spots. Sign says to download the app or go to Applebees.com and Text "I've arrived" to let them know I was there. There's no number listed to text. So I ended up calling the restaurant to let them know I was there. They said they aren't doing curbside and that I had to walk into the restaurant. So I get to the front door and it's locked. Now they have a doorbell. Stood there ringing for awhile. Finally, the girl I probably spoke to on the phone comes out. Not very pleasant. When I get home, the food was very cold and the serving size of the veggies are about a 1/4 of a cup full. I'm very disappointed.

I went here since it was in walking distance to my rental for the weekend. The guy inside was really friendly and gave me great advise on bait and tackle. 

He sold me what I needed at a really  cheap price. I ended up catching a lot of fish. 

I returned a second time for more bait. Very friendly.

Please believe the hype about this place. We had the opportunity to eat here during Essence Festival and it was nothing short of amazing. Thanks to the Yelp app, we were able to get on the waitlist for a table while still shopping. There is a nearby parking so the walk isn't far. Once I checked in with the hostess to let her know we arrived, the wait time was an additional 20-25 mins. Sara was our waitress and she was super nice and sweet. It was a lot of people dining in, but there's ample seating and a bar area. While waiting, there was a nice waitress that took drink orders if you were interested. I LOVED the French toast. So yummy!!

I went here last night with my husband's side of the family. The atmosphere was ok, if you don't mind the cigarette smell wafting over from the individuals who were waiting to be seated. Everyone in my group was haplessly sitting in the stench for half the dinner. 

My father in law got the pickled vegetables, which were good. My mother in law got some shrimp tempura, which she said was gross and damp with excessive oil. My husband ordered the tonkatsu ramen, which was mediocre but at least it wasn't overly salty. I ordered the chicken steamed bun, pointed to the menu and said "bird bun" and was subsequently given pork belly bun. I didn't feel like making a fuss since my husband likes pork belly but this pork belly was disgusting and has wasabi all over it. I ordered bim bim bop and it was the most nauseating bim bim bop I've ever had. I've eaten bim bim bap as TV dinners and as airplane food (on my way to Korea) but this was the first bim bim bap I couldn't come close to finishing. They put rehydrated shiitake mushrooms, pickled peas (extremely salty), mushy and wet bolgolgi, the typical carrots, and SALAD on top. The sauce was an overwhelming salty flavor of vinaigrette, soy sauce, and hot chili sauce and the food didn't even come in a hot stone! It came out moderately warm, probably because the heaps of cold salad affected the temperature of the meal.

Best of all...I got food poisoning within several hours later. I'm assuming the salad was contaminated? Now my pregnant self is taking explosive trips to the bathroom every few hours. Thankfully, at least no one else is sick. I'm furious. This may just have made it to the top of my list as my worst restaurant experience. I wish I took a picture of my bim bim bap. Just picture a bowl of salad and you'll essentially have a visual of my dinner last night.

So, this was a last minute effort at a quick lunch and I wasn't really impressed. We walked in and it was a "seat yourself" kind of ordeal. We sat ourselves and waited for someone to come fill our drink orders but no one came. We ended up sitting at the bar and had the bartender take our order. I wasn't very hungry so I ordered the truffle mac and cheese. My friend ordered a side salad and chargrilled oysters. Everything was just meh. Overall, service was a tad slow and I might go back during HH to give them another try, but probably not for lunch or dinner.

My dryer stopped heating just as I was trying to dry my second load of laundry.  I immediately called Aviv Appliances, since I had  used them before. The kind and efficient service man was there the next day, quickly diagnosed the problem and, because a part had to be ordered, returned the following day to install the part. I have had to deal with rude and unprofessional repair services before. Thank goodness for Aviv. They are kind, very professional, reliable  and know what they are doing. What a breath of fresh air!

My husband and I came to Reno for our one year wedding anniversary and had a chance to try out several spots in the area. Big Ed's is definitely in the list of places we will return to.  

I did the build your own for egg omelette and my husband got the French toast with the potato and egg plate. If you have a big appetite, this is the place to be.
Took wonderful care of our car after an accident...made drop off and pick up safe during Covid. Did great work on our car.
Great place work with me putting parts on that I asked them to put on. I appreciate them

What a great hidden Gem this was.  My cousin found this place via Instagram. The pictures are so enticing that I told her let's do it.  Following the GPS we found the place rather easily.  Parking was not ideal.  There is only two places on the street for parking. If you park on the right side of the building you will be towed.  If you park on the left side of the building, your car has to be in the spots close to the building...please take note.  We found parking on Tulane and paid the meter. 

Once in the building, we were in a long line, which was a good sign.  The reason the line was so long was because of the do it yourself ordering via computer.  As usual, we have bigger eyes then our appetites and ordered the shrimp burger, wings and style fries.  The style fries were awesome.  They were covered with seasoning and ranch dressing. The shrimp burger was a large patty stuffed with shrimp.  The only gripe I have, is it was too big to bite into.   However, I managed. The wings were spiced just right.  All and all it was a great hidden gem that I will return to.  

Take my advice and try it.  The prices were reasonable.

Did hollow scream last night, Busch garden said that they were on a restricted attendance. This was a lie! The place was absolutely packed it was a 70 or 80 minute wait to get on some roller coasters there was very little and decorations for Halloween except for the scare zones was very disappointed and a little scared that I may have a covered now because there was no spacing and there is no way they could ever do contact tracing. I'm really sorry I had to post this review but I feel it was necessary to inform other people who may be looking forward to go to this event. And I love Busch gardens
Stopped in for some takeout and was very happy.  Extremely clean restaurant and great food as well.

Super disappointed in this bar- it was my second time there, and out of our bachelorette group of seven, two girls had their phones stolen on the dance floor. Avoid if you like to retain your belongings.
Sad and lacking flavor, many better Thai places in town.

I generally find this to be a good store. The prices are consistently better than at Publix.  They usually have what I need.  I know which staff are friendly and efficient, and I ignore the rest and wait for them to be fired.  And my daughter has had many happy rides on Quicksilver the pony at the front of the store.

I just got an email from Elements asking me to review them. 
My first massage here was great, but the third and fourth were just *ok* even though it was with the same therapist.  Could have been my fault for not communicating my needs better. The atmosphere is great, the online booking is great, great staff, and that first massage was great. 
What would I change about this place? One must show up naked and ready to go if you want the full deal! Give us the full amount of time. So imagine this: you buy a package of 6 one-hour massages, but you actually only get 4.5 hours because of the 15 minutes knocked off of each one for undressing/dressing time (that's a lot in dog years). 
Would I go back? I have one gift card left so I have to.
We just moved here from El Paso and have really missed good Mexican food until we came here! The service was great, drinks were good, and the food was amazing!

Went around 10am on a Sunday morning and they were packed which says a lot about their product. Ordered an onion bagel with cream cheese and it was great. They keep the line moving and the wait for my bagel wasn't more than 5 minutes which was very nice! All the people working were masked up and very polite! Will definitely be returning!
I've have cooked all my life loved every bit of it all over the wogood enough    for me.  rld of a

The #PlatosOnOracle is my favorite place to shop and sell my clothes. I've been going there for a year and the store keeps getting better! My favorite thing about this store is their instagram account. I love that they post cute items as soon as they buy them and you can put them on hold then pick them up that same day. Love the staff and all the events they throw!
Kohls is a great place to shop. I can always find what I want there. Everyone is so pleasant and helpful. Definitely a great place to find what you are looking for at a reasonable price.
I don't live nearby but I've eaten here a few times over the years and it continues to be one of the few really excellent Chinese restaurants in the Reno area.

I moved to St. Pete a year ago and was always hesitant to take my car anywhere to have it serviced. I would end up driving 2 hours away to a family friend who is a mechanic. However, last weekend my car would not start and I had no choice but to find a shop near by to take care of my car. I am so pleased with this company and the manager Ryan. He explained everything to me in a way that allowed me to fully understand what was wrong with my car and what I would be paying for (parts, labor, etc.)-- he even printed out a diagram of the broken parts to show me exactly what was wrong. While my car was being repaired he also called me with updates so I wasn't left in the dark about what was going on. I am very pleased with the service and glad I have found a shop in the area that I can trust!
Bad salad. Old lettuce, tomato, or maybe it was the cheese. Or maybe the dressing? Poor quality. Not sure they know their beds of lettuce. Don't get a salad. Soup ok

Omgosh delicious. I had the matcha, matcha for breakfast (because why not, I'm on vacation). The matcha was so delightfully bitter to counter balance the sweet ice cream. The coconut is a great touch too!

I'd just like to say that, for the most part, the people here were courteous and respectful.

I had a horrible experience at this vet. I will concede that they have a state of the art facility and lots of high tech gear. And yes, they have secretaries and intake nurses who will call you to the room not by YOUR name, but by the name of your animal (who, newsflash people, does not know what you are saying). But a fancy machine and a bunch of nurses does not a good vet make. 

It started when I brought my cat in because she had problems with her teeth/gums. The doctor informed me that she had stomatitis. He also informed me that it would cost $1,500 - $2,500 to fix this problem. That included putting her under, x-rays, blood tests, a tooth cleaning, and possible extraction of 1 or perhaps even ALL of her teeth. It also included payment for the vet AS WELL AS a separate anaesthesiologist. He told me that this was the only course of action. They even wanted me to schedule the appointment for the following week and make an immediate down payment of half of the low end of the estimate, along with paying right then and there for blood tests. And some of the itemized costs were ridiculous. One of the costs for a single tooth extraction, not including costs for drugs, xrays, etc, was over $500! For the record, they really lay it on thick here, pulling out all the stops to make you feel guilty. There is nothing more sinister than playing on the fears and concerns of caretakers, whether they are caring for animals or people.

I was beside myself. I did not have $1,500 to spend on my cat at this point. If you have that kind of money, thats great; come to this bourgeois vet. If you dont have it, you will regret your visit. I came out feeling horrible. 

Instead of forking over thousands of dollars, I made an appointment with a nice little vet just outside of Philly. It is run by just ONE DOCTOR who I affectionately call the "cat whisperer" due to his ability to subdue my rambunctious (slightly violent) cat. (You can PM me for the name of the vet.) He gave me the SAME diagnosis but of course was able to help me at a FRACTION of the cost. Not to get into details, but it was under $400 for the same procedure and additional medications.

The argument can easily be made that the care was inferior. I did not have an anaesthesiologist on hand. They did not do a cancer screen. But my cat is fine! She is so much healthier and happier, and I was able to schedule an appointment immediately instead of waiting until Thursday (the doctor at CCVH's "dental day"). But seriously, how did vets remove/clean teeth in the old days without private cat anaesthesiologists and fancy cancer scans?

To reiterate, I don't really believe that these people are actually out to screw people or inflate costs. But I think that their trend towards expensive, slick looking care does not ALWAYS translate into better, more effective care.

I LOVE shopping here! I have lived in the neighborhood for almost 4 years but have always shopped at Lowes on Loughborough. Lowes decided to stop stocking the line for my weed trimmer so I decided to check Southside Hardware. They had 3 in stock so I bought one. The people working were very nice, too, so I went back again a few months later for something else. Again, they were extremely nice, happy, and helpful. It's a small place and I'm sure there are some things that I wont be able to find there, but any small thing I have needed, they had; including, weed eater line, rust stripper, steam cleaner rental, and so many other things. Aside from the employees being extremely nice, the best thing about Southside hardware is that they stock a lot of items that are very specific to old south city houses. They have replacement glass door knobs, a variety of door mounted mail slot parts, among other things. This is the kind of stuff Lowes or Home Depot does not keep in stock that you can almost be sure to find at Southside Hardware. From now on, I'll be giving as much of my business to this hardware store as opposed to the big box places.

Went to the drive thru and waited 23 minutes for me food, only 2 burgers, 2 fries.   Kept asking the window attendant if there was a problem and she kept saying no. Sounds like someone wasn't doing their job. This was on March 4, 2020. Also, French fries were cold and tasted like cooked in old oil. I won't ever go back.  Very disappointed.

It seems like we go there only once a year, using our Entertainment Coupon, and ordering the same entrees each time. Soup is what you'd expect for won ton and sesame chicken and steamed shrimp with garlic both very good. Ordered a large boneless spare rib appetizer, which was good, not too greasy. Had plenty of food to take home for leftovers If they're offering another coupon next year, we'll be back too. Only reason for 3 stars, service fair -- the owner is a nice guy but NEVER smiles. His son (grandson?) is much friendlier, takes the money and happy to make change when we ask to break big bills into smaller ones to leave a decent tip.

I have had surgery at Quail 3 times in the last year. Each experience has been exactly the same and I would recommend this center to anyone. The entire staff is friendly and seemed to care about my concerns, comfort and overall well being. Nancy is great and makes the whole process so much easier. The anesthesiologist was very friendly (and funny)  and made me feel at ease before going into the surgery center. I had no issues. The center is clean and was easy to find. I felt that they went above and beyond to help find a lab for me to go to prior to surgery as I had forgotten to get my labs done until the morning of my procedure. Overall I feel this is a great surgery center and would recommend to anyone!

Have been meaning for a while to try this place.  I saw they were doing Christmas Dinner take away.
So glad I did.  They thought of and included everything.  Including ice cream for dessert! I want expecting that. 
They had everything well packed and labeled. With very detailed but easy to follow instructions and really good bond paper (nice touch)  For was ready to eat in 30 minutes.  Easy peasy. 
The food was very good.  Everything tasted delicious even the Brussels sprouts (which none of us are big fans of)
Can't wait until we can go again in person next time.
Amazing atmosphere, fabulous owner, incredible food. We got the chicken parm and lasagna.  I've music playing while we enjoyed excellent wine. Highly recommended A+++++

Bistro 7, truly an example of when once was not enough.  Last month I met my girlfriends, "the Gal Pals" here for drinks and dinner.  We've been friends for a long time, so we spend more time catching up than really appreciating the subtleties of the dining experience.  That said, I did notice the trendy atmosphere and that the food did not disappoint, so I felt another visit was warranted.  

Tonight, dinner out with my husband and two friends, and all were willing to share their opinions , and a bite or two.  

The ambiance of Bistro 7 is very nice.  The lighting is just right, the decor is modern but not pretentious, the service is friendly, prompt but not rushed and overall, just very comfortable.  We began at a table in the bar area, and ordered two appetizers-brie potstickers and chips with blue cheese.  I mean, how can you go wrong with those combos...well, I guess you can, but they didn't- excellent!

Two of us ordered the plank salmon, very good and we'll prepared, my husband had the Lemon Grass Braised short ribs, also delicious but everyone agreed that their favorite taste of the evening was the Miso Crusted Chilean Sea Bass. 

After two hours we ended our evening completely sated.  I have nothing negative to say, at all.  A perfect evening...we will definitely return.

I called here after seeing good reviews, I had severe draining issues. The agent came out, told me all my pipes were wrong and that it would cost $5,000 to repair. I got a 2nd company to come out and confirm, from Matt's Plumbing. He found the actual issue, repaired it, and it only cost $1,200. 
Short end they tried to scam me out of thousands.

I just used A Aluminum and Rescreening and I have to tell you how refreshing it was to work with such a professional and courageous company that TRULY cares about their customers.  John the VP is one of the most professional and trusting people I have worked with.  Even with all the delays with Covid shortages, John made it happen and installed my sunroom as promised on time. John always returned my call or email so rapidly and even if it was late at night. He kept me uo to date and pushed the teams to nake it happen. EVEN IN THE RAIN!!!  The crewmen and lead Santiago did a wonderful job on my Aluminum roof!  I would absolutely recommend before you go anywhere, call them.  Their rates are reasonable, exceptional team and TRUSTWORTHY!!!   I WILL ALWAYS USE THEM for any of my screening and roof needs. Thank you A Aluminum, New Port Richey!!!

I just moved to Riverview and was missing my West Indian flavors and I happened to find this place. The food was pretty goood, I had the jerk chicken and macaroni. I haven't tried the curry yet but hopefully this will be my new spot.
Fantastic French food with charming atmosphere. The French onion soup and mussel and frites are my favorites. I'm a local and this is my favorite restaurant. Great date place.

A++++ customer service. Jenn went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience. The burrito was amazing! I had half of it yesterday and the second half today. It was huge. Great flavors and stuffed with chicken and a tasty seasoning. My daughters love the cheese quesadillas on the kids menu and the seasoning on the fries. We can't wait to come back.

I don't leave reviews very often but this restaurant was with leaving g a five star review.  I have driven past it literally 100 times and never tried it until last night for Father's Day.  The outside seating under a beautiful veranda with fans and bar wood type wood was great.  The restaurant was so good at social distancing as the tables were far apart.  They clearly could have put more tables outside but chose not too.  

Now to the food.   The appetizers were great and they were out in like 5 minutes flat.  We order a special cheese filled zucchini flower.  They were the least favorite part of the meal but still good.   The other appetizers wher Ford calmari, a cold seafood salad and mussels.   They were really great.  The seafood was very fresh 

On the the main courses.  I ordered a flat iron steak with mascarpone mashed potatoes which I loved.   My wife and daughter split two dishes.   They got the pasta with lobster and the whole fish cooked in salt which filet table side. And my son got the gel medallions.  We loved the. Dishes.  My daughter said it was the best fish dish she's ever eaten 

Now desserts.  Omg....   they were an amazing way to end the night.  Thank you Sapori.

I rarely, wait, never do reviews. That changes today, because I had a fantastic visit at The Bronzed Bee. I've recently moved to Philadelphia from NYC and have been yearning for a waxing place that is: 1. affordable 2. CLEAN 3. customer friendly. I know what you're thinking 2 & 3 should be a constant amongst all places but it really hasn't been here. 

Sarah was my esthetician, and she was absolutely wonderful. I'm an og when it comes to waxing and the pain doesn't really phase me anymore so we were just able to have pleasant conversation without it being awkward, cause you know.... lady bits.  The wax was quick and whatever cooling spray she used after was amazing. I choose Bronzed Bee because they do have a frequent waxer deal (go every three weeks and your wax is only $35)! I will be going back, especially because booking online is so painless.
Would have loved to see the manatees, however, I didn't notice that it is closed during the months of May to August.  Seriously???
Got a gyro,  AMAZINGLY. Good!  Was so surprised to find one that good in the US!  Thx. Loved it

Really nice gym! The staff is really nice and helpful. The equipment is clean and of high quality. They have a lot of options for classes (yoga, spin, Zumba, etc.). Overall I definitely recommend the gym :)

Reservation for a party of 6 was at 7pm. We got seated right away and was able to get waters and our first drinks promptly. We ordered our appetizers and dinner at the same time which was at about 7:20pm. We ran out of water and never saw our waiter for about 30min. Still no water or drink refills. A random waiter brought our table someone else's order which we had to correct and told him we still hadn't had our appetizers yet. When the Appetizers came but from a different server we Still had no water, drink refills or anyone to check on us. Thank you very much, Erica. Seriously, the best Ups store customer service representative!

Amazing! Amanda Rea and her team are superb! They make everything easy and really look out for everyone's best interest as well as great you like family. There is not one bad thing I can say about this restaurant. I had a French dip and it was perfect. My son had a grilled cheese sandwich and it was made with fresh cut cheese and homemade bread. They have the best hot chocolate and are very kid friendly.

Great service and amazing food! We stopped in and ordered carry-out. It was a bit of a wait but expected for a Saturday night. Will definitely visit next time we are in town.

I am so cheap when it comes to putting one dime into my vehicle, yet I am a spendthrift in most other areas.  For some reason I pay off a vehicle as soon as possible, because the whole idea of that monthly payment drives me insane.

I also procrastinate when it comes to having the yearly inspection, in fact as usual I had it inspected yesterday, which was one day after being due.

My neighbor swears by Al's, my husband's work place also uses Al's and swears they charge a third of the price of other mechanics and as well they should since they own twenty acres of used vehicles and catalog over one million parts.  

I have a tough time with mechanics and I believe they are all out to get me, so over the years I save every read out of the work that has been done on my vehicle.  Two years ago S&S Tire & Auto charged me $237.49 to have my front brakes completely replaced, you know the rotor things, pads, wheel bearings.  They also did a state inspection and the oil change thing.

At Al's I had the same things done but to my back brakes, plus an emergency brake replaced for a grand total of $445.73 and they said they discounted the labor, plus you know where they got the brakes from... Al's Auto right across the street which is junk yard heaven.  

In all of my years on earth I have never heard of having an emergency brake replaced, especially since I never use it.  He explained that every time you put your car in reverse you are wearing down the emergency brake.  Does anyone buy this?  I think mechanics smell like sardines.

I had an exceptional experience here when I visited. The burger was delicious. The manager whose name slips my mind stopped by and was very friendly. Only one kind of bread, worker had friends there hanging out (during COVID) and to say the place was dirty was an understatement. Second bad experience with Subways in Boise and will not eat there again!

This is how I left straight out of the shop with a fresh set of gels. They look like they're a week old and grown out. I wish she would have painted closer to my cuticles. Waste of $33.

Well, less than a week after replacing the screen on my iPhone6,  my phone fell out of my pocket and the screen broke again!  Mind you, I have a Tech21 case, and a screen protector, so I was a bit dismayed this happened - it shouldn't have.  

Remembering the warranty that Gamers Warehouse gave me (free replacement within a certain period, as long as I had the screen protector), I promptly returned to the store and asked to have my phone repaired. They looked at the screen and said sorry, the impact occurred outside the screen protector area, and we will have to charge you $110. Well, that was $20 more than I paid originally.  Then the owner said that was their cost.  At that point, I knew I was being taken for a ride, so I politely left.  The screen that broke was a third party (cheap) non-Gorilla glass knock-off. 

I headed up the road to the Apple Store. Turns out, Apple was happy to replace the screen with the exact same original Gorilla Glass screen for $129.  That was $19 more than the imitation knock-off.  Now, here's the good part.  Apple inspected my phone, told me there was bad news and good news.  They said my phone didn't pass their internal inspection, so it needed to be replaced. The good news?  They replaced my phone for the cost of the screen. And, its under Apple Warranty. 

Gamers Warehouse lost me as a customer.  Its a shame. They should have honored their warranty.  Or at the very least, offered to replace it at a discount. They did neither.  

If you need an iPhone screen replaced, spend the few extra bucks and go to Apple.

I honestly expected that ramen noodle cup shrimp, but no! These were practically jumbo shrimp. I eventually had to eat the quesadilla with a folk and knife, it was awesome! I also ordered the thirst quenching pineapple juice which had pulp in it. I personally love the pulp, but it was flavorful.

The decor can be describe as: Neon mandala Aztec street art. You'll enjoy the concept of an actual bus as their countertop. Very spacious and great for large groups

Danielle is amazing.  Clean, professional, very thorough.  I wouldn't go to anyone else.

Love, love, love this place!!! I was staying at the Tru hotel near here and HAD to check it out. The girl who was working was so nice and helpful that day! We ordered a meat cone and a bbq chicken cone. What a funny and great idea! They were so good!

Always love the simply elegance these guys bring to the table each time we dine. I don't know that there is anywhere, (sans the old bluebird) in Boise, where I feel like I am in Europe.

Wanting to venture out away from the unpleasant sights of downtown New Orleans for dinner, a cousin of mine recommended the Camellia Grill for dinner. So the family and I decided to take a little drive and check this place out. 

Upon walking in, you are greeted by a cashier that tells you to take a seat where you like. The setup is that of a diner with fixed barstools and you belly up to the counter. The family and I took our seats and were handed menus and a water. 

After making our decisions, the wife had red beans and rice; my youngest had a chocolate chip pancake; my oldest had chicken strips; and I had a bacon cheeseburger with fries. A lot of the stuff on the menu looked delicious. Since we were jerks, and came here 30 minutes before closing, I picked a cheeseburger quickly without thinking. 

In good time our food started arriving piecemeal. The four of us started enjoying our meals promptly, so these folks could go home. 

The cheeseburger was delicious. Very juicy, yummy bacon, gooey cheese, with the perfect bread to meat ratio. The fries were your basic fries, but great. The wife enjoyed her beans and rice, for the most part. She noted that there were clumps of uncooked rice. The kids enjoyed their food with no complaints. The service was also awesome and our waiter (who was also a cook!) did a great job with a friendly face and kept our drinks filled. 

I highly recommend this place. I did think this place was a little pricey, but it seems like everything is around New Orleans. 

I want to try and come back before I leave New Orleans. Give this little jewel a try if you are in this area! 

Enjoy!

TLDR; go to Smile Philosophy instead if your insurance takes it. 

I came in here because there were available appointments with my insurance the next day after I chipped a tooth. 

I had a few questions about what was covered, but was pushed into a room very quickly as I was asking the questions. They took an xray and made sure to do everything that my insurance would cover.

In walks the doctor (in jeans and sneakers, honestly I wasn't sure who this person was until he introduced himself). I could tell honestly from the look in his eye that he was a scam artist, because he also had a huge grin on his face when he BARELY even looked at the xray and declared, "Root canal!" I asked what he could point out on the xray that suggested the tooth needed a root canal (it looked identical to the adjacent teeth), at which point he just pointed to the root (again, identical to tooth next to it) but I figured he went to dental school, not me, so he probably knows what he is talking about. He then basically ran out of the room while I was still asking questions. I could hear him after in the next room talking up a deep teeth clean. The receptionist came in quickly with a form of all of the things I "needed done," out of pocket. $2,500 for a root canal, $700 for a deep cleaning, 2 fillings (covered by insurance)... either that, or go the route covered by insurance, and have the tooth PULLED. This is the lie I was told at this office. This man would have unnecessarily removed an entire molar from my 25 year old mouth when it was simply chipped, just to get paid more by the insurance company. He would have also given me an unnecessary filling on a tooth that didn't need it, again for more money. 

He is a crook, and that is not an overstatement. His staff are in on it too, and it is clear that they receive money or some other compensation for upping charges. The receptionist was very aggressive, and became very impatient and rude when I refused to book an appointment for the root canal, which REALLY tipped me off that this was no legitimate medical office.

One day later, I went to Smile Philosophy and was told by the dentist (actually dressed and composed as a dentist, very professional, just what I wanted in a dentist) that the tooth was simply CHIPPED, I had likely chipped it a long time ago and only now had it broken. She told me that it was advisable to get a FILLING on that tooth (covered by insurance) and a filling on ONE other tooth for a small cavity. She assured me that a root canal was very painful, very expensive, and very unnecessary in my case. She asked me where I was told that I needed 2 fillings, a deep clean, and a root canal. I told her, "Gentilly Family Dental," and she (again, very professionally) told me that she had heard many other complaints from patients with that office and dentist. It was apparently a common experience. 

Go to Smile Philosophy instead where the staff is all very friendly, honest, knowledgeable, and professional. They also have a Finding Nemo tank in the lobby which is way better than the smell of stale scams at Gentilly Family Dental.

AVOID AVOID AVOID. This "dentist" is a scam artist, and a bully. I am amazed that he still maintains his license.
