My wife and I were able to get a reservation on a packed Saturday for her birthday! Super awesome. The staff is super nice and helpful with getting started. The interior is a little dark for my taste but overall the place is really nice and the ambience is peaceful. We both got the special and I got a steak dinner. Both dishes were cooked perfectly to our request. The food came out fast and hot! We had a great time and I would definitely come back and try some of their fish dishes!

Kaleidoscope Flowers is an *awesome* florist option in downtown SB. I came here seeking some particular flowers, and they created and prepared the flowers with high quality. The customer service here is excellent as they are very helpful and the pricing is also reasonable.  I was very impressed with their cute store and all the neat things they sell, so much to browse and look at. The purple flowers I purchased here were very BEAUTIFUL and fresh!

Appears open and welcoming on the outside, but very unloving and unChristlike in reality. Dislikes the gays, women, divorcés, and a myriad of other 'others'.

So many friends have had to leave this church over these issues. And it's sad.
They need to re-evaluate a lot of their theology.

If your in the mood for mediocre fried foods and staff that dress and smell like homeless people this is the spot for you. Tucked away from the main street of broadripple because theyre so hardcore cant be seen above 56th st is this little hole in the wall. Comparing it to the mousetrap would be offensive to the mousetrap but also slightly accurate. The incompetence of the staff is only matched by their shitty attitudes. They take pride in pissing people off and offending anyone whi walks through the door. They do like hockey though, so thats cool. If you like hockey, weird hipster mustaches, ironically offensive bartenders, and PBR head on down.

Last night my back was a little achy so I went for a one hour massage and had a great session. I've been to H & J 3 times and I received an excellent massage each time. I had a male massage therapist yesterday and had a female in the past and both were great. Unfortunately, I did not get there names, sorry. If I could afford it, I'd go every week.

My first time trying ramen EVER and I'm so happy it was here! 10/10 delicious! I got the veggie ramen and added an egg. Their menu is full of variety and they also have a good selection of sake, beer, and plum wine. I would give 5 stars but they were very short staffed and they forgot to put in my friends order (even though we ordered at the same time) so my friend had to find a waiter to ask and she didn't get her order until I was already done eating. However, there was a blonde host and server that stood out to me, I wish I got her name but she was straight hustling all over the place and gave exceptional service regardless of the place being packed and the short staffing!

I've been a Westchase resident for going on three years now, and The Grind remains a favorite. Not only of mine, but of my dog as well. I love the coffee and the food and my dog loves the fact that they've always got a water bowl for him

It's a cool mix of small coffee shop vibe, great food, enough places for groups to sit, incredible coffee, and in a cool place in town. Maybe avoid it on the weekends when the tourists are here? That line gets looooong

We came here because my man loves to go to antique shops and it was recommended by a friend in town.  I on the other hand do not like to go to antique shops due to having to scrummage through old gross things!  But this place changed my mind.  It's very well laid out and has several different vendors in it.  All of which displayed their goods in a thoughtful way.  Some of it was meh to me, but I actually found things I liked!  WHAT???  This really happened.  I'm actually thinking of going back and getting a few things.  What can I say, the way stuff was presented actually sparked my creative process.  I would recommend this place to anyone - antique junky or antique foe!

every single crew or team was so professional and cheerful despite the 115 weather.  This is aa great company.

Coralie McGuire

I bought a massage from Harmony Massage through Groupon and scheduled my appointment through the site they use. Navigating the site was pretty easy in general, so that was nice, but that's been all that's nice. Three days before my massage I received a txt from the owner saying my appointment had to be cancelled, because the therapist had to go out of town for a family emergency and to reschedule. I immediately rescheduled with another therapist a few minutes after the txt. I texted the owner the day before to confirm my new appointment and found out that the other therapist was let go and the owner hadn't taken them off the website yet, so my next appointment was cancelled, too! The only response I received was that I needed the reschedule with someone else. I'm SUPER frustrated and annoyed. All I wanted was a nice massage before my wedding and this whole thing has just added more stress!  I would not recommend going to Harmony Massage.

The quality of food is unparalleled. I have yet to find a dish I don't thoroughly enjoy but I can't stop ordering the Turkish style fattoush salad and the Munto. Thank you Sultan for bringing so much joy to our dining experience during COVID!
Terrible food, everything was way too salty and the brisket was all fat...that will be our last time we order food from here.
Fantastic experience! I wish there was a location closer to me! Beautiful theater, comfy seats and great food and drink!

It's 2014, and yes, PDQ is open again!

Have you ever wondered what it's like to walk inside of a time capsule? Well, come in to PDQ. It's like nothing every changed. It's.... exactly the same. Their are dusty old records (perhaps due to the construction). Do you seek 8tracks? Do you have a hankering for VHS tapes still? Then you need to come to PDQ. It's all here. It hasn't changed much. You can still buy singles of records in those little boxes on the shelves. 

Hipsters can breath a sigh of relief: PDQ Records is open. When I popped by in December, they closed at 6. I'm sure the hours will increased. I gave up my record player long ago, but PDQ is local, and awesome. If you need records, GO.

I made an appointment here to make my mom happy while she was in town. I wasn't planning on buying anything or even considering something "bridal" for my wedding. But I appreciated the fact they had such a sustainable business model and that the dresses were extremely unique. Kelsey was so kind, asked if we preferred masks and was so kind to wear one the whole time. She pulled all different kinds of dresses, and of course I found the most fantastic off beat gown that I got to take home that day! They recommended a reasonable alteration place and overall, I had a fantastic experience and would highly recommend!
Nice ambience. The drinks are hit or miss. I really enjoyed a couple of them. The service is good. I'd recommend this place.

My review is based solely on my experiences with delivery. I don't think I've ever actually set foot in the restaurant, but they have always consistently delivered my food items in a timely manner. Of the insane amount of times I've ordered food I can only count on 1 hand how many times they screwed up my order. They live up to their slogan and promise!

I like the King of Prussia Dental Associates. They're easy to get to, and right on Allendale Road. If I arrive early, I rarely have to wait long for my appointment.

Don't have much experience directly dealing with the doctors, but the supporting staff are wonderful, including the nurses I've dealt with. I've gotten my teeth cleaned here, and they do their job quickly and efficiently, with minimal pain. I've also had x-rays taken several times. The facility is clean, and well-maintained.

If you're going to cancel last-minute or be late, do so ahead of time so you can reschedule, otherwise they may assess a penalization fee.

Bruce MacKay Pump & Well Service is a long-time, well respected company I keep on the short list for real estate transactions for clients and beyond. They are professional, on time, follow up is great, reports are clear and estimates are fair. Their front office staff is friendly and helpful. Techs and supervisors are willing to go the extra mile. Garrett Carr has been a wealth of knowledge in the field and all of the team at Bruce MacKay rocks.

My friend and I went for a hike and came downtown starving for lunch! We agreed sushi sounded good, this was the first place we saw. The place is cute with ample seating (indoor and outdoor). You place your order on an iPod and the food is brought out pretty quickly. 

Sushi rolls 
They different and large, a lot of rice. But, they were good. Definitely not sushi in the traditional sense. We had two rolls, which was more than enough. 

1/2 curry bowl
Unfortunately this didn't have much flavor. Not much of a curry taste at The 1/2 size portion was generous. We were happy we didn't get a full size. 

Overall, for a quick & cheap bite, this place isn't a bad choice.

The coffee is good and the service is very nice.  The price of the coffee for the size is way to expensive!  I got a ice coffee with caramel and it was almost $6.00!!
I think i got about 6oz to drink from ice.   
Hint,  if your next door competitor is Starbucks.  Don't be more expensive than Starbucks.  They will crush you.  Sorry but true.

My wife needed repair for her car following an accident.  She received a estimate and upon completion the price was exactly what they quoted.  They said it would take 3 days and the work was completed as they predicted.  They went above and beyond to make sure my wife was happy.  The price was very reasonable and affordable. They made what could be a stressful situation easy.

I conclusion I highly recommend this body shop and will use them in the future if necessary.

I love looking at all different types of art.  So when a friend invited me to go for free museum day, I jumped at the opportunity.  I realized it would be a busy day, with free admission, and it was.  I enjoyed seeing so many young families teaching their kids about the wonders of art.  The museum did a wonderful job handling the crowds and providing entertainment for the younger kids.  As we walked through the exhibits, we listened to volunteers explain various art works and explain Dali's style and intent.  The volunteers were passionate and made the tour through the museum fun and educational.  Interactive displays encourage self discovery and draw you in.  Going to the Dali was fun, I just wished the museum was bigger and had more displays.  It's worth going if you enjoy art!
This place was AMAZING!! Not only was the food fresh and delicious, but the owner and staff were friendly, fast and attentive. I highly recommend it! A hidden jem.

Do not use this florist....we ordered flowers on 7/10 for delivery the same day (before their cut off time). We were called hours later and told their delivery driver went home early and delivery was not possible. Online delivery was available on Sundays, so we asked for Sunday delivery, not an option. We were then promised Monday delivery, and given a whole $6.00 discount. Turns out they didn't bother delivering the flowers until Wednesday!! I asked for a full refund and they have been nothing but terrible. They refuse to refund me for the flowers and tried to tell me they were going to go back and pick them up in order to give me a refund. Chad, the VP of sales does not know how to handle Customer Service.  Just horrible.

Geri is amazing! My son had just moved to Reno to go to school and was looking for somebody to cut his hair and Geri made him very feel very comfortable and cut his long hair just the way he wanted it he was looking for someone that specializes in men with long hair and Geri  is the one !!! she did amazing will definitely be going back

This place had very unique and appealing decor. We went on a Saturday night with no reservations. We sat at the bar and I decided on a nonalcoholic drink called the summer cucumber limerita. It sounded interesting and tasted like nothing I've ever had before. It surprisingly had a spicy kick to it but was also sweet. Odd as it was, I liked it! After about 15 minutes at the bar, we were seated in the Jazz section per our request (a sectioned off part of the restaurant). The live band and singer were great. 
Our appetizer? Not so much. The cornbread was such a let down. The texture was too mealy and the flavor was off. It tasted bitter. The honey cream cheese butter served with it barely saved it. My shrimp and grits were very good though. I tried a bit of my fiancé's grilled chicken. It was tender and the seasoning was excellent. 
I thought we should stick around for dessert so I ordered a slice of pecan pie. I wasn't impressed. And the buttermilk ice cream that came on top? Gross. 
I didn't realize until we were seated that to see the live performance, an extra $10 is added to bill per person. It makes total sense though and the experience was worth it.

Brenda has been great to me.  She has helped empower me to be a better and stronger version of myself.  I leave my appointments feeling more confident, and I always feel like she actually cares about me and my life.  She has helped me to become my own person.  To me that's important, that she aided me in being me and didn't tell me what to do.  I would definitely recommend her to my friends and fam.

P.s. Ms Boldrey dresses very nice, and other reviews taking low blows about her appearance really speaks to that reviewer's pettiness.

Today was my first time here and the service was bad. Compared to Grassroots ybor which the staff is friendly and willing to recommend drinks and answers question you have about their drinks. While I was there I had to stop the staff to ask for drink and I was sitting at the bar. Also I hear someone order a drink call CBC cider and I ask a staff if it has alcohol since I don't consume alcohol and it sounded good and if I can try it. All I got from the staff was nothing here has alcohol and they don't sell it on tab (which I saw the other bartender serve the drink from the tab) he said that they only has CBD kombucha and walk away without letting me order a drink. If you new in this location you can definitely expect to be treated as a outsider since the staff at least the guy that we ask questions about the drink is not friendly and is more than happy to ignore you. So be ware of this. My recommendation try Bula in the same area or Grassroots in ybor staff is way better and more friendly.

Casual, clean, friendly breakfast & lunch spot.  Most breakfasts under $10.  Hash browns are shredded potato with nice crisp.  Everything tasted good, eggs were perfect for me with no oozey whites.  I got croissant with griddled turkey, spinach, poached eggs & hollandaise.  My daughter got choco chip pancakes, scrambled egg whites & soft bacon, all cooked and served the way she requested.  Big portions.  Bathroom was spotless.  You can get to-go drink to take with you.  This is not close to home, but if we are up this way at at breakfast time again, we'd return.  The two fresh quiche options and muffin of the day sounded good.

Wish I could give zero stars. We bought 4 tires through Amazon home install and had them shipped to the store. We had an appointment for 11am to get the tires installed. When we arrived at 11 it took them 30 minutes to acknowledge our existence, they then quoted us a higher price than what we already paid on Amazon. We contacted Amazon directly because you're not supposed to pay in store when you buy this service. Amazon tried calling this branch for an hour to resolve the issue and no one answered the phone. There were 7 employees around and they all just let the phone ring over and over. I'm still sitting here at 1pm, no tires on my car. I've never had such terrible service. Do not go to this store.

What a lunch truck gem. There was a lunch truck round up at Cartel last month, and immediately this was the place, I couldn't get enough of.

My husband and I both ordered the Banh Mi Dat Biet sandwich ( which includes: pork, ham, pate, butter,cucumber,daikon,cilantro and jalapeño) and it was so fresh and clean tasting, on a fresh roll. It's been so long since I've enjoyed a Vietnamese sandwich, that I was blown away. It had a nice kick to finish the sandwich due to those few jalapeños tucked inside. Despite having many other lunch trucks tempting us to spend our dollars, we ended up ordered a second sandwich to go, for breakfast the next day! 

The biggest surprise is that it was only $3.75. What a deal.

We decided to stop at the Odessa Hooters today to catch some college football and have lunch.  Wanting a great view of the tv we found seats at the bar.  The atmosphere was great, just what you want for a fun time watching our favorite teams.  The food was very good, wings came out hot and spicy, tots were on point and the beer was good and cold!  While all of the staff was great, I have to give a shout out to Miranda at the bar.  She really made our visit fantastic!  She was super friendly, never let our glasses go empty and suggested we try the new pretzels with beer cheese and they really hit the spot.  I could tell she treated every customer like her most important customer, knew several by name and was always looking out for who needed what.  Now this was no quick lunch, we stayed for an entire game and she never stopped.  Anytime she had one free second she was cleaning!  That bar was impressively clean and Miranda played a huge role in that.  Thanks for making our afternoon great, can't wait to go back next weekend!  Hooters, hope your listening, you have got a gem behind the bar!

Yes I know this is a chain mexican restaurant, but I'm a fan. I've been going to Margaritas for over 15 years. They were fairly popular in New England where I'm from and was happy when they started opening in PA. I'll be honest there's a lot of good mexican food in this area, so their food is decent, but there's a lot better out there if you're looking for authentic food. But I love their margaritas, especially their proseccorita, sure it sets you back about $13, but it's essentially two drinks in one and I love the raspberry flavored one. We stopped in twice at the collegeville location in the last week. Once for national margarita day where i had a couple house margs, and for a non-top shelf one, it's good. Not overly sweet and mine were strong. I love the Russelrita, but that's a splurge with the calories and I never find it's very strong, but it sure is tasty. 

We also shared a chicken salad, which came out with the wrong dressing, but it was a happy accident and we preferred the one they brought versus the one it came with. 

Service was be a bit challenging sometimes. We sat at the bar twice and it seems they enjoyed talking to each other and lost a little focus on the customers, but not a big deal.

I'm a sucker for happy hour, so I decided to check this place out after multiple recommendations. The interior was very nice and seems like a great after work hangout spot. We sat at the bar and all the staff were super funny and kind.

Just by a glance of the menu, their selections were top notch! Any where from nachos to pizza to clams, I really couldn't complain. And the prices were also great, ranging anywhere from $5-$10. I ended up getting a lemon drop with a margherita pizza and got to try some of the clams my friend had ordered. The pizza was just okay, the sauce didn't have much taste to it. The clams were just okay too. They were just missing something, and it felt like they were rushing with our orders. Since my pizza crust seemed a little undercooked towards the center.

For the amount of positive recommendations I had received for this place, I was let down a little. I did think that it was cute how instead of a candy jar by the door, they had a cookie jar! I would like to come back here again to give it another try.

I've wanted to take a women's self defense course for years now but never quite got up the nerve until I spoke to Joe, the owner of Tampa Bay Krav Maga. 

I had called a number of places about 2 yrs ago including speaking with Joe, who answered all of my questions readily, without rushing me off the phone or trying to sell me on his studio over others.  He seemed very genuine and knowledgeable so knew I would go to this studio, once my schedule could accommodate a class (even though it was a bit of a drive), and am so very glad that I did!  

KEY TAKEAWAYS:

- THE COURSE - 6 week women's self defense class (2hrs on Saturdays) are offered 3x/yr and $200 full price, although there are some special prices.  Absolutely phenomenal class and worth every penny, if you can make the time commitment!  You build upon your knowledge week upon week with the aide of great instructors, real life situations, and opportunity to fight off a simulated attack at the end of the course. 

- THE INSTRUCTORS - In addition to Joe, the owner, Kylie and Dora - instructors, also assisted during classes. All were knowledgeable, kind, and supportive. 

- THE STUDIO - The studio is open concept with one large right room, a waiting area, bathrooms, and an office. As such, there is typically one class at a time. 

- OTHER CLASSES - There are a number of other classes offered throughout the week including kickboxing and various levels of Krav Maga. All of which were included during my 6 week course, although I wasn't able to make any ... YET.  

- FINAL THOUGHTS - I would really like to come back for another 6 week course in the fall to further hone my skills and maybe try some of the other classes. It was very empowering as a female to learn tactics to defend yourself, regardless of size, age, or perceived strength.

So fun!! Had to wait in line to get in, but was worth it for the Christmas explosion inside. Drinks were crazy overpriced, but the ambiance makes up for it. This bar is great to stop by, have one drink and snap a bunch of photos, then move on. Highly recommend for a laugh and to get in the Christmas spirit with friends.

We were looking for a good breakfast that would offer a mom and pop feel and we definitely found it here. The service was pleasant and efficient from all beginning to end. The food was so good we contemplated going back the next morning. We did also have a chorizo pupusa but it was devoured before realizing we forgot a picture. Will for sure go back when in the area
Cheap and healthy and fast.  Nice clean dining area. No crowd.  Nice employees. Good location   Patio dinning.  Everything looks new.

I consider myself a connoisseur when it comes to pizza and enjoy all types, New York style, deep dish Chicago, wood fired and artisan. I have eaten at most of Chicagos finest including LouMalnati's, Genos, UNOs, Giordano's and many more across greater Chicago. I search out the best rated pizza whenever in a new city all over the United States, this is not one.
This pizza was a disappointment on every level. The dough was tasteless, sauce was bland and the cheese was a giant slab of white rubber. Even the toppings could not save this poor excuse for a pie. Chicago pizza parlors should band together and sue for using their great cities name together with pizza.   
If you are in Boise and are dying to have deep dish go anywhere else but here. Seriously even Pizza Hut would be a better choice.

DO NOT USE MOUNT LAUREL ANIMAL HOSPITAL!
We took our cat here and they performed unnecessary tests and ran up unnecessary fees.  Then they said it would be best to put our cat down.  When I said I wanted to get a second opinion they became nasty and very unprofessional.   I took the cat to Cat Clinic in Cherry Hill and he was shocked at the errors made and that they said to kill her.  He gave our cat some medication and she is doing just fine.

Wanted a quick lunch with convenient (and free parking) after a morning at the zoo.  The kids enjoyed a grilled cheese and I snarfed, I mean scarfed, down a turkey sandwich.  I'm a big fan of a heated/toasted sandwich, so snarf's hit the spot!

Sandwiches come in a few size choices to accommodate any hunger level, but I found that the novice (5") was big enough for me.  We had chips, but other sides are available.  And, they have many choices to satisfy your sweet tooth--cookies, brownies, shakes, ice cream, etc.
Fries were not even half full. Burger was overcooked and dry. Chicken sandwiches were also overcooked and very dry. Not going back, I wouldn't bother.

We had appointments at Vanderbilt & decide to walk here for lunch before driving an hour back home. We had a party member in a wheelchair & there is no indication from the front street of where the ramp was. We almost went somewhere else but found that there was access around back for persons who can't use steps. 
My daughter had chosen the place & I had no idea what to expect. So getting a "burger" was a little surprising when it came on flatbread and was a meat "roll" instead of a patty. The freshness & flavors were great. Loved the cucumber sauce. An order of fries (in my opinion) is large enough to share. The cost is not what I would consider a good value as $8 or so for just a flatbread sandwich & a pickle is a bit much. At least include a side item of choice. Maybe at 1/2 the size of ordering it separately? 
Staff very friendly & willing to answer questions. So it was minus one star for lacking street direction for handicap & for ala carte.

Went in to pick up some carry out and the cashier was straight up not wearing a mask. Usually I don't deduct stars for the actions of a single employee, but a rude host or confused waiter doesn't increase my chances of ending up hospitalized. Some solid healthy choices on the menu, but won't be back until after COVID.

OK but... 

In advance of my cut I told the stylist Sierra, "I want to be able to run my fingers through the ends and not have tangles," "I don't blow dry ever (because I run/swim every day) so don't blow it out." Near the end of the cut I noticed that Sierra was holding shearing scissors. Damn! I forgot to tell her not to use them! I asked, "I understand that shearing scissors cause the hair's ends to fiz out and get tangly and become quickly damaged. She said, "yeah, they do that." 

So here's the thing... a great salon won't use shearing scissors on your ends. They know better. Its been a week since my cut and I can't run my fingers through my hair, my fingers get tangled at the ends where she sheared my hair. 

In spite of my request, she also blew my hair out. She said she needed to blow it to finish the cut. OK, I get it, but don't charge me for it. 

My sweetie is getting his hair cut next, I'm recommending a different salon.

I have been there several times, never disappointed, good food and service, awesome views and Live music,,,,Stormbringer band tonight,,, if you haven't heard them you should... the best band around, every song is as good or better than original singers...lead guitar rocks a Fender Strat like only a few others can

Never disappointed..
Steak cooked to perfection..
Excellent customer service.
And if you like chocolate, the lava cake with Chantilly cream is  absolutely delicious!
Great anniversary weekend.
Thank you

Delicious homemade Italian goodness! 

I had the lasagna, layers of ricotta and beef with a delicious sauce. Side salad was excellent, nice and fresh! My husband had Angelhair pasta Alfredo...he loved it. Our good friend had a meatball Parmesan sandwich which he loved. The portions are huge here, you will have leftovers.

Well I went back to show n tell. Trying to have fun and find a girl to spend money on , I had $500  in cash. For the most part, the girls were friendly, they put on a good show, all that. Hair and makeup was done. I was having a drink when I was approached by a chubby girl with long curly brown hair, named  Page Now I'm not bashing her weight, beauty comes in all shapes n sizes. What I am bashing is her personality. She was drunk after two shots of watered down vodka, not at all a pretty crier, and felt the need to tell me personal info I'd be happier not knowing. Hearing about your brother committing suicide to get away from you  and how the state took your kids totally killed my mood. Than on top of that, she begged to come home with me for 100$ . I was so annoyed that I took my money to risqué down the block.
We showed up at 830pm on a Sunday night. There was live music. The band was great. We had the sampler, the blue crab cakes, the alligator cheese cake and the oyster po' boy. That was all good!

Biscuit Love came recommended and it was delicious. Nestled in an old home. Walk up ordering and then they assign a table. I enjoyed the Brûlée grapefruit, biscuit with tart cherry jam and scrambled eggs. Husband had the eggs Benedict with sausage gravy. It was all delicious. Cooked to order wait-staff friendly. Clean

Don't go for happy hour! We were walking down the warf and wanted to stop for a drink during happy hour. The restaurant was nearly empty, and we told the host we wanted some drinks with a view so he happily sat us near window. He gave us menus, and when he returned we told him we only wanted drinks. He then angrily grabbed the menus and walked away. We then didn't hear from any of the waitstaff the rest of our time there and had to flag someone down to pay. Didn't feel welcomed, won't be going back.

I was recently referred to this establishment from our local body shop.
I need to have a expensive and sentimental dog food stand painted.
I reached out to a body shop thinking that they could do it while painting a vehicle or parts.
They told me I should be going to bonehead performance as their business is powder coating. 
I went to bonehead with the item and was overwhelmed by the amount of finishes they provided.
 I finally picked out a two-step process and left the item.
One week later  the item was ready. 
When I picked it up I was amazed by how great it looked. 
It actually looked brand new actually better than new.
And all for $60. 
What a hidden gem this place is. 
I will be referring anyone I know to the fine establishment.
Thank you for a job well done.
Amazing takeout and delicious food. The staff is so friendly. Highly recommend!!!
I have never seen so many scone varieties, so delicious! The coffee is also ridiculously amazing. Service was excellent and quick. The outdoor space is also really nice.

I really want to like this place. It's clean, cute, great staff, and great prices. I've been there 4 or 5 times and I think my last time was finally my last. I can NEVER get a gel full set without it lifting or nails falling off. I don't abuse my nails, I take good care of them.. but I always seem like I'm loading up with nail glue after 2 days. This time it only took 4 or 5 days after a full gel set and I lost 2 NAILS while getting dressed
:( last time I lost 4 in just under a week. I've had the hot gel and acrylic. Idk what gel or powder they use, but it just is terrible.

If you come to Philly you must stop here. Easy parking in the garage across the street and public transportation accessible. 

Amazing vendors and the food is crazy diverse and good.

This place is a MUST GO. But go early. We tried Saturday morning around 1030 and they line was LONG. Which means it's good. We decided to try again the next morning and went about 730. There was no line and we walked right in. The staff was friendly and the service quick.  We shared the east nasty. It was a huge portion. The chicken was crispy and juicy. The biscuit was flaky and you could see the many layers. The gravy was delicious. We also had the bonuts, which were amazing. Not too sweet and served with a lemon crepe on top and blueberry reduction. The fresh squeezed OJ was really good too. 

They have indoor and outdoor seating. They're only open until 3. 

This place definitely need to be on your list when visiting Nashville.
Brandon was awesome. He was so helpful and very good at gos job because he reminded me of things I needed.

Very impressed with the customer service received by Kyle who made my appointment and for Celina who checked me in at the River location. Kyle answered the phone with a smile and was very thorough and friendly. Celina had a very welcoming demeanor with very positive energy. Angelica greeted me prior to the PA and very delightful and kind. It's so refreshing to meet individuals who care about you! Thank you so much you ALL deserve a day off with double pay or a pizza party in your honor!!! Kudos to those that hired you-  the office also was very clean!

The Boulevard is so fun! The environment is great and the entire place is so cute. Kennedy did my hair and did fantastic. She has such an eye for detail and was really gentle and careful. I really loved the entire experience and my hair looks amazing. Will definitely come back and see her!

Sierra Veterinary Specialists killed my friend's dog today. Didn't take care of him while under anesthesia during a CT scan and killed him. Beware of this place. If you're thinking about going, don't.
Used to order from here all the time. Massively over priced but decent food. They littered menus all over my neighborhood today and just like that they've lost me as a customer.
Nah. Wack ass service. Lock the door if people aren't supposed to come in. Then what? Wait outside for a $3 piece of pizza? Place is shit. Still love it

VERY LOW QUALITY CLOTHES, do not buy !!!

Stumbled into this cute little clothing boutique when I visited Nash for the first time, purchased a sweat suit set which was over $100!! I have worn this set a total of 3 times spanned out within 2 months to find out that the third time I wore it the seem was coming undone in the butt !! A freakin hole in the ass of these pants that I wore 3 times. Super low quality. Super disappointed. For how cute the store is and how much decoration they have in there, they should definitely be putting that money towards the quality of the janky ass clothes they sell. Smh never again. Save your money!!!

Seafood.  Great view and super friendly hostess.  Outside seating.. they were cleaning between guests.  Unfortunately that's where the good review ends.  We waited 15 min to get a beer and very sub par service, someone told us we would see our server soon.   Very unfriendly and acted as if she hated her job and just waNted us to leave.   Food was awful, never offered deserts and she rushed us out of there.   Just hiring a warm body to wait on guests is not doing anyone a favor Landry's.

I wish I could say I was super impressed with this place, really wanted to be, but eh, I wasn't. It's very beautifully decorated on the inside and the warm lighting helps create a welcoming environment as you walk in. 

When we arrived on a Sunday afternoon, it was pretty loud and busy as one would expect--lots
of families with small children, no big deal. We hadn't made a reservation so did not expect to be seated right away. The hostess was on a phone call and what we believe was a second hostess walked by a few times before actually greeting and seating us. We sat in a table that felt a little cramped by the window, but were content that we could people watch everyone outside. 

My boyfriend ordered the Chocolate Surprise Tiramisu and I ordered the Banana Split Waffles. I'd say these items were a bit overpriced at $13-$14 each. There was nothing that really stood out about them. The tiramisu tasted like a vanilla pudding with chocolate in it, and the banana split waffles were just very sweet waffles covered in warm bananas and ice cream.
We stopped here to give it a try and were surprised to find a new favorite.  The portions were plenty and great.  The sushi was fresh and diverse.  We will be back as regulars.

Arrived at opening. Dinning room tables and floors was dirty. Bathroom was disgusting and door lock doesn't work. None of the employees had any idea what was going on. I was "helped" by four people before I even paid. Food was ok as expected. It's sad that this store just recently opened too.

Did a root canal years ago where he put the post through the root of the tooth perforating it, which voids the tooth. An endodontist said he could maybe "patch the root" but couldn't guarantee it would last. He Didn't tell me, and I only found out after multiple dentists I went to asked "Who the hell did your root canal??" He either didn't take an X-ray after placing the post or saw he put it in wrong and was too lazy to care.

I just had this tooth pulled. An implant that is very expensive is the only option. Photo of tooth attached.

He needs to stop rushing with his patients. Stop overbooking. Slow down and do more quality work. Also, refer his patients to an endodontist for root canals.

I am paying thousands fixing his mistakes. Stay away.
Wonderful change of pace from our normal cuisine. Owners are fantastic and go over and beyond by connecting to their customers and offering personalized entree options.

After hearing the rave reviews for this place for the past 2+ years we decided to try it.  Food was pretty ok.  We had the calamari as appetizer and I had the chicken Parm  with pasta in  vodka sauce. We shared the appetizer and it could have been more, probably 16 to 18 rings came on the plate.  It actually liked like less because it was dwarfed by the plate. I'd say the pasta was a tad above average but the chicken Parm was pretty flavorless and and a bit dry even with the sauce and cheese.  Wife had shirt rib risotto.  Shirt rib was very tender and flavorful.  I didn't taste the risotto but she seemed to enjoy it.  Where the place went south was when we got the bill.  88 bucks for  pedestrian chicken Parm and risotto seemed like a reach.  We had ginger ale to drink at 2.75 each.  Place charges fine dining prices for average food and plastic drinking cups.  Probably won't go back except to try the takeout pizza but I think they would be hard pressed to beat Italian Villages pizza.

This is the place to get an amazing home cooked style fresh burger. You can tell these are not the run of the mill, over ordered, frozen burgers. I ordered the World Champ Cheeseburger which comes with lettuce, tomatoes, pickles, and onion (which I did not get onions.) Everything about it was just so good. They are not greasy, or bland. It honestly taste like when I was a kid and my Dad would make burgers for dinner. The bun for these burgers were perfect size to burger ratio. Prices are great. For the cheeseburger I got it was $3.75. However, this does not come with any sides. We just ordered a basket of fries and tots for the table to share. We also ordered the fried mac and cheese, along with mini corn dog bites, and those were also super delicious. I live in Tampa and I would/will absolutely make a trip over the bridge for a bite to eat here. Another great point about this restaurant is the cook. So we get there and there is about 5 tables or so that all sit around the same time. The waitress gets everyone's order and bring them each tables out as they come up. We had a table to 6 and I do not think we waited more than 15 mins for our tables order. So then the rest of the tables in our area are all served. Then the cook comes out to say hi and to make sure everyone is happy with their food. To me that was perfect. Gives everyone a chance to say if something is wrong or as everyone this night did, gives everyone a chance say Thank You to the chef. I will possibly be back as early as this weekend.

WOW! I've always passed this restaurant, but never thought of stopping until one day for a quick bite to eat. My mom ordered the soup of the day, the potato soup, and I ordered the pizza bites and mozzarella sticks. Let's just say the food was so good, we both had a little bit of everything! Their potato soup was phenomenal, no where even compares! I wish they offered this soup daily, my mom even enjoyed it more than their crawfish bisque soup that she's had in the past. I raved about it to my coworkers, so we decided to drive all the way over there and pickup for lunch. Their wrap was AMAZING! Plus their pickup time is pretty quick, and their staff is lovely. Thank you guys!
The build your own sandwich selection is amazing. Every time I've ordered the food has been fresh, delivery has been fast, and everything is yummy.

Friendly and helpful management.  Nice and new apartments in just about the most convenient location possible ! Close to world class shopping and dining.  Alway responsive to my questions and safe neighborhood for families.

My experience with this tattoo shop was HORRIBLE. It was my very first tattoo and I got it done by Orlando. He knew it was my first tattoo and completely took advantage of that. He made my tattoo look EXACTLY like what I told him I didn't want it to look like. He was completely rushing on both me and my friend's tattoo and didn't take into consideration that his art would be on our bodies for the rest of our lives. I would have given this place 0 stars but it didn't let me have that option. I'm sure there are better artists who work at the shop who actually care about their clients but I would suggest looking to get your tattoo done by anyone else besides Orlando.

I have been waiting for this business to open for so many months, the moment I saw it open  I gladly walked inside for a quick shopping trip, something that is not possible across the street at Supremo and their slooooowww lines. 

The produce wasn't very fresh, which was a bit disappointing. The prices seem to be pretty cheap, but to be honest, not everything had a price listed, so it was pure luck when my bill was only a few dollars. Fun fact: There doesn't look like there's a credit card minimum! 

I came back the next night for dinner with the boyfriend. The menu is pretty limited, but I got chicken shawarma and rice. The rice was great, but I unfortunately had to force down half of my shawarma. 

Normally I would give this place 3 stars based on the grocery and restaurant section, but the customer service throughout the store was great, so I added an extra star.

I definitely plan to return many times, and I will definitely raise my rating if those few things improve! :)

This was a totally YELP! find. My son has his violin lessons in Temple Terrace and we needed to pick up Chinese food on the way home. So I googled Temple Terrace + Chinese food. This place came up. It looked good and promising.

We ordered straight on YELP! and picked up the food after the lesson.

Potstickers - OK
Wonton Soup- Fantastic!!!
Sweet and Sour Chicken- usually do not order this, but trying to appeal to the kiddos, it far exceeded all of my expectations.
General Tsos Chicken- it was solid (and was probably MUCH better when it was first cooked, the food had sat for about 1hr. when we got home, so it was not as fresh)
Fried Rice- some of the best we have gotten in Tampa

Yes, we will go back. It was such a nice little place. Very clean and well taken care of.

Word of advice, if you google in the address it takes you to a mini strip mall. You must keep driving until you see this place specifically. Do not get sucked into the first Chinese restaurant (which is not BeiJing House)
Super good sandwiches!! Clean place and very nice owners. Prices may be a tad high but the food was certainly good. If you want a good quality sandwich this is the place to go. Highly recommended!

This is an excellent place to go get some amazing food! Drakes is my newly found favorite restaurant, I highly recommend going. It's especially great for a nice little date night. If you go, make sure you ask for Mattie: Amazing server, funny, and just overall just fun to talk to. He definitely made sure my dinning experience was fantastic!

Breakfast for three people took over an hour. At least it tasted good, shout-out to cooks. We ordered some tenders that were made but the server NEVER took to our table when we clearly said we would have liked them as appetizers. By the time (some other server) offered to bring them over we were already done with our food... they had been ready for a while. Server was acting odd: she never engaged in eye contact, NEVER refilled our drinks, and NEVER checked on us. I'm usually very understanding but she had zero sense of urgency and seemed like she had no idea what she was doing with none of the tables. I always give the benefit of the doubt of new employees and hoping they're doing the best they can, but she wasn't even TRYING.

This review is based on the teachers credit Union location on Rockville road in Avon Indiana. Last Saturday I deposited a check into the ATM because they were part of the co-op network of credit unions. I am a Navy Federal credit Union member and I live in Indianapolis so there is no Navy Federal credit Union within 200 mi of where I live so I use the teachers credit Union ATM to deposit a check last Saturday. The ATM did not give me a deposit slip after I inserted the check. The phone Monday I went inside this Bank's location and told them the situation and even had pictures of the final check in the back of the check and the envelope that the check came in to prove to them that there was indeed a check with my name on it that was deposited last Saturday in their ATM. They told me Monday that they filled out some type of ATM debit discrepancy form which looked like an affidavit. They said it would take five business days. So today Saturday morning I visited the bank at the same location and asked him what was going on since they said it will take five business days to process my check. They told me this morning that that county department still has to do their part with the check and then they said they would have to mail it to the Navy Federal credit Union headquarters in San Diego California after next week. And then they said that I might get a provisional credit the second Wednesday after next week my Navy Federal credit Union and then take another extra 5 days the process my check that I deposited into the teacher's credit Union ATM. So I had to call the bank that issued the check to me and cancel the check and put a stop payment on it because teachers credit Union failed to do their job within the five-day. That they told me that they needed to process the check. Teachers credit Union is a bank I would highly tell people not to go into to do business with at all. My question is for five business days what was their accounting department doing with my check?! But of course they didn't have any answers except I'm sorry I wish I could do more for you. 
Teachers credit Union does not know how to do their job in such situations as this. If you deposit a check, withdrawal cash or you have a very simple question to ask them - they may be able to help you. But for anyone that is in my situation do not stick your check into their ATMs or deal with these people even if they're in your credit Union's co-op network. You'll be wasting your time and you'll be adding so much more stress to your life. Please go to another credit Union or go to another bank. I highly recommend going to Indiana Members credit Union and skip teachers credit Union !!!!
Just ate at Wild River.  Great location on the River Walk.  Venue great.  Food average at best, had duck and mushroom ravioli, prices high based on the quality.

Okay, so we came here because Alton Brown said it was a best thing he ever ate, Shrimp and Grits...

Okay, Biscuit Love for Shrimp and Grits. I've never had Shrimp and Grits for breakfast, or at all. 

I can say they were the best shrimp and grits I've ever had, but also the only shrimp and grits I've ever had. I really enjoyed them, a lot.

Now we pushed it with 20 minutes in line, and that is more than I would wait, 8 am on a Monday morning. When we left the line was nearly 2 hours... Totally NOT worth that. 

So my wife had a favourite of ours, biscuits and gravy with potatoes. This brought down the review, they were quite possibly the worst we've ever had. She didn't finish them and I tried then and had no desire to eat them. The potatoes were super greasy and left her feeling queasy for most of the day. 

Quite possibly the most annoying part of the experience, I was talking with the people at the next table and when I turned back around our dishes had been cleared, I guess they wanted to turn the tables, but I wasn't finished with my $6 cup of orange juice.

Would I go back? Not likely. Even if the was no line... We saw all 3 locations, there was no line at Franklin.

This was my first Safelite experience- and it was fantastic.  Made the appointment on-line in less than 10 minutes; they even ran the numbers through my insurance company for me reducing my out of pocket expense.  The Technician, Samir, was on time, pleasant, and very professional.  I was curious of their process, and he was very patient with me, and even proud, to walk me through what he was doing and why.  I appreciated that.  He was on site at my home for about an hour - very satisfied with the whole experience.

Nice Standard America Fare restaurant.  Solid food, okay service.  If you're looking for a less adventurous dinner, this is the spot.

Positives:

My wife and I both had burgers based on recommendations, specifically, the Smokin' Betty Burger.  Both were cooked properly and delicious.  The pork belly was a nice touch and the egg was cooked properly as well.  Sometimes an egg on a burger is a yolky mess, this one was just a little soft in the middle to give the proper texture without the mess.  Fries were also solid.  

Extra note:  Burger was great reheated as well!  We took food home and it was very enjoyable.  

We also ordered the Cheesesteak eggrolls and some brussel sprouts.  Sprouts were good, but the Cheesesteak eggrolls were quite good and I would recommend.

Cocktails were standard.  I had a dry martini which was fine and my wife had some sort of bourbon and honey cocktail (I forget the name).  It was a little too sweet.  Otherwise the menu was fine.

Great menu size - a few burger options and some other American fare like bbq and chicken.  Their seasonal menu also looked great with some interesting fall options.  I'd return for that.  

We were also seated quickly and efficiently.  

Negatives:  

The service was a little odd/slow/stilted.  We were waiting for another couple to join.  I'm told they normally don't seat folks without a complete group (fine), but they seated us for whatever reason - great!  However, it took 15+ minutes our server to arrive and take a drink order, which he still did before the other couple joined.  Also hard to get a second drink once the dinner was served.  I'm not sure if our server was overly busy, but he also failed to check in after the food was served (not a big deal, but uncommon).  

Cold in the restaurant.  Somehow, my wife got seated under a vent which was constantly blowing cold (?) air on her.  We had to switch midmeal so she could warm up.  It's probably just that one seat, but it was uncomfortable.  

Overall - the food and enjoyable atmosphere overcome the minor issues with this place.  I'd expect a second visit would improve upon these negatives and I would recommend for those looking for some American comfort food.  

One of the better burgers in the City!

     -Loose shower knob
        ....just to name a few

Food was mediocre...definitely a local joint which I usually love. Shamed by patrons because I was not comfortable with them sitting right next to me. Other seats were available. Confirmed by bartender. If you don't like it stay home. Wow, thanks for the patronage!  They don't care...hence the problem.

Coma Coffee Roasters is an amazing local coffee shop tucked away in Brentwood office building. While you may think its offerings are as bland as the mid-70's style skyscraper that houses it, you'd be wrong! 

Having just moved across the hall in said office building, Coma Coffee Roasters' new spot is giant and offers the opportunity for those of us still working from home a chance to put on real pants and venture out to do work somewhere other than our kitchen tables. 

While you may come for the ample, socially-distanced workspace, you'll stay for the caffeinated beverages and the brand new, expanded food menu! 

I have been a big fan of Coma Coffee Roasters' cold brew for quite some time. When they started canning this cool treat, I rejoiced at having easier access to this energy giving nectar. But having it right from the source is even better. The cold brew is smooth without being overpoweringly strong. 

The pastries have always been a delightful treat when working from Coma Coffee Roasters. This particular trip I ordered the bourbon blondie. The moist cake was so flavorful. And you could actually taste this hints of bourbon! And adding to my love of this baked good, the portion was huge. More than I wanted to eat, but I cut it and took more than half home for my boyfriend to try after work. 

For my lunch I ordered the Southwest quesadilla. The cheese blend was off the chain. And all the veggies complemented the dish so well. I really loved this brand new food offering. Would absolutely order it again.

Like everyone says... the Dan Dan Noodles and Spicy Crispy Cucumbers are THE best. I have to order them everytime I'm here. And I usually will get two orders of each.

I love that you have the ability to change the spice levels on all their dishes. Normally I get what is listed on the menu for the appetizer, blow out my taste buds, then lower the level to a 4 for the remainder of the meal. 

For the entree, I usually pick the "Garlic Sauce Style" as it's a level 3 and I love the combination of ginger and garlic. You have your choice of Chicken, Beef, Pork, Shrimp, Tofu, etc. Entrees are served with rice.

Besides the amazingly HOT food, the service is super fast. We sat down, had drinks within minutes and before you know it, our Dan Dan noodles arrived. The staff is very pleasant and knowledgeable.

They're no longer accepting reservations via Open Table but you can reserve through Yelp!

Luis did a beautiful job!! He was courteous, pleasant, and on time!!
Please tell Ryan that Luis is a great employee. Danielle was a delight to deal with and made the estimate and scheduling of the job painless. Ken, the estimator, was fun and engaging. I will definitely use these guys again and would highly recommend them to friends and family.

So I am the proud first reviewer of the new Homegrown Pizza restaurant in Gentilly, which was most recently the home of the much beloved Munch Factory. Tonight was part of their soft opening, so our expectations were tempered.

Homegrown is about everything local: locally sourced ingredients, breads (Gendusa's) and drinks (Big Shot, Fest Cola). So, don't expect to find national brands like Coke and Pepsi. I only thought to take a picture of the mirliton spread, but we had a pepperoni pizza, cheese pizza and cheesy bread. The pizzas were good and we enjoyed the sauce. They were hot and...well, cheesy. The mirliton spread didn't work for us. The portion size was small with only two shrimp and then it had too much lemon. The owner politely comped that appetizer. 

Our waiter Jimmye provided great service. He was very friendly, fast and knowledgeable about the menu. He recommended the Chicken Strut and Rocket pizzas, but our kids only like two kinds of pizza, cheese and pepperoni. So we'll have to try the others next time like on date night. 

The restaurant was clean and quiet, but for some reason didn't smell like pizza. 

The owner told us about the Big Class program, which is a pizza poetry project. The restaurant is donating 10% of the April sales to the program. We loving supporting local and we will definitely be back.
